name: Early-morning wake-up, breakfast, and family interaction
description: Waking up in the morning light, she felt the laziness of the holiday, opened the curtains and let the sunlight fill the room. After washing up, she lit gardenia aromatherapy, played Zhou Shen's “Harmony of Light and Spring,” and did a simple five-minute stretch to wake up her body. Then she sent voice blessings in the family WeChat group on her phone with a selfie, and scrolled through Moments to like and reply to friends. Her mother called her to breakfast, so she went to the dining room to enjoy chicken soup rice noodles, chatted with her father about the new cultural project at his workplace, and her mother shared amusing stories about her students—the atmosphere was warm. After eating, she took the initiative to help her mother carry bowls and wipe the table. Her father watched the news on the sofa, and she felt warm inside.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize the annual writing topics and outline.
description: Entered the study and sat down at the desk by the window. Opened Notion to review the articles published last year and listed three core themes: 'Old Street Memories,' 'Green Lake Four Seasons,' and 'Dianchi Lake Past and Present.' Then, in a physical notebook, used a blue pen to refine 'Old Street Memories' into topics including 'The Old Bookstores and Teahouses of Wenming Street,' 'The Pharmacy and Pastry Shops of Guanghua Street,' and 'The Night Market and Jianghu of Yongdao Street.' Under each topic, sketched multi-angle outlines and bibliographies (including Wang Zengqi's 'Kunming's Rain' and Yu Jian's 'Kunming Notes'). After finishing, looking at the full pages made her feel grounded, and she wrote the year's keyword, 'deep cultivation,' on the title page. The entire process was focused and efficient.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: New Year's Day family dinner and after-dinner chat.
description: Hearing Mom call that dinner was ready, you walked into the dining room and saw the mushroom hot pot broth boiling, with the aroma of matsutake and porcini mushrooms filling the air. The family sat around the table, adding mushrooms and chicken while chatting: Mom told funny stories from her students' New Year's Eve party, and Dad said his workplace was about to launch a Kunming Old Street cultural promotion project. You shared your plans to complete the first draft of a prose collection before graduating in your senior year, travel to Nanjing, and stick with yoga. Dad encouraged you with 'to plant a tree, you must first let it take root,' so you set your annual keyword as 'deep cultivation,' and Mom put chicken in your bowl to show support. After the meal, you volunteered to wash the dishes, Dad wiped the table and put things away, and then you drank raw Pu'er tea with your parents in the living room while watching the New Year's Day gala. You tried to video-call your older sister Sun Yutong, but she didn't answer, so you left a message sharing funny moments from the gathering, enjoying the lazy afternoon.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Draw a New Year vision board in my journal.
description: Back in the study, I took out my beloved journal, colored markers, and classical-style stickers. Using the emerald-green water of Green Lake as the background, I drew an open book in the center to symbolize my writing dream. In different colors, I wrote annual goals such as "Complete the first draft of the essay collection," "Take a cultural trip to Nanjing," "Practice yoga twice a week," and "Read 24 books," and pasted on ink-wash stickers of red-billed gulls, teapots, and lotus flowers. I also marked milestones such as "Finish the outline in March" and "Summer practice in July," turning my wishes into a visual action map. The process was joyful and satisfying.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walking in Cuihu Park and observing red-billed gulls
description: You changed into a hoodie, jeans, and sneakers and went out alone, walking about 6 minutes along Huashan West Road to Green Lake Park. It was New Year's Day, and the park was crowded with visitors. At the best gull-viewing spot on Nine-Bend Bridge, you watched red-billed gulls wheeling and calling, while some tourists fed them gull feed. You used your phone to capture the light and shadows of sunlight filtering through willow branches onto the gulls' feathers, planning to use it as a Moments photo. Although you didn't meet your neighbor Aunt Xie, you felt the vitality of Kunming's winter and the festive ritual atmosphere in the lively surroundings, then slowly walked back home, drank water, and rested, slightly sweaty.
location: Near the Nine-Turn Bridge in Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and on the way back to the Cuihu Community

name: Yoga practice, shower, and changing clothes
description: In the bedroom, she unrolled her pink yoga mat, connected her phone to the Bluetooth speaker, and opened the yoga app to select the 30-minute Hatha Basic Introduction course. Following the voice guidance, she completed poses such as Mountain Pose, Triangle Pose, Warrior I, Cat-Cow, and Downward-Facing Dog. Although her form was not perfect, her body got a thorough stretch and relaxation, and she felt calm. After the practice she broke a light sweat, went into the bathroom for a hot shower to wash away fatigue, and changed into soft flannel loungewear, feeling relaxed and comfortable all over.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner, diary, and reading
description: Dinner was mushroom soup noodles cooked by Mom using the leftover mushroom broth, with greens and a poached egg. Eating and chatting with your parents, you shared photos of red-billed gulls taken at Cuihu Park and the lively scene in the park. Mom said she ran into Aunt Xie downstairs, and Aunt Xie wanted to come see your journal after the holiday; you smiled and agreed. After the meal, you returned to the study and wrote a gratitude journal entry on a blank page at the back of your journal with a fountain pen, recording three small things: the deliciousness of Mom's mushroom hotpot, the satisfaction of drawing the vision board, and the stretch after yoga. Then you picked up Wang Zengqi's Human-World Plants and quietly read the essay Rain in Kunming. Outside the window the sky was darkening, and the scent of ink brought a sense of peace.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Online blessings and interactions with family and friends
description: After leaving the study, she took a video call from her sister Sun Yutong on the living room sofa and chatted for nearly half an hour. She showed her newly drawn vision board and explained the keyword "deep cultivation." Her sister complained about working overtime on New Year's Day, and the two agreed to visit Nanjing together next time. After hanging up, she sent photos of red-billed gulls at Green Lake and a partial view of her journal to the close friends group "Yidun San." Zhang Jing and Wang Xinran praised and discussed them. Then she replied to Song Wen, a fellow friend in Chengdu, sharing her New Year keyword and writing plans. He responded with an emoji saying "Keep going, let's encourage each other" and arranged to discuss topic ideas online in a few days. The whole exchange was lively and warm.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation, reading, and falling asleep.
description: After finishing the online interaction, she got up to wash her face, brush her teeth, and do a basic nighttime skincare routine. She returned to the bedroom, turned off the main light, and kept only the bedside lamp on to create a tranquil atmosphere. Lying in bed, she put on earphones and played the Serene Piano Music playlist, closed her eyes, and let the music wash away the fatigue. Then she turned off the music, picked up The Grass and Trees of the Human World from beside her pillow, and read a few pages. She felt a warm familiarity when reading the passage about Kunming's rainy season, until drowsiness crept in and she closed the book and turned off the light. After lying down, she did not fall asleep right away. Instead, she reviewed scenes from the day—drawing in her journal, the family dinner, and the red-billed gulls at Green Lake—feeling a calm, steady satisfaction. She told herself that the first day of the new year had been perfect, and with the expectation of deep cultivation, she slowly drifted into sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning ritual and reading
description: I woke up to soft music on my phone. On this winter morning, the sky outside the window was the clear, unique blue of Kunming. After stretching in bed, I meditated with my eyes closed for 5 minutes, focusing on my breath to shake off the morning grogginess. After getting up, I opened the curtains and let sunlight fill the room. After a quick wash, I put on a comfortable oatmeal-colored knit cardigan and jeans. Sitting down at my desk, I picked up Wang Zengqi's 'Plants of the Human World,' turned to the chapter 'Rain in Kunming,' and read aloud the passage about mushrooms, waking myself up in a literary way and getting into the mood for today's communication with the editor.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing breakfast with mother.
description: Mother had already made steaming hot chicken soup rice noodles, topped with bright green chopped scallions and chives. As we ate and chatted, I told her I had an annual submission meeting in the afternoon. Mother encouraged me, saying: "Don't be nervous. Your writing is so good, Editor Xu will definitely see it." After drinking the last sip of hot soup, I felt warm inside.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning creative work and preparation
description: After helping my mother clear the dishes, I returned to my study. I browsed through the several outline drafts and reference materials I had organized, making sure my thinking was clear. I packed my laptop, notebook, and pen into the canvas bag. Then I did deep creative work, breaking down the outline of "The Cycle of the Four Seasons at Cuihu Lake" into finer detail, listing specific imagery for each season. For the afternoon communication, I wrote a concise creative statement. Around 11 o'clock, I sent a WeChat voice message to my good friend Song Wen, sharing my nervousness and seeking strength.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and online conversation with friends
description: Cooked a bowl of tomato and egg noodles for a simple lunch. Halfway through, my good friend Song Wen replied with a voice message, encouraging me: “What are you afraid of! Your Cuihu topic is so great, I’m super envious.” The recognition from a fellow friend made me feel much more grounded.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest
description: After the meal, she leaned against the living room sofa, soaking in the warm afternoon sun. Closing her eyes, she rehearsed in her mind the tone and key points of the afternoon phone call, and took a few deep breaths. When she stood up, she looked in the mirror and gave herself a confident smile.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Communicate with the editor and compile notes
description: On time, she contacted Xu Mingyuan, editor of *Cultural Horizon*, via WeChat voice call. As prepared, she clearly presented three topic proposals: 'The Four Seasons of Green Lake,' 'Memories of Old Streets,' and 'Dianchi Lake Past and Present.' Editor Xu showed strong interest in the topic 'The Four Seasons of Green Lake,' finding it highly visual and of literary value. In the end, it was settled that she would combine the prose collection creation with column pieces, submitting one in-depth essay each month, with the first piece on 'The Four Seasons of Green Lake' and a deadline of January 25. She went from being slightly nervous at first to becoming more and more confident after the conversation. After the call, she immediately opened the writing schedule on her computer, entered key information such as the confirmed topic direction, monthly submission dates, and manuscript format requirements, refined the writing steps, and set a monthly submission reminder for the 15th in her calendar.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Observations on the way to the bookstore
description: In high spirits, she decided to go to the bookstore to find more inspiration for the 'Four Seasons of Green Lake' manuscript. She put on her canvas bag, took The World of Plants and a notebook, and set out along Renmin Middle Road westward, passing the Huashan West Road metro station entrance, then turned into Cuihu North Road. She slowed down, carefully observed the plane trees and buildings along the road, and silently noted the winter colors and light and shadow to accumulate material.
location: Along the route from Renmin Middle Road to Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Work and study at Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Arriving at Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, she greeted the owner, Uncle Qin, and ordered a cup of the signature brown sugar pearl milk tea. She sat down in a window booth on the second floor overlooking Cuihu. She opened her laptop and polished the communication meeting notes into a more complete "Full-Year Writing Plan." Then she focused on background reading for "The Changing Seasons of Cuihu," copying the descriptions of Kunming's scenery from The Grass and Trees of the Human World into her notebook, and making comparative associations with the real winter view of Cuihu outside the window, thinking deeply.
location: Window seat on the second floor of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stroll around Green Lake and the walk home.
description: After leaving the bookstore, she deliberately took a detour to walk around the edge of Green Lake Park. The afternoon sunlight slanted across the lake, flocks of black-headed gulls wheeled and played, and on the shore were elderly people playing accordions and tourists taking photos. She sat quietly on a lakeside bench for ten minutes, enjoying the peaceful Kunming winter. She took a few photos with her phone and sent them to the best friends' group chat with the caption: "Just got out of the 'big scene' alive; let me be healed by the black-headed gulls." Then she walked home and ran into Aunt Xie from across the hall at the stairwell entrance, chatting for a while.
location: Green Lake Park and its surrounding areas, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and finally back home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road.

name: Ikenobo flower arrangement practice
description: After changing into loungewear, she set up a small flower-arranging corner on the living room coffee table. She took out the wintersweet, bird-of-paradise, and silver willow stored in the refrigerator, carefully pruned the branches and leaves, and fixed them into a basic rikka arrangement in the Ikenobo style. In the end she completed a small piece titled “Winter Greetings” and placed it in the center of the dining table. She took photos from different angles and sent them to Su Man, a classmate from her flower arrangement class, with the message: “This afternoon's ‘big project’ is wrapped up, and I'm in a good mood, so I came home and arranged some flowers. Do you think the lines of this bird-of-paradise go well together?”

participant.name: Su Man
participant.relation: Classmates from the flower arrangement class.

location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompany mother to buy groceries
description: After completing the flower arrangement, she accompanied her mother to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket to buy groceries. Her mother carefully selected mushrooms, chicken, and leafy greens, while she herself bought a few sprigs of purple forget-me-nots in the flower section, planning to embellish her flower arrangement.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening family reunion.
description: After walking home from the supermarket, she added forget-me-nots to the flower arrangement. Just then her father got home from work, and she excitedly pulled him over to the dining table to introduce her flower arrangement; he smiled and nodded in approval. Dinner was the mushroom and chicken stew her mother had prepared, with a golden broth and rich aroma. At the table, she shared in detail the results and feelings from her afternoon discussion with the editor, and her father encouraged her to settle down and write slowly. After dinner, she helped her mother clear the table and put the dishes into the dishwasher. Then she chatted with her father on the living room sofa about the topic "The Four Seasons of Green Lake." Based on his experience working at the Cultural Bureau in his youth, her father provided several old story leads about Cuihu Academy and Nine Dragon Pool, which was a delightful surprise.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Back in the study, she received a video call from her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen right on time. She excitedly showed off the flower arrangement she had completed that day and described in detail her entire afternoon conversation with Editor Xu. Her sister laughed on the video and said, "That's great! I knew your talent would be recognized! Once you've earned enough royalties, let's go for a seafood feast during Spring Festival!" The two sisters talked for half an hour before reluctantly hanging up.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Organize achievements and update the journal
description: I stored away today's flower arrangement photos and writing plan. Then I took out my beloved journal and, starting from today, wrote the first work entry with a blue ink pen. I drew a red-billed gull and a wintersweet flower, used a red marker to circle the deadline of January 25 for "The Four Seasons of Green Lake", and drew a star symbol beside it.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga relaxation and music time.
description: Changed into yoga clothes, spread out the yoga mat, and did 15 minutes of relaxing Hatha yoga poses, focusing on relaxing the neck, shoulders, and back. After finishing, lay on the bed, played Li Jian's Flowing Years on the Bluetooth speaker, closed her eyes, and immersed herself in peaceful and content thoughts.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading, gratitude journal, and sleep
description: Before turning off the light, leaning against the headboard, she continued reading the chapter about Kunming in The Grass and Trees of the Human World. Reading about Wang Zengqi's depiction of Kunming's teahouses and rain, she gained more emotional associations for the topic Four Seasons of Cuihu. Then she picked up her gratitude journal and wrote down three things to be grateful for today: smooth communication with editor Xu Mingyuan; healing from seeing red-billed gulls by Cuihu Lake; and feeling empowered by encouragement from family and friends. Finally, she turned off the bedside lamp and drifted into sleep with a sense of certainty and peace.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Waking up and having a simple breakfast
description: Woke up in the winter sunshine, read a few pages of The World of Plants, then got up to wash up. Mother had prepared small-pot rice noodles with mint leaves. While eating breakfast, she listened to Mother talk about the amusing story of Aunt Xie picking up a little kitten, and they chatted pleasantly.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take stock of 2024 writing income
description: In the study, she opened her laptop, logged into online banking and WeChat Pay backend, checked the 2024 royalty records item by item, and copied them into her financial ledger. After confirming that her total after-tax royalty income for the year was 82,000 yuan, she felt reassured.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Set up a monthly travel fund and share it to Moments
description: After reconciling the accounts, she used the mobile banking app to transfer some money from the royalty card to the newly opened savings account, and set up an automatic transfer of 2,000 yuan on the 16th of every month. In the journal, she drew a travel progress bar with icons of Dunhuang and Nanjing as final destinations, took a photo, and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption 'The first fund of the new year has arrived!' to her friends Wen and Song Wen, expressing her expectation for the trip.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch and an afternoon nap.
description: Mother made chicken soup with wild mushrooms and stir-fried some seasonal vegetables. They had lunch together and shared the morning's achievements. Father called back, teased her for being a little rich girl, and told her not to forget the salted duck when she went to Nanjing. After the meal, she cleared the dishes, curled up on the sofa browsing her friends' replies on her phone, and dozed off for half an hour.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Shuncheng Shopping Mall and researched mirrorless cameras.
description: I changed into a thick sweater and jeans, walked to the Cuihu East Gate bus stop, took Bus No. 2 to Xiaoximen Station, got off and walked 200 meters to Shuncheng Shopping Center. On the 4th floor digital area, I focused on trying the Fujifilm X-T30 II. I was attracted by its retro body and film-like colors, and also compared the weight and feel of Sony and Canon cameras. In the end, I preferred the Fujifilm and asked the salesperson about discounted packages and lens combinations.
location: Shuncheng Shopping Mall, No. 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Return to Green Lake and pick up the magazine at Zhibushi Bookstore
description: After coming out of Shuncheng Shopping Center, she scanned the code to rent a shared bicycle and rode along Renmin Middle Road toward Green Lake, passing the former site of a bookstore she often visited as a child, and arrived at Cuihu North Road. Stepping into Zhibushi Bookstore, Uncle Qin brought out a signed copy of the magazine Prose that he had specially reserved for her. After looking at the signature on the magazine's title page, she chatted with Uncle Qin about what had been happening lately. She mentioned that she was saving up for a trip, and Uncle Qin encouraged her to get out and see more, saying that only then would she have things to write about.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Green Lake walk to gather inspiration
description: Crossed the road into Cuihu Park, strolled along the Nine-bend Bridge, watched red-billed gulls circling and fighting over food, and used her phone to snap photos of gulls skimming past the willows. While resting on a bench, she used her notebook to record the golden fragments of sunset light on the lake and the figure of an elderly man playing the erhu.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Returned home to prepare dinner
description: Leaving Cuihu Park, she walked home along Cuihu West Road, passing through old alleys and smelling the aroma of fried potatoes and roasted erkuai. When she got home, her mother was stir-frying dishes in the kitchen.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family interaction
description: The family sat together for dinner, sharing the excitement of trying out cameras at Shuncheng and plans to buy one. Parents expressed support, and her father gave advice on lenses and accessories. After dinner, she cleared the dishes with her mother and sent a WeChat voice message to her older sister Sun Yutong sharing the day's rewards.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal organizing and essay writing
description: In the study, I spread open my journal and pasted in the financial inventory table, a photo of the travel fund progress bar, the camera comparison chart, and Green Lake photos, decorating them with washi tape and stickers. Then I opened my laptop and, based on the afternoon's observations at Green Lake, wrote the first section of the essay draft 'The Four Seasons of Green Lake' — the passage describing the red-billed gulls at dusk in winter. My ideas flowed, and I wrote for an hour.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading and relaxing before bed
description: Changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, reading a signed copy of Essays magazine. While reading an essay about an old teahouse, I thought of the leisurely feel of Green Lake. After finishing, I turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning reading and waking up
description: Woke up to the alarm clock, with a cloudy sky outside the window. Rubbing my eyes, I picked up “The Grass and Trees of the Human World” from beside the pillow, glanced through a few pages, and savored the quiet calm of the morning’s words. Stretching, I confirmed today’s schedule for the essay collection kickoff meeting, feeling both anticipation and a little nervousness.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning washing up and family breakfast.
description: After getting up, you first drank a glass of warm water and encouraged yourself in the mirror while washing up. Your mother, Li Xiulan, had already made steaming hot small-pot rice noodles, and you chatted with her about today's plans over breakfast. She smiled and said this was the first step of a great writer; Sun Yuwei rolled her eyes, but felt warm inside. She checked that her canvas bag contained her journal, fountain pen, and the printed copy of her electronic notes from Kunming Customs and Scenery.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk at Green Lake Park to enjoy the lake view
description: After breakfast, she changed into her sneakers and went out. Walking south along Huashan West Road, she reached Green Lake Park in a few minutes. She strolled along the lakeside path. The sky was cloudy, but the air was crisp. Red-billed gulls were rising and falling over the lake. She stopped to take a few photos and sent them to Song Wen in Chengdu: "This morning's lake is calm and powerful." After walking for ten minutes, she set off for Wenlin Street.
location: Lakeside Trail, Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk through Wenlin Street to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Coming out of the west gate of Cuihu Park, I turned from Cuihu South Road onto Wenlin Street. On the way I passed the flower shop I often go to, with fresh daffodils at the entrance, and I thought I'd buy a bunch next time. Sunlight filtered through the clouds and fell on the old walls of Wenlin Street, making my mood light.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mingyuan Bookstore essay collection kickoff meeting.
description: Pushing open the door of Mingyuan Bookstore, the familiar scent of old books rushed to greet her. Qin Mingyuan had already brewed Pu'er tea by the window. Sun Yuwei started a WeChat video call to discuss with Yang Xiao, who was far away in Chengdu. The three had an in-depth exchange on the concept of the essay collection The Breath of the City's Edge: Uncle Qin suggested approaching the urban texture from 'edge and breath'; Yang Xiao, from an editor's perspective, proposed arranging the chapters along spatial clues. They finally agreed on the tentative title The Breath of the City's Edge, planned to complete 12 core essays in 12 months, with the first essay focusing on Green Lake. Uncle Qin handed her the slightly yellowed Kunming Scenery and Customs, saying, 'Its final form will become clear as you walk.' Sun Yuwei carefully wrote this sentence on the flyleaf of her journal with a fountain pen. The meeting ended amidst enthusiastic discussion, and she left full of inspiration.
location: Window-side reading area at Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Design a monthly progress bar for the prose collection.
description: After the conversation, she did not rush to leave. She stayed in her seat, took out colored markers and stickers, and drew 12 small grids on a blank page to represent the 12 months. She colored the first grid Green Lake green and wrote “January: Green Lake.” Beside it she pasted a card with the photo of the red-billed gulls she had taken in the morning, and wrote keywords: “morning mist, gull calls, old people doing tai chi, the breathing of the lake.” At the bottom of the journal, she wrote a small line: “January 18 — first in-depth field visit to Green Lake.” When she finished, she took a photo and sent it to the family group chat. Her sister instantly replied, “The journal teacher is online!”
location: Reading area at Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch: Duanshi small-pot rice noodles
description: After leaving the bookstore, I happened to feel hungry. I walked east along Wenlin Street and went to the familiar Duanshi small-pot rice noodle shop. I ordered a bowl of the signature stinky tofu small-pot rice noodles with a marinated egg and sat alone in a corner. While eating, I quickly jotted down in my phone’s memo app a few golden lines that had come to me during the meeting, such as “The city has a breath, and its edges are its capillaries.” After finishing, I wiped my mouth and felt full of energy.
location: Duanshi Small-Pot Rice Noodles (Wenlin Street Branch), 74 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: After the meal, strolling and resting on Wenlin Street
description: After the meal, I walked slowly east along Wenlin Street. In the afternoon, a gap opened in the clouds, and sunlight poured down, making everything warm. I sat on a bench at the street corner, zoned out for a while, watched people passing by, and felt that this leisurely moment was precious. Then I got up and headed toward Cuihu North Road.
location: Near the intersection of Wenlin Street and Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Flipped through the essay collection at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore.
description: Stepping into the familiar Zhibushi Bookstore, the air was filled with the scent of paper and coffee. The clerk Xiao Li looked up and greeted her: 'Sister Sun, you're here! A few new travel essays just arrived.' Sun Yuwei nodded, walked to the essay section, picked up a new copy of 'Deep Time Journey', and stood by the bookshelf quietly flipping through it. Feeling the quiet atmosphere of the bookstore, her mind gradually calmed down. After about twenty minutes, she waved goodbye to Xiao Li.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and preparing to organize the materials.
description: After leaving the bookstore, I walked back along Cuihu North Road and turned onto Huashan West Road. The warm sun gradually disappeared, and the sky turned cloudy again. Back home, I changed into comfortable loungewear, poured myself a glass of warm water, sat down at my desk, and began preparing the material for the afternoon.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In the study, organized materials for the kickoff meeting.
description: Opened my laptop, put on earphones, and listened to the meeting recording again. I organized Yang Xiao's suggestions on chapter division into a document item by item, and also recorded Uncle Qin's inspirations about the book title and material accumulation. Then I opened the Kunming Local Records given by Uncle Qin and copied down several passages about Wenlin Street and Green Lake during the Ming and Qing dynasties, such as "Wenlin Street, where literati gathered in old times, with the sound of reading coming from deep in the alleys," and categorized these textual materials into the prose collection material library.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Talked with Song Wen on the phone about creative work.
description: After finishing that stage of organizing, I made a voice call to Song Wen. We talked for about twenty minutes. I shared my excitement about starting today's talks and also asked her, as a freelance writer, how to maintain a rhythm for long-term projects. She suggested setting "15 minutes of walking writing a day" as the minimum task line and recommended a writing app. After hanging up, I went to the living room and sprayed water on the pothos on the windowsill, feeling fulfilled.

participant.name: Song Wen
participant.relation: Friend, a freelance writer in Chengdu.

location: Home study and living room, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Home yoga relaxation practice
description: At 4:30 p.m., spread out the yoga mat in the bedroom. Turned on a soothing modern pop playlist, warmed up with several rounds of Sun Salutations, and focused on Warrior II and Pigeon Pose, concentrating on stretching the tense shoulders, neck, and hips caused by sitting for long periods. The 45-minute practice fully stretched the body, and the mind also became calm.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and creative sharing
description: After yoga, she took a shower and changed into a comfortable T-shirt. At the dinner table, Sun Yuwei excitedly shared the results of today’s essay collection kickoff meeting and told them the tentative title was Breath at the Edge of the City. Her mother Li Xiulan smiled and said the title sounded nice. Her father Sun Mingyuan pondered for a moment and said, “A good title, but the stories matter more.” Sun Yuwei nodded and then casually brought up her wish to buy a camera to assist with writing and recording, saying she had already chosen a model. Her mother said, “If it’s useful, buy it,” and her father didn’t object either, only reminding her not to act on impulse.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Place an online order for a mirrorless camera
description: At the dinner table, she received her parents’ approval and was in a great mood. Returning to the study, she opened the JD app and, based on yesterday’s research, confirmed the order for the Fujifilm X-T30 II mirrorless camera (with kit lens). She completed the payment smoothly with her linked bank card, and the page showed the “Order Successful” notification. She took a screenshot and sent it to the best friends’ group: “Gear upgrade! From now on I’ll take great photos for you!” Her sister immediately replied: “Finally you made the move!”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening reading and free writing
description: After ordering the camera, the excitement had not faded. First, in the study, she opened “Kunming Local Records” and read several passages describing the streets and markets of old Kunming in the late Qing and early Republic period. She jotted down a few inspirations in her journal, such as “streets are the city's blood vessels.” Then she moved to the sofa in the living room and continued reading Wang Zengqi's “The Grass and Trees of the Human World.” She read an essay about “Rain in Kunming,” which resonated with the sense of marginality discussed that day. Meanwhile, she sent Zhang Jing a WeChat message: “Want to go check out Zhibushi Bookstore together next weekend? I heard new postcards have arrived.” She replied, “Sure, I was just thinking of going!”
location: Home study and living room, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entries and gratitude diary
description: Back at the desk, I opened my journal. I decorated today's page with new stickers and carefully wrote: Today's achievements: successfully held the launch meeting for the essay collection, designed a 12-month progress bar, and placed an order for a Fujifilm camera. In the gratitude journal section, I wrote: 'Thank you, Uncle Qin and Yang Xiao, for so sincerely sharing your wisdom; thank you, Mom, for your rice noodles, always my source of energy; and thank you to today's sunshine and breeze for giving me the courage to turn my dreams into reality.' Finally, I reviewed the detailed plan for the January 18 in-depth field trip to Cuihu again and confirmed the key observation points.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime washing and skincare routine
description: Washed up and put on a hydrating mask. Lying in bed, I looked through a few photos I took today—roasted erkuai, the journal progress tracker, the clouds over Green Lake, and the cover of “Kunming Local Records,” which I got from Uncle Qin. I edited them briefly and saved them to the “Essay Collection Material” album.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation, relaxation, and sleep
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only the small bedside lamp. Dimmed the phone screen, played a 10-minute guided meditation audio, focused on breathing, and felt the body relax. After meditation, turned off the light and set the alarm for 8:30 tomorrow. Closing my eyes, the conversations from today's meeting flashed through my mind, along with the little green square labeled 'January Cuihu' in my journal. Feeling fulfilled and calm, with anticipation for all possibilities, I slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm went off right on time at 7:50. I slept soundly last night; although I was looking forward to it, I was no longer nervous. I neatly folded the quilt, put on my hoodie, and stood on the balcony for a while, feeling the cool, dry air. Then I washed up and did my skincare routine. Today I decided to brew a cup of hot Pu'er tea to refresh myself and warm my stomach.
location: Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning academic preparation and family phone call
description: Sitting at the desk, I first set aside the essay collection project to focus on preparing for the afternoon meeting with my advisor. I spent 15 minutes browsing the chapter on Cuihu Lake in 'Kunming Local Records,' then opened my computer and quickly reviewed several paper abstracts I had organized last week on 'urban literature' and 'non-fiction writing.' On that basis, I wrote down three core questions to ask Professor Wu and drafted a recommended reading list. Afterward, I went to the balcony to call my mother, shared today's plan, and she reminded me to eat on time. After hanging up, I continued deepening the literature review at my desk, sorting out the arguments and methodologies of the core papers, and tried to combine them with the concept of my personal essay collection to form a detailed outline. During a break, I checked the deadline reminder, which added to my sense of urgency.
location: Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and relaxing with a podcast
description: I took my campus card to Beiyuan Canteen and ordered a small-pot rice noodle. It was steaming hot and comforted my brain that had been running at high speed all morning. While eating, I listened to an episode of a podcast about "place writing," which matched today's academic theme. After the meal, I bought a cup of yogurt and slowly walked back to the dormitory.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, Beiyuan Restaurant

name: Midday tidying and rest
description: After returning to the dormitory, she organized the literature review outline and the list of core questions written in the morning onto her tablet, and checked the items in her backpack: journal notebook, pen, Kunming Local Records, and printed blank note paper. After everything was ready, she set an alarm for 13:10 and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes.
location: Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visited advisor Professor Wu Mingyuan for an academic discussion.
description: After the 13:10 alarm, I shouldered my backpack and walked to the College of Liberal Arts, about a 10-minute walk. The winter noon sun was warm, the campus quiet, and I silently reviewed the key points for discussion. At 13:50 on time I knocked on Professor Wu's office door, and the discussion went very smoothly. I first reported my preliminary research plan and candidly shared my confusion about combining essay writing with academic research. Professor Wu affirmed that the idea was creative, but also pointed out the need for more rigorous theoretical support. He recommended three books: Zhao Yuan's "Beijing: The City and Its People," David Der-wei Wang's "The Fiction of Realism," and Zhang Ning's "Dusk of the Land," and explained in detail how to integrate urban space theory into prose analysis. I listened carefully, scribbled down the key points, and felt my thinking greatly broadened.
location: Professor Wu's office, Continuing Education Building, School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Strolling around campus and running into an old friend, Li Haoran.
description: After coming out of the School of Liberal Arts, I detoured to the library as planned and happened to run into Li Haoran walking out with a backpack. Both of us were pleasantly surprised and chatted for more than ten minutes at the library entrance. He was back from leave and looked energetic. I briefly mentioned that I had been busy with my essay collection, and he said he looked forward to my work. When we talked about old high school memories, he suggested getting together with old classmates from Kunming after everyone's exams. I gladly agreed, and we agreed to set a time later.
location: Entrance of the Library, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize academic notes and book a yoga class
description: After saying goodbye to Haoran, she quickly returned to the dormitory. While her memory was still fresh, she immediately opened her laptop and entered every piece of Professor Wu's advice and the book list into her Notion academic notes word by word. Then she updated the research plan framework for next semester, put the recommended books at the top of the reading plan, and set a goal to complete the first reading of "Beijing: The City and People" by January 25. She wrote down her reflections in her journal. Afterward, she sent a WeChat message to Coach He Lu at Zhongmou Yoga Studio on her phone, asking about the basic yoga trial class the next afternoon. After the other party confirmed there was a spot, she completed the reservation. Then she found her workout clothes and placed them on a chair for easy changing tomorrow.
location: Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking and photography excursion at Cuihu Park
description: As the sun set, I changed into comfortable canvas shoes and walked 10 minutes to Green Lake Park. The sunset glow dyed the lake surface orange-pink. I used my phone to capture red-billed gulls skimming across the water, weeping willows reflected in the lake, and elderly people basking in the sun. These scenes provided inspiration for the essay “The Cycle of Seasons at Green Lake.”
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Resting at Xiangzi Tea Shop
description: After leaving Green Lake Park, I stopped by the Green Lake store of Xiangzi Tea Shop, a place I often visit, and ordered a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea — warm and tasty. Sitting on a round stool by the window, watching the streetlights gradually come on, I felt the warmth of the city and inner peace, enjoying a healing moment.
location: Xiangzi Tea Shop (Cuihu Branch), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near Cuihu South Gate)

name: Returned to the dorm and shared with parents via video call.
description: Sipped milk tea and strolled leisurely back to the dorm, with a gentle evening breeze along the way. Back in the dorm, I figured my father was already off work, so I made a video call and reported the day's progress to my parents: Professor Wu's approval, the recommended reading list, running into Haoran, and so on. Both parents were happy. Mom told me to take care of my health, Dad nodded and smiled. We chatted about everyday things, and I felt warm inside.
location: Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening creative work and journaling
description: After the video call ended, she started her evening free reading and writing at the desk in the dormitory. Following Professor Wu's suggestion, she began with "Records of Kunming Customs and Scenery" and, using the photos she took of Green Lake today, searched for more details for her essay "The Changing Seasons of Green Lake." She read the chapter about the historical changes of Green Lake and noted keywords in the literary materials section of her journal: "lotus leaves stretching to the sky," "winter bald cypresses," and "the legend of the Xima River." Then she opened today's journal page and recorded the whole day's activities—morning preparations, academic progress, her mentor's advice, running into Haoran, yoga appointment, and photography at Green Lake—with colored pens and stickers. Finally, in the gratitude journal section, she wrote: "At the moment when my mentor gently untangled my thoughts, I felt very happy. Thank you, Professor Wu, and thank the version of myself that prepared so seriously for academics."
location: Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxing and reading before bed
description: Close the journal, go wash up and change into pajamas. Turn off the main light, switch on the bedside night light, put on earphones, and play a 10-minute guided meditation to help calm the mind. After the meditation, lean back against the headboard and read Wang Zengqi's The Grass and Trees of the Human World for about ten minutes. When drowsiness comes, turn off the light, set the alarm for tomorrow's yoga class, and gradually fall asleep in a fulfilling sense of satisfaction, expected to be asleep before 23:00.
location: Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off. The winter morning in Kunming was gray and cold. Sun Yuwei put on a thick hoodie, washed up quickly, found her black yoga clothes, folded them into her backpack, and checked her water bottle and phone battery. Thinking about trying yoga that afternoon, she felt a mix of anticipation and nervousness.
location: Dingxin Apartment Dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast on campus and walk to the library.
description: At Canteen No. 1 on the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University, she bought a bowl of hot soy milk and a rose flower cake, and sat by the window. Watching the students on the sports field, she used her phone's memo app to note down today's weather and mood. After finishing breakfast, she walked along the tree-lined campus path toward the library. In the deep winter, the plane trees had lost all their leaves; she quickened her pace, thinking about reviewing ancient Chinese literature in the morning.
location: Yunnan University Donglu Campus, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: Canteen 1 and campus grounds

name: Review ancient literature at the library.
description: Sat down in the usual window seat on the third floor of the library, wrote out passages of "Li Sao" from memory, sorted out the thread of literary history, and used a highlighter to mark test points such as "imitation huaben" and "Gongan School". Occasionally looking up at the sparrows outside the window, her thoughts drifted to the afternoon yoga, then were drawn back to the book.
location: Self-study area on the third floor of the library, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Have lunch with roommates
description: Liu Jia sent a WeChat message asking to meet at the Second Cafeteria. The two each bought a bowl of small-pot rice noodles and chatted while eating. Sun Yuwei shared what she had gained from discussing her thesis with her advisor, and Liu Jia complained about how difficult the writing course paper was. Sun Yuwei told Liu Jia that she was going to try yoga in the afternoon, and Liu Jia was surprised and encouraged her.
location: Second Cafeteria, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return to the dormitory to rest and check equipment
description: She changed into loose yoga clothes, rolled up the yoga mat and put it into an old cloth bag, checked her water bottle and phone battery, and confirmed the reservation information. She sent a message on WeChat to confirm with her coach He Lu and received a reply.
location: Dingxin Apartment Dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute to the yoga studio
description: Walked to the bus stop at the school gate, took Bus No. 1, found a window seat, put on earphones to listen to Zhou Shen's "He Guang Tong Chen." Looking at the streets outside the window, got off at Panjiawan Station after 20 minutes, and walked a few minutes to find Dechun Commercial Building.
location: On Bus No. 1 from Yunnan University Donglu Campus Station to Panjiawan Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: First experience at the yoga studio
description: Arriving at Zhongmou Yoga Life Studio on the 4th floor, she checked in at the front desk, received a locker key, put on yoga socks, and entered the studio. As the class began, Coach He Lu's gentle voice guided her through breathing exercises, and then they learned Sun Salutation. Sun Yuwei's arms trembled in Downward-Facing Dog, and the backs of her thighs ached in Warrior I. He Lu walked over, helped her adjust, and encouraged her. An hour later, her limbs were sore but her mind felt clear. After class, she drank water in the rest area. He Lu gave her a card with shoulder and neck stretches, encouraged her, demonstrated the postures, and suggested she not eat a full meal right after practice, though she could have some fruit.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Lifestyle Center, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting back to the Green Lake area
description: She changed back into her everyday clothes, walked out of the building, and the sky had cleared. Taking the No. 101 bus, she watched Green Lake glistening outside the window and red-billed gulls circling, and snapped photos with her phone.
location: On Bus No. 101 from Panjiawan Station to Cuihu North Road Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Browsed Zhibushi Bookstore and talked with Uncle Qin.
description: She got off at Cuihu North Road and walked into Zhibushi Bookstore. Uncle Qin took out a kraft paper envelope from under the counter containing the magazines Prose and Book City. Sun Yuwei thanked him and talked about her essay collection idea. Uncle Qin suggested adding historical depth. After chatting about new books, she left.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entry on the first yoga experience.
description: Back in the dorm, after washing my face, I sat at the desk and drew a stick figure in downward dog pose in a blank journal with colored pencils. Though the drawing was crooked, it was fun. Beside it, I recorded my yoga feelings: the body is the most honest; Teacher He Lu said, "Breath is your rhythm." I decided to start a "Body Dialogue" column to record each practice.
location: Dingxin Apartment Dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Curled up in a chair, she video-called her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen. Her sister had just gotten off work, and while listening to her share about yoga, she teased her. Sun Yuwei showed the little figures she had drawn in her journal, and her sister encouraged her to keep it up, adding that yoga cards in Shenzhen were expensive and telling her to practice extra on her behalf. The two chatted about work and the weather in Shenzhen, and reminded each other to stay warm.
location: Dingxin Apartment Dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and a walk around Green Lake
description: First, I leaned against the headboard and read an essay about winter in Jiangnan in Prose magazine. Thinking I hadn't gone out for fresh air, I put on a scarf and went for a walk along the lake in Cuihu Park. The afternoon sun shone on the lake, red-billed gulls glided and scrambled for food, and I felt at peace.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus dinner
description: After the walk, she went to the No. 1 canteen, ordered a bowl of clay-pot rice noodles in mushroom soup, drank all the soup, and the warmth dispelled the chill.
location: First Canteen, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Looked up introductory yoga information.
description: Back in the dorm, I used my phone to search for beginner yoga precautions and Sun Salutation A step-by-step tutorial videos, carefully watched professional bloggers' explanations, created a "Yoga Knowledge" folder in my Notes, recorded the key engagement points and breathing techniques, and made a practice plan for every Tuesday and Saturday.
location: Dingxin Apartment Dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Drafting the final paper
description: Opened the computer and, based on yesterday's discussion with Professor Wu, decided to use 'the literary writing of local chronicles' as the entry point. Drawing on Kunming Customs and Scenery, I conceived an outline and wrote the first paragraph of the section 'Regional Space and Identity'.
location: Dingxin Apartment Dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Write a gratitude journal.
description: In the "Today's Little Blessings" section of her journal, she wrote: taking the brave first step into yoga; Uncle Qin's encouragement; her sister's care and her parents' WeChat messages; the beautiful sunset over Green Lake.
location: Dingxin Apartment Dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening meditation and stretching
description: Lay out the yoga mat, open the Tide app and do 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, following the guidance to clear the mind and feel the breath. Afterward, do 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to relax the muscles.
location: Dingxin Apartment Dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: Leaning on the bed, flipping through "Prose" magazine, reading an essay about hometown, I used a sticky note to jot down "astonishing linguistic density" and stuck it at the foot of the page. Then I read a few pages of "Introduction to Watercolor," imagining going to Green Lake to sketch and paint black-headed gulls.
location: Dorm bed, Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime journaling and tomorrow’s plan
description: I set my phone alarm for 7:30 and wrote tomorrow's core tasks in my journal: review the last two chapters of Ancient Chinese Literature at the library in the morning; organize the subheading structure of the Green Lake essay in the afternoon; contact Zhang Jing on WeChat to confirm Saturday's meeting. I turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Dorm bed, Dingxin Apartment, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine and reading at breakfast.
description: Sunlight streamed into the bedroom through the gap in the curtains. Sun Yuwei woke up and felt that most of the soreness from yesterday's yoga class had faded and her body was much more relaxed. She stretched, picked up her phone and looked at it for a few minutes, then got up, washed, and drank a cup of warm honey water. Her mother had already prepared breakfast—soy milk, eggs, and steamed rolls. While eating, she flipped through Wang Zengqi's The World of Plants, and when she read the passage about mushrooms during the rainy season in Kunming, she felt especially close to it. After eating, she took the dishes to the kitchen, brewed a cup of rose tea, and carried it into the study.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home)

name: Morning review of ancient literature
description: Sun Yuwei sat down at her desk, spread out the textbook and notes for A History of Ancient Chinese Literature, and focused on tackling Li Sao and Tang-Song poetry. She made flash cards with different colored sticky notes, writing the poem lines on the front and analysis points plus possible exam questions on the back. Around 10:30, her mother, Li Xiulan, came in with a plate of cut oranges and gently reminded her to rest. Sun Yuwei smiled and thanked her, stood up, paced around the study to loosen her shoulders and neck, and after a brief break resumed reviewing.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study room)

name: Pick up packages and family lunch
description: Her phone rang; the delivery man said the package had arrived at the gate of the community. Sun Yuwei excitedly ran downstairs and brought back a flat cardboard box — her online-ordered Fujifilm X-T30 II camera had arrived, and she was overjoyed. Soon her father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the whole family had lunch together. Her mother had made tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried choy sum, and seaweed egg drop soup. Her father asked about her revision progress. Sun Yuwei answered while eating and also shared her plan to explore the new camera. Her father smiled and said she should go out and take more photos instead of staying cooped up at home.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home and the entrance to the residential community)

name: Researching the new camera and quick inspiration notes
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei eagerly unpacked the camera, took out the body and the kit lens, and studied the buttons and menus with the quick start guide. She installed the battery and memory card, then tried shooting in the study, aiming at the forget-me-not arrangement on the windowsill and the small objects on the desk. She was pleasantly surprised by the camera's excellent straight-out-of-camera colors and film simulation effects. While looking through the viewfinder, a thought suddenly struck her — the lens is another kind of gaze; moments like the golden shards on the lake, a bird flying across, and the back of an old man are all worth freezing. She immediately opened her pocket journal and quickly jotted down this inspiration with a pencil, planning to use it as the entry point for an essay about Green Lake.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study room)

name: Get ready to go out and walk to the bookstore.
description: Sun Yuwei changed into a loose knit sweater, slung her camera bag over her shoulder, packed her journal, bus card, and some change, said goodbye to her mother, and went out. She chose to walk to Zhibushi Bookstore, heading along Huashan West Road toward Cuihu North Road, and it took about fifteen minutes. The sunlight was great along the way, so she couldn't resist taking out her new camera and taking a few shots of the light and shadows on old walls and the bougainvillea peeking over the wall tops, making a good start to today's test shooting.
location: Along the route from Huashan West Road to Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visit Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore
description: She pushed open the glass door of the bookstore, and the aroma of coffee mixed with the scent of ink and paper hit her. The owner, Qin Mingyuan (Uncle Qin), was sorting newly arrived magazines. Seeing Sun Yuwei, he smiled and greeted her, telling her that the new issue of Prose had been reserved for her. Sun Yuwei excitedly shared about her new camera and the prose inspiration she had just captured. Uncle Qin encouraged her to observe more and record more, saying that writing and photography are connected. She browsed several new books in the literature section, bought a few postcards she liked, and spent a leisurely time in the bookstore.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stroll and test shots at Green Lake Park
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, Sun Yuwei walked to Green Lake Park. The afternoon sun slanted across the lake, making the water sparkle. She strolled along the lakeshore, repeatedly taking out her new camera for a formal test shoot, trying different focal lengths and apertures to capture the moment the black-headed gulls flapped their wings, the reflections on the water, the distant pavilions and towers, and the rows of weeping willows. Although her technique was still unpolished, every time she captured a shot she liked, she felt sincere satisfaction.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bought groceries on the way home.
description: As the sun set, Sun Yuwei remembered that her mother had mentioned wanting mushroom soup that morning, so she stopped by the Haoshunlu Farmers Market on Qianju Street on the way and bought fresh oyster mushrooms and a small piece of tender tofu. Then she carried the groceries and walked slowly back to her home on Huashan West Road, arriving just as it got dark.
location: Haoshun Road Farmers' Market, No. 31 Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and on the way home

name: Have dinner with the family
description: Mother made a delicious pot of mushroom tofu soup with the mushrooms and tofu Sun Yuwei had bought. The atmosphere at the dinner table was warm. Sun Yuwei couldn't wait to share the photos she had taken at Cuihu Lake today. Her father was full of praise for the camera's image quality, while her mother was concerned about her study pressure and told her not to work too hard. The family chatted and ate, filled with joy and harmony.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan (home dining room)

name: Talked with her mother about her yoga experience
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei and her mother sat on the living room sofa chatting. She opened a yoga tutorial video on her phone and showed her mother the basic movements of Mountain Pose and Sun Salutation that she had learned the previous day. Her mother followed along—her movements were a bit stiff, but she practiced very seriously—and recalled that she had practiced tai chi for a while in her youth. The mother and daughter practiced while laughing and joking, and her father, watching the news nearby, occasionally chimed in with comments. The living room was filled with laughter.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home living room)

name: Evening tidying and journal entries
description: Back in her study, Sun Yuwei turned on the desk lamp, imported the photos from the camera into her computer, briefly browsed them, and sorted and named them. Then she opened her beloved journal and, under the 'Body Dialogue' section, recorded her bodily sensations from waking up early today, along with a simple sketch of a yoga pose. Next, she neatly transcribed the essay inspiration she had captured in the afternoon onto a new page of the journal and stuck beside it a postcard bought at the bookstore.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study room)

name: Free reading and relaxation before bed.
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the computer, took the newly bought magazine Prose from the bookshelf, and flipped through its articles. Reading a piece about life in the northern hutongs, she couldn't help thinking of the leisurely atmosphere of the Spring City. Before bed, she lay in bed and did ten minutes of deep-breathing meditation with her eyes closed, clearing her mind and letting all the beautiful feelings of the day settle.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study and bedroom)

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: Sun Yuwei finished washing up, set her alarm for 7:30 the next morning, and wrote in her gratitude journal: "Today, words, the camera lens, and home all felt very close to me." Then she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully, filled with contentment and calm.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 07:50. Drawing the curtains, I saw morning light and thin mist. After washing up, I changed into loungewear. Passing through the living room, I saw my mother, Li Xiulan, watering succulents on the balcony. She reminded me that breakfast was ready, including mushroom soup dumplings she had just learned to make. In the dining room, I had breakfast with my mother—soup dumplings with millet porridge—and we talked about trying out the camera. I showed her photos of black-headed gulls from Cuihu Lake. She laughed and said she wanted to be a model on the weekend, and I happily agreed. After the meal, I helped clear the dishes.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning review of Modern Prose Studies
description: In the study, I focused on reviewing the comparison of the writing styles of the three masters of modern prose. I sorted out the argumentative style of the preface to Wen Yiduo's Miscellaneous Notes on Tang Poetry and took notes, reviewed the delicate descriptions and sincere emotions in Zhu Ziqing's The Back View and Moonlight over the Lotus Pond, and wrote from memory the classic passages embodying the 'philosophy of love' in Bing Xin's To Young Readers. At 11 o'clock I closed the book and drew a comparison chart from memory, and at 11:30 I simulated answering a past exam question on 'the language art of Zhu Ziqing's prose.' During this, my mother brought in cut oranges and warm water, and I continued after eating them. Near noon I stood up to relax, looked out the window at the neighbor Aunt Xie and her little dog, did eye relaxation exercises, looked through yesterday's Green Lake photos, and then helped my mother set out chopsticks and bowls for lunch.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break
description: I had lunch with my parents. My mother made tomato scrambled eggs, cucumber salad, and mushroom soup, and my father Sun Mingyuan came home at noon. We chatted while eating about the fun we had photographing black-headed gulls at Green Lake yesterday. My mother laughed that my dedication was just like hers, and my father quietly picked up fish for me and reminded me to be careful during the afternoon yoga. After the meal, I helped clear the dishes and rested in my room for 15 minutes. At 13:10, I changed into yoga clothes and a loose hoodie, put on a light crossbody bag, and packed my yoga card and phone.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: Setting off from home on Huashan West Road, wearing earphones listening to light music, walking along familiar streets to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on Dongfeng West Road, sunlight filtering through the leaves, feeling relaxed.
location: On the way from Huashan West Road to Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Yoga studio class and post-class discussion
description: Arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio (4th floor, Dechun Commercial Building). After changing clothes, I greeted the instructor He Lu in the lounge and mentioned that I was looking forward to trying meditation. At 13:40, the Hatha yoga class began. He Lu led poses such as Cat-Cow, Downward Dog, and Warrior; the stretching soothed the slight soreness in my body. In the final 20 minutes, I did my first meditation—sitting cross-legged with eyes closed and focusing on my breath. Although distracting thoughts kept coming up, I experienced a brief moment of calm and emptiness. After class, I talked with He Lu, and she reassured me that losing focus is normal and suggested noticing the temperature change of the breath next time. Then we walked together to Zhiniao Coffee.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sitting for a while at a café.
description: Sat with He Lu at Zhiniao Coffee (Succulent Park Store), surrounded by succulents, in a cozy atmosphere. I ordered a hot latte, she ordered an Americano. We chatted about how I'm collecting material for a Kunming essay collection, and she recommended Michio Hoshino's “The Long Journey,” about nature and life, as reading that could inspire. We talked for about 40 minutes in a relaxed mood.
location: Zhiniao Coffee (Succulent Park Branch), near Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon walk and photography outing
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, I walked to Cuihu Park and saw roasted baba rice cake stalls along the way. Arrived at the park at 67 Cuihu South Road; the afternoon sunlight was gentle. Using my new camera, I captured close-ups of black-headed gulls diving to catch food, the golden ripples on the lake and the silhouettes of weeping willows under the setting sun. I also snapped candid shots of daily life: an elderly man feeding the gulls, a couple reading on a bench. Immersed in the viewfinder, I felt deeply healed.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and along the way

name: Passed by Zhibushi Bookstore on the way home.
description: As the light grew dim, she packed up her camera with satisfaction and walked home along Cuihu North Road. Passing Zhibushi Bookstore, she saw its orange-yellow lights, went in to greet the owner, Uncle Qin, and showed him the photos of black-headed gulls. Uncle Qin was full of praise. After a short stay, she left.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: When I got home, my father was already off work. For dinner, my mother had prepared braised fish in soy sauce and garlic spinach. While eating, I shared my first experience of yoga and meditation from the afternoon and showed the action shot of a black-headed gull swooping down. Father praised my improved composition, and Mother asked about my review progress and reminded me not to overdo it.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening tea break and diary preparation
description: After the meal, she returned to the study, took out the rose tea and opened it to enjoy the fragrance, and found a blank diary with a kraft paper cover and a smooth gel pen. She neatly arranged them on a corner of the desk to form a 'morning ritual corner'. Then she opened the title page, wrote 'Morning Essays — Beginning January 10, 2025', and designed a daily recording template: date/weather, emotional temperature from 1 to 10, today's creative intention, and a free-writing section, plus lines, wavy lines, and sun-and-flower decorations. She was very much looking forward to starting this new habit.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Write a gratitude journal and do meditation stretching.
description: She took out her journal, wrote three things on the gratitude page: gratitude to He Lu for her meditation guidance and acceptance, gratitude to her mother for the delicious meals, and gratitude to her new camera for helping her capture beautiful moments. At the end, she drew a rose. Then she returned to the bedroom, leaving only the warm bedside lamp on, played white noise of flowing water, and sat cross-legged on a cushion trying to focus on breathing meditation for about 10 minutes. Though distracting thoughts remained, they were calmer. Afterward, she did some simple pre-sleep stretches to relax her neck and shoulders.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and bedtime preparation
description: Leaning against the headboard, she read 'Kunming Scenery and Customs' given by Uncle Qin, learning that Green Lake was originally called 'Cai Haizi' and anecdotes about Wu Sangui, thereby building a rich background for her essay 'The Four Seasons of Green Lake.' At 22:00 she closed the book, set the alarm for 7:30 the next day, and aimed to fall asleep by 23:00. After washing up, she applied body lotion.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to Bed and Reviewing the Day
description: Got into bed, closed my eyes, and reviewed the day: focused review in the morning, yoga and meditation and Green Lake photography in the afternoon, designing new habits in the evening. The rhythm was clear, and my heart felt calm and fulfilled. I silently repeated that I would keep working hard tomorrow, and gradually fell asleep.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off right on time at 08:10. She confirmed that the morning journal alarm (07:40) she had set the night before had not gone off because she had adjusted her plans, but she still felt calm. Remembering the sense of peace after yesterday's yoga class, she decided to start a reading day at home today. She washed up briefly, changed into comfortable loungewear, and got ready for a long stretch of reading and organizing.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and a quick family chat.
description: Mother had prepared a simple breakfast: a bowl of hot milk, two slices of whole wheat toast, and a boiled egg. Sitting at the dining table, I told her while eating that I wouldn't go out today, planning to review and read at home, and maybe visit the bookstore in the evening. Mother smiled and nodded, saying she would make my favorite pot rice noodles for lunch.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reviewing classical literature and organizing my journal
description: In the morning, the review focus was the literary schools of the Wei, Jin, and Northern and Southern Dynasties. She spread out her textbook and notes and began sorting from the “Seven Scholars of Jian'an,” focusing on representative works and stylistic features. After about an hour and a half, she found it dull, so she took out her planner and rearranged the sketches from her recent Green Lake field trip plan and the reflective fragments from her yoga journal, using colored pens and stickers to make the page lively. Then she returned to reviewing and used a mind map to connect the anecdotes and literary contributions of the “Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove.”
