location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Mother made small-pot rice noodles, and Father came home from work to join the lunch. During the meal, she shared anecdotes about the Wei-Jin literati she had been reviewing. Father listened with great interest and added that he also loved reading Shishuo Xinyu when he was young. Mother reminded her to rest in the afternoon and not keep staring at books.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Feeling a bit sleepy after the meal, she didn't return to the study right away but took a half-hour nap on the living room sofa under a blanket. Closing her eyes to rest, she listened to the occasional birdsong outside the window, giving her brain a full break.
location: Living room sofa at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focused review and reading preparation
description: In the afternoon, her energy recovered. She returned to the study and continued the review tasks left unfinished in the morning, finishing all the notes on the literary schools of the Wei, Jin, Southern and Northern Dynasties. Around 16:00, she felt a bit hungry and, remembering the 'brown sugar pearl milk tea' mentioned in her reference notes, went to the kitchen and brewed a cup with brown sugar pearls and milk; the aroma filled the room. Then she took down the long-awaited A Writer's Notebook by Maugham from the bookshelf and prepared to start the afternoon's reading.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Immersed in reading 'The Writer's Notebook.'
description: Holding a cup of hot milk tea, she leaned back in the comfortable reading chair in the study and began reading A Writer's Notebook. The light outside the window gradually softened, and the sound of turning pages and the sweet fragrance of the milk tea fully immersed her in the literary world of Maugham's writing.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading reflections and the decision to start a morning journal
description: When I read the line that a writer's life is a life of constant recording, I was deeply moved. Thinking of my journaling hobby and the morning diary template I designed yesterday, I immediately decided to formally put it into practice starting tomorrow. Closing the book, I took a deep breath, eager to put this resolution into action.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Designing a morning journal template
description: She picked up a new blank diary with a kraft paper cover, turned to the flyleaf, and solemnly wrote in a pen: "Morning essays — starting January 10, 2025." Then she found her journaling tools and used a ruler, colored pens, and stickers to refine the designed basic template: she added a gradient to the "Emotion Temperature" section, drew small dots for "Today's Goals," and stuck a dried flower sticker in the corner of the page. When finished, she took a photo with her phone and sent it to the dormitory group chat with the caption "I'm ready! Starting tomorrow!" She soon received likes and comments from Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen. Liu Jia said, "What an exquisite sense of ritual!" This made her especially happy.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Get changed and get ready to go out
description: After completing the design, she put on a thicker cotton-linen jacket, picked up her canvas bag and phone, said goodbye to her mother, and went out.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Walked from home to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. The evening air was slightly cool, with sporadic light rain falling; I opened the folding umbrella I carried. Passing Cuihu Park, I saw a few late-returning red-billed gulls circling over the lake. I stopped to watch for a few minutes, feeling peaceful and fulfilled.
location: Along Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bookstore date and literary exchange
description: When I arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore in Kunming, Zhang Jing was already sitting in her usual seat by the window, having ordered a hot drink for herself. After I sat down, she excitedly shared the inspiration and outcome of designing her morning journal today. She laughed and said, "My literary-youth syndrome is acting up again," but her eyes were full of admiration. She also talked about the mischievous but adorable pupils in her class and the Maugham she had been reading recently. During our conversation, Uncle Qin, the bookstore owner, came over with a cup of tea. Seeing the book she was reading, he recommended Naipaul, who was equally skilled at writing character sketches, and said he had just stocked a copy of Naipaul's Miguel Street. At 19:30, the bookstore began playing the closing-time reminder music, and only then did the two of us reluctantly get up and say goodbye, agreeing to meet again next week. Before leaving, I bought that copy of Miguel Street from Uncle Qin.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: On the way home
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Jing, the rain had stopped. Walking back with the newly bought book in hand, I felt full of satisfaction.
location: Along Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Have dinner with the family
description: When she got home, her mother had already prepared dinner. On the table were a plate of stir-fried choy sum, a portion of steam-pot chicken, and mushroom tofu soup. During dinner, she shared what she had seen at the bookstore and the new books she had bought. Her father talked about the preparations for the cultural exhibition at his workplace, and they also discussed the weekend plans, confirming with her mother again the pleasant plan to go to Green Lake on Saturday afternoon at two o’clock.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Continued reading The Writer's Notebook and writing reading reflections
description: After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes and returned to her study. She made a cup of hot milk, reopened The Writer's Notebook, and continued reading the remaining chapters. Immersed in Maugham's profound insights on daily observation and recording, she wrote down brief excerpts and reflections in a notebook beside her as she read.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening exercise and meditation
description: She closed the book, changed into yoga clothes, and laid out a yoga mat in the living room. She played a soothing meditation track on her phone and did 15 minutes of stretching, focusing on feeling the “temperature change of the breath in the nasal cavity” that Coach He Lu had mentioned in yesterday’s yoga class. Then she sat cross-legged and meditated for 10 minutes, focusing on each inhale and exhale, letting the day’s thoughts settle.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Gratitude journal and preparing for bed
description: After meditation, she felt calm and joyful. Back in the bedroom, she quickly wrote today's gratitude journal in her planner: thanking Zhang Jing for chatting with her, thanking Uncle Qin for recommending the new book, and thanking herself for deciding to start a morning journal today. Then she placed the newly bought Miguel Street and the newly designed morning journal on the bedside table, set the alarm for 7:50 tomorrow morning, and planned to write her first morning journal.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Took a walk with my mother around Green Lake.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning journal, finalizing the gathering, and washing up and stretching
description: When the alarm rang in the morning, Sun Yuwei didn't linger in bed. She went straight to the study and started the new day with rose tea. In her diary, she carefully wrote the date, weather, and a mood rating, and set her creative intention for the day: to capture the moment the city awakens from the perspective of an elderly jogger in Green Lake Park. Then, in a WeChat group named 'Three Golden Flowers,' she finalized the exact time and place for tomorrow's gathering with her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi, deciding to meet at 2 p.m. at Zhiyu Coffee (Wenlin Street branch), and set a calendar reminder. After that, she washed up and, following a yoga app, did shoulder and neck stretches and the cat-cow pose to fully wake up her body.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Sun Yuwei came to the dining room. Her mother Li Xiulan had prepared small-pot rice noodles topped with a soft-yolk fried egg. Her father Sun Mingyuan was drinking soy milk while watching the morning news. As she ate breakfast, she shared her decision to start writing morning pages and mentioned that at noon she wanted to discuss adjusting the dinner menu with her mother. Her father nodded approvingly, and her mother smiled and said she happened to be planning to buy a sea bass today.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning review of Modern Prose Studies
description: Back in the study, Sun Yuwei entered focused review mode. She focused on reciting the artistic features of May Fourth-era prose, Zhou Zuoren's “Yanzhi” prose style, and Lin Yutang's advocacy of humorous literature, and tried to connect these knowledge points to her own writing—for example, borrowing Zhou Zuoren's plain and natural style to describe the old man at Green Lake, and using Lin Yutang's humor to write about the interactions of black-headed gulls. She recited aloud repeatedly, occasionally getting up and pacing to keep her mind active, and refilling her teacup.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Discussing family menu adjustments with my mother
description: Sun Yuwei took her journal to the living room, sat down next to her mother, who was trimming vegetables, and tactfully raised the issues of insufficient vegetable intake and the red-braised pork being too oily recently. Her mother smiled and called her a little housekeeper, but understood her thoughts. Together they discussed and decided that from tonight the menu would become lighter and healthier: steamed sea bass, blanched choy sum, garlic broccoli, and tomato egg drop soup, interspersed several times a week. Sun Yuwei also volunteered to record the family menu.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lunch and nutrition log
description: Lunch was a simple tomato and egg noodle dish. Sun Yuwei opened her diet tracking app and carefully entered the data: one serving of noodles, one egg, one tomato, and a kiwi after the meal. She regarded this small gesture as a way of attending to life. While eating, she talked with her parents about her plan to go to Green Lake tomorrow afternoon to gather creative material.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Midday reading of Miguel Street.
description: Sun Yuwei walked over to the bay window in the study, leaned against a cushion, and opened the newly purchased Miguel Street. She was drawn in by the vivid characters and details under Naipaul's pen. At the brilliant passages, she jotted down keywords such as 'plain description,' 'point of view,' and 'negative space' on the edge of her journal, gaining new thoughts on prose technique.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Continue reviewing Modern Prose Studies in the afternoon.
description: Refreshed after rest, Sun Yuwei focused on memorizing representative authors and works. She silently recited the characteristics of Bing Xin's 'Little Poems' and 'Letters to Young Readers', the meticulous structure of Zhu Ziqing's prose, and the sentimental style of Yu Dafu's travel essays. She used the method of reciting aloud and writing keywords from memory, and also drew a mind map by hand to connect the literary schools and representative figures.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Field visit to Cuihu Park for creative inspiration
description: Sun Yuwei put on canvas shoes, slung her small camera bag, and walked about 8 minutes to the east gate of Green Lake Park. She sat on a bench pretending to draw, but was in fact quietly observing: an older man with graying temples, wearing a faded athletic shirt, was walking backward while occasionally rotating his wrists, and he also chatted with another elderly man walking a dog about the park's water quality. These vivid details led her to quickly jot down keywords such as “the rhythm of walking backward, topics, water quality, and the ritual of morning exercise” in her sketchbook, accumulating material for her writing.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Browsing at Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore and going home
description: Coming out of the west gate of Cuihu Park, Sun Yuwei walked along North Cuihu Road for less than five minutes to reach the Paper, Cloth, and Stone Bookstore. The bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, greeted her with a smile and said the new issue of Prose he had reserved for her had arrived. She took the magazine and flipped through it, found an essay about the streets of Kunming that interested her, and chatted with Uncle Qin about the Cuihu essay she was planning. Uncle Qin suggested paying more attention to “long take” style descriptions. After talking, she also picked out a secondhand poetry collection in the poetry section. Then she hugged her books and walked back home along the same route, with sunlight casting dappled shadows through the plane trees on the way.
location: Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Organize today's materials
description: Back home, Sun Yuwei organized the scattered words and phrases in her sketchbook into a fluent written description in the study, and used her phone to photograph the cover of the new issue of "Prose" and the page with the article about Kunming streets, planning to put them into her journal later.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Handling editor emails and chatting with friends
description: Sun Yuwei turned on her computer and replied to an email from editor Xu Mingyuan, who confirmed the direction of the manuscript and reminded her of the January 25 deadline. Then she saw a WeChat message from her Chengdu friend Song Wen, chatted with him briefly via voice, complaining about the fragmented knowledge points for review, and sharing the novelty of starting morning pages and sketching at Green Lake.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: New healthy dinner experience
description: The dinner table looked brand new: steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and a refreshing tomato and egg soup. Mother indeed used less oil, but the sweetness of the sea bass and the crisp tenderness of the broccoli were perfectly preserved. Sun Yuwei excitedly took photos to document it, jokingly calling it a "milestone in healthy eating management," and specially picked out the tenderest meat from the fish's back for her parents, who looked at her with newfound respect.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Continued reading Miguel Street in the evening
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei did not scroll on her phone but picked up Miguel Street again. The dignity and humor that the characters in the book maintain in the face of difficult lives deeply moved her. She thought of the theme of “people on the margins of the city” that she wanted to express in her essays, and wrote in the blank space of her journal: “The dignity of ordinary people is the best story.”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Write gratitude journal and update planner
description: Sun Yuwei opened her daily journal, picked a satisfying dinner photo, printed it with her mini printer, and pasted it onto the page. In the gratitude journal section she wrote: 'Grateful for the healthy dinner Mom made today — it tasted great! Grateful to Uncle Qin for the book he gave me and his writing advice; grateful that I didn't stay in bed this morning and started a new habit.' Then she recorded today's diet data (protein, vegetables) in the health tracking section using stickers and text.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Go to Zhongmou Yoga Studio to practice yoga.
description: Sun Yuwei changed into her yoga clothes and walked about 7 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. Instructor He Lu had saved her a window-side spot. During the one-hour Hatha yoga class, she followed the guidance, releasing the day's fatigue through breath and postures, and felt refreshed all over after practice.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Returning home, washing up, and getting ready for bed
description: After yoga class, Sun Yuwei walked slowly home along Huashan West Road. The night was cool, but her body was warm. Once home, she took a quick hot shower, changed into comfortable pajamas, and while drying her hair, she set the alarm and reminders for tomorrow afternoon’s gathering on her phone. She also prepared the clothes and camera bag for tomorrow in advance and charged the spare battery.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Group chat with close friends to “rehearse” tomorrow’s gathering
description: Lying in bed, Sun Yuwei saw the 'Three Golden Flowers' group chat become lively: Zhang Jing sent a video of her visit to Zhiyu Coffee, and Chen Sisi started a 'What should we wear tomorrow?' poll. She enthusiastically joined the discussion, sharing photos of Green Lake and the story of the elderly people doing morning exercise. All three were looking forward to meeting the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: She turned off her phone, leaving only the small bedside lamp on. Sun Yuwei picked up Miguel Street and flipped through a few pages, reading to the end of that story that had inspired her. In her mind, the scent of roses, the rustling of pen on paper, the old man's back in the park, and the taste of steamed fish intertwined. She felt deeply content and sleepy. Glancing at her phone, she saw it was 22:50. She closed the book, turned off the light, and drifted off to sleep with a fulfilling heart.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning Journal
description: The alarm went off. She picked up her diary from the bedside table and continued fine-tuning her morning journal routine, using the first 5 minutes to set creative intentions and the last 5 minutes to write freely. She had prepared homemade brown sugar bubble tea and wrote down her intention: "Capture the overlooked everyday aesthetics in the market." She gave a score of 8 in the 'emotional temperature' column.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Checking the shopping list with mother over breakfast
description: Walking out of the bedroom, my mother had already prepared breakfast: soy milk, boiled eggs, and cold mixed vegetables. While eating breakfast, I went over the shopping list with my mother, including steamed sea bass, blanched choy sum, brown rice, and oats. Mother reminded me to pick fish with bright eyes and bright red gills, and I recorded it in my memo.
location: Dining room at home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Gather belongings and head out.
description: After breakfast, packed a canvas bag, placing the mirrorless camera, spare battery, shopping list, notebook, and water bottle inside, and checked that the camera's memory card was empty. Changed into a navy-blue hoodie and sports shoes, fixed her hair, and happily prepared to leave.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took Bus 119 to the market.
description: Walk from Cuihu Community to the Huashan West Road bus stop, wait 5 minutes, and take the No. 119 bus to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. Sit by the window, put on headphones and listen to a Yunnan folk song playlist, and watch the street scene outside. Arrive at the Zhuanxin Farmers' Market stop after about 32 minutes.
location: From Huashan West Road Bus Stop to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market Bus Stop, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, via Bus No. 119

name: Market shopping and shooting source material
description: She walked into the Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, went straight to the seafood area to pick a live bass and asked the stall owner to slaughter it, went to the vegetable section to buy water spinach and choy sum, and weighed out brown rice and oats at the grain and oil shop. In between shopping, she used her mirrorless camera to photograph close-ups of dried chili piles, vegetable greens with water drops, and fish and meat, gathering material for the essay collection “Breathing at the City's Edge.”
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home by car and organize the ingredients.
description: Carrying the groceries, she walked to Zhuanxin Bus Stop and took the bus about 40 minutes back to Green Lake Community. After arriving home, she put the sea bass in the fridge and the vegetables in the crisper, organized the refrigerator, and felt a sense of satisfaction.
location: From Zhuanxin Farmers' Market Bus Stop, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Community

name: Lunch, Chatting with Mother, and a Midday Rest
description: Mother made tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried choy sum with the ingredients she had bought the day before. While eating, they chatted about the time of the afternoon gathering. After the meal, she helped clear the dishes, went back to her room, leaned against the bed while scrolling on her phone, and rested for a while.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In the afternoon, got dressed and prepared for the get-together.
description: After waking up, checked the items to bring in the study: notebook, phone, Bluetooth earphones. Considering the café might be cool, changed into a navy-blue knitted cardigan, tidied up, and felt happy.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhiyu Coffee.
description: Walked from Green Lake Community along Green Lake North Road to Zhiyu Coffee, passed Green Lake Park and saw tourists feeding black-headed gulls, stopped briefly to enjoy the view, and arrived at the café at exactly 14:00.
location: Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; along the route from Cuihu Community to Zhiyu Coffee.

name: Waiting for a friend at the café
description: She arrived at Zhiyu Coffee early, sat down in a corner seat by the window, ordered a hot latte, flipped through Kunming Scenery and Customs, and confirmed the schedules of Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi via WeChat. Zhang Jing replied that she was on her way, and Chen Sisi also sent her location.
location: Zhiyu Cafe, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near Zhibushi Bookstore)

name: New Year's first gathering with close friends for a hearty chat
description: Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi arrived one after another and ordered coffee and cheesecake. Zhang Jing shared her plan to switch to a cultural and creative company after the New Year, and Chen Sisi showed photos of her award-winning works at the Ohara School flower exhibition, drawing everyone's admiration. Meanwhile, Wang Xinran, who was far away in Shenzhen, sent a video call. The four chatted animatedly across the screen, swapping stories from the annual meeting and teasing each other about new cameras and journals. The conversation ranged from career plans to the TV drama "Meet Yourself", then to everyone's reading lists and New Year goals. The corner of the café was filled with laughter.
location: Zhiyu Cafe, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near Zhibushi Bookstore)

name: After the gathering, walked home along Cuihu Lake.
description: After the gathering ended and bidding farewell to friends, she strolled back along Cuihu North Road on the periphery of Cuihu Park to Cuihu Community, enjoying the evening breeze and quiet buffer time, reliving the afternoon's laughter. Once home, she went to the kitchen to wash fruit first.
location: Cuihu North Road to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and organizing inspirations
description: At the desk in her bedroom, she pasted close-up photos of dried chili peppers taken today into her journal, recorded shopping lists and color inspiration, added the inspiration about "old house renovation" from the gathering with close friends, and wrote a prose draft: "In the afternoon coffee shop, the voices of four people rippled outward like the waves of Green Lake."
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Mother made steamed fish with the sea bass she bought in the afternoon, stir-fried garlic water spinach, and blanched choy sum. Father came home from work and showed photos of the market and a video screenshot with Wang Xinran at dinner. The parents were gratified and reminded her to rest.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga stretching and relaxation.
description: After dinner and a rest, unrolled the yoga mat in the bedroom and did 20 minutes of stretching, focusing on restorative poses to relax the hips, neck, and shoulders. Reviewing the day's experiences, both body and mind felt stretched and soothed.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and prose writing
description: In the study, read the chapter on the historical neighborhoods around Green Lake in 'Kunming Scenery Records' to prepare for the essay due January 25. Then I turned on the computer and refined the writing based on the draft and afternoon inspiration, enjoying calm focus.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Gratitude journal and meditation relaxation.
description: After a hot shower, changed into pajamas and wrote a gratitude journal by the bedside: grateful for mother's dinner, best friend's company, good photos, and father's support. Then did a 10-minute meditation, cleared my mind, and fully relaxed.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: Set the alarm for 8:00 the next morning, put the diary on the nightstand, and lay in bed reading 'Miguel Street,' feeling the humor and sadness of the characters in the book, gradually growing sleepy.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Turning off the lights to sleep, savoring a fulfilling and warm day—from morning journaling to laughter with close friends to the lively hustle and bustle of the market—and quickly drifting off to sleep.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Got up, washed up, and wrote the morning journal.
description: Woke up at 7:40 a.m. with cloudy skies and soft light outside the window. She stayed in bed for a moment, feeling the warmth of the quilt and the mushroom aroma from the kitchen. After getting up and washing up, she opened her morning journal at the desk, drew a symbol of sunlight filtering through the clouds, recorded her mood at 7/10, wrote today's intention: "enjoy the process, not the result," and recalled the passage from "Miguel Street" she had read the previous night, writing with a fountain pen about the poetry in ordinary life.
location: At home (bedroom), Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: After washing up, her mother Li Xiulan had already prepared breakfast: mushroom clear soup noodles, fried eggs, and homemade pickled radish. Sun Yuwei felt warm. She chatted with her mother about the aroma of the mushrooms and suggested going to Lakeside Restaurant together tomorrow after the exam to have mushroom hot pot. Her mother smiled and agreed to book a table in advance, encouraging her to take the exam with ease.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (dining room)

name: Morning review preparation and knowledge framework construction
description: After helping her mother clear the dishes, Sun Yuwei went into the study to review. She carefully checked her stationery (yellow, pink, and green highlighters, gel pens, etc.), spread out her notes on ancient literature and modern prose, and prepared A3 paper. She set her phone to play a playlist of soft music white noise and placed it high up to reduce distractions. Then she formally began reviewing, sorting out the literary schools and writers from the Wei, Jin, Southern and Northern Dynasties to the Tang and Song Dynasties, using yellow highlighters to mark core points and green for literary ideas. For modern prose, she classified it by period and school and created a mind map. During the review, her mother brought in cut apples, and she continued after a short break.
location: At home (study) in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Interacting with mother during class break
description: Sun Yuwei went to the living room. Her mother was reading and handed her a pear. While eating the fruit, she listened to her mother tell amusing stories about the new cat adopted by Aunt Xie downstairs. After a rest, she returned to the study, looked out the window at Green Lake, stretched her wrists and neck, and enjoyed the warmth of the sun.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (living room).

name: Morning review and reinforcement
description: Returning to the study, Sun Yuwei focused on strengthening her weak points. She took out her notebook of often-missed poem dictations and handwrote them for memorization, then closed the book and practiced essay questions by asking and answering herself, such as "Discuss the artistic features of Zhou Zuoren's early essays," organizing key points for the answer. Noticing sunlight falling on the pen tip outside the window, she used her mirrorless camera to capture the moment of light and shadow.
location: At home (study) in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch
description: Father Sun Mingyuan hurried back from overtime to have lunch together. Mother made small-pot rice noodles with chicken broth, adding choy sum and luncheon meat. The family of three sat around the table. Father asked about her review progress, and Sun Yuwei confidently said she was fully prepared. Father encouraged her not to put too much pressure on herself. The warm, everyday conversation made the midday meal wonderful.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (dining room)

name: Midday break and music time
description: After lunch, back in her bedroom, Sun Yuwei didn't want to take a nap. She stood by the window, played Accusefive's "Take Me to Find Nightlife" on the Bluetooth speaker, closed her eyes and sang along, letting her brain take a break from books and recharge for the afternoon review session.
location: At home (bedroom), Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon intensive review
description: Back in the study, the afternoon review began. Sun Yuwei first took out the printed poetry fill-in-the-blank worksheet and quickly wrote out the answers from memory; when she got stuck, she left it blank and checked it later. Then she opened her phone recorder to simulate an essay question on modern prose research, dictating her answer with the aim of clear logic and proper citations. The process was draining but the results were remarkable.
location: At home (study) in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxing and taking photos between classes.
description: After finishing intensive memorization, her shoulders and neck were sore and stiff. Sun Yuwei stood up and walked to the window. Seeing the mottled sunlight on the neighbor's wall, she took a few photos with her mirrorless camera. Then she went to the living room, poured warm water, drank it, and rested for a while.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study and living room)

name: Afternoon review—targeted problem-solving and summary.
description: After sitting down again, Sun Yuwei worked on the weak spots exposed by the self-test, reciting the classical poems she had stumbled over and placing sticky notes beside her notes to emphasize them. Then she moved to a summary review, quickly scanning the mind maps, key notes, and mock exam answers from the morning and afternoon to form a closed loop of knowledge.
location: At home (study) in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shoulder and neck relaxation and stretching.
description: After long hours at her desk caused shoulder and neck discomfort, Sun Yuwei dimmed the study lights, used a massage ball against the wall to roll and relax her trapezius muscles, then did neck circles and shoulder stretches, feeling the muscles loosen. She resolved to go to Zhongmou Yoga Studio to train with He Lu after the exam.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study and living room)

name: Contact my sister
description: After stretching, with both body and mind relaxed, Sun Yuwei contacted her sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen via WeChat voice. She said cheerfully that her exam preparation was going well and that she and her mother had agreed to go eat mushroom hotpot after the exam. She also asked about her sister's current work situation, and her sister reminded her to get enough rest.
location: At home (study) in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Mother made stir-fried oyster mushrooms, garlic choy sum, and steamed sea bass. The dinner atmosphere was relaxed. Father talked about amusing anecdotes from the Cultural Bureau, mother shared updates about her students, and Sun Yuwei talked about the sunlit photos she had taken. Family warmth dissolved the pressure of exam preparation.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (dining room)

name: Evening journal and gratitude diary
description: After the meal, she returned to the study and worked on her journal. She printed out today's photos of light and shadow, pasted them in, drew books and pens, played Accusefive's songs, and wrote, "Today's light was very gentle, the review was thorough, tomorrow I'll go have fun." Then she wrote a gratitude journal: grateful for her mother's mushroom soup noodles and dinner, her father's care, her sister's encouragement, and her own persistence, and she wrote down words to encourage herself.
location: At home (study) in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading: "Miguel Street"
description: Not wanting to touch her exam books anymore, Sun Yuwei picked up Miguel Street and curled up in the single armchair in the living room. Under the warm lamplight, she immersed herself in the vivid, down-to-earth stories of Naipaul's characters. She read slowly, sometimes closing her eyes to imagine the look of the street, and enjoyed the pure literary pleasure.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (living room sofa)

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: Closing the book and returning to the bedroom, Sun Yuwei washed up and changed into pajamas, then sat cross-legged on the bed. She played the 10-minute “Pre-Exam Relaxation” guide on her meditation app, focusing on her breathing and letting her thoughts drift away from the exam. After meditating, she did a set of bed stretches to loosen her legs and lower back.
location: At home (bedroom), Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flipping through the journal and going to sleep
description: Turning off the main light and leaving the bedside lamp on, Sun Yuwei looked through the evening notes and encouraging words in her morning diary and felt at ease. She set the alarm for 7:00 the next morning, put her phone in airplane mode, and after lying down, recalled the mind map and warm moments, took deep breaths, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: At home (bedroom), Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up, morning diary, and journal
description: Alarm went off, and you woke up from the warm bed. You did 10 minutes of free writing in bed, recording your mood before today's exam: “slightly nervous but fairly confident.” Then you took out your beloved journal and painted a vibrant asparagus fern with a green watercolor brush, writing next to it: “Today is suitable for a calm mind and a tranquil spirit; may the pen write with inspiration.” You checked your exam supplies (student ID, 2B pencil, black gel pen) and put them into the canvas bag together with your favorite fountain pen and notebook.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Breakfast and preparations before leaving
description: Your mother, Li Xiulan, has prepared steaming hot small wontons and a glass of milk for you. As you eat breakfast, you see a message your elder sister Sun Yutong sent in the family group last night: “A little surprise is on the way.” You smile knowingly but don't press for more, treating this anticipation as motivation for the exam. Before going out, you adjust your collar in the mirror, put on a light gray wool scarf, and pat some sunscreen onto your face.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk to Yunnan University
description: You set off from home and turned onto Cuihu North Road along the familiar Renmin Middle Road. The winter morning sunlight was just right, and the roadside trees cast mottled shadows in the morning light. As you walked, you silently recited lines from "Returning Home" in your mind, with light and brisk steps. At the school gate, you glanced at your phone and it was exactly 8:20.
location: Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Met up with her roommate and headed to the exam venue.
description: On the way to the Literature and History Building, you met your roommates Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen, who were also coming for the exam. The three walked side by side, quizzing each other on several key poets of ancient literature. Liu Jia recited a passage from Ruan Ji's Yonghuai Poems aloud, while Zhao Xiaowen quickly outlined the structure of Tao Yuanming's Returning Home. The little interaction before the exam eased the tense atmosphere considerably.
location: Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Took the final exam for Ancient Literature
description: You entered the exam room half an hour early and chose a seat by the window. After the papers were handed out, you calmed your mind and worked steadily from poetry dictation and famous-line analysis to the final essay question. You felt you performed normally, especially on the essay question that asked you to analyze the Wei-Jin spirit and literary self-awareness through Shishuo Xinyu; you wrote especially smoothly, as if your pen were dancing on the paper. After handing in the paper, you let out a long breath. Your shoulders and neck felt a bit tense, but your mood was light and cheerful.
location: Room 301, Wenshi Building, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Canteen lunch and relaxation
description: After the exam, the three of you went together to the Second Canteen for lunch. You ordered a steaming bowl of small-pot rice noodles with a poached egg, and the hot and sour broth instantly awakened your taste buds. While eating, you compared answers with your roommates and discussed a few uncertain multiple-choice questions. Although there were disagreements, the atmosphere was relaxed. After the meal, Liu Jia suggested walking back to the dormitory. You said you wanted to go to the library in the afternoon to review Modern Prose Studies. The three of you parted with smiles at the canteen entrance.
location: Second Cafeteria (Zeqing Hall), Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Library lunch break
description: You walked to the library and found a seat by the radiator in the quiet second-floor study area. Through the window, you could see the spire of the clock tower. After sitting down, you put on an eye mask, rested your head on the desk, and took a 20-minute nap. The hum of the radiator and the quiet outside the window quickly relaxed you, and stored up energy for the afternoon’s intense review.
location: Self-study Area, 2nd Floor, Library, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Reviewing Modern Prose Studies.
description: After waking up, you take out the class notes and textbooks for Zhu Ziqing and Liang Shiqiu and turn to the sections you marked last week. You focus on sorting out the aesthetic distinction between “leisurely prose” and “expressive prose,” and use a highlighter to mark keywords of different essayists’ language styles in your notebook. You refer to past exam questions and practice a short-answer question about the artistic features of Zhou Zuoren’s prose, listing a clear answer outline. When your head starts to feel fuzzy midway, you get up and walk to the bookshelf area, browse in front of the literature shelves, and come across a copy of Wang Zengqi’s “Plants and Trees in the Human World.” You can’t help reading for over ten minutes, and the corners of your mouth rise unconsciously.
location: Library, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: To change your mood, you choose a route to the bookstore that passes by Green Lake. On the lake in late winter, black-headed gulls still circled. You slowed down, paused by a plane tree on the shore, and watched the visitors and gulls. This brief mental break let you step out of the intensive review and breathe fresh air.
location: Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near Green Lake Park)

name: Received a gift from her older sister at Zhibushi Bookstore
description: You strolled leisurely to your familiar bookstore. Pushing the door open, a whiff of ink and coffee rushed toward you. Uncle Qin saw you and handed you a delivery package with a smile: "Yuwei, it arrived this morning. It's said to be from your sister." You took it in surprise, sat down on the sofa by the window in the small shop, and opened it. Inside was a set of premium ivory-white paper goods with fine texture and a wonderful feel, along with a simple dark-green cloisonné fountain pen. The card read "To the future writer," and it was signed by your sister, Sun Yutong. You were instantly struck by immense surprise and warmth. Happily, you took a photo and sent it to your sister and the family group, replying to your sister, "Absolutely love it!" Uncle Qin also came over to take a look and praised your sister for her excellent taste.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bookstore browsing and conversation
description: You tried the new fountain pen on the back of the greeting card and found that it wrote smoothly with just the right amount of resistance—you couldn't put it down. Then you took a turn around the bookstore and bought a newly arrived essay collection, Old Tales of Central Yunnan: A Life Portrait of a Border Town, as relaxing reading for the exam preparation period. Uncle Qin told you that a recent magazine had a good article about 'post-90s writers and regional writing about Yunnan.' He pointed out where it was, and you decided to read it carefully next time.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk back to the dormitory along Cuihu Lake
description: You carefully put the gift and the new book into a canvas bag and walked back to school along the shore of Green Lake. The setting sun spread a layer of gold leaf over the lake. You called your mom and shared the joy of receiving the gift. On the phone, your mother laughed and said, "Your sister is thoughtful," and reminded you again to go to Binhu Restaurant for mushroom hot pot together on the weekend after the exam. After hanging up, you felt warm inside.
location: Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Cuihu Lake Embankment)

name: Resting in the dormitory.
description: Back in the dormitory, Liu Jia was reading. You showed the gifts from your sister to your roommates, and they were all envious. You tidied your desk a bit, changed into comfortable loungewear, took out the insulated cup you brought from home, and drank some warm water.
location: Student dormitory, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoy dinner alone.
description: You didn't eat in the cafeteria. Instead, according to the agreement with your mother this morning, you went to Lakeside Restaurant, not far from the school. You ordered a steaming hot mushroom hot pot and a fragrant bowl of braised potato rice in a copper pot. Eating slowly on your own, you flipped through a newly bought essay collection, feeling very content and happy.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening writing and gratitude journaling
description: Back at the dorm, the roommates were each busy with their own things. You sat down at your desk and turned on the desk lamp. You spread open your journal, took out the new pen and paper goods you had received during the day, and began to write. Not only did you complete today's morning diary entry (recording the smooth exam and the gift surprise), but you also deliberately used the new pen and, with a heart full of gratitude, wrote down 'Three Good Things Today': 1. The exam went normally, and the Wei-Jin literature questions came easily. 2. My sister sent a gift for 'the future writer'—what a delightful surprise. 3. In winter, Cuihu Lake has beautiful red-billed gulls and sunset.
location: Student dormitory, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga stretching and body relaxation.
description: You unrolled the yoga mat. You didn't go to the yoga studio today, but you sat too long in the library this afternoon, and your shoulders, neck, and back were a bit sore. You opened the yoga music app on your phone and did a simple 10-minute stretch: Cat-Cow to relax the spine, Child's Pose to rest, Downward-Facing Dog for deeper stretching, and left-right stretches for the shoulders and neck. The campus outside the window gradually quieted, and the tension from the exam slowly released from your body with each breath.
location: Student dormitory, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Personal reading and wash-up routine before bed.
description: After stretching, your body felt much lighter, and you took a comfortable hot bath. Then, leaning against the bed, you continued reading the newly purchased essay collection about Yunnan folk customs. When you reached the passage describing the old streets of Weishan Ancient City, your mind wandered with longing. Now and then, you used the new fountain pen to make small marks in the margins and jot down a few random thoughts. Before bed, you set an alarm for tomorrow at 07:00 and saw a WeChat message from editor Xu Mingyuan saying 'Good luck on the exam.' You replied with a happy emoji.
location: Student dormitory, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and bedtime
description: You turned off the overhead light and left on only a small warm-yellow desk lamp. You put on your earphones and did a 5-minute bedtime meditation, focusing on your breath and clearing your mind. Fragments from the day flashed through your mind: the prose you had reviewed, the black-headed gulls at Green Lake, the feel of the pen sliding across the paper, and Uncle Qin’s warm smile. With the relief of letting go and the warmth of your sister’s care, you put down your phone before 23:00 and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Student dormitory, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and prepare for the exam.
description: The alarm went off, and Ryuichi Sakamoto's piano piece woke me. It was already bright outside the window. I got out of bed quietly while my roommate was still fast asleep. After washing up, I tied my hair into a ponytail, checked my student ID, two black ballpoint pens, spare refills, and watch, and put the Writer's Notebook, which might be helpful for the exam, back on the bookshelf. I put on a gray hoodie and a dark blue down vest to handle the temperature difference between Kunming's mornings and evenings.
location: Dormitory Building 4, Huayuan, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast
description: Alone, she went to the first floor of Zhiweitang, ordered a steaming hot mushroom and pork bun, a boiled egg, and a cup of freshly ground soy milk. Sitting by the window, she silently reviewed the chapters of Lu Xun's "Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk" while eating, giving herself a final mental warm-up for the exam.
location: First Floor, Zhiwei Hall, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-exam review
description: Arrived early at Wenhui Building, opened my notes in small classroom 2201, quickly reviewed the core styles of prose writers such as Zhou Zuoren, Zhu Ziqing, Lin Yutang, and Liang Shiqiu, and mentally rehearsed the logical framework for answering questions.
location: Room 2201, Building 2, Wenhui Building, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Modern Prose Studies exam
description: The exam started on time. The paper had essay questions and text analysis questions. One analysis question asked to combine Lu Xun's "From Baicao Garden to Sanwei Study" and Zhu Ziqing's "The Back" to analyze the differences in lyrical techniques. I thought of Lu Xun's cold restraint and Zhu Ziqing's warm sincerity, had clear ideas, filled the answer sheet, and handed it in fifteen minutes early after carefully checking.
location: Room 2205, Wenhui Building No. 2, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-exam discussion and returning to the dormitory
description: After leaving the exam hall, I discussed the difficulty of the exam and holiday plans with classmates Li Xiang and Wang Yue in the corridor. I saw my roommate Zhao Xiaowen coming out of the next exam room, and we smiled at each other. Then I walked back alone to Huayuan Dormitory. The campus sunlight was just right, the lawn was turning green, and the early cherry blossoms were swelling into buds; I felt a sense of relief. Back in the dorm, I put down my schoolbag and picked up my phone and wallet.
location: Corridor of Wenhui Building 2 and campus roads, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Roommates had a meal together to celebrate the end of exams
description: Met up with Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin downstairs at the dormitory. The four of us walked to 'Deep Alley Kitchen' on Wujiaying Subdistrict, behind the school gate, and ordered the signature small-pot rice noodles, fried potatoes, mixed black fungus salad, stir-fried pork with pickled cabbage, and Lijiang cured pork rib hot pot. As we ate, we chatted about holiday plans: Liu Jia planned to reserve a seat for postgraduate exam preparation, Zhao Xiaowen shared her excitement about her publishing house internship, Zhou Lin planned to return to her hometown in Hunan, and I excitedly told them about my plan to gather creative inspiration from 'The Four Seasons of Green Lake', taking photos with my phone of everyone laughing and messing around.
location: Deep Alley Kitchen, Wujiaying Subdistrict, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and socializing
description: After eating her fill, she slowly walked back to the dormitory, changed out of her coat, sent her sister Sun Yutong a WeChat message saying the exam was over and she felt relaxed, and messaged Uncle Qin at the bookstore to arrange a meeting in a couple of days. Then she made a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea. While drinking it, she scrolled through Moments, saw an article about independent bookstores shared by Zhang Jing, commented that she had just finished the exam and would get coffee another day, and replied to several classmates' discussions of the exam questions.
location: Dormitory Building 4, Huayuan, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon Documentary Viewing and Inspiration Notes
description: After packing my schoolbag, I put on headphones and played the documentary 'The Inspired Island' on my laptop. The film's perspective on urban flâneurs instantly made me think of the Green Lake idea, so I paused the video and wrote in my phone's memo: 'Urban writing = familiar strangeness; familiar scenery rediscovered with a defamiliarizing gaze.' In the second episode, the scene of a writer taking a late-night walk reminded me of my plan to go for an evening walk, and a tender feeling welled up in my heart.
location: Dormitory Building 4, Huayuan, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (at the desk)

name: Post-exam socializing and online shopping.
description: After watching the documentary, she had a detailed chat with Zhang Jing about how she felt after the exam, and agreed to meet for coffee at Zhibushi Bookstore on Saturday at 2 p.m. She checked Uncle Qin's WeChat; he had sent a smiley face and said that several new books suitable for her had arrived. She replied to her elder sister with a voice message asking what the couriered gift was, and her elder sister teased her to wait for the surprise. She also placed an order on Taobao for the essay collection "Take the Zither and Sing", which had been sitting in her shopping cart for a long time, as a post-exam gift to herself.
location: Dormitory Building 4, Huayuan, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening campus walk and dinner
description: In the evening, I went out with Zhao Xiaowen, walked along the ginkgo path, our long shadows stretched by the setting sun, and took a photo together in front of the library, recalling how we got lost when we first arrived as freshmen. We walked around Ze Lake, chatting about fun memories from four years of college: skipping classes to see film festivals and spring outings, with a faint sense of parting. We took silhouettes of the teaching buildings with our phones. Afterwards, we went to the second floor of Zhiweitang, where we each ordered a bowl of tomato-and-egg noodles and a portion of cucumber salad. While eating, we talked about her upcoming internship at a publishing house. I asked whether proofreading was tiring, and she made a 'painful but happy' expression, saying it was fun because she could read many manuscripts.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Ginkgo Avenue, in front of the library, Ze Lake), then to the second floor of Zhiwei Hall.

name: Evening free writing and yoga relaxation
description: Back in the dormitory, I drew today's mood curve in my journal and marked the highest points at 'exams finished' and 'group dinner.' Then I organized the documentary's memorable lines and the ideas from the Cuihu trip into subheadings: 'The Familiar Strangeness—How to Observe Cuihu Lake,' 'Sketches of People by the Lake,' and 'Sound Map.' Inspiration surged like grass shoots after rain. After that, I unrolled my yoga mat and did Cat-Cow, Child's Pose, and Pyramid Pose to relax, easing the tightness in my lower back from sitting through exams, and enjoyed my breath and body's stretch in the sunset glow.
location: Dormitory Building 4, Huayuan, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reflection, reading, and falling asleep
description: Sitting back at the desk, she opened the 'Morning Diary' template in her journal and rated her emotional temperature 8.5. She wrote down her post-exam feelings: 'The exam is over, like waking up from a long dream. The laughter of the dinner gathering, the footprints across campus, and the inspiration for the documentary all made today full.' She attached a Polaroid print of the dinner photos. After washing up, she leaned against the headboard and video-called her older sister, learning that the gift would be delivered tomorrow by SF Express. After hanging up, she flipped through over a dozen pages of creative notes for 'Breathing at the Edge of the City' and sketched out the autumn scene of Green Lake. Turning off the bedside lamp, she put on earphones and listened to classical guitar music, and added a reminder on her phone calendar for tomorrow's field-trip preparation. Around 21:30, she fell asleep peacefully amid the chirping of insects and music, dreaming of the rustle of ginkgo leaves and the scent of ink from a new book.
location: Dormitory Building 4, Huayuan, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and diary writing
description: The phone alarm rang, and Sun Yuwei slowly opened her eyes. Kunming's winter sunlight was already streaming through the gap in the curtains, carrying warmth. After washing up, she sat down at her desk in a beige knit cardigan, opened her morning journal, and wrote down her expectations for today's exam and her feelings about the beginning of a new journey.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the cafeteria to enjoy breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei grabbed her campus card and canvas bag and walked five minutes to Ziyuan Canteen. She ordered a steaming bowl of small-pot rice noodles with a rich broth, pickled vegetables, and minced pork—the best energy boost for exam day. As she ate, she silently reviewed key concepts of literary theory one last time, feeling relaxed.
location: From the rice noodle window on the first floor of Ziyuan Canteen, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the canteen seats

name: Pre-exam preparation and traveling to the test center
description: Returned to the dormitory to rinse her mouth, packed the exam essentials: pencil case, student ID, and water bottle. Walking out of the dormitory building, the cool air was refreshing. She walked along the main campus road for about 8 minutes toward Wenhui Building, where the exam was held. On the way she met her classmate Liu Jia, and they encouraged each other and agreed to celebrate with hotpot after the exam.
location: From Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Building 3, Wenhui Building

name: Taking the Literary Theory final exam
description: After the exam bell rang, Sun Yuwei quickly scanned the test paper and found that most of the questions were within the reviewed scope, so she answered them calmly. For the essay question, she combined “The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons” with her own creative writing experience, producing a smooth and effortless piece. She finished checking 20 minutes early, verified her personal information, and handed in the paper at exactly 10:40, feeling that everything was complete and satisfactory.
location: Room 3207, Building 3, Wenhui Building, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Group photo after the exam, returning, and signing for the package
description: After walking out of the exam hall, Sun Yuwei took a group photo on the steps in front of the teaching building with classmates Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, Zhou Lin, and others, commemorating the successful end of the first semester of their junior year. She then walked back to the dormitory, showed her pickup code at the parcel station on the ground floor, and signed for a heavy cardboard box from Shenzhen, sent by her elder sister. Clutching the parcel, she quickly went upstairs.
location: From the square in front of Wenhui Building at Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the express delivery station downstairs of Ziyuan Dormitory

name: Opening the package, trying the gift, and thanking her sister
description: Back at her desk, Sun Yuwei carefully opened the seal and found a set of white handmade paper goods with a warm, smooth texture, and an elegant black gift box containing a fountain pen with a smooth, warm barrel. What touched her most was a handwritten card: “To the future writer, may you breathe on paper — Sister.” She immediately took out new ink to try the pen. The nib was smooth and fluid, and she wrote, “January 15, sunny, today I received love and gifts.” Then she photographed the gift box, the card, and the test writing and sent them to her sister, along with a voice message: “Sis! I got it!! I love it so much! The pen writes so smoothly! Thank you for the surprise!” Soon she received her sister’s reply: “So glad you like it! We’ll talk more when you’re home. Enjoy your holiday~”
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch get-together with roommates
description: In high spirits, Sun Yuwei went downstairs to meet Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin. The four of them headed to the Deep Alley Kitchen restaurant outside the school's east gate, ordered stir-fried pork set meals, and excitedly discussed winter break plans while eating—from binge-watching shows to traveling, with laughter all the way.
location: Alley Deep Kitchen Restaurant outside the East Gate of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and desk tidying
description: After lunch, back in the dormitory, Sun Yuwei felt a little sleepy. She leaned against the headboard, put on earphones, and listened to light music for 15 minutes to let her mind fully relax. When she got up, she neatly put away the new paper and fountain pen her sister had given her, and stacked the scattered review materials on the desk into a pile, leaving a clean desktop for the next day's creative writing workshop.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Registered for the online prose writing workshop
description: Sun Yuwei opened her computer, pulled up the registration link for Prose magazine from her bookmarks, carefully filled in her name, school, and contact information, and briefly described her writing experience in the “Creative Experience” field. After submitting successfully, she immediately received a confirmation email. Following the prompts, she downloaded the Tencent Meeting client, tested her camera and microphone, and saved the meeting link and password in her phone's memos.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidy up the dormitory and share college memories
description: Sun Yuwei began tidying up her wardrobe and desk, preparing to take some luggage home tomorrow. From the depths of a drawer she pulled out an old dorm photo of the four of them looking young and shy from freshman year. She couldn't help smiling and immediately sent it to the dorm group chat. The group instantly exploded; everyone started frantically @-ing each other, reminiscing about military training mishaps and their first late-night chat, and agreed to go eat barbecue at the back gate of the school one more time tomorrow evening before going home.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Contact the editor to discuss the submission plan
description: Sun Yuwei sent a WeChat message to her editor Xu Mingyuan, reporting that her exams were over and asking about the direction for winter-break submissions: "Teacher Xu, I've finished my exams. I'd like to use the winter break to write a set of essays about Kunming's winter streets and alleys. Does this topic direction work?" She quickly received a reply: "Very good! One or two pieces, submit one by the end of the month. I look forward to your new work." She replied with a "Got it" sticker, with a clear goal in mind.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Changing clothes to get ready for the appointment.
description: Sun Yuwei put on a warm pair of fleece-lined jeans and a light blue woolen coat. Considering it might get colder in the evening, she brought an extra scarf, checked her phone, power bank, and wallet, and sent Li Haoran a message on WeChat: 'I'm heading out, see you in a bit!'
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to Firepit Tribe Restaurant.
description: Sun Yuwei walked about 15 minutes, through the east gate of the campus, to the Fire Pit Tribe Yunnan restaurant on Wenlin Street near the school. On the way, she received Li Haoran's reply: Got it! Waiting for you!
location: Along the route from the East Gate of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, to the Fire Pit Tribe Restaurant at No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China.

name: Gathering with old classmates
description: When Sun Yuwei arrived, Li Haoran was already seated; then Zhang Yang and Chen Qian also arrived. Everyone ordered specialties such as sour soup pig trotters, fried rushan cheese, and stir-fried mixed mushrooms, and caught up on each other’s news—Haoran’s life as a Shenzhen drifter, Zhang Yang’s postgraduate entrance exam preparation, and Chen Qian’s internship experience. The atmosphere was lively, and laughter was nonstop. She also took a few group photos to mark the rare time together.
location: Huotang Tribe Yunnan Cuisine Restaurant, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked back to school and said goodbye.
description: When the gathering ended, it was already dark and the streetlights were on. Sun Yuwei said goodbye to several classmates at the school gate. Li Haoran said he would come back to Kunming the day after tomorrow to find her. She walked alone along the campus path back to the dormitory. The evening breeze was pleasant, and she felt steady and content. Passing by Ze Lake, she saw the dormitory lights reflected in the water.
location: On the Yunnan University campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening diary, holiday planning, and contacting Mom
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, Sun Yuwei took out the fountain pen and notebook her sister had given her, and with a strong sense of ceremony wrote the opening of her diary: 'Received a romantic gesture from my family, completed an exam about growing up, and kept a promise to attend a cross-city gathering. January 15, 2025 is an ending, and even more, a beginning.' Then she turned on her computer and used a document to list her winter break writing plan: finish the first draft of the manuscript in the first week, start organizing the outline of the essay collection in the second week, and prepare the questions for tomorrow's workshop. After that, she sent a WeChat message to her mother: 'Mom, after I finish my exam tomorrow at noon, I'll take the subway back and get home around two ~ I want to eat the sweet and sour ribs you make!' Her mother replied instantly: 'Great! Be safe on the way, and send me a WeChat message when you get home.' The simple exchange warmed her heart.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga Stretching and Meditation
description: Sun Yuwei spread her yoga mat on the dorm floor, turned off phone notifications, and spent 15 minutes doing a gentle set of shoulder, neck, and spine stretches, releasing the fatigue of the day. Then she sat cross-legged, opened a meditation app, and did a 5-minute breathing meditation following the guide, letting her thoughts settle.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading and bedtime preparation
description: Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard, opened the essay collection "Taking the Zither and Singing," and read an essay about a rainy night in the South. The writing was delicate, and she felt a strong resonance. At 22:00, she put down the book, put on a steam eye mask, set the alarm for 7:30, turned off the desk lamp, and fell into a deep sleep with happiness and contentment.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Deep sleep
description: After lights out, Sun Yuwei soon fell into a deep sleep, listening to the occasional sound of vehicles outside the window and the lights of distant dormitory buildings. A new chapter of the winter break would begin when she woke up the next morning.
location: Room 316, Building 6, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Sun Yuwei's bedside alarm clock rang on time. She sat up from the warm bedclothes and saw the familiar neighborhood scene and the faint winter light outside the window. She put on comfortable coral fleece loungewear, went to the bathroom to wash her face, letting the cold water fully wake herself up, and was full of anticipation for today's return home and the evening workshop.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning journal and breakfast
description: Mom had already prepared breakfast: steaming white congee, golden fried eggs, and a small plate of Qiaojia pickled vegetables. Yuwei sat down at the dining table, took out her phone, opened the "Morning Diary" app, and quickly recorded: "Day 15. Exam week is over. Going home today, I feel a strange sense of ritual. I'm looking forward to the workshop tonight, and I hope I can learn something real from Teacher Chen." Then she ate and chatted with her mom about the afternoon plans.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pack up personal belongings
description: After breakfast, she returned to her room. Last night she had roughly packed the things she needed to bring back to school. Now she checked again: campus card, dormitory key, phone, power bank, earphones, a brand-new blank A6 journal, and her favorite Platinum fountain pen, which she had received from her sister. She put them all into her everyday canvas tote bag, feeling eager for today's writing.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take the bus to Chenggong Campus
description: She took Bus K38 from the "Cuihu North Road" stop near home, a ride of about one hour and ten minutes. Yuwei found a window seat, put on her earphones, and looped the soundtrack of "Little Forest," which she had been listening to recently. She closed her eyes and silently rehearsed in her mind the topic of the evening workshop, thinking about how to ask meaningful questions under the theme of "City and Private Memory."
location: On the K38 bus from Cuihu North Road Bus Stop to Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidy up dormitory luggage and say goodbye to roommates
description: Back in the dormitory, all three roommates were there. Everyone chatted while neatly packing their things: books, clothes, bedding, and toiletries. Zhou Lin took out the big group photo from the day before yesterday, and the dorm burst into laughter again as they recalled embarrassing moments from freshman military training. Zhao Xiaowen suggested taking a few sillier group photos to post to the shared album. Finally, Yuwei tidied her bed and pushed her suitcase to the corner, planning to take it home after lunch.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South Outer Ring East Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Farewell lunch with roommates
description: The four of them walked to their usual spot, Deep Alley Wine House on Zhenghe Road outside the school, a small restaurant known for its home-style dishes. They ordered salt-and-pepper mushrooms, steam-pot chicken, stir-fried porcini mushrooms, and vegetable soup. As they ate and chatted, the mood was tinged with even more reluctance than when exams ended. Yuwei explained in advance that she couldn't join the evening barbecue because she had a workshop at night; her roommates understood and told her to send lots of photos during the holiday. Finally, they split the bill equally and agreed to meet again in the first week of the semester.
location: Deep Alley Brewery, Zhenghe Road, outside University Town, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take the bus back to the city center and stop by the bookstore on the way
description: After saying goodbye to her roommate, Yuwei took her suitcase and boarded the bus back to the city at Ziyuan Bus Stop. She got off at the 'Cuihu North Road' stop and walked two minutes with her suitcase. The familiar 'Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore' came into view. She pushed the door open, and the wind chime rang crisply. The owner, Uncle Qin, sat behind the counter reading with reading glasses. Yuwei smiled and greeted him, briefly chatting about the relief after finishing exams. She quickly browsed the shelves in the literature section, picked out a book by Zhang Yiwei, 'The Stillness of Old Days', and paid.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the bus rides there and back.

name: Walk home and put the luggage away.
description: Coming out of the bookstore, Yuwei dragged her suitcase and walked 10 minutes back to her home in Cuihu Community. She put the books and suitcase in the corner of the room, quickly changed into loungewear, and felt completely relaxed. Her mother had left lunch for her, and she ate less than half a bowl of rice and a few bites of vegetables.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and organizing new stationery
description: She took a 20-minute nap in bed, which relieved the fatigue from the morning's running around. After getting up, she brewed a cup of Dianhong. She walked to her desk and carefully took out the handmade paper set and fountain pen her older sister had given her. She tore open the paper's packaging; the paper felt warm and smooth to the touch. Filling the new fountain pen with ink, she wrote the dormitory room number 'Ziyuan 1314' on the paper. The strokes were fluid, the ink did not bleed, and the feel of the pen satisfied her greatly.
location: Bedroom and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Thematic reading and workshop preview
description: She opened her laptop and browsed again through the email from the editorial department of Prose magazine, which contained an excerpt from Teacher Chen Si'an's representative work Shanghai Fortress and a writing outline. As she read, she jotted down a few core ideas in her notebook with her new fountain pen: “The tension of detail lies in the balance between the concrete and the abstract.” Drawing on what she had seen at the bookstore that afternoon, she thought about how to apply this theory to her own writing.
