location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free creation: an essay on returning home.
description: Closing the preview materials, she took out the new handmade paper item and decided to use it to write today's first essay. She wrote from the morning light to the bus, from saying goodbye at the dormitory to idly browsing in the bookstore, from the touch of the new fountain pen to the gradually darkening sky outside the window. The writing was natural and fluent, and she felt her thoughts slowly growing with the movement of the pen—a long-missed flow state that belonged to her as a creator.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Mom came home from work, and Yuwei took the initiative to help her in the kitchen, peeling garlic and picking vegetables. At the dinner table, she shared with her mother all the details of returning to school today: funny stories from her roommates, the dishes she ate, and the joy of finding new books at the bookstore. Her mother also looked forward to the evening workshop, and Yuwei said, 'I will ask serious questions!' After the meal, she cleared the dishes and washed them on her own.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Workshop equipment and mindset preparation
description: Half an hour before the workshop started. Yuwei checked the laptop's battery, microphone, and camera. She opened Tencent Meeting and changed her display name to "Sun Yuwei - Yunnan University - Department of Chinese." She flipped through the essay she had just written to confirm the direction she most wanted to ask about. She placed her notebook, pen, and a glass of warm water beside the computer, took three deep breaths, and calmed herself into a learning state.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attended the online creative writing workshop 'Capturing Details in Urban Essays'.
description: The meeting began. Chen Si'an showed up on time and shared how she captured material from the patterns of street lamps, the smells of the food market, and the words and actions of her neighbors. Yuwei listened with great concentration, nodding and quickly writing down a golden quote in her notebook: 'Details are not decoration; they are the skeleton.' When Ms. Chen showed a photo of a Shanghai alleyway and said, 'Concreteness is the only way to resist forgetting,' Yuwei couldn't help typing '+1' in the chat box.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online via Tencent Meeting)

name: Discussing creative struggles with writer Chen Si'an
description: After the workshop ended and it was time for open discussion, Yuwei took a deep breath and clicked "Raise Hand." The host invited her to speak. Her voice was slightly trembling but clear: "Hello, Teacher Chen! I'm Sun Yuwei from Kunming. You mentioned in class that 'private emotions need to be connected with public experience,' but sometimes when I write about the osmanthus fragrance along Cuihu Lake, it's very personal, and I'm afraid readers won't empathize. How should I strike the right balance?" Teacher Chen appreciated her question and suggested she could start from personal feelings, then introduce dimensions of seasons, rhythms, and changes in local life, so that personal feelings could have a shared cultural coordinate.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online via Tencent Meeting)

name: Washing up, journaling, and stretching before bed
description: After the meeting, Yuwei excitedly ran to the bathroom to wash up. She changed into pajamas and lay in bed, eagerly opening her new diary and neatly writing down the two biggest takeaways of the evening with her new fountain pen: “Asking good questions is more important than getting answers” and “The publicness of details lies in finding an anchor for resonance.” Then she got out of bed, unrolled her yoga mat, and did Cat-Cow Pose and Child's Pose for 10 minutes to relax her neck and shoulders, combined with abdominal breathing, letting her mood settle.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shared insights with her mother and planned the winter vacation
description: Mom hadn't gone to bed yet and was reading in the living room. Yuwei walked over, sat down beside her on the sofa, and excitedly shared the highlights of the workshop and the details of her conversation with Teacher Chen. She talked with lively gestures, and Mom listened with a smile and encouraged her, saying that the questions she asked were thoughtful and that she should keep writing well during the holiday—Mom supported her. They also talked about winter vacation plans, such as going to Zhibushi Bookstore twice a week and whether to go for a night run around Cuihu Lake.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Turn off the lights and rest.
description: Yuwei returned to her bedroom, turned off the light, and drew the curtains. Outside, the Kunming night was quiet. Lying in bed, the details of the day—the laughter in the dorm, the smell of ink in the bookstore, the feel of a fountain pen gliding across the paper, and the affirmation she received at the workshop—surrounded her like a warm tide. She felt extremely calm and content, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparations
description: At seven, the phone alarm rang. After waking up, I felt the soft winter morning light outside the window in Kunming, picked up "The Stillness of Old Days" from the bedside, and touched its cover. Then I got up and opened the curtains. By the bed, I did some simple shoulder and neck stretches and cat-cow breathing to wake up my body, then went to the bathroom to brush my teeth and wash my face, and changed into a comfortable set of loungewear.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Had breakfast with Mom and tidied up afterward

The two chatted about the day's plans while eating. After breakfast, she took the initiative to clear the tableware, washed the dishes in the kitchen, and tidied the dining table with her mother, making room for the next round of chores.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Household tidying and Spring Festival decoration preparation
description: Cleaned the living room and storage room with her mother, dug out old Spring Festival decorations such as couplets, window paper-cuts, and Chinese knots, and used a phone note app to record a list of items that needed to be replenished: gold-foil Spring Festival couplets, window paper-cuts, small lantern ornaments, red string, etc., and made a preliminary decoration plan. During this time, she took a short break, drank half a glass of warm water, and confirmed Friday's calendar.
location: Living room and storage room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sorting through workshop notes and writing
description: In the study, organized the sketch notes from last night's writing workshop, added Teacher Chen Si'an's remarks about detail, opened a document on the computer, and wrote a reflection essay titled 'The Capillaries of Detail,' about 800 words, blending her understanding of urban prose.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-lunch chat, family lunch, and noon break
description: Chatted with mother in the living room and helped her prepare vegetables, then had lunch with my parents. Dishes included shredded potatoes with green peppers, steamed pork with rice flour, and vegetable soup. Shared household findings and workshop takeaways, and agreed to go buy New Year goods in the afternoon. After the meal, I cleared the dishes and leaned back on the sofa for a short rest of about ten minutes.
location: China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Green Lake Community, home living room and dining room

name: Study organization and writing area revamp
description: After the lunch break, I tidied the study, sorted and stored textbooks and thesis materials, cleaned and wiped the desk, adjusted the desk lamp, and replaced it with a soft-light LED lamp. I set aside a shelf specifically for essay collections to read during the winter vacation, such as works by Zhang Yiwei, Shu Guozhi, and Wang Zengqi. I feel excited about the study corner.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: She put on a navy blue woolen coat, wrapped her scarf, checked the items in her bag (phone, keys, wallet, notebook), and left the house with her mother. They walked along Renmin Middle Road toward Cuihu South Road, chatting about gossip about her mother's colleagues and her own winter vacation writing plans.
location: Along the route from Renmin Middle Road to Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: New Year goods shopping and saying goodbye to her mother
description: At the New Year goods market on Cuihu South Road, I picked out Spring Festival couplets, window paper-cuts, small chili pepper ornaments, and Chinese knots. I also bought a pack of red cord, red cardstock, and craft scissors to use at home for making traditional Chinese knots and cutting window paper-cuts. After shopping, my mother carried the New Year goods and headed home first, while I said goodbye and prepared to go to Zhibushi Bookstore.
location: Spring Festival goods market on Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and reflections at the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore
description: She went alone to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. After greeting the owner, Uncle Qin, she picked out a copy of Yunnan Local Records, ordered a peach oolong tea, and sat down in a window corner to read The Serenity of Old Days. When a passage touched her, she used a portable notebook and a new fountain pen to jot down reflections, enjoying the quiet time in the bookstore.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking and birdwatching at Green Lake Park
description: Walked from the bookstore to Green Lake Park, admired the black-headed gulls circling over the lake in the sunset, sat on a bench and felt the winter tranquility, replied to best friend Zhang Jing's message, and agreed to meet at the bookstore at 2 p.m. tomorrow.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home and buy some bread
description: After leaving Cuihu Park, I walked home along the road. Passing the bakery at the intersection of Cuihu South Road and Renmin Middle Road, I was drawn in by the aroma, bought two whole-wheat walnut buns for the next morning's breakfast, and then returned home.
location: Bakery at the intersection of Cuihu South Road and Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the way home

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Had dinner with her parents. On the table was a tomato-and-egg hot pot made by her mother. She showed the New Year goods bought in the afternoon, and her father praised that the festive atmosphere was growing stronger. After dinner, she voluntarily cleared the dishes and wiped the kitchen counter.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Contacted friends online
description: In the study, I sent a voice message to my best friend Zhang Jing to confirm meeting at Zhibushi Bookstore tomorrow at 2 p.m., and suggested going to a newly opened milk tea shop afterwards. I also messaged my friend Sisi to ask for watercolor paint recommendations, planning to try small illustrations in my journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Creative journal making.
description: She used washi tape to paste materials such as the writing workshop ticket, a red-string sample from the New Year goods stall, a bookstore bookmark, and a fallen leaf from Green Lake into her journal, and used her new pen to record the day's mood, sensing the groundedness of the first day of winter vacation as she rebuilt her daily routine.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening yoga and meditation
description: Spread out the yoga mat in the living room, follow a video on your phone for a 15-minute vinyasa flow yoga practice, including sun salutations and twisting poses, then sit cross-legged for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on breathing and relaxing the body and mind.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bath and preparation before bed
description: Took a hot shower to relieve fatigue, dried my hair, applied body lotion, reviewed the day while brushing my teeth in front of the bathroom mirror, and changed into comfortable pajamas.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and journaling before bed.
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp, and read 'The Stillness of Old Days' while leaning against the bed, savoring Zhang Yiwei's calm and delicate prose. Afterward, I used my diary to record today's mood and expectations for tomorrow, then put the diary back in the drawer.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: She turned off the desk lamp, closed her eyes with a relaxed, satisfied feeling, and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning breakfast and organizing New Year goods
description: After getting up and washing up in the morning, she enjoyed a small-pot rice noodle breakfast with her mother Li Xiulan, chatting about today's plans while eating. After the meal, she helped sort and organize the Spring Festival couplets, window paper-cuts, and red chili pepper ornaments bought yesterday, and took close-up photos with her phone as journal material. Then she checked the camera battery and SD card capacity, refilled her new fountain pen with ink, prepared her canvas bag, packed a notebook, 'Yunnan Scenery and Customs', and earphones, and changed into canvas shoes ready to go out.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Home)

name: Going to Green Lake Park to gather inspiration
description: Starting from home, she walked along Renmin Middle Road to Green Lake Park, listening to Accusefive's songs and using her phone to photograph the bougainvillea on the old walls. After entering the park, she walked along the lakeside path watching black-headed gulls, then picked up her mirrorless camera to capture candid shots of morning exercisers doing tai chi and a young mother pushing a stroller. On a bench, she used her new fountain pen to record inspirations in her notebook, such as the detail of a gull's wing skimming the water and throwing up droplets. Then she walked to the Mid-Lake Pavilion, where she sketched the pavilion and the distant silhouette of the Yunnan Military Academy. After observing the vivid scene of a child feeding the gulls and taking a burst of photos, she sat quietly for twenty minutes, savoring the calm of the lake.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Eat tofu pudding rice noodles.
description: Feeling hungry after the outing, I went to the usual snack shop at the entrance of Cuihu Park and ordered a bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles. The tofu pudding was silky and tender, the rice noodles were springy and chewy, and with the special chili oil drizzled on top, it tasted wonderful. While eating, I used the memo app on my phone to jot down the fragments of inspiration I'd just had, gathering material for the afternoon's prose writing.
location: Snack shop at No. 4, Annex 7, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market
description: Walk to the Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, and according to the list in the phone memo, buy kale and baby mustard greens, and deliberately look for green-headed mushrooms. Chat with Aunt Zhao, the vegetable seller I know well; she recommends the freshest green-headed mushrooms and teaches me how to stir-fry them. After carefully selecting the vegetables, take photos with the camera of a basket of brightly colored mushrooms, then leave contentedly carrying a cloth bag.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home and have a family lunch
description: From the market, she walked home along Zhuantang Road and Renmin Middle Road. On the way, she passed a stationery store and picked out several greeting cards to mail to her elder sister in Shenzhen. After arriving home, she excitedly handed the green-headed mushrooms to her mother, Li Xiulan. Lunch was stir-fried choy sum, tomato and scrambled eggs, and last night's braised pork belly. At the table, she shared what she had seen at Cuihu and funny stories from the market. After lunch, she returned to the study, leaned back on the bean bag chair by the window, and continued reading Yunnan Local Records. Sunlight streamed through the glass onto the pages.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Home)

name: Meeting close friends at Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Walked to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore; on the way, received a message from best friend Zhang Jing saying she was already at the bookstore. After arriving, Zhang Jing had already ordered peach oolong tea. They high-fived, shared the seagull photos taken that morning, flipped through newly bought journal stickers and stamps together, and talked about recent reading. At the counter, they greeted Uncle Qin, the bookstore owner, who handed over newly arrived literary magazines and mentioned there was a new work by a favorite author inside. Yuwei shared the news that editor Xu Mingyuan had invited her to write an article about the changing wet markets. Uncle Qin encouraged her to write well. After setting a time for tomorrow's sharing session with Zhang Jing, they said goodbye.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home and organize photo materials
description: Leaving the bookstore, she walked home along Cuihu North Road and Renmin Middle Road. The afternoon sunlight was warm and soft, and she bought a croissant at a roadside bakery as a snack. After arriving home, she greeted her mother, who was watching a TV drama in the living room, then went straight into the study. She imported the photos from the camera SD card into her computer. After selecting a set of her favorite shots of seagulls spreading their wings, lake reflections, and pavilion sketches, she browsed the writing materials and creative writing workshop notes she had organized before, connected the fragments of inspiration from the morning with her previous reflections, and decided to write an essay about capture and farewell using seagulls as the point of entry.
location: The study at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Create the first draft of the prose piece 'Farewell, Seagulls'.
description: Focused on writing in the study, with fingers flying over the keyboard, she completed a draft of about 2,000 characters for the essay "Farewell, Seagulls" in one go. At the end, she noted the tentative title "Breath at the City's Edge," but thought "Farewell, Seagulls" was more fitting, like a solemn goodbye. After writing, she opened her journal, pasted in the printed photo of a seagull, and wrote down the day's thoughts in colored pen: every seagull's wing is an old dream scattered by the wind.
location: The study at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Short rest and family dinner
description: After finishing her writing, she stood up, went to the window to stretch her neck and shoulders, drank some water, and rested, hearing her parents chatting in the kitchen. At dinner, her father Sun Mingyuan also came home. Her mother used the qingtou mushrooms bought that morning to make stir-fried mushrooms, along with braised pork belly and stir-fried choy sum. The atmosphere at the table was warm. Yuwei showed her father the photos of seagulls and the market on her camera and recounted the day's experiences. Her mother mentioned that she would attend a sharing event at Mingyuan Bookstore the next day, her tone full of pride.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Home)

name: Received a request for a contribution from the editor.
description: Just as she was clearing the dishes, her phone vibrated. Editor Xu Mingyuan sent a WeChat message asking if she was interested in writing a short article about the changes in food markets around the Spring Festival in Kunming, about 1,500 words, with a relaxed style full of everyday life. Yuwei excitedly replied immediately to accept and jotted down the inspiration in her phone memo.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Home)

name: Preparing for the Mingyuan Bookstore sharing session.
description: Back in the study, she turned on her computer to further polish the speaking outline for tomorrow's 2025 Reading Plan sharing session at Mingyuan Bookstore. She flipped through selected passages from the essay collection 'Breathing at the Edge of the City' and her January reading notes, and distilled three core sharing points: how to capture details from daily life; how reading nourishes writing; and the cultural significance behind the transformation of a food market. She then cleverly incorporated the inspiration from Editor Xu's article assignment into the third point, marked it with a highlighter, and wrote a transition sentence.
location: The study at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga and meditation
description: After turning off the computer, she stretched and changed into loose athletic wear, laid out her yoga mat in the bedroom, and opened the yoga app on her phone. Following the video, she completed a 15-minute flow yoga session, focusing on stretching the backs of her legs and her back to relieve the soreness from walking more than 15,000 steps during the day. Afterward, she sat cross-legged on the mat for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, breathing deeply, gathering the day's scattered thoughts and slowly letting them go, feeling calm and fulfilled.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and preparing hot milk
description: After yoga, I went into the bathroom and took a warm shower to wash away the day's fatigue. Then I went to the kitchen and made myself a cup of hot milk. Carrying the milk into the bedroom, I left only the bedside lamp on to prepare for bedtime reading.
location: Bathroom and kitchen, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening reading and journal keeping
description: Curled up at the head of the bed, she opened Zhang Yiwei's The Serene Stillness of Old Days and immersed herself in the calm, contemplative prose for about half an hour. After closing the book, she took out her beloved journal and new pen, wrote a mood journal entry for the day, pasted in photos of the window paper-cuts she had taken in the morning, a ticket stub from Green Lake Park, and the packaging label of the greenhead mushrooms from Zhuanxin Market, and wrote this reflection: the sky was as blue as a piece of clean glazed glass; seagulls, the market, words, and friends—this was an ordinary yet radiant day of winter vacation.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: She closed her journal, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, placed tomorrow's speaking outline and canvas bag in a prominent spot on her desk, and checked the weather forecast—it would be sunny. She changed into cotton pajamas, turned off the bedside lamp, and after lying down, put on her earphones and randomly played “Give You a Bottle of Magic Potion” by Accusefive, letting the day's scenes replay in her mind: seagulls skimming across the lake, the laughter of the market auntie, Uncle Qin's hand handing over a magazine in the bookstore... Immersed in these warm details, she gradually relaxed, turned off the music at 11:00 p.m., and fell asleep with a fulfilling and peaceful sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Sun Yuwei woke naturally in the sunlight and noticed a small blister on the sole of her left foot from walking around Green Lake yesterday. From the kitchen came the aroma of small-pot rice noodles. She walked into the dining room, where her mother Li Xiulan had prepared two steaming bowls of small-pot rice noodles. While chatting with her mother about the afternoon sharing session, she ate her breakfast slowly, enjoying the relaxation of the holiday.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Organizing the exam-week journal
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei sat at the desk in her study, took out the newly bought journal with a Monet “Water Lilies” cover, and neatly transcribed the reflections from the small notes of exam week with the fountain pen her sister had given her. She also added the food-related moods she had missed over the previous few days, such as the celebration meal with her roommate at Xiangzishen Kitchen and the feeling of hearing local dialects at the vegetable market. She carefully pasted photos of Green Lake, ginkgo leaves, and a feather bookmark into the journal with glue dots, bringing the busy exam week to a close.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Preparation for the sharing session and care for blisters on the soles of the feet
description: Sun Yuwei made final preparations for the afternoon sharing session. She took out her speaking outline, marked with the reading passage from 'Farewell, Seagull,' and silently rehearsed the rhythm and tone, making sure she could smoothly share her reflections on 'The Writer's Notebook' and the original inspiration behind 'Breathing at the City's Edge.' Then, she found a band-aid in the medicine box, carefully applied it to the blister on the bottom of her left foot, and changed into a pair of canvas shoes with softer soles to ensure comfort when going out.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Family lunch and afternoon reading in the sun
description: Lunch was the mushroom and chicken soup her mother had carefully prepared. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, also came out of the study, and the family of three sat together. Sun Yuwei told her parents about her talk at the sharing session and was encouraged. After the meal, she cleared the dishes on her own initiative, brewed osmanthus oolong tea, and sat on the balcony wicker chair reading Zhang Yiwei's 'The Serenity of Old Days' while soaking up the sun, enjoying a quiet reading time.
location: Dining room and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore and help with the setup
description: Sun Yuwei changed into a navy blue sweater and dark navy skirt, put on soft-soled canvas shoes with band-aids on them, and packed her essay draft, new journal, fountain pen, power bank, and camera into a canvas tote bag. She walked about 20 minutes from Renmin Middle Road to Wenhua Lane, taking photos along the way of the plane tree shadows and the winter street scenes of the old neighborhood. After arriving at Mingyuan Bookstore, she set up chairs and wiped down the desks with the bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, and briefly talked about the seagull imagery in her essay collection.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenhua Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Core segment of the book club sharing session
description: After about fifteen book friends had arrived, Qin Mingyuan gave a brief opening. Sun Yuwei walked to the small central stage, first sharing her reading reflections on 'A Writer's Notebook,' then introducing the concept of her essay collection 'Breath at the Edge of the City'—capturing the city's rough and real breath with footsteps. She read the passage from 'Farewell, Seagull' describing water birds pecking at food and the reflection on the lake; the room was quiet and attentive. After the reading, the book friends applauded warmly. Qin Mingyuan commented that her writing had a distinctive 'sense of walking' and suggested she pay attention to the bargaining sounds at Zhuanxin Food Market.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenhua Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Post-meeting socializing and expansion of creative resources.
description: After the sharing session, the atmosphere was warm. Ms. Chen, who works at the museum, really liked the descriptions of plants on the urban fringe in her essays and suggested that they go to the outskirts together to look for material later. The freelance painter Xiao Meng was interested in the topic of a 'sound map of the vegetable market.' The two added each other on WeChat and agreed to visit Green Lake together next time. Sun Yuwei also had tea with Qin Mingyuan in a corner. She mentioned the editor's commission about the changes in Kunming's Spring Festival vegetable market. Uncle Qin said he was willing to help contact a few retired old Kunming residents for oral history interviews to accumulate vivid material for her writing.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenhua Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Took a detour to Green Lake to be alone and reflect
description: Sun Yuwei walked out of the bookstore. Instead of going straight home, she took a detour to Green Lake Park. In winter, Green Lake sparkled, and red-billed gulls circled and played. She found a bench under an old tree and sat down. Closing her eyes, she savored the encouraging looks and sincere suggestions from the sharing session, feeling the seed of creativity inside her beginning to take root. About twenty minutes later, feeling the chill, she got up and headed home.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Helping in the kitchen and family dinner
description: When she got home, her mother was washing rice and preparing to cook. Sun Yuwei washed her hands and helped trim and wash vegetables, and told her about meeting a book restorer and a freelance painter at the sharing session, and that Uncle Qin had agreed to help find people for oral history interviews. Dinner was tomatoes stir-fried with eggs, stir-fried snow peas, and the chicken soup from noon. Her father praised her progress in public sharing, and the family sat together warmly.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening creative work and sorting through inspirations
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to her study. Under the desk lamp, she used a mind map to draw the new topic ideas she had gained from the sharing session—"The Sound Map of the Vegetable Market," "Sketches of Teahouse Characters," "Those Moss-Covered Stone Slab Roads"—into her journal. She updated the WeChat notes for the new book friends she had met, added them to the "Creative Social" group, and also sent Qin Mingyuan a thank-you WeChat message along with a photo of the bookstore's atmosphere.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Online chat with close friend.
description: Her best friend Zhang Jing sent a voice message complaining that she was annoyed by her students while working overtime preparing lessons at school today. Sun Yuwei smiled and replied that the sharing session was 'a great success', and the two chatted animatedly for half an hour. They also agreed to find a day next week to visit a newly opened independent café and exchange journaling materials. The conversation made Sun Yuwei feel the joy of being understood.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Yoga and meditation relaxation
description: To relieve the fatigue of a day of walking and sitting, Sun Yuwei spread a yoga mat in the study, put on earphones, and followed the music for a Vinyasa flow yoga stretch. Then she sat cross-legged for mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath, clearing her cluttered thoughts, and letting her mind settle completely.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening washing up and personal care
description: Sun Yuwei took a hot shower, then drew water to soak her feet, continuing to read "The Quiet Stillness of Bygone Days" while soaking. After soaking, she carefully completed her basic skincare routine: patting on toner, applying moisturizing lotion, and doing facial relaxation exercises in front of the mirror, finishing her pre-sleep personal care routine.
location: Bathroom and study at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Bedtime reading and journal wrap-up
description: After changing into her pajamas, Sun Yuwei sat against the headboard and read an essay about old city bookstores from 'The Stillness of Old Days.' She was deeply moved, recalling the atmosphere at Mingyuan Bookstore during the day. After reading two chapters, she wrote in her diary: 'It feels so good to be recognized, seen, and nourished. The plant of my creativity is slowly growing in this city.' She gave today a score of 9. Finally, she set the alarm, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: At home, on the bed in the bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: The phone alarm rang on time, and I didn't linger in bed. I pulled open the curtains and let the warm winter morning sunlight slant into the room. Sitting on the edge of the bed, I closed my eyes and took three deep breaths, feeling the transition from light sleep to wakefulness, setting a peaceful tone for the new day. I also sprayed a little water on the pothos by the windowsill, and the droplets glistened on the leaves.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning diary and detail-writing exercise
description: Sitting down at the desk, I used the new fountain pen my sister gave me to write today’s date in my diary. First, in about 150 characters, I recorded the creative passion ignited inside me after yesterday’s sharing session at Zhibushi Bookstore, as well as my anticipation for the oral history project Uncle Qin proposed. Then, using the “detail capture” technique learned at the workshop, I began writing a short essay of about a hundred words on the pothos plant before me, focusing on the golden halo glowing at the edges of the leaf veins when sunlight passed through the leaves, and the fine particles floating in the air.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with Family and Recipe Planning
description: Mother brings over freshly made egg toast and hot milk, and the aroma fills the room. While eating, she chats with her about the “weight-gain meal plan” she conceived last night, hoping to improve her underweight build during the holiday. She seriously asks her mother how to pan-fry salmon until crispy outside and tender inside, and invites her to cook together in the afternoon. Her mother happily agrees and even suggests adding some avocado.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare a meditation environment and download the app.
description: After breakfast, I returned to the bedroom. I carefully made the bed, arranged the pillows comfortably, dimmed the desk lamp, took the lavender sachet out of the drawer, and gently placed it beside the pillow. Then I took out my phone, downloaded the Tide app, favorited both 'Sleep Meditation' and 'Focus Meditation,' and finally set a 22:30 meditation reminder in my alarm, hoping this little ritual would become a new habit in life.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading “The Serene Stillness of Old Days” and making excerpts.
description: Seated at the desk, I opened “The Stillness of Old Days.” Instead of rushing through the whole book, I chose several chapters describing everyday street life and read them slowly and carefully. I especially liked how the author used plain, unadorned writing to depict the neighbors’ conversations, full of the warmth of everyday life. In my journal, I copied down three inspiring sentences and noted beside them the rhetorical device of “entering the scene through sound,” which I could imitate, to get a feel for the language for the “food market” essay I planned next.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Refine the outline for the essay collection.
description: She took out Yunnan: A Record of Local Customs, which she had bought at Paper, Cloth and Stone Bookstore last week, and yesterday's notebook. She brought up the topic of the wet market as the core of the first chapter. Combining the oral history idea she had discussed with Uncle Qin and the fieldwork appointment with Sister Chen and Xiao Meng, she reorganized the outline for her essay collection Breathing at the Edge of the City. In the outline, she marked two key directions in red pen: oral-history interviews and detailed plain description, and also used the New Year goods market as the material bank for the first chapter.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and lunch
description: I went to the kitchen to help my mother with cooking, washing vegetables and peeling garlic while listening to her talk about interesting things at school. My father was rarely home, but today he was, and the three of us sat together for lunch. At the table, I shared my creative progress from the morning, especially my feelings about writing about the pothos. My father smiled and said I had paid close attention to details. After the meal, I cleared the table on my own and felt very at ease.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch break and relaxation
description: Went back to the room for a nap, but didn't fall fully asleep, just closed my eyes and rested, listening to the birdsong outside the window. Then leaned against the headboard, scrolled on my phone for a while, looked at a few watercolor illustrations of old alleys on Xiaohongshu, and suddenly felt inspired. I screenshotted and saved two of them, thinking they could be used as cover references for a prose collection.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Contact the yoga instructor and organize ideas for the commissioned article
description: First, she sent a WeChat message to yoga instructor He Lu: confirming that starting tomorrow (Tuesday, January 21), the flow yoga class will be from 2:00 to 3:30 p.m. every Tuesday and Friday, and asked if she needed to bring anything extra for the first class. He Lu quickly replied that wearing comfortable sportswear and arriving 15 minutes early would be enough. Then she turned her attention to the article invitation from editor Xu Mingyuan and quickly jotted down an initial outline in her phone's notes app for "Changes in Kunming's Spring Festival Food Markets," including changes in stall rents, the composition of shoppers, a comparison of Spring Festival goods varieties, and how to incorporate oral-history material.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Send an email to editor Xu Mingyuan.
description: Opened the email and wrote a formal reply to editor-in-chief Xu Mingyuan. Expressed strong interest in the topic “The Transformation of Kunming's Spring Festival Food Market,” briefly outlined the framework just conceived and Uncle Qin as a potential oral-history resource, and asked him to confirm the direction of the topic and the submission deadline. After sending the email, felt a small weight lift from my heart.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal organization and interview outline design
description: She took out her favorite journal and carefully pasted in the ticket from yesterday’s sharing session and a ginkgo leaf bookmark picked up at Cuihu Lake. Using colored pens, she recorded the three keywords she gained yesterday: “oral history,” “change,” and “emotion.” Then she turned to a new page and began designing an interview outline about “changes in the wet market” for old Kunming residents, listing five core questions, including “What was the earliest wet market you remember?” and “How have the things sold there changed over the years?”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon tea and rest
description: I got up and moved around a bit, made myself a cup of peach oolong tea, and walked to the living room balcony. While sipping the hot tea, I watched pedestrians coming and going on the street below, letting my tense mind blank out for a while. I also folded the yoga clothes I had changed out of last night and placed them by the sofa.
location: Living room and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Researching weight-gain recipes with her mother
description: She changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen, their "testing ground," with her mother. Following the plan from noon, they started making avocado egg salad and pan-seared salmon. She was in charge of cutting the avocado and tomatoes, while her mother controlled the heat for the fish. As they worked, they chatted and recorded every measurement and heat level in detail in a phone memo, planning to make them into beautiful recipe cards later.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Plated it carefully and brought the salad and salmon we had prepared together to the table. Dad took a bite and praised it repeatedly; Mom also thought it was very successful. The three of us happily enjoyed a healthy, nutritious dinner that I helped design.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk after dinner and dusk at Green Lake.
description: After a short rest, I changed into a coat and went downstairs for a walk with my family. I put on my earphones and played Li Jian's songs; I didn't walk with my parents, wanting to quietly process the day on my own. I strolled to Green Lake Park. Just then the lights were coming on, and the lake reflected the city lights and the outlines of distant buildings, giving off a serene charm. I sat on a lakeside bench for about ten minutes, feeling the cool night air and inner peace.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near No. 7 Huashan West Road)

name: Return to the study and receive confirmation from her best friend for their store visit
description: When I got home, I walked slowly into the study and saw my phone screen lit up—it was a WeChat message from my best friend Zhang Jing. She said she had confirmed the time for the café visit on Wednesday afternoon and asked me to be on time. I happily replied, “Sure thing! See you there!” and felt a little excited about the café date on Wednesday.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening stretching and preparing the environment for sleep
description: She changed into loose pajamas and spread out a yoga mat on the living room floor. Instead of doing intense vinyasa yoga, she followed a Bilibili creator for 15 minutes of soothing shoulder and neck stretches, and felt the tension in the back of her neck that had been tight all day ease considerably. After finishing, she returned to the bedroom, dimmed the lights, switched to a soft pillow, placed a lavender sachet beside her, turned on the small speaker, and played white noise—the sound of rain—creating the most comfortable environment for the upcoming meditation.
location: Living room and bedroom at home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: First 15-minute pre-bedtime meditation
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light. Lay in bed, put on earphones, opened the Tide app, and selected the '15-minute sleep meditation' guided course. Following the voice, I focused my attention on my breath. My mind did wander twice in the middle—thinking about tomorrow's yoga class and recipes—but each time I gently brought it back to my breathing. I felt very calm at the end.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal and tomorrow's plan.
description: I picked up the small notebook and, in the calmest moment after meditation, wrote the evening journal. I recorded my first meditation experience: 'My body was tenser than I expected, but the last few minutes were very peaceful.' Then I made a simple list for tomorrow: go to Zhongmou Yoga Studio at 2 p.m., send my sister the photos from yesterday's sharing session, and organize the interview outline. At the end of the journal entry, I wrote: 'Everything is gradually getting better.'
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and lights-out reflection
description: Turned off the phone screen, picked up "Stillness of the Old Days," and softly read two short essays. In such a quiet moment, no longer reading for writing, but simply enjoying the comfort the words themselves bring. After reading, set the alarm for 8:00 a.m. tomorrow and the "go to yoga studio" reminder for 1:45 p.m., then placed the prepared yoga clothes and sweatpants on the chair by the bed. Finally, turned off the desk lamp, and the room fell into darkness. Wrapped in the quilt, I silently reviewed the day: completed morning writing, started meditation, sent an email to my editor, made delicious food with my mom, took a walk at Green Lake... The fullness of the day left me not feeling tired, only calm and at peace. In the lingering afterglow of meditation, I soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up, journaling, and watering plants after breakfast
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, Yuwei was woken by her phone alarm. After getting up, she picked up her journal and used her new fountain pen to draw a yoga symbol in the corner of today's page, and added a note about studying weight-gain recipes with her mother yesterday. After washing up, she went to the dining room. Her mother had already cooked steaming hot small-pot rice noodles. While eating, Yuwei chatted with her mother about getting distracted during last night's meditation. After the meal, she went to the balcony and used a small spray bottle to water the pothos and spider plants.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Deep writing in the study
description: Yuwei opened her laptop and, drawing on the inspiration from yesterday's discussion with her mother, began outlining the chapter on 'Food and Memory' for the essay collection 'Breathing at the Edge of the City.' She wrote down keywords: 'small-pot rice noodles, mushroom season, mother's cooking.' Then she opened the folder 'Spring City Market Notes' and wrote the first observational paragraph for editor Xu Mingyuan's commissioned article, describing the smells of Zhuanxin Market.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidying the meditation corner and preparing for yoga
description: When her thoughts got stuck, Yuwei walked to her meditation corner, straightened the cushion, and lit an aromatherapy candle. Then she returned to the bedroom, packed her workout clothes, quick-dry towel, and water bottle into a canvas bag, and checked her yoga socks. Next, she opened her iPad and searched Bilibili for "Vinyasa Yoga Beginner Sun Salutation Detailed Explanation", following the video to stretch, adjusting the angles of her arms and legs in front of the mirror, and memorizing the key moves.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Her father came home at noon, and the family of three gathered at the dinner table. Her mother made stir-fried baby mustard greens, green-headed mushroom stew, and pan-seared chicken breast, saying it was to give Yuwei high-quality protein. Yuwei shared that she would go to yoga class in the afternoon, and her father said with a smile, "Don't practice too hard, or your legs might not lift tomorrow."
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and getting ready to go out.
description: After the meal, Yuwei curled up on the living room sofa, put on earphones to listen to soothing piano music, and sent a WeChat message to her best friend Zhang Jing: “I’m going to unlock vinyasa yoga this afternoon! I’ll call you after class~”. At 13:00 she got up and changed, putting on an off-white knit cardigan and jeans over a sports bra and yoga pants. After checking her phone, keys, and water bottle and applying lip balm, she said goodbye to her mother and briskly went downstairs.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking to the yoga studio and preparing before class
description: Yuwei walked from home to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, with sunlight casting shadows through the plane tree branches. She arrived after about 15 minutes, checked in half an hour early, and changed clothes in the locker room. Coach He Lu greeted her warmly, asked about her exercise habits and physical condition, told her the rhythm of today's class, and told her to relax.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: First vinyasa yoga class experience.
description: The class, led by He Lu, began with breath regulation and warm-up, then moved into the flow of Sun Salutation A/B. Yuwei had trouble keeping up at first, but gradually found the coordination of breath and movement under He Lu's gentle cues and assistance. He Lu specifically helped her correct her Downward-Facing Dog posture. After the 90-minute class, Yuwei's clothes were soaked with sweat, but she felt an unprecedented sense of relaxation and lightness.
location: Flow Yoga Classroom, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-class relaxation, a phone call, and a stroll home by Green Lake.
description: After class, Yuwei drank water in the rest area and chatted with He Lu, sincerely thanking her for the guidance. He Lu encouraged her to keep going. Then Yuwei sat down for a short meditation, feeling muscle soreness and inner calm. After leaving the yoga studio, she excitedly called Zhang Jing on WeChat, describing funny moments like almost falling in Warrior II pose and He Lu helping her adjust her leg position. The two agreed to meet at the Wilderness Café on Wednesday afternoon. After hanging up, Yuwei stopped by Green Lake Park on the way, sat on a bench watching the sparkling lake, took deep breaths to relax, and took photos. Then she walked home, stopping at the bakery on South Green Lake Road to buy whole-wheat walnut bread. When she got home, she changed into loungewear and collapsed on the sofa.
location: Green Lake Park and its surroundings, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Recording yoga experience and journaling
description: In the study, Yuwei took out her journal and carefully drew the pattern for day one on the "Exercise Check-in" page, writing in blue pen: "My body feels lighter, and so does my heart. Teacher He's voice is very gentle. For the first time, I felt the stretch in my spine during Downward Dog. Looking forward to Friday!"
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with family and helped with preparations
description: Yuwei went into the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic and trim greens, while her mother stewed pork ribs. The mother and daughter chatted about yoga jokes as they worked. At dinner, the family of three sat together eating stewed pork ribs with radish and garlic lettuce. Yuwei shared the details of her yoga class, and her father nodded in support of her persisting with exercise.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and creative associations.
description: After dinner, Yuwei returned to her study, picked up a collection of Yunnan local essays, and carefully read the passage describing the sunset over Dianchi Lake. Moved by the gentle prose, she thought of her own draft essay about Green Lake. So she created a “connection note” next to the draft and wrote: “The sunset glow over Dianchi and the morning mist over Green Lake—the breathing sounds of the city at different times.”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Chatting in the living room and interacting with the family group chat
description: Yuwei sat on the living room sofa with her parents watching TV news, while sending yoga photos to the family group chat. Her elder sister Sun Yutong quickly replied: "Yuwei, awesome! How did it feel the first time?" She immediately replied to her sister, and the two chatted in the group for over ten minutes about their thoughts on sticking with exercise.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bathing and bedtime meditation
description: Yuwei took a hot bath, relaxed with lavender bath salts, and carefully stretched her calves to relieve exercise soreness. Afterward, she sat cross-legged in her meditation corner in the bedroom, opened the Tide app, selected the “Breathing Exercise” theme, closed her eyes, and focused on her breathing, gently bringing her attention back whenever her thoughts wandered.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and going to sleep before bed
description: After meditating, Yuwei sat at her desk, opened her diary, and wrote about her first yoga experience, the light and shadows by Green Lake, and dinner with her parents. At the end, she wrote, “Thoughts may be tangled, but I made it through today. Everything is breathing.” Then, on the next day’s plan page, she wrote down the Wednesday appointment with Zhang Jing. At 22:20, she turned off the desk lamp, slipped into bed, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine: stretching, journaling, and breakfast
description: Waking up in the morning light, she still felt soreness in her right shoulder and neck from the vinyasa yoga class two days earlier. She did a few shoulder and neck stretches first to wake up her body. Then, in the study, she opened her journal, used her new pen to write a morning entry, recorded her impressions of the yoga class, and copied out the passage from The Writer's Notebook about daily rituals, thinking about how to weave it into her writing routine. Her mother brought over a steaming bowl of small-pot rice noodles. The sour, spicy, fresh, and fragrant flavor set the ritualistic tone of a Kunming morning. As she ate, she shared funny yoga stories with her mother and mentioned her plan to visit a bookstore with Zhang Jing in the afternoon.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning immersive creation: organizing the outline for the prose collection
description: In the study, she opened her laptop and used mind-mapping software to systematically organize the detailed outline of the essay collection "Breathing at the City's Edge," expanding branches around the central theme for the 12 core essays, and planning topics, estimated word counts, and source materials. She felt dissatisfied with the title, thinking it was too static, and longed for the writing to move dynamically through the city's fabric; a new urge to explore began to stir in her.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready to go out and walking to the appointment
description: She closed her laptop, flexed her wrists, and changed into an off-white knit cardigan and a dark brown scarf. With her canvas bag and journal in hand, she set off. She deliberately took a detour through Green Lake Park. The noon sunlight was just right, and flocks of black-headed gulls circled and squabbled over food on the lake. She stopped to watch and silently recorded the vivid scene. Then she crossed Wenlin Street and entered Wenhua Lane, rich in artistic atmosphere, ready to meet her best friend.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: walk from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road to Wenhua Lane, passing Cuihu West Road and Wenlin Street

name: Having lunch with her best friend Zhang Jing
description: Met Zhang Jing at the entrance of Wenhua Lane; she excitedly pulled you to a small restaurant she had newly discovered. You ordered a bowl of the signature mushroom noodles. The broth was delicious and the noodles were chewy. The two of you ate while commenting, and also shared recent trivialities of daily life. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: In the Alley Mushroom Noodle Shop, No. 38 Wenhua Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Exploring new places and having afternoon tea with my best friend.
description: After lunch, she first went to Eraser Bookstore. In the Yunnan local writers section, she found a 1990s collection of essays titled 'Kunming Street Life Essays', and felt as if she had found a treasure; after flipping through it for half an hour, she bought it. Then she walked to Rachel's Handmade at Banzhu Cuiyuan, ordered two cups of handmade milk tea and a dessert, and sat by the window. Zhang Jing shared funny stories from her elementary school internship, while you talked about the essay collection and your new yoga plans. The two of you also showed each other your latest journal layouts and stickers, and talked to your hearts' content.
location: Rubber Bookstore at No. 18 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; and Rachel Handmade at No. 4-12 Back Street, Banzhu Cuiyuan

name: Walked back home
description: At the entrance of Banzhu Cuiyuan, she said goodbye to Zhang Jing, slowed down to savor the joy of the afternoon exchange with her good friend, sorted out her thoughts, and mentally prepared for the evening's creative work.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, walking from Banzhu Cuiyuan to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, via Cuihu East Road

name: Refine the prose collection outline and create a writing progress schedule.
description: After returning home, she was still full of energy, so she continued adding inspiration keywords for each chapter to the outline. Then she drew a clear creative progress chart in her journal, marking the milestones “one chapter per month” and “first draft completed in July.” She wrote motivational words with colored markers and pasted carefully chosen seagull and book-page stickers, making the plan visual and full of drive.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Rest, tea brewing, and reading.
description: She got up from her desk, walked to the living-room balcony, brewed a cup of kuding tea brought back from Hainan, and leaned back in the chair. She took out the Collection of Essays on Kunming Folk Life bought that afternoon at the Rubber Bookstore, opened the title page, and immersed herself in the writing of earlier authors, feeling the everyday hustle and bustle of old Kunming and giving her mind a moment of relaxation.
location: Living room balcony at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helping mother prepare dinner and having dinner together
description: You took the initiative to go into the kitchen to help your mom pick and wash vegetables, and shared the old books you had found in the afternoon, creating a warm atmosphere. After Dad came home from work, the family sat together and enjoyed the home-cooked dinner Mom made. At the dinner table, you mentioned planning your essay collection with a mind map. Dad asked a few questions about the progress and encouraged you to write well. After dinner, you cleared the table and washed the dishes on your own.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and reading.
description: Back in the study, she turned on the desk lamp, took out the handwritten mind-map outline, added several new inspiration keywords to the branches, then continued reading the newly purchased essay collection and wrote a short but profound reflection in her journal.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Light yoga stretching
description: Changed into a sports tank top and yoga pants, spread out the yoga mat in the bedroom, did some basic Downward Dog and Cat-Cow poses, and specially added shoulder-opening movements targeting the right shoulder and neck to relieve the tension from sitting for a long time, feeling the comfort of the body gradually stretching.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wash up and evening skincare routine.
description: Turn on your phone and play a soothing piano piece, enjoying the quiet time alone. Carefully remove makeup, wash your face, pat on toner and lotion, complete the evening skincare routine, and let your skin repair overnight.
location: Home bathroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime reading and a brief diary entry
description: Leaning against the headboard, I opened "The Song of Wandering" and read two essays about city strolls, my thoughts drifting with the words. Then I picked up my journal and briefly wrote today's summary, recording the pleasant afternoon spent with friends, the productive creative blueprint from the morning, and new expectations for bedtime meditation.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime body scan meditation
description: She put on her earphones, opened the Tide app, and selected the 10-minute meditation themed 'Body Scan.' Following the guidance, she gradually relaxed her toes, ankles, calves... When the guidance focused on her shoulders and neck, she clearly noticed the soreness in her right shoulder, and gradually let it go under the guidance.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After meditation, journal updates and pre-bed reading.
description: Just after finishing meditation, with inspiration still lingering, she picked up a pen and recorded the key feelings from her first body scan meditation in her journal, including her physical state and emotional changes. After finishing, she turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside night light, picked up “Song of Wandering” and flipped through a few more pages, letting her thoughts gradually settle.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: Turning off the night light, she fell peacefully into sleep, surrounded by the night outside the window and the soft sounds of breathing inside the room.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretching and diary
description: The warm winter sun streamed in through the gap in the curtains, and the 7:30 alarm went off on time. Her shoulders felt a bit looser than the night before, so she did a 10-minute neck-and-shoulder stretch in bed, gently pressing her right shoulder with her left hand and slowly rotating her neck to feel the muscles relax. After putting on loungewear, she went to her desk, opened her journal, and wrote down the date and weather: ‘2025.1.23 Thursday Sunny 8–17°C.’ Seeing 44.4 kg on the scale, she smiled knowingly, recalling the lightness she had felt after yesterday’s yoga class. Then, in smooth handwriting, she wrote today’s core goal: ‘Immerse myself in flower arrangement and accumulate living inspiration for the essay collection Walking Deep into the Streets and Alleys.’
location: Bedroom and study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: After washing up, I went to the dining room, where my mother Li Xiulan had already cooked steaming hot small-pot rice noodles, with a rich broth topped with chives and minced meat. We chatted while eating, and I mentioned that I planned to go to Dounan Flower Market in the afternoon to buy flower materials in preparation for the Spring Festival. My mother smiled and said, "Buy more wintersweet; only when the house is filled with fragrance does it feel like the New Year." I felt warm inside.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Trip planning and equipment preparation
description: After breakfast, she returned to the study and opened the map app on her phone to confirm the route: a 12-minute walk from home to Wuyi Road Metro Station, then Metro Line 2 to Dounan Station, about 55 minutes in total. She planned to set out at 1 p.m. Then she took out her flower arrangement tools from the storage room: flower shears, wet floral foam, a dark green serrated vase, and an eco-friendly cloth bag. She carefully wiped the tools with a damp cloth and laid them out neatly.
location: Study and storage room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Balcony reading and creative thinking
description: The sunlight is just right. I brew a cup of rose pu-erh tea, curl up in the rattan recliner on the balcony, and open the "Kunming Street-Life Prose Collection". The descriptions of old Kunming's lanes and street cries feel very familiar. As I read, I jot down touching phrases on sticky notes, while repeatedly weighing the title: "Breathing at the Edge of the City" is too static... Maybe "Walking Deep into the Alleys" has more of a sense of walking? Or "South of Green Lake"? I cross out one option, then write down another, savoring the hesitation that precedes creation.
location: Balcony at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: Put down the book and went into the kitchen to help mother Li Xiulan prepare lunch. Trimmed the roots off the bok choy, peeled it leaf by leaf and washed it, sharing the description of Daguan Tower from the book she had just read. Her mother recalled visiting Daguan Tower in her youth, and the kitchen was filled with warm conversation. Then they enjoyed beef noodles in clear soup together—the noodles were chewy, the beef tender, with the freshly washed bok choy blanched. The sunlight was just right, and she looked forward to the afternoon trip to the flower market.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rest and outing preparations
description: After lunch, she returned to her bedroom for a 20-minute nap to conserve energy for the afternoon shopping. She woke up at exactly 1 p.m., changed into a comfortable hoodie and jeans, put on canvas shoes, and checked her phone, wallet, eco-friendly cloth bag, and bus card, making sure everything was in order.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Dounan Flower Market.
description: Putting on earphones, she played light indie music and walked briskly west along Cuihu South Road for about 12 minutes to Exit D of Wuyi Road Metro Station. She found a seat in the not-too-crowded carriage, opened the memo on her phone, and confirmed the shopping list again: mainly based on the Rikka style of the Ikenobo school, with wintersweet as the main branch, podocarpus as the secondary branch, daffodil bulb as the focal point, and silver willow to add a festive and prosperous touch. The city scenery outside the window sped by, and she felt a calm sense of anticipation before creating. After about 55 minutes, the train arrived at Dounan Station.
location: From Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Dounan Flower Market, Chenggong District, via Wuyi Road Station to Dounan Station (Metro Line 2)

name: Selecting flowers for the Spring Festival
description: Leaving Dounan Station, the flower market was crowded with people, the air filled with floral scents. She moved from stall to stall, stopping at a traditional flower stand to carefully select wintersweet branches with twisted forms and full buds, as well as clean-lined podocarpus as a substitute for pine branches; she also picked out two narcissus bulbs and a small handful of silver willow. She bargained in Kunming dialect with the uncle selling wintersweet, and finally bought all the flowers at a satisfying price.
location: Dounan Flower Market Main Venue, Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Returning home with flower materials
description: Carefully holding the flowers and cloth bag in her arms, she returned along the same route to Dounan Station and took Metro Line 2. The carriage was fairly crowded, so she placed the flowers carefully beside the seat to avoid crushing them. After about 62 minutes, she arrived at Wuyi Road Station and walked 12 minutes home. Though a little tired, seeing the greenery and vitality filled her heart with joy.
location: From Dounan Flower Market, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, via Dounan Station to Wuyi Road Station (Metro Line 2)

name: Flower arrangement creation and sharing
description: After arriving home, she spread old newspapers on the coffee table in the living room and took out her tools to start creating. First she trimmed the floral foam into a shape that fit the mouth of the vase; fixed the main wintersweet branch at the height of a standing flower arrangement, letting it extend diagonally outward to form the skeleton; inserted Podocarpus branches as secondary branches from the sides at staggered heights; and carefully placed narcissus and pussy willow as accents. Immersed in the work, she trimmed and adjusted repeatedly, enjoying the dialogue between branches and space. When she finished, she stepped back to admire it—the wintersweet's proud character, the pine branches' vigor, and the narcissus's elegance coexisting in harmony. Excitedly, she picked up her phone and took photos from multiple angles, immediately sending them to her best friend Zhang Jing and her elder sister Sun Yutong. Zhang Jing replied instantly: "Oh my god, it's as beautiful as a painting! Your hands are so skillful!" Her sister sent a string of thumbs-up emojis.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: She carefully placed the flower arrangement in a prominent spot on the living room TV cabinet. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic and chop scallions, excitedly describing her creative process. When her mother Li Xiulan came home from work, she was immediately drawn to the flower arrangement the moment she entered the entryway. She praised it endlessly and pulled her daughter over to take several photos in front of it. The family then enjoyed a hearty dinner: the braised fish her father loved and the stir-fried pork with green peppers her mother made. At the dinner table, she became the center of attention, describing in detail what she had seen at the flower market and her thoughts on flower arranging. Her father Sun Mingyuan even made an exception and asked some questions about the schools of flower arrangement, which she patiently answered. The whole family was filled with joy and harmony.
location: Kitchen, living room, and dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk at Green Lake Park
description: After dinner, she suggested going to Green Lake Park for a walk to help digest the meal. The family of three put on their coats and slowly walked to the park’s south gate, about 5 minutes. In the winter night, fewer people were strolling in the park, and the streetlights stretched their shadows. Holding her mother’s arm and listening to her father tell funny stories from work, she occasionally heard wild ducks paddling on the lake, and the air carried the fragrance of wintersweet, feeling the best New Year atmosphere in Kunming. Then they walked home together, about 5 minutes.
location: Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (South Gate entrance and inner loop road)

name: Recording reflections and deliberating the book title
description: After returning home, she went back to the study and opened her journal. She first spent 15 minutes writing in smooth prose about today's flower arranging process and feelings, especially her thoughts on branch balance. Then, drawing on the flower market crowd and the night view of Green Lake, she wrote on a sticky note: “City in Spring, Grass and Trees Deep?” … The word “deep” has a sense of time and vitality. She stuck the note on the corkboard and tentatively kept this as a backup title.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Skincare and Bedtime
description: Remembering the reminder from my right shoulder during yesterday’s body scan, I changed into yoga clothes and did a 20-minute gentle flow yoga stretch on the yoga mat at home, focusing on cat-cow, child’s pose, and shoulder-opening poses to relieve tension in my shoulder blades. Then I took a hot shower to relax my whole body, did my basic skincare routine carefully, and changed into cotton pajamas. I put on my headphones and opened the “Tide” app for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on my breath, and briefly experienced mental clarity. After the meditation, my mind felt completely clear, and I wrote in my journal: “During mindfulness meditation, I briefly experienced mental clarity; it was very comfortable.” I closed the journal, turned off the desk lamp in the study, and left only a warm light in the bedroom. At 22:50, I set my phone to Do Not Disturb and placed it on the nightstand, turned off the lamp, listened to the occasional distant sound of cars, and slowly fell asleep with a smile on my face.
location: Bedroom, study, and bathroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretching and journal planning
description: She woke up 15 minutes before the alarm, turned over lazily, and remembered the dream about her older sister coming home for the Spring Festival, feeling a warmth in her heart. While still in her warm blanket, she did 5 minutes of simple shoulder and neck stretches, enjoying the relaxation that quality sleep brought. Then she put on an off-white knit cardigan, sat down at the study desk, opened the beige journal, recorded her weight as 44.6kg, wrote 'entering Spring Festival preparation mode,' looked through last year's Spring Festival journal, decided to keep good records this year, and listed the core plans: draft the Spring Festival shopping list with Mom, buy cleaning supplies, and take an afternoon yoga class.
location: Bedroom and study at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and jointly making a plan for New Year shopping and cleaning
description: Mom brought over a small pot of rice noodles in chicken soup, topped with chopped green onions, chili oil, and a soft-boiled egg. We chatted while eating, sharing the funny story of dreaming about my sister, and learned that my sister also made a video call last night.
