Taking the opportunity, I settled with Mom to make the New Year shopping list after breakfast. After the meal, we curled up on the cloth sofa in the living room. Mom took out an old notebook, and I opened the memo app on my phone. Together we listed the New Year goods: gold-embossed Spring Festival couplets, blessing characters, new kitchen dishcloths, ingredients for flower cakes to give to neighbor Aunt Xie (rose jam, flour, lard), and dried wild mushrooms. Then we checked the cleaning tools at home and found the window brush was old and the glass cleaner was used up. After consulting a neighbor, Mom recommended a certain window brush from Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at 98 Fuchun Street. We confirmed tomorrow's cleaning assignments: Dad will handle high places and heavy lifting, and mother and daughter will take care of the bookshelf and wiping tables.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the supermarket to buy cleaning supplies
description: Changed into comfortable canvas shoes, put on earphones and listened to a podcast, walked south along Huashan West Road, passed the east gate of Cuihu Park, and arrived at the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at No. 98 Fuchun Street in about 12 minutes. After comparing in the cleaning supplies section, I chose a window squeegee with a sponge scraper strip recommended by a neighbor and a bottle of unscented glass cleaner. Passing the stationery section, I picked out some Year of the Rabbit red envelopes and Chinese-style stickers.
location: Starting from Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, heading to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Going home to help in the kitchen and having lunch
description: Carrying the purchased items, she walked north along Fuchun Street, crossed Cuihu South Road, and walked about 13 minutes to get home. After changing into loungewear, she went to the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic and trim green beans. While working, the mother and daughter chatted about the steps for tomorrow's big cleaning. Lunch was home-style dishes: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, sautéed seasonal vegetables, and leftover pork rib soup from last night. She felt at ease eating it.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday rest and reading in the study
description: I crawled into the study and curled up in the bean bag chair by the window, opened Yunnan Scenery and Customs, which I had started reading yesterday, and read the chapter on the historical changes of Kunming's "New Year Street." I thought it might echo the article "Changes at Zhuanxin Vegetable Market" that I had agreed to write with my editor, so I made pencil annotations and noted down keywords. About 20 minutes later, I felt sleepy and closed my eyes for a half-hour nap.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Head to the yoga studio for a Vinyasa flow class and meditation after class.
description: Changed into her navy blue yoga outfit, with a cream-colored knitted cardigan over it, drank a glass of warm water, and checked her yoga mat and towel. Starting from Huashan West Road, she walked west to Dongfeng West Road, then headed south along the road for about 16 minutes to arrive at Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the fourth floor of Dechun Commercial Building. The class was led by teacher He Lu. They first did breathing exercises, focusing on opening the chest and hips, and under guidance she carefully adjusted the alignment and engagement details in Triangle Pose and Warrior II. In the most anticipated section—preparation for a wall-supported headstand—she successfully found the feeling of pressing the elbows down and engaging her core with the teacher's assistance, lightly lifting her legs and holding for five seconds. After class, she sat cross-legged alone in the corner of the studio for a 10-minute sitting meditation, feeling especially peaceful inside.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visiting Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore along the way
description: After leaving the yoga studio, feeling stretched and relaxed, I walked east along Dongfeng West Road, then turned onto Cuihu North Road, for about 19 minutes, and ducked into Zhibushi Bookstore. Soothing jazz was playing. I saw Uncle Qin sorting newly arrived literary magazines, went over to say hello, and chatted about the funny moments from today's yoga class. Uncle Qin said I looked well. I quickly browsed the new issue of 'Duku' and a few essay collections, and noted down the titles to read in detail next time.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Handling preliminary ideas for an editor’s commissioned article.
description: Walked home from the bookstore along Cuihu North Road, changed into home clothes, and sat down at the desk. Opened WeChat and sent a message to editor Xu Mingyuan: 'Hello, Mr. Xu, I plan to finish the first draft of the article about the changes at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market before the New Year and send it to you on the 27th (next Monday). Does that work?' A few minutes later, she received a reply asking her to deliver it by the 28th. Relieved, she opened the memo app on her phone and started outlining the article: beginning with the layout of the old market in her memory, moving to the lively atmosphere of the new market, weaving in oral histories of veteran vendors, and finally concluding with urban transformation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Confirmed the division of tasks for kitchen help, dinner, and household cleaning
description: She closed her computer and went to the kitchen to help her mother set out bowls and chopsticks and serve the dishes. Dinner was a home-style Yunnan meal: braised chicken, stir-fried erkuai, and cold fish mint salad. At the table, she reported tomorrow's cleaning plan to her father, and he agreed to help in the morning. The family talked about when her elder sister would return, and her mother revealed that her sister had already booked a flight for the morning of the 28th. After dinner, her father brought out a folding ladder and an extension pole from the storage room, carefully checked the screws and joints, and she helped wipe off the dust. They confirmed the cleaning order again: focus on windows and the kitchen in the morning, then clean the study and the utility room in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen, dining room, living room, and storage room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Contact sister to confirm return date
description: In the family group chat, she @-mentioned her sister Sun Yutong to remind her to confirm the flight information. Her sister replied instantly and sent a flight screenshot: January 28, Shenzhen–Kunming, 10:30–12:45, with the message 'Be back on time!' She also asked if she should bring local specialties. Sun Yuwei said she wanted to eat roasted erkuai from Zhuanxin Vegetable Market, and her sister noted it with a smile.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize photos and refine the article outline.
description: Turned on the computer, imported the footage from the previous two visits to Zhuanxin Food Market into a folder named 'Zhuanxin Draft,' and selected four photos that best captured the contrast between old and new and the market atmosphere to use as illustrations. Then she opened her memo app again and refined the afternoon's ideas into a detailed writing outline, flagging points that needed supplementary interviews with long-time merchants, such as 'ask Uncle Chen, the mushroom seller, about how the customer base changed after the new market relocated.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Make a journal entry to record today
description: Open the journal and turn on the small desk lamp; today is the day for sticking in photos. Take out the Polaroids of yesterday's flower arrangement from the drawer, choose the one with the best light, and attach it to the page with decorative tape. Beside it, write: 'The crisp freshness of wintersweet and the steadiness of pine branches blend well, like a silent promise.' Then record the small breakthrough of doing a headstand in yoga class and the happy moments of planning the Spring Festival with Mom. In the corner of the page, draw a small yoga figure and stick on the newly bought Year of the Rabbit red envelope sticker.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Washing up and skincare
description: She put down the journal and went to the bathroom to wash up. She washed her face carefully with warm water, applied toner and lotion, and changed into cotton pajamas printed with little daisies. Looking at her rosy face in the mirror, she smiled with satisfaction, thinking that the day had been fulfilling and steady.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation, journaling, and going to bed
description: Sitting comfortably cross-legged on the bed with her back against a pillow, she opened the Tide app and selected the "Gratitude Meditation" theme. Closing her eyes, she followed the guided audio and recalled everything worth being grateful for today: her mother's laughter, progress in yoga class, her sister about to come home, and the editor's understanding. A warm feeling rose in her heart. After the meditation, she felt very peaceful inside. She picked up the journal by her bedside and solemnly wrote at the end of today's page: "I feel calm and warm inside." Then she turned to a blank page and listed tomorrow's to-dos: a thorough family cleanup, going for a walk in Cuihu Park to buy couplets, and contacting Zhang Jing to go to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market together to buy roasted erkuai. Then she turned off the bedside lamp. The room grew quiet, and moonlight spilled onto the floor through the gap in the curtains. She fell asleep peacefully, looking forward to tomorrow's cleanup and her sister's return home.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine preparation
description: The alarm went off at 7:45. After getting up, I washed up and, passing by the scale, weighed myself (44.5 kg), feeling satisfied. Then I went to the desk in my study to write the morning journal, recording the date, weather, and today's plan. In my planner, I noted the shopping trip and the study cleanup, and confirmed my sister's flight information for tomorrow. Afterwards, I had breakfast with my mother in the dining room: small-pot rice noodles with a poached egg. I discussed cleaning the study with her in the afternoon, then put on my canvas eco-bag, took my mirrorless camera, and got ready to go out shopping.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-New Year shopping and organizing at Zhuanxin Farmers’ Market
description: Walked from home to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, listening to music on the way and observing street breakfast stalls. At the market, did the final big pre-New Year shopping, photographed the lively scenes and vendors, recorded the hawking cries, and bought celtuce, Chinese yam, asparagus, and fresh strawberries, among other things. Afterward, carried bags full of ingredients back home on foot, handed the purchases to my mother, who praised the strawberries for being fresh. Then drank some water and rested, preparing for the afternoon's big cleaning.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, 69 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the round-trip route

name: Deep cleaning the family study and a simple lunch.
description: All three family members divided up the work for a deep cleanup of the study: my father moved the heavy items on the top shelves to the living room, while my mother and I sat on the floor sorting books and stationery into keep, undecided, and discard piles. We came across old issues of “Children’s Literature” and composition notebooks, which brought back childhood memories. My mother organized her journaling supplies and threw away dried-up ink pads and damaged stickers. At 12:10 p.m., my mother cooked simple rice noodles for lunch, and the three of us ate at home, chatting about writing and what we had seen in the market. After lunch, we continued cleaning: my father moved the bookcase aside to clear away accumulated dust, I wiped down the bookshelves, and my mother put away her journaling supplies. We packed up the old books and placed them on the balcony, planning to take them to a secondhand bookstore the next day. By three in the afternoon, the study looked brand new, with sunlight streaming in.
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; home study, living room, balcony, and dining room

name: Relaxing bath
description: After the big cleaning, I felt sore all over but full of accomplishment. I ran a bath of hot water, added lavender essential oil, and enjoyed a relaxing soak to unwind both body and mind.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Changed into loungewear, curled up on the bay window in the bedroom, and made a video call to her elder sister Sun Yutong. Confirmed the airport pickup time and place for tomorrow (11:20 at the arrivals gate). Her sister showed the New Year gifts she had bought for their parents (a cashmere scarf and celadon tea set). Yuwei shared the results of her spring cleaning, and they agreed to go together to Dounan Flower Market and make flower-and-plant paper during the holiday.
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, bedroom at home

name: Browsing purchase photos and organizing article materials
description: After the video call, she returned to the study, connected her phone to a Bluetooth speaker to play piano music, imported the market photos from the camera into the iPad, browsed through them one by one, starred the photos with a lively everyday feel, and began to outline the commissioned article, preparing material for writing.
location: Home study in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Help with meal preparation and family dinner
description: Went to the kitchen to help mother cook: peeled garlic, washed strawberries, and chatted while preparing dishes. At 6:30 pm dinner was served: stir-fried asparagus, yam and pork rib soup, pan-fried tofu, and fresh strawberries. The family of three sat together eating, discussing Chinese New Year decorations and airport pickup arrangements, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, Green Lake Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk in Cuihu Park to help digestion
description: After dinner she cleared away the dishes; since it was not dark yet, she went alone to Green Lake Park near her home for a walk, strolling slowly along the lake for about 40 minutes, watching black-headed gulls returning to roost and pedestrians out walking, and felt at peace.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the first draft of the article 'Changes in the Wet Market'
description: After the walk, she returned home, brewed chrysanthemum tea, opened her laptop, and using Zhuanxin Farmers' Market as the starting point, combined childhood memories, today's observations, and conversations with stall owners to focus on writing the first draft of the commissioned article. She refilled the hot water during the process, and by 9:30 in the evening had completed about two-thirds of it, with neat formatting and fluent writing. She decided to finish the rest and polish it the next day.
location: Home study in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening wash-up and meditation preparation
description: Turn off the computer, feeling mentally tired but satisfied. Go to the bathroom to wash your face carefully, apply toner and moisturizer, and complete the evening skincare routine. Back in the bedroom, leave only the bedside lamp on, sit on the bed, open the Tide app, and choose a breathing exercise course.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation, journal review, and reading
description: Wearing earphones and following an app, she did a 15-minute breathing meditation to relax her body and detach from the deep cleaning and writing. After the meditation, she used her journal to record the three most fulfilling things of the day: the successful deep cleaning, the full shopping haul, and the smooth opening of the article. Reviewing this week's meditation records, she found that the time it took to fall asleep had shortened, and she encouraged herself. Finally, she read a few pages of "Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan" until drowsiness came.
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, bedroom at home

name: Falling asleep
description: Close the book, turn off the bedside lamp, lie on my side and savor the fulfilling day, then quickly fall into a deep sleep.
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, bedroom at home

name: Morning wake-up and journal recording
description: Waking in the early morning, my body was a little sore from yesterday's thorough cleaning, but I felt full of energy. At the desk in my bedroom, I opened my journal, recorded my weight of 44.7 kg, wrote the theme sentence "Bright windows and clean rooms, welcoming my sister home," drew simple sketches of a small sun and a window, and noted two to-do items: "Finish the thorough cleaning" and "Polish the vegetable market article."
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and confirmation of chores
description: After washing up, she had breakfast with her parents, enjoying the flaky steamed buns and hot soy milk prepared by her mother. During the meal, they confirmed the division of labor for window cleaning during the big cleanup: her father was responsible for the exterior windows and the balcony sliding door, her mother for the kitchen and bathroom windows, and Sun Yuwei for the inner windows of the bedroom and study. Her father said he had already prepared an extension pole and old newspapers. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparations for the deep cleaning.
description: After breakfast, checked the cleaning tools and confirmed the squeegee, rags, bucket, and other items were all ready. Connected the phone to a Bluetooth speaker and played the jazz piece Take Five as background music to create an energetic atmosphere for the family deep cleaning.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family window-cleaning project (morning)
location: All around the home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: The morning work came to a temporary end, and her mother brought out the zhajiang noodles she had prepared in advance, with cucumber shreds and bean sprouts. Sun Yuwei and her mother sat at the dining table eating noodles while discussing what flavors of flower cakes to make when her sister comes back. Her father continued wrapping up his work on the balcony.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Whole-family window cleaning (afternoon)
description: After a short rest following the meal, she got back to wiping the windows. Sun Yuwei finished the last pane of glass in the study, cleaned the windowsill, and organized the cleaning tools. Her father put away the extension pole and wiped the water stains off the balcony sliding door. When the last pane sparkled in the sunlight, her mother stood at the tidy kitchen window and remarked that the house already looked ready for the New Year. The atmosphere was bright and warm.
location: All around the home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Result acceptance and manuscript polishing
description: After finishing the window cleaning, Sun Yuwei used her phone to take photos of the spotless windows, capturing the light and shadows cast by sunlight streaming through the glass onto the floor. Then she opened WPS in the study and revised the 1,200-word essay about the changes of Zhuanxin Vegetable Market, adding a detail: 'The Hui ethnic female boss selling tangyuan, the glutinous rice flour on the bamboo sieve glowing porcelain-white in the morning mist.' She went to the living room and read it aloud to her mother, who was wiping the TV cabinet. Her mother pointed out that the vendor's cry should be 'Tangyuan, hot tangyuan, with sesame filling.' Sun Yuwei gladly revised it and saved the document.
location: Study and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize old books and prepare to go out
description: Sun Yuwei went to the study, packed the two stacks of old books she had bundled earlier (about 15 volumes, including old textbooks, novels, and magazines) into an eco-friendly bag, confirmed that the community secondhand bookstore "Old Friends Secondhand Bookstore" was near Renmin Middle Road, about a 10-minute walk away, then changed into her coat and got ready to go out.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take used books to the secondhand bookstore
description: Walk to 'Old Friends Used Bookstore' at No. 160 Renmin Middle Road and explain the purpose to the owner. The owner picked out seven or eight books in good condition and offered to exchange them for two old comic books or deduct a few yuan. Sun Yuwei chose 'Tokyo: Eight Square Meters' and an illustrated guide to Yunnan plants, paid the few yuan difference, and left the bookstore satisfied.
location: Old Friends Second-hand Bookstore, No. 160 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home, tidying up, and journaling
description: After returning home, she brewed a cup of herbal tea, laid out her iPad in the study, opened the journal app, reserved a place for her sister's flight, drew a plane icon, and wrote 'Sister Yutong, returning to Kunming at 11:20 on January 28' in preparation for the upcoming confirmation call.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video-called her older sister to confirm the date of return.
description: Sun Yuwei made a video call to her sister Sun Yutong. Her sister showed her packed luggage and said she had prepared creative journal merchandise from Shenzhen and a few new books for her. The two sisters excitedly discussed plans to make flower cakes and take New Year photos together on Chinese New Year's Eve. After hanging up, Sun Yuwei quickly added the flight information 'January 28, 11:20 Shenzhen-Kunming' to her journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and family dinner
description: Sun Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic and trim vegetables, and her father came over to help cut the cured meat. The family chatted while preparing dinner. On the dinner table were stir-fried choy sum, stir-fried pork, and pork rib soup. Sun Yuwei shared the amusing story of sending books to the bookstore and her sister's flight information. The whole family agreed to do a thorough cleaning once her sister was back.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Post-Meal Rest and Outfit Change
description: After dinner, she helped her mother clear the dishes, then returned to the bedroom to change into athletic pants, a light jacket, and running shoes, put on her earphones, and got ready for an evening walk.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A winter walk in Cuihu Park
description: In the early evening, the air was slightly cool, and an orange-pink sunset glow filled the horizon. Sun Yuwei strolled leisurely along the Green Lake lakeside path, with an occasional gull circling over the lake. She took photos of the sunset reflected in the water with her phone and sent them to the family group chat with the caption, 'Bright windows and clean tables + sunset glow, today is perfect.' Then she sat on a bench near the South Gate, watching the passersby, feeling especially pleased.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Returning home and stretching to relax
description: After returning home, I changed out of my coat, spread a yoga mat on the living room carpet, and opened the Keep app to do a 10-minute full-body stretch, focusing on relaxing the arms, shoulders, and upper back, effectively relieving the muscle soreness from window cleaning.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and journal refinement
description: After stretching, she made a cup of lemon honey water and, under the desk lamp in the study, read *Eight Square Meters in Tokyo*, bought from a secondhand bookstore, highlighting interesting passages with a marker. During a break, she opened her journal, added the photos of today's window cleaning, and wrote about looking forward to her sister's return.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Wash-Up and Skincare
description: She began her evening skincare routine, taking off her makeup, cleansing her face, and applying hydrating toner and lotion in turn. She then soaked her feet in warm water to soothe the day's fatigue.
location: In the bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime body scan meditation
description: Opened the Tide app and selected the 10-minute "body scan" meditation. During the guidance, I noticed that the shoulder and arm muscles used heavily today still felt slightly sore, and gradually relaxed them through breathing. After the meditation, I felt calm inside and wrote in my journal: "Weekend review: family teamwork is powerful. Meditation quality improved, body awareness is sharper."
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and falling asleep.
description: Changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and read the rest of Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan. When I reached the chapter 'Washing windows in the first lunar month to greet the New Year in brightness,' I smiled knowingly. At 22:30, I turned off the bedside lamp, put on an eye mask, and fell asleep with steady breathing.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up, morning journal, breakfast, and shopping preparation
description: Sun Yuwei woke up naturally in the winter sunlight. After washing up, she made tea and sat at her desk. She opened her journal and wrote down today's keywords: “efficiency,” “flavor,” and “connection.” Then, following the list she had confirmed with her mother, she outlined the shopping order: first go to the dried goods section to buy porcini and matsutake mushrooms, then go to the bakery section to buy rose jam and flour, and finally go to the New Year goods street to buy Spring Festival couplets and blessing characters. After checking her canvas bag and phone power bank, she had breakfast with her mother, eating the small-pot rice noodles her mother had made. During the meal, they discussed the shopping plan and agreed to meet her father at Fuzhao Tower at noon. Sun Yuwei drew a small clay steam pot next to the lunchtime entry in her journal.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers’ Market.
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother put on light sneakers and set off from Cuihu Community. Walking past the edge of Green Lake Park, they saw elderly morning exercisers gradually dispersing, and her mother chatted about amusing stories from her college days. After about 17 minutes, they turned onto Zuantang Road and finally arrived at the main entrance of Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market at 09:41.
location: Walk from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Daguang Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Shopping for Chinese New Year goods at Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers’ Market.
description: The mother and daughter shopped for New Year goods at the noisy and crowded Zhuanxin Farmers’ Market. They were first attracted by a rushan stall, and Sun Yuwei used her phone to take photos for writing material. Then, at the time-honored “Tengchong Mountain Products Store,” the mother carefully compared the quality of the mushrooms and bought three jin of porcini and two jin of matsutake, while Sun Yuwei checked the prices and tracked the expenses with receipts. Next, at the “Xinrong Baking Ingredients Store” deeper in the market, they bought five jin of fine Yunnan rose paste, cake flour, and lard. The mother chatted with the shop owner about flower cake-making tips, while Sun Yuwei took careful notes beside her.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and last-minute Lunar New Year shopping.
description: After walking about 7 minutes from the market, they arrived at Fuzhaolou Steam Pot Chicken Restaurant. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, had already saved seats. The family ordered the signature steam pot chicken, grilled milk fan, and several seasonal vegetables. Her father shared what he had seen that morning while buying New Year goods at his workplace, and her mother showed the mushrooms and rose jam she had just bought. After the meal, her father rode a shared bike home for a nap, and mother and daughter went to the temporary New Year goods street outside Zhuanxin Market. At a stall selling handwritten Spring Festival couplets, they selected a pair of clerical-script couplets reading “Blessings Fill the Courtyard,” two velvet “Fu” character posters, and a pair of small lanterns.
location: Fuzhaolou Steamed Pot Chicken Restaurant, No. 36 Yunrui West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the nearby New Year goods street.

name: Go home to organize New Year goods and submit the commissioned article
description: Since they had quite a lot of things, the mother and daughter took a ride-hailing car back to their home in Green Lake Community. After arriving home, Sun Yuwei put the dried goods into sealed jars, left the Spring Festival couplets in the entryway for now, and neatly arranged the ingredients for flower cakes in the kitchen. Then, while her mother rested, she opened her laptop and emailed the revised final draft of “Taste Notes from the Zhuanxin Food Market” to editor Xu Mingyuan, with a note asking him to review it. A few minutes later, she received a positive reply saying the article would appear in the first column after the Spring Festival. Overjoyed, Sun Yuwei went downstairs and poured a glass of water for her mother.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break, personal relaxation, and preparation for yoga class
description: Having walked quite a bit in the morning, Sun Yuwei decided to take a nap. She listened to a podcast episode about "urban walking studies" on the living room sofa, then opened her Kindle and continued reading Tokyo Eight Square Meters; she couldn't help laughing when the author described scenes at a laundromat. At 15:50, she changed into her yoga clothes, filled her water bottle with warm water, and seeing that the sunlight outside was perfect, decided to walk to the yoga studio.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio, vinyasa flow class, and mindfulness meditation
description: Sun Yuwei set out from home, walked along Cuihu South Road and then turned onto Dongfeng West Road for about 28 minutes to reach Dechun Commercial Building, and went up to the Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the 4th floor. Before class, she met her instructor He Lu in the changing room and mentioned that she had been shopping all morning and felt her body was already warmed up. At 17:00, she started her fourth Vinyasa flow yoga class; the class went smoothly. During downward dog, He Lu corrected her core engagement. After class, as usual, Sun Yuwei sat quietly in the studio for 15 minutes of meditation, using deep breathing to relax her shoulders and neck. Before leaving, He Lu taught her a simple shoulder-and-neck relaxation exercise.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home, washing up, and having dinner with the family.
description: After yoga class her body was slightly warm, so Sun Yuwei strolled home at a leisurely pace. Once home, she took a hot shower and changed into dry loungewear. Her parents were stir-frying dishes in the kitchen, and she helped set out the bowls and chopsticks. Dinner was her mother’s stir-fried beef and garlic broccoli. At the dinner table, Sun Yuwei shared the editor’s positive reply, and the whole family was delighted. Her father reminded her to keep refining her writing.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepared flower cake dough with her mother.
description: After dinner, they rested for half an hour, and Sun Yuwei and her mother started working in the kitchen on time. Her mother tied on an apron and explained the ratio of water-oil dough and oil pastry while demonstrating. Sun Yuwei studied seriously and used her phone to take close-up shots of her mother kneading the dough. While weighing the lard, the mother and daughter laughed at each other over the disagreement about whether to use 15 grams or 20 grams. In the end, her mother gave in and followed her daughter's suggestion, adding 20 grams of lard. Her father was sorting gift boxes nearby.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Personal reading and essay conception
description: With a sense of satisfaction, Sun Yuwei returned to the study and continued reading Tokyo Eight Square Meters for about 40 minutes, making annotations beside the passage about "creating infinite possibilities in a limited space." Then she opened her computer, created a new document, and began outlining an essay about "the human warmth and connections in Kunming's food markets," wanting to include the vendors' calls she had heard and the smiles of a family she had seen that day.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening mindfulness meditation, journal organization, and bedtime preparation
description: After finishing writing, Sun Yuwei did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation using the Tide app at her desk, focusing on her breath and calming her thoughts. Then she took out that day's journal, wrote the date with a purple marker, and used washi tape and glue dots to attach the receipt from Fuzhao Lou, a photo of the spice stall taken at Zhuanxin Market, and a sketch of her mother's back while kneading dough. In the "Daily Summary" section she wrote: "Article accepted, yoga advanced, New Year shopping half done. Life needs this gentle rhythm." Starting at 22:00, she applied body lotion, put on a steam eye mask, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, and felt at peace.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the light, officially entering the night. Outside the window, the moonlight was like water, shining on the red fu character that had just been pasted up. She fell asleep peacefully, storing up energy for tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: In the early morning, Sun Yuwei woke up in the morning light and felt delighted after seeing the "See you tomorrow" message her sister had sent late the night before. She got up, opened the curtains, made the bed, then washed up and put on the red sweater her mother had bought the previous year. She quickly tidied up to add a festive touch for Chinese New Year's Eve.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Breakfast and family interaction
description: Sun Yuwei went to the dining room, where her mother had already prepared breakfast — small-pot rice noodles, soft-boiled eggs, and pickled radish. Her mother praised her for looking nice in the red sweater, and Sun Yuwei complimented her mother's cooking. Then she went to the kitchen to check on the fermented dough. The dough was just right, giving off a sweet fragrance of roses and flour.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China — home dining room and kitchen

name: Household chores assistance and meal prep.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei cleared the table, put on an apron, and helped her mother prepare ingredients. Together they handled matsutake mushrooms and bamboo fungus, chatting about the New Year's Eve dinner plan and her elder sister's return trip while working.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Go to the airport to pick up my sister
description: Sun Yuwei rode with her father to Changshui International Airport to pick up her sister. On the way, the father and daughter chatted about her sister's life in Shenzhen and the New Year goods, and the navigation showed the drive would take about 50 minutes. After arriving, they waited outside the exit of the arrival hall for her sister to appear.
location: Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (in a private car from Cuihu Community to Kunming Changshui International Airport) and the arrival hall of Kunming Changshui International Airport

name: Picked up my sister and headed back
description: Her elder sister Sun Yutong appeared with her luggage, and the three of them happily hugged and exchanged greetings. On the ride back, her sister gave Sun Yuwei a ginkgo-leaf necklace as a New Year gift. Sun Yuwei put it on right away, and the two sisters spent the ride sharing updates and amusing airplane stories.
location: Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (on the way by private car from Changshui International Airport back to Cuihu Community)

name: Returning home for a family reunion and sharing gifts
description: When the three of them arrived home, their mother greeted them warmly. The elder sister opened her suitcase and showed their parents the health supplements and new clothes. For Sun Yuwei, she had brought a necklace and an out-of-print novel. The whole family sat around drinking tea and listened to the elder sister share news from Shenzhen.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Pasting Spring Festival couplets and the "Fu" character
description: The whole family put up Spring Festival couplets and the character 'fu' at the entrance of the house and the unit door. Sun Yuwei handed over the couplets and checked that they were level, her sister was in charge of pasting them, her mother guided the height, and her father took photos. The upside-down 'fu' character carried the meaning of 'blessings have arrived.' Sun Yuwei also took photos to send to friends.
location: In front of the house and at the unit entrance, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Simple lunch
description: To focus all efforts on preparing the New Year's Eve dinner, Mother simply made ham stir-fried erkuai, dry-fried green beans, and tomato and egg soup. The family of four chatted while eating. The older sister remarked that Kunming's sunny day made her take a deep breath as she stepped out of the plane. After dinner, the two sisters cleared the table.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Prepare Chinese New Year's Eve dinner (Phase 1)
description: After lunch, the kitchen went into preparation mode for the New Year's Eve dinner. Her mother stewed chicken to make the base for steam pot chicken; her older sister washed vegetables and mushrooms and chopped scallions, ginger, and garlic; Sun Yuwei kneaded the fermented dough, wrapped it around rose-petal jam, and pressed it into flower-cake shapes with a mold. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of food and the melody of the Spring Festival Overture.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Baking flower cakes and processing ingredients.
description: Sun Yuwei put the wrapped 30 flower cakes into the oven in batches to bake. While waiting, she prepared the remaining ingredients for the mushroom hot pot: trimming and washing the various mushrooms, cutting the potatoes, tofu, and luncheon meat into pieces and slices, and packaging them on separate plates. When a sweet aroma came from the oven, she took out the golden, crisp flower cakes and let them cool.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Preparing the New Year's Eve dinner (stage two)
description: Mother fried crispy pork, her older sister helped by passing flour and beaten egg, and father set up the dining room and put out candies. Sun Yuwei made a cold fish-mint salad. Everyone in the family had a role, and the kitchen was full of laughter and cheerful voices.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Taking photos to document, then resting and regrouping.
description: After the New Year's Eve dinner was ready, Sun Yuwei took close-up shots of dishes such as steam pot chicken, crispy fried pork, and flower cakes, and posed with her sister in front of the braised fish for a photo. She sent the photos to her close friends' group chat “Spring City Squad,” and the group responded enthusiastically. The two sisters then took a short rest.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: New Year's Eve dinner opening and toast.
description: In the evening, a sumptuous New Year's Eve dinner was served, with a mushroom hot pot in the center, surrounded by steam pot chicken, crispy fried pork, cold fish mint salad, braised fish, and flower cakes. Father raised his glass to wish the family a safe and smooth New Year, and everyone clinked glasses to begin the New Year's Eve feast.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: New Year's Eve dinner and family discussion.
description: The family chatted as they ate. The older sister talked about her work in Shenzhen and her year-end bonus; Sun Yuwei shared that her essay had been praised and that her yoga had improved; their father recalled funny stories of organizing lantern shows when he was young; their mother teased about the romance at Green Lake back in the day. The two sisters also toasted their parents with tea in place of wine, and the atmosphere was warm and touching.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Watching the Spring Festival Gala and staying up for the New Year.
description: After dinner, the whole family tidied up and moved to the living room to watch the Spring Festival Gala. Sun Yuwei poured pu'er tea for everyone and set out a fruit platter. The family nestled on the sofa, laughing at the skits and commenting on the outfits in the programs, enjoying a rare time of reunion.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Midnight countdown and fireworks
description: As midnight approached, the whole family counted down with the TV and wished each other a Happy New Year. Outside, firecrackers and fireworks exploded in unison. The two sisters went to the balcony and watched while hugging each other; their parents soon joined them, and Dad gave the sisters lucky money in red envelopes.
location: Living room and balcony of the home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Sending and receiving red envelopes and online interactions
description: Back inside the house, Sun Yuwei sent and received New Year red envelopes in her close-friends group chat and her family-and-friends group chat, sharing a family photo and receiving praise and good wishes. She and her sister settled in the study, scrolling through photos on their phones and chatting about how their friends were doing, until drowsiness crept in.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Gratitude meditation and journaling before bed
description: After returning to the bedroom, Sun Yuwei first did five minutes of mindfulness meditation, recalling the warm moments of the day. Then she sat at her desk, opened her journal, wrote down the three words "reunion, joy, gratitude," and recorded her mood for the day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Falling asleep
description: After completing all the rituals, Sun Yuwei silenced her phone, dimmed the bedside lamp, and drifted off to sleep with contentment and anticipation amid the sporadic sound of firecrackers outside.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Getting up on New Year's Day and paying New Year calls.
description: Sunlight through the curtains woke Sun Yuwei. She put on the red cashmere cardigan her sister had given her, touched the ginkgo leaf necklace at her neck, and walked out of the bedroom. She said 'Happy New Year' to her parents and sister, who were already waiting in the living room, and received lucky money red envelopes from her parents and warm hugs from the whole family.
location: At home, Room 601, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reunion breakfast and Polaroid group photo.
description: Her mother served the first meal of the New Year, symbolizing reunion—sweet fermented rice boiled with tangyuan. The whole family sat together, eating and chatting about the fun moments from last night's New Year's Eve vigil. Her father made an exception and had a small sip. Her elder sister set the timer on the Polaroid and captured the warm moment of the whole family in new clothes. Her mother carefully stuck the photo on the refrigerator door.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Unit 3, Room 601; home, dining room

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: Packed her going-out items: Yuwei's mirrorless camera, thermos, coin purse, and a tiger-head sachet prepared as a gift for her best friend Zhang Jing. Her sister also checked her handbag. The two changed into comfortable flat shoes and got ready to walk to Cuihu Park.
location: At home, Room 601, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to Green Lake Park
description: The two sisters walked along the familiar Wenlin Street, passing through the noisy holiday crowd. Shops along the street were decorated with Spring Festival couplets and red lanterns hung high. The older sister pointed to a newly opened café and said, “We can come sit here another day.” Yuwei photographed a balloon vendor on the roadside with her phone.
location: From Wenlin Street to Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: In-depth tour of the Green Lake Spring Festival Temple Fair
description: The temple fair was packed with people, and the sound of gongs and drums filled the air. The two were first attracted by the wonderful lion dance, and Yuwei used her telephoto lens to capture the moment the lion 'plucked the greens.' Then they queued up to buy freshly baked flower cakes and candied hawthorn skewers with pulled sugar, and her sister also bought a stick of the stirring candy she had loved as a child. In front of the stage, they stopped to watch a ten-minute face-changing performance of Dian opera, and Yuwei clapped and cheered. Afterward, at the handicraft stall, they picked out two hand-embroidered tiger-head sachets. They kept one for themselves and planned to give one to Zhang Jing. Finally, Yuwei captured the focused expression of the master craftsman painting a dragon at the sugar-painting stall.
location: Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Temple fair book-hunting surprise
description: As she was about to leave the temple fair, Yuwei spotted a temporary secondhand bookstall in a corner of the park. She dragged her sister over and picked up a well-preserved 1980s copy of 'Kunming Folk Tales' and a thin collection of essays by Wang Zengqi; the stall owner only charged 15 yuan. Yuwei was overjoyed, and her sister teased her, 'Even at a temple fair, you can't forget to buy books.'
location: Temporary second-hand book stall at the northeast corner of Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home
description: The two sisters walked home along the familiar path for 15 minutes, carrying the rewards and contentment of the temple fair.
location: Cuihu South Road to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home for lunch and a short rest
description: Mom had already prepared a simple lunch: rice noodles heated in the leftover steam-pot chicken from last night, with several plates of cold dishes. The whole family ate happily, chatting and laughing. After the meal, Yuwei helped her mother clear the dishes, then returned to her room, carefully put away the old books and the tiger-head sachet, and sent Zhang Jing a WeChat message: "Jing, Happy New Year! See you on the fourth day of the New Year. I brought you a little trinket from the temple fair~" After that, she took a 20-minute nap on the sofa.
location: At home, Room 601, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Repotting the pothos
description: She remembered that she had wanted to repot the balcony pothos before Chinese New Year's Eve. She found a new terracotta pot and potting soil, carefully eased the pothos out, untangled its roots, laid clay pebbles at the bottom of the new pot, filled it with fresh soil, planted it, and watered it thoroughly. Seeing the pothos spread out comfortably in its new pot, she felt happy and took a photo with her phone.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Unit 3, Room 601, home balcony

name: Afternoon journal time
description: Yuwei spread her journal open on the desk, and her sister brought over hot tea and sat down beside her. She carefully pasted the temple fair ticket, the secondhand book stall's business card, a photo of sugar painting, and a ginkgo leaf picked up at the fair using a glue stick. She drew a simple lion dance with colored pencils and wrote her travelogue in pen: "January 29, 2025, sunny. Went to the Cuihu Temple Fair with my sister—crowds, drums and gongs, sugar paintings, tiger-head sachets... The flavor of the New Year is tangible; it is the warmth of the maltose candy in my palm." Her sister offered color-matching suggestions and asked her to outline the lion dance with a gold gel pen.
location: Home desk, Room 601, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Balcony tea break and casual chat
description: After the journaling session, the sisters went to the balcony and chatted over tea. They talked about the elder sister's job in Shenzhen and Yuwei's recent essay writing. The elder sister encouraged her to keep writing, saying her words were becoming more and more inspired. The afterglow of the setting sun streamed in, and the moment felt peaceful and beautiful.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Unit 3, Room 601, home living room balcony

name: Family leisure: watching a Lunar New Year movie
description: Dad suggested watching a light-hearted movie. Her older sister picked a comedy from last year on TV, and the whole family curled up on the sofa, cracking sunflower seeds and laughing as they watched. Yuwei leaned on her sister's shoulder and felt that this moment of ease was the true meaning of Spring Festival.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Unit 3, Room 601, home living room

name: Simple dinner
description: After the movie, Mom cooked simple dumplings, served with cold dishes and hot soup. The whole family sat around and ate. After the meal, Yuwei and her elder sister cleared the table together, put the dishes and chopsticks into the dishwasher, wiped the table, and mopped the floor.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, Room 601, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family chat and plans for tomorrow
description: After tidying up, the whole family returned to the living room. Dad brewed a pot of Pu'er tea. Everyone discussed the plans for tomorrow (the fourth day of the Lunar New Year): in the morning, they would first go to Grandma's house to pay New Year's greetings; in the afternoon, Yuwei was to meet Zhang Jing at the Zhibushi Bookstore. The elder sister said, "You go and have fun; I'll explain to Grandma on your behalf."
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Unit 3, Room 601, home living room

name: Personal time: organizing photos and making voice calls.
description: Yuwei returned to her room, backed up the photos taken at the temple fair to her computer, and picked out a few favorites — the lion dance, face-changing, her sister's smile, and the sugar-painting craftsman — for simple retouching. At that moment, her close friend Zhang Jing called on WeChat voice, and the two chatted for nearly an hour. Yuwei shared what she had seen at the temple fair and the tiger-head sachet, while Zhang Jing joked about being urged to marry during the New Year. They agreed to meet at Zhibushi Bookstore at 2 p.m. on the fourth day of the New Year. After the call, Yuwei sprayed a little water on the pothos.
location: Sun Yuwei's room, Room 601, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and mindfulness meditation
description: After washing up and changing into her pajamas, Yuwei sat cross-legged on the bed, opened the Tide app, and chose a 10-minute mindfulness meditation. She focused on her breath and bodily sensations. The noise of the daytime temple fair and the warmth of her family settled in that moment, and her body and mind relaxed.
location: Sun Yuwei's room, Room 601, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and falling asleep
description: After meditation, she picked up the journal on her nightstand and wrote the final line: "Mindful meditation for 10 minutes. My heart, like the repotted pothos, is rooted in warm soil, relaxed and at peace. Good night, New Year." Then she closed the notebook, turned off the light, and drifted into sleep with contentment.
location: On the bed in Sun Yuwei's room, Unit 3, Room 601, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Early rising and family breakfast time
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning; it was already light outside the window. I picked up my phone to check the date and weather. The forecast said sunny turning cloudy, with a brief shower in the afternoon, and temperatures of 8 to 16 degrees. I got up and opened the curtains and saw that some people in the neighborhood were already out walking their dogs. While washing up, I smiled at myself in the mirror, thinking about going to my grandmother's house this morning to pay a New Year call, and I felt excited. Afterward, I tidied the bedroom and opened the windows for ventilation. As I walked out of the bedroom, the aroma of sweet fermented rice wine and tangyuan drifted from the kitchen; my mother had already cooked the traditional breakfast. My sister had also finished washing up and sat down at the table, and my father was serving tangyuan for everyone. The family ate and chatted together. Mother reminded me to help out at grandmother's house, and Father said my uncle's family would also be there, and my younger cousins were looking forward to seeing us. After breakfast, I cleared the dishes with my sister and went back to my room to change into my going-out clothes.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Take a taxi to Grandma's house.
description: After the family got ready, they went downstairs and ordered a ride-hailing car. On the second day of the Chinese New Year, there were few cars on the streets and traffic was smooth. Starting from Huashan West Road, passing through Renmin Middle Road, then turning onto Bailong Road, they reached the residential complex where her maternal grandmother lived in about 20 minutes.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Jiayuan Community, No. 168 Bailong Road, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: New Year visit and family reunion dinner at grandmother's house.
description: Pushing open my grandmother's door, the aroma of food and fruit rushed in. My grandparents smiled from ear to ear when they saw us. I stepped forward to wish them a Happy New Year and took the red envelope my grandmother handed me. My uncle and aunt also arrived with my younger male and female cousins. My younger male cousin excitedly pulled me over to see the photos he took at yesterday's temple fair, while my younger female cousin stuck close to my sister and asked her for help with difficult winter vacation homework. The adults sat in the living room drinking tea and chatting, while my sister and I went to the kitchen to help my aunt arrange the fruit platter and cut fruit. At 12:30 noon, the hearty family feast began. My aunt and my mother had teamed up to cook a big table of dishes, including steam-pot chicken, fried rushan, steamed pork with rice flour, and my grandmother's signature braised fish. At the table, everyone talked about studies, work, and exam scores. I told my younger male cousin two Kunming folk legends, and the whole family clinked glasses and toasted, the atmosphere warm and lively.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Jiayuan Community, No. 168 Bailong Road, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home and rested briefly
description: At two in the afternoon, we said goodbye at my grandmother's house. She reluctantly stuffed my pockets with candy and snacks. My sister and I hugged our younger cousins and promised to meet again in the summer vacation. We took a taxi at the entrance of the residential community and returned home along the original route to the Cuihu community. When I got home, I felt a bit sleepy and rested on the sofa for fifteen minutes. Then I took out my phone to check the time, remembered that I had planned to go to Zhibushi Bookstore in the afternoon to "reconnoiter" for my new book and find inspiration for financial review, and decided to go out alone while it was still early.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Exploring the Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore and writing time.
description: I slung my canvas tote bag over my shoulder and walked to the Paper, Cloth and Stone Bookstore. Afternoon sunlight streamed through the plane-tree leaves and fell on the bluestone-paved path. When I pushed open the wooden door, the familiar scent of ink and coffee rushed to meet me; there were few customers inside, and it was very quiet. I exchanged New Year greetings with Uncle Qin, the owner, who was sorting books. He told me that a batch of new literary books had arrived yesterday and recommended a few works with styles similar to mine. After thanking him, I went to the new-arrivals section to browse and found a hardcover essay collection called 'Time of Grass and Trees' with an unusual cover, so I decided to buy it. Then I sat down by the window, took out my notebook, began outlining the key points for the evening's financial review, and jotted down writing inspiration.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rainy Birdwatching Walk at Cuihu Park
description: At about 4:15, as I left the bookstore, a fine drizzle began to fall. Holding an umbrella, I walked along Green Lake Road for a few minutes and entered Green Lake Park. In the rain, Green Lake was veiled in a thin mist and felt especially tranquil. The black-headed gulls that frequent the lake year after year paid no attention to the light rain and kept splashing and swooping, drawing surprised cries from visitors. I found a pavilion near the lakeside and sat down to watch raindrops spread ripples across the water, feeling incredibly at peace. Around 5:00, the rain gradually stopped, and the air became exceptionally fresh.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Return home and enjoy family time
description: After the rain, I put away my umbrella and slowly walked home along the familiar alleys. Passing the convenience store at the entrance to the neighborhood, I bought two chocolate bars that my sister likes. When I opened the door, Mom was already preparing dinner. I handed the chocolate to my sister, who was playing on her phone in the living room, and she was delighted. We leaned on the sofa and chatted. She shared photos of Shenzhen's spring scenery she had seen online, and I told her about my afternoon at the bookstore and Green Lake. At six, Mom served the shepherd's purse and pork dumplings she had wrapped, and with the homemade spicy-sour dipping sauce, they tasted amazing. During dinner, Mom and Dad asked about my afternoon outing, so I described the bookstore and the rainy scene in detail. After the meal, I took the initiative to help clear the dishes, and the family curled up on the sofa and watched a little TV.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Early-month financial review and wealth management adjustments
description: At around seven o'clock, thinking of tonight's financial review and meditation plan, I got up and went back to the study. Sitting at my desk, I opened the mobile bookkeeping app and, as planned, went through all of January's expenditures item by item: the mirrorless camera, the annual yoga course fee, New Year shopping, and daily expenses, confirming that each amount matched the payment records. I also checked bank text messages and confirmed that January's author royalties (including the column advance) had been fully received. Considering that large purchases like the camera had caused the budget to be exceeded, I decided to cut back on non-essential spending next month. Then I transferred the month's remaining funds into a current-plus wealth management product, set a February budget cap in the app (daily dining and entertainment no more than 1,500 yuan), and wrote a spending reminder: 'Ask yourself first: is this a necessity?'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Meditation practice: body scan
description: After checking the finances, I felt a little tense, so it was the right time to start today's meditation. I took out the yoga mat from the corner of the study and laid it out, put on earphones, and played a meditation audio guiding a body scan. Lying on the mat, eyes closed, I followed the guidance and slowly moved my attention from my toes, then to my ankles, calves, knees... step by step upward, feeling the subtle sensations in each part. After the practice, I wrote a summary in my journal: "After ten consecutive days of meditation, I fall asleep noticeably faster, feel more peaceful inside, and have decided to incorporate meditation into daily life."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organize journal and notes
description: After meditation, I felt in good spirits. I sat down at my desk, opened the newly bought Time of Grass and Trees, and browsed its table of contents. Then I recorded today's activities in my journal: the warmth of my grandma's house, the inspiration from the bookstore, my feelings about the rainy scene at Green Lake, and the results of my financial review. I wrote a reminder to myself: 'Manage your income and expenses like tending a garden, and make every yuan count.' Then I found the writing inspirations I had jotted down at the bookstore in the afternoon, highlighted the key points with a highlighter, and set them aside as material for future essays.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep preparation and falling asleep.
description: Closed the journal, turned off the study light, and noticed my sister's bedroom door was ajar with soft music coming from inside. I knocked and went in; she was lying on the bed looking at her phone. We exchanged a smile, and I gave her a hug: "Take care on the road tomorrow." She patted my back: "You too, remember to enjoy the visit tomorrow." After saying goodnight, I returned to my room and changed into pajamas. I turned off the bedroom light, leaving only a dim nightlight, and lay in bed reflecting on the day: from the family reunion to the richness of solitude, and then to managing life in an orderly way, feeling especially grounded after getting finances in order, and the consistent meditation practice also filled me with confidence. I smiled in the darkness, closed my eyes, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast.
description: At 7:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. I opened the curtains, and Kunming's partly cloudy, partly sunny weather lifted my spirits. After washing up, I went to the dining room, where my parents and older sister were already there. Since I had a yoga class in the afternoon, I prepared oatmeal with milk and a boiled egg for myself. My sister said she wanted to go to the market early to buy some mushroom sauce to take back to Shenzhen, and my mother suggested I go with her.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sisters' morning walk and shopping
description: After breakfast, my sister and I walked to Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. On the fourth day of the Lunar New Year, the market still felt full of festive atmosphere. My sister picked out several bags of oil-poached termite mushrooms and porcini mushroom sauce. I was attracted by a bunch of dried flowers and bought a small bouquet, planning to use it for journaling in the afternoon. On the way, we talked about her new project at the company in Shenzhen, and I shared the progress of my article about the Cuihu cafés. The closeness between us flowed in the morning light.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Set up a dedicated account for the Shanhai Fund.
description: Back home, I returned to my cozy study that I had decorated myself. I opened the mobile banking app and found the installment deposit, lump-sum withdrawal feature. I created a new account, solemnly noted it as Shanhai Fund, and set up an automatic transfer of 2,000 yuan from my royalties card on the 5th of every month starting February 1. After completing the operation, I felt a steady happiness of building strength for my dream.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping with housework and family leisure
description: I walked into the living room; my father was watching the news, and my mother was picking vegetables to prepare lunch. I moved a small stool over and sat down, helping my mother pick vegetables while listening to my father comment on the cultural programs in the news. We chatted about the newly opened coffee shop at the entrance of the community, and the atmosphere was relaxed and warm.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing and tidying up the study.
description: Back in the study, I began to tidy the desk. I put away the local-specialty gift box I had brought back from my grandmother's house yesterday, and placed The Time of Plants and Trees, which I had bought at the Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore yesterday, back into an empty spot on the bookshelf. The documents that had been spread across the desk during the financial review the night before were neatly clipped into a folder. The study smelled of paper and a hint of dried flowers.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Light lunch and midday rest
description: After my sister came back, the whole family sat around the table for lunch. At my request, my mother made a pot of green vegetable and tofu soup and two vegetable dishes. After the meal, I felt a little sleepy, so I went back to my room and took a 20-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon yoga class.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon preparation and packing small gifts
description: After resting, I changed into my yoga clothes and put a loose down jacket over them. I put the box of homemade herbal tea with roselle, mint leaves, and stevia leaves into a small cloth bag, planning to give it to Teacher He Lu. I checked the time and decided to leave around 1:30, so I could take a leisurely walk and arrive before class.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Zhongmou Yoga Studio.
description: I walked out, and the sunshine felt comfortable on my skin. I walked along familiar Cuihu South Road, watching a few resident birds drifting on the lake, feeling relaxed. The walk took me 15 minutes, just enough to calm down.
location: Along the route from Renmin Middle Road to Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Fourth Vinyasa yoga class (stage summary)
description: The class started on time. This was the last vinyasa flow class in the cycle arranged by coach He Lu. I focused on each breath and the flow of postures, feeling my body stretch more. After class, Teacher He Lu smiled and praised me for obvious progress in core strength. I was very happy, handed her the box of herbal tea, and we took a photo together. She also scheduled a practice plan with me for after the New Year.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-class relaxation and a quick stroll.
description: After class, I drank some warm water in the rest area of the yoga studio and chatted a bit more with Teacher He. Then I strolled home, and on the way stopped at the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket downstairs and bought a pack of colorful stickers and a few new watercolor pens to prepare for making my journal.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Immersive Spring Festival journal organization
description: After returning home, I spread open my journal and immersed myself in memories. Using a glue stick, stickers, and colored pens, I carefully arranged the menu insert from the Chinese New Year's Eve dinner, the temple fair ticket from the first day of the new year, yesterday's family photo at Grandma's house, a bookmark from Zhibushi Bookstore, and the dried flowers I bought today. I wrote down the warm details of each day in words: the crispy pork my mother fried, my sister holding my hand tightly, the red envelopes my grandmother prepared...
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: Dinner was a “family feast” specially prepared by Mother, featuring sweet-and-sour squirrel fish, which the elder sister loved, and several Yunnan stir-fry dishes. The family sat around the table, with conversation revolving around their reluctance to see the sister return to Shenzhen tomorrow and amusing stories from the Spring Festival. Father opened a bottle of red wine; the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family leisure time
description: In the living room after dinner, the TV was showing a rerun comedy film. My sister suggested playing a couple rounds of poker with our parents. I sat nearby, watching them play while adding the last few lines to my journal, and also took a photo of the card game.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Monthly meditation summary and journal
description: Back in the room, I finished the day's 10-minute mindful breathing meditation. After the meditation, I took out my meditation journal and carefully wrote down the summary of this 12-day cycle: the anxiety score dropped from 7 to 3, and sleep quality improved significantly. On the title page I wrote: 'Tranquility can be practiced.' And I decided to keep this habit for the long term.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discuss tomorrow's itinerary with mother and sister
description: After meditation, I went to the living room. My mother and sister had just finished watching a movie, so the three of us talked about the plans for tomorrow. My mother suggested that after taking my sister to the airport tomorrow morning, the whole family could go for a walk at Green Lake and feed the seagulls, then find a nice restaurant for lunch. I thought it sounded great, and immediately wrote down in my phone memo that my sister's flight was at 10:50 a.m., and set a reminder for "depart at 8:00".
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and arranging flowers before bed
description: Back in the bedroom, I changed into my pajamas. Instead of looking at my phone, I picked up the dried flowers I had bought today, trimmed the branches with scissors, put them in an unused small ceramic vase, and placed it on the bedside table. Then I curled up under the covers, opened the newly bought "Time of Plants and Trees," and immersed myself in an undisturbed world of words.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for sleep
description: I turned off the desk lamp and gently massaged my slightly sore waist and abdomen after the yoga class. Remembering that I needed to get up early tomorrow to take my sister to the airport, I adjusted into a comfortable position. Reviewing the day, it was full and peaceful, and I slowly closed my eyes with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation.
description: Morning sunlight streamed into the bedroom, and Sun Yuwei woke up naturally. Thinking about how her sister was returning to Shenzhen today, she felt reluctant to part, but more than that, she felt the contentment of having spent the Spring Festival with her family. She quickly got up, washed up, changed into a comfortable hoodie and jeans, and got ready to go out to see her sister off at the airport.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province
