name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: The sour and spicy aroma of the small-pot rice noodles cooked by her mother drifted from the kitchen. The family sat around the dining table, eating and chatting about work and life in Shenzhen. The warm conversation eased the atmosphere of parting.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Left home for the airport to see my older sister off.
description: After breakfast, the whole family went downstairs. At the door, her father hugged the two sisters goodbye and told them to be careful on the way. The sisters got into the pre-booked ride-hailing car and headed for Kunming Changshui International Airport. Along the way, they chatted about last night's meditation and the afternoon plans, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Downstairs of Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and on the way to Kunming Changshui International Airport (ride-hailing)

name: Seeing my sister off at the airport.
description: Arriving at Kunming Changshui International Airport, the two checked in boarding passes and baggage at the self-service kiosk. In a well-lit corner of the departure hall, they took a group photo with their phones as a memento. Sun Yuwei hugged her older sister, told her to report that she had landed safely, watched her sister walk into the security checkpoint, and felt a flood of emotions.
location: Departure Hall, Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning from the airport to the city, heading to Cuihu Park
description: Sun Yuwei didn't go straight home. She asked the ride-hailing driver to reroute to Cuihu Park. Watching the increasingly familiar street scenes outside the window, her mood calmed from the sadness of parting, and she began to look forward to the time strolling through the park with her mother.
location: En route from Kunming Changshui International Airport in Guandu District to Cuihu Park in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (ride-hailing car)

name: Transfer travel funds
description: After sitting down on a lakeside bench at Green Lake Park, Sun Yuwei used the mobile banking app to transfer 2,000 yuan to the dedicated account of the "Mountains and Seas Fund," with the note, "Our journey across mountains and seas officially sets sail!" She then sent the transfer screenshot to her sister via WeChat, along with a message encouraging her to work hard in Shenzhen and save up together for the trip this year.
location: Lakeside bench, Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meet up with her mother and visit Cuihu Lake to feed the seagulls.
description: Sun Yuwei met her mother Li Xiulan, who had arrived early, at the south gate of Cuihu Park; her mother had prepared bread crumbs. The mother and daughter fed black-headed gulls by the lake. The gulls competed to peck at the food, and a few even landed on Sun Yuwei's shoulder. Her mother laughingly recalled the funny story of Sun Yuwei being pecked while feeding gulls as a child. Sun Yuwei took many photos of the gulls and her mother's smiling face.
location: South Gate of Green Lake Park and lakeside, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch at Green Lake
description: After feeding the seagulls, the mother and daughter strolled to the time-honored Binhu Restaurant on Wenlin Street beside the park, took a window seat with a lake view, and ordered the signature tofu pudding rice noodles, fried potatoes, and papaya water. As they ate, they browsed the photos they had just taken, discussed which one was best, and planned to post them to the family group.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home.
description: After lunch, the mother and daughter strolled home slowly along the lake. The afternoon sun was warm. Passing a flower shop, the mother suggested buying a few light purple lisianthus, planning to put them in a vase in the study.
location: On the way from Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to home at Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road

name: Midday rest and tidying up the lingering traces of the Spring Festival
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei trimmed the lisianthus and put them in a vase, rested on the sofa while selecting and color-correcting the photos she had taken that morning, and was delighted to receive a cheering sticker from her sister. Then she and her mother sorted the New Year goods in the living room, dividing candies, cookies, and flower cakes into small portions. Her mother chattered about New Year social obligations while Sun Yuwei listened quietly, enjoying the warmth of ordinary family life.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Neighborhood sharing
description: At 3 p.m., neighbor Aunt Xie Xiulan came by and brought a piece of homemade cured meat for Spring Festival. Mother Li Xiulan thanked her repeatedly and had Sun Yuwei give her packaged New Year sweets and flower cakes in return. Aunt Xie praised Sun Yuwei for being quiet and refined, and invited her to learn to make Kunming pickled vegetables whenever she had time.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entry recording the first travel fund contribution
description: At 6 a.m., she brought her yoga mat to a quiet pavilion beside West Lake, laid out the mat facing the lake, and practiced Mountain, Tree, and Sun Salutation poses, breathing in the moist air while propping her phone to the side to record several clips. After practicing, she took a photo of the lake scenery with her yoga mat and posted the first image of her 'Poetry and Faraway Places' series on Xiaohongshu.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Looking through family photo albums
description: In the soft evening light, Sun Yuwei and her mother sat on the living room sofa looking through an old photo album. Her mother pointed at a photo of her as a little girl in a red sweater feeding seagulls at Green Lake, and once again told the embarrassing story of her crying loudly when a seagull pecked her finger. Mother and daughter burst into laughter. Sun Yuwei used her phone to take a picture of the photo, planning to share it in the family group chat.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepared dinner and ate.
description: Her mother went to the kitchen to prepare dinner, and Sun Yuwei helped wash and cut vegetables. Dinner was steamed fish, stir-fried greens, and tomato egg drop soup. During the meal, they talked about New Year's plans, and her mother encouraged her to study hard and write more essays in the new semester.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Leisure and Photo Sharing
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to her study and organized the photos she had taken that day—the seagulls at Green Lake, group photos of feeding the seagulls, and rephotographed old photos—into folders. She selected nine and posted them to the family group chat. In the group, her father gave a thumbs-up, her older sister sent laughing-crying and missing-you stickers, and her mother told her to get some rest.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mindfulness meditation, reading, and evening journaling
description: After replying to the messages, Sun Yuwei turned off her phone notifications, sat cross-legged on the carpet, and did 10 minutes of mindful breathing meditation, feeling calm inside. Then she read "The Time of Plants and Trees", immersed in the simple text. Afterward, she made herself a cup of rose pu'er tea, and in the tea's aroma continued writing down today's feelings in her journal: "Saying goodbye to my sister, feeding seagulls with my mother, flipping through old photo albums, laughter filling the afternoon... The first payment from the Shanhai Fund arrived, and the future is filled with limitless expectations."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: She turned off the main light in the study, tidied the desk, went to wash up, and put on a hydrating mask. Back in the bedroom, she lay in bed listening to soothing instrumental music, while images of the seagulls at Cuihu Lake and her mother's smile surfaced in her mind. Near 11 p.m., she turned off the bedside lamp, set her phone to silent, reviewed the fulfilling day, and fell asleep peacefully with anticipation for travel in 2025.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up in the morning and family breakfast
description: Awakened by the phone alarm and the light coming through the window, I stretched in bed and heard my parents talking in the living room. Today was the last day my sister would be home, so I got up right away, opened the curtains, and confirmed it was partly cloudy and sunny. After a quick wash, I changed into a comfortable hoodie and jeans. Mom had already cooked rice noodles, and on the table were the topping (meat sauce), pickled vegetables, and chives. The whole family sat around the table for breakfast in a warm atmosphere. My sister said she hadn't slept very well that morning, so we decided to go to the market early after breakfast. Dad reminded us to buy a fresh fish and said he would steam it for dinner.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Get ready to go out and walk to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market
description: I put on my canvas bag and checked my phone, wallet, earphones, and portable camera. Mom took her eco-friendly shopping bag and a small pull cart. I told my sister to rest and that we would make something delicious when we got back. Then Mom and I walked side by side out of the neighborhood, headed east along Renmin Middle Road, and passed through the south gate of Green Lake Park. In the early morning, there were already people exercising by the lake, and the air carried the damp fragrance of plants. Mom chatted as we walked, saying she had thought of the menu last night and would really show off her cooking today. Holding Mom's arm, I took a photo on my phone of her back as she pointed at a cloud in the distance.
location: Along the route from Renmin Middle Road to Daguan Street in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, passing Green Lake Park

name: Big grocery run at Zhuanxin Market
description: The market was bustling with voices, and the New Year atmosphere hadn't completely faded. First, I went to the stall my mother frequents and ordered the crossing-the-bridge rice noodle soup base and fresh rice noodles that my sister loves most. Then I moved through the vegetable section, picking out crisp pea shoots, enoki mushrooms, and a few leafy greens. Next, I went to the mushroom stall and bought fresh porcini and matsutake mushrooms. My mother also bought Xuanwei ham and milk fan at a local specialty shop. Throughout, I used my phone to record these lively scenes of everyday life—piles of chili peppers, a stall owner swiftly cleaning fish, and fresh greens still beaded with water.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning from Shopping and a Chance Encounter in the Community
description: Carrying large and small bags, she returned home with her mother, fully loaded. As they were approaching the entrance of the residential community, they ran into Aunt Xie, a neighbor who was heading out to buy groceries. Mother and Aunt Xie exchanged a few pleasantries, wished each other a happy New Year, and agreed that Aunt Xie would come over in the afternoon for a chat. She stood nearby, smiling as she listened, feeling the warm familiarity of community neighborliness.
location: The entrance of the residential community at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and along the way

name: Put away ingredients, prepare mid-morning snacks, and chat with family
description: When I got home, my sister heard me and came out to greet me. We put the ingredients into the fridge by category, and Mom began pre-treating some dried goods. I poured a glass of warm water for my sister and myself, sat on the living room sofa, and briefly told her about the fun photos I took at the vegetable market. Feeling a bit hungry, my sister and I decided to make a simple brunch. We fried two sunny-side-up eggs, my sister sliced a few slices of ham, and we made simple sandwiches. Sitting at the dining table, we ate slowly with warm milk, chatting about life in Shenzhen and a novel we hadn't finished discussing last night. Mom, listening in the kitchen, occasionally chimed in.
location: Home living room and kitchen at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday alone-time journaling and rest
description: Her sister and mother stayed in the living room chatting; she went back to her own room. She opened her laptop and imported the photos taken in the morning into a folder. On a whim, she opened a blank document and noted the impression of the morning market's voices, along with some sentences about "parting and everyday life" that had flashed through her mind during the conversation. Then she leaned back in her chair, closed her eyes, and did a brief 5-minute mindful breathing exercise to recalibrate. Afterwards, she lay down on her bed, set a 50-minute alarm, and, listening to the family's low voices from the living room, soon fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home study and bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon tea and family mobilization.
description: After the alarm rang, I walked out of the bedroom and found that Mom was already preparing in the kitchen. Dad had woken up from his nap and was sitting in the living room looking at his phone. My sister was tending to the plants on the balcony. I washed my face, went into the kitchen, and asked Mom if she needed help. Mom said to first wash and cut the mushrooms and vegetables we would need in the evening. Dad also volunteered to set the table and let the red wine breathe.
location: Kitchen, living room, and balcony at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Assisted with family dinner preparations in the kitchen.
description: She put on an apron and officially became the second-in-command in the kitchen. Her mother was the commander-in-chief. She simmered the steam pot chicken while preparing the broth for the mushroom hot pot. The task was clear: carefully wash the porcini and matsutake mushrooms, rinse them repeatedly under running water, and scrub the grit with a small brush; then wash and chop scallions, ginger slices, and garlic cloves; and watch the stove to control the heat. Her sister wandered in midway, picked up two slices of cooked ham to taste, and Sun Yuwei, quick as a flash, caught her on her phone with her cheeks puffed out and a smug expression. Her father was fiddling with wine glasses outside, and the kitchen was filled with laughter and the aroma of food.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Final tidying and space arrangement
description: Most of the dishes were ready, just needing to be reheated before serving. She washed her hands and left the kitchen; her sister was changing the water in the vases in the living room, so she went over to help. Her father had already wiped the round table clean and set out four sets of bowls, chopsticks, and wine glasses. She also trimmed the lisianthus she had bought earlier and arranged them in the vase at the center of the table.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-dinner rest and ritual preparation
description: The dishes were all ready, and Mom went to change her clothes. I turned on the camera and checked the battery and memory card. Dad opened a bottle of red wine that had been decanted in advance, pouring a small glass for himself and my older sister, and juice for me and Mom. Soothing light music played in the living room, and everyone sat on the sofa chatting, waiting for the meal to begin. The atmosphere was quiet and expectant.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family Farewell Dinner (Part 1)
description: The dinner officially began. Steaming steam-pot chicken, mushroom hot pot, steamed fish, dressed wood ear fungus, fried milk fans... filled the table. Everyone raised their glasses. I spoke first, wishing my sister a bright future and smooth sailing! We clinked glasses, and laughter and good wishes interwove. During the meal, my sister shared funny stories about landing a project in Shenzhen, while my parents told her to take care of herself while away. As we ate, I secretly used my camera to record these moments.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family send-off dinner (part 2) and group photo
description: When the meal was in full swing, she started the real work. Carrying the camera, she moved around the table, taking close-ups of family members laughing, chatting, and picking up food, focusing on capturing her sister's smile and profile. Then she set up the tripod, set the self-timer, and took a group photo of the whole family of four around the table, raising their glasses and smiling. The shutter sound froze this warm reunion night, tinged with a faint sense of parting.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cleaning up after the meal and heart-to-heart talk in the living room
description: After dinner ended, Dad volunteered to wash the dishes, and I helped Mom clear the table, wipe it, and put the leftovers into the fridge in separate containers. My sister went to the balcony to get some air. Once everything was tidied up, the family sat in the living room, brewed a pot of Pu'er tea, and chatted about plans. My sister said she would take a taxi to the airport by herself the next morning and that we didn't need to get up early. Mom and Dad gave a few more reminders. I sat nearby, listening quietly.
location: Home dining room, living room, and balcony at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entry for the farewell night.
description: Back in her room, she opened her laptop and imported all the photos taken that night. She carefully selected a group photo of the whole family raising glasses, a candid shot of her sister secretly eating ham, and a picture of her quietly smiling in profile, then printed these three photos with a portable printer. Next, she took out her beloved journal and decorated it with cherry blossom stickers and washi tape, placing the photos in carefully designed spots. In the blank space, she wrote with a calligraphy pen: "May you keep shining brightly, and remember to come home often for soup." Her heart felt full, with a calm sense of satisfaction.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Mindful meditation and reading before bed
description: I changed into pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bed, dimmed the desk lamp, put on earphones, and listened to soothing white noise. I did 10 minutes of mindful meditation, focusing on my breath and feeling every warmth I had experienced during the day, peaceful and fulfilled inside. After the meditation, instead of lying down right away, I picked up The Time of Plants and Trees from the bedside and read a few pages of a chapter about Kunming plants, relaxing in the quiet.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: She put down the book and turned off the desk lamp. With good wishes for her sister and a sense of fulfillment about the day, she soon fell sound asleep. In the dead of night she was awakened by the sound of a sudden, urgent rain, but her sleep had been peaceful before that.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Closing the windows and giving reminders in the late-night rain
description: A sudden rain shower beat against the awning, and the crackling sounds woke me from my dream. I got up, walked to the balcony in the dark, felt the coolness brought by the rain, and closed the window. Back in the bedroom, I picked up my phone and saw no new messages. I sent my sister a WeChat message: "Sis, remember to bring an umbrella before you leave. I checked the phone and it says Shenzhen may rain too. Good night." After sending it, I lay back in bed, listened to the rain, felt at ease, and soon fell asleep again.
location: Home bedroom and balcony, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Saw off her older sister in the early morning and comforted the family.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the whole family saw off sister Sun Yutong at the entrance of the residential unit. Yutong dragged her suitcase out of the house and stuck a note on the wall beside the door that read, 'Eat on time, don't stay up late, I'll check when I come back next time.' Sun Yuwei helped put her sister's luggage into the taxi trunk. The two sisters hugged tightly, and Yuwei softly urged her sister to send a message once she arrived. After Yutong got into the car, the family watched the taxi disappear into the morning mist. Back inside, Yuwei saw her mother wiping tears with her back to everyone, so she gently took her mother's arm and leaned on her shoulder. Her father silently watered the pothos on the balcony. Yuwei suggested going to see the newly bought gardenias, and led her mother to the balcony, where they stood quietly in the morning light to ease the sadness of parting.
location: Front doorstep at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the home’s entryway and balcony

name: Washing up, preparing breakfast, and having family breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei washed her face, changed into loungewear, and prepared breakfast with her mother. Her mother took out the leftover mushroom soup broth for rice noodles from last night. Yuwei sliced some Xuanwei ham and washed a handful of baby bok choy. The two worked in perfect coordination, with her mother heating the broth and Yuwei cooking the noodles. At breakfast, the family of three sat around the old folding table. Yuwei took a photo of her sister's note with her phone, added a filter, and sent it to the family group. Her father talked about the news that the number of red-billed gulls at Dianchi Lake had reached a new high, while her mother recalled the funny story of her sister always spilling soup when eating rice noodles as a child, gradually breaking into a smile. Yuwei ate a big bowl of rice noodles and drank all the soup, making her body warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidied up her older sister's room and luggage.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei and her mother began cleaning the spare room where her older sister had slept. They stripped the sheets and duvet covers and put them in the washing machine. Yuwei carefully wiped the bookshelf with a cloth and neatly arranged the scattered copies of One Hundred Years of Solitude and Taipei People. Her mother found a pearl hair clip in the nightstand drawer and froze for a few seconds. Yuwei quickly took it and put it back in the drawer, saying she would scold her sister when she came home next time. Then her mother pushed the two suitcases her sister had left behind into the living room, and the two of them squatted on the floor to sort and organize the contents. Her mother hung the thick coats back in the wardrobe and folded the light tops into storage boxes. Yuwei arranged the skincare samples neatly in an acrylic box and, finding an unopened tube of hand cream, laughingly announced that she would keep it for herself.
location: Sister’s bedroom and living room at home, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Simple lunch
description: Yuwei reheated the leftover mushroom soup rice noodles from the morning and paired them with last night's leftover wood ear mushroom salad for a simple lunch. Mother and daughter sat facing each other. Her mother told an embarrassing story about her elder sister mistakenly boarding the wrong train on her first solo trip during college; Yuwei was so amused she almost choked, and laughter filled the dining room again.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and unexpected discovery of her older sister’s old diary
description: After the meal, Yuwei felt sleepy. She had intended to take a nap in the study, but turned back because her phone was left in her sister's room. Near the bedside table, an old notebook slipped out from the gap in the bed. When she opened it, it turned out to be her sister's high school diary, in which was written in blue ballpoint pen: 'My little sister stole my Coke again today. So mad.' Yuwei laughed out loud, immediately took a photo and sent it to her sister. Her sister replied with a distraught emoji in seconds. Yuwei saved the photo and then curled up on the bean bag sofa in the study and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour.
location: Sister's bedroom and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sorting through emotions and journaling
description: Sun Yuwei curled up on the bean bag chair in the study, reading her sister's chat replies over and over. Then she opened her journal, used washi tape to attach a photo of the hand cream and screenshots of the diary, and next to them wrote today's reflection: 'Feb 3, 2025. My sister went back to Shenzhen. I received her hand cream and an old diary — so even an older sister, when she was little, also held grudges.' She also drew a lisianthus flower in green watercolor on the travel planning page and labeled it 'a gift from my sister.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Sharing funny stories and comforting mother
description: Yuwei sent a voice message to her friend Song Wen in Chengdu, sharing screenshots of her sister's diary. The two of them laughed together across the screen. After hanging up, she went to the living room and found her mother staring out the window, lost in thought, and her mood sank again. Yuwei sat down next to her mother, handed her the phone to read the diary, and joked that her sister also held grudges. After her mother laughed, Yuwei suggested they look through old photo albums together in the evening to see embarrassing childhood photos of the two sisters. Her mother's eyes lit up, and she immediately got up and went to the kitchen to brew Pu'er tea.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner
description: Yuwei helped her mother pick vegetables in the kitchen, planning to make tomato and egg soup and stir-fried greens. Yuwei took the initiative to dice ham and peel garlic. After finishing, she returned to the study to organize her journal. In the evening, her father came home from work, and the family of three had dinner in the dining room, with tomato and egg soup, stir-fried greens, and pickled pepper beef on the table. Yuwei brought up the diary of her elder sister that she had found during the day, and her father laughed heartily. Her mother smiled with tears in her eyes, moved by the deep sisterly affection. Yuwei added that her sister had said last night she would buy her a plane ticket to Shenzhen. Her father quietly placed a piece of beef on his wife's plate. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The whole family turned through old photo albums together.
description: After dinner, Yuwei took three heavy old photo albums from the bottom shelf of the bookcase, and the three of them sat on the fabric sofa looking through them. Her mother pointed at photos one by one and told stories: the photo of the two sisters by Green Lake in 1999, the embarrassing incident when the family went to Dali and her father was chased by a goat, and the candid shot of Yuwei crying uncontrollably at her elementary school graduation ceremony. Her father also added a comment about the photo of Grandma holding Yuwei. Laughter and warmth filled the whole living room.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mindfulness meditation and mood reflection.
description: After returning to the study, Sun Yuwei put on noise-canceling headphones and opened the "Tide" app for a ten-minute breathing meditation. She closed her eyes and regarded all of today's emotions—the sorrow of parting, tears, laughter, old diary—as passersby, letting them come and go. When the meditation ended, she silently said to herself: "Today was good; everyone tried so hard to express love."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Final journal entry and goodnight message.
description: Yuwei opened the last page of her journal and used dot glue to stick in a copy of the sticky note her older sister had left, then drew a bunch of lisianthus beside it. At the bottom of the page she wrote: "Sis, I've kept your note. When you come back next time, I'll check on you—be careful or I'll scold you." She then took a photo and sent it to her sister. Her sister quickly replied with a "you're asking for it" sticker and a voice message: "I miss you." Yuwei smiled and switched her phone to Do Not Disturb mode.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: Yuwei leaned against the headboard and opened 'The Light and Shadow of Plants' that Qin Mingyuan had saved for her. A passage in the book about winter sunlight read: 'In the long winter, there is always some warmth worth treasuring.' She read it aloud softly, then closed the book and turned off the lamp.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: In the darkness, Yuwei closed her eyes, and the images of the day surfaced in her mind: her sister's backward glance before getting into the car, her mother's profile as she wiped away tears, the crow's feet at her father's eyes when he told a joke, and the yellowed photo in the old album. She turned over, a soft calm welling up in her heart, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up and morning tidying.
description: At 8 a.m. sharp, the alarm went off. Sun Yuwei turned off her phone, stretched, and felt the fatigue accumulated over the holiday slowly fade. After getting up, she opened the curtains and let the morning light pour into the bedroom. After washing up in the bathroom, she was fully awake. While combing her hair, she noticed the scale showed 44.8 kg. She was in a good mood, feeling that the Spring Festival indulgence hadn't left too much of a trace.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home - bedroom and bathroom

name: Family breakfast and cleanup.
description: Sun Yuwei walked into the dining room. Her mother had already cooked steaming hot rice noodles, fragrant with chopped scallions and chili oil. Her father was eating while reading the news on his phone. She talked with her parents about the sticky notes her sister had left behind after leaving yesterday. Her mother laughed and said that girl always worries too much. The atmosphere was warm, and after finishing a bowl of rice noodles, she felt warm in her stomach. After the meal, she took the initiative to help her mother clear the table, carried the dishes to the kitchen, put on an apron, carefully washed the bowls and plates, then wiped the stove and put the condiment bottles back in place. A few minutes of simple housework gradually shifted her from the relaxed holiday mode to a clear and focused state.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; Home - Restaurant and Kitchen

name: Refine and print the thesis proposal.
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her study, opened her laptop, and began revising her thesis proposal titled A Study of Cultural Space in Kunming's Independent Bookstores. In accordance with the comments in an email from her advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, she revised item by item, narrowing the research question more precisely from the current survival situation to the construction process of cultural space and the production of meaning. After completing all the revisions at about 11 a.m., she printed the final draft on the shared printer. While waiting for the pages to print, she took a sky-blue document folder from the drawer and put the printed copy together with the previously obtained topic selection application form into it, preparing for the upcoming interviews and fieldwork.
location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Home - Study

name: Had a phone call with friend He Lu.
description: Just after putting the document folder away, the phone rang. It was her friend He Lu, with whom she had planned to attend yoga class that afternoon. He Lu excitedly said she had found a fun 'bee breathing' video and they could try it together in the afternoon, and complained that she had eaten too much during the New Year and was almost losing her abs. Sun Yuwei was amused and replied that her body was also rusty and in need of stretching. The two chatted for a few minutes and agreed to meet at the yoga studio in the afternoon.
location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study (phone call).

name: Early lunch and after-lunch preparation
description: Since she had a yoga class at two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei moved lunch earlier after discussing it with her mother. Lunch was her mother's simplified version of Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles, and the broth was still delicious. While eating, her mother asked what she wanted for dinner. Yuwei remembered that her mother had said the yogurt was almost gone yesterday, so she said she wanted something light and would buy yogurt at the supermarket on the way. After the meal, Sun Yuwei did not sit down right away but paced slowly in the living room to aid digestion. Then she went back to her bedroom, changed into her dark purple yoga outfit, put on a long down jacket over it, and packed her water bottle, phone, keys, and yoga class pass card into a canvas bag, ready to go out.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, home - dining room and bedroom

name: Go to the yoga studio and attend class
description: At exactly 13:00, Sun Yuwei slung her canvas tote bag over her shoulder and headed out, walked to the Renmin Middle Road bus stop, and took Bus No. 5 to Dongfeng West Road. Twenty minutes later, she got off at the “Dechun Commercial Building” stop and took the elevator to the fourth floor of Zhongmou Yoga Life Center. She changed into her yoga clothes in the locker room, drank water in the rest area, and browsed the notes on her phone while waiting for class. At exactly 14:00, she and He Lu spread out their yoga mats and began the first vinyasa flow yoga class after the holiday. The instructor guided them through breath work; she tried the humming bee breath that He Lu had mentioned and felt a slight vibration in her abdomen. During the class, the combination of postures and breathing kept her focused on the present moment. Although some core poses made her muscles tremble, she gritted her teeth and pushed through. After class, she and He Lu shared their feelings with each other and agreed on the next class time.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Life Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 West Dongfeng Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; and on the bus from Renmin Middle Road to West Dongfeng Road in Wuhua District

name: After-class exchange and return trip
description: After the class ended, Sun Yuwei and He Lu changed back into their clothes in the changing room and chatted while tidying up. He Lu said she would be on a business trip to Dali next week and couldn't attend the class together, and Sun Yuwei expressed regret. The two parted at the bus stop downstairs; He Lu walked toward Green Lake, and Sun Yuwei waited for the bus home. After getting on the bus, she put on her headphones, opened the podcast app, and listened to the latest episode of “Urban Folding,” which told the story of independent bookstores in Shanghai's longtang alleyways. The host's line, “Bookstores are the crevices of the city,” inspired her greatly, and she felt it was very suitable for her thesis. She thought of Wenlin Street and Wenhua Lane in Kunming and immediately jotted down several keywords in her phone's memo app: “cultural niche,” “urban crevices,” and “community glue.”
location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; on the bus from Dongfeng West Road to Renmin Middle Road; and in the changing room of Zhongmou Yoga Life Studio and at the bus stop downstairs.

name: Going home to rest and sort out the interview outline
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei first took a warm shower to wash away the sweat from yoga class, feeling refreshed all over. She wrapped her hair in a drying cap, went to the kitchen to brew a cup of rose tea, and washed an apple on the way. After a brief chat with her mother, who was watering flowers on the balcony, she went into the study, turned on her computer, and created a new XMind mind map with “Qin Mingyuan Interview Outline” as the central topic. She expanded branches around dimensions such as the bookstore’s cultural function, the owner’s business philosophy, reader community interaction, and pandemic response strategies, then incorporated the keywords from her memo and added specific questions under each branch. As the mind map gradually filled out, she exported it as an image and prepared to print it for the upcoming interview.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home - bathroom, kitchen, and study

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: Mother had made dinner: stir-fried beef, sautéed pea shoots, and tomato egg drop soup. Father came home from work, and the family sat around the table. Father asked about the progress of her thesis proposal. Sun Yuwei told him she had finished the final draft and planned to submit it the next day. Father reminded her to prepare well for the defense after submitting and not to take it lightly. She also chatted with her mother about the fun of the afternoon yoga class. After dinner, she helped clear the dishes, then sat on the living room sofa and scrolled through Douban groups on her phone for about ten minutes, checking new posts about independent bookstores in Kunming. Remembering the yogurt her mother wanted, she grabbed a light jacket, changed into canvas shoes, and got ready to go out to the supermarket.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home - dining room and living room.

name: Shopping at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket.
description: Sun Yuwei walked 8 minutes to the City Garden Supermarket near her home. She pushed a shopping cart, bought two large bottles of the plain yogurt her mother loved, and then grabbed a pack of her own probiotic drink. Thinking she would read in the evening, she bought a small pack of plain nuts in the snack section. At checkout, she saw the latest issue of Chinese National Geography magazine beside the cash register, with Yunnan's red earth on the cover, so she bought it too. After paying by scanning a QR code with her phone, she walked out of the supermarket carrying her shopping bag.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading and journaling
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei put the yogurt in the fridge and brought the magazine and nuts to the study. She brewed another cup of rose tea and took out the hardcover essay collection The Time of Grass and Trees and her planner. She first leafed through The Time of Grass and Trees and read an essay about spring rain, finding it fitting for the day. Then she opened the planner and, inspired by the lisianthus sticky note she had drawn yesterday, began recording today's experiences: the focus of revising her paper in the morning, the stretch of her muscles and bones from the yoga class, the podcast heard on the bus, and the magazine she had just bought. With a lake-blue gel pen, she drew a small, breathing figure in the blank space.
location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Home - Study

name: Evening socializing and relaxation.
description: Sun Yuwei put down her pen and saw more than a dozen unread messages in the high school girlfriends' group chat 'Four-Person Slacking Group' on WeChat. He Lu had posted a selfie after yoga class, and Song Wen asked if she had gotten slimmer. She smiled and joined the conversation, sharing the news that she had bought Chinese National Geographic, and took a photo of the cover to send to the group. They chatted about recent movies and books in a relaxed atmosphere. Around 21:30, after saying goodnight to her friends, she started her bedtime routine: she tidied the desk, put the printed interview outline she needed to take to Zhibushi Bookstore the next day together with the folder for her thesis proposal, and confirmed that all materials were in order. Then she applied a hydrating sheet mask, lay on the bed, and listened to a few soothing instrumental pieces.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Home - Study and Bedroom

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: She turned off the main light in the bedroom, leaving only a warm-yellow eye-care lamp. Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard, adjusted her breathing, opened the “Tide” app, and chose the 15-minute “body scan” meditation. Following the voice guide, she slowly moved her attention from her toes to the top of her head, feeling her whole body gradually relax. After the meditation, her shoulders and neck felt much lighter, and her breathing became steady and deep. She turned off the desk lamp, covered herself with the quilt in the quiet darkness, and briefly went through the next day’s plan in her mind: go to Zhibushi Bookstore to see Uncle Qin, submit the thesis proposal, and schedule an interview. With a little anticipation, she soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Home - Bedroom

name: Morning wake-up and meditation.
description: The phone alarm rang, and Sun Yuwei woke up feeling that she had slept very well. She leaned against the headboard and did a 10-minute mindful breathing meditation, feeling the crisp winter air and her body gradually waking up. She then recorded her weight, 44.7 kg, in the memo app on her phone. She opened the curtains, sunlight fell on the desk, and she started a new day.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Breakfast and packing
description: Li Xiulan, Sun Yuwei's mother, had cooked mushroom rice noodles, served with homemade pickled vegetables. While eating, Sun Yuwei told her mom the plan for the day: go to Chenggong Campus in the morning to hand in the research proposal to Professor Wu, and go to Zhibushi Bookstore in the afternoon. Li Xiulan reminded her to bring some flower cakes for Uncle Qin. After the meal, Yuwei checked her backpack and packed the final draft of the research proposal, a notebook, and other essentials.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Commute to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus
description: Left at 8:30 and walked to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, then took the metro to University Town South Station. On the way, she put on noise-cancelling earphones and listened to the podcast Urban Folding, jotting down keywords such as "member empowerment" and "community curation." About 85 minutes later, she arrived at University Town South Station, transferred to Bus Z9, and arrived at the East Gate of Yunnan University Chenggong Campus at 10:30.
location: Kunming public transportation (from Huashan West Road Metro Station to University Town South Station, then transfer to Bus Z9 to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus)

name: Submit the thesis proposal and meet with the advisor.
description: In the professor's office at the School of Literature, Sun Yuwei submitted her thesis proposal "A Study of Cultural Spaces of Independent Bookstores in Kunming" to her supervisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan. Professor Wu affirmed the local value of the topic, suggested adding oral history methods, and recommended that she interview Qin Mingyuan of "Mingyuan Bookstore" on Wenlin Street. The two discussed details, and Professor Wu also recommended two reference books.
location: Professor's office, School of Literature, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Campus activities and library research.
description: After the interview, Sun Yuwei first went to the library to return the novel she had borrowed before winter break. Then she strolled along the ginkgo path, photographing the patterns of winter sunlight through the branches. She returned to the library’s social science reading room and consulted Oral History Methods and Urban Cultural Space Research, recommended by her advisor, photographing important chapters to prepare for the interview.
location: Library and campus roads, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Commute back home
description: At 12:10, Sun Yuwei rode a shared bike to University Town South Metro Station and took the metro back to Huashan West Road Station. On the way, she used XMind in her phone memo to draw a preliminary interview question framework, inserting labels such as 'bookstore founding history', 'difficult moments in operation', and 'customer stories' into it.
location: Kunming public transport (metro from University Town South Station to Huashan West Road Station)

name: Family lunch.
description: When she got home, her mother Li Xiulan had prepared mushroom stewed chicken. Her father Sun Mingyuan also came home to eat together. Yuwei shared the results of her morning discussion with her advisor, and her father affirmed the topic choice and reminded her to mind her manners during interviews. The family was happy and harmonious.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lunch break and light reading.
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei rested with her eyes closed on the study sofa for 20 minutes, then flipped through the chapter on flower arranging with plants and branches in Time of Plants, seeking quiet inspiration for going to the bookstore in the afternoon.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Organizing notes and drafting an interview outline
description: At her desk, Sun Yuwei organized the morning's electronic notes, incorporating her advisor's suggestions, podcast inspiration, and photos of book references. Then she took out a sheet of A4 paper and formally drew up the framework of an interview outline, listing sections such as 'The Birth and Original Aspiration of the Bookstore', 'Changes in the Old Kunming Bookstore Ecosystem', and 'Memorable Customers', and wrote down possible follow-up questions for Uncle Qin, carefully filling over half a page.
location: Desk in the study, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Go to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore and interview Qin Mingyuan.
description: At 15:20, Sun Yuwei walked with flower cakes and an interview outline to Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. On the way, she stopped at Cuihu Park to photograph red-billed gulls. After arriving at the bookstore, she had an in-depth interview with the owner Qin Mingyuan, covering topics such as the bookstore's founding history, operational difficulties, and customer stories, and obtained rich firsthand material. Qin Mingyuan shared many vivid details. The interview lasted about an hour and a half.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Stroll at Green Lake Park
description: After the interview, Sun Yuwei walks to the nearby Green Lake Park and strolls along the lakeshore in the afterglow of the setting sun. Black-headed gulls flutter over the lake. She relaxes, savors the highlights of the interview, and ponders the direction of her paper.
location: Green Lake Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Return home for dinner
description: It is only a short walk home from Cuihu Park. Mother had dinner ready. Sun Yuwei ate dinner with her parents, sharing what she had gained at the bookstore that afternoon, and the family chatted warmly at the table.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening: sorting out writing and leisure
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to the study, transcribed the afternoon interview recording, and marked the important content. She then began writing a short first draft about independent bookstores in Kunming. During a break, she chatted with her sister on WeChat and sorted through the day's photos, planning to draw a sketch of Green Lake Park in her journal.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Going to bed
description: Sun Yuwei finished the day's activities, washed up, and went to bed around 23:10, ready to welcome a new day.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Get up, wash up, breakfast, and inspiration notes
description: Sun Yuwei got up to the sound of her alarm, opened the curtains, and saw it was sunny turning cloudy today. She washed up, changed, and prepared comfortable clothes. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared rose sugar buns and hot milk for breakfast. While eating, Yuwei reviewed yesterday's conversation with her advisor, took out her A5 notebook, and quickly jotted down keywords such as 'oral history method,' 'Qin Mingyuan,' and 'bookstore changes' to clarify the direction for her library research.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting by metro to Chenggong Campus
description: Sun Yuwei slung on her canvas bag, walked two minutes through the alleys of Cuihu Community, and entered from Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station. She took Line 5 to North Railway Station, then transferred to Line 1 to University City Station, the whole trip taking about 75 minutes. She found a seat on the metro, put on earphones, and listened to an episode of the podcast Urban Folding about independent bookstores in Shanghai. The concept of bookstore as community living room inspired her, and she immediately recorded her thoughts in her phone's memo app.
location: From Exit D, Huashan West Road Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to University Town Metro Station, Chenggong District (transferring via Line 5 and Line 1).

name: Arriving at the library, borrowing books, and morning study
description: After leaving University Town Station, she walked about 10 minutes through the early-spring campus and arrived at the library of Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus. She found "A Practical Guide to Oral History" and "Qualitative Research Methods" using the self-service search terminal, checked them out on her own, and then sat down in a window seat in the social science reading area. She took out a highlighter and a notebook and began nearly two and a half hours of focused reading, concentrating on chapters such as "Active Listening," "Follow-up Questioning Techniques," "Recording Equipment Setup," "Obtaining Informed Consent Forms," and "Transcription Standards," marking key concepts and templates in different colors and copying out question templates. At key points she paused to think about how to apply them to the interview with Qin Mingyuan.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus Library, Social Science Reading Area, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus lunch
description: Sun Yuwei left the library and walked five minutes to the Second Cafeteria (Ziyuan). Because she arrived early, she didn't miss the highly regarded mushroom and tender chicken rice. She found a corner seat and ate, scrolling through Xiaohongshu while eating. When she saw a note about visiting an independent bookstore in Hangzhou, she saved it casually to gather material for future travels.
location: No. 2 Canteen (Ziyuan), Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus stroll
description: Instead of going straight back to the library after lunch, Sun Yuwei took a walk on the lawn and main road in front of the library, basking in the early spring sunshine and feeling the quiet, open atmosphere of the campus. She saw several classmates taking photos on the lawn, enjoying the spring vibe.
location: The lawn in front of the library and the main road, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon library study and drafting interview questions
description: After returning to the library, Sun Yuwei continued reading about handling silence and unexpected situations in interviews, and preliminary transcription and analysis. She combined the points she had marked in the morning with her upcoming interview subject Qin Mingyuan, writing in her notebook: “Questions need room for follow-up,” “Opening remarks should create a relaxed atmosphere,” and “Pay attention to the interviewee's non-verbal cues.” Then she put away the reference books and began drafting initial interview questions for Qin Mingyuan, starting with core questions. She listed 8 core questions in total, leaving room for follow-up directions and prompts after each one, and finally adjusted the overall logical order.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus Library, Social Science Reading Area, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return metro ride
description: After packing up her bag and the two books, Sun Yuwei left the library and walked to University Town Metro Station, took Line 1 to North Railway Station, transferred to Line 5, and returned to the city center. On the metro, she closed her eyes to rest, reviewed the day’s study gains, and felt fulfilled.
location: From University Town Metro Station, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Huashan West Road Metro Station, Wuhua District (transferring between Line 1 and Line 5).

name: Milk tea break and walking home
description: After exiting Huashan West Road Station, Sun Yuwei took a detour to Qianju Street and found the Spring Tea Alley milk tea shop she had been noticing for several days. She ordered a brown sugar pearl milk tea with less sugar and, while waiting, took a photo of the uniquely designed wooden menu. Then, holding the warm milk tea, she walked back along Huashan West Road. Passing Cuihu Park, she saw people strolling and chatting by the lake in the early evening as the lights came on. She enjoyed this pleasant mix of liveliness and quiet and walked home with a light step.
location: 'Spring Tea Alley' milk tea shop on Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the walk around Green Lake to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei greeted her parents and put the milk tea on the dining table. The family of three had dinner together, and she shared what she had seen and heard while studying at Chenggong Library today. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, asked about the progress of her thesis preparation. Yuwei introduced in detail the process of studying oral history methods and drafting the interview outline. Her mother, Li Xiulan, suggested that when she interviews Uncle Qin, she could ask about the origins of the old objects in the bookstore.
location: Home Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rest, organize, and digitize the interview outline.
description: After dinner, after helping clear the dishes, Sun Yuwei returned to the study, rested briefly, and collected her thoughts. She then opened her Huawei laptop and created a new Word document, Paper-Cloth-Stone Bookstore Interview Outline (Final Version).docx. She entered and polished the 8 core questions she had handwritten in the afternoon to make them clearer and more conversational, and added 2 more questions (the biggest challenges in running the business and expectations for the future), forming a semi-structured interview outline of 10 questions. She also deliberately left several follow-up/notes rows in the document to prepare for deeper exploration.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading “The Time of Plants and Trees”.
description: After finishing work, she was a little tired but in a good mood. Sun Yuwei took The Time of Plants and Trees from the bookshelf, turned to the page with the folded corner from last time, and continued reading. The book's descriptions of plants and seasons calmed her and eased the pace of her work.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entry.
description: After closing the book, Sun Yuwei took out her beloved journal and used a fountain pen to record this day of special significance for her thesis fieldwork: "February 6, sunny turning cloudy. For the first time, I systematically prepared for fieldwork. I feel that my research is no longer armchair theorizing, but about to face a real, warm story. I'm looking forward to the interview next week." Beside it, she drew a simple sketch of a book and a cup of milk tea and wrote the keywords "close reading, outline, waiting."
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mindfulness meditation
description: Turning off her computer and phone, Sun Yuwei unrolled her yoga mat on the study floor and practiced her daily mindfulness meditation. Following the guidance of a meditation app, she focused on her breathing and acknowledged both the physical fatigue and mental fulfillment after rushing from the library to working from home. After 15 minutes, both body and mind calmed down.
location: Floor mat in the study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Prepare items for tomorrow
description: After meditating, Sun Yuwei made simple preparations for the items she might need tomorrow, Friday: she checked the pens and notebook in her backpack, confirmed that tomorrow’s yoga class was at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, and put her yoga clothes and towel into another cloth bag in advance.
location: Home study and bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and bedtime reading
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei changed into comfortable pajamas, lay down on the bed, picked up the poetry collection "To the Night" by her pillow, and flipped through a few pages, feeling the relaxation brought by the tranquil words.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: After turning off the lights, Sun Yuwei quickly fell asleep. Although she had been busy all day, a sense of inner satisfaction made falling asleep calm and easy. Today's weight was 44.7 kg. Though there was no dedicated exercise, she did have a long commute and a lot of walking in the library.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine and preparation
description: Woken by the alarm at 7:30 in the morning, I first did five minutes of mindful breathing, then washed up and weighed myself, seeing 44.6 kg. I toasted two slices of whole wheat bread and made a cup of instant coffee. While eating, I checked the WeChat group and saw the documentary screenshots shared by my close friend Zhang Jing. After that, I changed into loungewear, put my yoga clothes into a canvas bag, and checked the voice recorder battery to prepare for today's tasks.
location: Home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Interview preparation: write an outline, contact Qin Mingyuan, and organize equipment
description: In the study, she turned on the computer and revised the interview outline. Referring to 'A Practical Guide to Oral History', she reordered the questions, replaced two questions, and added lead-ins, finalizing it at 10 o'clock. Then she contacted Uncle Qin (Qin Mingyuan) via WeChat, sent the interview request and an explanation of the outline, and received a prompt reply agreeing to hold the interview at Mingyuan Book House at 2 p.m. the next day. After that, she immediately organized the interview equipment: a voice recorder, spare batteries, a power bank, an instant camera, and photo paper. After testing, she packed them into a canvas bag along with her notebook and reference books, and placed it on the study sofa.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and midday reading
description: At noon, my parents were not at home, so I cooked the shepherd's purse wontons my mother had wrapped. While cooking, I listened to an episode of the podcast "City Folding" about community bookstores. After the meal, I flipped through a back issue of Chinese National Geographic on the living room sofa, and when I read an article about a border town, I wrote down inspiring words in my journal.
location: Home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Freelance writing
description: Using the quiet afternoon, wrote an article for the "Cultural Horizon" column about observations of old-street cafés in Kunming, completed a 500-character opening, saved the document after the thoughts flowed smoothly, and left room for anticipation for the afternoon activities.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Yoga class and round trip
description: Changed into black yoga clothes, put on a hoodie and jeans over them, and brought a light trench coat. Walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, passing Green Lake Park. At 15:00, attended Coach He Lu's vinyasa flow yoga class on time, focusing on posture transitions, trying humming-bee breathing, and relieving tension in the shoulders and neck. After class, briefly talked with the coach about the new yoga blocks. Then walked home, took a shower, changed back into loungewear, and drank water to rest.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening outing and pre-movie preparations
description: Sitting in a rattan chair on the balcony watching the street scene, she took screenshots of the core interview questions and saved them. At 17:00, she changed into a dress and canvas shoes and walked to Qianju Street. At Guiye Teahouse (Qianju Street branch), she bought a hot brown sugar pearl milk tea with less sugar, then went to the Elephant Screening independent cinema to pick up her ticket and entered early to enjoy the quiet time.
location: Elephant Screening Independent Cinema, Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (including Guiye Teahouse)

name: Watch the re-release of Soul
description: I watched a movie in Screening Room 3 and was deeply moved by the animated film's theme of “sparks” and the meaning of life. My eyes teared up several times, especially struck by the line, “A spark isn't the purpose of life; the moment you want to live, the spark has already been lit.”
location: Screening Room 3, Elephant Screening Independent Cinema, Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buy postcards and write reflections
description: After the showing, I walked into the convenience store next door, picked out a Van Gogh 'The Starry Night' postcard, and wrote down my thoughts with a fountain pen: '2025.2.7 Soul is being re-released. In uncertain times, the thing I most need to be reminded of is: the spark is life itself. Grateful for this moment.'
location: Fangbian 24-Hour Convenience Store, Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and family conversation at dinner
description: Walking home along Qianju Street, she arrived to find that her parents had already eaten dinner. She showed her mother the postcards and movie ticket stubs and shared the day's experiences; her father asked how her interview preparation was going, and they chatted briefly.
location: Home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling, socializing, and meditation
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, she pasted the movie ticket stub and postcard into her journal, noted the date, copied down the lines that moved her, and reviewed the day's preparation and yoga class. Then she posted on Moments with a photo of the postcard, captioned: 'A spark isn't a life purpose... Today I was deeply warmed by Soul.' She received a like and comment from Zhang Jing, then chatted with Zhang Jing in private messages and exchanged goodnights. At 22:00 she did 10 minutes of bedtime meditation to relax her mind and body.
location: Home - bedroom and desk, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After meditating, she checked the interview equipment for the next day, placed the packed canvas bag at the entrance, checked the voice recorder battery again, then went back to the bedroom, turned off the light, and fell asleep with satisfaction and anticipation.
location: Home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and departure
description: In the early morning, Sun Yuwei woke up at her home in Cuihu Community, Kunming. The soft winter morning light streamed through the window, and her fingertips touched the thin frost condensed on the glass. She put on a loose sweater jacket and went to the living room. Her mother had already cooked steaming shepherd's purse wontons in the kitchen, and her father was spraying water on the plants on the balcony. After breakfast, she carefully checked the voice recorder, spare batteries, power bank, and Polaroid camera in her canvas bag, and confirmed the interview outline. After saying goodbye to her parents, she slung her canvas bag and insulated lunch bag over her shoulder and left, walking along the softly sunlit street to Huashan West Road Metro Station. She bought a bottle of water at a convenience store, checked the interview outline on her phone again, and took a deep breath.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuted to Dounan Flower Market.
description: From Huashan West Road Station, took Line 5 and transferred to Line 1 to Dounan Flower Market. There were not many people in the carriage; she leaned by the gangway. The view outside the window gradually opened up from dense residential buildings, sweeping past fields and the outlines of distant mountains. With earphones playing soft piano music, she silently ran through the interview opening and the key points for the flower arrangement class in her head to make sure her tone was natural.
location: Kunming Metro Line 5 in Kunming City, Yunnan Province, from Huashan West Road Station to Dounan Station.

name: Dounan Flower Market shopping and a chance encounter
description: Arrived at the flower trading hall on the first floor of Dounan Flower Market and picked out flower materials at a familiar stall. The stall owner warmly recommended long-stemmed white roses and gray-green eucalyptus leaves, and shared the deep-water revival technique: 'Cut the stems at a 45-degree angle, don't let the leaves soak in water, and they'll be perky after a night.' She noted it down carefully and paid. Then she went up to the second-floor flower materials area, where she happened to meet Su Man, a fellow flower-arranging enthusiast, and the two chatted while standing for about fifteen minutes. Su Man recommended low-maintenance green plants that suit the season and suggested practicing flower arrangement on her balcony next Wednesday. Yuwei readily agreed and marked it in her phone calendar.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and going home
description: Carrying the heavy floral materials, she took the metro back, carefully wrapping the stems in plastic bags to prevent water stains from soaking the canvas bag. On the metro, sunlight streamed through the window and fell on the white roses, making them look especially pure. After returning to her home in Cuihu Community, she briefly trimmed the roots of the flowers, placed them in a vase with fresh water in the living room, and planned to handle them more carefully in the evening.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch, midday rest, and interview preparation
description: Mother made a steaming hot bowl of mushroom soup noodles. Sun Yuwei ate heartily while vividly describing her experiences at the flower market and tips for reviving cut flowers, also mentioning her plan to interview Uncle Qin in the afternoon. Her mother joked that she 'never neglects study, socializing, or work.' After the meal, she lay on the sofa and took a half-hour nap to recharge. After waking up, she washed her face and changed into a clean cotton shirt, looking serene and refreshed. Sitting back at her desk, she did a final check of the battery levels on her voice recorder and Polaroid camera, and neatly copied the interview outline into a small notebook for easy reference during follow-up questions.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Mingyuan Bookstore.
description: She left on time and walked to Wenlin Street. On the way, she deliberately detoured to the Chuncha Lane milk tea shop on Qianju Street, bought a less-sweet brown sugar pearl milk tea for herself, and asked the clerk to brew a cup of raw Pu'er tea, carefully packing it up to bring to Uncle Qin. At 13:45, she stood in front of the wooden door of Mingyuan Bookstore, took a deep breath, and pushed the door open.
location: The milk tea shop on Chuncha Lane, Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street.

name: Oral history interview and reflection at Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Qin Mingyuan had already prepared the tea set at the corner tea table. Yuwei handed him the sheng pu-erh; the old man smiled, took it, and scalded the tea set with boiling water. She turned on the voice recorder and placed it on the small round table, and the interview officially began. Uncle Qin started with why he resigned from the publishing house twenty years ago to open a bookstore in Kunming, telling of his experiences hunting for old books everywhere and the bustling scene of small bookstores lining the area around Qianju Street in those days. Yuwei occasionally used her Polaroid camera to photograph the old books on the desk and Uncle Qin's gestures as he spoke. At the end, she asked if they could take a photo together, and the old man smiled and straightened his collar. After the interview, she didn't leave right away. She sat on the sofa, took out a small notebook to jot down the names of the vanished bookstores Uncle Qin had mentioned, and flipped through the recommended Hand-drawn Map of Old Kunming Bookstores, running her fingertip across the locations on the map to feel the texture of the city.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Resting at Green Lake Park.
description: Leaving the bookstore while it was still early, she slowly walked to Green Lake Park. The lake glittered in the sunlight, black-headed gulls drifted leisurely, and she sat down on a stone bench by the lake, letting the warm, story-filled details from the interview settle in her mind as a gentle breeze blew. Sunlight filtering through the willow branches cast dappled shadows on her small notebook.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Organize recordings and initial creative work
description: After getting home, she first took a hot shower and changed into loungewear, then plunged into the study. She transferred the voice recorder audio to her computer and listened back with headphones. When she heard Uncle Qin say, "A bookstore is like a bookworm, embedding itself in the cracks of the old city walls," her heart skipped a beat, and she immediately paused and neatly copied the sentence into her notebook.
location: Cuihu Community (Study), No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner
description: When she came out of the study, her mother was preparing dinner in the kitchen. Yuwei took the initiative to help trim and wash the vegetables. While skillfully picking the leaves off the celery, she chatted about the interesting bits from her interview, such as how Uncle Qin, in his younger days, once cycled dozens of kilometers to a scrap station on the city outskirts in search of an out-of-print book. Dinner consisted of several home-style dishes. During the meal, she excitedly shared what she had seen and felt during the day. Her father listened and nodded seriously, and her mother said with a smile, “What you're doing is very meaningful. Write these things down, and in the future they will become the memories of Kunming's people.” Her heart felt warm.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Write the essay “The Bookworm's Hideout”
description: Immediately after dinner, I returned to the study, opened a Word document, and began free writing using the title and core image "A Bookstore Is Like a Bookworm." I poured today's emotional impressions, thoughts about the changes in urban cultural spaces, and respect for Uncle Qin as a cultural guardian into the text. Ideas flowed, and in an hour and a half I produced a first draft of about 1,200 characters.
location: Cuihu Community (Study), No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing with mother and daily exercise.
description: After finishing the essay, she took the printed draft and Polaroid photos to the living room. Her mother was knitting; she sat beside her and read aloud the passage she was most satisfied with. Her mother looked closely at the photo and said Uncle Qin's smile was very warm. Then she did simple shoulder-and-neck relaxation and basic yoga stretches on the yoga mat in the living room.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (living room)

name: Journaling and flower arranging practice.
description: Returning to the study, she opened her journal to a new page for February 8 and carefully pasted the Polaroid photo onto it. Beside it, she copied down wonderful lines such as "A bookstore is like a bookworm," and lightly sketched the outline of eucalyptus leaves with a brush. Finally, she went to the living room and quietly practiced a simple basic rikka arrangement with the white roses and eucalyptus bought today, trimming, arranging them in a vase, and placing it on a corner of the desk.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study and living room)

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: She changed into pajamas, dimmed the lights, and leaned against the headboard for 10 minutes of mindful meditation. Many scenes from the day — the bustle of the flower market, the quiet of the bookstore, Uncle Qin's smile, her mother's words — flashed through her mind like a revolving lantern. She focused on her breathing and slowly calmed her excited nerves. After meditating, she went to the bathroom to wash up. At 22:30 she lay in bed, savoring the fulfilling day, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sunday morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: On Sunday morning, sunlight streamed through the gap in the curtains, and Sun Yuwei slowly woke up. Hearing her mother busy in the kitchen, she got up and first went to the balcony to take a deep breath of fresh air.
