When she walked into the kitchen and saw her mother preparing breakfast, she took the initiative to help set out the bowls and plates. This morning’s breakfast was spinach and pork liver porridge and a fried egg, specially made by her mother—it warmed both her stomach and her heart.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home on the second floor of Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Sign up for a meditation trial class
description: She sat down at the dining table, drinking congee while opening the WeChat mini program of “Jingxin Yoga Life Center”. Seeing that there were indeed only 3 spots left in the afternoon’s special meditation trial class, she immediately filled in her information and completed the online payment. After receiving the confirmation text message, she took a screenshot and saved it. After finishing breakfast, she helped her mother clear the bowls and dishes into the kitchen.
location: Second-floor home dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Archiving interview materials and revising essays
description: Taking my journal and pen into the study, I carefully took out the Polaroid photos that had dried overnight, selecting a close-up of Mr. Qin Mingyuan at his most engaged and a panorama of the bookstore. On the thesis material journal, I opened a new "Interview Inspiration" page, attached the photos with washi tape, and neatly labeled the date, interviewee, and interview topic with a black pen. Then I opened the first draft of the essay "The Bookworm's Hideaway" written last night, and, with the calm thinking from the day, revised it paragraph by paragraph. I focused on polishing the transitions around Uncle Qin's line, "A bookstore is like a bookworm that wedges itself into the crevices of the old town," and deepened the closing reflection on urban change. When done, I categorized the audio recordings, written notes, and the second draft of the essay on the computer into the "Thesis/Fieldwork/Qin Mingyuan" folder.
location: The study at home, second floor, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch and a short rest.
description: Her father came home from the Cultural Affairs Bureau, and the family of three sat around the dining table. Yuwei shared the amusing story from yesterday's interview with Uncle Qin and what she had gained from organizing the materials today. Her father then talked about the old street and alley preservation project that the bureau had been promoting recently. Yuwei felt it aligned with her column theme, so she asked a few more questions. After the meal, she helped her mother clear the table, then lay on the living room sofa with her eyes closed for 20 minutes.
location: Living room and dining room at her home, second floor, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flower arrangement preparation and online ikebana study.
description: After her energy recovered, she first went to the balcony to check the roses and eucalyptus leaves she had bought at Dounan Flower Market the day before. She took them out of the bucket, trimmed the roots again, and placed them in a shallow water basin to revive. Back in the study, she browsed several classic examples of Ikenobo rikka online, focusing on the spatial proportions among the main branch shin, the secondary branch soe, and the guest branch tai. Then she opened the class study notes Zhou Lin had shared the day before, wrote down a few key technique points on sticky notes, and stuck them on the edge of the worktable on the balcony.
location: Balcony and study at home on the second floor of Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Creating a tatehana arrangement on the balcony.
description: Spread a waterproof mat on the workbench on the balcony and put on gardening gloves. First, using eucalyptus leaves as the main branch, cut the stem at a 45-degree angle and insert it into the kenzan to secure it. Then, take the most vivid rose as the secondary branch, adjust its height and orientation to create a staggered composition with the main branch. Finally, use a few trimmed red berries and lisianthus as guest branches and filler flowers, carefully adjusting their positions on the kenzan to achieve an "asymmetric balance". Half an hour later, a rikka work combining the softness of roses and the toughness of eucalyptus leaves was completed. She stepped back a few paces, examined it closely, and felt the sense of breath flowing between the branches and leaves. After taking photos for the record, she moved the work to the coffee table in the living room and cleaned all the tools.
location: The balcony of her second-floor home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entries and reflections on flower arranging
description: After arranging the flowers, she used a mobile app to adjust the brightness and contrast of the multi-angle photos she had just taken of the arrangement, selected the most satisfying one, and printed it out with a portable printer. Back in the study, she pasted the printed photo onto that day's dedicated journal page. With a calligraphy pen, she neatly wrote '2025.02.09 Rikka Breathing' and recorded the flower materials used (roses, eucalyptus leaves, red beans). The most important part was writing a reflection in a fountain pen: 'The process of adjusting the branches is very much like adjusting one's inner self: less is more, and blank space is space. Flower arranging is not about filling, but about creating dialogue.'
location: The study at home, second floor, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Balcony reading and jasmine tea time.
description: The afternoon sunlight became softer. She went to the kitchen, brewed a cup of jasmine tea in a glass, and carried it to the balcony. Her father was still reading the newspaper in the living room, and her mother had gone out to buy groceries. She sat in the rattan chair on the balcony, opened Bai Xianyong's Taipei People, and began reading the chapter "A Sky Full of Bright Stars." The evening breeze blew over, bringing the faint fragrance of the eucalyptus leaves and the freshly trimmed flower branches on the balcony. She quickly became immersed in the story of Zhu Qing's fate and read more than forty pages in one sitting.
location: The balcony of her second-floor home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Handling household chores and resting
description: After finishing a reading session, she got up and rinsed the teacup, then put the book back on the bedside table in the study. Walking into the living room, she saw the flower arrangement on the coffee table and couldn't help taking a few close-up photos. Then she returned to the balcony, cleaned up the dried flower branch debris, and reorganized the workbench.
location: Living room and balcony of her home on the second floor, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and evening chat
description: Mother came back from grocery shopping and made Yuwei's favorites: scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried choy sum. The family of three sat around the dining table. Father was in a good mood today and talked about a colleague's child taking the civil service exam. Yuwei also shared today's flower arrangement insights and the progress of the editor's commission, saying she was very confident about the 'Cultural Landmarks' column. Mother reminded her not to overwork herself and to eat regularly.
location: Second-floor home dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: After-dinner relaxation and browsing the internet
description: After dinner, she went to the living room and slouched on the sofa for a while. She picked up her phone, looked at today's Moments and the official accounts she follows, and found some real-world grounding for the thoughts from the reading and interview just now.
location: Living room at home, 2nd floor, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Communicate with editor and plan column
description: After opening her laptop and logging into WeChat, she saw that editor Xu Mingyuan had left a message half an hour ago asking if she had any new ideas for the column. She thought for a moment, first replied with a sticker saying that she was thinking, then seriously typed: Mr. Xu, I am currently working on oral history interviews of independent bookstores, and I just organized yesterday's material today. I have an idea. I wonder if I could build a Kunming cultural landmarks series on this basis, with the first piece starting from a representative old bookstore. Do you think this direction is suitable? After sending it, she created a new Word document and began to flesh out the idea, writing down key points for the topic outline that needed to be submitted by Wednesday: the main thread of the first piece, potential interviewees, and the core perspectives she wanted to explore.
location: The study at home, second floor, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Online socializing and evening relaxation
description: Feeling a bit mentally excited, she needed to change her pace. She first sent a WeChat message to Su Man, sharing photos and reflections from today’s balcony flower arranging. Su Man quickly replied with praise, and they set a specific time to practice flower arranging together next week. She also sent a message to “Wenzi”: “Yesterday’s interview conversion rate was extremely high! I was inspired last night and wrote an essay. After organizing it today, I feel the column direction is clear too.” Wenzi replied with the word “Go!”. Then she opened the music app, played the playlist “Night Requiem”, and did a 10-minute pre-sleep stretch on the yoga mat in the corner of the bedroom.
location: Bedroom in the family home on the second floor, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for tomorrow.
description: After washing up, she took out her phone and confirmed the time (2 p.m.) and location (Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road) of tomorrow's meditation class, and placed the yoga clothes and water bottle she needed to bring on the small stool outside the study door in advance.
location: Bathroom and bedroom of the second-floor home at Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and lights out
description: She turned off the overhead light and turned on the small lamp by the bed. Lying flat on the bed, she began her daily mindfulness breathing exercise, focusing on the airflow at her nostrils and feeling her abdomen rise and fall. After ten minutes, feeling both mind and body calm, she turned off the light and fell into a deep sleep amid the faint scent of jasmine and books.
location: Bedroom in the family home on the second floor, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woken by her phone alarm, she saw cloudy skies outside the window and felt the cool air. Lying in bed with her eyes closed, she thought back to the column she had discussed with Editor Xu yesterday and felt reassured. She got out of bed, opened the curtains, and went to the bathroom to wash up. While washing up, she reminded herself that there were three important things to do today: scour the library for literature, try the meditation class, and prepare for living on campus.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: I walked out of the room and smelled the familiar sour-and-spicy aroma of small-pot rice noodles. Mom had already set out the bowls and chopsticks. I sat down to eat the steaming hot rice noodles (with a lot of pickled greens), chatting briefly with her. She said the temperature was dropping today and told me to dress warmly. I nodded and mentioned that I wouldn't be coming home tonight because I was staying at the dorm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-commute preparations and departure.
description: After breakfast, went back to the room and changed into a gray hoodie and thick jeans. Put the laptop, library card, power bank, thermos, notebook, and a pen into a canvas tote bag. On my phone, confirmed the location and route of the yoga studio again. At 8:30, said goodbye to my mother, who was tidying up the kitchen, and left on time.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus
description: Walk 2 minutes to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, use your transit card to take Metro Line 3 (toward East Bus Station) to Dongfeng Square Station, transfer to Line 1 (toward University Town South) to University Town Station. After exiting, scan a shared bike and ride about 8 minutes to the east gate of Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus. There were plenty of students in the train car, and the new-semester vibe was in full swing.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Metro Line 3 and Line 1 (from Huashan West Road Station to University City Station) and the shared-bike segment

name: Library literature search and borrowing
description: Parked the bicycle and walked into the Yunnan University Chenggong Campus library. On the third floor in the social sciences reading area, using a touch-screen search terminal, I searched with keyword combinations like Lefebvre, production of space, independent bookstore, and cultural space. I noted down the call numbers of relevant books and found the core chapters of The Production of Space (by Lefebvre) and the essay collection Reproduction of Urban Cultural Space among the shelves. Then I went to the periodical reading area and downloaded three papers related to Kunming's local cultural space to a USB drive. While checking out, I ran into my classmate Li Xin and chatted briefly about our thesis progress. Afterward, I carefully packed the borrowed paper books and the printed paper list into a canvas bag.
location: Social Sciences Reading Area, 3rd Floor, Library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus stroll and buying a hot Americano
description: After leaving the library, sunlight filtered through the clouds and the temperature was much higher than in the morning. Instead of hurrying to the cafeteria, she walked slowly along the ginkgo path, taking in the campus atmosphere. When she passed the little Time Post Office kiosk on campus, she went in for a look and bought a set of postcards printed with Yunnan University scenery. Then she bought a hot Americano at the campus supermarket, took a satisfied sip, and enjoyed a moment of tranquility.
location: Ginkgo Avenue and the campus supermarket on the Chenggong campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch
description: On the second floor of Ziyuan Canteen, she ordered a serving of Chengjiang lotus root starch, a small portion of steam-pot chicken, and a bowl of rice. She found a seat by the window and, while eating, scrolled through recent articles by other authors on the "Culture Horizon" WeChat official account to get a feel for the column. After lunch, she didn't leave immediately but sat for another ten-plus minutes and replied to a few WeChat messages.
location: Second Floor, Ziyuan Canteen, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading in front of the library during the noon break
description: After leaving the cafeteria, the sunlight was just right. I sat down on the bench outside the library, opened the table of contents and preface of the newly borrowed The Production of Space, browsed for about 15 minutes, and jotted down a few core keywords on a sticky note to warm up for the evening's deep reading.
location: Bench at the entrance of the library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: Noticing that it was almost 1:30, she closed her book and, following the navigation, walked to Jingxin Yoga Studio on the University Town Commercial Street in Chenggong District, about a 10-minute walk, and arrived early to prepare for the meditation class.
location: On the road from Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Serenity Yoga Life Studio, 2nd Floor, Zone B, University Town Commercial Street

name: First meditation experience in the afternoon
description: Arrived at the studio at 13:30 sharp, showed the mobile reservation code at the front desk, changed into loose clothing, and walked into the meditation room. Teacher Zhao Lihua was already sitting quietly with eyes closed in the center of the room. The class officially started at 14:00. Teacher Zhao guided everyone to sit in a comfortable posture and explained, “Observe the breath, don't control it, just watch.” Closing my eyes, I focused on the tip of my nose. Thoughts drifted by like a barrage of comments, but following the teacher's guidance I didn't judge them and gently brought my attention back to the breath. After about five or six minutes, I experienced a brief moment of stillness where thoughts ceased. When I opened my eyes, my shoulders and neck felt noticeably lighter. After class, I took the initiative to ask Teacher Zhao about my tendency for attention to wander. She smiled and handed me a small card printed with the “Three Deep Breaths Pause” daily practice method.
location: Meditation Room, Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Center, 2nd Floor, Zone B, University Town Commercial Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuted back to Wenlin Street in the city center
description: In the yoga studio changing room, she changed back into her own clothes and drank half a bottle of water. She decided to go straight to Wenlin Street to stroll around. From the bus stop near the yoga studio, she took Bus K to Erji Road Metro Station, transferred to Metro Line 1 to Chuanxin Gulou Station, then transferred to Bus 4 and got off at Wenlin Street Station. During the commute, she jotted down a few post-meditation reflections in her phone memo.
location: K-line bus and Metro Line 1 in Kunming, Yunnan Province (from Chenggong District to Chuanxingulou Station in Wuhua District), then transfer to Bus No. 4 to Wenlin Street Station

name: Stroll along Wenlin Street and grab some milk tea
description: Getting off the bus on Wenlin Street, I felt very relaxed looking at the familiar old bookstores, cafés, and unique little shops on both sides. I bought a warm brown sugar pearl thick milk tea (less sugar) at Yan Qilin Big Mouth Tea (Wenlin Street store). After getting it, I strolled slowly along Wenlin Street toward the area near the Yunnan University dormitory. Passing by "Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore," I flipped through the newly arrived literature section books through the glass window, thinking I would come back specially on the weekend to sit for a while.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (including the Yan Qilin Big Mouth Tea Wenlin Street store and surrounding area)

name: Return to the dormitory and tidy up
description: Carrying the milk tea, she walked about 8 minutes back to the student dormitory near Wenlin Street at Yunnan University. When she opened the dorm door, her roommates were all busy with their own activities. She put down the canvas bag and changed into comfortable pajamas. She neatly arranged the borrowed books and notebook on the desk, wiped the desktop with a wet wipe, refilled her cup with hot water, and put the newly bought postcards into the drawer.
location: In a student dormitory room at Yunnan University, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rest and relaxation.
description: Lying in bed, she scrolled through her phone for a while and replied to a few messages. Seeing her best friend Zhang Jing post a photo of her cat in the group chat, she couldn't help laughing. After resting for half an hour, she felt her energy return.
location: On the bed in the Yunnan University student dormitory on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner
description: She picked up her phone and keys and went out alone, found a clean-looking snack shop near the dormitory called Honghe Flavor Snack Shop, and ordered a portion of Jianshui small tofu and a bowl of cold rice noodles. The proprietress was very warm and even gave her a small plate of homemade pickled radish. She ate quietly by herself and felt fully energized.
location: Honghe Flavor Snack Shop, in an alley near the Yunnan University dormitory area, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening preparatory reading of literature
description: Back in the dormitory, her roommate had not returned yet. She turned on the desk lamp, made a cup of jasmine tea, and got into study mode at the desk. Picking up Chapter 3 of The Production of Space and referring to the downloaded paper list, she highlighted core concepts such as "social space" and "absolute space" with a marker, and made an initial organization of terminology and a mind map in her notebook. Whenever she came to brilliant passages, she would stop and write down her own annotations and associations. Before she knew it, more than two hours had passed, and her thoughts were much clearer.
location: In front of the desk in the student dormitory of Yunnan University on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with her best friend
description: Her eyes were a bit sore from reading, so she got up and moved around a bit. Seeing the WeChat voice message from Zhang Jing, who was already on vacation at home, she called her back with a video call. Zhang Jing was curled up on the sofa wearing a face mask. They chatted for about half an hour: Zhang Jing complained about the bizarre experience of grading primary school students' end-of-term exam papers, while Sun Yuwei shared her first experience with today's meditation class and what she had gained from the library. The two agreed that this weekend, after Sun Yuwei went home, they would take a flower arrangement class together or go for a walk by Cuihu Lake.
location: At the desk / in bed at Yunnan University student dormitory, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling the initial feelings of meditation
description: After washing up, she sat down at her desk, took out her journal, and flipped to the page for Monday, February 10. She wrote the title in green highlighter: "First Meditation Experience - Sunny (Afternoon Sunshine)". She recorded the process in detail: "Thoughts racing, briefly emptying the mind, asking questions after class." At the bottom of the page she stuck the little meditation card from the yoga studio and drew a small breathing wave line beside it with a gold pen. After writing, she set a reminder on her phone, telling herself to do one "three-deep-breath pause" every morning, noon, and evening starting the next day.
location: In front of the desk in the student dormitory of Yunnan University on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: New breathing exercise before bed and preparation for sleep
description: Her roommates came back one after another, and they chatted briefly about nightly topics. Zhao Xiaowen said she had gotten into an interesting elective course today. After the lights went out around 11:00, she half-reclined on the bed and practiced abdominal breathing as Teacher Zhao had taught: slowly inhale through the nose, letting the abdomen expand (silently counting 4 seconds), hold the breath (4 seconds), then slowly exhale through the mouth, feeling the abdomen sink back down (6 seconds). She repeated this about eight times and clearly felt her heartbeat slow and her body sink into the mattress. She stopped looking at her phone and soon fell asleep in the darkness, ending the day with rhythmic breathing and quiet introspection.
location: On the bed in the Yunnan University student dormitory on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: After waking up naturally, she stretched in bed for a few minutes. Her neck and shoulders felt much more relaxed due to last night's abdominal breathing practice. Noticing the bright sunshine outside and considering that it might turn cloudy in the afternoon, she took out a light jacket from the wardrobe. She exchanged morning greetings with her roommate Liu Jia, who was also up early, and briefly talked about how they had slept last night.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the canteen and have breakfast.
description: Carrying a backpack with a laptop and borrowed books, I walked from the dormitory to the cafeteria. I ordered two vermicelli buns and a cup of hot soy milk, found a seat by the window, and ate quietly. During that time, I checked my phone and replied to a confirmation message from editor Xu Mingyuan about the outline format.
location: Ziyuan Canteen, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Going to the library
description: After breakfast, she went straight to the library. The campus was very quiet in the early morning, and the air carried a coolness and the fragrance of grass and trees. She swiped her card to enter the library, took the elevator to the third floor, and went to her usual window seat.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus Library, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Focused reading at the library and building the outline framework.
description: I put down my backpack at a window seat in the library, opened my laptop and notebook. First, I closely read the borrowed "The Production of Space", marking key passages with a pencil. Combining it with local scholars' essays on Kunming bookstore culture, I unpacked and annotated theories such as "spatial practice" and "representational space" in my own words in the writing software. Then I began to draft the outline for the column topic "Kunming's Cultural Landmarks", listing several subheadings. Around 11:00 I took a short break, looked into the distance to relax my eyes, and used my phone to take a high-definition copy of a 1934 Kunming street map, saving it to the newly created "Column Materials" folder. My thoughts gradually became clear, and the skeleton of the outline took initial shape.
location: Window seat on the third floor of the library at Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, East Outer Ring South Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch with a roommate.
description: After clearing my desk, I headed to the cafeteria. At the entrance, I met my roommate Zhou Lin, and we queued together. I ordered tomato and scrambled egg rice. While eating, we chatted about the morning's progress at the library, and Zhou Lin complained about too much coursework. After the meal, we parted at the cafeteria entrance; Zhou Lin went to the teaching building, and I returned to the dormitory.
location: Ziyuan Canteen, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Midday break in the dormitory
description: After returning to the dorm, I backed up the draft column outline to a USB flash drive and synced it to my phone's notes app. Then I lay down on the bed, put on earphones, played some light music, and rested with my eyes closed for about half an hour to build up energy for the afternoon yoga class.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to the yoga studio
description: Changed into loose sportswear and yoga socks, set her phone to silent with only the alarm left on. Starting from the dormitory, she walked along the street outside the school for about 15 minutes and arrived at the Serenity Yoga Lifestyle Center on Cuiwei Road.
location: Jingxiu Yoga Lifestyle Studio, 128 Cuiwei Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Core Flow Yoga Class
description: The class started on time. I focused on following the teacher's instructions and tried to synchronize breath with movement. In Boat Pose, I felt my core muscles engage steadily, feeling much lighter than last week; in Downward-Facing Dog, the stretch in my back was obvious. After the one-hour class, my body was slightly sweaty and my mind felt relaxed and open.
location: Jingxiu Yoga Life Studio, Classroom 2, No. 128 Cuiwei Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Socializing in the locker room after class
description: After class, she met her yoga buddy He Lu in the locker room and brought up the poster she had seen for a new yin yoga class, saying she thought it suited her stiff neck and shoulders. He Lu readily suggested trying the class together next Tuesday, and the two happily agreed.
location: Changing room at Jingxiu Yoga Life Studio, 128 Cuiwei Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bought milk tea on the way back.
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, she slowly walked back to school along Cuiwei Road, her body still warm. At the roadside milk tea shop 'Tea Talk at Dusk,' she bought a medium brown sugar pearl milk tea with less sugar and extra pearls to reward herself.
location: Chayan Muse Milk Tea Shop, Cuiwei Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Download and set up the meditation app and social sharing
description: After returning to the dormitory, I opened my phone and downloaded the Tide meditation app. After registering, I found the "21-Day Meditation Introduction" check-in community and immediately applied to join, writing my goal in my personal statement. Then, in the app, I set Tuesday and Saturday evenings as fixed pre-bedtime meditation times, staggered with yoga practice. After completing the settings, I took a screenshot and sent it to He Lu, who replied with a "supervise.gif" animated sticker.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free time in the dormitory and socializing with roommates.
description: A relaxed afternoon. She drank milk tea with her roommates Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen and chatted about funny moments from yoga class. Later, she opened her computer and browsed mandala flower arrangement designs for journal layout inspiration, and also used her phone to take a close-up of the eucalyptus leaves on the corner of the desk.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and after-dinner walk
description: Went to the cafeteria with Zhao Xiaowen. Considering there was still meditation and flower arranging in the evening, she chose a bowl of vegetable porridge and a marinated egg, eating lightly. After the meal, the two strolled around the school convenience store and bought a pack of wet wipes.
location: Ziyuan Canteen and small supermarket, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening deep work and wrapping up the outline.
description: Back in the dormitory, she turned on the desk lamp and took out her laptop. First, she carefully examined the 1934 map scanned in the morning and hand-drew markers for important old bookstores or cultural venues near Wenlin Street in her notebook. Then she opened the column outline and, drawing on the spatial theory she had studied during the day, added two specific interview cases to the section "Physical Bookstores: The 'Third Space' of the City," including Qin Mingyuan's story. The whole process was focused and devoted, until the outline was complete in structure and clear in logic.
location: At the desk in the Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and end-of-day summary
description: I closed my computer and took out my journal. I stuck on the yoga studio's promotional card and drew a yoga silhouette, then used washi tape to attach the milk tea label, a screenshot of the meditation app's welcome screen, and a photo of eucalyptus leaves. Finally, with my fountain pen, I wrote: "2025.02.11 A day of fixed rhythm; mind is clear, and both body and heart have something to rely on." The whole process felt deeply satisfying.
location: At the desk in the Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening freestyle flower arrangement practice.
description: I took the roses and eucalyptus leaves out of the bucket and got out the newly bought terracotta vase and scissors. Instead of a fixed arrangement, I let the stems stretch naturally at different heights: first I inserted two eucalyptus branches to build the spatial framework, then used a half-open pink rose as the visual focus, and finally leaned a slightly shorter rose against the rim of the vase for a playful touch. When it was done, I placed it on the upper right corner of my desk, and a faint fragrance spread through the air.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: Before bed, she went to the bathroom to wash her face, brush her teeth, and apply night cream. She also deliberately soaked her feet in hot water to relieve the mild muscle soreness from yoga.
location: Bathroom, Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation
description: I put on my earphones, opened the Tide app, and selected the 5-minute "Bedtime Relaxation" meditation. Lying flat with my hands on my abdomen, I followed the guided instructions to do deep abdominal breathing. At first my thoughts drifted to the outline due tomorrow, but they were soon pulled back to the sensations in my body. By the end of the meditation, I was completely relaxed from my shoulders to my heels.
location: On the bed in the Ziyuan dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing to rest and fall asleep
description: I took off my earphones, turned off the desk lamp, set my phone to Do Not Disturb, and put it on the bedside table. Thinking back on a day of efficient study, satisfying yoga, a ritualistic meditation start, and a unique flower-arranging session, I felt a solid calm and quickly fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the Ziyuan dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up and morning meditation
description: At 7:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei was woken by her alarm. She got up, drank a glass of warm water, then sat on the edge of the bed and opened a meditation app for a five-minute morning meditation, focusing on her breath and the stillness of her thoughts to gather energy for the new day. After finishing the meditation, she checked in. The weather outside, changing from cloudy to sunny, cheered her up.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory Area, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and tidying
description: After meditation, Sun Yuwei brushed her teeth, washed her face, and did simple skincare in the dormitory bathroom. She changed into an off-white knit cardigan and dark blue jeans, put items such as her thesis folder, pencil case, journal, and ID documents into a canvas bag, and prepared to go out to study and for the upcoming contract signing.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory Area, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the library and buy breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei walked out of the dormitory into the slightly cool morning air, walked to the convenience store in the Ziyuan living area, and bought a bottle of mineral water and a ham sandwich as a snack for later. She then continued along the campus path toward the Chenggong Campus Library. The cherry trees along the road had begun to show scattered buds, which made her feel happy.
location: Ziyuan Living Area, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Literature Study at the Library
description: Sun Yuwei sat down at her usual seat by the window on the third floor of the library, took out the ethnographic essay collection 'The Survival and Transformation of Independent Bookstores' and her laptop, and focused on reading. She sorted through application cases of oral history methods in cultural space research, connected and compared them with yesterday's theoretical framework, gradually identified four application models of oral history, and recorded them in detail in her notebook.
location: The Humanities and Social Sciences Section, 3rd Floor, Library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Confirming the flower arrangement invitation
description: During a break from reading, Sun Yuwei received a WeChat message from her friend Su Man, confirming that they would meet downstairs at the dormitory at 1 p.m. and that Su Man would bring pink lilies and pine branches for the flower arrangement. She replied happily, tidied up the thesis materials on her desk, and put the materials she needed to read in the afternoon into a canvas bag separately.
location: Library, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus lunch
description: Sun Yuwei left the library and walked to the second floor of the Ziyuan Cafeteria. She chose a claypot rice with cured meats for lunch instead of her usual rice noodles to change things up. While eating, she browsed articles on the official WeChat account of Cultural Vision magazine, looking for inspiration for her future column.
location: Second floor, Ziyuan Canteen, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning to the dormitory and setting up the flower arrangement station
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei returned to the dormitory. She tidied the balcony next to her desk, brought out a folding table and spread a linen-cotton tablecloth over it, preparing a clean and tidy workspace for the upcoming flower arrangement creation, looking forward to spending creative time with Su Man.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory Area, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lantern Festival flower arrangement creation
description: At one in the afternoon, Su Man arrived as promised with pink lilies and pine branches. The two of them worked at the balcony worktable, discussing the proportions and negative-space principles of the Ikenobo school's rikka while creating the arrangement. Sun Yuwei was in charge of positioning the main stem, and Su Man used pine branches and lilies to build spatial layers. After an hour of careful collaboration, an ikebana work named 'Reunion' was completed—simple, elegant, and warm. They took photos to mark the occasion, and Sun Yuwei shared the pictures with her mother.
location: Balcony, Ziyuan Dormitory Area, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Saying goodbye and preparing to go out
description: After the flower arranging, Sun Yuwei walked Su Man downstairs and thanked her for the floral materials and guidance. Back in her room, she carefully placed the arrangement in a corner of her desk, then took her canvas bag with materials and journal and set out for the independent bookstore downtown.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory Area, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei walked from the dormitory to University Town Metro Station, took Metro Line 1, and arrived at Huashan West Road Station after about forty minutes. After exiting the station, she walked about ten minutes along Cuihu North Road to her familiar Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore. Jazz was playing in the store, and the air was filled with the scent of paper and coffee.
location: Kunming Metro Line 1, Yunnan Province (from University Town Station to Huashan West Road Station) and the walking section of Cuihu North Road

name: Bookstore reading and conversation
description: After Sun Yuwei greeted the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan, Uncle Qin brewed a cup of hot ripe pu'er tea for her. She sat in a corner by the window, took out the remaining two papers, and read attentively in the quiet atmosphere of the bookstore. During that time, Uncle Qin came over for a brief exchange about new books and recommended a collection of essays about strolling through cities in Southeast Asia.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Received a column contract offer and discussed it with mother
description: Sun Yuwei had just finished reading the paper when editor Xu Mingyuan sent an invitation to sign and an electronic contract for the “Kunming Slices” column of Cultural Horizon magazine. Her heart raced. She walked out of the bookstore onto Cuihu North Road, called her mother, and calmly explained the column invitation and key contract terms. Her mother was very happy and reminded her to pay attention to the copyright clauses. This support and recognition made her even more determined.
location: At the entrance of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Online contract signing
description: After talking with her mother, Sun Yuwei calmed herself down. On the wooden chair outside the bookstore, she carefully checked the contract terms on her phone and, after confirming they were correct, solemnly signed via an e-signature app. She saved a screenshot of the successful signing page, then went back into the bookstore to thank Qin Mingyuan and say goodbye, and packed up her belongings.
location: At the entrance of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home to help prepare dinner
description: Sun Yuwei walked about ten minutes from the bookstore back to her home on Renmin Middle Road. As soon as she entered, she smelled the aroma of steam pot chicken in the kitchen. Her mother was busy; she put down her canvas tote bag, washed her hands, and helped set out bowls and chopsticks and ladle out tangyuan. The mother and daughter prepared together for the Lantern Festival dinner.
location: Home kitchen, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family Lantern Festival dinner and celebration
description: When her father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, he gave Sun Yuwei a dark blue Lamy fountain pen as a gift, congratulating her on becoming a columnist. The family of three sat around the dining table, tasting steam pot chicken and black sesame tangyuan. Yuwei described the contract signing process in detail, and her father, drinking some wine, was full of pride in his voice.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watching the Lantern Festival Gala
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei helped her mother clear the dishes, then the family watched the Lantern Festival Gala in the living room. Outside the window, the full moon hung high. Yuwei leaned on the sofa, enjoying the rare, warm time with her parents, her heart full of happiness and contentment.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and reflection.
description: After the party ended, Sun Yuwei returned to her room. On the monthly calendar page of her journal, she solemnly wrote '2.12 Signing' and stuck on a gold medal sticker. Then she picked up the fountain pen her father gave her, recorded her feelings about today's flower arrangement creation, pasted the printed photo of the flower arrangement onto the page, and wrote down her hopes for her column writing.
location: Sun Yuwei's bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Washing up before bed and leaving reminders
description: After finishing her journal, Sun Yuwei went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into comfortable pajamas. Before going to bed, she opened the memo app on her phone and wrote the reminder '2.18 Yin Yoga appointment with He Lu,' then set the alarm for the next day.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: At nine in the evening, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard, flipping through a collection of essays about strolling through Southeast Asian cities that Qin Mingyuan had recommended, savoring the exotic atmosphere in the book. After a few pages, she grew drowsy, closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep peacefully, feeling fulfilled and content.
location: Sun Yuwei's bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning meditation, washing up, and breakfast
description: The alarm went off in the faint morning light of the mist. Sun Yuwei sat up in bed, looking forward to the new day. Sitting on the edge of the bed, she opened the Tide app and followed the guide to do a 5-minute breathing meditation, focusing on inner calm to charge up for the day's writing. While washing up, she softly said "Come on" to herself in the mirror. She warmed a glass of milk and paired it with two leftover flower cakes from yesterday. While eating breakfast, she quickly browsed a few cultural WeChat official account articles on her phone to get a feel for the language.
location: Bedroom, bathroom, and kitchen at home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Commute to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus
description: Carrying a backpack containing a laptop, a notebook, and a mirrorless camera, she walked from Cuihu Community to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station. There were quite a few people on the subway during the morning rush. Sun Yuwei put on earphones, quickly skimmed the transcribed recording of yesterday's interview with Uncle Qin in her phone's memo app, while catching up on sleep and rehearsing in her mind the topic to be discussed today. The subway car shook gently as she traveled from Huashan West Road Station to University Town Station, then walked to the Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University.
location: Starting from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, she took the subway from Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station to Daxuecheng Station, arriving at the Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Online editorial meeting finalizes the first piece for the column
description: She sat in a window seat in the humanities and social sciences section on the fourth floor of the library at Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus, put on her earphones, and contacted editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat voice call on time. Sun Yuwei brought up a topic she had been nurturing for a while—"Morning and Dusk on Wenlin Street"—and, drawing on the details of Uncle Qin's interview, explained how to slice into the daily life of the bookstore street from the dimensions of time and the senses. Xu Mingyuan affirmed the direction, found it highly readable, and emphasized the need for vivid imagery and sound descriptions, setting the deadline one week later. After the call, she immediately wrote "Morning and Dusk on Wenlin Street" and the due date in her journal, feeling full of motivation.
location: Window seat in the Humanities and Social Sciences section, 4th floor, Chenggong Campus Library, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reviewing source materials and outlining the article
description: In the library, Sun Yuwei opened the “Kunming Writing Materials” folder on her computer, systematically browsed the photos of the bookstore's interior and exterior taken a few days earlier, clicked on excerpts of the interview recording, and flipped through scattered observation notes in her journal. She picked out details such as “the light clink of metal hooks when Uncle Qin removed the door panels,” “morning light slanting onto the bookshelves and stirring up dust motes,” and “warm yellow evening light glowing through the glass window,” then quickly sketched a four-part structure for the essay in her notebook: Overture (the awakening of the alley), Morning Light (the opening of the bookstore and its people), Twilight (the settling of light, shadow, and stories), and Epilogue (the closing of the day).
location: Library, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Make a field shooting plan for tomorrow and the day after tomorrow.
description: According to the article framework, Sun Yuwei realized that the material she had on hand lacked the complete atmosphere of early morning and dusk. She decisively made a field collection plan in her phone's memo app for the next two days: arrive at Wenlin Street at 6:50 a.m. tomorrow to capture the scenes of the bookstore taking down its wooden shutters and the street waking up in the morning light; go again at the same time the day after tomorrow in the evening to capture the warm-toned light and shadows around sunset. She also marked the specific camera positions: the crosswalk directly opposite Zhibushi Bookstore, and the intersection of Qianju Street and Wenlin Street.
location: Library, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: The growling of her stomach brought Sun Yuwei back to reality. She closed her computer and walked to Ziyuan Cafeteria on the Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, where she ordered a steaming bowl of small-pot rice noodles and a cold, sweet papaya water. While eating, she thought through the details of the framework, occasionally glancing at her phone and replying to friends' messages.
location: Ziyuan Canteen, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth research and note integration at the library
description: Back at the library, she first did 10 minutes of standing relaxation, then focused on tackling the research notes from the previous two days. She opened mind-mapping software, integrated the handwritten key points with the electronic notes on her computer, and used different colors to distinguish the three sections — “spatial theory,” “oral history methods,” and “urban imagery” — clearly marking the relationships among the cited sources. After doing this, the overall structure of the literature review became extremely clear.
location: Library, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute from Chenggong back to Wenlin Street
description: Seeing that it was about time, I packed up and left the library. Before going to the metro station, I bought an iced Americano at the campus coffee shop to refresh myself. I took the train from University Town Station back to the downtown area, put on my earphones, and looped the white noise track "Coffee Shop Afternoon" to get in the mood for the upcoming site visit. On the metro, I continued refining my field-research plan.
location: Starting from Yunnan University Chenggong Campus in Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, via University Town Station to Huashan West Road Station, arriving at Wenlin Street in Wuhua District.

name: Scouting Wenlin Street to capture the dusk scene
description: Getting off at Huashan West Road Station, she walked to Wenlin Street. Sunlight filtered through the mist and plane tree leaves, casting dappled light and shadow. Sun Yuwei took out her mirrorless camera and walked slowly along the west side of the street, capturing the shadows of people jumping on the old red-brick walls as sunlight passed through the leaves, and also the fallen leaves on the bench. At the entrance to Qianju Street, she met an old man walking his dog. They chatted briefly; he said, "Wenlin Street used to be a dry road, with paddy fields on both sides." She immediately wrote down this dialect phrase in her phone memo.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (sections including Mingyuan Bookstore and Qianju Street)

name: Bookstore exchange and evening coffee
description: After taking photos, she walked into the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore on the street corner. The store was filled with the aroma of coffee. Uncle Qin (Qin Mingyuan) was organizing books behind the counter. Sun Yuwei ordered a hot oat milk and shared the photos she had just taken and the article framework she had conceived with him. Uncle Qin gave some suggestions, such as writing about the serendipitous book selections and readers in the bookstore. The chat gave her more confidence in the visual imagery and humanistic depth of the article.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and preparing dinner
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she walked home. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to her mother Li Xiulan saying she wanted to eat her tomato scrambled eggs. Once home, she changed into loungewear, went to the kitchen to help her mother pick vegetables and set out bowls and chopsticks. At the dining table, she shared the funny stories about today's contract signing and meeting the old man walking his dog. Her mother smiled and told her to write more old stories of Kunming.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner time
description: The family of three sat around the table eating. On the table were scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried pork with green peppers, and a plate of sautéed seasonal vegetables. Sun Yuwei again brought up her signed column and the progress of her first day at work. Her parents, Sun Mingyuan and Li Xiulan, were happy for her and reminded her to take care of her health and not stay up late, which made her feel warm inside.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening deep work, systematizing thesis notes.
description: Back in her room, the Lamy fountain pen was lying on the desk. She turned on the computer, combined the notes and mind maps she had brought back from the library with her thoughts from the day, and systematically organized the text of the “literature review” section of her paper. She separately extracted the key operation points of the oral history method and saved them as a practical guide that could be called up at any time. After finishing, she stretched and felt that the paper was beginning to take shape, and she was very satisfied.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: He Lu called with an invitation to watch seagulls on the weekend.
description: Just as she was about to close her computer, her phone rang—it was her yoga partner He Lu. On the call, He Lu excitedly said the weekend weather was wonderful and wanted to invite Sun Yuwei to Cuihu Lake to see the black-headed gulls that had just flown back to spend the winter. The two chatted for 20 minutes, from insights from yoga class to newly released movies. Sun Yuwei happily agreed, and they arranged to meet at Cuihu East Gate at 10 a.m. Saturday.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal record and tomorrow's plan
description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei took out her new fountain pen and journal and carefully recorded the day's three important events: "contract confirmation," "topic selection finalized," and "paper draft completed." Beside them, she stuck a newly purchased long-tailed bookmark sticker. Then she wrote down tomorrow's field trip plan: leave at 6:50, bring the mirrorless camera and voice recorder, destination Wenlin Street.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening washing up and reading
description: After washing up, she changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and reread an essay from the prose collection Uncle Qin had recommended, letting the words settle in her mind. Then she flipped through a few pages of reference photos for tomorrow's field visit, drafting the descriptions of the article in her head.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: At exactly 23:00, she turned off the light. Remembering her mother's advice, she silently said to herself, "Good luck tomorrow," and then closed her eyes. The lights and shadows of Wenlin Street and the conversations in the bookstore still lingered in her mind. Carrying expectations for the next day, she gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine and family breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei woke up to the alarm, washed up, and sat down at her desk. She opened the Tide app and did five minutes of mindful breathing meditation. Then she had breakfast with her mother, Li Xiulan: steaming hot ersi and warm milk. As they ate, they talked about the upcoming column. Her mother suggested she try writing about the food market from the perspective of the auntie selling mushrooms, which made her eyes light up, and she quickly wrote it down in her memo.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning work preparation and communication with the editor.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei went to her study, opened the call log, and transcribed the editor Xu Mingyuan's key points—such as 'on-the-ground perspective' and 'point the lens at ordinary people'—into a new notebook. Then, incorporating her mother's tips, she sketched a mind map of fieldwork priorities. At 9:00 sharp, she made a WeChat voice call to the editor, reporting on the progress of Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street and the concept for Poetry of the Wet Market. Xu Mingyuan affirmed the 'vendor's perspective' and suggested using the fieldwork methods from her thesis. After the call, she drew a mind map in her journal with Poetry of the Wet Market at the center, and decided to go to the vegetable market right away to experience it in person.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Created the first half of the first draft of “The Vegetable Market Poems.”
description: Sun Yuwei opened a blank document and began writing the second essay in the collection, 'Poetry of the Vegetable Market.' From memory, she described the colors and hawking cries of Zhuanxin Market, but after writing 800 characters, she felt the text was not vivid enough. She got up and listened to a few songs by Li Jian on the balcony, but it did not improve.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Field trip to Zhuanxin Food Market and note organization
description: Sun Yuwei put on her khaki trench coat and walked from home to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market. After arriving, she squeezed in front of a stall selling wild mushrooms to observe the stall owner, jotting down vivid details in her phone's memo app. After spending nearly an hour browsing the market and buying strawberries, she walked back, and on the way sat on a stone bench by the roadside to organize her writing sketches, polishing the sparkling sentences into paragraphs, such as "a bamboo carrying pole worn smooth and shiny by the years."
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (round trip from home).

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother had a simple tomato and egg noodle dish, reminiscing about what they had seen at the market. After the meal, she returned to her room, listened to Li Jian's songs, and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revised and continued writing "Poems of the Vegetable Market"
description: Sun Yuwei opened the document on her computer, inserted key fragments from her market notes into the morning's draft, and rewrote a passage from the "vendor's perspective" her mother had mentioned, feeling that the writing now had the flavor of everyday life. She then began the second half, but after writing a bit, felt drained and decided to set it aside for now.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Yoga practice and after-class discussion.
description: With half an hour before yoga class, Sun Yuwei changed into her workout clothes, slung her yoga mat over her shoulder, and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to He Lu to confirm the afternoon class. At 14:30 the class started on time. Today's session was a neck-and-shoulder relaxation sequence. In Cat-Cow pose she felt her spine move flexibly, and in Eagle pose she released the stiffness in her shoulder blades. After the 50-minute class, she talked with He Lu in the locker room, sharing her vegetable market experience and creative progress, and confirmed their plan to meet at 10:00 the next day at the east gate of Cuihu Lake to watch the black-headed gulls.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Picked up a package on the way home (received a postcard from my older sister)
description: Leaving the yoga studio, Sun Yuwei stopped by the Cainiao station at the entrance of her residential community on the way and picked up a postcard sent by her sister Sun Yutong from Shenzhen. It had a sunset photo of Shenzhen Bay Bridge and an encouraging message, which warmed her heart. She then went straight home.
location: Cainiao Station at the entrance of Cuihu Community, Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and home

name: Deep work: writing the latter half of the first draft of *Poems of the Wet Market*
description: Back home, Sun Yuwei pinned the postcard onto the corkboard at her desk, and inspiration surged. Taking advantage of the relaxed feeling after yoga and the fresh impressions of the wet market, she used her LAMY fountain pen to write vivid paragraphs in her notebook about the fish vendor, the tofu beauty, the auntie with a carrying pole, and other scenes. The “soul” of the article gradually took shape.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner conversation
description: Mother began preparing dinner, and Sun Yuwei helped in the kitchen by peeling garlic and trimming vegetables while describing what she had seen at the market. Mother added the "lingo" of the mushroom market. At dinner, she told her parents about the editor phone call, the field trip experience, and her yoga feelings, and mentioned that she was stuck on her writing. Mother suggested she write from the perspective of the mushroom-selling auntie, which made everything suddenly clear.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rewrite and refine the first draft of The Poem of the Vegetable Market
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei threw herself into her study and re-examined the draft from the “street vendor’s perspective” her mother had suggested. She changed the detached narration into an immersive experience and replaced unsatisfactory passages with vivid details recorded from the vegetable market. After rewriting the first draft, she read through the whole text and fine-tuned the structure, linking scattered paragraphs to make the rhythm smoother.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journal record and tomorrow's plan
description: After finishing the manuscript, Sun Yuwei wrote down today's keywords in her journal: 'called editor, vegetable market field trip, flow yoga, mother's advice', and tucked her sister's postcard into the journal. Then she turned to the next day's plan page and wrote, '10:00 AM, Cuihu East Gate, watch black-headed gulls with He Lu'.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: After washing up and changing into her pajamas, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and played Li Jian's By the Lake of Baikal. At 22:00 she opened the Tide app and completed a 5-minute mindfulness meditation check-in, then wrote down her thoughts of the day in her memo. Then she opened the essay collection recommended by Uncle Qin to read and draw writing inspiration, until she turned off the light and fell asleep at 23:30.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: Sun Yuwei woke up on Sunday morning to the sunlight outside her window and the sound of her mother busy in the kitchen. She reached for her phone, glanced at the time, then got up and washed up. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had specially cooked small-pot rice noodles with pickled cabbage and minced pork for her; the broth was rich. As they ate breakfast and chatted, Sun Yuwei mentioned that she was going to Green Lake with He Lu today to watch seagulls, and she and her mother agreed that she would be back around 10:30 to go to the market together. After breakfast, she checked her backpack and brought her mirrorless camera, phone, journal, and the postcard her sister had sent.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to Green Lake Park with He Lu to watch seagulls
description: Sun Yuwei walked from home along Huashan West Road toward Green Lake Park. The early spring air was slightly cool; in the neighborhood the magnolias were still in bud, and along the road she could see elderly people returning from morning exercise. She slowed her pace to enjoy the morning calm. She met her friend He Lu at the East Gate of Green Lake, right in the Siberian black-headed gull viewing season, with flocks of gulls circling over the lake. The two walked along the lakeside path, feeding whole wheat bread to the gulls and chatting. Sun Yuwei used her phone to snap the gulls spreading their wings and scrambling for food. They sat down on a bench near Jiulong Pool and shared what had been going on: He Lu talked about the new yoga poses she had learned, Sun Yuwei mentioned her plan to visit Zhuanxin Vegetable Market that afternoon for creative material, and she showed He Lu the postcard her sister had sent. They confirmed they would meet again after next Tuesday's yoga class, then said goodbye.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Said goodbye to He Lu and walked home
description: He Lu left first to go to her yoga class. Sun Yuwei saw that it was about the right time, so she turned and walked home along Huashan West Road. Passing the newsstand at the entrance of the residential community, she bought a copy of Spring City Evening News on the way.
location: Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Strolled through Zhuanxin Food Market with my mother to gather inspiration.
description: After returning home and meeting up with her mother, Sun Yuwei walked with her to the Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. The Saturday market was bustling with crowds and lively scenes. Sun Yuwei carried her mirrorless camera and moved through the fresh meat area, vegetable section, and mushroom stalls, focusing on photographing the soil-covered termite mushrooms, brightly colored chili peppers, and the deft movements of the tofu pudding stall owner skimming off the foam. Her mother, Li Xiulan, skillfully picked spareribs for the evening soup and fresh pea shoots, while introducing her to which stall owners were locals and whose cured meat was most authentic. Sun Yuwei jotted down the Kunming dialect vendors' calls and interesting conversations in her journal, accumulating rich writing material and deeply experiencing the lively, down-to-earth atmosphere of the market.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had lunch with mother at Happy Family Restaurant.
description: After the field trip, the mother and daughter found a clean noodle shop at Happy Family Restaurant outside the market. Both ordered a bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles with fried sauce and crushed peanuts, rich in flavor and just right to replenish the energy spent walking around all morning. While eating, her mother told her many stories about buying groceries when she was young.
location: Happy Family Restaurant, 106 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home, organized materials, and took a short rest
description: The mother and daughter carried the groceries they had bought, along with a bunch of white daisies her mother had picked up on a whim, and strolled home slowly. After arriving home, Sun Yuwei went to her room, imported the photos from her mirrorless camera into her computer, quickly browsed through them, and selected twenty or thirty satisfactory ones into a separate folder. In her journal, she recorded the layout of the vegetable market and the memorable moments with short text and casually drawn small icons. After that, she set a half-hour alarm and lay down for a short nap to recharge for the afternoon's deep creative work.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Deep revision of the essay "The Poetry of the Wet Market"
description: Sun Yuwei brewed a cup of green tea and opened the document “Poetry of the Vegetable Market” at her desk. She wove in the material she had heard while chatting with her mother that morning, shifting the narrative focus from her own observations to the specific character of “the auntie who sells mushrooms.” She added details such as the vendor calls, the small talk with regular customers, and even a black mole on the back of the woman’s hand, and inserted the line her mother had mentioned—“I want to become an auntie who sells mushrooms”—as the finishing touch. Completely absorbed, she polished the text again and again, cutting redundant expressions until she was satisfied.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Have dinner with the family
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the computer and went to the kitchen to help her mother, picking and washing vegetables, and put the white daisies she had bought into a vase. Her mother hummed a tune while stewing ribs, and the atmosphere was warm. Sun Yuwei told her mother about the initial progress of today's manuscript revision. Her mother nodded and said, “That’s right—what you write has to be about living, breathing people.” At dinner, her father Sun Mingyuan also joined them at the table, where there were pork rib stew with lotus root and stir-fried pea shoots. Sun Yuwei told her father about watching seagulls at Green Lake and what she had seen at the Zhuanxin Market. He listened with great interest and made a few remarks about how Kunming had changed. The family’s casual chat made her feel relaxed and happy.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Completed the final draft of "Poems from the Vegetable Market".
description: After dinner and washing up, Sun Yuwei brewed a pot of rose tea for herself, sat down at her desk, and entered the final sprint. She reorganized and polished the manuscript, naturally weaving the insight "Seagulls and the food market are both the breath of Kunming" into the ending. She weighed every word and adjusted the rhythm of the sentences, completely immersed in the writing. It was only after she typed the final period and read through the whole text to confirm it was error-free that she let out a long sigh of relief. By then it was nearly ten o'clock in the evening.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Send the manuscript to the editor and take care of bedtime tasks.
description: Sun Yuwei saved the manuscript as 'Vegetable Market Poetry Final Draft.pdf', then opened WeChat and sent a message to editor Xu Mingyuan with the file attached: "Teacher Xu, sorry to disturb you. After your guidance on our last call, I rewrote this piece, 'Vegetable Market Poetry', and I feel more satisfied with it than before. I'd like your criticism and corrections. Thank you very much!" After finishing this, she began working on her journal, pasting in mini photos of the Cuihu seagulls and the mushrooms at the vegetable market she had taken today, and recording her mood. She also sent her sister a voice message saying she had received the postcard, and shared her fulfilling day.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Relaxation and meditation before bed.
description: She changed into pajamas, turned off the main light, and left only a warm yellow desk lamp on. Leaning against the headboard, she did five minutes of mindfulness meditation to let her restless thoughts settle. After the meditation, she felt physically tired but deeply satisfied because she had finished the manuscript. She slipped into bed, the noise of the market and the cries of gulls by the lake still echoing in her mind, and soon fell asleep.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Getting up and morning meditation
description: She stayed up revising the manuscript until the early morning, and on Sunday she allowed herself to sleep until 9. Opening the curtains, she saw cloudy skies and soft sunlight outside. Using her meditation app, she began today's 10-minute meditation practice, continuing her 21-day meditation check-in plan. Her mind was a little foggy, but thinking of the bargaining sounds she had heard at the vegetable market yesterday and the way her mother chatted with the auntie at the mushroom stall, she gradually let those images settle, and her breathing became steady.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: View morning health data, including sleep and heart rate.
description: After meditation, go to the study, take out the fountain pen and the handmade-paper journal that my sister gave me, record the relaxed feeling after finalizing “Poetry of the Vegetable Market” last night, and sort out the impressive details from yesterday: Mom’s saying that “termite mushrooms must be torn along the grain to stay fresh,” and He Lu’s story about seagulls flying from Siberia to Shenzhen for the winter. List today’s to-do items. Open the family group and the close-friends group, share the good news of the finalized draft, and receive compliments and voice replies.
location: Study at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Breakfast and caring for the flower arrangement.
description: Leaving the bedroom, she saw her mother busy in the kitchen. First, she went to the living room to arrange the slightly wilted lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves bought last week in a vase, combining them with the daisies her mother had brought home yesterday. Following the Ikenobo school's "free flower" approach, she made the golden daisies and pale purple lisianthus collide in color, with one eucalyptus leaf extending diagonally outward to create a sense of spring-summer vitality. The new arrangement was placed in the center of the living room coffee table. Around 11 o'clock, her mother brought out small-pot rice noodles and roasted erkuai. As they ate, her mother showed interest in the finalized draft from last night.
location: Home living room and kitchen, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Housework and rest
description: After breakfast, she helped clear away the dishes and brewed herself some rose tea. Sitting on the sofa and scrolling through her phone, she saw the poster for the new exhibition at the gallery that Chen Sisi had posted and quietly liked it. She also spotted someone recommending Kunming’s newly opened independent bookstore “Yemu” and saved the address. She sorted out the shopping bags brought back from the vegetable market the day before, dividing the dried mushrooms her mother had bought into sealed jars, planning to make soup another day.
location: Home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: The whole family sat around the table, and Father came out to eat too.
