Mother had made stir-fried pea shoots and stir-fried pork with pickled vegetables, and Father talked about a funny little incident at work. I mentioned that I was going to an online book club in the evening, and Father asked what book I planned to share. I said 'My Old Beijing.' He nodded and said, 'The old Beijing in Lin Haiyin's writing has a real hutong flavor.' After dinner, I went back to the bedroom, leaned against a cushion, and read a passage from 'Hui'an House' for a while to get a feel for the evening sharing. Half an hour later, I felt sleepy, closed my eyes, and slept for 20 minutes.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Organized observation notes on independent bookstores
description: After waking up feeling refreshed, she sat at her desk, opened her laptop, and created a new folder. She looked through the photos in her phone album of Mingyuan Bookstore and Xiangxing Bookstore taken earlier: Mingyuan Bookstore with its warm yellow lighting and books piled up to the ceiling, and the arched window on the second floor of Xiangxing Bookstore facing the street. She decided to structure tonight’s sharing around “how bookstore spaces become containers for city stories,” and used the vendor stories she recorded while walking through the vegetable market yesterday as a contrast. She wrote down notes: “The market is alive, the bookstore is still, but both collect people’s shadows.” She reread the chapters “Hui’an House” and “Let’s Go See the Sea” from Old Stories of the South of the City and copied memorable sentences into her notebook.
location: Study at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Afternoon tea
description: After writing notes, I felt thirsty, went to the kitchen, and poured myself a cup of the Dianhong tea I bought yesterday. I also took out the flower cakes my roommate gave me last time as an afternoon snack. Leaning by the window, I saw children chasing and playing in the community below, with sunlight occasionally breaking through the clouds. This Sunday felt lazy and peaceful.
location: Home kitchen, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Write an outline for the book club sharing session
description: After afternoon tea, I returned to the study and systematically wrote the outline for the evening sharing session. I designed three levels: seeing the spiritual foundation of the city through 'Old Stories from South of the City'; from physical space to cultural space, why bookstores are the city's poetic containers (using Mingyuan Bookstore and Xiangxing Bookstore as examples); and field research — visiting bookstores with the 'smell of the wet market' to discover another kind of urban narrative. I prepared concrete examples for each level, thought about how to interact with other book lovers, exported the document to my phone, and marked the passages I planned to read aloud in a reading app.
location: Study at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Help prepare dinner and share a family meal.
description: I walked out of the study to the kitchen to help my mother prepare dinner. The meal was light; my mother simmered pork rib and radish soup and stir-fried garlic lettuce. I helped peel garlic and set the table. At 18:10 my father came out, and the three of us sat around the dining table. During the meal I confirmed the evening book club agenda and time once more. My father asked if I had thought about turning the bookstore sharing into the next column piece. I nodded and said I could, with the theme Encountering the Morning and Dusk of the City in Bookstores.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Equipment debugging and personal preparation
description: She went back to the bedroom half an hour early, moved the laptop onto the nightstand, plugged in earphones, opened the online meeting app, and checked the microphone and camera. Still in her loungewear, she deliberately changed into a light blue knit cardigan to feel more formal. She opened the WeChat group for the book club, saw the meeting link and agenda posted by the group owner, put her speaking outline nearby, made a cup of light tea, and quietly waited for the meeting to begin.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Attend the 'City and Literature' online reading-sharing session
description: The meeting started on time at 20:00, with 12 people attending. The book club members spoke freely around the theme. When it was my turn to share, I took a deep breath and then clearly and fluently talked about my observations of several independent bookstores in Kunming over the past six months, and how to re-read "Old Stories from the South of the City." I focused on the "Hui'an Hall" chapter, comparing it with the tranquil atmosphere of Mingyuan Bookstore, an old-style community bookstore. I used the "smell of the vegetable market" as a metaphor for urban vitality, saying that bookstores are archives that store a city's memories. After the sharing, someone in the comment section asked a question, and I answered it based on my field trip to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market last Friday.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Online discussion among book friends and exchanging WeChat contacts
description: After the book club ended, I received two private messages on social media. Yang Fan, a Kunming girl, said: "Your sharing showed me a different Kunming. I have a membership at Xiangxing Bookstore, but I never thought about its connection to 'Old Stories of the South of the City.' Let's go explore bookstores together next time!" Zhou Min, a master's student in comparative literature, asked for details about the bookstore culture interview. I replied to each and took the initiative to suggest adding each other on WeChat. After exchanging WeChat IDs, Yang Fan sent me the location of her usual bookstore, 'Wildwood Study,' and we agreed to go together next weekend. We also exchanged lists of bookstores we usually visit.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Nighttime wrap-up: washing up and journal review
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up. While showering, fragments of the book club exchange flashed through her mind; the new book-club friends brought more possibilities to her social life. After washing up, she dried her hair, sat down at her desk, and took out her journal. She reviewed today’s keywords: meditation, daisies, bookstore notes, online sharing, new book-club friends. With a blue fountain pen, she wrote down her thoughts from the book club, recording the impromptu inspirations from her comments and the topic “shop space and street narrative” that Zhou Min had mentioned. She printed a photo of Mingyuan Bookstore and pasted it into the journal, writing next to it: “A bookstore is a love letter written by a city to itself.” Finally, she checked tomorrow’s class schedule and assignments to make sure everything was ready.
location: Home bathroom and study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: She felt her eyes were dry, set down her phone, and lay back in bed. She opened the meditation app, selected the deep sleep meditation guided audio, and followed the voice to relax every part of her body. During a break in the relaxation, she thought of the yin yoga trial class she had scheduled with He Lu on Tuesday afternoon and silently looked forward to it. At 23:30, as the meditation audio ended, she turned off the bedside lamp and fell into a deep sleep amid goodnight whispers.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Waking up in the morning and family breakfast
description: The 6:30 alarm went off. Sun Yuwei got up, did a few simple stretches, and went to wash up in a light blue hoodie and canvas jacket. Then she went to the living room, where her mother, Li Xiulan, was preparing breakfast. She sat down to enjoy small-pot rice noodles and, while eating, chatted with her mother about the plan to go on a field trip to Wenlin Street that day to collect material for the first installment of the 'Kunming Slices' column, 'Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street'.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Left home and headed to Wenlin Street
description: Sun Yuwei checked her canvas tote bag for her journal, fountain pen, phone, and other items, said goodbye to her mother, and walked out. The streets were quiet in the early morning. She walked through Huashan West Road and several alleys, saw the breakfast stalls just setting out steaming erkuai, and felt the rhythm of the city waking up. About fifteen minutes later, she arrived at Wenlin Street.
location: Along the way from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Wenlin Street

name: Morning outing to Wenlin Street for inspiration
description: When Sun Yuwei arrived on Wenlin Street, the morning light was falling on the old locust trees and the blue stone slabs. She walked slowly along the street observing, using her phone memo to record details: white steam rising from the steamer baskets at a breakfast shop, an elderly person walking a dog, students on bicycles, and daisies and lilies with dew on them at a flower stall. She sketched in her journal and took photos, gathering vivid material for her column article.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near the intersection with Wenhua Lane)

name: Returned home to organize the field-collected materials.
description: After the field trip, Sun Yuwei walked home and organized her observations along the way. Once home, she went straight to the study, opened her laptop, imported the text notes and photos from her phone into a new folder “Morning and Dusk on Wenlin Street — Field Trip Material,” and quickly jotted down a few opening ideas.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focus on writing the first draft of the column.
description: Sun Yuwei poured a glass of hot water in the study and devoted herself wholeheartedly to writing 'Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street.' She repeatedly refined the opening, starting with the detail of white steam rising from the bamboo steamer, and used a fountain pen to adjust the paragraph structure and rhythm on the draft paper. During that time, her mother gently knocked on the door and brought her homemade sour plum drink. Around noon, her thoughts began to stall a little; she got up and paced around the room. Looking out at the view of Cuihu Lake, she decided to incorporate the detail of the flower-selling granny arranging daisies into her reflections on the changes of the old street. Feeling suddenly enlightened, she sat back down and continued writing.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and midday break
description: Her mother called her to come eat. Sun Yuwei went to the dining table and had lunch with her father, Sun Mingyuan, and her mother, Li Xiulan. Her mind was still on the rhythm of the manuscript, so she answered her father's questions briefly and ate quickly. After lunch, she returned to the study, saw the encouraging message from her friend Zhang Jing, replied with a smiley face, took a deep breath, and reopened the revision document to prepare for the afternoon's work.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In the afternoon, she deeply revised and completed the writing.
description: Sun Yuwei concentrated deeply and made substantial revisions to the more than two thousand words she had written in the morning, refining metaphors and cutting redundancy. Around 3 p.m., her mother brought over sliced oranges; their sweetness refreshed her. She reread her favorite passage and began to conceive of the image of a stall closing up at dusk as the ending. At 4:30 p.m., her eyes felt sore, so she went to the living room to adjust the flower branches and open a window for air. After a short rest, she returned to the study and continued adjusting the transition words between paragraphs, adding snippets of dialogue she had heard while gathering material to enhance the feeling of everyday life. At 6 p.m., she finished the final major revision and let out a long, relieved sigh.
location: Study and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: At dinner, Sun Yuwei was more relaxed than at noon. While eating, she shared amusing incidents and challenges from the day's writing with her parents. Her father asked how the manuscript was coming along, and she said it was basically finished today.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Deep proofreading and finalization
description: Sun Yuwei washed the dishes on her own, then made herself a cup of tea and returned to her study to start the final proofreading. She read through the entire text three times: the first time to check for typos and grammatical errors; the second to refine the overall rhythm and emotional tone; and the third to go over word by word and confirm punctuation. The whole process was tiring but fulfilling.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Backed up the manuscript and communicated with the editor.
description: Sun Yuwei was very satisfied with the manuscript. She clicked save and uploaded the document "Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street – Final Draft" to the cloud drive as a backup. Then she picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to Xu Mingyuan, the editor of Cultural Vision: "Editor Xu, the manuscript 'Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street' is finalized and will be submitted tomorrow." After sending the message, she felt a sense of relief and satisfaction.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and evening family communication.
description: Sun Yuwei walked into the living room and saw her mother reading. Her mother asked if she would like some honey water. She went back to the study and used a fountain pen to write the day's keywords in her journal: "Wenlin Street morning light, breath vapor, flower-selling granny" and "draft complete," and drew a sun and daisies. Her mother came in carrying two cups of warm honey water; she took one and drank slowly. Then she sat down beside her mother and talked about the details of the flower-selling granny she had met on her field trip. Her mother recalled how she had waited for her father to buy soy milk at the breakfast shop when Sun Yuwei was little, which warmed her heart. Afterwards she went back to her room and did a few minutes of neck and shoulder stretches to relieve the stiffness from sitting too long.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Sun Yuwei washed up and changed into her pajamas, drank a glass of warm milk, and then stood by the window looking at the quiet street. She drew the curtains and saw a congratulatory message from her friend Zhang Jing, to which she replied with a celebratory emoji. After turning off the light, she lay in bed, replaying the day's efforts in her mind. Thinking of the childhood details her mother had mentioned, she felt they could be written into her next article. She tossed and turned in bed, and finally fell asleep gradually with a sense of fulfillment and achievement.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: At 7:15 in the morning, the alarm went off. Sun Yuwei quickly got up and washed up in the bathroom. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had already prepared a breakfast of small-pot rice noodles with a poached egg. The mother and daughter chatted while eating; her mother asked about the progress of the manuscript, and Sun Yuwei said she could submit it today.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Submit the first draft of the column and wait for feedback
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to her study and did a final read-through of the document 'Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street.' At around 8:45, she sent the manuscript by email to Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Vision, and left a WeChat message to let him know. After sending it, she felt uneasy and continued tidying her desk while waiting for feedback.
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing her journal, reading, and processing editor feedback
description: To distract herself, Sun Yuwei took out her Wenlin Street field journal, printed photos, arranged them carefully, decorated them with colored pens, and wrote down the date. At about 10:32, she received WeChat feedback from editor Xu Mingyuan, who affirmed her manuscript and suggested deleting "suddenly" and changing "the noise outside the window" to "the sounds of the city outside the window." She immediately revised the text and replied to confirm at 10:45.
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Planning field research for the oral history thesis
description: After the manuscript was confirmed, Sun Yuwei struck while the iron was hot and turned to the oral history thesis assigned by her advisor Wu Mingyuan. She read the methodology documents and noted key points such as “avoid leading questions,” then drafted an outline of questions for Uncle Qin, the owner of Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, listing open-ended questions about the bookstore’s community-oriented changes.
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading and contacting her sister.
description: After the planning was done, Sun Yuwei flipped through the Kunming Dialect Dictionary and sent a voice message to her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, sharing the joy of having her manuscript accepted, asking about her sister's recent life, and reminding her to order less takeout and take good care of herself.
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch time
description: Mother prepared stir-fried pork with garlic sprouts, dry-fried green beans, stir-fried rapeseed shoots, and tomato and egg soup. Father Sun Mingyuan rarely came home at noon and mentioned that his retirement procedures were going smoothly and would be completed next month. The family chatted happily, and Sun Yuwei joked that after retiring, she would have her father learn calligraphy or help proofread manuscripts.
location: Green Lake Community Restaurant, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Got ready to leave and walked to the yoga studio.
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei cleared the dishes, returned to her room to change into yoga clothes, packed her yoga bag (water bottle, sweat towel, etc.), and took a 15-minute nap. When the 13:45 alarm went off, she left, walked south along Huashan West Road, crossed Dongfeng West Road, and after about 15 minutes arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the ground floor of Dechun Commercial Building.
location: En route from Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road.

name: Vinyasa yoga class and post-class discussion
description: The class began with shoulder and neck relaxation. After a set of vinyasa flow yoga, the soreness in her shoulders and neck was significantly relieved. After class, she chatted with yoga partner He Lu in the rest area over water. Sun Yuwei shared the good news that her manuscript had been accepted, and He Lu congratulated her. They discussed that they had originally planned to go to a cultural creative store that day but had postponed it for some reason, and agreed to attend a yin yoga class together next Tuesday.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flower shopping and oral history study on the return trip.
description: After leaving the yoga studio, Sun Yuwei strolled home. On the way, passing Cuihu South Road, she bought lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves from a mobile flower cart. After arriving home, she arranged the flowers in a vase, then read 20 pages of the oral history methodology document sent by her supervisor in her study and took notes. Inspired, she refined the outline for her questions to Uncle Qin, covering topics such as changes in the bookstore's readership and the functions of online book clubs.
location: Mobile flower cart on Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the Cuihu Community Study at 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Supermarket shopping with Mom and preparing dinner.
description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei and her mother walked arm in arm to the Carrefour Xiaoximen store to shop, chatting on the way about arrangements for her father's life after retirement. After shopping, they returned home. Sun Yuwei changed into loungewear and helped her mother in the kitchen—washing vegetables, peeling garlic, and cutting scallions—while her mother simmered pork rib soup. The kitchen filled with aroma as mother and daughter chatted about everyday things.
location: From Carrefour supermarket at Xiaoximen, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the Cuihu Community kitchen at 7 Huashan West Road

name: Family dinner time
description: Father came home from work, and the family sat around the table for dinner; the dishes were spare-rib soup, garlic baby bok choy, and pan-fried small yellow croaker. Father shared that his retirement procedures had gone through the entire process, and Sun Yuwei jokingly suggested he audit a university course or take up painting. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Green Lake Community Restaurant, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk in Green Lake Park
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei accompanied her mother downstairs to the lakeside path of Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park) for a walk. The evening breeze was slightly cool, the lake glittered, and red-billed gulls rested here and there. Her mother recalled taking her to feed the gulls as a child, and Sun Yuwei felt warm inside.
location: Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and flower arranging.
description: After returning home and taking a bath, Sun Yuwei trimmed the newly bought lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves and arranged them in a vase to decorate her desk. Then she recorded the day's events and mood in her journal, pasted in the shopping receipts, stickers, and flower card, and wrote in fountain pen: 'Today is a good day, and everything is moving in a better direction.'
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Chatting in the besties group and evening skincare routine
description: After finishing her journal, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and joined the 'Four Golden Flowers' group chat. She shared photos of her journal and the good news that her manuscript had passed. Her close friends Zhang Jing, Wang Xinran, and Chen Sisi all congratulated her, and they chatted about their daily lives. After the chat, she went to the bathroom to do her evening skincare routine.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and going to bed.
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the main light and opened the meditation app for an evening guided meditation on the theme "Feeling the Gifts of Daily Life." As she breathed deeply, she settled the day's emotions. When it ended, she set the alarm for the next day and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning washing up and breakfast.
description: Woke up in the morning to the sound of the alarm, with a fine drizzle outside the window. After a quick wash, she tied her hair into a low ponytail and changed into loungewear. Her mother had already cooked steaming rice noodles, topped with chopped green onions, minced meat sauce, and pickled vegetables. As she ate with her mother, they chatted about the comfortable stretch from yesterday's yoga class and the good news that her father's retirement procedures were almost complete.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Work in the study: preparing and organizing materials
description: After breakfast, back in the study, I put the printed interview records of Qin Mingyuan, the draft paper, the question-list notebook, and the USB drive into the canvas bag and checked my phone and power bank. I then began systematically organizing Uncle Qin's interview records, classifying them into three themes — “Changes of Bookstores,” “Reader Communities,” and “Old Kunming Memories” — with sticky notes, and used a red pen to mark key sentences that expressed the paper's viewpoints. I reviewed the draft paper and wrote a new research perspective beside the “Urban Public Space” section. When my lower back felt sore, I stood up and did a 5-minute shoulder, neck, and waist stretch, then continued proofreading the footnote format of the paper. Accompanied by the sound of rain outside the window, I worked with focus and fulfillment.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing and Sharing Lunch
description: Leaving the study, she helped her mother rinse rice and cook it, and wash the greens. Her mother prepared stir-fried tomatoes with eggs and seaweed soup, and reheated the braised pork ribs from the day before. Mother and daughter sat facing each other and enjoyed a home-style lunch. Mom asked about my progress on my thesis and column, and reminded me to take an umbrella when going out in the afternoon and to be careful. After the meal, I voluntarily did the dishes and we chatted about everyday things.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready to go out and heading to Yunnan University
description: Changed into dark blue jeans, an off-white knit sweater, and a khaki trench coat, put on a canvas bag containing materials, and picked up a black long-handled umbrella. I walked to the Huashan West Road bus stop, and on the way I could see red-billed gulls circling over Cuihu Lake. I took Bus No. 13 and sat by the window, passing Xiaoximen and Baihui Mall; the rainy, misty street scenes outside were hazy and quiet. On the bus, I silently rehearsed the topics to discuss with Teacher Wu in the afternoon: the paper's progress, the method for academically transforming Uncle Qin's material, and the topic for the old Kunming bookstore column.
location: Depart from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; take Bus No. 13 from Huashan West Road bus stop toward the Yunnan University area.

name: Campus stroll and waiting
description: Got off at Yunnan University station and, since it was still early before the agreed time, strolled around the campus. The campus was quiet and serene after the rain; on the ginkgo avenue, the bluestone slabs shimmered with water, and the red-brick walls of Huize Hall looked ancient and rustic. When I reached the library building, I used my phone's memo app to jot down an angle for the column "Old Bookstores and Urban Memory." Then I went to the School of Literature office building, got some water from the hallway dispenser, composed myself, and knocked before entering Professor Wu Mingyuan's office.
location: Inside the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discussed thesis progress with supervisor
description: Teacher Wu gently gestured for me to sit down. I handed him the draft of my thesis and reported on my recent interviews with Uncle Qin and the material obtained. Teacher Wu was very interested in the details of the three-generation business philosophy of Zhibushi Bookstore. He affirmed my fieldwork and instructed me on how to incorporate the individual oral history material into the academic framework of the urban cultural representation of Kunming. He took a book from the shelf, "Oral Tradition and Local Knowledge: The Practice of Oral History Methods," and handed it to me, suggesting I focus on the chapter "Narrative and Identity." He encouraged me to bring the keen observation of detail from my column writing into academic research, so that the paper would have warmth. We talked for about an hour, and I benefited a great deal.
location: Professor Wu Mingyuan's office, School of Literature Office Building, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home.
description: Took leave of Teacher Wu and walked out of the teaching building. The rain had stopped, and a thin sun was breaking through the sky. Bought a bottle of water at the newsstand by the school gate, walked to the bus stop, and took Bus No. 13 back. On the bus, I used my phone's memo app to record Teacher Wu's core suggestions and recommended reading list, and conceived an article for the 'Old Kunming Bookstores' column, sorting out a writing thread that radiates from the single store 'Paper Cloth Stone' to the bookstore ecosystem of Cuihu and Wenhua Lane. Jotted down key phrases: 'A Bookstore of Three Generations,' 'The Vanishing Mail-Order Catalog,' and 'Old Times of Book-for-Book Exchanges.'
location: From Yunnan University bus stop, take Bus No. 13 back to Huashan West Road

name: Organize notes and mark materials
description: After arriving home, she immediately went into the study, took out the materials and notebook, and carefully copied out Teacher Wu's suggestions. Using an orange highlighter, she marked passages in "Qin Mingyuan Interview Records" that could be used for column writing and thesis examples, preparing for subsequent writing.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Kitchen time: brown sugar eggs and refining the column idea
description: Feeling hungry, went into the kitchen and cooked a pot of warming brown sugar drink with free-range eggs, traditional brown sugar, red dates, and ginger, then poached two eggs in it. Carried the bowl to the study, and while eating the snack, opened the phone memos to refine the column ideas conceived on the bus into three sections: 'Warm Yellow Lamplight and the Smell of Old Book Pages,' 'A Chronicle of Regular Customers,' and 'Selling Old Stories in a New World.' Used voice input to quickly jot down several vivid, image-rich sentences.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community - at home, kitchen and study

name: Journaling and keeping in touch with book friends
description: After washing the dishes, she took out her journal in the study, wrote down the date and weather with a fountain pen, and pasted in a ginkgo leaf bookmark she had picked up on campus. In blue-black ink, she recorded the insights from meeting her advisor, wrote, 'Academics and creativity converge at this moment,' and drew a small illustration of a book and a pen. Then she picked up her phone, saw a message from her book friend Yang Fan, replied to the invitation to visit Yemu Study over the weekend, and agreed to meet at the entrance of Yemu Study at 2 p.m. on Saturday. She also shared her new column and the old-bookstore topic, which sparked Yang Fan's interest.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: Father came home from work and dinner was on the table. At the table, Mom brought up Dad's retirement again. Dad smiled and said that from early next month he wouldn't have to get up early and squeeze onto the bus; he would go to Green Lake for morning exercise and buy flaky buns. The family imagined a leisurely future life. I shared today's thesis progress, and Dad reminded me to listen to Professor Wu's advice.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening leisure reading
description: After helping Mom clear the dishes, she went back to the study, turned on the desk lamp, made a cup of light tea, picked up the unfinished "The Stillness of Old Days" from beside the bed, and immersed herself in its calm, clean narrative atmosphere, relaxing her body and mind.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening personal care and relaxation
description: Thoroughly cleansed her face, applied a hydrating mask, eye cream, and moisturizing lotion, and pressed her temples and Jingming acupoints to relieve eye fatigue. She changed into pajamas, lay in bed, put on earphones, and listened to the gentle piano piece 'Gymnopédie No. 1.' Reflecting on her full day, she felt clear-thinking and certain about her research direction.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: She used the Tide App for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath and relaxing her body. After turning off the music, she flipped through a few pages of "The Stillness of Old Days" and came across a passage describing the sound of rain at night, which matched her mood. She closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep with a calm sense of fullness.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning washing up and tidying
description: 07:15 alarm went off. Sun Yuwei got up and opened the bedroom curtains, seeing the cloudy, cool morning light of Kunming. She went to the bathroom to wash up, then returned to the room to make the bed, ready to start a new day.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning journal and daily plan.
description: Wearing comfortable loungewear, Sun Yuwei sat at the desk in her study and opened her journal. She wrote down the inspiration from her advisor Wu Mingyuan the night before about "making the thesis feel warm," and listed today's key tasks: prepare a new-job gift for Jingjing, meet at the café at 3:30 pm, and attend the lecture at 7 pm.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: Mother Li Xiulan served the freshly made small-pot rice noodles, and the mother and daughter chatted as they ate. Yuwei told her mother that she planned to give her treasured Hero fountain pen and hand-painted greeting card to Zhang Jing as a gift for entering the job. Hearing this, her mother smiled, praised her for being thoughtful, and asked about the details of Zhang Jing's new job.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Making gifts and revising the paper
description: Sun Yuwei first spent about an hour drawing a congratulatory card for her friend Zhang Jing's new job, painting the exterior of Mingyuan Bookstore in watercolor and writing a blessing on the inside. After the card dried, she took out her treasured Hero fountain pen from the drawer and placed it in a gift bag along with the card. Then, starting at 10 a.m., she opened her laptop and revised the literature review section of her graduation thesis, trying to incorporate the framework of “oral history and local knowledge” suggested by her advisor, integrating her previous interview with Uncle Qin from Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore. Midway through, she got up to fetch water and did some simple neck and shoulder stretches.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Help mother prepare lunch
description: Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan prepare lunch. That day they were having tomato and egg noodles, and she was responsible for washing and cutting the tomatoes. Mother and daughter chatted about everyday things as they prepared lunch, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and post-meal cleanup
description: Sun Yuwei had lunch with her mother. After the meal, she proactively cleared the dishes and washed them clean.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Brief midday rest.
description: Sun Yuwei leaned back on the living room sofa, set a 30-minute alarm on her phone, and closed her eyes for a nap to recharge for the afternoon date and the evening lecture.
location: Living room sofa at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Trimming and rearranging the daisies
description: After waking up, Yuwei saw that the daisies in the vase at home were a little wilted, so she took the flowers out, trimmed the withered roots and leaves, rearranged the composition, and put them back in the vase. This process made her feel calm and healed.
location: Balcony of the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Gathering creative material on a walk
description: At 14:30, Sun Yuwei changed into her trench coat, took her bag with the gift and her phone, and went out. Instead of taking the fastest route, she walked along Wenlin Street toward the café, taking a photo of an old woman selling flowers on the roadside as material for her essay. After about 15 minutes of walking, she arrived at Wenlin Street, then headed to Rainforest Café.
location: Walking path from Huashan West Road to Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Celebrating best friend's new job at a café
description: Sun Yuwei arrived early at Rainforest Café, chose a seat by the window, and ordered a brown sugar pearl milk tea while waiting for Zhang Jing. At 15:10, Zhang Jing arrived. Yuwei handed her the prepared gift bag. When Zhang Jing opened it and saw the hand-drawn greeting card and fountain pen, she was delighted, and the two hugged. Zhang Jing ordered a white peach oolong tea. They talked about interesting anecdotes from Zhang Jing's new job at a cultural and creative company, shared their recent plans, and discussed several newly opened independent bookstores.
location: Rainforest Café, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sitting quietly by Green Lake and returning home.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Jing, Sun Yuwei detoured to Green Lake Park, sat quietly on a park bench for 15 minutes, watching the seagulls circling over the lake and the strolling crowds, feeling full of warmth and calm. At 16:45 she got up and walked home, arriving around 16:50.
location: Walking paths around Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to rest and family dinner
description: After arriving home at 16:50, Sun Yuwei greeted her mother and briefly shared what had happened when she met Zhang Jing, then went back to her room to rest and relax. Around 17:30, she came out to help her mother prepare dinner. At 18:00, the family of three sat around the dining table for dinner, during which Sun Yuwei talked in detail about the topic of the evening lecture and the happy moments of meeting her best friend that afternoon.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Yunnan University
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei took her notebook and pen, left home at 18:50, walked along familiar streets for about 20 minutes, and arrived at the lecture hall of the School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, at 19:10.
location: Trail from Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University.

name: Attend the lecture “Urban Culture and Memory Spaces”.
description: Sun Yuwei entered the lecture hall and found a seat in the front row. The lecture was titled “Urban Culture and Spaces of Memory,” and the speaker was a nationally renowned cultural geographer from China. She listened attentively throughout and jotted down key theories and cases in her notebook. When the speaker mentioned the concept of “emotional geography,” she immediately thought of the independent bookstores she knew well in Kunming and made a special note of it.
location: Lecture Hall, School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Exchanged ideas with the speaker, Chen Zhichun
description: After the lecture, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to approach the presenter, Chen Zhichun, and, drawing on her thesis research, asked how to use the perspective of 'emotional geography' to analyze the urban memory spaces of old bookstores like 'Paper, Cloth, Stone'. She listened carefully to the presenter's answer and expressed her gratitude.
location: Lecture Hall, School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walked home at night
description: After the exchange ended, Sun Yuwei walked home in the night breeze, savoring the takeaways from the lecture, arriving home at about 21:05.
location: Trail from Donglu Campus of Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Community

name: Booked a comprehensive physical examination online
description: Reminded by her mother, Sun Yuwei opened the WeChat public account of Kunming First People's Hospital, selected the "comprehensive physical examination" package for the morning of February 22 on the appointment registration platform (including blood routine, liver function, kidney function, thyroid ultrasound, bone density, etc.), and wrote in the remarks box that she hoped to have all items completed on the same day. After completing the payment, she felt a weight lifted off her shoulders.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and reflection
description: After soaking her feet in warm water, Sun Yuwei sat back down at her desk, opened her journal, pasted in photos of the flower stall she had taken that day and a Polaroid of the flower arrangement, and wrote in detail about the insights from the evening lecture and Teacher Chen Zhichun's advice. She wrote: "Combining 'emotional geography' with 'Paper, Cloth, Stone' and 'Mingyuan Bookstore,' I feel my thesis has found a new breakthrough point."
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and relaxation
description: At 22:05, Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas, lay in bed, opened the Tide app on her phone, and did a 15-minute bedtime meditation, breathing deeply along with the guided audio, reviewing the fulfilling day, and feeling peaceful inside.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After meditation, Sun Yuwei did not fall asleep right away. Instead, she opened The Stillness of Old Days on the nightstand and read a few pages in silence. Around 22:55, she turned off the desk lamp, put down her phone, and gradually drifted off to sleep around 23:25.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up and morning meditation
description: Awakened by the sound of rain outside the window, I used the 'Tide' App for a rain soundscape meditation, taking deep breaths to ease the vague worry about tomorrow's physical exam. After finishing, I felt refreshed and at peace.
location: Bedroom, Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wash up and get dressed
description: After a quick wash, I changed into comfortable cotton loungewear (a light gray hoodie and dark blue casual pants) to get ready for working from home.
location: Bathroom, Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning diary and inspiration notes
description: At the desk in the study, wrote morning pages in a kraft notebook, recording the takeaways from yesterday's lecture. Wrote down keywords such as 'emotional geography,' 'bodily presence,' and 'spatial memory,' conceived a plan for a field trip to Dounan Flower Market, and listed today's to-do items.
location: Study, Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Light Breakfast and Family Conversation
description: She had breakfast with her mother (millet porridge, boiled eggs, and green vegetables), told her she would start fasting after 6 p.m. tonight to prepare for tomorrow’s physical exam, and her mother advised her to keep a light diet and asked about the checkup time.
location: Restaurant, Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Column planning and close reading of literature.
description: She opened her laptop and a map app, marked the location of Dounan Flower Market on the map on her phone, and worked out a route for gathering material. She wrote a detailed outline for 'Dounan Flower Market: A City's Fresh-Cut Flower Memories,' with questions covering flower farmers' daily schedules, the fresh-cut flower trading process, and the connection between flowers and city residents' lives. She printed the chapter on 'emotional memory of consumption spaces' from Oral Tradition and Local Knowledge, recommended by her advisor, highlighted key passages with a highlighter, and added annotations.
location: Study, Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Light lunch and a short break
description: Enjoyed the vegetable soup noodles and blanched lettuce prepared by my mother. After the meal, I took a 20-minute nap on the living room sofa, with Chopin's nocturnes playing to relax my mind and body.
location: Dining room and living room, Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Changing into yoga attire and simple preparation
description: Changed into a light purple yoga top and exercise pants, took her yoga mat, water bottle, and phone, grabbed a folding umbrella at the entrance, and prepared to go to the yoga studio.
location: Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio

location: Along the route from Renmin Middle Road to Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attend a flow yoga class and post-class meditation.
description: Arrived at the studio early to check in, drank water, and rested. At 14:00 the class began, and instructor He Lu led the vinyasa flow. During Savasana meditation, the morning bustle and floral fragrance of Dounan Flower Market surfaced in her mind, and she silently committed the inspiration to memory.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio Large Classroom, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Capturing inspiration after class and simple exchanges.
description: In the rest area of the yoga studio, I used my phone's memo app to record the images that flashed through my mind during meditation (an auction hall, a flower farmer with a bamboo basket, dewy roses, etc.), and shared my feelings about the class with Teacher He Lu, telling her how excited I was about the inspirational images.
location: Lounge area of Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Walk home and take in the street scenes
description: Left the yoga studio and walked back along the road. Passing the entrance of Green Lake Park, she noticed elderly people playing chess and an egret perched on the railing. She stopped to capture the scene with her phone, saving it as material for future writing.
location: Around Green Lake Park, from Dongfeng West Road to Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go home to rest and prepare dinner.
description: After returning home, I drank some water, rested, changed back into loungewear, then helped my mother trim the vegetables (celery), wash the vegetables (cherry tomatoes, greens), and set out the bowls and chopsticks.
location: Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having a light dinner with family
description: Father got off work early today, and the family of three had dinner together. Mother made steamed sea bass and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. At the table, they talked about tomorrow's physical exam and Father's retirement plans next month; the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Restaurant, Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening walk and beginning of fasting
description: After dinner, I began fasting as required by the health check-up. Half an hour after the meal, I accompanied my parents to Green Lake Park for a walk of about 40 minutes, enjoying the tranquil night scene of city lights reflected on the lake.
location: Green Lake Park Footpath, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Write a letter to Dad and make journal entries
description: In the study, I used a silver fountain pen and letter paper to write a letter to my father, who is about to retire. I expressed my gratitude and recalled warm childhood details, such as my father picking me up from school and browsing old bookstores, and wished him a happy retirement. After finishing, I put it into an envelope. Then, in my journal, I recorded yoga inspiration, scenes from the walk, and the warmth of writing the letter, and pasted in yellow leaves from Cuihu Lake.

location: Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

location: Bedroom, Room 202, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up, washing up, and preparing for the physical exam.
description: After the alarm went off, Sun Yuwei sat up in bed for a few seconds and took a deep breath, then went to the bathroom to wash her face with warm water and changed into a loose hoodie and sweatpants. Following the fasting requirement for the medical checkup, she only drank a small sip of warm water to moisten her throat. She checked the canvas bag for her medical insurance card, ID card, and appointment form, confirmed that the documents were all there, and got ready to go out.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Her mother accompanied her to the hospital
description: Mother Li Xiulan had already changed into her coat and was waiting in the living room, reminding Sun Yuwei to dress warmly. The two walked out of the residential complex and hailed a taxi by the roadside. On the way, her mother repeatedly reminded her to relax during the blood draw. Sun Yuwei leaned against the car window, looking at the street scene outside with slight nervousness. After about a 16-minute drive, they arrived at The First People's Hospital of Kunming.
location: From Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Kunming First People's Hospital (Main Campus), No. 504 Xunjin Street, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Complete the full physical examination
description: Following the appointment procedure, Sun Yuwei and her mother first registered and took a number at the health examination center, then queued for a blood draw. During the blood draw, the nurse wiped her arm with an alcohol swab. Sun Yuwei closed her eyes nervously, and her mother held her hand and comforted her softly. After the blood draw went smoothly, they proceeded through blood pressure, electrocardiogram, thyroid ultrasound, bone density testing, and other items. The doctor in the ultrasound room told her that the results would have to wait for the comprehensive report, and Sun Yuwei made a mental note. Her mother stayed with her throughout the whole process.
location: Physical Examination Center, Kunming First People's Hospital (Main Campus), No. 504 Xunjin Street, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with Mom.
description: After the physical examination, the mother and daughter walked about 12 minutes to the Baoshan Street branch of Jianxin Garden Cross-Bridge Rice Noodles. Since she had just had blood drawn, Sun Yuwei ordered a light bowl of vegetable rice noodles, while her mother ordered mushroom rice noodles. As they ate and chatted, Sun Yuwei said the blood draw was easier than she had expected, and her mother reminded her to rest well in the afternoon and not worry too much about the results.
location: Jianxinyuan Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles (Baoshan Street Branch), No. 195 Baoshan Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go home and organize the medical examination report
description: The mother and daughter walked home, taking about 22 minutes. After arriving home, Sun Yuwei sorted the medical examination reports by item, put them in transparent folders, and placed them in the desk drawer, planning to review them together once all results were out. Then she washed her hands, changed into loungewear, and felt a little sleepy.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Living room rest and family chat
description: Sun Yuwei turned on the TV to watch local news with her mother, but she could hardly keep her eyes open. Her mother brewed two cups of rose tea. Sun Yuwei curled up on the sofa resting with her eyes closed, listening to her mother talk about how Auntie Xie, a neighbor in the community, had gotten into graduate school, responding absent-mindedly now and then, enjoying a moment of family relaxation.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and nap
description: Mother made a light lunch: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed egg custard, and millet porridge. Sun Yuwei had a good appetite. After eating, she felt sleepy. She said goodbye to her mother, returned to the bedroom, put on an eye mask and earplugs, set a 30-minute alarm, and soon fell asleep.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room and bedroom

name: Compiling and reading field notes
description: After waking from her nap, Sun Yuwei made a cup of hot lemon water and sat at her desk. She opened her computer and entered, one by one, the notes she had written in her notebook during yesterday's field trip on Wenlin Street, filing them under categories such as bookstores, cafés, and old houses. From her canvas bag she took out Kunming Old Tales borrowed from Mingyuan Bookstore, turned to the Wenlin Street chapter, highlighted key time points and anecdotes with a highlighter, compared them with yesterday's impressions from the field trip, and wrote down several ideas for her thesis and column in her notebook.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Online socializing and relaxing with music
description: After reading for an hour, Sun Yuwei decided to relax. She connected the speaker and played soft piano music, then opened the close friends group “404 Not Found” and saw a photo of a newly bought bouquet from Zhang Jing and a song shared by Wang Xinran. She smiled and replied, mentioning that today's checkup had gone smoothly. She then browsed Xiaohongshu and Douban for about 15 minutes and bookmarked posts about two independent bookstores.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Took a walk with my mother
description: At 5:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei and her mother put on jackets and went downstairs. First they took two slow laps around the community garden, then passed through the small gate of the neighborhood and strolled along the tree-lined path by Green Lake. Pleasure boats drifted on the lake and a gentle breeze blew past. Her mother mentioned that her older sister Sun Yutong would send a WeChat video call tomorrow. Sun Yuwei said it would be a good chance to talk about her sister's new job, so her mother planned to send her some hometown flower cakes and ham. The walk relaxed Sun Yuwei's whole body and temporarily made her forget her worries about the physical examination.
location: Green Lake Park and Cuihu Community Garden, No. 6 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: After returning from the walk, her father Sun Mingyuan had also come home from work. Dinner was a clear-broth hotpot with tomato and pork ribs made by her mother, along with various vegetables and tofu. The family of three chatted while eating. Sun Yuwei shared the medical check-up process, and her father comforted her to relax, saying young people have good constitutions. The atmosphere at the table was warm, and Sun Yuwei took the initiative to help her mother clear the dishes.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and reading
description: Back in the bedroom, Sun Yuwei closed the door. She took out her new journal and wrote today's health checkup diary, recording her nervousness during the blood draw and her mother's company, noting that the bone density results were still pending, and making a memo for tomorrow's WeChat video call with her elder sister. Then she opened her favorite essay collection, made a cup of light tea, and immersed herself in the author's delicate prose for about an hour.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: At 21:00, Sun Yuwei went to the bathroom to take a shower and blow-dry her hair. After changing into comfortable cotton pajamas, she dimmed the desk lamp, opened a guided meditation audio on her phone, and followed the voice to practice 10 minutes of breathing meditation, helping herself fully relax and relieving the day's fatigue and the faint anxiety about the medical checkup results.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: After meditating, Sun Yuwei brushed her teeth, washed her face, and applied moisturizer. Back in bed, she did a final check of tomorrow's alarm, confirmed the phone was set to silent and placed on the nightstand. She closed her eyes, listened to the wind outside the window for a while, and slowly fell asleep in peace.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning waking, washing up, and mindfulness adjustment
description: Sun Yuwei woke naturally on Sunday morning; sunlight streaming through the bedroom curtains roused her. She stretched comfortably and checked the time on her phone. Then she got out of bed, opened the window for air, went to the bathroom to wash up, and splashed cold water on her face to wake up. After washing up, she returned to the bay window in the bedroom, looked out at the community garden, and closed her eyes for five minutes of mindful breathing, easing the unease from yesterday's physical exam and filling her heart with anticipation.
location: Bedroom and bathroom of Sun Yuwei's home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and preview of materials before the exhibition.
description: Sun Yuwei had breakfast with her mother, Li Xiulan, who had prepared hot milk, whole-wheat bread, boiled eggs, and local strawberries. Her mother shared a funny story about the newly opened bakery in the neighborhood and reminded her to wear an extra jacket for the afternoon trip to the Western Hills. After breakfast, Sun Yuwei went to the study, sent a WeChat message to her best friend Chen Sisi to confirm their afternoon appointment at the art museum, and opened the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum's official account to browse the article about the 'Yunnan Young Artists Group Exhibition' again. She noted the name of the artist Chen Ziang, who interested her, in her memo.
location: Dining room and study at Sun Yuwei's home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading, inspiration organization, journaling, and household chores
description: Sun Yuwei continued reading in the study the chapter of Old Tales of Kunming about the old teahouses on Wenlin Street and the literary anecdotes of the National Southwest Associated University. An idea for writing formed in her mind, contrasting the theme of “Material and Memory” in contemporary installation art with the old Lianda stories of wrapping objects in old newspapers. Afterward, she took out her journal and drew a camera and ginkgo leaf decorations next to “Art Museum” with colored pencils. Then she went to the balcony to fold and put away the dried clothes. Looking out at a corner of Cuihu Lake from the balcony, she felt at ease.
location: Study, bedroom, and balcony of Sun Yuwei’s home, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading and relaxation
description: Sun Yuwei curled up on the living room sofa and continued to read the chapters on old Kunming food in “Old Stories of Kunming.” She smiled knowingly when she came across the many ways to eat rice noodles, with the sounds of her mother preparing ingredients in the kitchen in the background, creating a peaceful family atmosphere.
location: Living room at Sun Yuwei's home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch and rest.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan returned from playing chess at Xiaoniao Park, and the family of three sat down for lunch. Mother made shredded pork with green peppers, stir-fried pea shoots, and tomato and egg soup. Sun Yuwei shared funny moments from a video call with her sister and confirmed the plan to see an exhibition in the afternoon. After the meal, she took the initiative to help clear the dishes.
location: Dining room at Sun Yuwei's home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday break, preparation, and taking the subway to the art museum.
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei went back to her bedroom and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes. After the 13:10 alarm went off, she got up and got ready to go out. She packed her journal, fountain pen, sketchbook, “Old Tales of Kunming,” phone, transit card, and other items into her canvas bag. She left at 13:10, walked five minutes to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, tapped her card to enter, and took Line 3 toward Xishan. On the subway she listened to classical piano music with earphones and arrived at Xishan Park Station at about 13:50, then walked five minutes to CGK Kunming Contemporary Art Museum.
location: From Sun Yuwei's home at Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the Metro Line 3 carriage and along Haihong Road, Xishan District

name: Meet up and visit the "Yunnan Young Artists Group Exhibition"
description: Sun Yuwei waited at the entrance of the art museum for Chen Sisi, who brought a sugar-free Americano. After checking their tickets, the two entered the exhibition hall to view a group exhibition of young artists featuring oil paintings, mixed media, installations, and other works. In front of an installation made of old newspapers and wire, Sisi explained the collective memory of information constraint. Sun Yuwei was drawn to Chen Zi'ang's abstract calligraphic landscape works and felt a synesthetic connection to the verbal rhythm of *Kunming Old Tales*. She jotted down keywords in her sketchbook such as "material and memory" and "verbal synesthesia."
location: Exhibition hall of CGK Kunming Contemporary Art Museum, Haihong Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-exhibition exchange and creative brainstorming at the café
description: After viewing the exhibition, the two went to the Guanjian Café on the first floor of the art museum and ordered a rose latte and red velvet cake. Sisi shared fun stories about the exhibition setup. Sun Yuwei came up with the idea for a joint exhibition titled The Weight of Words, combining calligraphy with installation art, and Sisi said she would include it in future planning. The two also agreed to attend an artist lecture together next time.
location: Guanjian Coffee, first floor, CGK Kunming Contemporary Art Museum, Haihong Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Strolling in Green Lake Park on the way back
description: Sun Yuwei said goodbye to Sisi, then walked to Xishan Park Station and took Metro Line 3 back to Huashan West Road Station. During the ride, she reviewed her artwork photos and sketch notes on her phone. After exiting the station, she did not go straight home, but detoured to Green Lake Park (Bird Park) and strolled along the lakeside, watching the sunset spread across the lake, breathing fresh air, and relaxing her mind.
location: Kunming Metro Line 3 carriage and Green Lake Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Sun Yuwei returned home, where her mother had already made spaghetti with tomato-meat sauce and broccoli. While eating, she excitedly shared her exhibition experience with her mother, especially mentioning Sisi's remark that 'art gives life a greater sense of ritual.' Her mother listened with a smile and said she wanted to go to an exhibition next time too.
location: Dining room at Sun Yuwei's home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize exhibition notes and decorate the journal.
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk, turned on the desk lamp, and organized the tickets, exhibition brochures, and printed photos. She used a glue stick to paste the ticket stubs and promotional pages onto a new page of her journal, wrote down the keywords discussed with Sisi with a black pen, sketched the outline of the wire installation, and wrote reflections on material memory and historical dialogue in the footer.
location: Desk in Sun Yuwei's bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with her elder sister Sun Yuting.
description: Sun Yuwei video-called her sister Sun Yutong on WeChat and excitedly recounted her afternoon at the exhibition and the creative exchange with Sisi, showing the contents of her sketchbook. Her sister praised her for becoming more and more thoughtful and complained about working too much overtime. The two talked about the bakery their mother had mentioned and agreed to try it together when back in Kunming, and also talked about the old-Kunming charm of Wenlin Street.
location: Sun Yuwei's bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and relaxation
description: After the video call, Sun Yuwei made a cup of hot milk, leaned against the cushion on her bedroom bay window, and continued reading the chapter on old Kunming's local customs in "Old Stories of Kunming." Immersed in the quiet night view of the neighborhood, she felt completely relaxed in body and mind.
location: Bay window in Sun Yuwei's bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mindfulness meditation before bed and bedtime preparations
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the main light, leaving only a bedside lamp on. Sitting cross-legged on the bed, she followed a mindfulness meditation audio on her phone for a 10-minute breathing exercise, calming her mind and thanking her body. After meditating, she went to the bathroom to brush her teeth, wash her face, and apply moisturizer and eye cream. Then she returned to the bedroom, packed the next day's textbooks into her backpack, and set the alarm for 7:20.
location: Bedroom and bathroom of Sun Yuwei's home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the bedside lamp, wrapped herself in the quilt, and savored in her mind the image of the abstract ink-on-linen work from the art museum mingling with the words of 'Old Tales of Kunming.' Carrying the fulfilling and peaceful feeling of art and life blending together, she drifted off to sleep.
location: Sun Yuwei's bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and meditation
description: At 6:50 in the morning, the alarm went off. Sun Yuwei woke up but didn't get out of bed immediately; instead, she did a 5-minute mindful breathing meditation, focusing on the present moment, feeling her chest rise and fall, and letting her thoughts calm down. After finishing, she slowly sat up and got dressed, ready to start the new day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei went to the dining room, where her mother, Li Xiulan, had already made small-pot rice noodles, topped with a fried egg and mint. During breakfast, she briefly told her mother about today's plan: first go to the First Municipal Hospital to pick up the physical exam report, then come back home to discuss. Her mother poured her some soy milk and reassured her, saying she had no classes in the afternoon and would wait for her at home.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to the hospital, picked up the physical examination report, and consulted the doctor.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei walked to the First People's Hospital of Kunming with her medical insurance card and ID card. On the way she passed Cuihu South Road, where morning sunlight spilled down and elderly morning exercisers carried radios to the park. After arriving at the hospital, she picked up her sealed report at the physical examination center using her ID card, sat down to read it, and found that her BMI was low and her hemoglobin was low. She was diagnosed with mild iron-deficiency anemia, with a doctor's handwritten dietary advice attached. She then went to the consultation desk to ask the doctor about iron-rich food combinations and confirmed the importance of animal liver, red meat, and dark green vegetables.
location: Physical Examination Center, Kunming First People's Hospital (Main Campus), No. 504 Xunjin Street, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: While taking the bus home, looked up recipes for gaining weight.
description: After leaving the hospital, Sun Yuwei walked to the Xunjin Street bus stop and took bus K2 home. On the bus, she used her phone to search for weight-gain and iron-supplement recipes, noted down quick dishes such as stir-fried beef with tomato, pork liver and spinach soup, and stir-fried chicken breast with broccoli, and put together a shopping list.
location: On Bus K2, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had a detailed discussion with my mother about the physical exam results
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan sat on the sofa and went through the report page by page. She pointed at the diagnoses of low BMI and anemia, feeling a little down. Her mother hugged her and comforted her, emphasizing that it is best to regulate one’s health when young, and that she should strengthen her nutrition according to the doctor’s advice. Together they set the near-term goal of “weight gain + iron supplementation” and decided to take action starting that day.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went shopping with my mother at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket
description: After the discussion, the mother and daughter took their shopping bags and walked to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street. The supermarket was very lively. Following their shopping list, they precisely selected eggs, chicken breast, beef tenderloin, pork liver, milk, broccoli, tomatoes, spinach, bananas, walnuts, almonds, and whole wheat bread. The mother also deliberately picked a bag of organic red dates to replenish qi and blood.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Returned home to put away the ingredients and prepare and enjoy lunch.
description: After shopping, the mother and daughter sorted the ingredients and put them in the refrigerator. Sun Yuwei voluntarily tied on an apron and helped her mother by washing and chopping vegetables, while her mother cooked scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried sliced beef, sautéed spinach, and mixed grain rice. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, came home at noon for lunch. At the table, she reported the physical exam results and the shopping details. Her father encouraged her to take good care of her health and mentioned the future plan for a family self-driving trip along the Western Yunnan Grand Loop.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and journal page ideas
description: After lunch and clearing away the dishes, Sun Yuwei returned to her bedroom. Instead of going to sleep right away, she sat at her desk and took out a newly bought journal. Using a ruler and colored pens, she drew a "Diet Diary" table with columns for date, three meals, snacks, water intake, exercise, and mood, and drew apple and broccoli patterns at the footer. After finishing, she felt grounded and took a nap of about 40 minutes.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Work with mother to formulate a one-week weight-gain meal plan.
description: After the afternoon rest, Sun Yuwei went to the kitchen and sat beside her mother at the kitchen island. Referring to the recipes on her phone and the hospital’s dietary recommendations, they made a one-week weight-gain meal plan together: three meals a day plus two snacks, breakfast including eggs and milk, lunch and dinner with one meat dish and two vegetable dishes, an afternoon snack of fruit and nuts, and a glass of hot milk before bed. She neatly copied it onto colorful sticky notes and stuck them on the refrigerator door. Her mother laughingly said the fridge now had “rule of law.”
location: Kitchen island at home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Writing in the study: reflections on the exhibition
description: In the afternoon it was writing time. Sun Yuwei sat down at the computer in the study and, combining insights from yesterday's exhibition visit and today's mood after the physical exam, wrote the essay 'From Canvas to Context: A Dialogue on "Texture"', connecting the deconstructionist works at the art museum with the scholarly spirit of the Southwest Associated University professors in 'Old Tales of Kunming' to explore the relationship between matter and spirit. Halfway through writing, she noted the details that needed verification in her memo, planning to look them up at the bookstore later.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Send a message to best friend Zhang Jing to share daily life
description: Tired from writing, Sun Yuwei leaned back in her chair and used her phone to send a WeChat message to her best friend Zhang Jing, sharing her physical examination report and health action plan, attaching photos of her fridge recipes, and agreeing to go back to school together next weekend to enjoy a special meal at the cafeteria.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading alone at Cuihu Park
description: Seeing the pleasant sunshine outside, Sun Yuwei walked alone to Cuihu Park, found a bench by the lake, and sat down, opening Old Stories of Kunming to continue reading the Wenlin Street chapter. A gentle breeze rippled the lake, and in the distance an old man was playing the bawu. She was immersed in the moment, storing up details for her evening writing.
location: Lakeside bench, Green Lake Park (Bird Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home, then went for a walk with my father and talked about travel plans
description: On the way back from Cuihu, Sun Yuwei heard an elderly person singing Dian opera in the pavilion and felt the moving beauty of life. When she got home, she happened to see her father changing shoes to go for a walk, so she took his arm and went downstairs with him. They circled the community garden several times as her father enthusiastically talked about a road trip route to western Yunnan he wanted to take after retirement. Sun Yuwei offered to help him plan the trip, including cultural attractions and food.
