location: Green Lake Community Garden, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Helped prepare dinner and had dinner with the whole family
description: After the walk, Sun Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother, peeling garlic and heating up salt-and-pepper crispy cakes. Dinner was pork liver and spinach soup, garlic broccoli, and noodles cooked in bone broth. The family of three sat around the table to eat; her father mentioned that she had promised to make a travel guide, and her mother shared the results of putting recipes on the refrigerator. The mood at the table was warm and relaxed.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In the study, finish the essay left unfinished this afternoon.
description: After dinner and a half-hour rest, Sun Yuwei returned to her study to continue the afternoon's writing. She refined her ideas and completed an essay of about 1,200 characters. At the end, she wrote: “Whether it is the deconstructed canvas or the bamboo strip walls of Lianda's school buildings, what they carry is an effort to find a spiritual outlet in a concrete medium.” After finishing, she felt very satisfied.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video call with her elder sister Sun Yuting.
description: After finishing the essay, Sun Yuwei made a video call to her older sister Sun Yutong, who was in Shenzhen. She excitedly showed her sister the recipes on the fridge and recounted the whole experience, from the hospital to the supermarket to making the plan. Her sister was gratified and encouraged her, and they agreed that during the summer vacation she would go to Shenzhen and her sister would take her out for delicious food. The two also talked about how things were going at her sister's work.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and journal recording
description: After showering and changing into pajamas, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk, poured a glass of warm milk, and opened her journal. Under the February 24 section of 'Diet Notes,' she recorded: breakfast - small-pot rice noodles; lunch - tomato scrambled eggs, etc.; dinner - pork liver and spinach soup, etc.; snack - nuts and milk; water - 3.5 cups; exercise - 30-minute walk. For mood she drew a smiley face and said to herself: 'Today was great; I turned my problems into action.'
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and going to bed.
description: Turning off the main light and leaving the night light on, Sun Yuwei lay down for her second five-minute meditation. The theme was gratitude: she was grateful for her mother’s breakfast, the doctor’s advice, the afternoon sunshine, and her parents’ care. Her breathing slowed, and she felt fulfilled and calm, then fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and meditation.
description: The alarm went off right at 7:10. Sun Yuwei didn't rush to get up. With her eyes closed, she did a five-minute morning mindfulness meditation, feeling the morning light outside the window and dispelling drowsiness. Then she got up, opened the curtains, enjoyed watching neighbors exercising in the community garden, changed into loungewear, and made the bed.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Eat a nutritious breakfast according to the meal plan.
description: Mother Li Xiulan is busy in the kitchen. Sun Yuwei prepares breakfast for herself according to the weight-gain recipe: one boiled egg, two slices of whole-wheat bread, a glass of warm milk, and she eats the apple her mother hands her. She records breakfast in the health check-in app, draws a smiley face in her journal, and writes down her weight-gain goal.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discussed travel accident insurance with her mother.
description: Near the end of breakfast, her mother, Li Xiulan, reminded Sun Yuwei that, because of her frequent outings and the planned trip to western Yunnan, she should buy accident insurance for peace of mind. Sun Yuwei thought this was reasonable and agreed to research and purchase a one-year accident insurance policy at home in the morning.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cleaning Up After the Meal
description: Sun Yuwei took the initiative to clear the dishes, rinsed them clean and put them into the draining rack, and wiped the dining table with a cloth. She gained a calm sense of control from these small everyday tasks, and prepared to start the morning's work.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Working in the study: comparing and purchasing accident insurance.
description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the study and used an insurance app and a WeChat mini-program to compare comprehensive accident insurance products from several companies in detail, focusing on sums insured, premiums, and coverage. She finally chose a product with an annual premium of 380 yuan, coverage of 500,000 yuan, and accidental medical benefits, filled in the information online, and paid via Alipay. After receiving the electronic policy, she saved the PDF to her phone, computer, and cloud drive as backups, and printed a paper copy to tuck into the last page of her journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading and writing
description: After dealing with the insurance, Sun Yuwei took "Kunming Old Tales" from the bookshelf, leaned on the single sofa by the window, and read the chapter about old stories of Wenlin Street. She was deeply attracted by the contrast between urban changes and the coffee shop. After reading, she opened her writing software and typed her thoughts into her material for urban rambling essays, sometimes copying wonderful passages into her notebook, sometimes staring blankly at the pigeons outside the window.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had lunch according to the recipe
description: Li Xiulan, her mother, prepared steamed fish, spinach tofu soup, and brown rice according to the recipe. Sun Yuwei ate everything properly and ticked the food record sheet. After the meal, she proactively helped her mother clear the plates and had an orange as fruit.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and yoga preparation
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for 12:45, and took a 20-minute nap. After waking up, she changed into yoga clothes, put her yoga mat, towel, and water bottle into her sports backpack, and took a banana from the kitchen as a pre-class snack.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-class snack and departure preparation
description: Fifteen minutes before leaving, Sun Yuwei ate a banana for energy, put on her sports bag, changed into her sneakers at the entryway, and checked her keys, phone, and access card. She looked at the navigation on her phone, confirmed that the yoga studio was about a 15-minute walk away, and left the house at ease.
location: Kitchen and entryway at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: Sun Yuwei walked out of the Cuihu Community gate and headed west along Renmin Middle Road. The spring afternoon sun was warm, and she wore earphones listening to light music. After passing a flower shop and a convenience store, she turned right and walked another 3 minutes to reach Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road.
location: Sidewalk from Renmin Middle Road to Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attended a yoga class (core strength exercises).
description: Sun Yuwei took the elevator to the fourth floor, signed in at the front desk, and entered the large classroom. At 2 p.m. the class began with the theme of core strength; Teacher He Lu led everyone through poses such as plank, boat, and Warrior III. Although she found it difficult, she gritted her teeth and completed the whole session. After class she talked with Teacher He Lu, who affirmed her progress and reminded her that they would try a new vegetarian restaurant together on the weekend.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home
description: After changing clothes and saying goodbye to Teacher He Lu, Sun Yuwei walked home the same way. Seeing red camellias blooming in the roadside flower beds, she felt cheerful and took photos with her phone to send to her older sister far away in Shenzhen.
location: Sidewalk from Dongfeng West Road to Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Researching travel routes with father
description: Sun Yuwei returned home and saw her father Sun Mingyuan wearing reading glasses, studying a Yunnan map and travel guides on the living room coffee table. She sat down beside him with great interest, and her father pointed to the Kunming-Dali-Lijiang-Shangri-La-Deqin route circled in red pen. She helped him use a travel app to check hotel and guesthouse reviews and off-the-beaten-path attractions along the way, especially searching for information on independent bookstores and cafés and noting it down in her phone memo.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mother arranged flowers to decorate the living room
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, came home holding pink carnations and white baby's breath, and the fresh floral fragrance instantly filled the living room. Sun Yuwei went up to help unpack the flowers, and her mother skillfully trimmed the stems and arranged them in a transparent vase, filling the living room with the spirit of spring. Sun Yuwei took photos and posted them to the family group chat with a caption praising her mother.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner preparation and family chat
description: Sun Yuwei took the initiative to go to the kitchen and help her mother pick vegetables. The mother and daughter chatted about yoga classes and the changes at Dounan Flower Market, and her mother mentioned seeing a stall selling exotic spices. Her father sat on the sofa with a tablet, studying the attraction guides she had sent earlier. The aroma of food wafted from the kitchen, and her father occasionally chimed in with questions about the attractions. The home was filled with a warm, lively atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner: discussed and finalized the travel plan.
description: Dinner was stir-fried lean pork with wood ear mushrooms, sautéed seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup, all made by her mother. At the dinner table, the trip to western Yunnan became the only topic. Her mother suggested an extra day in Dali to rest because of the road conditions. Sun Yuwei added distinctive stops such as Xiaolu Bookstore in Dali and Aruo Kangba Nansuoda Manor in Shangri-La. Her father took out paper and a pen, and the family finally settled on the itinerary: Kunming – Dali (2 nights) – Lijiang (2 nights) – Shangri-La (1 night) – Deqin (1 night) – return, and roughly confirmed the transportation, budget, and division of tasks.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take a walk around the neighborhood with Mom.
description: After resting for 20 minutes after the meal, Sun Yuwei and her mother put on comfortable shoes and went downstairs to walk along the garden path of Cuihu Community, continuing to chat about the travel details they had just finalized. Her mother reminded her to call ahead to confirm the bookstore-café she had her eye on. The evening breeze gently brushed their faces, carrying the scent of flowers and grass. An ordinary night felt especially beautiful because of family warmth and anticipation for the future.
location: Community garden and surrounding walking paths of Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the phone alarm went off. Outside the window, the sky was faintly light. The weather forecast said it would be cloudy today, with a brief shower in the afternoon. After lingering in bed for a bit, Sun Yuwei did a simple five-minute breathing meditation to calm her mind. After washing up, she changed into comfortable cotton trousers and a thin knit top. In the kitchen, her mother Li Xiulan had already steamed the eggs according to the new recipe. She heated a cup of milk and paired it with half a bowl of oatmeal, eating slowly. As usual, she recorded the day's meals in her journal. Then she checked the battery and memory card of her mirrorless camera, packed them along with a spare battery into her canvas bag, made sure her notebook and fountain pen had enough ink, and hung a light purple cotton mask on the strap of the canvas bag.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Went to Dounan Flower Market.
description: At exactly 7:00 in the morning, Sun Yuwei slipped out quietly, walked about 5 minutes to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 and transferred to Line 1 to Dounan Station, then walked about 8 minutes to arrive at Dounan Flower Market. The metro car was not crowded in the early morning, and the city's outline gradually became clearer outside the window. About an hour later, she arrived at Asia's largest fresh-cut flower trading market.
location: Public transportation route from Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dounan Flower Market visit and return trip
description: Sun Yuwei, camera in hand, wove through the main hall and the outer trading area of Dounan Flower Market. The main hall was buzzing with voices; bundles of roses, lilies, and carnations were piled up like small hills. She found Lao Zhang, a flower grower she had met before, who was unloading a truckload of small chrysanthemums just brought from the fields in Yiliang with his wife. She waited until Lao Zhang was done, went over to chat, listened to him describe the process of growing the flowers from sowing to market, and captured close-ups of his wrinkled but focused face. Then she wandered over to the area selling local floral materials, photographing the smiling visitors holding bouquets and the busy figures of workers transporting flowers. Before leaving, she picked out a bunch of light purple freesias still in bud, and the stall owner, an older woman, threw in a few extra stems of goldenrod. After buying the flowers, Sun Yuwei bought a cup of hot brown sugar pearl milk tea at a small shop by the market entrance. At about 10:25, holding the freesias and the milk tea, she took the metro back home from Dounan Station.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing Fieldwork Materials
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei imported the photos from the camera into her computer, categorized them into "Close-ups of Flower Farmers," "Floral Still Lifes," and "Market Scenes," and initially selected more than 30 representative works. She recalled the key points of her conversations with Old Zhang and other vendors and added them to her notebook, recording key information such as "It takes about 5 hours from the field to the flower shop" and "The difference between the wholesale and retail price of a single rose." Combining her experience learning the Ikenobo school of flower arrangement, she created a new document on her computer and preliminarily sketched out the structure for the second column article, "Flowers and Life at the Dounan Flower Market."
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, her mother Li Xiulan made Sun Yuwei's favorite beef noodles. The noodles were chewy, the beef was tender, and the broth was rich; she ate a big full bowl. At the table, she chatted with her mother about what she had seen and heard at the flower market. After the meal, she did not immediately open her computer. Instead, she leaned back on the living room sofa, listened to faint light music from outside the window, and flipped through the flower market notes she had written in her journal, letting the morning's experiences settle a little more.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Writing the column's first draft (morning part).
description: In the afternoon, a brief shower drifted past outside the window, and raindrops fell on the gardenia leaves. Sun Yuwei opened her laptop and began writing the first draft of “Flowers and Life at the Dounan Flower Market.” She first described the opening of the flower market in the early morning: the roar of trucks, the shouts of flower farmers, and the humid air mixed with the scent of flowers, trying to recreate the rough lines of Old Zhang’s palms and his composed look while counting money. Halfway through, her thoughts stalled. She took a sip of the brown sugar pearl milk tea she had bought that morning, stood up and moved around, then continued working on the transition paragraph.
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go out for coffee and a short break
description: To refresh herself by changing the environment, Sun Yuwei took her notebook and walked about 5 minutes to Apple West (Cuihu Store) near the community, where she ordered a hot Americano. While waiting for the coffee, she looked through photos of the flower market on her phone, seeking inspiration for the next passage. Carrying the coffee back home, she felt her thinking had broadened.
location: Apple West (Cuihu Store), South Cuihu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took a walk around the neighborhood with my mother
description: After the rain shower stopped, the air was especially fresh. At 4:20 p.m., Sun Yuwei put on her jacket and went for a walk in the neighborhood with her mother, Li Xiulan. They strolled slowly along the flower beds, talking about accommodation for the June trip to western Yunnan. Her mother said she had taken a liking to an inn with a terrace in Dali Old Town, while Sun Yuwei suggested looking at the reviews first. After the rain, the neighborhood was lush and green, and the air was full of the fragrance of earth and grass.
location: Inside the Cuihu Community residential compound, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-writing stretching and drafting the column (second half)
description: After returning from her walk, Sun Yuwei did a few minutes of simple yoga stretches on the floor mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing her shoulders, back, and lower back that had become stiff from sitting for a long time. Once her body was loosened up, she went back to her desk and continued the document she had left unfinished that afternoon. This time she focused on the light purple freesias she had bought, describing their form before blooming and how she felt after putting them in a vase. Using this as the main thread, she wove the entire essay together and ended with a reflective passage. She was so absorbed in her writing that only when her mother came in carrying a plate of walnuts and a glass of milk did she suddenly realize the sky had darkened.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Dinner
description: Dinner was her mother's stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tomato and egg stir-fry, and a steaming pot of pork rib soup, light and nutritious. While eating, her mother asked how her thesis topic selection was going. She gave a vague reply, her mind still on the article she had just written.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Polishing the first draft and contacting the editor
description: After a short rest following the meal, Sun Yuwei opened the document again and gave the draft she had written in the afternoon a first round of polishing. Referring to her notebook, she added details from the field trip, such as Old Zhang saying, “You city folks just like to see something new; we’re looking at the market,” and adjusted some words and phrases to make the language flow more smoothly. Then she sent a WeChat message to Xu Mingyuan, the editor of Cultural Vision, briefly describing the column’s entry point and structure and asking whether it matched the column’s tone. Xu Mingyuan replied quickly: “Very much looking forward to it. Just keep your style.” Receiving this affirmation, she felt much more at ease.
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and journaling
description: Sun Yuwei put down her computer, sat on the chair in the bedroom, picked up the essay collection "One Person's Village," and quietly read two pieces. The book's delicate observations of rural things moved her, and she thought about how to better apply that plain, powerful sensibility to her writing. Then she took out her journal and wrote a diary entry, recording today's meals (breakfast: eggs, cereal, milk; lunch: beef noodles; snack: brown sugar pearl milk tea; dinner: home-cooked dishes), her feelings from the flower market outing, and the difficulties and breakthroughs she encountered while writing.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Her older sister Sun Yutong called via video from Shenzhen. Sun Yuwei excitedly told her about this morning's amusing happenings at Dounan Flower Market, showed her the photos she had taken and a passage from a draft she had just written. Her sister smiled and said her writing was vivid, asked about her weight-gain plan, and reminded her to eat meals on time. They also talked about her sister's work and a trip to western Yunnan in June. Her sister said she had already applied for annual leave.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening hygiene and bedtime routine
description: After saying goodbye to her sister, Sun Yuwei began washing up. She washed her face with warm water and applied basic skincare. Then she checked tomorrow's class schedule and set an alarm for 7:30 in her phone notes app. She changed into pajamas, placed the freesia she had bought today on the nightstand, and leaned in to smell its fresh fragrance.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Stretching before bed and going to sleep.
description: Sun Yuwei lay on the bed, did a few minutes of simple leg stretches, and relaxed. Then she turned off the light, lay quietly in the dark for a while, and recalled the fulfilling day. The fatigue from finishing the draft set in, but more than that, there was the exhilaration of creation. She emptied her mind and slowly fell asleep.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning meditation and nutritious breakfast
description: The phone alarm went off at 7:45 on time. She slowly opened her eyes and stretched, remembering that she had stayed up late polishing her draft until 11 o'clock, but she still felt fine this morning. After washing up, she sat cross-legged on the bedroom carpet and did a 5-minute breathing meditation, letting her thoughts gradually settle. When she walked out of the bedroom, her mother was already busy in the kitchen. Hearing her footsteps, her mother said without turning around, 'Come and eat quickly—today's pork liver porridge is very tender.' Sun Yuwei responded and sat down at the table, in front of her a bowl of warm spinach and pork liver porridge, a boiled egg, and pickled cucumbers. She took out her journal and carefully recorded today's meals as the 5th day of her health tracking.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Deeply polish and refine the column article
description: After breakfast, carrying her water glass, she walked into the study and opened her laptop. She first revisited the draft of 'Flowers and Life at Dounan Flower Market' completed last night, as well as the photos she had taken with her phone at the flower market yesterday, and studied the close-up of the flower farmer Old Zhang's wrinkled hands. Shifting her thoughts, she began revising paragraph by paragraph, deleting two slightly long environmental descriptions and naturally weaving the farmer's dialect phrase 'These flowers recognize people' into the bargaining scene. The writing suddenly became more vivid. During a break, she stood up, gently touched the bunch of freesias brought back yesterday on the windowsill with her fingers, felt the suppleness of the petals, and corrected the use of the descriptor 'delicate.'
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Having lunch with my mother
description: The morning went smoothly. Her mother cooked scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried broccoli, and reheated yesterday's pork rib soup. While eating, Sun Yuwei told her mother about writing the article, saying she had quoted a flower farmer. Her mother laughed and said, "That old man is quite interesting." She continued recording the morning's meals in her journal.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Short rest after lunch
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei paced in the living room to aid digestion, checked her phone, and replied to roommate Liu Jia's messages. Feeling drowsy, she returned to the bedroom, drew the curtains, and took a nap of about 40 minutes to conserve energy for the afternoon's focused work.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Finishing the manuscript and confirming the final version
description: After waking from her nap, she washed her face and returned to the study. The afternoon's work was final polishing and proofreading. She read through the entire text, checked punctuation and typos, and adjusted several phrasings according to editor Xu Mingyuan's usual stylistic preferences to make the article more balanced. At 4:45 p.m., she completed the final proofreading, named the document Final Version of Flowers and Life at Dounan Flower Market, and saved it with satisfaction.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Post-rain relaxation and preparation
description: She walked out of the study onto the balcony and found that the light rain had stopped earlier in the afternoon. The sky outside had cleared a bit, and the air smelled of earth and plants. She took a few deep breaths, went back to the living room, and told her mother, who was sorting vegetables, that the manuscript was finished, adding that she would send it to the editor after her walk. She returned to the study, tidied the desk, and pulled up Xu Mingyuan's email.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Walking in the neighborhood after the rain
description: At 5 p.m., Sun Yuwei and her mother changed into comfortable shoes and went downstairs for a walk. The road was still a little damp, and the air was especially fresh. They walked slowly along the path on the side of the residential complex facing Cuihu Lake. Her mother reminded her that tomorrow was the last Friday of the month, so she should weigh herself again to see the effect of this month's weight gain. Sun Yuwei agreed and shared her relaxed mood after finalizing the manuscript. Mother and daughter chatted as they walked, reaching the familiar end of the path.
location: Footpath inside Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Dinner time
description: After returning home from the walk, her mother began cooking: stir-fried seasonal vegetables and steamed cured sausage, served with hot rice. Her father did not come home because he had a work-related social engagement, so the mother and daughter sat at the table and finished dinner together. Sun Yuwei filled her bowl with rice and said the manuscript was finalized and she would send it to the editor that evening.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Post-meal rest and preparation for publishing
description: After the meal, she cleared the dishes, returned to the study, opened her computer and the final draft document, and drafted a short, polite email informing the editor Xu Mingyuan that this was the second column piece about Dounan Flower Market, and thanking him for his anticipation. The email was saved as a draft.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Submit the manuscript.
description: At exactly 7 p.m., she opened the draft email, hovered the mouse over the 'Send' button, silently counted down three seconds in her mind, then gently clicked. The email was sent successfully. She took a deep breath and felt a sense of reassurance.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Received praise from the editor
description: About 40 minutes after sending, the WeChat notification sound on her phone rang. She saw that it was from editor Xu Mingyuan's avatar, and her heart beat faster. Xu Mingyuan replied: “Yuwei, it's really well written! Your observation skills are remarkable, you captured the soul of the flower market. The combination of that dialect and the hand detail is very touching. This draft is full of the flavor of life, exactly what we wanted.” After reading, Sun Yuwei's eyes felt slightly warm. She read the message over several times, then took a screenshot and saved it to her photo album as a memento. She walked out of the study and whispered to her mother in the living room: “The editor said I wrote very well.” Her mother smiled and gave her a thumbs-up.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Going out to buy milk tea as a self-reward.
description: Overjoyed after receiving the affirmation, she remembered her reward promise from last night—a cup of hot brown sugar pearl milk tea. At about 20:10, she grabbed her keys and phone and walked alone to Bison Store on Wenlin Street. The walk through streets and alleys took about 23 minutes. At the store, she ordered on her phone: a large cup of hot brown sugar pearl milk tea with an extra serving of oats. While waiting, she took a photo of the menu and the storefront and sent it to her friends' group chat. When the milk tea was ready, she took it and walked home.
location: Zhiren Liangcang Bison Store (Wenyuan Commercial Residential Building Branch), No. 5 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Sharing joy with her mother and preparing for the review.
description: She walked home holding a warm milk tea while her mother sat on the sofa watching a TV drama. She sat down beside her mother and showed her screenshots of the chat history on her phone. After looking at them, her mother touched her head with relief and said, "My girl did really well—reward yourself properly." The two chatted for a while. Sun Yuwei said that tomorrow would be the end of the month, and she needed to review her February writing, diet, and weight, and plan her March column topics and thesis progress.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Evening journaling and month-end review preparation
description: After finishing the milk tea, she went back to her bedroom. She took out her beloved journal and recorded in detail today's mood, insights from revising the manuscript, and the editor's praise. Then she opened the calendar and briefly planned the checklist for tomorrow's review (the end of the month): February's writing word count, column submission dates, a summary of journal and diet records, the weight change curve, and March plans, including topic ideas for the 'Cultural Horizon' column and a preliminary outline for the graduation thesis proposal.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Pre-sleep reading and reflection
description: After showering, she changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard. She picked up One Man's Village and read more than ten pages, her mood gradually calming from excitement as she immersed herself in the rural world depicted by Liu Liangcheng.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Bedtime meditation and preparing for sleep
description: After finishing reading, she turned off the overhead light, leaving only the bedside lamp on, put on her headphones, and played a 10-minute mindfulness meditation audio. She focused on her breathing and let go of the day's thoughts. After the meditation, she turned off the lamp and lay down, set the alarm for tomorrow (Friday) at 7:00 in the morning, savored the gains of the day, and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Morning meditation and breakfast record.
description: At 7:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. Sun Yuwei did five minutes of abdominal breathing meditation in bed, feeling the stillness of the early morning. After washing up, she went to the dining room, where her mother Li Xiulan had prepared a bowl of beef rice noodles topped with a soft-yolk fried egg. She sat at the table and enjoyed it slowly, drinking the hot soup. Then she took out her pocket journal, checked the food log page, and noted down the breakfast: beef rice noodles + fried egg. She glanced at the weight record, 44.8kg, and casually closed the journal.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: End-of-month financial and creative review.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei went to her study and took out the February budgeting journal and her laptop. She carefully checked her mobile banking and WeChat Pay statements and entered February's income and expenses transaction by transaction into the spreadsheet: 2,400 yuan in writing fees (including prepayments for two articles that had already arrived), 2,000 yuan deposited into the travel fund, and daily expenses on groceries, transportation, and insurance. Next, she cut out the printed proofs of two finalized pieces, including "Flowers and Life at Dounan Flower Market," and pasted them onto the creative progress page of her journal. Beside them, she noted editor Xu Mingyuan's feedback: "Remarkable observational skills—you captured the soul of the flower market." Looking through her diet records, she found that she had stuck well to extra snacks, but her water intake was sometimes insufficient. She used a highlighter to draw stars next to "8 cups of water a day" as a reminder.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Balcony rest and desk tidy-up
description: After the review, Sun Yuwei walked to the balcony to stretch her limbs. The pale purple freesias bought back from Dounan Flower Market on the windowsill gave off a delicate fragrance. She picked up the watering can and sprayed water on the petals and leaves, enjoying a peaceful moment. Then she returned to the study to tidy the desk, making room for the afternoon's creative work.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and inspiration notes
description: Sun Yuwei came to the living room, curled up on the sofa, opened Liu Liangcheng's One Man's Village, and read several essays about Huangshaliang. She suddenly had a new idea about gazetteer-style writing, immediately took out her notebook from her bag, and quickly jotted down a few keywords: vernacular dwellings, dialects, solar terms, and the elderly, as material for the March column.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The whole family discussed the travel plan for western Yunnan.
description: At lunchtime, my father Sun Mingyuan spread the printed "Final Itinerary for the Western Yunnan Loop" on the dining table. Pointing at points on the map, he explained the daily driving route in detail: depart from Kunming on June 2, first go to Dali to circle Erhai Lake, then to Lijiang Old Town, Tiger Leaping Gorge, and Shangri-La, and finally from Deqin to see Meili Snow Mountain before returning. My mother Li Xiulan raised questions about altitude sickness and accommodation, and my father answered each one. In the end, the whole family unanimously approved the route and looked forward to the June trip.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rest and diet note organization
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei helped her mother clear the dishes, then returned to her bedroom for a half-hour nap. After waking up, she wrote down the key points from the morning's review (the March plan to keep drinking water and take iron supplements) on a sticky note and stuck it to a corner of her desk. Then she went to the study and, feeling refreshed, summarized the week's data from the diet tracking page in her journal into the memo app on her phone, and decided that starting in March she would drink a glass of warm water every morning before breakfast.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the bookstore to plan the column and organize health notes
description: At 13:45, Sun Yuwei changed into a jacket and sneakers, grabbed her notebook and laptop bag, and set out from Cuihu Community. She walked along North Cuihu Road for about 7 minutes and arrived at Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore around 14:00. At the bookstore, she ordered a hot Americano, found a seat by the window in a corner, and opened her laptop. Combining past memories and her review, she wrote down several column topic keywords: mornings at Zhuanxin Food Market, the pingtan performers at Cuihu Park, and the changes of Shangyi Street flower market. She went to the front desk to chat with the owner, Qin Mingyuan, and asked about a collection of old photos of Kunming's old streets. Uncle Qin said there might be some on the weekend. Afterwards, she returned to her seat and used her phone's memo app to summarize a week of diet records, highlighted nutritional gaps in her digital notes with a highlighter marker, and confirmed once again that starting in March she would drink warm water every morning.
location: No. 32, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Kunming Paper, Cloth & Stone Bookstore)

name: Walk back home from the bookstore.
description: At 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei packed up her things and left the bookstore, walking home. Passing the fruit stall at the entrance of Cuihu Community, she stopped, picked out seasonal oranges and apples, chatted with the stall owner a bit about "Are the oranges sweet lately?", paid, and headed home with the fruit.
location: Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the way back from Zhibushi Bookstore to Cuihu Community)

name: Go home to rest and take a walk in the rain with mother
description: After arriving home at 16:20, Sun Yuwei put down the fruit and drank half a glass of warm water. Looking out the window, she saw that it was indeed drizzling. She took two umbrellas and called her mother, Li Xiulan, to go downstairs together. The two strolled slowly along the community path with umbrellas, breathing in the moist, fresh air. Her mother reminded her to deposit 2,000 yuan into the travel fund tomorrow (March 1). Sun Yuwei smiled and said she had already noted it. Her mother then asked about the mid-term review time for her graduation project, and she answered that it would probably be in April. The walk in the rain lasted until 17:30.
location: Walking paths within Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the streets along Huashan West Road.

name: Rested, prepared a meal, and headed to the yoga studio.
description: After returning from the walk, Sun Yuwei felt a little hungry. She picked an orange from the fruit she had just bought, cut it, and sat in the living room eating it while scrolling through her WeChat Moments. After a brief rest, she changed into her workout clothes around 18:00, took her yoga mat and water bottle, and set out from Cuihu Community at 18:15. Walking along Huashan West Road and Dongfeng West Road for about 16 minutes, she arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio in Dechun Commercial Building at 18:30.
location: Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Zhongmou Yoga Studio)

name: Take a flow yoga class
description: At 18:30, Sun Yuwei arrived on time at Zhongmou Yoga Studio for Friday's Flow Yoga class. The instructor focused on the flow of breath and postures, with smooth transitions between movements. In the final meditation, she felt very calm inside and silently set "deep cultivation" as her keyword for March. After class, she chatted for a while with her yoga partner He Lu, who said she had also recently started taking iron supplements, and the two agreed to exchange recipes next time.
location: Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Zhongmou Yoga Studio)

name: Walk home after yoga class
description: After the class ended, Sun Yuwei walked home. The autumn wind was slightly cool, and her body still carried the warmth from yoga. Passing the community entrance, she saw fine rain like silk threads beneath the streetlights and felt delighted.
location: Dongfeng West Road and Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the way back from Zhongmou Yoga Studio to Cuihu Community)

name: Bath and Relaxation
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and felt completely relaxed. She drank half a glass of warm water in the living room and then returned to the study.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Just as she sat down in the study, her phone rang. Her older sister Sun Yutong was calling via video from Shenzhen. The two chatted about the excitement back home over finalizing the travel plan and about funny stories from her sister's work. When her sister heard that Sun Yuwei had been keeping up with yoga and journaling, she exclaimed, "You're so much more disciplined than me." After hanging up, Sun Yuwei felt warm inside.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Create a to-do list for March
description: After the video ended, Sun Yuwei took a new sticky note from the drawer and wrote down her March to-do list: save for travel fund (3/1), check out restaurants with Yang Fan (3/5), complete the third field trip for the essay collection (Zhuanxin Vegetable Market), and conduct the second thesis interview with Professor Wu Mingyuan. After writing, she stuck the note on the wall directly in front of her desk as a reminder.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading, meditation, and going to bed
description: At 20:50, Sun Yuwei changed into her pajamas and continued reading "A Village of One" in bed for about half an hour, immersed in its plain writing. Afterward, she set her phone to Do Not Disturb, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, turned off the main light, and left only the bedside lamp on. At 21:45, she lay on her back and did a 15-minute body scan meditation, relaxing one by one from her toes to her whole body; the day's fulfilling moments flashed through her mind, leaving her calm and satisfied. After the meditation, she turned off the light at 22:00 and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and nutritious breakfast
description: After getting up at 7:30 in the morning, she sat cross-legged on a meditation cushion by the bedroom window and opened the “Tide” app on her phone for a 5-minute mindful breathing meditation, focusing on her breath and feeling the stillness of her body and the early morning. After the meditation, she went to the living room and drank the warm water her mother had prepared in advance, then entered the dining room to enjoy the breakfast her mother had made: a bowl of spinach and pork liver congee, a boiled egg, and a small helping of dressed wood ear mushrooms. While eating, she chatted with her mother about today’s plan to visit Green Lake. After the meal, she took out her “Diet Diary” journal and neatly wrote down the breakfast contents with a fountain pen.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Manuscript fee verification and travel fund savings.
description: After breakfast, she went into the study, opened her laptop, and logged into mobile banking. She carefully checked the freelance writing income for the month: two column fees from Cultural Horizon totaling 2,400 yuan, and a WeChat official account copywriting fee of 600 yuan, for a total of 3,000 yuan that had arrived. Following the financial plan she made at the end of last month, she calculated the necessary expenses for the month, then decisively transferred 2,000 yuan into a dedicated savings account named 'Mountains and Seas Fund' as a reserve for the western Yunnan trip, and saved a screenshot of the transfer receipt. Afterwards, she took out the travel fund journal with the green cover, turned to the latest page, and wrote in dark blue pen: 'March 1: deposited ¥2000, cumulative balance: ¥4000.' Below the amount, she stuck a sticker reading 'Set Dreams in Motion' and drew a checkmark. Her father had already arranged lodging in Deqin, and this 4,000 yuan gave her even more confidence for the June trip.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing and developing field material for the column.
description: Focusing on preparations for the third installment of the 'Kunming Slices' column, she browsed photos and scattered notes taken on Wenlin Street and Qianju Street last month on her study computer, created a new Word document, wrote candidate topics such as 'The Dialects and Flavors of Zhuanxin Vegetable Market,' 'The Silhouette of a Night Runner at Cuihu Lake,' and 'The Last Guardian of Shangyi Street Flower Market' on sticky notes and pasted them on the monitor frame, and tapped the keyboard to record the sentences and scenes flashing through her mind, building a skeleton for the next column.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch
description: At noon, her father came home from work and the family of three sat around the dining table. Her mother had specially made beef stir-fried with green peppers, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup to replenish Sun Yuwei's iron. She ate a good amount of beef and greens. During the meal, her father enthusiastically mentioned that he had already arranged a guesthouse in Shangri-La, telling Yuwei not to worry about the trip. Mother and daughter also talked about their plans to go to a bookstore and a park in the afternoon. The family atmosphere was warm and happy.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon reading on the balcony
description: After lunch, instead of taking a nap, she took the half-read book A Village of One to the balcony, sat down in the lounge chair, and basked in the early spring sunshine. She opened the book and immersed herself in Liu Liangcheng's narrative about time, the countryside, and life, occasionally looking up at the new greenery downstairs and the outline of Green Lake Park in the distance, letting her thoughts drift freely between the words and reality.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Weekly diet and water intake review
description: After reading, she returned to the study, took out her diet journal, and summarized the week's meals and water intake. She found that on two days last week her water intake had not met the target, so she used a highlighter to draw a bar chart at the bottom of the page, marked the issue, and wrote “Note!” Then she opened the “Drinking Water Time” app on her phone, raised today's water goal, and reminded herself to drink more warm water.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Book hunting at Zhibushi Bookstore and column writing
description: In the afternoon, she changed into sneakers, slung on a canvas bag, and headed out. After walking about 13 minutes along West Huashan Road, she arrived at Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore. The owner, Qin Mingyuan, warmly told her that the copy of 'Old Kunming's City and People' she had been looking for a couple of days earlier had arrived and was ready on the counter. Yuwei thanked him happily, took the brown kraft paper bag, removed the book, and sat in the reading chair in the corner, leafing through the yellowed old photos and text page by page, occasionally taking photos with her phone. Uncle Qin brewed a cup of tea. She continued writing in her notebook under the warm yellow light, combining the old scenes of Wenlin Street and Qianju Street in the old photos with her morning ideas, and wrote: 'From the old archway on Wenlin Street to the clothing shops on Qianju Street, every street in Kunming is a slice of time...' immersed in the peaceful Sunday afternoon of creation.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take a walk with Mother in Green Lake Park
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin and leaving the bookstore, she walked about 12 minutes along Cuihu North Road to the entrance of Cuihu Park, where her mother Li Xiulan was already waiting in a lotus-pink coat. The mother and daughter met and strolled along the lakeside path. The breeze carried the damp coolness of early spring, and the park was full of people walking, taking children out, and singing opera tunes. Yuwei enthusiastically shared what she had seen at the bookstore and her column ideas, and her mother suggested that she ask Uncle Qin again about the old photos of Zhuanxin Vegetable Market. Looking at the reflections of new willows on the lake and the passing crowds, the two spent a rare time together. After walking for about an hour, they walked back together to their home in Cuihu Community, taking less than a minute.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mother and daughter prepare dinner.
description: Walking into the kitchen, her mother put on an apron and started preparing dinner. Yuwei volunteered to wash the mushrooms and greens. Tonight's menu was stir-fried seasonal vegetables, pork rib and mushroom soup, and sliced pork with green peppers. As mother and daughter worked, they chatted about how hard it was to find lodging in Deqin, as her father had learned, and the atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and dreams of travel
description: Father came home from work, and the family of three sat around the table to enjoy dinner. Yuwei gave a detailed account of what she had gained from the Paper, Cloth, and Stone Bookstore, especially the inspiration the old photo collection kept by Uncle Qin had brought to her column. Father also enthusiastically shared hiking routes around Shangri-La recommended by the innkeeper. The family felt even more concrete anticipation for their trip to western Yunnan in June.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with her elder sister Sun Yuting.
description: After dinner, she returned to the bedroom and sent her elder sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen, a WeChat video request. When it connected, Yuwei excitedly held up her phone to show the fund transfer screenshot: "I saved 2,000 as planned today, and with the previous amount, it's 4,000 yuan in total!" Her sister smiled happily on the other side of the screen and said she had also started looking at sun protection gear. The two then talked about the specific itinerary for the Western Yunnan loop, and her sister promised to take a few days off in June, hoping the whole family could travel part of the route together.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal time and reading.
description: After hanging up the phone, she was still in a good mood. She took out today’s journal, added the afternoon’s food record, and deliberately used one page to sketch from memory and phone photos the old Kunming street scene she had seen in the bookstore, with a short reflective passage written beside it. After finishing, she picked up Liu Liangcheng’s “A Village of One” and read, immersed in the words until she gradually felt sleepy.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and meditating before bedtime.
description: At 9:30 p.m., I put down my book, changed into soft cotton pajamas, briefly tidied my desk and bed, and left the room neat and orderly. At exactly 10 p.m., I lay in bed, put on earphones, opened the “Tide” app, and chose the “Body Scan” meditation. Guided by a gentle female voice, I relaxed each part of my body from my toes to the top of my head, letting the thoughts and gains of the day settle. After the meditation ended, I turned off the desk lamp, wrapped myself in the blanket, and fell asleep in peace and contentment, carrying confidence and anticipation for March.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning mindfulness meditation
description: The phone alarm rang, and Sun Yuwei turned it off. She walked to the living room, filled a glass with warm water, and drank it slowly, feeling the warmth slide down her throat. Then she returned to the bedroom, sat cross-legged on the carpet, opened the Tide app, and began a 5-minute morning mindfulness meditation, focusing on the rhythm of her breath and letting her mind gradually wake up, setting the tone for an orderly day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and diet record
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, had already cooked millet pumpkin porridge and fried a sunny-side-up egg. Sun Yuwei helped set the table and ate with her mother. After the meal, she carefully recorded in her journal: 'Breakfast: 1 bowl of millet pumpkin porridge, 1 fried egg.' Her mother asked about her walk yesterday, and the two chatted about their plan to go to Dounan Flower Market next week.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing study space
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the bedroom, sat down at the desk by the window, plugged in her laptop, and opened the school's academic affairs system website. She filled a glass of water and placed it beside her, reminding herself to stay well hydrated. It was cloudy outside, with occasional sunlight falling on the keyboard.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Online learning and reading academic literature
description: Sun Yuwei logged into the school's academic affairs system to watch the course recording of "Modern Chinese Literary Trends" on "root-seeking literature," typing key points into an electronic document and taking screenshots of the PPT. Around 10:00, she got up and moved around, then downloaded and read two core journal papers on CNKI, "Urban Imagery and Spatial Narrative: The Cultural Landscape of Independent Bookstores in Kunming" and "From 'Zhibushi' to 'Mingyuan': An Analysis of Survival Samples of Independent Bookstores in Kunming," taking notes and marking citations in Zotero as she read. At 11:20, she began collecting information on inheritors of "Kunming paper-cutting" for the "Introduction to Intangible Cultural Heritage" group presentation, recording key information in a shared document.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch
description: Mother made stir-fried rice with shredded pork and green peppers, and seaweed egg drop soup. Sun Yuwei controlled her portion, eating a little over half a bowl of the fried rice and finishing the soup, then recorded in her journal: "Lunch: stir-fried rice with shredded pork and green peppers (a little over half a bowl), seaweed egg drop soup 1 bowl." The mother and daughter chatted about plans for next week.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Contact Mingyuan Bookstore to schedule the interview time.
description: After clearing the dishes, Sun Yuwei leaned back on the sofa and contacted Qin Mingyuan via WeChat. She expressed her interest in 'The City and People of Old Kunming' and explained her graduation thesis topic, hoping to make Mingyuan Bookshop her first interviewee. Qin Mingyuan readily agreed and set the first formal interview for 2:00 PM this Friday at the bookstore. After confirming, she felt excited.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: Sun Yuwei changed into a light blue hoodie and jeans, took her crossbody bag containing a power bank, campus card, and ID card, and checked her student ID. She checked the bus route to Chenggong campus on her phone, decided to take Bus 1 and transfer to Bus K20, estimated 1 hour and 50 minutes, and left early.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take the bus to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus.
description: Sun Yuwei walked to the Renmin Middle Road bus stop and took Bus No. 1. Sitting in a window seat, she put on her earphones and listened on repeat to Bach's cello pieces, watching the street scenes and plane trees outside the window, drafting her paper outline and rehearsing interview questions. After arriving at Juhuacun Station, she transferred to Bus K20 and continued toward University Town. The buildings outside gradually became sparser, with distant mountains stretching on and on.
location: On Bus No. 1 and K20 from Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District

name: Graduate image information collection
description: After arriving at the Chenggong Campus, Sun Yuwei walked quickly to the Student Union Hall and waited in line for about 20 minutes. When her turn came, she walked up to the blue backdrop, adjusted her collar and hair as the photographer instructed, took off her earphones, and smiled for the photo. The staff told her the electronic photo would be issued in a week, and she felt relieved.
location: First-floor lobby of the Student Union Hall, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus walk and photography.
description: After completing the collection, Sun Yuwei strolled leisurely around campus. First, she photographed dew drops on grass blades in the sunlight on the lawn in front of the library, then walked along the path to Ze Lake, where she took photos of black swans swimming and the reflection of the clock tower. She marveled at the poetry of spring and saved the materials into the 'Kunming Slices Field Collection' folder.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: the lawn in front of the library, Zehu Lake, and the bell tower.

name: From Chenggong to Mingyuan Bookstore.
description: Sun Yuwei took the bus to University Town Metro Station, then transferred to Line 1 toward the city center. In the carriage, she opened the memo on her phone and sorted through draft interview questions for Qin Mingyuan, such as his original intentions for running the business and customer stories. As the subway emerged from underground onto the elevated section, the sunset glow lit the view, and the journey was peaceful.
location: Rail Transit Line 1 and bus from University City Metro Station, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District.

name: Arrive at Mingyuan Bookstore and have a preliminary discussion with Qin Mingyuan
description: Sun Yuwei stepped into Mingyuan Bookstore right on time; the lighting was warm, filled with the scent of paper and coffee. Qin Mingyuan was organizing the bookshelves and invited her to sit in a window seat on the second floor, where the twilight over Green Lake was visible. She briefly explained her thesis framework and interview directions. Qin Mingyuan mentioned early anecdotes about the bookstore and his business philosophy. The atmosphere was relaxed; she noted key points and confirmed the interview arrangement for Friday.
location: Window seat on the second floor of Zhibushi Bookstore (Mingyuan Book House), No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Left the bookstore and walked home
description: After saying goodbye to Qin Mingyuan, Sun Yuwei walked home along the Cuihu Park path. As the evening lights came on, Cuihu was tranquil, with a few scattered pedestrians strolling. She felt a long-lost sense of ease and quickened her pace, looking forward to dinner at home.
location: Green Lake Park trail from No. 32 Cuihu North Road to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner
description: Both parents were already at home; her mother had prepared braised fish and garlic stir-fried lettuce. The family of three sat together for dinner. Sun Yuwei chatted with her father about taking photos at school and the situation at Mingyuan Bookstore. Her father supported her thesis topic and encouraged her to talk more with the bookstore owners. Her mother also asked about progress. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize notes, review the paper, and update the journal.
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her desk, quickly organized the key points from her afternoon exchange with Qin Mingyuan into the thesis interview preparation document, and flagged the questions to ask on Friday. She exported the literature notes from the two papers she had read in the morning, selected three quotations, and copied them into the thesis proposal database. Then she opened her journal, used a fountain pen to record the day's schedule and reflections, pasted a photo of Zehu Lake in the margin, and noted 'A Glimpse of Zehu Lake, Spring 2025.' She felt her life was fulfilling and well organized.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing materials for tomorrow and the column essay
description: Sun Yuwei emptied her backpack and put in the textbooks and notebooks she would need for Monday. Then she created a new document, “Kunming's Bookstore Scenes (First Draft),” inspired by her conversation with Qin Mingyuan, and wrote an opening of about 400 words: “At the wooden stairway landing of Mingyuan Bookstore, there is always a beam of light... In the afternoon, returning from the modern campus in Chenggong to the century-old bookshop by Green Lake, it feels like traveling from one era to another.” She saved the document, ready to continue polishing it.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Sun Yuwei went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into pajamas, set her phone to Do Not Disturb and placed it on the nightstand, dimmed the room lights, and arranged the pillow and quilt, creating a quiet sleeping atmosphere.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime body scan meditation
description: Sun Yuwei lay flat on her bed and followed the Tide app's guided body scan meditation, gradually moving her attention from her toes through her whole body, feeling the groundedness of her body against the mattress, relaxing the muscles tensed from a day of rushing about, and letting her mind grow calm.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading to relax and going to bed.
description: After the meditation ended, she felt calm. She picked up A Village of One from the bedside and continued reading. When she came to a passage about hometown and faraway places, she was lost in thought for a moment. Around 23:50, she closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and gradually drifted to sleep amid the occasional sound of traffic outside the window, ending the day with a fulfilled mood.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and washing up
description: After the alarm went off, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and did 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breathing and letting her thoughts settle from the day's rush. After meditation, she picked up a thermos from the bedside table and slowly drank a few sips of warm water, then washed up simply, changed into a white T-shirt and jeans, and recorded her starting weight and mood for the day in her journal.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with my mother and chatting about everyday things
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared breakfast: spinach and pork liver congee and boiled eggs. While eating, Sun Yuwei mentioned to her mother that she had arranged to have lunch with her roommate at the school cafeteria that day, and her mother reminded her to eat more vegetables. The two chatted about how her father's contact with accommodations in Deqin was going, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute to Yunnan University.
description: Sun Yuwei packed her document folder, notebook, and water bottle, checked her phone battery, then put on her canvas bag and left home. She walked about 5 minutes to the "Xiaoximen (Renmin West Road)" bus stop on Renmin Middle Road, and then took Bus No. 1 to Yunnan University Donglu Campus. On the bus, she wore earphones and listened to a podcast about "local chronicles and literature." Because the signal was unstable, she turned to watching the bustling scene of breakfast stalls on Wenlin Road outside the window.
location: People's Middle Road bus stop in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, and the No. 1 bus route.

name: Process the verification of student registration information.
description: After arriving at school, Sun Yuwei went to the Student Records Office on the 2nd floor of the administration building, waited in line for about 10 minutes, then submitted her student ID and ID card to the administrative staff member. She carefully checked every item on the personal information form—name, ID number, major, place of origin, etc.—and signed after confirming everything was correct.
location: Academic Records Section, 2nd Floor, Administration Building, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Picked up assignment feedback and ran into a classmate
description: After coming out of the administration building, Sun Yuwei walked to the College of Liberal Arts office building and picked up the assignment feedback for Contemporary Chinese Literary Trends at the counselor's office. In the hallway, she ran into her classmate Lin Yue. The two chatted by the window for about 10 minutes. Lin Yue shared how she was preparing for the postgraduate entrance exam re-examination, while Sun Yuwei talked about the interview progress for her graduation thesis.
location: Office Building of the School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and journaling time at Zhigong Pavilion.
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Yue, Sun Yuwei came to the quiet Zhigong Pavilion beside the School of Literature. Sitting on the bench, she opened 'One Man's Village' and read two chapters. In her journal, she wrote several sentences for the beginning of the column essay she had conceived yesterday, but she was not satisfied and crossed them out. During this time, she transferred 50 yuan of pocket money to her 'Travel Fund' account on her phone as a reward for completing the image collection yesterday.
location: Bench near Zhigong Pavilion, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had lunch with her roommate in the cafeteria
description: After putting away her books, Sun Yuwei walked along the ginkgo avenue toward the student cafeteria, and on the way sent a WeChat message to her roommate Liu Jia to confirm where to meet. The three sat down by the window on the second floor of the cafeteria. Liu Jia ordered spicy rice noodles, Zhao Xiaowen had a green pepper and stir-fried pork rice bowl, and Sun Yuwei chose tomato and egg noodles. They chatted while eating about winter break experiences and post-graduation plans. Sun Yuwei also shared her trip to Chenggong the day before to collect images and her preliminary discussion with Uncle Qin. After the meal, her roommates left first. She filled a cup with warm water, drank it alone, and marked in her phone memo: “today's water intake goal progress: 1/8.”
location: No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, 2nd Floor, Student Cafeteria, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: Sun Yuwei left through the school's north gate, walked along Wenlin Street and turned into Dongfeng West Road, listening to light music through earphones at a moderate pace. It took about 25 minutes to walk to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, letting herself settle into the relaxed feeling of preparing for yoga.
location: Walking path from Wenlin Street to Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Flow yoga group class and post-class shopping
description: At 13:20 she arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio and changed into her yoga clothes. The class started on time at 13:30. The instructor's music had a strong sense of rhythm. Sun Yuwei focused on the flow of asanas with each breath, moving from Mountain Pose to Downward-Facing Dog, then Warrior II, Revolved Triangle Pose, and more, as her heart rate gradually rose. After class, she did a 5-minute Savasana meditation. Afterward, she went to the front desk to ask and learned that Instructor He Lu had a class the next afternoon, so she marked a reminder in her phone calendar. Then she went downstairs and bought a bottle of fresh milk and a box of blueberries at the convenience store as an extra snack for after she got home.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and the convenience store downstairs

name: Walked back home
description: Sun Yuwei walked home from the yoga studio carrying fresh milk and blueberries. Passing the fruit stall at the entrance of the residential complex, she hesitated for a moment but didn't buy anything extra, because there was still stock in the fridge at home.
location: Walking path from Dongfeng West Road to Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing interview notes and column writing
description: After washing her hands, Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the study, organized the key points from the phone recording of yesterday's preliminary communication with Uncle Qin into written notes, and drew up a more specific list of questions for Friday's formal interview. Then she drank half a glass of fresh milk, opened the beginning of the column essay she wrote the day before and silently reread it several times. She decided to abandon the stiff metaphor and rewrote the first paragraph using the call of the koel at dawn at Green Lake as the starting point. After finishing the revision, she recorded today's diet and exercise in her journal and drew a small leaf in the margin.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: Hearing the sound of her mother busy in the kitchen, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to help. She was in charge of picking the scallions and cilantro, also washed the blueberries they had bought and put them on a plate, and set out the bowls and chopsticks for the family of three.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The family of three sat together around the table, and dinner was the sour fish with pickled cabbage and stir-fried pea shoots that mother had made. At the table, father Sun Mingyuan mentioned that the accommodation in Deqin had been booked—a guesthouse with a view at the foot of Meili Snow Mountain; mother talked about something amusing that happened at school that day. Sun Yuwei listened quietly, occasionally joining in.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: An evening walk with mother after dinner
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei and her mother changed into comfortable shoes and walked along the flower beds in the neighborhood, occasionally stepping out of the gate for a short stroll on Huashan West Road. They talked about the cold front coming next week; her mother reminded her to bring a coat when doing the interview on Friday, and Sun Yuwei shared the small progress she made today on revising the opening of her column.
location: Internal footpath of Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the vicinity of Huashan West Road

name: Stretching before bed and teaching Mom introductory yoga.
description: After a short rest from the walk home, Sun Yuwei spread out her yoga mat on the living room floor for a gentle pre-sleep stretch. Her mother saw this and said she wanted to join her in early morning yoga starting tomorrow to relieve shoulder and neck discomfort. Sun Yuwei happily agreed, and the mother and daughter immediately searched on their phones and downloaded a beginner instructional app called "Daily Yoga," agreeing to start at 6:30 the next morning in the living room.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and essays
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the study and continued reading One Person's Village. When she read a paragraph about "dogs," she was deeply moved, and she wrote a few lines of impromptu notes in the notebook beside her. Afterward, she tidied the desk and laid out the yoga mat in advance for tomorrow morning's yoga class.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and meditation before sleep.
description: After brushing her teeth, washing her face, and applying moisturizer, Sun Yuwei changed into loose pajamas, checked her phone alarm, and charged her fitness band. Then she leaned against the headboard, put on earphones to listen to low-frequency meditation music, and did 10 minutes of gentle stretching (rolling her ankles and stretching her arms). Then she lay down, closed her eyes, and did a 5-minute body-scan meditation. The image of practicing yoga with her mother the next morning came to mind. She turned off the light with a smile, set the air conditioner to sleep mode, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mother-daughter morning yoga and stretching
