description: Early in the morning, she did yoga with her mother in the living room using the Daily Yoga app's beginner-level morning wake-up course, helping her mother adjust her postures and breathing. After yoga, they each drank warm water and did simple arm and shoulder stretches by the kitchen window. Sun Yuwei recorded the completed yoga session in her journal, drew a small yoga mat pattern, and noted it as Day 1 with Mom.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and a cozy breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei helped her mother in the kitchen, poaching eggs and toasting whole-wheat bread while her mother warmed milk. Father Sun Mingyuan got up, and the three sat around the dining table, chatting about the quality of their sleep and the progress Father had made in contacting accommodations in Deqin. Sun Yuwei recorded the breakfast in her journal: poached eggs, whole-wheat bread, and milk.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning reading and replying to messages
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei browsed “The City and People of Old Kunming” in the study, quickly checked WeChat messages, replied to her yoga partner He Lu’s message about iron-supplementing recipes, and exchanged simple greetings. Outside the window, the fog gradually lifted and sunlight spilled onto the pages.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for a video call
description: Sun Yuwei walked to the balcony to water the green plants, checked her phone battery, felt the breeze and the scent of flowers in the sunlight, and prepared for a video call with her sister.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with sister to share warm moments
description: Her elder sister Sun Yutong called via WeChat video from Shenzhen. Sun Yuwei excitedly shared photos and feelings from the morning yoga session with their mother, and her mother also leaned into the camera. The three women chatted happily. Her sister praised it as a new family tradition and mentioned that her work project was going smoothly. Sun Yuwei took a screenshot to preserve the warm scene.
location: Balcony and living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare interview outlines and materials
description: After hanging up the phone, Sun Yuwei returned to the study, took out the printed interview outline, marked keywords, checked the voice recorder battery, and made sure the notebook and pen were in her canvas tote bag.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei shouldered her canvas bag, put on her earphones, and headed out. She walked about 13 minutes through the tree-lined paths of Cuihu Community, along Huashan West Road toward Cuihu North Road, and arrived at the Paper, Cloth, and Stone Bookstore in Kunming.
location: Walk from home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore at 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Conduct a field interview at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore in Kunming.
description: Sun Yuwei interviewed the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan in the quiet staff break room of the bookstore. She asked about his original intention for opening the bookstore, memorable stories from running it (such as maintaining the community during the pandemic), and the challenges he faced (the impact of online platforms, rising rent). She recorded the whole session and took careful notes, marking passages that could be used in her thesis.
location: Staff lounge, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Expressing thanks after the interview and walking to Little Bird Park.
description: After the interview, Sun Yuwei thanked Uncle Qin and agreed to visit again next week, then walked south along Cuihu North Road and arrived at the south gate of Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park) in about 12 minutes.
location: Walk from Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the South Gate of Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cuihu Park walk and catching up with book friends
description: Sun Yuwei walked along Nine-Bend Bridge to Bamboo Grove Island in the park, sat down on a lakeside bench to let her thoughts from the interview settle, sent a WeChat voice message to her book friend Yang Xiao to share what she had gained from the interview, and enjoyed the lake breeze and scenery.
location: Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (from Nine-Bend Bridge to Bamboo Grove Island area)

name: Walking home and chatting over lunch.
description: Sun Yuwei walked out of the east gate of Cuihu Park and walked along Huashan West Road for about 5 minutes to return home. She had lunch with her parents and shared her morning interview experience. Her father praised the progress, and her mother told her to drink plenty of water and not overexert herself.
location: Walked from the East Gate of Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the Cuihu Community Home Restaurant at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organized interview recordings and notes.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei imported the recording file into her laptop in the study. Wearing earphones, she went through the playback and supplemented her notes sentence by sentence, highlighting several quotes from Qin Mingyuan about maintaining the community during epidemic prevention and control. She summarized three arguments that could be used for her thesis, archived the recording and documents by date, and updated the status on her thesis progress sheet.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rest, reading, and journaling time
description: Sun Yuwei got up to stretch, brewed rose tea, went to the living room window to watch the sunlight fall on the osmanthus tree, then returned to the study to flip through the chapter on old Kunming teahouses in Old Kunming: The City and Its People for inspiration for her column, and watered the freesias on the windowsill. After that, she took out her beloved journal and recorded the yoga and tidying up, the interview insights, and the joy of video-calling her sister; she also made up the reading notes she had missed yesterday and noted important class meeting dates in her memo.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helped prepare dinner and had dinner with family
description: Sun Yuwei went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare ingredients, peeling garlic and trimming vegetables. As the three sat around the table for dinner, they talked about the evening class meeting arrangements, and her mother reminded her to rest early after it ended.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Take a walk around the neighborhood with my mother after dinner.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei and her mother went downstairs and took a walk around the Cuihu Community to help digest the food, chatting about her mother’s recent work and interesting stories about her students.
location: Ground floor of Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-class preparation and attending the online class meeting
description: Sun Yuwei returned home, washed blueberries and grapes as a snack, opened Tencent Meeting to make sure the equipment was working, and copied the important dates from the class meeting notice into her phone's memo. At 8 p.m., the class meeting started on time. The counselor emphasized matters such as checking graduation credits, the thesis defense schedule, and upcoming campus job fairs. Sun Yuwei took careful notes and screenshotted important information.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation, meditation, and reading to fall asleep
description: After the class meeting, Sun Yuwei washed up, applied a hydrating mask, and changed into pajamas before lying down on the bed. Following the app's guidance, she did a 15-minute body scan meditation, relaxing her whole body step by step from toes to the top of her head, feeling deep calm. Then she picked up A Village of One from the bedside and read two short chapters. She turned off the light at 22:30 and fell asleep peacefully listening to the faint wind outside the window.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and journaling
description: Early in the morning, I practiced Cat-Cow, spinal twists, and a simple Downward Dog with my mother on the yoga mat in the living room. My mother's arms trembled, but her gaze was determined, and she held for three breaths. Afterward, I returned to the study to update my journal, writing down my weight of 44.95 kg and wake-up time, recording my mother's progress, and then listing the breakfast plan.
location: Living room and study at Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out
description: Had a nutritious breakfast with her mother, eating whole wheat toast, fried eggs, warm milk, nuts, and mango. Her mother mentioned dreaming of her father growing flowers on the balcony after retirement, and Sun Yuwei agreed and planned where to put the flower stand. After the meal, she washed the dishes, cleaned up the kitchen, went back to the bedroom to organize her backpack, and packed her laptop, interview outline, voice recorder, student ID, and other items.
location: Dining room, kitchen, and bedroom, Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning academic work: organize interview recordings and draft a presentation outline
description: In the study, she turned on the computer and voice recorder, listened again to the interview with Uncle Qin, quickly recorded key viewpoints and quotes, annotated parts that could be used in the main body of the thesis, and filed the photos and notes into the 'Thesis-Field Data' folder. Then she created a PPT, using 'From Spatial Narrative to Cultural Memory' as the framework, filled in content according to the three dimensions of 'bookstore spatial layout, reader profile, and business philosophy', and on the notes page considered the applicability of David Harvey's time-space compression theory.
location: Study, Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare the dessert for dinner and relax at lunch.
description: Together with my mother, I took out the semi-finished flower cakes, brushed them with egg wash, and baked them in the oven at 180°C for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, we moved the dining table to the balcony and spread a plaid tablecloth on it. At lunch, my mother cooked tomato and egg noodles. Sun Yuwei replied to messages in her close friends' group chat while eating, and sent a private message to Yang Fan to arrange a visit to a dessert shop. Afterwards, she rested with her eyes closed on the living room sofa for 15 minutes, got up at 13:00, checked her backpack and USB drive, and got ready to go out.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room, Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to Yunnan University and an unexpected campus encounter
description: Walked from home to Huashan West Road bus stop, took Bus 92 to Yunnan University Donglu Campus, and listened to interview clips on headphones along the way. Arriving early, I read "One Man's Village" on a bench at Zhigong Pavilion and happened to run into classmate Lin Yue; the two of us briefly talked about fieldwork and post-graduation plans.
location: On Bus No. 92 and at Zhigong Pavilion, Donglu Campus of Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Thesis discussion with supervisor
description: Reported the preliminary findings on Mingyuan Bookstore in Professor Wu Mingyuan's office at the School of Literature and presented a PPT analysis framework. Professor Wu affirmed the solidity of the primary sources, suggested adding interviews with 2–3 readers of different age groups, and recommended Lefebvre's The Production of Space as a reference for deeper theoretical analysis.
location: Professor Wu Mingyuan's Office, School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and organize the advisor's suggestions
description: After leaving the School of Literature, she walked to the Cuihu North Road bus stop and took Bus No. 92 back, using her phone's notes app to record her supervisor's key suggestions on the way. After getting home, she went straight to the study, used a highlighter and notebook to list two major tasks—'supplement reader interviews' and 'deepen the theory of spatial narrative'—broke them down into concrete action steps, and taped the list next to her computer screen.
location: On bus No. 92 in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and in the study at Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road

name: Father's Retirement Celebration Dinner and What Followed
description: Plated the baked flower cakes and garnished them with mint leaves, and prepared sour plum drink and tableware. Father Sun Mingyuan came home with his retirement certificate and commemorative fountain pen, and the family reunited. During dinner, her mother served mushroom hotpot and cold mixed rice noodles. Sun Yuwei proposed a toast to her father. He recounted thirty years of work stories and encouraged her to be down-to-earth in her field research and scholarship. After dinner, Sun Yuwei volunteered to do the dishes. Her mother suggested a walk around Cuihu Lake to aid digestion. She also posted a short note on WeChat Moments to commemorate her father's retirement, along with photos of the flower cakes and hotpot.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room, Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: In the study, she connected a video call with her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, pointed her phone at the not-yet-cleared dining table so her sister could 'cloud taste' the remaining flower cakes, and recounted in detail the day's thesis discussion and the entire celebration of their father's retirement. Her sister laughed and said she would come back next month during her leave to taste the mushroom hotpot made by their mother.
location: Study, Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Nighttime personal time: journaling, reading, meditation, and bedtime preparation.
description: First, she pasted the Polaroid photo of her father and his retirement certificate into the journal and recorded her reflections. Then she leaned against the headboard in the bedroom to read the chapter of One Man's Village about 'the covering of time and the memory of land,' noting that it could echo the spatial memory in her thesis. Next, she did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, imagining herself lying on the lotus leaves in Cuihu Lake. After the meditation, she continued reading and wrote the annotation 'Good writing is writing that can hear the sound of the wind.' Finally, she closed the book and set the alarm for 6:30 the next day.
location: Study and bedroom, Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: After turning off the light, she drifted off to sleep in the quiet night, with anticipation for her thesis and gratitude for her family.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Get up and drink warm water
description: At 06:25 in the morning, her phone alarm went off. Sun Yuwei got up, went to the kitchen, drank a glass of warm water to wake up her body, and felt full of energy.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning yoga with mother
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan did yoga together in the living room, reviewing Cat-Cow and Downward Dog poses and focusing on Tree Pose. Her mother Li Xiulan was very happy after succeeding, and the family atmosphere felt warm.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Breakfast and diet record
description: Had breakfast with her parents. Her mother made millet porridge, flower cakes, and eggs. Sun Yuwei took a photo of the table and recorded the meal.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Journaling and flower arrangement sketch ideas
description: In the study, work on the journal, record yesterday’s little moments and draw sketches, then refine the “wabi-sabi miniature landscape” floral design sketch to be discussed with He Lu, conceiving the arrangement of dried wood, succulent varieties, and pottery jars.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Getting ready to go out and walking to the yoga studio.
description: She changed into khaki cotton-linen trousers and an off-white knit top, put on a dark brown trench coat, and checked the backpack for yoga clothes, shopping bags, phone, power bank, nuts, and the printed floral design plan. At 08:25, she set out from Cuihu Community, walking along Cuihu South Road to Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, a walk of about 15 minutes, enjoying the morning sunlight and the scent of trees.
location: Along the route from Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China to Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Coffee and small talk after arriving early at the yoga studio
description: Arriving at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, the front desk told her that He Lu was in a private lesson. Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the lounge and went over the floral design proposal. After class, He Lu brought her a hand-brewed coffee, and the two chatted about aromatherapy.
location: Rest area, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Browsing small shops on Wenlin Street
description: Taking advantage of the half hour before the communication meeting, Sun Yuwei went downstairs and strolled along Wenlin Street, walked into a pottery shop called "Shanmu Handcraft", saw a ruggedly shaped teacup, and took a photo as inspiration for miniature landscape tea set elements.
location: Shanmu Handmade Pottery Shop, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Formally discuss the floral design plan
description: Back in the rest area of the yoga studio, Sun Yuwei showed and explained the wabi-sabi miniature landscape plan to He Lu in detail, using succulents, deadwood, and old clay pots to create a style combining Zen and nature. He Lu approved the concept, agreed on a budget of 200 yuan, and set the arrangement to start at 1:30 p.m.
location: Rest area, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Take the subway to Dounan Flower Market.
description: Took the metro from Dongfeng West Road Station, transferring to Lines 5, 1, and 4, and arrived at Dounan Station after about 40-plus minutes. Along the way, she made a shopping list in her head.
location: Metro in Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (Dongfeng West Road Station to Dounan Station)

name: Shopping at Dounan Flower Market and lunch
description: After arriving at Dounan Flower Market, Sun Yuwei headed straight to the succulent area and carefully selected varieties such as Aeonium, Haworthia, and Sedum rubrotinctum. In the materials area, she found perfectly shaped dried azalea branches, pinecones, and dried moss, and bought two large plain clay pots and one small one. Through bargaining with the vendor, the total cost was kept under 200 yuan. Then she had a bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles at a small stall at the market entrance for lunch, taking in the lively street atmosphere.
location: Dounan Flower Market and nearby stalls, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Returning by metro and walking back to the yoga studio
description: After lunch, carrying the bags of purchases, she took the subway back the same way to Dongfeng West Road Station. After exiting the station, she quickened her pace and walked back to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, sharing photos of pinecones in her close friends' group chat along the way.
location: Kunming Metro, Yunnan Province, China (from Dounan Station to Dongfeng West Road Station), then walking to Dechun Commercial Building.

name: Built a floral miniature landscape and received a season pass as a gift.
description: After returning to the yoga studio, I put on an apron and began creating with He Lu on the solid-wood low table. First I laid dried moss at the bottom of a clay pot, filled it with potting soil, carefully planted the succulents and adjusted their positions, inserted dried azalea branches diagonally and secured them, wrapped the joins with thin hemp rope, and decorated a small clay pot with pinecones and moss. He Lu helped pass tools and observe the effect. It took more than two hours to complete a miniature landscape full of rustic charm and Zen. He Lu was very pleased and gave me a quarterly yoga pass worth 1500 yuan as a thank-you. The two agreed to refresh the flower arrangement once a month, with the cost reimbursed by the studio. After the creative session, I ate the apple and nuts I had brought in the lounge area to replenish my energy.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Attend evening Vinyasa yoga class
description: After changing into her yoga clothes, she warmed up briefly in the studio. The 17:00 evening Vinyasa flow class officially began; a male teacher led a smooth sequence of challenging vinyasa poses. Sun Yuwei was in excellent form and smoothly completed the combination of Extended Side Angle Pose, Half Moon Pose, and Lord of the Dance Pose. After class, during the relaxation meditation, she felt her body opening up and her mind calm. She then took a quick shower at the yoga studio.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, large classroom, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk home
description: After class, she walked back to Cuihu Community, enjoying the street scene as the lights came on. Passing the corner of Wenlin Street, she noticed that the milk tea shop she wanted to visit was already closed.
location: Along the route from Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China, to Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road

name: Have dinner with the family
description: When she got home, her mother had already made dinner: stir-fried pea shoots and tomato egg drop soup. Sun Yuwei showed her parents the finished miniature landscape photos on her phone, earning her mother's praise and her father's comment that they were 'evocative'; the family atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Organized materials and shared them with her close friend.
description: After dinner, she returned to her bedroom and sorted through the photos and videos taken during the day at the flower market and the yoga studio. She selected the best shots of the miniature landscape and the flower market purchase footage, sent them to the besties group chat "Sleepless Chat for Five Cents," and received enthusiastic praise from her friends.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Shower and skin care
description: After a day of outdoor activities and yoga that made me sweat a lot, I took a hot shower to wash away the fatigue, then put on a hydrating mask to moisturize my dry skin.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Evening journaling, reading, and schedule planning.
description: After taking off the face mask, she started working on her journal, using a cute flowchart to record the key steps of building the terrarium, decorating it with dried moss and writing down her reflections. Then she read parts of Liu Liangcheng's One Man's Village. Next, she put her yoga season pass into her card holder, added a reminder in her phone calendar to refresh the flower arrangements in the middle of each month, and checked her email.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Meditation and reading before bed to fall asleep.
description: After finishing her bedtime preparations, she sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated for 15 minutes, reviewing the touching moments of the day. Then she leaned against the headboard and reread the essay about 'grass' from 'One Person's Village.' Finally, she turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Morning mother-daughter yoga
description: Sunlight streamed in through the living room's floor-to-ceiling windows. I laid out the yoga mat and played the light music “Morning Light” on my phone. I encouraged my mother to try a new pose, “Warrior I.” She held onto the back of a chair and slowly raised her arms, saying her legs were sore, but her eyes were very focused. I guided her to gaze at a fixed point in front and adjust our breathing together. After three rounds of breath, her posture actually remained steady. When she finished, she smiled and said, “My legs are going to fall off.” I smiled and handed her a towel. The unspoken understanding between mother and daughter flowed in the morning light.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming (home living room)

name: Washing up, weighing, and morning tidy-up
description: I walked into the bathroom and splashed warm water on my face to wake up. Stepping on the scale, it showed 44.88 kg, about 0.1 kg heavier than yesterday, probably because of the red date and white fungus soup Mom simmered last night. I made a funny face at the mirror, changed into a comfortable cotton-linen home dress, and used a wooden comb to gather my hair into a low ponytail, feeling fresh and clear-headed.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (home - bathroom, bedroom)

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: On the dining table were brown sugar steamed buns made by my mother, boiled eggs, and a fruit platter cut by my father along with hot milk. After I sat down, my father brought up his retirement walking plan, saying he wanted to go for a walk in Haihong Wetland Park. My mother suggested the whole family go together on the weekend, and I nodded in agreement, feeling that the rhythm at home was shifting from 'work mode' to 'family leisure mode' — very relaxed and comfortable.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (Home – Dining Room)

name: Refining the prose draft in the study
description: I carried my teacup into the study. The faint sound of birdsong from Green Lake Park drifted through the window. I turned on the computer and opened the latest document of The Watch Behind the Glass. I read it aloud paragraph by paragraph, examining the rhythm of each sentence. The emotional buildup at the opening was a bit slow, so I condensed two long sentences to make the image more focused. The closing metaphor, "like the light of a bookstore, faint yet enduring," felt a little stiff. After thinking for a moment, I changed it to "like the books in a bookstore that have been read so many times their spines have gone white—soft in voice, yet every word clear." After reading it through once and confirming that it precisely expressed what I had in mind, I saved the final version.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (Home - Study)

name: Wrap-up work and replying to messages.
description: I saved the document and backed it up to the cloud drive. Picking up my phone, I replied to Song Wen's article link sent in the early morning: 'Read it. The oral history approach is very solid and gave me inspiration for my thesis interview design. Thanks!' Then I checked the work group of editor Xu Mingyuan, and with no urgent messages, I exited the work interface and switched to browsing mode.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (Home - Study)

name: Free reading time.
description: I picked up this copy of the monthly magazine 'Prose' and sat down on the living room balcony. The sunlight was just right. I flipped to an essay about a café in a small Jiangnan town, read two pages, and absorbed the damp, languid atmosphere in the writing, imagining what new discoveries the afternoon at Mingyuan Bookshop might bring. This half hour was a warm-up for the immersive reading in the afternoon.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming (Home - Living Room Balcony Lounge Chair)

name: Helped my mother prepare the meal and had lunch together.
description: I walked into the kitchen, and my mother was washing lettuce. I helped her peel garlic and cut tomatoes while we chatted. She said the tilapia at the supermarket today was very fresh and she was planning to make sauerkraut fish. I said that sounded good, and I happened to be thinking of going to the bookstore in the afternoon to help digest. At lunch, the three of us sat around the table. My father tasted the soup and praised its delicious flavor. Simple home-style dishes, but they tasted especially good because of the family companionship.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming (home - kitchen, dining room).

name: Midday rest and getting ready to go out
description: After lunch, I cleared the dishes on my own initiative. Then I sat on the living room sofa and browsed Xiaohongshu notes about eating in Kunming on my phone—nothing new. At 1:50, I went back to the study to pack the canvas bag for going out: journal, two pens, phone, keys, tissues, a cup of warm water, and I also made a point of stuffing that issue of the monthly magazine 'Prose' into my bag, planning to read it with Pu'er tea at the bookstore.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming (Home - Living Room, Bedroom)

name: Walk to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: I put on lightweight canvas shoes, slung my canvas bag over my shoulder, and went out. Starting from the residential compound, I headed south along Cuihu West Road and turned onto Yuantong Street. The plane trees by the roadside were beginning to sprout new leaves, and the willows by Green Lake were a lush green. I slowed my pace to enjoy the spring breeze. When I passed the familiar Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore (32 North Cuihu Road), I thought to myself: 'I'm not going to your place today—I'm going a little farther, to Mingyuan Book House.'
location: Along the way from Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, to Mingyuan Bookstore at No. 74 Yuantong Street.

name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore to relax and meet new book friends.
description: At 14:20 I arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore, a small shop hidden on the ground floor of a residential building, quiet and cozy. I ordered a pot of pu’er tea (15 yuan), sat by the window, and flipped through the latest issue of Prose monthly. About half an hour later, a bespectacled young man walked over to the bookshelf beside me, and I recognized him as Yang Fan from the book club group. I plucked up my courage and greeted him softly, and he was pleasantly surprised too. We sat down and chatted. He shared how the book Local Knowledge he had recently read inspired his writing, and I asked him for advice on field research methods for writing about local culture. He recommended several books about Kunming’s urban memory, and I carefully noted them down in my journal. Before leaving (16:50), I paid for the little book An Oral History of Kunming’s Local Culture (38 yuan).
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 74 Yuantong Street, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Walking home and shopping at the supermarket
description: After leaving Mingyuan Bookstore, I walked south along Yuantong Street, passed Huashan West Road, turned into Fuchun Street, and arrived at City Garden Supermarket. I picked out a few apples and a box of kiwifruit, then remembered that the daisies at home had withered, so I chose a fresh bunch of white daisies (12.8 yuan). Passing the snack section, I grabbed a pack of seaweed potato chips (8.5 yuan) for myself, as a little snack for next week's writing.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Trim the flower branches and arrange them in a vase.
description: After arriving home, I cut the daisy stems at an angle, removed the extra leaves, and put them in the blue-green glass vase that my mother usually uses. I placed the vase on the living room coffee table, and the arrival of the new flowers instantly brought a spring atmosphere to the house. That itch from arranging flowers at the yoga studio yesterday was finally satisfied.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (home - living room)

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Mother made pickled cabbage fish and stir-fried choy sum. As I ate, I shared with them what I had seen and heard at Mingyuan Bookstore that afternoon, mentioning that I had met a fellow book lover named Yang Fan, and some of his points were very interesting. Father told me to interact more with thoughtful people like him, while Mother praised the little daisies I bought today, saying they were very pretty. The atmosphere at the table was harmonious, and the feeling of home was warm and reassuring.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (Home – Dining Room)

name: Evening journal planning for next week's tasks
description: I sat at my desk, spread open my journal, and used colored pens to plan next week's creative tasks. Monday: design the reader interview outline for my thesis; Tuesday: set as the field trip day for the 'Kunming Slices' column, planning to go to Zhuanxin Food Market; Wednesday to Friday: write the first chapter of the thesis, with three hours of deep writing each day. On the adjacent blank page, I also stuck the sticky note with Yang Fan's recommended book list that I received today. Turning to the photo of yesterday's flower arrangement corner at the yoga studio, I took out my mini photo printer, printed it, stuck it behind today's date, and wrote 'Seasonal flower arrangement card: got it.'
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (Home - Study)

name: Keeping her parents company and having family chats
description: I closed my journal and went to the living room. My mother was watching a local opera program, and my father was scrolling through his phone beside her. I curled up on the sofa and chatted with them for a while, mentioning my plan to take them to Haihong Wetland next week. My mother was very happy and said that my father really should get out more after retirement.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (home - living room)

name: Personal grooming and skincare
description: I went back to the bedroom and changed into my pajamas. First I washed my face with warm water, applied basic skincare (toner, serum, face cream), and then blow-dried my hair. I felt a lot fresher all over.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (home - bathroom, bedroom)

name: Simple stretching to relax.
description: Before bed, I did a few simple stretching moves on the yoga mat to relax my legs, which had walked a lot today, and my lower back, which was a bit tense from sitting for long periods.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming (home - yoga mat in the bedroom)

name: Bedtime meditation
description: I turned off the light, leaving only a small nightlight by the bed. Sitting cross-legged on the bed, I closed my eyes and began a 15-minute meditation. I tried to clear my mind of stray thoughts about next week's plans and focus on my breath. Those thoughts, rising and falling with each breath, were turned over gently like pages of a book and gradually became quiet.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (home - on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Bedtime reading
description: After meditation, I picked up the newly purchased Oral History of Kunming Local Culture, turned to the chapter Yang Fan recommended, and read the part about memories of old Kunming streets and alleys. The writing was vivid and I was completely absorbed.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (home - on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Turned off the lights and rested.
description: I read until my eyelids grew heavy, then closed the book and turned off the desk lamp. From outside the window came the faint chirping of insects on the spring night. In the soft darkness, I looked back on the day: the satisfaction of finishing the manuscript, the joy of a new book, and the warmth of dining with family—all that beauty sank into my heart. Soon I fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City (home - on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Waking Up and Morning Yoga
description: At 6:20 in the morning, she was woken by birdsong outside the window. She walked to the window to watch the morning light over Green Lake, then washed up. At 6:30, she went to the living room and laid out yoga mats with her mother, Li Xiulan, and practiced the Sun Salutation A sequence. The two were in perfect sync, and her mother's movements were smoother than in previous days. When they finished, they exchanged smiles, and her mother remarked that persistence pays off.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom, living room)

name: Breakfast and tidying up
description: Mother prepared small-pot rice noodles. She added rose sugar to enhance the flavor and paired it with jasmine tea. They chatted while eating about Women's Day greetings and hopes for the submission. Father's door was tightly shut, and he was still resting. After the meal, she cleaned up and rinsed the dishes, tidied the bedroom bed, rolled up the yoga mat, and opened the window for ventilation.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (dining room, kitchen, bedroom)

name: Writing and submitting in the study
description: In the study, I opened my laptop, checked my email, found and replied to the topic confirmation email from Xu Mingyuan, editor of "Cultural Horizon." Then I read over the essay "Watching Behind the Glass" one last time, logged into the submission email for "Southwest Literature," and sent the manuscript, my heart racing with anticipation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning reading and journal organizing.
description: Read Chapters 1 and 2 of "Kunming Local Culture Oral History". While reading, excerpt key viewpoints in a journal, mark them with a mint green highlighter, and especially record the passage on oral history value mentioned by fellow reader Yang Fan. Draw a simple cultural coordinate map of the Green Lake area. Brew jasmine tea and occasionally gaze out the window to relax.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: She received a video call from her elder sister Sun Yutong. Her sister, in Shenzhen, wished her a happy Women's Day and asked about her plans for the day. She shared her morning submission, and her sister encouraged her by saying it would definitely be fine. They chatted for about ten minutes and agreed to video call again in the evening. After hanging up, she felt even better.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Received the acceptance notice and celebrated with a family lunch.
description: At noon she received the acceptance email from Southwest Literature. Excited, she took a screenshot and sent it to the family group 'The Three of Us' and privately messaged her elder sister. Then she ran into the kitchen to share the good news with her mother, who hugged her and said she knew she could do it. At lunch, her father Sun Mingyuan smiled and encouraged her when he heard the news. The family of three ate tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and pork rib soup, and talked about Women's Day plans.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study, kitchen, dining room).

name: Lunch break and journaling
description: Returned to the bedroom for a short rest of about twenty minutes. After waking up, opened the journal, wrote down the acceptance notice content with a mint green highlighter, drew a small flower, and noted 'March 8, 2025, submission accepted!' Then organized the morning reading notes to prepare for designing the interview outline in the afternoon.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Design a field research interview outline
description: In the study, she opened a new document on her laptop, reviewed yesterday's discussion with book friend Yang Fan about open-ended questioning, and used that approach to design the fieldwork interview outline for her graduation thesis. She listed eight main questions and directions for progressively deeper follow-up questions, then saved the document when finished.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Changing clothes and getting ready to go out
description: She changed out of her loungewear into a light blue dress, slung on her canvas bag, checked her wallet, phone, and keys, told her mother, who was reading in the living room, that she was going to the flower shop to buy flowers, and her mother smiled and agreed.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buy flowers at the florist and arrange them at home
description: She walked along Huashan West Road to the Xijian Huatian Flower Shop, greeted the proprietress, chose pink carnations and eucalyptus leaves, and wrapped them simply in light purple wrapping paper. After returning home, she trimmed the branches, placed them in a glass vase, and set it on the living room coffee table. Her mother praised her good taste, and then they chatted in the living room. She shared the design of her interview outline, and her mother, as a Chinese language teacher, suggested asking more 'why' and 'how' questions, which she carefully noted down.
location: The 'Xijian Huatian' flower shop at No. 90 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the living room at home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Going out to dinner with my mother.
description: Changed shoes and went out with my mother, walking along Renmin Middle Road to Shuncheng Shopping Center while chatting about the weather and the subway. We sat down at Yunwei Xiaoguan, a Yunnan fusion restaurant on the third floor of the mall, and ordered mushroom hot pot, crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, and tamarind juice. As we cooked the mushrooms, we talked about childhood anecdotes. Halfway through the meal, I handed my mother a bouquet of carnations with both hands and wished her a happy Women's Day. Moved, she took my hand and said, 'You have always been my pride.' After the meal, I linked arms with my mother and slowly walked home. The evening breeze was slightly cool and the streetlights were on. When we got home, my father had already gone out to meet old friends.
location: At the 'Yunwei Xiaoguan Yunnan Fusion Cuisine' restaurant on the third floor of Shuncheng Shopping Center, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and on the way there and back.

name: Washing up and skincare
description: After arriving home, she removed her makeup and washed her face, cleansing thoroughly with facial cleanser, then patted on toner and lotion. She put on a hydrating sheet mask and lay on the sofa with her eyes closed for about fifteen minutes. After removing the mask, her skin felt hydrated.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Share the good news with the close friends group.
description: While curled up in bed, she posted the news in the WeChat best friends group that her essay had been accepted by 'Southwest Literature'. Zhang Jing, Chen Sisi, and Wang Xinran sent amazed emoji and congratulations one after another. Chen Sisi proposed celebrating at the next gathering, Wang Xinran joked about hoarding signed copies, and she replied with a smile, warmed by the blessings for half an hour.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and saying goodnight
description: She opened her journal and used a highlighter to write down the day's keywords: '2025.3.8 Women's Day, carnations, notice of acceptance.' She drew small flowers and leaves, and recorded her feelings about the morning yoga, the accepted submission, her mother's smile, and best friends' blessings, thinking this was the best Women's Day. After finishing, she went to her mother's room to say goodnight. Her mother, who was reading, looked up and smiled, replying, 'Good night, sleep well.'
location: Bedroom and mother's room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: She sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated mindfully for ten minutes, taking deep breaths, reviewing the good things of the day, and feeling grateful. After meditation, she checked the messages on her phone. In the family group, her father had sent encouragement, and her older sister had also sent a private message praising her. She replied with a heart and 'Okay, sis.' Finally, she turned off her phone and the bedside lamp, and fell asleep in the moonlight, satisfied.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and family breakfast
description: The phone alarm rang, and Sun Yuwei woke up naturally. Still in her pajamas, she walked to the window, drew the curtains, and confirmed that today's weather would be overcast turning cloudy. After a quick stretch, she tied her hair into a high ponytail with a hair tie and changed into light gray yoga clothes. She gently woke her mother, Li Xiulan, and together they laid out yoga mats in the living room. They started with several rounds of Sun Salutations coordinated with breathing as a warm-up. Then came the day's main practice: her mother, with Sun Yuwei's assistance, tried a simplified King Pigeon Pose. Although the posture was not yet standard, she was very earnest. Sun Yuwei filmed the process using a phone holder. After the practice, they watched the video together. Her mother laughed at her own "clumsy" performance, while Sun Yuwei smiled and noted it beside her. With her mother's consent, Sun Yuwei planned to trim the video slightly with a phone editing app in the afternoon to keep as a memento. After yoga, Sun Yuwei felt refreshed. She went to the kitchen first, brewed a cup of warm honey water, and drank it. Then she prepared breakfast with her mother: reheated leftover multigrain porridge from last night, cut two plates of fruit (apples and kiwifruit), and fried three eggs. The three of them sat around the dining table eating quietly, while her father, Sun Mingyuan, read the morning newspaper as he ate.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning time in the study: information processing and reading
description: Returning to her study, she turned on her computer and phone. First, she quickly scanned WeChat and checked several group chat messages, including a message from her close friend Zhang Jing about meeting up next week and replies in the college roommate group discussing the paper. Then she opened her email, found no new messages, and confirmed that the formal acceptance notice from Southwest Literature had not yet arrived. She wasn't anxious, thinking the editor might still be handling it since the weekend had just passed after Women's Day, and decided to check again in the afternoon. Then she opened the desk drawer and took out her beloved journal and several colored gel pens. She added the memory of yesterday's Women's Day gratitude dinner in pink ink and used sticky notes of different colors to mark the week's key tasks: Wednesday - Zhuanxin field trip, Thesis first draft - start as soon as possible. Then she opened Oral History of Kunming Local Culture, which she had bought yesterday at Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore, placed the bookmark at the last two chapters, and began to read attentively, writing marginal notes in pencil next to key paragraphs to build background knowledge for Wednesday's fieldwork.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Column topic discussion and field-trip planning
description: After finishing her reading for the time being, she took out her phone and sent a WeChat message to Mr. Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Horizon. She greeted him politely, then clearly explained the idea for her third column, 'Kunming Slices: Solar Terms in the Food Market': use Zhuanxin Market as the core and weave the essay together by observing how ingredients change after the Beginning of Spring. Xu Mingyuan replied quickly, approving of this angle of entering 'life' through 'food', and again stressed that she could record more brief oral accounts from vendors to add the hustle and bustle and authenticity of everyday life. Sun Yuwei noted every point in her phone's memo app, and they agreed to set out for fieldwork on Wednesday morning. After hanging up, she opened the map app and searched for bus routes near Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. Considering that she lives by Green Lake and the market is near Xinwen Road, she planned a route walking to Xiaoximen and taking bus No. 5, about 30 minutes in total. Then she opened Dianping and saved a few highly rated time-honored snack shops and specialty stalls in the market as potential entry points for interviews. After doing all this, she continued reading Oral History of Kunming Local Culture and finally finished the last two pages of the book.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going out shopping and returning home.
description: After greeting her family, she changed into a white hoodie and jeans for going out and walked to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street near her home. She pushed a shopping cart, picked out a few fresh Crown pears and a bunch of bananas in the produce section, and found a can of chrysanthemum tea that looked good on the tea shelf. Thinking that her father would practice calligraphy in the evening, these would make a good pot of tea to clear heat. She carried the shopping bags home, put the pears, bananas, and chrysanthemum tea away in the kitchen, washed her hands, and got ready for lunch.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch and casual conversation
description: On the table were tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried choy sum, and some leftover braised pork from yesterday. While eating, Sun Yuwei chatted with her parents about the food market topic she had discussed with the editor that morning. Her mother, Li Xiulan, a local, said with great interest, 'Zhuanxin Market? There's a shop there selling sweet fermented rice wine with a really mellow flavor, and another selling flaky buns. You young people can go try them.' Sun Yuwei quickly made a note and said she would definitely go on Wednesday. Her father listened on the side with a smile.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and a nap
description: After helping to clear the dishes, Sun Yuwei returned to her room. She didn't take a nap right away. Instead, she leaned against the headboard and edited the mother-daughter yoga video she had recorded that morning on her phone, using Kuaiying to quickly cut the highlights and add some light music, then saved it to her phone's photo album. After doing this, she felt a little sleepy, set an alarm for 13:00, and closed her eyes for a short rest. To have energy for the library in the afternoon, she took a brief nap.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the Chenggong Campus Library of Yunnan University.
description: The alarm went off. She quickly washed up and changed into a light blue shirt. She put on her backpack filled with books and a laptop and headed out. After walking five minutes to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, she swiped her card and entered. She took Metro Line 2. The carriage was a bit crowded, so she listened to light music through earphones while silently drafting in her mind the questions she might ask in Wednesday's interview. About 30 minutes later, she arrived at University City Station. After exiting, she walked 15 minutes and reached the library of Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus at around 14:30.
location: Library, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning books at the library, doing research, and happily receiving a notice of acceptance
description: Entering the library, she first returned Kunming Local Cultural Oral History at the self-service checkout/return machine. Then, following the call number, she browsed carefully between the Anthropology/Sociology and Architecture/Art shelves. After searching for a while, she found the two books she had been longing for: Urban Corners: Place and Spatial Narratives and The Survival Aesthetics of Independent Bookstores. Their worn covers showed how popular they were. She put both books on a table in the reading area and quickly flipped through the tables of contents and introductions, confirming that the content closely matched the direction of her thesis. She then took the books to the service desk to complete the borrowing process. Just as she finished checking out and walked out of the library entrance, her phone gave a “ding” email notification. She stopped, opened the email on her phone, and found it was the formal notice of acceptance from the editorial office of Southwest Literature! The body was a carefully worded electronic acceptance agreement, and the email ended with a sincere congratulations. Sun Yuwei's heart pounded, and a brilliant smile spread across her face. She walked quickly to a bench outside the library, sat down, read through the terms of the agreement carefully, then excitedly took a screenshot and forwarded it to her advisor Professor Wu Mingyuan and her father, with the message: “Finally got it!”
location: Library, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visited Mingyuan Bookstore along the way
description: In a great mood, she took the metro from University City Station back to the city center. After getting off, she made a detour on foot to her usual Mingyuan Bookstore. Pushing open the glass door, the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan was sitting behind the counter drinking Pu'er tea. She greeted Teacher Qin warmly and shared the good news of receiving the acceptance letter today. Teacher Qin was genuinely happy for her. She walked around the store, noticed that a few new issues of Essays and Duku had arrived, and bought two to read at home.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 74 Yuantong Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and having afternoon tea
description: Walking slowly home along the tree-lined path beside Green Lake, with a gentle breeze on her face, she felt especially lighthearted. Pushing open the door, she found her mother arranging flowers in the living room. She told her mother the good news, and the mother and daughter hugged happily. Sun Yuwei brewed the chrysanthemum tea she had bought at the supermarket, washed two pears, and brought them to the living room. Sitting on the sofa, eating pears and drinking tea, she sent a WeChat message to her elder sister Sun Yutong, sharing the double joy of the good news that her father was going to learn calligraphy at a senior citizens' university and that her work had been tentatively accepted for publication.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening family time: casual conversation and dinner.
description: She took out the copy of Essays magazine she had just bought, leaned back on the sofa, and flipped through two articles. Meanwhile, the phone rang; it was her advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan. On the phone, the professor affirmed her progress in writing, encouraged her to keep working hard, and asked about the progress of her term paper. Sun Yuwei briefly reported her plan and said she would go to the vegetable market on Wednesday to gather material. Her advisor expressed support and reminded her to combine theory with localized observation. When her father came home from work and heard that Sun Yuwei had received the notice of acceptance, the usually quiet man smiled and said, 'My daughter has really made something of herself.' At the dinner table, the whole family was relaxed. Sun Yuwei brought up her father's calligraphy hobby. Her father said he planned to go to the senior university tomorrow to look into the enrollment process. Her mother chimed in, 'Practicing calligraphy is good for cultivating the mind.' Sun Yuwei said, 'Then after dinner I'll go with you to pick a good brush. A classmate told me the brushes at Cuihu Wenfang across from the neighborhood are quite good.'
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanied her father to pick out calligraphy supplies
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei took her father's arm and strolled to “Green Lake Stationery” across from the neighborhood. Inside, the air was filled with the fragrance of ink, and the walls were lined with all kinds of rice paper and calligraphy works. The shopkeeper greeted them warmly. Sun Yuwei accompanied her father to stop at the writing brush counter. He picked up several goat-hair and mixed-hair brushes and gently ran his fingers over the brush tips to feel their elasticity. Sun Yuwei helped him choose, and in the end her father selected a mixed-hair brush with an ebony handle designed for regular script, saying it felt good in hand. She also helped him pick out two stacks of mi-character-grid calligraphy paper and a box of “Yidege” ink, and her father paid with satisfaction.
location: Cuihu Wenfang, South Cuihu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and organizing
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei went to her study. First, on today's journal page, she wrote in gold ink, 'Received the acceptance letter — a little highlight of my life,' and pasted a bookmark she had bought from Mingyuan Bookstore as decoration. Next, she recorded the key points from her communication with the editor, the suggestions her supervisor gave over the phone, and the fact that her father planned to sign up for a calligraphy class. Then she opened her laptop, created a new document, and began organizing a question outline for the Wednesday column's field trip, and browsed a few articles about Yunnan local cuisine for reference.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Free time and online socializing.
description: After a stretch of work came to an end, she felt somewhat relaxed. Seeing the message from her best friend Zhang Jing saying that next week she wanted to invite her to check out the new 'Tangbai' café by Cuihu Lake, she happily agreed. Afterwards, she chatted briefly with her fellow reader Song Wen in the writers' group. Song Wen praised her for being quick and asked how to communicate efficiently with editors. Sun Yuwei patiently shared some of her own experience.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Relaxation and meditation before bed.
description: After turning off the computer, she felt a slight ache in her eyes. She went to the bathroom, washed her face with warm water, and applied moisturizing toner and lotion. Then she brought a basin of hot water from the kitchen and placed it in front of the sofa in the living room. While soaking her feet, she scrolled through short videos about stationery and journals on Bilibili for a while, letting her mind completely unwind. After soaking her feet, she changed into pajamas and sat cross-legged on the bed. She turned off the light, opened the white noise app on her phone, and played the sound of gentle rain. Closing her eyes, she began a 15-minute mindfulness meditation. During the meditation, she tenderly reviewed all the small joys of the day: the laughter while recording a video with her mother, the excitement of receiving the acceptance notice, the warmth of accompanying her father to pick out a calligraphy brush... Her heart was filled with peace and contentment, and a smile spread across her lips. After the meditation, she lay down gently, stretched out her body, pulled up the quilt, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and family breakfast
description: At 6:30 in the morning I was woken by the alarm clock. Remembering that today was Tuesday and I had yoga class, I perked up, got up to wash, and took a deep breath in front of the mirror; the excitement from the intent-to-hire letter I received yesterday was still with me. Then I unrolled the yoga mat with my mother in the living room for the seventh day of morning yoga. My mother was already able to follow the rhythm naturally, and in triangle pose she stretched hard and smiled. After practice, she suggested we practice at least three times a week. We pinky-swore, and the family yoga tradition was officially established. At 7:10 we moved to the dining room. My mother brought out chicken soup rice noodles. While eating, my father mentioned that he was going to register at the senior university in the afternoon and would use the regular-script mixed-hair brush we picked out last night. My mother reminded him to apply for the canteen meal card after registering. At 7:45 my father changed into his jacket, checked his brushes, ink, paper, and inkstone, and we saw him off at the entrance. Watching his hale and hearty back as he walked away, I felt the quiet warmth of everyday life.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning content creation and social media engagement
description: At 8 o'clock, she returned to the study and processed the photos taken last week at Zhuanxin Vegetable Market. She selected twelve warm-toned photos for subtle adjustments and paired them with a short essay of about 300 characters, “A Color Atlas of the Vegetable Market: Kunming's Lively Hustle”. At exactly 10 o'clock, she published a Xiaohongshu note under the account “Yuwei Slow Record”. Then, opening the backend messages, she was pleasantly surprised to find a private message from Zhang Qiming, an editor at Shanghai Bluebird Publishing House, who praised the narrative perspective and asked whether she had any intention of expanding it into a book. Heart racing, she politely replied with thanks and gave him her WeChat ID. After finishing the creative work, she walked to the balcony, drank water and relaxed while watching the morning-exercise crowd in Green Lake Park. She sent a voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing, saying “Seems like something big happened,” and then quickly replied to several comments in the comment section.
location: Study and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Refine the column framework and look up exam information.
description: Returning to the study, I opened the framework document for 'Solar Terms in the Market' and, based on editor Xu Mingyuan's suggestions, thought about how to dynamically combine the solar terms with the changing stalls. While writing, I noticed my problem with retroflex and alveolar consonants, so I browsed online for information about the 'Putonghua Proficiency Test Guide' and also searched for 'Aigo voice recorder', adding the product to my shopping cart and deciding to discuss the purchase with my mother later.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Discuss Mandarin exam registration and lunch break.
description: Before lunch, in the living room, I told my mother about the pronunciation difficulties I was encountering in my writing. She suggested signing up directly for the May Mandarin proficiency test to correct them systematically. After checking the registration time and process on my phone, I made up my mind to take it. At 12:30, my mother brought out tomato and egg noodles and cucumber salad. After eating alone, I was still preoccupied with news from the publisher, so I forced myself to go back to the bedroom for a forty-minute nap, put on an eye mask, and listened to soothing music to let my mind go blank.
location: Living room and bedroom, home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon online tasks: purchase textbooks online and communicate with the editor.
description: After the lunch break, I felt refreshed and decisively placed an order in the study for the Putonghua Proficiency Test Guide and an aigo voice recorder, and set a phone reminder to read aloud for 20 minutes every morning at 6:45. At 14:00, the phone alert rang. Zhang Qiming, an editor at Qingniao Press, approved the WeChat friend request and once again expressed his intention to collaborate and asked whether she had similar series works. After she introduced the framework of the upcoming 'Solar Terms at the Food Market', he said he was very interested, and they agreed to have a deeper discussion after Wednesday's field trip.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Balcony reading, afternoon tea, and heading out to the yoga studio.
description: Sitting in a rattan chair on the balcony brewing chrysanthemum tea, she leafed through Urban Corners: Place and Spatial Narratives, borrowed from the library yesterday, noting down field observations such as “stall display logic” and “vendors’ regional expressions” in her journal. At 15:00, she changed into light purple yoga clothes, walked to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Line 3 (toward Xishan Park) for about 15 minutes, got off at Wuyi Road Station, and walked from Exit C to Dechun Commercial Building.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Vinyasa yoga class and post-class health discussion
description: Started the vinyasa yoga class on time, with a strong rhythm. She felt more stable than before in Downward-Facing Dog and Warrior II. After class, the instructor He Lu proactively talked with her and suggested combining Eagle Pose and Half Moon Pose to enhance core balance. Then, sitting on the sofa in the rest area, He Lu shared her breakfast secret: oats + chia seeds + blueberries with unsweetened yogurt, and explained methods for supplementing high-quality protein. Sun Yuwei carefully recorded all of this in her journal.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping on the way back
description: She walked from the yoga studio to the subway station and took the subway back. After getting off at Huashan West Road Station, she stopped by Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on the way, bought a bunch of pink daisies and a bottle of mango yogurt to bring some life to the home, and then walked home.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and on the way home

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: After arriving home, she put the little daisies into a vase, went to the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic and wash vegetables, and excitedly shared the private message from the publishing house. Her mother smiled and encouraged her to seize the opportunity but not to rush. Her father returned and said that the senior university registration was done and classes would officially start next week. Dinner was the cold chicken and stir-fried vegetables her mother had made. During the meal, she shared funny yoga stories, while her father enthusiastically talked about the calligraphy class teachers. After dinner, she voluntarily cleaned up the dishes.
location: The kitchen, living room, and dining room of the home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Learned of her sister's promotion while walking around Green Lake
description: She changed into canvas shoes and went out for a walk along Cuihu Park. When she reached the pavilion in the middle of the lake, she received a WeChat message from her elder sister Sun Yutong: "Just received the promotion email! Senior Product Manager!" She almost jumped for joy and immediately sent congratulations in the family group chat followed by a string of fireworks and celebration emoji.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening online communication: feedback on column framework and video call celebration with sister
description: After the walk, she calmed down at home and, in her study, sent the framework document for Solar Terms in the Market to editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat. He replied quickly, offering three professional suggestions including 'match each solar term with specific stall changes to enhance the sense of dynamism,' and encouraged her to take more photos during Wednesday's field trip. At 20:10 she moved to the bedroom bay window and video-called her older sister, who had just gotten off work and excitedly shared details of her promotion interview. She told her sister about the publishing house invitation, and the two laughed happily across the screens.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling, field trip preparation, and washing up.
description: Flipped open the journal and wrote in cherry-pink pen: Morning yoga (day 7), Xiaohongshu gained attention from a publisher, registered for the Putonghua proficiency test, older sister promoted to senior product manager. Beside it, drew small daisies and a sun, with the note, "Today is a day full of possibilities." Then in the study, finalized the Wednesday field-trip outline, clarified the key stalls and questions, checked the camera and notebook, and confirmed the weather forecast was clear. At 21:40, began removing makeup, cleansing, and applying a hydrating mask. Mother knocked on the door and brought warm milk, asking if I was too tired. I replied, "I'm tired from being happy," and continued with my skincare routine.
location: Study and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading, meditation, and falling asleep before bed
description: Leaning against the headboard, she continued reading Corners of the City. When she came across the discussion on the narrativity of space, she folded the page to mark it because it matched the concept of her column. At 22:40, she laid out the yoga mat on the bed and meditated for 15 minutes, focusing on her breath and exhaling all new messages, excitement, and tension. After turning off the light and lying down, images of her sister's smiling face, the publisher's direct message, and the smooth yoga postures flashed through her mind. She set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and gradually fell asleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm went off right on time at 6:25. She had slept well the night before and woke up full of energy. Today was a yoga day; she and her mother had agreed to practice together on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings. After a quick wash, she changed into a sports tank top and yoga pants and tied her hair into a neat bun. Outside the window, the sky was already bright and cloudy—she had a feeling it would be a good day to go out and gather source material.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning yoga practice
description: Mother Li Xiulan had already laid out the yoga mat in the living room. The two of them followed their agreement and did a 30-minute vinyasa flow session, starting with Sun Salutations, then linking Warrior I, Warrior II, and Triangle Pose, and ending with Shoulderstand and Fish Pose. During Savasana, hearing her mother's steady breathing made her feel especially grounded. Afterward, they pinky-swore to keep the unshakable yoga date every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 6:45 to 7:15.
location: Living room of home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Journal recording and today's planning
description: After yoga, she went to the study and took out her refillable journal. On the weekly routine page, she neatly wrote the morning yoga commitment with a cherry-blossom-pink highlighter and drew a small sun to symbolize the commitment was in effect. Then she flipped to today's page and roughly planned her to-dos: write the thesis in the morning, go to Zhuanxin Market to gather material, and wait for the Mandarin textbook delivery.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and household chores
description: Mother had prepared simple fried egg toast and hot milk. During breakfast, she shared the post she had seen on Douban the night before about old buildings in Kunming. Mother smiled and said I was becoming more and more like a "field investigator." After the meal, she cleared the dishes on her own and added cat food for the two cats basking on the windowsill.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mandarin morning reading warm-up.
description: The first day of formal preparation for the Putonghua proficiency test. Standing on the balcony, you opened the Putonghua Learning app and followed the audio to read aloud single-syllable words for 10 minutes and short passages for another 10 minutes. You found quite a few problems with your vowels and tones, and noted error-prone words such as lún, liǔ, and niǎn in your phone memo.
location: Balcony at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the first chapter of the graduation thesis.
description: In the study, I opened my laptop and continued writing Section 1 of Chapter 1 of my thesis, “The Spatial Formation and Community Embeddedness of Independent Bookstores in Kunming.” The first two hours were highly productive; starting from the theory of spatial production and combining observation notes from the Zhibushi Bookstore, I completed the “Spatial Flow and Host-Guest Interaction” paragraph, about 1,000 characters. After getting stuck, I decided to follow the original plan and visit Zhuanxin Farm Market for inspiration, hoping to find ideas for “the everyday vitality of community life” in the thesis.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Visited Zhuanxin Farmers' Market to observe and gather material.
description: I put on my camera backpack, changed into canvas shoes, and walked about 30 minutes to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. The market was loud and bustling, like a whirlpool of colors and sounds. I captured a wealth of material: piles of fresh spring bamboo shoots, bright tender pea shoots, and a vendor deftly shelling walnuts. I struck up a conversation with a granny selling chive blossoms, and she said in her thick Kunming dialect, "This year's chive blossoms are the tenderest—they smell wonderful when stir-fried with eggs." These vivid scenes added rich street-life atmosphere to my thesis material bank.
