location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and organizing field-trip photos
description: I walked home from the market. My mother had left a meal: green pepper stir-fried pork and cucumber salad. As I ate, I roughly browsed through the color-rich photos in the camera on my phone, and seeing the vegetables and the vendors' smiles made me feel great. After the meal, I imported the photos into my computer and created a folder named 'Zhuanxin Field Trip 0311.'
location: Living room and study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon thesis writing and content deepening
description: After the lunch break, she returned to the study. The material gathered from the morning field trip made the paper writing go smoothly. She wrote the elderly woman's words into the article as a typical case of 'community embeddedness,' giving the academic analysis a human touch. By 5 p.m., the first draft of Chapter 1 had accumulated about 2,500 characters, more than expected. She read it through and used the annotation function to mark three places where theoretical citations needed to be added.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: A relaxing stroll around the neighborhood
description: After working at my desk for a long time, my shoulders felt stiff, so I went downstairs and walked a few laps around the neighborhood to stretch. Several camellia bushes in the neighborhood were blooming beautifully. I couldn't help taking a photo, thinking, "Life needs a bit of red," and planned to post it on Moments in the evening.
location: Inside the Cuihu Community residential area, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Signed for the Mandarin textbook and made a morning reading plan.
description: Just after getting home, the doorbell rang. She signed for the Putonghua Proficiency Test Guide and a voice recorder purchased on JD.com the day before. Excitedly, she opened the package and sat at her desk. Referring to the test syllabus, she spent half an hour on sticky notes making a morning reading plan for the next day: from 7:00 to 7:20 a.m., read aloud single-syllable words and short passages. She stuck the note on the inside cover of the textbook and wrote 'May test, aim for Grade 2A' with a highlighter on the monthly plan page of her journal.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Dinner was the sour pickled fish her mother made, sour and spicy and appetizing. At the table, she eagerly shared what she had seen at Zhuanxin Market that afternoon, especially the elderly woman selling chive flowers. Father Sun Mingyuan smiled after hearing this and said that her grandmother used to love going there too, and that it felt like nothing had changed. The family chatted about the changes in Kunming's old town, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Finalize the weekend flower market pop-up event with friends.
description: After dinner, back in the study, she contacted her flower-arranging friend Su Man via WeChat to finalize the Dounan Flower Market flash event this Saturday (March 15). She suggested creating pieces with peach blossom branches discarded by flower merchants. Su Man agreed and said she would bring a tripod to film the process and post it on social media. The two agreed to meet at Dounan Metro Station at 8:30 on Saturday morning.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online communication)

name: First experience with a Mandarin textbook and pronunciation training
description: After chatting with Su Man, I picked up the newly arrived Mandarin textbook again, which is clearly organized. I recorded a short reading with a voice recorder, and when I played it back, I listened carefully and identified and marked the tone issues that need focused correction, such as the difference between 'rain' and 'language'.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Free journaling and reflections from the creative field trip
description: She took out her beloved loose-leaf journal to record what she had seen and heard on today's outing. Using a printout of the purple pea blossom photo she had taken at the market as decoration, she wrote beside it, 'The vitality of the street market is the best footnote for a thesis.' As she settled the day's thoughts onto the page, she felt a sense of healing.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening Wash-Up and Skincare
description: Went to the bathroom to carefully remove makeup, cleansed my face with facial cleanser, then applied toner, lotion, and eye cream in order, completing the evening skincare routine methodically as usual.
location: Home bathroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime meditation and relaxation
description: She dimmed the lights in the bedroom, sat cross-legged on the bed, and opened the "Tide" app on her phone to choose the 15-minute "body scan" meditation guide. Closing her eyes, she followed the guidance to relax each muscle group from head to toe, letting the day's thoughts settle as her brain gradually grew calm.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime preparations and warm family greetings
description: After meditation, I felt extremely calm in both body and mind. I picked up my phone and saw that my elder sister Yutong had shared a photo of working late in Shenzhen in the family group. I replied, “Sister, take care of yourself and keep going!” Then I plugged the phone in to charge, set the alarm for 6:25 tomorrow, and got into bed, recalling the fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Feeling fulfilled and organized, I turned off the bedside light and soon drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Getting up and waking the body
description: After the alarm went off, Sun Yuwei did not get up immediately. Instead, she stretched in bed and did shoulder and neck exercises, feeling the stiffness in her body gradually ease. She weighed herself, recorded 44.99kg, and took a photo of the scale with her phone to save. Then she opened the curtains, and the morning sunlight streamed into the bedroom. From outside the window came the birdsong and morning exercise sounds of Green Lake Park. She drank a glass of warm water and started the new day.
location: Home bedroom, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and Mandarin morning reading
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan laid out yoga mats on the living room balcony for their regular Thursday 'yoga consolidation.' They focused on Cat-Cow pose and Child's pose. Because her mother's shoulders were sore from grading exam papers the day before, Sun Yuwei gently pressed her mother's back during Child's pose. Her mother felt her back relax, and the two agreed to complete three practice sessions this week. Afterward, Sun Yuwei started her morning Mandarin reading practice on the balcony. She took out her new textbook and a voice recorder and followed along practicing 10 error-prone monosyllabic words, paying special attention to the distinction between retroflex and dental initials. When she played back the recording, she found that the characters shì and shí were still not pronounced correctly, so she marked them in the textbook. Then she read the short essay 'Friends and Others' aloud, timing herself at 4 minutes and 15 seconds. Feeling that the pace was too fast, she decided to slow down and focus on rhythm in the future.
location: Living room balcony of home, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and tidying up
description: Her mother had prepared plain congee, fried eggs, and dressed lettuce strips for breakfast. As she ate, Sun Yuwei discussed the day's plans with her mother: in the afternoon she would go to Chenggong Campus to see her advisor and discuss her thesis, and in the evening she would have a call with the publishing house editor. Her mother encouraged her to prepare carefully and reminded her to bring a power bank. After the meal, Sun Yuwei helped clear the dishes, rinsed them briefly, and put the books on the desk back in place.
location: Home dining room, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare materials for the afternoon thesis discussion
description: Sun Yuwei turned on her computer, organized the photos taken yesterday at Zhuanxin Market, and selected 5 photos that best showed the details and sense of space according to the order of the stalls. She opened the first-chapter framework document of her paper, marked the points in the 'Spatial Production Theory' section where fieldwork material could be combined, and wrote down three questions to ask her advisor: how to make the fieldwork material connect naturally with the theory, whether she needed to supplement the bookstore customer observation data, and whether the first-person perspective in the draft was appropriate.
location: Home study room, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and planning the weekend schedule
description: After finishing her thesis preparation, Sun Yuwei started working on her journal. She recorded yesterday's field trip impressions with text and drawings, outlining the mint leaves she had seen at Zhuanxin Market with a green watercolor pen. Then she planned the route for a quick trip to Dounan Flower Market with Su Man on Saturday: she planned to leave home at 9:00, take Metro Line 2 to Dounan Station, browse the main venue and the surrounding flower stalls, and return at 12:00. She pasted screenshots of recommended stalls exported from her phone into the journal and highlighted the flower-cake shops she wanted to visit with a fluorescent marker.
location: Home study room, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading and collecting materials for the thesis.
description: To enrich the theoretical background of her thesis, Sun Yuwei logged into the Journal of Yunnan University database and downloaded 3 papers on 'urban public space and community identity'. She spent nearly two hours first reading the abstracts and conclusions, marking the parts relevant to her research direction, then highlighting key concepts with a highlighter. Midway through her reading, she got up to stretch, changed the water for the small daisies on the windowsill, and felt better at the sight of the vigorous plants.
location: Home study room, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Online communication with Su Man and lunch break
description: Sun Yuwei asked Su Man via WeChat whether she could bring one more canvas tote bag to carry flower materials for Saturday's flower market activity. Su Man readily agreed and sent photos of a new flower arrangement she had made (created with peach blossoms and rape flowers). Sun Yuwei suggested trying the new products at the flower pastry shop at the flower market entrance, and Su Man happily agreed, also mentioning that she had recently been learning pressed flower art. Sun Yuwei said she was interested in seeing the finished works. After chatting, since her mother was not at home, Sun Yuwei cooked herself a tomato-and-egg noodle soup with lettuce for lunch and watched an episode of the documentary 'Jishi' about an ancient city market in Yunnan while eating, gathering material for her wet market topic. After the meal, she lay on the sofa for 15 minutes with her eyes closed to relax.
location: Home study and dining room at Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei began packing her backpack for school, checking the items: laptop, power bank, notebook, printed thesis materials, campus card, water bottle, and folding umbrella. She changed into an off-white knit cardigan and put on a sun hat. Checking the map on her phone, she confirmed that the metro from home to University Town Station would take about 95 minutes, longer than she had expected, so she decided to leave earlier.
location: Home, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Subway Commute and Reading
description: Sun Yuwei walked from home to Huashan West Road Station, took Kunming Metro Line 3 to Dongfeng Square Station, then transferred to Line 1 toward University City. There were not many people in the carriage, so she found a seat near the door and sat down, using her commute time to read on her phone a book review about Bauman's "Liquid Modernity" recommended by her supervisor. Whenever she came across an inspiring point, she took a screenshot or copied it to her memo to build material for her thesis.
location: Kunming Metro Line 3 (Huashan West Road Station to Dongfeng Square Station) and Line 1 (Dongfeng Square Station to University City Station)

name: Study at the Chenggong Campus Library and walk to the School of Literature
description: After arriving at Chenggong Campus, Sun Yuwei went to the second floor of the library, found a quiet seat by the window, connected to the campus network, copied the key points from the book review she had read on the subway into her thesis notes document, and pulled up yesterday's field-trip photos. She tried writing a 200-word scene description as part of her thesis observation case. Then she packed her backpack and walked along the Cherry Blossom Avenue to the School of Literature. On the way, she saw cherry blossoms in full bloom, took photos, and sent them to the family group chat; her mother liked them. She arrived early at the building where Professor Wu's office was, bought a cup of warm water at the drink bar, and organized her thoughts while reviewing the questions she wanted to ask.
location: Library of Yunnan University Chenggong Campus and campus cherry blossom avenue, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discuss the framework of the first chapter of the thesis with advisor Wu Mingyuan
description: Sun Yuwei walked into Professor Wu's office and submitted the outline of the first chapter of her thesis and a fragment of the first draft. Professor Wu read it carefully, circled key points with a red pen, and suggested using "bookstore cultural ecology" as the core analytical perspective instead of the original "spatial narrative." He also pointed out that the fieldwork descriptions were vivid but the theoretical connection was insufficient, and suggested citing Lefebvre's concept of "spatial practice." He also recommended focusing on Chapters 3 and 4 of Liquid Modernity, and agreed to discuss the revised version next Wednesday. The discussion lasted about 50 minutes, and Sun Yuwei felt she had gained a lot.
location: Professor Wu's Office, 3rd Floor, School of Liberal Arts Building, Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus walk and note organization
description: After leaving the office, Sun Yuwei took a walk around the campus and sat down on a wooden bench in the open corridor outside the College of Liberal Arts building. She used her phone’s memo app to quickly organize the discussion points: adjust the theoretical framework, supplement readings of Bauman, and include data on bookstore visitors from the urban floating population. She found the draft’s “community embeddedness” section weak and decided to design a bookstore customer questionnaire over the weekend.
location: Outdoor corridor outside the School of Literature building, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Return commute and walk by Green Lake
description: Sun Yuwei walked to University Town Station and took Metro Line 1 on the way back. It was evening rush hour and the carriage was crowded, so she stood and continued reading the downloaded paper excerpts she had saved earlier. When she transferred to Line 3 at Dongfeng Plaza Station, she saw a gorgeous sunset glow outside the window and snapped it with her phone. After arriving at Huashan West Road Station, she made a spontaneous decision to enter the Green Lake Park she was passing for a walk. In the early evening, Green Lake was lively, with willows showing tender green buds, elderly people playing chess and taking walks, and a few resident black-headed gulls by the lake. She recorded a video with her phone. After leaving the park, she bought two large apples at a fruit stall near the entrance of the residential community.
location: Kunming Metro Line 1 (from University Town Station to Dongfeng Square Station), Line 3 (from Dongfeng Square Station to Huashan West Road Station), Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family time.
description: When she got home, her mother had already made celery stir-fried beef, stir-fried choy sum, and tomato and egg soup. Father Sun Mingyuan had gotten off work earlier, so the family of three rarely had a complete dinner together. Sun Yuwei enthusiastically shared the results of her discussion with her advisor, and her parents were happy for her. Her mother told her not to be nervous about her call with the editor that evening, and her father reminded her to carefully note down the suggestions. After dinner, she took the initiative to help clear the table.
location: Home dining room, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for a call with the publishing house editor.
description: After washing the apples, Sun Yuwei returned to her study to prepare for the call with her editor. She listed an outline in her notebook: the core concept for the wet market topic, "Chinese Street Life Scenes"; a list of 10 candidate cities; a sample chapter direction using Zhuanxin Market as the entry point; and questions about the publishing process, image-to-text ratio, and timeline. She picked out the three wet market photos with the most lively street-life feel as backups. Then she poured a glass of warm water, set her phone to Do Not Disturb, opened a new document to take notes, marked key questions with sticky notes, took a deep breath to calm herself, and waited for the call.
location: Home study room, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Voice call with Zhang Qiming, editor at Bluebird Publishing House
description: Sun Yuwei made the WeChat voice call on time. Editor Zhang Qiming introduced Bluebird Press's successful experience with lifestyle and aesthetics books (such as Four Seasons in the Vegetable Garden and The Map of Chinese Handicrafts), and explained in detail the publishing positioning of “China's Street-Life Panorama.” He suggested using 10 city food markets as the main thread, with each chapter about 8,000 words and 20 photos, and asked her to submit an outline and sample chapters the following week (including a table of contents, two sample chapters, and sample photos). Sun Yuwei took careful notes and asked questions about the sample chapter format and illustration copyright. The call had a pleasant atmosphere, and Editor Zhang praised her Xiaohongshu posts, saying her writing “has the flavor of everyday life.” The whole call lasted about 42 minutes.
location: Home study, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online call)

name: Record the key points of the call and make a follow-up plan
description: After the call, Sun Yuwei immediately organized the key points in her notebook: the main publication line would be "Everyday Chinese Street Scenes"; submit the Kunming sample chapter next week; next step: design a list of 10 cities and gather market-research materials for each city's food market. She decided to spend one hour each evening starting the next day collecting online information, and drew a roadmap for the new project in her journal: prepare the sample chapter, submit it for review, revise, sign the publishing contract, then begin formal writing. She also set a reminder on her phone calendar to complete the first draft of the sample chapter by March 19.
location: Home study room, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: Though a little tired, she was in a good mood. Sun Yuwei washed her face with a gentle cleanser, then applied a hydrating sheet mask. While the mask was on, she leaned against the headboard and listened to Ryuichi Sakamoto's "Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence" to help relax.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Room 301, Building 1, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: After dimming the lights, Sun Yuwei sat cross-legged on the carpet for a 15-minute meditation. Taking deep breaths, she reviewed the day's experiences like playing a movie: morning yoga, morning reading on the balcony, her advisor's suggestions, the editor's affirmation, and so on. Then she let the images dissolve and focused on her breathing. After the meditation, she felt fewer distracting thoughts. She changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and read 'Oral History of Kunming Local Culture.' She happened to come across the record of the renovation of Zhuanxin Market in the 1990s, which was helpful for the historical narrative of her thesis, and decided to excerpt it the next day. Before turning off the light, she set her alarm for 6:40 and checked off today's tasks one by one in her journal, feeling grounded.
location: Home bedroom, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: After turning off the lights and lying down, Sun Yuwei was still excited about the new project, but after meditation her mind had calmed down, and she gradually felt drowsy. Thinking about tomorrow's task of gathering information on produce markets in other cities and Saturday's flower market plan with Su Man, she slowly fell asleep in a warm, reassuring feeling.
location: Home bedroom, Room 301, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning activities: yoga, morning reading, breakfast, and preparation
description: Early in the morning, I did morning yoga with my mother in the living room, completing the Sun Salutation A sequence and the Cat-Cow pose to relax the neck, and received my mother's encouragement. Then, on the balcony facing Cuihu Lake, I did Mandarin morning reading, following along with the error-prone words in the Putonghua Proficiency Test Special Textbook, focusing on correcting retroflex and flat tongue sounds and front and back nasal sounds, and recorded the difficult pronunciations in my journal. For breakfast, I had the fried egg toast and hot milk my mother made, and cleaned up the dishes after the meal. Afterwards, in the study, I reviewed the notes from yesterday's discussion with my advisor, listed three core arguments to fill in for today's paper, checked that there was no reply from my advisor in my email, and packed my backpack with my computer, notebooks, and books, ready for a day of study.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wrote and sent the first draft of the first chapter of the thesis
description: Focusing on writing the remaining part of Chapter One of the thesis in the study, using "spatial intertextuality between bookstores and food markets" as the entry point, she transformed observations from the field visit to Zhuanxin Food Market into theoretical analysis and consulted her notes on Bauman's Liquid Modernity to strengthen the argument. She finally completed a draft of about 3,100 words, saved the document as a PDF, and sent it with an explanatory email to her supervisor, Professor Wu's mailbox. Then she tidied up the reference books and desktop, turned off the computer, and relaxed her fingers and neck.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Had lunch with my parents at a restaurant, with home-style dishes such as shredded beef with green peppers and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. After the meal, I rested with my eyes closed on the living room sofa for about 15 minutes, and briefly browsed Moments to relax, seeing photos of a Hangzhou cultural and creative park shared by my cousin Shen Wei.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sorting fieldwork notes and collecting wet-market materials
description: Archived the scattered field-note manuscripts from recent days (including the recording draft from Zhuanxin Vegetable Market and the interview record with the owner of Zhibushi Bookstore, etc.) by theme. Used a desktop scanner to scan each page into a PDF, uploaded it to the cloud drive, and created an index file. Then she collected images and text about representative vegetable markets in Shanghai, Chengdu, Chongqing, and Xi'an online, browsed the Douban group 'Vegetable Market Enthusiasts' to bookmark highly upvoted posts, and excerpted key information into the 'Street Life Scenes Sample Chapter Material' document.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Prepare for Saturday's Dounan Flower Market event
description: Replied to friend Su Man's WeChat, confirming to meet at the Dounan Flower Market metro station exit at 10 a.m. on Saturday. Browsed Xiaohongshu guides for checking in at the Dounan Flower Market pop-up events, marked three flower shops she wanted to visit, and recorded to-do items and a flower-buying budget in her journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Yoga class
description: After changing into her yoga clothes, she walked about 15 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, stopping at a convenience store to buy a bottle of water. She attended the 'Core and Balance' flow yoga class led by He Lu, tried Half Moon pose, and successfully held it, which gave her a sense of accomplishment. After the class, she changed back into her everyday clothes in the locker room, hydrated, and exchanged advice with He Lu on follow-up practice. Then she received a WeChat message from her older cousin Shen Wei saying she had arrived at the mall, and prepared to meet up.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, and the travel route to and from there.

name: Meet cousin Shen Wei, buy flowers, and go home.
description: Walk about 10 minutes from the yoga studio to Shuncheng Shopping Center, where I met my cousin Shen Wei at the Starbucks Reserve coffee corner. She shared her insights from a trip to Hangzhou and her career plan to shift from advertising design to curation. We encouraged each other and agreed to collaborate on cultural creative projects in the future. Then I walked along Renmin Middle Road to Huajianyu Flower Shop, picked a bouquet of white-and-green daisies, exchanged a few pleasantries with the auntie who owns the shop, and then strolled along the east bank of Green Lake, enjoying the evening breeze. Finally, I went home and put the flowers into the vase by my desk.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: Starbucks Reserve coffee corner on the first floor of Shuncheng Shopping Center at No. 11 Dongfeng West Road, Huajianyu Flower Shop on Renmin Middle Road, and the route along the way back to Cuihu Community

name: Dinner
description: Had dinner with my parents and shared the main experiences of the day, including sending the first draft of the thesis, meeting with my cousin, and buying the little daisies. My mother expressed anticipation about my cousin's new plans, while my father reminded me to keep polishing the thesis and to balance work with rest.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening activity in the study
description: After checking the wedding invitation in the high school classmates group and replying briefly, she scrolled through Zhao Qi's Moments privately and noted in her journal whether she'd attend. Then she recorded in detail that day's timeline, the word count of her thesis, and her yoga achievements. Next she reviewed her notes on Bauman's *Liquid Modernity* and marked the core arguments of Chapter 3. Finally she opened her computer and made a preliminary outline for the publisher's sample chapter, "Everyday Chinese Street Scenes," listing the planned wet market case studies and attaching the material links she'd collected during the day.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Washing up and skincare
description: Washed my face with an amino acid facial cleanser, applied hydrating toner and eye cream, and massaged my face while brushing my teeth, paying attention to my skin's condition.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime activities: meditation, reading, and preparing for sleep.
description: Used the Tide app for a 15-minute guided mindfulness meditation, letting her thoughts withdraw from the day's busyness and gradually relaxing her body and mind. Then she leaned against the headboard and read the chapter about the old bookstore at Green Lake from 'Oral History of Kunming Local Culture', and copied down a sentence describing the secondhand book market to keep as material. She checked tomorrow's weather, which was light rain turning cloudy, noted 'bring umbrella' in her memos, and set the alarm for 7:00 the next day. Finally, she turned off the light and drew the curtains, falling asleep peacefully with thoughts of the upcoming trip to Dounan Flower Market.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine: yoga, morning reading, breakfast, and getting ready to go out.
description: After getting up at 6:40 a.m., Sun Yuwei did a 30-minute morning yoga session alone in the living room, focusing on Cat-Cow and Downward-Facing Dog poses. Then she went to the balcony for morning Putonghua reading practice, using a voice recorder to correct her retroflex pronunciation. At 7:30, she had breakfast with her mother Li Xiulan, eating freshly baked flower cakes and hot milk, and talked about her mother's plan to go to the supermarket in the afternoon. After breakfast, she organized her flower arrangement toolkit in the study, putting hemp rope, scissors, and other items into a canvas tote bag, confirmed her meeting with Su Man at Dounan Flower Market via WeChat, and finally changed shoes and put on a hat, ready to go out.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute: walk to the metro station and take the metro to Dounan Flower Market.
description: Starting from Cuihu Community, she walked along Cuihu South Road to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, then took Line 2 of the Kunming Metro to Huancheng South Road Station, and transferred to Line 1 to go to Dounan Station. The whole trip took about 60 minutes. On the way, Sun Yuwei took out her reading notes for "Liquid Modernity" to review, occasionally looking up at the station announcement screen.
location: Kunming Metro Line 2 and Line 1 (Huashan West Road Station - Huancheng South Road Station - Dounan Station)

name: Met up with Su Man at Dounan Flower Market for a pop-up floral art creation and shopping.
description: At the entrance of the fresh-cut flower trading area of Dounan Flower Market, she met up with Su Man. The two entered the crowded sea of flowers, picked up peach blossom branches, eucalyptus leaves, and carnations that had been discarded by flower merchants but were still in good condition, and created an open floral installation titled “Kunming March” on the spot in front of the white wall of the aisle, attracting passersby to stop and take photos. Su Man shot a short video and posted it on Moments. After the creation, they continued to browse the dried flower area. Sun Yuwei bought dried eucalyptus, pink muhly grass, and pinecones, while Su Man chose succulents. As they walked, they discussed the theme for their next creation.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took the subway back home and picked up the package.
description: After parting with Su Man at the entrance to the flower market, Sun Yuwei took Metro Line 1 and transferred to Line 2 on her way back. The carriage was crowded, so she stood and browsed photos of the floral installations on her phone. After arriving at Huashan West Road Station, she walked to the Hive Box locker in Cuihu Community, entered the pickup code, and took out the new MacBook Air package, full of anticipation.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After returning home, she shared small-pot rice noodles with her mother Li Xiulan for lunch. The noodles were served with chives, pickled mustard greens, and minced pork, and the broth was sour, spicy, fresh, and fragrant. As she ate, Sun Yuwei told her mother about the morning's flower arrangement work, and her mother praised her creativity. After the meal, she went back to the bedroom, set a 20-minute alarm for a nap, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Set up the new MacBook Air and draft a preliminary writing outline
description: After her lunch break, Sun Yuwei opened the new MacBook Air in her study, plugged it in to complete the initial setup, transferred important documents from her old computer via a USB flash drive, downloaded the writing software Ulysses, logged into her account, and was satisfied with the new keyboard. She then opened mind-mapping software to build an outline for the publishing house's "Chinese Street Scenes" series, selecting five cities: Kunming, Chengdu, Guangzhou, Xiamen, and Xi'an. Under each city, she wrote entry points such as "the morning bustle of everyday life," "street vendors' secret language," and "the codes of authentic local snacks," with a clear sense of direction.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Changed clothes and walked to Eraser Bookstore.
description: Sun Yuwei changed out of her loungewear into an off-white cotton dress and a light blue knitted cardigan, brought her phone, power bank, and new computer, walked along Cuihu East Road and Wenlin Street for about 13 minutes to reach Eraser Bookstore on Cuihu North Road, and saw that the small blackboard at the door listed today's books.
location: Eraser Bookstore (Cuihu North Road Branch), 18 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Gathered with close friends at Eraser Bookstore and strolled to Green Lake Park.
description: Sun Yuwei met Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi at the coffee corner of Xiangpi Bookstore. She showed them photos of her flower arrangement creations from the morning and her new laptop, and shared the experience of receiving an invitation from a publisher. The three discussed plans for gathering material at the vegetable market and topics for sample chapters, flipping through journals and art books with light laughter. After the gathering, they strolled along Wenlin Street to Green Lake Park, enjoying the lake view at sunset and watching square dance rehearsals and water birds on the lake.
location: Eraser Bookstore (Cuihu North Road branch), No. 18 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and Green Lake Park

name: Buy fruit at the supermarket and return home to arrange dried flowers.
description: After parting with her best friend, Sun Yuwei walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street and bought Hongyan strawberries and loquats. After returning home, she put the dried eucalyptus leaves she had bought in the morning into a clay pot in the living room, and hung pink muhly grass upside down on the balcony drying rack to air-dry, adding a natural touch to the room.
location: No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and Cuihu Community

name: Have dinner with family and continue project work and journaling
description: During dinner, shared stir-fried choy sum and stir-fried green peppers with pork with her parents. Sun Yuwei shared the day's experiences. Her father Sun Mingyuan encouraged her to write steadily, and her mother Li Xiulan recalled fond memories of taking her daughter to the vegetable market. After dinner, back in the study, based on the inspiration her mother provided, she added a section called "Conversations with Vendors" to her writing outline. With a fountain pen, she recorded the day's flower arrangement details and her best friends' suggestions in her journal, and pasted in the Dounan Flower Market ticket and dried flower stems and leaves as tangible memories.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening routine: video call, washing up and skincare, meditation, reading, and going to sleep.
description: Sun Yuwei had a video call with her elder sister Sun Yutong to celebrate her birthday, and they shared updates with each other. After hanging up, she washed up and applied moisturizing toner and lotion, then did a 10-minute meditation to relax. Next, she read the chapter in Oral History of Kunming Local Culture about the changes of Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. After confirming in her journal the next day's appointment with Su Man, she turned off the light at 22:30 and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake up and do morning reading on the balcony.
description: Woken by her self-made alarm (playing the intro of "Spring City Flower"), she remembered that today was the fourth anniversary of the publication of her first column, and her mood was elated. After washing up, Sun Yuwei put on a loose cotton T-shirt and went to the balcony. She took out her Mandarin proficiency test textbook and a voice recorder, focusing on practicing the front and back nasal words that her mother had pointed out. After recording, she listened back and felt that her tongue tip position was more accurate than yesterday. Her mother, Li Xiulan, was preparing breakfast in the kitchen and smiled knowingly at the sound of her reading aloud.
location: The balcony of home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning family yoga
description: After morning reading, Sun Yuwei and her mother spread out yoga mats in the living room and completed several rounds of Sun Salutation A, adding Revolved Side Angle Pose and Bridge Pose. Her mother praised her recent progress in core strength, and she attributed it to her consistent weekly practice. After the practice, she poured her mother a cup of warm water.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, home living room

name: Breakfast and departure preparations
description: Breakfast was the small-pot rice noodles topped with minced meat that her mother had made, and Sun Yuwei ate to her heart's content. While eating, she told her parents her plans for the day: a morning yoga class, a visit to Kafka Café to commemorate her writing anniversary, and then Zhibushi Bookstore. Her father reminded her to be careful, and her mother said she would eat lunch at home. After finishing, she went back to her room, changed into a simple white shirt and jeans, and checked her backpack: a new MacBook Air, a journal, a power bank, and a pack of tissues.
location: Dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Zhongmou Yoga Studio for the morning Vinyasa flow class.
description: Sun Yuwei walked to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Line 3 to Wuyi Road Station, and after exiting, walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the 4th floor of Dechun Commercial Building. She attended coach He Lu's Vinyasa Flow Yoga improvement class; the class focused on vinyasa flow sequences, with emphasis on strengthening the core and hip flexibility. She tried hard to keep up with the pace and found balance and awareness in Warrior III and one-legged standing forward fold. After class, she exchanged insights with He Lu and was praised that her breath control was more stable than before.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and mother's pronunciation training
description: After class, Sun Yuwei took the subway back home the same way. After a short rest, she began pronunciation training with her mother on the balcony. Her mother had her read aloud the new short essay "Rain in Kunming." After listening carefully, she marked the retroflex initials and front/back nasal issues with a red pen, demonstrated the pronunciation herself, explained the tongue position, and had Sun Yuwei watch her mouth shapes and repeat. Sun Yuwei felt that she had found the right strength and placement of the tip of her tongue, and her pronunciation was much clearer. Her mother also taught her a little "tongue-twisting" technique and told her to practice it every day.
location: The balcony of home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take a short break and head to Kafka Café
description: After training, Sun Yuwei went back to her room, applied sunscreen, put her computer and journal into a canvas bag, and also tossed in the dried eucalyptus leaves she had unpacked last night. After going out, she walked to the gate of the residential community, scanned a shared electric scooter, rode along Huashan West Road to Cuihu South Road, then along Cuihu East Road to the intersection of Wenlin Street, parked at the non-motor vehicle parking spot, and walked into Kafka Bookstore on the second floor.
location: Kafka Bookstore (Wenlin Branch), No. 203 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: At Kafka Bookstore, commemorating the publication day of my first column.
description: Sun Yuwei walked into the bookstore and went straight to the familiar window seat with the dark green wooden frame, where the plane tree outside had just sprouted new buds. She ordered a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea and a bacon sandwich, opened her MacBook Air, and deftly found the manuscript 'Writing in the Border Town' published on March 15, 2019, in Ulysses. While eating lunch, she read it carefully from the beginning. Though the writing was immature, it recorded her unique insights into frontier writing and fragments of daily life, which moved her and strengthened her direction as a writer.
location: Kafka Bookstore (Wenlin Branch), No. 203 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Publishing commemorative content and April writing plan
description: After reading, Sun Yuwei took a screenshot of the opening paragraph of the article, wrote a commemorative post in Moments, and attached a photo of the spring-filled scene outside the window. She then contacted editor Xu Mingyuan on WeChat and sent a voice message thanking him for accepting her work four years ago and for his ongoing guidance. Xu Mingyuan replied, encouraging her to keep writing and reminding her that she could start planning a submission. Afterward, she took out her beloved journal and wrote down the day's date and mood with a fountain pen. On the April planning page, she wrote: complete the second chapter revision of the thesis (discuss with advisor on March 19), complete the Kunming sample chapter for the “Chinese Street Scenes” publishing house's wet market series (submit next week), and prepare a Chengdu travel guide (finish the first draft by mid-April for the May Day trip). While writing, she thought about a possible angle for writing about Chengdu's wet markets.
location: Kafka Bookstore (Wenlin Branch), No. 203 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visit Zhibushi Bookstore (including round trip)
description: Sun Yuwei packed up her things and walked two and a half minutes from the café to Zhibushi Bookstore. Pushing the door open, she saw the owner Qin Mingyuan sorting through newly arrived "Duku". She greeted him and said she had come to buy "Essays". Qin Mingyuan smiled and took out the copies of "Essays" and "Duku" he had set aside for her. She then browsed the literature section, picked up a book called "City and Place" and flipped through it, chatted with Qin Mingyuan about today being her writing anniversary, and showed him the plan in her notebook. Qin Mingyuan encouraged her to keep up the writing craft. After checking out, she walked home along Cuihu North Road, with pleasant sunshine and a happy mood.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Arranging dried flowers and entryway floral display
description: Back home, Sun Yuwei took out the dried eucalyptus leaves, pink muhly grass, and pine cones she had bought at Dounan Flower Market the day before. She threw away the old flowers in the entryway, rearranged the new materials with vases, and created a layered dried-flower arrangement full of spring spirit. After adjusting the position a few times, she placed it on the cabinet with satisfaction, adding a touch of spring to the home.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Research Chengdu food market guides and update the outline.
description: At the desk in her study, Sun Yuwei opened the mind map on her MacBook Air, entered the file 'Chinese Street-Life Scenes,' and under the 'Chengdu' branch refined the food market outline based on online guides. She shortlisted three candidates: Yulin Comprehensive Market, Fuqin Market, and Qingshiqiao Seafood Market, and recorded each market's features, transportation, and opening hours in preparation for writing a sample chapter. During this time, she also sent a message to a high school classmate studying in Chengdu to ask for local market recommendations.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk in Green Lake Park and family dinner
description: Leaving the study, Sun Yuwei changed into a pair of comfortable canvas shoes and called her mother, who was folding clothes, to go for a walk at Green Lake. Mother and daughter strolled slowly along the lakeside path; the spring willows were freshly green and a gentle breeze touched their faces. As they talked, her mother asked how she felt about visiting the café. Sun Yuwei said she had rediscovered her original intention for writing, and her mother shared funny stories about her students. After a full loop, they rested for a while on a lakeside bench. Then they walked home, passing a supermarket on the way to buy fruit for the next day. When they got home, her mother had already prepared dinner: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised pork belly, and tomato and egg soup. The family of three chatted while eating. Her father asked about the progress of her thesis, and Sun Yuwei said the third chapter was ready to be submitted to her supervisor; her father encouraged her to try to publish it.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the dining room at home

name: Attended an online essay-writing lecture and organized notes.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei put on her headphones and attended an online essay-writing lecture hosted by the literary magazine Dianchi via Zoom in her study. The theme was “The Choice of Imagery in Nonfiction.” She listened carefully and recorded key points in her computer's memo app. After the lecture, she quickly organized her notes and entered the inspirations into a draft in Ulysses, writing down keywords such as “Spring at Green Lake,” “Colors of the Wet Market,” and “Layers of Sound,” planning to use them when writing the sample chapter.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening washing up and bedtime activities
description: Feeling tired but fulfilled, Sun Yuwei first went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into comfortable pajamas, and set her phone to Do Not Disturb. After getting into bed, she put on her eye mask, opened the Tide app, and did a 15-minute body scan meditation, relaxing her body from her toes upward. Afterward, she picked up the Essays magazine she had bought that day and skimmed through two articles; reading a good piece about market culture made her excited. Then she recorded the three most important things of the day in her bedside ring-binder journal: remembrance, walking, and study. Finally, she checked WeChat and saw her close friend Zhang Jing had liked and commented “Keep loving life”; she replied with a smiley face. Her sister Sun Yutong had posted photos of working overtime over the weekend in the family group. After replying briefly, she put her phone on the nightstand, turned off the light, and fell asleep with a peaceful mind.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, bedroom at home.

name: Morning routine: meditation and morning reading
description: After being woken by the alarm at 6:45, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and used the Tide app for a 10-minute body scan meditation to gradually wake up her body and mind. Then she opened the curtains, stood by the bedroom window, and began her morning Mandarin reading practice, focusing on distinguishing initials, recording herself on her phone for self-checking, and marking the difficult points.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk in Cuihu Park

location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

I planned sections such as the morning market bustle, the vendors' hands, and the seasonal color palette, incorporating the narrative perspective of the beauty of repetition from Perfect Days.

location: Lobby of Broadway Cinema, No. 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watching the movie Perfect Days
description: Immersed in the film Perfect Days, I felt the protagonist's repetitive yet poetic daily life, and thought of ordinary people like the elderly flower seller at Green Lake Park and the neighbors doing morning exercises downstairs. My heart was filled with tranquility and fulfillment.
location: Screening Room, Broadway Cinema, No. 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: After the show, quickly noted down inspirations and walked to the next venue.
description: After the movie ended, she quickly jotted down in a notebook in the cinema lobby lounge her thoughts on the contrast between male and female perspectives, repetition and eternity, and cinematic language. Then she walked to Kafka Bookstore on Wenlin Street, taking in the evening street atmosphere.
location: Dongfeng West Road to Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Writing my post-viewing reflections at Kafka
description: At a corner seat on the second floor of Kafka Bookstore, ordered a cup of hot milk tea and, under the title 'Poetically Dwelling in Repetition,' wrote a nearly 1,000-character reflection that compared the film's emotional impact with observations from the food market, incorporating insights from my column writing.
location: Kafka Bookstore, 2nd floor, 203 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stroll at Green Lake Park
description: Paying the bill and leaving Kafka, I walked along Wenlin Street to Green Lake Park, strolled along the lakeside in the afterglow of the sunset, watching elderly walkers and children leaving school, letting my mind fully settle.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Go home and have dinner with family.
description: After the walk, I walked back home. Mother had prepared red-braised fish and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. The three of us had dinner together, sharing our thoughts on the movie and the progress of the column writing. Father asked about the writing progress with concern.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening tidying up and future planning.
description: Back in the room, I decorated today's viewing-notes page in my journal, put the notes and column materials in a prominent place on my desk, added a skin-care reminder for tomorrow to my phone calendar, and recorded it on the March 18 page of the journal.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and daily review
description: Take a hot shower and apply a hydrating mask, send a message to best friend Zhang Jing to share thoughts about the movie, then record weight, steps, and today's completed tasks in the journal, and organize secondary priorities.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation
description: On the bed in the bedroom, I put on earphones and did a 15-minute body scan meditation, letting the movie scenes, journal entries, and scattered thoughts gradually settle, and my heart returned to calm.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Read 'Winter Notes' before bed.
description: After meditating, she turned on the bedside lamp and continued reading Winter Journal for about an hour, losing herself in Paul Auster's narrative until she felt sleepy, then closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Morning routine: yoga, tea, morning reading, and breakfast.
description: After the alarm went off at 7:00, Yuwei got up and unrolled a yoga mat in the bedroom. Her mother, Li Xiulan, also joined, and the mother and daughter did a 30-minute morning yoga session focused on spinal flow and neck-shoulder relaxation. After yoga, Yuwei went to the living room and tried brewing loose-leaf Pu'er tea in a gaiwan. Her technique was awkward, but the tea was clear and sweet. She noted in her journal that she needed to ask Uncle Qin for advice on water temperature. Then she went back to the study and read a prose piece aloud for 20 minutes using a Mandarin app, focusing on practicing front and back nasal sounds. At 7:55, her mother prepared breakfast, and Yuwei helped bring out the small-pot rice noodles. The family of three then had breakfast together in the dining room, accompanied by boiled eggs and pickled vegetables. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, mentioned the "Old Kunming Streets and Alleys" cultural exhibition being prepared by his workplace and said it might offer an opportunity for her to contribute writing. Her mother asked about the time of her yoga class.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Draft the column "Solar Terms in the Vegetable Market"
description: At 8:30, she sat down at her desk, spread out yesterday’s movie review and field notes from Zhuanxin Vegetable Market, opened her laptop, and created a new document. Starting from ‘Beginning of Spring,’ she compared the film’s way of discovering poetry in repetitive labor with the vegetable market grannies’ routine of preparing erkuai according to the solar terms. As she wrote, she sketched the structure in her journal, and got up midway to brew some pu-erh tea to reset her thinking. At 11:20, she completed about 1,200 words of the opening and outline, saved the document, and felt the ideas flow smoothly.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and midday break
description: At 11:30, I went to the dining room and ate the er si (rice noodles) cooked in pork rib soup that my mother had prepared. After finishing quickly, I checked my phone, replied to my best friend Zhang Jing's question about the manuscript, and saw an in-depth report on urban writing shared by editor Xu Mingyuan, so I replied that I'd read it over the weekend. After the meal, I returned to the study, cut and pasted the passage about 'repetition and poetry' from my reflections onto the first page of my column material notebook, changed the water for the daisies on the windowsill, set a 20-minute meditation alarm, and lay down on the small sofa to relax. When the alarm went off at 12:25, I felt refreshed and got ready to go out in the afternoon.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the yoga studio for a flow yoga class.
description: At 12:30, she changed into yoga clothes and walked to Jingxin Yoga Life Studio. Passing through the alleys of Cuihu Community, she followed Huashan West Road to Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road, arriving in about 13 minutes, and texted her mother that she had arrived. At 13:00, she took a one-hour vinyasa yoga class led by instructor He Lu, which focused on core and balance sequences. She was more stable in 'Half Moon Pose' than last time. After class, He Lu suggested she try yin yoga, which is good for the deep stretching needed by someone who sits for long hours writing. Yuwei planned to check next week's schedule and sign up.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Basic cleansing and hydrating skin care.
description: Leave the yoga studio at 14:00, walk east along Dongfeng West Road for about 6 minutes, turn into an alley near Cuihu South Road, and arrive at Yuerong Skin Management Studio. At 14:10, start a 1-hour basic cleansing and hydration treatment. The beautician first uses a device to examine the skin and points out oil secretion in the T-zone, then performs makeup removal, cleansing, iontophoresis with serum, and a hydrating mask. During the process, Yuwei almost falls asleep. After it ends at 15:10, her face is clear and hydrated.
location: Yuerong Skin Care Studio, near Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Casual chat and inspiration gathering at the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore.
description: At 15:15, she left the studio, headed west along Cuihu South Road, then turned onto Cuihu North Road, and pushed open the wooden door of Paper, Cloth and Stone Bookstore. The owner, Qin Mingyuan, was sorting bookshelves. Yuwei shared her thoughts on "Perfect Days" and her idea of working the wet market into a column. Uncle Qin was impressed and recommended the newly arrived illustrated edition of "Diannan Bencao", noting that the entries on wild vegetables for each solar term would help her write about "Awakening of Insects". Yuwei read the "Spring Equinox" chapter, took photos, skimmed a few literary magazines, and chatted with Uncle Qin for about half an hour.

participant.relation: A friend across generations / Bookstore owner

She picked out fresh loquats and strawberries, and bought the light soy sauce her mother had asked for. She left the supermarket at 16:45, walked home along Renmin Middle Road, arrived downstairs at the residential complex at 16:55, and met her neighbor Aunt Xie Xiulan in the elevator, exchanging greetings.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and along Renmin Middle Road on the way home

name: Returning home to rest and accompanying mother for a walk around Green Lake.

At 17:30, her mother changed shoes, and the mother and daughter went downstairs, crossed the street, and entered Green Lake Park. They walked a lap along the flagstone path by the lake. The evening breeze was cool. Her mother talked about fun things at school, and Yuwei shared new ideas for her column and the refreshing feeling from her skin care routine. At 17:55, they left through the side gate and went home.

name: Family dinner

Her father again mentioned that his workplace's 'Old Kunming Streets' cultural exhibition could introduce a curator, and Yuwei agreed, feeling it was a great practical opportunity.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Continue writing and preparing sample chapters in the evening
description: At 18:45 I returned to the study, opened the column draft written in the afternoon to polish and supplement it, and incorporated the note about “eating shepherd's purse during Awakening of Insects” from Diannan Materia Medica, which Uncle Qin had recommended, into the article to enhance the local flavor. At 20:00 I switched to the publisher's outline for “China's Street-Life Scenes”; combined with my reflections on the vegetable market, I added fragmentary inspirations for a “Chengdu Teahouse” chapter after the “Kunming” chapter and marked materials to be verified later.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening socializing: replying on WeChat and video-calling with roommates.
description: At 20:30 I picked up my phone and saw Zhao Xiaowen in the college roommate group chat posting a photo of Dali rushan and saying she would bring some back on Saturday. Yuwei replied that she was looking forward to it. She also saw Song Wen sharing a call for submissions on "food literature" in the writing group, so she saved the link and sent a private message to thank him. At 21:00 she made the dorm group video call on time. Liu Jia was preparing her internship interview script, Zhao Xiaowen showed the starry sky from the rooftop of her Dali inn, and Zhou Lin spoke quietly outside the library. The four shared updates on their internships, travels, and writing, and agreed to have a meal together on Saturday afternoon in Wenhua Lane. At 21:30 they said goodbye and hung up.
location: Study and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation, reading, and meditation before going to bed.
description: 21:30 Finished washing up, used a repair mask as the beautician suggested, applied skin care, changed into pajamas, and put two drops of cedarwood essential oil into the aromatherapy diffuser at the head of the bed. 22:00 Leaning against the headboard, I flipped through photos of the 'Spring Equinox' chapter of 'Diannan Materia Medica' taken in the afternoon, gathering material for tomorrow's writing. 22:15 Put down my phone, took out my sakura fountain pen, recorded today's schedule in my journal, and wrote tomorrow's to-do list: continue the second section of the column (Spring Equinox - shepherd's purse), look up Chengdu food market guides, prepare materials for the discussion with Professor Wu, and drew a smiley face to mark my mood as 'Fulfilled!' 22:30 Turned off the main light, kept the warm yellow bedside lamp on, put on earphones, and did a 15-minute body scan meditation, relaxing gradually from head to toe. 22:45 Meditation ended, turned off the desk lamp, adjusted my breathing, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

Afterward, on the balcony, using the eucalyptus leaves, pink muhly grass, and lisianthus she had brought back from Dounan Flower Market yesterday, she completed a free-style flower arrangement with reference to 'Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana.'

location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Washing up and breakfast

She put the printed draft and notes together into a document folder.

At 11:00 she got up to rest, replied to editor Xu Mingyuan's progress inquiry, and liked a friend's WeChat post. name: Helping in the kitchen to prepare lunch.
description: Went to the kitchen to help mother trim baby bok choy and slice tomatoes, making tomato and egg soup. The mother and daughter chatted about their evening walk plan as they worked.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch
description: Lunch for the family of three, with steamed sea bass, garlic baby bok choy, and tomato and egg soup. She shared details about spring bamboo shoots from the morning's writing, and her father talked about the old Kunming street-life culture exhibition being prepared by his workplace, which sparked new writing inspiration.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and journaling
description: After a 15-minute nap, I worked on my journal, noting the keywords 'spring bamboo shoots,' 'the old bamboo shoot seller,' and 'shepherd's purse dumplings.' I pasted a small eucalyptus sprig left over from the morning flower arrangement into the journal to preserve today's floral inspiration.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon writing and browsing calls for submissions
description: Continue writing the Chinese toon section of "The Solar Terms in the Food Market," combining the detail of Chinese toon tied with cotton thread at the market and the memory of eating scrambled eggs with Chinese toon at home, about 400 words; read through the first draft, delete redundant adjectives, and adjust logical transitions; at 15:00 browse the call for submissions on the literature forum "Urban Memory," note the deadline and word count requirements, and conceive a prose piece about "Memories of Old Kunming Food Markets"; at 16:00 refine the full text again and finalize the main body.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bumped into Aunt Xie during an evening walk.
description: Changed into sportswear, took her journal, and walked along Renmin Middle Road with her mother. At the entrance to the residential complex, they met retired teacher neighbor Xie Xiulan. She took the initiative to ask about memories of the old Kunming food market. Aunt Xie recounted the bustling scene of the old market on Qingnian Road, mentioning the tofu stall run by a Mr. Li, the old man from Lincang selling free-range chicken, and the tofu-flower rice noodle stall, and revealed that the market would be demolished next month. Later, they walked by the lake in Green Lake Park, sat on a wooden bench to add supplementary notes, and set 'the demolition of the old market on Qingnian Road' as the key material for the next essay.
location: Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and Sharing
description: Go home to help prepare the meal. At dinner, excitedly share the gains from running into Aunt Xie during the walk. Father reminds her that she can go to the archives department to look up historical materials about the old vegetable market on Qingnian Road.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize interview leads
description: Back in the study, I created a new document, systematically organized the vendor information and market layout that Auntie Xie mentioned, listed the demolition of the old market on Qingnian Road as a key thread for the writing piece “Kunming Wuhua Wet Market,” and began to sketch out the article's framework.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Discuss the thesis with the supervisor over video
description: She reported her writing progress to Professor Wu Mingyuan via a WeChat video call. They had an in-depth discussion on two issues: integrating the theoretical framework of the first chapter with the oral history materials, and adding new perspectives to the literature review. The professor suggested consulting the relevant chapters of “Oral Tradition and Local Knowledge.”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening Journaling and Skincare
description: Noted the key points from Aunt Xie's interview and the thesis discussion in her journal, and reflected on her writing bottleneck; then went to the bathroom to wash her face, apply a hydrating mask, and played piano music to relax.
location: Study and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed, meditation, and sleep preparation
description: Read the chapter on the changes of the old vegetable market in Oral History of Kunming Local Culture and mark key passages; at 22:00 use the Tide app for a 15-minute body scan meditation; at 22:15 write tomorrow's to-do list in the phone memo: go to Zhibushi Bookstore to return books and look up references, complete the illustrations and layout for 'Solar Terms in the Vegetable Market,' reply to editor Xu Mingyuan, then turn off the light and go to sleep after checking the roommate dinner group message.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up, washing up, and weighing himself
description: In the early morning, soft morning light filtered through the curtain gap. The weather forecast showed 'sunny turning cloudy, 12~24'. After a quick wash, she stepped on the scale and saw the number 45.2kg, which reminded her of the anemia diagnosis in her medical checkup report. She silently reminded herself to be sure to eat a boiled egg for breakfast today. After drinking a glass of warm water, she felt her body slowly waking up.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga on the balcony
description: She unrolled the yoga mat on the balcony, facing toward Green Lake Park. Today's practice was 30 minutes of flow yoga with basic stretching, focusing on shoulder-opening and twisting poses to ease the stiffness in her neck and shoulders from sitting for so long the night before. Between breaths, she mulled over the writing and the plan to buy a new computer, and her thoughts gradually became clear.
location: Balcony at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: Her mother had already cooked steaming hot rice noodles and specially added a boiled egg and a few slices of spiced beef for her. She mentioned to her parents that she would go to Renmin Middle Road in the afternoon to look at computers. Her father reminded her to compare prices, and her mother said with a smile, 'Finally made up your mind.' The gentle family atmosphere gave the new day a warm start.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Finalized "Solar Terms in the Vegetable Market"
description: Returning to the study, I opened the old laptop. I added the information Aunt Xie Xiulan mentioned while walking yesterday evening—that the old food market on Qingnian Road would be demolished in June—into the ending of *Solar Terms in the Food Market* as a footnote to the changing times. Then I read through the whole text three times, fine-tuned the description of the spring rain scene at the Qingming market, and selected the photos of dew-covered shepherd's purse and the panoramic market view taken two days earlier. The final draft was about 2,600 words. After confirming there were no errors, I backed up the document and photos separately to a USB drive and cloud storage. When I finished, I let out a long sigh of relief.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Online consultation and comparing computers.
description: She opened WeChat on her phone and sent a message to her cousin Gao Yuan, a product manager in Shenzhen, asking about the differences in experience between the MacBook Air M2 and the Pro for writing and light image editing. While waiting for his reply, she opened a tech media review video and compared the two machines' weight, battery life, and value for money. Her cousin quickly replied, recommending the Air version with 16G+512G. Decision made: a silver MacBook Air M2.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Organized writing notes and rested
description: Stand by the window, look into the distance, and stretch your neck. Back at the desk, record the fragments of inspiration from finalizing The Solar Terms of the Vegetable Market and the new topics that came to mind in the journal, leaving clues for the next creation.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and midday relaxation
description: Lunch was stir-fried pork with green peppers and tomato egg drop soup, cooked by Dad. It was home-style but tasty. While eating, I chatted with my parents about today's news and fun things at school. After the meal, I took the initiative to help clear the dishes.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: Checked the bank cards and ID card in her wallet, and used her phone to confirm the business hours of the Apple authorized store on Renmin Middle Road (address: No. 37 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming). She brought a lightweight canvas tote bag, ready to carry the new computer. She said hi to her mother, who was reading the newspaper in the living room, and said she would be back in about an hour or two.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the Apple Authorized Store
description: She left home and walked east along the sidewalk on Renmin Middle Road. The sunlight was just right, and the plane trees on both sides of the street had just sprouted new buds. After walking for about 8 minutes, she soon saw the sign of an Apple authorized store.
location: Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (section from No. 123 to No. 37)

name: Purchase and set up a new MacBook Air
description: After entering the store, she went straight to the displayed MacBook Air and felt its light, thin design firsthand. After confirming with a staff member that the silver 16GB/512GB version was in stock, she swiped her card to pay without hesitation (9,999 yuan). The staff helped her activate it, set up her Apple ID, and briefly taught her a few trackpad shortcuts. The experience was very good.
location: Apple Authorized Reseller, No. 37 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked back home
description: Carrying the paper bag containing the new computer, she felt delighted. Walking back, she couldn't help gently touching the new computer through the paper bag, imagining its texture, and felt full of anticipation for the creative work about to begin.
location: Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (section from No. 37 to No. 123)

name: Showing parents the new computer and data transfer
description: When she got home, her parents had already made tea. She sat on the sofa, carefully opened the package, and showed the new computer to her parents. They marveled at how thin and light it was. Her mother touched the keyboard and asked, "Will typing be very fast with this?" She smiled and nodded. Then she transferred the important files from the old laptop to an external hard drive to prepare for the old computer's "retirement."
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Balcony flower arranging practice
description: I set the computer aside temporarily and went to the balcony. The few wildflowers I had picked during yesterday's walk were already a bit wilted. I pruned them and combined them with the eucalyptus leaves at home, arranging them in a small pottery jar. The focused process of arranging the flowers pulled me out of the excitement of buying the computer, and my mood returned to calm.
location: Balcony at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading and self-reflection
