description: I picked up Różewicz’s Creating and Tools and looked again at the passage about the ‘double-edged sword of tools.’ The worry about ‘over-reliance on devices’ rose in my mind once more. I sought answers in the book, reminding myself that the core of writing is always thought, not the medium.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and sharing with family
description: During dinner, Mom praised Dad's cooking. At the table, I described in detail the process of buying the computer that afternoon and shared my cousin's advice. As we were eating, Aunt Xie Xiulan from across the hall brought over a plate of rose yam cakes she had just learned to make. I showed her the new computer, and Aunt Xie kept praising me, saying, "Yuwei is really promising." Laughter filled the house.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Trying out the new computer to write the essay "Tool Worship"
description: After clearing the dining table, I couldn't wait to return to the study and turn on the new computer. The welcome screen with 'Hello' during the initial setup felt deeply ceremonial. I created a new document in Pages and began writing the essay 'Tool Worship'. It recounts the whole process from the old laptop to the new MacBook Air, focusing on the creative anxiety and new expectations brought by the change of tools. The sound of the keyboard was crisp and clean. After about an hour and a half, a first draft of around 1,500 words was completed smoothly.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Opened FaceTime, and my elder sister Sun Yutong, far away in Shenzhen, appeared on the screen. She immediately noticed the new computer packaging box behind me and smilingly asked which model I had finally bought. I proudly showed her the silver Air and read aloud the passage from 'Tool Worship' about 'tools are an extension of thought.' My sister encouraged me: 'Tools are part of creation; don't overthink it.' Her reassurance put me much at ease.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Cleaning up the old computer and archiving files
description: After the call with her sister, she organized the remaining course folders and personal photos on the old laptop and backed them up to a portable hard drive. Then she carefully wiped the old computer clean, wrapped it in a dry cloth, and placed it solemnly in the desk drawer. At that moment, it felt like a small farewell ceremony.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Body stretching and pre-sleep preparation
description: She spread her yoga mat on the living room floor and did a simple yin yoga stretch, focusing on releasing the tension in her shoulders, neck, and back, which had become tight from the day's excitement and writing. She changed into comfortable pajamas and dimmed the bedroom lights.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Late-night meditation and journaling
description: Sitting cross-legged on the bed, I began a 15-minute meditation. In the first few minutes, my thoughts lingered on the "Hello" screen of the new computer and the anxiety about tools mentioned in "Tool Worship." Gradually, I focused on my breath, took a deep breath, and let that fresh, slightly anxious feeling slowly settle. After meditation, I opened my TN journal and wrote down the day's key words in pen: final draft, new tools, ritual, restraint and acceptance. Reviewing this fulfilling day, I felt steady and calm. I set the alarm, turned off the light, and got ready for sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and yoga practice
description: The phone alarm rang. Rubbing my eyes, I pulled open the curtains and saw a clear, cloudless sky outside. I stepped on the scale, which showed 45.1kg. I drank a glass of warm water, brushed my teeth, washed my face, and tied my long hair back with a hairband. I picked out a light gray yoga outfit and prepared for morning practice. On the yoga mat on the balcony, facing Green Lake, I began my practice. Starting with Cat-Cow, I moved through Sun Salutations, Warrior II and other postures, feeling the spine stretch and the core engage. Today I deliberately held Warrior II for 5 extra breaths to feel the stretch in my side waist. Afterward, on the small tea table on the balcony, I set out the simple tea set I had bought yesterday: boiled water, warmed cups, pried off about 5g of Pu'er tea cake, added the tea, awakened it, poured in water, and decanted the liquid. I took a small sip of the first infusion; it was slightly bitter with an aged aroma. I carefully noted in my journal: 'First infusion: deep red liquor, smooth on entry, no pronounced sweet aftertaste.'
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: Her mother brought out small-pot rice noodles with a poached egg and braised beef. Sun Yuwei ate while sharing the joy of buying a new computer yesterday and told her mother she would send the manuscript to the editor today. Her mother smiled and told her not to rush, while her father slowly sipped soy milk and asked about her plans for the royalties. The family chatted over the meal in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sending the manuscript and postscript
description: Opened the new MacBook Air and opened the final draft of “Solar Terms in the Vegetable Market” (about 2,600 words). After re-checking the demolition information for the old vegetable market on Qingnian Road and confirming it was correct, she created a new email, uploaded the attachment, and wrote in the body: “Dear Teacher Xu, this is the final draft of ‘Solar Terms in the Vegetable Market,’ which has been revised according to your last suggestions. I hope it can pass your review. Best regards.” She clicked send, let out a long sigh of relief, and looked forward to the editor’s reply.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free writing and reading notes
description: While waiting for the editor's reply, she continued yesterday's writing. She opened the writing software and thought about 'how tools liberate and restrict creators,' and wrote: "This smooth machine seems to invisibly plan a more 'efficient' creative path, yet I somewhat miss the occasional pauses and reflections brought by the old computer's lag." She continued with about 500 more characters. Then she set aside her writing and read the chapter on 'tools shaping thinking' in 'Creation and Tools', underlining with a highlighter and writing her thoughts in the margin: "This is exactly the contrast to the 'tool obsession' I want to write about; it should be introduced into the text." After about 40 minutes of reading, she filed the notes into the material folder for 'Tool Worship'.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Received the editor's praise and pre-meal preparation.
description: Her phone vibrated and she received a WeChat reply from editor Xu Mingyuan: “Yuwei, I've read your manuscript. The everyday warmth and poetic quality blend really well. We'll use it in the next column. Great work!” Sun Yuwei's heart raced. She excitedly took a screenshot, saved it, and immediately forwarded it to the family group chat. Her mother instantly replied with a thumbs-up emoji. While she was still excited, her best friend Wang Xinran called. They talked for about 15 minutes. Sun Yuwei shared the good news that her manuscript had been accepted and mentioned that she planned to go to Dounan Flower Market with Su Man tomorrow. Wang Xinran said she was very interested. After hanging up, she went to the kitchen to help her mother wash lettuce and cherry tomatoes and make a vinaigrette dressing, preparing lunch.
location: Home study and kitchen, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch
description: Lunch was vegetable salad, tomato and egg soup, and last night's green pepper stir-fried pork. The family chatted while eating. Father said his workplace is organizing an activity for retired employees next week; Mother mentioned that her students did well on the monthly exam. The lunch atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday journal organization
description: After the meal, she returned to her room and did not take a nap. She opened her journal, decorated the page with newly purchased book-shaped stickers, and wrote in fountain pen: final draft sent and accepted, first taste of Pu'er tea, essay on tools in progress. On the page from yesterday when she bought the computer, she added a note: feeling happy but also carrying the subtle pressure of debt. She recorded all of the day's feelings and gains.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking to the yoga studio and preparing before class
description: After changing into a clean T-shirt and athletic pants, she put on her yoga bag. Walking out of the residential area, she headed west along Renmin Middle Road, turned onto Dongfeng West Road, and walked about 12 minutes in total to arrive at the Dechun Commercial Building. After arriving at the studio, she changed into yoga clothes, laid out her mat, and poured lemon water in the rest area. When Coach He Lu passed by, Sun Yuwei said excitedly, "Coach He, the editor said they'll use the article I wrote last time in the next column!" He Lu's eyes lit up and she patted her on the shoulder: "That's great! I knew you could do it! Next time I'll bring homemade oat cookies to celebrate!"
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4F, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Flow Yoga Class
description: The class started on time. It began with breathing exercises and gradually unfolded a vinyasa flow sequence with Warrior I, Warrior II, Triangle Pose, and Half Moon Pose. Sun Yuwei followed the cues closely, feeling each pose mindfully and focusing on the coordination of breath and movement. During the final relaxation, she let go completely, feeling her limbs extend and her mind calm.
location: Classroom 1, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-class discussion and herbal tea
description: After class, He Lu brought herbal tea, and the two sat down on the sofa in the lounge area. Sun Yuwei shared the editor's comments in detail, and He Lu encouraged her to keep writing, saying she felt her style was becoming more and more mature. They chatted for about 20 minutes in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere, and then Sun Yuwei packed up her things and got ready to leave.
location: Rest area of Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Went to the supermarket to stock up and returned
description: Leaving the yoga studio, I turned from Dongfeng West Road onto Fuchun Street and walked about 10 minutes to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. Pushing a shopping basket, I bought according to the list: two bottles of mineral water, a box of cherry tomatoes, a pack of mixed nuts, and several individually wrapped chocolates, spending about 45 yuan in total. After paying, I walked home along the same route and arrived in about 9 minutes.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the round-trip route.

name: Afternoon tea and packing gear for tomorrow's pop-up event
description: After putting away her purchases, she boiled water and cut two pieces of the rose yam cake that Aunt Xie had given her yesterday, arranging them on a plate. She made a simple matcha latte with matcha powder and milk; the milk foam was not very fine, but it tasted okay. While drinking the matcha latte, she prepared for tomorrow’s pop-up flower arrangement event: she took out her DSLR camera from the study, checked the battery level, and put in spare batteries and a charger; found an A5 sketchbook, a gel pen, gardening scissors, and cut-resistant gloves, and placed everything into a canvas tote bag. She also wrote a checklist in the memo app on her phone to make sure everything would be ready for tomorrow.
location: Kitchen, bedroom, and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Resting on the sofa and browsing the internet.
description: After tidying up, she collapsed onto the sofa and scrolled through her phone. She saw that editor Xu Mingyuan had shared an in-depth article on local literature in the work group. She clicked in, read the first few paragraphs, found it inspiring, and saved it. She then browsed updates from a few lifestyle bloggers she follows, relaxing for half an hour.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner preparation and family meal
description: Her mother began to get busy, so she went over to help peel garlic and trim vegetables. Her mother said that tonight she would make stir-fried choy sum and sweet-and-sour ribs, and asked her to help blanch the ribs. The mother and daughter chatted on and off, and Sun Yuwei shared funny moments from today's yoga class. At dinner, the family sat together. Her father praised the sweet-and-sour ribs profusely, and her mother asked how she felt after the afternoon yoga session. Sun Yuwei mentioned that she and Su Man were going to Dounan Flower Market tomorrow, and her parents told her to be safe. The dinner atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Communicating with Su Man about the details of the pop-up event
description: After dinner, she sent Su Man a WeChat message: "Manman, I've got everything ready—camera, scissors, and gloves are all packed. Shall we meet at Exit C of Dounan Metro Station at 9 tomorrow?" Su Man instantly replied with an OK emoji and added, "I've brought gardening clippers and a few rolls of twine on my side. Your main job is to document—shoot both photos and videos so we can edit a short video later. The theme is 'Spring Revival'." The two confirmed the details for tomorrow's meeting, full of anticipation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing journal entries and diary
description: Opened the journal and recorded the moments of the day in detail: the excitement of the editor confirming acceptance of the manuscript, the first taste of pu'er tea, reflections on continuing the essay, the comfort of the yoga class, and the anticipation of tomorrow's event. At the end, she wrote: "This is a Friday filled with hope and calm. From the excitement of the new computer, to the serenity amid the tea fragrance, to the comfort after yoga, everything feels just right. Looking forward to tomorrow's flower market flash mob." Turning the bits and pieces of the day into words, she felt fulfilled and at peace.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read a book about Pu'er tea before bed
description: Before bed, she continued reading the Pu'er tea culture book, focusing on the chapter 'Storage and Aging of Pu'er Tea,' thinking about how to connect it with the theme 'The Reappearance of Time' and gain some writing inspiration. After reading for about 40 minutes, she closed the book and prepared to wash up.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Nighttime bedtime routine and sound sleep
description: Went into the bathroom to wash up, put on a face mask, and applied body lotion. After changing into pajamas, I checked the canvas bag for tomorrow to make sure everything was packed, and plugged in the phone charger. Then I sat cross-legged on the bed and started a 10-minute mindful breathing meditation on my phone, focusing on the sound of breathing and letting the day's remaining thoughts and fatigue slowly dissolve with each breath. After the meditation, I turned off the bedside lamp, got under the covers, and in the dark reviewed tomorrow's schedule: meet Su Man at Exit C of Dounan Metro Station at 9, with the theme 'Spring Revival', bringing the camera to document. After confirming there were no issues, I adjusted my position and, with a day full of gains and anticipation for tomorrow, gradually fell into a peaceful sleep and slept well all night.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning yoga sun salutations
description: On Saturday morning the sunlight was just right. Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan spread yoga mats on their balcony and did a simple 15-minute Sun Salutation together. Her mother reminded her that Dounan Flower Market would be crowded today and to stay safe. Her mother’s clear voice and gentle movements made Sun Yuwei feel at ease.
location: Balcony at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Quick breakfast and check the equipment bag.
description: After yoga, she took a quick shower. Her mother had prepared small-pot rice noodles and hot milk. While eating, Sun Yuwei checked her backpack: camera, two spare batteries, sketchbook, charcoal pencil, scissors, twine, water bottle, and a large eco-friendly cloth bag. Everything was in order. She planned to buy grilled erkuai on the way.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Wuyi Road Metro Station
description: Putting on her earphones and slinging her bulging canvas bag over her shoulder, Sun Yuwei headed out. On Renmin Middle Road, the morning was already bustling, and tender buds were sprouting from the plane trees along the street. She bought a grilled erkuai with shredded potato from a roadside breakfast stall, wrapped it in oil paper, and put it in her bag. After walking about 13 minutes, she arrived at Wuyi Road Metro Station.
location: Wuyi Road Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take the subway to Dounan Flower Market.
description: After swiping her card through the gate, she found the subway not crowded. Sun Yuwei sent Su Man her location from a corner on her phone: “On my way, see you at Exit C at 9!” The other party replied with an OK emoji. The train went from Wuyi Road Station on Line 3 to Dongfeng Square Station, then she transferred to Line 2. The view outside the window gradually changed from dense buildings to open fields, and about an hour later the train arrived at Dounan Station.
location: From Wuyi Road Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Dounan Metro Station, Chenggong District

name: Met up with Su Man at Dounan Flower Market
description: After exiting the station, she saw Su Man at a glance, waiting at Exit C with a huge canvas bag on her back. Sun Yuwei ran over smiling and handed her the still-warm grilled erkuai: “A surprise for you!” Su Man's eyes lit up, took it, and took a big bite. The two chatted about the day's plans and walked together toward the main venue of Dounan Flower Market.
location: Exit C, Dounan Metro Station, Dounan Subdistrict, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Collaborate on creating the floral installation "Spring Revival"
description: After entering the flower market, the two headed straight for the waste recycling area on the outskirts. Sun Yuwei borrowed a small cart from a flower vendor she knew and focused on collecting discarded dead branches, dried reeds, and intact broken vines; Su Man picked a few half-bloomed peach blossom branches and a few bunches of forget-me-nots that had not completely wilted. After meeting up, in the open space of the pop-up area, Sun Yuwei used dead branches and twine to make a frame about 1.5 meters tall, and Su Man carefully adorned it with peach blossom branches and forget-me-nots, creating a visual effect of 'withered wood meeting spring,' which attracted many citizens to stop and take photos.
location: Dounan Flower Market pop-up area, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Give an interview to the "Kunming Is Interesting" media outlet.
description: Just as they were making final adjustments to the work, a young reporter wearing a press badge came over to talk to them, introducing himself as an editor-reporter for “Kunming Is Interesting” and saying he was drawn to the work. The two gladly agreed to the interview. Sun Yuwei talked about her creative concept of redefining spring with discarded flower materials, and Su Man added details about flower selection and securing methods. The reporter took a photo of them with the work and said it would be published along with the article.
location: Dounan Flower Market pop-up area, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Had lunch with Su Man and discussed follow-up plans.
description: After the interview, the two had lunch at a small shop called "Lingxian Cold Jelly" near the flower market, ordering tofu pudding rice noodles and papaya water. While waiting, they looked through photos of the installation on their phones. Su Man suggested, "This series can be continued. Next time, we could combine discarded wood from construction sites with dried plants to make an 'oasis in the cracks of the city.'" Sun Yuwei agreed wholeheartedly and suggested inviting a few friends along next time.
location: Lingxian Liangfen, near Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Leave the flower market and take the subway back to the city center
description: After saying goodbye to Su Man at the entrance of the flower market, carefully put away the camera and sketchbook, and took Metro Line 2 then transferred to Line 3 to return to Wuyi Road Station. On the metro, closed my eyes and recalled the creative process of the morning; the text framework for an essay surfaced in my mind. After getting out of the station, walked along Green Lake. The sunshine was warm, the willows were newly green, and I felt at ease.
location: From Dounan Metro Station, Chenggong District, to Wuyi Road Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying cold jelly on the way and walking to the bookstore
description: Passing by Green Lake West Road, Sun Yuwei saw the familiar Lingxian Cold Jelly shop and remembered she was still a little hungry, so she bought herself a bowl of sweet-and-sour cold jelly and ate it while walking as an afternoon snack. After finishing, she walked a few minutes along Green Lake North Road and pushed open the glass door of Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore.
location: Cuihu West Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District

name: Reading, sorting out thoughts, and creative practice at the bookstore.
description: The bookstore smelled of coffee and old books. Sun Yuwei greeted Uncle Qin, who was tidying the shelves, and excitedly showed him the photos of the 'Spring Revival' installation on her phone. Uncle Qin praised it again and again. Then she sat down in her usual spot, took out her sketchbook and pen, and began writing a draft of an essay about 'Cycles and Rebirth': 'Discarded flower branches regain life through ingenious design, just as forgotten stories are rediscovered among old pages...' At one point, she looked up and saw the brilliant weeping crabapple blossoms outside the window, and quickly sketched a few lines with her pencil. She also connected her laptop to the bookstore Wi-Fi and composed a WeChat Moments post: 'Using withered branches and peach branches, awakening spring in a corner of the city. Thanks to my best partner @Su Man.'
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Chatted with Uncle Qin and recorded in journal
description: Tired from writing, I walked to the bar counter and poured a cup of tea for Uncle Qin and myself. Sitting opposite him, I talked about being interviewed today by 'Kunming Is Interesting' and his views on local media topic selection. Uncle Qin suggested: 'You could write an essay about small art installations in urban public spaces, connecting art with community life.' Thinking it was a great idea, I immediately took out my journal and used a fountain pen to write down keywords such as 'urban micro-installations' and 'community art', and drew a simple sketch of the flower materials used today.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home and stop by the supermarket for groceries on the way.
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she walked home carrying her canvas tote bag. First she stopped at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at 98 Fuchun Street, pushed a shopping cart, and picked a box of Shine Muscat grapes, a bag of plain potato chips, and a bottle of low-sugar oolong tea as snacks for the evening. At the checkout, she saw white lisianthus on sale and picked up a bunch on the spot.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Return home to put things away and take a short rest
description: Back home, her mother was busy in the kitchen. Sun Yuwei washed the grapes and put them in the fridge, trimmed the stems and removed the leaves of the lisianthus, and arranged them in a vase on the windowsill, making the whole room come alive. After changing into loungewear, she flopped on the sofa for a while and replied one by one to her friends' likes and comments from earlier.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Have dinner with parents and share today’s fun moments.
description: Dinner was her mother's specialty dishes: sweet and sour pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. At the dinner table, Sun Yuwei excitedly told everyone about her creative work with Su Man and the experience of being interviewed. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, liked the photos she had taken, and her mother asked whether she had eaten lunch on time and whether the jute rope on her hand was hurting. The whole family chatted happily.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organized today's photos and notes, edited short-video footage.
description: After the meal, she returned to the study, inserted the camera SD card into the computer, and created a folder named “0322 Dounan Flower Market Quick Visit.” She quickly browsed 72 photos and selected 12 with the best composition and lighting. Then, using a mobile editing app, she spliced together the short videos taken at the flower market, added upbeat background music, and made a 15-second “Highlight of the Day” short video, saving it as material for later.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Her sister Sun Yutong called via video. Sun Yuwei turned the camera toward the computer screen to show her the short video she had edited in the afternoon. Her sister praised it repeatedly and encouraged her to try submitting it to lifestyle-oriented WeChat public accounts. The two chatted for half an hour, and her sister reminded her as usual to eat on time and go to bed early. After the call, Sun Yuwei opened the draft of her afternoon essay again and continued writing a few lines of unfinished reflections.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and journaling.
description: She picked up Wang Zengqi's “The Plants and Trees of the Human World” from the bedside, turned to the chapter about rain in Kunming, and read several passages. Then she took out her beloved journal and, using stickers and colored pens, recorded the day's keywords: “Dounan,” “Spring Revival,” “Discarded Flower Materials,” “Interviewed,” and “Uncle Qin's suggestion.” She also wrote a reflection with her fountain pen: “When withering meets creativity, spring lives not only on the branches but also in the heart.”
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Simple stretching, meditation, and bedtime preparation
description: Spread the yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did a few relaxing Cat and Child poses to relieve the day's fatigue. Then I sat down cross-legged, steadied my breathing, and meditated for 10 minutes, focusing on each inhale and exhale. After that, I washed up, changed into pajamas, and charged my phone and camera batteries.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read relaxing content and fall asleep naturally.
description: After lying down in bed, she didn't immediately reach for her phone. Instead, she picked up Everyday Ikebana and turned to the "Nageire" chapter. The sense of calm brought by the words made her feel relaxed and content. After reading a few pages, she put down the book and turned off the desk lamp. In the faint glow of the streetlight outside the window, listening to the occasional sound of cars passing in the distance, she gradually fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning, washed up, weighed myself (45.3 kg), then did simple neck, shoulder, and body stretches in the living room to prepare for the yoga class.
location: Home bedroom and living room at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: Walk west along Renmin Middle Road to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, about 8 minutes, arriving at the 4th floor of Dechun Commercial Building at 7:28, ready for the yoga class.
location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Room 4001, Floor 4, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Flow yoga morning class and post-class stretching.
description: Attended the morning flow yoga class led by instructor He Lu, with the theme of backbends and shoulder opening. From cat-cow warm-up to poses such as locust pose and camel pose, it ended with a 10-minute corpse pose meditation. After class, she did an extra 5 minutes of shoulder, neck, and hip stretches to help her body transition smoothly.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio Classroom 2 and Rest Area, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Buying vegetables and heading home for breakfast.
description: Walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket to buy Shanghai bok choy, loofah, tomatoes, strawberries, apples, and red dates; after returning home, boiled eggs, warmed milk, and had them with whole wheat bread for breakfast, then organized the ingredients into the fridge.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Home Kitchen & Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road.

name: Working in the study: sharing coverage of her works, journal reflections, and travel plans
description: I browsed the 'Interesting Kunming' WeChat official account's report on the 'Spring Revival' floral installation, and shared the interview comments and photos of the work with my friend Su Man, my close friends group, and family group. Then, in my journal, I sketched a small draft of the work with a pen and wrote down new reflections. Next, I opened my MacBook to look up Chengdu travel guides, planned routes through Kuanzhai Alley, Du Fu Thatched Cottage, and other places, and jotted down names of niche teahouses and bookstores.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: She cooked tomato and egg noodles for lunch by herself. After eating, she cleared the table, rested with her eyes closed on the sofa in the bedroom, set the alarm for 13:30, and entered a light afternoon nap.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon stroll to Wenlin Street and discovered a teahouse
description: I took an umbrella and went out, walking along Renmin Middle Road to Wenlin Street in a light rain for about 20 minutes. Passing a tea house with traditional decor called "Yunshuijian," I was drawn in by the sandalwood and tea fragrance wafting out and decided to go inside and try it.
location: From Renmin Middle Road to Yunshuijian Teahouse on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near Cuihu North Road).

name: Pu'er tea ceremony experience and tea ware selection
description: At the Cloud and Water Teahouse, Teacher Zhou brewed Bingdao raw pu-erh and ripe pu-erh one after another, explaining the origin, vintage, and processing characteristics of ancient-tree pu-erh. She used the tip of her tongue to feel the thickness and sweet aftertaste of the tea liquor, and recorded the tea varieties and mouthfeel on her phone. After the tasting, she bought a white porcelain gaiwan, a fairness cup, tasting cups, and samples of Bangdong raw pu-erh, ten-year aged ripe pu-erh, and ancient-tree sun-dried black tea. Teacher Zhou hand-wrote the tea names and years on the tea packages and gave her a copy of the book "Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way."
location: Tea-tasting area, Yunshuijian Teahouse, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home and set up the tea corner
description: After the rain, I returned home along Wenlin Street and across Cuihu South Road, reaching home in less than 20 minutes. I washed the new tea set with warm water, spread a linen square cloth on the small side table by the study window, and placed the gaiwan, fairness pitcher, tasting cups, and tea samples on it, creating my own "tea corner" and feeling a deep sense of satisfaction.
location: From Yunshuijian Teahouse on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the window of the home study at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road.

name: Dinner with Father
description: Father returned from playing chess, and I shared amusing stories from the teahouse with him. The two of us prepared the meal together in the kitchen. Father made stir-fried eggs with luffa, and I stir-fried Shanghai greens. We quietly enjoyed dinner with two dishes and a soup.
location: Home Kitchen and Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Designing a tea-tasting log and practicing tea brewing for the first time.
description: After dinner, she returned to the tea corner in her study. In her journal, she used a ruler and colored pencils to draw a "Tea Tasting Log" table with columns such as date, tea name, water temperature, and aroma. Then she used a new white porcelain gaiwan to brew some old jasmine dragon pearl tea. Though her movements were still unskilled, her heart gradually calmed as the floral fragrance rose. Holding the new cup and sipping slowly, she savored the peace of the twilight.
location: Tea corner in the home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening socializing: video chat with older sister and sharing with friends
description: My older sister Sun Yutong sent a video invitation. I showed her my newly arranged tea corner and tea set, shared how I felt about vinyasa yoga, listened to her vent about the overtime pressure from her company's major product version update, and we agreed to talk again during the Qingming holiday. Afterwards, I sent my friend Su Man photos of the teahouse experience and my tea corner. She praised them as full of Zen and agreed to drink tea together next time she comes to Kunming.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: Curled up on the study sofa, I opened Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Dao, a gift from Teacher Zhou, and read the first chapter about the old teahouses of Taipei. The writing is plain yet evocative, and the night feels especially tranquil.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching, meditation, and journal reflection
description: Did 10 minutes of stretching on the yoga mat in the bedroom to relieve the muscle tension from backbends and shoulder opening, then sat cross-legged and meditated for 10 minutes, focusing on breathing and clearing the mind. Then she returned to the desk and wrote today's date "3.23 Sunday" and her tea-tasting feelings in the journal: "Drinking jasmine dragon pearls from a new cup, the dusk is deep and my heart is extremely still. The tea corner has just taken shape... Starting tomorrow, I will really use them to record raw pu'er."
location: Bedroom and study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: She closed her journal, turned off the desk lamp, and lay down to sleep. Outside the window, moonlight fell gently across the floor, and she felt an unprecedented sense of peace and contentment.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up activity
description: Woken by the alarm at 7 a.m., I first weighed myself after getting up—the scale showed 45.2 kg—then washed up. After that, I spread a light green yoga mat on the balcony and did a 30-minute flow yoga practice, starting with Cat-Cow, moving into Downward-Facing Dog, feeling the stretch along the back of my body, and ending with 5 minutes of seated cross-legged breathing to fully awaken my body from sleep. From outside the window came the indistinct chatter of the breakfast stall downstairs.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: master bedroom, bathroom, and balcony.

name: Morning tea ritual.
description: With anticipation, she sat down at the tea corner by the study window. Using the gaiwan and fairness cup bought the day before at 'Yunshuijian,' she weighed out the 'Bangdong raw pu'er' dry tea. After warming the cups carefully, she added the dry tea and gently swirled it to release the aroma. The fresh orchid fragrance was calming. She slowly poured water and decanted the tea; the liquor was light yellow and translucent. Taking small sips, a slight astringency gave way to a clean, sweet aftertaste. She carefully recorded the tea name, water temperature, and taste in the 'Tea Tasting Log' section of her journal, took a photo, and sent it to the close friends group. Chen Sisi replied praising her refined everyday life.
location: Tea corner by the study window at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast
description: Mom had already prepared small-pot rice noodles according to the weight-gain recipe. The broth was dotted with chives and chili oil, especially tempting, and she had added extra minced meat. While eating, I told Mom I planned to accompany her for a walk around Green Lake in the afternoon. Her eyes lit up and she kept saying yes. Sunlight streamed through the window onto the dining table, making breakfast taste warm and cozy.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to Yunnan University Donglu Campus.
description: After breakfast, I packed my laptop and thesis outline into a canvas bag, put on earphones, and walked 5 minutes to Wuyi Road Metro Station. I took Metro Line 3 toward East Coach Terminal Station and arrived at Yunnan University Station about 20 minutes later. After exiting the station, I walked along Ginkgo Path toward the College of Literature. In the early morning campus, there were already students reading aloud.
location: Starting from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, she took Line 3 from Wuyi Road Metro Station to Yunnan University Station, then walked to the School of Liberal Arts, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, at No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Discussed my graduation thesis with my advisor.
description: Knock on Teacher Wu's office door, piled with books, and hand him the first draft of Chapter 3 of the thesis. Teacher Wu put on reading glasses and circled the parts needing revision with a red pen. He suggested adding oral history interviews with 'old tea regulars' to add depth, and listed several reference books, especially the teahouse chapter of 'Old Tales of Kunming'. I carefully noted the key points and consulted my advisor about my writing questions.
location: Mr. Wu Mingyuan's office, School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Borrowing books and looking up materials at the library
description: After bidding farewell to her advisor, she walked to the university library. In the social sciences reading area, she found Old Stories of Kunming and unexpectedly discovered that Teahouse Life at Southwest Associated University was inspiring for essay writing, so she checked out both. Then, at a window seat on the second floor, she connected to the campus network, downloaded a sample thesis, and spent half an hour carefully studying its chapter structure. The plane trees outside the window swayed gently in the breeze.
location: Self-study Area, 2nd Floor, Library, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk home
description: Walked from Yunda to Yunnan University Metro Station, took Metro Line 3 back to Wuyi Road Station. After exiting the station, bought a bag of freshly baked egg-white cakes at the Jiahua Bakery at the intersection to bring to Mom, then walked along Wucheng Road to the downstairs of my home.
location: From Yunnan University Metro Station, 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, take Line 3 to Wuyi Road Station, then after exiting, return to 123 Renmin Middle Road via Jiahua Bakery along Wucheng Road.

name: Having lunch with my mother
description: By the time she got home, her mother had already prepared lunch: stir-fried broccoli, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and rib soup. She handed her mother the egg-white cakes she had just bought, and a smile immediately appeared in her eyes. While eating, she briefly shared what happened at school that morning. The atmosphere was relaxed, and after the meal she took the initiative to wash the dishes and chopsticks in the kitchen.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch break and writing preparation
description: She didn’t return to the bedroom. She leaned back on the rattan chaise lounge in the study, and sunlight cast a patch of light through the curtain gap onto the spine of Old Tales of Kunming. She covered her abdomen with a jacket, set a 20-minute alarm, and took a short nap. When the alarm went off, she got up, washed her face, felt refreshed, brewed a cup of rose tea, opened her MacBook Air, set her phone to Focus mode, and quickly listed the outline for the afternoon essay in her journal: introduction, body, conclusion.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: At home, continued writing the fourth essay in her prose collection.
description: She officially began writing the piece titled "Kunming's Old Teahouses." Combining yesterday's experience at Yunshuijian with the materials she had looked up in the morning, she started with sensory details: the steam from the tiger stove, the feel of the bamboo tables and chairs, and the sound of tea drinkers chatting. She hit a bottleneck when writing the section about teahouses as information hubs, so she got up and made a cup of 10-year aged ripe pu'er tea that Zhou had given her. After the warm, smooth tea went down, her thoughts opened up, and she continued typing. By 4:30 pm, she had completed a first draft of about 1,000 characters.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Had breakfast at the dining table in the living room at home with father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan. Mom prepared millet porridge, boiled eggs, and apples. During breakfast, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to talk with her parents about the architectural framing techniques she learned in yesterday's photography class. Her father encouraged her to take time to shoot more old streets. Her mother reminded her to go to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at the community entrance today, because there was a membership-day discount and she could buy some fresh vegetables.
description: After tidying up the desk, I changed into comfortable going-out shoes with my mother, and we walked along the quiet Wucheng Road, past Xima River, to the south gate of Cuihu Park. The weather was cloudy and felt pleasant. On the way, my mother talked about the plot of the TV drama she had watched last night. After entering the park, we strolled slowly along the lakeside path, talking about the newly blooming rose bushes and the leisurely visitors. I shared the parts I found interesting while writing my essay that afternoon, and my mother listened with great interest. When we reached the flagstone path near the bamboo grove, my mother stepped on a loose brick, and her body tilted slightly. I instinctively reached out to support her arm. She frowned slightly and said she had twisted her foot a little.
location: Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the walking route from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road to the park.

name: Handled her mother’s sprained ankle.
description: She carefully helped her mother sit on a nearby bench, asked her not to move her ankle for now, and after confirming that the ankle joint had not become significantly more swollen or red, helped her walk slowly home along the same path. On the way, she quickly searched online for 'sprained ankle ice compress' and planned the treatment steps in advance. After arriving home, she helped her mother sit on the sofa, took off her socks, applied a cold compress with an ice pack wrapped in a towel, and also found the Yunnan Baiyao aerosol spray at home and sprayed it.
location: From the park bench at Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, return along the same route to the living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Dinner and sharing household chores
description: After Dad came home from work and learned what had happened, he took the initiative to put on an apron and cook. I was in charge of rinsing the rice and cooking it, washing the vegetables, and setting out the bowls and chopsticks. At dinner, the whole family sat together. Following the doctor's advice, I reminded Mom to move less these days, and Dad agreed, telling her to rest more. After the meal, I volunteered to do the dishes and let Mom sit and rest.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Watching TV with Mother
description: After dinner, I helped my mother sit down on the sofa in the living room. She watched a rerun of 'The Reader' on China Education Television, while I poured her some warm water and cut the washed strawberries into small pieces on a plate beside her. Halfway through, I changed the ice pack for her again. As we watched the program, I listened to my mother comment on the guests' readings, and the atmosphere was peaceful.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Brewing ripe pu-erh and organizing tea-tasting notes in the evening
description: After settling my mom in, I returned to the tea corner in my study and continued practicing brewing with this afternoon's ripe pu-erh, savoring the changes in thickness and sweetness of each infusion. In my journal, I completed the tasting notes I had written in the afternoon, bringing the first day of tea tasting to a close.
location: Tea corner of the study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading and stretching meditation
description: Picked up 'Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way' given by Teacher Zhou and leaned on the sofa by the window to read slowly. The author's writing is plain yet flavorful, and reading it calms the mind. After reading for about half an hour, I did 10 minutes of simple stretching and 5 minutes of meditation on the yoga mat to release the day's thoughts and ease the neck and shoulders stiff from long sitting.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Write in journal to record today
description: Under the desk lamp, I opened my journal and used a pen to record the whole day: the key points of the thesis discussion, the progress of the essay writing, the treatment of and worries about my mother's sprained ankle, and my reflections on my first formal tea tasting. My handwriting was careful; I wrote not only the events but also my concern for Mom's health and my expectations for the new week.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Wash up and get ready for bed
description: She put down her journal, went to the bathroom, and carefully washed her face, brushed her teeth, and applied evening skincare. Passing through the living room, she confirmed that the light in her mother's bedroom was off. Back in her bedroom, she changed into soft pajamas, set her phone to silent, and left only a small night light on.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep habits and falling asleep
description: Lying in bed, I glanced at the digital clock on the bedside table. As I got ready to sleep, I recalled the moment I steadied my mother, and a faint sense of lingering fear and relief rose in my heart. With the dim streetlights outside the window and the muffled sound of the neighbors' television, I slowly closed my eyes and, in peace, with a touch of concern for my mother, gradually drifted into sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning greetings
description: After getting up in the morning, she first went to the next room to visit her mother, who had injured her ankle, asked about her recovery, poured her some warm water, and started the new day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga
description: Unroll the yoga mat on the balcony and do a 30-minute yoga practice, focusing on standing poses such as Tree Pose and Warrior III, feeling the body's balance and stability.
location: Balcony at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning Tea and the Surprise of an Article Payment
description: In the tea corner of the study, used a new gaiwan to brew Bangdong raw pu'er, tasting its crisp floral aroma. On the phone, a bank notification showed that the 1,000 yuan contribution fee from Southwest Literature had arrived. Felt happy, took a screenshot to keep, and shared it in the family group and the best friends' group.
location: Study at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and family warmth.
description: Father cooked rice noodles, and I helped bring a bowl to Mother. Everyone ate and chatted. When Father saw the manuscript fee notice in the family group chat, he sent a red envelope as encouragement. Mother had a good appetite and even ate a flower pastry.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shared the joy with her sister via video call.
description: After breakfast, I had a video call with my sister Sun Yutong and shared a screenshot of my manuscript payment. She praised me a lot and suggested compiling the essays into a book; she has editor friends who could help recommend it. The two of us made a plan to complete a first draft by April.
location: Study at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focused creative work in the study.
description: After hanging up the video call, she felt cheerful. She opened her laptop and continued polishing the essay 'Kunming's Old Teahouses', incorporating observations and physical sensations from yesterday's walk at Green Lake. She wrote nearly 2,000 characters, and the first draft was basically complete.
location: Study at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: To take care of her mother, she cooked tomato and egg noodles herself, added extra greens, cut up kiwifruit, and heated up flower cakes as a snack. Then the family sat around and had lunch, and her mother praised the noodles for tasting good.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday tasks and reading
description: After lunch, she returned to the study, called Fuzhao Building to reserve a private room, and contacted her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi to confirm the dinner gathering in the evening. Then she went to the bedroom, lay down, and read the chapter about Republic of China teahouses in Old Stories of Kunming, accumulating material for her writing. About half an hour later, the alarm went off and she got ready to go out.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: study and bedroom.

name: Go to the yoga studio and practice
description: Changed into yoga clothes and left home, walked to the bus stop, took bus No. 101 to Art Theater Station, and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. Attended He Lu's vinyasa flow yoga class, practicing poses such as Warrior III and Half Moon. After class, shared the good news about the manuscript fee with He Lu.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the bookstore and spend some time there.
description: After yoga class, I said goodbye to He Lu and walked 12 minutes through the lanes near Green Lake to Zhibushi Bookstore. Sitting by the window, I organized my reflections on the yoga session, then shared the good news about my article payment with Uncle Qin. Uncle Qin recommended a nonfiction work about urban memory, and we exchanged creative insights.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to rest after shopping
description: After leaving the bookstore, she walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street, bought oranges and kiwis for her mother, and used her writing fee to buy a cloth-bound journal with hand-painted Green Lake illustrations. Then she walked home, put the fruit in the refrigerator, tidied herself up, and got ready to go out for a meal.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road.

name: Heading to the group dinner, sharing the meal, and saying goodbye
description: After tidying up a bit, she rode a shared bicycle to Fuzhao Tower to meet her parents. At six in the evening, she had dinner in a private room with her parents and her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi, tasting authentic Yunnan dishes such as steam-pot chicken and ganbajun mushroom fried rice. Her father shared the experience of publishing articles in his youth. She paid the 480 yuan bill with her manuscript fees. After the meal, she said goodbye to relatives and friends at the entrance, and her parents went home first.
location: Fuzhaolou Steam Pot Chicken Restaurant, No. 36 Yunrui West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking alone in the residential community
description: After returning to the residential complex, she didn't go upstairs immediately but walked alone in the garden for 20 minutes, reviewing the day's experiences and feeling grounded and content.
location: Inside the Cuihu Community residential compound, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: Return to the study, print out photos from the dinner gathering and paste them into the new journal, then write down reflections. Next, read The Teahouse Life of Southwest Associated University in preparation for the thesis. Then do ten minutes of yoga stretching and ten minutes of mindfulness meditation. After that, go to mother's room to apply ointment and massage her ankle, then wash up. Before bed, lean against the headboard and read the chapter "Tea and Zen Are One" from Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way. Finally, write tomorrow's plan in the journal: go to Yunnan University library in the morning to research materials, draft a new essay in the afternoon, then turn off the light and sleep.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: study and bedroom.

name: Morning balcony yoga
description: In the early morning, I did a 35-minute flow yoga practice on the balcony, focusing on relaxing the neck and shoulders and opening the hips, synchronizing breath with movement, feeling the body stretch and calm, charging up for the day.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Brewed ripe pu-erh and kept a tea-tasting log.
description: After yoga, she brewed ten-year aged ripe pu-erh in a white porcelain gaiwan. The tea liquor was amber-colored with a rich red-date aroma. In her journal she recorded the water temperature, tea color, mouthfeel, and lingering sweetness, and wrote about today's feeling of inner peace.
location: Tea corner by the window in the home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and caring for mother
description: She cooked tomato and egg noodles for her mother, who has limited mobility. As they ate breakfast together, she told her not to move around too much and asked about her ankle's recovery, showing thoughtful care for her mother.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning creative session and floral arrangement inspiration adjustments
description: In the study, she worked on the core writing of the fifth piece in the prose collection, “Breathing at the City’s Edge — The Sound Chapter.” In the middle of writing, she hit a bottleneck, stood up, and arranged the remaining flowers (freesias, eucalyptus leaves, and dried branches) using Ikenobo-style principles. After finishing, she took a photo and shared it with her friend Su Man. The touch of her fingers brought inspiration, and she resumed writing with the texture of “touch” as the thread, comparing the noisy food market to a frosted cloth bag. The writing flowed smoothly, and she completed the day’s writing goal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing lunch and reading during the lunch break.
description: Went to the kitchen to prepare a simple lunch, heated up porridge, and stir-fried a light dish of loofah with eggs, then had lunch with my parents. After the meal, I sat on the living room sofa reading "Teahouse Life at Southwest Associated University." Reading the chapter where the university students read and discussed in the teahouse, I felt transported.
location: Dining room and living room at home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Chengdu trip planning and reservations.
description: After the lunch break, she had a voice call with her book friend Yang Xiao to finalize the Chengdu itinerary: fly to Chengdu on the afternoon of April 12 and return on April 21; set a route for visiting independent bookstores such as Wuzhao Bookstore and Duben Book House; arrange a visit to Guanyin Pavilion Old Teahouse and a one-day trip to Qingcheng Mountain on April 15. Then she booked round-trip second-class high-speed rail tickets from Kunming South Station to Chengdu East Station (974 yuan in total) and a female dorm bed at Lazy Bones Youth Hostel near Eastern Suburb Memory (320 yuan for April 13-20). Next, she studied the Chengdu metro network, marked the destinations on the map, planned a route mainly using Lines 2 and 7, and began making a wish list.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanied my mother on the balcony to get some fresh air.
description: Brewed rose tea for my mother, helped her to the rattan chair on the balcony, and we chatted. She shared amusing stories from a business trip to Chengdu in her youth, when she visited People's Park, which added to my anticipation for travel.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stroll at Green Lake Park
description: Changed into sneakers and walked to Green Lake Park. The evening temperature was comfortable. I strolled along the willow-shaded path by the lake, used my phone to capture the late-spring willow shadows and lake light, and sat quietly on a rock by the water for a while to clear my mind.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Massage mother's ankles.
description: After returning home from the park, she applied a warm towel to her mother's injured ankle, sprayed on Yunnan Baiyao aerosol, and gently massaged it. Her mother felt much more comfortable and praised her for being attentive.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: After work, her father cooked stir-fried bitter melon and braised pork ribs. The family of three sat around the table for dinner and shared what they had seen and heard during the day. Sun Yuwei talked about the finalized Chengdu trip and had her parents' support.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal: planning a wish list for the Chengdu trip.
description: After dinner, in the study, she took out the 'Chengdu Trip' journal spread, and using colored pens and her drawing skills, carefully made a wish list, wrote down the specialties of each shop, and drew small illustrations, further refining her travel plan.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading: “Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Dao”
description: She brewed a cup of ancient-tree sun-dried black tea, sat in the tea corner of the study, and read the chapter on 'tea and calming the mind' from 'Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way'. She casually wrote down a reflection with a pencil: 'Tea is a moment of peace, and also a reunion with oneself.'
location: Tea corner by the window in the home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: In the bedroom, she called her sister Sun Yutong via video to share the excitement of finalizing the Chengdu itinerary and show off the journal pages she had just completed. Her sister suggested going to Heming Teahouse in People's Park to experience gaiwan tea. The two chatted happily for half an hour, with laughter throughout.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal reflection and plan for tomorrow
description: After hanging up, she wrote today's reflection in her journal: “Use flower arranging to break through the writer's block and make the chaos clear. Taking care of my mother made me feel the weight of home.” She also planned tasks for tomorrow: go to the Yunnan University Chenggong Campus library in the morning to look up the oral history materials recommended by her advisor, and in the afternoon draft the sixth piece of “Breathing at the Edge of the City,” “The Territory of Scents.”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: She went into the bathroom to shower, changed into comfortable pajamas, then did 5 minutes of simple leg stretches and 3 minutes of meditation on the bed to calm her thoughts from the day and let herself drift into sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Turned off the main light, kept the bedside reading lamp on, and continued reading the chapter 'The Years of Pu'er' from 'Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way' in bed. When the flavor was strongest, she closed the book and turned off the light, falling asleep in anticipation and tranquility.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and health measurements
description: At 7:00 in the morning the alarm went off. After turning off the phone, I opened the curtains; it was cloudy outside and the sky was barely light. I went to the bathroom to wash up, then stepped on the scale. The number stabilized at 45.3 kg, confirming that the anemia treatment was working well. I walked to the window and took five deep breaths, feeling the cool morning air.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and tea tasting
description: I spread out the yoga mat on the balcony and did about 30 minutes of yin yoga stretching, focusing on opening the shoulders and hips, to prepare for the upcoming desk work. Afterward, I sat down in the tea corner and brewed a pot of the newly arrived ancient-tree sun-dried black tea. The liquor was bright orange-red with a rich floral aroma. In my tea-tasting notes I wrote: "The color is bright orange-red; it tastes sweet and mellow on the palate, with a floral fragrance that clings to the cup. Perfect for starting a focused day."
location: Balcony at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and conversation with mother
description: Mother had already cooked small-pot rice noodles, with bright red chili oil. While eating, she asked her mother about her ankle recovery; her mother said it was much better and that she walked much more briskly. She shared the excitement of finalizing the Chengdu itinerary yesterday and told her mother that the flight to Chengdu was set for April 12. Her mother urged her to be careful and stay safe.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning work: setting up the material library and archiving field notes
description: In the study, she wiped clean the desk, opened the MacBook Air, and spent about 30 minutes creating three core folders: 'Essay Collection_Material Bank', 'Published Manuscripts', and 'Pieces to Be Written'. She dragged the transcribed recordings of Qin Mingyuan's interview from the USB drive, photos of the vegetable market sketchbook, and several saved Word documents into the respective folders one by one. Paper materials such as old newspapers, clippings, and hand-drawn maps were also sorted and organized, marked with different colored sticky notes. During a break, she received a WeChat message from editor Xu Mingyuan asking about the progress of the essay collection, and replied, 'I'm organizing the materials and expect to complete the first draft by mid-April.' As she neared the end, she saved all files, rolled her neck, looked out at Green Lake outside the window, reviewed the organization process in her mind, and casually jotted down keywords such as 'black-headed gulls', 'night market', and 'old neighborhood' on a piece of white paper to warm up for choosing the afternoon's topic.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and afternoon rest
description: At noon, my father came home for lunch, and my mother made stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, shredded pork with green peppers, and vegetable soup. As we ate, I listened to my father talk about his experience organizing old photos from the 1950s and 1960s at the Cultural Bureau. After lunch, I took the initiative to clear the dishes, then leaned back on the living room sofa and leafed through Old Stories of Kunming. When I read the description of Zhengyi Road in the 1950s, I silently noted that feeling. Later, I closed my eyes on the sofa and rested for 15 minutes. When I woke up refreshed, I brewed a cup of light tea and replied to Zhang Jing’s flower arrangement in the best friends group chat “Four Seasons,” liking it and saying “Really beautiful.”
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon work: finalize topics, sequence, and schedule
description: Returning to the study, based on the existing 7 chapter outlines, I determined the themes and narrative angles for the remaining 5 chapters: the existential reflection of red-billed gulls (the resonance between migratory birds and urban drifters), the watcher of University Road Night Market (the night and day of the stall owners), the eve of relocation in Zongshuying old community (the neighbors' last group photos and farewells), my father's daily life after retirement (a narrative starting from morning tea), and the subtle breathing relationship between the city and me (closing the book). The writing order was set according to emotional progression: Chapter 4 "Old Teahouse" (first draft already written), Chapter 5 "Red-Billed Gulls", Chapter 6 "Night Market", Chapter 7 "Old Community", Chapter 8 "Father", Chapter 9 "City Breathing". I opened the calendar on my phone and set deadline reminders for each chapter: first draft done by April 15, revisions completed by April 20. Then I updated the full table of contents for "Breath at the City's Edge" in Pages and added the title for Chapter 12. After sitting too long, my neck and shoulders felt sore, so I did some stretching. I took out my journal and wrote solemnly on the "Monthly Plan" page: "Finish the first draft of 'Breath at the City's Edge' by mid-April, and polish it to final form before graduation." Next to it, I drew a simple sketch of tea leaves. The goal felt clear and within reach.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk with mother around Cuihu
description: After changing into my outdoor shoes, I told my mother I was going out and walked east along Renmin Middle Road for about 10 minutes to the south gate of Cuihu Park. My mother was already waiting at the south gate, with light steps. As we walked, she chatted about news on her phone: 'The seagulls at Cuihu Lake are starting to fly back.' Holding her arm, I reported on the progress of my essay collection: 'I've thought of titles for the remaining five pieces, and I can write them by April.' She patted the back of my hand and said, 'Good.' We took a slow loop around the lake, feeling the evening breeze. Then I walked home with my mother along the same path. On the way we saw a roasted erkuai stall, and my mother asked if I wanted to buy some. I replied, 'Let's go home for dinner.'
location: Cuihu Park and surrounding trails, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: When I got home, Dad had already helped bring out the dishes. Mom had made pickled cabbage fish and stir-fried choy sum. As we ate and chatted, Dad asked about the Chengdu trip plans. I explained the bookstore-and-teahouse route from April 12 to 15 in detail, and he nodded in approval. After dinner, I took the initiative to help Mom clean up and wash the dishes.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: After drying her hands, she returned to the study and placed a video call to her sister Sun Yutong. She excitedly told her that the Chengdu itinerary had been finalized: she had booked a high-speed train ticket for the morning of the 12th and the return trip for the 21st, and had set a schedule for the essay collection, with the first draft to be completed by mid-April. Her sister was very happy after hearing this and said she wanted to be the first to read it. She also asked about their parents' health, and Sun Yuwei told her that their mother's foot injury had healed, reassuring her. The two chatted for about half an hour.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal review and quiet reading
description: After hanging up the phone, she returned to the study, opened her journal, and recorded in detail today's creative plans and progress. Flipping to yesterday's page (March 26), she wrote down her gratitude for the inspiration and unblocking that flower arranging had brought. Then she picked up Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way and read two articles under the bedside lamp, feeling calm and determined.
location: Home study and bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stretching and meditation before bed
description: Remembering that she had been sitting all day and her shoulders were sore, she changed into pajamas and first did a few simple relaxation moves on the yoga mat, then did about 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, fully moving her joints and relieving the soreness. Then she sat cross-legged and did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath and emptying her mind, so her body and mind were completely relaxed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After washing up in the bathroom and applying skin care products, she returned to bed, picked up 'Old Tales of Kunming', and read the last few pages. When she read the description of an old tea house from the 1980s, she thought the detail could be used in her fifth essay. She set the alarm for 7:00 tomorrow, turned off the overhead light, and left only the night light on. Closing her eyes, she reviewed the day's routine: the materials had been archived, the theme had been finalized, the schedule had been set, and the Chengdu trip was properly arranged. She felt grounded and clear-headed. After about ten minutes, her breathing gradually evened out and she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine.
description: In the early morning, she did a 30-minute vinyasa yoga practice on the south-facing balcony, including Sun Salutation warm-up, Warrior II, and Triangle Pose, and ended with neck and shoulder relaxation and meditation. Then, in the tea corner of the study, she brewed ten-year-aged ripe pu-erh in a white porcelain gaiwan. The tea liquor was bright wine-red and clear, with a mellow, thick mouthfeel like rice water. She recorded the tea-tasting experience and the changes in aroma in her journal, and pasted in that day's calendar paper. Afterward, she had breakfast with her parents, enjoying the beef rice noodles her mother had made, garnished with chives and mint. As they ate, her father talked about the district culture bureau's weekend activities, and her mother shared interesting stories about the Cuihu neighbors. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning writing and a walk around Cuihu Lake.
description: In the study, using a MacBook Air, I continued writing the sixth essay, "Kunming's Old Teahouses," drawing inspiration from notes on "Old Tales of Kunming" and "Teahouse Life at the National Southwestern Associated University," depicting the intellectual collisions of literati in Republican-era teahouses. Midway, my thoughts got stuck, so I went for a walk in Green Lake Park to observe weeping willows and black-headed gulls, used my phone to photograph light and shadows on the water. After inspiration reignited, I returned home to continue writing, smoothly finished the closing paragraph of the first draft, and recorded my progress on the journaling creation page.
location: Home study at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Green Lake Park on Cuihu South Road

name: Lunch and rest
description: Had a light lunch with my mother, enjoying tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. After the meal, I took the initiative to help clear the dishes, then briefly browsed social media on my phone in the bedroom to relax.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus
description: After packing her notebook, fountain pen, and prose materials, she set out from home and walked to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, then took Metro Line 1 to University City Station. On the way, she read excerpts of essays by the writer Chen Wenxuan on her phone in the carriage, warming up for the afternoon lecture. The whole journey took about 105 minutes, from the city center to the Chenggong campus.
