location: Kunming Metro Line 1, Yunnan Province (Huashan West Road Station to University City Station)

name: Strolling on campus and attending a literature lecture
description: Arriving early at Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus, she ran into her roommate Zhao Xiaowen, who had just come out of the library, while walking on the tree-lined path near Ziyuan Canteen, and they briefly talked about their recent daily lives. She then went to the lecture hall of the School of Literature to attend the lecture "Local Writing in Prose Creation" given by Chen Wenxuan, and took a seat near the front. During the lecture, Teacher Chen shared his writing habit of observing at the old-street vegetable market in Kunming and proposed that "locality is not exoticism, but a shared breath after deep rooting," which stirred strong resonance in her. She took detailed notes. During the Q&A session, she gathered her courage to ask how to avoid a travelogue-style enumeration of local details and received the answer: "The key is an emotional anchor - start from people's real reactions." She gained a lot.
location: Lecture Hall, School of Literature, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and campus roads

name: Post-lecture discussion and small campus gathering
description: After the lecture, she queued for a signature. Teacher Chen Wenxuan recognized Sun Yuwei and praised her insightful question, encouraging her to travel more, observe more, and immerse herself in life. She was given a signed copy of the book 'Distant Mountains and Echoes'. Afterwards, she contacted her roommate Zhao Xiaowen via WeChat, and the two met at a campus milk tea shop, ordered brown sugar pearl milk tea, and excitedly shared the lecture's takeaways and creative reflections. They chatted for half an hour about campus life and writing progress in a pleasant atmosphere.
location: Outside the School of Literature Lecture Hall at Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the on-campus milk tea shop

name: Commuting back to Wuhua District
description: After saying goodbye to her roommate, she went to University City Metro Station and took Line 1 back to the city center. On the way, she eagerly opened the newly gifted copy of 'Distant Mountains and Echoes,' savoring the delicate prose in the preface and feeling full of strength; the nearly two-hour commute didn't seem long at all.
location: Kunming Metro Line 1, Yunnan Province, from University Town Station to Dongfeng Square Station.

name: Yoga class and post-class shopping journal
description: Attended He Lu's flow yoga class on time. With the instructor's assistance, she tried a side plank variation and successfully held it for 5 seconds, making a breakthrough in core strength. After class, she walked home and stopped by Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on the way to buy Gannan navel oranges and blueberries her mother likes. After returning home, she washed her face, carefully recorded the lecture's key points, her feelings about asking questions, and the yoga breakthrough in her journal in the study, and pasted in photos taken at Cuihu.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street; and home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Help prepare dinner.
description: Sun Yuwei washed the blueberries she had bought and handed them to her mother, then helped pick vegetables and peel garlic. Mother and daughter chatted while preparing the meal in the kitchen. Sun Yuwei excitedly recounted Teacher Chen's answer from the lecture; her mother listened with a smile, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home kitchen, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: After her father came home from work, the family of three enjoyed the stir-fried celtuce and braised pork ribs her mother had made. Sun Yuwei gave a full account of the day's lecture gains and her yoga breakthrough. Her parents were happy for her, and the whole family agreed to go to Cuihu Park together on the weekend.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and article revision
description: In the study, I carefully read the first two chapters of Distant Mountains and Echoes and was moved by the book's southern narrative and detailed descriptions. Inspired by it, I opened my computer and made partial revisions to that day's draft of Old Teahouses in Kunming, trying to incorporate Teacher Chen Wenxuan's “emotional anchor” concept and more delicate sensory descriptions.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: I initiated a video call with my older sister Sun Yutong, who is far away in Shenzhen, sharing the highlights of the lecture Q&A and my creative insights, and I was praised by my sister. The two of us also discussed the details of next month's cultural trip to Chengdu. My sister reminded me to check the weather on Mount Qingcheng in advance and bring suitable clothes. The conversation was warm, and I felt reassured.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal reflection and tomorrow's plan
description: After the video call ended, I went back to the study and wrote down the day's highlights in my journal: my question being affirmed by Teacher Chen, and my breakthrough in a yoga pose. Based on the afternoon's inspiration, I planned to deepen the first draft of "Kunming's Old Teahouses" on Saturday morning, and try using the "emotional anchor" concept in my writing practice.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Stretching and meditation before bed
description: She did 15 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching on the bedroom balcony to relieve muscle tension from sitting for a long time and after yoga. After changing into her pajamas, she sat on the cushion at the edge of the bed for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath and emptying her mind to prepare for sleep.
location: Home bedroom balcony and bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, I leafed through Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way and read an essay about Pu'er tea, savoring the taste of the morning tea. When I felt sleepy, I put down the book and turned off the bedside lamp, falling asleep at around 00:10.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and applying sunscreen for the first time
description: In the early morning, she spread a yoga mat on the balcony and completed 30 minutes of vinyasa yoga to stretch her body. Then she carefully applied the newly purchased SPF50 sunscreen, took a photo and sent it to her close friends' group, marking it as “Sun Protection Day.” She brewed Bangdong raw pu-erh tea and wrote “First record of Sun Protection Day” in her tea tasting log, deciding to incorporate applying sunscreen into her fixed morning routine.
location: Balcony at home, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast Together and Family Agreement
description: Had breakfast with my parents, enjoying the steamed dumplings and rice noodles my mother prepared. During the chat, we decided to go for a walk around Green Lake at around 10:30 in the morning; I would go out to run errands first and then come back to pick them up. Father nodded in agreement, and Mother talked about the fork in the road from last night's walk.
location: Home dining room on Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Carefully prepared a gift for a gathering with close friends
description: In the study, I picked out Li Juan's Remember One, Forget Two or Three and Shu Guozhi's The Ideal Afternoon, carefully wrapped them in kraft paper, tied them with twine, and tucked in eucalyptus leaves. On a journal card, I wrote a blessing and clipped it under the twine.
location: Study at home, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Skin care and shopping
description: She booked the basic cleansing and hydration treatment at Yuerong Skin Care Studio via a mobile app and walked about 10 minutes to 98 Fuchun Street. At the studio, she received a basic facial care session from the beautician, including makeup removal, facial steaming, ultrasonic cleansing, blackhead treatment, and ice hammer soothing for the skin. The beautician reminded her that UV rays were strong and she needed sun protection, and Sun Yuwei asked about sunscreen products. After the treatment, she chose a 158-yuan combination physical and chemical sunscreen at the checkout counter, paid with WeChat Pay, and pasted the receipt into her notebook. She shared a makeup-free photo on WeChat Moments, and her best friend Zhang Jing commented and liked it. She then left the studio and began walking home.
location: Yuerong Skin Management Studio, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home to rest and enjoy family time at Green Lake Park.
description: After walking home from the studio, she rested briefly, put the new sunscreen on the bathroom vanity, and added an "apply sunscreen" step to her morning journal. Then she walked with her parents from home to the south gate of Green Lake Park. In the park, they strolled along the lakeside, admired the cherry blossoms, watched old men playing chess, and enjoyed the sunshine and lake views. Later, they went to the Lingxian Liangfen shop on Green Lake West Road, where the three of them tasted the sweet-and-sour pea flour jelly and fried potatoes, eating in the shade while watching people walk their birds, enjoying a pleasant family time.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Lingxian Liangfen (Green Lake West Road Branch), Xishan District

name: Afternoon: writing, reading, tidying the study, and meditation
description: In the study, she opened her MacBook Air and, based on the concept of 'emotional anchors' from Teacher Chen Wenxuan's lecture the day before, deepened her revision of 'Old Teahouses of Kunming', adding delicate sensory descriptions. During breaks in the revision, she brewed ripe pu-erh tea and sipped it while thinking. After writing, she tidied the desk and tea corner, washed her hands, then did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation in the corner of the study, relaxing with white noise.
location: Study at home, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking around the neighborhood and shopping at the supermarket
description: After meditating, she put on her running shoes and jogged along Renmin Middle Road toward Fuchun Street to get some fresh air. On the way, she stopped at City Garden Supermarket and bought two boxes of blueberries and the yogurt her mother liked. Along the way, she called her book club friend Yang Xiao, shared her insights from the lecture, and agreed on a meeting time for their trip to Chengdu next month.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Renmin Middle Road and Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helped prepare dinner and had family dinner
description: After getting home, she took the initiative to help her mother wash vegetables, rinsed the blueberries they bought and arranged them on a plate, and cut tomatoes. She chatted with her parents about interesting stories from Chengdu she had heard from Yang Xiao. During dinner, they talked about their afternoon walk around Cuihu Lake, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home on Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and video call with sister
description: After dinner, she organized her journal in the study, pasting in the morning's skin-care receipt, a sunscreen sample, and a screenshot of Zhang Jing's Moments post, and recorded her feelings about "Protection Day." Then she had a video call with her older sister Sun Yutong, showing the results of the skin-care treatment. Her sister praised her complexion and recommended the moisturizing spray she used, so Sun Yuwei noted the brand.
location: Study at home, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading, writing postcards, and evening skincare
description: After the video call, she read Chapter 3 of Chen Wenxuan's Distant Mountains and Echoes and underlined key passages. Then she picked a Green Lake scenery postcard and wrote to book friend Yang Xiao, sharing insights from the lecture. While washing up, she followed the beautician's method: she used cleansing oil and an amino acid facial cleanser to thoroughly remove sunscreen, applied hyaluronic acid moisturizer, and massaged it in.
location: Home study and washroom, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and bedtime reading to ease into sleep
description: After changing into my pajamas, I did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation in the bedroom to unwind from the day's exhaustion. Then I lay in bed reading the 'Calming the Mind' chapter of 'Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way.' When sleepiness came, I turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home bedroom, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and heading to the yoga studio
description: The alarm went off at 7:30. Sun Yuwei woke up, stretched, and realized it was Sunday; she felt relaxed. After getting up, she followed her morning skincare routine: washed her face with a gentle cleanser, carefully applied sunscreen, the touch of her fingertips feeling fresh with a citrus scent. She changed into yoga clothes, picked up her yoga mat and water bottle, put on earphones to play light music, and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. Heading west along Renmin Middle Road, passing familiar streetscape and crossing a quiet alley, she arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio in Dechun Commercial Building after about 12 minutes.
location: Start from home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and walk to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road.

name: Morning vinyasa flow yoga class (core and balance)
description: At 8:05, she arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, checked in, put her belongings in the locker, and laid out her yoga mat at the back of the studio. At 8:15, the class began on time as instructor He Lu led a vinyasa flow practice themed 'core and balance'. Sun Yuwei focused on her breath and postures, moving from cat-cow to one-legged downward dog, and finally held a side plank variation for a full 8 seconds, feeling a surge of accomplishment. After class, everyone sat together in a circle and meditated for 5 minutes, and she felt her body and mind become soft and calm.
location: Large Classroom, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rest after yoga class and morning tea journaling
description: After the yoga class, she said goodbye to the instructor and fellow students, and Sun Yuwei walked home. On the way, she deliberately detoured into the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at No. 98 Fuchun Street, buying a bottle of mineral water and a pack of soda crackers as supplies, as well as blueberries her mother likes. After arriving home, she took a quick shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. Then she sat down at the tea corner by the window in the study, brewed the leftover Bangdong raw pu-erh from yesterday in a white porcelain lidded bowl, and sipped it slowly. She opened her journal, noted down her thoughts from the morning class, and wrote: "After yoga class, my skin feels translucent; sunscreen and morning light complement each other."
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (passing by Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at No. 98 Fuchun Street)

name: Breakfast and a short chat with mother
description: Mother Li Xiulan brought out freshly steamed rice cakes and homemade assorted vegetables, along with a cup of hot milk. While eating breakfast, Sun Yuwei chatted with her mother about the morning yoga class and told her that she would meet her close friend at Wenhua Lane in the afternoon. Her mother smiled and reminded her to take an umbrella, saying the weather forecast predicted possible showers in the afternoon.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing prose material and developing creative ideas.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to the study and opened her laptop. Instead of rushing to write a new draft, she first organized the source material library for her essay collection Breathing at the Edge of the City. She carefully recorded in the corresponding documents the sentences related to emotional anchors that she had copied yesterday from Distant Mountains and Echoes, as well as several images she had thought of for future writing (such as the tailor shop on the old street and a beam of light after the farmers' market closes). This sorting work gave her a clearer sense of the manuscript's structure and settled her mind.
location: Study desk at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and party preparations
description: Mother made Sun Yuwei's favorite tomato-and-egg noodles. After the meal, she took the initiative to help clear the dishes. Back in her bedroom, she prepared for the afternoon get-together with her close friends: she took from the bookshelf two books wrapped in kraft paper—Li Juan's Remember One, Forget Two or Three and Shu Guozhi's The Ideal Afternoon—and double-checked the handwriting on the card. She changed into an off-white cotton-linen dress with a light green scarf, looking gentle and spirited, and put the moisturizing spray recommended by her sister into her canvas bag.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Spring gathering with close friends at Bookworm Café.
description: At 1 p.m., Sun Yuwei picked up her canvas bag with the gifts and her phone and set out from home. She chose to take a detour along Wenlin Street, enjoying the dappled sunlight through the plane trees and the calm before the gathering. She arrived at the Bookworm Cafe early, sat in a corner by the window on the second floor, and ordered a drink for each of the three: Silver Needle white tea for herself, osmanthus latte for Zhang Jing, and salted caramel macchiato for Chen Sisi. Soon after, Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi pushed the door open together, and the three hugged with laughter. During the gathering, Sun Yuwei shared the progress of her essay collection to put them at ease; Zhang Jing talked about the stress of students fighting in her class and the open class; Chen Sisi excitedly told them that the new media art exhibition she had curated was about to open. They encouraged one another, and Sun Yuwei took the opportunity to suggest going to Anning to soak in hot springs before the summer vacation, which was unanimously approved. She gave them the wrapped books and recommended a hydrating mist to Chen Sisi. The gathering was relaxed and pleasant. They took a group photo and agreed to go see Chen Sisi's exhibition together next weekend.
location: Window corner on the second floor of Bookworm Café, No. 52-2 Wenhua Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home and family dinner
description: At 5 p.m., after hugging her best friend goodbye at the café entrance, Sun Yuwei walked back alone along Wenhua Lane. The evening breeze dispersed the heat of an afternoon of lively conversation. She savored moments from the gathering in her mind, especially Zhang Jing's line that teachers also need to be seen, and thought it could be used in a future article. When she got home, her parents had already prepared dinner: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed sea bass, and tofu soup. During the meal, she shared fun stories from the afternoon gathering and told her father that Chen Sisi was going to hold an exhibition. Her father, Sun Jianguo, was delighted and said he would go see it if he had the chance.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organized publication records and journal inspiration.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to the study, opened her laptop, and quickly tallied the titles, platforms, and word counts of the articles she had published this month in Cultural Horizons and on other platforms, then created a new document named “April Pending Submissions List” with several topic ideas, completing the whole process efficiently. Afterward, she turned off the computer, opened her journal, and used colored pencils to trace the small patterns from the menu at Bookworm Café, recording the funny moments and touching points from today's gathering. She neatly wrote Zhang Jing's words, “Teachers also need to be seen,” and the suggestion about Anning Hot Springs on a dedicated material page. As the journal gradually filled with color and words, she felt a solid sense of satisfaction.
location: Study desk at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading of Remembering One, Forgetting Three or Two.
description: She picked up the book 'Remembering One, Forgetting Two or Three' that she had saved for herself from the bedside, and leaned against the headboard to read comfortably. Li Juan's writing was clean and funny, making her laugh out loud; she read about 40 pages in one go. In the middle, her mother Li Xiulan knocked and brought her a glass of hot milk.
location: Bedside in the bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mindfulness meditation to relax.
description: After reading, Sun Yuwei turned off the main light and kept only the bedside lamp. She spread a yoga mat on the floor, sat cross-legged, opened the meditation app on her phone, and played a 15-minute body scan meditation. She moved her attention slowly upward from her toes, feeling every part of her body, and finally let her thoughts settle, ending a fulfilling and warm day.
location: On the yoga mat in the bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Contact sister and prepare for bed.
description: After meditation, Sun Yuwei picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, telling her that the sunscreen she used today felt great and not to worry, and sharing her plan to visit Chen Sisi's exhibition next week. Her sister quickly replied with a thumbs-up emoji. Then she set her alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning and got ready for bed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading before bed.
description: She continued flipping through the book Remember One, Forget Three or Two beside her, or scrolling through her phone for interesting content, enjoying the leisurely time before bed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: In her warm bed, Sun Yuwei closed her eyes, savored the fulfilling day, soon fell into a peaceful sleep, and recharged for tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake up, do morning yoga, and enjoy tea.
description: At 6:45 in the morning, she woke up naturally in the gentle morning light, full of energy. After a quick wash-up, Yuwei and her mother, Li Xiulan, started 30 minutes of morning yoga on the balcony and successfully completed the full set of Sun Salutations. Afterward, she took out the 2013 aged tea nuggets given by her friend Su Man and brewed them in a purple clay teapot. The jujube-red tea liquor gave off a glutinous rice and date aroma and felt smooth on the palate. Yuwei wrote in her journal: at month's end, aged tea soothes body and mind; March dissolves in a cup of tea. Her mother tasted it and praised it repeatedly.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home balcony)

name: Breakfast and morning routine
description: After yoga and tea, Yuwei prepared breakfast with her mother. She warmed milk, toasted bread, and boiled eggs, while her mother cooked her signature small-pot rice noodles. The mother and daughter chatted over breakfast, sharing their sleep quality and plans for an evening walk. Her mother complimented her on looking well. After the meal, Yuwei cleared the dishes on her own.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Home Restaurant)

name: Morning skincare and outfit change.
description: Yuwei went back to her bedroom and bathroom, carefully applied SPF50 sunscreen and basic moisturizer. She felt her skin was in good condition and regarded applying sunscreen as a ritual to start the day. Then she changed into comfortable loungewear and prepared to begin the morning's work.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home bedroom, bathroom)

name: Morning work planning and reading.
description: Yuwei opened her MacBook Air in the study to browse the day's work goals, then read about 40 minutes of Chen Wenxuan's Distant Mountains and Echoes. The book's insights on daily life and essay writing resonated with her; she underlined key points with a pen and wrote annotations.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Organized this month's journal and writing materials.
description: In Notability on her MacBook Air, Yuwei systematically organized March’s journal photos and writing materials. She created a new folder “2025-03” and filed photos of yoga, tea tasting, gatherings, and so on by date. At the same time, she renamed drafts of articles published in March as “date-title” and consolidated them into the “2025 Q1 Essay Collection Material Library.” Looking at the three completed articles, she felt a strong sense of fulfillment.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Midday break and contacting my sister
description: After two hours of continuous work, Yuwei got up to stretch and walked to the window to look at the street view. She picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen: “Sis, what was that moisturizing spray you recommended last time? I’m almost out and want to buy another bottle.”
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Family lunch.
description: Mother made tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried bok choy, and pork rib soup. Father Sun Mingyuan also came home for lunch. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting about funny stories from Father's workplace and Yuwei's feelings about organizing her materials that morning. She also showed her latest tea-tasting notes. The atmosphere was warm and happy.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Home Restaurant)

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, Yuwei helped her mother clear the table, then went back to her bedroom to rest with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes. The short break made her more energetic in the afternoon.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Plan April's thesis and creative work progress
description: Full of energy, Yuwei sat back at her desk and opened Excel to make a detailed plan for April. She divided the worksheet into three modules: 1. Thesis progress, broken down into completing the literature review by April 10, completing the interview by April 15, and submitting the first draft by the end of the month; 2. Essay collection sprint, setting a goal of two pieces per week, highlighting the need to finish before April 18; 3. Chengdu trip preparation, detailing the itinerary and listing the bookstores and teahouses she wanted to visit. She also set healthy habit goals such as 'yoga three times a week,' 'daily sunscreen,' and 'tea tasting.' After completing the plan, she took photos with her phone and sent them separately to her advisor Professor Wu Mingyuan and editor Xu Mingyuan, with a note asking for advice, and quickly received brief but positive replies.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Afternoon tea and a short rest
description: After three consecutive hours of planning work, Yuwei felt tired, paused her tasks, and brewed a cup of rose tea with a few soda crackers. She walked to the living room sofa, sat down, and scrolled through the Moments on her phone, seeing her friend Zhang Jing share students' essays and Chen Sisi share an exhibition preview.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home living room).

name: Get ready to go out and apply sunscreen
description: After finishing afternoon tea, Yuwei went back to the study to tidy up the tea set, preparing to take a walk with her mother by Green Lake. She carefully applied SPF50 sunscreen to her face and arms again, feeling as if she were putting on an invisible protective suit, and then went out with her mother.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home)

name: Evening walk around Green Lake
description: At 5 p.m., Yuwei and her mother walked about 5 minutes to Cuihu Park. They strolled slowly along the lakeside path, watching the pleasure boats on the lake and the Sleeping Beauty peak of the Western Hills in the distance, while discussing the packing list for the Chengdu trip. Her mother suggested she bring a light jacket to cope with the temperature difference between morning and evening.
location: Little Bird Park (Green Lake Park), Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Met a neighbor on the way back from a walk.
description: On the way back from the walk, when they reached the entrance of the residential community, they ran into Aunt Xie Xiulan, their neighbor across the landing. She had just come back from her daughter's house, carrying a cloth bag printed with the words 'Sunshine Blue Sky Kindergarten'. She greeted them happily and handed over homemade flower cakes wrapped in oil paper, saying, 'Yuwei, out for a walk with your mother again? Come, come, these are flower cakes I made myself, fresh out of the oven. Take them home and have a taste!' Yuwei and her mother quickly thanked her and accepted the cakes. The three chatted for a while, and they learned that Aunt Xie's grandson attends Sunshine Blue Sky Kindergarten, and that she had picked up the cakes from her daughter's house after picking up her grandson from school.
location: Entrance of Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Assist with dinner preparation
description: Walking home, Yuwei felt warm inside and helped her mother prepare dinner. She washed and cut the cucumbers and tomatoes, while her mother made stir-fried green peppers with pork and a cucumber salad. The kitchen was filled with the homely smell of cooking. After the busy preparation, a refreshing dinner was ready.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Home Kitchen)

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home, and the family had dinner together. Yuwei shared in detail the April plan she had made that afternoon, mentioning her thesis, the prose collection, and the Chengdu trip. Her parents were very supportive, and her father reminded her to be safe during the Chengdu trip. Her mother mentioned that a neighbor had sent over flower cakes, and her father joked that Auntie Xie had always been warmhearted. The atmosphere at the dinner table was harmonious, and the family chatted as they ate.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Home Restaurant)

name: Housework and a brief rest
description: After dinner, Yuwei rushed to wash the dishes and tidy up the kitchen. Then she sat with her mother on the living room sofa to watch the TV news for a while. While chatting, she broke off a small piece of the flower cake that Aunt Xie had given them and shared it with her mother. Indeed, the crust was flaky and the filling fragrant, with a rich rose flavor.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home living room).

name: Evening tea tasting and month-end reflection
description: Yuwei returned to the study and lit the sandalwood incense her friend Su Man had given her, and a peaceful aroma filled the room. She took a serving of ancient-tree raw pu’er from the tea canister and brewed it in a gaiwan. In the lingering fragrance of tea and sandalwood, she opened her journal and wrote neatly on the last page of March: “March: from a yoga habit to a tea-table ritual, from 3 essays to 1 possible publication. Life is like brewing tea—you can’t rush it. April: steadily finish the first draft and bring an empty cup to Chengdu.” She closed the journal, her heart full of anticipation for the future.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Evening skincare and bedtime reading
description: Yuwei returned to the bedroom and carefully completed her evening skincare routine with cleansing oil and an amino acid facial cleanser. After changing into pajamas, she leaned against the headboard, picked up Distant Mountains and Echoes, and finished reading Chapter 4. The words in the book made her feel calm.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home bedroom, bathroom)

name: Mindful meditation and falling asleep
description: Yuwei turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside nightlight. She sat cross-legged and did a 15-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath and letting the day's thoughts slowly settle. After the meditation, she set her phone alarm for 7:00 tomorrow, turned off the light, and soon fell asleep, feeling fulfilled and orderly.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning family yoga, reading aloud, and skincare
description: At 6:45 in the morning, the alarm went off and I woke up naturally. In the living room, my mother had already laid out the yoga mats. Together we completed a 30-minute vinyasa yoga session, focusing on the flow of breath and temporarily letting go of my anxiety about the thesis. At 7:15, my mother went to prepare breakfast, and I stayed in the living room, using a mobile app to read along with a 20-minute Mandarin prose reading, a habit I've had recently. At 7:35, I returned to the bedroom, carefully applied SPF50 sunscreen, and finished my basic skincare routine.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and confirmation of weekend exhibition plans.
description: At 7:50, the whole family sat around the table enjoying breakfast—the small-pot rice noodles and fried eggs my mom made. While eating, I chatted with my parents about today's plan—to go to school and submit the thesis draft. At the same time, I took out my phone and sent a message in the "Back Wave Three Sisters" bestie group chat to confirm the specific time for going together to see Chen Sisi's new media art exhibition this weekend (April 5 or 6), and arranged for everyone to discuss it again in the evening.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparation before going out
description: At 8:30, I returned to the study and did a final check of my backpack: the printed thesis (placed in three different colored folders just in case), a USB drive with the electronic version of the thesis, a laptop, a power bank, a notebook, and pens. Once everything was ready, I put on my canvas bag and changed into canvas shoes at the door.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus
description: 9:00, I walked 5 minutes from home to Dongfeng Square Station on Metro Line 2. After the train departed, I put on my earphones but didn't listen to music; instead, I closed my eyes and silently reviewed the core framework and conclusions of my paper in my mind. About 40 minutes later, the train arrived at Chunrong Street Station, and I transferred to Bus Z10. On the bus, I opened the memo on my phone and jotted down a few questions I wanted to discuss with my advisor. At around 9:55, I arrived at Yunnan University Chenggong Campus.
location: Kunming Metro Line 2 (Dongfeng Square Station to Chunrong Street Station), transfer to Bus Z10 to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus

name: Submit the first draft of the graduation thesis and discuss it with the advisor.
description: At 10:00, I knocked on Teacher Wu's office door on time, and he nodded for me to come in. I handed him the printed thesis and a USB drive, briefly reported the thesis topic, research methods, and main findings, and frankly expressed my concern about theoretical depth. Teacher Wu flipped through the table of contents and the conclusion, said the framework was clear and logically coherent, said he would provide detailed review comments within a week, and encouraged me to start preparing the defense PPT. At 11:00, I thanked him and left the office. The heavy weight in my heart was finally lifted, and I felt a sense of relief, but I was also vaguely worried about the “theoretical depth” issue Teacher Wu had mentioned.
location: Office of Professor Wu Mingyuan, School of Literature, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxing on campus and heading back.
description: At 11:10, I didn't leave school immediately but took a slow walk along the ginkgo path near the School of Literature. The April sunlight cast dappled shadows through the new leaves. Breathing deeply the scent of grass and earth, my tense nerves gradually relaxed. I took a photo of the new buds on the branches and sent it to the family group chat with the caption, 'After submitting the first draft, I feel like I've sprouted new buds too.' At 11:20, I walked to the bus stop, and at 11:30 I boarded the returning Z10 bus.
location: Ginkgo Road near the School of Literature, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Z10 bus stop

name: Midday commute and heading home.
description: At 11:40 I arrived at Chunrong Street subway station and boarded the return train. The car was not crowded. I took out my phone and saw that my parents had liked my post in the family group chat, and the close-friends group had replied to set a time for the evening. I was in a good mood. I opened the music app and shuffled a light folk song. At 12:20 I exited the station and walked; at 12:25 I opened the front door and smelled the aroma of home-cooked food.
location: Kunming Metro Line 2 (Chunrong Street Station to Dongfeng Square Station), then walked home to Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch and midday rest
description: At 12:30, the whole family had lunch together. On the table were my mother's stir-fried cured meat with garlic sprouts, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and green vegetable soup. My parents asked about the thesis submission, and I shared how I had just felt. My father praised me for being organized. After the meal, I helped my mother clear the dishes, then went back to my room, set an alarm for 13:20, lay on the bed with my eyes closed to rest, and did a brief ten-minute mindful breathing exercise to relax my body and mind.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Zhongmou Yoga Studio.
description: At 13:30, the alarm went off. I changed into my yoga clothes, put on a loose jacket, and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on Dongfeng West Road. The sunlight on the way was just right; as I walked, I gently loosened up my shoulders and neck, preparing for the upcoming class. In less than 15 minutes, I reached the familiar studio entrance.
location: From home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Vinyasa flow group class.
description: At 14:00, the class started on time. Guided by the instructor He Lu, I focused on the flow from Sun Salutation to the Warrior series. My clothes were soaked with sweat, but I felt especially refreshed. After class, I drank some water in the rest area and chatted briefly with He Lu, sharing the joy of submitting my thesis today. She smiled and said, "You look great, you've really opened up." At 15:10, the class ended, and I felt both body and mind were fully stretched and relaxed.
location: Large classroom at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walked home and had a short rest.
description: At 15:10, I walked home. After arriving, I washed my face with warm water, changed into clean, comfortable loungewear, and poured myself a glass of cool boiled water. I felt refreshed and calm, ready for the afternoon tea time.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tasting ancient-tree raw Pu'er tea and establishing a tea archive
description: At 15:30, I sat down at the tea corner I had carefully arranged in my study and took out the 2019 raw pu-erh tea from ancient trees that I had been eager to open since yesterday. Using a tea pick, I carefully pried off 6 grams of tea leaves and placed them in a gaiwan. I boiled water, warmed the cup, and awakened the tea, moving gently and attentively. I poured in water to brew. First, I smelled the lid aroma—a refreshing floral and honey fragrance mingled with a faint aged scent. Then I looked at the liquor color—golden and translucent, gradually turning orange-red. Finally, I tasted it—there was a slight astringency at first, but it quickly dissolved, filling my mouth with saliva and leaving a long, sweet aftertaste. I meticulously recorded the aroma, taste, and physical sensation of each infusion in my journal, comparing them with the ripe pu-erh I usually drink. At 17:00, I spread the brewed leaves on a white porcelain plate, took a photo, and pasted it into my journal, creating a complete 'tea profile' for this new tea. While tasting the tea, my advisor's comment about 'theoretical depth' inadvertently came to mind, but it was quickly diluted by the lingering charm of the tea.
location: Tea corner in the study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening walk at Cuihu Park.
description: At 17:00, my mother suggested going out for a walk. We changed into comfortable shoes and walked to Cuihu Park. In the evening, a gentle breeze brushed our faces at Cuihu, and the setting sun dyed the lake golden. We took a loop around the lake road, taking about 45 minutes. I shared with my mother how I felt about submitting my thesis today and the wonderful tea-tasting experience. We chatted happily, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. At 18:00, we bought some fresh loquats at the park gate and then slowly walked home.
location: Ring Road, Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Help prepare dinner and share a family meal.
description: I arrived home at 18:00 and took the initiative to help my mother in the kitchen, washing vegetables and peeling garlic. At 19:00, dinner began, and the table included braised fish, which my father likes. At the table, I gave a full account of today's meeting with my supervisor. My father listened with great interest and even gave me some advice on preparing for the thesis defense. After the meal, I cleared the table and did the dishes on my own.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening free writing and reading
description: At 19:00, I returned to the study. First I took out my new journal and used a fountain pen to record the important moments and feelings of the day, then I stuck in a fallen leaf I had picked up while walking by Cuihu Lake. Afterward, I opened Distant Mountains and Echoes, which Chen Wenxuan had given me, and continued reading. I was deeply moved by a passage in the book about “the tranquility of writing” and wrote my own thoughts in the margins. The idea of writing was brewing in my mind, and a lingering worry about the theoretical depth of the thesis also surfaced again.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening skincare and family connection.
description: At 20:00, I started my evening skincare routine. At 20:15, while applying hand cream, I sent a very long WeChat voice message to my sister Sun Yutong, far away in Shenzhen, sharing the relief of submitting the first draft and the happy moments I felt today, and mentioning my worries about the theoretical depth of the thesis. Soon, my sister replied with a string of “Great!” and “Proud of you!” and comforted me by saying, “Just do your best,” which made me feel warm inside.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Confirm weekend exhibition plans
description: At 20:30, the best-friends group chat became lively. The three of us finally confirmed that this Saturday (April 5) at 2 p.m. we would go together to see Chen Sisi's new media art exhibition, and we agreed to have dinner together afterward. I marked it on my calendar and started looking forward to the weekend gathering.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime body scan meditation
description: At 20:50, I turned off the main light and kept only a bedside nightlight. I lay in bed and played an audio guide for body-scan meditation, following along to relax every part of my body one by one, from my toes to the top of my head. After 15 minutes, I felt my whole body and mind settle down, and the day's tension, joy, and faint worries slowly faded with each breath.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep
description: After meditation, I picked up the book Ordinary Tea, Extraordinary Way from the bedside, flipped through a few pages of the chapter on Pu'er, and savored the afternoon's tea tasting experience, feeling peaceful inside. At 21:45, I felt drowsiness coming over me, closed the book, turned off the light, and calmly fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning family time and personal rituals
description: She woke up earlier than usual and opened the curtains to a cloudy day. After quickly washing up, she and her mother Li Xiulan spread yoga mats in the living room and did 30 minutes of partner stretching, paying special attention to a few moves for her mother's shoulder and neck discomfort. Then she brewed jasmine tea in a glass on the balcony, carefully watching the flowers unfold. In her journal, she recorded the water temperature, pouring method, tea color, and sweet aftertaste, and made line drawings of the tea leaves. Afterwards, she applied sunscreen and hydrating toner. She shared Jiahua flower cakes and hot milk with her mother for breakfast, while browsing email and WeChat on her phone. She saw an email from her advisor Wu Mingyuan, with comments on the draft sent in the early hours, and decided to look at it more carefully when she got to school.
location: Room 301, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Commuted to Chenggong Campus and read academic literature.
description: Shouldered a backpack containing a laptop and notebooks and headed out, walked to Panjiawan Metro Station, took Line 3 to Dongfeng Plaza Station, and transferred to Line 1 toward University Town. In the subway car, opened the literature app and quickly skimmed an overview article on Lefebvre's theory of “production of space” to prepare for later borrowing and study.
location: Kunming Metro Line 3 and Line 1, Yunnan Province (from Panjiawan Station in Wuhua District to University City Station in Chenggong District)

name: Library borrowing and preliminary study of spatial theory
description: Arriving at the Chenggong Campus Library of Yunnan University, I used my student ID to look up the call numbers at the search desk, then went to the social sciences reading area and checked out Lefebvre’s The Production of Space and Foucault’s Discipline and Punish. I sat down by the window, opened the introduction to The Production of Space, marked key concepts with a highlighter, and wrote down my questions and reflections in my notebook.
location: Social Sciences Reading Area, Floor 2, Yunnan University Library, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and campus walk, receiving feedback from advisor.
description: Leaving the library, she walked to Ziyuan Canteen, ordered the signature small-pot rice noodles with braised tofu and blanched greens, and while eating observed the everyday practices in the canteen space, which reminded her of Lefebvre's theories. After the meal, she strolled along Ze Lake to aid digestion and watched the black swans swim. Her phone vibrated with a WeChat message from her advisor Wu Mingyuan, saying that the comments on the first draft had been sent to her email, pointing out framework issues, and asking for an afternoon meeting. She immediately replied to accept.
location: Ziyuan and Zehu Lake Trail at Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meet with advisor to discuss thesis revision direction
description: She walked quickly to Room 307 on the third floor of the College of Liberal Arts building, where her advisor Wu Mingyuan had already made tea and was waiting. The advisor said the thesis had meticulous observations but was too matter-of-fact, and suggested analyzing the independent bookstore as a 'cultural space.' He recommended The Production of Space and circled three core concepts—spatial practice, representations of space, and representational spaces—as keys for reflection. She took careful notes and felt suddenly enlightened.
location: Room 307, 3rd Floor, School of Literature Building, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting back to the city center.
description: After saying goodbye to her advisor, she took the metro back to the city. In the carriage, she quickly jotted down several breakthrough points from the interview in her phone memo, then decided to go to Shuncheng for skincare shopping, using the pleasure of strolling to digest the new academic information.
location: Kunming Metro Line 1, Yunnan Province (from University Town Station to Huancheng South Road Station, transfer to Line 2 to Wuyi Road Station)

name: Shopping at Shuncheng and walking to the café
description: Arrived at Watsons on the basement level of Shuncheng Shopping Center, tried the hyaluronic acid hydrating toner, and saw that the soothing masks were buy-two-get-one-free. Immediately contacted her best friend Zhang Jing to split the order, and paid after getting a positive reply. In the 'Skincare Journal' note on her phone, she recorded the purchase date, product name, price, and initial impressions. Then she walked along West Dongfeng Road to Really Happy Coffee, located in the direction of Shulin Street.
location: Watsons, B1, Shuncheng Shopping Center, 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Zhen Gaoxing Coffee, 98 Shulin Street, Xishan District

name: Café writing and journal organization.
description: At Zhen Gaoxing Coffee (Shulin Street branch), ordered a signature latte, sat by the window, then opened her computer and journal. First she organized the key points from the meeting with her advisor into a complete revision memo, then pasted the receipt for the newly purchased skincare products into her journal and wrote down her first impressions, drew a sketch of the street outside the window, and finally conceived the opening of a short essay about 'space and memory'.
location: Zhen Gaoxing Coffee (Shulin Street Branch), 98 Shulin Street, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to the food market with her mother, took a walk around Green Lake, and returned home.
description: Walked from the café to the bus stop at the south end of Shulin Street, took Bus No. 62 to Green Lake East Gate stop, and met up with my mother, Li Xiulan, at Green Lake Market. She had already bought spring bamboo shoots and was picking out toon shoots; I was attracted by the sweet fermented rice wine and bought a small portion. Then the two of us strolled along the path around Green Lake. The weather was cool, with a few black-headed gulls on the lake. I gave my mother a detailed account of my conversation with my advisor and the direction of my thesis revisions, and she encouraged me, saying 'take it slow.' Finally, we walked home along Huashan West Road, and when passing the old Chinese parasol tree, I recalled waiting as a child for my father to get off work.
location: Cuihu Vegetable Market, 4 Cuihu South Road, Cuihu Park Lakeside Road, and Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Back home, her father Sun Mingyuan had already brewed some raw Pu’er tea. Her mother had made stir-fried spring bamboo shoots, mushroom and tofu soup, and mint salad. The family of three ate and chatted. Her father asked about the progress of the thesis; when he learned that she had a new idea, he nodded and encouraged her, “Doing scholarship requires patience.”
location: Room 301, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing ideas for revising the paper
description: After the meal, she returned to the study to integrate library notes, interview recordings, and memo ideas. She opened XMind and, with the dialectics of the spatial triad as the core, organized the revision framework for the three chapters of the thesis, highlighting how to apply 'spatial practice, representations of space, and representational spaces' to the analysis of independent bookstores.
location: Study room, Room 301, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discussed postponing the trip with book friends.
description: After organizing the framework, she sent a WeChat voice message to her book friend Yang Xiao, explaining that due to the in-depth revision of her thesis, the originally planned cultural trip to Chengdu on April 12 would have to be postponed to the summer vacation, and she sincerely apologized. Yang Xiao graciously said he understood and joked that hotpot restaurants in Chengdu wouldn't require waiting in line during the summer. They agreed to meet again in the summer.
location: Study room, Room 301, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Close reading of The Production of Space
description: Reopened the borrowed copy of “The Production of Space” and focused on reading Chapter 1, marking it up with three colored pens: red to underline definitions, blue to circle case examples, and green to write down thoughts. She tried to connect the concept of “spatial practice” with Zhen Gaoxing Coffee, which she had visited in the afternoon, and sketched an initial concept map on A4 paper.
location: Study room, Room 301, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening personal care, reading, and meditation
description: After closing the book, she felt tired but fulfilled. She did her evening skincare routine: used the newly bought hyaluronic acid hydrating toner as a wet compress and applied a soothing mask, while soaking her feet and listening to an episode of a podcast about "urban space and literature". After washing up and changing into pajamas, she lay in bed and read a few pages of "Miguel Street". Before turning off the light, she switched on the small bedside lamp and used doodles and keywords in her ring-bound journal to record the core of the day: a spatial-theory cube, a microphone, a ticket-change icon, and a simple drawing of spring bamboo shoots, and wrote down "The mist has cleared; the direction is clear." Then she put on headphones and did a 10-minute guided body scan meditation, gradually relaxing.
location: Room 301, Building 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Falling asleep
description: She turned off the light, put her journal and pen back on the nightstand, and fell into a peaceful sleep with a clear idea of the new framework for her thesis and a sense of inner satisfaction.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga, tea-tasting notes, and family breakfast
description: At 6:50 in the morning, the alarm went off. Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan did partner yoga in the living room, focusing on stretching their shoulders, neck, and back, and then massaged each other afterward. Sun Yuwei then went to the study and continued steeping raw Pu'er tea, carefully savoring the changes in each infusion, and used a green gel pen to record the color, aftertaste, and aroma of the tea in her journal. Then she read aloud Bing Xin's prose work Stars and Spring Water. At 8:15, she had breakfast with her parents. Her mother had made small-pot rice noodles with ham shreds and chopped green onion; her father watched the news. The family discussed the weather for the Qingming Festival, and her mother suggested going to the flower market to shop in the afternoon. Her father reminded them to buy enough incense sticks and candles. After breakfast, Sun Yuwei washed the dishes and tidied up.
location: Home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk to the bookstore and study “The Production of Space”
description: Sun Yuwei packed her canvas bag with The Production of Space, her laptop, a journal, and a pen, changed into a cotton-linen long skirt and a light jacket, and walked from home to the Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. On the way, she saw a fire safety notice at the entrance to the residential community and arrived about 17 minutes later. In the corner by the window of the bookstore, she put on noise-cancelling headphones, systematically studied the first chapter of Lefebvre's The Production of Space, focusing on the triadic dialectic, recorded her questions and reflections on the core concepts in Word, and drew a mind map in her journal. The bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, brought her warm water and recommended a new book, Paris: The Biography of a City, saying it had an intertextual resonance with Lefebvre's theory.
location: Kunming Paper-Cloth-Stone Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Lunch, rest by Cuihu Lake, and a midday nap
description: Sun Yuwei walked from the bookstore to the Sanwan Tofu Pudding Rice Noodle Shop on Qianju Street, ordered a bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles with extra toppings and a glass of papaya water, and browsed book excerpt notes on her phone while eating alone. Then she walked to Green Lake Park, sat on a lakeside bench to watch the red-billed gulls that had not yet flown away, and rested for 15 minutes enjoying the spring breeze. After that, she walked home and found that her mother had already bought apples and oranges for tomb sweeping. After changing into home clothes, she took a 20-minute nap in the bedroom, and after waking up spent 15 minutes tidying her desk, filing away the morning's notebooks, and preparing for the evening's organization.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Went with her mother to the flower market to buy Qingming Festival offerings.
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan walked from home to the Renmin Middle Road bus stop and took Bus 92 to the Jingxing Street Flower Market. On the bus, Sun Yuwei shared her thoughts from that morning's reading, and her mother praised her effective study method. After arriving, they went straight to the memorial supplies shop. Sun Yuwei picked 15 flawless white chrysanthemums with long stems, and her mother bought smoke-free, eco-friendly incense and candles, plus fruit such as fragrant pears and cherry tomatoes. They then browsed the rest of the flower market. When her mother saw fresh edible roses and wanted to make flower cakes, Sun Yuwei chose the freshest pack. On the way back, because they were carrying quite a few things, they took a taxi at the flower market entrance. On the way, they discussed the preparation steps, and her mother said she had already soaked the glutinous rice flour in advance.
location: Kunming Jingxing Flower, Bird and Jewelry World, Jingxing Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Making and tasting flower cakes with mother
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei and her mother put on aprons and started making flower cakes in the kitchen. Sun Yuwei washed the rose petals, drained them, and cured them with white sugar and honey, while her mother deftly kneaded the dough and prepared the flaky oil pastry and the water-oil pastry. The mother-daughter pair worked in perfect sync: Sun Yuwei rolled out the wrappers, her mother filled them, and they arranged the cake rounds on a baking tray, brushed them with egg yolk, sprinkled with sesame seeds, and put them in the oven. Sun Yuwei used her phone to photograph her flour-covered hands, the plump unbaked cakes, and the gradually golden finished pastries in the oven. When they came out, the aroma filled the room. They each tried one—crisp on the outside, sweet and fragrant on the inside—and praised each other's skill.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Family dinner
description: Mother prepared stir-fried spring bamboo shoots, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, cucumber salad, and sweet fermented rice wine for dinner. The family of three ate in the dining room. Sun Yuwei shared photos of the flower cakes she had made in the afternoon, and her father praised them repeatedly. At the table, they confirmed tomorrow's departure time of 9 a.m. for tomb sweeping at Jinbao Mountain and the driving route.
location: Dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk along Green Lake with mother.
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei and her mother changed into flat shoes and walked slowly along the Green Lake path, covering more than half the lake. They confirmed the details of the next day's tomb-sweeping visit again, including what items to bring. Sun Yuwei also shared with her mother her understanding of the concept of family space in her thesis, and her mother expressed support.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Evening study: organizing notes and revising the thesis framework
description: Sun Yuwei entered the study, first recording her thoughts from today's bookstore reading and flower cake making in her journal. Then she turned on the computer, linked the notes from the bookstore with the thesis revision framework drawn yesterday, and filled the gap in the second chapter of the thesis with Lefebvre's thoughts on the representation of space, discovering that the theory could well explain a case of urban spatial transformation.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Online socializing and inspiration exchange
description: Sun Yuwei chatted with her friend Song Wen in Chengdu on WeChat, sent photos of flower cakes, and talked about food, recent rejections, and writing blocks. Song Wen suggested combining spatial theory with urban walks to write an essay, which made Sun Yuwei's eyes light up.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Reading Miguel Street and relaxing with music
description: Feeling a little mentally tired, Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas, moved to sit on the bedroom bay window, opened a playlist of soothing classical music, and picked up Naipaul's Miguel Street to read the "B. Wordsworth" chapter. The poet in the story, who wanted to write a poem about the moon, made her feel both warm and bittersweet, helping to relax her tense nerves.
location: Bay window in the bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening skincare and foot soaking
description: Sun Yuwei used the newly bought hyaluronic acid hydrating lotion for a wet compress, applied a soothing mask, and filled a foot bath bucket with hot water to soak her feet. While soaking, she scrolled through Xiaohongshu and saved a vintage-style journal layout idea.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Tidying up the journal and preparing for tomorrow.
description: Sun Yuwei sat back down at her desk, opened her journal, and wrote down today's three gratitudes: her mother's rice noodles, the book Uncle Qin recommended, and the successful flower cakes. Then she took out a small backpack to prepare items for tomorrow's tomb-sweeping: a bottle of water, wet wipes, and a plastic bag for garbage. She also trimmed the white chrysanthemums, placed them in a vase, and put the vase in the refrigerator to keep them fresh.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China; desk in the bedroom at home.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: Sun Yuwei put on her noise-canceling headphones and followed a 10-minute guided meditation audio to do a body scan, relaxing tense muscles and calming her mind. After the meditation, she turned off the desk lamp and, amid the scent of grass and rose aromatherapy, savored the fulfilling day and fell asleep with reverence for the Qingming tomb-sweeping visit.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China; on the bed in the bedroom at home.

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yuwei was woken by the alarm clock. She opened the curtains and felt the clear, bright sky. She sat quietly in bed for a moment, then did 15 minutes of yoga and stretching on the bedroom floor to loosen her muscles and wake up her body, preparing for the tomb-sweeping and outing later that day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing tomb-sweeping items and family breakfast.
description: Yuwei changed into a white cotton-linen shirt and dark gray trousers. She went to the study, trimmed the white chrysanthemums and daisies, and tied them into two elegant bouquets. Then she went to the kitchen to help her mother set out bowls and chopsticks and boil water for her father. The family sat together and ate small wontons in chicken soup and boiled eggs. During the meal, her father made sure he had the car keys and wallet, her mother checked the offerings such as fruit, flower cakes, and spirit money, and Yuwei checked her phone battery and placed her flat canvas shoes and the bouquets by the door, ready to set out.
location: Study, living room, and kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Jinbaoshan Cemetery
description: Dad drove the rental car, taking Yuwei and Mom from Cuihu Community through the busy Qingming Festival streets to Jinbaoshan Art Garden in Xishan District. Along the way, Dad told stories in a calm, nostalgic tone about how, when he was young, Grandpa used to take him by bike to visit graves in the countryside. Yuwei listened and used her phone's memo app to jot down writing keywords about driving routes and family memories.
location: In the car en route from Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Jinbaoshan Art Garden, Gaoyao Village, Xishan District

name: Paying respects to ancestors and walking in the cemetery
description: Arriving at the Sun family tombstone in Siyuan Garden, Jinbao Mountain Art Garden, Yuwei placed the flowers in front of the stone. Her mother lit incense and candles and laid out offerings, while her father burned paper money and murmured about the family's recent news and Yuwei's studies. The three bowed in order of seniority, and Yuwei pictured her grandmother's kind face. After the tomb-sweeping, the three strolled slowly along the cemetery path. Yuwei photographed a tree covered in white blossoms as material for an essay, and finally they got back into the car and drove away from the cemetery.
location: Sinian Garden at Jinbaoshan Art Garden, Gaoyao Village, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the cemetery trail

name: Going to the lunch spot.
description: The return traffic was relatively smooth. Dad focused on driving, Mom looked at the outline of Xishan Mountain outside the window, and Yuwei put on her earphones to listen to soothing classical piano music, relaxing and preparing for the family dinner.
location: En route from Jinbaoshan Art Garden to Qi's Old Yunnan Flavor Qianzhang Rou Restaurant on Haiyuan South Road, Xishan District.

name: Family gathering
description: The family took their seats in a private room at Qi's Old Yunnan Flavor restaurant and ordered sliced braised pork, crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, mushroom hot pot, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. When the steaming hot pot arrived, her father served Yuwei some soup and asked about her thesis progress and career plans. Her mother suggested obtaining a teacher qualification certificate as a safety net. Yuwei listened earnestly and shared her preliminary thoughts about wanting to work in freelance writing and curation. The conversation was warm and honest.
location: Private room at Qi's Old Yunnan Flavor Qianzhang Rou Restaurant, Haiyuan South Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-meal rest and work messages
description: While her parents went to the restroom, Yuwei checked her phone and replied to editor Xu Mingyuan's messages about fee adjustments and a column proposal. She first sent a grateful emoji, then composed a long message proposing an essay on "Green Lake Park as a Space of Urban Memory," and received a positive reply from the editor.
location: Private room at Qi's Old Yunnan Flavor Qianzhang Rou Restaurant, Haiyuan South Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned to home in the city center
description: Dad drove the family back home to Cuihu Community in Wuhua District. On the way, they discussed the evening menu. Mom proposed grilling for dinner, accompanied by the newly purchased fresh Qingming tea.
location: On the way from Haiyuan South Road, Xishan District, to Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District

name: Midday rest at home
description: After arriving home, Yuwei changed out of her long pants into casual home pants, helped her mother put the grave-sweeping cloth bag on the balcony, then went back to her room and lay on the bed to rest for an hour, listening to the introduction section of the audiobook “The Production of Space” while letting her thoughts drift between waking and dreaming.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon tea and walking to the tea house
description: In the afternoon, Yuwei made a cup of black tea and chatted briefly with her mother. Then she slung on her canvas tote bag, packed her phone, wallet, and notebook, and left home. She walked west along Renmin Middle Road, then along Cuihu North Road for 15 minutes to reach Yunshuijian Teahouse, enjoying the tree-lined walk.
location: Along the way from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Yunshuijian Tea House on Cuihu North Road.

name: Signed up for a tea ceremony class, picked out tea utensils, and chatted over tea.
description: At Yunshuijian Teahouse, Yuwei signed up with the owner, Yang Dingguo, for the introductory tea ceremony course held every Saturday afternoon in April. She filled out the registration form and scanned a QR code to pay the tuition. Then she picked out a basic Dehua white porcelain gaiwan and a blank journal in the display area. Afterward, the owner brewed her a cup of Mengding Ganlu tea. She asked about the proper ways to drink tea during the Qingming solar term. The owner talked about everything from tea picking to storage, and Yuwei jotted down the key points in her newly purchased journal.
location: Yunshuijian Teahouse, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stroll at Green Lake Park
description: After leaving the teahouse, Yuwei walked along Cuihu West Road to the south gate of Green Lake Park. On the Qingming Festival afternoon in the park, she continued listening to the audiobook "The Production of Space" with her earphones, walked along the lake shore for half an hour, observed the kite-flying and photo-taking crowds, and felt the interaction between body and space.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home to help prepare dinner
description: Yuwei walked home from the park and saw her mother picking vegetables in the kitchen. She washed her hands, pulled up a small stool, sat down beside her, and helped peel garlic and trim green beans while sharing what she had learned at the tea house and what she had seen at Green Lake.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Private writing
description: Yuwei returned to her study and opened her laptop. She first quickly organized today's observations—the tomb sweeping, family warmth, the elegant teahouse, and the spring charm of Green Lake—into a writing outline, then opened the essay she hadn't finished yesterday and polished several paragraphs.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was braised pork ribs with spring bamboo shoots, stir-fried choy sum, and cold dressed fish mint, all made by Mom. Dad opened a bottle of red wine, and the three of them had a small drink. Yuwei shared that she had signed up for a tea ceremony class and bought tea utensils; her parents expressed support, and Dad also told an amusing story about going to Xishuangbanna to drink Pu'er tea when he was young. The atmosphere at the dinner table was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening tea tasting and journaling
description: After the meal, Mother washed the new lidded bowl and brewed fresh Qingming tea. Yuwei sat at the tea table, decorated her new journal with tape and stickers, and neatly wrote out the day's schedule. The family sat around drinking tea, with topics ranging from late relatives to funny stories of Yuwei's childhood; the atmosphere was warm and quiet.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and Fine-Tuning the Paper Framework
description: Yuwei returned to the study, opened Lefebvre's “The Production of Space”, and, combining it with her daytime observations at Green Lake Park, connected the concept of “spatial practice” in the theory with inspiration for her essay. Under the “Urban Walking Essay” section of the paper outline on her computer, she added several key arguments.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening skincare and journal organization
description: After reading, Yuwei went to the bathroom to remove her makeup, cleanse her face, and apply a hydrating mask, while soaking her feet for 20 minutes to release fatigue. Then she sat cross-legged on the bed, using tape and stickers to paste materials such as the day's tomb-sweeping photos and teahouse business cards into her journal, and wrote a simple plan for tomorrow.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After setting the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, Yuwei leaned against the headboard and read V.S. Naipaul's Miguel Street for about 20 minutes. She then turned off the light and did 5 minutes of bedtime meditation, letting her mind sink into stillness, and fell asleep peacefully before 22:50, ending this ritual-filled Qingming Festival.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake-up, morning preparation, and partner yoga
description: The alarm went off at 7:30, and Sun Yuwei woke up. After washing up, she put on loungewear and went to the living room, where she did morning partner yoga with her mother, Li Xiulan, focusing on coordinated stretches for the shoulders, neck, and spine to ease the sore shoulders and back from tomb-sweeping during Qingming.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning tea ceremony and journal entry
description: After yoga, Sun Yuwei took out the small purple clay teapot and the flower cakes her mother had made, and began her morning tea ceremony.
