She weighed 8 grams of raw Pu'er tea on an electronic scale, heated the water to 95, warmed the pot, awakened the tea, infused it, poured out the tea, and savored it carefully. In her journal, she recorded the tea's pale golden, translucent color, floral and honey aromas, and sweet aftertaste, as well as the wonderful pairing of the flower cakes with the tea. The journal documented the tea ceremony in detail.
location: Balcony/dining table at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Sun Yuwei put away her journal, and her mother had already set out breakfast, with flower cakes, tea, and the fresh pork wontons cooked by her father. During breakfast, she excitedly told her parents about the afternoon tea ceremony class and shared the teahouse owner's interesting remarks about 'spatial practice.' Her father thought it suited her social science academic bent, and her mother urged her to attend the class attentively.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Studying spatial theory and drawing a mind map
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei cleaned her desk, brewed a second pot of tea, and went to her study to read Lefebvre's The Production of Space, focusing on the chapter on the triad of spatial practice, representations of space, and representational spaces. Using XMind on her laptop, she drew a detailed mind map, combining core concepts with her thesis framework, and thought about how to apply spatial theory to the study of cultural essays.
location: Cuihu Community Book Room, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Help mother prepare lunch
description: Sun Yuwei heard her mother busy in the kitchen, so she closed her laptop and went to help. Her mother was trimming spring bamboo shoots. She took over, and while chatting, cut the bamboo shoots and set them aside, preparing to make stir-fried spring bamboo shoots with sliced pork. The mother and daughter talked about their Qingming Festival impressions and the afternoon tea ceremony class.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and rest
description: Lunch was stir-fried pork slices with bamboo shoots, garlic Chinese broccoli, and tomato and egg soup. At the table, Sun Yuwei shared what she had gained from reading about spatial theory that morning, and her father talked about the history book he had been reading recently. After the meal, she helped clear the dishes and then got ready for an afternoon nap.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and reading time
description: Sun Yuwei did not go to the bedroom. Instead, she leaned on the study sofa for a while and replied to a few WeChat messages. Then she took out Miguel Street and read two chapters, fully absorbed. When she felt sleepy, she napped on the sofa for 20 minutes. After waking, she felt refreshed and prepared for the afternoon tea ceremony class.
location: Sofa area, Cuihu Community Study Room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the Yunshuijian Teahouse
description: Sun Yuwei changed into a cotton-linen dress, carried her newly purchased Dehua white porcelain lidded bowl and notebook, put on flat cloth shoes, and went out. She walked from Cuihu Community through the lakeside path of Cuihu Park and arrived at Yunshuijian Teahouse in about 15 minutes.
location: Lakeside trail of Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (on the way from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, to Yunshuijian Teahouse, No. 112 Cuihu South Road)

name: Tea Ceremony Introductory Course (Lesson 1)
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at Yunshuijian Teahouse a few minutes early; the aroma of tea swirled in the air. The tea ceremony teacher first explained the essentials of brewing with a white porcelain gaiwan. Sun Yuwei listened carefully, took out her own gaiwan, and practiced step by step under the teacher's guidance—warming the cup, adding the tea, rinsing the tea, pouring in water, and decanting the tea liquor—noticing how the water flow speed and the pouring point affected the taste. During the break, she took the initiative to chat with Zhao Min, a Yunnan University student majoring in art design, sitting next to her. The two hit it off, added each other on WeChat, and agreed to practice together after next week's class.
location: Yunshuijian Teahouse, 112 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Strolling through Green Lake Park and collecting material.
description: After the class, Sun Yuwei and Zhao Min went for a walk together at Cuihu Park nearby. The afternoon sunlight sparkled on the lake. The two strolled along the willow-shaded path by the lake, chatting about everything from the art of tea to school life, and especially about topics for their graduation projects. Sun Yuwei took in the spring afternoon at Cuihu Lake, observing the elderly taking walks, children playing, and black-headed gulls returning north. In her mind, she began to ponder an essay about Cuihu Park as an urban public space.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Walk home
description: Sun Yuwei and Zhao Min said goodbye at the park gate, then walked home along the familiar Green Lake lakeside road. The spring breeze brushed their faces, and they felt refreshed.
location: Cuihu Lakeside Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (walking from Green Lake Park back to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road)

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei washed her hands and went to the kitchen to help her mother prepare dinner. While trimming the vegetables, she excitedly shared with her mother the water-temperature control techniques she had learned in the tea ceremony class and talked about her new friend Zhao Min.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner included braised beef and cucumber salad made by her mother. At the table, Sun Yuwei also shared what she had seen and learned in the tea ceremony class with her father. The family chatted happily as they ate. After dinner, she washed the dishes on her own initiative.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening yoga practice
description: After resting for half an hour, Sun Yuwei spread out her yoga mat in the bedroom, opened a shoulder and neck stretching yoga video, and followed along for about 30 minutes, focusing on cat-cow pose, threading the needle pose, and neck stretches. Diaphragmatic breathing calmed her mind and body. After the class, she only drank plain water.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening free time: journaling and socializing.
description: After yoga, feeling refreshed in both body and mind, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk and opened her journal. She carefully recorded the key points of tea brewing from the tea ceremony class, the fun chats with Zhao Min, and her feelings from the walk around Green Lake. She flipped through the photos on her phone of the shimmering Green Lake and the tea set, chose her favorite, printed it, and stuck it into the journal. Then she sent a WeChat message to her friend Song Wen, sharing the newly learned "Phoenix Nods Three Times" technique and the Green Lake photos. Song Wen encouraged her to write the Green Lake essay as planned.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening reading.
description: After finishing her journaling and social catch-ups, Sun Yuwei picked up Miguel Street and read two more chapters, ending the day’s reading with those humorous and bittersweet stories.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening wash-up, skincare routine, and foot soak
description: Sun Yuwei got up and went to the bathroom to wash up. Following her evening skincare routine, she first removed her makeup and cleansed her face, then applied a soothing mask. After that, she filled a basin with hot water, added a few pieces of dried mugwort, and began soaking her feet. While soaking, she reviewed the day's gains and felt happy.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime meditation and organizing
description: Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas, dimmed the lights, sat cross-legged, and began a 10-minute meditation. She focused on her breath and cleared her mind, feeling the day come to a peaceful end. After meditating, she wrote down a rough idea for tomorrow in the daily planning section of her journal: go to Zhibushi Bookstore to check out newly arrived books.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Sun Yuwei adjusted into a comfortable sleeping position, closed her eyes, and with a sense of fulfillment and contentment, quickly fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning partner yoga
description: Early in the morning, Sun Yuwei was awakened by natural light. She unrolled yoga mats in the living room at home with her mother Li Xiulan and did a basic Hatha yoga practice with soft music. The mother and daughter focused on breathing and stretching, and after completing the 30-minute practice they felt refreshed in both body and mind, setting a peaceful tone for the day.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning tea and routine planning.
description: After yoga, Sun Yuwei brewed ripe pu-erh in a white porcelain gaiwan, trying the 'fixed-point water pouring method', and savored the tea's date-like aroma and smoothness. Sitting at the living room coffee table, she recorded her tea-tasting experience in her journal and wrote down her plan to drink tea every day this week and note the physical and mental changes.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast.
description: Mother prepared crossing-the-bridge noodles, boiled eggs, and pickled radish, and the family of three sat around the dining table. Father read the newspaper, while Sun Yuwei chatted with her parents about Zhao Min, a new friend she had met at yesterday's tea ceremony class. Her parents expressed support for her hobby. The breakfast time was warm and precious.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidied up the desk and cleaned the room.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to her room, put the scattered books back in their places, wiped the desk with a damp cloth, organized her stationery and journal supplies, folded her clothes, and made the bed. The room became neat and bright, and her mood brightened accordingly.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: This week's tea tasting review and summary
description: In the clean study, Sun Yuwei brewed a cup of fresh tea, opened this week's tea-tasting journal, and reviewed every tea-tasting record since April 2. She used a mind map to sort out the characteristics of different tea types, brewing techniques, and changes in bodily sensation, then photographed the summary and sent it to her tea friend Song Wen, sharing the week's tea insights.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped her mother prepare the meal
description: Sun Yuwei went into the kitchen, tied on an apron, and helped her mother trim garlic sprouts, peel garlic, and rinse rice to cook. Her mother asked about her relationship with Zhao Min, and Sun Yuwei smiled and told her that they had already arranged to practice making tea together next week. While preparing the meal, the mother and daughter chatted about everyday life.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and midday rest
description: A hearty lunch was prepared, including stir-fried spring bamboo shoots with cured pork, sweet and sour spare ribs, and more. The family chatted while eating, and her father suggested an outing next week. After the meal, Sun Yuwei helped her mother clear the dishes, then took a 20-minute nap on the living room sofa to recharge for the afternoon activities.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio and attend a group flow yoga class
description: Sun Yuwei changed into her yoga clothes and walked from Cuihu Community to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. Walking along Huashan West Road and Dongfeng West Road, she bought a cup of milk tea at a drink shop she passed. She arrived at the studio around 13:25. At 13:30, she began a 60-minute Power Flow yoga class, focusing on her core and breathing under the guidance of instructor He Lu. After class, she talked with He Lu and accepted the invitation to experience Yin Yoga.
location: Along the route from 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Walked to Zhibushi Bookstore and visited it.
description: After leaving the yoga studio, Sun Yuwei walked about 15 minutes along the Green Lake path to Zhibushi Bookstore. Inside, she greeted the owner, Uncle Qin, who told her about newly arrived magazines and an obscure travelogue titled 'Song of Wandering.' Sun Yuwei happily browsed through them and ended up buying the new issue of 'Harvest' and 'Song of Wandering,' exchanging a few pleasantries with Uncle Qin.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Inspiration gathering and journal creation at Green Lake Park
description: After leaving the bookstore and entering Green Lake Park, Sun Yuwei sat down on a bench under the flowering trees near the west gate, opened her journal, and began conceiving an essay about 'Green Lake.' Blending recent fragments of inspiration, yoga insights, and thoughts on spatial theory, she wrote a passage describing Green Lake as a container-image, immersed in the lake light and tree shadows until evening fell without her noticing.
location: Inside Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Take the No. 5 bus
description: Sun Yuwei put away her planner and went to the bus stop across from the east gate of Cuihu Park to wait. Around 17:45 she boarded Bus No. 5, stood near the window in the middle of the carriage, and, feeling tired, hung her crossbody bag in front of her chest as she watched the street scenes outside.
location: From the Green Lake Park East Gate bus stop in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, took Bus No. 5 (traveling to near Renmin Middle Road).

name: Losing and Finding the Journal
description: When she got off the bus and walked to the entrance of the residential complex, Sun Yuwei noticed that the clasp of her crossbody bag was open and her journal was missing. She immediately realized it may have slipped under the bus seat. She ran back to Xiaoximen Bus Stop in a panic but didn't find it. She called the bus hotline and learned that the bus had already finished its route and she would need to check the next day. She then searched along the road with her head down, even rummaging through roadside trash bins, but still found nothing. In the end, she went home dejected.
location: Along Renmin Middle Road, Xiaoximen Bus Stop, and the dispatch office of Bus No. 5, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The letdown after going home and pouring out one's heart
description: Sun Yuwei returned home feeling devastated. After brushing off her parents' questions, she hid in her bedroom. Sitting on the bed, feeling wronged and anxious, she opened WeChat and poured out to her close friends Zhang Jing and Zhou Lin the story of losing her journal. The two friends comforted her with voice messages and suggested going to the public transport company the next day to inquire about lost items.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Low mood and late-night insomnia
description: After talking with her friend, Sun Yuwei still felt heavy-hearted. After washing up, she lay in bed tossing and turning, repeatedly recalling the essay inspirations, yoga insights, and unpublished poems in her journal. She scrolled through the few remaining photos in her phone album, tears wetting her pillow, and did not fall asleep until the early morning. Her sleep quality was extremely poor.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning home activities
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off. Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan did partner yoga in the living room, using Sun Salutation A to regulate their tired bodies and minds from last night's insomnia. After finishing, she brewed pre-Qingming Longjing tea at the tea table on the balcony, tasted it, casually jotted down the color and aroma of the tea, and took photos with her phone to upload to her private cloud drive. Then she read her tasting notes aloud in Mandarin, slowly and firmly, completing a ritual of self-soothing. Finally, she had breakfast with her parents. Her mother had made small-pot rice noodles, and her father silently added minced meat sauce to her bowl. She told them her plan for the day was to go to the bus dispatch office and Yunnan University Library. Her mother comforted her that the notebook was just a temporary residence permit for inspiration.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Checked lost and found
description: Sun Yuwei walked to the dispatch office at the Cuihu terminus of Bus No. 5 and asked the staff about the notebook she had lost the day before. After looking through the lost-and-found register and checking the warehouse, they told her it had not been found. Though disappointed, she accepted it calmly. Walking out of the dispatch office, she encouraged herself in the morning light and resolved to move on.
location: Dispatching office at the Green Lake terminal stop of Bus No. 5, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near the north gate of Green Lake Park)

name: Walked to Yunnan University and Cuihu Lake to relax.
description: Sun Yuwei walked along Cuihu Road to Yunnan University. On the way, she paused beside an empty bench by the lake, did deep breathing while watching water birds and weeping willows, let her mother's words of comfort echo in her mind, gradually calmed down, and regained the strength to move forward.
location: Along the shore of Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Spatial theory reading
description: In the east reading room on the third floor of Yunnan University Library, Sun Yuwei focused on reading the chapter on space-power relations in Foucault's "Discipline and Punish" to add theoretical depth to her paper, excerpting the panopticism discussion and drawing a relation sketch. Meanwhile, Song Wen, a fellow writer from Chengdu, sent a WeChat message asking about progress; she replied briefly and then continued her reading.
location: East Reading Room, 3rd Floor, Library, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch
description: Sun Yuwei ate small-pot rice noodles on the second floor of the 121 Canteen. She deliberately switched to a corner seat by the window, observed the daily energy of students on campus, and felt slightly brighter.
location: Second floor, 121 Canteen, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei took a 20-minute nap on the sofa in the library's leisure area, leaning against her backpack. This made up for the mental energy she had lost to insomnia, and by the time she woke up, her headache had lessened.
location: Library leisure area, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home
description: Sun Yuwei walked 20 minutes home, buying a box of strawberries at a fruit stall on the way as an energy boost for the afternoon's writing.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon Creative Work and Tea Break
description: In a new notebook, Sun Yuwei tried hard to recall the prose inspirations, yoga insights, and draft Green Lake short poems from the lost journal, struggling to capture fragments. Then she turned on her computer to write the essay "The Lost Pages," using this experience as the background, expressing that "some words are destined to belong only to specific moments and paths." When she hit a mental block, she went to the balcony to wash the glass from the morning, organize the tea samples, and enjoy Lipton black tea and strawberries as a short break, then continued writing, weaving the evening walk scene and her mother's words into the piece. She spent the rest of the time reading the first chapter of "The Song of Wandering."
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buy fresh flowers and back up digital files
description: Sun Yuwei walked to Xijian Huatian on Renmin Middle Road and selected light purple forget-me-nots and white daisies, planning to place them in vases at home to brighten her mood. After returning home, she first kept the flowers in a bucket, then turned on her computer to back up today's Longjing tea tasting photos, essay draft, and reading recordings on both the local hard drive and the cloud for better data security.
location: Xijian Huatian, No. 90 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road.

name: Evening walk around Green Lake
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother walked along the lakeside road of Green Lake Park. She told her mother that the notebook really had not been found. Her mother took her arm and comforted her by using the example of water birds foraging for food every day. The evening breeze carried the fresh scent of water plants, and she felt much relieved.
location: Lakeside Road, Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flower arranging and helping with dinner.
description: Sun Yuwei trimmed the freshly bought flowers and arranged them in a white porcelain vase, placing it in the center of the dining table, brightening the atmosphere at home. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother pick vegetables and peel garlic. The two exchanged thoughts about the day's writing, and the process of preparing dinner was relaxed and warm.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of three enjoyed stir-fried spring bamboo shoots with cured pork, shredded potatoes with green peppers, and tomato and egg soup. Sun Yuwei shared her thoughts on reading “The Wanderer’s Song,” while her father talked about the Old Kunming photo exhibition being prepared by the Cultural Affairs Bureau. The atmosphere at the table was warm and harmonious.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Polish the essay and publish it
description: Sun Yuwei gave the final polish to her essay 'The Lost Page Numbers' in her study, firmly ending it with 'The lost page numbers will eventually be rewritten in another way,' then published the article on her personal WeChat official account, accompanied by photos of midday Longjing tea and the tea table at sunset. Soon after, she received heartwarming messages from readers.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening meditation
description: Sun Yuwei meditated on the bay window in her bedroom, focusing on her breath and letting the feeling of loss flow away with each exhale. When she finished, most of the tightness in her chest had faded, and her heart returned to calm and softness.
location: Bay window in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Ceremonial tea and journaling
description: Sun Yuwei brewed ripe pu-erh in a white porcelain gaiwan on the balcony. The amber tea liquor was smooth on the palate. On the first page of her new journal, she wrote about today's mood and drew a winding mountain road. Beside it she wrote, 'The road is long, but every step counts,' telling herself that although she had lost her journal today, she had found the courage to move forward again.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading.
description: Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and continued reading the second chapter of The Song of Wandering, thinking about the shortcomings of her essays and jotting down revision inspirations on sticky notes.

name: Helped with household chores and family dinner

Dinner was the pork rib and radish soup my mother had simmered, stir-fried broccoli, and roast duck my father had brought back. The three of us chatted while eating; I shared funny stories about the test and yoga, my father talked about things at work, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

As I tasted it, I compared it with yesterday's Shou Mei and recorded in detail the differences in color, aroma, and mouthfeel between the two in my planner. Then I turned on the computer and incorporated my reflections on this morning's sunlight, tests, yoga, jasmine, and tea into writing an essay titled 'The Time of a Cup of Tea and the Warmth of a City'.

At 21:15 I started reading Miguel Street for 20 minutes, experiencing the poetry of ordinary life in Naipaul's writing.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep

location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

The aroma is quite bold. Let's taste it together another day.”
