location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk, yoga, washing up, and makeup
description: She changed into light sportswear and walked with her mother to Green Lake Park, brisk-walking along the lakeside path for 20 minutes, enjoying the cool morning air and the mist over the lake. Then they returned home and did a 15-minute vinyasa flow yoga stretch together on yoga mats on the balcony, with smooth movements and a theme of being grateful to their bodies for achieving the goal. Standing still, she read aloud in Mandarin a passage from 'Kunming Notes' describing Green Lake in spring. After that, she went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into going-out clothes (a light knit top and jeans), carefully applied sunscreen, and put on a fresh, natural makeup look to start the new day in top form.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the lakeside trail of Green Lake Park

name: Have a celebratory breakfast with the family.
description: Had breakfast with her parents in the dining room. Her mother had specially prepared mushroom omelette, purple rice porridge, and side dishes. When her father learned that she had reached her target weight, he smiled with relief and told her to keep it up. Yuwei's appetite opened up, and she finished most of the bowl of porridge and the omelette.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to Yunnan University Library
description: After packing up her thesis materials, notebook, thermos, and journal, she set out. She walked to Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Line 3 of the metro to Yunnan University in Chenggong District. The whole trip took about 95 minutes, and she read 'Kunming Notes' on her Kindle as a pastime.
location: From Huashan West Road Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Yunnan University Metro Station, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Thesis theory chapter finalized
description: At a window seat on the third floor of the library at Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus, I opened my laptop and put the finishing touches on the first draft of the theoretical chapter of my thesis. I polished the core discussion of sense of place and bookstore cultural space, and carefully checked the reference formatting to make sure it met academic norms.
location: Window seat on the third floor of the library, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Simple lunch and sharing news
description: I went to the quick meal counter on the first floor of Ziyuan Canteen and ordered a tomato-egg rice bowl and a freshly baked flower cake as a treat. While eating, I sent a WeChat message to my sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, sharing the good news that I'd reached my target weight, along with a happy emoji.
location: First Floor, Ziyuan Canteen, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon campus walk and online exchange
description: After dinner, I walked along the tree-lined path by Ze Lake on campus to aid digestion and enjoy the spring sunshine. Meanwhile, I replied on WeChat to Uncle Qin's message from yesterday, thanking him for recommending a prose collection about Kunming's old streets and alleys, telling him that the thesis was wrapping up smoothly, and agreeing to visit the bookstore in a couple of days.
location: Tree-lined path by Ze Lake, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal time and tea tasting notes.
description: Back in the library lounge, I sat on the sofa, took out my beloved journal, and added a tea tasting record page, setting up a section for comparing water pouring methods. Using the small thermos and portable tea strainer I carried with me, I tried brewing my own raw pu-erh with a low pour, and recorded in detail the water temperature, pouring speed, tea liquor color, and taste, comparing them with the high-pour method from a few days ago.
location: Sofa seat in the rest area of the library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Zhongmou Yoga Studio.
description: Packed up and left the library, walked to the metro station, took Metro Line 3 back to Dongfeng West Road Station in the city center, then walked to the yoga studio. The whole trip took about 85 minutes.
location: Along the route from Yunnan University in Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Vinyasa flow group class.
description: Arrived at the yoga studio ten minutes early, drank water in the rest area, and changed into yoga clothes. Then attended a 60-minute vinyasa flow group class led by instructor He Lu. The class pace was smooth; after completing a warrior sequence, her body felt stretched and strong. After class, she shared with He Lu the joy of reaching the target weight. He Lu suggested increasing high-quality protein intake and avoiding high-sugar foods to maintain the weight.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take a walk with Mother in Green Lake Park
description: Changing into flat shoes, she walked from the yoga studio to Cuihu Park and met her mother at the west gate. The two walked side by side along the lake shore, with light sparkling on the water. Yuwei shared the news that her thesis had been successfully completed and briefly mentioned the new essay she was considering. The mother and daughter chatted about everyday matters and discussed simple plans for after submitting the thesis the next day. The atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Lakeside walking path around Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near the West Gate).

name: Went home after shopping at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market.
description: After the walk, she and her mother went on foot to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, where they bought fresh vegetables, fruit, and eggs, and at a flower stall picked a bouquet of light purple forget-me-nots and several white lisianthus, planning to replace the withered flowers at home. Then the mother and daughter carried the ingredients and flowers home on foot, and on the way also bought pears that her father liked.
location: From Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, Xinwen Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huaxi West Road

name: Have dinner with the family
description: Mother simply cooked the vegetables she had bought. Dinner included stir-fried seasonal vegetables, cold mixed black fungus, and mushroom soup. The family of three sat around the dining table, chatting about the day's experiences, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening tea tasting, journaling, and flower arranging
description: In the study, she used the new glass fairness pitcher and the low-pouring method to brew a cup of black tea sent by a friend. At the same time, she took out her beloved journal, drew a blooming purple iris in the blank space on the page where she reached her target weight, reviewed her tea-tasting notes from the previous three days, and wrote down her reflections on comparing water-pouring methods. Then she paired the forget-me-nots and lisianthus she had bought with eucalyptus leaves, trimmed them, and arranged them in a clear glass vase on the living room coffee table, creating a fresh spring countryside feel that gave the living room a whole new look.
location: Home study and living room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing joy with best friend and bedtime meditation
description: Leaning on the sofa, she shared the good news of reaching her target weight with her best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat voice messages and sent photos of the newly finished flower arrangement. Zhang Jing praised her warmly, and the two agreed to meet at an independent café by Green Lake on the weekend. Afterwards, she changed into her pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bay window cushion in the bedroom, and did a 10-minute meditation, letting the day's joy, calm, and contentment settle. Finally, she set the alarm for 7:00 the next morning.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, she read a few pages of Notes on Kunming as bedtime reading, savoring the familiar charm of Kunming in Yu Jian's writing. Then she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully, ending the day with a fulfilled and contented feeling.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk
description: At 6:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei got up right on time and walked about five minutes from her home in Green Lake Community to Green Lake Park. She did 20 minutes of brisk walking along the lakeshore. The early morning lake gave off a slightly cool mist, and birdsong came in waves. She took a deep breath and felt her spirits lifted for the day. Along the way, she took a few photos with her phone of morning light passing through willow branches, saving them as journal material.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Family flow yoga
description: After the walk, her mother Lin Wan had already laid out the yoga mats. Sun Yuwei and her mother did a 30-minute vinyasa flow yoga session in the living room, starting with three rounds of Sun Salutation A, focusing on Warrior I, Triangle Pose, and Cow Face Pose to open the shoulders. Her mother's breathing was smooth today, and the two coordinated well. Afterward, they felt stretched out all over, and the tightness in their shoulders and necks was gone.
location: Living room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (Cuihu Community)

name: Light tea in the early morning to wake up.
description: After yoga, she took a shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. Sun Yuwei went to the study and brewed a pot of Yangbi walnut-infused green tea bought a few days earlier from Zhuanxin Market, using a glass cup. Watching the tender green tea leaves slowly unfold in the hot water and tiny bubbles cling to the side of the cup, she took slow small sips, and the fresh botanical aroma instantly awakened her body and mind.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: Her mother Lin Wan served mushroom rice noodles and pickled radish. Sun Yuwei helped her father Sun Jianguo fill his bowl with rice noodles, and the family of three sat around the table for breakfast. She brought up going to Zhibushi Bookstore later that day to look for a book about Yunnan's ancient architecture, and her father expressed his support. She also casually asked her mother about the plan for the afternoon walk. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road (Cuihu Community), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Creative work in the study and journal drawing
description: After breakfast, she went into the study. Sun Yuwei prepared for today's journal theme, "Tea Dance." She took out a transparent fairness pitcher and Yunnan green tea leaves, turned her journal to the "Tea Tasting Records" page, and set out colored pencils, watercolor pens, and other tools. At 9 o'clock, she began brewing by pouring 95°C water slowly from a fixed height, carefully observing the three stages of the tea leaves unfurling in the water: first opening like butterfly wings, fully blooming like orchids, then sinking like jellyfish. She delicately sketched the process on watercolor paper using light green, dark green, and grayish blue, and recorded the water temperature, brewing technique, and the light sweet floral aroma she smelled. She also took a few photos to post on WeChat Moments in the evening.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Deepening tea-tasting records and travel reading
description: Putting on her headphones and playing natural white noise, Sun Yuwei continued refining the “Tea Dance” page in her journal, writing down her reflections: “Today's tea is not for quenching thirst, but for watching its dance, smelling its fragrance, and tasting its spirit. The breath of the mountains melts in the throat, as if standing on a tea mountain after rain.” Then she opened “Searching the City: Chengdu,” focusing on chapters about Kuanzhai Alley and Du Fu Thatched Cottage, marking cultural landmarks that interested her on the phone map, and creating a new collection called “A Cultural Ramble through Chengdu.” She thought that in the future she definitely wanted to go to the old teahouses at Qingcheng Mountain to drink gaiwan tea and write essays.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Lunch and casual family chat
description: Mother made Sun Yuwei's favorite red three-delight and black fungus salad. At lunch, she shared with her parents the 'Tea Dance' journal she had drawn in the morning and her Chengdu travel plans. Her father recalled that when he was on a business trip in Chengdu, he had eaten at an old restaurant called 'Nuli Can' with excellent taste, and told her to note it down. She immediately jotted down this lead in her phone's memo.
location: Dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road (Cuihu Community), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Midday organizing and to-do confirmation
description: After the meal, she helped clear the dishes. Remembering the mild iron-deficiency anemia report from her last checkup, Sun Yuwei followed the doctor's advice and made a cup of red date and longan water, and took an iron supplement. Then she checked her canvas bag to make sure she had her journal, colored pens, water bottle, umbrella, and portable phone charger, preparing to go out in the afternoon. She sent a WeChat message to Uncle Qin at Zhibushi Bookstore, letting him know she would come over in the afternoon.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Bookstore treasure hunt
description: Walked about 13 minutes to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. The owner, Qin Mingyuan, was sorting newly arrived books and recommended a book about the horse caravans of western Yunnan. She sat down in a corner among the stacks, first flipping through 'The Ancient Road Under the Hump Route,' then finding an illustrated book called 'Old Buildings of Kunming's Old Streets.' She chatted with Uncle Qin for at least half an hour about the fun of buying books in Xizhou, Dali, and finally bought both books.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: A short break at the corner café.
description: Leaving the bookstore, she walked about 5 minutes to Salvador Café & Western Restaurant on Wenlin Street. Sun Yuwei ordered a latte and sat on a bar stool by the window, flipping through the newly purchased 'Old Kunming Street Architecture,' and used a pencil to mark a few lanes she wanted to visit, such as the old herbal medicine shop on Wenmiao Straight Street and the old factory building in Tiepi Lane. After drinking coffee for about 20 minutes, she noticed the sky outside darkening, so she got up, paid, and went home.
location: Salvador Café & Western Restaurant, No. 76 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Packing up for the return trip and preparing to change clothes
description: Walked about 15 minutes home from the café. Light drizzle began on the way, but fortunately she had brought an umbrella. After arriving home, Sun Yuwei put the newly bought book on the desk, noted the old streets she had marked in the café into her Kunming Memories notebook, and added a line: If it's sunny on Sunday, I can go explore. She labeled the new book with the purchase date and place. Then she changed into a more comfortable floral dress, grabbed her journal and a small wicker basket, and got ready to go out for a walk and shopping with her mother.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (Cuihu Community)

name: Evening mother-daughter walk
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Lin Wan strolled along the lakeside path of Green Lake Park; the air after the rain was especially fresh. She shared what she had found at the bookstore that day, while her mother mentioned an interesting essay a student at her school had written about old objects. They sat down to rest on a bench under a big tree, and Sun Yuwei suggested going to Zhuanxin Market on the weekend to buy flowers to prepare for her flower arrangement project. Her mother happily agreed, as she also wanted to buy some lilies.
location: Cuihu Park Ring Road, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Supermarket shopping
description: In the latter half of the walk, the mother and daughter made a detour to the nearby Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and bought bok choy, green peppers, and fruit for dinner. In the fresh produce section, Sun Yuwei spotted newly arrived fresh-cut flowers, picked out a few light purple daisies and a eucalyptus branch, planning to use them for flower arranging at home. Her mother teased her, saying she “just can’t walk past them again.”
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Prepare dinner
description: When she got home, Sun Yuwei washed her hands and helped her mother trim the freshly bought bok choy. As they trimmed, she shared stories of the Yunnan horse caravans from “The Ancient Road Under the Hump Route.” Her mother was very interested and felt these stories would be well suited to writing as essays. Hearing the discussion, her father also came into the kitchen.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (Cuihu Community)

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was stir-fried baby bok choy, green pepper with pork, and tomato egg drop soup. At the table, the family chatted about weekend plans: Mother said she had a flower arrangement class tomorrow afternoon, Sun Yuwei smiled and said that today's materials had just arrived; Father said he needed to go to the Cultural Bureau tomorrow to take care of something. The dinner atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road (Cuihu Community), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening flower arranging and meditative creation
description: Returning to the study, Sun Yuwei turned on the desk lamp. She tried to make a slanting-style flower arrangement using the purple coneflowers and eucalyptus leaves she bought that day, matched with a small woven bamboo basket already at home, and named it "Autumn Letter." After finishing it, she opened her newly bought "The Architecture of Kunming's Old Streets," and referring to the photo of the Wenmiao Straight Street archway in the book, she drew a sketch in her journal and wrote: "Tomorrow should be fine and clear; if I go to visit, I must write an essay on 'The Taste of the Old Street.'"
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Evening Tea and Daily Journal
description: After brewing a pot of Keemun black tea, Sun Yuwei opened her journal and neatly wrote with her fountain pen about the whole day, from the morning walk to the flower arranging just now. At the end of the page she wrote her mood: 'From the afternoon bookstore, to the evening walk, and then to the flower arranging by the window, today has been very fulfilling. My weight is well maintained, and my mood is peaceful.' She also pressed a rain-soaked plane tree leaf she had picked up at Cuihu into the journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Pre-sleep meditation, free reading, and falling asleep.
description: After changing into her pajamas, Sun Yuwei lay on her back and opened the Tide app for a 20-minute body scan meditation. Following the guided instructions, she relaxed her body inch by inch from her toes to the top of her head. Her fatigue dissipated and her mind became calm. After the meditation, she picked up her phone to reply to her best friend Zhang Jing's message about photos of the new café, then opened WeChat Reading to read the 'Spring and Autumn of Plants' section of 'Human World, Grass and Trees' for 15 minutes. She smiled knowingly when she read Wang Zengqi's description of rain in Kunming. At 9:15 PM, she set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, turned off the desk lamp, and fell asleep peacefully amid the faint chirping of insects and the night sounds of the city outside the window.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (Cuihu Community)

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: Woke up naturally and felt full of energy. Weighed herself and recorded it in her journal: 45.8 kg. Drank a glass of warm water and did a simple 5-minute stretch. Took an iron supplement, then changed into a sports bra, quick-dry T-shirt, and hiking pants.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and packing up.
description: Mother had prepared small-pot rice noodles and soy milk. We chatted about today's Western Hills plan while eating. After eating, I returned to the bedroom to pack my backpack: hiking shoes, water bottle, two apples, sunscreen, hat, light jacket, power bank, portable yoga mat. I sent a WeChat message to He Lu to confirm the meet-up time.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Xishan
description: Walk 5 minutes to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, take Metro Line 3 to Xishan Park Station (about 30 minutes). After exiting, walk 5 minutes to the Visitor Center of Xishan Scenic Area, breathing fresh air along the way.
location: From Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, take Metro Line 3 to Xishan Park Station, and then go to the Visitor Center of Xishan Scenic Area.

name: Meeting point and start of the hike
description: Arrived 10 minutes early and tidied up in the visitor center restroom. He Lu arrived wearing a bright orange quick-dry shirt. They checked each other's gear, took a group photo, and then headed to the entrance of the Nie Er Tomb trail.
location: Xishan Scenic Area Visitor Center at Xu Xiake Square, lower level of Metro Line 3, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Western Hills Hiking: Section 1
description: They started climbing from the Nie Er's Tomb trail. The trees along the stone steps were cool and the air was fresh. Walking and chatting, they shared their thoughts on the finalized thesis and a documentary about breath meditation. They paused at the entrance of Huating Temple, feeling the tranquility of the ancient temple.
location: The section from the Nie Er's Tomb trail to Huating Temple within Xishan Scenic Area, Xishan District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Rest and stretching at the mountainside
description: Arrived at the viewing platform in front of Taihua Temple, where Dianchi Lake suddenly opened up before them. Rested for 15 minutes, shared apples, energy bars, and sports drinks. He Lu taught shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the pressure of the backpacks.
location: Viewing platform in front of Taihua Temple, Xishan Scenic Area, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Western Hills hiking, second section.
description: After recovering our strength, we continued onward. We stopped at the Longmen Grottoes to admire the cliffs and the view of Dianchi Lake. The final stretch of steps was steep, but the temptation of reaching the top of Lingxu Pavilion kept us going.
location: Taihua Temple to Dragon Gate Grottoes to Lingxu Pavilion in the Western Hills Scenic Area.

name: Hilltop yoga
description: Find an open platform and spread out the yoga mat. Under blue skies and white clouds, with a panoramic view of Dianchi Lake, practice Tree Pose, Warrior I, and Triangle Pose. With the breeze blowing, the body opens up and the mind becomes calm and free. They agreed to come again another day.
location: Viewing platform near Lingxu Pavilion, Xishan Scenic Area, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Down the Mountain and on the Way
description: Walk easily down the mountain along the Maomaoqing Reservoir trail. He Lu explained roadside plants, such as the original herbal plant for Yunnan Baiyao that stops bleeding. Then they arrived at Chama Flower Street.
location: The trail from Maomaoqing Reservoir in Xishan Scenic Area, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Chama Flower Street.

name: Vegetarian lunch
description: Each ordered a serving of crossing-the-bridge rice noodles with mushroom broth. The broth was flavorful and the noodles were smooth. They shared their feelings about doing yoga on the mountain and exchanged insights on outdoor practice. They agreed to go hiking together again next time the weather is nice.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Xishan District, Xishan Scenic Area, Tea Horse Flower Street, “Suxinzhai” Vegetarian Restaurant

name: Return transport
description: Took Bus C62 from the Tea-Horse Flower Street Bus Stop to Western Hills Park Station, then transferred to Metro Line 3 to Huashan West Road Station (about 40 minutes). Listened to music and rested on the bus and metro.
location: Took Bus C62 from Chama Flower Street to Xishan Park Station, transferred to Metro Line 3 to Huashan West Road Station, and then walked home.

name: Return home to rest and tidy up.
description: After arriving home, her mother was reading in the living room. She took a hot shower, changed into loungewear, and rested on the sofa with her eyes closed for half an hour, using a throw pillow to prop up her feet.
location: Living room and bedroom, home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and planning
description: Sitting at my desk, I opened my journal. I wrote down my reflections: 'Standing at Lingxu Pavilion, Dianchi Lake became the backdrop of my breathing. As the wind blew, I felt like a tree, with branches and leaves spreading out and roots gripping the rocks.' I recorded my heart rate recovery data, sketched the outline of the Western Hills, and planned the next hiking route.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing equipment and looking up information
description: Clean out the hiking backpack and put the dirty clothes in the washing machine. In the journal, add 'knee pads, wet wipes, trash bags'. Search for 'Kunming surrounding area hiking guides' on the phone and copy interesting text to the memo app.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Flower arrangement creation
description: Took out the purple coneflowers and eucalyptus leaves bought yesterday at City Garden Supermarket. Trimmed the leaves and branches and arranged them in a terracotta vase. Tried a 'casual natural style' and placed the finished arrangement in the entryway.
location: Coffee table in the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family time and dinner
description: Father came home from work and praised the purple daisies. For dinner, Mother made a stir-fry with red three-chopped ingredients and wood ear mushrooms from the fridge, plus tomato egg drop soup. During the meal, she shared today's mountain climbing experiences and the yoga He Lu had taught; the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mixed-brew tea tasting experiment
description: Take out the gaiwan and put in Yunnan black tea and dried osmanthus at a 3:1 ratio. After a quick rinse with 90°C water, taste three infusions. Record each infusion's aroma, sweetness, and lingering aftertaste in detail, and draw an aroma-change curve. Note: 'Next time, try Yunnan black tea + rose + a little dried tangerine peel.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Free reading time.
description: She leafed through "Old Street Architecture in Kunming," compared it with what she saw on today's walk, marked the old streets of interest, and planned to visit them on the weekend.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Online chat with close friend.
description: Zhang Jing sent a WeChat message asking how I felt today. During the voice call, I described the wonderful mountaintop yoga, the Dianhong osmanthus tea experiment, and my flower arrangement insights. She was envious and we agreed to go hiking together next time. I joked about being her 'traveling yoga coach.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and getting ready for bed.
description: She changed into pajamas and lay flat on the bed. She opened the Tide app and did a 10-minute body scan meditation, progressively relaxing her slightly sore calves, thighs, and back to relieve the fatigue after exercise. Afterward, relaxed, she drew a branch of osmanthus flowers and a few tea leaves on the “Dianhong Osmanthus Tea” page of her journal. She watered the pothos, checked the textbook for tomorrow’s class, turned off the light, listened to soothing piano music, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk around Green Lake and buying breakfast.
description: Woke up at 6:30 in the morning, washed up quickly, changed into a loose cotton-and-linen dress, and went for a walk in Cuihu Park near my home. I strolled slowly along the lake, watching an old man casting a net to catch fish in the morning light. The annoyance brought on by the reader criticism my editor forwarded last night gradually faded, and I realized that criticism reminds me not to let my writing stay on the surface. Around 7:10, I left through the south gate of Cuihu Park, saw the familiar breakfast stall by the road, bought two grilled rice cakes (one with chili sauce and sweet sauce, the other with only sweet sauce for my mom) and a bag of hot soy milk, and walked home holding the warm breakfast, feeling better.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with Mom and morning yoga
description: Back home, she had breakfast with her mother and handed her a piece of erkuai coated with sweet sauce. Her mother asked why she hadn't slept well the previous night. Sun Yuwei told her about the reader's criticism. Her mother comforted her, saying that being able to hear criticism is a good thing, and being able to absorb it is growth, and encouraged her not to be too hard on herself. After breakfast, the mother and daughter laid out yoga mats on the balcony for morning yoga. Her mother deliberately did extra forward-supporting movements, as if to support her from the front. Sunlight spilled across the floor through the pothos leaves. During tree pose, they almost fell over together, laughed, and felt much more relaxed.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning outing: went to Dounan Flower Market to purchase flower materials and returned.
description: After yoga, she went back to her room, changed into a white T-shirt and beige wide-leg pants, took her iron supplement, packed her canvas bag, and put in her sun hat, thermos, and other items. She made a list of the flower materials she needed. She set out at 9:00, walked about five minutes to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, and on the way sent a voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing saying she was going to the flower market; Zhang Jing encouraged her to buy flowers as a treat for herself. She took Metro Line 5 and transferred to Line 1, arriving at Dounan Flower Market about an hour later. In the fresh-cut flower section, she picked purple irises with dew, white daisies, and pothos leaves according to her list, and was also attracted to the newly arrived freesias, so she bought a small bunch. The woman running the stall gave her a few extra fern leaves. Holding a newspaper-wrapped bundle of flowers, she took the Metro back, catching a light scent of iris on the way and feeling her gloom washed away by the fragrance. She got home around 11:10, cut the stems at an angle on the balcony, wrapped them in damp newspaper for 'reviving,' drank a large glass of plain boiled water, and rested briefly on the sofa. While scrolling through her phone, she saw the 'reverse-hand' flower arrangement structure shared in the flower-arranging group and decided to try it in the afternoon.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Make lunch with mom and take a midday nap
description: At 11:30, her mother began preparing lunch, and Sun Yuwei went over to help. She picked water spinach while her mother sliced cured meat, and they chatted about what they had seen at the flower market. Her mother mentioned that the balcony cactus needed pruning, and Sun Yuwei suggested using mint leaves to make tea. For lunch they made stir-fried cured meat with green peppers, garlic water spinach, and tomato and egg soup—simple and refreshing. After the meal, she leaned against the rattan sofa in the study and used her phone to look up the habits of irises and daisies, preparing for the afternoon flower arranging. When drowsiness came, she drew the blackout curtain and took a short nap on the sofa for about half an hour.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Balcony gardening and learning about plants.
description: Waking from her nap, she went to the balcony and saw her mother pruning dead rose branches, so she picked up a watering can to help water the flowers and used small scissors to help cut dead leaves. Then her mother sat on a small stool and pointed at the plants on the windowsill, explaining care tips: geraniums like dry conditions and are afraid of root rot, while mint needs plenty of water and fertilizer. The more Sun Yuwei listened, the more interested she became. Thinking of the "Kunming Garden Plants" chapter in the essay collection she was planning, she earnestly took out her journal and recorded the key points.
location: Balcony at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Flower arrangement creation “Late Spring Whispers” and online sharing.
description: After the flower materials were fully rehydrated, I started arranging on the balcony with a small table, an old purple-clay flower container, flower scissors, and a kenzan. I used the “reverse-dominant” structure I had seen in the morning: purple irises rising high as the main branch, white daisies clustered as the guest branch, and pothos leaves drooping low to create a sense of flowing water. After repeated adjustments, I removed the largest pothos leaf, making the work more open and airy. I named it “Late Spring Whispers.” Then I carried the arrangement to a well-lit corner of the living room and photographed it from multiple angles. I selected the three most satisfactory photos and posted them to the Ikenobo enthusiasts group, with my creative process and the flower list. Group member Su Man suggested tilting the main branch 5 degrees further to the left; after the adjustment, it looked more harmonious.
location: Balcony and living room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cleaning flower containers and making cold-brewed tea
description: After the online exchange ended, she cleaned the flower vases, returned the flower shears and the kenzan to their places, and placed the flower arrangement in the center of the living room coffee table. Feeling thirsty in the afternoon, she tried the cold-brew tea recipe she had seen on a website: put 5 g of jasmine tea into a cold-water jug, add 500 ml of purified water, close the lid tightly, put it in the refrigerator, and set an alarm to taste it after 4 hours.
location: Home balcony and kitchen, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journal keeping and essay outline planning
description: Back in the study, she opened her journal, first recorded the plant care knowledge her mother taught her with colored pens, and drew small flower patterns. Then she conceived the outline for the essay collection 'Plants in Kunming Courtyards', writing: Chapter 1 'Green Hanging by the Windowsill Eating the Wind', Chapter 2 'Mint, Jasmine, and Time', Chapter 3 'The Migration Map of an Herb'.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk with Mom at Green Lake.
description: At 5 p.m., the temperature turned cooler. Mom suggested taking a walk around Green Lake, and the mother and daughter changed into soft-soled shoes before heading out. The lake reflected the old buildings on the opposite shore, and returning waterbirds chattered among the plane tree branches. Mom took her arm and said as they walked, 'You don't need to rush to turn your essays into a grand piece; it's enough if you can capture the true flavor of Kunming's courtyards.' Sun Yuwei nodded, feeling that what truly mattered in life was not others' opinions, but the lake before her and her mother's company.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner for a family of three.
description: When she got home, her father had already finished work and was sitting on the sofa looking at a calligraphy copybook. At dinner, Sun Yuwei showed him the flower arrangement photos. Her father praised her for being dexterous and told amusing stories from work, making the whole family laugh. Dinner was braised pork ribs, cucumber salad, and tofu with green vegetable soup—warm and reassuring.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tasting cold-brewed jasmine tea
description: After dinner, I took the cold-brewed jasmine tea out of the fridge and poured it into a glass. The tea was pale golden with a delicate jasmine fragrance. I took a sip—it was pleasantly cold and sweet, with none of the astringency of hot-brewed tea. It felt wonderful. Excitedly, I drew a cup of tea and a snowflake symbol in my journal and wrote, “Fridge experiment: a big success!”
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening in-depth journal organization
description: Sipping cold-brewed tea, she organized the care knowledge learned in the afternoon, her mother's words during the walk, and the detailed essay outline into a complete page. Using purple, green, and blue pens, she marked flower arrangement tips, plant notes, and essay inspirations respectively, making the journal page colorful and well-organized.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Self-review and revision of the article.
description: She opened her laptop and reread the old draft that readers had criticized as 'too petty-bourgeois.' Keeping her original style, she added to the passage describing the rainy afternoon the vendor woman and her flowers that she had seen that morning at Dounan Flower Market, along with a short story about her mother growing mint. After the revision, the article gained a more grounded, down-to-earth quality. She sent the revised draft by email to editor Xu Mingyuan, with a note explaining the direction of the changes.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Voice chat with best friend Zhang Jing.
description: The phone rang; it was her best friend Zhang Jing. Leaning against the bed, she told Zhang Jing about her day's experiences: from the low spirits in the morning, to being healed by the scent of flowers at the flower market, to the gains from revising her article in the evening. Zhang Jing jokingly called her the broken flower school — no matter how broken the flowers were, in her hands they could be pieced together into brilliance. The two agreed to go to Zhuanxin Wet Market next week to buy groceries and cook, and ended the call happily.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation, reading, and falling asleep
description: After hanging up the phone, she changed into cotton pajamas, sat cross-legged at the foot of the bed, put on her earphones, and did a 10-minute body-scan meditation, relaxing from her scalp to her toes. Reviewing the day’s events, she felt a calm sense of security. Then she opened The Insect Book beside her pillow and read the passage where Fabre describes dung beetles pushing dung balls. That kind of patient, observant writing inspired her that prose should learn to “squat down and see the world.” After reading two sections, she closed the book, filled the water glass on her bedside table, set the alarm for 7:00 the next morning, softly said goodnight to the brightly lit Green Lake outside the window, turned off the light, and fell asleep in tranquility.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up, weighing in, and morning preparations.
description: The alarm went off right at seven. Sun Yuwei got up, went to the bathroom first, then stepped on the digital scale, which showed 45.7 kg. She took her usual two iron supplements and drank a glass of warm water. Looking at the overcast sky outside the window, the weather forecast predicted light rain today, so her morning walk plan was canceled.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine of brewing ripe pu-erh in a purple clay teapot and journaling
description: In front of the tea table in the study, Sun Yuwei brewed ripe Pu'er tea with a small purple clay pot. She weighed out 8 grams of tea leaves, warmed the pot and cups, added the leaves, rinsed them quickly with boiling water, then poured water using a high-pour technique. After tasting, she found the tea liquor richer and smoother than when brewed in a gaiwan, with a more concentrated aroma. She then wrote down her comparative thoughts in her refillable journal, recording how the heat retention of the purple clay pot brought out the woody aroma of the ripe Pu'er, and drew a quick sketch of the small pot.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning family yoga
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan spread yoga mats on the living room balcony and practiced mainly meditation and stretching. They sat down facing each other, took deep abdominal breaths, felt the flow of breath, and then slowly stretched their necks, shoulders, and spine. Afterwards, they stood by the window looking at the rain, and her mother said that rainy days are good for staying home and getting things done.
location: Balcony of the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast together
description: Mother Li Xiulan prepared multigrain steamed buns, boiled eggs, and hot soy milk, and Sun Yuwei had breakfast with her. During the meal, they mentioned that the afternoon tea ceremony class would cover water temperature and rhythm. Mother used the old saying 'water and fire in harmony' as a metaphor for the importance of using the right timing and heat in doing things.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with editor Xu Mingyuan
description: Morning meditation completed: 5 minutes of breathing meditation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Free reading and journal organizing
description: After the interview, Sun Yuwei did not start writing immediately. Instead, she continued reading Old Street Architecture of Kunming in the study, went through the chapter on Wenming Street, and sketched the hip-and-gable roof and carved window of Fulin Hall in her journal. Later, she also flipped through In Search of the City: Chengdu to take notes for a future trip.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped with meal preparation and lunch
description: Sun Yuwei went into the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan prepare lunch, peeling garlic and cutting scallions to help make braised beef. After her father Sun Mingyuan came home, the three ate together, talking about the cultural activities at her father's workplace and what he gained from his morning exchange with the editor. Her father praised the editor's suggestion, saying that scholarship must not rest on its laurels. After the meal, Sun Yuwei cleared the dishes and washed strawberries.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break
description: Sun Yuwei leaned back on the living room sofa, using her phone to browse flower arrangement videos shared by a gardening blogger, learning decluttering and pruning techniques. She then closed her eyes and dozed for about twenty minutes, saving her energy for the afternoon tea ceremony class.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Yunshuijian Teahouse
description: Sun Yuwei changed into an off-white linen long tunic and light blue jeans, slung on her canvas bag, and walked out of the community with an umbrella. After a three-minute walk to Huashan West Road bus stop, she took bus No. 1 for five stops to Danxia Road Intersection stop, then walked two more minutes to Yunshuijian Teahouse.
location: From Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, take Bus No. 1 from Huashan West Road Bus Stop to Danxia Road Intersection Stop, then walk to Yunshuijian Teahouse, No. 88 Danxia Road

name: Tea ceremony lesson: water temperature and rhythm.
description: In the lecture room on the second floor of Yunshuijian Teahouse, the tea ceremony teacher explained the optimal brewing water temperatures and pouring rhythms for different teas. Sun Yuwei used a thermometer to precisely measure the water temperature, repeatedly practiced the 'Phoenix Nods Three Times' and 'circular pouring' techniques, and brewed Phoenix Dancong tea at three water temperatures — 90, 95, and 100 degrees — for comparative tasting, recording the differences in aroma and taste. After class, she tasted sample teas with Sister Zhao and exchanged insights.
location: Lecture Room, 2nd Floor, Yunshuijian Teahouse, No. 88 Danxia Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking in the rain at Green Lake
description: After class, when she left the teahouse, the rain had stopped. Sun Yuwei took a taxi from Danxia Road to Green Lake Park, about a 15-minute ride. After the rain, there were few visitors in the park. She strolled along the waterside path, enjoying the thin mist on the lake, drops on the weeping willows, and ducks swimming. She took photos of the lake scenery with her phone and lingered for about half an hour, feeling relaxed.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home
description: Coming out of the south gate of Green Lake Park, Sun Yuwei walked about ten minutes back to her home at 7 Huashan West Road in Cuihu Community. After the rain, the streets were quiet and the air was fresh.
location: Walk from Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Watering the pothos and relaxing at home.
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei first went to the balcony to check the potted plants such as pothos, sprayed water on them with a small spray bottle, and wiped the dust off the leaves with a damp cloth. Then she sat on the living room sofa and browsed the chapter on cicadas in "The Records of Insects," enjoying some leisure time.
location: Balcony and living room of home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Dinner and casual family conversation
description: Mother Li Xiulan made a vegetable stir-fry and corn rib soup, and Sun Yuwei had dinner with her parents. At the table, they talked about the importance of water temperature from the afternoon tea ceremony class. Father Sun Mingyuan shared his experience of brewing tea with boiling water in his younger days, and Sun Yuwei smiled and corrected him, saying it depends on the tea leaves. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening white tea tasting and themed journaling
description: Sun Yuwei brewed White Peony in a glass cup in her study, taking about 5 grams of tea leaves and infusing them with water at around 90 degrees, observing the leaves unfurl and the tea liquor change color. She used watercolors to depict the pale yellow-green of the tea and the way the leaves sank, then wrote her tasting impressions in her journal and pasted the watercolor painting into it.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journal review and reflection notes
description: After pasting the finished watercolor insert into her journal, Sun Yuwei reviewed the day's events and recorded the editor's suggestions and her own reflections, realizing that a personal style, like a small path, can also lead to secluded beauty. Then she discussed the next day's plans with her mother, Li Xiulan, and agreed to go to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market together in the morning to buy fresh ingredients.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and body scan meditation
description: Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas, sat cross-legged in the bedroom, turned off the light, opened a white noise app to play the sound of rain, and did a ten-minute body scan meditation, relaxing each part from the top of the head to the toes. After the meditation, she turned on the light and read "The Book of Insects" for about ten minutes, feeling her thoughts settle.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: Sun Yuwei closed the book, turned off the light, and, with frogs croaking outside the window, closed her eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Decision to get up and write.
description: At 7 a.m., I woke naturally to the crisp sound of birdsong. After stretching, I first checked the weather on my phone (cloudy to clear, 16-24), then weighed myself on the scale and recorded 45.6 kg in my journal. Sitting on the edge of the bed, recalling editor Xu Mingyuan's advice, I flipped open the journal by the bed and solemnly wrote: 'Today's decision: do not avoid a delicate personal style, but in future writing, consciously incorporate observations of the surrounding social and natural reality, so that the work moves from personal emotion to shared experience.' This decision set the tone for today's actions.
location: Bedroom and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning walk at Green Lake and coming up with ideas
description: Put on workout clothes, grab a water bottle, and walk about 8 minutes from home to the South Gate of Green Lake Park. Stroll along the lake for 20 minutes, breathing in the damp morning air and watching elderly people doing morning exercises and seagulls playing on the water. During the walk, use the memo app on your phone to sketch out a framework for an essay blending today's street-life observations, with inspiration surging from the old street's bricks and tiles and the cries of vegetable vendors.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family morning yoga.
description: After returning home from the walk, Mother had already prepared the yoga mats. The mother and daughter did 30 minutes of morning yoga on the balcony, accompanied by the morning breeze. Today's movements were much smoother, especially in Warrior II, where she felt the stability and strength brought by the previous sessions. Mother praised her for having a good complexion.
location: Balcony of the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Nutritious breakfast
description: Had breakfast with her parents. Her mother cooked fragrant small-pot rice noodles with poached eggs and fresh vegetables. They chatted about today's plan to go to the vegetable market. After breakfast, she took her iron supplement.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tea tasting and journal review
description: After breakfast, I sat at the desk and spread out the journal from the past six days. I categorized them as 'regular / blended / cold-brew' and marked them with different colored markers. My favorite combination was 'Dianhong + osmanthus,' and I highlighted it with fluorescent stickers. I wrote 200 words of tea-tasting reflections and planned next week's theme: 'comparative evaluation of different water qualities (mineral water vs purified water).' I browsed my phone album, selected a group photo of this week's teas, and planned to print it out later.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping at Zhuanxin Food Market
description: She set out on foot with her mother at 10:30 and arrived about 27 minutes later at the bustling Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers Market. The market was abuzz with noise and full of fresh vegetables, fruits, mushrooms, flowers, and snacks. While helping her mother choose ingredients for dinner (green peppers, tomatoes, fish), she used her phone to capture the vendors' expressions and an elderly woman's smiling face. Passing a flower shop, she bought a bunch of budding lilies and a few sprigs of light purple forget-me-nots, planning to arrange flowers in the evening. Then they walked back home.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Assisted with meal preparation and family lunch
description: After returning home, she helped wash and trim the vegetables, peeled the tomatoes, and, under her mother's guidance, learned to make a stir-fried celtuce with garlic. The three of them sat around the table and enjoyed a hearty, home-style lunch. After the meal, she helped her mother clear the table.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday nap
description: After dinner, I took a 30-minute nap on the sofa in the study to relax both body and mind.
location: The sofa in the study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Thesis revision annotations and planning
description: After a refreshing lunch break, opened the computer and received detailed comments from advisor Wu Mingyuan on the thesis draft. Read through them carefully twice and highlighted key suggestions such as “The spatial theory analysis needs to be further deepened.” Listed a revision plan for next week in the notebook: 1. Add Lefebvre's “production of space” theoretical framework; 2. Reanalyze Section 1 of Chapter 3 in light of the Kunming star-rated hotel case; 3. Revise the logical chain connecting the conclusion with the theory.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with book friends
description: As arranged, she had a video call with book friend Yang Xiao. Yuwei shared her confusion about the ordering of her essay collection. Yang Xiao, as an editor, suggested breaking the chronological order and trying a three-part structure of “season, urban space, and inner monologue.” This suggestion made Yuwei feel enlightened. They also talked about the books they had been reading recently, and Yuwei recommended “The Old-Fashioned Girl's Shopping Route.”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the yoga studio for the group Vinyasa Flow class
description: After ending the call, she changed into professional yoga attire, slung on her yoga bag, and walked five minutes from home to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station at 15:45. She took Metro Line 3 for three stops to Dongfeng West Road Station, then walked three minutes after exiting and arrived at Zhongmu Yoga Studio at 16:00. She then attended a 60-minute vinyasa flow yoga group class. Led by instructor He Lu, she attempted a more difficult side plank variation; her core trembled, but she felt her strength improving. After class, she briefly discussed her practice with He Lu, who encouraged her to try the "Dance Flow" sequence.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-class sharing between mother and daughter at Cuihu
description: After the yoga class, she texted her mother to meet at Cuihu Park. The two sat and rested on a park bench. Yuwei shared her progress in today's yoga class and her study plan. Her mother was always the best listener and encouraged her to strike a balance between work and rest.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and flower handling
description: After returning home, her father did the cooking, making braised fish and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. After dinner, Yuwei voluntarily cleared the table and washed the dishes. Then she took out the lilies and forget-me-nots bought at the market today, trimmed the stems and leaves with flower scissors, arranged them in a glass vase, and placed them on the dining table to add a touch of color to the home.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Printing photos, deepening evening journaling, and flower arranging
description: After tidying up, at 18:35 I walked to Kunming Kaibang Digital Photo Printing at 132 Cuihu South Road to print out the group photo of this week's tea products from my phone. I got home around 19:10, spread out my journal, carefully pasted in the printed photos, and added a few sketches of today's market scenes beside them, such as "Aunt Xie's green pepper stall" and "the three-wheeled cart selling spring water." Then I adjusted the angle of the lily and forget-me-not flower arrangement and placed it on the coffee table.
location: Study and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening planning, meditation, and reading before sleep.
date: When I got home, my mother was preparing lunch. The three of us ate stir-fried seasonal vegetables and braised beef. I shared the preliminary conclusions from the morning's insurance comparison, as well as the plans for the afternoon and evening. After the meal, I went back to my room and took a 20-minute nap on the sofa.
description: Opened next week's class schedule and planned the coming week's writing and revision schedule in her journal, marking the 'spatial theory' section as important. After washing up and changing into pajamas, she lay in bed and used a meditation app for a 15-minute body scan meditation, shifting her attention from her slightly sore muscles to her breathing. After meditating, she picked up Tsurezuregusa from the bedside table and read for more than ten minutes. Then she set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning and gradually fell asleep in the soft, warm light, expected to drift into dreamland by 21:30.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk, grocery shopping, breakfast, and family yoga
description: At 6:30 in the morning, I went for a walk in Green Lake Park and jotted down imagery inspiration about 'stillness and flow' by the lake. On the way home, I passed the small supermarket downstairs and bought a bag of fresh rice noodles and tomatoes. After returning home, I enjoyed the small-pot rice noodles my mother had made, brewed some ancient-tree Pu'er tea, and shared the day's news with her. After breakfast, I unrolled a yoga mat on the balcony and practiced Cat-Cow and twisting poses with my mother. When we finished, she reminded me to keep a proper posture while writing.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and home in Cuihu Community at No. 7 Huashan West Road, as well as the small supermarket downstairs.

name: Starting thesis revision and catching up on theory.
description: Returning to the study, she turned on the computer and reviewed the thesis annotated by her advisor Wu Mingyuan, carefully reading each comment. She marked the section 'Supplement spatial theory analysis' as a priority and created a to-do list. Then she took Lefebvre's 'The Production of Space' from the bookshelf, marked several key chapters, and laid the theoretical foundation for revising the thesis.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Ten Selected Core Essays
description: In the study, I spread out drafts and printed manuscripts from the past two years, read them repeatedly, and made pencil notes. First I selected 15 pieces, then carefully picked the 7 highest-quality ones, and decided to select the remaining 3 in the bookstore in the afternoon based on new inspiration.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and family time.
description: After taking an iron supplement in the kitchen, she had lunch with her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan, who had come home at noon. She shared her morning progress on selecting manuscripts. Her parents suggested going to a bookstore in the afternoon for inspiration, and they planned to climb Xishan on the weekend.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon break
description: Returned to the bedroom, drew the curtains, and took a nap of about 40 minutes listening to birdsong outside the window, recharging for the afternoon's activities.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Hunting for books at the bookstore, exchanging ideas, finalizing the manuscript, and shopping along the way.
description: At 1 p.m., I walked to the Kunming Paper-Cloth-Stone Bookstore. After exchanging a brief greeting with the owner Qin Mingyuan, I went to the social science section on the second floor to study The Production of Space and The Practice of Everyday Life, taking note of case ideas in relation to Kunming's urban space. Then I received a WeChat call from editor Xu Mingyuan, discussing a new topic about “the lives of people on the urban fringe,” and I promised to submit a proposal next week. Afterwards, I had an iced Americano in the coffee area on the first floor. Using the theoretical inspiration from just now, I picked the final three essays from the candidate manuscripts and bought Kunming's Wet Markets and Life and a notebook. On the way home, I bought yogurt for my mother at the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and chose osmanthus and dark plum tea bags for myself.

name: Learning abdominal breathing techniques and meditation
description: I changed into comfortable pajamas and carefully studied the steps of diaphragmatic breathing on my phone. Then I turned off the lights, lay flat on my back, placed my hands on my abdomen, and began to practice. I slowly inhaled, feeling my belly rise, then slowly exhaled, feeling my belly sink. I practiced for 10 minutes and felt very relaxed. Then I did a 5-minute body scan meditation, relaxing from my toes to the top of my head one by one.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening tea and quiet reading
description: After calming her body and mind, she brewed a pot of light aged white tea in a small teapot. Leaning against the headboard, she opened Wang Xiaobo's essay collection “My Spiritual Home” and read quietly under the warm yellow desk lamp, letting the fragrance of tea and books accompany her.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening journaling and bedtime preparation.

Mom made fried egg toast and fruit, while I specially brewed Bangdong ancient-tree spring tea. The tea was fresh and crisp on the palate, with a long lingering sweetness.

Finally, she wrote a summary: “I have successfully gotten rid of my dependence on milk tea, and my rhythm has become calm and orderly.” She also began outlining next month's theme of “comparing different water qualities.”

After lunch, she returned to her room and rested for 20 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's plans.

Along the way, she sent a message to her close friend Zhang Jing to let her know she was on her way.

location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Basic skin cleansing and care

name: Had breakfast at the dining table in the living room at home with father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan. Mom prepared millet porridge, boiled eggs, and apples. During breakfast, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to talk with her parents about the architectural framing techniques she learned in yesterday's photography class. description: After leaving the beauty salon, I walked slowly along Dongfeng West Road toward Cuihu Park, met up with my mother by the lake, and we strolled along the lakeside together. I told her excitedly that the paper had finally passed its final check, and asked in detail about her preference for accommodation at Fuxian Lake. She said she wanted to stay in a guesthouse that was "quiet, with a lake view."
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Family dinner

At the dinner table, I relayed Mom's requirements for the homestay to Father, and he shared several self-driving travel guides he had seen. We decided to wait for my older sister's video call tomorrow before finalizing the plan.

name: Family discussion about travel plans.

name: Journal keeping and solitary time
description: After the family meeting, returned to my study. Opened the journal, pasted in today's tea photos and the coffee shop receipt, drew a little yoga figure with colored pencils, and noted the satisfaction of finishing the thesis. Then, on the 'Travel Plans' page, organized my parents' ideas into bullet points.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime relaxation ritual and reading
description: After washing up, she changed into comfortable pajamas, turned off the bedroom main light, switched on the aromatherapy diffuser, and sat cross-legged on the bed to begin 15 minutes of abdominal breathing practice. After the meditation, she picked up the new translation of Tsurezuregusa on the nightstand and casually flipped through seven or eight pages, taking in the quiet, serene, and solitary atmosphere of Yoshida Kenko's writing. Then she turned off the bedside lamp, set the alarm for 22:45, closed her eyes contentedly, and drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning ritual: Cuihu Lake walk and family yoga
description: After waking up early, Sun Yuwei changed into sportswear and walked to Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park), which was very close to home, to enjoy the weekend tranquility and watch elderly morning exercisers and egrets. Then she returned to the balcony at home, where she and her mother Li Xiulan unrolled yoga mats and did a 30-minute home yoga practice with birdsong, including poses such as Cat-Cow and Downward-Facing Dog, stretching their bodies and starting a vibrant day.
location: Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the balcony at home.

name: Family breakfast and discussing the plans for the day
description: The family had breakfast in the dining room. Her mother had prepared congee with side dishes, toasted bread, and fried eggs. While eating, Sun Yuwei shared today's plan with her mother: pack clothes and book a guesthouse at Fuxian Lake in the morning, and attend the last tea ceremony class in the afternoon. Her mother reminded her that the community clothing donation bin is right next to 56 Cuihu South Road and is very convenient.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Closet decluttering and Fuxian Lake homestay booking
description: Sun Yuwei organized her wardrobe in the study, selected 15 items based on the 'not worn in a year' rule, including ill-fitting dresses, faded T-shirts, and outdated jeans, and neatly packed them into an eco-friendly bag. Then she turned on her computer, compared several two-bedroom, one-living-room homestays by Fuxian Lake on Ctrip, and finally chose 'Fuxian Lake Zhenshui Xiaozhu,' paying the deposit with her manuscript fees. She sent a screenshot of the order to the family group chat and also separately to her older sister Sun Yutong, letting her know the homestay was booked and waiting for her sister to arrange transportation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go to the community charity clothing recycling bin to donate.
description: Sun Yuwei carried a heavy eco-friendly bag of clothes and walked about 5 minutes to the community clothing donation bin beside No. 56 Cuihu South Road. The sunlight filtered through the French plane trees, and she felt happy. After arriving, she tightly tied the bag opening, solemnly dropped it into the donation bin, and took a photo for the record.
location: Community charity clothing recycling bin beside No. 56 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and midday relaxation.
description: Back home, her mother had already prepared lunch: bitter vegetable soup, stir-fried pork, and cold rice noodles. The family ate together. After lunch, Sun Yuwei curled up on the living room sofa, scrolled through the “Minimalist Living” group on Douban, browsing members' minimalist practices to find inspiration for posting in the afternoon.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: After a half-hour lunch break, Sun Yuwei made herself a cup of cold-brew osmanthus oolong tea, and the refreshing tea fragrance lifted her spirits. She packed her tea-tasting journal and pencil case into a canvas bag, changed into a comfortable linen maxi skirt, and got ready to head out for her tea class.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Took a ride to the tea ceremony class.

location: Kunming, Yunnan Province, on Bus No. 5 from Cuihu Community Bus Stop in Wuhua District to No. 28 Danxia Road, Xishan District

name: Tea ceremony course final assessment and farewell to classmates
description: At the Yunshuijian Teahouse, Sun Yuwei attended the last class and graduation assessment of the tea ceremony course. She calmly completed the gaiwan brewing of Phoenix Dancong and the zisha teapot brewing of ripe pu-erh tea, earning the teacher’s praise: “Your water pouring is very steady, and your tea pouring is very precise.” After class, she chatted happily with her classmate Sister Zhao about tea ceremony and journaling, and they hit it off so well that they added each other on WeChat. Sun Yuwei drew a small orchid next to Sister Zhao’s name in her journal as a keepsake, and they agreed to go tea tasting by Green Lake another day.
location: Yunshuijian Tea House, Yard No. 28, Danxia Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dusk walk and inspiration-gathering at Green Lake
description: After class, Sun Yuwei walked back to Cuihu Lake and strolled along the shore to take in the scenery. The evening sunlight was soft and the lake sparkled. She photographed moments of light and shadow among the weeping willows, the water, and the visitors, preparing them as material for a Douban post.
location: Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to rest and journal
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei changed into loungewear, poured a cup of warm water, and curled up on the sofa. She took out her tea ceremony class notes and added her tea tasting reflections to her journal, comparing today's Fenghuang Dancong 'mountain charm' with the ripe Pu'er tea 'aged aroma'.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening mother-daughter walk and sharing around Cuihu Lake.
description: Sun Yuwei took her mother’s hand and went for another walk around Green Lake. She showed her mother photos of donated clothes, shared the joy of finishing her tea ceremony course, and told her about a new friend, Sister Zhao. Her mother praised her for getting better and better at arranging her life. In the sunset glow, the mother and daughter talked about their anticipation for the trip to Fuxian Lake. The lake reflected the purple-red sky, warm and beautiful.
location: Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and discussion of the Fuxian Lake itinerary
description: After returning from the walk, her father had already prepared dinner. At the dinner table, the family discussed the trip to Fuxian Lake. Her father shared a few off-the-beaten-path scenic spots, and her mother was full of praise for the lake-view room at the guesthouse. After dinner, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to clean up the dishes, enjoying the small joy of serving the family.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post on Douban to share minimalist practice
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei opened her computer in the study, logged into the Douban group "Minimalist Living," and posted "[Personal Account] From 'A Wardrobe Hard to Come By' to '15 Items Decluttered': My Second Minimalist Practice." She described in detail the process of organizing her wardrobe and donating items, attached before-and-after photos and recycling bin photos, and sincerely shared her psychological shift from "can't bear to throw things away" to "making the best use of everything." The post quickly received likes and comments, and she carefully replied to every group member, exchanging insights in depth.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Setting consumption principles and recording them in a journal.
description: After posting, Sun Yuwei opened her brown softcover journal and, on today’s page, wrote the core consumption principle “one-in, one-out,” and drew “+” and “−” symbols. Then she tore out the page and pinned it to the corkboard in front of her desk as a warning for the future.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime meditation and breathing relaxation
description: Sun Yuwei changed into her pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bed, and played a 15-minute guided meditation audio. Following the guidance, she practiced diaphragmatic breathing, slowly inhaling to feel her belly rise, then slowly exhaling, releasing the day's fatigue and thoughts.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and falling asleep peacefully
description: After meditation, relaxed in body and mind, Sun Yuwei picked up "Tsurezuregusa" from the bedside, turned to the bookmark, and read three or four passages, savoring the quiet, tranquil charm of Yoshida Kenko's writing. At 22:45 she closed the book, turned off the desk lamp, and fell asleep peacefully with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning Green Lake walk and interview preparation
description: Set off from home in sportswear and power-walked along the Green Lake trail for 20 minutes. A thin mist hung over the lake in the early morning, and the black-headed gulls were still asleep. While walking, I used my phone's memo app to add interview questions, including ‘how I felt the first time I completed a work on my own.’ After the walk, back home, I checked the voice recorder battery and camera memory card in the living room, opened my notebook, clipped a pen in place, and made sure the interview gear was all ready.
