location: From the home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Green Lake Park at No. 67 Cuihu South Road, then returned home.

name: Partner yoga with mother on the balcony
description: Her mother Li Xiulan had already laid out the yoga mat. The two of them did a partner shoulder-opening sequence. Sun Yuwei assisted her mother in completing a Camel Pose variation, and her mother praised her for well-controlled strength. Then they did Cat-Cow Pose to stretch the spine, ending with Child’s Pose to relax. Morning light cast dappled light and shadows through the pothos on the balcony.
location: Balcony of home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and confirming interview arrangements
description: Mother prepared fried egg toast and milk, and Father poured pu'er tea while reading the morning newspaper. As she ate, Sun Yuwei confirmed that Mother had packed a lunch box with cold eggplant and cherry tomatoes. Father reminded her to be careful in the many alleys of Guandu Old Town and urged her to come back early. After the meal, she put the lunch box into her canvas bag.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting to Guandu Ancient Town
description: Walk to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station. Before entering the station, send a WeChat message to editor Xu Mingyuan to confirm the meeting point is the archway at the main gate of Guandu Ancient Town. Take Metro Line 1 for about 15 minutes to Xingyao Road Station. On the way, check the location of the old-artisan shop 'Zhou's Silver Workshop' in the ancient town on your phone and note it in the memo. After getting out of the station, take a taxi for about 10 minutes to the main gate of Guandu Ancient Town. Along the way, blue jacarandas are in full bloom outside the window.
location: From Huashan West Road Metro Station in Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, take Metro Line 1 to Xingyao Road Station, then take a taxi to the main gate of Guandu Ancient Town in Guandu District.

name: Joint interview with a veteran craftsman of silver-inlaid black copper at Guandu Ancient Town.
description: After meeting up with editor Xu Mingyuan at the front gate archway, they walked on foot to the old house in the deep alley. Grandpa Zhou, wearing a navy blue Chinese tunic suit, demonstrated the chasing and engraving process in the courtyard. Xu Mingyuan filmed, and Sun Yuwei recorded audio and took notes throughout. She noted down the craft formula 'silver wire inlaid into a copper body, soaked in chemical solution to oxidize and turn black,' and captured details such as Grandpa Zhou being beaten while learning the craft in his youth and practicing engraving characters under an oil lamp. Midway, when his apprentice brought tea for a break, Sun Yuwei asked about young people's views on passing on the craft, and Grandpa Zhou shook his head, saying, 'Very few are willing to learn.' At the end of the interview, Sun Yuwei asked an additional question: 'If you were to compare your craft career to an object, what would it be?' Grandpa Zhou answered, 'This chasing tool—the more you sharpen it, the brighter it gets.' She noted this sentence down as the opening of her article.
location: Zhou's Silver Workshop, No. 12 Yunjin Lane, Guandu Ancient Town, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Return home.
description: Took a taxi back the same way from the entrance of Yunjin Lane. On the way, I quickly reviewed the recording on my phone, which was about two hours long, and wrote on the notebook cover: “The chisel grows brighter the more it is ground—opening line.” Arrived downstairs at home at 12:25.
location: Took a taxi from the entrance of Yunjin Alley, Guandu Ancient Town, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, back to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District.

name: Lunch, organize interview materials, and take a midday rest.
description: After washing her hands, she sat at the dining table and opened the lunchbox. Her mother was trimming vegetables beside her and asked about the interview. Sun Yuwei showed her close-up photos of the silver wire inlay, and her mother praised the craftsmanship. After the meal, she went into the study, copied the audio files to her computer, and used a thick pen to mark key timestamps in her notebook (such as 'Uncle Zhou talks about his apprenticeship—10:35-11:09'), and wrote 'The chisel gets sharper with use' on a sticky note for easy reference. Then she lay on the living room sofa with her eyes closed for 15 minutes to relieve fatigue. When she woke up, she boiled water and made a cup of Yunnan green tea (Lincang large-leaf variety), sat on the study bay window and drank tea while daydreaming, the tea fragrance washing away her tiredness.
location: Dining room, study, and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Detailed sorting of interview materials in the study
description: She put her phone on silent and placed it in the drawer, focusing on processing the recording. She turned on her computer and used Notepad to transcribe key parts segment by segment, organizing the oral account by 'apprenticeship experience—craft techniques—inheritance difficulties,' and annotating each segment with visual imagery (e.g., 'can describe the movements under the oil lamp'). She opened the seven pages of handwritten notes, highlighted the key points with a marker, drew a narrative flow chart on A4 paper, and decided to begin with 'the chisel gets brighter the more it is ground,' weave craft details and apprentice stories into the middle, and return to the impact of mechanical reproduction on handicrafts at the end. Satisfied with the preliminary outline, she sketched a draft in her journal. Twice during this period, she refilled her cup of Yunnan green tea.
location: Desk in the study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to Zhongmou Yoga Studio.
description: She changed into yoga clothes and loose sweatpants, put her yoga mat on her back, and walked along Renmin Middle Road, turning right onto Dongfeng West Road for about 15 minutes. Along the way, she passed a street-corner newsstand without stopping. The autumn wind on her face took away the fatigue of the interview. After checking in at the yoga studio's front desk, she placed her hoodie and mat in the locker in advance.
location: Walk from home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road.

name: Vinyasa flow group class.
description: Instructor He Lu had arranged a sequence focused on spinal flow and hip opening, set to upbeat yoga music. Sun Yuwei moved smoothly through Cobra Pose and Downward-Facing Dog Pose in sync with her breath, though in Half Moon Pose her right leg wobbled slightly; Instructor He gently supported her pelvis to cue alignment. The class ended with Corpse Pose, and she felt her whole body stretched and released, her mind cleared of the interview clips, leaving only physical stillness. After class she went to the front desk to drink lemon water and refresh herself.
location: Large Classroom, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home and took a short rest.
description: She walked home from the yoga studio at a brisk pace. After arriving home, she first hung the yoga mat on the balcony to air out, changed into loose loungewear, and drank a large glass of warm water. Then she sat on the edge of the bed and replied to three WeChat messages from her elder sister Sun Yutong, agreeing to a video call at 19:30.
location: Walk back from Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Walked with mother around Green Lake, sharing interview stories.
description: Walking side by side with my mother Li Xiulan along the Green Lake trail, we made a full circle around the lake. The setting sun reflected on the lake, and waterbirds pecked for food. Sun Yuwei excitedly recounted two details about Grandpa Zhou: in winter, when his hands were stiff with cold, he would warm them by the brazier and then go back to carving; and at eighty, he still sharpened his tools at five every morning. My mother suggested that adding such daily habits to the article would make it vivid for readers, so Sun Yuwei immediately noted in her phone memo 'five in the morning, sharpening tools — a visual scene'. The two took a photo together on the Nine-Turn Bridge in the twilight.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and helping with cleanup.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work and cooked chicken in clear soup, stir-fried lotus root, cucumber salad, and stir-fried baby bok choy. At the dinner table, he briefly shared what he had gained from the interview, and Father sighed that old handicrafts needed to be preserved. After dinner, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to wash the dishes and pots, while her mother wiped the table and mopped the floor in tacit coordination, leaving the kitchen tidy again.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had a video call with my older sister to finalize the travel details for Fuxian Lake.
description: With the iPad propped up on the desk for a video call, her older sister Sun Yutong, in her rented apartment in Shenzhen, asked about the interview. Then they compared two guesthouses and finally chose the previously booked lakeside two-bedroom, one-living-room unit, because it was quiet and had a wooden boardwalk leading directly to the lake. They confirmed their father's suggestion: on May Day, first take a boat to Gushan Island, and the next day cycle around the lake. Sun Yuwei wrote the agreement in her daily journal: "Friday afternoon, self-drive from Kunming to the west shore of Fuxian Lake, stay at a guesthouse for two nights, Gushan Island + cycling around the lake," and said she would look up the cycling route on the west shore and send it to her sister.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of the home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tasted White Peony tea and recorded today's gains in her journal.
description: Boiled water and brewed a cup of 2019 Fuding White Peony. The tea liquor was pale yellow, clear, with a delicate floral fragrance. I opened my journal, wrote down the date and the key phrase 'Guandu Ancient Town, silver-inlaid black copper, Uncle Zhou's chisel gets brighter with polishing' in pen, drew a small silver-wire pattern, and stuck on a memo note reading 'Craft formula — copper base, silver wire, chemical solution'. After tasting the tea, I wrote my thoughts: 'At the end of the interview, Uncle Zhou touched his shiny silver-wire chisel and said that a person is also a chisel—the more it is polished, the brighter it becomes. Maybe the article should end with this sentence.' I closed my journal.
location: Desk in the study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Water the pothos and tidy up the study
description: Went to the balcony and used a spray bottle to thoroughly mist the pothos potted plant, and removed three yellow leaves. Back at the desk, put the interview notebook, voice recorder, and camera back in place, stacked the manuscript paper neatly, and clipped the sticky note reading 'a chisel gets sharper the more it is ground' into the daily journal for later use. The study was restored to a tidy state; opened the curtains and looked at the city lights in the night outside the window.
location: Living room balcony and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and abdominal breathing
description: After changing into pajamas, she sat cross-legged on the bed and dimmed the bedside lamp. Closing her eyes, she practiced abdominal breathing: inhaling deeply as her belly rose, exhaling as it fell, repeating about 15 times. Then she did a ten-minute awareness meditation, letting the image of Grandpa Zhou's calloused fingers and wrinkled smile appear, linger, and fade in her mind. Finally, she ended with five long, deep breaths, feeling her chest relaxed and her body warm.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Pour a glass of warm water for mother and set it by her bedside, then return to the bedroom, set the alarm for 7:00 tomorrow morning, and put the phone on the charger. Lying down and pulling up the quilt, with the lingering fragrance of white peony tea in the air, I remembered mother saying during the evening walk, "Doing interviews is like falling in love with old stories." The corners of my mouth curled up slightly. Listening to the faint sound of a dog barking in the distance, I soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk: Taking in the morning air at Green Lake.
description: Sun Yuwei woke up on time at 6:40, with faint light filtering through the curtain gap. After washing up quickly and changing into her sports shoes, she was already walking along the path in Cuihu Park before 7 o'clock. After yesterday's rain, the air was especially fresh, carrying the damp scent of soil and plants. She walked a slow lap around the pavilion at the center of the lake, her steps brisk and her mood elated, because the final draft of her thesis was due today. At 7:10, she returned home feeling fresh and clean.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Morning family yoga: flowing with mother
description: Sun Yuwei changed into her yoga clothes and pushed open the living room window to let the morning breeze in. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had already laid out the mats. They started with Sun Salutations and did a 30-minute gentle vinyasa flow. Her mother was in especially good form today, moving more fluidly than usual. Sun Yuwei couldn't help praising her: "Mom, your downward-facing dog is getting more and more accurate!" Her mother smiled and replied, "It's from practicing with you." They finished at 7:30, both feeling relaxed in body and mind.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Breakfast and organizing materials.
description: Mother Li Xiulan made steaming hot oatmeal porridge and boiled eggs, and father Sun Mingyuan went downstairs as usual to buy fried dough sticks. At the table, father flipped through the local morning paper and said, "The weather is nice today, it's a good day to go out." Sun Yuwei responded casually, but in her mind she was planning the final check of her thesis. After breakfast, she returned to her small study, opened her laptop, and began digitizing and archiving the recordings and handwritten notes from yesterday's interview with the old artisan specializing in black copper and silver inlay in Guandu Ancient Town. She sent a WeChat message to her editor Xu Mingyuan: "Editor Xu, I'm organizing the interview material from yesterday. I'll send you a short essay this afternoon."
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Core work: revising and submitting the paper
description: Sun Yuwei put on her headphones, turned on white noise, and began the most important task of the day. Following the comments from her supervisor Wu Mingyuan, she focused on deepening the spatial theory analysis section, incorporating perspectives from her previous research on the cultural space of independent bookstores, adding a unique highlight to the paper. At 11:15, she finished the final proofreading: page numbers, references, and table of contents, all correct. She submitted the final version through the university thesis system and sent an email CC'ing her supervisor. The moment she clicked the send button, she leaned back in her chair, let out a long breath, and smiled.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Social interaction: received a wedding invitation
description: Just as she finished dealing with her thesis, Sun Yuwei's phone rang with an email notification. It was a preview image of a gold-embossed electronic wedding invitation sent by high school classmate Zhao Qi. Opening it and looking at the photo of Zhao Qi in a wedding dress, a mix of emotions welled up in her: happy for her friend, and also sighing at how fast time flies. She took a screenshot and sent it to her best friend Zhang Jing, saying, 'Hey, Jingjing, Zhao Qi is getting married!' The two chatted for a bit, then Sun Yuwei opened her journal and formally recorded the matter.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Lunch at home and midday rest
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, made a light lunch: tomato scrambled eggs, pea shoot soup, and rice mixed with Lao Gan Ma chili sauce. As she ate, Sun Yuwei chatted with her parents and told them the flight information for her sister that afternoon. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, immediately said excitedly, 'Let's go have mushroom hot pot tonight!' After the meal, Sun Yuwei cleared the dishes on her own initiative, then went back to her bedroom, drew the curtains, put on an eye mask, and took a 30-minute nap.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Journal recording and appointment planning
description: Feeling refreshed after her lunch break, Sun Yuwei took out her TN journal and used her fountain pen to write down her reflections on receiving the invitation. Then she planned the details for attending: she used the map app on her phone to look up the location of the wedding banquet hotel (assuming it was in Panlong District), checked the taxi fare, and looked up bus routes. In the new-idea section of her journal, she wrote 'dress code keywords: simple, appropriate, soft color palette,' roughly estimated a red envelope budget, and marked 'source material, source material' as a reminder to record it as writing material.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Writing an electronic draft: "Time Between a Craftsman's Fingers".
description: While the inspiration was still there, Sun Yuwei opened a document and wrote a short essay of about 800 words. She skillfully combined the memory of yesterday's interview about the black-copper silver-inlay craft with her feelings about the passage of time after receiving the invitation today. At the end of the essay, she mentioned that a wedding was another form of presenting one's work. After finishing, she proofread it once and emailed it to Editor Xu, with the message: Editor Xu, this is a small insight derived from the interview. I wonder if it can be used as column material.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Preparations for airport pickup and light handicraft tasks
description: Sun Yuwei changed out of her loungewear into a light blue cotton-linen dress, and lightly applied moisturizer and sunscreen. She gently watered the mint and pothos that her father kept on the balcony, while wondering what local specialties her sister would bring back from Shenzhen. At 16:15, her father Sun Mingyuan called her: 'Weiwei, time to go!'
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Went to Changshui Airport to pick up her elder sister Sun Yutong
description: At 16:30, her father Sun Mingyuan drove the whole family to the airport. Sun Yuwei sat in the back seat, chatting with her family about the surprise of her sister coming home early, occasionally checking Sun Yutong's flight status on her phone. They arrived at the arrival hall of Kunming Changshui International Airport at 17:20. While waiting at the exit, when she saw her sister Sun Yutong walking out quickly with her suitcase, Sun Yuwei waved excitedly, then stepped forward with her parents and gave her sister a big hug.
location: Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and a brief family rest.
description: After picking up her older sister, Sun Yuwei drove back into the city. In the car, her sister shared interesting stories about Shenzhen and her work projects, and the car was full of laughter and conversation. Passing through the northern part of the city, her parents suggested buying popsicles to satisfy a craving. They got home at 19:00, rested briefly, and then went out for a walk together. Along familiar streets and alleys, they walked to Green Lake Park. Sun Yuwei and her sister walked side by side, listening to her sister talk about Shenzhen's fast pace, while also sharing her own college life and the frustrations and sense of achievement of being a 'full-time' writer.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Family reunion dinner: mushroom hot pot.
description: After the walk, the family of four went directly to Binhu Restaurant on Wenlin Street, a mushroom hot pot place near Sun Yuwei's home that they often visited. They ordered porcini mushrooms, green-headed mushrooms, and termite mushrooms, all steaming hot. During the 20 minutes of waiting for the broth to boil, the family sat together with a lively atmosphere. Her elder sister suggested a self-driving trip to Fuxian Lake during the May Day holiday; her mother supplemented the route; her father immediately took out his phone to show the maps and travel guides he had recently studied. Everyone reached a consensus. Surrounded by the laughter and chatter of her family, Sun Yuwei felt immensely happy and grounded.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family time: sharing recordings and memories.
description: After dinner, they went home. Sun Yuwei suggested listening to the gift her sister had brought back—a smart speaker. Everyone sat around the sofa, and her sister Sun Yutong showed off her new smart-home favorite. Then Sun Yuwei played on her phone the recording of the black-copper-and-silver-inlay craftsman hammering copper from yesterday. Everyone listened quietly, and her father, Sun Mingyuan, said, “This sound carries the flavor of history.” The atmosphere was warm and full of laughter.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening wind-down and mind-body relaxation
description: At 21:45, Sun Yuwei finished washing up and changed into comfortable silk pajamas. She turned off the main light, leaving only a warm-yellow desk lamp on. Sitting down on the bed, she wrote a few keywords at the end of today's journal: "thesis final draft, family warmth, Zhao Qi's wedding, sister's return." Then she put down her phone, sat cross-legged, and began 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation. She focused on her breath, feeling the rise and fall from her abdomen to her chest, and felt gratitude and calm toward life and her family. At 22:45, she lay down and fell asleep with a satisfied smile.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Getting up and waking the body
description: The alarm went off, and Sun Yuwei woke from sleep, feeling the morning light outside the window. She stretched in bed, then got up to weigh herself, recording 45.7 kilograms. After gently moving her neck and wrists, she felt her energy gradually returning and got ready for the new day.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning walk and chat with sisters
description: Sun Yuwei changed into a cotton-linen dress and went downstairs with her sister Sun Yutong to walk around the Cuihu Community garden and the surrounding alleys. The morning air was fresh, and the grass on the stone-slab path was dotted with dew. Her sister told her about a cultural-creative bookstore she often went to in Futian District, Shenzhen, describing the handmade-paper wall. Sun Yuwei was fascinated, and they agreed to go to Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore together in the afternoon.
location: Cuihu Community garden and surrounding alleys (near No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming)

name: Morning family yoga
description: Sun Yuwei, her mother Li Xiulan, and her older sister Sun Yutong spread out yoga mats in the living room and did morning yoga. Sun Yuwei led the class, guided her mother to adjust her postures; her sister fell sideways to the ground because she was unsteady, and the three of them laughed heartily. After yoga, her mother said her body felt more comfortable than yesterday.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Building 1, Unit 3, Room 502, living room

name: Breakfast time
description: In the kitchen, Sun Yuwei cooked small-pot rice noodles, simmering the soup base from pork bones and adding pickled mustard greens, chives, and minced meat. She brewed a low-sugar black tea with fresh milk for herself and paired it with flower cakes. After tasting the rice noodles, her mother and sister praised her improved cooking, and her sister said the flavor matched her memory.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning work and a short break
description: Sun Yuwei put on headphones in the study, organized the recording of her April 27 interview with an old craftsman in Guandu Ancient Town, noted down key quotes, and archived photos and notes by theme. Afterward, she went to the balcony, trimmed the yellow leaves of the lisianthus and changed the water, then looked toward Cuihu Lake to relax her eyes. Later, she brewed osmanthus black tea in the living room, browsed her phone to check the editor's reply, and saved a Cuihu walking route, taking a short break to recharge.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Green Lake Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study, balcony, living room).

name: Write the first draft of the interview article.
description: Sun Yuwei opened a document in her study and began drafting the interview article. She started with the scene of first meeting the old craftsman, incorporated details from the recording, and described the story of the old man who began learning his craft at 15, worked for 60 years, and had hands covered in calluses. She focused on typing, completed about 1,500 words, and felt the writing flowed smoothly and pleasurably.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch preparation and meal
description: Sun Yuwei, her mother, and her elder sister worked together in the kitchen to prepare lunch. She peeled garlic and washed cilantro, her sister heated the mushroom soup brought from Shenzhen, and her mother made shepherd's purse and pork dumplings and so on. The lunch was rich in dishes, including mushroom soup, braised prawns, stir-fried pea shoots, and matsutake sashimi. During the meal, her sister shared funny stories from her Shenzhen workplace and was called a 'workaholic' by her colleagues; her mother urged her to rest more.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon break
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the bedroom, drew the curtains, played white noise of rain, fragments of the manuscript flashing through her mind as she quickly drifted into a light sleep to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon preparation and heading to the yoga studio
description: Sun Yuwei woke up from her afternoon nap, drank some water, changed into yoga pants and a quick-dry T-shirt, and gathered her yoga card, phone, keys, and books. At the entrance of the residential complex, she scanned a shared bike and cycled about 12 minutes to Dechun Commercial Building. The spring breeze along the way was pleasant, and she noticed the 'Spring Rest' coffee shop.
location: Rode from 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Flow yoga class and post-class relaxation.
description: Sun Yuwei attended Instructor He Lu's flow yoga group class at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, themed Spinal Flow, stretching her body through the transitions between poses. After class, she talked with the instructor, who recommended the Fuxian Lake Jianshan hiking route and sent a location pin. Then, in the rest area, she drank lemon water and ate whole-grain crackers, and looked up the location of Zhibushi Bookstore.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, picked up magazines, and chatted.
description: Sun Yuwei walked from the yoga studio to Cuihu North Road, passing through streets shaded by plane trees to relax her mind. When she arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore, the owner, Uncle Qin, took out the latest issue of Harvest magazine for her. The two chatted in rattan chairs; she shared her thesis and the news of her sister coming home, while Uncle Qin brewed Pu'er tea and remarked on how wonderful family reunions are. She flipped through the magazine and saw an article about cloisonné craftsmanship, which inspired her writing.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meet up with family at Green Lake Park and take a walk.
description: Sun Yuwei walked to the south gate of Green Lake Park and met up with her mother and older sister. Her sister handed her a sugar-free brown sugar bubble tea. The three women strolled side by side around the lake, while her sister related her Shenzhen colleagues' experiences of living in Dali and gathering around the stove to brew tea, and Sun Yuwei added to the conversation from time to time. They rested on a bench in the mid-lake pavilion, admiring the lake surface gilded by the sunset and enjoying the breeze.
location: Lakeside walking trail and the lake-center pavilion at Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home in the evening and preparing dinner
description: The mother and her two daughters walked home from the north gate of Cuihu Park, buying chives and spring onions at the vegetable shop at the entrance to the residential community on the way. Back home, the whole family made dumplings together: the mother kneaded the dough and rolled out the wrappers, the elder sister was fairly skilled at rolling wrappers, Sun Yuwei filled the dumplings and pinched the pleated edges, and their father joined in to help after getting off work. The radio at home was playing a program, and the family chatted while they worked, in a cheerful atmosphere.
location: Walk from Cuihu Park to the kitchen and living room of Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dinner and family chat
description: Sun Yuwei prepared the dipping sauce and cooked two pots of dumplings: chive and egg, and shepherd's purse and pork. The family sat around and tasted them. Her father opened a beer, her sister poured a glass, and Sun Yuwei drank Pu'er tea. During the meal, the conversation continued to the Fuxian Lake road trip plan, her sister's work, and her article writing progress. Her father encouraged her to carefully document the old crafts and affirmed her efforts.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening movie preparation and viewing
description: After Sun Yuwei and her sister cleared the dishes, they set up the projector and connected the laptop. Her sister picked Hirokazu Kore-eda's 'Still Walking'. She brewed jasmine tea and set out nuts and bayberries. The sisters curled up on the sofa to watch the film. When a flashback scene appeared, her sister was reminded of their childhood. After the film, they discussed their understanding of regret and the depth of a mother's love.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Building 1, Unit 3, Room 502, living room

name: Journaling and abdominal breathing
description: Sun Yuwei wrote in her journal under the desk lamp in the study, recording the date, keywords, and screenshots of the hiking route recommended by He Lu. Then she returned to the bedroom, dimmed the lights, and did 10 minutes of abdominal breathing, feeling the flow of breath and letting her thoughts settle.
location: Study and bedroom at Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Stretching, reading, and falling asleep before bed.
description: Sun Yuwei did some simple stretches to loosen up, then went to the balcony to water the lisianthus and pothos. Back in bed, she read an article about cloisonné in Harvest magazine for about ten minutes. After turning off the light, she reviewed her fulfilling day in the dark, thought about tomorrow's plans for writing and visiting the flower market, and gradually drifted into a warm sleep.
location: Bedroom and balcony, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Morning light streamed through the curtains onto the wooden floor, and Sun Yuwei was naturally awakened by her body clock. She got up, drank a glass of warm lemon water, stepped on the scale to confirm her weight was 45.8kg, then did a few shoulder and neck stretches to wake up her body and prepare for morning yoga.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk by Green Lake
description: Sun Yuwei entered the park through the south gate of Green Lake. The warm late-spring sunlight filtered through the leaves onto the lake. She wore earphones and listened to soft piano music, watching elderly people walking their birds by the lake and young people jogging. A wonderful metaphor about 'cracks and light' came to mind, connecting to the craft of black copper inlaid with silver, and she found inspiration for the ending of her manuscript.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Morning yoga with Mom
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan spread out yoga mats in the living room for one last joint practice before the mothers' union spring outing. In Warrior II, they sensed each other; in the partner Tree Pose, they balanced with tacit coordination. When they finished, they pressed their palms together. Her mother reminded her that she would no longer be supervising at home starting tomorrow, and Yuwei replied with a joke.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and route planning for the flower market.
description: The family sat around the dining table eating the small-pot rice noodles Mom had made. Sun Yuwei and her sister Sun Yutong discussed the route to Dounan Flower Market and decided to cycle there; Dad chimed in to remind them to buy flowers that are easy to care for. The atmosphere was relaxed and cheerful.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rode bikes with her older sister to Dounan Flower Market and picked out flowers
description: Sun Yuwei and her sister each scanned a shared bike and rode along Renmin Middle Road for about 45 minutes to reach Dounan Flower Market. The market was colorful and fragrant, and the two moved through the stalls. Yuwei chose lisianthus with dew drops and pale yellow daisies, while her sister picked sunflowers. They teased each other that the flowers matched their personalities, and Yuwei took photos of her sister; the sunlight fell through the greenhouse canopy onto the side of her face, making her look especially lovely.
location: Dounan Flower Market (No. 76 Jingui Street), Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Returning home to arrange flowers and write the latter half of the interview article.
description: After riding her bike home, Sun Yuwei couldn't wait to trim the flower branches. She arranged the lisianthus at staggered heights in a clear vase, placed it at the left front of her desk, and put the daisies in a clay jar on the windowsill. The study instantly came alive. Then she turned off her phone, opened her notebook, and focused on writing the 'Inheritance Dilemma' section of her manuscript, weaving her sister's 'crack' metaphor into the real struggles of artisans. She avoided deliberate sentimentality and let the details speak. When she got tired of writing, she looked up at the flowers, and inspiration arrived with their fragrance.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Mom had prepared garlic stir-fried water spinach, green pepper stir-fried pork, cold cucumber salad, and mushroom soup. At the table, they talked about big sister's plan to return to Shenzhen the next day and what to bring for the trip to Fuxian Lake. While eating, Sun Yuwei thought about the ending of her article and decided to echo the scene of the walk by Cuihu Lake.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Light Midday Rest
description: Sun Yuwei set a 25-minute alarm, put on a steam eye mask, and lay down for a short rest. The sounds of birds outside the window and distant traffic interwove, and she soon fell into a light sleep, giving her brain a brief break.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Polishing the Full Draft and Afternoon Tea Break
description: After the lunch break, feeling refreshed, Sun Yuwei read through what she had written in the morning, adjusted the wording and rhythm, and checked the quotes from the old craftsman word by word. She placed the “Cracks and Light” metaphor from her Green Lake concept at the end, gently concluding the piece with a single sentence (about 2,800 characters). After finishing, she made a cup of tangerine peel pu-erh tea, went to the living room, and while drinking tea, jotted down keywords such as “Cracks and Light” and “Copper Pieces and Flowers” in her journal. She also took photos of the flower market and sent a message to her friend He Lu to thank her for the hiking route recommendation.
location: Home study and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk with mother around Cuihu
description: Sun Yuwei walked along the Cuihu lakeside path holding her mother’s arm, the setting sun stretching their shadows long. Her mother told amusing anecdotes about teachers and students at school. They walked to the pavilion in the center of the lake and sat down, looking at the sparkling water. Yuwei said with emotion, “Once we set off tomorrow, the days feel like they start moving faster.” Her mother replied that time really did fly and her daughter’s college days would soon be over. Yuwei held her mother’s hand tightly, savoring the warmth of the moment.
location: Near the Mid-Lake Pavilion in Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helped mom prepare dinner.
description: Back home, Sun Yuwei put on an apron and helped her mother wash vegetables and peel garlic. Her mother decided to make steamed sea bass and green vegetables. As they worked, they discussed what fruit to bring before setting off the next day. Yuwei suggested strawberries and blueberries.
location: Home kitchen, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and confirming details of the May Day trip
description: Dinner was very sumptuous: the steamed sea bass was tender and sweet, and Dad opened a bottle of homemade plum wine. The conversation centered on the next day's trip to Fuxian Lake. Older sister showed the safe route along the lakeside boardwalk that He Lu had sent, and Yuwei reported that she had prepared sunscreen, band-aids, and other supplies. After dinner, the family continued to confirm the details: Dad took out his notebook to check ID cards and driver's licenses, older sister zoomed in on the phone navigation to explain the highway route, and Yuwei used her phone memo to check off the packing list item by item—tent, picnic mat, mosquito repellent, and so on.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Send the manuscript and image suggestions
description: Sun Yuwei opened her computer in the study and sent an email to editor Xu Mingyuan with the final Word document attached. In the body, she briefly reported her idea for restructuring the article to strengthen the contrast between 'hardship' and 'heritage,' and attached photos such as close-ups of hands taken in Guandu Ancient Town, suggesting they be used as illustrations. She also wrote the photo captions and composition concepts. After confirming everything was correct, she clicked send.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Chatting with my sister and doing journaling.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei and her older sister sprayed water on the flowers in the living room and arranged the bouquets, naturally chatting about fashion, life in Shenzhen, and their thoughts on The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons. Under the warm yellow floor lamp, time seemed to slow down. Then she returned to the study, took out the leather journal she had used for nearly three years, pasted the flower market ticket on the left page, and wrote entries such as “Sunny, rode bikes with my sister to the flower market...” She then printed a screenshot of the hiking route as a small photo, pasted it next to tomorrow's date, and noted “Tomorrow's goal: lakeside boardwalk.” Finally, she wrote today's diary entry, recording her mother's words, the relief after submitting the manuscript, and her anticipation for tomorrow.
location: Living room and study at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: Sun Yuwei changed into comfortable pajamas, turned off the main light and left only an aromatherapy lamp on, adding a few drops of lavender essential oil. She sat cross-legged on the bed and followed a guided meditation audio for a 15-minute practice, reviewing scenes from the day—the shimmering water of Green Lake, the fragrance of the flower market, the focus of her writing, the warmth of her mother's palm—and letting them settle. In the final five minutes, she focused on abdominal breathing, feeling her lower abdomen rise and fall as her body gradually relaxed. After the meditation, she turned off the aromatherapy lamp, lay down, pulled up the quilt, and silently repeated to herself, “Thank you. Today was good. See you tomorrow,” before soon falling into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm went off on time at 6:45. You turned over and sat up, rubbing your shoulders and neck. Before going to bed last night, you had a phone call with your sister, and the regret about canceling the trip had been eased. You put on loungewear, went to the bathroom, and splashed cold water on your face to fully wake up. Returning to the bedroom, you opened the curtains. The weather was sunny turning cloudy. You sprayed water from a small spray bottle onto the lisianthus and daisies; water droplets rolled in the morning light.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Brisk morning walk at Cuihu Park
description: Putting on sneakers and a quick-dry T-shirt, she walked to Green Lake Park. The Labor Day morning was very quiet, with only a few elderly people practicing tai chi. She walked briskly along the lakeside path, breathing the air thick with moisture, and began sorting through her advisor's comments on the introduction to the first chapter of her thesis: "The theoretical transition is abrupt; you need to add argumentative logic related to cultural studies." She quickly jotted down a few keywords in her phone's memo: popular culture turn, locality.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: At-home yoga and meditation
description: Back home, you spread your yoga mat in the living room and followed the Keep course for a 20-minute basic sequence. From Cat-Cow to mobilize the spine, to Mountain pose with abdominal breathing, you felt the steadiness of the body. The gentle feeling from practicing with Mom yesterday was still there, but today practicing alone, you focused more on the breath and the extension of the body, easing the stiffness after waking up in the morning.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home living room)

name: Having breakfast with parents and deciding to cancel the trip
description: After finishing yoga, Mom had already set breakfast on the table: steaming rice noodles, fried eggs, and soy milk. When you sat down, Dad brought up the cancellation of yesterday's planned road trip to Fuxian Lake. He took out his phone and demonstrated: he had already confirmed the refund. Mom smiled and said, 'The guesthouse owner is kind. She's keeping the room. When your elder sister comes back for summer vacation, we'll all go together.' You nodded. In the morning light and the sound of your family's voices, that trace of regret vanished.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan (home dining room)

name: Focus on revising the first chapter of the thesis.
description: After breakfast, I returned to the study and officially entered battle mode. I turned on the computer and opened the first chapter draft of 'The Literary Writing of Kunming's Urban Cultural Memory' annotated by my advisor. Fully focused, I first rewrote three paragraphs of the theoretical framework in the introduction, connecting the theory of sense of place and cultural memory more naturally; then I checked the references one by one and added the page numbers for the citations from Yi-Fu Tuan's 'Space and Place'. During this time, I only got up twice to pour water, kept my phone on silent, and the entire morning flew by amid keyboard typing and thinking.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study room)

name: Chatted with my mother over lunch.
description: Mom called you to eat. Lunch was light home-style food: sautéed pea shoots, tomato scrambled eggs, and the spare rib soup stewed yesterday. While eating, you chatted with Mom about the progress of revising your paper that morning, a little proud of yourself. Mom encouraged you: focus on getting the paper done well; nothing else is urgent. You said 'mm,' feeling warm inside.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan (home dining room)

name: Lunch break and handling messages
description: After dinner, you leaned on the living room sofa and did not go back to your room immediately. You opened your phone and sent a voice message to your sister in the WeChat family group: "Sis, Fuxian Lake is changed to summer vacation! Mom said the three of us will go boating together then. Don't forget!" Then you scrolled through editor Xu Mingyuan's Moments, liked the photos of Beijing hutongs he shared, but did not proactively send him a message.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home living room)

name: Continue revising the paper and proofreading the formatting.
description: After a brief break, you returned to your study. The afternoon's work was more about finalizing things. You reread the revised first chapter and adjusted the word order of several sentences to make the prose flow more smoothly. Next, following the university's latest thesis formatting requirements, you checked the headers, footers, font sizes, and line spacing page by page, and updated the table of contents. After confirming there were no issues, you saved the file as Revised Draft_V2 and emailed your supervisor Wu Mingyuan with an explanation of the revisions.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study room)

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: After saving the document, you stretched and felt some soreness in your neck and shoulders. You decided to leave early for Zhibushi Bookstore. You changed into a comfortable cotton-linen long skirt, slung a canvas bag with your Kindle and notebook, and checked yourself in the full-length mirror at the entrance—you looked in good spirits.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home entryway)

name: A literary afternoon at Zhibushi Bookstore
description: You walked about 13 minutes from home, under the plane-tree shade along Green Lake, to the familiar Zhibushi Bookstore. On the afternoon of Labor Day, the bookstore was quiet and nearly empty. Uncle Qin was sorting newly arrived periodicals. When he saw you, he smiled and waved: 'Yuwei, you're here? I saved the new issue of People's Literature for you.' You took the magazine and chatted with Uncle Qin for a while. He said he had recently brought in a batch of travel essays about local culture, which were just up your alley. You lingered among the bookshelves for over half an hour and finally selected a prose collection with a very plain cover, 'Time of Grass and Trees', as reading material for the trip to Hangzhou next Thursday. At the register, you noticed a new batch of local cultural bookmarks beside the counter and picked one printed with Green Lake scenery.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Green Lake Park walk and outdoor mini yoga
description: After leaving the bookstore, you didn't rush home; instead, as originally planned, you circled back to Green Lake Park. The evening sunlight had softened, and the lake was sparkling. You walked a full lap around the lake, feeling especially relaxed. When you grew tired, you found a bench in a quiet waterside corridor, sat down, took out your phone, and followed an 8-minute mini yoga video for shoulder and neck relaxation to do a simple set of stretches. Breathing and twisting, you felt much of the fatigue from sitting all day drift away with the evening breeze.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: After walking about 5 minutes home from Green Lake Park, Mom was busy in the kitchen. You washed your hands and went over to help. “Mom, let me wash the vegetables.” You took the chives from her and picked off withered leaves one by one. Mom was simmering a pot of chicken soup, and the aroma filled the whole kitchen. You chatted while working, and you told her that you had bought a new book at the bookstore in the afternoon and had also exercised. Mom smiled and said: “That's right, balancing work and rest.”
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (home kitchen)

name: Family dinner
description: Dad came home from work, and the three of you sat around the dining table. Dinner was abundant: old hen soup, steamed sea bass, chive scrambled eggs, and a plate of seasonal wild greens you like. As you ate and chatted, Dad asked about your thesis. You said you had finished most of it today, and one more check tomorrow would be enough. He nodded with satisfaction. The conversation turned to plans for Fuxian Lake this summer, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan (home dining room)

name: Family documentary time
description: After clearing the table, you suggested watching the documentary about Yunnan wild mushrooms. Mom immediately responded: "Great! I've been wanting to watch it." Dad also sat down on the sofa. You turned on the projector and searched for the film. The documentary showed all kinds of mushrooms, the hardships of the mushroom pickers, and the temptation of a mushroom feast. Mom sighed as she watched: "When we were kids, there were so many mushrooms on the mountains! Termite mushrooms, ganba mushrooms—that aroma still makes my mouth water just thinking about it." You and Dad listened to her memories with smiles.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home living room)

name: Journal keeping and solitary time
description: After the documentary ended, you returned to your room and took out your beloved journal. You sat down at your desk and began today's entry. You took out the Green Lake scenery bookmark you bought today and stuck it on the page for today's date. First you wrote: "Seen from today, the decision to cancel Fuxian Lake was a sensible and calm gain." Then you recorded your thoughts on revising the thesis: "Rewriting the theoretical transition in the introduction felt like opening up the Ren and Du meridians of the essay." Finally, you copied down a sentence from the cover of the new book "Time of Grass and Trees": "Deep among the grass and trees, find the order of time." And you drew a few simple strokes of flowers and plants.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom desk)

name: Relaxing Bath and Nighttime Preparation
description: Closing the journal, you felt fulfilled and satisfied. You picked up your pajamas and went to the bathroom to take a comfortable hot shower. The warm water washed away all the fatigue, and you closed your eyes and let your mind go blank. Back in the bedroom, you took out your phone and sent a more detailed message to your sister: Sis, the guesthouse plan is set! Mom said she's super looking forward to the three of us going together during summer vacation, and she even said she'd charter a boat to tour the lake! You should plan your annual leave in advance!
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home bathroom, bedroom)

name: Reading before bed and falling asleep.
description: After drying your hair, you leaned against the headboard and opened the newly purchased Kindle e-book "The Time of Grass and Trees." You finished the preface and the first chapter; the writing was delicate and warm, very suitable for reading before sleep. As it approached 22:40, you closed the reading app and put the Kindle on the nightstand. You turned off the bedside lamp, adjusted into a comfortable sleeping position in the dark, and, with a fulfilled and calm mind, slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Morning wake-up, reading, washing up, and stretching
description: Woke up naturally in the early summer sunlight. Leaning against the headboard, I finished the last pages of 'The Flower Market in the South' from 'The Time of Plants', and drew a pencil line beside the paragraph 'The Peony's Departure'. After getting up, I first drank warm water, then went to the bathroom to wash up. While brushing my teeth, I did chest-opening and shoulder-rolling exercises, and also replied to my roommate's message. Then I did simple stretches on the living room mat, loosening my neck and legs to prepare for the day's walking. From outside the window came the sound of neighbor Aunt Xie walking her dog.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast with Mom and getting ready to go out
description: Mom had already cooked small-pot rice noodles, served with toasted baba cakes, oil-fermented bean curd, and sour pickled vegetables. As we ate, Mom and I checked the items for the trip: shopping bags, a mirrorless camera, a journal, and a water bottle. Mom checked my sneakers and reminded me that we would be walking a lot today. Dad was watching the news nearby and told me to be careful because the flower market would be crowded. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Went to Dounan Flower Market.
description: I walked with my mother to Wuyi Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 3, transferred to Line 2 and then Line 1 to Dounan Station. After exiting the station, we walked along Jingui Street to the Dounan Flower Market. On the subway, my mother recalled the hydrangeas in the courtyard of the old family home in Qujing, and I shared the “main, secondary, guest” branch arrangement principles I learned in the Ikenobo flower arrangement class. Mother and daughter chatted pleasantly all the way.
location: From No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, walk along Renmin Middle Road to Wuyi Road Metro Station, take the metro to Dounan Station, and walk to Dounan Flower Market at No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District.

name: Carefully selecting floral materials at the flower market.
description: Entering the main trading hall of Dounan Flower Market, she was greeted by flowers everywhere and a lively atmosphere. She walked through dozens of stalls, repeatedly comparing the bloom levels of peonies and the colors of lisianthus. In the end she picked a bouquet of large peonies in pink and white, and a bunch of light purple lisianthus. Her mother suggested adding some eucalyptus leaves, so they also chose a small bundle of imported eucalyptus. After bargaining with the flower farmer, she paid 70 yuan (40 yuan for peonies, 20 yuan for lisianthus, 10 yuan for eucalyptus). The flower farmer wrapped them up skillfully in newspaper, and she carefully took them and held them in her arms.
location: Main Trading Hall, Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Returning with the flower materials.
description: Holding the bouquet, I walked out of the flower market and took Metro Line 1 back. In the subway car I found a corner spot. Mom put her shopping bag on her lap as a cushion, and I gently placed the bouquet on it, guarding it with my hand the whole way for fear of jostling or squeezing. Mom laughed and said I was protecting the flowers as if they were a child. At 11:30 we exited at Wuyi Road Station and walked a few minutes home.
location: Take the metro from Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Wuyi Road Station, and walk back to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road.

name: Preparing flower materials and family lunch
description: After arriving home, I first placed the bouquet by the kitchen sink, boiled water to prepare for handling the flowers, and took out my mirrorless camera and plugged in a card reader to import photos. Dad went to the wet market and bought crucian carp and tofu; Mom made crucian carp and tofu soup, stir-fried pea shoots, and cucumber salad. During lunch, I talked about what I'd seen at the flower market, such as an elderly man buying sunflowers to give to his wife, and Dad listened with great interest. Mom showed Dad the flower market photos and praised my taste, and the table was full of holiday warmth.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch break and photo sorting
description: After the meal she went back to her room and rested against the headboard for twenty minutes. During the break, she transferred photos from her mirrorless camera to her phone via Bluetooth, selected a few with good angles, and saved them in preparation for posting to the family group chat.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mother-daughter flower arranging, setting up a flower corner, and family sharing
description: After the midday rest, she took out scissors and a spray bottle and prepared the flowers by the kitchen sink. Following the principles of cutting stems at a 45-degree angle and removing excess leaves, she used peonies as the main branch, lisianthus as the guest branch, and eucalyptus as the filler layer, arranging them in two clear glass vases, which she placed on the living room coffee table and beside the TV cabinet. Her mother turned the vases to adjust the viewing angle. Using the leftover small-bud lisianthus and eucalyptus, she set up a mini flower corner on her desk and took photos from multiple angles with her phone. She sent the flower arrangement and close-ups to the family group chat 'Sun Family Nest' with the caption 'I picked a corner of spring on Labor Day.' Her sister Sun Yutong gave it a thumbs-up in the group, saying the living room even smelled of flowers. Her mother also posted a morning photo of Green Lake, and they briefly chatted about her sister's May Day holiday plans. She saved the warm chat screenshots into her journal material folder.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Making a journal entry to record the flower arrangement diary
description: She took out her beloved journal and watercolor pens, carefully peeled off the small labels brought back from the flower market ('Peony - Heze,' 'Lisianthus - Kunming,' 'Eucalyptus - imported') and pasted them in. Beside them, she used a pen to record her floral arrangement ideas, insights on pairing flowers, and warm moments from the family group chat. At the same time, she printed selected photos with the portable printer and pasted them in.
location: The study at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cuihu Park stroll and bookstore visit.
description: I took my mirrorless camera and keys, and walked to the south gate of Cuihu Park. In early summer, lotus leaves covered the water of Cuihu Lake. I walked slowly along the lake, photographing the blue sky, white clouds, willows, and leisurely pedestrians reflected on the water. At 16:30 I exited through the park's west gate and turned onto Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. The owner, Uncle Qin, recommended prose anthologies about the two places. I browsed and bought "Kunming Sketches" (48 yuan). At 17:00 I set off from the bookstore and walked home, arriving at 17:22.
location: Cuihu Park, 67 South Cuihu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 North Cuihu Road

name: Prepared dinner with Mom and had a family dinner
description: When she got home, she put away her mirrorless camera and new books, then went to the kitchen to help her mother pick over pea shoots and trim the dead leaves from the eucalyptus. Dinner was multigrain rice, shredded pork with green peppers, and stir-fried pea shoots. At the table, her father praised the elegant color scheme of the flower arrangement, saying it added life to the house. She opened the photo album on her phone to show close-ups of the flower market stalls and the details of the flower arrangement. Her mother deliberately brought the peony vase from the living room to the dining table, and the family chatted about holiday anecdotes as they ate.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Personal time: music, writing ideas, and sharing with close friends
description: Back in her room, she put on her earphones and listened to soothing piano music while flipping through the newly bought 'Kunming Notes,' especially liking the two pieces on Dounan Flower Market and Green Lake. In her phone's memo app, she sketched out an essay on 'Kunming Flower Market,' writing down two core paragraphs that start with the flower farmers' cries. Her best friend Zhang Jing sent a WeChat message asking about her vacation plans. She sent her the flower market photos and a short video of the flower arranging. Zhang Jing said it was gorgeous, and they agreed that she would come to her home next week to see the floral works and go together to Zhibushi Bookstore.
location: The study at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening cleansing and relaxing foot soak
description: She took a hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue, applied a soothing face mask, and soaked her feet in a foot bath tub for fifteen minutes. While soaking her feet, she opened her phone's photo album, archived the close-up flower photos by date, and also took a photo of the cover of Kunming Travel Notes for keepsake.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading and meditation before bed
description: I leaned against the headboard and read a few pages of the chapter on flowers and people in 'The Time of Plants', then browsed the Green Lake chapter in 'Kunming Sketches'. At 21:15 I put down the book and turned off the light, did ten minutes of mindful meditation, focusing on my breath and letting my nerves relax. The scent of flowers and the cries of vendors from the flower market still lingered faintly in my mind.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wrapping up and recording life's little joys
description: After meditating, I turned on the light and went to the study, and organized the selected photos from the flower market into the "Diary-Photos" folder on the computer hard drive. Then I returned to the bedroom and, in the "Today's Little Joys" section on the last page of my journal, wrote: "At the flower market I bought peonies and lisianthus, and the eucalyptus leaves my mom chose were the finishing touch; under the blue sky at Green Lake, the stone-paved road had warmth; the new book Uncle Qin recommended is set in the alley right outside our door. Labor Day, a perfect day."
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: Turned off the light and lay down, taking in the fresh scent of eucalyptus leaves inside and the early-summer air outside the window, recalling the flower market, the subway conversation, the flower arranging, the family group chat replies, the Green Lake pigeons, and the bookstore sounds. With contentment and peace, I slowly drifted into sleep.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning tidy-up and family breakfast
description: Woke up at 8 a.m., did some simple stretching, drank warm water, changed the water for the flowers on the windowsill, and trimmed the arrangement. She then had breakfast with her parents, eating rice noodles and chatting about the day’s plans; her parents offered suggestions for the Hangzhou trip.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Planning the Hangzhou cultural itinerary and purchasing tickets in the study
description: In the study, I turned on the laptop and the hand-drawn map, planned a cultural itinerary for Hangzhou, marked places such as Xiaoshu Library, Innocent Age Book Bar, and the Folk Art Museum of the China Academy of Art, designed a cycling route around West Lake, and added the bookstore recommended by Uncle Qin to my memo. Then I used a mobile app to check movie schedules, bought a ticket for the 14:20 showing of Dwelling in the Spring at Broadway Cinemas (Shuncheng Branch), and sent a message to my best friend Zhang Jing to let her know about the movie plan.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helping prepare lunch and family lunch
description: In the kitchen, she helped her mother pick and wash vegetables and shell broad beans while listening to her mother talk about her older sister's recent situation. At lunch, the family of three had home-style dishes. Her father shared amusing anecdotes from his business trip to Hangzhou and suggested a morning walking route, and her mother reminded her to be safe when going out.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday rest and preparing to go out
description: After lunch, she went to the bedroom for a half-hour nap to recharge for the afternoon. After waking up, she put on a dark green cotton-linen dress and packed her canvas bag, journal, pen, power bank, tissues, and folding umbrella, getting ready to go out.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuted to the cinema, picked up the ticket, and waited for the screening.
description: Walked from the residential area to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Line 3 for one stop to Wuyi Road Station, then walked through Nanping Pedestrian Street to reach Shuncheng Shopping Center. After picking up tickets at the self-service machine at Broadway Cinemas, bought a Super Orange drink at Nayuki Tea, then tidied up and entered Hall 5 to wait.
location: Metro Line 3 from Huashan West Road Station Exit D to Wuyi Road Station Exit A in Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and Broadway Cinema on the 5th floor of Shuncheng Shopping Center at No. 11 Dongfeng West Road.

name: Watched the film Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains
description: Watched the film 'Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains' in Screen 5 at the Broadway Cinema, with about 20 other people. The scenery of the Fuchun River and the film's narrative rhythm were captivating. During the screening, she wrote down phrases such as 'Water has no fixed form, but people have constant feelings' in her journal.
location: Broadway Cinema Hall 5, 5th Floor, Shuncheng Shopping Center, No. 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: After the movie, she went shopping at the mall and wrote in her journal at the café.
description: After the movie, while wandering on the first floor of Shuncheng Shopping Center, I found a hybrid bookstore called 'Paper, Cloth, Stone' with a quiet coffee area. I ordered a Dianhong black tea latte, sat by the window, wrote movie-inspired notes in my journal, and drew a simple sketch of a black-awning boat with the date annotation "2025.5.3 Spring River Water Warm."
location: No. 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, 1st Floor, Shuncheng Shopping Center, Zhibushi Bookstore Coffee Area

name: Walked home after strolling in Green Lake Park
description: Starting from the bookstore, walked about 15 minutes and entered through the south gate of Green Lake Park. Strolled along the lakeside path, enjoying the dawn redwoods, lotus leaves, and night herons. When I reached the Nine-Bend Bridge, a light rain began to fall. I opened my umbrella and continued walking for about 20 minutes, exited the park from the west gate, then walked about 10 minutes along Green Lake North Road back to the residential compound.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Returning home, changing clothes, resting, and having dinner with family
description: After returning home, she first changed out of her slightly damp dress, put on loungewear, drank a glass of warm water to rest, and sent a voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing to share her thoughts on the movie. Then she had dinner with her parents. On the table were cold chicken shreds salad, tomato egg drop soup, and stir-fried water spinach. She shared the movie plot, and her parents also shared their own feelings.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In the study, revising the paper's literature review.
description: After the meal, she opened the final draft of the thesis in her study and, referring to her advisor's revision comments, focused on supplementing the literature review section. She searched and read three recent related papers on CNKI and the school library database, and properly incorporated their core viewpoints into the discussion in Part 3. During this time, her mother brought in sliced apples.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journal wrap-up, relaxation, and preparing for bed
description: Moved to the bedroom, pasted the movie ticket stubs into my journal, wrote down the two sentences that struck me most, flipped through 'Kunming Random Notes' and inserted a bookmark. Then made peppermint tea, put on earphones and listened to Chen Li's playlist. Finished my nighttime skincare, lit an incense stick, did a 10-minute meditation session, and turned off the light at 22:30 to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up and washing up.
description: Woke up naturally in the dim light of a cloudy day, tidied the bed, then went to the bathroom to wash up, cleansing the face with warm water and applying moisturizing toner and lotion.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (bedroom and bathroom)

name: Online check-in and family breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei left the bedroom, first drank a glass of warm water, then used her phone to check tomorrow evening's flight information to Hangzhou via the Umetrip app, selected a window seat to complete online check-in, and sent a screenshot of the successful seat selection to the family group chat “Sun Family Courtyard” along with a note. Her mother, Li Xiulan, was preparing breakfast in the kitchen and reminded her daughter to bring a light jacket to cope with the temperature drop. Sun Yuwei helped her mother carry the steamed posu buns to the table, and the two chatted about the day's home arrangements while eating breakfast.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (living room and dining room)

name: Early morning yin yoga stretching.
description: Half an hour after breakfast, Sun Yuwei changed into a sports tank top and leggings, spread out her light blue yoga mat in the living room, and opened the Keep app to do the "Flow Yin Yoga" class for a 40-minute session. Because the weather was cool and overcast, she focused on forward folds, twists, and hip and back stretches, and added extra neck-and-shoulder relaxation moves to prepare for the long flight. When she finished, she did a 5-minute final relaxation and felt her muscles loosen. Finally, she rolled up the yoga mat and tucked it into a corner of her carry-on suitcase as the first step of packing.
location: Home (living room), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Make a list and pack travel items
description: After yoga, walked into the bedroom and began packing according to the Hangzhou Trip Checklist on my phone memo. First confirmed that the document pouch (ID card, student ID, and bank card) was placed in a waterproof bag, then took out two sets of sportswear, a thin knit cardigan, and cotton-linen trousers from the wardrobe and folded them into the suitcase. Next sorted out the electronics area: Kindle, mirrorless camera, power bank, various charging cables (organized with cable ties), and a lightweight laptop, placing them one by one. Finally put in sunscreen, sunglasses, and a toiletry kit in travel-size containers, checked the weight, and zipped up the suitcase.
location: At home (bedroom), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Replying to social messages and taking a short break
description: After packing, I leaned back on the living room sofa, took out my phone to reply to my best friend Zhang Jing's earlier voice message, and agreed to have mushroom hotpot together after returning from Hangzhou, with the specific time set for Thursday noon or Friday evening. While waiting for her reply, I scrolled through Moments and liked the book review shared by Uncle Qin from Zhibushi Bookstore.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China; home (living room sofa)
