name: Read a collection of essays and wrote handwritten annotations.
description: She took out the essay collection “Here and Now,” which she had bought at Uncle Qin’s bookstore, from her backpack, curled up in the bean bag chair in the study, turned on the lamp, and immersed herself in reading. When she came to the passage describing the afternoon light and shadows in the old city streets and alleys, she savored it repeatedly. Using a 0.5 mm mechanical pencil, she wrote a note in the margin: “Is this the Hangzhou I’m about to see? I really want to walk into an alley like that and smell the moss and old wood.” She also underlined her favorite sentences and marked the page numbers so that she could quote them later when writing in her travel journal.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (study, bean bag chair).

name: Family lunch and travel chatter
description: Lunch was tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried pea shoots, and mushroom soup. The family of three sat around the table, and the conversation centered on tomorrow's trip to Hangzhou. Father Sun Mingyuan suggested that if his daughter was interested in seal carving, she could visit the China Seal Museum. Sun Yuwei immediately noted it in her phone memo. Mother Li Xiulan asked whether the suitcase had been packed. After receiving a positive answer, she felt reassured and joked that her daughter was being a bit too 'anxious.'
location: China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Green Lake Community, home (dining room)

name: After-lunch nap
description: Feeling a little drowsy after the meal, Sun Yuwei returned to her bedroom and drew the thin curtains. Without setting an alarm, she fell asleep naturally for about half an hour. The faint sounds of her father watching the midday news and her mother washing the dishes drifted in from the living room, creating a steady, secure atmosphere that let her sleep lightly but peacefully.
location: At home (bedroom), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Immersive reading and travel journal creation
description: After the midday break, she sat down at the desk and took out her travel journal. The previous page already had a movie ticket stub from Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains and a hand-drawn sketch of a black-awning boat. On this page, she wrote in detail with a fountain pen about her thoughts on the film, and wrote about her expectation for Hangzhou: 'Tomorrow I'm setting off. Right now I'm like a book about to be opened, and Hangzhou is the story waiting to be read.' At the same time, she opened the map app on her phone, bookmarked the places she planned to visit, and silently planned her route.
location: Home (study), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Homemade afternoon tea and relaxation
description: She paused her writing, made herself a simple milk tea with a black tea bag and fresh milk, and cut a plate of apples as an afternoon treat. While drinking, she browsed Xiaohongshu. After seeing autumn photos of Hangzhou Xiaoshu Library, she looked forward to the trip even more. Then she put down her phone, played a soothing piano piece, and quietly emptied her mind.
location: Home (living room), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Afternoon restorative yoga stretching
description: After resting, I changed back into my workout clothes, opened the Bilibili video "10-Minute Restorative Yoga Before Bed," and repeated the practice twice for about 40 minutes in total. Through poses such as Child's Pose, Cat-Cow Pose, Butterfly Pose, and Happy Baby Pose, I focused on relieving the hip and back stiffness caused by prolonged sitting, preparing for the long flight. After practice, I felt as relaxed as if my whole body had been recalibrated.
location: Home (living room), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Assisting with housework and organizing luggage
description: After yoga, she first drank a glass of warm water, then went back to the bedroom to check the position of the items in her suitcase again. Recalling her mother’s reminder, she took a light sun-protection jacket from the wardrobe and tucked it into the side pocket. Then she went to the kitchen, saw her mother preparing ingredients for dinner, and took the initiative to help peel garlic and trim scallions. As the mother and daughter worked, they chatted. Sun Yuwei shared about the book she had read in the afternoon, while her mother told childhood stories from the streets of Kunming. The kitchen was filled with the warmth of everyday life.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China (living room and kitchen)

name: Family dinner and casual home conversation
description: Dinner was mother's spicy diced chicken and pickled fish with sour mustard greens, both dishes Sun Yuwei loved. Father opened a treasured cake of Pu'er tea and said tea after the meal would help cut the grease. During the meal, he told an amusing story about a business trip to Hangzhou when he was young, where he ate Pian'er Chuan noodles in the rain for three days straight, making the whole family laugh. Mother asked if they wanted to take an evening walk around Green Lake to aid digestion, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Green Lake Community, home (dining room)

name: Evening Walk with My Mother
description: After dinner, after half an hour of rest, the sky gradually darkened. Sun Yuwei and her mother put on light jackets and took a slow walk along the internal roads of Cuihu Community. Her mother hooked her arm and talked about her first solo trip to Dali when she was young: taking a seven- or eight-hour long-distance bus, staying in a small inn, and meeting a talkative guide. Yuwei asked her mother if she had been afraid at the time. Her mother smiled and replied, "When you're young, you just have that energy to explore the world. You're the same now."
location: Cuihu Community (internal road), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Final luggage confirmation and evening wash-up.
description: After walking home, Sun Yuwei opened the side pocket of her suitcase again and checked one by one that her ID card, bank card, and power bank were there, then put her house keys and medical record booklet in as well, just in case. Then she went to the bathroom to remove her makeup and wash her face, and applied toner and lotion for basic skincare.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (bedroom and bathroom)

name: Pre-departure journaling and reading reflection
description: After washing up, she changed into cotton pajamas, sat at the desk in her bedroom, and turned on the eye-care desk lamp. She took out the new travel journal prepared for the trip to Hangzhou, pasted a collected West Lake postcard on the first page, and carefully wrote down the day's date and weather with a fountain pen. Then she pulled 'Kunming Sketches' from the bookshelf and read carefully the chapter about the Golden Horse and Jade Rooster Archways, as a final look back at her hometown before leaving, seeking an inner counterpart for the journey ahead.
location: At home (bedroom desk) in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Meditation and relaxing music before bed
description: After finishing her journal, she turned off the main light, leaving only an aromatherapy night light, and lay relaxed in bed. She opened the Tide app on her phone and chose the 10-minute 'Travel Visualization' meditation. Following the guide, she imagined going through security, boarding, flying above the clouds, and landing in Hangzhou the next day, feeling a subtle mix of anticipation and calm. After the meditation, she played the soothing folk song 'The Ideal at Thirty', letting her mind settle in the music.
location: At home (bedroom), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After the music gradually faded, she dimmed all the lights, placed the next morning's clothes by the bedside, and checked once more that the phone alarm was set. With the peace of mind and anticipation for the upcoming journey, she closed her eyes, adjusted her breathing, and gradually drifted into sleep.
location: At home (bedroom), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: I woke up in my warm bed, and outside the window the weather in Kunming was turning from cloudy to sunny. As usual, I drank a glass of warm water first, then washed up briefly. Looking in the mirror, I recalled a passage from the essay collection I had read before bed last night about 'the ritual of saying goodbye', and thought that every moment of today should be treasured.
location: The home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: Mom had already set the breakfast table: steaming rice noodles, fried eggs, and a small dish of fermented bean curd. Dad, while drinking soy milk, checked the weather in Hangzhou on his phone and said, “It will start raining tomorrow. Did you bring an umbrella?” I nodded, feeling warm inside. Mom put a few more slices of meat in my bowl and reminded me, “Remember to eat on time when you get to Hangzhou.”
location: The home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanying Mom to the market to buy groceries.
description: After breakfast, I offered to accompany my mother to the vegetable market. We set off on foot from home, passed through several old alleys, and arrived at Longxiang Farmers Market in about 15 minutes. The air smelled of earth and fresh flowers. At a familiar stall, my mother picked out a few handfuls of tender green pea shoots and bought a fresh crucian carp, saying she would make her signature "clear soup crucian carp" for me. I helped her carry the basket and listened to her chat with the stall owner in Kunming dialect, feeling at ease.
location: Longxiang Farmers Market, Longxiang Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk in Green Lake Park and sharing with close friends
description: After buying the groceries, I let my mother go home first and turned into Cuihu Park. It's only a six- or seven-minute walk from home. In May, the lotus leaves in Cuihu's pond were just beginning to unfold, a lush green expanse. I walked slowly along the stone path by the lake, watching elderly people doing morning exercises and young people walking their dogs. On a quiet bench, I sat down, opened WeChat, and sent a message to my best friend Zhang Jing: "Sister Jing, I'm about to head to Hangzhou! Just finished going to the market with my mom, feeling so blessed. When I get back, let's meet at a café by Cuihu!" I also attached a photo of the lotus leaves I had just taken. Then I kept scrolling through Moments for a while and saw everyone posting about the last day of the holiday, but I felt that today had been especially fulfilling for me.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: When I got home, my mother had already prepared a spread of dishes with the fresh ingredients she had bought in the morning: clear-soup crucian carp, pea shoot and sliced pork soup, cucumber salad, and stir-fried greens. At the table, my father again brought up his old classmate who had volunteered at the China Seal Museum in Hangzhou, saying that I could mention his name when I visited. I smiled and agreed, and began to plan the next day's itinerary in my mind. My mother kept putting food on my plate, as if trying to make up for the meals I would miss in the coming days.
location: The home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Short nap during lunch break
description: Feeling a bit sleepy after lunch, I went back to my room and drew the blackout curtains. Lying in bed, I used meditative breathing to relax completely. The image of the lotus leaves at Green Lake from the morning still flashed through my mind, and I soon slipped into a light sleep.
location: The home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organized my mother's old photos and made a digital album.
description: After the afternoon nap, she was full of energy and started today's core task. She carefully took out the old photo album with yellowed cover from the living room cabinet, sat on the floor, and looked through it carefully one by one. From the photo of her mother in a floral dress by Green Lake as a young woman, to the warm photo of her holding her elder sister as a baby, to the image of her teaching me to write... she almost burst into tears. She took out her phone, opened the Baidu Netdisk app, scanned and imported the selected photos one by one, and created a new album under the theme 'Mom's Time.' She added small captions to particularly meaningful photos, such as 'Little Li of the Art Troupe,' 'First-Time Mother,' and 'Mom Teaching Weiwei to Write Hand in Hand.' Looking at these digitized memories, she felt this was the best gift for her mother.
location: The home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preliminary concept for a family portrait
description: After finishing the digital photo album, I took out my TN journal and began planning the 'National Day Family Portrait' project. I decided the theme would be the 'Republic of China vintage style' that Mom wore when she was young. I opened the Dianping app and selected three highly rated vintage-style photo studios in Kunming: 'Xingya Photography,' 'Shiguang Photo Studio,' and 'Jiumeng Portraits,' and saved them. In the memo I noted the budget: 'about 500 yuan per person, 1,500 yuan for three, and 2,000 yuan for four including my sister.' At the thought of Mom's surprised expression when she sees the plan, I couldn't help smiling.
location: The home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pack luggage and do a final confirmation.
description: Packing my luggage was the last step before departure. Last night, Mom had already helped me dry the hand-washed T-shirts. I folded them carefully and placed them in the carry-on suitcase. I checked off my ID card, student ID, copy of the admission letter, power bank, camera, and umbrella. Finally, I put my TN journal and a good fountain pen into my canvas bag. I zipped up the suitcase and weighed it: exactly 9.5 kg, so it could be carried on without checking it in.
location: The home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Before setting off, she said goodbye to her family and video-called her sister.
description: After everything was packed, I pulled my suitcase to the living room and said goodbye to Mom and Dad. Dad patted me on the shoulder and said, “Bon voyage,” and Mom came over and gave me a big hug. I video-called my sister first, then ordered a car to the airport. I connected with my sister Sun Yutong on WeChat video; she had just gotten off work in Shenzhen. I first showed her the “Mother’s Time” digital photo album I had just made. As she swiped through it, she exclaimed, “Mom was so beautiful when she was young!” Then I explained in detail my planned family portrait in “Republican-era retro style.” My sister agreed completely and said with a smile, “Mom will absolutely love it! I’ll sponsor your startup fund right away!” She immediately transferred me 500 yuan on WeChat, with the note “Family Portrait Sponsorship Fund (Weiwei Advance Edition).” We chatted for about half an hour, with Mom and Dad cutting in from the side; the atmosphere was wonderfully warm.
location: The home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take a ride-hailing car to the airport
description: After the video call, I ordered a ride-hailing car. After getting in, I opened the Umetrip app again to confirm the flight status and gate information—everything was normal. Then I put on my earphones, played my favorite playlist, and watched the street scenes rapidly recede outside the window, feeling full of anticipation for the unknown journey. As the car crossed Kunming's streets and gradually headed toward the airport, the scenery along the way changed from city to suburbs, and my thoughts drifted toward the upcoming trip to Hangzhou.
location: In a ride-hailing car from Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Kunming Changshui International Airport

name: Arriving at the airport, checking in, and passing through security
description: The ride-hailing car quickly arrived at the departure level of Kunming Changshui International Airport. Since she had already checked in online, she went directly to the self-service baggage drop counter and checked her luggage easily. Then, holding her boarding pass and ID card, she passed through security. The whole process went smoothly. In the departure hall, she found a seat near the boarding gate and relaxed a bit.
location: Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal time before boarding
description: With half an hour left before boarding, I opened my journal. First, I drew a simplified little tree, wrote "National Day Family Portrait Fund" beside the main trunk, and drew two small fruits underneath—one labeled "500 yuan (sponsored by my sister)" and the other left blank. Then, on the blank page next to it, I wrote today's reflection: "It's time to set off, to carry on the dream my mother had when she was young, and to write my own story. Today, with one photo after another, I put home into my heart." I printed my sister's transfer screenshot from my phone and carefully pasted it into the journal.
location: Near the boarding gate in the departure hall of Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: During the flight
description: After boarding, I found my window seat and stowed my backpack. Once the plane was cruising, I asked a flight attendant for a cup of warm water. In the stillness at 10,000 meters, I opened my journal again to record the flight diary. I wrote about the bustling vegetable market when I accompanied my mother to buy groceries this morning, the fresh fragrance of lotus leaves at Green Lake, my mother's youthful face in old photos, and my sister's hearty laughter during our video call. The clouds outside the window were unbelievably beautiful. I closed the journal, leaned against the window, and let my thoughts drift toward Hangzhou, where we were about to land.
location: On the flight from Kunming to Hangzhou

name: Arrive in Hangzhou and check into the hotel.
description: The plane landed smoothly at Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport. When she turned on her phone, she received a message from her mother: "Message me when you arrive; your bed is made." She replied with an OK emoji. After picking up her luggage, she took a taxi. About 40 minutes later, she arrived at the pre-booked hotel—Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou West Lake Broken Bridge Branch). After checking in, she went to her room.
location: Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province, then to Home Inn Selected (Hangzhou West Lake Broken Bridge Branch), No. 85 Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Check-in, settling in, and bedtime preparations
description: Upon entering the room, I first checked the environment—it was clean and tidy. I opened my suitcase and took out toiletries and a change of clothes. After a quick wash, I changed into pajamas, lay on the bed, and reviewed the full and fulfilling day. Thinking that tomorrow I would go to explore Hangzhou's Xiaoshu Library and the Innocent Age Book Bar, I was filled with anticipation.
location: In the room at Home Inn Selected (Hangzhou West Lake Broken Bridge Branch), 85 Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Quick journal wrap-up and going to sleep
description: Before going to bed, she drew a small outline of an airplane in her journal. At the end of today's entry, she wrote a line: "2025.05.05, a farewell full of warmth, and the beginning of a brand-new story. Weight: 45.8kg." Then she turned off the bedside lamp, closed her eyes, and soon fell into a deep sleep amid the rippling sounds of West Lake.
location: In the room at Home Inn Selected (Hangzhou West Lake Broken Bridge Branch), 85 Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Hotel morning wake-up and planning
description: After the alarm went off, Yuwei woke up in the hotel room and felt the morning light of West Lake spilling in through the curtains. She stretched her neck and shoulders and did a full-body stretch, then boiled water and brewed Yunnan ancient-tree black tea. She opened her TN journal and planned today's route for the 'Hangzhou Digital Journey,' marking the key times for buying a Kindle and taking a yoga class.
location: Inside the room at Home Inn Select (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Broken Bridge Branch), No. 20 Baoshishan Xia'er Lane, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Hotel buffet breakfast and online price comparison
description: Yuwei, wearing a hoodie and jeans, went to the hotel's first-floor restaurant and had white rice porridge, boiled eggs, pickled vegetables, and soy milk for breakfast. While eating, she opened her phone and compared Kindle Paperwhite prices on the JD.com, Tmall, and Amazon China apps, taking screenshots to record the key figures.
location: First-floor restaurant of Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Duanqiao Branch), No. 20, Baoshi Mountain Xia'er Lane, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Room work: compare prices, buy a Kindle, and download e-books
description: Back in the hotel room, Yuwei sat at the desk. Through the Amazon Student section, she confirmed that the Kindle Paperwhite cost 788 yuan, about 120 yuan cheaper than on JD.com, so she decisively placed an order and chose express delivery to the front desk. Then she used her computer to log on to the cooperative platform of Yunnan University Library, downloaded more than ten e-books including 'Dreaming of the West Lake' and 'Hangzhou Memories', and pushed them to the Kindle cloud via email. The order showed that delivery would arrive in the evening.
location: At the desk in the room at Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Broken Bridge Branch), No. 20 Baoshishan Xia'er Lane, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning stroll by West Lake
description: Yuwei put on a light jacket and walked along the Second Lane below Baoshi Mountain to Beishan Street, strolling to the vicinity of the Broken Bridge and Remnant Snow scenic spot near West Lake. The West Lake and the Broken Bridge in the early morning mist made her feel at ease, and she used her phone to capture the reflection of Baochu Pagoda and the lake view.
location: Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (near Broken Bridge and Remnant Snow)

name: Explore the Innocent Age Book Bar.
description: Yuwei walked from the lakeside to the Innocent Age Book Bar at the foot of Baoshi Mountain. The shop was quiet and full of a scholarly atmosphere. She browsed the literature section and the Hangzhou culture display, chose a signed copy of “Ordinary Alleys of Hangzhou” as a travel souvenir, and chatted with the staff about the bookstore's history and the stories of Baoshi Mountain.
location: No. 32 Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, The Age of Innocence Book Bar (Baoshi Mountain Branch)

name: Vegetarian lunch by the West Lake and yoga appointment
description: Yuwei had lunch at Suxin Snack Shop near the book bar, enjoying vegetarian goose noodles and Dingsheng cake. While waiting for the food, she used Dianping to search for and book a vinyasa flow yoga trial class at 2 p.m. at Yunshui Yoga Studio in Xihu District, at the new-customer price of 69 yuan, and received a confirmation text message.
location: Along Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang (Suxin Snacks)

name: Commuted and took a Vinyasa flow yoga class.
description: After lunch, Yuwei took Tour Bus Route 2 at the Broken Bridge bus stop, enjoying the scenery along the western route of West Lake along the way. About 25 minutes later, she got off at the Botanical Garden stop and walked to Yunshui Yoga Studio in the creative park on Yugu Road. She had changed into sportswear beforehand and attended a vinyasa yoga class at 2 p.m., practicing poses under the guidance of a gentle instructor. After class, she chatted with the instructor over tea, and the instructor recommended a vegetarian restaurant near Lingyin Temple.
location: Yugu Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (Yunshui Yoga Studio)

name: Afternoon tea break and e-book organizing.
description: After yoga class, Yuwei ordered an iced latte at Photosynthesis Coffee on Yugu Road, sat by the window, used her iPad to reclassify downloaded e-books into the 'Hangzhou Moments' collection, and leafed through the sample of "Dreams of the West Lake", finding it very fitting.
location: Yugu Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (Photosynthesis Coffee Shop)

name: Returned to the hotel and unboxed the Kindle to decorate it
description: Yuwei took a ride-hailing car from Yugu Road back to the hotel. On the way, she received a text saying the Kindle had been received by the front desk on her behalf. After picking up the package, she carefully unboxed it at the desk in her room, powered it on, set the language, connected to Wi-Fi, and imported e-books to the device via USB. Afterward, she decorated the protective case with "Starry Night" stickers and put a "Traveler" label on the corner, feeling fully satisfied.
location: At the desk in the room at Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Broken Bridge Branch), No. 20 Baoshishan Xia'er Lane, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Dinner and an initial visit to Wulin Night Market
description: In the evening, Yuwei rode a shared bike via Beishan Street and Huancheng West Road to Wulin Night Market. At the market, she sampled cong bao hui and ding sheng gao as dinner, browsed handicraft stalls, and bought a copper bookmark printed with the Three Pools Mirroring the Moon pattern.
location: Along Wulin Road (Wulin Night Market), Gongshu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Night journal and Xiaohongshu guide posting
description: After washing up, Yuwei sat cross-legged on the bed, pasted the bookstore receipt, night-market bookmark, and Kindle unboxing photo into her journal, and recorded her feelings. She then posted on Xiaohongshu with images including a Kindle close-up, a back view of West Lake, a working photo at a coffee shop, and journal page-turning shots. In the caption she shared in detail the money-saving process of buying a Kindle through student verification, and replied to comments.
location: On the bed in the room at Home Inn Selected (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Duanqiao Branch), No. 20 Baoshi Hill Second Lane, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Video call with family
description: Yuwei leaned against the headboard and made a video call to chat with her family. Her mother asked about the weather in Hangzhou, her father asked about the plan to visit Xiaoshu Library tomorrow, and her sister chatted about yoga instructors. The lively exchange made Yuwei feel the warmth of home.
location: On the bed in the room at Home Inn Selected (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Duanqiao Branch), No. 20 Baoshi Hill Second Lane, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Reading, meditation, and falling asleep before bed
description: Turning off the main light and leaving only the bedside lamp, Yuwei read “Hangzhou Past” on her new Kindle for about 30 minutes, feeling how the words echoed today’s experiences. She then did a 10-minute bedtime meditation to relax. After meditating, she recorded the day’s expenses and her weight (45.8 kg) in her journal, confirmed tomorrow’s alarm, turned off the light, and fell asleep full of anticipation for the next day’s visit to Xiaoshu Library.
location: On bed at Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Broken Bridge Branch), No. 20 Baoshi Hill Second Lane, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Waking up in the morning.
description: The familiar morning light filtered through the gap in the curtains, casting dappled shadows across the familiar room. Unlike usual, I didn't get up immediately. Instead, I turned over and hugged the quilt, quietly looking around this little world of mine — last night's journal lay open on the desk, and the Christmas cactus on the windowsill shone with a healthy glow. Thinking that I would be leaving all this behind tonight, a sweet flutter of anticipation rose in my heart. I picked up my phone and checked the flight information again: Kunming Changshui 19:00 to Hangzhou Xiaoshan.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning brisk walk and stretching
description: I changed into sportswear and running shoes, went downstairs, and crossed the neighborhood. The morning air carried the slight coolness of early summer and the scent of grass. I deliberately took a detour to the building where Aunt Xie, my neighbor, lives. Seeing that the bougainvillea she had planted had bloomed into a purple waterfall, I couldn’t help taking a photo with my phone. Then I jogged slowly to Green Lake Park, walked briskly twice along the lakeside path, found a quiet corner in the lakeside corridor, and did some simple leg stretches.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Washing up and having a simple breakfast at home
description: When I got home, Mom was already busy in the kitchen, and the unique tangy aroma of little-pot rice noodles came from the clay pot. “Weiwei, go wash up quickly, we can eat soon!” I responded, took a quick shower, and changed into the loose cotton T-shirt I usually wear at home. Sitting at the dining table, I slowly ate the steaming hot rice noodles while Mom kept reminding me that the nights in Hangzhou are windy, so I should bring that thin knitted cardigan.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pack yoga gear.
description: After breakfast, she returned to the bedroom and took out a foldable travel yoga mat and two sets of quick-dry workout clothes from the cabinet. She skillfully folded the mat in half, rolled it tightly, and secured it with the strap, then put it into a small waterproof storage bag prepared in advance, along with the two sets of clothes, a phone stand, and sun-protection arm sleeves. She carefully placed this storage bag into the outer compartment of her carry-on suitcase.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Final luggage check and handling school affairs.
description: Referring to the checklist in her phone memo, she started checking her luggage item by item. In the carry-on case: mirrorless camera, laptop, TN journal, Kindle, a few skincare products, and a change of underwear. In the backpack: wallet, power bank, earphones, and a water bottle. She picked up the mirrorless camera, checked the battery and memory card, and made sure everything was ready. Then she opened the school's academic affairs app, saw that the thesis submission window was open, and added a calendar reminder. She also cleared a supplementary course application for a general education course from last semester—the system showed Approved.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Handling work matters and saying goodbye
description: Sat down at the desk, opened the laptop, and sent a WeChat message to advisor Wu Mingyuan: “Professor Wu, I'm flying to Hangzhou tonight and should arrive a little after ten. I can read literature remotely at any time, and I'll report to you as soon as I make progress on the thesis.” After sending it, opened the latest revised manuscript sent by Editor Xu, quickly read it through, confirmed there were no issues, and replied: “Editor Xu, the manuscript is fine. I'm flying out tonight. If I get any new material here later, I'll send it to you.” Then glanced at the phone; Dad said in the family group chat that he would come back early at noon.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Print files and organize documents
description: She organized the e-check-in confirmation for the youth hostel and the electronic flight itinerary, connected to the printer at home, and printed them out. She placed them in a transparent document folder and put it in the inner pocket of her backpack. While waiting for the printout, she opened the desk drawer and saw Here and Now, the book she had bought from Uncle Qin at Zhibushi Bookstore. She hesitated, but couldn't bear to pack it into her already full suitcase, so she gently put it back on the shelf, thinking she would read it when she returned.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Completed the profile article
description: The last task of the morning was to finish the character profile that had been left incomplete. I put on my headphones, played soft piano music, and immersed myself in writing the final two paragraphs of inner monologue about the inheritor of the intangible cultural heritage, weighing the wording again and again. At 11:40 a.m., I read through the whole piece and once again echoed the themes of “loneliness” and “inheritance.” In the email body, I wrote: “Editor Xu, the article is now finished, with the theme highlighting the dialectical relationship between ‘inheritance’ and ‘loneliness.’ Do you think this is acceptable?” Then I clicked send.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch time
description: Dad Sun Mingyuan arrived home before noon, carrying a bag of cream puffs that Mom loves. On the table were a refreshing cold cucumber salad, stir-fried green peppers with pork, and vegetable soup. The conversation revolved around my upcoming trip to Hangzhou, my older sister Sun Yutong's reminders, and amusing anecdotes from Dad's business trips to Hangzhou when he was young. The three of us ate and chatted; laughter and the aroma of the food intertwined, making the farewell atmosphere warm rather than heavy.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday farewell walk in Cuihu Park
description: After lunch, without taking a nap, I changed into a plain dress and strolled alone to Green Lake Park. The afternoon sunlight filtered through the trees, sparkling on the lake. On benches, elderly people were playing chess, and children were feeding the few remaining waterfowl. I sat down in a shady corner near the Lake Heart Pavilion, closed my eyes, and felt the breeze, the sound of water, and the unique leisurely atmosphere of Kunming. This was, in a way, a silent farewell to the park I had been playing in since childhood.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Returned home and did final tidying up.
description: Back home, she checked the zippers and locks on her luggage again. She plugged in her phone, power bank, iPad, and Kindle so that they would all be fully charged before she set out. She deliberately placed her journal and a new pen in the outer pocket of her backpack for easy writing on the plane. With everything ready, she sat down on the living room sofa and quietly scrolled through this spring's photos of cherry blossoms and campus corners in her phone album.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-departure preparations and family interaction
description: At 3:30 p.m., Dad picked up the car keys and said to me, “Weiwei, it's about time. Let's leave early so the traffic isn't bad.” Mom Li Xiulan came out of the kitchen with a folded thin knit cardigan and tucked it into the side pocket of my backpack: “I told you to take it. Hangzhou is windy, and it's cool in the morning and evening.” I smiled and accepted Mom's hug, feeling warm inside.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Drive to Changshui Airport
description: At 15:45, Dad started the car. Mom sat in the back seat, right next to me. The car drove through familiar streets and onto the Second Ring Expressway. Along the way, Dad reminded me to let them know I was safe when I arrived, while Mom kept talking about the youth hostel's location and whether it was clean. I leaned against the window, watching the scenery race by, my heart full of anticipation for the future.
location: Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (en route)

name: Airport check-in and baggage drop-off
description: At 16:15, the family arrived at the airport. Dad helped me take the suitcase out of the trunk, and Mom helped me adjust my backpack straps. At the self-service check-in kiosk, I scanned my ID card, confirmed the window seat (31A), and printed the boarding pass. Then I checked in my luggage; watching the suitcase disappear into the conveyor belt, I felt a sense of relief. In front of the security checkpoint, I hugged my parents and said goodbye: "Dad, Mom, I'll text you once I arrive." I let out a long breath, turned around, and walked through the security gate.
location: Departure Hall, Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waiting for the flight and reading
description: After passing through security, I didn't linger long in the duty-free shop and walked straight to Gate 22. I found a quiet corner, took out my thermos and filled it with hot water, then pulled my carefully decorated Kindle out of my backpack, opened 'Selected Chinese Essays', and read two travel essays about towns in Jiangnan. At ten minutes to seven in the evening, the boarding announcement came. I closed the Kindle, put it back in my bag, and joined the boarding queue.
location: Near Gate 22, Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-flight period
description: After boarding and finding my seat, I buckled my seatbelt and turned off my phone before takeoff. As the plane taxied and climbed, through the window I took one last look at Kunming growing smaller in the twilight, its myriad lights like stardust. Once the flight leveled off, I took out my TN notebook and recorded today's feelings with a pen: 'Sitting by the window, at the moment of takeoff, the lights of my hometown became a handful of stars beneath my feet. I am going to Hangzhou.' I also jotted down a few scattered writing inspirations about Jiangnan.
location: On the flight from Kunming Changshui International Airport to Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport

name: Arriving in Hangzhou and commuting by subway
description: The flight arrived about 10 minutes later than scheduled. After landing at 22:10, I turned on my phone, first texted my family to let them know I was safe, and then saw a WeChat message from my elder sister Sun Yutong: “Welcome to Hangzhou! I'll treat you to dinner tomorrow!” I followed the signs to the subway station and scanned the QR code with Alipay to enter. I took Line 7 and transferred to Line 1, getting off at Longxiangqiao Station. This time, I was no longer a tourist but a passerby about to stay here for a while, feeling the city's damp night breeze, so different from Kunming's.
location: On the way from Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, No. 1 Road, Linping District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province to Longxiangqiao Metro Station in Xihu District.

name: Check in and settle in at the youth hostel.
description: Following the navigation, I walked and found the booked Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel. At the front desk was a young woman with a ponytail who briskly verified my ID, handed me a room card and a set of clean sheets and a duvet cover. I stayed in a four-bed female dorm on the third floor. There was only one girl in the room, wearing headphones and watching videos; we nodded and smiled at each other. I quietly made my bed and organized my belongings. After washing up, I took out today's boarding pass and the copy of "Here and Now" I'd brought from home, placed them by my pillow, and got ready to sleep, full of curiosity about the new city and the new beginning.
location: Room 323, Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), West Wing, 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Falling asleep late at night in Hangzhou
description: Lying on the upper bunk, listening to the occasional car sounds from downstairs and the faint footsteps in the hallway, the subtle noises of the unfamiliar environment made it hard to fall asleep. It was past 1 a.m. when my roommate finally came back late at night, moving very quietly, but the sound of rummaging through things and the water running in the bathroom were especially clear in the silence of the night. I forced myself to empty my mind, and slowly drifted off to sleep in this city thousands of miles from Kunming.
location: Room 323, Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), West Wing, 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning yoga and breakfast
description: At 6 a.m., the phone alarm rang. Sun Yuwei woke up, took a few deep breaths, changed into yoga clothes, and headed to Gushan Park with a yoga mat and phone stand. She walked through quiet neighborhoods, spread the mat on the waterside pavilion, and practiced sun salutations, focusing on muscle stretching and body balance. After practice, she used her phone to record a time-lapse of the lake and took a photo with the Broken Bridge in the background, sharing it to the family group and Xiaohongshu. Back at the hostel, she showered, changed into a cotton-linen dress, brewed a cup of old-tree black tea with flower cakes as breakfast, and leafed through “Hangzhou Stories” to prepare for the day.
location: Waterside pavilion near Xiling Seal Art Society, 31 Gushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Cycling the highlight section of West Lake
description: Sun Yuwei put on a sun-protection jacket and earphones, scanned a shared bike at the entrance of the youth hostel, and started cycling around West Lake westward along Beishan Street. She stopped by Broken Bridge to take a photo of the 'Broken Bridge with Remnant Snow' stone tablet with Baochu Pagoda in the background, passed Bai Causeway and felt the poetry beneath the green willows, pushed her bike up the slope beside Xiling Bridge to overlook the full view of Solitary Hill, then turned to the northern section of Su Causeway and paused briefly in front of Chunxiao Pavilion. Throughout the ride she was bathed in the morning breeze, there were few tourists, and she felt cheerful. Finally she rode back to the Beishan Street entrance and returned the bike.
location: West Lake Scenic Area along Beishan Street, Bai Causeway, Su Causeway, and Yanggong Causeway, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Immersive reading at Xiao Library
description: After returning the bike, Sun Yuwei walked back to the youth hostel, looked up the route to the Liangzhu Culture and Art Center, packed her backpack (e-reader, digital camera, power bank, journal, etc.), and left at 9:55. She took Metro Line 3 and transferred to Line 2 to Liangzhu Station, then walked to the "Big Roof" designed by Tadao Ando. Entering Xiaoshu Library, she was struck by the tall circular reading space. She took down "The Records of Jiangnan Gardens" and a collection of architectural works from the tall bookshelves, and immersed herself in reading on a cushion in the corner for over an hour. She wrote "Light is a building material here; concrete becomes gentle too" on a sticky note and put it on the wall. At 12:00 she bought commemorative postcards in the cultural and creative area and left.
location: Liangzhu Cultural and Arts Center (Xiaoshu Library), No. 12 Gudun Road, Yuhang District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Lunch at the village canteen.
description: Sun Yuwei walked to the villagers' canteen near Xiaoshu Library. In the nostalgic setting, she ordered a bowl of noodles with shredded pork and water bamboo, a piece of Dingsheng cake, and a cup of osmanthus sour plum drink, and ate to her heart's content. While eating, she sent a WeChat message to her friend Lin Yue, telling her about the afternoon plan at the Pure Times Book Bar on Baoshi Mountain, and invited her to come over when she was free.
location: Liangzhu Cultural and Art Center Commercial Area (Villagers' Canteen), Yuhang District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Writing at the book café and meeting with friends
description: Starting from Liangzhu, she took Metro Line 2 and Line 1 to the city center. After exiting at Longxiangqiao Station, Sun Yuwei bought a taro wheel cake and a cup of grass jelly to replenish her energy. She then hiked up Baoshi Mountain and reached the Pure Times Book Bar halfway up the mountain at 14:35. She ordered a cup of Longjing tea and, at a window seat, used her laptop and journal to organize the day's observations, turning her morning yoga, cycling, and Xiaoshu Library experience into delicate prose. At 15:40, her friend Lin Yue arrived, and the two talked about their impressions of Hangzhou, recent work, and exchanged book lists. Lin Yue reminded her that the date for the family photo had not yet been confirmed; after discussing, she left at 16:15. Sun Yuwei continued writing and finished the ending of the essay.
location: Age of Innocence Book Bar (Baoshi Hill Branch), No. 8 Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Finalized the date for the family portrait
description: After coming down the hill, Sun Yuwei strolled along Beishan Street toward Broken Bridge. Sitting on a lakeside bench, she made a family video call, showed her mother the sunset over West Lake, and heard her father greet her from off-screen. Smiling, she turned the phone so her family could see Leifeng Pagoda in the distance. After hanging up, she immediately contacted her friend Zhang Jing to confirm the family portrait photo shoot on Saturday afternoon, and sent the confirmation to Lin Yue and her older sister, settling one matter on her mind.
location: Lakeside bench on Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (near Broken Bridge)

name: Vegetarian dinner
description: Feeling relaxed, Sun Yuwei walked to Yisu Vegetarian Restaurant at Lakeside Intime, and ordered a matsutake mushroom clay pot, osmanthus-glazed lotus root stuffed with sticky rice, and osmanthus rice wine. She used her phone's macro mode to photograph the delicately plated dishes and sent them to her family, enjoying the fresh vegetarian meal on her own.
location: Yisu Vegetarian Restaurant, B1, Intime Department Store (Hangzhou West Lake Store), 98 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Lakeside night tour and shopping
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei strolled through the night market stalls at Hubin Intime, picked out a silk scarf for her mother, and bought a box of Dingsheng cake for her older sister. Then she walked back along Hubin Road, stopped at West Lake Music Fountain Square to enjoy the tail end of a fountain performance, and finally rode a shared bike back to the youth hostel.
location: No. 98 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, Lakeside Intime in77 and the surrounding area of West Lake Music Fountain Square.

name: Organizing travel journal
description: Back at the youth hostel and washed up, Sun Yuwei spread out her travel journal under the small bedside lamp. She used glue dots to attach the postcard from Xiaoshu Library, the wheel cake wrapper, and a complete plane-tree leaf collected during the day, and drew a simple route map of the cycling trip. Beside them she wrote: 'Language is too light, while the lakes and mountains are too heavy. Today's Hangzhou was fluid and full of light. The concrete texture of Xiaoshu Library, the woody fragrance of the Innocent Age Book Bar, the lingering warmth of the wheel cake, and the promise of a family portrait are all kneaded into this page.' Afterward, she printed the screenshot of the transfer her older sister had sent as her contribution to the family portrait and pasted it in.
location: Room, West Block, Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel, No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Reading before bed and exchanging messages with the editor
description: After finishing her journal, Sun Yuwei used her e-reader to continue reading the chapter “Literary Gatherings among Lakes and Mountains” from “Hangzhou Memories.” While checking her phone before bed, she saw a message from editor Xu Mingyuan asking about the progress of the article on Green Lake in Kunming. She replied that she was currently in Hangzhou for inspiration, would have new ideas, and would complete the draft as soon as possible. The two briefly exchanged views on Jiangnan culture.
location: Room, West Block, Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel, No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Sun Yuwei switched off the bedside lamp, feeling calm and fulfilled inside, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room, West Block, Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel, No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: Waking up in natural light on a cloudy day, she changed into her yoga clothes, filled a bottle with warm water, and grabbed her yoga mat and phone, ready to head to the lakeside of West Lake for her morning yoga ritual.
location: Inside a room at Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), West Block, No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Morning Yoga by West Lake
description: Walked to a quiet lakeside platform along Beishan Street by the West Lake, spread out a yoga mat, and practiced a combination of Warrior II, Extended Side Angle, and Cat-Cow poses, feeling her breath merge with the morning breeze. Afterward, she used her phone to shoot a time-lapse and posted it to Xiaohongshu with music, with the caption “The awakening of the second day in Hangzhou, giving my body to the morning mist.”
location: A long terrace along the lake on Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Washing up, having breakfast, and confirming the itinerary with Fang Qing at the youth hostel.
description: After returning to the youth hostel, she took a quick shower, changed into an off-white linen shirt, khaki wide-leg pants, and canvas shoes, and packed her canvas bag with her mirrorless camera, journal, and other items. In the common area, she brewed some Yunnan ancient-tree black tea and paired it with Zhiweiguan Dingsheng cake as breakfast. At the same time, she confirmed with Fang Qing via WeChat that they would meet at the hostel entrance at 9:00; Fang Qing instantly replied OK. She also saw that her yoga video on Xiaohongshu had received more than a dozen likes, which gave her a small sense of satisfaction.
location: West Block, No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, public area of Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch)

name: Went with Fang Qing to an independent café to exchange journals.
description: She met Fang Qing at the entrance of the youth hostel. Fang Qing suggested taking the bus, so the two walked to Huanglong Sports Center Station and took Bus 28 for about 15 minutes to Wulinmen Station. Then they cut through alleys, climbed up an old residential building, and arrived at the independent café “Life Journal.” Retro jazz was playing inside. They ordered pour-over coffee, sat down in a corner by the window, and took out their journals to share travel inspiration. Fang Qing showed the collected tickets, dried leaves, and hand-drawn street scenes; Sun Yuwei shared quick sketches of Kunming's vegetable market and her West Lake yoga journal. They talked freely about writing, travel, and the ideal life.
location: Life Journal Independent Café, No. 26, Shihuqiao Road, Gongshu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Treasure hunting in old bookstores
description: Fang Qing led her through the alleys, passing a stall selling scallion pancakes, and they walked to the “Wenshixuan” used bookstore on Zhongshan Middle Road. The two plunged into the piles of books. In a corner, Sun Yuwei found a 1980s photography collection, “Old Images of West Lake.” Excitedly, she photographed it and sent it to the family group chat, and also selected “West Lake Folk Tales” and “Hangzhou Alleys,” spending 48 yuan in total.
location: Wenshixuan Used Bookstore, 128 Zhongshan Middle Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Had lunch with Fang Qing at a vegetarian restaurant
description: Fang Qing recommended her usual vegetarian restaurant, "Plain Heart." The two ordered mushroom vegetarian noodles, osmanthus-glazed lotus root, and cold mixed Indian aster, chatting about their respective freelance careers and sharing funny stories about missing deadlines. Both laughed, saying they had found their "other self."
location: Near Zhongshan Middle Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, Suxin Vegetarian Restaurant

name: Selected and mailed out a Mother's Day gift.
description: After lunch, she walked to the Hubin Intime shopping area. She first went to the counter of the Zhiweiguan flagship store and bought six freshly baked flower cakes, then turned into the nearby Oyster Bookstore and carefully selected the essay collection Here and Now. She asked the clerk to wrap it in plain elegant gift paper and wrote a blessing on a card with a fountain pen. Afterwards, at a nearby SF Express outlet, she sent the flower cakes and the book together back to her home in Kunming. After paying the shipping fee, she breathed a sigh of relief, feeling that she had completed an important task. At the stationery store next door, she bought West Lake Ten Scenes washi tape and postcards as a small reward for herself.
location: No. 252 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province; the main branch of Zhiweiguan Restaurant and the nearby SF Express outlet

name: Urban walk and conversation with Fang Qing
description: After sending the gifts, the two of them shifted into a leisurely citywalk mode, strolling along Dongpo Road and Pinghai Road. Fang Qing pointed out the Longjing tea shop run by her friend and the alley that hid delicious scallion pancakes. At the “Cycle&Cycle” bakery, they split a canelé, tried on trendy hats and joked with each other, talking about future plans and the small joys of the moment.
location: Hubin Yintai in77 and surrounding area, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Resting and saying goodbye at Random Composite Art Space
description: Tired from wandering around, the two walked into the Random multi-purpose art space and ordered sparkling water to rest. Sun Yuwei admired the new washi tape she had bought, and Fang Qing shared her illustrated book of Hangzhou plants. Fang Qing mentioned she had plans that evening, but since it was still early, she suggested they go to a nearby vegetarian restaurant for dinner. She gave Sun Yuwei a set of her own original journal stickers. The two hugged and agreed to meet again in Kunming later, but they did not part ways immediately; instead, they headed together to the dinner spot.
location: Random Composite Art Space, near Hubin Intime in77, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Had dinner with Fang Qing at Qingchun Canteen
description: Fang Qing walked with her to the vegetarian restaurant "Qingchun Canteen" that she strongly recommended. They ordered black truffle fried rice, osmanthus-flavored Lipu taro, and porcini mushroom braised rice, and continued their deep conversation about the desire for freelancing and the real confusion around it. They felt they had become friends too late. At checkout, they added each other on WeChat and agreed to stay in touch. After dinner, the two formally said goodbye.
location: Qingchun Canteen Vegetarian Restaurant, No. 98 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Returned to the youth hostel and organized the gains.
description: After saying goodbye to Fang Qing, she took Bus No. 28 back to the youth hostel at Longxiangqiao Bus Stop. On the bus, she edited her WeChat Moments post, adding the café group photo and the old-book photos, with the caption, “An afternoon of swapping journals, and meeting an interesting soul.” Back in her hostel room, she sat down and flipped through the newly purchased photo collection Old Shadows of the West Lake, and took a few photos of her favorite old pictures with her phone.
location: Inside a room at Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), West Block, No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Evening journaling
description: At the desk in the youth hostel, she laid out today's haul in a row: stickers, the second-hand bookstore receipt, the café's business card, and new washi tape, then began journaling. She stuck the café card in the upper-left corner and made a border with washi tape. She rephotographed the old photo from Old Images of West Lake, pasted it into the journal, and wrote her reflections with a fountain pen. She printed out the group photo she asked a staff member to take for her and pasted it onto a blank page, writing, “Spending an afternoon with someone on the same wavelength is the magic of travel.”
location: At the desk, Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), West Block, No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Voice call with mother
description: After finishing her journal, she sent her mother a voice message saying she had walked around a lot today and was about to rest, without mentioning the gift. Her mother replied, reminding her that Hangzhou's weather is changeable and she should put on more clothes. Sun Yuwei felt warmed by this and replied goodnight.
location: Inside a room at Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), West Block, No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Pre-sleep reading, meditation, and going to bed
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, she leaned against the headboard and read the chapter "Southern Song Imperial City" from "Hangzhou Memories" on her Kindle for about thirty minutes. Then she turned off the main light, turned on the night light, and did a 10-minute pre-sleep meditation focused on her breathing. After meditating, she recorded three small things she was grateful for in her phone's memo app. Finally, she set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, put on an eye mask, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Zhejiang Province, Hangzhou, Xihu District, 160 Tianmushan Road, West Building, Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), on the bed

name: Woke up in the early morning and walked to the yoga platform by West Lake
description: At 6:10 a.m., Sun Yuwei woke up at the youth hostel. After checking her phone messages, she replied to her mother, changed into her yoga outfit, and quietly left the room with her yoga mat. She walked about fifteen minutes through the quiet morning streets to a secluded lakeside platform on the east side of Broken Bridge on Bai Causeway. She spread out her mat, took a deep breath, and immersed herself in the peaceful lakeside morning light.
location: The lakeside platform near Broken Bridge on Bai Causeway, Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning yoga practice by West Lake
description: Yuwei warmed up with Sun Salutations, then challenged balance poses Half Moon and Tree, imagining herself as a tree by West Lake, rooting down and growing upward. She recorded a 30-second short video on her phone, wrote a caption about her fifth day of yoga practice, and posted it on Xiaohongshu, showing the pose transitions in the morning light.
location: The lakeside platform near Broken Bridge on Bai Causeway, Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Returned to the hostel, took a shower, and enjoyed breakfast.
description: After yoga, Yuwei walked back to Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel, took a quick shower to wash off the slight sweat, changed into a cotton-linen shirt and jeans, packed her computer bag and confirmed all thesis-related items, then came to the public area on the first floor. She brewed black tea, ate the peanut butter toast bought last night, checked comments on Xiaohongshu, and replied to netizens.
location: Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Finished the final draft of my paper in the Plum Blossom Pavilion and shared the good news with my family
description: Yuwei took her laptop bag and thermos, walked about 26 minutes from the youth hostel to Plum Blossom Pavilion, and chose a corner with good light. She opened her laptop and the annotated document from her advisor Wu Mingyuan to familiarize herself with key paragraphs. At exactly 9:00, she had a video discussion with her advisor, who affirmed the framework and depth of the thesis and only suggested three changes to the conclusion. She took careful notes and, immediately after hanging up, revised the wording of the conclusion, replaced academic terms, generated a PDF, and uploaded it to the university thesis system. After submitting, she sent a screenshot to her advisor to thank him, and he replied with a thumbs up and congratulations. She then leaned against the pavilion pillar and sent a message to the family group chat announcing that graduation was done. Seeing her family's joyful replies, she felt at ease.
location: Plum Blossom Pavilion, Baochu Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Stroll along Gushan Road at West Lake and enjoy leisure
description: After submitting the paper, Yuwei walked from the Plum Blossom Pavilion along Baochu Road and turned onto Gushan Road, treating herself to a leisurely time. With the lake on her left and Baoshi Hill on her right, she used her mirrorless camera to photograph the pleasure boats and the city skyline, recorded a little squirrel by the roadside, and paused in front of Su Xiaoxiao's tomb to savor the poetry of 'I ride a painted carriage, and you mount a piebald horse.'
location: Gushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Enjoyed lunch at Suxin Vegetarian Restaurant.
description: In the afternoon, Yuwei took a taxi from the foot of Gushan Hill to Suxin Vegetarian (Cuiyuan Branch), a ride of about seventeen minutes. In this elegant and unpretentious restaurant, she ordered a bowl of mushroom and vegetable fried rice and a bowl of Buddhist's Delight soup, and ate quietly by herself, enjoying a moment of peace.
location: Suxin Vegetarian Restaurant (Cuiyuan Branch), 294 Wenyi Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang

name: Took a taxi to Xiangshan Campus, China Academy of Art.
description: After lunch, Yuwei called a ride-hailing car at the restaurant entrance and headed to the Xiangshan Campus of the China Academy of Art on Zhuantang Street. The drive took about forty minutes. Leaning against the window, she watched the view outside shift from the city to a lush green countryside, her heart full of anticipation for the afternoon trip.
location: On the way from Wenyi Road to Zhuantang Subdistrict, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Visited the Xiangshan Campus of the China Academy of Art, the Folk Art Museum, and Nanshan Bookstore.
description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, Yuwei arrived at the art academy. She first visited the Folk Art Museum and was stunned by the tiled facade and light-and-shadow effects designed by Kengo Kuma. She spent an hour photographing the patterns cast on the white walls by the afternoon sunlight through the tiles. Then she strolled around the campus, feeling the unique character of the Architecture Museum, and paused in front of the train café. After leaving the art academy, she walked to Nanshan Bookstore in the Xiangshan International Art District outside the school gate, selected an illustrated edition of Records of Jiangnan Gardens as a collection item, and also took a liking to Miscellaneous Notes on Yuezhong to give to Uncle Qin's bookstore.
location: No. 352 Xiangshan Road, Zhuantang Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, Xiangshan Campus of China Academy of Art, and Nanshan Bookstore in Xiangshan International Art District

name: Cycled back toward West Lake along Zhijiang Road
description: After buying the books, Yuwei scanned a shared bike and rode north from the art academy along Zhijiang Road. Along the way, she saw the outlines of the Qiantang River Bridge and Six Harmonies Pagoda in the distance. The breeze brushed her face, and the ride was smooth and pleasant.
location: Along Zhijiang Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Booking the National Day family portrait at dusk on Bai Causeway
description: Yuwei parked her bike near Hubin Road, walked to the bench at the entrance to Bai Causeway, and sat down. Facing West Lake in the twilight, she called 'Time Memory' Photo Studio in Wuhua District, Kunming. She clearly communicated the details of the vintage Republic-era package, reserved a slot for 9:30 a.m. on October 3, and paid a 300 yuan deposit. After hanging up, she immediately took a screenshot of the confirmation message and sent it to the family group chat with a note for her family. Seeing her mother's reply, she felt her wish had come true.
location: Bench near the entrance of Bai Causeway, West Lake District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Walking along West Lake and watching the sunset
description: After booking the family portrait, Yuwei felt relaxed. She strolled slowly along Lakeside Road, watching the sunset sink little by little behind Leifeng Pagoda and the distant mountains, dyeing the lake surface golden orange. She found a quiet stretch of embankment, leaned on the railing, and enjoyed the view until the sky darkened and the city lights came on.
location: Hubin Road Pedestrian Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Take a taxi back to the youth hostel.
description: It was getting late, so Yuwei hailed a ride-hailing car on Hubin Road and returned to Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel. The ride took about ten minutes, bringing her back to a familiar area.
location: Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Youth hostel common area and socializing with illustrators
description: After returning to the youth hostel, Yuwei rested on the sofa in the common area and flipped through The Jiangnan Gardens, which she had bought during the day. A bespectacled freelance illustrator from Guangzhou greeted her proactively; it was the traveler she had crossed paths with yesterday. The two naturally chatted about today's experiences. Yuwei shared her impressions of the art academy and the museum, and the illustrator showed street sketches she had drawn in Hangzhou. They followed each other on Weibo and agreed to visit her studio when Yuwei later goes to Guangzhou.
location: First-floor public area of Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), No. 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Return to the room, organize the journal, meditate, and go to sleep
description: After the social event, Yuwei returned to Room 306. Under the bedside lamp, she took out her TN journal, pasted in screenshots of the successful thesis submission, the Folk Art Museum ticket, the Nanshan Bookstore receipt, and a text message screenshot of the family photo reservation. She wrote the date and her feelings about the thesis submission in blue pen, sketched the shadows of the roof tiles in green pen, recorded her weight as 45.5 kg, and wrote three small things in the gratitude section. After washing up, she changed into pajamas, read a passage from "Hangzhou Past" on her Kindle, then meditated cross-legged for 10 minutes, focusing on her breath to relax her body and mind. Before going to sleep, she sent her mother a goodnight voice message, and after turning off the light, she fell asleep peacefully amid the faint city noise outside the window.
location: Room 306, Fanxi Fans Youth Hostel (Huanglong Sports Center Branch), 160 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Getting Up and Morning Preparation
description: At Duixiangjia Youth Hostel, in the female four-bed dorm, she was woken by her phone alarm, lingered in bed for two minutes, then got up. Opening the curtains, morning light streamed into the room. After a quick wash, she changed into light athletic wear and packed today's essentials—her phone, Bluetooth earbuds, room card, and a small bottle of water—into a canvas tote bag.
location: Partner's Home Youth Hostel, No. 182 Zhongshan North Road, Gongshu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Last morning yoga at West Lake and video recording
description: Walk to the open space near the music fountain on Hubin Road beside West Lake, face the lake, and complete the final sun salutation yoga practice. Record a few vinyasa sequences and speak to the camera, summarizing the five-day morning practice experience at West Lake. Then publish a wrap-up post on Xiaohongshu, temporarily bringing the "Poetry and Faraway Places" series to a close.
location: Open space near the music fountain on Hubin Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang (beside West Lake)

name: Return to the youth hostel, pack up, and check out
description: Walking back to the Partner’s Home Youth Hostel with a slightly sweaty body, she quickly rinsed off, then put the remaining luggage (a change of clothes, a charger, and “The Complete Essays of Lu Xun”) back into her backpack. She tidied the bed, returned the room card, and said a brief goodbye at the front desk.
location: Partner's Home Youth Hostel, No. 182 Zhongshan North Road, Gongshu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Mother's Day video call
description: Sitting on the sofa by the window in the youth hostel lobby, I put in my earphones and made a WeChat video call with my mother, Li Xiulan. She was arranging flowers in the living room and mentioned the flower cakes and the roselle she had bought last time. We chatted for half an hour, wished each other a happy Mother’s Day, and I felt warm inside.
location: No. 182 Zhongshan North Road, Gongshu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, common area on the first floor of Dui Xiang Jia Youth Hostel

name: Breakfast and departure preparation
description: Walked to Zhou Suzhen Traditional Huzhou Wonton Shop, ordered a bowl of signature large wontons and a serving of xiaolongbao. While eating, I checked today's high-speed train schedules from Hangzhou to Shaoxing on a mobile app and booked a G-series train departing from Hangzhou East Station at 09:16.
location: Zhou Suzhen Traditional Huzhou Wonton Shop, No. 156 Jietansi Lane, Gongshu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Commuted by metro to Hangzhou East Station.
description: Walked from the wonton shop to Ding'an Road Metro Station, tapped the card to enter, took Hangzhou Metro Line 1, and arrived at Hangzhou East Railway Station about 25 minutes later, ready to take the high-speed train.
location: From Ding'an Road Metro Station to Hangzhou East Railway Station (Metro Line 1)

name: High-speed rail to Shaoxing North
description: She boarded a G-series high-speed train from Hangzhou East Station to Shaoxing North and sat by the window. As the train started smoothly, the urban scenery outside gradually turned into fields. She jotted down her thoughts about Mother's Day and home on her phone's memo app.
location: Train GXXXX on the Hangzhou-Ningbo high-speed railway (Hangzhou East Station to Shaoxing North Station)

name: After resting on the sofa for 20 minutes after the meal, Sun Yuwei opened her wardrobe and tried on three outfits. In the end, she chose a light beige wool cardigan with a dark long skirt and a silver necklace, an outfit that was both appropriate for the formal VIP preview and retained an artistic touch.
description: After exiting Shaoxing North Station, follow the signs to the BRT bus stop, take the bus bound for Lu Xun's Hometown, and get off at Lu Xun's Hometown Station after about 30 minutes. After walking about 5 minutes, you will see a white screen wall with “Lu Xun's Hometown” written on it.
location: Shaoxing North Station BRT Line 1 to Lu Xun's Former Residence Bus Stop, Yuecheng District, Shaoxing City, Zhejiang Province

name: Explore Lu Xun Hometown Pedestrian Street in advance
description: Before entering the former residence, she first strolled slowly along the Lu Xun Hometown Pedestrian Street. She listened to the folk tunes hummed by the boatmen on black-awning boats, watched the old women hand-making stinky tofu in roadside shops, and felt the lively atmosphere of the water town.
location: Lu Xun's Hometown Pedestrian Street, Lu Xun Middle Road, Yuecheng District, Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province

name: Lunch at Xianheng Restaurant
description: Walked into Xianheng Hotel and sat by the window. Ordered the signature fennel beans, braised pork with preserved mustard greens, and a cup of huangjiu milk tea. Tasted the fennel beans and imagined the scene of Kong Yiji back then; the braised pork was rich but not greasy, and eating it with white rice was satisfying.
location: Dine-in area of Xianheng Hotel, 179 Lu Xun Middle Road, Yuecheng District, Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province.

name: Visiting Lu Xun's Former Residence: Hundred-Plant Garden and Three-Flavor Study
description: She officially entered the Lu Xun Former Residence scenic area. From the kitchen stove to the Hundred-Plant Garden, she crouched at the foot of the mud wall, fingertips touching the damp brick crevices, imagining the childhood of the honey locust tree and the fleeceflower root. Then she found the Three Flavor Study and looked through the fence at the desk carved with the character 'early'. While resting on a bench in the scenic area, she opened her memo and began outlining an essay titled 'Rebirth from the Hundred-Plant Garden to the Three Flavor Study', and recorded the sound of oars from a black awning boat as audio material.
location: Lu Xun Native Place Scenic Area, No. 241 Lu Xun Middle Road, Yuecheng District, Shaoxing City, Zhejiang Province (Baicao Garden, Sanwei Study)

name: Nostalgia at Shen Garden and journaling.
description: Walked to Shen Garden, bought a ticket, and entered. Standing for a long time before the "Chaitoufeng" stele, the joys and sorrows of Lu You and Tang Wan filled her mind. In the shade of a tree by the stele, she took out her journal, recorded the day's impressions and phrases with a fountain pen, and sketched a simple branch of plum blossoms.
location: In front of the Phoenix Hairpin Stele in Shen Garden, No. 318 Lu Xun Middle Road, Yuecheng District, Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province.

name: Bus back to Shaoxing North Railway Station.
description: After leaving Shen Garden, she walked to the Lu Xun Hometown bus stop and took BRT Line 1 back to Shaoxing North Station. On the bus, leaning against the window, she watched the city scenery outside; she was a bit tired but mentally excited.
location: From Lu Xun Hometown Bus Station, Yuecheng District, Shaoxing City, Zhejiang Province, to Shaoxing North Station (BRT Line 1).

name: High-speed train back to Hangzhou East
description: At Shaoxing North Station, she passed through the ticket gate with her ID card and took the Hangzhou–Ningbo high-speed railway back to Hangzhou East Station, about a 35-minute ride.
location: Hangzhou–Ningbo high-speed railway train GXXXX (from Shaoxing North Station to Hangzhou East Station).

name: Metro to the new youth hostel
description: Take Metro Line 1 from Hangzhou East Station to Ding'an Road Station, then walk to Home Inn Business Hotel after exiting the station.
location: Hangzhou East Station to Ding'an Road Station, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (Metro Line 1)

name: Check in to Home Inn Business Travel Hotel and rest
description: Checked in at the front desk of Home Inn Business Travel Hotel, got the room card, entered the single room, put down my backpack, tidied my things, and felt a hotel atmosphere completely different from the previous youth hostel.
location: Home Inn Selected (Hangzhou West Lake Lakeside Music Fountain Branch), No. 4 Guohuo Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Evening exploration: a stroll along Southern Song Imperial Street and dinner
description: After a short rest, she went out and merged into the bustling crowds on Southern Song Imperial Street. She browsed a few small shops selling creative cultural products and snacks, and finally found a time-honored Dingsheng Cake shop at the entrance to Hefang Street, bought two freshly made Dingsheng cakes and a cup of traditional sour plum drink, and ate while walking.
location: The area around Southern Song Imperial Street / Hefang Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Hotel evening: sorting materials and journal time
description: Back in the hotel room, I sat down at the desk, opened my laptop, and imported and organized today's photos of Shaoxing.
