I gently tucked the fallen leaf I had brought back from Hundred-Plant Garden into the pages of the Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk chapter in The Complete Prose of Lu Xun. In my journal, I used colored tape to attach a fragment of the Xianheng Restaurant receipt and began carefully filling in today's travel journal.
location: At the desk in the room at Home Inn Plus Hotel, No. 4 Guohuo Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Reading and thinking about tomorrow's return plan
description: Leaning against the headboard with a small lamp on, she flipped through the section on the Hundred-Plant Garden in Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk from Lu Xun's Selected Essays, matching it with her morning experience, and occasionally smiled knowingly. Then, in her phone's memo, she wrote down preliminary thoughts: tomorrow returning to Kunming, pack light; bring Shaoxing preserved mustard greens and fennel beans for her parents, and Longjing tea for her close friends.
location: On the bed in the room at Homeinns Business Travel Hotel, No. 4 Guohuo Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Washing up and going to bed
description: She got out of bed and went to the bathroom to wash up. In the mirror, she saw a post-travel glow in her eyes. Back in bed, she replied to messages from her older sister and childhood friend in the group chat, and they exchanged goodnights. She turned off the bedside lamp. With Hangzhou's night sky showing through the gap in the curtains, in that completely unfamiliar hotel room, she fell into a deep sleep full of inspiration and satisfaction.
location: Washroom/room at Home Inn Selected, No. 4 Guohuo Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Getting up and washing up
description: At six in the morning, Yuwei was awakened by her alarm in her room at the Home Inn Selected hotel in Hangzhou. Outside the window, West Lake was overcast with rain threatening. After washing up, she changed into her yoga clothes, packed her waterproof jacket, phone, and small cross-body bag, and prepared for the last morning ritual.
location: Homeinns Selected Hotel (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Pedestrian Street Branch) - Room, No. 539-4 Fengqi Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou

name: Last morning yoga session at West Lake
description: Walked about 13 minutes to the usual place near Jixian Pavilion at Lakeside Park by West Lake. In the fresh air before a light rain, completed 25 minutes of yoga: seated meditation and a series of stretches. Finally, facing the lake, recorded a 30-second video and photographed the lake view under low-hanging clouds. Posted on Xiaohongshu: "Six days, six mornings, West Lake witnessed my breathing. Returning to the nest.", with the recording and photos attached.
location: Hubin Park, Hangzhou West Lake Scenic Area, No. 1 Longjing Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou (near Jixian Pavilion)

name: Return to the hotel to take a shower and pack up
description: Back in the hotel room, I took a quick shower and changed out of my sweaty yoga clothes. I carefully packed: put the three newly bought books, Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk, and the mirrorless camera into the backpack, tucked a fallen leaf from the Hundred-Plant Garden into my notebook, and checked the corners of the room to make sure nothing was left behind.
location: Homeinns Selected Hotel (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Pedestrian Street Branch) - Room, No. 539-4 Fengqi Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou

name: Breakfast
description: In a corner of the hotel’s first-floor restaurant, I enjoyed the buffet breakfast: hot milk, a fried egg, and half an apple. I also ate the Dingsheng cake I bought yesterday on Hefang Street as dessert, savoring Hangzhou’s “sweetness.”
location: Home Inn Plus Hotel (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Pedestrian Street Branch), No. 539-4, Fengqi Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou - First Floor Restaurant

name: Checkout and leaving a message.
description: Yuwei dragged her suitcase to the front desk to check out, wrote 'Thank you for your care, and I wish you all the best.' on a sticky note, stuck it on the side of the reception counter, and smiled goodbye to the front desk clerk.
location: Home Inn Plus Hotel (Hangzhou West Lake Hubin Pedestrian Street Branch) - Front Desk, 539-4 Fengqi Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou

name: Commuted by metro to Xiaoshan Airport.
description: She walked from the hotel to Ding'an Road Metro Station, took Hangzhou Metro Line 1 toward Xiaoshan International Airport, the whole trip taking about 1 hour 5 minutes. On the train, she listened to light music with earphones, browsed photos on her phone, and planned the stories she would tell when she got home.
location: Inside the carriage on Hangzhou Metro Line 1 (Ding'an Road Station to Xiaoshan International Airport Station)

name: Airport waiting and creative work
description: Arrived at Terminal 3 of Xiaoshan International Airport and checked in, then printed the boarding pass. After that, she lingered for twenty minutes at the 'Xiaofeng' Bookstore in the departure hall and bought 'Life Monthly' and Fan Jinshi's biography 'My Heart Belongs to Dunhuang'. After passing through security, she sat down in a quiet corner of the waiting area, copied the inspiration 'From Hundred-Plant Garden to Three-Flavour Study' from her phone memo into her carry-on journal, and sketched the essay outline. In between, she got some hot water and replied to editor Xu Mingyuan's WeChat message about the manuscript fee adjustment.
location: Departure hall and waiting area, Terminal 3, Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou.

name: Pre-boarding preparations
description: Hearing the boarding announcement, she packed up her journal and book in advance, went to the convenience store to buy a bottle of water, then joined the boarding queue.
location: Terminal 3, Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou - waiting area

name: Flight and writing
description: The flight took off on time and lasted about 3 hours and 40 minutes. After the takeoff stabilized, Yuwei flipped through "Life Monthly" for half an hour, then put on an eye mask and meditated with closed eyes for 20 minutes, reviewing the journey. Then she took out her travel journal and used colored pens and stickers to record precious memories such as the sound of oars on the awning boats and "Phoenix Hairpin" at Shen Garden. Finally, she took out her essay outline and began writing the opening of "The Rebirth from the Hundred-Plant Garden to the Three-Flavor Study", about 400 characters.
location: On a flight from Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport to Kunming Changshui International Airport

name: Pick up luggage
description: The plane landed at Kunming Changshui International Airport. She followed the crowd to the baggage carousel, quickly retrieved her luggage, and happily pulled up the handle of her suitcase.
location: T1 arrivals hall - baggage carousel, Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming

name: Meeting with parents
description: Seeing her parents from afar in the arrivals hall, Yuwei jogged over, gave her father Sun Mingyuan a big hug, and tightly held mother Li Xiulan's hand, saying with a smile, “I'm home!” Her father took the suitcase, her mother draped a coat over her, and the three walked together to the parking lot.
location: T1 Arrival Hall - Pick-up Hall, Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming

name: Chatting on the drive home
description: In the car on the way home, Yuwei sat in the back seat leaning against her mother's shoulder. Her father asked about trip details while driving, and her mother looked through the photos of West Lake on her phone, exclaiming in admiration. Outside the window, the sky over Kunming was still bright, and Yuwei felt the secure contentment of returning to the nest.
location: Inside the car on the airport expressway and city roads from Guandu District to Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Arriving home and sharing gifts
description: Arrived home around 18:10. Yuwei put down her luggage and took a deep breath of the familiar scent of home. She immediately took out the gifts: Shaoxing preserved mustard greens and fennel beans for her father, and a Hangzhou silk square scarf and West Lake Longjing tea for her mother. Her mother tried on the scarf at once and twirled happily in front of the mirror; her father took the preserved greens and said with a smile, “Your mom will definitely make braised pork with these for you.” Yuwei then handed him a small box of Longjing tea, asking him to compare it with the taste of Yunnan Pu'er.
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming – home living room

name: Family dinner — Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles
description: Mother served the carefully prepared crossing-the-bridge rice noodles. At the table, Yuwei vividly recounted her trip to Hangzhou while eating: the lively atmosphere of Southern Song Imperial Street, the architectural beauty of Xiaoshu Library, the sticker stories of her hostel roommate Fang Qing, the marvelous feeling of touching the mud wall base at Hundred-Plant Garden, and her stunned reverie in front of the 'Phoenix Hairpin' stele in Shen Garden. Her parents listened with great relish.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming - Home Restaurant

name: Packing up luggage and souvenirs
description: After the meal, I went back to the bedroom and put the clothes to be changed into the washing machine. Then I carefully spread out all the souvenirs on the desk—the mirrorless camera, journal, new book, fallen leaves, bookmark, tickets—and examined them closely, feeling the lingering aftertaste of the journey slowly settling.
location: Home bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Sharing the trip with her best friend and older sister.
description: She took out the Longjing tea she had brought for her close friends, took a photo, and sent it to the 'Iron Triangle' group chat with the message: 'Hand-carried the taste of Hangzhou spring; waiting for you to come drink it,' and shared a set of beautiful photos. Her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi replied instantly. Then she made a video call to her older sister Sun Yutong, far away in Shenzhen, and excitedly shared her experiences in Shaoxing and the gains along the way, chatting for over ten minutes.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Journal organization and writing plan
description: Turn on the desk lamp and sit at the desk, pressing the fallen leaves brought back from Baicaoyuan into the book 'My Heart Belongs to Dunhuang'. Carefully copy the essay opening written while waiting for the flight at the airport into the writing planning section of the journal, and write a brief plan after it: '5.12-5.15 Complete the first draft of "The Rebirth of From Baicaoyuan to Sanwei Study" and contact Editor Xu to pitch the column.'
location: Home bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Reading and bedtime preparation
description: Sitting at the edge of the bed, she flipped through a few pages of Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk and felt a sense of peace. Then she washed up, changed into comfortable pajamas, and got ready for sleep.
location: Home bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After getting into bed, she opened 'Life Monthly' and read two articles. Then she turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on. Closing her eyes, she recalled the morning mist over West Lake, the foot of the mud wall in Hundred-Plant Garden, and the warmth of seeing her parents, and fell asleep peacefully with a smile.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: The sunlight outside the window was just right, streaming in through the light green curtains. Yuwei woke up naturally and felt the reassurance of being home. She drank some warm water and did a few simple stretches in bed. After washing up, she found that her mother had already gone to work, but had left a note and rose flower cakes. She made a cup of hot milk, heated the flower cakes in the microwave, and sat leisurely at the dining table, browsing through the audio she had recorded in Shaoxing yesterday, feeling as if she were still in the lingering charm of Jiangnan.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organize travel photos and audio materials
description: She opened her laptop, imported the photos from her camera and phone, and created three clearly organized folders: 'Hangzhou West Lake,' 'Xiaoshu Library,' and 'Shaoxing.' Then she put on headphones and used Audacity to edit the sound of the oars of a black-canopied boat and the birdsong she had recorded in Shaoxing the night before. She carefully removed noise, adjusted the volume balance, and finally saved two high-quality audio files of about 3 minutes each, named 'Shaoxing Oars' and 'Shaoxing Birdsong.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Published a Xiaohongshu summary post and a yoga compilation.
description: She opened a photo-editing app and selected 6 photos from the six-day trip: morning mist over West Lake, a window at Xiaoshu Library, a close-up of a black-awning boat, the mud wall base at Hundred-Plant Garden, the Phoenix Hairpin Stele at Shen Garden, and a yoga back view by West Lake. Using a preset template, she arranged them into a nine-grid collage and wrote an empathetic caption that looked back on the trip as a resonance between literature and landscape. She specifically mentioned how moved she was when touching the mud wall at Hundred-Plant Garden in Shaoxing, and included a link to her newly edited audio. After posting, a fan commented that it felt like watching a flowing prose poem, which gave her a small sense of accomplishment.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and short break.
description: She opened the fridge; her mother had prepared cooked rice noodles, pickled vegetables, chives, and minced pork. She skillfully cooked an authentic pot of Kunming small-pot rice noodles, sour and spicy to whet the appetite. After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes and divided the Longjing tea she had brought back yesterday into three small packages, tying them with twine in kraft paper bags, ready to give to Uncle Qin and her close friends.
location: Kitchen/living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Go to Ping'an Graphic Printing Shop to print photos
description: She put on her canvas bag, slipped her phone and a pack of Longjing tea into it, and walked about 7 minutes to the printing shop in the mall she often went to. She sent 25 carefully selected high-quality travel photos from her computer to the staff via a USB drive and asked to print them as 6-inch glossy photos. During the 10-minute wait, she browsed the store's newly arrived tape and sticker supplies and couldn't resist buying two rolls of washi tape.
location: Ping'an Graphics, No. 107 Luofeng Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Visit Zhibushi Bookstore and give Longjing tea as a gift.
description: She walked about 11 minutes to the familiar Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, holding the printed photos and gifts. The store was very quiet; Uncle Qin was patrolling the shelves. She walked up, took the pack of pre-Qingming Longjing tea from her canvas bag, and said with a smile, “Uncle Qin, I brought this back for you from Hangzhou yesterday. Have a taste.” Uncle Qin took it with surprise and delight, and the two chatted about what she had seen on the trip. She looked around the bookstore and ended up buying a copy of Chinese National Geography's Jiangnan Special Issue and a retro-cover Traveler's Notebook insert as extra materials for her journal.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Making a Jiangnan travel journal
description: After returning home, she spread out her TN journal, laying out in a row the photos she had just printed, the ticket stubs from Shaoxing's scenic spots, the bookmark from Xiaoshu Library, the washi sticker Fang Qing had given her, and a fallen leaf from Hundred-Plant Garden that had been tucked in a book. She first glued on the ticket stubs and used watercolor pens to draw the waves of West Lake; on the right-hand page, she wrote neatly in pen, 'The moss at the foot of the wall of Hundred-Plant Garden heard the echoes of childhood,' and pasted on the leaf and the washi sticker. Throughout the process she was completely absorbed, as if reliving the trip.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Hatha Precision Alignment Class at the Yoga Studio
description: She changed into her yoga clothes, brought her own mat and water bottle, and walked about 16 minutes to Zhongmu Yoga Studio. Today she had booked a "Hatha Precision Alignment" class led by teacher He Lu. To soothing music, she effectively relieved the shoulder and back stiffness caused by prolonged sitting during travel through a 20-minute vinyasa flow and a 15-minute deep stretch. After class, she had a brief chat with He Lu and thanked her for the video she had recommended earlier.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Purchasing fruit and beverages on the way home
description: After yoga, she felt relaxed in body and mind. She walked home, stopping by the 'City Garden Supermarket' near her home to buy a box of fresh blueberries and a bottle of imported sparkling water, preparing for the evening's family sharing session.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Her parents came home from work one after another. Seeing the blueberries on the table, her mother smiled and said that her daughter was thoughtful. Dinner was braised beef, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and hot soup made by her mother. At the table, Yuwei casually talked about what she had seen at the bookstore and how relaxing the yoga class was. Her father asked about the gains from her trip. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing travel stories with the family on the projector
description: After dinner, the family of three sat together on the sofa. Yuwei connected her phone to the TV and played the travel photos she had taken with her camera last time and the edited Shaoxing Oar Sounds audio. As she played them, she vividly recounted the feeling of touching the mud wall in Hundred-Plant Garden and the awe of looking out the window at Dawn Study. Her father was full of praise for the panoramic view of West Lake, and her mother was particularly interested in the story of Shen Garden, remarking, "You've been sensitive to these literary scenes since you were little; now we're traveling through your eyes."
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Household tidying and replenishing consumables.
description: She helped her mother clear the dishes, sorted the empty laundry detergent bottles and express delivery boxes, and prepared them for her mother to give to the recycling auntie the next day. Her mother praised her for being sensible, and she smiled, "Getting out and about really does make you more independent."
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: She lay on the bed in her bedroom and video-called her older sister in Shenzhen. The two chatted enthusiastically. Yuwei shared today's itinerary and the details of her journal creation, and showed her sister a photo of the Longjing tea she had saved for her. Her sister, in turn, asked about her trip to Hangzhou and shared news of a “City Green” art exhibition recently held in Shenzhen, encouraging her to visit if she had time. They agreed that when Yuwei came for her graduation trip, her sister would take leave to accompany her throughout.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Personal browsing inspiration and pre-bed preparation.
description: She returned to the bedroom, half-leaning against the headboard, and flipped through the Jiangnan Special Issue she had bought today, deeply drawn to an article about the new lifestyle in Shaoxing’s water towns. Then she opened her phone memo and carefully recorded a few essay keywords that had emerged during her journal creation: “the sound of oars,” “the sound of wooden doors,” and “the reflections of stone arch bridges.” After that, she went to the bathroom to wash up and do her daily skincare routine.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and relaxation
description: She picked up the copy of Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk beside her pillow and turned to the essay “From Hundred Herbs Garden to Three-Flavour Study.” Combining the memories of her firsthand visit a few days earlier, she recreated the scenes in her mind as she read, feeling a deeper resonance. After reading for 30 minutes, she took off her glasses and rubbed her eyes.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Record mood and bedtime
description: She gently closed the book, took out her small notebook, drew a little star, and wrote “contentment” next to it. She turned off the main light, leaving a warm yellow reading lamp on. Lying in the soft bed, she thought about the journal she had pasted during the day and her parents’ smiling faces, and with a full sense of ease and calm, she fell asleep peacefully before 22:30.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretch
description: At 7:28 in the morning, the phone alarm rang, and Sun Yuwei woke up. She spread out her yoga mat beside the bedroom bay window and spent 10 minutes doing gentle stretches from her neck to her ankles one by one. The fatigue from returning from the Hangzhou trip yesterday gradually faded with the soft movements. She felt her shoulders were more flexible than yesterday, which opened up her body for today's creative activities.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and casual chat with family.
description: Mother Li Xiulan had already cooked steaming hot small-pot chicken soup rice noodles in the kitchen, served with fresh mint and pickled vegetables. As she ate, Sun Yuwei chatted with her parents about the West Lake photos she had pasted in her journal last night. Her father asked about her impressions of the former residence in Shaoxing, and she excitedly talked about the moss and cicada shells at the base of the mud wall in Baicaoyuan. Her mother smiled and reminded her not to forget to collect her Mandarin certificate today.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidying up the desk and brewing tea
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to her study and spread the Jiangnan special issue of Chinese National Geography and her travel notes, which she had brought back from Zhibushi Bookstore yesterday, on the desk, and opened the audio file of the black-awning boat oars recorded during the trip on the computer for later use. Then she went to the kitchen to brew a cup of jasmine tea that her mother had just bought, ready to start her focused creative morning.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Focused on composing the essay The Shadow of Lake and Mountain.
description: On the desk lay the keywords from her memo and the sketches from her journal. Sun Yuwei put on her headphones, looped the recording of water and birdsong she had made at West Lake, and began writing from the reflection of the Mid-Lake Pavilion in her memory. She deliberately broke with her previous writing style, trying to depict with finer strokes the clarity that Jiangnan’s misty rain brought. During breaks, she occasionally paused to sip jasmine tea and leafed through the passage describing the Hundred-Plant Garden in Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk to get a feel for the language. After more than three hours of continuous writing, she saved the document and read it through, feeling that her writing had achieved a breakthrough and the first draft had begun to take shape.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and rest
description: Sun Yuwei fried two slices of bacon and an egg by herself and made a simple sandwich with toast. Her mother had gone out to buy groceries, and her father was watching TV in the living room. She ate alone in the dining room while browsing several cultural essay articles on a WeChat public account on her phone, letting her mind rest.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sign for receipt of the Putonghua Proficiency Test certificate
description: The doorbell rang, and the long-awaited express delivery arrived. Sun Yuwei signed and received the document envelope, went back to her study, and carefully opened it with a utility knife. When she saw the score report showing 'Level 2A' and scores close to 'Level 1B' in reading aloud and speaking, a feeling of gratification rose in her heart. She took photos of the certificate and the waybill as keepsakes.
location: At the doorstep of the residence and in the study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing the joy of getting the certificate in the family group
description: Sun Yuwei edited the photo of the certificate, added the caption 'Got it!' and posted it to the family WeChat group named 'Sun Family's Little Nest.' Her mother replied instantly: 'Awesome! Now you'll have even more confidence for making cultural programs.' Her elder sister Sun Yutong, far away in Shenzhen, then sent three thumbs-up emojis and teased, 'From now on, your Mandarin will be much more standard than your big sister's.' Yuwei smiled and replied a few lines in the group, and the whole family shared in the joy.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday walk and supermarket shopping
description: Sun Yuwei put on a light jacket and went out for some fresh air. She walked south along Huashan West Road for about 12 minutes and arrived at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. As planned, she bought the blueberries needed for Mother's Day at home, her favorite sparkling water, and two bottles of yogurt. At the checkout, she saw freshly stocked lychees at the fruit stand and grabbed a small box on a whim, planning to enjoy them with tea in the afternoon.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Go home, boil water, and brew Longjing tea.
description: Sun Yuwei returned home with the purchased items and put the blueberries and sparkling water in the refrigerator. She took out the Longjing tea she had brought back from Hangzhou from the tea canister and brewed it in a glass. Outside the window, the sky was gradually darkening, just as the weather forecast had said. She felt a thrill of anticipation, ready to welcome the afternoon rain shower.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon: listening to the rain, savoring tea, and yoga.
description: Sure enough, a rain shower began outside the window, and raindrops pattered against the glass. Holding the cup of clear Longjing tea, Sun Yuwei leaned against the soft cushion on the study's bay window and listened quietly to the rain, her mind perfectly at peace. After finishing half a cup of tea, she spread her yoga mat on the open floor beside the bay window and, accompanied by soft music and the sound of rain, did a few extra gentle stretching and forward-folding twisting poses. Both body and mind felt stretched and relaxed, as if she had completed a rainy-day ritual.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, bay window and yoga mat in the home study

name: Record the day’s achievements and travel inspiration in a journal
description: As the rain gradually let up, Sun Yuwei sat down at her desk and took out her TN refill journal. First she wrote the date and weather with her fountain pen, then decorated the receipt record for the Mandarin Proficiency Certificate with simple drawings and washi tape. Next, she copied into the journal the flashes of inspiration—the sentences and feelings—she had captured while writing the essay “Shadows of Lakes and Mountains,” and beside them she stuck a small fallen-leaf bookmark brought back from the Hundred-Plant Garden. She felt that each day’s accomplishments had been neatly and properly put in place.
location: At the desk by the bay window in the study at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Planning the topic for the 'Kunming Slices' column
description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop and created a new document titled “Column Topic Proposal: 'Contemporary Young People's Cultural Root-Seeking'.” Drawing on thoughts from her trip to Shaoxing and the enthusiasm for root-seeking she observed among young people at Lu Xun's former residence, she began organizing her ideas. She considered incorporating arguments about cultural memory from the paper assigned by her mentor Wu Mingyuan, wrote down several potential interviewees, such as the president of the local Hanfu club and a history-and-culture enthusiast of Kunming's old streets, and thought about photo directions, such as the flagstone roads in Kunming's old streets and the wall of old photos in a modern café. After finishing the document, she planned to send it to editor Xu Mingyuan the next morning.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Share today's experiences in a group chat with besties
description: In the 'Iron Triangle' best-friend group chat, Sun Yuwei sent photos of listening to the rain and a Longjing tea cup, and shared the good news that the first draft of her essay was complete and her certificate had arrived. Zhang Jing teased her, saying 'today you're possessed by the god of literature.' Chen Sisi mentioned that the contemporary art exhibition she had been preparing at the art museum over the weekend was about to open and asked Yuwei if she wanted to come see it. Yuwei readily agreed and said she could arrange it for the weekend.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Help mother prepare dinner
description: Seeing her mother Li Xiulan preparing dinner in the kitchen, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to help pick beans and wash scallions. The mother and daughter chatted while working. Yuwei told her mother that she had received her Mandarin certificate today and that her prose writing was going smoothly. Her mother smiled and said, "Quite a harvest today. I'll add a plate of your favorite shredded chicken salad for dinner."
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: The mushroom soup at dinner was very delicious. During the meal, Sun Yuwei shared all of the day's gains: her satisfaction with the first draft of the essay, the surprise of the certificate, and the excitement of planning the column in the afternoon. Her father Sun Mingyuan encouraged her: “The path of writing requires a lot of perseverance. It's great that you can consistently turn your travel feelings into words.” Her mother Li Xiulan added: “The certificate is also very useful. Whether you become a teacher, a journalist, or work in cultural communication, it is a plus.”
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize journal and read Chinese National Geography's Jiangnan Special Issue
description: After a short rest following the meal, Sun Yuwei returned to her study. She first jotted down a few core ideas from the afternoon's column planning in her journal, refining the framework for the "Cultural Root-Seeking" topic. Then she opened the Jiangnan Special Issue of Chinese National Geography, focusing on the chapter about ancient villages in Huizhou, searching for more material on "cultural belonging" and doing homework for her column.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Discussed column topics with the editor online.
description: After organizing her thoughts, Sun Yuwei sent a long WeChat message to editor Xu Mingyuan, briefly outlining the column topic "Cultural Root-Seeking of Contemporary Young People" she had planned that afternoon and asking if he was interested. Xu Mingyuan quickly replied, saying the angle was novel and encouraged her to refine it into a complete plan that could be finalized next week. She felt very encouraged.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime Preparation and Reading Lu Xun’s Essays
description: Sun Yuwei changed into her pajamas, sat on the bed, and read the annotated version of 'From Hundred-Plant Garden to Three-Flavor Study' from 'The Complete Prose of Lu Xun', taking in the interpretations of different scholars. Then she trimmed a multi-headed lily at home and arranged it in a small clay pot by the bedside as that day's flower arrangement practice.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light. She adjusted her sleeping position, opened the meditation app, and followed the guided audio for a 15-minute body-scan meditation. Images of rain over West Lake, the greenery of the Hundred-Plant Garden, and the words she had written today surfaced in her mind, making her feel fulfilled and at peace.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read freely until falling asleep
description: After meditation, Sun Yuwei browsed for a while through an article in Life Monthly about craftspeople of time-honored brands. Feeling sleepy, she closed the book, turned off the light, and fell peacefully asleep to the sound of the pattering night rain.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning grooming and weight recording.
description: I got up early in the morning, washed up in the bedroom and bathroom, rinsed my face with warm water, then weighed myself and recorded 45.9 kg. Afterward I did shoulder and neck stretches in the living room, breathing fresh air and taking in the birdsong and morning light outside the window.
location: Home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom and bathroom).

name: Having breakfast with her parents
description: Sitting around the dining table with my parents, I enjoyed the crossing-the-bridge rice noodle breakfast my mother had prepared; the broth was clear and fragrant. While eating, we shared today's plans, and my father also joined the discussion about the afternoon's seasonal housework arrangements. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home (dining room), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the essay 'The Storyteller's Shaoxing'.
description: In the study, she focused on writing the essay 'The Storyteller's Shaoxing.' Using the folding fan and the black-awning boat model she had brought back from Shaoxing as inspiration, and playing the sound of oars from an awning boat in the background, she immersed herself in the writing. It took three hours to complete the first draft, after which she read it aloud and revised it twice, especially adjusting the rhythm of the ending. Finally, she saved the document with satisfaction and added notes for illustration inspiration.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Rest and reflection on inspiration
description: She went from the study to the living room, brewed a cup of Longjing tea, and took a short rest on the sofa. Opening her phone memo, she jotted down a few reading reflections about a novel set in Hangzhou that came to mind while writing, as well as a new idea for journal layout: using willow leaves as calendar markers.
location: Home (living room), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: At lunchtime, the family of three had a light lunch of tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried choy sum. While eating, they chatted. Sun Yuwei told her parents that the essay writing was going smoothly, and they agreed to start the seasonal housework at 1 p.m. Her father volunteered to take apart and clean the fan.
location: Home (dining room), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon reading and a short rest
description: After the meal, she went back to her bedroom, leaned against the headboard, and read a collection of Hangzhou short stories on her Kindle. One story about a Longjing tea farmer brought back memories of visiting tea gardens in Hangzhou. After reading two stories, she felt a little sleepy, closed her eyes, and rested for about 20 minutes, fully relaxing.
location: Home (bedroom), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: The Great Family Summer Transition.
description: The whole family worked together to switch over to summer items. Together with her mother, she carried summer quilts and bamboo blinds out of the storage room, took down the heavy curtains, and put up emerald-green bamboo blinds. Her mother cleaned the air conditioner filters, while her father disassembled and wiped down the floor fans. Then the family put away the winter cotton slippers and thick pajamas, and the home was outfitted with summer gear.
location: Home, 7 Huashan West Road, Green Lake Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (living room, bedroom, study, balcony, etc.)

name: Afternoon tea and journal preparation
description: After finishing the seasonal transition work, she returned to the study and brewed a cup of fresh Longjing tea. She took out her travel journal and the pressed dried leaves from Shen Garden, carefully secured the leaves, and prepared to finish the journal.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Completed the Jiangnan travel journal
description: She pasted the last postcards and attraction tickets from the trip into her journal in chronological order, and with her beloved brush and ink, wrote on the final page, 'To the Jiangnan we will one day return to,' completing the entire Jiangnan travel journal. Closing the book filled her with a sense of achievement.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Stroll and photography at Green Lake Park
description: She changed into sports shoes, brought her phone, and walked alone to Green Lake Park. In the early summer, the lotus flowers at Green Lake were in bud and the weeping willows swayed gently. She took photos of the scenery with her phone and sent them to her elder sister in Shenzhen, sharing the view of Kunming entering summer. After walking for about 20 minutes and enjoying the evening breeze, she strolled home.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner was the dry-fried green beans and cucumber salad my mother made. The family ate and talked about what we saw at Green Lake and how things felt after the season change, remarking that the house had gotten cooler. It was a warm, cozy atmosphere.
location: Home (dining room), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-meal rest and journaling
description: After dinner, I sat on the living room sofa, opened my journal, briefly recorded today's journaling and my mood about the changing seasons, and stuck in a willow leaf brought back from Cuihu Lake as a symbol. Then I scrolled on my phone to reply to messages from my best friend and roommate.
location: Home (living room), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare for video call
description: Return to the bedroom, change into a light gray pure cotton top, prepare the journal completed today, browse the Republic-era style family portrait outfit reference photos sent by my older sister, and think about the color scheme to discuss during the video call.
location: Home (bedroom), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Had a video call with my sister Sun Yutong, showed off today's completed journal, and received her praise. The two of us browsed Republic-era style outfit matching photos together, and finally chose a color scheme of lotus root purple and light gray. My sister decided to send samples to Kunming for a fitting before making the final decision.
location: Home (bedroom), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening wash-up and relaxation
description: After hanging up the video call, I washed my face with warm water and did my evening skincare routine, changed into loose pajamas, washed away the fatigue, and relaxed both body and mind.
location: Home (bathroom), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read a collection of Hangzhou short stories before bed.
description: Lying in bed, opened the Kindle and continued reading a collection of short stories set in Hangzhou; the story of a Longjing tea farmer evoked deep memories of visiting tea plantations in Hangzhou, as if I could smell the tea fragrance.
location: Home (on the bed in the bedroom), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and outlook
description: She put down her Kindle, sat cross-legged on the bed, and meditated for a few minutes with her eyes closed, reviewing the day's wonderful moments and feeling calm and joyful.
location: Home (on the bed in the bedroom), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Recording inspiration and preparing for sleep
description: Picked up her journal and quickly wrote down the scattered thoughts and sentences about the “Cultural Root-Seeking” column that had surfaced before bed, then closed the notebook, turned off the light, and got ready to sleep.
location: Home (on the bed in the bedroom), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: Put everything down, close your eyes, and quickly drift into a peaceful sleep.
location: Home (on the bed in the bedroom), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga
description: In the early morning, I practiced yoga on the bedroom balcony, starting with meditative breathing, completed three rounds of Sun Salutations, and did 15 minutes of stretching and relaxation focused on the shoulders and neck. The mint on the balcony gave off a cool scent, and birds sang in the distance.
location: Bedroom balcony at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and a chat with mother.
description: After washing up, she had breakfast with her mother, eating small-pot rice noodles and drinking homemade brown sugar pearl milk tea. Her mother reminded her to bring a jacket because of the temperature drop and suggested going to Zhuanxin Market on the weekend to buy porcini mushrooms.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Working in the study: replying to my advisor and revising my essays.
description: In the morning, I focused on work in my study. First, I looked at my advisor Professor Wu Mingyuan's suggestions on the defense PPT. He emphasized highlighting the originality of the fieldwork, using interview photos and quotes from independent bookstores. I recorded each point one by one, adjusted the framework, and sent a brief reply to my advisor. Next, I revised the essay 'The Shadow of Lake and Mountain,' cutting redundant metaphors according to editor Xu Mingyuan's comments and weaving in the human details from the Zhibushi Bookstore recording to make the article more concise. I worked at my desk until noon, then got up to water the mint on the balcony and do shoulder rolls.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and a short break
description: Lunch with my mother: tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried seasonal greens. She reminded me not to look at the screen while eating. After lunch, I looked through the Republic-era qipao sample photos my sister had sent, looking forward to the real thing.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and reading
description: After the meal, she browsed the magazine Southwest Customs and Scenery recommended by Uncle Qin in the study, carefully reading the report on old residential buildings in Jianshui. She jotted down keywords such as "spatial layout, oral history, adaptive reuse" as potential column topics. About half an hour later, she closed her eyes and rested for twenty minutes.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walked to Qianwang Street.
description: She changed into a light blue cotton-linen dress, slung a canvas bag and a journal over her shoulder, and walked from Cuihu Community to Mingyuan Bookstore on Qianwang Street. Passing through the south gate of Cuihu Park, with dappled light and shadow under the plane trees, she enjoyed the tiny commute from family chores to the world of books.
location: Passing the south gate of Green Lake Park, along the route from 7 Huashan West Road to 3 Qianwang Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bookstore Time
description: Arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore and talked with the owner, Qin Mingyuan (Uncle Qin). Uncle Qin shared the background of his reporting and field research on old residential houses in Jianshui, a topic that fit the main thread of contemporary young people's cultural root-seeking. Later, at a corner bookshelf, she found and bought a Republican-era album of old Kunming photographs, Old Images of Green Lake. As instructed by her mother, she bought a bunch of fresh eucalyptus leaves at the flower shop at the entrance of the alley.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 3 Qianwang Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home and prepare for shopping
description: After walking home from the bookstore, she placed Old Impressions of Green Lake on her desk, trimmed the eucalyptus branches, and put them into the blue ceramic vase in the living room. After a short rest, she changed into a light T-shirt and trousers, brought a reusable shopping bag and a thermos cup, and prepared for the evening grocery run.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family shopping at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market
description: Met my mother at the entrance of the residential area and took bus No. 65 to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. At a familiar stall, my mother selected green-headed mushrooms and porcini mushrooms, chatting with the stall owner about prices and cooking methods. Later she bought tender tofu, pea shoots, and scallions, preparing ingredients for a mushroom soup for dinner. The market was bustling, filled with a pre-weekend atmosphere.

After my father came home from work, the three of us had dinner together, enjoying mushroom soup, stir-fried pork slices with pea shoots, and cold cucumber salad. My father asked about the progress of my thesis, and I briefly explained the defense arrangements. The atmosphere was warm and reassuring.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Chatting online with my older sister

Her sister praised the color scheme and told her that the sample clothes for the family portrait she had mailed would arrive tomorrow, and they agreed to choose and match them together.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Write a column topic outline
description: Back in the study, based on the afternoon conversation with Uncle Qin, began drafting the preliminary outline for the second column piece from the perspective of "cultural heritage through architecture," divided into three chapters: the spatial layout of old houses, the residents in oral history, and contemporary revitalization and reuse. After finishing, sent Uncle Qin a message to share the direction.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime journaling and reading
description: After washing up, I opened my journal in the bedroom and used a blue gel pen to record today's keywords: yoga, morning mist, bookstore, Jianshui, mushrooms. I also pasted the receipt from Mingyuan Bookstore and old photos from Old Images of Green Lake into the journal. Then I leaned against the headboard and flipped through a newly bought picture album, feeling the atmosphere of Kunming in the last century from the yellowed images.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and Sleep
description: After closing the book, she felt intermittent soreness in her shoulders and neck. She put on earphones and followed a 15-minute guided meditation audio to relax her whole body from head to toe. When it was over, she turned off the desk lamp. In the darkness, she thought back on the fulfilling day, felt content, and her breathing gradually calmed as she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake up, weigh in, stretch on the balcony, and record inspirations.
description: After waking up naturally in the early morning, I sat quietly on the edge of the bed for a moment, feeling that the tightness in my shoulders and neck had eased compared with yesterday. Then I walked to the balcony and did some simple stretching for about 10 minutes in the morning light and breeze. Back inside, I weighed myself: 44.6 kg, the same as yesterday. I opened the memo app on my phone and quickly jotted down the fragment of Master Zhou's folk song that surfaced in last night's dream: "A sigh grown out of the soil."
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home bedroom and balcony)

name: Prepared and enjoyed a nutritious breakfast, and checked the delivery information.
description: After washing up, she heated a glass of milk in the kitchen, toasted two slices of whole wheat bread, and cut blueberries for breakfast. While eating, she checked Cainiao on her phone and confirmed that the package her sister had sent last night showed 'picked up' and was expected to arrive in a day or two. She then replied to her sister, saying that she would try on the samples and take photos as soon as they arrived.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Preparing materials for the journal-sharing meetup and watering the pothos.
description: After breakfast, I went to the study, opened my journaling tool box, and picked out a few photos of spring outings and vintage floral stickers for the afternoon sharing session. From the drawer, I took out the album "Old Scenes of Green Lake," turned to the "Wenlin Street" page, and used my phone to take several photos that captured the architectural details of old Kunming, planning to use them as collage inspiration. Then I sprayed water on the pothos on the windowsill, carefully checked the leaves, and trimmed off a yellowing leaf.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Brew tea and set up the video equipment.
description: While waiting for the water to boil, I wiped the dust off the desk with a damp cloth. After the water boiled, I brewed a cup of pre-Qingming Longjing tea in a glass; the tea leaves slowly unfurled in the water. Then I opened my laptop, logged into WeChat, and tested the camera and microphone to make sure the devices were working. At that moment, I saw Liu Jia in the dormitory group chat asking if everyone was ready.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Dormitory group video call
description: The video connected right on time, and I had a long-awaited online reunion with college roommates Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin. Zhao Xiaowen had gotten a bit tanned and excitedly shared her experience selling at a stall in Dali Old Town and swapping stories with backpackers; Zhou Lin talked about the nerve-wracking process of her thesis defense; Liu Jia vented about the anxiety of job hunting in her hometown. The four of us agreed to meet up again in Kunming after the graduation defense in June. We ended the call with a “cheers” gesture across the screen, full of laughter and anticipation for the future.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (in front of the desk in the home study)

name: After the video, rest and post to Moments
description: After the video call ended, I leaned back in my chair, sipped warm Longjing tea, and savored the conversation just now. From the screenshots, I chose one in which everyone was laughing happily and wrote as a caption: “I had a virtual meetup with my faraway sisters today. I listened to Xiaowen talk about the charms of Dali, and Zhou Lin share the nerve-racking moments of her defense. It felt like we were still in that little dorm by Green Lake. See you in June!” Then I clicked post.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Ate lunch and chatted with her mother
description: Mother made cold rice noodles with shredded chicken and specially added wild mushrooms and tender tofu bought at noon. During the meal, she took the initiative to bring up the afternoon journal-sharing session, telling her mother that Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi would both attend. Mother smiled and told her to have fun, added a spoonful of chili oil to her bowl, and reminded her not to catch a cold.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

description: After the meal, she leaned back on the living room sofa and opened the photo album Old Images of Green Lake. When she came to an old photo of the Fish-Viewing Tower at Green Lake from the 1940s, she found that it had changed a great deal compared with the present. She immediately jotted down keywords in her phone memo, including "Mid-Lake Pavilion," "Waterside Pavilion," and "People Watching Fish," as material for her next column. After reading for about half an hour, she felt drowsy, set an alarm for 13:30, leaned back on the sofa, and closed her eyes for a nap.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (living room sofa at home)

name: Changed clothes and walked to the café.
description: After the alarm went off, she returned to her room, changed into an off-white cotton-linen dress, put on her canvas bag, and carefully checked her journaling tool kit: scissors, tape divider board, release paper, stickers, and colored pens. After confirming nothing was missing, she grabbed her keys and phone and left. Walking along the tree-lined path for about 15 minutes, she passed through the south gate of Green Lake Park and arrived at Spring Dawn Café, No. 8 South Cuihu Road.
location: Walk from Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China, to Chunxiao Cafe, No. 8 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

The three each ordered a drink (Sun Yuwei ordered lime sparkling water) and then started their journal-sharing session. Zhang Jing showed off her newly purchased vintage floral washi tape, and Chen Sisi brought out handmade cloth-pulp paper and flower-pressed paper. Sun Yuwei then shared her “Wenlin Street” journal page, collaged with photos from the “Old Images of Green Lake” photo album, and explained her concept. The three exchanged stickers, chatted while creating, and each completed a collage full of “Old Images of Green Lake” vibes in a currently popular style, and they all felt very satisfied.
location: Chunxiao Café (large table by the window), No. 8 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

The lake was very peaceful in the evening, the sunset afterglow gilding the water, with several black-headed gulls gliding on the surface. I used my phone to photograph the backlit silhouette of the pavilion at the center of the lake and the reflections of distant high-rises in the water, feeling especially content. Then I continued walking home.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (took photos along the way and then returned to Cuihu Community)

While working, she shared interesting stories from the afternoon's journal-sharing session and showed her mother photos of the collage works made with Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi. Her mother praised her for making them look nice and asked whether this hobby was expensive. Sun Yuwei smiled and explained that many materials could be made by herself, and that the fun lay in the process.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home kitchen)

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was stir-fried snow peas, garlic lettuce, braised crucian carp, and tomato and egg soup, all made by her mother. Her father asked about the progress of the graduation defense PPT. Sun Yuwei told him the framework was ready and she would find time tomorrow to fill in the content. Her father also shared a lecture he had heard at the cultural center that day about the preservation of old houses in Jianshui. She found it very interesting and carefully noted down a few key terms.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Resting after the meal and enjoying fruit.

I peeled a few longans, ate a dozen or so blueberries, and drank a cup of chrysanthemum goji tea. I felt very comfortable, and the fatigue accumulated during the day dissipated considerably.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (living room sofa at home)

name: Organized the interview recording and extracted folk song clips.
description: Closing the study door, I poured myself a glass of warm water, put on earphones, and opened the interview audio of Master Zhou on the computer. After listening intently for about half an hour, I finally found the folk song he had hummed while talking about driving rafts on Dianchi Lake in his youth. My heart raced. I listened to it three more times, confirmed the lyrics, wrote them down, and marked the timestamp.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (in front of the desk in the home study)

name: Writing the draft for the second column article.
description: Her inspiration was ignited. Using the lyrics she had just recorded, she opened a document and started writing. Beginning with "In Master Zhou's singing, there is no technique—only the power of a river rushing down from upstream..." she wrote the draft of her second column in one go. The writing process was extremely smooth, and every cell in her body was jumping with excitement.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (in front of the desk in the home study)

name: Make tonight's journal entry.
description: After finishing the draft, paste the 'Wenlin Street' collage page created at the afternoon sharing session into a newly opened weekly journal. In the blank space beside it, write the reflection with a blue-green pen: 'The old man's singing is like a healing medicine, curing the restlessness of modern people.' Then draw a small musical note in the corner, representing the folk song that touched me.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (in front of the desk in the home study)

name: Washing up, skincare, and meditation before bed
description: She put down the journal and began washing up. After cleansing her face with a gentle facial cleanser, she patted on toner, essence, and lotion in turn. After her skincare routine, she turned off the main light and lit a lavender-scented aromatherapy candle at the bedside. Then she sat cross-legged on the bed and followed a phone app's guidance for a 10-minute bedtime meditation, focusing on her breath to let the nerves that had been tense all day relax.
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Bedtime reading
description: After meditation, my whole body relaxed. I picked up Chinese National Geography from the bedside table and flipped to an article about the water systems and farming stories of the Hani Rice Terraces in Yunnan. It was very relaxing to read. After about 20 minutes, my eyes felt a bit sore, so I closed the book and turned off the bedside lamp.
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China (at home, on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Fell asleep after confirming tomorrow's plan.
description: In the dark, I picked up my phone and glanced at tomorrow's calendar reminder; there were no hard commitments. I sent my mother a 'good night' message, then turned off my phone and placed it on the charging pad. Turning over, I listened to the chirping of insects outside the window, with Master Zhou's mountain song melody still lingering in my mind. My breathing gradually became steady and long, and I finally fell asleep around 23:30, a little earlier than planned, in a very good mental state.
location: Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China (at home, on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Morning journal and breakfast
description: Waking naturally in the early morning, the sky outside the window turned from clear to cloudy, and sunlight sprinkled onto the desk through the pothos. After doing simple stretches in bed, she felt energetic and weighed 44.7 kilograms. Using her journal, she quickly recorded the lingering inspiration from finishing the second draft of her column the night before and today's plans: accompanying her father to the library, making the defense PPT, and relieving shoulder and neck tension. Then she washed up briefly, poured a glass of warm honey water in the kitchen, ate a slice of whole wheat toast and a few blueberries, without disturbing her mother who was still resting, ready to make efficient use of the morning library trip.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk with her father to the library.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan had already packed the books to return and was watching the morning news in the living room. Yuwei put on her canvas bag containing a laptop and notebooks, and left the house with her father. The father and daughter walked to the Wuhua District Library. On the way, Yuwei took the initiative to ask about the lecture on old Jianshui houses that her father had mentioned at dinner the day before yesterday. Her father recalled the folk-culture expert's detail at the lecture about how the old houses' courtyards and winding corridors were natural resonance chambers, making the sound of folk songs particularly beautiful. This material made Yuwei's eyes light up, and she repeatedly said it was terrific.
location: On the way from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Wuhua District Library, Kunming (No. 114 Dongsi Street, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province)

name: Library material search and borrowing.
description: After arriving at Wuhua District Library, her father went to the periodicals room on the second floor to read newspapers, while Yuwei headed straight to the Local Documents Room on the third floor. Guided by the librarian, she first found The History of Yunnan Folk Music Collection and discovered that an entire chapter introduced the Haicai-style singing of the Yi people in central Yunnan, perfectly matching the theme of the third column piece. Later, she consulted back issues in the periodicals room and luckily found the 1987 bound volume of Southwest Folkways magazine. Its documentary report on the teahouses and folk artists on Wenlin Street in Kunming provided solid material for the sound comparison of Wenlin Street. She photographed the key pages to save, and completed the borrowing process for The History of Yunnan Folk Music Collection.
location: Kunming Wuhua District Library, No. 114 Dongsi Street, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Share what she gained with her father and walk back.
description: Yuwei found her father, who had just finished reading the newspaper, in the library lobby. She excitedly shared the joy of finding an old issue of “Southwest Folkways” and said she could show him the article about the teahouse on Wenlin Street tonight. Her father smiled and said his Jianshui lecture notes could be a reference for her. The two chatted about everyday things under the ginkgo tree in front of the library, then walked back home the same way they came.
location: On the road from Wuhua District Library, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Organizing materials and planning the PPT.
description: Back in her home study, she imported the dozens of pages of reference photos taken at the library that morning into her computer, categorizing and naming them by theme such as analysis of haicaiqiang singing and the history of teahouses on Wenlin Street. She made a cup of green tea, opened “A History of Yunnan Folk Music Collection” and read it carefully, jotting down a few new ideas and quotations in her journal, fully preparing herself to make the thesis defense PPT in the afternoon.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Have lunch with the family.
description: Mother Li Xiulan made Yuwei's favorite stir-fried wild mushrooms with green peppers and tender tofu soup. At the dinner table, Yuwei shared her morning discovery at the library, and the family chatted happily. When her mother heard that she was making a PPT about the sounds of Kunming's streets, she suggested recording the vendor calls at the morning market near home, saying that was the most authentic sound of old Kunming. Yuwei felt the idea was full of the flavor of everyday life.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and PPT structure planning
description: After dinner, she didn't start working right away. She returned to the bedroom, lay on the bed, and rested with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes. Then she opened the Keynote app on her phone and created a new project, first adding the photos she took during fieldwork (Master Zhou's old courtyard, a corner of Mingyuan Bookstore, and the market auntie) and the compiled outline of interviewee quotes. She then set the afternoon's workflow along a timeline of 'fieldwork tidbits - sound memories - academic reflections'.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focused on creating and refining the defense PPT.
description: In the afternoon, she put on noise-canceling headphones, played a white noise playlist, and focused on making the Keynote. She arranged materials such as the audio clip of Master Zhou singing folk songs, the photos of Uncle Qin's bookstore, and the portrait of the market auntie into the corresponding timeline nodes one by one, paying special attention to the originality emphasized by her advisor and adding a short text explanation under each page of field material. Every so often she stood up and looked into the distance to relax. Afterward, she inserted the screenshots she had taken at the library that morning of the report on Wenlin Street teahouses from Southwest Customs and the discussion of Haicai tune from A History of Yunnan Folk Music Collection into the relevant chapters as visual material to support her points on the sound comparison of Wenlin Street and the relationship between music and space. The PPT was beginning to take shape, and she felt a mix of fatigue and accomplishment.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shoulder and neck pain care and rehabilitation exercises
description: After working hunched over my desk for a long stretch, my shoulders and neck began to protest. A sudden sharp pain shot through my left shoulder blade, and my whole shoulder felt stiff. I stopped right away and applied a hot water bottle to my left shoulder and neck for 15 minutes. Then I opened the '15-Minute Shoulder and Neck Relaxation' video saved in my Bilibili collection and followed along with the full neck rehabilitation yoga routine. I slowed down the movements and focused on poses like 'lateral neck flexion' and 'chin tuck,' and the stiff muscles gradually loosened through slow stretching. After finishing, I drank a large glass of warm water and felt my whole body much more relaxed and stretched out.
location: Yoga mat in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Sunset stroll and capturing inspiration at Green Lake Park.
description: I changed into the linen-blend wide-leg pants and white T-shirt I bought last Friday, grabbed my phone and canvas bag, and headed to Cuihu Park for a walk, using the time to adjust my ideas for revising the draft. The light in the park was soft in the early evening. I walked along the lakeside path for half an hour, feeling the breeze off the lake. The golden sunset shining on the water was incredibly beautiful, so I took a few photos to send to my sister in Shenzhen. While walking, I kept thinking about how to revise the ending of "Morning Haze on Wenlin Street." I juxtaposed the historical report about the teahouse I found in the library, the inspiration from my conversation with my father about the resonance of the courtyard, and the cries of vendors at the Wenlin Street morning market to create a time-and-space-crossing "sound montage" effect. An idea for a more powerful ending gradually became clear. After the walk, I walked home in a good mood and bought a box of blueberries at the fruit stall at the entrance of the neighborhood as an after-dinner snack.
location: Cuihu Park, 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the route to and from

name: Have dinner with the family
description: Mother made a clear-soup hot pot, and the family sat around cooking vegetables and sliced meat in it. At the table, Yuwei shared the progress on the PPT she had made that afternoon and the sunset by Cuihu Lake, and formally asked her father to borrow his Jianshui lecture notes. Her father readily agreed and fetched them for her from the study after dinner.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reply to the editor's manuscript reminder and polish the column article
description: After dinner, she received a WeChat message from editor Xu Mingyuan asking about the progress of revisions to "Morning Smoke on Wenlin Street". Yuwei replied calmly: "Editor Xu, I'll send it to you before Wednesday. Today I found some excellent material in the library and had a new idea for the ending. I'm halfway through the revisions, and the final version will have more depth." Then she opened the lecture notes her father had given her, and combining today's new material with inspiration from the park, she opened the draft under revision on the computer in her study and naturally incorporated into the ending the contrast between "erhu music from the teahouse vs. the cries of the morning market" and the detail of "the residential courtyard as a natural sound field". The article immediately gained a sense of depth. She polished it word by word until she was satisfied, saved the revised version, and turned off the computer.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and wrap-up.
description: Took out today's journal, used the new little musical-note stickers to decorate the page beside the folk-song inspiration notes, and wrote down in detail the key points from Southwest Scenery and Customs found in the library, as well as a summary of the conversation with my father about Jianshui architecture. I used a fountain pen to add simple drawings of an open book and an erhu, and finally stuck in the sunset photo taken at Green Lake in the afternoon. Looking at such a full harvest, I felt very grounded.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up, skincare, and pre-bedtime relaxation.
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up, washed her face with warm water, and applied basic skincare products. Returned to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, lay down on the bed, opened the Tide app and played a 'body scan' style guided mindfulness meditation, focusing on feeling every inch of relaxation from toes to the top of the head.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After the meditation ended, drowsiness set in. I turned off the desk lamp and lay down in the dark. Memories of the whole fulfilling day quickly flashed through my mind—the scent of books in the library, my father's advice, the lake view in the evening, the editor's reminders about the deadline, and the satisfying revision. Although my shoulders were still a little sore, my plan was clear, and my drowsiness grew. Before the preset bedtime, I closed my eyes and fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and stretching
description: Woke up to the sound of rain; weight 44.4 kg. Because of sore shoulders and neck, I spread out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of neck rehabilitation yoga and full-body stretching. Afterward, I checked the electronic metro card and the headphone battery; everything was ready.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out.

After eating, she changed into a cotton-linen jacket and jeans, and put the graduate registration form, degree application, campus card, History of Yunnan Folk Music Collection, and other items into her canvas bag. At 8:20, she left with an umbrella and walked to Jiaosanqiao Metro Station.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Metro commute and material warm-up

Found a seat on the metro, put on earphones, and looped the recorded interview with Master Zhou, focusing on identifying the grace notes and ending treatment in the Horse Driving Tune, while marking the rhythm changes in the phone memo. After about 55 minutes, got off at University Town Station and walked to Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus.
location: From Jiaosanqiao Metro Station at the intersection of Renmin Middle Road and Qingnian Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to University Town Metro Station (Line 2), Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

After checking, the teacher said the materials were fine and that the defense is scheduled for 8:30 a.m. on June 3 in the third-floor conference room of the school; arrive 15 minutes early.
location: Academic Affairs Office, 2nd Floor, Office Building of the School of Humanities, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Ran into my advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan
