After looking at the PPT screenshots together, the professor pointed out that the logical order needed adjustment and suggested practicing in advance.
location: Corridor on the third floor of the Humanities College Office Building, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Campus walk and lunch

I took a sandwich and hot tea out of my canvas bag, and ate while reminiscing about my college days, cherishing the tranquility of being a current student.
location: Ginkgo Avenue and the lakeside bench at Ze Lake, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and midday rest
description: Walked to University Town metro station and took the metro back, resting her eyes and relaxing her neck and shoulders on the train. Lying on the bed for a nap, listening to the rain, her body gradually relaxed and the soreness in her neck and shoulders melted away.
location: University Town Metro Station, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (via Line 2)

name: Confirming HPV vaccine and writing preparation

After finishing the tea, she returned to her study, opened her laptop, and combined the inspiration from 'Green Lake in the Fog' with the idea of 'leaving blank space' to frame her column 'Fogbound Green Lake: Whispers of a Kunming Morning': the first part would describe how the fog visually blurred the boundaries of Green Lake, the second part would deal with the silence and details of sound, and the third part would explore the contemplation that blurriness brings amid urban noise. She wrote an outline and the first two paragraphs in one go, about 600 characters in total, and felt it flowed very smoothly.

She changed into pajamas, turned on only the night light in the bedroom, and sat cross-legged for 10 minutes of mindful breathing meditation to settle her thoughts. After meditation, she picked up “A History of Folk Music Collection in Yunnan” and leafed through it until drowsiness crept in.
location: At home: study and bedroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Falling asleep
description: She turned off the desk lamp and put her phone on the bedside table. Yuwei silently reviewed what she needed to do tomorrow morning, grateful for a fulfilling and peaceful day. The rain outside had long stopped; she closed her eyes peacefully in the quiet night and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and physical activation
description: At 7:30 in the morning, the phone alarm rang softly. Sun Yuwei turned it off, pulled open a corner of the curtain, and confirmed that the weather was sunny turning cloudy. Wearing loose pajamas, she completed a 15-minute neck recovery yoga routine on the mat beside the bed, focusing on stretching her trapezius and shoulder blade area, which had stiffened from desk work. After yoga, the soreness in her neck and shoulders was noticeably relieved, and her mind felt clear. Then she stepped on the scale, and the needle settled at 44.4 kg. She felt satisfied.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast, final draft finalization, and feedback confirmation
description: At 7:50, Sun Yuwei walked out of her bedroom. Her mother had already set a simple breakfast (hot milk, whole wheat toast, and a boiled egg) on the table. Nibbling on her toast, she opened Shimo Docs on her phone and gave 'Morning Bustle on Wenlin Street' one final read-through, checking word by word that the formatting, paragraphs, and punctuation were correct. At 8:25, she clicked the 'Send to Xu Mingyuan' button and sent the manuscript. Then she sent a WeChat message to her father: 'Dad, is the weekend exhibition on Saturday or Sunday? What time exactly should we go?' She got up, cleared the dishes, and returned to her study. Her phone soon vibrated. Editor Xu Mingyuan replied with a sticker saying 'Got it! Great!' and added, 'We'll do the typesetting next Monday. The payment will be sent as usual with next month's column. Thanks for your hard work!' She relaxed completely. Right after that, her father called and confirmed the plan: meet at 2 p.m. on Sunday at the entrance of the Wuhua District Cultural Center. Sun Yuwei casually noted the appointment in her phone's memo.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Going out, a stroll around Green Lake, and a book-hunting trip
description: At 9:10, Sun Yuwei changed into a comfortable cotton-linen dress, put on her off-white canvas tote bag, and placed her phone, keys, kraft paper notebook, pen, wallet, and foldable eco-friendly bag inside. She opened the door and went out, feeling happy. Instead of navigating directly, she deliberately took a small detour and walked about 3 minutes to enter Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park). After the rain, the air in the park was unusually fresh. She strolled along the lakeside path, saw elderly people doing morning exercise and toddlers learning to walk, and felt a peaceful happiness. After about 20 minutes of walking, she exited from the park's east gate, turned onto Wenlin Street, and after another 10 minutes' walk, arrived at 10:10 at her usual 'Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore'. She paused in front of the new-book recommendation stand, attracted by a simply bound copy of 'Ikebana: A Classic Introduction to the Ikenobo School'. Flipping through the table of contents, she found it was exactly what she needed, so without hesitation she took the book to the counter and paid.
location: Starting from home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, passing through Cuihu Park (Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province), to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore (No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province).

name: A treat after buying books at the bookstore.
description: After leaving the bookstore, Sun Yuwei was in a great mood and decided to treat herself. She walked into her familiar “Tea Talk House” on Wenlin Street and ordered a warm brown-sugar pearl milk tea with less sugar. With a book in one hand and the milk tea in the other, she happily took a photo on the street of the milk tea and the bookstore sign.
location: Chayan Guanshe, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip, lunch, and midday rest
description: At 11:15, Sun Yuwei walked back along Wenlin Street and arrived home at 11:35 after about 20 minutes on foot. She carefully placed the newly bought books on her desk. At noon, her mother was eating at the school cafeteria, so she was home alone. Using the fresh mushrooms and dried noodles in the refrigerator, she cooked herself a simple and delicious bowl of mushroom soup noodles. While eating, she replied to a few messages in her close friends' group chat on her phone. After eating, she washed the dishes and rested with her eyes closed on the living room sofa for 20 minutes as a short nap.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, and the return section of Wenlin Street

name: Ikebana creation and sharing with family.
description: At 12:45 p.m., Sun Yuwei officially began arranging flowers at home. She took out an old bamboo tube vase left by her mother from the back of the cabinet and rinsed the eucalyptus leaves and lisianthus she had bought online with warm water. She opened the newly purchased “The Way of Flowers” and carefully studied the chapter on the basic structure of “rikka.” She spent about 40 minutes trying to trim the branches and secure the main stem, giving the arrangement a staggered, upward-stretching posture. Although her technique was still a bit raw, the finished piece made her eyes light up with the combination of fresh green and gentle pinkish-white. At exactly 3:00 p.m., she took photos of her work as a memento, selected a few favorites, and sent them to the “Qiushi Building Sisters” close-friends group and the “Loving Family” family group, with the caption: “Today's rikka practice—I feel pretty good about myself!”
location: Balcony of the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping with household chores and interacting with family
description: At 3:45 pm, Sun Yuwei heard the sound of her mother opening the door with a key and immediately went up to greet her, proudly showing off her flower arrangement. Her mother’s eyes lit up and she praised her again and again: “Oh my, did you arrange this? It’s beautiful! Even more elegant than the ones you buy outside!” Seizing the moment, she suggested going to Dounan Flower Market on the weekend to buy more professional flower containers, and her mother readily agreed. Afterward, mother and daughter prepared fresh pea shoots and snow peas together in the kitchen, chatting about amusing stories from school and the workshop as they worked.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and evening check-in
description: When her father came home from work, he praised the flower arrangement on the dining table as soon as he entered. Dinner was her father's favorite: steamed scallops with garlic and vermicelli, stir-fried pea shoots, and tomato and egg soup. The family of three chatted while eating. Sun Yuwei told her father that she and her mother had finalized the plan to go to Dounan on the weekend. Her father smiled and said, 'As long as you two have fun, I'll just stay home and read.' The dinner atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling, online socializing, and ikebana study
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to clear the dishes. At 19:15, she returned to the study, opened a new journal, recorded the day's events, wrote down in detail the steps and insights of flower arranging, and pasted in printed sample photos of the arrangement. Then she opened WeChat, saw the compliments on her flower arrangement photos in the best friends' group and the family group, and replied to each one. She made a video call to her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, held up her phone to the flower arrangement, and excitedly shared the joy of finding a treasure of a book and succeeding in flower arranging. They talked for half an hour, and her sister also recommended several Shenzhen flower shop accounts. After ending the video call, still not satisfied, she picked up the book she had bought in the afternoon, turned to the chapter about difficulties encountered in flower arranging, took notes with a fountain pen, and used a highlighter to mark key points such as 'the flower's tilt angle should not exceed 45 degrees', immersed in the joy of knowledge until 21:30.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bed washing, meditation, reading, and falling asleep
description: At 21:30, Sun Yuwei got up and went to the bathroom to wash up and carefully complete her evening skincare routine. After changing into pajamas, she returned to the bedroom, turned off the main light, and left only the night light on. Sitting on the edge of the bed, she opened the meditation app and selected a 10-minute 'body scan' meditation course. Following the guidance, she moved her attention from her toes to the top of her head, letting her tense nerves fully relax. After the meditation, she felt peaceful inside. She picked up the new book 'The Way of Flowers' beside her bed and read a few pages introducing flower containers and tools. At 23:15, she closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, pulled up the covers, and with a full and complete sense of satisfaction, quickly fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Sun Yuwei woke up naturally in the relaxed vibe of Saturday, with sunlight spilling onto the floor through the gaps in the curtains. She recalled the chapter on 'Nageire' from The Way of Flowers she had read last night, and felt delighted. While brushing her teeth, she marked 'remember to buy red meat to eat today' in her phone memo to prevent anemia. After washing up, she carefully applied sunscreen, put on a light blue cotton-linen dress, and got ready for a full day.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoying breakfast with her mother
description: Sun Yuwei walked into the dining room, where her mother, Li Xiulan, had already cooked a steaming pot of clay-pot rice noodles and specially added two more slices of braised beef, telling her to keep up her nutrition. Mother and daughter ate and chatted. Sun Yuwei excitedly shared amusing episodes from flower arranging last night, while her mother smiled and reminded her to remember to negotiate the price of flower containers when she went to the flower market later.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking the subway to Dounan Flower Market
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother each carried a canvas bag and walked from home to Wuyi Road Metro Station. After getting on Line 2, Sun Yuwei wore earphones and listened to a podcast about "Urban Memory", while her mother scrolled through videos on her phone about flower care tips. The train changed to Line 1 at Huancheng South Road Station and continued toward Dounan Station. The city scene flashed by outside the window as the two of them looked forward to their trip.
location: Kunming Metro Line 2, Yunnan Province (from Wuyi Road Station to Huancheng South Road Station), then transfer to Metro Line 1 (from Huancheng South Road Station to Dounan Station)

name: In-depth shopping and experience at Dounan Flower Market
description: After arriving at Dounan Flower Market, the mother and daughter were immersed in an ocean of flowers. Sun Yuwei went straight to the fresh-cut flower area to look for double-petal sunflowers. After comparing three stalls, she chose a bunch with full flower heads and thick stems; her mother helped bargain and paid, joking that it was a coming-of-age gift. They then went upstairs to bargain for a terracotta-colored wide-mouth vase. Sun Yuwei also bought a bundle of eucalyptus leaves and a bunch of pale purple baby's breath dried flowers on her own, spending more than 80 yuan in total. Before leaving, her mother bought a bowl of pea starch jelly from a food cart at the market entrance as a mid-trip break.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Dounan Subdistrict, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took the subway back home
description: On the metro ride back, Sun Yuwei carefully placed the flower container at her feet and held the sunflower bouquet in her arms. Mother and daughter chatted about what they had just seen. Her mother talked about the old days when she went to Dounan to buy flowers as a young woman, while Sun Yuwei shared her idea of writing a column piece titled "Dounan Morning." The two were full of warmth. After leaving the station, Sun Yuwei suggested stopping by the supermarket to buy some beef, and her mother readily agreed.
location: Kunming, Yunnan Province: Metro Line 1 (from Dounan Station to Huancheng South Road Station), transfer to Metro Line 2 (from Huancheng South Road Station to Wuyi Road Station)

name: Simple lunch and flower material preparation.
description: Back home, her parents had already prepared lunch, and according to Sun Yuwei's reminder, the dishes included tomato-braised beef brisket. She quickly ate a few mouthfuls of rice, then couldn't wait to take out the newly bought flower materials. On the balcony, she cut the roots of eucalyptus leaves and sunflowers diagonally at 45 degrees and soaked them in water for care, then tied the dried gypsophila into a bunch and hung it upside down on the drying rack to air-dry for shaping. The sunlight fell on the bouquet, very beautiful.
location: Living room and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap and meditation
description: Sun Yuwei lay on the bed in her bedroom, listening to the faint city sounds outside the window. She opened the meditation app on her phone and did a 20-minute 'Relaxation Meditation' session. She focused on her breathing, relaxing her shoulders and neck, which had become tense from getting up early and wandering around. After the meditation, she felt much more refreshed, storing up energy for the afternoon's activities.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei took her satchel containing a notebook, pens, and the column manuscript, and decided to walk to the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore in Kunming. She strolled along Green Lake Ring Road, with weeping willows by the lakeside and a moist breeze, feeling at ease. About 20 minutes later, she arrived at the bookstore on Green Lake North Road.
location: Cuihu Ring Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the way from home to Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore)

name: Attended the tea and book gathering 'Kunming Dialect and Urban Memory'
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at the bookstore early and helped the owner, Qin Mingyuan, set up the tables, chairs, and tea sets. After the tea-and-book gathering began, everyone sat in a circle and exchanged ideas. When it was Sun Yuwei's turn to share, she started with the onomatopoeic word “xīliū” from her column article Morning Cooking Smoke on Wenlin Street, describing the vivid scene of Kunming people eating steaming rice noodles, which sparked a lively discussion. Grandpa Zhang, who sings Dian opera, improvised a passage from Youchun (Spring Outing), and Professor Wang from Yunnan Normal University shared views on dialect and regional identity. Sun Yuwei took careful notes.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidying the ancient books bookshelf and discovering an old map.
description: After the tea book gathering ended, Sun Yuwei and Qin Mingyuan stayed in the shop to organize the ancient bookshelves. While pulling out a dusty cardboard box from the bottom, she touched the rough paper and opened it to find several old maps labeled 'Kunming City Street Map, 23rd Year of the Republic of China.' The two carefully unfolded them; on the yellowed paper, the old names of Zhengyi Road and Wenming Street, and the vanished Jinri Tower, were clearly visible. Sun Yuwei excitedly borrowed three from Qin Mingyuan to include as supplementary attachments for her graduation thesis. Qin Mingyuan readily agreed and reminded her to keep them away from moisture. Then they spent nearly an hour making an initial classification of the other materials in the box.
location: Ancient books shelf area, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home and buy ice cream on the way.
description: Sun Yuwei said goodbye to Qin Mingyuan and walked out of the bookstore holding the borrowed map in a document folder. The sky was still bright. She walked along the road to the corner of Wenlin Street, entered a familiar cold drink shop, and bought two of her favorite fresh milk crispy ice cream bars as a small reward for a fulfilling day. Eating the ice cream, she strolled slowly home, a gentle breeze brushing her face, feeling very pleasant.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province: from Cuihu North Road to the cold drink shop at the intersection of Wenlin Street and Cuihu North Road, and on the way home

name: Setting up the new flower vases and tidying the study.
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei put her backpack and the map on the desk. Then she carefully trimmed and arranged the sunflowers and eucalyptus leaves that had been soaking in water since morning, placed them in a terracotta-colored wide-mouth vase, adjusted the angle, and put it in the center of the living room coffee table. The room immediately gained a bright autumn feel. Then she returned to the bedroom, tidied the desk, and carefully spread out the map to study in the evening.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: at the living room coffee table and the bedroom desk

name: The whole family had dinner together and shared the day's amusing anecdotes
description: Dinner was abundant. Sun Yuwei talked animatedly about what she had seen and heard at the afternoon tea book club and the 'treasure' map she had found. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, was very interested in the map. He put on his reading glasses, examined it closely, and pointed out that the city gate tower was on what is now Jinbi Road. Her mother smiled, touched the sunflowers in the vase, and said the living room suddenly felt full of vitality. The whole family was warm and happy, enjoying the weekend evening.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Special topic research and note organization
description: Sun Yuwei put on her earphones and played light music. First, she used her phone to take high-definition photos of different details on three old maps, then turned on her computer and created a new folder called "Kunming Old Maps - Thesis Attachments." She organized the notes from the afternoon tea book club while referring to the street names on the maps, recording in detail the origins of dialect words like "xiliu" (slurp) and Professor Wang's interpretations, and made connections between them, adding detailed annotations for her graduation thesis.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of her home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Immersive journaling
description: Sun Yuwei took out her new journal and began recording today's experiences. She pasted the ticket from Dounan Flower Market into it with tape as a keepsake, and drew a sunflower beside it. She also cut out a map section from an old newspaper, creating a contrast between old and new with the Republic of China-era map she had found today. She carefully recorded the Yunnan opera rhyming speech she had heard at the afternoon tea book gathering and her excitement when she found the old map, and used dried flower materials to make a small decorative touch.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of her home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shared today’s experiences online with her roommate.
description: Sun Yuwei lay on the sofa and sent a WeChat voice message to her roommate Liu Jia. They talked about the map they discovered today, and Liu Jia said enviously that she wanted to go along next time. Sun Yuwei shared the dried flowers and flower containers she had bought at the flower market, and also sent Liu Jia a photo of part of the map. The two also recommended books they had been reading recently to each other. The more Sun Yuwei chatted, the more excited she became, and her voice unconsciously rose.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online chat)

name: Evening meditation and relaxation
description: Sun Yuwei dimmed the lights, sat cross-legged on the bed, and did a 15-minute pre-sleep meditation. She guided herself to release the excitement, joy, and novelty she had captured during the day one by one. After the meditation, she felt completely relaxed, and drowsiness gradually crept in.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read "The Way of Flowers" before bed
description: Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard, opened the book "The Way of Flowers" and turned to the chapter on "thrown-in flowers". The book's unconventional idea of casually tossing flowers and branches into a vessel reminded her of the sunflowers she had arranged. She read with great interest until drowsiness crept in, then closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep at around 00:45 the next morning.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Woke up and had a video call with her older sister.
description: I was woken by a video call from my sister Sun Yutong. In Shenzhen, she was complaining that summer had failed to arrive, wearing a short-sleeved shirt with the air conditioner on, longing for Kunming's year-round mildness. We chatted for nearly an hour, from her job at a major internet company to my thesis defense preparation, the conversation light and intimate. She said she would fly back to Kunming during the National Day holiday and promised to have a qipao tailored for me and take a family portrait together. After hanging up, I lay in bed savoring this longing that spans cities, feeling warm inside.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast: tofu pudding rice noodles
description: After washing up, I went to the dining room. My mother Li Xiulan heated up the leftover tofu pudding rice noodles from last night and served them with sliced braised beef. I mixed in homemade chili oil and crushed peanuts; it was savory, fragrant, and soft. Mother was washing scallions in the kitchen and reminded me of today's power outage time, telling me not to use the computer for too long.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Scan and organize old maps
description: In the study, she scanned three 1934 Kunming city street maps borrowed from Uncle Qin at Zhibushi Bookstore (including Luosiwan, outside Xiaoximen, etc.) using her phone. The paper was yellowed and the edges slightly worn. She took high-definition photos one by one and saved them as PDFs, naming files like '1934_Luosiwan.jpg', and created a new folder 'Thesis Attachments_Historical Maps'. While sorting them, her eyes lingered on the maps, imagining the waterfronts and streets of nearly a hundred years ago.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Revise the thesis defense draft and contact the advisor.
description: In the study, I opened my laptop to refine the defense presentation draft for five days later, weaving in newly discovered details such as Luosiwan being a former bay shore of Dianchi Lake and the area outside Xiaoximen having been a freight dock. While typing, I read silently, striving to give the thesis a humanistic warmth. Meanwhile, I sent a WeChat message to my advisor Wu Mingyuan to ask about predicting questions from the defense committee.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Clear broth hot pot lunch and family chat
description: Mother made a clear-soup hot pot with a generous handful of pea shoots and ham slices. We chatted as we ate. I shared the plan for my older sister to come back for National Day and have custom qipaos made for a family portrait. Mother smiled brightly and said she would wear a navy-blue qipao. I also mentioned the afternoon power outage arrangement, and Mother reminded me that the balcony chairs were already prepared. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare before the power outage and contact roommate Liu Jia
description: Using the half hour before the power outage, she sent a WeChat message to her roommate Liu Jia, inviting her to go to Zhibushi Bookstore next week to look at newly arrived local chronicles. Liu Jia replied instantly, thrilled. Then she got some water, picked up the book “The Way of Flowers” and a notebook, and went to the living room balcony to prepare for reading during the power outage.
location: Living room and balcony of home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading The Way of Flowers on the balcony during a power outage
description: The power was cut in the neighborhood on schedule. Sitting in a rattan chair on the balcony, I quickly browsed a Japanese flower arrangement book by natural light, drawn to “Ohara So”’s “thrown-in style,” and made pencil notes in the margins. I imagined going with my friend Su Man to the flower nursery by Green Lake to gather wildflowers and try a free-form thrown-in creation, and wrote the plan “Thrown-in style—Su Man—Green Lake flower nursery practice” in my notebook.
location: Balcony of the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing flower-arranging reflections
description: After reading, she opened her notebook at the small round table on the balcony and wrote down a few reflections on 'The Way of Flowers'. She recorded Xiaoyuan Cang's unique understanding of the relationship between flowers and space, as well as her inspired extensions about the 'thrown-in' style of arrangement, planning to use this as core material for next week's journal.
location: Balcony of the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After the call, tidying up and relaxing
description: The power came back and the home lit up again. I first went to the kitchen to help my mother pick the mushrooms for the evening meal, then returned to the bedroom, turned on the computer, and read through the revised defense draft from the afternoon once more, confirming that the logic flowed well and there were no typos, and gradually relaxed.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room and bedroom

name: Mushroom soup dinner and family conversation
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work. Dinner was a mushroom soup my mother had newly learned to make, using porcini and Brazilian mushrooms; the aroma was rich, and she said it was specifically to supplement my iron. The three of us chatted about my sister's National Day plans and the details of my thesis defense preparation, and the atmosphere was warm and peaceful. I shared what I'd discovered while reading on the balcony and said I wanted to learn a new flower arrangement style, and my father asked for details.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watching a documentary about Kunming's old town
description: After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes and curled up on the living room sofa, using the iPad to cast and play the saved documentary “The Vanishing City Gate Towers.” In the black-and-white footage, the arches and bluestone-paved roads of the old city gate towers echoed the vanished waterfront lines such as Luosi Bay described in her thesis. She watched while jotting down film details related to the thesis in her phone memos.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wash up before bed
description: After the documentary ended, I returned to the bathroom to wash up, took out my contact lenses, changed into my pajamas, and made the last preparations before bed.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shoulder and neck rehabilitation exercises
description: She unrolled her yoga mat on the bedroom floor and carefully completed a set of shoulder and neck rehabilitation exercises. Recently, sitting for long periods while revising manuscripts had made her neck stiff, and every stretch and twist soothed the muscles.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime journal organizing and creating
description: After exercising, I sat down at my desk and opened my journal. I used brown and dark green watercolor paints to draw a few river lines simplified from the map, and pasted in a small sample print of the scanned map (a Polaroid print). I noted down today's agreement with my sister, my reflections from reading The Way of Flowers on the balcony, and the place-name verification points that moved me while watching a documentary. Finally, I wrote in a silver gel pen: “Longing is amber-colored, wrapping up all the small glimmers of everyday life.”
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and Sleep
description: Turned off the main light, turned on the small bedside lamp, and did 15 minutes of meditation leaning against the headboard to let the day's thoughts settle. Then I turned off the light, listened to the faint distant traffic outside the window, and with my sister's face and the slightly yellowed texture of the map flashing through my mind, gradually fell asleep.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Wake up, wash up, eat breakfast
description: Woken by the soft music alarm on her phone, she saw light rain falling outside through the window; the air felt moist and fresh. After getting up and washing up, her mother had already prepared piping hot Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles with pickled vegetables. While eating breakfast, she replied to her friend Song Wen's message about submission platforms and had a brief exchange.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Yunnan University
description: Carrying a backpack with a laptop, a notebook, and an umbrella, and holding a long-handled umbrella featuring the silhouette of old Kunming buildings, I walked 15 minutes along Wenlin Street to the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University to begin the day of study.
location: Along the route from No. 7 Huashan West Road to No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Researching literature at the library
description: In the current periodicals room on the second floor of the Yunnan University Donglu Campus library, she looked through the latest issue of Human Geography magazine, found an article about the changes in Kunming's old neighborhoods, carefully copied out the discussions of 'street texture' and 'public space', photographed key maps with her phone, and flipped through other related papers. She entered the abstracts into EndNote to find support for the theoretical framework of her paper.
location: Current Periodicals Reading Room, Second Floor, Library, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and receiving the column layout link.
description: While eating fried Ersi noodles on the second floor of Dingxin Restaurant at Yunnan University, I received the layout preview link for the column "Dounan Morning" sent by Editor Xu. I put down my chopsticks and read it carefully. Seeing that the photo I took of the breakfast shop on Wenlin Street was perfectly presented, I happily took a screenshot. I ran into my roommate Zhou Lin.
location: Second floor, Dingxin Restaurant, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Checking the defense group announcement
description: Walked to the notice board on the first floor of the College of Liberal Arts to check the grouping list for the graduation thesis defense, and found that I was the first in the third group, at 8:30 a.m. on June 3, in Room 303 of the college. Used the memo app to record it, took a photo, and sent it to my advisor, Wu Mingyuan.
location: Bulletin board on the first floor of the School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus walk and online socializing
description: After the rain, the air was fresh. I took a walk along the ginkgo path to aid digestion. I replied to WeChat messages from my advisor Wu Mingyuan and my roommate Liu Jia about the defense grouping, and shared a screenshot of the column layout on Moments with the caption
location: Ginkgo Road, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walked back home
description: While walking home from Yunnan University, I passed Zhibushi Bookstore and saw Uncle Qin Mingyuan organizing new books. I smiled and waved at him through the glass. I completed about 40 minutes of exercise.
location: Near Zhibushi Bookstore on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Writing and organizing materials at home
description: Changed into loungewear, created a new Word document titled “Dounan Morning_Draft_0526” at the desk in the bedroom, and, combining the morning’s literature knowledge with the memory of yesterday’s flower market, conceived and wrote nearly 1,200 characters of the draft outline and opening paragraphs. Along the way, I also changed the water for the double-petal sunflowers on the windowsill.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Thoroughly clean the room
description: She spent an hour clearing expired printouts and old manuscript paper from her desk, sorting them for recycling; rearranged the messy books on the bookshelf by category; and carefully wiped down the new terracotta-colored flower container and flower arrangement tools, placing them in a prominent spot on the windowsill. After cleaning, the room was bright and spotless, with everything in order.
location: Bedroom and study at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the supermarket to buy iron-rich ingredients
description: She walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, where she selected premium beef and prepared fresh pork liver for iron supplementation. She also bought the yogurt and blueberries that her mother likes.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing dinner and sharing news.
description: She handed the ingredients to her mother and took the initiative to help wash vegetables and slice beef. While handling the ingredients, she told her mother about the joy of receiving the layout link, the nervousness of seeing the defense list, and the sense of accomplishment after cleaning the room. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Family dinner
description: The family of three enjoyed stir-fried beef with green peppers, stir-fried pork liver, and egg custard. Father Sun Mingyuan asked about the preparation for the thesis defense, and the daughter reported in detail; the atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Column writing and journal entries
description: Back in the bedroom, spent about an hour revising and polishing the first draft of 'Morning at Dounan', adding details about buying flowers and descriptions of the flower market atmosphere, completing about 1,600 words. Then decorated the journal with washi tape and stickers, recorded the library discoveries, layout screenshots, and defense group assignments, and wrote a short reflective piece, summing it up as 'a well-ordered day.'
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation
description: After changing into pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bay window cushion in the bedroom, closed her eyes and meditated for 15 minutes, focusing on her breath, emptying her mind, feeling the peace of the rainy night, and settling the day's trivialities and joys.
location: Bedroom bay window at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: She lay down on the bed and read the 'Nageire' chapter of The Way of Flowers for half an hour, making notes in the margins based on yesterday's flower arrangement experience. At 22:20, she closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep peacefully listening to the rain outside the window.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Morning preparations and breakfast
description: At 7:15 the alarm went off; it was cloudy with a hint of light outside. After lazing in bed for 5 minutes, she got up, walked to the desk, and opened Voice Memos on her iPhone to prepare for recording the mock defense. She changed into the prepared smoke-gray cotton-linen long coat, went to the bathroom to wash up and apply toner. When she got to the dining room, her mother Li Xiulan had already gone to work. On the table, the insulated cover kept a steaming hot small-pot rice noodles and two flower cakes. While sitting down to breakfast, she quickly browsed the overnight messages in the workshop group on WeChat and received a suggestion from editor Xu Mingyuan about the "urban memory" topic. She noted the key points and replied, "Got it, Mr. Xu, I'll think about it."
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, bedroom and dining room at home

name: First round of mock graduation defense practice and revision
description: At 8:15, she returned to the study, stood in front of the full-length mirror, opened the voice memo app on her phone, and began the first round of rehearsal for the mock graduation defense presentation, deliberately controlling her speaking pace and looking at herself in the mirror. After recording, she listened back and found that the transition between the second paragraph, "spatial production theory," and the fourth paragraph, "place-name changes," was stiff. She wrote the key revisions in red pen in her draft notebook. Then she opened the defense presentation script on her laptop, made targeted refinements to the end of the second paragraph and the beginning of the fourth paragraph, added a sentence about "the resistance of everyday life" as a logical link, saved the document, and backed it up to a USB drive.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Mock defense second-round practice and meditation relaxation
description: At 9:10, she stood in front of the mirror again for a second round of recorded mock defense. After the revisions, her presentation was much smoother, with proper pacing and a steady gaze at herself in the mirror. Instead of replaying the recording immediately, she sat cross-legged on the yoga mat in her study as planned, opened the meditation app, and did a 15-minute guided meditation on the theme of “focus and calm” to help herself step out of the nervousness of the defense.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Re-listened to the defense recording and recorded notes in the journal.
description: After the meditation, she put on headphones and carefully listened to the recording of the second mock defense, confirming that the overall structure was coherent and that her eye-contact issue had improved after deliberate practice. Then, with a red pen, she wrote a summary in her TN journal: second round OK, still need to silently say the word steady to yourself when going on stage for eye contact and speaking pace, and the transition sentences have been revised.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Reading and gathering writing materials
description: There was still some time before the workshop class. She didn't start on her homework immediately, but instead took out "Old Stories of Kunming" borrowed from Zhibushi Bookstore from the shelf, and flipped through the chapter about Zhuanxin Farmers' Market in Wuhua District. She used her phone to photograph descriptions of the old market layout and a clock shop, gathering material for the essay "The Clock at the Food Market" she planned to write in the evening. At the same time, she opened her iPad and searched for "modernized qipao" on Pinterest, saving a few images that suited her style to the album "Qipao Inspiration," thinking about going with her older sister to have one custom-made during the National Day holiday.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Lunch and household tidying
description: At lunchtime, she heated up the tomato scrambled eggs her mother had prepared in advance and the leftover pork rib soup from yesterday, and served them with a bowl of white rice. After eating, she cleaned up the kitchen, washed the dishes and chopsticks, and rolled up the yoga mat and put it back. Then she washed a few plums and put them into a lunchbox, filled her thermos with warm water, and got ready for the afternoon online course.
location: Home kitchen and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Nonfiction writing workshop online course and group discussion.
description: At 12:30 sharp, she opened Tencent Meeting on her laptop and attended the fourth session of the online workshop "Nonfiction: From the Scene to the Text." In the first half, the instructor explained in detail "The 'I' in Nonfiction: The Scale and Ethics of Intervention." Sun Yuwei listened while quickly jotting down key points in her notebook, reflecting inwardly on the "overly smug" passages in her own column. At 13:45, they entered the break and group discussion. Her group communicated in real time via voice on WeChat. A classmate pointed out sharply that in "Dounan Morning" she "intervened too much, acting like a judge rather than an observer." She responded calmly, sincerely accepted the criticism, and said that in "Market Clock" she would be a pure observer. The group reached a consensus: "Allow the observing self; avoid the judging self." In the second half, students reviewed each other's work. After listening carefully to two classmates' pieces, she offered thoughtful suggestions in the chat box. The class ended at 15:00.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Go to the yoga studio and prepare before class
description: After class at 15:00, I put the laptop, notebook, and thermos into a canvas backpack, changed into comfortable canvas shoes, put on earphones, grabbed my keys and phone, locked the door, and left. From home, I walked west along Renmin Middle Road and turned onto Dongfeng West Road, walking about 15 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. On the way, I listened to a podcast about describing settings in nonfiction writing to find inspiration for the evening's assignment. After arriving at the yoga studio at 15:30, I first greeted my friend He Lu at the front desk and chatted for a bit, then went into the changing room, changed into yoga clothes, laid out the yoga mat, and set my phone to Do Not Disturb mode.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yin yoga class instructed by He Lu
description: At 15:45, He Lu's Yin Yoga class started on time, focusing on deep muscle and connective tissue stretching, including long holds in poses such as pigeon pose and frog pose. While holding child's pose, He Lu guided everyone to notice the subtle changes in the body brought by breathing. Sun Yuwei felt the tension in her neck and shoulders completely released during that hour. After class, the two chatted briefly. She laughed and said, “Being self-employed makes me so anxious, my whole body is tense. I rely on your class to keep going.” He Lu smiled and comforted her.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio group class room, Room 4001, 4F, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: After-class milk tea chat with He Lu
description: After yoga class, the two walked to the 'Yidiandian' milk tea shop next door. Sun Yuwei ordered a hot brown sugar pearl milk tea, her favorite, while He Lu got a lemonade. They sat by the window and talked about the instability of their jobs, their uncertainty about the future, and the books they had recently read. Sun Yuwei shared how nervous she had felt during the morning's mock defense, and He Lu cheered her up.
location: Yidiandian milk tea shop, Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, she walked back along Dongfeng West Road and, on the way, turned into Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street. She went straight to the fresh food section and carefully picked out a piece of beef tenderloin weighing about 200 grams and a box of pork liver, to replenish iron tomorrow morning. Before leaving, she remembered the local-brand yogurt her mother liked, grabbed a bottle of plain flavor, paid, and walked home carrying the shopping bag.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare ingredients, family dinner, and post-dinner cleanup.
description: At 18:10, she arrived home and put the beef and pork liver in the refrigerator and put the yogurt away. Since her mother was not off work yet, she washed and cut the tomatoes and greens and arranged them neatly on the kitchen cutting board. At 18:30, her mother Li Xiulan came home and was very pleased to see the prepared ingredients, quickly stir-frying two dishes. The family of three sat around the dining table. Her father Sun Mingyuan asked about her thesis defense preparation. Sun Yuwei reported on the mock defense insights from the morning and the transition sentences she had revised, and also shared the workshop debate about “the self as an intervener.” Her mother commented thoughtfully: “Maintaining objectivity when writing is like doing scholarship—difficult but very important. If you can realize that, it is progress.” After dinner, she helped her mother put the dishes and chopsticks into the dishwasher, then returned to the study.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Conception and creation of the first part of the nonfiction work 'Wet Market Clock'
description: She opened a Word document and began writing the micro non-fiction piece 'Vegetable Market Clock.' She decided to make the owner of the clock shop at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market the protagonist and, through the vegetable vendors who appear at different times in his eyes, show the rhythm of the market. She first wrote the core passage describing the owner repairing an old Shanghai watch, then filled in the details. When she got stuck midway, she got up to drink water in the living room and flipped through two pages of 'The Way of Flowers' to find inspiration.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Made today's journal entry.
description: Closing the laptop, she took out her TN journal. First she stamped the date with a date stamp, then used a fountain pen to record the day's key events: improvements for the mock defense, takeaways from the workshop debate, and the relaxed feeling after yin yoga class. She cut out the receipt from Yi Dian Dian milk tea and the supermarket shopping receipt, stuck them beside the notes with glue tape, and finally drew a simple stick figure doing yoga, with the words "Refueling complete" next to it.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Evening meditation and relaxation.
description: Sitting cross-legged on the yoga mat again, I did 15 minutes of mindful breathing meditation, letting go of the day’s thoughts so my brain could rest completely and prepare for the late-night writing session ahead.
location: Yoga mat in the home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing and polishing the second part of the nonfiction work "Wet Market Clock"
description: After meditation, her energy recovered. She returned to the computer, opened the document, and continued writing. She described the clock shop owner as "the guardian of time" and the vegetable vendor as "a flowing landscape", carefully polishing every detail. She wrote late into the night and completed a first draft of about 2,000 characters in one go. Finally, she polished it sentence by sentence, checked for typos, and ensured the language was concise and powerful.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Submit writing assignment and interact in the family group
description: Opened the workshop assignment submission page, uploaded the document 'The Wet Market Clock', and clicked submit after confirming everything was correct. Then in the family WeChat group she posted a photo of the empty brown sugar pearl milk tea cup she had drunk that afternoon, with the caption: "Mom, today's beef is so tender, let's make celery stir-fried beef tomorrow!" At the same time, she tagged her elder sister Sun Yutong: "Sis, about the qipao we planned to order when we return to Kunming for National Day, I've saved a few pictures and will send them to you later! Good night."
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: She turned off the computer, went to the bathroom to brush her teeth and wash her face, and changed into comfortable pajamas. After getting into bed, she picked up "The Way of Flowers" from the bedside and finished the last chapter, "Thrown Flowers," appreciating the shared beauty of "negative space" and "breathing" in flower arrangement and literature, feeling completely content. At 1:00 she turned off the bedside lamp; all was quiet outside the window, and she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and having a simple breakfast
description: The alarm went off for the third time before I managed to drag myself out of bed. Rubbing my sleepy eyes, I walked to the kitchen and saw that Mom had already left for work, with a note on the table reading, “Congee is in the pot, remember to have some.” After a quick wash-up, I took a few soda crackers from the cupboard and, chewing them dry, brewed a cup of my favorite brown sugar pearl milk tea, trying to use the sweetness to dispel the grogginess from staying up late to write.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Confirm the defense materials and get ready to go out.
description: Carrying the milk tea back to the study, she opened the memo on her phone and carefully checked the list of materials for the thesis defense: vaccination record form, USB drive with the final thesis, PPT backup... Every item was checked off. She changed into a clean white shirt, applied a light layer of sunscreen, picked up her canvas bag, and placed her phone, keys, and wallet inside.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to the community hospital.
description: Put on my headphones and went out, walked west along Renmin Middle Road, then turned onto Wenlin Street. The sunlight in Kunming at the end of May was just right; the jacaranda trees by the roadside were in full bloom, and a faint floral scent filled the air. Walking and stopping, I took a few photos of the purple petals that had fallen on the sidewalk. Traffic on Wenlin Street was sparse, with the occasional early-rising elderly person walking a dog.
location: From Renmin Middle Road to Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pick up vaccination records at the community health service center
description: Arriving at the community health service center, she presented her ID card at the vaccination window. After verifying the information, the doctor handed over the stamped vaccination record certificate and reminded her to come back for the second shot in two months. She thanked him and carefully tucked it into the inner pocket of her canvas bag.
location: Huashan Subdistrict Community Health Service Center, No. 78 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket
description: After leaving the community hospital, she didn't go straight home; she turned into Fuchun Street on the way. From the old-fashioned barbershop on the street came the snip-snip of scissors, and a few elderly women sat on plastic stools at the entrance, chatting in the sun. She quickened her pace, hoping to finish the shopping a bit earlier.
location: From Wenlin Street to Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping for ingredients at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket
description: In the fresh food section, she carefully picked a box of fresh pork liver, then took some mangoes and a watermelon (seasonal fruits). Remembering that her mother had said last night she wanted some edamame, she scooped up a small bag as well. At checkout, seeing a new yogurt flavor next to the register, she grabbed a bottle.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk home
description: Carrying shopping bags and walking home, the bag was a bit heavy, and I shifted it from one hand to the other several times. Sunlight cast dappled shadows through the plane tree leaves, and a white cat squatted on the wall yawning. I thought to myself that once the thesis defense was over, I really needed a good night's sleep.
location: Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Renmin Middle Road

name: Preparing lunch with her mother.
description: When I got home, I found that Mom had already come back. In the kitchen I helped her pick over and wash the pork liver and edamame she had just bought. While washing the vegetables, we chatted about what had happened at the community hospital and the countdown schedule for the thesis defense. Mom was very concerned and asked if she needed to accompany me that day. I smiled and declined, saying, “I can handle it myself; just wait for my good news.”
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Lunch was stir-fried pork liver, edamame in cold dressing, and tomato and egg soup made by Mom. At the table, she proactively brought up having successfully obtained the vaccination record. Dad nodded and said that the documents that needed to be prepared should be prepared properly, while Mom picked up several pieces of pork liver and kept urging her to eat more to replenish her iron. The family chatted about neighborhood small talk while eating, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Plan the thesis defense schedule in journal.
description: After lunch, I returned to the study, cleaned the desk, and spread out my journal. I took out my favorite four-color ballpoint pen and beige sticky notes and began to systematically plan the schedule for the last few days before the defense. On the weekly page, I used a ruler to draw a clear countdown timeline: May 31, print the final thesis and PPT; June 1, go to school to check the venue; June 2, final rehearsal; and even noted down what time to get up, what to wear, and what to eat for breakfast on June 3. On the blank page next to it, I also drew a handmade "mood monitoring" memo page, using colored pencils to mark blocks of different colors, ready to record emotional fluctuations. The whole process was quiet and focused.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: After bringing her journal planning to a pause, she stretched and decided to go out to Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore for a change of scene. She put on a sun hat and walked slowly along Cuihu North Road. Sunlight cast dappled shadows through the leaves, and a gentle breeze would occasionally blow past. On the way, she saw several students sketching and stopped to watch for a while.
location: From Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu North Road

name: Read and refine the presentation draft at Zhibushi Bookstore.
description: Pushing open the bookstore's wooden door, the familiar smell of ink and coffee rushed toward me. I nodded to Uncle Qin behind the counter, and he smiled and pointed to the usual seat by the window. I sat down there and ordered a cup of Pu'er tea. Opening my laptop, I first flipped through the chapter on the Yunnan–Vietnam Railway in the book 'Old Kunming Stories' I had borrowed last time, then picked up a local gazetteer reference book and compared the wording of geographical names in my presentation draft. I even read a few lines in a low voice to feel the rhythm of the language. Uncle Qin passed by, saw the draft covered with annotations, and asked quietly, 'Still preparing for the defense?' I nodded, and he said, 'Take it easy and prepare well.'
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Talked with older sister while walking home
description: Realizing it was about time to go home, she packed up her books and computer and said goodbye to Uncle Qin. On the way home, she sent a voice message to her older sister Sun Yutong, talked about how the thesis defense preparation was going, and excitedly shared the design of the “countdown page” in her journal. When she mentioned having a cheongsam custom-made when her sister came back for National Day, her sister laughed on the other end of the voice message and said, “Sure, after your defense, let’s plan the details carefully.” She felt warm inside.
location: From Cuihu North Road to Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing family dinner with Mother
description: When I got home, my mother had already started preparing dinner. I went up to help, peeling garlic while sharing with her some local cultural tidbits I had seen at the bookstore. I told her that Uncle Qin had said the bookstore had a new batch of books about old photos of Yunnan, and that I wanted to go take a look after my thesis defense. The kitchen was filled with the sound of spatula tossing and the aroma of rice.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Father came home from work, and the family sat down for dinner. Mother had made her favorite steamed sea bass and garlic water spinach. At the table, Father asked about the day, and she gave a full account of the trip from the community hospital to the bookstore. When Mother heard that she had also bought pig liver on purpose, she was very pleased and felt that she had really grown up. The dinner atmosphere was relaxed, with little pressure, as if it were just an ordinary family meal before the defense.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Finalize the statement draft and send it to the advisor
description: After dinner, I returned to the study, turned on the computer, and did the final check before sending the thesis presentation. I read it word by word, paying special attention to sections involving historical place names. I found that the phrasing of 'the starting station of the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway' was somewhat vague. I opened a web page to verify, and after confirming it was correct, I named the file 'Defense_Statement_V3_20250528.docx', wrote a short email with thanks and reminders about corrections to key paragraphs, and clicked send to Professor Wu's email.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revise the manuscript, fix the errata, and update the journal
description: About half an hour after sending the email, she received a quick reply from Professor Wu. He pointed out that "the starting station of the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway" was inaccurate and should be specified as "Kunming North Station." She immediately opened the document to make the correction and noted the erratum in her phone memo. Then she opened her journal, completed the part left unfinished at the bookstore this afternoon, and made a small "correction note" page, recording the exchange with her advisor as a real case in the thesis defense process, feeling that the process itself was meaningful.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxation and emotional journaling
description: Putting down the pen, she felt that today's tasks were almost done. She turned on the lavender essential oil diffuser via her phone, and the room was immediately filled with a soothing fragrance. Curled up in a chair, she picked up her journal, flipped to the 'Mood Tracking' page, drew a smiley face next to it with a green pen, and wrote beside it: 'Today was fulfilling, and I feel clearer about my thesis defense preparation. Dinner with family, the chat with Uncle Qin, and my sister's encouragement all make me feel very at ease.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and meditation to prepare for falling asleep
description: Changed into comfortable pajamas and lay down on the bed. Picked up the essay collection The Way of Flowers I've been reading recently, and flipped through a few pages, but my thoughts began to drift and my eyes started to droop. Realizing that drowsiness was setting in, I closed the book, turned off the desk lamp, and left only a warm yellow bedside lamp on. Then I did 15 minutes of breathing meditation, focusing on my breath and letting the day's thoughts slowly settle.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Try to fall asleep
description: After the meditation, her body felt much more relaxed, but her mind was a little restless because she had been thinking too much about the defense. She tossed and turned in bed—her body exhausted, but her brain still running. She tried abdominal breathing and eventually, amid the haze, gradually lost consciousness.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and breakfast conversation
description: At 7:00 a.m., the alarm went off. Sun Yuwei spread out her yoga mat in the bedroom and completed a 10-minute mindful meditation and a simple spinal twist, feeling the fresh post-rain air. After washing up, her mother Li Xiulan had already prepared small-pot rice noodles. During breakfast, she contacted customer service at Shiguang Photo Studio via WeChat to confirm that the family photo shoot would be on October 2 at 10 a.m., selected three sets of Republic of China-style outfits, paid a 600 yuan deposit, saved the chat records and transfer screenshots, and recorded it all in her journal.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready to go out and walking to the print shop.
description: Sun Yuwei saved the final version of her thesis to a USB drive, checked her phone, earphones, umbrella, and water bottle, then set off from home at 8:30 and walked to Jiahui Graphics on Huancheng West Road. The walk took about 31 minutes. She put on her earphones to listen to light music and enjoyed the quiet morning streets. She arrived at the print shop at 9:05.
location: Huancheng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Jiahui Graphics (Huancheng West Road Store))

name: Printing and binding the thesis.
description: Sun Yuwei handed the USB drive to the clerk and asked for three copies of the final thesis to be printed double-sided on A4 paper, using 80g cream-colored paper. During printing, she personally checked the layout and noticed that a table was misaligned across pages. She then used the store's computer to adjust the margins and table size and reprinted the affected pages. After binding, she carefully checked each copy's cover, table of contents, main text, appendices, and references to ensure that the spine text was straight and complete.
location: Huancheng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Jiahui Graphics (Huancheng West Road Store))

name: Returning home, discussing the manuscript, and planning to go out again
description: At 10:00, Sun Yuwei quickly returned home with her paper and placed it on her desk. At 10:10, she turned on her computer and saw the editor Xu Mingyuan's revision suggestions for her column article. She spent 20 minutes strengthening the "observer" perspective at the ending, and after revising, sent it by email. Then she flipped through her journal and crossed off completed tasks. Seeing it was overcast outside, she decided to go to Zhibushi Bookstore earlier than planned, intending to stop by City Garden Supermarket on the way and return the old map to Uncle Qin. She got ready to go out.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Going out shopping, returning a map, and enjoying bookstore time
description: At 11:00, Sun Yuwei walked to City Garden Supermarket and bought pork liver, beef tenderloin, blueberries, and mangoes. At 11:15 she went on to Paper Stone Bookstore; on the way she encountered scattered raindrops and opened her umbrella. After arriving, she returned an envelope containing the 1934 Kunming city street map to Qin Mingyuan. Then she ordered a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea, sat by the window, and flipped through "Bridges of Kunming," enjoying the quiet time in the bookstore in the rain. At 12:00 the rain began to lighten, so she closed her umbrella and walked home carrying her shopping bags.
location: No. 32, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Kunming Paper, Cloth & Stone Bookstore)

name: Return home for lunch and a nap
description: At 12:00, Sun Yuwei walked home. After arriving at 12:15, she helped wash the vegetables. Lunch was stir-fried pork liver with green peppers, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and seaweed egg drop soup. She shared her morning experience of printing the thesis and going to the bookstore with her mother. After lunch, she cleared the dishes, went to her bedroom for a nap, and set an alarm for 15:15.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon journaling and reading
description: After waking from her lunch break, Sun Yuwei brewed a cup of chrysanthemum tea and began working on her journal. She drew a vintage camera with green watercolor paint, pasted in the payment screenshot and the bookstore promotional card, and recorded in detail the confirmation of the family photo, the minor incident while printing the thesis, Uncle Qin's inscription, and the inspiration from Green Lake after the rain. When she finished, she opened The Way of Flowers and continued reading the “Nageire” chapter.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening family time: meal preparation, dinner, and a walk.
description: At 16:00, Sun Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic and wash tomatoes, chatting about how the mint on the balcony was growing. At 17:00, her father Sun Mingyuan got off work, and the family of three had dinner together. The dishes included pork rib and lotus root soup, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and cucumber salad. She shared that her paper had gone well and talked about what she had found at the bookstore. Her father reminded her not to be nervous about the defense. At 18:00 after dinner, she and her mother went for their usual walk in Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park). The air was fresh after the rain. They walked two laps along the lakeside path, chatting about funny student stories and graduation plans.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Personal Time: Socializing and Hobbies
description: At 18:30, Sun Yuwei returned to her bedroom and saw that her best friend Wang Xinran had posted on WeChat Moments about Shenzhen Design Week. She liked, commented, and privately messaged her, learning that Wang Xinran had been promoted to supervisor, and they agreed to celebrate online after the thesis defense. Afterwards, she shared the thesis printing episode in the three-person best friends group chat, and the three of them had a sticker battle amid laughter. At 19:00, she continued watching the documentary Soul of the Dai and Li on her tablet and recorded writing inspiration. Then she opened her journal, drew the progress on the Defense Countdown page, and wrote Peaceful Anticipation.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxation and sleep
description: At 20:30, Sun Yuwei set her phone to Do Not Disturb, unrolled her yoga mat, and did 15 minutes of rehabilitation yoga for her lower back, shoulders, and neck. At 21:00, after washing her face and doing skincare, she curled up in bed and continued reading 20 pages of The Way of Flowers, marking passages. At 21:30, she took out today's planner and wrote down her thanks: gratitude for her mother's company, the time at the bookstore, her close friend's encouragement, and herself for completing all her plans. She closed the notebook and turned off the light. At 22:20, she did abdominal breathing and fell asleep feeling at peace and with anticipation.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning ritual
description: Woke up to the alarm on my phone, drew the curtains, and felt Kunming's overcast weather. I did 10 minutes of meditation and simple spinal twists, drank warm water, read two pages of "The Way of Flowers," and started a calm day for myself.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Energizing breakfast and family conversation.
description: In the kitchen, she helped her mother Li Xiulan prepare breakfast and enjoyed chicken soup rice noodles and poached eggs. While chatting with her mother, her mother urged her to come home early because of the bad weather, and she felt the warmth of family.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparation and scene setup for the defense rehearsal
description: I connected the laptop to the TV, opened the defense presentation slides, and placed a timer, phone stand, and warm water on the coffee table. My mother tidied the sofa and prepared to watch the rehearsal as the first official audience member.
location: Home living room, Unit 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Final defense mock rehearsal
description: Rehearsed the thesis proposal defense presentation, which took 15 minutes and 38 seconds. My mother, as the audience, gave feedback, pointing out three slips of the tongue where I said “second space” instead of “third space,” and that eye contact should be natural, reminding me that I could treat it as pitching a new topic to an editor. I used my phone's memo app to record the key points.
location: Home living room, Unit 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video review and self-correction
description: Back in the study, put on headphones, review the slip-of-the-tongue spots her mother pointed out, and practice pronunciation with Voice Memos. Copy the latest PPT document to a USB drive and upload it to Baidu Netdisk for backup to keep files safe.
location: Home study, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Material verification and itinerary fine-tuning
description: I wrote the list of materials needed for tomorrow's defense on a sticky note and put it in a conspicuous place on the desk. Mother reminded me to prepare the gifts for grandmother's home tomorrow, so I took the gift bag and dried flowers out to the living room.
location: Study and living room at home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare Dragon Boat Festival gifts and journal records
description: After trimming the dried hydrangeas and chamomile, arranged them in a kraft paper tote bag, placed in a box of flower cakes and a box of dried mushrooms, tied a twine bow, and wrote a blessing message. Then I took out my travel journal and, on the page for 'The Night Before the Defense,' drew simple illustrations with coffee-colored watercolor and noted the key points about eye contact that my mother had pointed out.
location: Home study, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Strolling and clearing her mind at Green Lake Park
description: Changed into canvas shoes, went downstairs, and took a walk along the lake at Green Lake Park, feeling the misty water vapor over the lake on the cloudy day and the occasional black-headed gulls flying past, relaxing my tense nerves after the thesis defense rehearsal.
location: Cuihu Park, Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province
