name: Family lunch.
description: Father came home from work at noon, and the family shared the garlic vermicelli steamed scallops and stir-fried pork with green peppers that Mother had made. They chatted about the new bakery in the community and the black-headed gulls at Green Lake, in a relaxed atmosphere. After the meal, she helped clear the dishes.
location: Dining room at home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon nap
description: She set a 14:00 alarm, put on a steam eye mask, and lay in bed for a 20-minute nap to let her body and mind relax.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Changed into a cotton-linen dress, carried a canvas bag, set out from Cuihu Community, walked about 35 minutes along the plane tree shade by Green Lake breathing the moist post-rain air, and arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore.
location: On the walk from Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road

name: Returning the map and tea chat at the bookstore
description: Gave the archival envelope with the 1934 old Kunming map to bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan. Uncle Qin praised the map's good condition and treated her to freshly roasted Mandheling coffee. The two discussed her graduation thesis on the 'third space' concept. Uncle Qin suggested holding a small exhibition titled 'Urban Memories in the Bookstore' at the bookstore during the summer, displaying maps, postcards, and journals, and inviting old Kunming residents to share stories. I gladly agreed and recorded the idea.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and a bookstore stroll.
description: At the usual window seat, she ordered a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea, opened her journal to record exhibition ideas, the taste of Mandheling coffee, and the suggestion in her mother's eyes, and pasted in a photo of the gray-blue sky outside the window. Then she browsed local chronicles and travel magazines in the bookstore.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Leisurely walk home and supermarket shopping.
description: Leaving the bookstore, she walked home along Cuihu North Road. Passing the City Garden Supermarket on Fuchun Street, she went in and bought strawberries, blueberries, and black pork collar to build up energy before the thesis defense. After paying, she carried her canvas bag and walked home.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Helping with meal preparation and organizing clothes
description: After getting home, she put the fruit in the fridge, gave the meat to her mother, helped peel garlic and wash vegetables, and shared her ideas for the bookstore exhibition. At 17:00 she went back to her bedroom, carefully ironed the white shirt she would wear the next day with a garment steamer, and hung it behind the door to ensure it had no wrinkles.
location: Kitchen and bedroom of the home at Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: For dinner, we enjoyed the black-pepper grilled steak Mom had made with pork collar, along with stir-fried seasonal vegetables and mushroom soup. Dad opened some juice. We talked about the Dragon Boat Festival plans: tomorrow morning we would go to Grandma’s house first, and in the afternoon there were the thesis defense and the get-together. I thanked Mom for her guidance on the defense that morning.
location: Dining room at home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: After-dinner digestion and living room chat.
description: After helping her mother clear the dinner table, she sat with her father on the living room sofa watching the news. She took out her phone to review the defense PPT script, silently correcting the places where she usually stumbled, and occasionally chatting about community topics with her father.
location: Home living room, Unit 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Deep journaling and self-reflection
description: In the bedroom, I spread out my journal and spent nearly an hour and a half carefully recording today's mood: the nervousness of the rehearsal and my mother's wisdom, the ritual of returning the map, the exhibition idea, and all the preparations. I drew a four-panel comic to record the highlights and small mistakes.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dragon Boat Festival Gift Wrap-Up Confirmation
description: She rechecked the Dragon Boat Festival gift bags for her grandmother and older female cousin, confirmed that the blessing cards were written and the twine bows on the closures were intact, and placed the gift bags on the entryway shoe cabinet to make sure she wouldn't forget them when going out the next day.
location: Living room and entryway of the home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparations and reading time
description: She washed up, changed into pajamas, checked the three alarms on her phone and tomorrow's itinerary list. She did 15 minutes of focused meditation. Then she turned off the main light, turned on the bedside lamp, and read "The Way of Flowers" for 20 minutes. When drowsiness set in, she turned off the light at 22:00 and drifted into sleep with the reassuring sense that everything was ready.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 402, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and meditation.
description: Woke up naturally before the alarm went off, awakened by the faint aroma of zongzi leaves drifting in through the window. Opened the curtains and took a deep breath of the morning air, then sat cross-legged on the bed for a 10-minute meditation, focusing on breathing, with a heart full of anticipation and peace.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and tidying
description: After finishing meditation, I changed into comfortable loungewear and went to the bathroom to wash up, smiling at myself in the mirror while brushing my teeth. Back in the bedroom, I pinned up my hair with a shark clip and put my journal and recitation script into the canvas bag.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dragon Boat Festival family breakfast.
description: Entering the dining room, she saw the table already set with a plentiful breakfast. Her father was peeling a salted egg yolk and pork zongzi, and the room was filled with the aroma of glutinous rice. Her mother specially brought out a low-sugar red bean paste zongzi prepared for her and encouraged her to relax for the defense. She drank soy milk, tasted the zongzi, and enjoyed a sweet, warm morning.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: After breakfast, she sat on the living room sofa and had a video call via WeChat with her elder sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen. Her sister showed off her newly done red highlighted hair and excitedly talked about her graduation ceremony. She congratulated her sister and reminded her to return to Kunming in July for the opening of the Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore exhibition.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing to go out and depart
description: After hanging up the video call, she packed the prepared dried flowers, flower cakes, and dried mushroom gift boxes into a reusable cloth bag as a Dragon Boat Festival gift for her grandmother. Her mother also changed clothes and brought herbal snacks. The two changed shoes at the entryway, put on sun hats and brought water, ready to go.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watching the dragon boat race while walking to Grandma's house
description: Walked with my mother from home to my grandmother's house on Yuantong Street. Passing by the Panlong River near Yuantong Bridge, I was drawn by the gongs and drums of a dragon boat race and stopped to watch two folk dragon boat teams fiercely competing, with spectators on the shore cheering and an excited atmosphere. I bought a serving of cold rice noodles and ate while walking, feeling the festive vitality. Then I continued on my way, walked through Wenlin Street, noticed a newly opened independent café by the roadside, and thought I could come and sit there after the thesis defense.
location: From the riverbank of the Panlong River in Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near Yuantong Bridge) to Yuantong Street, Wuhua District, passing through Wenlin Street

name: Visiting Grandmother and Grandfather
description: Arriving at her maternal grandmother's house, her grandmother had already prepared tea. As soon as they met, she pressed a peace amulet wrapped in red cloth into her hand, telling her to wear it at the thesis defense for good luck. Moved, she accepted it and chatted with her grandparents about her recent writing and defense. Her maternal grandfather asked with great interest about borrowing a map from the old bookstore and the poetry gathering she would attend in the afternoon.
location: Grandmother's living room, a residential building on Yuantong Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: On the way back, took a walk through Cuihu Park.
description: After saying goodbye to her maternal grandparents, she and her mother took a detour to Cuihu Park for a walk. The park was full of Dragon Boat Festival atmosphere. Children were flying kites, and egrets were soaring over the lake. They walked slowly along the willow-shaded path, chatting about what they had seen beside the Panlong River, feeling relaxed.
location: Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: After returning home, her mother had quickly prepared a simple lunch: leftover zongzi, pea shoot soup, and sliced braised beef. The family of three sat together and enjoyed the meal warmly. While eating, she told her parents about going to a poetry gathering in the afternoon.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rest and checking the defense materials.
description: After lunch, returned to the bedroom, lay on the bed for half an hour to clear my mind. Then got up, sat at the desk, and carefully checked that the printed thesis, the USB drive with the defense PPT, student ID, and ID card were all in order. After confirming everything was correct, I wrote down the warm moments of the morning in my Moleskine gratitude journal: my grandmother's safety charm, my sister's red hair, and the sound of drums and gongs at the dragon boat race.
location: Home bedroom and desk, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: She put on her canvas bag containing the recitation script and journal, took her thermos, and walked alone to Mingyuan Bookstore (Paper, Cloth and Stone Bookstore) on Cuihu North Road. Sunlight cast dappled shadows through the leaves as she silently practiced the passages to recite in the Kunming dialect along the way.
location: Walk from Renmin Middle Road to No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dragon Boat Festival poetry gathering at Mingyuan Bookstore
description: The poetry gathering was held in the bookstore's backyard, with about twenty people sitting in a circle. After a brief opening by store manager Qin Mingyuan, the recitation session began. She stood up and read an excerpt from her own "Morning on Wenlin Street" in authentic, gentle Kunming dialect, drawing knowing smiles from the poetry friends and praise from an elderly grandmother. Qin Mingyuan privately told her that the exhibition "City Memories in Bookstores" would open on July 12 next month and asked for her help. She nodded excitedly.
location: Backyard of Mingyuan Bookstore (Zhibushi Bookstore), No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip, supermarket shopping, and preparing dinner at home
description: After the poetry gathering ended, I walked home along the same route, and on the way dropped by Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, where I picked up fresh strawberries, blueberries, and a bottle of plum wine that Father likes. After getting home, I put the fruit in the fridge, handed the plum wine to Father, then put on an apron to help Mother in the kitchen, slicing vegetables and sharing amusing moments from the poetry gathering. Mother listened with great interest.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; returned from Cuihu North Road, passing the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at 98 Fuchun Street, finally arriving home at Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Family Dragon Boat Festival dinner
description: The dinner was more lavish than usual. Her mother made the hot-and-sour fish and stir-fried pea shoots she loved, and also heated up zongzi. Her father poured a glass of the plum wine she had bought, and the family clinked glasses to celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival. At the table, she shared what she had seen and heard at the poetry gathering, while her father talked about the Cultural Bureau's new plan to protect the old neighborhood.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing equipment before the defense
description: After washing up, she returned to the bedroom and began final preparations for the thesis defense. She took out a black bachelor's gown and a white shirt from the wardrobe and carefully ironed them with a steam iron. She arranged her thesis, USB flash drive, ID card, and other items in order, then hung them on a hook behind the door. Finally, she set three consecutive alarms on her phone at 6:30, 6:40, and 6:50.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling time and gratitude log.
description: Sat down at the desk, opened the Moleskine gratitude journal, and used a fountain pen to record today's heartwarming moments: cold rice noodles with plenty of vinegar, Grandma's protective amulet, the old lady's praise at the poetry gathering, Father's excited expression about the exhibition, and so on. I also drew simple zongzi and dragon boat doodles with colored pencils.
location: At her desk at home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Online exchange and editor's reply.
description: After finishing the journal, picked up the phone and messaged writer friend Song Wen to share thoughts about the poetry gathering; the two chatted about their creative insights. Then replied to editor Xu Mingyuan's Dragon Boat Festival greetings, told him the manuscript was progressing smoothly, and attached a photo of clouds.
location: At the bedside at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxing and reading before bed
description: Before bed, do 10 minutes of abdominal breathing to calm your body and mind from the day's excitement. Then pick up The Way of Flowers and turn to the penultimate chapter, 'Nageire,' immersing yourself in the quiet world of flower arrangement.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wash up and prepare for bed
description: I closed the book and went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking in the mirror, I recalled all the beautiful moments of today and felt calm and determined inside. Back in the bedroom, I checked that my phone alarm was on, switched it to Do Not Disturb mode, and placed it on the nightstand.
location: The book recommended by Uncle Qin.

name: Going to bed
description: She turned off the bedside lamp and closed her eyes in the darkness. Images of the dragon boats she had seen during the day, the aroma of zongzi she had smelled, and the poetry recitations she had heard surfaced in her mind, and the corners of her mouth lifted into a smile involuntarily. Filled with peace and a sense of being loved and blessed, she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning reading and gratitude.
description: Woke up in the early morning, drank warm water on an empty stomach, then curled up on the bedroom bay window and read "Stories of the Sahara," smiling at the amusing anecdotes of Sanmao and José. After closing the book, I felt grateful for the warmth of yesterday's Dragon Boat Festival and recorded my gratitude as journal material.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, bedroom bay window

name: Family breakfast.
description: The family had breakfast together at the dining table in the living room, eating the small-pot rice noodles Mom cooked and the fried eggs Dad made, with pickled radish on the side. They talked about the day's plans. Dad reminded everyone to bring a photocopy of their ID cards, and Mom showed interest in the family portrait plan. The family was filled with laughter.
location: Dining table in the living room, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Send the column article
description: In the study, she did a final check of the manuscript “Morning on Wenlin Street,” reviewing punctuation and paragraph transitions, then sent it by email to editor Xu Mingyuan with a greeting. With the week’s important writing task completed, she felt relieved.
location: The study at Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reply to friend Song Wen
description: In the study, she sent her friend Song Wen a voice message on her phone, sharing meditation methods for coping with writer's block, recommending meditation audio, and encouraging her to overcome the difficulties.
location: The study at Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Book the nine-valent HPV vaccine.
description: Walked to the community health service center, filled out a health form, and at the vaccination registration window made an appointment for the nine-valent HPV vaccine. The nurse informed me that it was out of stock and would require a 2-3 month wait; I completed the registration and obtained an appointment voucher.
location: Renmin Middle Road Community Health Service Center, No. 68 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Field trip to Green Lake Park
description: After booking a vaccine appointment, I stopped by Green Lake Park on the way, strolled along the lake, enjoyed the morning lake view and waterbirds, photographed budding lotus flowers by the lotus pond, and gathered writing inspiration.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying iron-rich ingredients
description: Walked from Cuihu Park to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, selected iron-rich ingredients such as pork liver and beef tenderloin, and also bought black sesame paste and blueberries that Mom likes, to be used for dinner.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Start the Family Portrait Plan WeChat group
description: After returning home, she created a WeChat group called “Family Portrait Plan” in the living room, and added her mother and her sister, who was far away in Shenzhen, to the group. She shared early photos of her maternal grandmother as style references, and suggested that they pick out clothes together for the National Day family portrait. Her family responded enthusiastically.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, living room sofa.

name: Family lunch.
description: For lunch we had spaghetti with tomato meat sauce. The three of us chatted while eating. Father asked about my thesis defense preparation, and mother brought up the family photo again, putting meat in my bowl and telling me to eat more.
location: Restaurant, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest
description: After lunch, I went back to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, and rested. First, I made a colored-pencil sketch of the lotus buds at Green Lake in my journal, then listened to piano music and took a 40-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth sketching at Green Lake Park
description: She changed into a light jacket, and with her journal, watercolor pens, and voice recorder, went to Green Lake Park again. Under the shade near the pavilion in the center of the lake, she sketched and wrote down scenes from yesterday's Dragon Boat Festival poetry gathering and dragon boat race, and recorded the sound of an elderly person singing Yunnan opera.
location: Near the Mid-Lake Pavilion in Green Lake Park, 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Updating her journal and sorting out her feelings
description: Back home, she played music on the radio in the study, took out her cherry-blossom-colored journal, pasted in the registration receipt, lotus leaf photo stickers, and cheongsam model clippings, wrote down today's successful appointment, the launch of the family portrait plan, and her sketching experiences with a fountain pen, and used a highlighter to write words of gratitude and encouragement.
location: The study at Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mock defense rehearsal
description: She changed into a formal white shirt, took her defense script, and practiced the defense presentation in the small yard in front of her home, focusing on the research significance and innovation points. She recorded herself on her phone for self-evaluation, repeatedly adjusting her speaking pace and intonation until the logic was clear and natural.
location: Small courtyard, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family Dinner and Helping Out
description: For dinner, enjoyed stir-fried pork liver, tomato scrambled eggs, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. After the meal, she voluntarily washed the dishes and helped her mother clean up the kitchen, while telling her mother about the small hiccups during the defense rehearsal and receiving her mother's gentle encouragement.
location: Dining room and kitchen, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Immersive reading of One Hundred Years of Solitude.
description: Brew a cup of chrysanthemum tea, sit at the bay window in the bedroom and read One Hundred Years of Solitude, immersed in the story of the small town of Macondo where magic and reality interweave, forgetting time.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, bedroom bay window

name: Organizing defense materials and tomorrow's plan.
description: In the study, I put the speech microphone, the final draft of my thesis, and a USB flash drive into my backpack, and hung up the graduation gown and white shirt. In the memo app on my phone, I made tomorrow's venue-checking checklist: confirm the classroom, check the equipment, test the microphone, and set two alarms.
location: The study at Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and review
description: She meditated cross-legged by the bedside in her bedroom for 15 minutes, reviewed the wonderful moments of the day, and practiced self-affirmation and reflection.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Read "The Way of Flowers" before bed
description: Lying in bed, rereading the notes on the 'thrown-in' style from The Way of Flowers, feeling the vitality of the plants until drowsiness came over me.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and getting ready for bed
description: She went to the bathroom for a simple wash-up, applied hand cream, returned to bed, said goodnight to her mother, and fell asleep with calm and anticipation.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Final preparations before the defense
description: In the dormitory, Sun Yuwei was woken by the alarm clock. After getting up, she drank half a glass of warm water, put on the white shirt and dark skirt she had ironed the night before, and carefully placed the safety amulet her grandmother had given her into the pocket of her bachelor's gown. She exchanged words of encouragement with her roommates Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen as they got up one after another, then checked each item in her thesis defense materials bag: the four printed copies of her thesis, the USB flash drive, and the pen. She took two deep breaths to calm her nerves.
location: Student dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to the School of Literature
description: Sun Yuwei left the dorm with light luggage and walked to the College of Liberal Arts. A gentle breeze blew across the morning campus. She slowed down, stopped at the campus convenience store to buy a flower cake as breakfast, ate it while walking, and spent 5 yuan.
location: Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Graduation thesis defense and receiving an 'Excellent' grade.
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at the defense room on the third floor of the College of Liberal Arts at 7:15, adjusted the PPT projection and microphone, sat down, and silently reviewed her key points. Around 8:00, the other defense students and committee members arrived one after another, and she smiled at the lead examiner, Professor Wu Mingyuan. The defense began at 8:30. Wearing the bachelor's gown she had laid out the night before, she smoothly presented her thesis "A Study of the Cultural Space of Kunming's Independent Bookstores" in 15 minutes, then calmly answered questions from the three examiners. In particular, she gave a thorough response to Professor Wu's question about the interaction between bookstores and community culture, drawing on the Wenlin Street case. After the defense, the committee deliberated, and Professor Wu Mingyuan announced on the spot that the thesis had been rated "Excellent," praising it as "both warm and profound." Overjoyed, Sun Yuwei bowed in thanks and took a group photo with Professor Wu in the corridor. She then sent the good news to her parents, her sister, the close friends group chat, and her friend Song Wen via WeChat.
location: School of Literature, Yunnan University, 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dorm rest and luggage packing
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her dormitory, took off her graduation gown and changed into a light T-shirt and jeans, folded the gown and put it in her bag, then began packing for the trip home that evening. She packed the books she wanted to bring her mother, including Border Town, along with daily necessities. Sitting on the edge of the bed, she called her mother via video to share the joy of successfully defending her thesis and told her she would be home in the evening.
location: Student dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Celebration lunch
description: Sun Yuwei and her three roommates, Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin, invited their advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, to have lunch together at the newly opened "Slow Time" café near the school gate. The five sat around the table and ordered lattes, matcha cake, and sandwiches. Professor Wu gave supplementary comments on the thesis and encouraged their future academic development, and the roommates all praised Sun Yuwei's defense performance. Sun Yuwei beamed with joy, scooped cake with a small spoon, and sent the good news to her yoga partner He Lu via WeChat.
location: Manshiguang Coffee, 121 Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go for a solitary walk around Green Lake to reflect.
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei walked alone to Cuihu Park for a stroll. She sat down in a lakeside pavilion and recorded her feelings in her phone's memo: "The defense is over, like a grand farewell." After writing, she bought a bunch of fresh sunflowers from a stall by Cuihu Lake for 15 yuan, planning to take them home.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Grocery shopping at the supermarket on the way home
description: Sun Yuwei walked home from Green Lake Park holding sunflowers. Passing the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, she thought the family might be short on fruit, so she went in and bought one jin of strawberries and a box of blueberries, spending 28 yuan. On the way, she sent a WeChat voice message to her elder sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, asking about the specific dates for her annual leave in July and discussing how to arrange their time together.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Dragon Boat Festival family reunion
description: When Sun Yuwei got home, her mother Li Xiulan gave her a big hug. She put the sunflowers in a vase, put the fruit in the fridge, and stuck a sticky note reading "Excellent defense!" on the refrigerator door. Then she helped her mother in the kitchen, unwrapped the steamed zongzi, and set out utensils. Mother and daughter chatted about the defense details while preparing food, and her mother nodded repeatedly, proud of her daughter. While cooking, her mother added beef for extra nutrition. Sun Yuwei washed the dishes and arranged the tables and chairs. After her father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, the family sat down to enjoy the Dragon Boat Festival dinner, with braised beef, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, cucumber salad, plus red bean paste zongzi and salted egg yolk and pork zongzi. Sun Yuwei shared in detail the good news that her thesis had been rated excellent. Her father peeled a salted egg yolk zongzi and handed it to her. After dinner, they moved to the living room to watch the news. Sun Yuwei made a video call to her elder sister Sun Yutong, letting her "join" the family dinner remotely. The three showed zongzi to the camera and shared laughter. Her sister said she would definitely have the hometown wild mushroom hotpot when she came back in July. Afterwards, Sun Yuwei sat by the window, flipping through her father's book "Kunming Gardens Chronicle."
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Slow moments before bedtime
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her room and did her usual washing up and basic skincare, washing away her fatigue. After that, she sat at her desk and worked on her journal, pasting the defense schedule ticket stub on the first page, clipping a cafe coaster beside it, and writing in colored pens: "Great defense, celebrated with mentors and friends, finally home. The flowers are sunflowers — see you in July, sis." Finally, she quietly read Border Town for 10 minutes, immersed in the tranquil world written by Shen Congwen.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and Sleep
description: After reading, Sun Yuwei sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated for 10 minutes before sleep, letting the excitement and contentment of the day slowly settle. Thinking of the family portrait plan for National Day, she curled the corners of her mouth slightly. At about 23:15, she turned off the bedside lamp and fell into a deep sleep, content and at peace.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning: getting up, washing up, and saying goodbye to roommates
description: I woke up naturally to the sound of drizzling rain and birdsong, lingered in bed for a while to enjoy the relaxation after the thesis defense, and drank warm water from my thermos to refresh myself. While washing up quietly in my loungewear, I chatted with my roommates Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen about their dreams; Zhao Xiaowen had already packed her luggage and was preparing to take the high-speed train home in the afternoon. Then, at the dormitory entrance, Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, Zhou Lin, and I asked the dorm supervisor, Aunt Wang, to take a group photo, with the dormitory door covered in decorations as the background. The four of us hugged tightly and agreed to meet up beautifully at the graduation ceremony. The goodbyes were full of smiles and reluctance.
location: Girls' dormitory and dormitory lobby, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize the dormitory and sort and pack personal belongings.
description: She officially began deep decluttering, dividing four years' worth of books into four piles: professional textbooks to be set aside for the used-book exchange, favorite reads to send home, out-of-print books to leave for Uncle Qin at Zhibushi Bookstore, and books to return to the university library. She sorted clothes the same way; old T-shirts and jeans were packed up to be donated to the community recycling bin. When she came across her freshman-year notes and ticket stubs from scenic spots, she couldn't help sitting on the floor and poring over them for a long time, a smile on her lips.
location: Female students’ dormitory, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Dormitory wrap-up and school-leaving registration
description: Wiped the desk and bed with a damp towel, and took away all personal trash. Carrying a backpack and a bag of old books weighing about ten jin, I walked to the Student Affairs Center, queued up to complete the temporary leave registration procedures, confirmed the graduation ceremony time as June 25, and turned in the dormitory key.
location: Student Affairs Center, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The last meal on campus: crossing-the-bridge rice noodles
description: I went alone to my favorite canteen window and ordered a steaming bowl of chrysanthemum crossing-the-bridge rice noodles. Sitting by the window, I savored them slowly amid the sound of rain, watching the few classmates who had stayed on campus during summer vacation. I felt this flavor would forever be linked to the summer after my thesis defense, so I ate with particular care.
location: Student Cafeteria, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking around the campus and taking commemorative photos
description: After the meal, holding an umbrella, she walked slowly along the ginkgo path in front of the School of Liberal Arts, using her phone to photograph the leaves made especially glossy green by the rain, the ivy on the wall of the old library, and the stone tablet engraved with the school motto. Each photo was a solemn farewell to four years of youth.
location: Main campus road, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Leaving school through the east gate of Donglu Campus, carrying old books for donation in my left hand and an umbrella in my right, I walked along Wenlin Street for about 15 minutes. On the way, I bought a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea at a roadside milk tea shop as a treat for myself after a morning of hard sorting. The air after the rain was fresh with the scent of soil and greenery.
location: From Wenlin Street to Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Initial discussion of the used-book drifting event for graduation season
description: She handed the old books she had brought to the bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, and shared the good news of passing her defense with distinction. Uncle Qin happily brewed a pot of Pu'er tea. During the chat, he mentioned that the number of student customers had recently decreased. Sun Yuwei had an idea and suggested using these books to hold a graduation used-book drifting activity called 'The youth that can't be taken away, I leave it to you.' The two agreed at once. At a small table by the window on the second floor of the bookstore, she took out her journal and worked with Uncle Qin on kraft paper to plan the event details: set the theme, poster placement (bookshelves, campus BBS), and drifting rules (one book for another, write a graduation message). She drew a small night light in the corner of the poster draft with a pen, symbolizing 'words light the way forward.'
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Browsing bookstores and choosing second-hand books
description: After finishing their business talk, Sun Yuwei browsed leisurely in the shop and found a copy of Wang Zengqi's “The Taste of Life” for her mother and “I Would Die for You,” which she wanted to read herself. Uncle Qin smiled and gave them to her as graduation gifts. She happily thanked him and bought a postcard printed with old Kunming street scenes, planning to write to her older sister in faraway Shenzhen.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with her older sister and a stroll around Green Lake.
description: Under the ivy-covered pergola outside the bookstore, she received a WeChat video call from her elder sister Sun Yutong. Seeing the bookstore surroundings, her sister guessed she was at their usual place again. After learning that her thesis defense had been excellent, she cheered, then talked about a project she had just taken on and encouraged her younger sister to keep writing well. They chatted for about 20 minutes and agreed to return to Kunming in July to eat mushroom hot pot. After hanging up, she went back into the bookstore, used her phone to photograph her favorite corners such as the new book pile by the window and the goldfish bowl on the cashier counter, then strolled along Cuihu South Road carrying her books and unfinished milk tea, turned into Cuihu Park, sat for a while on a lakeside bench, feeling the moist wind blow as she watched wild ducks glide leisurely across the water, and took photos on her phone to remember the moment.
location: Outdoor wooden pergola at Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Cuihu Park (Cuihu South Road).

name: On the way, stop at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket to buy supplies.
description: Leaving Cuihu Lake, she walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street and bought fresh pork liver, beef tenderloin, red-fleshed dragon fruit, and blueberries according to the list. At the flower shop next to the fresh food section, she carefully picked a bouquet of pale purple lisianthus with white daisies to add life to the home. After checking out, she donated the old clothes she had packed earlier at the entrance.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk home
description: Carrying supermarket shopping bags and flowers, walked 10 minutes back home on Renmin Middle Road. The rain had stopped and the sky was gradually brightening.
location: Fuchun Street to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home and share fun stories with my mother.
description: When she got home, her mother was preparing dinner. Sun Yuwei put the lisianthuses in a vase, placed the ingredients in the refrigerator, and gave her mother 'The Taste of Life', explaining that it was a graduation gift from Uncle Qin. As the mother and daughter trimmed vegetables and chatted in the kitchen, she vividly told the story of the book-crossing activity she had planned with Uncle Qin and her phone call with her older sister. Her mother was very happy to hear it.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. After learning about the old-book drifting plan, her father Sun Mingyuan said he could support it by selecting books of literary value from the old books being disposed of at his workplace. Her mother filled a full bowl of beef brisket stewed with radish for Sun Yuwei, feeling sorry that she had lost weight from moving books. Sun Yuwei also shared Professor Wu's comments at the thesis defense, and her parents' pride was written all over their faces.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After the meal, tidy up and arrange the room.
description: After helping clear away the dishes, I returned to the bedroom. I trimmed the newly bought lisianthus and arranged them in the white ceramic vase on the nightstand, placed the secondhand books I'd picked up in the bay-window reading corner, dusted the desk, turned on the aroma diffuser with sweet orange essential oil, and got ready for evening writing.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and brainstorming old-book drifting
description: Putting on earphones and playing an indie folk playlist, she used a fountain pen to record the day in detail in her cherry-blossom-colored journal: she pasted in a small photo of the ginkgo path, a sticky note with a sketch of the bookstore event, and a corner of the supermarket receipt, and drew the ideal display rack design for the old-book drifting activity with colored pens, writing the copywriting golden line: “A book’s drifting is the soul fragments we exchange in summer as we cross the sea of people.” She was completely immersed, and time flew by.
location: Home bedroom study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading The Stranger before bedtime.
description: Under the small lamp on the bay window, I opened Camus's The Stranger and read Meursault's courtroom monologue, gaining a new insight into the absurd. I copied the sentences describing the afternoon light and shadows into the margin of my journal, and drew a figure sitting on a bench.
location: Bedroom bay window at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening washing up and relaxing meditation
description: I went to the bathroom to wash up, applied body lotion, changed into silk pajamas, sat on the carpet by the bed, and used the Tide app for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation. Following the guidance, I focused on my breathing, imagined myself as calm as the water of Green Lake, and swept away the day's fatigue.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: I turned off the light and lay down, running through tomorrow's plan in my head: in the morning, send the complete old-book crossing plan to Uncle Qin for confirmation, and say goodnight to my sister. With anticipation for the upcoming book-crossing activity and the warmth of family, I fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and light stretching
description: Woke up naturally after the morning alarm, feeling well rested. Drank half a glass of warm water on an empty stomach, then stood by the bedroom bay window and did 5 minutes of shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches to relieve the soreness from moving books the day before. After stretching, she washed up and applied skincare.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and information processing
description: My mother had prepared small-pot rice noodles with a poached egg and braised beef. While eating breakfast, I browsed my email and official accounts on my phone and replied to editor Xu Mingyuan's message about confirming the manuscript.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Went to Nanqiang Street for street-life observation and material collection
description: Departed from home at 08:30, walked to the metro station, took Line 5, transferred to Line 3, then Line 2 to Tangzixiang Station, and walked to Nanqiang Street. Ordered a hot Americano at the outdoor seating outside Xiangwang Café, took out a notebook to observe and record: street vendors, craftsmen, children, sketching with a pencil, recording conversations with a voice recorder, and collecting creative material.
location: Xiangwang Café on Nanqiang Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and immediate writing
description: At 11:00, I ended the observation and returned home the same way. Once home, I turned on the computer in the study and organized the observation material into a draft essay of about 1,200 words titled An Afternoon Symphony on Nanqiang Street, describing the interactions among street vendors, cooks, and diners.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and midday break
description: Mom made tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried seasonal greens, and rice. After the meal, I cleared the dishes and helped Mom turn the jar of pickled plums. Then I leaned back on the living room sofa, closed my eyes, listened to music, and rested.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Rest and organizing flower arrangement notes
description: After a lunch break of about 20 minutes, I browsed Dounan Flower Market photos and ikebana class notes in the study, organized and analyzed past flower arrangement works in my journal with illustrations and text, and wrote down new inspirations, such as using dead branches from Nanqiang Street as structural material.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to the yoga center, yoga class, and after-class cooperation discussion
description: At 14:00, she changed into yoga clothes and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, arriving at 14:15. She attended the vinyasa flow yoga class that started at 14:30, working on core and leg strength. After class, the studio owner He Lu proposed a collaboration, inviting her to design floral landscapes for the studio every month in exchange for covering her monthly card fee plus a subsidy. She readily agreed, and they discussed the initial details.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bought groceries on the way home.
description: Walked from the yoga studio to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and carefully selected dinner ingredients: pork liver, chicken breast, baby bok choy, tomatoes, and lemons.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Arrived home, helped with housework and handled ingredients
description: After returning home, she sorted the ingredients and put them in the refrigerator, then helped her mother prepare dinner: slicing and marinating the pork liver, and washing the greens. She also tidied the dried flowers on the balcony and pruned withered branches and leaves.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Catch-up journaling
description: In the study, used a journal to record the sights and sounds of Nanqiang Street and He Lu's invitation, and wrote down an inspiring sentence: 'Today I heard a wonderfully catchy street cry, like a gong warmed by the sun, with a voice carrying the burnt aroma of roasted erkuai.' To be used for future prose writing.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: Her father came home from work, and the family of three had dinner together. The main dishes were stir-fried pork liver and sautéed bok choy. At the dinner table, they shared what they had seen on Nanqiang Street and the flower-arranging invitation. Her parents were happy. Her father suggested reading more books, and her mother reminded her with concern not to get too tired.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: After-meal tidying and pre-class preparation.
description: After dinner, she took the initiative to wash the dishes and wipe down the stove. Then she returned to the study to set up her laptop and earphones, opened the online meeting software to check the network and microphone, and prepared a notebook and pen for the online class.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Online nonfiction writing workshop
description: The course started at 19:00. The instructor explained the story structure of nonfiction writing, from the three-act play to chronological restructuring. She took careful notes and asked questions in the discussion area. 20:30–20:40 was a break; she stood up to stretch and checked the network. At 20:40, she continued studying model essay analysis and how to build suspense and emotional tension, and she tried to fit the Nanqiang Street story into the model. The course ended at 21:30.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Post-class review and journal record.
description: After class, she opened her journal, quickly noted the workshop's core points (hooks, beats, emotional arcs), summarized the day's important events and takeaways, and wrote a closing line: a fulfilling day with unexpected delights, and the door to a new world slowly opening.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Nighttime bedtime routine
description: At 22:15 began evening skincare and washing up, changed into pajamas, and organized things for the next day. At 22:40 leaned against the headboard and read the chapter on analytical reading in How to Read a Book for 10 minutes. At 23:00 turned off electronic devices, did a 10-minute bedtime meditation, then went to sleep.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning warm water and campus stroll
description: Sun Yuwei woke up naturally to the sound of her alarm clock, feeling refreshed. She first drank a glass of warm water on an empty stomach, then washed up simply and changed into light sportswear. At 07:10, she left home and walked to Yunnan University's Donglu Campus. She strolled leisurely for 15 minutes on the paths beside Ginkgo Avenue and the bell tower, savoring the birdsong and tranquility of the morning campus, mentally preparing for this milestone day.
location: Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Revising the final draft, printing, and binding
description: Sun Yuwei entered the Donglu Campus library, sat in a corner by the window, and opened her laptop. Referring to the screenshots of the defense committee's suggestions saved on her phone, she carefully revised the final draft of her thesis, correcting the wording in the conclusion and refining the formatting of two references. At 07:55, after confirming everything was correct, she selected "Jiahui Printing (Huancheng West Road Store)" in the cloud printing mini program, uploaded the file, and chose a yellow coated-paper cover with perfect binding for 4 copies. At 08:10 she walked to the print shop. She arrived at 08:35 and paid after confirming the print quality was perfect.
location: Jiahui Graphics (Huancheng West Road Store), Huancheng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Submitting the paper and sharing the joy
description: Carrying the four bound copies of her thesis, Sun Yuwei walked back from the print shop to the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University. She went straight to the office building of the School of Liberal Arts, submitted the thesis to the academic affairs teacher, and neatly signed her name on the "Thesis Submission Confirmation Form". After checking it and finding nothing wrong, the teacher smiled and congratulated her: "Sun Yuwei, well done. Congratulations on graduating!" She happily thanked her, filled with a sense of accomplishment. After leaving the office, she immediately sent a WeChat message to her mother: "Mom! The thesis was submitted successfully! The teacher said it was great!" with a victory emoji.
location: Office of the School of Literature, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Small Joys on the Way Home
description: After receiving a loving emoji reply from her mother, Sun Yuwei walked home in a pleasant mood. Passing by Green Lake Park, she stopped to take a photo of the shimmering lake with her phone and casually posted it on Moments with the caption: "The dust has settled; a new chapter begins." On the way, she was also thinking about how to plan the rest of the day once she got home. At 09:45, she pushed open the door.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focused creation and milestone confirmation
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei excitedly hugged her mother. After briefly sharing the joy of submitting her thesis, she plunged into her study. She opened her class notes and began to conceive the writing workshop assignment 'Lane Entrance.' Using her observations from Nanqiang Street a few days earlier and the 'scene-conflict-resolution' structure learned in the online workshop, she smoothly wrote a story of about 1,600 words about an old grandmother who ran a photo studio in an alley. During this time (around 10:30), a text message alert sounded, and she caught a glimpse of the 2,000 yuan quarterly bonus from the 'Kunming Slice' column arriving in her account. Her heart leaped with joy, but she suppressed the excitement and continued focusing on the assignment. At 10:50, she submitted the story to the workshop system. Then she took out her dedicated accounting notebook, added the previous 8,000 yuan and the bonus, solemnly wrote 'Total: 10,000 yuan,' and drew a smiley face and the mark 'Flight Fund Achieved!' beside it.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Assisting with meal preparation and a joyful lunch
description: Sun Yuwei walked out of the study with an irrepressible smile on her face. As she helped her mother bring lunch to the table, she animatedly recounted her morning at school. Her mother was warmed by her joy, and the mother and daughter enjoyed lunch in a warm atmosphere. The dishes were braised beef, garlic broccoli, and bitter greens in clear soup, which her mother had specially prepared.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Planning three afternoon tasks
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei decided to take a 15-minute nap. When the alarm rang, she sat at her desk, took out her TN journal, and used a dark green fountain pen to plan the afternoon schedule: 1. Go to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore to buy "An Illustrated Album of Old Kunming Architecture" for her father; 2. Go for a walk in Green Lake Park and select a bunch of daisies for her mother; 3. Go home and write reading notes on "The Art of Travel."
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Gift shopping and a stroll in the park
description: Sun Yuwei walked to Zhibushi Bookstore. As soon as she entered, she shared the good news about her thesis and the prize money with the owner, Uncle Qin Mingyuan. While congratulating her, Qin Mingyuan brought out a copy of the Old Kunming Architecture Album from the back room and handed it to her: "I knew you'd come. I saved it for your father—this is my last copy!" Sun Yuwei happily bought the book and asked Qin Mingyuan to recommend a reliable flower shop nearby. Following his directions, she found a flower shop called "Flower Time" on Cuihu West Road and carefully chose a bouquet of yellow-green daisies mixed with lisianthus. After paying, she carried the flowers to Cuihu Park, sat on a bench by the lake, soaked up the sun, watched people come and go, and enjoyed a leisurely afternoon.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading notes and family time
description: After getting home, Sun Yuwei first put the daisies into a vase and placed them on the living room coffee table, and the whole room immediately came alive. Then she went back to her bedroom, opened Chapter 5 of The Art of Travel, read carefully and took notes, focusing on the author’s discussion of “exoticism” and “the anticipation of travel.” At 16:30, she closed the book, walked into the kitchen, tied on an apron, and began helping her mother pick vegetables and peel garlic to prepare dinner. Mother and daughter chatted about the afternoon’s experiences and the bookstore owner’s story.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and laying the groundwork for the plan
description: When her father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, he immediately noticed the bright bunch of daisies on the living room coffee table and the album Old Architecture of Kunming beside them, and looked curious. Sun Yuwei smiled mysteriously without explaining right away. At dinner, the family of three chatted as they ate, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere. Sun Mingyuan was in a good mood that day and proactively talked about a very interesting neighborhood conservation planning project at work, which Sun Yuwei listened to with relish.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Officially announcing the Sanya plan.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei solemnly asked her parents to sit down on the living room sofa. She took a deep breath and, slightly excited, announced the good news that her column bonus had arrived and her travel fund had reached 10,000 yuan. She formally proposed: 'Mom and Dad, during the winter break at the end of the year, I want to use this money to take you both to Sanya!' Then she showed the draft itinerary in her phone memos, describing the imagined beach, coconut groves, and seafood feast. Her mother Li Xiulan's eyes reddened instantly; she hugged her daughter tightly and said yes over and over. Her father Sun Mingyuan tried to stay calm, but the smile at the corners of his mouth could not be hidden. He patted his daughter on the shoulder and said: 'My girl has grown up!'
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family discussion and video call to share good news
description: The atmosphere at home immediately became lively. Her parents began to discuss it eagerly, with her mother worried that Sanya would be crowded in winter, while her father was very interested in the seafood market. Sun Yuwei immediately made a video call to her older sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen. Hearing the news, Sun Yutong cheered loudly on the other end of the screen and said that when she returned to Kunming in July, she would make her younger sister treat her to a wild mushroom hot pot as a "celebration." The family burst into laughter across the screen, and basically settled on an initial plan of a 5-7 day self-guided trip during the winter vacation.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and Wandering in the Sea of Books
description: After her parents went back to their room to rest, Sun Yuwei's excitement still had not subsided. She returned to her bedroom, opened her journal, and used the metallic stickers she had received today as a prize as the background, recording in detail three milestones: thesis submitted, award money received, and family meeting. She also pasted in a printed card of the Cuihu lake photo she took today, the florist's receipt, and a piece of book-cover paper. Then she picked up The Art of Travel and leaned against the bed, reading quietly for half an hour, deeply drawn to the chapter on exoticism.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: At 21:30, Sun Yuwei turned off the desk lamp and went to the bathroom to wash up and apply skincare. She carefully applied moisturizing lotion, smiled at herself in the mirror, and thought about the full and rewarding day — her heart filled with satisfaction and warmth. At 22:00, she returned to bed and did a 10-minute bedtime meditation, grateful for all the wonderful things that had happened. At 23:00, she turned off the light and fell asleep deeply with a smile.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and information sync
description: Waking up in the morning, she drank the warm water her mother had prepared, picked up her phone to check messages, and saw a WeChat message from editor Xu Mingyuan sent in the early hours, informing her that the column article fee would be raised to 350 yuan per 1,000 characters. Filled with gratitude and motivation, she immediately composed a sincere reply.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretching and sharing joy
description: She went to the balcony and did a simple set of stretching movements to loosen up her body. Seeing her mother preparing breakfast, she excitedly shared the good news about the increase in writing fees. Her mother smiled and was happy for Yuwei, and reminded her to plan the day well.
location: Balcony of the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Confirm the payment details and discuss the topic selection
description: Back in the study, I opened my laptop and had a WeChat voice call with the editor Xu Mingyuan, further discussing the details of the fee adjustment and confirming that the new rate would take effect starting from the next column. At the same time, we discussed a new topic direction — the survival of Kunming's old bookstores during graduation season. Inspired, I decided to submit the draft next week.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Systematically gather Sanya travel guides
description: Officially began planning the Sanya trip. Opened several travel apps and comprehensively looked up Sanya's climate features, popular attractions (Nanshan Temple, Wuzhizhou Island, Yalong Bay), local food (coconut chicken, Lingshui sour noodles), and well-reviewed family-style resort hotels. I wrote down the key information in my A5 journal with different colored pens, and used sticky notes to mark two categories for my parents: “cultural attractions” and “leisure beaches”.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flower arrangement practice and relaxation
description: Stepping away from the travel guide for a moment, she walked to the balcony and cut a few blooming blue plumbago and mint sprigs from the flowerpots her mother had been tending. She casually arranged them in a small bamboo tube into an elegant linear composition. This was her daily Ikenobo practice; ten minutes of focus gave her mind a rest and brought a touch of cool green to the study.
location: Balcony of the living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and itinerary discussion
description: At lunchtime, the family of three sat around the dining table. Yuwei excitedly shared with her parents the good news of a higher manuscript fee and the Sanya travel guide she was working on, and specifically asked about her parents' preferences for attractions. Her mother was very eager to visit Nanshan Temple, while her father preferred to find a quiet beach hotel and rest well. She carefully noted these suggestions in her journal to prepare for finalizing the itinerary later.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, she felt a little sleepy, returned to the bedroom, lay on the bed, and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes. The short rest helped her regain energy and build up strength for the afternoon tasks.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Refined the travel plan and sorted out the leaving-school checklist
description: Feeling refreshed, I continued to refine the morning's travel guide, focusing on transportation (shuttle from the airport to the hotel) and accommodation (shortlisting two family apartments that fit the budget and had good reviews). After that, I switched tasks, turned to a new page in my journal, and began listing a 'Graduation Checkout Checklist': return library books, cancel the student ID, deal with dorm luggage, collect the diploma and degree certificate... Finally, I solemnly picked up my pen and crossed out the first item, 'Submit final thesis draft,' feeling a great sense of accomplishment.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Refuel and get ready to go out
description: Feeling a bit thirsty, I decided to go out for some fresh air. I brought my water bottle, wallet, and phone, changed my shoes at the door, and planned to buy something at the nearby convenience store, then browse at the bookstore I usually go to.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Convenience store shopping
description: She walked to Miaoning Convenience Store near the neighborhood. She bought a bottle of her usual mineral water and also grabbed a box of yogurt. At the checkout, she saw flower cakes on the shelf and remembered that Uncle Qin liked them, so she packed two portions to take to the bookstore.
location: Miaoning Convenience Store (Fuchun Branch), No. 66 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visit Mingyuan Bookstore
description: After leaving the convenience store, she walked along Wenlin Street to the familiar Mingyuan Bookstore. The bookstore was very quiet, and Uncle Qin was tidying the shelves. Yuwei handed him the flower cakes she had brought and then talked about her graduation plans and the trip to Sanya. At Uncle Qin's recommendation, she found a book about Hainan's Li and Miao ethnic cultures and a picture album about island architecture, intending to add cultural depth to the trip.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 146 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A walk in Cuihu Park and inspiration gathering.
description: After leaving the bookstore, she walked along the tree-lined path of Cuihu West Road into Green Lake Park. The evening breeze brushed across the lake, bringing a hint of coolness. Wearing earphones and listening to soft piano music, she thought about the angle for the article about the old bookstore that she had just discussed with the editor. She sat on a lakeside bench for a while, jotted down a few key sentences in her phone memo, and envisioned a warm segment for the Sanya trip: "watch the sunset over the sea with Mom and Dad at dusk."
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home for dinner with family
description: Walking home in the glow of the setting sun. Her mother had already prepared dinner. At the table, Yuwei talked about her discoveries at the bookstore that afternoon and the inspiration she had gained from her walk, and the family enjoyed dinner together in a warm and happy atmosphere. Her father also said he was looking forward to the "Sunset at Sea" suggestion.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Fruit platter and rest after the meal
description: After the meal, she cleared the dishes with her mother, then sat in the living room eating fruit and watched the news for a while.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with best friend Zhang Jing.
description: Back in her bedroom, she connected a WeChat video call with her good friend Zhang Jing on time. Yuwei excitedly shared three pieces of good news: an excellent grade on her thesis defense, a raise in her column writing fee, and taking her parents to Sanya. Zhang Jing was happy for her and shared a small amusing story about teaching at school. The two agreed that before Yuwei left school, they must find a weekend to visit the newly opened 'Rubber Bookstore' again.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing journal and reading before bed
description: After hanging up the phone, she sat down at her desk, opened her journal, and carefully pasted in the Sanya travel guide information she had gathered today, the receipt from Mingyuan Bookstore, and the inspiration notes from her walk around Green Lake, adding categorized annotations. This gave her a feeling of orderly satisfaction. Then, after washing up, she changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, picked up the copy of Dream of the Red Chamber that had been by her side for a long time, and casually read a couple of chapters, immersing herself in the world of classical literature.
location: Home study and bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for sleep and drifting into dreams
description: At 22:30, the phone alarm went off. She closed her book, turned off the ceiling light, and left only a small nightlight on. Lying in bed, she quickly reviewed the fulfilling day: she had received professional recognition, the family trip now had a clear direction, and she had shared her joy with a good friend in the evening. With this sense of certainty and satisfaction, she fell into a deep sleep before 23:00, ending this extremely productive and wonderful summer Friday.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Early morning preparation and breakfast
description: On a rainy morning, Sun Yuwei got up at 7 o'clock sharp. After a quick wash, she drank a glass of warm water to wake up. Her mother had prepared steaming small-pot rice noodles with soft-yolk fried eggs and homemade sour radish. The two talked as they ate about the editor's message about a raise in her writing fee, and her mother encouraged her to keep up the good work. After the meal, she checked her yoga bag, took her umbrella, put on her earphones, and got ready to go out.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cycled to the yoga studio in the rain
description: Sun Yuwei, holding an umbrella, scanned a shared bike at the entrance of the residential community and rode for about 15 minutes to the yoga studio. The rain was fine and dense, and she carefully avoided vehicles. She finally parked downstairs at Dechun Commercial Building and took the elevator to the 4th floor.
location: The route from Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road.

name: Morning yoga practice
description: At Zhongmou Yoga Studio, teacher He Lu led the students in a themed practice of “Shoulder Opening and Spinal Twist.” With soothing music and the teacher's gentle cues, Sun Yuwei carefully completed each pose. The tightness in her shoulders and neck was noticeably relieved, and after class she felt calm in both body and mind.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After class, returning home and shopping along the way
description: After the yoga class ended, the rain paused briefly. Sun Yuwei bought a hot brown sugar pearl milk tea at Yidian Milk Tea Shop on the first floor of Dechun Commercial Building to treat herself, then walked to the bus stop, took bus No. 89 for three stops, got off at Huashan West Road Station, and walked home.
location: The Yidiandian Milk Tea Shop at Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the area along Cuihu Community

name: Make a Sanya travel plan and print it.
description: After changing into loungewear, Sun Yuwei used a laptop in her study to consolidate the travel guides she had collected earlier, created a document covering attractions, hotels, and transportation options, copied it to a USB flash drive, walked to the nearby Ping'an Printing and Copy Shop, and printed three color copies for her parents to flip through.
location: Study at home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Ping'an Graphics, No. 107 Luofeng Street

name: Family lunch.
description: At lunchtime, her mother made green pepper stir-fried pork, stir-fried pea shoots, cold cucumber salad, and tomato and egg soup. Sun Yuwei brought up that she was working on travel plans. Her father expressed support and reminded her to book a sea-view room in advance, while her mother hoped the itinerary would not be too rushed.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday reading.
description: After helping Mother clear the dishes and chopsticks, Sun Yuwei went back to the bedroom, leaned against the headboard, took out Ye Shengtao's Wen Xin, and read for about 20 minutes. The sky outside the window was gloomy, and the atmosphere inside was quiet for reading.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon nap
description: Sun Yuwei set a 30-minute alarm and lay down for a nap to recharge for the afternoon family discussion.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family trip discussion and afternoon tea
description: After waking from her nap, Sun Yuwei spread the printed travel plan on the living room coffee table, and the three of them sat around and began a formal discussion. She explained the itinerary in detail, from checking into the hotel to going to the First Market on the last day. Her father approved renting a car and self-driving; her mother had some concerns about the intensity of the one-day trip to Wuzhizhou Island. In the end, they settled on a basic framework of four sightseeing days and one free day, tentatively scheduled for the first week after leaving school upon graduation. After the discussion, her mother cut a plate of watermelon, and mother and daughter relaxed on the sofa scrolling through their phones, enjoying some easy time.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling time.
description: Sun Yuwei sat at the desk by the living room window, took out her A5 loose-leaf journal, colored pencils, and glue, and reviewed the week's key events: her thesis defense was rated excellent, the bonus arrived, the manuscript fee increased, and today's family meeting. She drew a simple timeline, pasted in the café napkins and dried maple leaves she had collected earlier, wrote down her reflections with a fountain pen, and finished organizing the journal before dinner.
location: Desk in front of the living room window at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: For dinner, her mother made sauce-fried eggplant, steamed sea bass, and seaweed and egg drop soup. The family talked about the trip again, and her father said he would ask about the annual leave approval process at his work unit tomorrow. The dinner table was full of anticipation for the family trip.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxation and socializing after the meal
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei stood on the balcony and stared blankly at the night view of Green Lake for a while, then sent a WeChat message to her best friend Zhang Jing to update her on the progress of the travel plan, and scrolled through Xiaohongshu, saving an article about character interview techniques.
location: Balcony and living room of home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Nonfiction writing workshop course
description: She entered the study ten minutes early, locked the door, checked the microphone and camera, put on headphones, and logged into the workshop meeting link.
