The course topic was "Interview Skills: Opening the Interviewee's Heart." The instructor explained open-ended questioning and empathetic listening. In the mock interview segment, Sun Yuwei did role play with another participant, using the newly learned skill to ask, "What was the most memorable trip of your childhood?" She gained a lot and filled three full pages of notes. After class, she spent 15 minutes organizing the key methods into a mind map and did a few minutes of neck and shoulder stretches to relieve the fatigue of prolonged sitting.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online meeting platform)

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After changing into her pajamas, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and continued reading the chapter of The Literary Mind that had been interrupted during the day. The rain had stopped outside the window, and the air was fresh. About 20 minutes later, drowsiness set in. She turned off the bedside lamp, set the alarm for 8:30 the next morning, recalled the well-planned arrangement of the day, and fell into a deep sleep with contentment.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning reading and balcony time
description: I woke up naturally in the quiet Sunday morning light. After getting up, I first went to the kitchen and drank a glass of warm water to wake up my body. Then, wearing loose loungewear, I walked to the south-facing balcony, sat down in a rattan chair, opened Haruki Murakami's What I Talk About When I Talk About Running, and read intently for half an hour amid the occasional birdsong from downstairs and the greenery of Green Lake Park in the distance, letting the words settle in my mind.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Interview technique simulation practice
description: After finishing her balcony reading, she returned to the study and began mock interview practice. First, she opened her laptop and created a document named "Interview Practice - Dad", and listed at the top the key points learned in yesterday's workshop: "open-ended questions", "follow-up questioning techniques", and "nonverbal signals in listening". Considering that her father, Sun Mingyuan, spoke little and was introverted, she decided to start from specific scenarios and designed questions such as "Dad, what was summer like at Green Lake Park when you were little? Were there vendors selling ice pops?" and added several hypothetical follow-up paths. Then, holding the printed interview outline and a pen, she went to the living room to ask her father to help with a mock interview. She started recording with her phone, chatting from the old cinema by Green Lake to the rice noodle shop that had disappeared from the street corner, successfully digging up details about firewood and handmade chili sauce. After the interview, she returned to the study, put on earphones, listened to the recording while organizing the transcript, faithfully recording her father's Kunming dialect narration, and marking the key moments where she had successfully used follow-up techniques. Finally, she packaged the transcript and interview reflections and submitted them via email as the workshop assignment.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study and living room)

name: Warm family lunch
description: Mom made stir-fried peppers with pork and cucumber salad. At the table, Sun Yuwei vividly recounted the fun of interviewing Dad, imitating the blissful look on his face when he recalled braised erkuai, making Mom laugh uncontrollably. Dad said "It's not that exaggerated," but the corners of his eyes were full of smiles. The family ate and chatted together, in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday meditation
description: After lunch, I returned to my room, drew the curtains, and took a 30-minute nap in the quiet atmosphere. When I woke up, I didn't get up immediately. Instead, I lay in bed listening to the occasional birdsong outside the window, letting my thoughts drift, gathering inspiration for the afternoon's copywriting.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Finalizing and writing the copy for the Graduation Season Used-Book Drifting Activity
description: After her lunch break, feeling refreshed, she sat down at her desk and first called Qin Mingyuan to finalize the theme, venue layout, and participation process for the graduation-season used-book drifting event. Uncle Qin mentioned that a few long tables could be placed under the old locust tree at the entrance of Mingyuan Bookstore. Sun Yuwei had an idea and suggested using twine and clips to hang participants' reading messages on the branches, creating a beautiful sight. The two agreed on the core theme of the event, "Making Friends Through Books: A Summer Farewell and Heritage," and confirmed all the details. After hanging up, she made a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea, opened a document, and started writing the event copy. With delicate strokes, she depicted the story of an old book circulating during graduation season, weaving in the meaning of parting and the passing on of books on a university campus. Every line was filled with nostalgia for campus life and warmth for the transmission of knowledge. She was completely absorbed in the writing, and the copy was emotionally rich and touching.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Owner of Mingyuan Bookstore, an elder

location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Resting, relaxing, and keeping in touch with friends
description: After writing for a long time, she got up and moved around. She went to the living room, and while drinking water, sent a WeChat message to her good friend Zhang Jing: "Jing, I'm free all next week. How about we visit the 'Wheat Field Bookstore' you mentioned last time on Wednesday or Friday afternoon?" After sending it, she stood by the window looking at the street scene downstairs to relax her eyes.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal recording and material organization
description: She took out her beloved journal and used washi tape to make a small border in the corner. She copied the highlights from the morning interview with her father and the draft outline of the afternoon promotional copy into the journal in beautiful handwriting. Then she found a previous photo of the sky toward Green Lake on her phone, did a simple layout, printed it as a small photo, pasted it into the journal, and wrote: 'Today, from my father's memory, I smelled the Kunming of twenty years ago.'
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free-form creation and column topic brainstorming
description: Open a music app and play the collected Yunnan folk song playlist. While listening, doodle in the notebook and brainstorm topics for next week's column. The inspiration from yesterday's workshop and today's conversation with my dad came together, and I thought of writing a series about "Sound and Memory," starting from a girl from Kunming listening to her father describe the sounds of old streets, turning it into an essay that combines personal experience with urban change. She thinks this direction has great potential.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take an evening walk with my mother at Green Lake Park.
description: As the weather turned cooler, her mother suggested taking a walk in Cuihu Park. The mother and daughter changed into flat shoes, left at 17:30, and strolled slowly along Renmin Middle Road for about 15 minutes to reach Cuihu Park. On the way, her mother talked about wanting to go to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market next week to buy fresh wild mushrooms, while Sun Yuwei mentioned the column she was planning. Her mother gave her many ideas about the sounds of old Kunming, such as the cries of tofu pudding vendors and the storytelling voices in teahouses. When they arrived at Cuihu Park, the sunset glow had dyed half the sky red. Sun Yuwei used her phone to photograph the beautiful scene, capturing a peaceful and lovely Sunday evening. During the walk, they also naturally talked about plans after graduation and her sister's recent phone calls. Sun Yuwei also suggested accompanying her mother to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market next week to learn how to pick fresh ingredients. The conversation between mother and daughter was warm and casual, and the walk lasted about 45 minutes.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (No. 67, Cuihu South Road)

name: Dinner time and housework
description: After returning from the walk, her mother began preparing dinner, and Sun Yuwei took the initiative to help pick vegetables and set out the bowls and chopsticks. Dinner was simple tomato and egg noodles, accompanied by the sour pickled radish her mother had made, refreshing and tasty. After the meal, she hurried to clear the dishes and wipe the table clean.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading of “I Am”
description: Returned to the study, turned on the desk lamp, took out Zhang Xiaofeng's prose collection "I Am", and casually opened a page to start reading. When I read the piece "Mother's Feathered Robe", I remembered the evening walk with my mother and felt my heart fill with warm, soft emotions. I also flipped through the journal I had organized today and felt that the day had been very fulfilling. Before bed, I continued reading Zhang Xiaofeng's prose collection for half an hour, until 21:00.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Before-bed relaxation and yoga reading
description: First, she took a hot shower and changed into comfortable pajamas. Back in the bedroom, she did a simple set of shoulder and neck stretches and relaxing bedtime yoga moves in front of the mirror. Then she sat on the edge of the bed, opened a new page in her journal, and wrote a few lines of today's reflections: 'Family interaction plus creative output makes for an ideal weekend.' Then she turned off the main light, leaving only a warm yellow bedside lamp, picked up Zhang Xiaofeng's essay collection, and read for another 20 minutes until sleepiness came.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to bed
description: Turning off the bedside lamp, I quickly fell asleep in quiet contentment, ending this full and delightful Sunday.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning yoga.
description: Before the alarm went off, Sun Yuwei woke naturally in the faint morning light. Still in her pajamas, she got up and drank the large half glass of warm water she had poured on her desk the night before, waking her sleeping body. Then she did some simple stretches on the yoga mat and a few cat-cow poses, letting her mind settle into the day's rhythm—the school departure procedures, the article post, and the evening writing class.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and a simple breakfast
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei tied her hair into a high ponytail and changed into a light blue shirt and off-white trousers. According to today's plan, to get to the library early to return books, she skipped the cafeteria and quickly ate the bread and milk she had bought last night, then stuffed her library card and the paperwork for leaving school into her canvas bag.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the library
description: Sun Yuwei walked out of the dormitory building with her canvas bag and headed toward the library along the main campus road. The morning air was fresh and slightly cool. She slowed down and silently noted the scenery along the way: the orange cat basking in the sun downstairs, the newly posted lecture poster at the canteen entrance, trying to capture the last campus memories with her eyes.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (route from Ziyuan Dormitory to the Library)

name: Return books and complete the first step of the school-leaving procedures
description: After arriving at the library, Sun Yuwei used the self-service borrowing/returning machine to return the last three borrowed books one by one: "Border Town," "The Three of Us," and "The Biography of Su Dongpo." The system prompted "Return successful," and she went to the service desk to ask the librarian to confirm there were no outstanding fees. The librarian stamped the first "Library Cancellation Seal" on the graduation clearance form and said with a smile, "Congratulations on graduating." This simple act made her truly feel the weight of farewell.
location: First-floor main service desk, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus Library, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Step two in completing the school-leaving procedures
description: Leaving the library, Sun Yuwei walked about 15 minutes to the Student Affairs Center. At the "Departure Services" window, she handed in her student ID and the confirmation form. After checking, the staff stamped the form with a "Student ID Canceled" seal. Fewer and fewer blank spaces remained on the form, and her college life was about to come to an end. She carefully placed the form into her folder.
location: Student Affairs Center, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return to the dormitory
description: After completing the school-leaving procedures, Sun Yuwei felt both relieved and conflicted. She walked back along the campus path; passing Ziyuan Canteen, she smelled the aroma of steamed buns, but she had already eaten breakfast, so she continued toward the dormitory to prepare for the upcoming post publication.
location: Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (route from the Student Affairs Center to Ziyuan Dormitory)

name: Edit and publish the promotional post for the used-book drifting event.
description: Back in the dormitory, Sun Yuwei opened her laptop and integrated the event copy, the poster designed by Qin Mingyuan, and the detailed process into a single package. Then she edited and laid it out on the backend of the "Yunnan University Campus Account" and the "Mingyuan Bookstore" official accounts. She repeatedly checked for typos and formatting to ensure the post was rich in both text and images. Finally, she took a deep breath, scheduled the post for 11:20, and prepared in advance the message she would share on WeChat Moments.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Have lunch with roommates
description: At noon, three roommates returned to the dorm after class or errands, and the four of them agreed to go to Ziyuan Restaurant. They ordered boiled pork slices, dry-fried green beans, and tomato and egg soup. At the table, they talked about how the article was spreading. Liu Jia said she saw many classmates sharing it, and Xiaowen said the article had been liked. Yuwei shared the "sense of ritual" of stamping that morning, and the atmosphere was warm and lively.
location: Second Floor, Ziyuan Restaurant, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and personal time.
description: After lunch she returned to the dormitory, and her roommates each went about their own business. Yuwei lay in bed, scrolling through her Moments, and saw that the article had been published on time. Waves of reposts and comments like "targeted" and "so meaningful" poured in, and she felt a wave of satisfying accomplishment. Then she closed her eyes and took a 20-minute nap.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon tea and discussion about preparing the graduation dinner
description: After a short nap, Sun Yuwei got up. She took a carton of yogurt and a pack of soda crackers from her snack box as an afternoon snack. She cleaned up the dormitory carpet, arranged four floor cushions, and took out nice pens and letter paper from the bookshelf, preparing for the afternoon's "graduation dinner planning meeting" with her roommates.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discuss the graduation dinner and the handwritten letter pact.
description: At 2 p.m., the roommates finished their tasks one after another, and the four of them sat in a circle on the dormitory carpet. Sunlight streamed through the window onto the old wooden floor. They officially finalized the time (evening of June 16), location (a Yunnan restaurant near the school called "Yunshangyao"), and format of the graduation dinner. Most importantly, Sun Yuwei proposed that each person handwrite a letter, and it was warmly received. Zhou Lin immediately pulled out four sheets of vintage stationery, and the four of them laughingly agreed to exchange these youth-sealed words at the dinner.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening solitude and campus stroll
description: After the discussion, the roommates went off to their own tasks. Sun Yuwei put on her earphones and walked out of the dorm alone. She first went to the convenience store and bought a bottle of cold tamarind juice. She strolled slowly along the tree-lined path by Ze Lake, watching the ducks swimming and water lilies in the lake, and gradually calmed down. Finally, she walked to the bleachers of the sports field, sat down, took out her watercolor pens and journal, and drew the dinner plan and the ceremonial feeling of stamping.
location: Ze Lake tree-lined avenue and sports field stands, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Simple meal with roommates
description: Coming back from the playground, she happened to run into Liu Jia, who had just returned to the dormitory. Neither of them wanted to go to the cafeteria again, so they used a small electric pot to cook two bowls of instant noodles, adding ham sausage and eggs. They played a variety show as background sound, eating and chatting about post-graduation plans, spending a relaxed and ordinary dinner time.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-class preparation and organizing notes
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei sat down at her desk, plugged in her computer, entered the online meeting software ahead of time, and adjusted her headset and microphone. Then she took out her notes from the previous workshop and reviewed the key points on "interviewing techniques" to prepare for the upcoming third session.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attend a nonfiction writing workshop course
description: At 7:10 in the evening, the class began on time. Teacher Wu Mingyuan's topic was “Structural Organization and Narrative Rhythm Control in Nonfiction Writing.” When commenting on Sun Yuwei's “family interview” assignment, the teacher noted that she showed potential in scene reconstruction but suggested adding more subtle sensory details. Yuwei took careful notes and, during the post-class discussion, asked a question about balancing subjective emotion with objective narration, receiving a detailed answer from the teacher.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online course)

name: After-class cleanup and late-night chat with roommates
description: After the class ended, Sun Yuwei turned off her computer, feeling fulfilled in both body and mind. She stretched and noticed that her three roommates had all finished washing up and were lying in bed or scrolling through their phones. She walked to the balcony to enjoy the evening breeze for a while, then came back and softly shared what she had gained tonight. Everyone chatted a bit about writing details, then the conversation turned back to graduation. Laughter and conversation echoed in the quiet dormitory.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and journaling
description: The late-night chat ended and the dorm gradually grew quiet. Sun Yuwei turned on the bedside lamp, leaned against the headboard, and took out Stephen King's 'On Writing' to read for 20 minutes. The advice in the book confirmed what was taught in tonight's class, and she benefited a lot. After reading, she took out the journal with that day's entries, made a few quick additions, and marked keywords such as '6.9 First Step Away from School, Dorm Night Talk, Writing Class Takeaways.'
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: At 22:30, Yuwei got out of bed and went to wash up. After coming back, she did a few simple pre-bed stretches to relax. She set her phone alarm, turned off the main light, and left only a small nightlight on. At 23:30, Sun Yuwei took one last look at her phone, then turned off the screen, turned off the light, and fell asleep on schedule. The day's scenes flashed through her mind like a movie: the library stamp, her roommates' smiles, the dinner plan, the teacher's comments... Carrying anticipation for the future and attachment to the past, she gradually fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 416, Building 3, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparations and commute.
description: After waking naturally with her biological clock, she got out of bed quietly and first drank a glass of warm water. Because she was nervous about the event, she only ate half a flower cake made by her mother, packed her canvas bag, and left with her camera, power bank, and "The Little Prince." She walked to the Huashan West Road bus stop and took bus K13 to Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus, silently reviewing the event schedule on the bus. After arriving at the North Gate, she quickened her pace toward the tree-lined square.
location: North Gate, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, East Outer Ring South Road, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Set up the event venue.
description: Together with Qin Mingyuan and volunteer Xiao Lin, they unloaded folding tables, display racks, and other supplies from the tricycle. They used hemp rope and clips to fasten the handwritten banner “Meet Friends Through Books: A Summer Farewell and Legacy” between two ginkgo trees. Uncle Qin set up the tabletops and built display stands from old books, while I placed the succulent pot I had brought at the corner of the table. The venue was beginning to take shape.
location: Linyin Square, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning used-book drifting activity.
description: The event officially began. Standing at the entrance, I guided the first batch of graduates to register their information, write messages on cards, and stick them on the title page of the book. Everyone's messages were sincere, such as "May you become a shining star." I raised my camera to capture the profile of a female student sticking her card on the page. Uncle Qin was nearby chatting with several professors about the old school history. More than 50 teachers and students participated.
location: Linyin Square, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stomach Discomfort and Rest
description: The sun rose higher, the temperature climbed, and her stomach began to ache dully, probably because she had an empty stomach and was nervous. After greeting Uncle Qin, she walked to Ziyuan Convenience Store, bought a pack of soda crackers and a bottle of hot honey citron tea, and sat on a chair outside the store, eating and drinking slowly. After resting for 15 minutes, her stomach felt much better.
location: Ziyuan Convenience Store, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Continue activities and services
description: After resting, I felt better and returned to the event. The crowd was growing; I was responsible for registration for the book-drifting activity and helping classmates who had trouble carrying books pack them up. A junior from the history department came over with a stack of books, excitedly saying she had found a copy of '1587, A Year of No Significance' left by a senior from the year above, with handwritten notes inside. This sense of legacy made all the hard work worth it.
location: Linyin Square, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and recovery
description: Went to the second floor of Ziyuan Restaurant and ordered a bowl of non-spicy clear-broth small-pot rice noodles with a fried egg. While eating, she scrolled through the morning photos on her phone, picked a few to edit, and planned to post an event update in the afternoon. She met two junior female students from the art department, who said they had seen the event post on Moments and came specially.
location: Second floor, Ziyuan Restaurant, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rafting craze
description: The afternoon activity reached a new peak; teachers living nearby and students' parents also brought their children to join. She guided a child to pick the picture book 'The Little Prince' and helped write a wish card. As books flowed, the table gradually emptied, and the registration sheet filled three full pages—over 80 students had participated, and the cumulative number of drifting books exceeded 200 volumes. After 16:00, the crowd gradually thinned, and she began to prepare for wrapping up.
location: Linyin Square, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Event wrap-up
description: Together with Uncle Qin and the volunteers, she counted the remaining books and carefully put away the registration forms and message cards. Then they took down the banner and display racks and moved the tables and chairs to the small truck Uncle Qin had parked on the roadside. Though tired, looking at the piled-up supplies, she felt deeply satisfied.
location: Linyin Square, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return materials to the bookstore
description: Rode in Uncle Qin's small truck and helped unload display racks, leftover books, and other supplies from the truck, storing them temporarily in the backyard of Zhibushi Bookstore. Uncle Qin said they would continue tomorrow, and they briefly discussed tomorrow's setup plan.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Chance encounter at dusk and an in-depth conversation.
description: When moving books in the backyard, Lin Shen took the initiative to help and recognized her as the event organizer. After moving the books, she rested in a corner of the bookstore's reading area. Seeing 'The Little Prince' in his canvas bag, she started talking with him about lines from the book and about the confusion and expectations of graduation. She learned that he was also a third-year master's student in the History Department at Yunnan University and was about to leave Kunming. Before parting, they exchanged WeChat contact information.
location: Reading Area, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk home
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Shen, she chose to walk home. The setting sun dyed the sky orange-pink. Walking past Cuihu Park and watching the lake glisten, she felt much lighter.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Mom had already made dinner: stir-fried Chinese broccoli, pickled vegetable stir-fry with pork, and chicken soup. I excitedly described the success of the event, especially the reflections of a junior from the history department. Mom listened with a beaming smile, and Dad, who rarely praises, said, 'That's more like it.'
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing event materials and debriefing
description: After showering, she sat at her desk, opened her laptop, and imported the photos from her camera and phone into folders by categories such as "check-in," "messages," "conversations," and "panorama." Then she took out her A5 loose-leaf notebook and wrote "Old Book Drift Event Review," recording the number of participants, total books, and issues such as the unstable tables and chairs and the strong afternoon sun, along with improvement plans.
location: Home desk at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and getting washed up.
description: I opened the journal, wrote the date and the keyword 'First Day of Old Book Drifting' with a mint green highlighter, pasted in a photo of a handwritten card from a classmate, drew an open book and a little fox, and wrote Lin Shen's WeChat nickname in the corner. Then I washed up briefly and changed into comfortable pajamas.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard of her bed, she read the passage about the fox in The Little Prince: 'It is the time you have wasted for your rose that makes your rose so important.' She was deeply moved. Afterwards, she did a simple ten-minute stretch to relieve the soreness in her shoulders, neck, waist, and back. After turning off the light, she listened to the faint sound of traffic outside the window and fell asleep with a sense of tiredness, excitement, and a touch of sweetness. By 23:30 she was already sound asleep.
location: At home, on the bed, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Woke up in the early morning, washed up, and prepared
description: At 5:30 in the morning, the alarm rang on time. Sun Yuwei rubbed her slightly sore legs and got up with the satisfaction of yesterday's successful old-book drifting activity. After drinking half a glass of warm water and washing up briefly, she changed into a linen-cotton shirt and sport pants, put her voice recorder, journal, and camera into her canvas bag, and got ready for a day of fieldwork and activities. Birds chirped outside the window; a new day began.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had breakfast with my mother and shared funny stories from yesterday's activities
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared small-pot rice noodles and fried dough sticks. While eating breakfast, Sun Yuwei excitedly told her mother about running into Lin Shen at yesterday's used-book drifting event and talking about The Little Prince. Her mother smiled and encouraged her to make friends through books and to treasure her college years. The warm breakfast made her feel very grounded.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wenlin Street morning market outing, capturing inspiration from street life.
description: After the rain, the air was fresh. Sun Yuwei walked to the morning market on Wenlin Street. Using her phone, she recorded the vendor's cry, "Fresh bok choy! Five yuan for two bunches!" and the sound of shoppers haggling. In her journal, she sketched the play of morning light on dew-covered mint leaves and wrote down the inspiration, "The light filtering through the gaps in the awning falls on the tender green mint leaves, like a still-life painting." Before leaving, she bought two red-bean flower cakes at Aunt Xie's stall, planning to leave them for her parents.
location: Morning market on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan (near Green Lake Park)

name: Went home, wrote a short essay 'Morning on Wenlin Street,' and submitted it to the editor
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei made herself a cup of the brown sugar pearl milk tea her mother had cooked, and in the study she opened her laptop to organize the morning market recordings and journal shorthand. She wove details such as the morning light, awnings, street vendors' calls, and the aroma of flower cakes into an 800-character draft essay, 'Morning on Wenlin Street'. After polishing it, she emailed it to editor Xu Mingyuan as backup material for the 'Kunming Slices' column.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took a ride-hailing car to commute to the Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University.
description: Considering she was a bit tired, Sun Yuwei took a ride-hailing car instead of the subway to Chenggong Campus. On the way, she browsed photos in the event group on her phone and thought through the layout details of the 'Make Friends Through Books' message wall that needed to be added that day. The car entered the Second Ring Expressway, and the city scenery flowed past.
location: Ride-hailing car, en route from Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University in Chenggong District.

name: Morning session of the second day of the used-book drifting activity, with a message wall and book list display added.
description: Sun Yuwei, Qin Mingyuan, and volunteer Xiao Lin set up a “Make Friends Through Books” message whiteboard and a “Recommended Book List” display shelf beside the former site of the Tree-Lined Square on the Chenggong campus of Yunnan University. On the first day, word of mouth spread, and the number of morning participants far exceeded expectations. Many people brought books and were also attracted by the message wall. Sun Yuwei guided everyone to write messages while photographing lively moments of selecting books, chatting, and writing sticky notes with her camera, and proactively talked with students about their reading reflections, using “Why did you choose this book?” as an icebreaker.
location: Linyin Square, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and confirming graduation dinner details with roommate Liu Jia
description: After the event handover, Sun Yuwei went alone to Ziyuan Restaurant for clear-soup small-pot rice noodles to recharge. During the meal, she confirmed via WeChat voice with her roommate Liu Jia the final dishes and details for the handwritten letter exchange at the June 16 graduation dinner (Yunshangyao Restaurant), and agreed that she would bring cards to write on.
location: Ziyuan Restaurant, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The afternoon session of the old book floating activity wrapped up; moved supplies to Mingyuan Book House.
description: The afternoon activities remained very lively. Sun Yuwei carefully read every message at the message wall and used her phone to snap more than a dozen of the most wonderful ones as material. At 15:30, as the event drew to an end, she, along with Qin Mingyuan and Xiao Lin, carried the remaining books that had not been released, signs, message-wall sticky notes, and other supplies into Qin Mingyuan's van, then drove to Mingyuan Bookstore at No. 202 Wenlin Street and neatly stored everything in the storage room.
location: Linyin Square, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, East Outer Ring South Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; and Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 202 Wenlin Street.

name: A walk in Green Lake Park and sorting out thoughts
description: After leaving Mingyuan Bookstore, Sun Yuwei walked to Green Lake Park, found a quiet bench on the Nine-Bend Bridge, and sat down, letting the lake breeze relax her tense nerves. She opened her journal, recorded a few interesting conversation snippets and messages from today's activities, and drew a simple sketch of a girl reading a book from behind.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home, cook dinner with my parents, and discuss accommodation for the Sanya trip
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei helped her mother Li Xiulan trim chives. While trimming, she recounted the amusing moments from today's event and the wonderful content on the message wall. During dinner, the family discussed follow-ups to the event. Sun Yuwei confirmed with her father Sun Mingyuan her accommodation preferences for the Sanya trip. Her father said that a guesthouse or hotel near the beach would be fine, and her mother added that it would be best if it was near Nanshan Temple with convenient transportation.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-class preparation for the online writing workshop.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to the study 10 minutes early, opened her laptop, adjusted the camera and earphones, prepared a notebook and pen, and entered the online meeting room ahead of time to wait for the class to start.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The online writing workshop concluded, and my piece was singled out by the instructor as an example.
description: The course began at 19:30. The instructor reviewed the key points of the entire workshop and gave final comments on the graduation assignment—the interview exercise. Sun Yuwei's interview draft was selected as an example for detailed analysis, and she was praised for her attention to detail and emotional sensitivity. She carefully noted the revision suggestions. Before the course ended, everyone took a group photo online and said goodbye. Sun Yuwei messaged her classmate Song Wen on WeChat to share how they felt.
location: Home study (online classroom), Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journal review and bedtime stretching
description: After the class, Sun Yuwei opened her journal and pasted in the wrappers of the flower cakes she had collected, the Polaroid photos from the event, and the wonderful sticky notes she had torn off the message wall, then wrote her reflections: "The vitality of culture lies in flow and sharing." Afterward, she spread out her yoga mat in the bedroom and did 15 minutes of pre-sleep stretching and meditation, replacing the regular yoga class she had missed because of the event, to ease her fatigue.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study and bedroom).

name: Reading The Little Prince before bed and writing down reflections.
description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei picked up The Little Prince on the bedside table, turned to the rose chapter she had discussed with Lin Shen, read it again, and wrote in the margin: "Taming is the process of needing each other."
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening hygiene routine and lights out for sleep
description: Sun Yuwei applied a hydrating mask and did a careful skincare routine. While brushing her teeth, the workshop feedback and the stories from the message wall still echoed in her mind. She turned off the lights and went to sleep at 23:30. Caught between great satisfaction and exhaustion, she fell into a deep sleep in less than five minutes.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and warm water
description: Sunlight slipped in through the gap in the curtains. Sun Yuwei slowly opened her eyes, reached for the glass of water on the nightstand, and took a few sips of warm water. The warm liquid slid down her throat, and she was fully awake. She replied to the message from her editor Xu Mingyuan on her phone, confirming that the column deadline was June 15, and prepared for the final day of the old-book exchange event.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and morning skincare routine.
description: In the bathroom, she washed her face with warm water and applied moisturizer and sunscreen. She tied her hair into a ponytail, put on an off-white cotton-linen shirt and light blue jeans, and checked the contents of her canvas bag: the 50 handwritten postcards she’d written yesterday, notebook, fountain pen, power bank, sunscreen, mineral water, and yoga clothes.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and gear check
description: Mom Li Xiulan had cooked small-pot rice noodles. Sun Yuwei ate while chatting with her mom about the day's schedule, mentioning the yoga class in the afternoon. After eating, she did a final check of her canvas bag and yoga clothes in the living room to make sure everything was ready.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus
description: Shouldering my canvas bag, I walked to Wuyi Road Station on Metro Line 3, took the metro to Dongfeng Square Station, transferred to Line 2, and rode to Daxuecheng Station. On the way, I read an e-book for a while and took a nap. After exiting the station, I walked about 15 minutes through the tree-lined avenue of Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus and arrived at Linyin Square.
location: Inside the carriages of Metro Line 3 and Line 2, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning session of the secondhand book drifting activity
description: Arrived at the tree-lined square of Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus, helped Qin Mingyuan and Xiao Lin sort the last row of books. Guided participants through registration and handed out the handwritten postcards written earlier. Many people looked pleasantly surprised when they received them. I paused to look at the new sticky notes on the message wall and felt moved.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Person in charge of Mingyuan Bookstore

location: Linyin Square, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and activity data statistics
description: At noon the sun was strong. She went to the second floor of Ziyuan Restaurant with Qin Mingyuan and Xiao Lin. Sun Yuwei ordered rice with beef and sour bamboo shoots. During the meal, they checked the data from the three-day event: 231 total participants, 1,257 drifting books, and 189 messages on the message wall. Qin Mingyuan suggested holding another reading salon in autumn, and Sun Yuwei agreed to help design the poster.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Person in charge of Mingyuan Bookstore

location: Ziyuan Restaurant, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, East Outer Ring South Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Event wrap-up and venue cleanup
date: Yes, it is related. The two episodes of neck and shoulder discomfort on May 16 and 18 both occurred after prolonged sitting and intense work: on the 16th, after working at my desk to revise an essay draft and reply to my advisor, my neck and shoulders felt tight; on the 18th, after four consecutive hours of focused work on the defense PPT, I experienced a cramping pain in my left shoulder blade. Later, from the 21st to the 25th, I persisted with rehabilitative yoga (about 60 minutes in total) combined with hot compresses, and the symptoms gradually eased. This shows that prolonged sitting and mental work directly triggered the neck and shoulder problem, and targeted exercise can effectively improve it.
description: After lunch, they returned to the tree-lined square to wrap up. Sun Yuwei helped Xiao Lin fold the tent and move tables and chairs, sweating profusely. Qin Mingyuan packed the remaining books and transported them to a temporary warehouse. By 2:30 p.m., the square had been restored to its original state. After saying goodbye to Qin Mingyuan and Xiao Lin, she hurried to the subway station.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Person in charge of Mingyuan Bookstore

location: The tree-lined plaza and the warehouse of Mingyuan Bookstore, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute to Zhongmou Yoga Studio
description: Walked from Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University to University Town Station, took the metro back the same way to Wuyi Road Station, and after exiting walked about 8 minutes to Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road. In the elevator, I unbuttoned the top button of my shirt to let some air in, looking forward to the yoga class relieving my shoulder and neck soreness.
location: Inside the carriages of Metro Lines 2 and 3 in Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Restorative yoga class
description: After arriving at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, she quickly changed into her yoga clothes and entered the classroom. In the quiet atmosphere with five students, teacher He Lu led restorative poses such as Cat-Cow Pose, Downward-Facing Dog Pose, Child's Pose, and Bridge Pose. Sun Yuwei followed attentively and could clearly feel the stiffness in her back from moving books ease away, leaving her relaxed and content.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Browsed the Paper, Cloth & Stone Bookstore.
description: After yoga class, I walked about 19 minutes to the Zhibushi Bookstore on Wenlin Street. I browsed around, flipped through a newly arrived collection of essays by a Yunnan local writer, picked out a few journal stickers and a light blue stamp, and spent 18 yuan in total.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home
description: Carrying the small paper bag from the bookstore, she walked home along Wenlin Street and Cuihu Road. The evening sunlight was gentle, and bougainvillea was in full bloom. Passing the fruit stand at the entrance to the neighborhood, she bought a few loquats.
location: Cuihu Community (street-facing), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Interview with mother Li Xiulan
description: After arriving home, her mother was reading in the living room. Sun Yuwei took out her phone, turned on the recorder, and interviewed her mother about her teaching experience. Li Xiulan recalled that when she first became a teacher, she would prepare lessons late into the night and buy stationery for her students at her own expense. She was very moved when telling the story of a girl from the mountains who later gained admission to university. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, brewed pu-erh tea and occasionally interjected with additional details. The recording lasted 40 minutes.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was Mom's pickled cabbage fish and stir-fried seasonal vegetables; the family chatted as they ate. Sun Yuwei shared how the event wrapped up and what it felt like to interview her mother. Mom added a few funny stories that hadn't come up in the interview, and Sun Yuwei silently noted them down for her writing.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk in Cuihu Park to sort out thoughts
description: Put on sneakers and went out, walking along Cuihu Road to Green Lake Park. The park was lively in the evening; I walked slowly by the lake as the evening breeze blew. As I walked, I organized the interview content in my head, and the article framework gradually became clear. I sat down on a lakeside bench, took out my pocket notebook, and quickly jotted down keywords.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Return home.
description: She put away her notebook and walked home along the west gate of the park. The streetlights were already on, and many residents were out walking, so she quickened her pace.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Write the first draft of the nonfiction story 'Mother's Podium'
description: In the study, I closed the door, opened my laptop, and started writing under the title 'Mother's Podium.' Beginning with the nervousness my mother felt when she first stepped onto the podium as a young woman, I connected the stories of her and her students, all the way to her last class before retirement. The sound of keyboard tapping was clear, and I was fully absorbed in writing. Around 22:30, I completed a 2,500-character first draft, then spent 30 minutes reading through it and adding details, such as the glasses she wore when grading homework and the chalk dust on the podium. After saving the document, I shut down the computer.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime reading
description: After getting into bed, she picked up Cai Chongda's "No More Than Skin" and leafed through it for about 10 minutes. When she reached the passage describing the mother, she was reminded of the manuscript she had just finished and felt deeply touched.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal review and bedtime preparation
description: At the desk in my bedroom, I opened my journal, stuck on the stamp stickers bought at the bookstore, and used a fountain pen to record today's key items: the old-book drifting event concluded successfully (231 participants, 1,257 books floated), restorative yoga, interviewing Mom, and finishing the first draft. After that, I went to the bathroom to wash up, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: I woke up to the alarm on my phone, got up, and went to the bathroom to splash warm water on my face to wake up. Walking out of the room, I saw my father Sun Mingyuan watching the morning news on the sofa in the living room. After greeting him, I went to the kitchen, poured a glass of warm water, and drank it; most of the fatigue from staying up late writing faded away.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Buy flowers
description: Changed into a loose cotton-linen dress, took my coin purse downstairs, and followed the navigation along Renmin Middle Road for about 8 minutes to reach Xijian Huatian (Fresh Flowers, Opening Flower Baskets, Coffee). Inside, a fresh floral fragrance greeted me. I chose a bunch of yellow-and-white chamomile with dew, paid 12 yuan, and also took a photo of the small daisies in a vase in the shop.
location: Xijian Huatian (Fresh Flowers, Opening Flower Baskets, Coffee), No. 90 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Arranging fresh flowers
description: Carrying the bouquet, she walked back home the same way, which took 8 minutes. After arriving home, she unwrapped the paper, cut the flower stems diagonally, placed them in the clear glass vase on her desk, and set it beside her journal. The room instantly brightened.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Enjoyed breakfast and read the report.
description: Her mother Li Xiulan had made fried eggs and toast, along with a glass of hot milk. While eating breakfast, she browsed the electronic edition of Spring City Cultural Daily on her phone. When she saw the headline 'Graduation Season Old-Book Drifting: Keeping Knowledge and Warmth Alive on Campus' and the copy that mentioned her, the corners of her mouth rose involuntarily and a sense of accomplishment welled up in her heart. She gently patted her mother's hand and showed her the line; her mother smiled and nodded.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Make a journal to record yesterday and this morning.
description: After breakfast, I went back to the study, took out my TN journal, and first used washi tape to collage a simple border on the page. Then I recorded: yesterday's old book drifting activity ended successfully; the emotion I felt when interviewing Mom; and this morning's joy at seeing the report. I wrote the words 'Words Have Echoes' in colored pen and drew a small open book next to it.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Polish and submit the nonfiction story assignment
description: She opened the document 'Mother's Podium' on her laptop, checked it word by word for grammatical errors, and read it aloud, feeling the rhythm of the sentences and the flow of emotion. In the paragraph describing her mother's first time stepping onto the podium, she felt the tone could be softer, so she sent her mother a WeChat voice message reading that passage aloud. After listening, her mother laughed and said, 'It is somewhat like that, but my legs weren't shaking as much as you said.' She noted this detail and adjusted the wording. At 11:45, she confirmed the manuscript was perfect, converted the document to PDF, attached a creative statement of about 200 characters, logged in to the online platform of the non-fiction writing workshop, and submitted it.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Answer the reporter's interview phone call
description: Just after handing in the assignment, her phone showed an unfamiliar landline number. She took a deep breath, walked to the balcony, and answered the call. The caller was Li Xiang, a reporter from "Spring City Culture News", conducting a follow-up interview about the report published that morning. Asked about the original intention behind planning the old book drifting activity, the most unforgettable moment, and her feelings after seeing the report, she looked at the sparkling ripples of Cuihu Lake below and clearly shared her understanding of "the transmission of words and emotions". The interview lasted about 15 minutes, and after it ended she felt a fulfilling sense of being recognized.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Lunch and sharing joy
description: Mother made her favorite tomato-and-egg noodles. While eating, she told her parents about the newspaper interview and showed them the article page on her phone. Father pushed up his glasses and said calmly, ‘A good thing—keep writing.’ Mother was delighted and said, ‘I always said your writing can move people!’ Smiling, she took a screenshot of the article, sent it to her close friends’ group chat, and captioned it ‘Today’s happiness comes from writing!’
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Midday rest and reading
description: After the meal, she returned to the bedroom, drew the curtains halfway, and prepared to rest. Leaning against the headboard, she opened “Skin,” which she had not finished reading the night before. When she reached the chapter “Disability,” she was moved by the reshaping of the father’s image. After reading for ten minutes, she felt sleepy, set the alarm for 14:00, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Conceive an outline for a WeChat official account article
description: After the alarm went off, she got up and washed her face, feeling much more refreshed. She sat down at her desk, opened a new Word document, and typed the title 'Does Writing Need a Methodology?' She quickly wrote down the keywords in her mind: the workshop discussion, the phrase 'sincerity is more important than technique' she heard when interviewing her mother, and her own experience of moving from imitation to finding her own voice. She drew a simple mind map on paper as the article's framework.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Wrote a long WeChat official account article titled Does Writing Need a Methodology?
description: Following the outline, I began immersive writing. The opening quoted the workshop instructor's words, then combined insights from interviewing my mother to explore the relationship between 'method' and 'truth' in nonfiction writing. I admitted that the first draft had been too focused on technique, but later I realized that the most moving power comes from sincere emotion. As I wrote, I jotted down phrases and paragraphs that came to me in flashes of inspiration in my notebook, accumulating material for a future essay collection. By 16:50 the first draft was nearly 2,500 words, with a complete structure and clear logic. I read it through once, adjusted a few places in tone, and added a photo of chamomile on the desk as the cover image for the piece.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: An evening walk alone to relax
description: After sitting for nearly three hours, I decided to go out for a walk. After changing into sneakers, I walked about 2 minutes from home to Cuihu Park. I strolled along the lakeside path for about 40 minutes, and saw an elderly person feeding pigeons with a child, and college students playing guitar and singing on a bench. The evening breeze blew by, carrying away the day's fatigue and also making the writing problem I had been thinking about in the afternoon clearer.
location: Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Help mother prepare dinner
description: After her walk, she went home and saw her mother picking over vegetables in the kitchen, so she washed her hands and went over to help. Her mother planned to make green pepper shredded potatoes and mushroom soup for dinner. While helping peel garlic, she chatted about an article on food writing she had read that afternoon, and said she wanted to write about her mother's cooking skills in her essay collection. Her mother smiled and teased that her clumsy cooking was nothing worth writing about, but her eyes were full of delight.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family dinner and everyday small talk
description: The meal was served, and the family of three sat down to dinner. She shared the news that she had submitted her assignment and finished writing her WeChat public account article. Her father asked about graduation, and she told him that the first draft of her thesis had been approved, and that she mainly wanted to use this time to build the structure for her essay collection. Her mother reminded her to prepare a handwritten letter for the graduation dinner, to use words to record those memorable times.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Publish a long article on the official account
description: Back in the study, opened the WeChat official account backend, copied and pasted the article Does Writing Need Methodology? written in the afternoon, inserted the chamomile cover image, and set the tags #WritingThoughts #Nonfiction #DailyReflections. At exactly 20:00, decisively clicked the Mass Send button.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: In-depth discussion with fellow book lovers and conversation with my mother
description: Less than 20 minutes after the article was published, multiple messages came in on the backend. Her book friend Yang Xiao posted a long comment, quoting the article's view on "sincerity" and raising a question: "In nonfiction writing, for the sake of emotional authenticity, is it acceptable to artistically process factual details? Does that count as deceiving the reader?" Drawn in by the question, she replied in the backend with her own views. The two went back and forth more than a dozen times around "writing ethics and the boundaries of art," carefully weighing each reply. During the exchange, she went to the living room to pour water, and her mother asked what she was busy with. She briefly explained the discussion with her book friend. Her mother, drawing on her experience as a Chinese language teacher, added: "Artistic truth is not equal to real-life truth, but the feelings that move people must be genuine." She kept that sentence in mind. The conversation went on until 22:05, leading her to think more deeply about writing. Before bed, she said to Yang Xiao, "Thank you for your thoughts—I learned a lot too."
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Read 'Story' and consolidate critical thinking.
description: Feeling deeply satisfied, I picked up Robert McKee's Story from the nightstand, turned to the chapter on 'Protagonist and Antagonist,' and revisited yesterday's reading. Combining tonight's discussion with Yang Xiao and Mom, I made notes in the margins as I read, thinking about how to apply this theory to the conception of the next article to make the story's conflict more compelling.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Journaling the day's highlights
description: Closing the book, she took out her TN journal, turned to today's page, and decorated the corner with daisy stickers. She wrote down a few moments that made her feel fulfilled today: the surprise at seeing the report, the tacit understanding with her mother while revising the draft via voice message, and the in-depth discussion with Yang Xiao about writing ethics. Finally, she concluded: "Words are a bridge, connecting me and this world."
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Preparing for sleep and meditative relaxation
description: After finishing the journal, she went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into pajamas, lay down on the bed, turned off the main light and left only a small night light on. She opened the meditation app on her phone, chose a 5-minute breathing guide, slowly relaxed her whole body along with the guidance, let today's events gently pass through her mind like a movie, and then emptied her thoughts. At 23:30, she turned off her phone, closed her eyes, and fell asleep with fulfillment and peace.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Perhaps because last night's late-night exchange with my book friend Yang Xiao lasted too long, when I woke up on Saturday morning it was already fully light. Although I missed my usual early-morning yoga class slot, my spirits were still good. First I drank a glass of warm water, did some simple stretches, changed into light yoga clothes, and decided to attend the morning class. My mother was preparing breakfast in the kitchen, and I told her I would be back later for lunch.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: I left with my yoga mat and water bottle. The plane tree leaves in the community rustled in the breeze. I walked along familiar streets, passed the entrance to Cuihu Park, and saw that the morning exercisers had already dispersed, leaving only some elderly people strolling leisurely by the lake. After about 15 minutes, I arrived at Dechun Commercial Building.
location: Along the route from Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Morning yoga class
description: Today is Saturday, and Ms. He Lu's class is still very popular. The class was mainly vinyasa flow yoga. Under the teacher's guidance, I focused on the flow of breath and body. Although I missed the early class, I was still in good shape, and my downward-facing dog hold stayed stable for over 45 seconds. After class, Ms. He Lu specifically praised my recent progress. During the break, I seized the opportunity to talk with her about collaborating on the flower arrangement decor for the café. Based on the café interior photos she showed me, I proposed using white lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves together to create a fresh and natural style. Ms. He Lu thought the plan was very good and said it would be confirmed after she talked with the shop owner.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stopped by the supermarket on the way to do some shopping.
description: After yoga class, I felt light and relaxed. On my way home, I deliberately made a detour to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, thinking I should buy Linlin some lychees, her favorite. In the fruit section, I chose a box of bright red lychees (about 15 yuan) and a few loquats, wanting her to taste the flavors of home. At the checkout, I noticed fresh mint on the shelf and picked up a small bunch to steep in water.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Returned home to rest and refresh
description: When I got home, I put the lychees and loquats in the refrigerator to chill. I briefly mentioned to my mother that He Lu wanted to collaborate on floral art. She smiled and said, 'That's great, your flower arrangement skills finally have a place to shine.' I drank some water, put on my canvas bag full of notebooks and camera, and got ready to head out to Yuantong Mountain for a field trip.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Observation and inspiration-gathering in the Yuantong Mountain neighborhood
description: I rode a shared bike and got to Yuantong Mountain in about 10 minutes. It was Saturday, so the park entrance was livelier than usual. I slowed down and took care to record these moments: elderly men sitting under the trees playing chess with focused expressions, street vendors’ colorful balloons swaying in the wind, and the cheerful laughter of children chasing and playing. I took a few photos full of everyday life and quickly sketched these vivid scenes in the journal I had brought with me.
location: The block near Kunming Zoo-Yuantong Mountain, No. 92 Qingnian Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Return home to organize materials and write.
description: Back home, I immediately turned on my computer and transformed the scenes and feelings captured during the field trip into words. Under the title "Peace in the Midst of Noise," I focused on the brief moments of beauty that people of different ages found in the shared space of Yuantong Mountain, and completed the last short neighborhood observation essay, "An Afternoon on Yuantong Mountain," in one go. After reading it through and confirming it was correct, I submitted the piece to the course platform and sent an email to my advisor, Wu Mingyuan, telling him the series was complete and wishing him a pleasant weekend.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Help prepare lunch
description: Coming out of the study, my mother was busy in the kitchen making our favorite small-pot rice noodles. I washed my hands and went over to help peel garlic and chop cilantro. As we prepped the ingredients together, we chatted; I talked about the inspiration I had while writing, and she shared amusing stories from school this week. The kitchen had a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoying lunch
description: The small-pot rice noodles my mother had cooked were brought to the table, steaming hot, with a sour, spicy, fresh and fragrant aroma. I ate to my heart's content; this truly was the most comforting taste of home. After the meal, I voluntarily cleared the table and washed the dishes spotlessly clean.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and preparation for airport pickup
description: I dozed off on the sofa for a moment. I checked my phone and saw that Liu Jia had sent a message in the dormitory group saying she was about to leave. I got up and went back to my room, putting a power bank, a sun-and-rain umbrella, and a small bottle of mosquito repellent into my canvas bag. Remembering that the chamomile I bought yesterday was still in the vase on my desk, I carefully picked a few stems, wrapped them simply in kraft paper, and tied them with twine—a little surprise prepared for Linlin.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Set off for the subway station
description: I put on my canvas bag, held the bunch of chamomile, said to my mother, 'Mom, I'm off,' then left and went downstairs. After walking about 15 minutes, I reached Wuyi Road Metro Station and swiped my phone to enter the station.
location: Wuyi Road Metro Station (Line 3, Line 5), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take the subway to the airport
description: I got on the subway and shared real-time locations with Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen in the group chat. We agreed to meet at Tangzixiang Station when transferring to Line 6. On the train, the three of us chattered about Linlin's arrival, guessing whether she had lost weight again or had become more fashionable, and we looked through the Shenzhen photos she had posted in the group. The whole way was filled with laughter and cheerful talk.
location: From Wuyi Road Station on Metro Line 3 to Changshui Airport Station on Line 6, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waiting and airport pickup
description: The three of us arrived early at the exit and waited. I held the bouquet of chamomile tightly, feeling a little excited. When we saw that familiar figure striding out in the signature white T-shirt, sunglasses, and pulling a suitcase, we immediately cheered in unison. Linlin dropped her suitcase and ran toward us, and the four of us hugged tightly, laughing and jumping, drawing stares from people around. I shoved the bouquet into her hands. She hugged me in surprise, her eyes slightly red.
location: Kunming Changshui International Airport Arrivals Level, Dabanqiao Street, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning to school by subway
description: On the subway back, Linlin couldn't wait to open her suitcase and share the Shenzhen specialties she brought: Bao Master pastries and various kinds of gifts. The four girls squeezed together, sharing a durian pastry, chattering about her experiences since arriving in Shenzhen, and the carriage was filled with our laughter. After arriving at University Town Station, we walked back to the familiar campus together.
location: From Changshui Airport Station on Metro Line 6 to University Town Station on Line 1, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dormitory reunion and sharing.
description: Back in the dorm, everything felt alive again. The four of us sat around my desk eating the lychees I had bought that morning, while Linlin commented on how the dorm had changed over the years. We talked about what was going on in our lives: Linlin complained about the fast pace of work in Shenzhen, Jiajia shared the anxiety of preparing for the graduate entrance exam, Xiaowen told funny stories from the publishing company, and I talked about my column and the new workshop invitation I had received. The room was filled with the warmth and liveliness that belonged to the four of us and that we had missed for so long.
location: Ziyuan Student Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dinner
description: Everyone decided not to go out and simply have a light meal at the familiar cafeteria, to recall the taste of college. I ordered a small-pot rice noodle, and the other three each ordered a bowl of rice noodles or er si. During the meal, Linlin suggested taking a walk by Ze Lake in the evening to revisit the campus night view, and everyone agreed.
location: Snack counter, 2nd floor, Ziyuan Dining Hall, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus walk and photography
description: The sky was darkening, and lights were coming on around the campus. The four of us walked by the familiar Ze Lake. The evening breeze was gentle, dissipating the day’s stuffy heat but also bringing a hint of parting sadness. We talked about our plans after graduation, and in the middle of plans that scattered us in all directions, a touch of melancholy crept into our hearts. I suggested taking a few group photos with our phones, so on the lawn in front of the library, with the illuminated teaching building as the background, the four of us made all sorts of goofy poses, trying to preserve this rare night forever.
location: Zehu Lake and the lawn in front of the library, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dorm room late-night chat and washing up
description: Back in the dorm, we turned off the lights and lay on our own beds, talking freely in the dark. We talked about funny military training stories from when we first met as freshmen, the horror movies we had stayed up late to watch, and the craziness of braving the rain to see an exhibition... Our voices grew quieter as a wistful mood spread. I knew it was time to do that thing.
location: Ziyuan Student Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Wrote a graduation letter alone.
description: Once my roommates' breathing became steady, I quietly pulled the bed curtain closed and turned on my little desk lamp. I took out the kraft letter paper I had treasured and that smooth fountain pen from the drawer, and began writing a handwritten letter to each of Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin. As the pen rustled across the paper, I poured all the little moments of the past four years—the unspoken gratitude and reluctance to part—into the words. I wrote about late nights studying together, the difficulties we overcame together, and every joy and sorrow we had shared... By the end, I was deeply moved by my own memories, and my eyes were a little moist. I gently folded the letter paper, put it in the envelope, and wrote their names on the front.
location: At the desk in Ziyuan Student Dormitory, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidying up and going to sleep
description: I gently turned off the desk lamp and placed the three letters in the most prominent spot on the desk. I climbed into bed, and as I lay there listening to the occasional chirping of insects outside the window, memories of today's reunion with my roommates flashed through my mind, filling my heart with warmth and gratitude. Today was a day of reunion and farewell, and I marked this bond with a gentle footnote in the best way I could. With this sense of peace, I closed my eyes and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: On the bed in the Ziyuan Student Dormitory, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning ritual and hanfu styling
description: Woke up on time at 6:00 in the morning, drank the half cup of warm water that had been left to cool overnight, and felt the dawn light outside the window. Excitedly, she and her three roommates changed into the light cyan Hanfu that had been ironed in advance, helped each other with makeup, combed their hair into buns, and put on tassel hair accessories. The dormitory was filled with laughter and the sound of camera shutters. They took several fun group selfies with their phones, capturing the most beautiful moment of this graduation morning.
location: Room 4-202, Ziyuan Dormitory, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The last campus walk and breakfast before graduation
description: Wearing hanfu, the four of them decided to set off early for one last campus stroll. They first went downstairs from the dormitory and looked up for one final glance at the ginkgo tree that had witnessed countless late-night conversations; then they walked slowly along the familiar ginkgo path, talking softly about their first impressions of one another in freshman year.
