After arriving at Ziyuan Restaurant, they chose their usual window seat and ate a steaming bowl of small-pot rice noodles—that was the taste of their graduation breakfast.
location: Inside Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province: Ziyuan Dormitory Building, Ginkgo Road, and Ziyuan Canteen

name: Walking to the graduation ceremony venue
description: After breakfast, the four of them, holding the graduation gowns they had prepared in advance, walked along the campus road to the gymnasium. Along the way, they saw many graduates also wearing academic gowns, and they exchanged smiles and greetings.
location: Within the Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: from Ziyuan Dining Hall to the main venue of the gymnasium

name: Attending the 2025 graduation ceremony.
description: Entered at 8:00 and sat in the middle section directly facing the stage. The ceremony began on time. Everyone stood for the national anthem, then listened to the president's speech, "Literature carries the Way; aim high with noble aspirations." Sun Yuwei quickly noted down a few words that moved her. During the degree conferral, she and her roommates went to the stage one by one, had their tassels turned by their advisor, and collected their diplomas. When they smiled at each other, their eyes were filled with four years of youth and growth.
location: Main Hall, Gymnasium, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth campus check-ins and yoga progress sharing
description: After the ceremony, the four quickly put on their graduation gowns over their Hanfu and entered “final check-in” mode. In front of the library, they asked a classmate to take the classic group shot of tossing their caps in the air; on the steps of the teaching building’s atrium, they deliberately recreated the pose from the first photo they took upon entering school; finally, on the cherry blossom path, they took the “glancing back with a smile” photo. During a break in the photo taking, Sun Yuwei excitedly said to her roommates: “Do you know? I’ve been taking He Lu’s class at Zhongmou Yoga Studio twice a week recently. In yesterday’s flow yoga class, I actually held Downward Dog for 45 seconds! The teacher said my flexibility has improved a lot.” Zhao Xiaowen clapped and laughed: “No wonder you stand so straight in photos!” The four burst into laughter.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: plaza in front of the library, steps in the teaching building atrium, cherry blossom path

name: Lunch and brief rest
description: Back on the second floor of Ziyuan Restaurant, they ordered clay pot rice and chatted about fun moments from the ceremony and the afternoon plans while eating. The waitress came over to take photos, saying it was too meaningful to remember that they were wearing hanfu. After the meal, the four decided not to go to the dormitory but to lean back on a shady bench outside the restaurant and rest for 20 minutes, feeling the breeze and savoring the last times on campus.
location: Corner booth on the second floor of Ziyuan Restaurant, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the shaded bench downstairs.

name: Afternoon campus exploration and quiet time alone
description: First, she went to the study area on the second floor of the library and sat for 20 minutes, savoring the quiet of being a student for the last time. Then she moved to the sports field and walked around the red track again and again, talking about their respective future plans (Zhou Lin is going to Shenzhen for internet operations, Zhao Xiaowen was admitted to graduate school in Hangzhou, and Liu Jia is returning to Chengdu to join a publishing group). After taking a group photo on the lawn in front of the administration building, Sun Yuwei walked alone to the stone steps in front of the library, sat down, took out her pen and journal, watched the underclassmen passing by, and quietly wrote two lines in her diary: "The shutter is the world's, and the memory is the heart's."
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: self-study area on the second floor of the library, running track at Nanyuan Playground, lawn in front of the administration building, and stone steps in front of the library

name: Annual appointment in front of the library and a solemn farewell
description: At 16:00, the four of them gathered in the square in front of the library and sat in a circle, just like their first freshman class meeting. Their memories began with meeting over a bowl of rice noodles, recounting the daily routine of borrowing notes and chatting all night, and telling stories of the seasons turning. Finally, Sun Yuwei solemnly proposed, "Let's meet every June from now on! We'll take turns going to Chengdu, Shenzhen, Hangzhou, and Kunming, like stamping a seal on our graduation anniversaries." The four linked pinkies, sealed the promise, and took a group selfie with their phones to capture this solemn and warm agreement.
location: Central square in front of the library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Said goodbye to my roommate and took the subway back home.
description: After keeping their appointment in front of the library, the four of them formally said goodbye at the campus gate. Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin returned to the dormitory to pack their luggage. Sun Yuwei headed alone to University Town Metro Station, took Line 1 to Dongfeng Square Station, and then walked 10 minutes to her home in Cuihu Community. The whole trip took about 40 minutes.
location: From University City Station to Dongfeng Square Station on Kunming Metro Line 1, Yunnan Province, then walking to Cuihu Community

name: Go home and share graduation feelings
description: At 17:10 she arrived home. Her mother was busy preparing dinner, and her father opened the door for her. Sun Yuwei excitedly showed the graduation photos on her phone, sharing the moving moments of the ceremony and the annual reunion promise with her roommates. Her mother served a bowl of white fungus soup with reduced sugar, and the family chatted while eating. Her father encouraged her: 'Keep writing the stories you want to tell.'
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Household tidying and putting things back in place
description: After dinner, she returned to her room and carefully hung the graduation gown and Hanfu in the wardrobe. She took out the three handwritten letters she had written the night before from her backpack, put them into envelopes, and wrote “6.16 Dinner Exchange” on a sticky note, which she placed in the inner pocket of the backpack. Then she charged her phone and camera, imported the camera photos to her laptop via the data cable, created a folder called “2025 Graduation Youth Finale,” and began a preliminary selection of today’s photos.
location: Sun Yuwei's bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: A walk before bed and a heart-to-heart talk between mother and daughter.
description: At 18:45, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to ask her mother to go downstairs for a walk. The two followed the familiar Renmin Middle Road and turned into Green Lake Park (which Sun Yuwei often called Little Bird Park), walking at a very slow pace. Her mother asked her who gave the best speech at the ceremony, and Sun Yuwei described how moved she was when the principal mentioned the idea that literature conveys the Way. She then took the opportunity to talk about her plan to focus on writing that essay collection after graduation. Her mother held her hand and said: You have your own hobbies and pursuits, and we all support you. Along the way, they sat on a bench by the lake for two minutes, watching night joggers pass by and feeling the gentle summer night of Kunming.
location: From Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the lakeside path at the east gate of Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park).

name: Journal time and nighttime reading
description: After returning from the walk, she quickly took a shower. At 19:30 she sat back at her desk and opened her journal. She chose a group photo of four people wearing hanfu on the cherry blossom path, printed it out with a portable photo printer, and pasted it into the journal. Beside it, she neatly wrote the day's keywords in a light blue gel pen: 'morning sun, gardenia fragrance, mortarboard cap, clasped hands, annual appointment.' She then spent half an hour organizing photos, selected nine to post on Moments, and wrote: 'The past is beyond recall; the future is still something to look forward to. Thank you, my youth.' After posting, she picked up Shen Congwen's 'Border Town' from her bedside and read quietly for 20 minutes.
location: Sun Yuwei's bedroom desk and bedside at Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and gratitude meditation
description: At 22:00, she closed the book, set the alarm for 8:00 tomorrow morning (reminding herself to bring the handwritten letter before tomorrow noon's gathering at Yunshang Yao), and wrote on the last page of her journal: "Tomorrow's to-do: bring the letter, keep the appointment." Then she lay down in bed, turned off the light, and closed her eyes recalling all the moments worth being grateful for today: her roommate's smile, the principal's words, her parents' tremella soup, the pinky promise of the annual appointment... She silently said thank you three times. Five minutes later, she fell into a deep sleep in peace and contentment.
location: Sun Yuwei's bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: At 22:30, Sun Yuwei fell asleep. Today, she had put a warm and perfect full stop to her four years as an undergraduate; her heart was full of the happiness of being surrounded by love and a gentle hope for the future.
location: Sun Yuwei's bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and planning.
description: Woke up to the sound of the alarm, washed up, changed into a white shirt, put on the graduation gown, and adjusted the tassel and bow tie. Opened the phone to browse flower arrangement portfolios and documents, confirmed them and saved them, then created a graduation day checklist in Notes. Her roommates were also getting ready, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory (4#212), Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare a bouquet surprise for my roommate.
description: Rode a bike to Blossom Time Flower Shop at the school gate, chose white lisianthus, pale pink lilies, and eucalyptus leaves, asked the owner to wrap them into a bouquet with a twine bow, took it back to the dormitory, and hid it under the desk to surprise her roommate.
location: Huakai Shiguang Flower Shop, outside the main gate of Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Completed the journal entry.
description: At the dorm desk, I used my journal to record yesterday's events—wearing hanfu, eating small-pot rice noodles, and so on—and stuck in souvenir photo stickers. I checked the handwritten letter and camera battery in my backpack, and got ready for the day's itinerary.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory (4#212), Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to the graduation ceremony with roommates
description: The four of them walked together to the gymnasium, chatting and laughing along the way. Sun Yuwei quietly revealed that she had prepared a little surprise for her roommate, and the others curiously pressed for details.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (from Ziyuan Dormitory to the Gymnasium)

name: Graduation ceremony and degree conferral
description: Attended the graduation ceremony in the gymnasium, listening to speeches by the university president and a teacher representative. When the school song played, her eyes welled up. She went on stage to have the president turn her tassel, and the degree certificate was solemnly presented. Four years of college life were condensed into that moment.
location: Gymnasium, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took photos on campus and shared the joy with family
description: After the ceremony, the four of them moved around the campus taking photos: adjusting tassels in front of Huize Hall, freezing mid-jump on Ginkgo Avenue, and throwing graduation caps in front of the library. During this time, Sun Yuwei video-called her mother by Ze Lake; her mother and father happily congratulated her on graduating and said they would celebrate at home that evening.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Huize Hall, Ginkgo Avenue, Library, Ze Lake, etc.)

name: Yunshangyao graduation dinner
description: The four walked to the Yunshangyao Restaurant outside the East Second Gate and ordered Yunnan dishes such as mushroom hot pot and crossing-the-bridge rice noodles. During the meal, they raised their glasses and reminisced about college life. Sun Yuwei shared the amusing memory of watching horror movies in the dormitory, and the atmosphere was warm with a hint of sadness.
location: Yunshangyao Restaurant, outside East Gate 2 of Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discovered a bouquet and took an afternoon nap
description: Back at the dorm, my roommates discovered the bouquet on the desk as a surprise and hugged me, touched. Then we used the bouquet as a prop for a dorm photo shoot. Afterwards, I washed my face simply, lay on the bed and rested for half an hour. Sun Yuwei took the opportunity to polish the manuscript titled The Lively Atmosphere of Wenlin Street Morning Market on her phone.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory (4#212), Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Creating a floral design portfolio and service description
description: Opened the laptop, organized photos of the flower arrangements into a 10-page PPT, displayed by style category. Then drafted a floral design service description in Word, listed common flower materials and styles, and exported it as a PDF, making full preparations for the contract signing the day after tomorrow.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory (4#212), Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon tea graduation conversation
description: They went to Ziyuan Cafe. The four of them ordered lemon tea and tiramisu and sat under outdoor umbrellas, chatting about future plans. Sun Yuwei shared her writing and travel plans, Liu Jia talked about working in Hangzhou, and Zhou Lin was preparing for the graduate entrance exam. They recalled funny incidents such as getting lost hiking in their freshman year, laughing until they cried.
location: Ziyuan Café, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Final polish and submit the manuscript
description: After returning to the dormitory, I sat on the edge of the bed, opened my computer, and added detailed description of the mushroom-selling grandma to "The Bustling Life of the Wenlin Street Morning Market" to make the article warmer. After finishing, I sent an email with a note asking the recipient to review and correct it, drawing a close to my final university assignment.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory (4#212), Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Exchanged handwritten letters and made plans to reunite
description: She took out three carefully prepared handwritten letters from her backpack. Everyone read the messages aloud, recalled moments of supporting one another, and tears fell. The four hugged tightly and agreed to reunite every June via video or in person; their friendship would never end.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory (4#212), Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Late-night chat in bed and falling asleep
description: After the lights were turned off, the four lay under the covers for their last night of whispers, talking about work, boyfriends, and Sun Yuwei's manuscript. Sun Yuwei quoted 'The Little Prince' to express how precious their friendship would be after parting, then silently gave thanks for the four years together, meditated for 3 minutes, and slowly fell asleep.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory (4#212), Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, No. 10 Yunxue Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: After the alarm went off, Sun Yuwei woke up right on time, with faint morning light outside. She drank a few sips of the warm water left in her thermos from last night and felt energetic. After washing up quickly, she changed into comfortable cotton-linen trousers and a T-shirt to prepare for today's move. She carefully put the three handwritten letters her roommates had given her last night and placed under her pillow into her canvas bag.
location: Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: The last breakfast at the dormitory.
description: Sun Yuwei went to Ziyuan Restaurant for breakfast with her roommates Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin for the last time. The four sat in their usual window seats and ordered their customary small-pot rice noodles. The atmosphere of their conversation was more relaxed than usual; they occasionally mentioned future plans and treasured the time of eating noodles together even more. Zhou Lin joked that Shenzhen's rice noodles definitely couldn't have this flavor, and Zhao Xiaowen suggested that in the future they should meet up every year and find a place to eat specialty rice noodles.
location: Ziyuan Restaurant, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Packing luggage in the dormitory and bidding farewell to classmates.
description: Back in the dorm, Sun Yuwei officially started packing. She opened the storage box under the bed and pulled out the journal from her freshman year, the handmade bookmark Xiaowen had given her, the ginkgo leaf specimen she had picked up in the library as a sophomore, and other items—each one carried memories. She sorted them into "take/donate/discard" categories: books piled into a small mountain, bowls and plates wrapped in old T-shirts; clothes folded neatly and packed into woven bags; journal materials and dried flowers stored in sealed containers. Liu Jia helped carry the heavy boxes of books to the first-floor dorm manager's office. At 10:00, the four of them cleaned the dorm for the last time, hugged and took a group photo at the door, tears in their eyes, and agreed to "meet in the group chat tonight."
location: Ziyuan Dormitory, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Complete the dormitory check-out procedures.
description: Sun Yuwei took the keys to the cleaned dorm room and the completed, roommate-signed check-out form to the dormitory supervisor's office on the first floor to complete the check-out procedure. She chatted with the dorm auntie for a bit and thanked her for four years of care. The auntie smiled, pressed a pack of homemade flower cakes into her hand, and wished her a bright future.
location: Dormitory management office, 1st floor, Ziyuan Dormitory Building, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The final lunch break and farewell at the campus café
description: With her luggage temporarily stored at the dormitory management office and a while still left before her roommates left campus, Sun Yuwei walked alone to Ziyuan Café, ordered an iced Americano, and sat by the window. As she opened the photo album on her phone and looked at the campus corners she had photographed over the past four years, she uploaded the group photos to their four-person group chat. She felt calm and composed; this cup of coffee was like a farewell ritual to campus life.
location: Ziyuan Café, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Moving the last pieces of luggage and formally saying goodbye to her roommate.
description: Back downstairs at the dormitory, the three roommates had basically finished packing and were getting ready to leave one by one. Sun Yuwei did a final check of the now-empty room. Liu Jia helped her move the heaviest suitcase downstairs. Under the ginkgo tree on the school's main road, the four said goodbye again and agreed to meet in the group chat that evening. She watched Zhou Lin take a taxi to the airport, Liu Jia board a bus to the train station, and Zhao Xiaowen pull her suitcase toward the subway station. Sun Yuwei took a deep breath and also headed to the bus stop.
location: Under the ginkgo tree on the main campus road, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take the bus home and say goodbye to the city scenery along the way
description: From the school gate, she walked to the 'Yunnan University Station' bus stop, carrying a canvas bag and a carry-on suitcase, got on Bus No. 1, and swiped her student card. She deliberately chose a window seat. The bus passed through the university town and entered the city. She quietly watched the scenes outside: the weeping willows by Green Lake, the cafés on Wenlin Street, the sign of the Lakeside Hotel... Every frame was like a replay of a youth movie. The bus swayed along, and a steady feeling of starting a new life rose in her heart.
location: From Yunnan University Station bus stop, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District.

name: Arrived home and received a warm welcome from her mother
description: She opened the door with her key, and the air conditioner in the living room was already running. Her mother, Li Xiulan, came out of the kitchen to greet her, beaming and hugging her, saying, 'My daughter has graduated.' On the table, iced sour plum drink and a plate of flower cakes were already waiting. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, sent a WeChat message from work, saying he would come home early for dinner. Sun Yuwei drank the sour plum drink, savoring the taste of home, and felt completely at ease.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Settle luggage and plan the study room
description: After finishing the sour plum drink, Sun Yuwei began to put away her luggage. First she hung clothes in the bedroom closet, then put the books back on the old bookshelf in the study by category (literature, essay collections, and journaling reference books). Noticing that the desk was a bit crowded, she placed the floral art portfolio and a few frequently read books on one side of the desk, and temporarily put the remaining odds and ends into a storage bin. She thought to herself that she would plan the study layout properly the next day.
location: Bedroom and study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Resting and organizing journal materials
description: After finishing the settling-in, she felt a bit tired but very happy. Sitting down at the desk in her bedroom, she opened a new journal and carefully transcribed the fragmentary phrases she had written on the bus today (such as 'A farewell to youth is a rickety Route 1 bus') and her final feelings about campus. She pasted in the graduation photo, a bus ticket stub, and a fallen leaf picked up at the bus stop, recording this special day.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of her home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work on time, and the family sat around the dining table. Mom made her favorite pickled fish with sour cabbage and stir-fried shrimp with asparagus. At the table, Sun Yuwei shared amusing anecdotes from graduation, her roommates' future plans, and the news that she would be signing the day after tomorrow to become the florist at a yoga studio. Her father smiled and nodded, telling her to work steadily; her mother asked about the details of the contract, and the family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk with her mother to Green Lake Park.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei and her mother took a walk to Cuihu Park as usual. The sun was setting, and the lake surface sparkled. Mother and daughter sat side by side on a bench, talking about their feelings about graduation and their hopes for the future. Her mother told her that home would always be her strongest support. Sun Yuwei leaned on her mother's shoulder, feeling extremely at ease.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Alone at Green Lake Park, zoning out.
description: Mom went home first to prepare fruit. Sun Yuwei stayed a little longer in the park alone, sitting on the stone steps beside Nine Dragon Pool, watching residents doing evening exercise and children playing. She sent her sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen a WeChat message: 'Graduated and home, everything is fine,' then slowly walked home.
location: Beside the Nine Dragon Pool, Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Create the “June Appointment” group chat and plan a reunion
description: Back home, she curled up on the sofa, opened WeChat, and created a group chat named "June Promise," adding Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin. She uploaded a group photo from their four-person graduation dinner, took a screenshot of the passage in last night's letter about their reunion, and sent it to the group. She started the discussion: "Girls, where should we go for the first stop?" Zhou Lin was the first to reply, "Hangzhou," because Lin Yue is there and the cultural atmosphere is great. Liu Jia immediately seconded it. Everyone discussed it and finally agreed to meet in Hangzhou in June 2026, with Zhou Lin in charge of the initial itinerary. The four exchanged hug emojis and agreed to check in every year on this day.
location: Sofa in the living room, home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Back in the bedroom from the living room, Sun Yuwei made a video call to her older sister Sun Yutong. Her sister, in her rented apartment in Shenzhen, saw the family home behind her through the camera and said with a smile, "Our college graduate is officially back!" Sun Yuwei shared details of her graduation ceremony and moving, and the two chatted for half an hour about work, life, and future travel plans. Her sister encouraged her to prepare well for the contract signing the day after tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Core journaling time.
description: After the call ended, she finally settled down to work on her journal. This time the theme was #graduation season#. She used small clips to attach the handwritten letters from her roommates last night into the notebook, along with the campus group photo printed today and bus ticket stubs. On the diary page she wrote: "I left my little world, but I carried with me all the light it gave me." It took a full hour before she closed the notebook with satisfaction.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of her home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stretching and reading before bed
description: She did a 10-minute bedside stretching routine to relieve the sore back from moving. Then she leaned against the headboard and picked up the last few chapters of Skin, which she'd brought back. Feeling drowsy halfway through, she put the book down contentedly. Although she didn't go to yoga class specifically, the physical exertion from today's move made her feel the exercise requirement had been met.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and review
description: She turned off the main light, leaving only a small desk lamp. She took out her phone and set a few reminders for tomorrow's schedule: organize the flower arrangement portfolio in the morning, and contact Teacher He Lu in the afternoon to confirm the signing time the day after tomorrow. After finishing a simple gratitude meditation, she felt grateful for all the encounters over the past four years. Tomorrow and the day after, a brand-new life blueprint awaited her first stroke on paper.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Say goodbye and goodnight to my roommate on WeChat.
description: Just before falling asleep, she sent a message in the 'June Appointment' group: 'Have you all settled in today? I miss you so much.' Soon, Liu Jia sent a photo of her rented apartment in Shenzhen, Zhao Xiaowen showed off her cat, and Zhou Lin posted a selfie from the airport departure lounge. The four chatted a bit more and said goodnight to each other. Sun Yuwei felt that although they were apart, their hearts were still tightly connected by a thread of warmth.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: She turned off the desk lamp and lay down on her familiar little bed. Listening to the faint sound of traffic drifting from afar outside the window, she felt an unprecedented peace and warmth. She knew that one chapter had ended, but a better story was in its prologue. Goodnight, Kunming. Goodnight, new life.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woken up by the sunlight filtering through the plane tree leaves outside the window, I lingered in bed savoring the novelty of having moved back home yesterday. After getting up, I opened the curtains and went to the bathroom to wash up. Considering that today's contract signing was a semi-formal occasion, I put on simple light makeup, focusing on my eyebrows and applying dusty rose lipstick.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing breakfast with mother.
description: Mom was busy in the small kitchen, the sour aroma of small-pot rice noodles filling the room. I helped set out Yunnan flower cakes and pickled scallions. While eating rice noodles with a poached egg, I told Mom that I was going to the yoga studio in Panlong District this morning to sign the florist agreement. Mom happily said she would fry an extra poached egg to celebrate and told me not to be nervous.
location: Dining room, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready before going out and taking a walk around the community
description: After breakfast, she went back to her room, picked up the document folder (flower arrangement design description and work photos), put on her commuting bag, and confirmed that her phone memos were correct. She left early, took a detour through Cuihu Community, and passed under Aunt Xie Xiulan's building, where she saw firecracker flowers in full bloom. At the fruit stall at the community entrance, she bought two fresh figs.
location: Cuihu Community (No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province)

name: Take the bus to Jingxin Yoga Life Center
description: Walk from Cuihu Community to Huashan West Road Bus Stop, take bus No. 228 to Jingxin Yoga Life Studio, about a 35-minute ride. Sitting by the window, watching the street scene recede. On her phone, she received a message from college roommate Liu Jia in the "June Appointment" group asking about today's signing, and she replied with a "keep going" emoji sticker.
location: Bus No. 228 (from Huashan West Road Station to Dongfeng East Road Station)

name: Sign the florist agreement
description: Arriving at Serenity Yoga Lifestyle Center, the young woman at the front desk warmly led her to the office. Teacher He Lu had already brewed flower tea. She carefully read the Resident Floral Designer Employment Agreement: design and maintain the floral installation once a month, with all yoga class fees waived and a monthly payment of 800 yuan. She happily signed her name and the date on the Party B line. Teacher He Lu congratulated Yuwei: “Your flower arrangements are full of spirituality. I look forward to your first creation.”
location: Jingxin Yoga Life Center (3rd Floor, Jiayuan Building, 86 Dongfeng East Road, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province)

name: Social sharing and creative brainstorming at a café
description: After signing the contract, she took a photo in front of the green plant wall in the lounge and edited a WeChat Moments post to share her new identity: "In the name of flowers, a bond with yoga — new identity unlocked: resident florist at Jingxin Yoga Studio. Grateful for the trust; the future holds promise!" Afterwards, she walked with He Lu to the 'Dark Green' cafe, and while drinking an iced latte, she noted her ideas for floral arrangements in the studio's functional areas: a bright Matisse style for the front desk and a cool linear feel for the meditation area, and confirmed 'Summer Coolness' as the first creation theme for July.
location: “Dark Green” Independent Coffee Shop (No. 53 Bailong Road, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province)

name: Took the bus back home
description: After saying goodbye to Teacher He Lu, I took Bus No. 236 from the bus stop near the café to head back. I felt drowsy on the bus and dozed off leaning against the window the whole way. When I got to the building entrance, I ran into Auntie Xie Xiulan, a neighbor. She was holding a plate of freshly baked flower cakes and said warmly, "Yuwei, you're back! Come over this evening and try them—I just took them out of the oven!" I happily agreed.
location: Bus No. 236 (Bailong Road Stop to Huashan West Road Stop)

name: Midday relaxation and organizing.
description: After returning home, she first put the signed agreement copy and the original contract into a document folder in the study. Then she took off her coat, changed into loose loungewear, drank a glass of the sour plum drink her mother had prepared, and collapsed on the living room sofa for a while, looking at the likes and comments on her Moments feed on her phone, feeling thoroughly pleased. She also ate two figs she had bought as a lunchtime fruit.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal creation: recording the moment of signing
description: Sitting down at the desk, I took out my journal. On today’s page, I drew a large star with a highlighter and wrote the title “First Floral Design Contract 2025.6.18.” I attached the printed photo of the contract signing with washi tape and carefully recorded the signing process and my feelings beside it. Finally, I took out the dried pressed flowers I had brought back from Dounan last time and carefully pasted a small lilac flower as a memento.
location: Study, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday recharge: studying and relaxing.
description: Closed the journal, stood up, and stretched her neck. Brewed a cup of rose tea, sat by the bay window, and leafed through The Ikenobo Flower Manual. Combining the summer coolness theme mentioned by Teacher He Lu, she sketched a few simple flower diagrams on scratch paper. Noticing the flickering light and shadow of the plane tree leaves outside the window, she took a photo and sent it to her best friend Zhang Jing on WeChat, inviting her to have a meal together on the weekend if she was free.
location: Bay window of the study, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Green Lake Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Housework help and outdoor shopping
description: Zhang Jing replied that the weekend was fine. Then Mom picked up a reusable bag and asked if I wanted to go to the supermarket with her; she wanted to stew ribs that evening. I happily agreed, and the two of us walked about 12 minutes to reach the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street. I pushed the shopping cart while Mom chose fresh winter melon and corn, and also bought a tender piece of pork loin, planning to make sweet and sour pork tenderloin for me.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket (98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province)

name: Helping in the kitchen and chatting with family
description: After coming home, I put on an apron and helped my mother pick vegetables and wash corn, chatting while we worked. I told her in detail about the contract signing today and the feedback on my work from Teacher He Lu. My mother listened with great interest and said, "My girl really knows her own mind," and reminded me that starting tomorrow I would officially be a florist, so I should focus on creating my pieces with a calm heart.
location: Kitchen, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Phone call with father and group chat interaction
description: Dad called before leaving work and said something urgent came up at work and he would be home later. I took the phone and proudly showed off today's successful contract signing to Dad. Dad laughed on the phone and said, "Great, my girl can earn money with her skills. When I get back tonight, I'll raise a glass to you." While waiting for dinner, I sent a voice message to the "June Appointment" group: "Sisters, I signed the contract today! When you come to Kunming, I'll take you to the yoga studio to arrange flowers!" The group immediately became lively. Liu Jia led the teasing and called for a virtual celebration. Zhao Xiaowen and Zhou Lin also sent celebration stickers, and we chatted for a while about how we've been doing lately.
location: Living room, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pleasant family dinner
description: Just as Dad came in, Mom brought the last bowl of soup to the table. At the dinner table, I was the absolute center of attention. While eating the sweet-and-sour pork that I had helped make, I recounted the scene of the contract signing, the latte art at the café, and the design idea for the 'Summer Cool' theme. Dad kept saying great and gave me several pieces of ribs.
location: Dining room, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tasting flower cakes at Aunt Xie's home
description: After the meal, my mother and I went to visit Aunt Xie. In the small courtyard at Aunt Xie's house, we ate freshly baked flower cakes, crisp on the outside and soft on the inside, while chatting about family matters. Aunt Xie praised me for signing the contract today, saying she had long seen that I would amount to something.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Cuihu Community (Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province)

name: Night Tour of Cuihu Lake
description: After leaving Aunt Xie's house, it was almost dark. I changed into my sneakers and went out alone for a walk. I strolled along the paths of Cuihu Park. The early summer evening breeze carried the fresh scent of the lotus pond, which was very pleasant. I sat under the upturned eaves of the Fish-Viewing Tower, watching the koi and the reflected lights in the water, and quickly jotted down several floral design inspirations about “water” and “light” in the notes app on my phone.
location: Green Lake Park (No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province)

name: Making Plans with Su Man for the Saturday Trip to Dounan
description: After walking home from Green Lake Park, she first washed her face. Back in the bedroom, she opened her laptop and organized the inspirations she had recorded into the “Serene Flower Art” folder. Then she picked up her phone and sent a message to Su Man, a friend she had met in the flower arrangement class, inviting her to go to Dounan Flower Market on Saturday to buy supplies for the “Cool Summer” theme. Su Man quickly agreed, and the two arranged to meet at Dounan Metro Station at 9 a.m. on Saturday.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: Drank a glass of warm milk, changed into comfortable pajamas, and continued reading “Skin” with the bookmark in it. After reading for over half an hour, she put down the book and did a few simple yoga stretches on the bed to relieve the muscle tension from sitting all day and walking.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and gratitude meditation
description: After finishing stretching, I went to the bathroom to wash up carefully and do skincare. Back in bed, I turned off the main light, turned on the small bedside lamp, and spent five minutes in a brief gratitude meditation, recalling today's smooth signing, family support, and friends' blessings, feeling calm and satisfied inside.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Random notes and outlook for tomorrow
description: I reached for my journal on the nightstand and quickly wrote a mood note: "June 18, sunny. With flowers as my pen, I formally write a new chapter." After writing, I briefly listed a few small goals for tomorrow: return books at the community library and contact Teacher He to confirm the initial flower list. After doing all this, I closed the journal, turned off the light contentedly, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Cuihu Community, Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: On a cloudy morning, Sun Yuwei woke up to the 8:30 alarm. After washing up and changing into loungewear, she went to the dining room. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared red date millet porridge, boiled eggs, and pickled vegetables. As they ate, they chatted. Her mother asked about the details of yesterday's contract signing, and Sun Yuwei shared He Lu's affirmation and the prospects for cooperation. Her mother expressed support and encouragement.
location: Dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Working in the study: making a summer plan and preparing the desk for flower arrangements.
description: After breakfast, I returned to the study, took out the light green lotus journal, and carefully made a detailed Summer Mind-Body Balance Plan, including fixed Hatha yoga every Tuesday and Thursday, daily shoulder and neck stretches, adjusting the diet to high protein and more vegetables, setting the phone to silent at 23:00, and going to bed before 23:30. Then I organized yesterday's signed documents, the yoga studio floor plan, and my personal flower arrangement portfolio, created a new folder for the Serenity Yoga and Floral Art Collaboration, and based on the yoga studio's decoration style, conceived the first floral arrangement proposal. I wrote down keywords such as withered branches and white porcelain vases, pink roses and eucalyptus leaves, and hanging green plants, and planned to submit the preliminary plan next week.
location: Study at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mother-daughter lunch time
description: At noon, her mother Li Xiulan prepared cold-mixed rice noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Her father Sun Mingyuan was not present because he had already eaten earlier and had gone out to attend a photography class at the senior citizens' university. Mother and daughter sat facing each other for the meal. Sun Yuwei shared the results of her morning plan, and her mother praised her planning ability, adding that the lotus flowers at Green Lake Park had bloomed and suggesting she take a relaxing walk there in the evening.
location: Dining table in the living room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and preparation before yoga class
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei went back to the bedroom for a 30-minute nap. She woke up around 13:30, changed into a light gray athletic suit, packed her yoga mat, water bottle, and phone into a sports backpack, checked her phone battery, confirmed that it would take only about 15 minutes on foot to reach Jingxin Yoga Life Studio at No. 83 Dongfeng West Road, and booked a 14:00 Hatha yoga class in advance on the mobile app.
location: Bedroom of the home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Hatha yoga class and face-to-face meeting about floral art collaboration
description: At 13:45, she left home on foot wearing earphones playing light music, walked through Renmin Middle Road, and arrived 15 minutes later at Jingxin Yoga Life Studio, No. 83 Dongfeng West Road. At 14:00, she attended a 60-minute Hatha yoga class on time, following instructor He Lu through a sequence combining breath and postures. Although she still felt unfamiliar with poses such as Triangle Pose and Warrior II Pose, she gradually got the hang of it. After class, He Lu gave her a simple posture assessment and specifically recommended strengthening shoulder and neck relaxation at least twice a week. Afterwards, the two drank lemon water in the rest area and had an in-depth discussion about the floral design collaboration. Sun Yuwei showed her initial concept, and He Lu praised the Oriental aesthetic plan of "dried branches and white porcelain vase," agreeing to refine the color scheme and purchasing list next time. She left on foot around 16:00 and got home at 16:15.
location: Classroom and rest area, 3rd floor, Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Center, 83 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Summer walk in Green Lake Park and soundscape capture.
description: After getting home, she washed her face, changed into a cotton-linen dress and canvas shoes, put her phone, earphones, and pocket notebook into a canvas bag, and rested for a while. At 17:00 she walked to Cuihu Park. The setting sun spread across the lake, lotus leaves were dense, lotus buds were just beginning to open, and many photography enthusiasts stopped to take photos. Under the willows by the lake, elderly men were playing chess at stone tables, and onlookers fanning themselves with palm-leaf fans occasionally exclaimed in admiration; couples whispered on benches; vendors hawked fresh lotus seedpods and boiled peanuts. Sun Yuwei used her phone to take photos of the silhouettes of lotus leaves, close-ups of the old men playing chess, and the backs of vendors. She also opened Voice Memos to record the wind, the sound of chess pieces being placed, and children's laughter, planning to use the material for her serial column “The Soundscape of Summer.” At about 18:15 she left through the east gate of the park, bought mineral water at a grocery store on the way, and walked about 15 minutes back home.
location: Cuihu Park and its surroundings, 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening family dinner
description: When she got home, her mother, Li Xiulan, had already prepared dinner, including fish with pickled vegetables, stir-fried garland chrysanthemum, and seaweed egg drop soup. Her father was still out, so mother and daughter sat facing each other for the meal. Sun Yuwei shared her yoga class experience and what she saw while walking by Green Lake, mentioning the old men playing chess and the vendor selling lotus seedpods. Her mother recalled memories of strolling around Green Lake in the evenings when she was young. After the meal, Sun Yuwei voluntarily cleared the dishes and wiped the table.
location: Dining table in the living room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Parent-child movie time: 'A Bite of China'
description: After cleaning up, mother and daughter sat down on the living room sofa. Her mother suggested watching a cultural program, so they streamed “The Taste of Time” from A Bite of China, an episode about human-interest stories of fermented and preserved foods. While watching, Sun Yuwei paid attention to details she could use in her writing, such as the aroma of old-vat pickled cabbage and the sheen of winter cured pork. After it ended, the two discussed the episode, and her mother said they could try making homemade pickles another day. Sun Yuwei happily looked forward to it.
location: Sofa area in the living room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Column revision and exploring new topics
description: Back in the study, she turned on her computer and saw that editor Xu Mingyuan had replied, affirming that the draft of 'The Liveliness of the Wenlin Street Morning Market' submitted yesterday was finely observed, but suggesting that she add a passage describing the various sounds of the market — vendor calls, clashing pots and bowls, bargaining, and so on — to enhance the sense of presence. Sun Yuwei recalled the details, added a sound passage of about 200 characters, and resubmitted it. She then browsed local news websites and noticed a report on the 'renovation of Kunming's old neighborhoods,' thinking it could be a topic worth exploring in depth for the next column.
location: Study at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime journaling, stretching, and reading
description: After turning off the computer, she took out her light green journal. On the planning page, she wrote down the day's key points in blue ink and gave herself a score of "B+"; in the mind-body balance check-in section, she checked off "yoga class," "walk," and "light dinner." Then she did a 10-minute shoulder and neck stretch on the yoga mat in the bedroom. Afterwards, she washed up and did her evening skincare routine, and heard her father come home in the living room and speak softly with her mother. After changing into loungewear, she leaned against the headboard and read about 15 minutes of Wang Zengqi's "The Plants of the Human World" under the warm yellow lamp. As drowsiness grew, she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully around 23:00.
location: Study and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk around Green Lake
description: At 7:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei put on her lightweight sneakers, walked through Cuihu Community, and met her neighbor Auntie Xie Xiulan, who was doing morning exercise, at the entrance of the residential area; they greeted each other. Then she walked along Cuihu South Road to the South Gate of Green Lake Park, strolled for 20 minutes around the lake in the park, admired the fresh green lotus leaves on the water, and listened to an early-rising elderly man playing the saxophone. She felt delighted.
location: Cuihu Park, 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Washing up, breakfast, and journaling
description: After walking home, Sun Yuwei cleansed her face with warm water and applied sunscreen. Breakfast was flower cakes and hot milk prepared by her mother Li Xiulan. She sat at the dining table, opened her journal, and used a fountain pen to record the date, weather, and mood, and listed today's key matters: Mom's summer vacation, afternoon yoga class, and returning books to Lin Shen in the evening.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning at home: writing and self-improvement
description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the study and first sent He Lu, her yoga instructor, a WeChat message to confirm the afternoon private lesson. Then, based on the revision comments sent back by editor Xu Mingyuan, she gave the final polish to her column piece 'The Bustling Morning Market on Wenlin Street', listened to the morning market recording again to add details, and submitted it by email. Next, she gathered inspiration for the yoga studio's floral design, searched for healing-style flower arrangements, created an online document folder for the 'Tranquil Mind Yoga Studio Summer Rhythm and Breeze Plan', and bookmarked related articles.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Family lunch: Mom is on summer vacation.
description: Mother Li Xiulan came home carrying vegetables and roast duck, announcing that summer vacation had begun. Mother and daughter cooked together in the kitchen; mother made tomato and egg noodles while Sun Yuwei helped slice the roast duck. At the dinner table, mother shared her summer plans: she wanted to join square dancing, learn swimming, and also learn flower arranging. Sun Yuwei promised to teach her and said that in the afternoon she could go to the yoga studio to work on a table flower arrangement plan. After the meal, Sun Yuwei did the dishes and let her mother take a nap.
location: Home restaurant, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Going to the yoga studio
description: Sun Yuwei changed into her yoga clothes, packed her yoga supplies, told her mother, and went out. She walked along Dongfeng West Road, enjoying the shade of the plane trees, and arrived at Dechun Commercial Building after 20 minutes. She took the elevator to the 4th floor, went to Zhongmou Yoga Lifestyle Studio, checked in at the front desk, and changed clothes.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Life Center, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Private one-on-one rehabilitation yoga lesson
description: In the personal training room, coach He Lu guided Sun Yuwei through abdominal breathing, Cat-Cow Pose, Thread-the-Needle Pose, Eagle Arms, and wall shoulder-opening, with hands-on assistance, focusing on relaxing the neck, shoulders, and upper back. The class effectively relieved the neck and shoulder soreness caused by long hours of desk writing.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Life Center, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: After-class exchange and return trip
description: After class, Sun Yuwei drank some water in the rest area and exchanged impressions with He Lu. He Lu suggested two daily exercises: neck side bends and a doorway chest opener, and they scheduled the next class. Sun Yuwei jotted down the key points in her small notebook. Then she changed clothes, left the yoga studio, and on the way stopped at City Garden Supermarket on Fuchun Street to buy white lisianthus, eucalyptus leaves, and baby's breath as flower materials.
location: China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Dechun Commercial Building, 4th Floor, Room 4001, Zhongmou Yoga Lifestyle Studio (after-class exchange); China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 98 Fuchun Street, Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket (shopping).

name: First floral design plan
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the study at home, changed out of her sportswear, and washed her hands. Then she spread white paper on the table and, referring to the yoga studio space photos, hand-drew a sketch of the 'Summer Charm and Clear Breeze' floral arrangement plan. She designed the front desk with a transparent vase holding white calla lilies and eucalyptus leaves, and the changing room with light green ceramic pots accented with lisianthus and baby's breath. She listed the flower materials and a budget of about 300 yuan, and took a photo to send to He Lu for feedback.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening rest and family dinner
description: After finishing the flower arrangement design, Sun Yuwei brewed jasmine tea on the living room balcony to rest. At 6:30 p.m., her father Sun Mingyuan came home from work. Her mother had prepared dinner: stir-fried vegetables, shredded pork with green peppers, and roast duck. At the dinner table, Sun Yuwei shared her feelings about the yoga class and the flower arrangement design. Her father teased her, and the family atmosphere was relaxed and happy. After dinner, mother and daughter cleaned up the dishes together.
location: Home restaurant, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Heading to Mingyuan Bookstore.
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei changed into a cotton-linen dress, took the book Eight Lectures on Poetry to return and the text message tucked inside it, and walked 15 minutes to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (on the way to Mingyuan Bookstore on foot)

name: Saying goodbye to Lin Shen at Mingyuan Bookstore
description: In the window corner of Mingyuan Bookstore, Sun Yuwei met Lin Shen, a graduate student in the history department. He had ordered a hot Americano for her in advance and gave her a hand-bound collection of modern poetry with a blessing inscribed on the flyleaf. Sun Yuwei returned the books and a thank-you letter, and the two talked about his plans to pursue a doctorate in Beijing and his recent reading reflections, spending a warm time together amid the bookstore's soft music and dim yellow lighting.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Seeing someone off and returning alone.
description: The bookstore was about to close, and the two got up. Sun Yuwei stood at the bookstore entrance and watched Lin Shen walk into the night until his figure disappeared. Then she walked home alone along Wenlin Street.
location: From the entrance of Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China, to the way home.

name: Evening journaling and sorting out emotions
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei recorded the day's events in detail in her journal: her mother's return, yoga class, floral art inspiration, and her farewell to Lin Shen. She read aloud a poem by Hai Zi from the poetry collection Lin Shen had given her, then treasured the collection on her bookshelf. Looking at the lisianthus she had bought, she thought about using it tomorrow to create a flower arrangement expressing remembrance and blessings.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Pre-sleep preparation and simple stretching
description: Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas and, on the yoga mat on the floor, followed He Lu's advice by doing neck tilts and shoulder rolls to stretch for 3 minutes. Then she washed up and applied body lotion. After getting into bed, she sent a message to her older sister Sun Yuxin in Shenzhen to share the day's experiences, and her sister replied with a head-pat emoji.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: Sun Yuwei put her phone on silent, turned off the desk lamp, and, with the day's faint melancholy and calm, sank into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning wake-up and getting ready
description: At dawn on the summer solstice, it was already fully bright. Sun Yuwei woke up naturally before her alarm and was still moved by last night's goodbye with Lin Shen, but she wanted even more to record this feeling. After a quick wash-up, she changed into a comfortable cotton-linen long dress, went to the study, and opened the curtains to let the summer solstice sunlight spill across the desk. She wrote the date in her journal and drew a shooting star symbol as the prelude to the day's creation.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (own residence)

name: Writing the prose piece A Solo Journey
description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the study, created a new document, and began writing under the title A Person's Journey. The scene of saying goodbye to Lin Shen at the bookstore last night, the warmth of his fingertips when he handed her the poetry collection, and fragments of late-night WeChat conversations over this period all flowed into smooth prose. During writing, she got up twice to get water in the living room and water the mint on the windowsill. By 11 a.m., she finished a draft essay of about 2,200 characters. After reading through the whole piece, she felt much calmer, and saved the file to the essay collection Slow Travel Notes as item No. 16.

At their familiar stall, they bought green-headed mushrooms, porcini mushrooms, and several seasonal vegetables. Sun Yuwei also picked a small bouquet of mixed-color lisianthus, blueberries, and a pot of mint at the flower shop. Her mother laughed that she bought more flowers than vegetables.

location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (own residence)

She walked slowly along the lake for about 50 minutes, watching night joggers, hand-in-hand couples, and the shimmering lake under the streetlights, recalling the essay she had written that day and last night's farewell, and gradually felt calmer inside. On the way home, she ordered a box of replacement pen refills for her journal.

location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (own residence)

On the owner's recommendation, she bought a medium kenzan for 65 yuan, Ikenobo special flower scissors for 120 yuan, an antique-style black water basin for 80 yuan, and binding aluminum wire for 15 yuan, 280 yuan in total. Su Man shared the schedule for tomorrow's workshop, emphasizing the basic composition of rikka and the structure of 'shin, soe, uke,' and reminded her to bring a notebook. They agreed to meet at the classroom door at 8:30 tomorrow morning.

The rice noodles were smooth, the tofu pudding refreshing, and the grilled erkuai crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside—she ate very contentedly. After finishing, she took a photo of the flower market and sent it to the 'Yuwei Slow Records' Xiaohongshu material folder.

Su Man replied suggesting she add water to the basin until the cut ends were submerged and tilt the main stem 15 degrees to the left. After adjusting, Sun Yuwei's arrangement looked even better.

description: Mother Li Xiulan cut watermelon, and the whole family sat in the living room eating and chatting. Sun Yuwei told them about running into Su Man at the flower market and tomorrow’s workshop, and her parents were very happy. Afterward, she returned to the study, opened the floral design class notes from the yoga studio, and, using the theme ‘Summer Charm, Clear Breeze,’ made a shopping list of flower materials in her phone notes: white calla lilies, areca palm leaves, jasmine, and light green lisianthus, planning to buy them wholesale in Dounan after the workshop.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Help set up dinner and dine with family
description: Sun Yuwei helped her mother set the table and carry dishes. Dinner included fish with pickled cabbage and cucumber salad. The family of three ate and chatted; Sun Yuwei shared amusing stories from the flower market, and her father talked about the 'Old Kunming Streets and Alleys' cultural exhibition his workplace was preparing, inviting her to go see it.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening study, organizing notes, and updating Xiaohongshu and journal.
description: Sun Yuwei turned on the desk lamp in the study. She spent the first half hour organizing the day's knowledge of rikka structure into systematic notes and drawing detailed diagrams. Then she took photos of the purchased tools and flower materials, noting prices and insights. Next she edited her Xiaohongshu account "Yuwei Slow Record," publishing preview content and photos of her work. Finally, she opened her journal and used stickers and highlighters to record the day's important moments, pasting in the flower market ticket and a eucalyptus leaf.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Stretching and meditation before bed
description: Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas and did a 15-minute pre-bedtime stretch on the yoga mat in her bedroom, relaxing her shoulders, back, and leg muscles. Then she put on her earphones and followed a 10-minute guided meditation audio, feeling the rhythm of her breathing and calming her mind.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and falling asleep.
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the bedside lamp, leaving only the small desk lamp on, and read the Differential Mode of Association chapter in From the Soil, thinking about Fei Xiaotong's description of the acquaintance society and considering that it could be used as material for next week's column. After reading half the chapter, she closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep, looking forward to tomorrow's flower arrangement workshop.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine: get up, wash up, have breakfast, and organize the tool kit
description: The 7 o'clock alarm went off. When Sun Yuwei woke up, the soreness in her shoulders and wrists felt lighter than yesterday. Out of habit, she opened Xiaohongshu and was pleasantly surprised to find that Yuwei's Slow Recordings had over 1,000 followers. She read several comments praising the layout and content, took a screenshot, and then got up contentedly. After washing up, she carefully applied sunscreen in front of the mirror. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared breakfast with rice noodles and fried eggs. As they ate, they chatted about today's flower arrangement workshop. After the meal, she went back to her room and packed a water basin, a needle frog, flower scissors, handouts, and band-aids into a canvas bag. After confirming everything was in order, she put the bag on her back.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking the subway to the flower arrangement classroom
description: Messaged flower friend Su Man on WeChat to let her know I was leaving, and got a flower emoji reply. Walked about 5 minutes from home to Wuyi Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1 toward Daxuecheng South Station, arrived at Dounan Station after about 50 minutes, then walked about 5 minutes to the flower arrangement classroom. On the way, on the metro, I used my journal to write down today's small goals: memorize the vertical flower structure, master the technique of fixing the three main branches, and organize my notes in the evening.
location: From Wuyi Road Metro Station in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Dounan Metro Station in Chenggong District, finally arriving at the 'Manye Flower Art' shared classroom on the second floor of Huahua World inside Dounan Flower Market.

name: Attended the Ikenobo Ikebana workshop (morning course).
description: Arrived earlier than the agreed time; Su Man had already set up the venue and offered her a cup of self-brewed rose tea. In the morning class, Su Man taught the basic rules of Rikka, explaining in detail the material selection principles and angle-fixing techniques for the three main branches: shin, soe, and uke. Sun Yuwei seriously practiced fixing the shin branch over and over with pine branches, but the angle was always not upright enough. Her finger was pricked by the kenzan, and a small drop of blood oozed out. She applied a Band-Aid and continued practicing. Su Man passed by, helped adjust it, and likened it to a pine tree on a cliff.
location: Shared classroom of 'Manye Floral Art' on the second floor of Flower World, Dounan Flower Market (No. 76 Jingui Street), Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Workshop lunch break, light meal, and flower market visit.
description: After class, went with Su Man and two or three other trainees to the Huale Food Court on the second floor of the flower market to eat rice noodles. During the meal, they exchanged the morning's insights and asked about the practical problem of the offset angle of the 'lateral branch'. A senior trainee enthusiastically answered. After finishing quickly, they strolled for a few minutes in the fresh-cut flower section of the flower market to relax their eyes and mood.
location: Huale Food Plaza on the second floor of Dounan Flower Market and the fresh-cut flower section, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Attend the Ikenobo Ikebana workshop (afternoon practice)
description: The afternoon practice was more intensive; she used the experience gained during the lunch break to readjust the angles of the floral materials. During practice, her finger was pricked by the needle frog again, but she put on a band-aid and continued. In the end, she completed the work, and Su Man commented that “the structure is stable.” Although it was not stunning, it was a very good start for Sun Yuwei, who was learning the rules of rikka systematically for the first time.
location: Shared classroom of 'Manye Floral Art' on the second floor of Flower World, Dounan Flower Market (No. 76 Jingui Street), Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After class, buying medicine, taking the subway home, and reviewing
description: After class, she packed up her tools and said goodbye to her flower-arranging friends. She walked to the Jianzhijia Health Pharmacy (Yinshi Jiayuan Branch) at the entrance to the flower market and bought waterproof band-aids and iodine cotton swabs to have on hand. Then she walked about 10 minutes to Dounan Metro Station and took Metro Line 1 back. On the train, she sat in a window seat, took out her journal, and quickly sketched a diagram of the angles of the three main branches of rikka from memory, marking the key points with a three-color pen: the true branch standing tall, the secondary branch at 15 degrees, and the inviting branch in the opposite direction. This made her understanding of the day's knowledge points clearer.
location: Jianzhijia Health Pharmacy (Yinshi Jiayuan Branch), Longxing Road, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, then via Dounan Metro Station to Wuyi Road Metro Station

name: Returning home for dinner, politely declining the publishing invitation, and relaxing with family.
description: After arriving home, her mother had already kept dinner for her: braised pork ribs, cucumber salad, and greens. Sun Yuwei ate while scrolling through her phone and saw a private message on RedNote from an editor at Qinghe Publishing House asking if she would consider publishing her journal as a book. After thinking for five minutes, remembering that she was focused on writing the essay collection 'Slow Living Notes', she politely declined: she would complete the current work first, and perhaps they could collaborate in the future if the opportunity arose. After sending the reply, she felt at ease. After dinner, she took the initiative to clear the dishes, then sat in the living room with her mother watching TV and chatting. She shared funny stories from learning flower arrangement and showed the band-aids on her hands; her mother told her to be careful. After resting for a while, she changed into flat shoes and prepared for a walk.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking in the neighborhood garden and listening to podcasts
description: She put on her earphones, played the newly discovered podcast of Yunnan folk stories, and strolled slowly around the community garden for more than thirty minutes to loosen her legs and feet, which had become stiff from standing for a long time. Passing the small square, her neighbor Aunt Xie, who was walking her dog, greeted her, and they exchanged a few casual words about family life.
location: Garden and square in the residential community at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxing shower and browsing illustrated planners.
description: After walking home, she took a hot bath to relax her whole body. She changed into pajamas, curled up in bed, and opened Xiaohongshu to browse casually. She was drawn to several bloggers' illustrated journals, which vividly combined watercolor and collage. She watched for nearly an hour, and an idea grew in her mind to learn illustration and make her journal more unique.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Explore a Learning Path for Digital Illustration
description: She sat up in bed, opened her laptop, searched “Learning Digital Illustration from Scratch” and “Drawing Tablet Recommendations,” carefully browsed course websites and Zhihu experience posts, jotted down well-reviewed courses and entry-level drawing tablet models on sticky notes, and posted them on the corkboard by her desk, deciding to sign up for a class when the chance came.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of her home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Update Xiaohongshu and write in the journal
description: She opened Xiaohongshu, politely replied to the publishing house editor's private message, once again expressing her thanks and declining. Then she updated her feed: she chose a photo of the tatehana work taken after the workshop, wrote a caption sharing her learning experience, and also shared the joy of passing 1,000 followers. After that, she took out her beloved journal and carefully recorded everything about the day, from the morning surprise, the flower arrangement challenge, the determination in declining the invitation, to the excitement of a new hobby.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of her home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stretching, reading, listening to music, and falling asleep before bed.
description: She turned off her computer and phone, did a 15-minute pre-sleep stretch on the bed, relaxing her shoulders, neck, and wrists. Then she picked up “From the Soil” and read quietly for half an hour. After that, she put on headphones, played soothing instrumental music, closed her eyes, reviewed the day’s experiences, set the alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow, and finally turned off the bedside lamp, falling asleep quickly in the moonlight and the distant sound of traffic.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Wake up, wash up, eat breakfast
description: At 7:00 a.m., the alarm went off. Yuwei got up and went to the bathroom to wash up, carefully avoiding the wound on the middle finger of her right hand, which was covered with a band-aid. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had already prepared breakfast: plain congee, boiled eggs, and a dish of fermented bean curd. While eating, she browsed Xiaohongshu on her phone and left comments and likes on yesterday's photos of her work.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Treating the wound, booking a beauty salon appointment, and organizing the tool kit
description: After breakfast, she returned to the bedroom and cleaned the fingertip pricked by the kenzan with an iodine cotton swab, then put on a waterproof bandage. Next, she found the phone number of “Yueji Beauty and Wellness Club” and booked the basic skin care treatment (deep cleansing, hydration, and soothing massage, 188 yuan) for this Saturday, June 28, at 10:00 in the morning. The customer service representative reminded her not to wear makeup that day. She recorded the appointment details in her journal, then checked and organized her ikebana tool kit to make sure the flower shears, kenzan, and other tools were all in place.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute: Heading to Dounan Flower Market
description: Yuwei put on a cotton-linen shirt, shouldered her tool bag, left at 7:55, walked 8 minutes to Wuyi Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 (toward University City South) for about 35 minutes, and reviewed the key points of flower arrangement on her phone memos on the way.
location: Metro Line 2 from Wuyi Road Station in Wuhua District to Dounan Station in Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Arrive at Dounan Flower Market and head to the classroom.
description: At 8:40, she exited Dounan Station, walked through the busy flower market trading hall in the morning, and arrived at the Ikenobo flower arrangement classroom on the second floor of the flower market by 8:55.
location: Ikenobo Ikebana classroom, 2nd floor, Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Ikebana workshop, day 2: Basic Seika style (morning)
description: The morning class focused on the basic form of Seika. The instructor demonstrated inserting Seika into three types of flower containers — a vase, a bowl, and a dish — emphasizing the angle of the stems and the direction of plant growth. During practice, Yuwei focused on 'a posture as if in the wind', adjusting the tilt of the anthurium stems, and was especially careful not to be pricked by the needle frog.
