location: Ikenobo Ikebana classroom, 2nd floor, Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch break: had lunch with the participants and exchanged thoughts.
description: After the class, Yuwei, teaching assistant Su Man, and several students went to the food court on the first floor of Dounan Flower Market for rice noodles. During lunch, she asked Su Man for tips on adjusting anthurium flower stems. Su Man explained with photos and demonstrated how to balance the composition using the direction of the green leaves. Everyone shared insights from their morning practice.
location: Food Court, First Floor, Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Ikebana workshop Day 2: Seika basic form (afternoon).
description: In the afternoon, she continued to practice in depth. Within three hours, Yuwei independently completed a plate flower arrangement using 15 stems of materials including bamboo, anthuriums, and bird of paradise leaves. She worked hard to apply what she had learned in the morning, and her work earned the instructor's comment that it 'felt like a gentle breeze brushing the face.'
location: Ikenobo Ikebana classroom, 2nd floor, Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Packed up the tools and said goodbye to Su Man.
description: After the class, Yuwei cleaned the workbench, wiped the kenzan and flower scissors clean and put them away, and agreed with Su Man to meet again at the next workshop.
location: Ikenobo Ikebana classroom, 2nd floor, Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Commute: Return to downtown
description: She entered Dounan Station and boarded Metro Line 2 for the return trip. On the train, she played with the areca palm leaves and reviewed the diagonal insertion technique.
location: Metro Line 2 from Dounan Station, Chenggong District, to Wuyi Road Station, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Return home to put away tools, take a quick rest, and change clothes
description: Arrived home at 16:50, put the tool kit back on the shelf in the flower-arranging area, washed her face, changed into loose loungewear and yoga pants, and prepared for yoga class.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: After changing clothes, Yuwei left at 17:10 and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, enjoying the evening breeze.
location: Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, walking from home to Dechun Commercial Building

name: Warm-up and communication before class
description: Arriving at the yoga studio half an hour early, Yuwei told the instructor He Lu that her shoulders and arms were tense from arranging flowers all day, and then did her own warm-up for her neck, shoulders, and spine.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rehabilitation and physical therapy yoga course
description: The class started at 18:00. Aimed at shoulder and arm fatigue, it used twists, cat-cow pose, and weight-bearing poses to relax the trapezius and rotator cuff muscles. After class, she felt her shoulders were relaxed and the pain in her fingertips had eased.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home
description: After the class, Yuwei changed clothes and walked home with a relaxed body and mind, enjoying the cool evening breeze.
location: Dongfeng West Road to Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Arrived home, prepared dinner
description: After entering, her mother had almost finished preparing dinner. Yuwei washed her hands and went to the kitchen to help bring out the bowls, chopsticks, and soup.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home kitchen and dining room

name: Dinner: celebrating father's photography award
description: During dinner, her father Sun Mingyuan announced that his photograph Morning Mist over Green Lake had won the Best Artistic Conception Award in the senior university's final photography review and would be recommended for the district's public art exhibition. Her mother praised him, Yuwei congratulated him, and suggested celebrating at the dessert shop on Green Lake North Road over the weekend. Her father also mentioned planning a self-driving tour route. The dinner atmosphere was cheerful.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Organized workshop notes and practiced floral pattern drafts.
description: After the meal, Yuwei used areca palm leaves in the flower arrangement practice area to simulate the diagonal insertion technique she learned today. She drew three structural sketches of flower arrangements in her journal, marked the key angles, and decided to buy more inexpensive flowers to practice with after completing the course.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; the flower arrangement practice area in the bedroom at home.

name: Night stretching and skincare
description: Before bed, she did a 10-minute shoulder and neck stretch, cleaned the wound on her finger with povidone-iodine and applied a band-aid, then put on a hydrating mask (as a warm-up for Saturday's skincare routine).
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and falling asleep
description: Before turning off the light, she picked up the essay collection by her bed and read a few pages, then turned off the light and got ready to sleep, feeling fulfilled.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation of flower arrangement tools
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off, and sunlight streamed through the curtains into the room. Thinking about today being the completion day of the flower arrangement workshop, she felt elated. While washing up, she checked the right middle finger that had been scratched by the kenzan the day before; the wound had scabbed over and was fine. She changed into a comfortable thin white cotton-linen dress and packed her flower arrangement tool kit: kenzan, flower scissors, water tray, spray bottle, and so on, checking them one by one to ensure everything was in order.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and creative sharing
description: Mother Li Xiulan prepared breakfast: a bowl of steaming small-pot rice noodles, accompanied by a plate of cut mango. While eating, Sun Yuwei shared her idea for today's final project—using green pomegranate branches and pink lotus flowers to express “the stillness and clamor of midsummer”. Father Sun Mingyuan nodded and praised the title as very evocative, while her mother reminded her that the sun was strong and not to forget to bring water.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking the subway to Dounan Flower Market
description: After breakfast, I applied sunscreen at home, put on my canvas bag carrying a tool kit, and left home at 7:45. I walked about 8 minutes to Wuyi Road Metro Station and entered by scanning my ride code. I took Metro Line 2 to Huancheng South Road Station, transferred to Line 1, and headed to Dounan. About 40 minutes later, at 8:15, I arrived at Dounan Station, then walked to the flower market after exiting the station. Along the way, I saw many flower farmers carrying fresh flowers, and the air was filled with a faint floral fragrance.
location: Kunming Metro, Yunnan Province: Line 2 to Line 1

name: Field trip and inspiration gathering before the flower market class
description: Arrived early at Dounan Flower Market and didn't go straight to the classroom. Wandered through the fresh-cut flower trading area, taking in the most vibrant morning atmosphere of the flower market. Saw piles of hydrangeas, lilies, and sunflowers; touched the newly arrived pomegranate branches to feel their toughness and curvature, and quickly sketched a few lines in my journal to confirm the composition proportions for 'Sounds of Summer' conceived last night. Also took a few photos of lotus flowers with beautiful light and shadow as reference material.
location: Fresh Cut Flower Trading Area, Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Learning the principles of free-style flower arrangement composition
description: At 9 a.m., the class started on time. Teacher Su Man explained the core concept of free-style flower arrangement—emphasizing personal emotion and negative space—and used palm leaves as an example to demonstrate how to create unique lines and a sense of space through techniques such as twisting and tearing. Sun Yuwei listened attentively and tried to imitate on the practice materials she had brought. She found the palm leaves tough and highly malleable, and the small wound on her finger gave her a subtle tactile sensation when she touched the leaves, making her more focused.
location: 'Huajianji' Classroom, Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunchtime exchange and creative discussion
description: After class at noon, she went to the Huale Food Plaza in the flower market with Su Man and two classmates she knew well. The place was bustling, with all kinds of snack stalls. Sun Yuwei ordered a bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles and a bowl of cool papaya water. During the meal, everyone talked about their own understanding of ikebana. She asked Su Man for advice on how to combine digital illustration with ikebana works. Su Man was very interested and suggested trying to use illustration to deconstruct the lines of plants, which gave her new ideas for her future creative direction.
location: Huale Food Plaza, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Final piece: Sounds of Summer.
description: In the afternoon it was time for the graduation creative work. Sun Yuwei chose the following materials for her concept: two green pomegranate branches with natural curves, a half-open pink lotus flower, three spreading lotus leaves, and several supple foxtail grasses. She arranged these elements at varying heights in a shallow water dish, creating the mood of "the cicadas' chirping makes the forest seem even more tranquil." Teacher Su Man, while making her rounds, stopped in front of her work and commented, "Bold yet harmonious, with a sense of musicality." Sun Yuwei felt a deep sense of accomplishment, and the wound on her finger seemed to hurt less.
location: 'Huajianji' Classroom, Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Completion ceremony and group photo
description: At around 4 p.m., the completion ceremony officially began. Su Man presented completion certificates for Ikenobo flower arrangement to ten students, including Sun Yuwei, one by one. Sun Yuwei accepted hers with both hands, a warm surge rising in her heart. Afterwards, everyone took a group photo in front of their own works. Su Man held her hand, encouraged her to continue advancing, and recommended the intermediate course in September. Sun Yuwei and several classmates added each other on WeChat and created a group chat named "2025 Ikenobo Workshop," agreeing to share works and exchange regularly in the future.
location: 'Huajianji' Classroom, Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Saying goodbye to the flower market and planning the return trip
description: After the closing ceremony, Sun Yuwei reluctantly said goodbye to Su Man and her classmates at the entrance to the flower market. She walked out alone; the sunshine was still bright. Feeling the weight of the hand tool kit, she felt full of fulfillment. She opened the map on her phone and planned a route to Baiteng Digital Plaza.
location: Entrance to Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Subway ride back and researching graphics tablets
description: From Dounan Station, she took Metro Line 1 back to the city center. Along the way, Sun Yuwei took out her phone and carefully reviewed the reviews of several entry-level graphics tablets she had saved last night (Wacom, Gaomon, etc.) in her notes app, comparing feel, pressure sensitivity, price, and user reviews. She recorded the key parameters on the 'Digital Devices' page of her journal and initially shortlisted two models within a budget of 500-600 yuan. She got off at Xiaocaiyuan Station at 17:40 and walked about 10 minutes to Baiteng Digital Plaza.
location: Transfer from Metro Line 1 to Line 2, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Trying out a graphics tablet at Digital Plaza
description: At 5:50 p.m., she walked into a drawing equipment store called "Zhihui Digital" in Baiteng Digital Plaza. After explaining her purpose to the clerk, she personally tried the Wacom One (about 650 yuan) and the Gaomon M6 (about 480 yuan) she had previously liked online. She carefully felt the touch of the pen tip on the tablet surface and the delicacy of the pressure sensitivity, and asked about compatibility with drawing software. After nearly an hour of comparison, she leaned toward the Wacom One for its smooth feel like a real paintbrush and decided to come back to buy it tomorrow.
location: Zhihui Digital Store, Baiteng Digital Plaza, No. 127 Yuantong North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking Home and a Sugarcane Juice Break
description: After finishing the experience, she walked out of the Digital Plaza and decided to walk home, relaxing along the way. The evening sunlight had softened, and a gentle breeze was blowing. She walked south along Yuantong North Road to Renmin Middle Road, passed a stall selling freshly squeezed sugarcane juice, bought a cup, stood there taking a few sips, watching the after-work crowds and traffic while sorting through the rich thoughts of the day, and felt very pleasant.
location: Along Yuantong North Road to Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and sharing the joy of finishing the course
description: When she got home, her mother was preparing dinner, and the aroma of mushroom chicken soup drifted out of the kitchen. Sun Yuwei excitedly showed her parents the completion certificate and photos of her work "Summer Sounds" on her phone. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, felt proud of her. He looked at the photos several times and brought up his award-winning photograph "Morning Mist over Green Lake," saying that art is universal. Her mother asked about changing the appointment at the beauty salon, and she said she had already called and changed it to 2 p.m. At the dinner table, the family chatted and laughed in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize certificates and share reflections.
description: After dinner, she returned to the study. She carefully taped the completion certificate onto the special page of her journal with clear tape, and beside it wrote in colored pens the creative inspiration for "Sound of Summer" and a summary of the three-day course: "From the precision of standing flowers to the boldness of free flowers, ikebana is the art of subtraction. I learned to have a dialogue with plants." Then she opened WeChat, sent the carefully selected photos of her work to the "Besties Trio" group and the "College Roommates" group, and immediately received a flood of praise. She happily replied to each one.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Online registration for the digital illustration course
description: As planned, I turned on the computer and logged in to the course platform for 'Introduction to Digital Illustration for Beginners' that I had been following a few days ago. I confirmed the course details again: an 8-week course, costing 599 yuan, starting at 8 p.m. on July 1 (next Wednesday). I decisively filled in my personal information and completed the registration via WeChat Pay. Afterwards, following the instructions received by email, I downloaded the trial version of the accompanying drawing software and registered the account required for the tutorials, feeling excited about stepping into a new artistic field.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walking around Green Lake and rescheduling the beauty appointment
description: After successfully registering, she felt a bit keyed up and decided to go out for a walk to calm down. Following a familiar route, she walked toward Green Lake Park near her home. At night, Green Lake was even more tranquil, with the streetlights along the shore reflected on the water. While strolling, she called Yueji Beauty & Wellness Club to reschedule tomorrow morning's 10 a.m. skin care appointment to 2 p.m., and confirmed the address and precautions. The evening breeze was pleasant, and as she sorted out her rhythm for flower arrangement and illustration classes, she felt at ease.
location: Around Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime stretching and planning for tomorrow
description: After returning home, she changed out of her long dress and did 10 minutes of gentle stretching on the mat in the living room to relieve the tension in her shoulders, neck, and lower back from standing and walking all day. After stretching, she sat at her desk, opened a new page in her journal, and began planning the next day's (June 28) itinerary: buy the Wacom One drawing tablet she had her eye on at the digital mall in the morning, and go to the beauty salon at 2 p.m. for skin care. After planning, she opened “From the Soil” by her bedside and read the chapters after “The Differential Mode of Association,” about 30 pages.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wrapping up the journal and going to bed
description: Closing "From the Soil," she picked up her pen and put the finishing touches on today's journal. She drew a small lotus leaf outline and embellished the page with a photo of today's completion certificate, screenshots of the course registration, and simple line drawings of digital illustration software icons beside the text. After finishing the entry, she replied to the unread messages in her close friends' group and her roommates' group, and set the alarm for 7:00 tomorrow morning. She turned off the desk lamp, lay in bed, and reviewing this fulfilling and complete day, she fell into a deep sleep at 23:00, her heart full of pride and expectations for the future.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning washing up and breakfast
description: Woke up at seven in the morning, washed up and did skincare, and treated the small wound on her hand left from yesterday's flower arrangement practice. She had breakfast with her mother Li Xiulan, eating small wontons with fresh pork filling and steamed sweet potatoes. During their chat, she mentioned her plan to buy a drawing tablet and take an illustration course today. Her mother advised her to be patient when learning new things. While eating, she browsed Xiaohongshu on her phone and replied to several comments about last night's work "Sounds of Summer".
location: Home at Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk to Baiteng Digital Plaza
description: After breakfast, she checked her backpack, packing her wallet, phone, power bank, water bottle, and folding umbrella. She put on canvas shoes, said goodbye to her mother, and went out. She walked along Renmin Middle Road, passing familiar breakfast stalls and newsstands, and headed toward Baiteng Digital Plaza in the fresh air after the rain, arriving about 25 minutes later.
location: From Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Baiteng Digital Plaza, No. 127 Yuantong North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, via Renmin Middle Road and Yuantong North Road.

name: Choosing an entry-level drawing tablet
description: At the drawing tablet specialty zone on the third floor of Baiteng Digital Plaza, combining yesterday's hands-on experience with a cost-performance comparison, I finally bought a 'Huijing Pro' drawing tablet for 498 yuan, with a basic version of drawing software included. I felt a slight pang when paying, but I was full of anticipation about learning a new field.
location: 3rd Floor, Baiteng Digital Plaza, 127 Yuantong North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Zhibushi Bookstore to Read and Take Notes
description: Carrying the newly bought drawing tablet, I walked about 13 minutes to Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore. After greeting the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan, I ordered a hot latte and sat by the window in the literature section reading Dajia magazine. I was touched by an essay about 'Dusk at Green Lake' and, thinking of my own column topic, took out my notebook and quickly jotted down a few keywords and writing directions.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning Home, Lunch, and Midday Rest
description: After leaving the bookstore, she took a detour around Cuihu Lake, photographed the misty lake surface after the rain and the green willow branches, and saved the photos to the 'Column Material' album on her phone. She quickened her pace and walked home, where she had lunch with her mother, Li Xiulan. The dishes included stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised pork ribs, and tomato and egg soup. They chatted about the morning's experiences while eating, and she showed off her newly bought drawing tablet. After the meal, she helped clear the dishes, then went back to the bedroom, drew the curtains, and took a nap for about half an hour.
location: Home at Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Take the bus to the beauty salon
description: After my midday rest, I got up, washed my face, applied sunscreen, and left with a small crossbody bag. I walked to Xiaoximen Bus Stop, took Bus No. 83, got off at Dongfeng West Road stop after about three stops, and walked two minutes to Yueji Beauty and Wellness Club. There was a bit of traffic on the way, but I had allowed plenty of time and arrived without rushing.
location: From Xiaoximen Station near Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, take Bus 83 to Dongfeng West Road Station, and arrive at Yueji Beauty and Wellness Club, No. 88 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: First professional skincare treatment.
description: She arrived at the beauty salon early, checked in at the front desk, drank rose tea, and filled out a skin-type questionnaire. At 14:00, the beautician Xiao Zhou led her into the treatment room and performed a basic deep-cleaning and hydrating facial treatment that lasted about 1.5 hours. During the treatment, Xiao Zhou noticed the small scratches on her fingers and thoughtfully applied a repairing ointment after the facial was done. After the treatment, her skin was clear and hydrated, and on Xiao Zhou's recommendation she bought a bottle of moisturizing lotion.
location: Yueji Beauty and Wellness Club, No. 88 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and recording the care experience
description: After the treatment, she took the bus back home along the same route. Sitting at her desk, she opened her journal and carefully recorded the treatment steps, product experience, and comfort level (9 points), and wrote down Professor Xiao Zhou's daily skincare advice. Then she set four quarterly skincare reminders in her phone calendar (September 28, December 28, March 28), took a screenshot and sent it to her mother Li Xiulan, with the message: Mom's intervention plan has started, time to be a bit more polished! and got a laughing emoji reply from her mother.
location: Home at Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Unpack, install drivers, and test the graphics tablet
description: After recording the care experience, she could not wait to unbox the drawing tablet. She connected it to her laptop via USB and downloaded and installed the latest driver from the official website. After restarting the computer, the driver showed a successful connection. She opened the drawing software, created a new canvas, and used the pressure-sensitive pen to test lines of varying pressure and thickness. The pen was responsive and smooth, everything worked normally, and she was satisfied with the device.
location: Bedroom at home, Kongjian Junyuan, 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk and observation at Green Lake
description: Seeing the fresh air after the rain, she changed into her sneakers, told her mother, and walked to Green Lake Park. She strolled along the lakeshore for about 40 minutes, observing the evening life of residents and the natural scenery: elderly people exercising, children playing, and waterbirds gliding on the lake. She carefully framed shots with her phone, taking photos of preening seagulls, weeping willows, and a sunbathing stray cat, and saved them to the "Column Material" album.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home, preparing the meal, and dinner
description: After the walk, she returned home. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, was already home from work and watching TV. She chatted with her parents about what she had seen on her walk, then went to the kitchen to help her mother, washing vegetables and peeling garlic. At dinner, they enjoyed mushroom chicken soup and several home-style dishes. She served her parents food and soup. At the table, her father mentioned a preliminary idea for a summer road trip, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home at Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: First attempt at creating with a drawing tablet.
description: After dinner, she returned to the bedroom and closed the door, opened the drawing software, and imported the seagull photos taken at Green Lake. She tried to use a graphics tablet to draw the seagulls in flight, but the strokes were hard to control and the lines never came out right. After repeatedly undoing and redrawing, she felt frustrated. In the end, she only completed a slightly stiff seagull outline with background lotus leaves. She saved the practice draft as a JPEG with the number “#001” and sent it to the best friends group (Zhang Jing, Chen Sisi, Wang Xinran), mockingly saying, “A digital novice has just started; here is my first abstract seagull……” Zhang Jing replied, “It has a soul,” which brought a little comfort.
location: Bedroom at home, Kongjian Junyuan, 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and sorting floral materials.
description: After putting away the drawing tablet, she opened her journal and recorded the care treatment experience and her feelings about creating with a drawing tablet for the first time. She wrote, "The road of illustration is long and difficult and requires great patience," and drew a small seagull sketch with a question mark next to it. Then she sorted the leftover flowers from the workshop: intact lotus leaves and palm leaves were wrapped in newspaper to make dried flowers, while withered branches were discarded. She took out the certificate of completion for the flower arrangement course and a photo of her work Sound of Summer, pasted them onto a dedicated page in the journal, and wrote, "Flower arrangement is subtraction, and also the pruning of the heart." She photographed it and sent it to Teacher Su Man to express her gratitude.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Kongjian Junyuan, 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Leisure time before bed
description: First, she spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of simple stretching to ease her shoulders and wrists, which were stiff from drawing. Then she leaned against the headboard and read the chapter 'Blood Ties and Geopolitics' in From the Soil. After reading, she left the bedroom and sat on the living room sofa with her mother Li Xiulan, chatting about everyday family matters. She scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while, replied to her best friends' group chat teasing about the seagull painting, and checked tomorrow's (June 29) weather forecast.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Kongjian Junyuan, 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up before bed and going to sleep
description: In the bathroom, she washed her face carefully and applied moisturizing lotion following the method the skincare specialist had taught her, and observed that the wound on her finger had fully healed. Back in the bedroom, she set an alarm for 7:30 a.m., turned off the main light and left only a small bedside night light on, lay down, reviewed the fulfilling day, felt calm and satisfied, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home at Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning routine at home.
description: Woken by the morning light, I meditated and stretched by the bed. After washing up, I changed into a linen dress and canvas shoes. I had breakfast with my mother, eating tofu pudding rice noodles, and discussed today's plan for collecting material. After the meal, I cleared the dishes, checked the items I was taking (notebook, camera, etc.), and then went out.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to Sanyi Teahouse on Wenming Street to gather creative material.
description: Walked to the Duanshi Street bus stop and took Bus No. 3 to Wenming Street. At Sanyi Tea House, I ordered Pu'er tea, watched tea drinkers playing chess and chatting, recorded conversations and expressions, photographed details of the old buildings, and gathered material for my column.
location: No. 15, Wenming Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Sanyi Tea House)

name: Round trip to Fengning Farmers' Market to buy fruit and flowers
description: Take Bus 113 from Wenming Street Station to Jiaoling Intersection Station, and enter Fengning Sunshine Farmers’ Market. Select fresh grapes and peaches, and buy daisies. Get mint leaves given by the fruit vendor. Then take Bus 54 back to the home near Renmin Middle Road.
location: No. 1022 Jiaoling Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Fengning Sunshine Farmers' Market)

name: Returned home to rest and helped mother prepare the meal
description: After returning home, she washed the fruit, placed it on a plate, and put daisies in a vase. She shared her experiences at the teahouse with her mother, showed her the photos, and then went into the kitchen to help pick vegetables and prepare lunch.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Lunch included cold shredded chicken, shredded potatoes with green peppers, and tomato and egg soup. The family of three chatted while eating. Yuwei talked about her observations at the teahouse, and her father recalled his experiences of going to teahouses in his youth. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch break and writing preparation
description: After the meal, I drew the curtains and took a half-hour nap. After waking up feeling refreshed, I made myself an iced brown sugar pearl milk tea and got ready to start the afternoon's writing.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Write the column draft "Old Teahouse: A Pot of Pu'er While Watching Clouds Roll and Unfold"
description: Focused on writing in the study, turning what she had seen and heard during the morning teahouse visit into a draft of her column. Took a 15-minute break on the balcony midway. Completed about 2,000 words and noted at the end to revise tomorrow. Then tidied the desk and filed the materials.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Walking in Green Lake Park, editing photos, and posting an update on Xiaohongshu.
description: In the evening, walk to Green Lake Park and take two laps around the lake. Sit on a lakeside bench, use a phone photo editing app to adjust the teahouse photos to a nostalgic tone, and select nine. After composing the caption, post to Xiaohongshu, tagging the teahouse and the park. After seeing fans' comments and interactions, walk home.
location: Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Park).

name: Family dinner and after-dinner cleanup
description: Dinner was the mushroom hotpot Mother had made, with a delicious broth. As they ate, they shared writing progress and Xiaohongshu feedback. Father talked about the plans of the photography club at the senior college. After the meal, she took the initiative to help clear the dishes, put them in the dishwasher, and wipe down the dining table.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video call with best friend Zhang Jing.
description: In the bedroom, she video-called her best friend Zhang Jing on WeChat and chatted for half an hour. Zhang Jing shared funny stories about her students, and Yuwei talked about her teahouse fieldwork and progress with her drawing tablet. They agreed to visit a creative culture bookstore together next week.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening preparation before bed
description: After finishing the video call, I changed into pajamas and did my evening skincare routine. I archived today's field research notes and the electronic draft to the cloud drive.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Read “From the Soil” and took notes.
description: At her desk, continued reading Fei Xiaotong's From the Soil, reaching the "Elder Rule" chapter. She made margin notes in pencil, copied key concepts into her notebook, and wrote down thoughts connected to her observations at the teahouse.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (at the desk in the bedroom)

name: Bedtime meditation and journal organization
description: Turned off the main light, left the night light on, and did a 10-minute body scan meditation in bed. Then she took out her material notebook and recorded the day’s teahouse details, writing feelings, and interactions with family and friends in words and simple drawings, and pasted in small photo cards of the teahouse.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Free relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: After finishing the journal, I listened to light music and shared photos of the teahouse with my sister in Shenzhen. Before bed, I turned off the electronic screen and flipped through the essay collection. At 23:00, I turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Wake up, wash up, and start morning preparation
description: At 7:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. Thanks to a good night's sleep, Sun Yuwei's shoulders and neck felt relaxed, and the wound on her finger had healed. After lingering in bed for a while, she got up and opened the curtains. The sky outside was overcast and the air was full of moisture. After washing up, she applied skincare products, changed into a loose cotton-linen loungewear set, and got ready for the day.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk by Green Lake
description: With a folding umbrella and her phone, Sun Yuwei went downstairs, crossed the neighborhood, and walked about five minutes to the west gate of Cuihu Park. A light drizzle began to fall. She opened her transparent umbrella and took a slow walk around the lake along the stone path. The air was fresh and humid, and ripples spread across the lake. She took a few deep breaths, feeling the tranquility of the rainy-season morning. On the way, she ran into Aunt Xie, a neighbor who was also out for morning exercise, and they smiled and greeted each other from a distance.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home for breakfast
description: After returning from a walk, her mother Li Xiulan had prepared breakfast: a steaming bowl of small-pot rice noodles, with a fried egg and blanched pea shoots. Sun Yuwei ate while chatting with her mother about the day's plans and the weather. Her mother reminded her to change into long sleeves when the temperature dropped. After the meal, she felt warm and content.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revise and submit the column article
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei went into her study, opened her laptop, and pulled up the draft of her column “Old Teahouse: A Pot of Pu'er Watching Clouds Roll and Unfurl” completed the day before. She focused on revising the ending, adding observations of the new young tea drinkers appearing in the teahouse—they used their phones to photograph the details of the old teapot and discussed social media check-in tips. This change gave the article a contemporary feel and added depth. At 11:00 she sent the final draft by email to Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Vision, with a courteous and modest message attached. After it was sent, she felt relaxed from her focused morning.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Mother prepared stir-fried bitter melon, sliced pork with garlic sauce, and tomato-egg soup for lunch. Sun Yuwei ate contentedly and took the initiative to help clear the dishes after the meal. Then she returned to the bedroom, set a 13:00 alarm, and lay down for a nap to let her mind fully relax.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Communicating with He Lu about floral arrangement execution details
description: While lying in bed, Sun Yuwei contacted He Lu from Zhongmou Yoga Studio via WeChat. She told her that the floral design plan had been finalized and she could send the renderings, and asked whether the flower containers prepared by the yoga studio were plain terracotta pottery. He Lu replied about 10 minutes later, saying she trusted Yuwei's aesthetic and didn't need to see the images. She confirmed that the containers were ready, and the two agreed to set up directly on site.

participant.name: He Lu
participant.relation: Person in charge of Zhongmou Yoga Studio

location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Finalize the floral design plan and create a shopping list
description: After waking from her afternoon nap, Sun Yuwei was in good spirits. She opened the floral design document Summer Rhyme, Clear Breeze on her computer and confirmed that the main flowers were white calla lilies and pale green lisianthus, with areca palm leaves and jasmine as accents, using eco-friendly floral foam, and keeping the budget under 250 yuan. Then she detailed a shopping list in her journal: 10 calla lilies, 5 lisianthus stems, 3 areca palm leaves, 1 bunch of jasmine, and 2 blocks of green floral foam, preparing for the afternoon flower market trip.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Organized June income and expenses and planned the July budget.
description: Sun Yuwei opened her expense-tracking app to review June expenses: digital drawing tablet 498 yuan, flower arrangement course and tools 300 yuan, beauty care 188 yuan, daily expenses about 800 yuan. On the income side, last month's manuscript fee was about to arrive. Based on this, she made a July budget, set aside 2,000 yuan for a family travel fund, and set a savings goal of 1,500 yuan. In the notes, she wrote her expectations for an illustration course and a flower arrangement side business. This review gave her a clearer picture of her finances.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Changing clothes and getting ready to go out
description: After sorting out her finances, Sun Yuwei felt a little tired and decided to go out for some air as planned and visit flower materials on the way. She changed into a light blue long-sleeved linen-cotton shirt, dark jeans, and an off-white knitted cardigan, put on a canvas bag containing a power bank, keys, an umbrella, and her journal, and prepared for light rain and cooler weather.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A short visit to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore.
description: Sun Yuwei walked about 10 minutes by umbrella to Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. As she pushed the door open, a wind chime tinkled, and the shop was filled with the scent of coffee and old books. She greeted Uncle Qin Mingyuan behind the counter, ordered a hot latte, and sat down in a corner by the window. She casually picked up Four Seasons Essays to read, letting the words recharge her and enjoying some time to herself.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rainy walk at Green Lake Park
description: Coming out of the bookstore, the rain grew slightly heavier. Sun Yuwei opened her umbrella and entered the park through the east gate of Green Lake, choosing a path she didn't usually take, passing through a bamboo grove and the Fish-Watching Pavilion. The rain tapped on the umbrella, water gurgled in the distance, and the air was filled with the scent of earth and vegetation. She took three photos of the misty lake view with her phone to use as journal material, and her mind settled into calm.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home to help mother prepare dinner
description: Sun Yuwei returned home at 17:15, changed shoes, and went to the kitchen to help her mother. She washed her hands and helped trim vegetables and rinse scallions, chatting about her afternoon trip to the bookstore and the park while working. Her mother jokingly called her an “old maid,” and the mother and daughter chatted about everyday things in the kitchen, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home kitchen, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and washing dishes
description: At 18:00, father Sun Mingyuan also returned home, and the family of three shared her mother's cooking: braised pork ribs, stir-fried Chinese broccoli, and cabbage and tofu soup. During the meal, her father asked about the manuscript. Sun Yuwei reported that it had been submitted and was encouraged by her father. After dinner, she took the initiative to do the dishes and clean up the kitchen, allowing her mother to rest.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watching the pre-class preview video for the digital illustration course
description: After finishing the housework, Sun Yuwei logged into the illustration course platform in her study and watched the first orientation video to understand the course structure and required software and hardware. She took out her drawing tablet, recalibrated the pressure sensitivity settings of the stylus as instructed, and tested the feel by sketching lines in the drawing software, preparing for the upcoming lessons.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Neck and shoulder stretching and foam roller relaxation
description: After turning off the computer, Sun Yuwei laid out her yoga mat on the study carpet and carefully completed 3 sets of targeted neck and shoulder stretches, holding each movement for 30 seconds. Then she used a foam roller to relax her upper back, relieving the fatigue accumulated during the day, and finished today's workout check-in.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read 'River Town' before going to bed.
description: After stretching, Sun Yuwei washed up, did her skincare routine, changed into pajamas, and sat propped against the bed reading He Wei's River Town under the warm yellow bedside lamp. Immersed in the author's documentary narrative of the small town of Fuling on the Yangtze River in the 1990s, she felt the power of the writing and spent 45 minutes without realizing it.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entries and June review
description: Closing the book, Sun Yuwei took out her journal and drew a simple June calendar, marking the month's important events with icons: graduation, signing the contract, completing the flower arrangement course, buying a drawing tablet, and first visiting Sanyi Tea House. She wrote a monthly summary, noting that June was a month of farewells and new beginnings. She affirmed her persistence in flower arrangement, her column, and yoga. Her initial foray into digital painting was not very satisfactory, but she looked forward to July. She then listed the next day's plan: shop at Dounan Flower Market in the morning, and do flower arranging at the yoga studio in the afternoon. After finishing the record, she felt fulfilled and grounded.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: After finishing her journal, Sun Yuwei saw a WeChat message from her elder sister Sun Yutong and immediately made a video call. Through the screen, she shared with her sister, who was in her apartment in Shenzhen, the fun stories of submitting her column and walking in the rain today, while her sister complained about an overtime project. The two chatted casually and agreed to explore shops together when they returned home for National Day.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and free activity
description: After hanging up the video call, Sun Yuwei put on earphones and followed a 5-minute guided meditation to clear her mind. Then she picked up her phone and scrolled through Xiaohongshu, followed a few new illustration bloggers, and saved color schemes, while also checking the bus and subway routes to Dounan Flower Market on a map app to prepare for the next day's trip.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: At 22:30, Sun Yuwei set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and lay down. Rain pattered outside the window. Feeling the warmth of the quilt and her body relaxing, she slowly drifted into sleep, looking forward to July.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Gentle morning stretching and breakfast
description: At 7:15 in the morning, I woke in the morning light. Because of a leg injury, I gave up the planned yoga and instead did 15 minutes of gentle stretching in bed, focusing on my neck, shoulders, and ankles. Then I washed up, changed into loungewear, and went to the dining room. My mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared breakfast: steaming tomato and egg noodles with a small dish of fermented bean curd with termite mushrooms. She asked about the wound with concern. I told her it was a little swollen but not painful, and only then did she feel at ease. She reminded me again not to go out cycling today. The breakfast time was warm and peaceful.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Accidental injury and medical visit
description: After breakfast, I was about to go out to Mingyuan Bookstore. When I rode a shared bike to an alley entrance on Renmin Middle Road, a yellow stray dog suddenly darted out and bit my calf. In pain and shock, I pressed on the wound briefly with a handkerchief and immediately took a taxi to the emergency department of the Wujing Campus of the Third People's Hospital of Kunming, the nearest hospital. Doctor Wang Wei cleaned the wound, thoroughly disinfected and bandaged it, and prescribed a rabies vaccine. In the vaccination room, Nurse Chen Min gave me the first injection and reminded me of the follow-up vaccination times on days 3, 7, 14, and 28, and prescribed a three-day course of antibiotics. The whole process took about 2.5 hours (including about 20 minutes of round-trip transport). After the treatment, I took a taxi home.
location: Wujing Campus, Kunming Third People's Hospital, No. 319 Wujing Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Recovering at home with her mother.
description: It was nearly 10:45 when I took a taxi home. My mother, Li Xiulan, had been waiting after receiving my message. She helped me to the sofa, poured warm water, and went to the kitchen to heat up a bowl of chicken soup she had prepared earlier. I leaned back on the sofa while she trimmed vegetables and chatted with me, telling amusing stories about her students to distract me. My initial restlessness was gradually soothed by her calm and care, and I enjoyed the warmth of home after being injured.
location: Living room and bedroom of home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Light lunch and midday rest
description: Lunch was the tomato and egg noodle soup and cucumber salad my mother had specially prepared; it was fresh and delicious. After the meal, I took the antibiotics the doctor had prescribed. Mother insisted that I go back to my room for a nap and rest well. When I lay down on the bed, the wound on my calf hurt faintly, but the mental tension finally loosened, and I fell asleep soon, recovering energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Online photography course registration and camera shopping
description: After waking from a nap, I felt better. I sat in front of the laptop in my study and used the quiet rest time to take care of things. I opened the browser and found the website of a local photography training institution I had been following for a long time. After repeatedly comparing the course content, I signed up for the "Basic Photography Class" starting on July 5 and paid the tuition of 1680 yuan via online banking. Then I searched for "Sony 6000" on the e-commerce platform, carefully browsed reviews of different packages, and finally chose a reputable store to order the body plus 16-50mm standard lens kit, and noted the invoice information. Seeing the "expected delivery tomorrow" message, I felt full of anticipation for the upcoming study.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Browsing Xiaohongshu and Gathering Information
description: After closing the shopping webpage, I opened my phone and scrolled through Xiaohongshu, searching specifically for keywords such as 'freelance work from home' and 'freelance writer efficiency'. I browsed experience posts shared by four or five bloggers, saved posts about the Pomodoro Technique and how to build a work-from-home ritual, and took screenshots of introductions to several time-management apps. This relaxed form of learning accumulated inspiration and material for planning my daily routine later.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Replanning daily routine and adjusting the journal
description: After collecting inspiration from Xiaohongshu, I took out my beloved journal, fountain pen, and washi tape, and sat down at my desk. I opened the page for July 1 and crossed out the plan I had written last night: wake-up yoga, Dounan Flower Market shopping, and afternoon flower arranging at the yoga studio. Then I opened a new page and began to replan the coming week. I adjusted the original yoga time to gentle morning stretching, set the morning as an immovable home writing time from 9:00 to 12:00, arranged to go out or stay home to read and work on manuscripts in the afternoon depending on the injury, and reserved a place to restart yoga and flower arranging classes after recovery. After finishing the plan, I posted the new schedule decorated with sunflower-pattern tape on the corkboard in front of my desk, re-establishing the rhythm of my freelance life.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of her home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Warm dinner with parents
description: My father, Sun Mingyuan, came home from work and asked with concern about the gauze on my leg. I played it down and reassured him it was nothing. Dinner was a light meal specially prepared by my mother: steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and a small bowl of yam and pork rib soup. At the table we chatted about things at my father's workplace, and the atmosphere was relaxed and warm. They encouraged me not to rush, to let the injury heal first, and that work could wait. That meal warmed my heart.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Relaxing in the living room and chatting with family
description: After the meal, I took the initiative to clear the dishes, but my mother insisted I rest more, so I went to the living room and sat with my parents on the sofa. My father was watching a CCTV documentary, and my mother was knitting beside him. I leaned on my mother’s shoulder and talked about signing up for a photography class and buying a camera today. She smiled and said, “It’s always good to learn more while you’re young.” I curled up on the sofa, savoring this rare, peaceful moment of being cared for by my parents.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: After returning to my bedroom, I made a video call to my elder sister Sun Yutong, who works in Shenzhen. She was on the subway heading home from work. After hearing about today's "frightening experience" of mine, she was first startled, then began to tease me: "Our 'freelance writer' has had such a 'story-filled' first day." She didn't comfort me too much, but asked whether I was clear about the follow-up vaccination arrangements and urged me to get the shot on time. She also suggested that since I now had a photography class and a camera, I could try "combining text and images" as a new style for my next piece. Her suggestions always gave me new inspiration, and we talked for about half an hour before reluctantly hanging up.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Reading before bed and physical and mental relaxation
description: After hanging up, I snuggled in bed, picked up He Wei's River Town from the bedside table, turned to where I had left off, and continued to immerse myself in the story of that small town by the Yangtze in the late 1990s. The words made me temporarily forget the pain in my leg and today's accident; my mood became calm and open. I read for about 50 minutes, and only closed the book when my eyes felt a bit sore. Both my body and mind were relaxed.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Today's journaling and stretching before bed
description: After closing the book, I sat back down at my desk and opened my journal. With a fountain pen, I neatly wrote out the day's events: the dog bite, getting the rabies shot, my mother's chicken soup, signing up for the photography class, and looking forward to the new camera. Beside it, I stuck a note about rabies precautions as a testament to this unusual day. Finally, I wrote a line in small characters: "Plans can be broken, but you can re-anchor the rhythm of your life yourself." Then I went back to bed and did a gentle pre-sleep stretch, avoiding my calf, to let my body fully relax.
location: In front of the desk and on the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: Set the alarm for 8:00 tomorrow morning and checked the vaccination reminder in my phone calendar. Turning off the desk lamp, I thought back over everything from today in the darkness: although it was full of surprises and awkward moments, my family's support and my own replanning gave me more confidence about my future path as a freelancer. I closed my eyes and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning preparations (wound care, washing up, and getting dressed)
description: Woke up at 7:30 in the morning, first carefully checking the wound on her calf to confirm it did not feel hot, then doing simple neck stretches and shoulder rolls to wake up her body. She then went to the bathroom, carefully wrapped the gauze on her leg with plastic wrap to keep out water, and took a quick shower. After the shower, she removed the plastic wrap, confirmed the gauze was dry, changed into a light blue cotton-linen long dress, and tied her hair into a low ponytail in front of the mirror, looking neat and energetic.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home bedroom and bathroom

name: Breakfast and preparations for going out
description: Went downstairs to have breakfast with mother Li Xiulan, enjoying hot rice noodles and side dishes. During the meal, confirmed the location of the camera package that mother had signed for on her behalf. Messaged Uncle Qin at Mingyuan Bookstore on her phone, agreeing to arrive at the store at 10 a.m. After the meal, helped mother clear the dishes, returned to the bedroom, and packed a laptop, journal, stationery, water bottle, and column outline draft into a canvas bag. As she went out, she took the folding umbrella mother handed her, ready for the cloudy weather.
location: Dining room and entrance at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: She chose to walk about 2 kilometers to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, observing the streetscape along the way and stretching her legs. Her calf was still slightly sore but improving. Passing Cuihu Park, she saw elderly people practicing tai chi and used her phone to take a photo of the clouds reflected in the lake, imagining it as an illustration for her column.
location: On the route from Renmin Middle Road to Wenlin Street in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (passing Cuihu Park)

name: Discuss and finalize the workstation rental and contract signing with Qin Mingyuan
description: Arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore and discussed the details of renting a workstation with the owner Qin Mingyuan in the window-side reading area while drinking brown sugar pearl milk tea. In the end, they settled on a monthly rent of 500 yuan, for use from 14:00 to 17:00 every day (excluding Mondays), with Wi-Fi and outlets provided, plus one free drink per day as a bonus. Then the two signed a handwritten agreement, and she paid the first month's rent via WeChat transfer. Uncle Qin led her to a long desk by the window. Sun Yuwei set up her computer and journal and placed a sticky note written with "Always Stay True to My Original Aspiration" on the corner of the desk, formally establishing her personal creative corner.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Assess and plan the workstation organization scheme
description: After sitting down, she found the desk covered with old books, tangled charging cables, and a cardboard box of scattered draft paper. She immediately took out her notebook and made a quick sketch, planning to divide the items into three categories: "books to keep," "miscellaneous items to put away," and "waste paper to discard." She also thought about using the empty bookshelf and storage boxes nearby to tidy everything up.
location: Workstation at Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Short midday break and a light meal
description: After prolonged mental work, she stood up and walked around the bookstore browsing the shelves to give her eyes a rest. Then she went to the Zhijia convenience store across the street to buy a chicken sandwich and a bottle of water, solving lunch simply, and leaving time to tidy her workstation before the midday break.
location: Zhijia Convenience Store and Mingyuan Bookstore at the intersection of Wenlin Street and Longxiang Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Started tidying up the workstation.
description: Putting on disposable gloves, she first sorted the draft paper in the cardboard boxes and discarded the waste paper, then used cable ties to tidy and bundle the messy cables under the desk, and arranged the scattered old books by size on the nearby bookshelf. After his lunch break, Qin Mingyuan also came over to help carry away the unwanted old magazines. The two chatted about running the bookstore while working. After an hour and a half of tidying, the workstation looked completely refreshed.
location: Workstation at Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the column article “The Paper-and-Ink Vigil of Wenlin Street” and shooting reference material.
description: At her tidy desk, she turned on the computer, created a new document, and began writing a column for Cultural Horizon about the culture of independent bookstores in Kunming. Inspiration flowed, and she smoothly completed the initial framework and an opening of about 1,000 words. After two hours of writing, she stood up to stretch, went to the bookstore entrance and Wenlin Street to photograph street scenes, old buildings, and close-ups of bookstore signs as supplementary image materials. Returning to her seat, she finished the remaining parts, read through and polished the wording, and finally sent a message to editor Xu Mingyuan informing him that the first draft was complete, preparing to send it later by email.
location: No. 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Mingyuan Bookstore and the streets of Wenlin Street.

name: Walk home and listen to a podcast.
description: After packing up and saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she left the bookstore. A drizzle began to fall, so she opened the umbrella her mother had slipped into her bag, walked along Wenlin Street, and turned onto Renmin Middle Road. Along the way, she put on her earphones and listened to a podcast episode about urban walks, feeling the moist, fresh air of Kunming in the rain.
location: Along the route from No. 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Unbox the new camera and try it out
description: After getting home, I couldn't wait to open the delivery that my mother had accepted on my behalf—a brand-new Sony mirrorless camera. I carefully attached the lens, inserted the battery, turned it on to familiarize myself with the interface, and took test shots of the potted plants on the windowsill and the bookshelf at home, feeling excited about the upcoming online photography course.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner and conversation
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the family of three had a rare dinner together. During the meal, she shared the joy of having rented a workspace today, and her mother once again reminded her about the details of wound care. After dinner, she took the initiative to do the dishes and thanked her mother for her help.
location: Home Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Select and organize essay manuscripts in the study.
description: Entered the study, took out the prose manuscripts accumulated over the past six months, and went through them one by one under three themes: 'City,' 'Distance,' and 'Whispers.' Used colored sticky notes to mark 18 high-quality pieces, and sketched a table of contents in the journal, recording each piece's title, word count, and revision intent.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and journaling
description: A 15-minute meditation on the floor mat in the bedroom, focusing on breath to calm the mind stirred by creation and planning. After it ended, I opened my journal at the desk and wrote the day's routine and reflections in pen: "I have my workstation, I have my camera, and everything is slowly coming into place. Recovering from injury is also a form of practice."
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Online photography course preview and equipment study
description: I quickly read the camera manual sections on basic operations and parameter settings, then opened Xiaohongshu on my phone and browsed the photography tutorial notes I had saved, focusing on aperture-priority mode and basic composition rules to prepare for the formal online class.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: Before washing up, I carefully checked the plastic wrap covering the wound, then leaned half against the headboard and read 'The Lonely City'. The passages in the book about the city and the individual echoed my experience at the bookstore during the day, and I enjoyed this quiet reading time before bed.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Removed the plastic wrap, quickly washed up, and in her phone memo simply listed the next day's work plan: refine the classification approach for the essay collection in the morning, and continue writing at the bookstore in the afternoon. She set the alarm, tidied up the items needed for the next day, then lay down, recalling the street scenes, the note at the desk, and the feel of the new camera, and fell asleep contentedly.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up, washing up, and wound care
description: Woken by the alarm at 7 a.m., the swelling and pain in my leg wound had lessened. In the bathroom, I disinfected the wound with an iodophor cotton swab, waited for it to dry, then applied a sterile dressing. After a quick wash-up, I changed into comfortable loungewear.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and morning stretching
description: Mom made hot porridge, steamed eggs, and corn. During breakfast, she handed over povidone-iodine cotton swabs and reminded her to change the dressing. Dad asked about her schedule while watching the news. After the meal, she did gentle stretching on the living room carpet for 5 minutes while listening to a podcast about urban reading rooms, looking for inspiration for decorating the study.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Get ready to go out and walk to Shuncheng Shopping Center
description: Put on the canvas tote bag, confirmed phone and keys, and wrote the shopping list in the journal: acrylic file holder, wooden pen holder, modular desktop bookshelf, and aromatherapy refill. Then walked along Renmin Middle Road to Shuncheng Shopping Center. Passing the entrance of Green Lake Park, she watched waterbirds foraging on the lake, and arrived at MUJI on the second floor of the mall about 9 minutes later.
location: Along Renmin Middle Road and Cuihu Park to Shuncheng Shopping Center, No. 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Shopping at MUJI
description: At the MUJI store, she carefully compared the white acrylic file rack, wooden pen holder, and modular desktop bookshelf, chose the set with the best value for money, and paid with the bank card for her writing earnings. She also took a walk through the stationery and aromatherapy areas and bought a bottle of eucalyptus aromatherapy refill and a roll of washi tape to decorate her journal.
location: MUJI store, 2nd floor, Shuncheng Shopping Center, 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked back home and sorted the purchased items.
description: Carrying the shopping bag, she walked back the same way, sat down on a lakeside bench in Green Lake Park, watched elderly people practicing tai chi and egrets skimming the water, and took photos of the lake view on her phone to send to her mother. After getting home, she unwrapped the storage supplies, wiped them clean with wet wipes, sorted the washi tape and aromatherapy items into categories, and took a short rest with some water.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Green Lake Park

name: Contact regarding leave and lunch
description: She sent a WeChat voice message to her yoga partner He Lu to ask for leave, saying she could not attend Thursday’s class because of a leg injury and the vaccine reaction. He Lu understood and said she would bring yam and pork rib soup to visit in the evening. Then she had lunch with her mother, eating tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. When they talked about He Lu’s upcoming visit, her mother was very happy.
location: Living room and dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and helping with household chores
description: She helped her mother bring in the clothes that had been dried on the balcony and fold them, then returned to the bedroom and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes. She got up on time at 13:00, feeling refreshed.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Set up the study workstation (phase one)
description: Clear away yesterday's clutter from the desk and wipe the desk clean. Assemble the newly bought file rack and pen holder, and stand the frequently used books upright in sections for literary theory, classic essays, and journal materials. Put journals, washi tape, fountain pens and the like into the wooden pen holder, place the mirrorless camera and spare batteries on the second shelf of the bookshelf, and create a preliminary tidy creative space.
location: At home in the study by the south-facing window, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Arranging the essay collection and creating the table of contents
description: Sitting at the tidy desk, she carefully sorted the printed drafts of the 18 selected essays into three themes—city sketches, letters from afar, and private musings. She started with the pieces about Kunming's old streets, moved on to travel observations, and finally returned to inner monologue. She numbered the pages of each piece, wrote a brief compilation note for each section, placed them in a transparent ring binder, and initially formed the complete framework of 'Slow Travel Notes'.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Study cleanup wrap-up and afternoon tea
description: I cut a sprig of eucalyptus and put it in a small glass bottle on the corner of my desk, then pasted a decorative paper with a Kant quote on the wall. I took a panoramic photo of the study and a close-up of my workspace with my phone and sent them to my mom. After that, I brewed a cup of Yunnan black tea, peeled an apple, and sat in a rattan chair on the balcony, drinking tea in the afternoon sun while browsing photos, feeling content.
location: Study and balcony at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Welcomed and hosted He Lu.
description: Hearing the doorbell, she opened the door to welcome He Lu, who was carrying an insulated pot. He Lu brought yam and pork rib soup and asked in detail about the dog bite and her vaccine reaction. She also shared a recovery recipe for nourishing the blood and replenishing qi. The two chatted about the new tricks from their flower arrangement class, and their laughter filled the room. The pain was softened by their friendship.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner
description: Mom ladled out the pork rib soup that He Lu had brought and stir-fried two vegetable dishes. When Dad came home from work and heard that He Lu had come by, he praised her for being a kind friend. After drinking two bowls of soup, a warmth spread through her whole body, and she felt very content.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and listening to music on the balcony
description: After dinner, sitting in a rattan chair on the balcony, listening to Max Richter's piano pieces, reading "The Lonely City". When I read the line "Loneliness is not the absence of company, but the absence of resonance with a certain meaning," I recorded it in my phone's memo, planning to write it into an essay later.
location: Balcony at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and meditation
description: In the study, I used a fountain pen to record today’s important moments in my A6 journal: the MUJI shopping list, the completed study arrangement, the finished essay ordering, and He Lu’s caring soup, and I sketched the soup bowl. After closing the journal, I sat on a cushion and meditated with my eyes closed for 10 minutes, focusing on my breath.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Preview the photography course handouts
description: Opened the laptop and reviewed the key points for tomorrow's online photography class: the exposure triangle, white balance, and focus modes. Marked the relevant pages of the Sony mirrorless camera manual with sticky notes and charged the camera battery in advance.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Nighttime washing and wound care
description: Washed her face and brushed her teeth, carefully wiped her lower body with warm water while avoiding the wound, changed the dressing again, and applied erythromycin ointment.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, she continued reading the essay collection. At 22:00 she turned off the light and slowly fell asleep with a calm heart wrapped in warmth and a sense of order.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and desk beautification
description: Awakened by the pattering of rain in the early morning, I sat on the edge of the bed and spaced out for a while, feeling the damp coolness in the air. After washing up, I went into the study and carefully stuck a note with Wang Zengqi's words, "The flavor of everyday life is what soothes the human heart most," on the left wall of my desk. I took down the withered dried flowers from two weeks ago and replaced them with eucalyptus leaves I had picked and air-dried by Cuihu Lake. The potted mint on the corner of the desk was moved to the balcony to get some rain. After all this, the desk felt wonderfully fresh. Then I unrolled the yoga mat in the living room and did 40 minutes of gentle morning yoga, focusing on stretching my neck, shoulders, and upper body, avoiding leg movements.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: After yoga ended, my mother Li Xiulan had already cooked steaming hot small-pot rice noodles. The rich red broth with pickled vegetables, chives, and minced meat was the perfect comfort on a rainy day. I chatted with her while eating and told her I planned to sort out the entire first draft of my essay collection in the morning. Mom smiled in anticipation of my work and put another piece of braised tofu on my plate.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Completed the first full layout of the essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes'.
description: Sitting at the tidy desk, I turned on the computer and formally compiled the 18 essays I had sorted yesterday into three sections — 'City Sketches,' 'Letters from Afar,' and 'Whispers of Time' — into a single Word document. For each section, I typed out the epigraph I had been mulling over for a long time: 'At familiar street corners, salvage the whispers of time'; 'Every letter is a journey of the soul'; 'A letter to oneself, making peace with time.' I carefully proofread all the title formatting, unified the fonts and line spacing, added page numbers, and finally saved the file as 'Slow Travel Notes' v1.0.docx. Looking at the file name, I felt a surge of satisfaction. I took a screenshot of the table of contents and sent it via WeChat to the editor Xu Mingyuan and my advisor Wu Mingyuan, with the message: 'Dear teachers, the layout of the first edition of the essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes' is complete. Please review it at your leisure. I look forward to your reply.' Leaning back in my chair and watching the rain outside gradually stop, I felt that everything in the world had become gentle.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap and photography practice
