description: After completing the first draft, I picked up the new Sony 6000 camera and walked to the balcony. The world after the rain was exceptionally clear and bright. I tried to use the light knowledge from yesterday's photography lecture notes, aimed the lens at the potted mint with water droplets on its leaves, and also captured the rain lines dripping from the distant eaves. Back in the study, I took close-ups of the dried flower bouquet on the corner of the desk and the new sticky notes on the wall. This purposeless creation made me feel relaxed and happy.
location: Balcony and study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and a short rest
description: For lunch, Mother simply stir-fried water spinach with garlic and reheated the yam and pork rib soup that my friend He Lu had brought yesterday. Father Sun Mingyuan came home for the meal. When he heard I had finished the first draft, he gave a rare, gratified smile and said, “Hard work pays off.” After the meal, I helped clear the dishes, then closed my eyes and rested on the sofa for 15 minutes to build up energy for the afternoon.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the hospital for the second dose of rabies vaccine
description: I left home at 1 p.m. after checking my backpack: medical insurance card, vaccination record form, water bottle, and folding umbrella. I walked to Renmin Middle Road Metro Station, took Line 3 to Wuyi Road Station, and then walked about 5 minutes from the exit to reach the Third People's Hospital of Kunming. The whole trip took about 50 minutes. At the appointed time, I went into the inoculation room and received the second rabies vaccine injection; my arm felt sore for a while. Then I sat quietly in the observation area for 30 minutes with no abnormal reactions, and wrote in my phone memo: “3 p.m., second shot done, mild soreness, no other discomfort. Doctor's advice: drink more water and avoid spicy food.”
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Guandu District, 319 Wujing Road, Kunming Third People's Hospital

name: Strolling through Cuihu Park on the way back
description: After leaving the hospital, I didn't go straight home but walked slowly along Dongfeng West Road, arriving at Green Lake Park about 20 minutes later. After the rain, the lake sparkled, the lotus leaves were emerald green, and water droplets rolled at the center of the leaves. I sat down on a lakeside bench, letting the gentle breeze blow over me, and zoned out for a quarter of an hour, letting the slight fatigue after the vaccination drift away with the wind.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home to rest and recharge, share the first draft, and video call with my sister
description: After returning home, I changed into comfortable loungewear, drank a large glass of warm water, and lay on the sofa to rest. When I opened my phone, I saw that my advisor Wu Mingyuan had replied with an emoji meaning 'OK, got it, will read soon,' while my book friend Yang Xiao sent a string of messages like 'Wow! Can't wait! Great!' I also casually shared the draft document with Yang Xiao. Then I called my older sister Sun Yutong by video; she was walking on the streets of Shenzhen after work. Listening to me excitedly talk about completing the first draft, she smiled and congratulated me, repeatedly reminding me to rest after the injection. We chatted for over ten minutes and agreed that when she comes back to Kunming for vacation in August, the two sisters will go to Dounan Flower Market together.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk with her mother and supermarket shopping.
description: Before dinner, my mother suggested going out for a walk. We headed out again and took a slow loop around Green Lake Park, watching the elderly playing instruments and singing by the lake at dusk and the birds returning to their nests. Then we turned into Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, where Mom bought some fresh green vegetables and fruit. I saw the newly stocked cucumbers looked very crisp, so I picked up two as well.
location: Green Lake Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street

name: Family dinner
description: After getting home, I helped my mother in the kitchen. Dinner was stir-fried baby bok choy, tomato and egg stir-fry, and winter melon meatball soup. At the dinner table we chatted about everyday things; Mom talked about a stray cat she saw at Cuihu Lake in the afternoon, and Dad talked about a funny incident at his workplace.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening time: photo editing, Xiaohongshu, journaling, and meditation
description: Today I was more tired than usual, so I didn't arrange any complex mental work. First I imported the test photos taken with the camera today into my computer, used photo editing software to lightly brighten the colors, chose a photo of mint on the balcony, added the caption “The mint after the rain is as fresh as the feeling of finishing the first draft,” and published a Xiaohongshu post. Then I took out my beloved journal and slowly wrote down with a fountain pen the most highlight-worthy things of the day: the completion of the first draft of the prose collection, the second vaccine shot, and my sister's encouragement. I also drew a small sketch of a soup pot next to it. Afterwards, tiredness welled up. I put on earphones and listened to a few soothing instrumental pieces, and finally did ten minutes of meditation, letting the day's jumbled thoughts slowly settle.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Bathing, getting ready for bed, and bedtime reverie
description: I turned off my computer and phone early, took a warm shower, carefully avoiding the injection site on my arm. I changed into comfortable pajamas, went back to my room, closed the curtains, and sat quietly on the bed for a while, recalling the warm moments from today. After turning off the light, I lay in bed. My body was tired, but my mind was still excitedly flashing through sentences from the essay collection, wondering how the editor and teacher would evaluate it and what style the cover should use... In a faint sense of satisfaction and anticipation, I gradually fell asleep, around 23:00.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga
description: In the early morning, I spread a yoga mat on the south-facing balcony at home and did a yoga practice focused on relaxing the shoulders and neck and stretching the hips. Listening to the sounds of the breakfast stall downstairs opening, I deliberately slowed my breathing to build up energy for the morning photography practice.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and itinerary confirmation
description: At the dining table, she had breakfast with her mother, Li Xiulan, eating the small-pot rice noodles her mother had prepared. While eating, she used her phone to confirm the meeting place and time for the photography class, and talked with her mother about how she felt after getting vaccinated yesterday, telling her she was feeling fine and mentioning that she would bring flower cakes home at noon.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: First attempt at digital painting
description: After breakfast, I moved to the study, turned on the computer, and watched a Procreate basics tutorial saved on Bilibili. I connected my newly bought drawing tablet and tried drawing simple lines and color blocks to feel the pressure sensitivity and brush effects. As a first-time user, my operation was a bit clumsy. I paused after 20 minutes to save my energy for the photography class I was looking forward to.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Set off for the photography class meeting point
description: Checked that the camera battery was fully charged and the memory card had been formatted. Then she put the camera, a spare battery, water bottle, sun hat, and small notebook into a canvas tote bag, changed into canvas shoes, and took sunscreen. After locking the door, she walked to the meeting point under the memorial archway on Wenming Street in Kunming Old Street. Passing through Qianwang Street, she saw early-rising elderly people playing chess at the alley entrance; the cafés had just opened, and the street was bathed in sunlight.
location: Along Huashan West Road and Wenming Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Outdoor practice on the old street for photography class
description: They gathered under the Wenming Street archway, where photography teacher Li explained the key practice points for aperture-priority and shutter-priority modes. They then wove through Wenming Street and Guanghua Street, shooting the divisions of light and shadow under the arcade corridors and the lively moments of morning-market vendors, practicing focusing techniques and capturing the eye contact exchanged between vendors and customers. During a break, she exchanged composition insights with a female student using a film camera. After the class ended at 11:45, she stayed behind alone to continue shooting.
location: Wenming Street and Guanghua Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying flower cakes, walking home, and lunch
description: After the photography class, she went to Jiahua Bakery on Guanghua Street. She queued up and bought a freshly baked flower cake and ate it on the spot, and bought another one in a bag to take home for her mother. Then she returned the same way. Passing Cuihu, she noticed some lotus flowers had bloomed, so she took photos with her phone and sent them to her elder sister Sun Yuqing. After picking up a package (the newly bought journal inserts) from the community parcel locker, she went home. Once home, she had lunch with her parents, eating cold eggplant salad, shredded pork with green peppers, and pickled cabbage and red bean soup. She shared funny moments from the morning's photography class and showed off her favorite shots on the camera, then put the flower cake she had brought back on the dining table.
location: Jiahua Bakery on Guanghua Street, along the path at Green Lake Park, and home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon break
description: After changing into loose loungewear, she took a 20-minute nap on the bed in her bedroom and set an alarm to ensure enough energy for writing in the afternoon.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Mingyuan Bookstore.
description: Walked about 20 minutes to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street. The sunlight grew stronger along the way, so she opened her parasol. Passing Lakeside Hotel, she smelled the aroma of rice noodles.
location: On the way to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bookstore writing and online communication
description: After arriving at Mingyuan Bookstore, you greeted the owner, Uncle Qin, and sat down at your usual window-side seat. You turned on your computer and imported the RAW photos taken in the morning into Lightroom for a quick preview. Using them as inspiration, you added about 800 words to the document "The Paper-and-Ink Vigil of Wenlin Street", describing the atmosphere of Wenming Street in the early morning, where the noise of street vendors and the quiet of the arcades coexist. Then you sent a WeChat message to the editor, Xu Mingyuan, briefly describing your writing progress. Editor Xu replied affirmatively and suggested moving tomorrow's online revision meeting to 5:00 p.m., so you sent him the draft document. In addition, you replied to your reading friend Yang Xiao's WeChat message, shared photos of the old street, and promised to show her the new draft next week. You also contacted Song Wen, a writer from Chengdu, to ask about recent literary WeChat public accounts that accept submissions and their acceptance rates.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Online manuscript revision meeting
description: At Mingyuan Bookstore, I opened Tencent Meeting and held an online editing session with editor Xu Mingyuan. We discussed in detail issues such as paragraph structure and image density in the first three essays of Notes on Slow Travel, and I shared my original intentions for writing. The atmosphere was professional and efficient. After half an hour, we finalized the focus of the next stage of revisions.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sat briefly at Green Lake on the way home and went home to rest
description: Packed up and left the bookstore, walked along Cuihu Road, found a shady stone bench at the southwest corner of Cuihu Park, and sat down to browse the memos on my phone and record inspiration from the revision meeting, watching boats on the lake and people out for a stroll. Then I went home, drank a glass of water, and opened the new delivery (notebook refills) that had arrived, getting ready to replace the pages in my journal. I sat on the living room sofa chatting with my mother, who was trimming green beans, shared how the revision meeting went, and sent photos of the arcade light and shadows and the silver jewelry stall owner to my best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat.
location: Bench at the southwest corner of Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, and the living room at home in Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road

name: Helped make dinner.
description: She joined her mother in the kitchen to prepare dinner, helping to snap green beans, peel garlic, and set out bowls and chopsticks, and chatted about her exchange with her best friend Zhang Jing. Mom praised, 'Our Yuwei has an artistic eye.' The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner time
description: Had dinner with parents. Dishes included stir-fried green beans with garlic, pan-fried mackerel, and tomato and egg soup. We chatted while eating. Father Sun Jianguo reminded me that after the revision meeting ends, I can listen more to the editors' opinions. The family atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dusk walk around Green Lake.
description: I changed into my sports shoes and headed to Green Lake Park. It was getting late and the light was soft. I brought my camera and captured the sunset reflected on the lake and the silhouettes of a couple on the shore. My sports watch showed 3.5 kilometers walked; the walk relieved the soreness in my shoulders.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Organizing photos and chatting with friends
description: After returning home, she imported the day's photos into a computer folder, carefully selected 5, processed them into similar tones, and sent them to her best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat along with her photography notes. Zhang Jing quickly replied, praising the comfortable colors, and shared her industrial-style photos taken in an abandoned factory on the outskirts. The two chatted happily on WeChat for about 30 minutes and agreed to go looking for inspiration together next week.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening journaling and meditation
description: Light a scented candle, open the journal, and paste in today's photography class receipts, Jiahua Bakery wrappers, and my favorite photo printed with the instant photo printer (light and shadow of the arcade). Then write down today's reflections and takeaways with a fountain pen. Afterward, put on earphones and do 10 minutes of mindful meditation to let my thoughts settle.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime preparation, reading, and planning for tomorrow
description: After taking a shower and drying her hair, she put on pajamas and placed the computer and power cord she would need tomorrow by the bedside. Leaning against the headboard, she read Chapter 2 of “The Lonely City” and penciled lines in the top margin that resonated with her. After 30 minutes of reading, she wrote a plan on the next-day page of her journal: in the morning, she would polish the essay according to the revision suggestions; in the afternoon, she would take a detour to Green Lake for a brisk walk before going to the book house. Then she set the alarm to 7:30 and turned off the light to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and breakfast
description: She woke up naturally before the alarm, first watered the mint plant on the windowsill, then spread out her yoga mat in the bedroom and did 20 minutes of gentle stretching to relax her hips and shoulders. Mom had steamed buns and heated soy milk. During breakfast, she ate mushroom and pork buns and talked with Mom about the afternoon video call with the editor to revise the manuscript. Mom encouraged her: "Believe in yourself; your writing has always been full of warmth."
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organize photos and prepare for the manuscript revision meeting
description: In the study, she imported the photos taken on Wenming Street yesterday into her computer, created a new folder, and carefully selected three photos: the morning light and shadow of the old arcade buildings, the grilled rice cake vendor, and the reflection on the rain-soaked flagstone road. She adjusted brightness and contrast with a mobile photo-editing app and posted them to Moments with the caption: "The texture of the old street is the palm print of time. At the instant of pressing the shutter, it feels as if half a day of fleeting life has been sealed away. A small harvest from yesterday's photography class. #Kunming #WenmingStreet." Then she charged the camera battery. Next, she opened the electronic document Notes on Slow Travel, switched to track changes mode, highlighted the questionable passages according to Editor Xu's earlier suggestions, and listed three uncertain questions in her notebook: "Is the transition between the second and third collections abrupt?" "Will 'Night Visit to the Old Book Stall at the University of Finance' repeat with later chapters?" "What entry point does the editor-in-chief expect for the author's preface?" She also prepared sticky notes and a pen, fully preparing for the afternoon video meeting.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Receive manuscript advance, family lunch, and midday rest
description: Just as she was about to have lunch, she received a WeChat notification from Editor Xu saying that the 3000-yuan advance payment for the first draft of "Slow Travel Notes" would arrive next Tuesday. Joy surged in her heart, and she immediately took a screenshot and sent it to the family WeChat group. Dad rarely praised her: "Well written. Keep it up." Mom smiled and suggested celebrating with mushroom hot pot on the weekend. During lunch, the whole family shared the joy, and the atmosphere was especially relaxed. After lunch, she returned to her room and neatly wrote on the "Dream Savings" page of her journal: "2025.07.06, advance payment of 3000 yuan received, plan to deposit into travel fund card," and drew stars. Then she took a 30-minute nap. After getting up at 14:00, she made brown sugar pearl milk tea, adjusted the microphone and camera on Tencent Meeting, ensured the network was stable, and prepared for the afternoon manuscript revision meeting.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video draft-revision meeting with the editor and digesting the feedback
description: At 14:45 she entered the Tencent Meeting room early, and at 15:00 Editor Xu logged in on time. The meeting lasted about an hour. Editor Xu affirmed the "warmth and observational power" of the writing, but seriously pointed out that the three pieces "Night Visit to the Used-Book Stall at the University of Finance and Economics", "Old Times in the Bookstore", and "One Afternoon" were structurally weak or repetitive in theme, and suggested deleting them to strengthen the cohesion of the collection. Editor Xu also strongly recommended adding a 1,500-character author's preface. Sun Yutong listened carefully and took notes, and even asked questions about the entry point of the preface. After the meeting, she received the meeting minutes. While reflecting alone, she recalled her advisor Professor Wu Mingyuan's words, "Good works are the product of revision." In the end, she firmly wrote in her notebook, "I have decided to adopt the suggestions," and listed a specific revision checklist: 1. Delete those three pieces; 2. Write a new author's preface of about 1,500 characters, with the tentative theme "The Original Intention of Walking Slowly: From Campus to the City, Finding One's Own Rhythm"; 3. Adjust the metaphorical wording in "An Afternoon in the Old Teahouse". She stuck the checklist on the upper right corner of her screen to remind herself.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walking in Green Lake Park and letting inspiration settle
description: Put on low-top canvas shoes, bring the Moleskine notebook and pen, and walk about 11 minutes from home to Green Lake Park. The evening breeze brushes your face as you stroll around the lake, watching water birds rise and land. Sitting on a bench near Guanyu Tower, you jot down inspirations for the foreword: "Where do I begin?" "The city's rhythm and my own pace" "Slow travel—not just travel, but an attitude toward life." Use your phone to photograph the sunset glow on the lake, letting your thoughts settle in tranquility.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: After walking home, she helped her mother pick and wash vegetables. Mother and daughter chatted about the revision meeting details and the park scenery while they worked. Mother said with a metaphor: "Doing scholarship is like cooking—sometimes you have to remove some ingredients for the main flavor to be clearer." At 18:30, her father came home, and the family of three had stir-fried seasonal vegetables and braised pork ribs. At the table, she shared her revision plan and her intention to start writing the preface tomorrow morning. Her parents both encouraged her: "You have determination—go for it."
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: After the meal, she cleared the dishes and went to the balcony to read Haruki Murakami's "What I Talk About When I Talk About Running," happening to reach the passage about "stay persistent and keep a steady rhythm," while drinking Lapsang Souchong rose black tea. Afterwards, she played Curtis Harding's piano pieces on her phone to let her mind wander. Back in the study, she opened her journal, pasted in the Green Lake inspiration notes, and recorded the day's emotions: morning delight (manuscript fee) — afternoon struggle (cutting the draft) — evening determination (the decision). She drew stars, small scissors, and daisies. Then she did 10 minutes of mindful meditation, washed up, changed into pajamas, set the alarm for 7:30 tomorrow morning, and wrote in her phone memo: "Tomorrow at 9:00 a.m., in the study, start writing the preface. Do not waver." She turned off the light at 22:30 and fell asleep.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off on time. Sun Yuwei slowly got up, opened the curtains, and saw the potted mint on the balcony gently swaying in the morning breeze. She moved her shoulders and neck, which had stiffened from sitting and writing for a long time, and felt that her leg injury had almost completely healed, making her steps much lighter. Afterward, she did a simple morning tidy-up.
location: Bedroom and balcony at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: Her mother Li Xiulan had already cooked Sun Yuwei's favorite small-pot rice noodles, adding pickled mustard greens and minced pork, with an enticing aroma. The mother and daughter sat down to breakfast in the dining room. Sun Yuwei shared her reflections on Haruki Murakami's 'What I Talk About When I Talk About Running', which she had read the night before, and told her mother that she would follow the decision from the revision meeting that morning, cutting three essays to make 'Slow Travel Notes' more tightly structured.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Writing planning and organization
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her study, flipped through the page in her journal where she had drawn a little scissors and daisies, and against the 'Slow Travel Notes' v1.0 document on her computer, went over the revision checklist she had made after discussing with Editor Xu last night, confirming the three pieces to be deleted and the revision approach. She brewed a cup of rose tea and prepared to start the morning's 'surgery' on the manuscript.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Trimming and structural adjustment of the prose collection
description: Sun Yuwei began seriously carrying out the cuts to her essay collection "Slow Travel Notes". She deleted "Morning Song of the Vegetable Market" from the "City Sketches" section, which repeated the theme of later chapters; removed "A Letter to Chengdu" from the "Letters from Afar" section, whose emotion was too thin; and reluctantly deleted "Night Visit to the Old Bookstall at the University of Finance and Economics", which clashed slightly with the overall tone. After each deletion, she copied the relevant paragraphs into a backup document. Then she carefully adjusted the order of the remaining chapters and updated the table of contents, reducing the collection from 65 pages to 58 pages, making the structure more compact and refined.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Balcony rest and meditation
description: After finishing the core task, Sun Yuwei left the computer, went to the balcony to water the potted mint plant, and gazed out at the Green Lake view to rest her eyes. Then she drew the sheer curtain, sat cross-legged on her yoga mat for a 10-minute meditation, cleared her mind, and recharged for the afternoon's activities.
location: Home balcony, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family Lunch and Invitation
description: Mother served her special mushroom rice noodles, and the wild mushroom broth was delicious. While eating, Sun Yuwei invited her, “Mom, would you come with me to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street this afternoon? I can show you the draft I finished revising this morning.” Li Xiulan readily agreed, also wanting to buy a few new books on educational psychology.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Afternoon rest and preparation to go out.
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei helped clear the dishes. She returned to her room, carefully placed the printed manuscript of her essay collection and her journal into the inner compartment of her canvas bag, and double-checked her wallet and phone. The sunlight outside the window was just right, so she changed into a light blue cotton-linen dress and cheerfully got ready to go out with her mother.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, living room and bedroom at home

name: The mother and daughter walked to Mingyuan Bookstore.
description: At 1:40 p.m., Sun Yuwei and her mother set out from their home at 123 Renmin Middle Road and strolled along familiar streets toward Wenlin Street. As they walked, they chatted: Li Xiulan mentioned that Aunt Xie's cat across the street had run away again, while Sun Yuwei shared what she had seen and heard at her photography class on Wenming Street a couple of days earlier. The 15-minute walk was full of the warmth of ordinary family life.
location: Walk from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Wenlin Street.

name: Manuscript sharing at Mingyuan Bookstore
description: After arriving at Mingyuan Bookstore, mother and daughter sat down in a corner of the reading area by the window. Sun Yuwei took out the bound manuscript and journal from her bag, showed her mother in detail the ideas for reorganizing the three parts of Slow Travel Notes, and told her about the professional suggestions Editor Xu had made at yesterday's revision meeting. Li Xiulan put on her reading glasses and flipped through the pages carefully, especially admiring the piece 'An Afternoon at Green Lake.' She also suggested that Sun Yuwei write a little more in the preface about her childhood memories of watching birds at Green Lake with her father. The bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, recognized the regular customers and brought over a pot of jasmine tea, praising Sun Yuwei's writing: 'It has a kind of spirit, like the water of Green Lake—calm on the surface, but with stories underneath.'
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Selecting and buying books at the bookstore.
description: After the tea break, mother and daughter each browsed the new-book section of the bookstore. Sun Yuwei found a new translation of Yoshida Kenko's Tsurezuregusa, and was also attracted by a photography collection titled 'Old Photos of Kunming: 1980-2000,' flipping through scenes of streets from her childhood memories. Li Xiulan picked out two books on adolescent classroom psychology. At checkout, Qin Mingyuan gave a discount for the regular customer, and Sun Yuwei proactively paid for the books with the manuscript fees she had saved. Her mother's smile was full of pride and gratification.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home from a walk.
description: The two of them walked out of the bookstore carrying book bags. Instead of going straight home, they walked along Wenlin Street for 4 minutes and took a detour to Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park). The setting sun stretched their shadows long, casting them onto the sparkling lake. They sat on a lakeside bench for ten minutes, watching wild ducks frolic. Sun Yuwei felt a peace and contentment she had not known for a long time—a double nourishment from literature and family. Then they walked about 18 minutes along Cuihu West Road back home.
location: From Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, via Green Lake Park, walk back to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road.

name: Family dinner preparation
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei helped her mother prepare dinner. She trimmed a few scallions and washed the greens, while her mother began stewing the pork ribs she had bought at the supermarket in the afternoon. Cheerful music played in the kitchen as the mother and daughter chatted about what they had seen at the bookstore that afternoon. They decided that tonight's menu would be pork rib and lotus root soup, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a cucumber salad.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the family sat around the dining table. The dinner atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. Sun Yuwei took the initiative to share what she had gained at the bookstore that afternoon and her mother's suggestion about the author's preface. Her father was very interested and encouraged her to write more about Kunming's local scenery. Sun Yuwei felt that her family was her strongest support.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Housework and a stroll around the neighborhood
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes. Afterwards, she did not immediately start her evening activities; instead, she changed into flat shoes and took a leisurely half-hour walk alone in the neighborhood, to help digestion and let her thoughts settle a little more.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and the surrounding neighborhood

name: Exchange with book friend Yang Xiao
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the study, opened WeChat, and saw a message from her book friend Yang Xiao. Yang Xiao expressed concern about the revisions to "Notes on Slow Travel" and suggested that adding an essay about "Longing" to the "Whispers" section would enrich the emotional layers. Sun Yuwei found the suggestion inspiring and in line with her own feelings. She earnestly replied, "Got it, I'll give it serious thought, thank you!" and noted down this inspiration in her journal.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Organizing journal and reading the new book
description: Sun Yuwei first went to her study, pasted into her journal the receipt from her afternoon book purchase at Mingyuan Bookstore, a sticker printed with "Wenlin Street," and a pressed plane-tree leaf she had picked up in Green Lake Park, then recorded the day's thoughts and feelings with her fountain pen. After washing up, she changed into pajamas and cozily curled up in bed. She opened the newly bought Essays in Idleness and read a few passages by Yoshida Kenko about "sitting quietly with nothing to do," feeling calm at heart.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province — home study and bedroom

name: Bedtime meditation and planning for tomorrow.
description: Turn off the main light, leaving only a small bedside lamp. Sun Yuwei completed her second short meditation session of the day (about 5 minutes), regulated her breathing, and cleared her mind of the day's thoughts. Then she picked up her phone and quickly listed the key points of tomorrow's plan in her memo: start writing the preface to 'Notes on Slow Travel' at 9 a.m.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and sleep
description: Sun Yuwei set her phone to silent, picked up 'Tsurezuregusa' again, and immersed herself in Yoshida Kenko's world of quiet, lucid words. The rustling of pages, accompanied by the occasional chirping of insects outside the window, made her feel very at ease. At 11:15 p.m., she closed the book, turned off the desk lamp, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning, thinking about writing the preface. After drinking a glass of warm water, I opened the curtains to find bright sunshine outside. I did 10 minutes of simple stretching, deliberately moving my left arm to confirm that the soreness from the vaccination two days ago had basically disappeared, and felt refreshed. Then I went to the dining room. My mother had already left for morning self-study at school, and in the insulated pot she had left mushroom rice noodles with a note telling me to drink the soup first. I added two spoonfuls of homemade oil-preserved termite mushrooms. While eating breakfast, I browsed my phone to see whether the editor, Mr. Xu Mingyuan, had sent a message, and I also saw friends in a group chat discussing last night's thunderstorm.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and Planning
description: After breakfast, she returned to the study, opened her journal, and recorded the day's mood: "No rain this morning, and the sunlight pours into the study—it's good weather for writing." She listed today's to-dos: get the third vaccine dose (remember to bring the vaccination record book), think through the self-preface, and write the first part. In the journal, she drew a syringe and a small envelope as a memento.
location: Study room, Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go out to get the third rabies vaccine shot and visit Cuihu Park along the way
description: Left on time at 8:20, took Bus No. 65 to Kunming Third People's Hospital in Guandu District. On the bus, sitting by the window, I thought about the opening of the preface. After about 35 minutes, I got off and walked to the hospital, where I smoothly registered. The vaccination doctor confirmed it was the third dose and praised how well I was recovering. While injecting, I asked about the recovery of my leg wound. The doctor examined it and said the swelling had gone down, so I could resume yoga but should avoid inverted poses or deep squat poses. After the vaccination, I sat quietly in the observation area for 30 minutes and left only after confirming I had no discomfort. Afterwards, I deliberately took a detour to Cuihu Park for a short stay. I saw an elderly man writing the two-character phrase 'floating life' in water with a brush on the stone steps, his strokes vigorous and powerful. I was deeply touched and privately noted down this feeling of 'slowness' and 'recording' as inspiration for the preface. Then I walked a few minutes back home, changed into loungewear, and brewed a cup of rose tea.
location: Kunming Third People's Hospital Wujing Campus, 319 Wujing Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Wrote the first draft of the author's preface and received an advance on the manuscript fee
description: After sitting down at the desk, she officially began writing the first part of the preface. She started from the summer of 2018 when she first set foot on the Yunnan University campus, recalling the moments in Chinese Department classes when she was encouraged by her teacher, and then the birth of her first column, 'The Paper-and-Ink Vigil on Wenlin Street.' She focused on explaining the origin of the book's title: during her sophomore year, she watched an elderly man playing chess by Green Lake. The old man pondered for a long time before placing a single stone, and she suddenly understood that words are not meant to chase the world but to record its breathing. The writing went very smoothly, and by near noon she had written about 1,100 characters of the first draft. Just as she was polishing it, a bank text message popped up on her phone: she had received an advance of 3,000 yuan for the manuscript. She jumped up excitedly, immediately transferred the money from her daily expense card to her Dream Travel Fund card, bringing the balance to 4,000 yuan, and solemnly recorded the transaction in her journal with a pink heart drawn next to it.
location: Study room, Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: For lunch, she simply reheated the leftover yam and pork rib soup from last night and ate it with the rice noodles her mother had left. After eating, she leaned back on the living room sofa and read Essays in Idleness, which she had bought from Mingyuan Bookstore. Reading the passage about 'idleness and quiet,' she felt it matched the mood of her morning writing very well. Then she took a 30-minute nap to regain her energy.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Polish and organize the first draft of the author's preface.
description: After the midday break, she returned to the study, read through the part she had written in the morning, and changed colloquial expressions into more elegant written language—for example, changing 'said' to 'recounted in a gentle, unhurried way'—and added a descriptive detail of sunlight passing through the curtain and falling onto the manuscript paper to make the text more vivid.
location: Study room, Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Restorative yoga class and an after-class walk
description: In the afternoon, she prepared for the yoga class: changed into professional yoga clothes, rolled up her yoga mat and packed it, and filled her bottle with lemon water. Wanting to ask more about poses for wound recovery, she set out 20 minutes early and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio in Dechun Commercial Building. After arriving, she talked with coach He Lu at the front desk and proactively mentioned that she had been vaccinated the day before yesterday and the leg wound. He Lu said today's class would safely focus on upper-body stretching and core control, and suggested adding spinal twists. The class was one-on-one with soothing meditation music, moving from Cat-Cow and Downward Dog to shoulder-neck stretches and spinal twists. He Lu made fine adjustments to her postures throughout and also talked about dietary methods to speed up healing. After the class, her shoulders, back, and waist felt very relaxed. Instead of going straight home, she took a walk around the edge of Green Lake Park, enjoying the evening street life, and rewarded herself with a sea salt cheese ice cream cone at an ice cream stand.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home, take a shower, and prepare dinner
description: After walking home, she first took a warm shower to wash off the sweat and felt refreshed all over. After changing into loungewear, she went into the kitchen and saw the tomatoes, eggs, and cucumbers her mother had left in the refrigerator, so she decided to make tomato scrambled eggs and cucumber salad, along with rice, to prepare for dinner.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Polishing the ending of the preface
description: While waiting for my mother to come home, I returned to the study and revised the first part of the preface again. At the end, I added a sentence about 'the slowness of Green Lake' as a closing for the section, which completely set the tone of the entire preface.
location: Study room, Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Have dinner with my mother and share my writing progress online with my sister.
description: When her mother Li Xiulan came home, the dishes and chopsticks were already set. Her mother was pleasantly surprised and praised her. While eating tomato scrambled eggs and cucumber salad, she happily shared two pieces of good news from the day: the manuscript fee had arrived and the vaccination had gone smoothly. Her mother also shared funny stories from school. After dinner, she curled up on the living room sofa and sent screenshots of the opening paragraphs of her preface to her sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen, asking whether it felt familiar. Her sister quickly replied by voice message, saying with a laugh that the words were full of images, as if she could see the little girl with a ponytail lost in thought by Green Lake back then, and they agreed to catch up over video on the weekend.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening study time: journaling and reading
description: After returning to the study, I opened my journal and solemnly recorded the important events of the day. With a fountain pen, I drew a small envelope and a syringe. Then I continued reading Essays in Idleness. When I came across a passage about the impermanence of the world, I felt a strong resonance with the deletions and revisions of my own manuscript.
location: Study room, Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: Sitting on the soft cushion of the bay window in her bedroom, she opened a meditation app and did a 10-minute relaxing meditation, reviewing fragments of the day in her mind: the emotion of writing the preface, the surprise of receiving the payment, the ease of the yoga class, and the warmth of sharing with family. After meditating, she went to the bathroom to wash up, then carefully changed the dressing on her thigh wound with povidone-iodine. The wound was healing well.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only the small nightlight by the bed. Smiled knowingly at the goodnight sticker my sister sent. Set my phone to Do Not Disturb, took a few deep breaths, and gradually fell asleep with beautiful hopes for my future writing career.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 3, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation, breakfast, and setting up the writing environment
description: Sun Yuwei woke up on the tatami, did some stretching and washed up, then enjoyed the mushroom rice noodle breakfast her mother had prepared. During breakfast she read a passage from Tsurezuregusa and shared the good news with her mother that the manuscript payment had arrived. After the meal she went to the study, watered the mint, turned on her computer, and opened the printed manuscript to create a writing atmosphere.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Complete the first draft of the second half of the author's preface.
description: Sun Yuwei put on headphones in her study, played white noise, and focused on writing the second part of her preface, incorporating homage to the literary styles of Wang Zengqi and Shen Congwen, delicately portraying the influence of Yunnan culture on her writing sensibility, completing a draft of about 1,500 characters.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Rest during a writing break
description: Sun Yuwei walked to the living room balcony, looked at the people passing below and the black-headed gulls in the distance, drank water, and stretched her neck and wrists, mentally preparing for the afternoon trip to Zhibushi Bookstore.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having lunch with my mother
description: Mother prepared tomato scrambled eggs, cucumber salad, and sea bass. Sun Yuwei excitedly told her mother that the first draft of the preface was done. The mother and daughter chatted easily, and her mother encouraged her.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday nap
description: Sun Yuwei rested for 20 minutes on the tatami in the study, leaning against a pillow with her eyes closed. When she woke up, she washed her face with cold water and regained her energy.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei put the revised printout and red pen into her canvas bag, walked from home, took a detour via Qianju Street, and arrived at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore after about 15 minutes.
location: From Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu North Road

name: Revise the author's preface at the bookstore and exchange ideas with Uncle Qin
description: Uncle Qin led Sun Yuwei to a window-side workspace on the second floor. She took out the printed manuscript and revised it line by line with a red pen, adjusting long sentences and metaphors and cutting redundant parts. Uncle Qin passed by and commented that it had 'the flavor of everyday life.' After finishing the revisions, she went downstairs for an in-depth exchange with Uncle Qin. He used Plants and Trees of the Human World to share his insights on writing prefaces, stressing that sincerity is more important than elegance. Sun Yuwei was deeply inspired.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home
description: With gains and inspiration, Sun Yuwei walked home from the bookstore along Cuihu North Road with a light step.
location: From Cuihu North Road to Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Polish the author's preface, save it as V2.0, and rest.
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei immediately typed the revised paper draft into her computer, read through the whole text, and adjusted the tone to make it more natural. At 16:00, she saved it as Slow Travel Notes_With Preface_V2.0. Then she had some yogurt for a short rest and replied to her book friend Yang Xiao on WeChat.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing for headstand practice
description: Sun Yuwei laid out her yoga mat against the wall in the living room, took out her yoga blocks, jotted down the practice steps in her phone's memo app, and saved a beginner headstand tutorial video on Bilibili.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing journal notes and recording what I gained.
description: Sun Yuwei recorded her writing progress in her journal in neat handwriting, especially noting the golden line that sincerity is more important than elegance, and drew a structural sketch of the preface.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing the meal with mother and family dinner
description: Sun Yuwei helped her mother pick vegetables and peel garlic, listening to her mother talk about amusing events at school; after her father came home, the family enjoyed a steam-pot chicken dinner. Sun Yuwei reported on her writing progress, and her father agreed with Uncle Qin's suggestion. The atmosphere was warm.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Take a walk with family in Cuihu Park
description: The family of three went to Cuihu Park for a walk to aid digestion, enjoying the afterglow of the setting sun. Her father talked about a cultural exhibition project, while her mother and Sun Yuwei discussed the home-style dishes in Wang Zengqi's essays, enjoying a quiet family moment.
location: Cuihu Park Trail, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Little Bird Park)

name: Reading photography books to find inspiration
date: While my sister was resting, I walked about 27 minutes to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. Thinking that she might be suffering from heatiness after returning, I specially picked some Akizuki pears to stew with rock sugar and snow pear in the evening, and also bought a bunch of dewy daisies to add a fresh touch to the dinner table. Walking and shopping alone also served as a stretch after sitting for a long time.
description: After walking home and washing up, Sun Yuwei browsed through “Old Photos of Kunming: 1980-2000” brought back from the bookstore in her study. She examined the images of Wenming Street from 1985, imagining the old street life, and accumulated inspiration for her writing.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Digital painting practice: eucalyptus leaves
description: Sun Yuwei turned on the graphics tablet and drawing software, practiced drawing eucalyptus leaves, sketched the spiral leaf outlines and filled them with a green brush, then saved the work when done.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Look up the key points for a headstand and take notes
description: Sun Yuwei watched a saved headstand tutorial video in the living room, carefully studying the starting position, core engagement, and safe falling techniques. She used voice input to add notes such as "tighten the core, lift the shoulder blades" to her memo, and looked forward to practicing the next day.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After taking a hot shower, Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas and did some simple shoulder and neck stretches in the bedroom, dimming the lights to create a quiet atmosphere.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and meditation
description: Sun Yuwei wrote down today's keywords in her journal — “completion,” “sincerity,” and “preparation” — then sat cross-legged for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation to calm her mind.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Read before bed and turn off the light to sleep
description: Sun Yuwei read the passage about “stillness” in Section 51 of Tsurezuregusa, immersed in the tranquility of the text. Then she turned off the bedside lamp and drifted into sleep with the calm of having completed the author's preface.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Early-morning headstand breakthrough practice
description: Spread a yoga mat in the living room and did a 10-minute full-body warm-up, focusing on the wrists, neck and shoulders, and core. Then I tried a headstand against the wall, interlacing my hands on the floor and lightly touching the mat with my head. After several attempts to adjust the core engagement, my legs finally left the wall, and I held the inversion for about one minute. In the inverted field of vision, I felt an odd sense of tranquility and strength, and a realization welled up in my heart: 'Growth is not about conquering, but about persisting gently.'
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home living room)

name: Morning routine: washing up, breakfast, journaling, and publishing to the official account.
description: After yoga practice, she showered and changed, then went to the dining room to have breakfast with her mother: small-pot rice noodles. As they ate, she shared the joy of doing a headstand for the first time that morning, and her mother reminded her to be careful. After the meal, in the study, she recorded the practice steps, physical sensations, and emotional changes in detail in her journal, adding simple line drawings. Then on the computer, she distilled the text into a short essay, added a photo of her yoga mat, titled it “The World You See in a One-Minute Headstand,” and formatted and published it on her WeChat official account. After the article was sent out, she saw that her friend Zhang Jing and yoga coach He Lu had tapped “Wow.”
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home)

name: Wrote the essay "After Being Bitten."
description: Using the experience from seven days ago of being bitten by a stray dog and getting vaccinated as material, she wrote the essay "After the Bite" in the writing software in her study. In the morning, she completed a first draft of nearly 1,200 characters, writing about fear with a restrained touch and about being moved with warm details, practicing the belief that "sincerity is more important than elegance." In the afternoon, she polished and revised it, adjusting the order of sentences to make the rhythm smoother. Finally, she read it through twice to make sure there were no mistakes, saved the file, and backed it up to the cloud drive.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study room)

name: Family lunch and casual conversation
description: My parents came home from work, and lunch was scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried choy sum, and Chinese yam pork rib soup. At the table, I excitedly brought up the handstand breakthrough again. My father smiled and reminded me to be safe, while my mother asked about the afternoon yoga class schedule and told me not to come back too late.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan (home dining room)

name: Midday rest and reading.
description: Sitting in a rattan chair on the balcony, she read three essays from 'Essays in Idleness' and immersed herself in the leisurely, Zen-like prose. After about an hour, she felt drowsy, leaned back in the chair, and rested with her eyes closed for about fifteen minutes, regaining her energy.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home balcony)

name: Get ready and walk to the yoga studio.
description: She packed her yoga clothes, water bottle, and other items, changed into black yoga pants and a gray sports tank top, and practiced headstand key points in front of the full-length mirror while adjusting her breathing. Then she took her keys and went out, listening to light music through earphones, walking south from Cuihu Community along Huashan West Road, turning right onto Dongfeng West Road, and arriving at Dechun Commercial Building after about 15 minutes.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Yoga class and post-class discussion
description: After arriving at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, she greeted the instructor He Lu, changed clothes, and did some simple stretching on the mat. During class, after a group warm-up, they practiced headstands. Under He Lu's guidance, she successfully held a headstand against the wall for 10 seconds. The instructor praised her core strength and recorded a video, reminding her to avoid putting pressure on her neck. After class, the two chatted in the rest area for about ten minutes. He Lu praised how steady her headstand was and joked that if she ate a lot after training, she would need extra practice. They laughed, said goodbye, and agreed to meet next week.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying ingredients on the way home
description: Walking home from the yoga studio, I received a call from my mother on the way, so I turned into the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street, picked out a box of mixed mushrooms, a piece of silken tofu, and a bunch of cilantro, paid, and then returned to Cuihu Community through the alleys.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Returning home to rest and checking social security information
description: After returning home, put the ingredients in the kitchen, changed into loungewear, poured warm water and rested on the sofa, and replied to friends' comments on the new article on my phone. Later, went to the study, turned on the computer, searched for "Guide to Social Insurance for Flexible Employment Personnel in Kunming", and bookmarked a few important webpages.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home)

name: Family mushroom hotpot dinner
description: Mother made hot pot with clear chicken broth, adding purchased mushrooms and tofu. The family of three sat around the pot cooking ingredients. During the meal, mother mentioned again that after graduating she had no employer paying social insurance, and suggested she apply as a flexible-employment individual; father agreed. She said she had already checked the guide today and planned to go to the Social Security Center next week for consultation. Her parents were willing to help prepare materials such as the household registration booklet.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan (home dining room)

name: Family walk at Green Lake Park.
description: After dinner, she went for a walk with her parents at Cuihu Park to aid digestion. A cool breeze was blowing, and streetlights reflected on the lake. As they walked, they chatted about the funny moments from the afternoon yoga class and the life attitude of the instructor He Lu. Her parents said, "That girl really looks full of energy." They walked a full lap around the lake, bought iced sour plum drink, and then returned home.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Evening journaling and reading in the study.
description: Back in the study, she first used her phone to check the reservation process for the Kunming Social Security Bureau in detail and browsed posts in the service guide. Then she opened her journal and solemnly recorded today's milestones—successful headstand, completed first draft of an essay, and family planning discussion. She drew a small upside-down figure in watercolor and wrote beside it, 'Growth is not conquest, but gentle persistence.' Then she flipped through the dog-eared pages of 'Tsurezuregusa' and found that its view on 'leisure' resonated with her current state of mind, so she wrote down a reflection.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study room)

name: Bedtime meditation, planning, and sleep
description: I closed my laptop, tidied the desk, washed up, did my skincare routine, and changed into pajamas. On the bed, I sat cross-legged and meditated for 10 minutes, fully relaxing my body and mind. Then I used my phone's memo app to list tomorrow's plan: continue revising the essay "After Being Bitten" in the morning, and go to the social security center in the afternoon to consult and process the application. I turned off the bedside lamp, adjusted the air conditioner temperature, and fell asleep with the satisfaction of reviewing today's achievements.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Getting up and waking up in the morning.
description: Waking up in the bedroom of her home on Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming in the early morning, July sunlight filtered through the curtains with warmth. She sat up, loosened her shoulders and neck, and recalled the sense of accomplishment from yesterday's successful headstand. She tied up her hair with a whale-shaped hair tie and went to wash up, starting a new day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast, reading, and tending to plants
description: After washing up, she went to the balcony and used a spray bottle to water the mint, hearing birds chirping outside the window. Walking into the kitchen, she saw the note Mom had left on the coffee table and served herself a bowl of hot rice noodles. Sitting at the dining table, she flipped through 'Essays in Idleness' while eating, enjoying the peaceful morning.
location: Balcony and dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Check social insurance policies for flexible employment.
description: In the home study, she logged on to the official website and WeChat official account of the Kunming Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, and looked up in detail the application conditions, contribution bases, and required materials for flexible employees to participate in the basic pension insurance and medical insurance for employees. She noted the minimum contribution base of 3,100 yuan, a monthly payment of about 600-plus yuan, and other information, and saved screenshots to the “Social Insurance Application” folder.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth research on social security policies and discussion with her older sister.
description: I continued researching the policy details, checked that the handling address was the Wuhua District Social Security Center (near Cuihu South Road), and calculated that paying at the minimum base would amount to about 7,200 yuan per year. Then I sent a WeChat message to my elder sister Sun Yutong, asking about the cost of flexible-employment insurance in Shenzhen. She quickly replied, sighing, "It's not cheap, but it is worth paying," and we exchanged our experiences.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Organized information and drafted next week's to-do list.
description: On the next week's page of her journal, she drafted a “Monday to-do list”: go to the Wuhua District Social Security Center to inquire and submit materials. Next to today's items, she added an asterisk note “Materials are ready.” Closing the notebook, she felt that most of the task was already done.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Rest and have brunch with Mom.
description: From the study, she walked to the balcony, took a deep breath, looked at the blue sky and white clouds, and did a few stretches. Her mother, Li Xiulan, came back from school and brought cold rice noodle rolls. Lunch was earlier than usual. Yuwei excitedly repeated the social security inquiry results to her mother, who nodded approvingly and reminded her to wear a coat when going to the bank in the afternoon. The two chatted warmly.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon nap and reading
description: After lunch, she returned to the bedroom and lay on the bed with a bamboo mat, opening Essays in Idleness and reading a few essays about gardens and plants. Growing drowsy, she put down the book and rested with her eyes closed for about forty minutes.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize social security materials and go to the bank to print bank statements.
description: After the lunch break, I sorted out the materials according to the checklist: ID card, household register original and copies, and white-background photos. Then I changed into a dress, took an eco-friendly cloth bag, and walked about 12 minutes to the China Construction Bank 24-hour self-service bank near my home (Xiaoximen Branch). At the self-service terminal, I inserted the designated bank card for social security deductions and printed the last three months of bank statements.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and China Construction Bank 24-Hour Self-Service Bank (Kunming Xiaoximen Sub-branch)

name: Go home and tidy up the document files.
description: Back home, she neatly placed all the materials into a transparent document folder, wrote "Social Security Application Materials Checklist" on a sticky note with a highlighter, stuck it onto the front of the folder, and finally put it into her usual backpack.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Discuss the teaching-assistant procedures with flower arrangement master Su Man.
description: In the study, she checked the assistant process for tomorrow's “Summer Evening Breeze” flower bouquet workshop with flower arrangement master Su Man via WeChat: there will be 8 students, and she will mainly help demonstrate material selection and guide arrangement, and needs to prepare flowers in advance and remind students of details such as cutting sunflower stems at a diagonal.

participant.name: Su Man
participant.relation: Flower arrangement instructor, both mentor and friend.

location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Dounan Flower Market to purchase floral materials
description: Left with a canvas bag, Bluetooth earphones on, listening to a podcast. Took Metro Line 1, transferred to Line 2, then Line 4 (or took Bus K28), arriving at Dounan Flower Market in about 65 minutes. According to the 'Summer Evening Breeze' color palette list, bought sunflowers (main flower), lisianthus, eucalyptus leaves, daisies, and floral tape.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Su Man's studio to prepare tools.
description: After finishing the shopping, she took a taxi (about 54 minutes) to the flower arrangement studio on Cuihu North Road. Together with Su Man, she trimmed the flower branches and leaves, arranged the vases, and prepared scissors, floral foam, and other tools. Su Man asked Yuwei to rehearse how to guide students in tying bouquets and gave her approval. As she left, she was given a bunch of daisies.

participant.name: Su Man
participant.relation: Flower arrangement instructor, both mentor and friend.

location: Su Man's Flower Arrangement Studio, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxing walk in Green Lake Park
description: After leaving the studio, she walked about 15 minutes to Green Lake Park holding a bouquet of small daisies. The evening lake breeze was cool, and light and shadows rippled on the water. She sat on a bench, put the flowers beside her, enjoyed the breeze, and replied to messages on Moments. About half an hour later, she walked home, taking about 12 minutes in total. Today was fulfilling and pleasant.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home for a shower and tidy up.
description: After getting home, she took a quick shower and changed into a comfortable cotton-linen house dress. She put the daisies into a vase and placed it on the desk in her study, and the whole room instantly came to life.
location: Bathroom and study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Chatting with best friend Zhang Jing on WeChat
description: Leaning back in the study chair, she made a WeChat voice call to her best friend Zhang Jing, sharing her excitement and nervousness about preparing to be the flower arrangement teaching assistant today. She said, "I went to Dounan today and bought super pretty flowers." Zhang Jing jokingly called her a 'flower fanatic' and sent a 'Go for it!' sticker. The two chatted about recent news for half an hour and agreed to visit a newly opened coffee shop on Wenlin Street next week.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Make a journal entry to record today
description: Took out my beloved journal and colored pens, pasted the flower market receipts and a small dried eucalyptus branch into the journal in a collage style, and wrote the title “0711 A Day of Running Around for Flowers and for the Future.” Then I copied the social security policy and Monday’s to-do procedures into the task section, and drew a little sun.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and relaxation.

description: She walked from home to Guanghua Street, using her camera to photograph the clouds at the end of the old street as an exercise. After arriving, the photography teacher reviewed last week's assignments and emphasized 'narrating with light and shadow.' Then about 20 students dispersed to practice. She focused on shooting the steam from an old tea shop, the arc of a silversmith's work, and the blurred figures of pedestrians, trying slow shutter speeds. The teacher confirmed the focus accuracy and suggested increasing the ISO in areas of light-and-dark contrast. The class ended.
location: Guanghua Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (section from near Victory Hall to Yunrui Park)

name: Tea tasting at an old teahouse and photo sharing.

Selected three satisfactory photos: the teapot in steam, a close-up of the silversmith, and blurred passersby on the stone-slab road. Used the phone to edit the photos and adjust the contrast, with the caption: Time on Guanghua Street. The older the lens, the more it understands the whispers of the old street. Posted it to WeChat Moments.
location: 'Yinyuanzhai' Old Teahouse, 85 Huashan South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

Once home, changed out of the dust-covered dress, put on light makeup, and confirmed the inscription on the title page of the advance copy of Slow Travel Notes. Sent a WeChat to Zhao Xiaowen to confirm meeting at the café at 3 p.m., and got her reply that she was heading out.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and balcony plant care
description: At lunchtime, my mother prepared tomato scrambled eggs and oyster sauce lettuce, and I had lunch with my parents. During the meal, I excitedly showed them photos of the old teahouse I had taken that morning, and my father recalled that he used to go there often when he was young. After the meal, I went to the balcony to water the mint and pothos, picked off withered leaves, and enjoyed the afternoon sun.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (dining room and balcony)

name: Go to the appointment at the café on Nanqiang Street.

She deliberately took a detour through Cuihu Park to enjoy the leisurely weekend vibe and watch the boats on the lake. After walking through the park, she arrived at Old Place Café at No. 16 Nanqiang Street, took a seat by the window, and soon saw Zhao Xiaowen hurrying over through the glass; she waved to greet her.
location: Starting from home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, passing Green Lake Park (No. 67 South Green Lake Road), arrive at Laodifang Cafe, No. 16 Nanqiang Street

name: A café date with my good friend Zhao Xiaowen.
description: Met Zhao Xiaowen and ordered a matcha latte and Earl Grey tea. Zhao Xiaowen brought out a handmade illustrated album, containing the awkward group photo of the four of us from our freshman dorm, photos from our four years of college, tickets, movie ticket stubs, and handwritten notes. The last page was a hand-drawn calendar that read, 'We must meet every June.' I was deeply touched and gave her a sample copy of 'Slow Travel Notes' in return, and talked about where the inspiration for the title came from. The two of us exchanged updates: Zhao Xiaowen's workplace stories as a newcomer to a publishing house, and my anxiety and freedom as a freelancer. She agreed to help contact her friend at an art academy to design the cover for my essay collection. We agreed that, even though we are in different places, we should video chat at least once every two months.
location: Old Place Café, No. 16 Nanqiang Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Saying goodbye, heading home, and sitting briefly by Cuihu Lake
description: Hugged Zhao Xiaowen goodbye at the café entrance and felt light-hearted carrying the heavy hand-drawn photo album. On the way home, she stopped by the bakery next to Shuncheng Shopping Center to buy a baguette and soft European-style bread for tomorrow's breakfast. Afterward, she detoured to Green Lake Park, sat quietly on a lakeside bench for ten minutes, and savored the afternoon's laughter and emotions in the evening breeze.
location: Starting from 16 Nanqiang Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, passing BA Bakery at 11 Dongfeng West Road, and ending at Cuihu Park, 67 Cuihu South Road

name: Family dinner sharing the joy of being together.

location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep review and falling asleep
description: Back in the bedroom, I finished the last entry in my journal, noting the breakthrough in painting and Monday's to-dos. Leaning against the bed, I read Tsurezuregusa, savoring the line 'The heart is a flower that falls on its own, without waiting for the wind,' which resonated with my mood. Then I turned off the light and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, feeling my breath and heartbeat. After meditation, I didn't fall asleep right away, so I read a few more pages of Tsurezuregusa and let the words lead me gradually into dreams. Finally, I set the alarm for 8:00 the next morning, turned off the light, and fell asleep, carrying the day's light and shadows, laughter, and the sound of pages into my dreams.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province
