name: Rest and sleep
description: After sending the message, I felt fulfilled. I saved the manuscript and sent my mother a WeChat message: “Mom, Jingjing is much better. We're settled in, don't worry.” I attached a photo of the lake view taken in the evening. Then I gently closed the computer and turned off the desk lamp. In the moonlight coming through the window, I saw the sleeping Zhang Jing; her face seemed more relaxed than during the day. Finally, drowsiness came over me. I tiptoed to the other bed and lay down. Glancing at the phone screen, Zhang Jing still hadn't replied, but I felt at peace. When the sun rises tomorrow, everything will be different. I closed my eyes and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room at Qiaoqiao Yunqi Guesthouse, Fuxian Lake, Huanhu East Road, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm went off at seven on the dot, playing the soft 'River Flows in You'. After silencing the alarm, she stretched in bed and felt well rested. She had slept soundly after finishing 'Flower Trace' the night before. After getting up, she drew open the curtains. Outside was a clear Monday, and sunlight streamed through the plane tree leaves outside the window. She went to the bathroom to wash up and splashed her face with cold water. Back in her room, she changed into a simple white T-shirt and denim shorts, preparing for the possibly long trip ahead.
location: Space Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and an unexpected phone call
description: Mom had already made small-pot rice noodles, and the aroma filled the air. I had just sat down to eat when my phone rang — it was Zhang Jing. As soon as I answered, I heard her choked, hoarse voice haltingly telling me that her boyfriend had suddenly broken up with her last week; she hadn't slept all night and felt as if she had fallen into a deep well. My heart tightened. I put down my chopsticks and said softly to soothe her, 'Jingjing, don't be afraid. I'm here.' After listening to her, I made a decisive decision: 'I'll come over right now to be with you. Let's go somewhere we can get some air.' After hanging up, I quickly explained briefly to Mom. She didn't ask anything more, just sighed, went to the kitchen, packed two just-made flower cakes in a food bag, and handed them to me: 'Take these for the road. Take good care of that girl.'
location: Space Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Quick packing and catching a taxi
description: She quickly stuffed a change of clothes, her journal, a laptop, 'Tsurezuregusa', a power bank, and a toiletries bag into her backpack. After putting on her sneakers at the entryway, she went out with the bulging backpack. Downstairs, she called a ride-hailing car through an app at the entrance of the residential complex, setting the destination to the community at No. 810 Beijing Road where Zhang Jing lived. In the car, she sent Zhang Jing a message: 'I'm almost there, don't be afraid.' The ride took about 16 minutes. Looking out the window at the passing streetscape, she thought about how she could make her feel better.
location: Space Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Embrace and Decide the Itinerary
description: The ride-hailing car stopped at the entrance of the residential complex. Seeing Zhang Jing already standing on the steps of the building entrance, wearing loose loungewear, eyes swollen like walnuts, looking haggard. I quickly got out and walked toward her, without saying anything, first gave her a tight hug, letting her cry silently on my shoulder. After a while, I released her and said softly, "Come on, I'll take you somewhere you can catch your breath." I took out my phone, quickly searched on Ctrip and booked a room with a lake view at "Qiaoqiao Yunqi Homestay" on Fuxian Lake, and scheduled a ride-share to Fuxian Lake.
location: Residential complex at No. 810 Beijing Road, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: On the way to Fuxian Lake
description: Zhang Jing and I got into the back seat of a ride-hailing car. She leaned on my shoulder and, along the way, poured out the details of the breakup in fits and starts: how cold he was when he said he wanted to break up, how she tried to keep him, and her self-doubt. I listened quietly and didn't say much, only handing her tissues and gently patting her back from time to time. The driver drove quietly, and the city buildings outside the window gradually gave way to open fields and distant mountains. When the car passed a stretch of highway where Dianchi Lake was visible, I softly told her to look at the water. Zhang Jing followed my gaze for a while, said nothing, but her breathing seemed to become steadier.
location: On the expressway from Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Chengjiang City, Yuxi City.

name: Arrival and Check-in at the Homestay
description: After a drive of about 88 minutes, the ride-hailing car stopped at the courtyard entrance of Qiaoqiao Yunqi Guesthouse. The owner, a kind-faced woman around fifty, saw Zhang Jing's condition but asked nothing—she just smiled gently and brought over two cups of warm water with osmanthus blooms floating in them. They checked in and received the key to a second-floor room with a balcony facing the lake. After briefly putting down their luggage, Zhang Jing stood on the balcony, looked at the shimmering lake in the distance, and let out a long sigh.

participant.name: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

location: Qiaoqiao Yunqi Guesthouse, Fuxian Lake, Huanhu East Road, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

name: A walk and heart-to-heart conversation on the lakeside boardwalk
description: After putting down the luggage, Zhang Jing said she didn't want to stay in the room and wanted to go out for a walk. The two of them slowly walked along the lakeside boardwalk, which was a two-minute walk from the guesthouse. Sunlight poured through the clouds onto the lake, and the wind was so strong that it tousled their hair. As she walked, Zhang Jing shared more details—for example, the first book he gave her, and how he had also taken the pothos they had raised together. I listened quietly and, amid the creak of footsteps on the wooden planks, shared a reflection from Tsurezuregusa on “all things are impermanent”: “Some things are like the ripples on this lake—they appear violent, but in the end they return to calm.” I suggested she could try writing down how she felt at this moment. Zhang Jing gave a wry smile and said, “I probably can't write it.” So I said, “Then don't say anything for now—just feel the wind.”
location: Fuxian Lake Time Trail, East Lakeshore Road, Chengjiang City, Yuxi, Yunnan Province.

name: Homestay lunch and rest
description: Tired from walking, we returned to the guesthouse. The proprietress recommended her homemade copper-pot fish and potato braised rice. When the dishes arrived, they were steaming hot and gave off a rustic aroma. Zhang Jing didn't have much appetite and only managed a few sips of fish soup. I picked a piece of fish for her and slowly ate my own meal, making idle conversation about the bougainvillea planted in the guesthouse courtyard. After the meal, Zhang Jing went back to the room to lie down for a while, while I sat on a rattan chair on the balcony, opened my journal, and briefly wrote down the morning's feelings in pen: "Accompanying her to a place with wind feels more meaningful than writing a thousand words."
location: Qiaoqiao Yunqi Guesthouse, Fuxian Lake, Huanhu East Road, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

name: Watching the scenery from a stone bench by the lake and being struck by inspiration.
description: At two in the afternoon, Zhang Jing said she couldn't sleep, so the two of them went for another walk by the lake. When they got tired, they sat down on a stone bench by the lake, facing the water. Time passed slowly, and the sun began to set, dyeing the entire lake a flowing rose-gold. The water sparkled, so beautiful it left them speechless. Zhang Jing leaned on my shoulder and was quiet for a long, long time. Then she suddenly whispered softly, “The wind here is really healing.” Turning to look, I saw that the corners of Zhang Jing's mouth had finally turned up slightly. Just then, I saw not far away an elderly couple with graying hair, supporting each other as they slowly walked along the boardwalk. The old man stopped to help the old woman straighten her collar, which the wind had messed up. Zhang Jing's gaze followed them, with envy, sadness, and a kind of relief in her eyes. This scene, like a seed, suddenly fell into her heart.
location: Stone viewing bench beside the Fuxian Lake Time Trail on Huanhu East Road, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner at the homestay.
description: Back at the guesthouse, the hostess had already prepared dinner: lightly stir-fried vegetables and a bowl of hot soup. Perhaps because she had watched the sunset, Zhang Jing's mood seemed to have calmed down a bit, and she voluntarily ate half a small bowl of rice. While eating, she used her phone's memo app to note down the scene of the elderly couple by the lake, and her mind was already drafting the framework for the story about 'stars at the bottom of the lake.' After the meal, Zhang Jing said she was tired and wanted to rest early.
location: Qiaoqiao Yunqi Guesthouse, Fuxian Lake, Huanhu East Road, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

name: Time for companionship and independent creation.
description: After Zhang Jing took a shower, she fell into a deep sleep under the soft light before nine, breathing evenly. She tucked the edge of the quilt around her, then walked quietly to the desk, turned on the desk lamp, and set it to a warm yellow light. First she opened the memo on her phone and quickly wrote down the story outline, then she opened her laptop and created a new document named The Star at the Bottom of the Lake. Blending the evening's inspiration with Zhang Jing's confidences today, her fingers began to fly over the keyboard. In the story, a little star accidentally falls into a cold lakebed and sinks into loneliness and darkness, until every night, gentle moonlight passes through the water and warms it little by little; finally it shines again, becoming the deepest light at the bottom of the lake.
location: Room at Qiaoqiao Yunqi Guesthouse, Fuxian Lake, Huanhu East Road, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

name: Complete the creation and send it
description: Time flew by as the words flowed. She wove in the metaphor Zhang Jing had once used, 'like falling into a deep well,' and also added the image of an elderly couple by the lake supporting each other. At 1 a.m., she typed the final period; the full text was about 2200 characters. She read it over softly and felt a gentle strength in the words. She exported the document, sent it to Zhang Jing via WeChat, and typed a line in the message box: 'Every star has had its days at the bottom of the lake, but the moonlight has always been there.'
location: Room at Qiaoqiao Yunqi Guesthouse, Fuxian Lake, Huanhu East Road, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

name: Guesthouse breakfast and checkout.
description: In the courtyard of the Shuyan Mountain Retreat B&B by Fuxian Lake, they enjoyed breakfast, including plain congee with small side dishes and copper-pot braised potato rice. Zhang Jing looked better and talked about a touching passage in the novel The Star at the Bottom of the Lake about an old couple living by the lake. After the meal, the two packed their luggage together, checked the room, and completed the check-out procedures.
location: No. 22, Xiaowan Village Committee, Yousuo Town, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province (Shuyan Shanjü Resort Homestay Courtyard, Fuxian Lake).

name: Ride back to Kunming
description: Taking the reserved ride-hailing car from Fuxian Lake back to Kunming city. On the way, Zhang Jing checks her work plan while you put on earphones and doze off to light music. The car stops at a service area for 5 minutes, and both of you stretch. Zhang Jing agrees to go to Paper Stone Bookstore on Friday.
location: In a ride-hailing car (from No. 22, Xiaowan Village Committee, Youzuo Town, Chengjiang City, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province to Wuhua District, Kunming City)

name: See off a friend and walk home to shop
description: Arrived at the entrance of Zhang Jing's residential community, hugged her goodbye, and reminded her to rest. Then she walked home, stopping at Old Li's fruit stall on the way to buy two mangoes and a box of unsweetened yogurt. Around 11:30, she returned home at No. 7 Huashan West Road.
location: At the entrance of Zhang Jing's residential community in Wuhua District, Kunming, then walked via Lao Li's roadside fruit stand to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road

description: After returning home, her mother asked with concern whether she had eaten. She put her suitcase back in the room, washed up briefly, and changed into home clothes. location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Cuihu Community (living room and bedroom at home)

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Had lunch with her mother; the dishes included stir-fried seasonal vegetables, cold chicken, and tomato and egg soup. She shared her experiences at Fuxian Lake and news about Zhang Jing. After the meal, she rested on the sofa for a while, browsing her phone to relax, and prepared for the afternoon vaccination.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (home dining room and living room)

name: Heading to the hospital to get vaccinated
description: After resting at home for half an hour, she changed into light clothing, took her medical insurance card and medical record booklet, and walked to the Third People's Hospital of Kunming. She walked along Huashan West Road and Renmin Middle Road for about 30 minutes, then registered, paid, and waited in line for the vaccination at the hospital.
location: Walk from No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Kunming Third People's Hospital (No. 319 Wujing Road, Guandu District)

name: Received the fourth dose of rabies vaccine.
description: At the emergency department of Kunming Third People's Hospital, she received the fourth dose of rabies vaccine. After verifying her information, the nurse injected it into the outer upper arm; the procedure took about 2 minutes. The nurse advised avoiding alcohol, spicy food, and strenuous exercise for 24 hours, and scheduled the final dose for July 29. After the injection, she rested in the observation area.
location: No. 319 Wujing Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Emergency Department, Kunming Third People's Hospital)

name: Remaining under observation and shopping on the way back
description: Waited in the observation area for 30 minutes, during which she edited a Moments post visible only to herself titled "Fourth Dose" and browsed Xiaohongshu. After confirming she felt fine, she left the hospital and bought a bottle of room-temperature water at a convenience store on the way home.
location: Kunming Third People's Hospital observation area, then walked back to Wuhua District via Wujing Road, Guandu District

name: Vaccine reaction led to an afternoon nap
description: After returning home, she felt noticeably tired. She changed into pajamas, drew the curtains, set a 40-minute alarm, and took a nap in bed. When she woke up, her body was relaxed and her mind was refreshed.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Organize travel materials and record in the journal.
description: At the desk in her study, she imported the Fuxian Lake photos from her phone into a journaling app, chose soft-toned photos, and wrote down her feelings: the lake's blue is a healing color. She also recorded the source of inspiration for creating The Star at the Bottom of the Lake.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study room)

name: Walk to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Shouldering my laptop bag, I walked along Cuihu South Road westward, passing Green Lake Park, and reached Mingyuan Bookstore (Zhibushi Bookstore) in about 15 minutes. Uncle Qin was tidying the bookshelves and nodded to me. I walked to the window-side workstation on the second floor.
location: Walk from No. 7 Huashan West Road to the Zhibushi Bookstore (Mingyuan Book House) at No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revising the essay collection manuscript and exchanging ideas
description: Focused on revising the essay collection at my second-floor workstation, completing the optimization of the preface and the polishing of two essays. At about 18:50 I went downstairs to rest. Uncle Qin handed me warm water and asked about my progress. He suggested keeping an eye on small publishing studios such as 'Maitian Culture' and shared experiences from his past book friends. I thanked him for the advice and decided to look into it later.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (second-floor workspace and first-floor counter at Mingyuan Book House)

name: Weighing in, recording weight, and preparing to leave
description: In the bookstore, next to the restroom, I found a public smart scale. I stepped on it, and it showed 43.6 kg, making me realize I had recently lost weight. I recorded it in my phone's memo app and took a screenshot, then resolved to pay more attention to nutrition. I packed up my computer and notebook and said goodbye to Qin Mingyuan.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (outside the restroom on the first floor of Mingyuan Bookstore)

name: Go home and have a snack
description: Walked home in 10 minutes; Mom had prepared warm milk and whole grain crackers. After eating, you felt much warmer.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home)

name: Family dinner
description: Had a light dinner with her mother, talking about the afternoon's manuscript revision progress and plans to meet friends tomorrow.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan (home dining room)

name: Evening journal creation and recording
description: At the desk in the bedroom, using a newly bought A5 journal, she wrote the date and the mood keyword "return, vaccine, body weight, new scale" in a green gel pen. She printed and pasted the photos she had organized in the afternoon, and wrote down the weight gain plan: "Weight gain plan launched: record diet and weight daily." The record was completed an hour later.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (at the desk in the bedroom at home).

name: Publish a travel post on Xiaohongshu
description: In bed, she used her phone to select 6 photos of Fuxian Lake scenery and close-ups of her journal, and wrote: “Thank you, Fuxian Lake, and thank you to the one who listened to the wind with me. There is a passage in ‘Stars at the Bottom of the Lake’ that I love: ‘What we may need is just an escape and a listener.’” She attached an excerpt from the novel. After posting, she quickly received likes and comments comforting Zhang Jing.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (at home, on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Received a private message from a publishing house editor about collaboration
description: On Xiaohongshu, she received a private message from Li Xue, an editor at Yunnan People's Publishing House, praising the quality of the prose excerpt and asking about the possibility of collaborative publication. You sobered up a little, politely replied with thanks, and left your email address.

participant.name: Li Xue
participant.relation: Editor at Yunnan People's Publishing House

location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (at home, on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Reading and reflection before bed
description: Too excited to sleep after receiving news from the publishing house, she recorded her initial thoughts on her phone about publishing the essay collection. After calming down, she read several pages of Diving into Mountains and Seas until drowsiness came. At 00:15 she put down the book and her phone, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (at home, on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Morning gentle stretching and wound observation.
description: By the bedroom window, in the soft light of a cloudy day, Sun Yuwei did 15 minutes of gentle full-body stretching, especially relaxing her shoulders, back, and leg muscles. Then she carefully examined the scabbed wound on her left calf, dipped a cotton swab in povidone-iodine and gently wiped it, confirmed the wound was dry and free of redness, and applied a thin layer of erythromycin ointment. She wrote in her journal: "The wound is in good condition, a mark from day 23."
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoying a warm breakfast with family
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, prepared hot brown sugar porridge and fried eggs. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, who rarely watched the morning news, asked Sun Yuwei with concern how she felt returning from Fuxian Lake yesterday and urged her to rest. The family chatted happily, and Sun Yuwei secretly looked forward to eating the wild mushrooms her mother would cook today.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidy up the room and prepare to welcome best friends.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei quickly tidied the scattered manuscripts and books on the bedroom desk, returned the sofa cushions to their places, and placed the small stone ornament brought back from Fuxian Lake on a corner of the desk, adjusting her mood for the arrival of her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Best friend's birthday surprise visit and decoration
description: Just after nine, Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi arrived with a handmade osmanthus cream cake, colorful balloons, and handwritten greeting cards. They deftly stuck the balloons onto the bookshelf and window frames, and the originally quiet room was instantly filled with a birthday atmosphere. Chen Sisi mysteriously handed over a gift box, setting the stage for a later surprise.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Unpacking gifts and handwritten blessings
description: The three of them curled up on the soft floor cushions in the bedroom. Sun Yuwei first opened the hardcover copy of Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana that Chen Sisi had given her; on the flyleaf were words of encouragement from her close friends. Zhang Jing gave Sun Yuwei the colored ink she had been asking about for a long time, which made her very happy. The gift, carrying the warmth of handwriting, made Sun Yuwei's eyes well up.
location: On the soft mat in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Balcony picnic-style lunch and journaling time
description: The three of them stayed in, setting the fruit, cold rice noodles, and snacks Mother had prepared on the narrow balcony table and enjoying lunch like a picnic. A gentle afternoon breeze blew as they ate and flipped through their college-era journals, chatting from freshman-year military training photos to the graduation defense, with laughter never stopping. Chen Sisi pointed at last week's Fuxian Lake photo and said, “Weiwei always shines in places like this.”
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Best friend takes leave and says farewell
description: The close friends each had plans for the afternoon: Zhang Jing needed to prepare lessons, and Chen Sisi had to return to the flower shop. The three hugged and said goodbye at the door, agreeing to meet again next time. Sun Yuwei stood at the door watching their figures disappear around the corner of the stairs, her heart full of warmth.
location: In front of home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Alone time: reading a book on flower arrangement and taking a nap
description: After seeing off her best friend, the room became quiet again. Sun Yuwei, holding An Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana, flipped through the first few chapters by the window and was drawn to the artistic mood of "standing flowers". As drowsiness came over her, she gently put the book beside her pillow, drew the curtains, and took a nap of about 40 minutes to ease the fatigue from the previous day's journey.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Practiced flower arranging and helped Mom prepare the meal
description: After her nap, Sun Yuwei felt refreshed. Using a vase and the white lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves her mother had bought, and drawing on insights from a flower arrangement book, she tried trimming and creating a small arrangement. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan peel garlic and wash greens to prepare the ingredients for the birthday dinner, and happily shared the gift Chen Sisi had given her.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family Birthday Dinner: Longevity Noodles and Mushroom Feast
description: Father Sun Mingyuan got off work on time, tied on an apron, and personally cooked longevity noodles, topping them with a poached egg and chopped scallions. Mother Li Xiulan stir-fried fragrant ham with porcini mushrooms, made a cold black fungus salad, and steamed a sea bass. The whole family sat around the table. Father raised his glass to wish Sun Yuwei, on her twenty-third birthday, that her writing would shine and that she would be safe and happy. He also, for once, mentioned his experience of having his submissions rejected in his youth, encouraging her to keep writing.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Unwrapping my sister's gift and sharing with the family.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei couldn't wait to open the package her sister Sun Yuting had sent from Shenzhen. Inside was a hardcover copy of Selected Modern Chinese Essays, with a handwritten letter tucked inside: 'To my most literary little sister, may your pen always be free.' Sun Yuwei read it aloud to her parents, and her mother joked that her older sister was the one who thought of this younger sister the most.
location: Living room sofa at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Birthday journal reflections and thanks.
description: Back in the bedroom, Sun Yuwei used the colored ink that Zhang Jing had given her to record every detail of the day in her journal: the wound from her morning stretch, her best friend's laughter, her father's longevity noodles, her mother's mushrooms, and her sister's book. At the end she wrote down her thoughts: 'A year wrapped in love, moving more firmly toward where my heart leads. The wound has scabbed over, like a special birthday badge.'
location: At the desk in the bedroom of the home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Thank her sister via WeChat.
description: Sun Yuwei sent a voice message to her elder sister Sun Yuting, describing the birthday details and her surprise at receiving the essay collection, and thanking her for remembering her. The two agreed to explore the old streets of Kunming together in August.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Leafing through new books and replying to well-wishes
description: Sun Yuwei opened the new essay collection her sister had given her and flipped through it casually. Moved by the words, she jotted down a few lines of inspiration in her notebook. At the same time, she picked up her phone and briefly replied to the birthday wishes in her WeChat Moments and from friends.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Meditation relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: Sun Yuwei set aside half an hour of quiet time, turned off the lights, played soft meditation music, lay in bed doing breathing exercises, and let the day’s joy and emotion settle. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into comfortable pajamas.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Sun Yuwei, leaning against the headboard, continued reading a few pages of the ikebana book, letting the beautiful words accompany her to sleep. At around 00:30, she turned off the light and slowly fell asleep with a warm and grateful heart.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Morning wake-up and gentle stretching
description: Woke up to the alarm at 6:50; the air outside smelled fresh after the rain. Stayed in bed for 5 minutes scrolling through photos from yesterday's birthday party on my phone. After getting up, I did 15 minutes of gentle stretching on the bedroom floor mat, focusing on the neck, shoulders, and left leg. Checked the wound on my left calf: the scab is dry, the edges are flat, and there is no redness or swelling.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: Mother served the small-pot rice noodles, with broth made from chicken soup simmered last night. While slowly eating breakfast, she sent a message to her photography class group chat: "We're meeting at Jingxing Street Flower and Bird Market at 9 today. I'll bring my mirrorless camera." Mother asked about today's plans, and she excitedly described the camera she had received yesterday and her photography practice plan for today. Mother laughed and said, "With those eyes of yours, you can find beauty all day long." After the meal, she helped her mother clear the dishes.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparation before going out
description: In the study, I checked the camera bag: mirrorless camera, spare batteries, two 32GB memory cards, notebook, and fountain pen. I stuffed "Kunming Street Chronicles" into the bag. After changing the breathable dressing on my left leg wound and confirming it was fine, I put on canvas shoes and a light blue cotton-linen shirt, and slung the canvas bag over my shoulder.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go to Jingxing Street for photography practice
description: Set out from home at 8:20, walking south along Huashan West Road. The road was wet after the rain, and raindrops hung on the plane-tree leaves. Passing Wenmiao Straight Street, she saw a flower shop arranging fresh-cut flowers, and used her phone to photograph the reflections on the road and send them to her friends' group chat. She arrived at the entrance of Jingxing Street market at 8:40 and met up with her photography class group. Under the teacher's guidance, she practiced candid shooting using the scattered light and reflective puddles after the rain. She crouched by a goldfish stall waiting for a fish to leap out of the water, and took burst shots of a stray cat jumping up to catch a flying insect in silhouette, shooting about 200 photos in two hours. After the group disbanded at 11:00, she strolled the market alone for 15 minutes and bought a bunch of lisianthus and two stems of eucalyptus. She walked home at 11:15 and arrived at 11:30.
location: Jingxing Street Flower and Bird Market, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wound dressing change and record.
description: She put the flowers into the vase in the entryway, then returned to the study and unwrapped the gauze on her left leg. The edge of the scab was slightly yellowish, with no discharge. She cleaned it with saline, applied mupirocin ointment, and changed the dressing. In her journal's "Wound Log," she wrote: "July 17: healing well, no redness or swelling. Walked about 7,000 steps today. At yoga class, be careful to avoid stretching the leg at large angles."
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and casual family chat
description: Dad came home for lunch at noon, and Mom made tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and radish pork rib soup. At the dinner table, we scrolled through the photos on the camera, showing a cat catching a bug and the smiling face of a flower-selling girl. Dad praised the lighting and shadows, and Mom said I had loved observing details since I was a child. Laughing, I said I wanted to turn it into an illustrated piece for the supplement of Cultural Vision. After the meal, I helped Mom clear the dishes.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Drowsiness came over me after the meal. I took a one-hour nap covered with a thin blanket on the bean bag in the bedroom, with the air conditioning set to 26°C. From outside the window came the sound of children in the neighborhood laughing as they splashed in puddles. Half asleep, I vaguely thought this could be used in the opening of my next article.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Green Lake Park walk and returning home
description: After a short rest, she recovered her energy and went out for a walk in Green Lake Park. It took six minutes on foot from home to the park's south gate. She walked slowly along the lakeside path; after the rain the lake water was murky, but the lotus flowers were in full bloom with water droplets hanging on the petals. She sat on a bench looking at the lake and wrote in her phone's memo: “After the rain, Green Lake carries the fresh scent of lotus leaves in the wind.” Then she walked back home from the south gate, buying a chilled sour plum drink from a small shop on the way. Once home, she washed her face, changed into yoga clothes, put on a loose cotton-linen shirt, filled her water bottle with warm water, grabbed her yoga mat, and got ready to go to the yoga studio.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the yoga studio, talk before class, and take a restorative class
description: 14:50 left home, walked to Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Line 3 to Dongfeng Square Station, then walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the 4th floor of Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road. Arrived at 15:05, chatted with coach He Lu about yesterday's birthday, told her about the wound on the left leg, and He Lu adjusted the practice sequence to focus on restoration and meditation. At 15:40 began the restorative yoga class: used butterfly pose instead of bound angle pose to avoid stretching the left leg, assisted wall-supported headstand prep and held steady for 10 seconds; core strength improved noticeably, and shoulders, neck, and upper body were stretched and relaxed. After class, used a yoga ball to relax the shoulders and neck, exchanged knee rehabilitation experiences, and agreed to go to a tea set shop on Xinying Road on Saturday afternoon. At 17:10, after class, took the metro back home along the same route, passing Wenlin Street to see bougainvillea petals falling, and arrived home at 17:25.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidying up and flower arranging
description: After arriving home, she took out the lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves bought in the morning, trimmed the roots, and put them back into a vase. She took a photo of the vase and the dusk outside the window with her phone and posted it on Moments with the caption: “After the rain, the quiet look of orange and green.” Then she changed into loungewear.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Father came home from work, and the three of us sat around the table for dinner. Mother made dry-fried green beans, stir-fried river shrimp with chives, and winter melon and pork rib soup. I shared the sense of achievement from steadily holding a headstand in yoga class. Father talked about his unit's new intangible cultural heritage protection project and asked me to help edit the WeChat official account article, and I readily agreed. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preliminary screening of photography materials and helping father edit copy
description: After the meal, I imported the camera memory card into the computer, quickly browsed about 200 photos in Lightroom, marked 16 promising ones — a cat leaping in silhouette, goldfish light spots, a flower seller's smile — and dragged them into the '0717 Jingxing Street' folder for retouching and writing a post. I found time to help my father revise the opening of the WeChat article about the intangible cultural heritage project. He replied, 'This section is well revised, it's vivid.'
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journal keeping and creative exchange
description: Brewed jasmine tea, spread out the journal, wrote a birthday gratitude passage with new ink, and recorded today: on the left side, pasted the ticket from Jingxing Street Market and a small sample print of a cat photo; on the right side, sketched a simple drawing of a headstand pose with a pen. After recording, opened WeChat and sent a message to Song Wen: "I took a batch of photos at the flower-and-bird market today. It reminded me of the 'City Whisper' topic you mentioned last time. I think Jingxing Street suits it well. Shall I send you my first draft on Friday?" Sent Zhang Jing a location link: "Saturday at 2 p.m., at the newly opened 'Empty House Bookstore' on Qianju Street. I've arranged to go to Xinying Road with He Lu first, so I'll be a bit late, but I'll definitely come." At 22:00, closed the journal.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Her elder sister Sun Yutong called via video from Shenzhen. After seeing the vase photo in her Moments, she asked how today went. She showed her the photos on the camera, talked about how the yoga class felt and how the wound was healing, and said she planned to visit a teaware shop with a friend on the weekend. Her sister said, 'You're such an artsy soul, living such a rich life every day.' She refined the route of old streets and alleys her sister wanted to explore when she returned to Kunming in August: from the old bookstore on Wenming Street to the coffee shop on Guanghua Street, then to the flower and bird market on Jingxing Street, joking that she would draw a Kunming-exclusive walking map. After hanging up, she felt warm inside and looked forward to August.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: At 22:45, turned off the light and sat cross-legged on the yoga mat in the bedroom for 15 minutes of breathing meditation, feeling my body: left leg was fine, shoulders and neck were relaxed, mood was calm and content. At 23:00, leaned against the headboard and browsed the birthday gift Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana. Seeing the discussion of negative space in the chapter on new Rikka designs, I jotted a few notes in my notebook, took a photo, and sent it to Song Wen: "This is very similar to the 'textual negative space' we discussed last time." After reading one chapter, closed the book and turned off the light at 00:15, falling asleep with a satisfied aftertaste and anticipation of meeting in August.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and first exploring the balcony
description: Sun Yuwei was naturally awakened by the daylight outside her window. Wearing her nightgown, she walked to the balcony and lightly touched the withered asparagus fern in the pot; the leaves crumbled at her touch. A wave of frustration rose in her heart, but it was soon diluted by the clear blue sky outside and the shimmering light on Green Lake in the distance. Seeing the small daisies blooming on the neighbor’s balcony, she had a bold idea to renovate her own balcony. She turned and went to the bathroom to freshen up. In the mirror, her eyes were still sleepy, but they were already brightening, and she decided that today she would definitely talk to her mother about it.
location: Balcony and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had breakfast with mother and proposed the renovation plan
description: Mother Li Xiulan brought over steaming small-pot rice noodles and freshly baked flower cakes. Sun Yuwei cautiously began, "Mom, those dead asparagus ferns on the balcony are making me feel really heavy. Last night I came across a post about a 'balcony spiritual corner.' How about we transform it today?" Li Xiulan put down her chopsticks, her eyes brightening. "I was just about to say that! Those flower pots should be replaced too. Shall we go to Dounan Flower Market this afternoon to find some new ones?" The mother and daughter hit it off at once and quickly drew up a shopping list: blue plumbago, mint, nutrient soil, a small round rattan-woven table, and two cushions.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Talked with my best friend about rescheduling and sorted out the preparations.
description: Sun Yuwei sent a voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing: "Jingjing, the plan changed today. I've decided to go all out with Mom on a balcony makeover! Let's move our bookstore trip to tomorrow, Saturday. Are you free tomorrow?" Zhang Jing quickly replied: "Haha, the little gardener is on the job! I'm free tomorrow, see you in the afternoon. Don't forget to take some photos of the 'transformation' and send them to me!" After smooth communication, Sun Yuwei changed into an old T-shirt and jeans and cleared out half of the balcony clutter to make space for cleaning.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Deep-cleaned the balcony with her mother.
description: The mother and daughter put on masks and gloves, uprooted the withered asparagus fern and a few unknown plants, poured out the hardened old soil, and moved the empty flowerpots to the faucet to rinse them clean. Sun Yuwei carefully swept dust and soil from every corner of the balcony with a broom, then wiped the floor tiles and the railing in the corner with a wet cloth. Li Xiulan used an old storage box to neatly arrange the assorted vases and gardening tools. The whole balcony was now clean and fresh. The earthy smell on Sun Yuwei's fingertips reminded her of the flower and plant photos she had taken on Jingxing Street yesterday, filling her with even more anticipation.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Simple lunch and plan confirmation.
description: The mother and daughter simply cooked two bowls of sour soup noodles with a poached egg in each. While eating, Sun Yuwei checked the flower market guide again, compared prices of rattan-woven tables and chairs, and decided to buy them at the scene. She changed the dressing on her left leg wound and found that the scab had hardened; the pain was basically gone, and she could move around moderately.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took a taxi to Dounan Flower Market.
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother hailed a ride-hailing car and set out from Cuihu Community, taking the Second Ring Expressway to Chenggong. On the way, Sun Yuwei envisioned what the balcony would look like after the renovation, while her mother browsed flower care tips on her phone. Soft folk music played in the car, and their conversation was relaxed and pleasant.
location: On the way in a ride-hailing car from Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, to Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming

name: Shopping for plants and furniture at Dounan Flower Market
description: At the main hall of Dounan Flower Market, Sun Yuwei carefully picked out a pot of blue plumbago and a pot of mint with thick leaves, thinking it would be convenient for making drinks or tea. Her mother decided on a light wood-toned rattan round table and two matching cushions, which felt smooth and delicate. They also bought a bag of nutrient soil and a small trowel. The two returned home fully loaded.
location: Main hall of Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home from Dounan Flower Market
description: There was some traffic on the way back, but Sun Yuwei didn't feel anxious at all. Looking at the back seat filled with flowers and furniture, she felt a great sense of accomplishment. Her mother dozed against the seat, and Sun Yuwei used her phone to take a few photos of the street scenes of Chenggong outside the window, saving them as writing material.
location: During the ride-hailing trip from Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, to the Cuihu Community home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Transplanting new plants and arranging the reading corner
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei put on gardening gloves, spread clay pebbles and nutrient soil in the bottom of the flowerpots, carefully repotted the blue plumbago and mint, and gently pressed down the soil. Her mother moved the rattan table and chairs to the brightest corner on the east side of the balcony and laid out linen-colored seat cushions. Sun Yuwei washed her hands, placed a brown leather journal and a copy of the essay collection "The Art of Living" on the table, and added a fountain pen — the little reading corner instantly came to life. She took a photo and sent it to Zhang Jing, who exclaimed: "Wow! So beautiful! I'm coming to check it out in person tomorrow!"
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Water with root-setting water and try out the reading corner.
description: After all the new plants were settled in, Sun Yuwei used a spray bottle to carefully water them thoroughly to settle the roots. Water droplets rolled on the petals and leaves, looking especially clear and bright. She picked off a few limp leaves, then gently sat down on the cushion. The sunlight happened to slant in, warm but not harsh. She opened a collection of essays and read a few pages, and the irritation caused by the withered plants completely dissolved. Her mother brought over a plate of washed fragrant pears and looked at her with a smile.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Balcony wrap-up and online work communication
description: Mother went to prepare dinner. Sun Yuwei continued finishing up on the balcony, putting nutrient soil and tools into the storage cabinet, and packing up the dead old soil and branches. Back in the bedroom, she opened her laptop and sent a message to editor Xu Mingyuan: "Teacher Xu, have you read the two newly revised pieces from the essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes' we discussed last time? I feel I've been in good form recently. I'd like to develop a new topic about 'family space and state of mind'—do you think it would work?" Xu Mingyuan quickly replied: "I just finished reading them. A few details can be polished. If you have ideas for the new topic, you can send me an outline first." Sun Yuwei noted it down and felt very good.
location: Balcony and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: Sun Yuwei walked into the kitchen and volunteered to wash the vegetables and rinse the rice. While trimming green peppers, she told her mother about the oddly shaped cacti she had seen at Dounan Flower Market that afternoon. Li Xiulan mentioned that Father Sun Mingyuan's appetite had improved since he recently quit smoking. Sun Yuwei casually picked a few mint leaves from the newly planted balcony pot, washed them, and put them into the freshly brewed chrysanthemum tea.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: The whole family had dinner on the new balcony.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work and was stunned as soon as he entered the balcony: "Wow! Is this a different place? It's completely different!" He sat down in the rattan chair, tapped the tabletop, and praised, "Not bad, tasteful." The family decided to have dinner right on the balcony. A gentle breeze blew with the fragrance of newly planted grass. Sun Mingyuan drank chrysanthemum tea with mint and told stories about a longtime colleague at his workplace retiring. The atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Record feelings in journal and share with older sister
description: After tidying up in the evening, Sun Yuwei returned to her bedroom, took out photos of the balcony before and after the renovation, opened her journal, and carefully wrote down every emotional shift from frustration to satisfaction with a fountain pen. She sent a WeChat message to her older sister Sun Yutong with the comparison photos: 'Sis Tong, look! Mom and I made a masterpiece today! Can we hold book club meetings on the balcony from now on?' Her sister instantly replied with a string of thumbs-up emojis: 'Awesome! When I come back in August, this will be our sisters' afternoon tea base!'
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Conceived a new topic and did a pre-bedtime meditation
description: After receiving the editor's reply, Sun Yuwei sat down at her desk and opened a blank document. Using today's balcony renovation experience as a starting point, she sketched an outline for a series of essays titled "Creating a Spiritual Habitat in Limited Space", and her thoughts gradually became clear. After a quick wash-up, she did 10 minutes of meditation in bed, feeling content and calm. The wound on her left leg was only a bit sore after sitting for a long time, and it improved after she propped it up with a pillow.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Immersive reading before bed and falling asleep.
description: After meditation, Sun Yuwei was not sleepy at all. She picked up An Introduction to the Ikenobo School of Flower Arrangement from the bedside and continued reading from where she had left off. When she read the line, Plants have their own nature; why seek to be plucked by a beauty? she unconsciously thought of the two pots of tender green on the balcony, and felt even more at peace. An hour later, drowsiness came over her. She turned off the light and lay down, savoring the color of the blue plumbago, and fell deeply asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and washing up.
description: At eight in the morning, Sun Yuwei woke from a dream and picked up her phone to check the weather forecast, learning that it would be cloudy turning to thundershowers today. She then got out of bed, went to the bathroom to brush her teeth and wash her face, and weighed herself: 44.1kg. She thought about how her mother always said she was too thin, so she should eat well at the music festival today.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Breakfast and an unexpected invitation
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, had already cooked a bowl of small-pot rice noodles, adding sour pickled vegetables and minced meat. Sun Yuwei sat at the dining table slowly eating breakfast, when her phone kept vibrating. Her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi were frantically sending voice messages in the group chat, using 'graduation madness' as an excuse to invite her to this afternoon's Wubaili Music Festival. She listened to the voice messages while eating the rice noodles, hesitated inwardly, and finally replied with an 'OK'.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Replying to close friend and preparing to go out
description: Leaning against the headboard, Sun Yuwei replied in her best friends' group chat: 'Okay, I'll be there in the afternoon, just don't be too loud.' Then she dug a sun-protection jacket and a light T-shirt out of the wardrobe, picked up noise-cancelling earphones, a planner, colored pens, and a water bottle from the desk, carefully packed them into a canvas bag, and thought she would treat it as a field observation.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Relaxing at home and browsing guides.
description: Sun Yuwei didn't force herself to read or write. She curled up on the living room sofa, opened her phone, and scrolled through music festival venue maps and experience posts shared by fans on social media, silently planning her afternoon activity area—the gently sloping lawn behind the venue.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, made her specialty cold rice noodles and mushroom fried rice. During the meal, Sun Yuwei told her parents that she would go to the music festival with Zhang Jing and Sisi in the afternoon. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, reminded her to stay safe and not be too late, while her mother kept saying she should avoid heatstroke in crowded places. She acknowledged them while eating.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Waiting for best friend and simple stretching.
description: After eating, Sun Yuwei changed into a light T-shirt and jeans, and did a few minutes of simple stretching on the living room floor to ease the muscle soreness left over from yesterday's yoga class. At the same time, she sent a message to Zhang Jing asking where they were, and learned that they had already left and would arrive at the community gate soon.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Meet up with my best friend.
description: Sun Yuwei slung her canvas bag over her shoulder and went downstairs, walking to the gate of the residential complex. Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi were already standing by the roadside, both wearing bright T-shirts and extremely excited. Chen Sisi linked arms with her as soon as she saw her.
location: Main gate of Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Taking a ride to the music festival
description: The three took a ride-hailing car from Huashan West Road in Wuhua District to Huanhu East Road in Guandu District. In the car, Zhang Jing excitedly shared her new phone case and discussed the band they wanted to see in the afternoon; Sun Yuwei put in one earbud to listen to music, leaving the other ear to her best friend's chatter and laughter, quietly watching the streetscape recede outside the window.
location: In a ride-hailing car, from Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China to Huanhu East Road, Guandu District.

name: Arrived at the music festival and entered the venue.
description: After a nearly one-hour drive, the car arrived at Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center by Dianchi Lake. The square was a sea of people, and from the distant stage came deafening music and drumbeats. After passing through the ticket gate, Sun Yuwei told her close friends she wanted to go somewhere less crowded. The two said they understood and agreed to meet up again that evening for Miserable Faith's show.
location: Outer plaza of Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center, Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Journaling and observing on the lawn
description: Sun Yuwei walked alone to a relatively quiet gentle grassy slope behind the venue, spread her sun-protection jacket on the ground and sat down, and put on noise-canceling headphones. She took her journal and pen out of her bag, sketched the outlines of the stage lights in the distance, the vibrant colors on the lawn, and the exaggerated hairstyles around her, and observed this liveliness completely different from her daily life, silently noting vivid details.
location: Lawn area inside the venue, Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center, Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Miserable Faith Concert and 10,000-Person Sing-Along
description: In the evening, the band Miserable Faith took the stage. As the familiar melody began, the whole venue broke into a chorus of ten thousand people. The immense sound wave was hard to completely shut out even with noise-canceling headphones. Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi squeezed out of the crowd and pulled Sun Yuwei to the edge of the crowd. The voices of thousands surged in like a tide. She felt her chest vibrate along with it, and seemed to understand the power of collective emotion, but she still knew in her heart that her own world was elsewhere.
location: In front of the main stage in the inner venue of Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center, Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: End of the music festival and departure.
description: After the last few songs came to an end, it was getting dark. The three of them slowly moved toward the exit with the crowd. Sun Yuwei took out her phone and photographed the stage lights gradually going out in the distance, as a record of this brief 'intrusion.'
location: Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center, East Huanhu Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Street-food dinner.
description: After the show, there were quite a few food stalls outside. The three of them found a stall selling grilled erkuai and stuffed tofu, each bought a portion, and shared a bottle of iced sour plum drink. Standing by the roadside, they ate and chatted about the music festival while enjoying the cool evening breeze from Dianchi Lake, feeling much more relaxed than in the crowd.
location: Night market stall outside the Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center, Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Taking a ride home
description: After eating, the three of them hailed a ride-hailing car to return from Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, to Huashan West Road, Wuhua District. In the car, her two close friends were still enthusiastically discussing, while Sun Yuwei leaned against the window, quietly gazing at the streetlights and traffic rushing past outside, letting the day's bustle gradually settle down.
location: In a ride-hailing car, from Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China, to Huashan West Road, Wuhua District.

name: Returned home and relaxed with a bath
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei greeted her parents and went straight into the bathroom. The warm water washed away the sweat, dust, and the ringing in her ears. She changed into clean, comfortable pajamas and felt refreshed all over.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Diary writing and journal organization
description: Sun Yuwei sat at her quiet desk and turned on the desk lamp. She took the music festival ticket stub and pages covered in sketches out of her canvas bag, carefully used masking tape to stick the ticket stub onto her diary, drew in the blurred silhouettes of the crowd during the evening's massive sing-along beside it, and then wrote in ink: 'This is the edge of my world, but it truly exists. The power of that collective shout was real, and I am even more grateful for the present—back at my quiet desk, hearing the pen tip move across the paper.'
location: Cuihu Community Reading Room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China.

name: Send the selected topic information to the editor.
description: After completing her journal, Sun Yuwei picked up her phone and sent a message to her editor, Xu Mingyuan: ‘Teacher Xu, sorry to disturb you on the weekend. I went to a music festival today and had some new feelings about “the individual and the group” and “noise and stillness”. I think it could make a good new topic. Would you be interested in hearing my ideas? No rush, reply whenever you have time.’
location: Cuihu Community Reading Room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China.

name: Bedtime reading
description: After sending the messages, Sun Yuwei finished washing up, turned off the main light, and left only the bedside lamp on. She picked up 'Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana' and flipped through a few pages. Because she had used up quite a lot of energy during the day, her mind was calm. After reading for half an hour, drowsiness gradually crept in.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Falling asleep
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the bedside lamp, and the room fell into darkness. The sounds of the afternoon seemed to still echo in her ears, but her heart was peaceful, and she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning washing up and family breakfast.
description: I woke up in the early morning to my phone alarm. Outside the window, the rain had just cleared, and the air was humid. I got up and weighed myself, seeing a reading of 44.3 kg. After washing up, I went to the kitchen, where my mother, Li Xiulan, had already prepared millet porridge and steamed buns. The three of us had breakfast together. During the meal, I mentioned my plan to go for a nutrition consultation and to pick out a retirement gift for my father. Father said it didn't need to be expensive, and my mother and I exchanged a knowing look. Breakfast ended in warm conversation.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Kangyuan Nutrition Consultation for the initial visit.
description: After breakfast, I put on a canvas bag containing my notebook and thermos, changed into flat shoes, and walked west from my home in Cuihu Community along Cuihu South Road, through quiet alleys, reaching Kangyuan Nutrition Consultation Studio at No. 106 Guanghua Street in about 5 minutes. At 9 o'clock sharp, a female nutritionist, Dr. Chen, received me. In the consultation room, I described in detail my problems of being underweight, feeling fatigued, and having a poor appetite. Dr. Chen measured my height, weight, and body fat percentage, analyzed my food diary for the past week, gave suggestions to increase high-quality protein and healthy fats and adjust the structure of my three daily meals, and recommended using a body fat scale for daily monitoring. I carefully noted the key points and made an appointment for a comprehensive evaluation at the hospital's nutrition department next time. After the consultation, I felt more confident about improving my health.
location: Kangyuan Nutrition Consulting Studio, No. 106 Guanghua Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Xuanya Four Treasures of the Study Shop to choose a retirement gift.
description: After leaving the consultation center, I walked north along Wenming Street and stepped into the quaint 'Xuanya Four Treasures of the Study' shop. The clerk, Old Zhou, greeted me warmly. I explained that I wanted to choose a gift for my retired father. Old Zhou showed me several Duan inkstones and Huzhou writing brushes. I carefully compared the stone textures and the springiness of the brush tips, and finally chose an antique Duan inkstone, a rosewood brush rest, Huizhou ink sticks, gold-flecked Xuan paper, and a calligraphy copybook of Zhao Mengfu's regular script. Old Zhou wrapped them carefully in a brocade box, and I held the gift box with a warm feeling in my heart.

participant.name: Lao Zhou
participant.relation: Clerk at the calligraphy supply store

location: Xuanya Four Treasures of the Study Shop, No. 49 Wenming Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying mushroom ingredients at Zhuanxin Farmers’ Market, going home to process them, and making a simple meal.
description: After leaving the calligraphy supplies shop, I walked about 25 minutes to Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market at 69 Zhuantang Road. At the familiar mushroom stall, the owner, an older woman, helped me choose jizong mushrooms, porcini mushrooms, and bamboo fungus, and reminded me that the porcini must be stir-fried thoroughly to prevent poisoning. I also bought a free-range chicken, ham, Chinese cabbage, tofu, and vermicelli. Carrying the heavy bags, I walked home. Once home, I first placed the brocade box of the Four Treasures of the Study on the desk, then soaked the mushrooms by type, blanched the chicken and put it in a clay pot, and sliced the ham. My simple lunch was hot porridge with pickled vegetables and a boiled egg, during which I browsed articles and messages on my phone.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and home at 7 Huashan West Road

name: Balcony plant care and rest record.
description: After the meal, she went to the balcony, watered the newly planted blue plumbago and mint, and checked how the new leaves were growing. She dealt with the dead asparagus fern, cutting off the withered branches and loosening the soil. She sat for a while in the rattan chair, enjoying the fresh air after the rain, and took out her notebook to jot down the key points from the morning's nutrition consultation, savoring a moment of peace.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Making mushroom hot pot broth and side dishes by hand
description: In the afternoon, she tied on an apron and carefully scrubbed the rehydrated mushrooms. After blanching the free-range chicken, she put it in a clay pot with water, ginger slices, and Sichuan peppercorns, brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned to low heat and simmered slowly. During that time, she called her mother to confirm the method for briefly frying the boletus mushrooms in oil and how to adjust the broth. After simmering for an hour, the chicken broth turned golden. She added the mushrooms and ham slices to enhance the umami, and the aroma filled the air. After tasting the termite mushrooms and confirming they were fully cooked, she turned off the heat. Then she prepared the side dishes: cut the tofu into cubes, tore the cabbage into pieces, and soaked the vermicelli until soft, neatly arranging them with the other ingredients. In the center of the dining table, she set up the induction cooker and the clay pot, getting everything ready for dinner.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Giving retirement gifts, sharing a mushroom hot pot, and an after-dinner walk
description: Before dinner, I wrote a greeting card with a fountain pen on handmade flower-and-grass paper, thanking my father for supporting my writing and wishing him a picturesque retirement. After my parents came home, I held out the brocade box and solemnly presented the gift. My father was pleasantly surprised; he stroked the Duan inkstone and praised my good taste, while my mother smiled and poured wine. The hot pot was bubbling, and the whole family sat around it enjoying the mushroom soup base. My father praised the seasoning, and during the meal I shared what I had learned from the nutrition consultation, which the whole family supported. After dinner, I changed into comfortable shoes and walked along Cuihu Road and through the community garden to help digestion. The streetlights stretched our shadows. We ran into a stray cat, and I felt grounded and warm inside.
location: Home dining room and roads around the residential area at 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Shared today's experiences with my older sister, who is far away in Shenzhen.
description: After returning from my walk, I sat on the chair in my study and sent a long voice message to my elder sister Sun Yutong, describing the details of the gift prepared for Father and the cozy scene of the hotpot dinner. My sister praised me for becoming more thoughtful, asked to see what Father looked like when he received the gift, and agreed to video chat in detail next time, confirming that the plan to explore Kunming's old streets together in August is still on the schedule.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Writing the first draft of the column 'Family Space and State of Mind'
description: After the chat, I opened my laptop and, drawing on the family scenes I observed at the music festival yesterday and today's feelings from preparing a gift for my father and renovating the balcony, organized the topic "Family Space and State of Mind" suggested by editor Xu Mingyuan. I flipped through interview notes and street photos and began drafting the framework for a column about the changes in Kunming's traditional courtyards and family relationships. I kept stopping to look at the sketches and reflections in my journal, letting my thoughts settle into words until late into the night.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and relaxing with music
description: She closed her computer, took out the newly bought Kuretake Gansai watercolor paints and a blank journal, pasted in photos of the mushroom hot pot she had taken, sketched the outline of a brocade box with a pencil, and wrote down important moments of the day such as the nutrition consultation, gift selection, and family dinner, along with gratitude to her family. Then she put on her earphones, played soothing piano music, leaned back in her chair with her eyes closed, and completed her evening meditation and relaxation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading flower arrangement books and going to bed
description: After washing up, she changed into pajamas and read the chapter on fixing flowers in a vase from Introduction to Ikenobo Flower Arrangement under the desk lamp, then put in a bookmark. She checked tomorrow’s weather and schedule, and set the alarm. After turning off the light, she lay down on the cushion in the study. The side profile of her father stroking his inkstone and the steam from hot pot surfaced in her mind, and she drifted into sleep with gratitude and a sense of creative fulfillment.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: After getting up at 7 a.m., I did 20 minutes of yoga on the balcony, focusing on shoulder openers and side stretches. Then I quickly prepared breakfast of milk, oatmeal, and almonds while reviewing today's task: handling social insurance. After that, I went to the study, took out my ID card, household registration booklet, and bank card, and put them in a document folder, then used the map app on my phone to confirm the location of the Wuhua District Administrative Center. Next, I watered the blue plumbago and mint on the balcony, observed the plants, and took photos. Back in the study, I browsed phone news and social media, changed into a T-shirt, jeans, and canvas shoes, and sent a WeChat message to my older sister Sun Yutong saying I was about to head out. The whole morning was spent preparing calmly, laying a solid foundation for the day's schedule.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Complete social insurance procedures for flexible employment
description: At 8:45, she walked from home to the Wuhua District Administrative Center, walking quietly along Huashan West Road while listening to soft music. At 9:00, she arrived at the service hall, took a number and waited in line, then submitted her ID card, household registration booklet, bank card, and other materials to the counter staff, stating that she wanted to apply, as a flexibly employed person, for the basic old-age insurance and medical insurance for urban workers. Under their guidance, she chose the minimum contribution base, filled out the application form, and set up a bank card auto-debit agreement. After carefully checking the receipt, she tucked it into her notebook. The whole process took about two and a half hours. When it was done, she walked home with a light heart, feeling that she had completed a major life matter.
location: Wuhua District Administrative Center Service Hall, No. 1 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch, journaling, and midday rest
description: After returning home, I found the stir-fried beef and cucumber salad that my mother Li Xiulan had prepared before going to work. After heating them in the microwave, I brewed a cup of mint tea from the balcony. After lunch, I used washi tape to attach the social security payment receipt into my journal, wrote down my reflections with a fountain pen, recording the reassuring feeling of signing up for my first social security at age 22, and drew a seal pattern. After the meal, I rested on the living room sofa for 20 minutes, then shared journal photos and balcony plant photos in the besties group (Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi), chatting casually with friends.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Purchase weight-gain ingredients and tidy the home
description: At 1 p.m., she put on a sun-protective jacket and walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. At the supermarket, she bought chicken breast, avocado, whole-wheat bread, mixed nuts, and whey protein powder according to the nutritionist's list. In the small appliance section, she compared two body fat scales, checked reviews on her phone, and decided not to buy one for now. Then she walked home and, on the way, bought a copy of 'Wenyi Fengshang' at a newsstand. After arriving home, she portioned the ingredients for freezer and room-temperature storage, washed her hands, made lemon water, and sat by the floor-to-ceiling window reading the magazine's essays.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the route there

name: Buying vegetables at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market
description: At 3 p.m., she walked from home to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. At a vegetable stall she bought tender green water spinach, fresh limes, and cherry tomatoes to make a dinner salad. The stall owner, an auntie, warmly gave her two spring onions. Then she walked home, thinking about how to pair the dinner.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focused writing: refining the first draft of the column.
description: She set her phone to silent and continued revising the first draft of her column on her laptop in the study. The theme was the transformation of traditional courtyard houses in Kunming and family relationships. She incorporated her feelings when buying the Four Treasures of the Study for her father, the atmosphere of the whole family gathering for mushroom hotpot the day before yesterday, and the materials she had looked up about old residences around Green Lake, describing the emotional bond between people and space in old courtyards. She kept writing for about an hour and forty minutes, deepening and refining the framework of the first draft.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Balcony rest and evening plant care
description: After closing the computer, I went to the balcony to stretch, checked the plants, removed old leaves from the mint, and then sat in the rattan chair looking out at the cloudy sky and the after-work street scene, zoning out and calming my mind.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing and enjoying a healthy dinner
