description: Alone in the kitchen, I heated up the leftover mushroom soup from yesterday, boiled an egg, stir-fried the water spinach I had bought, and made a salad with lime and cherry tomatoes. Then I ate slowly, enjoying a healthy and satisfying dinner.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with her elder sister Sun Yuting.
description: After the meal, she proactively made a video call to her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen and shared in detail the entire social security application process from today, including the contribution tier she chose and the staff's attitude. Her sister praised her initiative and shared her own experience from back then. The two agreed to have another video call next week to discuss the plan to explore old streets in August.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Immersive reading and evening journaling
description: After hanging up, she returned to the study and finished the day's chapter of Introduction to Ikenobo Flower Arrangement. Then she recorded the day's schedule in her journal, pasted in the body fat scale comparison data she had cut out in the morning, used simple drawings to record the supplies she purchased, and planned tomorrow's work: sending a manuscript outline to editor Xu Mingyuan.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening meditation, washing up, and reading before sleep.
description: Turn off the phone screen, do 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation in the bedroom, focus on breathing and let your thoughts settle. Then wash up and apply a moisturizing mask. After that, lie in bed and continue reading 'Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana', noting key points about the Rikka structure. Set the alarm for 7:10 tomorrow morning, turn off the light, and go to sleep, peacefully ending the day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woken by the 6:20 alarm, 10 minutes earlier than usual. She sat up gently and felt the soft morning light through the curtains. She walked barefoot across the floor to the bathroom to wash up, changed into a light cotton-linen long dress and canvas shoes, then checked the wound on her left calf, finding that the peeling at the edge of the scab was no longer obvious and felt smooth.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Quick breakfast
description: Mom had already gone out to school, leaving on the kitchen table a breakfast covered with an insulated lid—a steaming bowl of rice noodle strips topped with minced meat and chives. She quickly ate the noodles and soup, washed the bowl and chopsticks, and put them back in place. Before leaving, she carefully folded the hand-drawn floral sketch she had finished last night, placed it in the inner pocket of her canvas bag, and checked the canvas tote she planned to bring to the flower market, making sure the scissors and tape were also there.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Dounan Flower Market.
description: Left on time at 6:45 and ordered a ride-hailing car via her phone. The morning rush hour had just begun, but traffic toward Chenggong was not too heavy. Familiar street scenes flashed past the window. She opened the car window, and the morning breeze carried a faint scent of grass into the car. On the way, she opened her journal and quickly reviewed the flower material list and arrangement composition notes from the previous night, silently confirming the color scheme in her mind.
location: Along the route from No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District

name: Selecting materials at the flower market in the early morning
description: Arriving at Dounan Flower Market, the morning market was already bustling with voices. Holding her hand-drawn sketches and list, she wove through the wet aisles. She first spotted blue plumbago covered in dew, bargained with the auntie at the stall, and bought three bundles. Then she chose pure white lisianthus and a few gracefully shaped eucalyptus branches. She squatted in front of the stall and carefully inspected the freshness of the flowers. Meanwhile, she took out her journal and pen, quickly sketched a few lines of flower farmers moving flowers, and recorded a snippet of the bargaining dialogue: "Little girl, do you run a flower shop? You have a good eye!"
location: Main hall of Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip to the yoga studio
description: Returning fully loaded, she got into the ride-hailing car for the trip back with three big bags of flower materials. She carefully placed them on the back seat to avoid crushing the blossoms. During the ride, she replied to the caring messages in her best friends' group chat about handling social security yesterday, and briefly shared her excitement about completing her floral design debut today. Outside the window, the sunlight gradually brightened.
location: Along the route from No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District

name: Flower material pretreatment.
description: Arriving at the yoga studio, she greeted Chen Jie, the studio owner, and went straight to the back workroom. She carefully trimmed excess leaves and branches, removed unnecessary thorns and damaged petals, and cut the flower stems to different heights according to the composition. Then she cut the special floral foam into suitable shapes and soaked it in water mixed with preservative. The worktable gradually became covered with prepared flower materials.
location: Back office of Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flower arrangement and receiving the first design fee.
description: At 11:00 sharp, she carried the flower materials into the hall and began to create. She first confirmed the composition in her mind, then used blue plumbago as the base, outlined soft layers with lisianthus, and used eucalyptus leaves to create naturally cascading, dynamic lines. The whole piece conveyed a clear, cool summer feeling. Several trainees who had just finished their morning class stopped out of curiosity and exclaimed, "So pretty!" At 11:50 the work was finished. The studio owner, Sister Chen, was very satisfied and immediately took cash from the register and handed it to her, saying warmly: "This piece fits our studio's vibe perfectly! Yuwei, I'll have to book you in advance for the autumn festival decorations." She took the weighty design fee, and a sweet sense of recognition and fulfillment welled up inside her. While packing up her tools, she used her phone to take beautiful shots of the piece from multiple angles and photos of herself with it.
location: Lobby of Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walking Home and Sharing Lunch
description: She walked out of the building in a cheerful mood; the early summer sun was already a little scorching. She walked home along Dongfeng West Road through the plane-tree shade by Green Lake. Passing Little Bird Park, she heard birdsong and felt that everything was wonderful. When she got home, she happened to catch the lunch her mother had made after returning from school. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had made her favorite mushroom braised rice with a few light side dishes. At the table, she excitedly shared the whole process of the successful flower arrangement, including the curator's praise and invitation, as well as the design fee. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, rarely showed an approving smile and said, "You earned it yourself; that's real ability." Her mother also repeatedly praised her for having artistic talent since she was young. The family ate together joyfully. After the meal, she took the initiative to clean up the dishes.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sent the outline to the editor and organized the journal.
description: After dinner, she returned to the study, opened her laptop, found the column outline she had drafted a few days earlier among a pile of drafts, marked '7.22 final draft' next to the title, and sent it to editor Xu Mingyuan by email, also notifying him on WeChat. Putting down her phone, she took out the journal she had used at the flower market, carefully completed the sketch of the flower farmer from just now, and wrote down with her fountain pen the key takeaways from today's flower arrangement debut and her plans for future cooperation with the yoga studio.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Light midday rest and equipment preparation
description: After finishing her journal entry, she felt a little tired. She folded the clean yoga clothes she would need for the afternoon yoga class into her sports backpack, and placed a thermos and a towel beside it. Then she leaned back in the recliner in her study and rested with her eyes closed for 25 minutes, with her phone alarm set for 15:10.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Free exploration and community interaction
description: After the lunch break, she regained her energy. She scrolled on her phone for a while, shared photos of today's floral arrangement in the close friends' group chat, and received praise and a barrage of stickers from her friends. After replying to messages, she walked to the newly renovated reading corner on the balcony, picked up Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana, turned to the chapter on color matching, and made a few notes while comparing them with the photos of her work on her phone.
location: Reading corner in the study and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to the yoga studio
description: The 15:10 alarm went off. She changed into her yoga clothes, grabbed her bag, and headed out. It takes less than 10 minutes to walk from home to Dechun Commercial Building. She strolled along slowly, enjoying the afternoon breeze, still savoring the joy her floral arrangement had brought everyone.
location: Along the route from No. 7 Huashan West Road to No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga class and breakthrough
description: Arrived at the yoga studio on time; the afternoon flow yoga class was about to begin. She briefly talked with the instructor He Lu about the recovery of her left leg, and He Lu nodded in understanding. During the class, the instructor led everyone through standing postures. Given her condition, the instructor focused on guiding her through poses such as Warrior I, emphasizing how to stabilize her legs. In the last 15 minutes of the class, He Lu encouraged her to try a headstand against the wall. With He Lu's assistance and protection, she succeeded for the first time in lifting both legs away from the wall, holding herself steadily in the air for 10 seconds before slowly coming down.
location: Large classroom at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Small get-together after yoga class.
description: After the class ended, the two sat down on the tatami in the rest area. He Lu handed her a glass of warm water, and they chatted about fitness gear. “Last time you said you wanted to buy workout shorts. I recently saw some really good quick-dry brands online. Do you want to take a look?” He Lu took out her phone and showed her the styles. Sun Yuwei also shared the joy of her first floral design debut, and the two agreed to go shopping together at Shuncheng Shopping Center tomorrow afternoon.
location: Rest area of Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Return home and prepare dinner
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, she walked home. When she arrived, her mother was already preparing dinner in the kitchen; tonight's dinner would include a clear beef soup that her father loved. She washed her hands and took the initiative to help her mother pick a few scallions and cilantro on the balcony.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and casual chat
description: The family of three had dinner together in a warm atmosphere. She shared the details of her successful headstand that afternoon. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, smiled and said, “It seems both yoga and flower arranging can cultivate one’s mind and body.” Her mother, Li Xiulan, reminded her with concern to stretch well at night so she wouldn’t be sore the next day. After dinner, she cleared the table and helped her mother wash the dishes.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing materials and recording reflections
description: After washing the dishes, she returned to the study. She turned on the computer, imported the photos of today's floral arrangement taken with her phone, selected three with the best light and shadow, made simple brightness adjustments, and saved the originals. Then she opened a new document and began writing a floral design journal entry titled 'Debut: Planting a Patch of Coolness in the Yoga Studio,' recording in detail every step from conception and material selection to the dialogue with the space.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Balcony reading and wound care
description: She spent an hour on a recliner on the balcony reading "Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana" and marked key pages with bookmarks. At 21:00 she went to the bathroom to wash up. Before showering, she carefully examined the wound on her left calf, applied a little of the doctor-prescribed ointment with a cotton swab, then picked up the journal on the nightstand and wrote in the "Wound Observation Notes" section: "July 22, the slight peeling at the edge of the scab has disappeared, the surrounding skin has returned to its normal color, no pain on pressure, healing well."
location: Balcony reading corner and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and bedtime preparation
description: She changed into her pajamas, turned off the light, and sat cross-legged on the bed. She opened the meditation app and played a 10-minute guided breathing meditation. When it ended, she felt completely relaxed in body and mind. Then she got up, went to the living room, poured a glass of warm water, put it on the bedside table, and set the alarm for 7:00 the next morning.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, she picked up a thin essay collection by her pillow, For You, Jerusalem, and flipped through a few pages. At about 22:20, feeling sleepy, she closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell into a deep sleep in the quiet night.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast reading
description: The morning alarm went off; the sky was overcast and last night's rain lingered in the air. I laid out the yoga mat in the bedroom and did 20 minutes of gentle stretching and breathing exercises, feeling my body open up. Afterwards, I had a small-pot rice noodle breakfast with my mother, Li Xiulan, in the dining room, chatting as we ate. After the meal, I flipped through "An Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana," pondering the use of negative space in floral art and how to incorporate it into my prose writing.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Mingyuan Bookstore to focus on writing
description: After packing her laptop, the kraft-paper journal, and *Kunming Local Records*, and grabbing a folding umbrella, she walked from Cuihu Community through the morning paths of Green Lake Park and arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore at 145 Wenlin Street about 15 minutes later. She settled into her usual window seat on the second floor, and the shop owner, Qin Mingyuan, handed her a pack of new Yunnan black tea. She opened her computer and focused on revising the description of Fuxian Lake in the Distant Places section of her essay collection *Notes on Slow Travel*. She incorporated the layered texture of the blue plumbago she had felt during flower arranging the previous day into the prose, using the ripples of the lake as a metaphor for the curves of the flower stems. During the session, a light rain began outside the window; the aroma of tea and books interwove, and her creative writing flowed freely.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 145 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Ran into book friend Yang Xiao at lunch
description: The rain gradually lightened. I closed my laptop and went to Binhu Restaurant at No. 202 Wenlin Street next door for lunch. At the door, I ran into Yang Xiao, a book friend who was on a business trip to Kunming, and we pleasantly shared a table. We ordered small-pot rice noodles and cucumber salad, and ate while chatting about the literary book list she recently edited and the prose I was writing. The mood was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went home to organize the essay draft and take a midday rest
description: After saying goodbye to Yang Xiao, she walked home along Cuihu East Road. The air was crisp after the rain, and the lake surface shimmered; she noted the scene as writing material. Back home, she printed out the Fuxian Lake passage and the previous chapters of the prose manuscript that she had revised in the morning, clipped them together with paper clips, and placed them on the small round table in the balcony reading corner to prepare for showing her sister in the evening. Then she rested in the bedroom for 30 minutes with her eyes closed, and afterward changed into light outdoor clothes and brought her water bottle and eco-friendly shopping bag.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Purchasing sportswear with He Lu at Shuncheng Shopping Mall.
description: After walking about 10 minutes, I arrived at the ground floor of Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, and met my friend He Lu, who was just coming out of the yoga studio. We exchanged a smile and headed to Shuncheng Shopping Mall together. While chatting about yesterday's yoga class and what had been going on, we made a beeline for the sportswear section. He Lu helped me try on a few athletic shorts, comparing the fabric and stretch. In the end, on her suggestion, I chose a pair of dark blue high-stretch shorts, and He Lu also bought a sports tank top for herself.
location: Shuncheng Shopping Mall, No. 11 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Buying fruit at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket
description: After finishing the shopping, I said goodbye to He Lu and walked on to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at 98 Fuchun Street. In the fruit section, I picked out dragon fruit for my mother, blueberries for my father, and an avocado for my own breakfast tomorrow. After checking out, I carried the shopping bags and walked home, putting the fruit into the refrigerator one by one.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped mother prepare dinner and had dinner with parents.
description: I heard the sound of Mother preparing ingredients in the kitchen. After washing my hands, I went in to help. Mother was stir-frying bitter greens; I washed the tomatoes, beat the eggs, and peeled the garlic. Mother and daughter chatted as we worked, sharing the day's writing progress and the new shorts I had bought, and Mother talked about what was new in the neighborhood. Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the whole family sat around the table, enjoying bitter greens soup, tomato scrambled eggs, and steamed bass. I talked in detail about the morning's writing inspiration and the afternoon's shopping experience. Father smiled approvingly and said, 'It is good to have a plan.'
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening break and a video call with her older sister Sun Yutong.
description: After dinner, I helped clear the dishes and chopsticks, then went to the reading corner on the balcony, curled up in the rattan chair in the night breeze, leafed through "Kunming Customs and Scenery", organized my thoughts for chatting with my sister, and kept the printed draft of the essay collection at hand. At 20:00, my sister Sun Yutong called via video right on time. I excitedly held up my phone to show off the newly renovated balcony reading corner and the essay collection draft, and my sister also shared the good news of her promotion to senior product manager. We cheered across the screens, talked about our feelings, and agreed to explore Kunming together when on vacation.
location: Balcony reading corner and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal notes on touching moments.
description: After the call, she felt warm inside. Sitting down at her desk in the study, she opened her leather journal and recorded the evening's moments in colored ink. She drew a small sketch of a WeChat video call interface, noted the date, and circled the good news of her sister's promotion with a highlighter. In her diary, she wrote: "Even through a screen, I can feel the warmth of family. It feels so good to be supported."
location: At the desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep reading, meditation, and going to bed
description: After washing up, changed into pajamas and checked that the wound on my left calf was fine. Leaning against the headboard, I read the chapter on the structure of 'rikka' in 'Introduction to Ikenobo Ikebana' to build theory for the next flower arrangement practice. Then I turned off the light and did 20 minutes of breathing meditation to settle my thoughts. After the meditation, inspiration struck with a prose title about 'rain, flowers, and the bookshelf.' Using a sticky note on the journal cover, I wrote it down in the dark. After confirming I could read it clearly, I lay down peacefully, listening to the insects chirping outside the window, full of anticipation for tomorrow, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation.
description: The alarm went off. Outside the window, the sky was gloomy, and showers were forecast. Sun Yuwei sat cross-legged on the bed doing deep-breathing meditation, then did Cat-Cow pose and neck-and-shoulder stretches. While washing up, she noticed that the dog bite on her left calf had fully healed, leaving only a light pink mark. She changed into a loose cotton-and-linen long skirt and a thin knit cardigan, and put her laptop, printed drafts of her essay collection, a folding umbrella, a power bank, and other items into her canvas bag.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Mother Li Xiulan served steaming hot chicken er si noodles with clear broth. While eating, Sun Yuwei chatted about the fun of looking at Uncle Qin's old photo collection at the bookstore yesterday. Her mother smiled and reminded her to be careful of slippery paths at the wetland park, and stressed that at tomorrow's doctor's appointment she should ask clearly about dietary details, especially whether she can eat ejiao cake.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore and focus on revising the manuscript.
description: Sun Yuwei opened her navy blue folding umbrella and walked about 12 minutes to Mingyuan Bookstore, passing Green Lake Park, where she saw sparrows hopping on the wet grass. After reaching her second-floor seat in the bookstore, she spent ten minutes browsing current affairs news on the Xuexi Qiangguo app, then opened her laptop and the printed draft and immersed herself in revising an essay about the vegetable market, weighing words and trimming flashy metaphors. Around 11:00, Uncle Qin, a fellow book lover, came over with a cup of Pu'er and shared a black-and-white old photograph of the 1985 Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, which gave her new metaphorical inspiration. She gratefully photographed it and saved it to her material library. The whole process lasted until 12:10.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 95 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch at Binhu Hotel and thank Uncle Qin.
description: After packing up her computer, Sun Yuwei went with Uncle Qin to the nearby Binhu Restaurant for lunch, ordering classic small-pot rice noodles and fried potatoes. During the meal, she sincerely thanked Uncle Qin for sharing the old photos and discussed how to capture an authentic street-life atmosphere in her essays. Uncle Qin suggested observing people's expressions and speech details more closely, which made her writing approach clearer.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and midday tidying.
description: She walked home, the road surface reflecting the bright light. After arriving, she saw her mother preparing lessons in the living room. She changed out of her damp shoes, placed a cushion behind her back on the sofa, and closed her eyes to clear her mind for about forty minutes. Then, in the study, she opened her iPad and entered Uncle Qin's old photos and new inspiration for manuscript revisions into the electronic memo for "Slow Travel Notes." Afterwards she sent a voice message to Song Wen, her freelance writer friend in Chengdu, discussing a new column theme that blends the concept of negative space in flower arrangement into modern writing. Song Wen replied with praise: "Great idea, looking forward to the finished piece."
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-yoga preparation and snack
description: She changed into dark blue high-stretch athletic shorts and a white loose T-shirt, and put a towel, water bottle, and black sesame candy into the yoga bag. To avoid low blood sugar, she ate half a banana and a spoonful of peanut butter beforehand.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to the yoga studio, taking a flow yoga class, and exchanging conversation
description: She walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, listening to piano music on her earphones. Upon arrival, guided by instructor He Lu, she moved from Cat-Cow and Downward Dog into core and scapular stabilization exercises to prepare for a headstand. During wall-supported headstand practice, Sun Yuwei held the pose on her own for 12 seconds, and He Lu praised, "Your core really has gotten stronger!" After class, she chatted with He Lu in the rest area, and He Lu suggested taking a hot bath to relax. Sun Yuwei ate a black sesame candy to replenish her energy.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Zhuanxin Farmers Market to shop and walked home.
description: After leaving the yoga studio, I walked to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. At the usual butcher shop I bought pork ribs and asked the stall owner to chop them into pieces. At the vegetable stall I picked iron-stick yams, red dates, and goji berries, and bought half a jin of white erkuai for my father. With a heavy bag of groceries in hand, I walked home through the alleys. It started raining just as I entered the door.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing and having dinner with parents
description: Sun Yuwei changed into loungewear, went into the kitchen to help her mother, peeled and cut Chinese yam into pieces, while her mother cut ribs and blanched them. The two chatted about breakthroughs in yoga class while working. Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the family of three sat around the dining table, enjoying fresh yam and rib soup and garlicky water spinach. She shared her yoga achievements, Dad smiled and nodded, Mom picked the biggest rib for her.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Clinic visit preparations and communication with mother.
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei confirmed her appointment for 10:30 the next morning on her phone in the study. She listed on paper the physical exam report from February, her weight records from the past week, the specific times when she felt fatigued, her recent diet structure, and the questions she wanted to ask the doctor, then put them into a document folder along with her ID card, medical insurance card, and bankbook. She then went to the living room and showed the folder to her mother, explaining in detail the next day's consultation process. Mom urged her to make sure to ask whether donkey-hide gelatin cake is suitable for her, and reminded her to go to bed early tonight.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal time
description: Sun Yuwei sat in the reading chair in her study, opened her paper journal, and used a dark green fountain pen to record the day's experiences: the flow state while revising manuscripts at the bookstore, the sense of achievement from breaking 12 seconds in a headstand, the inspiration from Uncle Qin's old photos, and the warm conversation with her mother in the kitchen. She also stuck a hand-drawn style sticker she had picked up at the Zhuanxin Farmers' Market on the edge of the page.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Before bed, she soaked her feet in hot water, the warm water enveloping her feet and melting away her fatigue. Then she did a ten-minute body scan meditation under the bedside lamp. After that, she picked up her phone to check the route to the Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine for tomorrow and the subway times. Once she confirmed, she set the alarm for 7:30. Then she read a few pages of 'The Night Submarine,' immersed in the world of words. She turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment, surrounded by the scent of lavender.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: Woke up naturally at 7 a.m., did 10 minutes of gentle stretching and deep breathing. Then had a breakfast of tomato and egg ersi with mother Li Xiulan, discussing the day's plans while eating: go to the nutrition department at the Municipal First People's Hospital in the morning, and invite mother to a newly opened tea house in the afternoon. After breakfast, organized the medical visit materials, checked the physical examination report, nutrition consultation records, and question list, and confirmed bringing the medical records.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Walk to the hospital and the nutrition department outpatient clinic
description: Walked from Cuihu Community to Kunming First People's Hospital (main campus), enjoying the street scenery along the way, arriving at 8:54 after about 34 minutes. At 9 o'clock, I consulted the outpatient nutrition department on time, told the attending physician about being underweight and tired, and handed over the physical examination report. The doctor arranged a body composition analysis, which showed low body fat percentage and insufficient muscle mass, and gave a personalized weight-gain plan: ensure adequate eggs, dairy, red meat, and nuts daily, combined with light strength training 3 times a week. I also took out a list of questions to ask about concerns regarding traditional Chinese medicine conditioning and ejiao cake. The doctor recommended nutritional supplementation as the foundation, with TCM as a supplement, and that a comprehensive decision should be made.
location: Kunming First People's Hospital (Main Campus), No. 504 Xunjin Street, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the supermarket to shop and then return.
description: Leaving the hospital, she walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, passing Jinbi Road and Fuchun Street, listening to a podcast on the way, and arrived after about 35.6 minutes. At the supermarket, following the doctor's advice, she bought fresh steak, eggs, walnuts, pure milk, as well as red dates and wolfberries for making yam and pork rib soup. She then walked about 13.2 minutes back to her home in Cuihu Community.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Health plan after returning home, lunch, and afternoon nap
description: After arriving home, she drank water and ate walnuts to replenish her energy. In the study, she went online and ordered a smart body composition scale with same-day delivery. She opened her journal and solemnly wrote the title 'Health Tracking Awakening Plan.' Based on the outpatient notes, she drew a record table and wrote a short-term goal: 'Gain weight healthily to 47 kg and raise body fat percentage to 21% within three months.' Then she went to the kitchen to prepare a weight-gain lunch: she marinated a steak with sea salt and black pepper, pan-seared it to medium, and served it with multigrain rice and blanched broccoli. As she ate, she recalled the doctor's advice. After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes, organized the outpatient records into the health file on her computer, then drew the curtains and took a nap for about 20 minutes.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Body fat scale arrival and first measurement
description: After the lunch break, the doorbell rang and I received a white smart body fat scale delivered the same day. After unboxing, I downloaded the app according to the manual and connected successfully. I stood on it barefoot to measure. The data showed: weight 44.0 kg, body fat percentage 19%, muscle mass insufficient, basal metabolism normal. I resolved to monitor daily and record the results in the health section of my journal.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Going to Lü'e Teahouse for a cozy afternoon tea with her mother
description: After a quick tidy-up, she changed into a simple dress, took her journal, and walked about 4.7 minutes to Green Calyx Teahouse on Wenlin Street. She chose a seat by the window and waited for her mother, ordering osmanthus oolong, rose pu'er, and mushroom snacks. Her mother, Li Xiulan, arrived as promised. Amid the fragrance of tea, they shared the full details of the morning hospital visit and the nutritionist's advice. Her mother also talked about how she had not been prone to gaining weight when she was young, and chatted about family matters and her concern about her elder sister's job. She recorded the warm get-together in her journal and pasted in the teahouse's business card.
location: Lü'e Teahouse, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home with mother along Cuihu Lake
description: After tea, I walked home with my mother along the tree-lined path by Green Lake Park. The air was fresh after the rain and the lake surface glittered. Arm in arm, we discussed the dinner menu and decided to make yam and pork rib soup.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, via Cuihu Park to No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Helped mother prepare the meal and had family dinner.
description: After returning home, she changed clothes, washed her hands, and went to help in the kitchen. Her mother prepared the pork ribs, while she peeled the Chinese yam, cut it into rolling chunks, and rinsed the red dates and goji berries. At dinner, her father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the family sat together enjoying yam and pork rib soup, blanched choy sum, and stir-fried pork with green peppers. Sun Yuwei served soup for her parents and briefly mentioned today's health management plan, which her father supported.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Evening journal recording and review
description: Back in the study, she opened her journal and added her afternoon tea thoughts, detailed body-fat scale data, and the day's food intake records to the 'Health Tracking' section. Reviewing the thread of the day, she felt fulfilled.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Shared progress with my sister on WeChat
description: Sent a WeChat message to elder sister Sun Yutong, who is far away in Shenzhen, sharing the body fat scale data and the nutrition department plan, and took a photo of part of the journal. My sister praised me and shared her own fitness check-in screenshot, confirming her plan to return to Kunming in mid-August.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Soaking feet and meditating to relax
description: Boil hot water, add a mugwort foot bath bag and soak the feet, while doing a 10-minute evening meditation to calm the mind and release the fatigue of the day.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Balcony reading time
description: Changed into pajamas, she went to the reading corner on the balcony, lay on the rattan chair under the desk lamp, and read "The Night Submarine," immersed in the fantastic and gorgeous prose until drowsiness overcame her.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and planning for tomorrow
description: Close the book and go back to the desk. On the next-day page of the journal, write plans such as 'Rabies vaccination (final dose)', 'Organize revision ideas for The Slow Travel Notes', put away the medical card, turn off electronic screens, and set the sleep alarm for 22:30.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: She got into bed and, with her mother's good-night words, fell asleep contentedly, ending this fulfilling, healthy, and warm day.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Community)

name: Morning preparations and breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei got up at 07:00, washed up, and following the checklist she made last night, packed her DSLR camera, spare batteries, cleaning cloth, and a small shorthand notebook into her canvas bag. Then at 07:40 she had breakfast with her mother Li Xiulan. On the table were chicken soup rice noodles, plain milk, and boiled eggs. Her mother peeled an egg for her and encouraged her to stick to the weight-gain plan. Sun Yuwei drank the milk and felt reassured.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Cycling to and participating in the photography course graduation practice
description: Sun Yuwei set off from home on a shared bike and headed for the old street area on Yongdao Street, arriving just as the light was soft. Starting at 08:20, she, together with Teacher Gao from the photography course and about eight classmates, went deep into the old street for the graduation practice 'A Day in Old Kunming'. She crouched by a grilled erkuai stall to capture steam and halos, earning the teacher's praise. She independently completed 20 sets of framing and, at the end of the activity, received her completion certificate from Teacher Gao.
location: Yongdao Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (under the century-old camphor tree at the street entrance)

name: On the way home, bought magazines; had lunch and a midday rest.
description: After the photography class ended at 11:20, Sun Yuwei walked home. On the way, she detoured to a newsstand at the intersection of Huashan West Road and Renmin Middle Road and bought the July issue of the monthly magazine Prose. She arrived home at 11:50 and had lunch with her parents, Sun Mingyuan and Li Xiulan. The table had stir-fried beef and mixed-grain rice. She showed her parents her photography works and received their approval. After lunch, Sun Yuwei stood on the balcony to aid digestion, browsed the magazine's table of contents, and replied to her best friend Zhang Jing's message, agreeing to buy fresh matsutake mushrooms for her on Sunday.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (via the newsstand on Renmin Middle Road)

name: Make an exercise plan and take a nap
description: Sun Yuwei used her computer in the study to make a workout plan for the next week, including a brisk walk around Green Lake on Monday and a yoga sequence on Wednesday. She marked it with green and purple highlighters, printed it on A4 paper, and posted it on the wall by her desk. Then she set an alarm and took a 30-minute nap in the bedroom to regain energy.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Afternoon artistic time: organizing photographs, journals, and reading
description: Sun Yuwei brewed a cup of raw Pu-erh tea, imported the morning's photos into her computer in the study, selected 6, and saved them to the folder 'Light and Prose of Kunming.' She then recorded her photography reflections in her journal with a light brown pen, thinking of Wang Zengqi's lines about Kunming. Later, she opened the monthly magazine Prose and read an article about the alleys of a small southern town. Touched by the line 'The moss in the cracks of the bluestone slabs is the fingerprint of time,' she wrote 'The Texture of Time' on a sticky note and tucked it into the printed draft of Slow Travel Notes, ready to incorporate it into her revisions.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Tending flowers and plants with Mom
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan tended the plants together on the balcony. Her mother repotted the jasmine, while Sun Yuwei adjusted the angle of the areca palm flower arrangement she had finished last week to better match the evening sunlight and shadows. Her mother praised her for making progress in flower arranging, and the two chatted about everyday matters.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family dinner
description: At dinner, there was an extra dish of spinach mixed with walnuts on the table, and Sun Yuwei ate a lot. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, looked at her photography works again and praised the composition. This was the third meal of the day in her weight-gain diet.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening yoga and health data recording
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei went back to her bedroom, changed into yoga clothes, and lit an aromatherapy candle. She first did some simple stretches and Cat-Cow pose to aid digestion. At 18:30, following the audio guidance, she did a 30-minute core flow yoga session, including Mountain pose, a bent-knee Downward Dog variation, Plank pose, and the Warrior series, finishing with 2 minutes in Child's pose. After yoga, she stepped barefoot onto the body fat scale and recorded the data: weight 44.2 kg, body fat percentage 18.7%. She also logged the day's food intake of about 2,200 kcal in the health app on her phone, checked off the exercise log in her journal, and wrote an encouraging note to herself.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Shared via video call with my best friend Zhang Jing.
description: Sun Yuwei brewed rose tea, video-called her best friend Zhang Jing, shared her photography course certificate and proud works, and Zhang Jing shared funny stories from school. Sun Yuwei invited Zhang Jing to attend a Vinyasa flow yoga class at Zhongmou Yoga Studio next Wednesday, and agreed to buy porcini mushrooms for her at Zhuanxin Market the next day.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Reading 'The Submarine at Night'.
description: After hanging up the video call, Sun Yuwei continued reading 'The Cloud-Cutting Record' from 'The Night Submarine.' Drawn by the book's imagination and the charm of its language, she copied down a brilliant metaphor and immersed herself in the tranquility of reading.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Bedtime preparation: meditation, planning for tomorrow, washing up, and reading before bed
description: Sun Yuwei first did 10 minutes of meditation, focusing on her breath. After finishing, she wrote down her to-do list for the next day: go to Zhuanxin Market with her mother to buy mushrooms, bring a canvas bag and cash, sort out the revised draft of "Slow Travel Notes," and remind herself to get the rabies vaccine on July 29. Then she did 5 minutes of child's pose and legs-up-the-wall pose in the bedroom, went to the bathroom to wash up, and changed into pajamas. At 10:10 p.m., she leaned against the headboard and read "The Submarine at Night" for 10 minutes until her eyelids grew heavy, then turned off the light and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning wake-up, meditation, and breakfast
description: On Sunday morning, Sun Yuwei woke up naturally without an alarm and noticed that a light rain had fallen outside, leaving the air especially fresh. She sat cross-legged on the bed, opened her meditation app, and did 10 minutes of mindful breathing, letting her thoughts settle from last night's dreams, and felt her mood gradually calm down. Afterward, she went to the dining room and had breakfast with her mother, Li Xiulan, enjoying mushroom rice noodles and hot milk. During the meal, she told her mother about her plans for the day: contacting her best friend Zhang Jing to ask about insurance, going to Zhuanxin Market to buy dried porcini mushrooms for a classmate, and going to Decathlon in the afternoon to buy brisk-walking gear. Her mother reminded her that it might rain in the afternoon and told her to bring an umbrella.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Consulted my close friend and completed the accident insurance application.
description: At her desk in the study, Sun Yuwei contacted her best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat voice call to ask about accident insurance. Zhang Jing, a primary school teacher, patiently shared the insurance products she had purchased and explained in detail key points such as the deductible and reimbursement ratio. After about half an hour on the call, Sun Yuwei compared several products on her computer and, taking Zhang Jing’s advice into account, chose a comprehensive accident insurance plan with an annual premium of 496 yuan, covering accident medical care and hospitalization allowance. After carefully reading the terms, she completed the online payment. When she received the electronic policy, she saved it to her “Important Documents” folder and sent a screenshot to Zhang Jing with a message of thanks.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walked to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market to buy mushrooms
description: Sun Yuwei changed into a comfortable cotton-linen dress, put on a canvas bag, and walked about 15 minutes from home to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. The market was buzzing with people. She found her usual mushroom stall, and the auntie vendor greeted her warmly. She picked out half a jin of good-looking dried porcini mushrooms for her friend, and also bought a small bag of fresh black porcini for herself, planning to have her mother cook them in the evening. She took photos of the mushrooms with her phone and sent them to a friend far away, who replied with a "drooling" sticker.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned from shopping and helped mother prepare lunch.
description: Sun Yuwei returned home carrying the mushrooms. She sealed the dried porcini mushrooms and put them in the storage cabinet, and placed the fresh mushrooms in the draining basket. She briefly noted down the purchases in her journal and prepared the electronic scale to weigh herself later. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan peel potatoes and trim vegetables, chatting as they worked. Her mother smiled and said that tonight she would make fried rice with the fresh black porcini mushrooms.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Lunch was simple tomato and egg noodles with pickled cucumbers made by her mother. The family of three sat around the dining table, and her father asked about Sun Yuwei's morning plans. She shared her experience of buying insurance. Her father nodded and praised her for having risk awareness, while also encouraging her to exercise more, saying that a healthy body is the greatest insurance. Sun Yuwei smiled in agreement and served her father some food.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and reading.
description: Drowsiness hit after the meal. Sun Yuwei leaned back on the living room sofa and picked up the Prose monthly she had brought back from Zhibushi Bookstore the day before. She turned to an article about a rainy alley in a small Jiangnan town. The writing was delicate and gentle, perfectly matching the post-rain scene outside the window, drawing her in and softening her heart.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Decathlon to pick out sports gear, then go home and wash it.
description: Sun Yuwei wrote a shopping list in her journal: cushioned running shoes, quick-dry athletic top and pants, and a sports water bottle. Then she carried her shoulder bag and left. She took Bus No. 1 for about 20 minutes to Decathlon on Cuihu South Road. Inside the store, she went straight to the running shoe area and told the male sales associate that she wanted a pair of cushioned running shoes suitable for brisk walking. The associate recommended several pairs; she tried on three and tested the feel on the store's treadmill, finally choosing a pair in a light gray and mint green colorway. She also matched them with a quick-dry T-shirt and slim-fit athletic pants in the same color family, along with a lightweight sports water bottle. After paying with Alipay, she took the bus home, immediately put the new clothes into the washing machine on a gentle cycle, wiped the running shoes with a damp cloth, and hung them together on the balcony to air dry.
location: Decathlon (Cuihu Store), No. 27 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sorting out the final project for the photography course
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the study, imported the photos she had taken on Yongdao Street the day before, themed "A Day in Old Kunming," from the camera memory card to the computer, and filed them in the "2025 Photography Course Graduation Work" folder. As she browsed them, she recalled the scenes from when she took them and shortlisted about 50 photos with pleasing composition and lighting. She planned to do post-processing in Lightroom later, gathering material for her personal content account "Yuwei's Slow Notes."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pilates class and buying groceries afterward
description: Sun Yuwei changed into her yoga clothes, walked 15 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, and took Instructor He Lu's one-hour advanced core Pilates class. Accompanied by soothing music and the teacher's steady cues, she focused on core engagement and breathing rhythm. Although her clothes were soaked with sweat, she felt that the lower back soreness from long hours at the desk had clearly eased and her posture was straighter. After class, she walked home relaxed. Passing the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street, she remembered that her mother had mentioned wanting to make a bitter melon salad, so she went in and bought a cucumber, a box of cherry tomatoes, and a dragon fruit as a snack.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Assist with dinner, weigh food, and share dinner with family.
description: Sun Yuwei returned home and helped her mother Li Xiulan prepare dinner. The kitchen was filled with the rich aroma of fried rice with black porcini mushrooms. Before the meal, she stepped on the scale, and the electronic screen showed 44.3 kg—the same as yesterday. She breathed a sigh of relief. During dinner, the family of three enjoyed porcini mushroom fried rice, cucumber salad, and tomato and egg drop soup while chatting happily. Her father asked about photography books, and Sun Yuwei recommended The Photography Book. Her father said he would go to the bookstore on the weekend. Her mother asked about the comfort of her new sports shoes, and Sun Yuwei smiled and said they were very comfortable, planning to break them in at Green Lake that evening.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rest after the meal, get ready, and do the first speed-walking check-in at Green Lake Park.
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei voluntarily cleared the dishes, then returned to the bedroom. The new athletic clothes and running shoes on the balcony had dried. She changed into the mint-green quick-dry set and running shoes with a faint fragrance, and checked the brisk-walking route on her phone's fitness app and the check-in rules of the WeChat fitness supervision group. As darkness fell, she put on earphones, entered the park from Green Lake's south gate, walked along the west bank greenway, detoured past Nine-Bend Bridge, and completed 2.5 kilometers of brisk walking to cheerful music at a pace of 8:10 per kilometer. She shared photos of Green Lake's night scene in the 'Yuwei Self-Discipline Growth' WeChat group and checked in to record this fulfilling day.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Bathing, changing clothes, and skincare
description: After getting home, Sun Yuwei took a warm shower to rinse off the sweat, then changed into loose loungewear. She then did a simple facial spa, applied a face mask, and used the mask time to tidy her desk.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Digital painting practice, creative reflection, and journal review
description: After finishing her face mask, Sun Yuwei sat down at her desk, opened her iPad, connected the graphics tablet, and continued her digital drawing practice, attempting to copy a summer lotus pond landscape photo. But after a few strokes, she felt that the layers were jumbled and the color transitions unnatural, and she could not achieve the desired effect. She paused and reflected in her journal: “A bottleneck is not the end; it is a signpost for turning.” She decided to temporarily set aside her illustrator goal and start with lighter watercolor stickers, then reassess after three months. Afterward, she drew a simple line-art plant sticker in Procreate and found it much smoother. Then she opened her journal, wrote down the day's routine in pen, and highlighted representative events with a highlighter: “accident insurance successfully purchased,” “new Decathlon gear acquired,” and “first brisk walk around Cuihu.” In the diary section, she wrote about her reflections on creative bottlenecks and also noted today's weight of 44.3 kg and a small discovery from daily life: the auntie selling mushrooms at Zhuanxin Market was wearing a beautiful blue dress today.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Soaking feet, reading, and preparing for bed
description: Sun Yuwei filled a bucket with hot water, added lavender essential oil and a foot bath ball, and continued reading the issue of Prose Monthly that she hadn't finished in the afternoon while soaking her feet. The article describing the rainy alleys of Jiangnan ended with the line, We are all passersby in the rainy alley, and there is always someone waiting for you under the eaves. It made her feel very tender inside. After finishing the foot soak, she closed the book, turned off the light, and got into bed. Recalling the fulfilling day that began with morning meditation and ended with an evening brisk walk, she felt a solid sense of contentment. Silently reminding herself that she needed to get up early on Monday for an early class, she soon fell asleep to the sound of fine insects chirping outside the window.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga, breakfast, and getting ready.
description: In the early morning, she did yoga stretches on the home balcony, focusing on relieving muscle soreness from the previous day's brisk walk, with the sound of wind outside the window and deep breathing. Then she washed up in the bathroom, used the body fat scale, and her weight was stable at 44.4 kg. In the dining room, she enjoyed the warm soy milk and two flower cakes her mother had prepared for breakfast while browsing followed sticker accounts on her phone for journaling inspiration.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Ride a shared bike to Mingyuan Bookstore and tidy up the workstation.
description: Starting from home, I rode a shared bicycle along Huashan West Road, passing through the quiet outskirts of Cuihu Park in the early morning, and headed to Mingyuan Book House (Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore) on Cuihu North Road. After arriving, I greeted Boss Qin, who was arranging new books, then went to my usual seat in the corner on the second floor, put down my canvas bag, opened my laptop, and brewed a cup of green tea for myself, preparing for the writing ahead.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: At the book house, focused on revising the preface to the essay collection, with tea break conversation
description: At her workstation on the second floor of Mingyuan Bookstore, she made narrative adjustments to the preface of the essay collection "Slow Travel Notes". She deleted some serious theoretical explanations, recalled small touching moments in life, and rewrote the preface in a more intimate and heartbeat-tinged language. During the process, she referred to "Spring City" magazine and illustrated-style notes for essay inspiration. When she went downstairs to refill water at 10:30, she chatted with Boss Qin about slow living and journal creation. Boss Qin suggested that if she ever published a journal collection in the future, she could try making it a co-branded edition with a bookstore, and this suggestion made her happy. After that, she returned to her workstation and continued optimizing the preface structure, linking the beginning and ending with descriptions of the morning scenery at Green Lake, making the essay more vivid and complete. The whole writing state was relaxed and smooth.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cycled home, picked up the package, and had lunch with her father.
description: After packing up her things, she cycled away from the bookstore and headed home. Along the way, she picked up a set of printable sticker paper and a pair of craft scissors at the Cainiao pickup station at the entrance of the residential community, which made the afternoon's creative work even more anticipated. When she got home, she had lunch with her retired father, who had warmed up the meal (her mother was not home at noon). While eating and chatting, she excitedly shared with her father the progress of her writing at the book house and the novelty of her first brisk walk yesterday. Her father lovingly reminded her to take care of her knees and shared his own experience of morning jogging when he was young. The family lunch was warm.
location: Cainiao Station near Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the dining room at home

name: During the midday break, flipping through journaling materials
description: Instead of taking a nap, she sat on the bay window in the bedroom, spread out the newly bought sticker paper, craft scissors, and yesterday's copy of Spring City magazine, selected photos with city streetscapes from the magazine, and thought about how to match them with the camellias she would paint in the afternoon, gathering inspiration for her journal creation.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Afternoon sticker creation and tea-break reading.
description: In the study, she used the Procreate app on her iPad to design stickers. Based on the camellia sketch she drew last night, she carefully outlined the contours, adjusted the petal curves, and added leaves, saving four different color schemes. During the process, she felt no anxiety, only a relaxed sense of play. Midway, she stood up to stretch her wrists and drink water. At 4:30 p.m., she went to the living room sofa to rest, brewed a cup of rose tea, and read the article about Zhuanxin Farmers' Market in the "Kunming Streets and Alleys" column of Spring City magazine. Its delicate descriptions and human warmth resonated with her and also inspired her writing. After the break, she returned to the study, printed the designed camellia as a black-and-white line drawing on newly purchased sticker paper, cut it out, and stuck it in her journal. Looking at the physical result, she felt very satisfied and planned to use the flower as the cover of the first page of her journal.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family dinner and an affectionate phone call
description: Mother came home from work and prepared dinner: stir-fried bitter melon, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stewed pork rib soup. At the table, Yuwei shared the smooth progress of her afternoon sticker creation with her parents. The whole family was happy, and her mother also told funny stories about her students. After dinner, she had a brief video call in the living room with her older sister, who was far away in Shenzhen. After seeing the photos of the camellia stickers, her sister found them very cute and encouraged her to keep creating.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening walk on Cuihu East Road
description: Put on sneakers and went out alone for a walk along Cuihu East Road. Instead of walking fast, I relaxed my body and mind at an easy pace, and as I walked, I mentally drafted the content to post later when creating the group chat with He Lu and Zhang Jing, including the group name "Exercise Flower Supervision Team" and the specific check-in rules, to make sure my thoughts were clear.
location: Cuihu East Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Listening to music and personal leisure time
description: After returning home and washing her face, she played soft classical music in the bedroom. She scrolled through the camellia sticker photos taken in the afternoon on her phone and chose the one she liked best. Then she browsed a few journaling bloggers' Xiaohongshu posts for inspiration, but restrained herself from continuing to scroll so as not to get distracted.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Create a brisk walking accountability group.
description: At the appointed time, she created a WeChat group named 'Exercise Flower Supervision Group' and added He Lu and Zhang Jing. As the initiator, she posted a detailed announcement: every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, each person should complete at least 30 minutes of brisk walking and share a route screenshot; after each yoga class, share feelings in the group via text; He Lu, as the teacher, would provide professional comments and encouragement on the exercise notes. He Lu soon replied 'Got it' with a clenched-fist emoji. Zhang Jing also expressed support and suggested a weekly group summary every Sunday evening. The group chat was lively, marking the official launch of the exercise supervision plan.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Organize the day's journal notes.
description: At the desk in the study, she recorded today's "inner journey" in her journal and pasted in printed camellia stickers and a photo of the sunset she had taken. She wrote "Today's keywords: letting go and beginning," and recorded the day's major breakthroughs: letting go of the anxiety about digital painting and starting sticker creation, as well as successfully setting up an exercise supervision group. This gave her a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: She went through her usual evening wash-up routine. Because she was in a good mood, she took more care with her skincare than usual, and smiled at herself in the mirror while applying the products.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, she continued reading the "Kunming Flavors" column in Spring City magazine. The description of rice noodles with pea porridge was mouthwatering, so she decided to go to a long-established shop near her home the next morning. After reading, she got out of bed, took out the T-shirt and loose trousers she would wear the next day from the wardrobe, and placed them on the chair. She turned off the bedside lamp and, in the darkness, reflected on the relaxed shift from "obsession" to "ease" during the day, soon falling asleep.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Waking up early, morning stretching, and enjoying a breakfast of rice noodles with pea flour soup.
description: After being woken by the alarm, I did some simple stretches in bed to wake up my body, weighed myself at 44.5 kg, and recorded it in my food diary. After washing up, I changed into a comfortable cotton-linen dress, listened to the podcast 'Left and Right' playing on my MP3, and strolled leisurely along Huashan West Road and Wenlin Street to Duanshi Small Pot Restaurant. I ordered a bowl of rice noodles with pea porridge, watched the owner pour the steaming pea porridge over the noodles, and sprinkle on crispy pork cracklings, crushed peanuts, and chopped scallions. I savored it slowly with a cup of freshly ground soy milk, feeling warm inside and out.
location: Duanshi Xiaoguo (Wenlin Street Branch), No. 74 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the Third Municipal Hospital for the fifth rabies vaccine dose.
description: From the breakfast shop, she walked to the bus stop at Baihui Mall and took Bus No. 1 to Wujingqiao Station. On the way, she used her phone to book a medical appointment on the Yunnan Health Code mini-program. After arriving at Kunming Third People’s Hospital, she took a number at the adult vaccination clinic and waited. She then entered the vaccination room, where the doctor verified her information and gave her the final rabies vaccine injection in her left upper arm. The doctor told her the full vaccination course was complete, effective antibodies had been produced, and the wound had healed well. She let out a long sigh of relief and carefully put away the vaccination record.
location: Outpatient Department of Kunming Third People's Hospital, No. 319 Wujing Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bought flowers and took a ride back to Cuihu Community
description: After leaving the hospital feeling light and at ease, I decided to walk part of the way. Passing by Chajie Flower Market, I bought a large bunch of chamomile kept in water and a few eucalyptus branches, spending 28 yuan in total. Holding the bouquet made me feel especially cheerful. Then I took Bus No. 1 from Wujing Bridge Station, got off at Huashan West Road Station, and walked back home to Cuihu Community.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Arranging flowers at home and preparing and enjoying a weight-gain lunch
description: After getting home, she first trimmed and arranged the chamomile and eucalyptus leaves, placing them in a glass vase on the living room desk in a pleasingly staggered arrangement. Then she started preparing lunch ingredients: marinating chicken breast with salt and black pepper, and soaking quinoa in water. Then she pan-fried the chicken breast in olive oil until golden brown on both sides, and served it with cooked quinoa, lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber slices, drizzled with vinaigrette. She poured a cup of sugar-free yogurt and grabbed a small handful of walnuts. While eating, she recorded the nutritional data in her diet log app and confirmed that her calorie intake for the day met the target.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Resting in bed at noon and reading magazines
description: After clearing away the dishes, she rested in bed for half an hour. She picked up the Spring City magazine from the bedside and continued reading the article about Kunming's old streets that she hadn't finished, using it to help digestion and relax.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: She slung her canvas bag over her shoulder, packed her laptop and journal, and walked to Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. Along the way, sunlight cast mottled shadows through the plane trees, and she felt very pleasant.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: At Zhibushi Bookstore, wrote the author's preface for the essay collection and adjusted the camellia stickers.
description: After arriving at the shop, she greeted Boss Qin, ordered her usual Dianhong tea, and sat down at her familiar seat on the second floor. She opened her laptop and began writing the preface to her essay collection, "Confessions of a Slow Walker," using the renovation of her balcony as a starting point to explore the essence of slow living. Boss Qin brought over a small plate of homemade mung bean cakes midway, and the two had a brief exchange. The writing went smoothly, and she basically finished the first draft of the preface. Then she took a break with some tea, took out her tablet, opened Procreate, and fine-tuned the details of a set of camellia stickers she had drawn yesterday. Satisfied, she closed the app.
location: Window-side seat on the second floor of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rode a shared bike to Zhongmou Yoga Studio
description: After packing up and saying goodbye to Boss Qin, she scanned a shared bicycle at the bookstore entrance and rode along Cuihu West Road toward Dongfeng West Road to Zhongmou Yoga Studio.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attended a large yoga class and completed a headstand independently for the first time.
description: After arriving at the yoga studio, she smiled and greeted instructor He Lu, used the fingerprint lock to open the locker, and changed into her own yoga clothes. In class, the instructor deliberately guided everyone through headstand practice; because her wound had fully healed, she was allowed to try the full sequence today. With He Lu’s encouragement and assistance, she successfully left the wall for the first time, engaged her core, slowly lifted her legs upward, and held the pose independently for 15 seconds. When she came back down into Child’s pose, He Lu led the applause for her. She herself felt her legs trembling slightly, but her heart was full of a huge sense of accomplishment. After class, she shared the breakthrough with the instructor, who suggested she try to hold for 5 more seconds next time.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home to rest, bought an iced Americano, and prepared dinner with her mother.
description: After class, she walked home and bought an iced Americano along the way as a reward for herself. Once home, she washed her face, changed into loungewear, and collapsed on the sofa for a while looking at her phone. Her mother, Li Xiulan, returned from work and was preparing dinner in the kitchen. She enthusiastically went to help, washing vegetables and cutting tomatoes while excitedly sharing the joy of her headstand breakthrough in yoga class. Her mother smiled and praised her for being diligent.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan also returned home, and the family sat together enjoying the tomato and egg noodles made by her mother, which were light and delicious. At the dinner table, she shared with her father the progress on today's vaccination and the preface writing; her father nodded calmly and said that was good.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Set off for the south gate of Green Lake Park.
description: After checking the weather forecast on her phone and confirming it wouldn't rain, she changed into her athletic shoes, took her sports watch, MP3 player, and portable water bottle, and walked out to the south gate of Cuihu Park.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Briskly walk 3 km around Cuihu Lake.
description: I did the brisk walk as planned, taking the outer loop route around Green Lake. I turned on my sports watch to record the route and pace and listened to the episode of the podcast Now Left, Now Right about the Yunnan horse caravans. I kept a pace of about 7:30 per kilometer, with a light sweat and smooth breathing. Afterward, I did some simple stretching by the lake to relax.
location: Cuihu Park Lakeside Trail, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening wash-up, journaling, and exercise group check-in
description: After getting home, I took a shower and changed into pajamas right away. Then I sat at my desk, took out today's journal, pasted the printed camellia stickers and photos of the chamomile bouquet onto the journal pages, and recorded today's weight, diet, exercise, and how I felt about my breakthrough at the yoga studio. Afterward, I opened the 'WeChat Sports Flower Supervision Team' group on WeChat, posted a screenshot of my brisk-walking route and a headstand photo to check in, with a message expressing my joy over the breakthrough. He Lu replied instantly, praising my steady pace and improved core strength, and Zhang Jing also sent a thumbs-up emoji.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Video call with her elder sister Sun Yuting.
description: A video call request from her elder sister Sun Yutong popped up, and the two sisters chatted for nearly an hour. Yuwei shared the relief of getting vaccinated, her breakthrough in yoga headstand, and the fragrance of chamomile flowers, while Yutong talked about some amusing moments from her new project in Shenzhen and the night view outside her window.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening magazine reading and note-taking
description: After saying goodbye to my sister, I leaned against the headboard and continued reading the article about the old street in the magazine Spring City, making small pencil notes on the pages where I found it interesting.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After reading the magazine, she went to the bathroom and did her skincare routine. She picked up the sticky note on the bedside table reminding her to change the dressing, smiled at the words '5th injection' written on it, tore it up, and threw it into the trash can.
