She turned off the main light and left only the night light on. Lying in bed, she briefly reviewed the full day, and fell peacefully asleep with a sense of contentment and slight tiredness.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning wake-up and body conditioning.
description: At 6:50, I was woken by the patter of rain outside the window, feeling relieved because the wound had healed. Wearing long-sleeved yoga clothes, I first moved the mint leaves on the balcony to a place where they could get rain, then spread out the yoga mat and completed a 45-minute yin yoga sequence to the sound of the rain, focusing on opening the hips and relaxing the shoulders. Afterward, I stepped on the body fat scale: 44.5 kg, body fat 18.9%. I recorded the data in my health tracking journal and drew a small upward arrow beside it.
location: Bedroom and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Customized breakfast and daily preparations.
description: Following the weight-gain plan, she made a bowl of deluxe milk oatmeal: a base of oats and milk, with an extra poached egg and a handful of nuts sprinkled on top. She left a note on the refrigerator magnet: 'Egg added to breakfast, weight gain in progress.' After breakfast, she quickly washed up, changed into a comfortable cotton-linen shirt and jeans, and slung on a canvas tote bag containing her laptop and books.
location: Home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan: kitchen and dining room.

name: Morning market shopping and heading to the bookstore
description: She took a folding umbrella and went out. The rain gradually let up. She walked to the morning market on Wenlin Street near her home, went straight to the fruit stall, picked a box of fresh, plump blueberries, and added a bag of figs. After buying the fruit, she strolled leisurely to Zhibushi Bookstore. As she pushed the door open, the crisp sound of a bell rang out; the owner, Uncle Qin, was sitting behind the counter sorting old books.
location: From the morning market on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road

name: Deep creative writing and proofreading
description: At the window seat on the second floor of the bookstore, I finalized the essay 'The Cobbler at the Alley Entrance.' I opened my laptop and first carefully went through several old photos of 1980s Kunming street scenes that Uncle Qin had sent via WeChat yesterday. A blurry figure of a cobbler in one of them sparked a missing passage of detailed description in the manuscript. I spent an hour finalizing the newly added paragraph, then read through and revised it sentence by sentence. Around 11 o'clock, I took a printed draft downstairs and asked Uncle Qin to proofread it. Wearing reading glasses, he circled several dialect expressions and punctuation issues with a red pen. After half an hour of discussion, the draft was finalized, and Uncle Qin agreed to help check the clean proofs of the sample book early next week.
location: Window-side seat on the second floor of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A simple lunch and neighborly small talk.
description: Walking home from the bookstore, the rain had stopped completely, and sunlight was beginning to peek out. At the front door, she ran into Aunt Xie from across the hall, who was heading out to buy vegetables, and they chatted for a few moments about her grandson’s funny antics. She was home alone at noon, so she cooked the mushroom noodles bought the previous evening, adding an egg and a few slices of ham. While eating the noodles, she browsed the layout templates for “Yuwei’s Slow Notes” on her phone, planning the first post for the afternoon.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - dining room and front door.

name: Afternoon journaling and leaving for school
description: After eating lunch quickly, she washed the blueberries and figs from the morning market and put them in a glass bowl. She took out her loose-leaf journal and wrote in pen, “The idea has landed; I feel at peace.” Then she drew a small row of celebration symbols. Afterward, she changed into lighter canvas shoes, packed her textbooks and iPad, and walked to Panjiawan Metro Station, planning to take Line 3.
location: From the study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Panjiawan Metro Station.

name: Commute by metro to Chenggong Campus
description: She entered Panjiawan Metro Station and took Line 3 to Yunnan University’s Chenggong Campus. On the subway, she put on earphones and began writing the caption for the first episode of “Yuwei’s Slow Record” — an essay about the rainy season in Kunming — and then selected 9 related photos from her phone. As the subway crossed the city, the scenery outside the window gradually changed from high-rises to open fields, and her thoughts became clearer.
location: From Panjiawan Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, via Metro Line 3

name: Course on the History of Modern Chinese Literature
description: Attended class in the College of Liberal Arts teaching building. Today's lecture focused on Shen Congwen's native-soil fiction. Some of the professor's points inspired the essay I'm revising, so I scribbled a few keywords on the flyleaf of the textbook: 'urban-rural perspective' and 'objects and people'. After class, I discussed a few literature search questions with my classmate Liu Jia.
location: School of Liberal Arts Teaching Building, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return metro commute.
description: After class, she walked to the metro station and took Line 3 back to the city center. On the metro, she finalized the 9 photos and captions for her Yuwei Slow Record post.
location: From Yunnan University Chenggong Campus in Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Panjiawan Metro Station in Wuhua District, via Metro Line 3

name: First post on digital account
description: Walked home, brewed a cup of rose tea, opened my laptop, logged into the newly registered account “Yuwei's Slow Record,” formatted and uploaded the carefully selected photos and short essay, and set a scheduled post. After publishing, I felt a bit nervous and expectant, refreshing the page every few minutes. When I saw that a stranger had liked it and commented, “The Kunming in the photos looks so gentle,” I immediately replied, “Thank you~” and felt a wonderful sense of connection.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing dinner with family far away.
description: Started preparing dinner, found dumpling wrappers and leftover meat filling from yesterday in the fridge, and wrapped 15 small wontons. After boiling, added seaweed and dried shrimp, which was refreshing and satisfying. While eating, I sent the draft photo of the newly designed mint leaf sticker to my sister Sun Yutong via WeChat. Soon, my sister replied with a voice message of encouragement, saying the lines were much smoother than the camellia version, and that I could start preparing for mass production. I was very happy to be praised.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-rain brisk walking training at Green Lake
description: In the early evening, while it was still light, she changed into sportswear and running shoes and walked to Green Lake Park. After a day of showers, the air was especially fresh and moist. She put on her earphones and started today's brisk-walking training, keeping a pace of about 7 minutes and 20 seconds per kilometer along the lakeside avenue, completing 3 kilometers. On the way, she took several photos of Green Lake after the rain with her phone; the sunset glow reflected on the lake was beautiful. After finishing, she checked in on the “Sports Flower Supervision Group” WeChat group, and Coach He Lu immediately replied with praise.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Evening home tidying, creative work, and social time
description: After returning home, she washed up, changed into loungewear, put the blueberries and figs she had bought today into the refrigerator, loosened the soil for the mint on the balcony, and dried her wet canvas shoes with a hair dryer. Then, in the study, she opened the drawing tablet and continued in Procreate to refine the second sticker of the 'Plants Collection' — the mint leaf. She traced the veins stroke by stroke, using the actual plant on the balcony as reference; the lines were much smoother than when she drew the camellia. After finishing, she exported it, printed it, cut it out, and pasted it onto this week's planning page in her journal. Around 10 p.m., she shared a screenshot of her first Xiaohongshu post with her friend Song Wen, with a note thanking her for her encouragement. Song Wen quickly replied with a celebration sticker pack and said she would go like and comment.
location: Bathroom, bedroom, and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and falling asleep.
description: Dimming the light and leaning against the headboard, she took the Spring City magazine she hadn't finished reading yesterday from the bookshelf, read the last article about 'Cuihu Families,' and casually copied a favorite sentence into her notebook. Before bed, she put down her phone and did five minutes of abdominal breathing, letting the day's thoughts gradually settle. Finally, she turned off the light and fell asleep contentedly.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning refresh and brisk walk at Green Lake Park
description: At 6:40, Yuwei's alarm went off on time. She turned it off, took a deep breath, changed into her workout clothes, washed up briefly, and left the house. After walking about 11 minutes from her home on Renmin Middle Road, she arrived at the west gate of Green Lake Park. The air was moist and birds were singing everywhere in the early morning. She began walking briskly around the lake, keeping a steady pace of about 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer, while mentally sorting through the day's to-do items: revise the manuscript, yoga, social security deduction. After finishing 3 kilometers, she did some simple stretches on a bench near the east gate and used her phone to take a photo of the lake's reflection in the morning light, full of quiet contentment.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home and breakfast time
description: After stretching, Yuwei walked back home along the same route to Cuihu Community on Renmin Middle Road. Once home, she stepped on the body fat scale: 44.8 kg, body fat 18.8%. She photographed the readings on her phone's memo app. Her mother had prepared warm milk oatmeal and fried eggs. At the table, Yuwei told her parents that she would go to the bookstore that day to finalize the preface to her essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes'. Her father reminded her not to rush, and her mother said with a smile, 'Uncle Qin definitely saved you a good seat again.'
location: At home, Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning tidying and social security setup.
description: After breakfast, Yuwei returned to her room and packed her laptop, notebook, and the Spring City magazine into a canvas bag. She watered the mint plant on the windowsill, then sat at her desk, opened the mobile banking app, set up automatic deduction on the 15th of every month for flexible-employment social insurance, and enabled SMS alerts. After confirming success, she added a recurring reminder to her phone calendar, feeling that another major concern had been resolved and she was much more at ease.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Zhibushi Bookstore and finalize the manuscript reading.
description: After taking care of some chores, Yuwei shouldered her canvas bag and headed out, walking to Zhibushi Bookstore. Along the way, she passed several breakfast stalls and some old shops, feeling the city waking up. After about 17 minutes, she saw the warm sign of “Zhibushi Bookstore.” The bookstore had only been open for a little while, and her usual window-side seat on the second floor was indeed empty. She sat down, ordered a cup of Yunnan small-grain drip-bag coffee, opened her laptop, and began polishing the preface “A Slow Traveler’s Confession” in “Slow Travel Notes.” Following Uncle Qin’s suggestion from yesterday, she tried adding a passage in Kunming dialect to make the writing more vivid. During a break, she went downstairs to find Uncle Qin and asked him to read the newly added section. Uncle Qin read it and nodded repeatedly. Yuwei also browsed a few newly arrived essay collections on the shelves for inspiration.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home and had lunch.
description: After packing up and saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, Yuwei walked home, feeling a little hungry. When she got home, her mother had already made lunch: stir-fried choy sum, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and a small portion of her favorite crispy fried pork. Yuwei chatted with her parents while eating, sharing the progress she had made on the final draft at the bookstore that morning. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. After the meal, she took the initiative to help clear the dishes.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday break and pre-yoga preparation.
description: Yuwei didn't take a nap. Instead, she sat at her desk, opened Xiaohongshu, and saw that the post on "Yuwei's Slow Notes" had gained several new comments. She replied to every reader carefully. One comment said her writing had "a gentle power," which warmed her heart, and she took a screenshot and shared it with her best friend Zhang Jing. Then she spent some time studying tutorials on designing journal stickers with Procreate to prepare for tonight's creative work. After that, she changed into yoga clothes, packed her yoga mat and water bottle into her backpack, and got ready to head to Zhongmou Yoga Studio.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga Class and Headstand Breakthrough
description: Yuwei walked about 12 minutes to the Dechun Commercial Building, took the elevator to the 4th floor, and arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio early. The 2 p.m. vinyasa flow yoga class started on time. Under the guidance of instructor He Lu, Yuwei devoted herself fully to the sequence of asanas. The key part today was headstand practice. With He Lu's assistance and encouragement from several senior students, Yuwei took a deep breath and tried going up the wall on her own for the first time. Her movement wobbled a bit, but she quickly stabilized her core and successfully held the pose for 20 seconds! When she came down, He Lu led the applause, and the classroom rang with encouraging claps. The instructor smiled and said, 'Yuwei, your core strength has improved a lot—well done!' After class, she chatted with He Lu and happily agreed to sign up for next month's advanced vinyasa class. The two high-fived to seal the deal.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-class rest, supermarket shopping, and going home
description: Yuwei drank some water in the rest area, caught her breath, and sent a check-in message to the exercise supervision group: "Today's challenge succeeded! Headstand for 20 seconds achieved~" She felt full of strength. Then, on the way, she dropped by the Dushi Mingyuan fresh supermarket next door, bought a small bunch of organic spinach, a box of blueberries, and the tofu her dad loved. At checkout, she saw an old yogurt promotion and grabbed a box on impulse. Afterward, carrying her shopping bag, she strolled home. The sunlight was just right, so she took a photo of the bougainvillea on the roadside and sent it to her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen: "Sis, look, the bougainvillea at home is blooming so well. I miss you a little."
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Home leisure and magazine reading
description: After arriving home, Yuwei put the ingredients in the fridge, then took a shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. She sat at her desk, made a cup of rose tea, picked up the magazine "Spring City" from beside her pillow, and turned to the article about the old shops on Wenlin Street that she hadn't finished reading yesterday, immersing herself in the author's delicate prose and enjoying the quiet afternoon.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Help prepare dinner and have family dinner.
description: Mom started preparing dinner, and Yuwei took the initiative to go into the kitchen to help trim and wash the vegetables. The mother and daughter chatted while they worked. Today Mom made stir-fried spinach, pan-fried tofu, and corn and pork rib soup. At the dinner table, Yuwei excitedly told her parents about her breakthrough at the yoga studio today. Her father picked up a piece of tofu for her and said with a smile, 'Our Yuwei is getting better and better at taking care of herself. Awesome!' The family sat around the table enjoying a warm dinner.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home in Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and sticker creation.
description: Yuwei returned to the study and opened her beloved loose-leaf journal. She first pasted in this morning's body-fat data, then carefully recorded the day's important moments with her newly bought pink fountain pen: "The author's preface is finalized, and Uncle Qin said OK! A yoga class breakthrough — a freestanding headstand held for 20 seconds. The automatic social insurance deduction is set, so I feel at ease." She also spent some time designing a set of sticker illustrations on the theme of 'Clear Sky After Rain' in Procreate, with rainbows, clouds, and raindrops, which she planned to print out later to decorate her journal.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and evening reading
description: Yuwei got up to wash up and do her skincare routine. After basic maintenance, she leaned against the headboard, put on earphones, and played a soothing piano piece. She sent her sister a voice message, briefly chatting about today's life and the yoga breakthrough, and the two agreed to video call next time. Then she turned off the music, picked up Spring City magazine, finished reading the article about old shops on Wenlin Street, and jotted down in the margins the names of several interesting shops mentioned in the article. Feeling sleepy, she turned off the bedside lamp and, with a sense of satisfaction at the fulfilling day, quickly fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run and recovery
description: At 6:30 in the morning, she put on old running shoes and walked from home to Cuihu Park. After jogging about 800 meters along the lakeside path, she switched to brisk walking because her stamina couldn't keep up, completed about 2 kilometers of brisk walking, did simple stretches on a park bench, and recorded her first jogging experience in the phone memo app: 'A bit breathless, but the scenery is worth it. August, take it slow.' At 7:00 she returned home, weighed 44.9 kg, recorded the date, morning weight, morning jogging distance, and physical feelings in detail in her journal, drew a little sun, and then briefly massaged her calf muscles.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, and home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community.

name: Breakfast and family conversation.
description: Her mother Li Xiulan had prepared breakfast: rice noodles, fried eggs, and blanched baby bok choy. As they ate, she shared funny moments from her morning run with her mother and mentioned that she planned to visit the sporting goods store He Lu recommended in the afternoon to look at running shoes. Her mother supported the idea and reminded her to try the shoes on and make sure they were comfortable, and said they could discuss next week's menu together in the evening.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting, refreshing the workspace, and drawing up a revision plan
description: After packing her commuter bag, she walked from home to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, feeling the energy of the morning rush hour along the way. At the window-side workstation on the second floor, she took down the old sticky notes and replaced them with a hand-written goal card reading "August, take it slow," put eucalyptus leaves and dried flowers into the vase on the desk. Then she opened her laptop, compiled the email annotations from her advisor Wu Mingyuan and the voice suggestions from editor Xu Mingyuan, highlighted key points with a highlighter, made a 10-day chapter-by-chapter revision plan for "Slow Travel Notes," printed it, and stuck it on the partition.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and printing the sample copy of the essay collection.
description: Feeling hungry, I went to Duanshi Xiaoguo on Wenlin Street and ordered a bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles. While waiting for the food, I flipped through my morning running photos. I happened to run into Uncle Qin, the owner of Zhibushi Bookstore, and briefly talked about writing prose in the Kunming dialect. After the meal, I walked to Yunyin Press on the same street, handed the final electronic manuscript of Slow Travel Notes to the owner, and confirmed the rice-paper and thread-bound specifications. While waiting, I bought water at a newsstand. When all 10 sample copies, redolent with the scent of fresh ink, were presented to me, I felt immense satisfaction and a sense of realness, as if the work had taken on weight and warmth for the first time.

participant.name: Uncle Qin
participant.relation: Owner of the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore.

location: Duanshi Xiaoguo at 74 Wenlin Street and Yunyin Studio at 60 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Selecting running shoes and resting on the way back
description: Carrying the sample book, she walked from Wenlin Street to the sporting goods store on Renmin West Road. After explaining her needs to the clerk, she tried on cushioned running shoes from three brands, carefully comparing the fit and feel, and finally bought a pair of lightweight white running shoes. Excitedly, she sent a message to He Lu to thank her. Then she walked home carrying the new running shoes and the sample book. After arriving home, she took a quick shower, put the new running shoes on the shoe rack at the entrance and took a photo, placed the sample book on the desk, and, smelling the scent of ink, decided to proofread it carefully later.
location: Sporting goods store on Renmin West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Family Time and Meal Planning
description: After resting, I helped my mother prepare dinner, chatting while picking over the vegetables. I took out last week's food diary and analyzed it with my mother. We found that our intake of vegetables and high-quality protein was insufficient, so we worked out a meal plan to gain weight for the next week and agreed to go to the wet market together tomorrow morning. That evening, we specially added steamed sea bass and garlic broccoli.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Starting monthly financial management
description: After dinner, I went back to the desk in my bedroom, downloaded a budgeting app, and set up categories such as "Creative Spending," "Dining," "Fitness," and "Transportation." I set the social insurance for flexible employment, automatically deducted on the 15th of each month, as a recurring fixed expense, and entered the first expense: the cost of the running shoes. Then, on the finance page of my journal, I drew a savings progress bar from 1 to 30, filled in the number "1," and resolved to manage my nest egg carefully.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading and evening stretching
description: After completing the financial planning, picked up Yang Xiao's poetry collection and leaned back on the balcony lounger to read a few poems. Under the moonlight, I came across a poem about Kunming that felt similar to the feeling at Green Lake during my morning run. Then I practiced a few minutes of yoga stretching on the mat, reviewed the shoulder-and-neck warm-up before headstand, and though I didn't do the headstand, I imagined the feeling of stability.
location: Bedroom balcony and floor mat at home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and evening journaling
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up. While brushing my teeth, I savored the feeling of smelling a sample book's printer's ink for the first time today. Back in my room, I opened my journal, pasted in a sample piece of the book, and recorded my weight data, morning run experience, and thoughts on printing the sample book. Beside the finance page, I drew a simple sketch of a pair of running shoes, representing that this new pair is the starting point of my self-discipline in August.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: She changed into her pajamas, charged her phone, and set the alarm for 6:40. Then she picked up a collection of essays about old streets in Kunming and read a few pages, soaking up the city's atmosphere and seeking inspiration for tomorrow's writing. After 10 minutes of reading, she turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretch and breakfast
description: Woken at seven in the morning by her phone alarm, she did 15 minutes of yoga stretching on the bedroom carpet to ease the muscle soreness from the day before and drew little weather symbols in her journal. Then she had breakfast with her mother, Li Xiulan, tasting mixed sauce ersi noodles and discussing the morning plan to go to Green Lake for an outdoor photo shoot and to Haoshun Road Farmers Market. Her mother reminded her to take her keys.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to Green Lake Park
description: After breakfast, I put on my canvas bag with a mirrorless camera, took a thermos cup and my journal, and set off from home, walking about 8 minutes along West Huashan Road to the south gate of Green Lake Park. The morning air was moist, and there were already many people exercising in the park, with willow branches gently swaying in the wind.
location: Along the route from Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the south gate of Green Lake Park.

name: Photography class outdoor shooting practice at Green Lake
description: Met up with photography teacher Wang and classmates at the South Gate of Cuihu Park. The outdoor shooting theme was "Lines and Reflections in Morning Light." She learned to use horizontal composition and aperture-priority mode, and photographed the upturned eaves of the Mid-Lake Pavilion, water reflections, and lotus dewdrops by the lakeside and at the Nine-Bend Bridge lotus pond. Teacher Wang praised her light-and-shadow perspective.
location: Lakeside at the South Gate of Cuihu Park and the lotus pond at Nine-Bend Bridge, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to Haoshun Road Farmers' Market
description: After the photography class, I walked about 15 minutes along the tree-lined path on Cuihu West Road to the Haoshun Road Farmers Market on Qianju Street, planning to meet my mother and buy groceries.
location: Along the route from Cuihu Park in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Haoshun Road Farmers Market, No. 31 Qianju Street

name: Shopping at the market with mother.
description: She met her mother Li Xiulan at the entrance of the market. Her mother skillfully picked out organic vegetables, mangosteen, and dragon fruit. Sun Yuwei opened the bookkeeping app and carefully entered the expenses, setting the category “Vegetables and Fruits”. The market was bustling with noise, full of the vibe of everyday life.
location: Haoshun Road Farmers' Market, No. 31 Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home with mother.
description: After shopping, the mother and daughter carried their shopping baskets and walked about 20 minutes home along Qianju Street and Huashan South Road, chatting about what to cook for lunch along the way in a warm atmosphere.
location: Along the route from Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Design and make handmade stickers.
description: After returning home, she opened her drawing tablet in the study and used Procreate to design botanical patterns. She printed them on sticker paper, carefully cut them into stickers, chose a maple leaf shape, and stuck it on that day's page in her journal, enjoying the joy of handcrafting.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and giving books to parents
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the whole family had lunch together. Sun Yuwei solemnly brought out two advance copies of Slow Travel Notes and gave them to her parents. Her father flipped through them in silence and gently touched her signature; her mother excitedly read aloud the title of the chapter about Green Lake. The home was filled with pride and warmth.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rest and preparing a sample copy for my advisor
description: After dinner, returned to the study, quickly imported and selected Green Lake photographs, marked the three most heavily revised chapters in the sample book to be given to advisor Wu Mingyuan with colored sticky notes, thought through the key points to explain when meeting, then rested with eyes closed for 20 minutes.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go to Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University.
description: Take the sample book and notes, walk from home to Huashan West Road Metro Station, take Line 2 to Huancheng South Road Station, transfer to Line 1 to University Town Station, then ride a shared bicycle after exiting the station to Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus, and walk to the faculty apartment. The whole trip takes about an hour.
location: Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Metro Line 2 and Line 1 (from Huashan West Road Station to University City Station) and the surrounding area of University City in Chenggong District

name: Give a complimentary copy to advisor Professor Wu Mingyuan.
description: At Professor Wu Mingyuan’s home in the faculty apartment, she presented the sample copy and opened the marked chapters, explaining her revision approach such as refining the wording and incorporating the Kunming dialect. The professor looked through it carefully and affirmed, saying he would read it closely and then give written feedback. After talking for about forty minutes, she took her leave.
location: Faculty Apartment, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing and brainstorming on the way back on the subway.
description: After leaving Yunnan University, I rode a shared bike back to University Town Station and took the return metro. On the train, I listened to light music with earphones, selected Green Lake photos, thought about a Xiaohongshu caption, and replied to my best friend Zhang Jing's WeChat, telling her that we could go to Paper Stone Bookstore together tomorrow.
location: Inside the carriages of Metro Lines 1 and 2, Kunming, Yunnan Province (University Town Station to Huashan West Road Station)

name: Creating and reading freely at home
description: After getting home, she brewed a cup of Dianhong black tea. In her study, she first made a quick pencil sketch of the 'Morning Light at Green Lake' scene, and after half an hour of drawing, she turned to reading an anthology recording stories of Kunming's old streets, accumulating material for her next article, until her mother called her to help prepare dinner.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Help mother prepare dinner
description: She went into the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan pick vegetables and peel garlic, while sharing the details of meeting Professor Wu in the afternoon. She mentioned the teacher's affirmation of her use of dialect. Her mother was very happy and promised to make mushroom soup on the weekend to celebrate.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: The family of three sat around the table for dinner, and her mother had cooked several home-style dishes. The conversation ranged from the latest news about her elder sister Sun Yutong, who works in Shenzhen, to her upcoming essay collection. The atmosphere was calm and steady.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanying Mother on a walk around Cuihu Lake
description: After dinner, mother and daughter walked side by side along the lakeside trail around Cuihu for about forty minutes. The evening breeze was gentle, and the streetlights stretched the tree shadows. They talked about the elder sister's work pressure and her own creative plans. Her mother patted her hand lightly and urged her not to work too hard, and expressed pride in the upcoming book.
location: Lakeside Trail, Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Updated Xiaohongshu and interacted with followers.
description: After returning from the walk and washing her face, she opened her laptop in the study, uploaded photos of the finished handmade stickers and selected Green Lake photos to her Xiaohongshu account “Yuwei's Slow Notes”, shared her crafting experience and photography gains with relaxed words, patiently replied to followers' likes and comments, and felt a deep sense of accomplishment.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Nighttime tidying and next-day planning
description: After tidying the desk, she took out the exercise supervision group notebook to draft content for tomorrow's weekly summary and review the group members' exercise achievements this week. In her journal she recorded today's weight of 44.9 kg and nearly 6 kilometers of walking, drew a vine sticker pattern, and wrote tomorrow's plan: organize the chapters that may receive feedback in the morning, go to Paper Stone Bookstore to write in the afternoon, and do the exercise group weekly summary in the evening.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Yoga stretching and bedtime reading.
description: On the bedroom carpet, I opened the online class video from Zhongmou Yoga Studio and did a 15-minute Yin Yoga stretch, focusing on relaxing my calves and back after standing for a long time. After finishing, I changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and browsed Yang Xiao's poetry collection, letting my mood completely calm down in the quiet words.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: You closed the poetry collection, went to the bathroom to wash up, set the phone alarm for 7 a.m. the next day, and finally wrote goodnight in your journal. After turning off the light, with the faint sound of insects outside the window, you fell asleep peacefully, feeling content and looking forward to tomorrow.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake-up and family morning routine.
description: Yu was awakened by the sound of rain outside the window. She checked the phone weather and saw it was a shower. After getting up, she weighed herself at 45.0 kg and recorded it in her phone memo. After washing up, her mother Li Xiulan had prepared chicken soup rice noodles. They had breakfast together in the dining room, talked about going to Zhibushi Bookstore today to revise the manuscript and lunch plans, and her mother reminded her to bring an umbrella.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Yuwei put on a light jacket, took a canvas bag holding her laptop, journal, and fountain pen, and, holding an umbrella, set out from home. She walked along Renmin Middle Road, turned onto Cuihu North Road, and after about 15 minutes reached Zhibushi Bookstore in the drizzle. Upstairs, she settled into her usual seat by the window on the second floor.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focus on revising the first three chapters of the essay collection
description: Yuwei sat at a window-side workstation on the second floor of the bookstore, opened her laptop, and revised the first three chapters of her essay collection against the annotations of her advisor Wu Mingyuan and editor Xu Mingyuan. After reading through, she adjusted the paragraph transitions in the second and third chapters chapter by chapter, cut a redundant passage of scenery description, and marked two places needing delicate foreshadowing with green sticky notes. Accompanied by the sound of rain outside the window, she focused on completing the initial revisions.
location: Second floor of Paper Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch: Duanshi small-pot rice noodles
description: Yuwei walked to the Duanshi Small-Pot Rice Noodle Shop on Wenlin Street, ordered a bowl of classic small-pot rice noodles and a serving of braised tofu, and sat by the window to eat. During the meal, she used her phone memo to record sentences that flashed through her mind while revising, polishing the ending of Chapter 3.
location: Duanshi Xiaoguo (Wenlin Street Branch), No. 74 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Book donation and exchange at Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Yuwei returned to Zhibushi Bookstore and went into the Mingyuan Book House area on the first floor, where she saw the owner Qin Mingyuan sorting newly arrived literary magazines. Yuwei gave Uncle Qin a sample copy of the essay collection Slow Travel Notes. Delighted, Uncle Qin put on his reading glasses, flipped to the passage describing the bookstore, and read aloud, “What is hidden in the pages is the old time of this street,” praising it as vivid. The two chatted about the newly stocked books on Yunnan customs, and Uncle Qin promised to write a reading response after finishing them.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 1st Floor, Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Heading to Nanke Café
description: Yuwei said goodbye to Uncle Qin, held her umbrella through the damp Green Lake South Road after the rain, turned into a quiet alley, and headed to the Nanke Café where she had agreed to meet her best friend.
location: Nanke Café, in an alley off Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A small gathering with close friends at a café
description: Yuwei arrived at Nanke Café, where her close friend Zhang Jing had already ordered a hot latte and was waiting. Yuwei gave Zhang Jing a sample copy of "Slow Travel Notes". Zhang Jing excitedly flipped through it and asked about the layout and cover details. The two exchanged new journals; Zhang Jing shared photos from her cycling trip around Erhai Lake, and Yuwei showed how to use the botanical stickers she had designed yesterday. Yuwei also wrote a blessing message on a sticky note for her Shenzhen friend Zhou Lin, ready to send it later.
location: Nanke Café, in an alley off Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Send a sample copy to Zhou Lin by courier.
description: After the coffee gathering ended, Yuwei walked to the Cainiao Station on Cuihu North Road, sent the sample copy with the recipient information filled in to Zhou Lin in Shenzhen, scanned the code to pay the postage, photographed the tracking number, and sent it to Zhou Lin to remind her to check.
location: Cainiao Station (Kunming Materials Compound, Building 28, Shop 103), No. 100-50 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Resting at Home and Journaling
description: After returning home, Yuwei drank some water and rested. Then, at her desk in the bedroom, she opened her Hobonichi journal and used a fountain pen to record the day's experiences: the bookstore in the rain, Uncle Qin's praise, Zhang Jing's smiling face, and her feelings about sending the books—decorating the page edges with botanical stickers. Afterwards, she replied to comments from followers on Xiaohongshu's "Yuwei's Slow Notes" about bookstore recommendations.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping out in the kitchen and dinner for the family of three
description: Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan prepare dinner. She shelled beans and washed vegetables, and shared the positive feedback she had received from giving away books during the day. Her mother was very happy and suggested adding a cucumber salad. After her father Sun Mingyuan got off work, the family of three sat around the dining table and enjoyed stir-fried pork with green peppers, cucumber salad, tomato and egg soup, and stir-fried green beans. Her father asked about the progress of the manuscript revision and said that help from many people would make the book more solid. The atmosphere during the meal was warm.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-dinner family leisure and walk preparation
description: After dinner, Dad read the newspaper in the living room, and Yuwei helped Mom clear the dishes. After the rain stopped, Mom suggested going for a walk around Green Lake, so Yuwei went back to her room and changed into her sneakers.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked with mother around Green Lake after the rain
description: Yuwei and her mother walked arm in arm to Green Lake Park. After the rain, the air was fresh, the lake surface had fine ripples, and the roadside plants were dotted with water droplets. As they strolled along the lakeside path, they talked about her older sister Sun Yutong, who works in Shenzhen. Her mother said Yutong was busy with her project but might take leave and come home at the end of August, which made Yuwei full of anticipation.
location: Little Bird Park (Cuihu Park), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home to prepare for a video call with my sister.
description: After the walk, Yuwei returned home, washed her face, and applied a soothing serum to relax her shoulders and neck. She then sent a WeChat message asking her elder sister Sun Yutong if she was free for a video call, and her sister quickly agreed.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with her elder sister Sun Yuting.
description: Once the video call connected, her older sister shared the progress of her company's new project launch. Yuwei described in detail her day of delivering sample copies of the book: Uncle Qin's affirmation and Zhang Jing's excitement. Her sister joked that the 'reader meet-and-greet' warm-up was a success and encouraged Yuwei to relax and enjoy creating. The call lasted about 50 minutes. After hanging up, Yuwei felt very warm.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Home relaxation, shoulder and neck stretching, and meditation
description: After the video ended, Yuwei spread out her yoga mat in the bedroom, put on soft instrumental music, and after warming up her wrists and neck, followed the Keep shoulder-and-neck soothing course for a 15-minute stretch, focusing on relaxing her trapezius and shoulder blades. Then she sat cross-legged with her eyes closed for a 10-minute abdominal breathing meditation; with the post-rain tranquility, her fatigue dissipated with each exhale.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading, journaling, and bedtime
description: Yuwei put away her yoga mat, washed up, applied skincare, and changed into cotton pajamas. Lying in bed, she read about half an hour of Yang Xiao's poetry collection "To the Night". Before turning off the light, she used her bedside journal to record the core feelings: the focus of rainy days, the company of friends, and the warmth of family. She also wrote down her weight of 45.0 kg and a small plan to go to the supermarket for fruit the next day. Then she turned off the light at 22:30 and fell into a dream in the quiet after the rain.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and heading to Cuihu Park
description: At 6:30 a.m., the phone alarm went off on time. Sun Yuwei did not stay in bed; she opened the curtains and let the morning sunlight spill into the room. She changed into the new cushioned running shoes and sportswear she had bought yesterday, neatly tied her hair into a ponytail, took a few sips of warm water, and started recording on the mobile fitness app. She left at 6:50, walked from her home on Huashan West Road to Green Lake Park, passed through familiar alleys and along Green Lake South Road, breathing fresh air, and arrived at Green Lake Park about 10 minutes later, just before 7:00.
location: En route from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road

name: Morning Run Breaks the One-Kilometer Mark
description: At exactly 7 o'clock, Sun Yuwei started her morning run on the lakeside trail of Cuihu Park. She jogged at her own pace and adjusted her breathing. At 800 meters, the familiar side stitch came, but she slowed down and persisted without stopping, finally completing the 1-kilometer goal in 8 minutes 15 seconds. After running, she found a bench by the lake to stretch, watched elderly people doing tai chi during their morning exercise, and the sparkling morning light on the lake made her feel calm and fulfilled.
location: Cuihu Park Lakeside Trail, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Strolling the morning market and shopping.
description: After finishing her morning run, Sun Yuwei stopped by the morning market at the park entrance on the way home. At a familiar stall, she bought a box of freshly available blueberries (15 yuan), then went to the adjacent pastry shop and bought three freshly baked flower cakes (6 yuan) to bring to her mother for breakfast. She opened the newly downloaded expense-tracking app on her phone and carefully recorded the expense.
location: Morning market stall beside Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going home for a shower and breakfast
description: After returning home at 8 o'clock, Sun Yuwei took a quick shower and changed into comfortable cotton-linen loungewear. At the dining table, her mother Li Xiulan had already prepared hot milk and boiled eggs. Yuwei handed her mother a flower cake and shared the joy of breaking through 1 kilometer on her morning run. Her mother smiled and praised her, and the two chatted about the news from her sister Sun Yutong's video call last night that she might return to Kunming. The atmosphere was warm.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning organizing and planning.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to her desk. She opened her journal, wrote down this morning's achievement of 'running over 1 kilometer' with her pen, and drew a small trophy icon. Then she took out the notebook of her conversation with Qin Mingyuan, the owner of Zhibushi Bookstore, quickly skimmed it, highlighted the key points for today's work at the bookstore, and designed a simple interview framework.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Collecting material at Zhibushi Bookstore
description: At 9 o'clock, Sun Yuwei packed up her notebook and iPad and walked to Zhibushi Bookstore. Leaving Cuihu Community, she headed north along Huashan West Road, turned onto Cuihu North Road, and arrived about 10 minutes later. She greeted the owner Qin Mingyuan, who was sorting books, then went straight upstairs to her regular seat at “Mingyuan Bookstore”. She created a new document titled “[Kunming Column, August] The Changing Independent Bookstores of Kunming” and began searching online for historical materials about Kunming's long-established bookstores. Cross-referencing her interview notes, she identified three representative bookstores, including Bowen Bookstore and Wheat Field Bookstore, as candidates. During this time, Uncle Qin came upstairs to refill her water and chatted briefly about the bookstore's daily routines.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch: small-pot rice noodles
description: At noon, Sun Yuwei packed up and walked to Duanshi Small Pot Rice Noodle Shop. Starting from Zhibushi Bookstore, she headed south along Cuihu North Road, turned onto Wenlin Street, and arrived about 10 minutes later. She ordered a steaming bowl of the signature small-pot rice noodles; the sour and spicy broth whetted her appetite. While eating, she sent a WeChat message to her mother to confirm the fruit and ingredient list for the evening.
location: Duanshi Xiaoguo (Wenlin Street Branch), No. 74 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mailed the postcard to a friend
description: After lunch, at 12:45, Sun Yuwei did not go straight back to the bookstore. First she bought a stamp at a stationery store by the roadside, then walked to the Cainiao Station in Tianjundian Lane. Arriving at 1 p.m., she took out the handwritten postcard she had written last night, decorated with a few blooming champaca flowers, addressed to her book friend Yang Xiao. She mailed the postcard—sending a little piece of her heart.
location: Cainiao Station (Kunming Tianjundian Building 4 Store), Building 4, No. 14 Tianjundian Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return to the bookstore and schedule an interview by phone.
description: At 13:15, Sun Yuwei walked back from the Cainiao Station to Zhibushi Bookstore, and returned to her second-floor workstation at 13:30. She took a deep breath and dialed the number Uncle Qin had given her for Old Li at Bowen Book House. When the call connected, she politely introduced herself and expressed her intention to interview him. Old Li's voice was kind, and he readily agreed to the interview, arranging to meet at Bowen Book House at 10 a.m. this Wednesday (August 6). After hanging up, Yuwei excitedly wrote down the interview time and reminders in her journal.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reviewing editor feedback and midday rest
description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei's phone vibrated with a WeChat voice message from her editor Xu Mingyuan. She put on her earphones and listened carefully. Editor Xu thought the structure of Slow Travel Notes was complete and the overall quality good, but the writing style in some chapters could be more concise, emphasizing personal feelings rather than too much descriptive narration. Yuwei took out her notebook, quickly noted down the key revision directions with symbols, and replied with a voice message thanking him. After finishing the work, she felt a little tired, poured herself a glass of water, walked to the second-floor window and watched the pedestrians below. She also took a photo of today's journal page filled with notes and the street scene outside as an alternative image for tonight's Xiaohongshu post. After a short break, she felt much more refreshed.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the supermarket to shop
description: At 3 p.m., Sun Yuwei left the bookstore and walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. She headed south from Green Lake North Road, crossed Qianju Street, turned onto Dongfeng West Road, then turned onto Fuchun Street, arriving about 20 minutes later at 3:20 p.m. She first carefully picked out mangoes that her father likes and blueberries for herself in the fruit section. Then she went to the flower section and chose a fresh, dewy bunch of white lisianthus and a few eucalyptus branches, planning to bring new life to her desk, which had been looking wilted.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Went home to tidy up and arrange flowers.
description: At 16:10, Sun Yuwei walked home carrying her purchases. She came out of Fuchun Street and headed north along Huashan West Road, returning home around 20 minutes later at 16:30. After arriving home, she first took out the newly bought lisianthus, trimmed the roots with scissors, removed excess leaves, and arranged them in a clear glass vase bought last time at Dounan Flower Market. She placed the vase on her desk in her room, and the room instantly gained a touch of freshness. Then she put away her journal, iPad, and other items, and organized and filed the materials and interview notes she had collected at the bookstore today.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and family time
description: Yuwei went into the kitchen and helped her mother, who was picking vegetables, as they chatted about the joy of successfully booking the interview over the phone today. After her father Sun Jianguo came home from work, Yuwei eagerly shared her feat of running 1 kilometer that morning. The family sat around the dining table, enjoying an ordinary but warm dinner, while Xinwen Lianbo was airing on TV.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal and creative work.
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei returned to her room. She took out her beloved TN journal and used different colored pens to record the day's key events one by one: her mood after the 1 km morning run, the confirmation of the interview appointment, and the key points from the editor's voice messages. Afterward, she opened Procreate on her iPad and, inspired by the lotus pond at Green Lake this morning, began creating a new sticker design depicting lotus flowers and leaves in the moonlight.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Xiaohongshu sharing and interaction
description: Sun Yuwei opened Xiaohongshu and edited a new note. She chose a photo of this morning’s Green Lake scenery, a screenshot of her journal page, and a screenshot of her 1-kilometer running record, with the caption: “From 800 meters to 1 kilometer, every Monday deserves a small improvement.” After publishing it, she replied to each encouraging comment from her fans and browsed the latest updates from a few book bloggers she followed.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Listen to feedback and relax
description: Sun Yuwei put on her noise-canceling headphones and carefully listened to Editor Xu's voice feedback again. In the electronic document of "Slow Travel Notes," she highlighted the paragraphs that needed adjustment and added her own revision ideas as comments beside them. After finishing this, she felt much clearer in her thinking, then stood up and did a few simple shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the fatigue of a day spent at the desk.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and inner reflection
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, Sun Yuwei did not immediately pick up her phone. She leaned back in the lounge chair on the balcony and opened the poetry collection 'To the Night' given to her by her book friend Yang Xiao. As the night breeze gently brushed past, she carefully read a poem titled 'Fishing Lights Under the Moon' and lightly drew wavy lines beside the sentences she liked with a pencil, feeling peaceful and fulfilled inside.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Goodnight journal and tomorrow's planning
description: Back at the desk, Sun Yuwei switched into 'goodnight journal' mode. She first confirmed that all of today's to-do items had been checked off, then took out another page in the schedule section to plan tomorrow's (Tuesday's) work priorities: mainly, based on Editor Xu's feedback, start revising Chapter 4 of 'Notes on Slow Travel,' and prepare the specific questions needed for Wednesday's interview with Mr. Li of Bowu Bookstore.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the desk lamp, leaving only a dim night light on. She lay down in the soft bed, replaying in her mind the morning light of today, the scent of books at the bookstore, the editor's advice, and her parents' smiles. Feeling that she had spent a fulfilling and meaningful day, she looked forward to tomorrow's interview and creative work, and slowly drifted into sleep with this sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparations
description: Woken by the soft morning light of the cloudy sky outside, I felt a little proud thinking about yesterday's morning run breaking the 1-kilometer mark, but the writing pressure in my shoulders tightened again. Turning over, I saw the sample copy of Slow Travel Notes and my journal spread open at the bedside, and I resolved to break through the bottleneck of Chapter 4 today.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with her mother and planning the day's schedule.
description: Mother Li Xiulan made fragrant egg pancakes and warm milk. While eating, Yuwei wrote down today's plan in her journal: 1. Go to Zhibushi Bookstore in the morning to discuss revision ideas with Uncle Qin; 2. Wait for Editor Xu's revision suggestions in the afternoon; 3. Attend a flow yoga class at Zhongmou Yoga Studio in the evening. Her mother reminded her that there might be a shower today, so remember to bring an umbrella.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare to go out and walk to Paper-Cloth-Stone Bookstore
description: I packed my canvas bag: laptop, a sample copy of Slow Walk Notes, my journal, a power bank, a water bottle, and a folding umbrella. I put on my off-white linen-blend dress, changed into canvas shoes at the entrance, and left home on foot for the bookstore. Starting from home, I walked along Huashan West Road, turned onto Cuihu North Road, and passed tall plane trees with dappled morning light. When I passed City Garden Supermarket, I thought I could drop by on the way back from yoga class in the afternoon to buy some lisianthus.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Revising essay collection at the bookstore and seeking guidance
description: She sat down at the window-side workstation on the second floor of Zhibushi Bookstore and began revising Chapter 4 of “Slow Travel Notes.” When writing about “mushroom season,” she kept feeling that it lacked the local flavor of everyday life. Around ten o’clock, she took the sample copy downstairs to find Uncle Qin and frankly told him about her creative block. After flipping through it, Uncle Qin pulled out a yellowed copy of “Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan” from the bookshelf, pointed to a passage describing how ganba mushrooms were prepared over a fire pit in southern Yunnan, and said: “Feel the flavor in this writing.” Yuwei was deeply drawn in. With his permission, she took it back upstairs, copied out three wonderful passages, and the way to revise suddenly became clear.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Owner of the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore.

location: Second floor of Paper Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Handle online communication and make plans for tomorrow
description: She caught her breath and drank some water. She opened her phone and replied on Xiaohongshu to comments about yesterday's run. Then she opened the shared document and gave the question list for tomorrow morning's interview with Mr. Li of Bowen Bookstore a final check, making sure all the core questions were covered.
location: Second floor of Paper Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and a walk in Cuihu Park
description: I walked to the 'Dajiujia' snack shop on Wenlin Street and ordered a serving of the signature Tengchong fried erkuai and a bowl of papaya water. While waiting for the food, I quickly typed the key points from my excerpts into my memo, thinking about how to incorporate them into my prose. After finishing lunch, I took a detour to Cuihu Park for a walk. The cloudy day made the park especially peaceful, with weeping willows gently brushing the water. I sat on a lakeside bench, looked through the photos of 'Notes on Central Yunnan' on my phone, and felt the resonance between the words and the scenery.
location: “Dajiujia” Snack Shop, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return to the bookstore, integrate the editor's suggestions, and design the interview outline.
description: Back at the bookstore, she felt calm. She opened her computer and indeed received the detailed revision-suggestion document from editor Xu Mingyuan. In it, more than ten sentences that could be cut or reworded were marked in red. She took out her notebook, analyzed the editor's approach item by item, marked the corresponding places in the sample book with a highlighter, and wrote down her revision thoughts. After dealing with the editor's feedback, she opened a new document and focused on planning the outline for tomorrow's interview with Elder Li of Bowen Bookstore. Based on the confusion about 'the inheritance of literary lineage' she had encountered while revising the essay, she designed three sets of progressively deeper questions.
location: Second floor of Paper Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Left the bookstore, returned home, and prepared for the yoga class.
description: I packed up, said goodbye to Uncle Qin, and thanked him for his advice. On the walk home, a fine rain began to fall, so the umbrella I had brought in the morning came in handy. After getting home, I drank a glass of warm water and rested on the sofa with my eyes closed for ten minutes. Then I changed into the yoga clothes I had prepared, put on a sports jacket, slung my yoga mat over my shoulder, told my mom, 'I'm off,' and went out with the umbrella, walking along Dongfeng West Road toward Zhongmou Yoga Studio.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Owner of the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore.

location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Attended a flow yoga stress-relief class
description: Arrived on time at Zhongmou Yoga Studio. Coach He Lu's vinyasa flow class moved smoothly, from Sun Salutation to Warrior sequence to inversion poses. Sweat ran down my temples, and the tension in my neck and shoulders dissolved with each breath. After class, I took the initiative to ask He Lu about the pressure on the outside of my knee after yesterday's morning run. The coach suggested adding 5 minutes of ankle and hip activation warm-up before running.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After yoga, bought flowers and walked home.
description: After leaving the yoga studio, the rain had stopped and the air was especially fresh. She stopped by the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and bought a bouquet of pale purple lisianthus and some fresh blueberries. Carrying the flowers and fruit, she walked home cheerfully. The osmanthus in the neighborhood was in bloom, and a faint sweet fragrance drifted in the air.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Flower arranging, tidying up, and preparing dinner
description: After arriving home, Yuwei first trimmed the lisianthus stems and put them into the glass vase in the entryway. Then she went to the kitchen, where her mother was preparing dinner. Yuwei took over the task of washing vegetables and also volunteered to make a cucumber salad. The mother and daughter chatted as they worked, and Yuwei shared the joy of finally breaking through a bottleneck while revising her manuscript, saying the book Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan recommended by Uncle Qin was excellent.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the family of three sat together for dinner. Yuwei told in detail how she solved her writing difficulties that day through talking with Uncle Qin and reading local historical documents, and her parents were happy for her. Her father also shared that he had seen a new publication about local culture at the Cultural Bureau and thought it was a good sign.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-meal cleanup and leisure
description: After clearing the dishes with her mother and wiping the dining table clean, Yuwei made herself a cup of rose tea and then returned to her room.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Review and Address the Advisor's Feedback
description: Feeling both nervous and excited, I opened my phone and saw the WeChat message from my advisor, Mr. Wu Mingyuan. He sent a photo of a sample book he was annotating, along with a voice message: “The narrative pacing is good, but the dialect usage in a few places could be refined further. I expect to give you complete feedback the day after tomorrow.” After listening carefully, I immediately replied with thanks, converted the voice message to text, and jotted down the initial points in my journal.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and Procreate creation
description: She opened her journal, first drew a lisianthus she had seen today, and wrote down her feelings about breaking through the revision bottleneck and Uncle Qin's guidance. Then she opened Procreate and, inspired by the text of "Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan," tried to design a set of watercolor-style sticker illustrations themed around "fire pit," "mushrooms," and "old street," accumulating material for her Xiaohongshu account.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of the home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Leisure time with family
description: She left the room and went to the living room. Father was watching the news, and mother was scrolling on her phone. She sat down next to her mother and discussed what to wear and which voice recorder to bring for tomorrow's interview with Old Li from Bowen Bookstore. Father reminded her that she had to go out for the interview tomorrow and should rest early tonight.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening hygiene and bedtime routine
description: Back in her room, she washed up and did her skincare routine. She soaked her feet in mugwort to ease the day’s fatigue. After blow-drying her hair and changing into comfortable pajamas, she felt her body and mind open up from the inside out.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and falling asleep
description: She turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. She took out the notes she had excerpted from Jottings from Central Yunnan that afternoon and read them carefully, feeling the accumulation of time behind the words. She closed the notes, dimmed the light, thought about tomorrow's interview and the mentor feedback that would soon be returned, and fell asleep peacefully with calm anticipation.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and preparation
description: After the alarm went off, Sun Yuwei got up, opened the curtains, and stepped on the scale to see 45.1 kg. She did a few stretches and heated some water in her health pot. Then she prepared breakfast, cooking the small-pot rice noodles her mother had prepared and adding a boiled egg and a small bunch of bok choy. She opened the Boohee Health app to log her breakfast; the system showed that her protein and vegetable intake were still not up to target, so she saved a screenshot and planned to make up for it at lunch. After eating, she checked her interview bag: the voice recorder was fully charged, spare batteries were in the inner pocket, the notebook was marked with sticky notes, and she quickly went through the printed interview outline, confirming that the questions were clear and well organized.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Bowen Bookstore and complete the interview
description: Sun Yuwei put on her interview bag and sun hat and walked west along Renmin Middle Road toward Bowen Bookstore. Passing a flower shop, she noticed lisianthus and planned to buy some on the way back. At about 8:20, she arrived at Bowen Bookstore at 18 Dongfeng West Road. The shop owner, Old Li, was wiping the bookshelves. Yuwei greeted him and then observed the layout inside the store. Old Li brewed some Pu'er tea, and the two chatted about daily bookstore life. At 9 o'clock, the interview formally began. Yuwei turned on her voice recorder and took shorthand notes. Old Li started from the bookstore's founding in the early 1990s, recalling stories of old readers who came to hunt for books through all weather. Yuwei asked follow-up questions about the storefront size and best-selling categories, and the conversation grew deeper. The latter half focused on the bookstore's changes and the transition from print books to e-books. Old Li brought out readers' message books from 2000 to 2020. Yuwei photographed them for the archive, especially a video of a little girl's message from 2005: “When I grow up, I'll also buy many books here.” At 10 o'clock, the interview wrapped up. Yuwei thanked him and bought Old Images of Kunming's Old Streets and Records of Market Life in Central Yunnan at her own expense. Old Li gave her 20% off.
location: Bowen Book House, No. 18 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and flower shopping, then back to the bookstore
description: After the interview, Sun Yuwei walked to the "One More Bowl" ersi restaurant at No. 59 Wenlin Street, checking her diet app along the way. After arriving, she chose a window seat, ordered clear-soup ersi with a braised egg and cold cucumber salad, and logged her lunch into the Mint Health app. She noticed the vegetable intake reached half the recommended amount and protein had improved, so she set a 1.5-liter water goal for the afternoon and wrote herself an encouraging note. After the meal, she picked a bunch of pink-and-white lisianthus at a flower stall on the corner of Wenlin Street, then carried the flowers along Cuihu North Road back to the Zhibushi Bookstore, pausing by Cuihu Lake to enjoy the sparkling water.
location: Another Bowl of Ersi Restaurant, No. 59 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepared the workstation and organized interview materials.
description: Back at her workstation on the second floor of Zhibushi Bookstore, Sun Yuwei first put the lisianthus flowers in a vase and placed it on the corner of the desk. Then she opened her laptop, imported the interview recording, created a new folder named 'Bowen Bookstore Interview', and took photos to back up the key notes in her notebook. Afterward, she put on headphones, played back the recording, and organized segment-by-segment summaries, extracting core stories such as the bookstore's relocation, the old readers' persistence, and the literary fever of the 1990s, and marking passages suitable for the column. She particularly noted the detail of an elderly reader who came to the bookstore every Wednesday rain or shine, and decided to use it as the opening of the column.
location: Workspace on the second floor of Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revise Chapter 6 of the essay collection to incorporate new material
description: After sorting out the interview material, Sun Yuwei opened the document for Chapter 6 of her essay collection and tried to weave the details of the old city memories she had heard that morning into the old street section, citing the story of a retired teacher who went book hunting every Wednesday. While writing, she felt the writing lacked historical depth, and her progress was intermittent, so she took out “Old Photos of Kunming's Old Streets,” which she had bought that morning, and referred to the old photographs to find a more accurate descriptive angle.
location: Workspace on the second floor of Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Coffee break
description: Sun Yuwei paused her writing and went to the coffee area on the first floor of the bookstore, where she bought a hot Americano and sat on a high stool by the window to rest. She watched the passersby on Wenlin Street—a young mother pushing a stroller, an elderly person carrying a vegetable basket, and a middle school student in uniform. Opening the Mint Health app, she checked her water intake and found she still had more than half of her daily goal to go, so she got up to fetch a cup of water.
location: First-floor coffee area, Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Continue revising the manuscript to break through the bottleneck
description: After the break, Sun Yuwei returned to her desk, browsed Uncle Qin's recommended 'Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan,' and referred to its descriptions of old streets. She rewrote the first two paragraphs and added concrete details such as 'Wenlin Street was a gathering place for literati during the Republican period' and 'the buildings around Cuihu Lake experienced a transformation from tiled eaves to concrete.' Still, she felt it lacked some depth and was not satisfied.
location: Workspace on the second floor of Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Notifying the editor and tidying up the workspace.
description: Putting the manuscript aside for now, Sun Yuwei sent a WeChat message to editor Xu Mingyuan: “Teacher Xu, today I interviewed Old Mr. Li from Bowen Bookstore, and the material is very rich. I revised the old street section of Chapter 6 twice, but it still lacks historical depth. Tomorrow I plan to go to the provincial library to check the Kunming City Gazetteer. I'll organize my interview notes when I get back tonight.” Then she tidied the desk, put the books, notebook, and charging cable into her bag, and carefully took the lisianthus out of the vase and placed it into her tote bag.
location: Workspace on the second floor of Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home
