description: Sun Yuwei carried her bag and a bunch of lisianthus, walking along Green Lake toward home. The evening sky was a soft orange-pink, and the lake sparkled with ripples. As she walked, she thought about her plan to go to the Provincial Library tomorrow to consult Kunming City Gazetteer, History of Kunming's Urban Development, and Wuhua District Cultural and Historical Materials.
location: Walking trail around Green Lake, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and flower arranging.
description: Back home, Mom had already set the dishes on the table, including fish with pickled cabbage, garlic pea shoots, and mixed wood ear salad. The family chatted while eating; Sun Yuwei shared what she had seen and heard interviewing Old Mr. Li of Bowen Bookstore. Her father Sun Mingyuan asked detailed questions about the bookstore relocation, and Yuwei answered them one by one. After dinner, she opened the Mint Health app to log dinner and found that although her total daily intake was still unbalanced, it was better than yesterday. She reminded herself to add a serving of fruit tomorrow morning. Then she pruned the lisianthus and arranged it in a vase in the living room, adjusting the branches. Her mother Li Xiulan praised the flowers for being beautiful, and Yuwei smiled in response, feeling very happy.
location: Dining room and living room at home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing the supervisor's annotation feedback
description: While sorting through her interview notes in the bedroom, Sun Yuwei received a WeChat message from her supervisor Wu Mingyuan—a photo of annotated page proofs, exactly the old street chapter she had revised repeatedly that afternoon. The annotation read, "It lacks historical depth; you may consult the Kunming City Gazetteer, etc." After reading it carefully, she listed in her notebook the directions for supplementary materials: local gazetteers, city archives, the transformation history of the old street, and so on. She replied to her supervisor, "Thank you, Professor Wu. I'll go to the Provincial Library tomorrow to look up materials."
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal entry and tomorrow's plan.
description: Sun Yuwei took out her green-covered journal, wrote down the date and key events with a pen, condensed the interesting stories told by Old Li from Bowen Book House into brief notes, pasted in a photo of a bookshelf she had taken, and drew a quick sketch of a lisianthus as decoration. On the diet record page, she drew a small sun to represent improved nutrition. After finishing a video call in the evening, she opened the last page of the journal again and wrote out the next day's preliminary plan: go to Yunnan Provincial Library at 9 a.m. to look up the 'Kunming City Gazetteer' and 'The History of Kunming's Urban Development', have a simple meal nearby at noon, continue revising Chapter 6 in the afternoon, and noted to bring an apple before leaving in the morning. Reading and a video call with her elder sister were interspersed among the journaling activities.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading "Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan" in preparation for research
description: Sun Yuwei sat in the bedroom chair, continuing to read 'Trivial Notes from Central Yunnan,' focusing on the chapters about old streets and urban changes. She marked passages such as 'The Teahouse Culture of Wenlin Street During the Republican Era' and 'The Old City Renovation Around Green Lake in the 1990s' with sticky notes, and highlighted them with a marker, so that she could look up reference materials at the Provincial Library tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Her phone buzzed. Sun Yuwei picked up the video call from her older sister Sun Yutong. Yutong had just left work at her office in Shenzhen, and the two chatted about recent news. Yuwei shared amusing moments from today's interview and the bottleneck she hit while revising her manuscript. Yutong encouraged her not to worry and to take it slowly, and offered that if Yuwei needed help looking up materials in Shenzhen, she should just say the word. Yuwei smiled and nodded, feeling warm inside.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: Sun Yuwei soaked her feet in hot water in the bathroom, added two drops of lavender essential oil, listened to "Dianchi" from her folk song playlist while soaking, closed her eyes and let her mind drift for a few minutes, slowly relaxing the tension of the day. After soaking, she applied hand cream and felt much of her fatigue dissipate.
location: In the bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading to fall asleep
description: Sun Yuwei set her alarm for seven the next morning, placed 'Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan' and the materials she would take to the provincial library on the nightstand, turned off the main light, and left only a desk lamp on. After lying down, she recalled a striking detail from today's interview—the expression of Old Li's mouth turning up at the corners as he talked about the old reader who came to the bookstore every Wednesday. Leafing through the description of the Republican-era teahouses on Wenlin Street in 'Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan', she gradually felt drowsy, closed the book, and dimmed the light. From outside the window came the faint sound of insects. She turned over and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake-up preparation and morning run
description: At 6:30 the phone alarm rang. After getting up, I saw the road outside was wet but the air was fresh. Remembering yesterday's advisor's comments and the historical materials problem I needed to tackle today, I felt both pressure and anticipation. I quickly changed into quick-dry sportswear, put on my earphones, and set today's diet goals in my phone memo: more vegetables and protein, and 1.5 liters of water. Then I walked to Cuihu Park and started my third morning run. The air was especially fresh after the rain. As planned, I increased my jog to 1.2 kilometers. Midway, at 800 meters, I had difficulty breathing, but I slowed down and adjusted my breathing, and successfully met the goal. After the run, I stretched carefully on a lakeside bench, looked at the reflection on the water, and felt that my leg strength had improved compared with last week.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near No. 7 Huashan West Road)

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out.
description: After getting home at 7:40, taking a shower, and changing clothes, I had breakfast with my mother Li Xiulan. Mother made whole-wheat sandwiches (with fried egg, lettuce, and ham slices), and I poured myself a glass of warm milk. I opened the "Mint Health" app to record the protein and vegetable intake of breakfast, and noted that lunch should include more vegetables and soy products. I took a photo of the breakfast and sent it to the sisters' group chat with the label "Today's breakfast check-in". After the meal, I packed my notebook, power bank, the print draft to be revised, and "Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan" into a canvas bag, checked the confirmation SMS for the provincial library reservation, took an umbrella, said goodbye to my mother, and went out, silently remembering today's route.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuted to the Provincial Library and consulted local documents.
description: Walked 8 minutes from home to Cuihu South Road. Passing Cuihu Park, she saw elderly people doing morning exercises and remembered the “old teahouses” that Elder Li mentioned during yesterday's interview at Bowen Bookstore, so she decided to pay more attention to Republican-era teahouse culture while researching. At 8:45, she arrived at her reserved seat in the Local Documents Reading Room of Yunnan Provincial Library and searched the Kunming City Gazetteer and Wuhua District Gazetteer. Following the suggestions in her advisor's annotations, she focused on reading the records of Jinma Archway, Wenming Street, and old teahouses, photographing and archiving key pages with her phone. In her notebook, she compared the historical materials with the portrayals of Bowen Bookstore and old street scenes in her own essays, marking paragraphs that could be directly cited. More than two hours later, she found the key materials to solve the problem of “insufficient historical depth.”
location: Yunnan Provincial Library, No. 141 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and midday break
description: At nearly 12:00, she packed up her materials and walked 15 minutes to Jue Zheng Jing Vegetarian (Minsheng Street branch). She ordered a mixed mushroom set meal, deliberately choosing dishes with broccoli and tofu, and logged her lunch in the Mint Health app; her protein and vegetable intake were significantly better than yesterday. While eating, she flipped through the historical photos taken in the morning and thought about how to weave them into the next round of revisions. At 12:55, she returned to the Provincial Library, rested with her eyes closed on the sofa in the lounge for 15 minutes, then took out her morning notes and highlighted 3 core pieces of historical material that could be directly used for revising the old-street section of Chapter 4, thinking about how to combine the “hard core” of the historical material with the “warmth” in Elder Li’s words.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 14 Shalang Lane, Juezhengjing Vegetarian (Minsheng Street branch); Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 141 South Cuihu Road, Yunnan Provincial Library rest area.

name: Focused on revising the prose draft
description: At 1:15 p.m., I opened my laptop at the Provincial Library and began revising chapters four to six of Notes on Slow Travel. I inserted the historical material on "the street layout of Kunming in the Qing Dynasty" that I had excerpted that morning into the opening of the old street historical narrative, solving the problem my advisor had pointed out. In the chapter describing "mushroom season," I incorporated records of wild mushroom trading from the Kunming City Annals, making the text seem older and richer. For the old street section, I wrote while referring to my notes, and after finishing the draft, I felt the whole essay now had a weighty historical undertone.
location: Yunnan Provincial Library, No. 141 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Moving to a bookstore, finalizing manuscript revisions, and communicating with the editor
description: The provincial library closed at 4 p.m., so I packed up half an hour early and walked six minutes to Zhibushi Bookstore in Kunming. When I arrived at 15:37, the owner, Uncle Qin, was sitting behind the counter reading and greeted me with a smile. I went straight upstairs to the quiet workstation on the second floor. Immersed in the bookstore atmosphere, I gave the fourth through sixth chapters, which I had revised today, a final polish and read-through. Then I opened WeChat and sent editor Xu Mingyuan a voice message briefly reporting my revision approach, explaining how I had used newly found historical materials to restructure the old street chapter, and asking for his initial thoughts on the new version. After finishing all this, I let out a long breath and felt that today's main tasks were complete.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping and organizing at home.
description: At 4:35 p.m., she left the bookstore and walked 17 minutes to the City Garden Supermarket near her home. Based on the missing items recorded in the app, she bought chicken breast, broccoli, blueberries, eggs, and tomatoes, checking the freshness of the fruits and vegetables as she selected them. She also bought two 0.5 mm gel pens for journaling and excerpts. Then she walked 8 minutes home, sorted the ingredients into the refrigerator, put the chicken breast in the fridge for dinner, placed the new pens in the pen holder in the study, and clipped the pages of historical materials she had printed at the library today into the binder in order.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and family dinner
description: After putting things down, I took the initiative to walk into the kitchen and told my mother, Li Xiulan, that I would be in charge of one dish tonight. I cut the chicken breast into pieces, marinated it with cooking wine and pepper, broke the broccoli into small florets, and cut the tomatoes into chunks. Mother was washing vegetables and chopping scallions on the side, and while she was busy, she shared old photos of Kunming's old teahouses she had seen at the Provincial Library. After hearing this, Mother also recalled how her father had taken her to that kind of old teahouse. At 6 p.m., the family of three sat down to dinner on time. I had made stir-fried broccoli and chicken breast with tomatoes, and my father Sun Mingyuan also sat down. At the table, I described in detail the old maps of the Jinma Archway and Wenming Street I had seen at the Provincial Library, sharing the old street scenes in the historical records and how they have changed today. Father listened with great interest and added some old stories, while Mother happily asked whether today's goal of drinking 1.5 liters of water had been met.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entries, editor feedback, and video call with sister.
description: After dinner, she rested for a while and then returned to her room. Using a new pen, she drew a small-seal-script sticker silhouette of “City Gazetteer” in her journal and sorted the keywords she had copied at the library today—“Golden Horse Archway,” “Wenming Street,” “Old Teahouse”—recording them with a combination of drawing and text. She also added the note “link to Elder Li’s oral account at Bowen Book House” as a clue for future writing. At 7:15 pm she opened WeChat and saw a voice message reply from editor Xu Mingyuan, who was very interested in the newly revised version. He affirmed the approach of weaving historical materials into the old-street descriptions and also suggested making the market scenes in the “Mushroom Season” chapter more detailed. After listening carefully, she wrote down the suggestions in her notebook and replied that she would continue polishing it tomorrow. Then, as usual, she had a video call with her sister Sun Yutong, who works in Shenzhen. Her sister shared the joy of launching her company’s new project, while Sun Yuwei talked about the sense of achievement from her 1.2-kilometer morning run and the excitement of unearthing “treasure” historical materials at the provincial library. Her sister praised her for becoming more and more able to get things done, and the two agreed to meet in Kunming next month when her sister takes leave and to go to Dounan Flower Market together.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read “Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan” and organized the results of manuscript revisions
description: After hanging up the video call, she took out Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan, referred to her journal, and read key passages describing the street life of Wenming Street. She found that the book's descriptions of street vendors "selling water pipes and grilled rice cakes" were highly consistent with the records in the Wuhua District Gazetteer, and she excitedly made annotations in the book. Then she used her laptop to organize today's revision results and tomorrow's plan: go to the provincial library in the morning to add details about the mushroom market, and finish polishing the last two chapters at the bookstore in the afternoon.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening wash-up and relaxation
description: Took a comfortable hot shower, changed into pajamas, and felt all the fatigue in her body disappear. Then she brought over a basin of hot water, added a mugwort foot-soaking pack, and began soaking her feet. Meanwhile, she opened her phone and played the saved Rain Sounds White Noise playlist, letting both body and mind completely relax.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and daily journal summary
description: After soaking her feet, she leaned against the headboard, picked up the bedside copy of Essays in Idleness, and casually read two sections, savoring the quiet, serene beauty of the words as her thoughts gradually calmed. She turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on, then took out her journal and wrote a short daily summary: [Morning run 1.2km] [Provincial Library archival gains] [Rewrites: main body of chapters four to six completed] [Editor feedback]. After setting her alarm for 6:30 a.m. the next morning, she turned off the light and fell asleep with a satisfying sense of accomplishment from a full day, already silently planning tomorrow's route to the Provincial Library.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off on time, and Sun Yuwei woke from sleep. Though the soreness in her legs from the previous morning's run was still there, she was in good spirits. She quickly washed up, changed into comfortable cotton-linen loungewear, took out her mint-green journal, and jotted down her plan for the day: "Spend time at the provincial library, dig into city gazetteers, browse the bookstore, draft an outline, and do evening yoga to relax my shoulders and neck." Her mother, Li Xiulan, had already cooked steaming small-pot rice noodles in mushroom soup and specially added a boiled egg. While eating breakfast, Yuwei opened her diet app and carefully logged: "Breakfast: 1 bowl of small-pot rice noodles, 1 boiled egg." Seeing that rice noodles had dominated yesterday's food log, she added a note in the app with today's goal: hit the protein target and quit milk tea for good!
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Organize backpack and prepare for departure.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to her room to pack her canvas bag. She carefully checked the items she needed to bring: a power bank, a notebook, two pens of different colors, and a voice recorder. She also deliberately put in "Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan," which she had thought might be useful when reserving at the provincial library yesterday. Before leaving, she tied a neat ponytail in front of the mirror in the entryway, made sure her phone, access card, and other items were all with her, and then left home.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk to the Provincial Library
description: Walking out of the community entrance, Sun Yuwei headed south along Huashan West Road, turned onto Cuihu South Road, and walked to the Yunnan Provincial Library. The morning air was fresh and pleasant, and the plane tree leaves along the road swayed gently in the breeze. She took a deep breath, felt refreshed, and arrived at the library after about a 15-minute walk.
location: Sidewalk on Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Immersive archival research
description: After entering the Yunnan Provincial Library, Sun Yuwei went straight to the local documents room on the third floor, sat in the reserved window-side corner, and began digging into historical materials on the old Kunming street Yangshikou and the Heijing salt merchants. She first looked through the Commerce Volume of the Kunming City Annals for records of the predecessor of the Mushuihua Wild Mushroom Market from the 1940s to the 1980s, photographed key pages with her phone, and copied key place names and time points into her notebook, such as the Mushroom Street on Nanba Road and the Mountain Goods Market at Xiaobanqiao in Guandu District. Then she consulted the Wuhua District Annals and found detailed descriptions of Yangshikou and records that merchants from Heijing had transported large quantities of ganba mushrooms from southern Yunnan to Kunming for trade. These details excited her greatly, and she felt the past of the old street coming alive before her eyes.
location: China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 141 Cuihu South Road, Yunnan Provincial Library, 3rd Floor, Local Literature Room

name: Lunch and post-lunch rest.
description: Seeing readers coming in and out of the reference room, she also felt hungry. Sun Yuwei packed up her laptop and walked to the nearby Maitianjia Bakery & Café she often went to. She ordered a vegetable chicken salad and a cup of unsweetened soy milk. Sitting by the window, she recorded in her food diary app while eating: "Lunch: vegetable chicken salad, unsweetened soy milk". Both protein and vegetables were sufficient, and she felt very satisfied. Since sitting for a long time right after a meal is not good, she decided to take a walk around Cuihu Park to help digestion. She walked slowly along the lakeside path for about 15 minutes, watching wild ducks playing on the lake and elderly people exercising in the distance, letting her eyes and mind relax. After that, she returned to the library and rested with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes on the bench in the lobby rest area, regaining energy for the afternoon.
location: Maitianjia Bakery and Light Meal Restaurant near Yunnan Provincial Library, No. 141 South Cuihu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China; the tree-lined path around the outer edge of Green Lake Park; and the rest area in the lobby of Yunnan Provincial Library

name: Continue verifying historical materials and organizing notes.
description: After a short break, Sun Yuwei returned to the Local Literature Room on the third floor, refreshed. She opened her laptop, categorized all the materials she had photographed that morning, and cross-checked them with the descriptions of "market fairs" in the copy of "Miscellaneous Records of Central Yunnan" she had brought with her. She found that "Yangshikou" was not only an important distribution center for mushrooms in that era, but also a trading hub for salt, cloth, and mountain goods. These discoveries filled her with confidence to rewrite the "Old Street" chapter. She drew a timeline and a spatial distribution map in her notebook, laying a solid foundation for starting to write the next day.
location: China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 141 Cuihu South Road, Yunnan Provincial Library, 3rd Floor, Local Literature Room

name: Move on to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: After working continuously in the library for nearly six hours, Sun Yuwei packed up all her materials and walked to Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. She had walked this route many times, and the rich cultural atmosphere along the way lifted her spirits; it took about 15 minutes on foot to reach the bookstore.
location: Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Systematically organize and establish a writing framework at the bookstore
description: The moment she entered the bookstore, the familiar smell of coffee and books greeted her. Sun Yuwei said hello to Uncle Qin, the owner, then went straight upstairs to her usual seat by the window. She took out her laptop, imported all the historical photos she had taken on her phone, and organized them by keywords such as 'architecture,' 'shops,' 'folk customs,' and 'mushroom market.' Then, she created a new folder called 'Old Street Rewriting' in her writing software, and based on what she had learned that day, she made a timeline of key points to rewrite and key images, such as 'the taste of litsea cubeba,' 'the dialect of bargaining,' and 'red soil in bamboo baskets.' It made her feel as if she had found the last few pieces of a puzzle, and it felt wonderful.
location: Workstation on the second floor of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: After finishing the sorting work at the bookstore, Sun Yuwei picked up her backpack and hurried to Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road. The two places were close, so it took her less than ten minutes on foot.
location: Cuihu North Road to Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Yoga class preparation and discussion
description: After arriving at the yoga studio, Sun Yuwei changed into her yoga clothes in the changing room. In the lounge, she met the instructor He Lu and brought up the shoulder and neck issues she had after running the day before, asking whether that day's yin yoga class focused on stretching. He Lu told her that there would be several poses specifically for the shoulders, neck, and spinal twists, and advised her to coordinate with deep breathing while holding them. Yuwei also shared her food diary with He Lu, who was satisfied with her protein intake and encouraged her to keep it up.
location: Rest area, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Yin yoga class
description: When the class began, the lights in the studio were dimmed to a soft glow. Under the gentle guidance of the instructor He Lu and soothing music, Sun Yuwei felt the soreness and relaxation in her body while holding poses for a long time. Especially in Child's Pose and Supine Spinal Twist, the fatigue from sitting for a long time in the library the day before was greatly released. She focused on her breathing and felt the tension in her shoulders and neck gradually melt away.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, large classroom, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: After-class discussion and walking home.
description: After class, Sun Yuwei waited at the entrance of the building for He Lu to change and come out, and they briefly exchanged notes on today's food diary. She showed He Lu the app screenshots. He Lu praised that the lunch was well matched, encouraged her to keep it up, and also shared a high-protein bagel she had recently tried. After chatting for a few minutes, Yuwei said goodbye to He Lu and walked home along the familiar route. The sky was getting dark, streetlights were already on along the roadside, and a gentle breeze was blowing; after yoga, both body and mind felt relaxed and at ease.
location: From Dongfeng West Road to Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: When she got home, her mother Li Xiulan had already prepared a hearty dinner. Her father Sun Mingyuan had specially gone to the deli downstairs to buy half a roast chicken, and her mother had also made a pot of mushroom and tofu soup. Although they had not ordered hot pot delivery, the light yet nutritious meal suited everyone's taste. At the table, Sun Yuwei excitedly shared what she had discovered at the library that day: stories about "Yangshikou" and "Heijing merchants". Her father listened with great interest and added that Heijing's salt had long been famous, and that traders exchanging salt for mountain products was a common sight on the ancient roads of Yunnan. The whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Organizing study materials and planning creative work
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei came to the study, organized the notes she had taken today, the photos she had taken, and the book “Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan”, and checked that all materials had been imported into the computer and backed up. Then she opened the essay collection document, and under the newly created “Old Street Rewrite” folder, based on the key points she had listed in the afternoon, worked out the specific structure for tomorrow’s writing: the first section would describe the bustle of the early market at the Mushroom Market, the second section the geography and culture behind the market, and the third section would close with personal feelings. Looking at this clear framework, she felt full of anticipation for tomorrow’s rewrite.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening journaling
description: Sun Yuwei took out her beloved journal and drew a timeline of the day's events with colored pens, highlighting the discovery of 'Yangshikou' at the Provincial Library and the sense of accomplishment from listing the rewrite points at the bookstore. In the corner of the page she drew a cute little ganbajun mushroom and wrote beside it: 'Fresh material get!'. Then she opened her diet app, reviewed today's records, and after confirming there was no milk tea intake, sent herself a note: 'Protein target hit, successfully stayed off milk tea, keep it up!'
location: Home study/bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Washing up and relaxing with a foot soak
description: After recording all the thoughts of the day, Sun Yuwei got up and went to the bathroom. She took a hot shower, then soaked her feet with the mugwort pouch her mother had prepared for her. The warm water wrapped around her feet, and the fatigue of the whole day drifted away.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Reading and relaxing before bed
description: Sun Yuwei changed into comfortable pajamas, leaned against the headboard, opened Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan, and reread several passages about market trading that she had paid special attention to in the library today. The vividness of the text made her look forward to tomorrow's writing. She put her phone on the bedside table, ready to let her mind and body sink into sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Going to bed
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the bedside lamp, slowly closed her eyes with full enthusiasm for tomorrow’s creative work, and quickly fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Wake-up and health record
description: Woken by birdsong outside the window, sunlight poured into the bedroom. In a cheerful mood, she stepped on the scale and confirmed her weight was 45.2kg, then carefully logged the morning data in a diet app. After a quick wash-up, she changed into the cotton-linen shirt and khaki trousers prepared for the photography class, and carefully checked the camera battery and memory card.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and brief journal entries
description: Mother had already prepared breakfast: warm milk, boiled eggs, and whole-wheat bread with blueberry jam. At the table, I shared my reflections on reading 'Essays in Idleness' with her, and she said with a laugh, 'You're always thinking about books.' I quickly drew simple sun and cloud sketches in my journal and noted my mood as 'full of anticipation.'
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Yunnan University
description: Walking along Green Lake South Road in the early morning, with a gentle breeze on my face and plane tree leaves rustling, I headed to the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University, full of anticipation for the photography class.
location: From Cuihu South Road to No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Outdoor photography: the beauty of symmetry in old buildings
description: She gathered with her teacher and classmates in front of Huize Hall at Yunnan University for the course themed 'The Beauty of Symmetry in Old Architecture.' In the corridor of the School of History, she learned about symmetrical composition, used aperture-priority mode to shoot details of the relief carvings, captured light and shadow, and took dozens of satisfying photos.
location: Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Transitioned to walking to Zhibushi Bookstore.
description: After the outdoor shoot, she walked to Zhibushi Bookstore. Passing a bakery along the way, she was attracted by the sweet aroma, but because of her dietary goals she only glanced at the new bread through the window and continued on.
location: No. 2 Cuihu North Road to No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Settling into the bookstore and preparing coffee
description: Entered Zhibushi Bookstore, greeted owner Qin Mingyuan, and ordered a lightly sweetened osmanthus latte. Went to the dedicated workstation on the second floor, put down my backpack, connected my computer, opened a light music playlist, and prepared to enter a writing state.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Finalized and backed up the final chapter of the essay collection.
description: I put on headphones and immersed myself in writing. Based on feedback from my supervisor and editor, I revised the last three chapters and the afterword of the essay collection, unified the language style, completed the final draft, and backed it up on both the cloud and a portable hard drive. I left the 'Old Street' chapter blank for now, marked as to be rewritten.
location: Second-floor workstation at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and calorie management.
description: Went to Binhu Restaurant, ordered a green pepper and pork rice bowl and lemonade, and logged the calories in a diet app. After the meal, relaxed by the street, stepping away from the intense writing, and watched the crowd on Wenlin Street.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking to the café
description: Walking along Wenlin Street to the Go-for-a-Walk Café, after receiving Zhou Lin's WeChat message I quickened my pace, sorting out ideas for the floral sticker copy in my head.
location: No. 202 Wenlin Street to No. 48 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Brainstorming for a floral sticker collaboration
description: In a café with Zhou Lin, she drank osmanthus latte and, using the Illustrated Flora of Kunming, finalized six local flowers as the theme for the first season: camellia, jacaranda, magnolia, rose, primrose, and dandelion. Zhou Lin was responsible for line drawings and watercolors, and Sun Yuwei was responsible for the 50-character floral caption for each sticker. They agreed to submit the first draft by August 14.
location: The 'Sanbuqu' independent cafe at No. 48 Wenlin Street, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the farmers' market
description: After saying goodbye to Zhou Lin, she walked through alleys full of everyday life to Haoshun Road Farmers' Market; along the way, vendors' sugar-roasted chestnuts and roasted sweet potatoes exuded a rich, lively atmosphere.
location: No. 48 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province to No. 31 Qianju Street

name: Purchase healthy ingredients
description: At the bustling farmers' market, she bought free-range eggs, Red Fuji apples, bananas, broccoli, water spinach, and a pack of dried mushrooms. She logged the expenses in a diet app, found that her vegetable intake for the day met the target, and felt happy.
location: Haoshun Road Farmers' Market, No. 31 Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home
description: Carrying two large bags of ingredients, she strolled home. Once home, she put the eggs in the refrigerator and the vegetables in a colander, savoring life's little joys.
location: No. 31 Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Brief rest and replying to messages
description: Sitting on the living room sofa drinking warm water and replying to WeChat messages, she shared thumbnails from today's photography class in the family group. Her sister instantly replied, "Beautiful!" and she switched back from outdoor-shooting and writing mode to family mode.
location: Dining table in the living room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and in-depth conversation
description: The family of three had dinner together. Mother made stir-fried water spinach, broccoli with shrimp, and tomato and egg soup. We shared photography class tips and flower sticker ideas. Father suggested writing copy inspired by the camellia culture of the Spring City, and Mother congratulated me on finalizing the essay collection. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Photo selection and journal records.
description: On the computer, I used Lightroom to select and edit the photos taken at Yunnan University. Then, in my Midori journal, I wrote down today's three good things in a gray fountain pen: the essay collection was finalized, the café brainstorming was great, and at dinner I listened to my father tell stories about the old streets. I added a casual line drawing of a camellia.
location: Cuihu Community Home Study, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Soaking feet and evening reading.
description: After washing up, I boiled water to soak my feet and relax my legs. While soaking, I read 'Miscellaneous Records of Central Yunnan' and found the passages about 'Yangshikou', which corroborated the materials for rewriting the old street. I felt satisfied.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and meditation before bed
description: Lying in bed, she continued reading Essays in Idleness, then turned off the light, put on earphones, and meditated for 10 minutes, focusing on her breath and letting her body and mind gradually relax after the day's fullness.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Plan tomorrow's arrangements.
description: In her phone’s memo app, she planned Sunday: in the morning, rewrite the “Old Street” chapter; in the afternoon, go to the supermarket to stock up on yogurt and nuts; in the evening, preview the modern and contemporary literature course.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to bed
description: Putting down her phone, she fell into a peaceful sleep, carrying the day's sense of fulfillment and anticipation for the new day.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Getting up and morning tidying.
description: Woken up by the alarm, it was cloudy outside the window. After getting up, I went to the bathroom to wash up, gently cleaned the blister on my left heel with warm water, and applied a breathable adhesive bandage. Then I changed into comfortable loungewear for a fresh start to the day.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Cloudy, 19-24°C
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Confirm the manuscript payment has arrived and record it in the accounts.
description: Back at the desk in the bedroom, I opened the mobile banking app to confirm that the 1,200 yuan article payment had arrived. I took out my personal journal, and on the finance page neatly wrote down the date, the source—“Column fee from Cultural Horizon”—and the amount with a fountain pen, and drew a small payment-received symbol beside it, feeling a sense of accomplishment from my first clear income coming in.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Review diet records and develop an adjustment plan.
description: Logged into the health management app and reviewed the diet records from August 6 to 9. The analysis found that vegetable intake was insufficient, especially dark leafy greens, while protein was basically adequate. I wrote this week's adjustment plan on a sticky note: every lunch must include a serving of leafy greens, and replace some refined rice with millet and brown rice to optimize the nutritional structure.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Buy a week's worth of healthy ingredients at the supermarket.
description: Carrying a canvas bag and a shopping list prepared in advance, she walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. In the supermarket, she selected broccoli, spinach, tomatoes, cucumbers, chicken breast, eggs, millet, and brown rice according to the list, and also grabbed two fresh lemons to soak in water. At checkout, she used her membership discount and saved more than ten yuan.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Making lunch and relaxing during the lunch break
description: After returning home, she sorted the purchased ingredients and put them into the refrigerator. Then she began preparing lunch: she made a stir-fried spinach dish with the freshly bought spinach and eggs, and cooked millet congee. While eating, she used an app to log the dishes and calories, fulfilling her dietary adjustment requirements. After the meal, she leaned back on the living room sofa and listened to her favorite folk music. The sunlight streamed through the curtains onto the floor, and she felt very relaxed. She also browsed through the photos she had taken yesterday and deleted a few whose composition she was not satisfied with.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Exchanged thoughts on watercolor works with her close friend Zhou Lin online.
description: Opened WeChat and looked at several scanned watercolor hand-painted images sent by my friend Zhou Lin. The jacaranda in the pictures had light, translucent brushstrokes and elegant colors; I was instantly drawn in. I replied seriously with voice messages, describing in detail my favorite details and parts, asked about the paint and brush brands she used, and together we recalled the fun times of visiting flower markets. We had a wonderful conversation.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online).

name: Monthly financial review and establishment of a travel fund
description: She opened her journal and the expense-tracking app and carefully checked the expenses that had occurred this month: yoga renewal 800 yuan, running shoes 369 yuan, watercolor class registration fee 450 yuan, and miscellaneous meals about 1,200 yuan, totaling about 2,819 yuan. Adding the 1,200 yuan royalty that had just arrived and the previous balance, she calculated the available balance for the month. Then, with great deliberation, she wrote the goal of setting aside 800 yuan under the “Short Trip Travel Fund” column in her diary: “Go to Jianshui Ancient City, eat baked tofu, and ride the little train.”
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Explore beginner watercolor learning resources.
description: She browsed watercolor painting tutorials on Xiaohongshu, from choosing paper for beginners to basic water-control techniques, and was deeply drawn to a flower-painting video. She went to the blogger's homepage, saved three detailed beginner tutorials, and added a set of basic watercolor paints and two recommended brushes to her shopping cart, planning to wait for Zhou Lin's recommendations before making a final decision.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Have dinner with parents and share expense-tracking insights.
description: She prepared dinner in the kitchen with her mother, Li Xiulan, cooking millet porridge, making smashed cucumber salad, and pan-frying two chicken breasts. At the dinner table, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to mention that she had received her manuscript payment today and had carefully kept her accounts. Her mother was gratified and encouraged her to develop good habits; her father smiled and said that money should be spent where it counts, supporting her using it for writing and fieldwork trips, which made her feel at ease.
location: Home kitchen and living room dining table, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk and restocking personal care items at the pharmacy
description: After dinner, she accompanied her parents for a walk to the nearby Cuihu Park, which was very lively. Then they went to the Yixintang Great Health Pharmacy at the community entrance (next to the north gate of Junzhuanye Compound on Ru'an Street). She bought a small bottle of povidone-iodine and a box of large breathable band-aids to replenish supplies for the follow-up care of the blister on her left heel. During the walk, the family talked about her elder sister Sun Yutong's recent work.
location: Streets near Cuihu Park in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the Yixintang Health Pharmacy on Ru'an Street

name: Personal hobby time: journal sorting and flower arrangement practice
description: Back in her room, she first copied the key points and tool recommendations from the afternoon watercolor tutorial into her journal, titled "The First Thing I Want to Learn—Watercolor," and pasted in today's grocery shopping list. Then she unwrapped the flowers bought yesterday and practiced the free-style vase arrangement she learned in flower arranging class, repeatedly adjusting the angles of the flowers and leaves, enjoying a therapeutic creative time.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime skincare, meditation, and reading
description: First, she took a hot shower. After showering, she carefully examined the blister on her left heel, disinfected it with a cotton swab dipped in povidone-iodine, and applied a newly bought band-aid; the blister no longer hurt. Then she turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp, and sat in meditation for 5 minutes using the abdominal breathing method learned in yoga class, experiencing a moment of mental clarity. After calming down, she wrote down today's feelings in her diary, noting that 800 yuan became the ticket to Jianshui and that the seed of watercolor painting was becoming clearer in her heart. Finally, she picked up Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan by the bedside and read for ten minutes. When drowsiness came, she turned off the light and went to sleep, recharging for tomorrow.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom bed, Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparations and brisk walk around Cuihu Lake
description: Woke up naturally at 6:30 in the morning, full of energy. After changing into workout clothes, carefully checked the blister on her left heel, disinfected it with iodophor, and applied a waterproof bandage. After a quick wash, drank a glass of warm water and walked about 5 minutes to Cuihu Park. Since the blister on her foot had not healed, she switched to brisk walking for 40 minutes. On the lakeside boardwalk she met her friend He Lu, and they walked side by side, excitedly sharing how stunning Zhou Lin's watercolor paintings had been last night. He Lu asked about the blister and reminded her to adjust her diet gradually.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Breakfast and collecting introductory watercolor information
description: Returned home at 7:30, took a shower, and changed into loungewear. Mother had already prepared hot rice noodles. While eating breakfast, I scrolled through Xiaohongshu and Bilibili and saved 3 videos of 'Must-buy tools for watercolor beginners' and 2 guides on 'Learning watercolor from scratch.' After breakfast, I went back to the study, turned on the computer to systematically organize the collected information, joined the 'Watercolor Painting for Beginners' group on Douban, and browsed featured posts. Then I opened the shopping app, added Sakura solid watercolors, Baohong watercolor paper, several nylon brushes, and other tools to the cart, but did not buy them immediately, planning to ask Zhou Lin before deciding tomorrow.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuted to Paper Stone Bookstore
description: Packed the commuter bag, took the laptop, notebook, and journal, said goodbye to my mother, and went out. Walked 5 minutes to the Renmin Middle Road bus stop, took Bus No. 65 for 3 stops, about 15 minutes, and got off at Wenlin Street Entrance. After getting off, walked 5 minutes to Wenlin Street. Passing Aitami Bakery, bought an oat latte and a bag of whole-wheat scones as supplies for the morning at the bookstore.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning column writing
description: At 9:30, she arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore, chose the quietest corner seat by the window with good light and sat down. She opened her laptop and began writing the August column 'The Cultural Texture of Kunming's Independent Bookstores' for Cultural Horizons. Around 11:30, the bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, passed by, handed her a stack of handwritten notes titled 'Anecdotes of Old Bookstores', and talked about his feelings about the old bookstores that had vanished on Dongfeng Road, giving her new writing inspiration. While thinking, she jotted down a few key points in her journal.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and a walk on Wenlin Street
description: At 12 o'clock I closed my computer, walked about 3 minutes to the Lakeside Restaurant on Wenlin Street, and ordered a serving of mushroom fried rice and a bowl of winter melon soup. After eating, I strolled slowly along Wenlin Street to aid digestion, looking at the windows of secondhand bookstores by the roadside.
location: Binhu Hotel, 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Wenlin Street

name: Afternoon column writing
description: Back at Zhibushi Bookstore, she buried herself in writing again. Using the materials Uncle Qin had given her, she wrote about another 1,500 words and polished the opening section from the morning. Midway, her eyes felt sore, so she stood up, strolled between the bookshelves, and flipped through a copy of "Anecdotes of Yunnan." Then she organized the watercolor tool list and purchase decision points onto a dedicated page in her journal.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying medicine on the way home and afternoon yoga.
description: At 14:30, she packed up her things and said goodbye to Uncle Qin. On the way to the bus stop, she stopped at a Yixintang Pharmacy on the roadside and bought a box of new adhesive bandages and a small bottle of povidone-iodine. She took Bus 65 back home on Renmin Middle Road. She arrived home around 15:00, changed into her yoga clothes, and did a 15-minute relaxation sequence on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on stretching her shoulders, neck, and legs.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flower arranging and reading time
description: At 15:10 she began practicing flower arranging, adjusting the gladioli and daisies bought at Dounan Flower Market last week and rearranging them into a more layered composition. After that, she curled up on the bean bag on the balcony, listened to a folk song playlist, and continued reading Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan. When she reached the part about Bai tie-dye in Dali, she jotted down some notes in her notebook.
location: Balcony and study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped her mother prepare dinner and talked with her.
description: At 5:30 p.m., she went into the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic and trim vegetables. While they worked, she described what she had learned from chatting with Uncle Qin at the bookstore today and her plan to learn watercolor painting. Her mother was very supportive and said she could go with her tomorrow to check out the stationery store on Wenhua Lane.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the dining table enjoying dinner. Her father asked about her writing progress and shared what he had seen and heard at the bookstore that day. The atmosphere around the table was warm.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Late-night video chat with best friend Zhang Jing
description: After dinner, returned to the bedroom and proactively sent a video call invitation to my best friend Zhang Jing; the call lasted nearly 50 minutes. She excitedly shared the funny story about the naughtiest boy in her class drawing an 'ugly turtle that won an art award' today, which made me laugh out loud. I also shared my new inspiration for writing a column with her, and the two of us agreed to visit the newly opened 'Awakening Bookstore' together next Saturday.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and reading.
description: After hanging up the phone, she sat down at her desk, took out a new journal, first drew a simple sketch of the two mandarin ducks she had seen in Green Lake during the brisk walk today, and then recorded the day's experiences in detail. She organized her reading notes on 'Miscellaneous Records of Central Yunnan' and set aside a separate page for her inspiration about tie-dye.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime preparation, meditation, and reading
description: At 21:30, I began my pre-sleep skincare routine and changed into pajamas. Sitting cross-legged on the cushion at the foot of the bed, I did a 5-minute meditation exercise, trying to focus on my breath. At 22:00, I leaned against the headboard, opened Miscellaneous Records of Central Yunnan, and leisurely read a chapter about old Kunming teahouses for 20 minutes.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sleep
description: At 22:30, she turned off the lights on time and checked the blisters on her feet. Thinking that she could ask Zhou Lin about watercolor the next day, she fell into a deep sleep with hope for the future.
location: At home, on the bed, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and phone browsing
description: At 7 a.m., the phone alarm went off right on time. It was cloudy outside, with soft light. The blister on her left heel from yesterday's brisk walk around Green Lake had healed, leaving her feeling light on her feet. Sun Yuwei opened the curtains, heard her mother moving around in the kitchen, and flipped through her phone with a happy heart. When she confirmed the appointment to meet Yang Xiao that afternoon, the corners of her mouth curled up unconsciously.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and morning planning
description: Sun Yuwei spent 15 minutes washing up and tied her hair into a neat ponytail. Back in the bedroom, she quickly scanned the day's priorities in her journal: finish the flower language copy in the morning, prepare the gift, and meet Yang Xiao in the afternoon. The floral sticker materials and reference resources she needed were already neatly arranged on her desk.
location: The bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Sun Yuwei comes to the dining room; her mother, Li Xiulan, has already cooked steaming hot small-pot rice noodles topped with chives and minced pork. While eating, she tells her mother that she will meet a literary friend from Chengdu in the afternoon. Her mother smiles and reminds her to treat the friend well, asking whether she should prepare some fruit to bring along. Sun Yuwei says the teahouse has it covered, and compliments her mother's cooking.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: After-meal cleanup and preparation for writing.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei helped her mother clear the dishes into the kitchen, rinsed them briefly, and put them back on the dish rack. Outside the window, the clouds in the direction of Green Lake were thin, and the weather was pleasant. Back at her desk, she prepared her laptop, reference books for the essay collection, flower stickers, and a black pen, ready to start the morning's writing.
location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; the dining room and kitchen at home.

name: Completed the first draft of flower-language copy for the floral stickers
description: Sun Yuwei officially wrote the accompanying flower-language copy for Zhou Lin's flower sticker project. Fully focused, she quickly skimmed 'Plant Culture' and several essay collections to find inspiration for six flowers: camellia, jacaranda, rose, lily, daisy, and hyacinth. She positioned the camellia's flower language as 'ideal love and humility,' and the jacaranda's as 'tranquility and far-reaching vision, and the beauty of solitude.' For each flower she wrote about 200-250 words, blending literary imagery with reflections on life, carefully weighing every phrase. By 11 o'clock the first draft was basically complete. After reading it through and polishing it, she sent it to Zhou Lin via WeChat with the message: 'Linlin, the first draft is done. See if the style and word count are OK. If you have any ideas, just say so anytime~'
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Carefully prepared a meet-up gift for a literary friend.
description: Sun Yuwei took out the carefully chosen cloth-bound journal from her desk drawer, wrapped it neatly in cotton paper, and tied it with a piece of hemp string. From the storage cabinet, she took out two boxes of Kunming’s local Pan Xiangji flower cakes and put them in a kraft paper bag as a gift for Yang Xiao. She then sent Yang Xiao a WeChat message: “Sister Xiao, I’m all ready! See you at Tingyuxuan this afternoon~” Yang Xiao quickly replied with a smiley face and a “Looking forward to it!” sticker.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Had a simple lunch with my mother and confirmed the itinerary.
description: The mother and daughter simply cooked two bowls of vegetable and egg noodles. As she ate, Sun Yuwei checked her phone; Yang Xiao had arrived in Kunming half an hour ago and settled into the hotel. She opened the map app and planned the route from home to Cuihu Tingyuxuan Teahouse, planning to leave early and buy a cup of milk tea on the way past Xuefu Road.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Cycled to Xuefu Road to buy milk tea
description: Sun Yuwei carried a cloth bag full of gifts, went out, scanned a shared bike on the roadside, and rode toward the 1 Diandian milk tea shop on Xuefu Road. The breeze brushed her face, and her heart was light.
location: In Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, cycling from Renmin Middle Road to Xuefu Road

name: Bought milk tea and cycled to Tingyuxuan Teahouse at Cuihu.
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at the 1 Dian Dian milk tea shop at No. 275 Xuefu Road and bought a medium brown sugar pearl milk tea (30% sugar, no ice). Then she continued cycling and arrived at the Tingyuxuan Teahouse by Cuihu Lake in less than 10 minutes.
location: 1 Diandian Milk Tea Shop, No. 275 Xuefu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, then to Cuihu Tingyuxuan Teahouse, No. 70 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District.

name: In-depth exchange with literary friends at Cuihu Teahouse
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at Tingyuxuan Teahouse ahead of time, chose a seat by the window overlooking the lotus pond, and ordered raw Pu-erh tea and two portions of osmanthus cake. At around 1:20 p.m., Yang Xiao appeared with a canvas bag and black-framed glasses; they smiled at each other. Yang Xiao gave her in return a limited-edition poetry collection from Chengdu’s “Yiwei Bookstore” and a few red panda refrigerator magnets. They started by talking about the novels they were each writing, then moved on to the aesthetics of loneliness in “Tokyo Eight Square Meters” and the stories of writing letters for others in “The Camellia Stationery Shop,” before extending to Ryuichi Sakamoto’s musical philosophy and Shen Congwen’s Xiangxi world. Yang Xiao shared amusing stories from Chengdu’s cultural scene, while Sun Yuwei shared her daily life of journaling and flower arranging. The aroma of tea and the scent of books intermingled. Midway, Sun Yuwei shared the brown sugar pearl milk tea she had brought, and Yang Xiao brought out homemade cookies. Their conversation lasted until 4:30 p.m., filled with easy laughter.
location: Cuihu Rain-Listening Pavilion Teahouse, No. 70 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dusk stroll around Green Lake and a reluctant farewell
description: The two walked out of the teahouse and strolled along the embankment of Green Lake. The soft evening light gilded the lotus pond and weeping willows with a golden edge. They naturally talked about their urban lives and family upbringings. Sun Yuwei shared an amusing story about seeing Uncle Qin at Zhibushi Bookstore yesterday, and Yang Xiao remarked on how cool and pleasant Kunming's early summer evenings were. Passing a creative goods stall, they each chose a handmade brass bookmark. When they reached the north gate of the park, it was almost 7 p.m. Reluctantly, they said goodbye, agreeing to meet again when Sun Yuwei went to Chengdu, and Yang Xiao would send her prose draft to her. After wishing each other well and taking a commemorative photo, they went their separate ways.
location: Cuihu South Road, Cuihu West Road, and Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (inside Cuihu Park)

name: Walked home alone and savored the afternoon.
description: Sun Yuwei walked home alone along Huashan West Road. The streetlights had just come on in the evening, and the air was filled with the aroma of dinner. As she walked, she savored the afternoon’s conversation, feeling warm and fulfilled inside. She took photos of the evening sky and the streetlights with her phone and saved them to the “Today’s Memories” album.
location: Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - walking from Green Lake Park back to the residence on Renmin Middle Road.

name: Shared funny stories from the meeting with my mother and had dinner together.
description: When she got home, her mother Li Xiulan had already prepared the meal. While washing her hands, Sun Yuwei eagerly talked about Yang Xiao she had met that day: the poetry collection she gave, the writers they discussed, and the cultural atmosphere of Chengdu. Her mother listened with great interest and asked whether all Chengdu girls were as well-spoken as Yang Xiao. Sun Yuwei smiled and nodded, and the mother and daughter shared dinner in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Immersive journaling to record today's gathering
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the study, turned on the desk lamp, and took out her beloved journal. She neatly laid out today’s café receipt, the refrigerator magnet Yang Xiao gave her, the Green Lake cultural-creative bookmark, and a postcard printed with the language of flowers. Using colored pencils, she drew a “mental map” of this meeting, depicting the view outside the teahouse window, pasted in the photo of the cover of the poetry collection Yang Xiao had given her, and neatly wrote down the key points and feelings with a calligraphy pen: “From urban loneliness to literary ideals, kindred souls met at Green Lake.” She wrote very slowly and attentively, hoping to seal every feeling of this day into the pages.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Thanked Yang Xiao, made plans to meet again, and did evening skincare.
description: After finishing the journal, Sun Yuwei immediately sent Yang Xiao a WeChat message: “Thank you, Sister Xiao, I'm so happy today! Looking forward to your prose draft.” She also attached the photos she took today. Yang Xiao quickly replied: “Me too! Today was amazing. I absolutely loved your journal gift! I'll send you the draft as soon as I'm back in Chengdu! Good night~” Afterward, Sun Yuwei went to the bathroom for a quick evening skincare routine.
location: Home study and bathroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Read Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan and meditate before bed.
description: Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas, lay in bed, and read the chapter 'Old Tales of Cuihu Lake' from 'Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan,' savoring what she had seen and felt at Cuihu Lake that day. Around 22:40 she put down the book, turned off the main light, left only the bedside lamp, and did a 5-minute meditation, focusing on the touching moment when Yang Xiao handed her the poetry collection. Her heart was filled with peace and gratitude.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Set an alarm clock and get ready for bed.
description: After meditation, drowsiness washed over her. Sun Yuwei set her alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning, put her phone into Do Not Disturb mode, whispered "goodnight" to herself, then turned off the light and fell asleep in warmth and contentment.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake up and morning routine
description: Woken by sunlight streaming through the mint green curtains. Stepping barefoot onto the floor, she subconsciously checked the blister on her left heel—it had mostly subsided, leaving only a slight redness and no pain when pressed. She decided to let her foot rest another day and resume morning running tomorrow. She picked up her phone, crossed off the 'check blister' memo she had written last night in her journal app, and noted in the health log: 'Recovering well; slow jog tomorrow.'
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home bedroom)

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Following the aroma of small-pot rice noodles, I walked into the kitchen. Mom was filling the bowls and said with a smile, “You got up just in time. I put a little more pickled cabbage.” Taking the bowl, I first sipped the hot soup, and warmth spread from my stomach. While eating, I chatted with Mom about today's plan: “I signed up for a watercolor class this morning, and I'll go to Mingyuan Bookstore to write this afternoon. I'll be back in the evening for class. Do you need me to buy anything nearby on the way?” Mom shook her head and told me to be careful riding my bike.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home kitchen)

name: Sent work-related WeChat messages and confirmations.
description: After breakfast, she returned to her room, opened WeChat, and sent a message to Zhou Lin: “Linlin, good morning! Have you seen the flower-language captions? Feel free to share any thoughts anytime~ Don't hesitate if you need me to make changes! By the way, I signed up for a watercolor class, so I can draw materials for you in the future, haha!” After sending the message, she opened last night's memo and quickly went through the list of art supplies to buy today (Sakura solid watercolors, Baohong cold-pressed paper, Qiuhongzhai brushes, masking fluid), making sure nothing was missing.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Signing up online for a pre-recorded watercolor course
description: Sat at the desk, opened the laptop, and logged into the watercolor teaching platform saved in her bookmarks. After comparing the course outlines and teacher styles of two basic courses, she chose the recorded course that had high ratings and a systematic 8-week schedule. Paid 468 yuan via WeChat Pay, and the page immediately popped up the course link and the first lesson video. She didn't rush to watch it; instead, she set a recurring reminder on her phone for every Wednesday at 8:00 p.m., then sent the course link to her own email as a backup.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Cycle to purchase art supplies
description: Putting on a sun hat and mask, I got on my bicycle parked downstairs and set off. About fifteen minutes later, I arrived at the 'Yuncai Art Supplies Store' on Fengzhu Street. The shop was filled with the smell of paper and paint. I browsed in front of the shelves and strictly followed the list: Sakura 24-color solid watercolors, Baohong medium-rough paper pad with four-sided glue binding, two Da Vinci squirrel-hair watercolor brushes of different sizes, one Wahong round brush, and one tube of Holbein masking fluid. At the counter, I saw an A5 journal with a cloth cover next to the register. It felt nice, so I grabbed one. The total was about 520 yuan. The owner was a gentle middle-aged man who enthusiastically taught me how to tell the uses of flat and pointed brushes.
location: Yuncai Art Supplies Store (shop), No. 56 Fengzhu Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Go home and organize art supplies.
description: Leaving the store, I cycled home. When I walked in, Dad was about to leave for work. Seeing me carrying a large paper bag, he smiled and asked, "What nice things did you buy?" I excitedly opened the bag to show him: "Dad, I've officially started learning watercolor!" Dad said a few encouraging words and went out. Carrying the art materials back to the study, I wiped a corner of the desk with a damp cloth, set out the solid watercolors, paint dishes, brush washer, and brush holders one by one, and put the newly bought journal beside them. Looking at the watercolor corner just taking shape, I felt full of anticipation.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Organizing and travel preparations
description: After sorting out her painting materials, she took out her notebook and re-checked the excerpts from local chronicles about Kunming's old streets, with special attention to 'the rise and fall of shops on Guanghua Street' and 'the old customs of Yongdao Street.' She packed the notebook and the empty laptop bag, then took the poetry collection Qingcheng that Yang Xiao had given her from the bookshelf, deciding to bring it as a palate cleanser during writing breaks. She changed into a comfortable cotton-linen dress and flat canvas shoes at the entryway, then set off on foot to Mingyuan Bookstore.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (Residence)

name: Immersive writing: first draft of the Old Street chapter.
description: After a 15-minute walk, she arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore. The bookstore was very quiet in the morning, with only the sound of pages turning. She nodded to Uncle Qin in the corner as a greeting, sat down in her usual seat by the window, and ordered a hot Americano. She opened her laptop and handwritten notes and devoted herself to the “Old Street Memories” chapter of the essay collection. She merged historical details such as “the old herbal medicine shop on Guanghua Street” and “the engraving stall on Yongdao Street” with the street scenes her grandmother had described in her childhood memories. The writing had more warmth and vividness than the earlier draft. During this time, Uncle Qin brought over a glass of water and said softly, “Writing about old Kunming again? It’s well written—show it to me another day.” She smiled and agreed.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore (bookstore), No. 114 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lunch and ‘recharging’.
description: After finishing a long paragraph, she saved the document, walked out of the study, and found a small shop called 'Laozihao Douhua Mixian' in a nearby alley. She ordered a bowl of the signature tofu pudding rice noodles, plus a serving of soy flour glutinous rice balls. While waiting, she opened Yang Xiao's poetry collection and carefully read several poems about 'city dusk,' feeling the rhythm and imagery in the language, trying to merge them into the phrasing of her own prose. After eating, she saw Zhou Lin's WeChat reply: 'Just finished reading it! It's great! A few places could be more poetic—let me organize my thoughts and send them to you!' She replied with a happy emoji, sensing that there would be new revision tasks in the afternoon.
location: Time-Honored Douhua Rice Noodles (Restaurant), Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Taking a break at the bookstore and replying to messages
description: After lunch, I bought a cup of lemonade nearby and strolled back to the bookstore. When I got back to my seat, I opened the message from Zhou Lin. She made a few suggestions, such as changing “the flower language of the jacaranda is tranquility” to “the purple of the jacaranda is summer's gentlest annotation of stillness.” I thought it made a lot of sense, so I immediately wrote it down in my memo and plan to revise it tonight or tomorrow.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore (bookstore), No. 114 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Finalizing Writing and Gathering Supplementary Material
description: The afternoon passed very quickly. She devoted herself to writing again, read through the morning's first draft, and revised a few transitions in the description of "city sounds." When she was in full flow, she opened a local history forum and found two more short stories about Fulin Hall's old prescriptions, adding them to the chapter. Around 16:00, she felt that her writing state was very good and that the skeleton of the first draft of the old street chapter was basically complete. She saved the final version, got up and browsed around the bookstore, bought a photography book on Yunnan local architecture, and planned to use it as visual reference for the next chapter.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore (bookstore), No. 114 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Stop at the supermarket for groceries on the way
description: Leaving the bookstore, I walked to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on the way back. There was no yoga class today, so I could take more time. Pushing a small cart, I bought a few tomatoes, a bunch of scallions, a box of eggs, and a bag of dried noodles, planning a light dinner for the evening. Passing the yogurt section, I picked up a box of plain yogurt as well. At checkout I found the member-day discount, and tomatoes and eggs happened to be on promotion, so I happily saved a few yuan and noted this small saving in my journal.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket (supermarket), No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Going home and a short time with art supplies
description: Walked home carrying shopping bags. When I entered, Mom was picking vegetables in the kitchen. I put things in the fridge and briefly talked about today's writing progress. Then I went back to the study, picked up the watercolor pens I bought this morning, twirled them between my fingers, and felt their weight. I opened the newly bought journal, drew a simple smiley face on the first page, and wrote the date '2025.08.13 - The watercolor world begins'.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (Residence)

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: I prepared dinner with my mother and was in charge of washing tomatoes and chopping scallions. Mother stir-fried water spinach with garlic and reheated the leftover braised pork from yesterday. At the dinner table, I excitedly shared today's "watercolor beginnings" with my parents—from signing up, buying art supplies, to setting up the desk. Dad asked how much it cost.
