When I told them the number, Mom clicked her tongue, but Dad smiled and said, "Investing in your hobbies is worth it." The meal was full of joy and harmony.
location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home restaurant)

name: Housework and pre-class preparation.
description: She took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes. After returning to her room, she rearranged the watercolor supplies on her desk, fixed the paper onto the drawing board, poured clean water, and laid out old newspapers. Then she opened her laptop, clicked on the first recorded lesson, and first dragged the progress bar to get a rough idea of the course content and duration. She took a deep breath and switched her phone to Do Not Disturb mode.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Watercolor Lesson 1: Flat Wash and Color Chart Exercises.
description: At exactly 20:00, I sat down at my desk, put on earphones, and officially began my first watercolor lesson. The teacher started by explaining how to hold the brush and how to mix water. Following the video step by step, I first drew grids on the paper with a pencil, then mixed yellow, blue, and red, and carefully attempted flat washes. However, the first stroke immediately spread into a wet patch. I was somewhat flustered and erased several times without success, but watching the pigment naturally bloom on the damp paper, creating textures of varying depth, made me laugh instead: "So this is what watercolor is!" Not discouraged, I followed the tutorial and made a color chart with the remaining paint, labeling each square with the name of the pigment and the amount of water added. Although a few squares were not painted evenly, I enjoyed that clumsy sense of creativity.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Post-class organization and journal records
description: After the class, she didn't turn off the computer right away. Instead, she put the finished color charts aside to dry, picked up her newly bought A5 journal, and wrote her first watercolor study record. She carefully painted a few small watercolor elements: a wobbly palette, a paintbrush, and a color block. Then she used tape to stick the receipt for today's art supplies into the notebook, and wrote down her feelings about her first class: 'My hand is unskilled, but my heart is full. The paint has a candy-like fragrance, and the movement of water is free.'
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home study)

name: Reading before bed and interacting with companions
description: After washing up and applying skincare, changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed. Flipped through the poetry collection 'Qingcheng' given by Yang Xiao, found the poem describing Dujiangyan, read it twice, and felt the power of the words. Remembering that she needed to revise the flower language copy tomorrow, she opened the memo on her phone and carefully reviewed the suggestions Zhou Lin had made that afternoon, drafting a rough response in her mind. At this moment, the fulfillment of writing during the day, the freshness of watercolor, and the recognition from friends intertwined, making her feel at ease.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home bedroom)

name: Bedtime meditation
description: Turn off the main light, leaving only a small bedside lamp. Sit up straight, listen to the soft sound of rain in the guided meditation app, take deep breaths, and draw your attention away from the excited mood back to each breath. This is the fourth day of persisting with meditation. Though images of the day's paint blending occasionally flash through my mind, I have learned to gently brush the thoughts away.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home bedroom)

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: After the meditation ended, I lay back down and turned off the desk lamp. In the darkness, I touched my left heel and it was completely numb. Tomorrow I can resume my morning run and see Green Lake in the early morning. With a little anticipation for the next day, I soon fell asleep.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (home bedroom)

name: Waking up and morning run
description: Woke up naturally at 6:28, two minutes before the alarm. Touched the old blister on my left heel and found it had completely healed. Outside the window were the wet black-tiled roofs of the old street after the rain. After washing up, I changed into sports clothes, drank half a glass of warm water, did some stretches on the yoga mat, and felt in good shape. Then I walked about 5 minutes to the west gate of Cuihu Park, jogged 1.5 kilometers along the lake at a pace under 8 minutes per kilometer. Breathing was much smoother. When I ran to the "Xima River" ruins, I met a silver-haired runner who gave me a thumbs up, and I smiled and nodded in response. After running, I walked slowly under a large banyan tree by the lake to cool down, feeling the satisfaction of sweat soaking through my back.
location: Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park), Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home, wash up, breakfast, and morning tidying
description: After running home, Mom had already placed steaming multigrain porridge and xiaolongbao on the table. She was wearing a dark green cardigan today and looked especially lively—probably because she is retiring tomorrow and felt relaxed. She finished breakfast quickly, and at the same time spent 15 minutes carefully going through the 6 floral line drawings sent by Zhou Lin, marking keywords for each change in her notes to discuss at the evening video call.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go to Zhibushi Bookstore and return home.
description: Carrying her laptop and journal, she rode a shared bike slowly along Renmin Middle Road. At the intersection with Wenlin Street, she saw that Zhibushi Bookstore was already open. She parked and went in. Uncle Qin was sorting newly arrived local gazetteers. She borrowed a copy of the new Illustrated Guide to Yunnan's Time-Honored Brands, and he smiled and pushed over a packet of rose cakes he had baked himself: “Try them, they're just baked. Riding on an empty stomach in the morning—be careful you don't get a stomachache.” After leaving the bookstore, she rode home, about 15 minutes. Once home, she washed her hands, brewed a cup of green tea, and sat down at the desk in her study. Outside, the rain had completely stopped, and sunlight briefly broke through the clouds, casting dappled light and shadow on the old wooden floor.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: from home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road, then back home.

name: Final polishing and submission of the short story 'The Vigil Behind the Glass'.
description: In the home study, she opened the document on her laptop. Based on the revision suggestions her mentor Wu Mingyuan had given last time, she focused on adjusting the rhythm of the dialogue in the middle section of the story, where the daughter argues with her father over the photography exhibition, changing the originally somewhat lengthy monologue into more concise reactions. She then carefully weighed every word of the emotional climax paragraph at the end, ensuring it remained restrained yet powerful. At 11:00, she converted the final draft to PDF using Word, and sent it together with the completed electronic registration form by email to the organizing committee of the Kunming Literature New Talent Award. After receiving the auto-reply, she saved a screenshot of the confirmation letter to the 'Big Moment' page of her journal and drew a small completion mark next to it.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Lunch and relaxation
description: Mom made her signature tomato scrambled eggs and cold okra salad. During the meal, I brought up wanting to go to the flower market by Green Lake this afternoon to look at hydrangeas. Her eyes lit up: "Sure, pick some white and purple ones; they'll look nice in the living room." Seizing the opportunity, I asked, "Is there any vase you especially want? I'll try to get one for you tomorrow?" She didn't suspect anything and said with a smile, anything. I pursed my lips and smiled, knowing she'd be pleasantly surprised tomorrow. After the meal, I cleared the dishes and also threw this morning's workout clothes into the washing machine.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Afternoon rest and reading of Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan
description: The afternoon sun hid behind the clouds again, and the air was filled with the dampness of post-rain vegetation. She took a bag of cookies, brewed a cup of rose tea, and sat on the old rattan chair on the balcony, reading a passage from Miscellanies of Central Yunnan for 30 minutes. When she came to the section about the 'Release Pond' at Cuihu Lake in the late Qing Dynasty, she subconsciously made a note in her phone's memo app: it could serve as an opening for the next column, 'Street Life Memories'.
location: Home balcony, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Discuss column topics online with editor Xu Mingyuan.
description: Had a WeChat voice call with editor Xu Mingyuan for about 20 minutes. Drawing on the local chronicles she read today and the old-street materials she collected at the bookstore yesterday, she smoothly proposed the next column theme: 'The Everyday Memories of Kunming's Old Streets — from Fulin Hall to Ruanjia Lane.' He was very interested after hearing it, said it was a good angle, and suggested adding some observations from today's young people to give the article a more contemporary feel. They agreed on a deadline one week later and a length of about 3,000 characters. After the call, she quickly wrote the confirmed framework and key points into her journal.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Practice watercolor wet-on-wet technique and color blending, with a short rest.
description: Feeling relaxed, she spread out her watercolor notebook and began practicing the wet-on-wet and color-joining techniques she had learned in yesterday's recorded class. Using a slightly damp brush dipped in viridian and Prussian blue, she tried to paint a few hazy water lily leaves. Although her water control was still unsteady and the first leaf's edges spread a bit out of control, the second and third leaves gradually took on a translucent quality. She kept all three leaves as 'progress within failure,' carefully cut them out with scissors, pasted them on the right side of her dedicated journal, and wrote next to them in small characters tomorrow's improvement idea: 'Use less water, and wait until half-dry before adding the next color.' She also drew a tiny watering-can doodle to record her thoughts. At 15:20 she packed up her painting supplies, felt her eyes ache a little, and leaned back on the living room sofa with eyes closed to rest for 15 minutes. During that time her phone buzzed twice. It was a message from Zhou Lin, saying she was ready for the video call at 8 tonight. She replied, 'OK, I just finished sorting out my comments on your line draft.' Then she scrolled through Zhihu for a while and saw a post about 'how to choose a retirement gift,' and silently took a screenshot.
location: Home study and living room, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon: reading 'Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan' and recording inspirations
description: Continue reading "Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan" on the balcony for half an hour. I was deeply moved by the rise and fall of the Cuihu Lake teahouses during the Republican era. In the "Column Material" section of my journal, I wrote down "Teahouses and Jianghu: Seeing the Ways of the World from the Tea Tables" as a candidate passage for next month's column.
location: Home balcony, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dinner party preparation: called father and went to the flower shop to look at flower materials
description: I called Dad. I had already noted in my memo: "Cuihu Courtyard Private Kitchen," and the private room is called "Listening to Lotus." Dad said on the phone that he had asked around; the minimum spending is 588 yuan, the environment is quiet, and you can see a corner of Cuihu Lake. We also discussed the menu: steam-pot chicken, steamed sea bass, Xuanwei stir-fried pork, and the vegetarian stir-fried bitter melon that Mom loves. The guest list was finalized, with Aunt Xie invited to join us. Before hanging up, I made a point of saying, "Dad, I'll take care of the flowers—don't worry." He chuckled and said, "Alright. Your mother is truly lucky to have a daughter like you." After hanging up, I put on a light cardigan and walked to Zaiye Florist, about 13 minutes away. I looked carefully at the hydrangeas—the light purple ones here are in full bloom, round and full, and there are also white double-petal lisianthus, whose flower language is "eternal love." The owner, a young woman, heard that this was a retirement surprise for my mother and offered to help pick out several hydrangeas with many buds and sturdy stems, saying they were sure to bloom beautifully over the next couple of days. I added the owner on WeChat, and we agreed that I'd come by at ten tomorrow to pick up a bouquet, arranged with a few lisianthus blooms and white baby's breath.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, from home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road to Zaiye Flower Shop (Cuihu Branch) at No. 22 Qianju Street

name: Returned home and had dinner together
description: Walking home from the flower shop, I passed the fruit stand at the entrance of the residential community and bought a box of blueberries and a few kiwis on the way. After getting home, I washed the fruit, sliced it onto a plate, and set it on the dining table. Mom was delighted to see the fruit and picked up a blueberry to feed me. I secretly updated tomorrow's flower budget in my phone memo. Dad also came home from work and brought back a roast duck. The three of us sat around the dining table, under the warm yellow light, in a cozy atmosphere. As we ate, I naturally said, "I just passed the flower shop on the corner and saw the hydrangeas blooming beautifully. Mom, let's buy two bunches to put in vases." Mom readily agreed. Dad also teased, "Now that I'm retired, we should really have more flowers and plants at home." Everyone laughed. After the meal, I volunteered to do the dishes and let Mom go rest in the living room and watch TV.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening chores and free time
description: After washing the dishes, I took the sportswear that had been soaking since morning out of the washing machine and hung it on the balcony. Back in the bedroom, I opened the link to the recommendation letter from a weekly magazine editor that I had received after practicing watercolor in the afternoon, and replied with a short thank-you email. Then, leaning against the bed, I began brainstorming in my journal for tomorrow's retirement card for my mother. I jotted down a few lines, but they felt too clichéd, so I deleted them, took a deep breath, and decided to write it tomorrow morning. I also tried out keywords such as fulfillment, companionship, and new beginnings.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video conference preparation and discussion of flower line drafts with Zhou Lin.
description: At 19:45 I set up the phone stand, poured myself a glass of warm water, turned on the desk lamp, and put on the table the printout of the revision checklist for Zhou Lin's line drawings that I had organized in the afternoon. I took a deep breath and sent Zhou Lin a WeChat message: “I'm ready, we can start anytime~” At 20:00 the video call connected. Zhou Lin was in her apartment in Shenzhen, with her drawing tablet and line drawings spread out on the table. The two of them discussed the drawings one by one. The jacaranda branches she had drawn tended to be languid in their direction, and I suggested adding a little curve so they would feel more as if brushed by the wind. The magnolia corolla she drew was relatively small, and I suggested enlarging it by about a third, because in Kunming's cultural imagery the magnolia represents “dignified and noble.” She agreed strongly, saying she had felt the same but hadn't been sure. She picked up a pen and marked things on the screen, while I read out the notes one by one from the printout. Finally she said happily, “You have a sharp eye. After these changes, it immediately looks different!” They agreed that tomorrow evening she would send over the revised version, and they said goodnight to each other cheerfully.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and Washing Up
description: After hanging up the video call, she sat down at her desk, feeling completely happy, and carefully wrote down the day's key events in her journal: 'Completed the fifth morning run; submission successful; column topic confirmed; banquet planning (flowers set) + tomorrow's flower pickup time; tonight's video discussion with Zhou Lin was very productive, and the revision plan is complete.' While showering to light music, rubbing shampoo into her hair, she thought of the sentence to write on tomorrow's card: 'Mom, may your new life be as full and perfect as a hydrangea.' The corners of her mouth curled up without her noticing.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Drafting Mom's retirement card.
description: After drying her hair and changing into pajamas, she sat back down at her desk. She tried writing repeatedly with a pencil on the manuscript paper and finally settled on a passage: 'Teacher Li, in the past twenty-two years, you have taught so many children to see the world. Starting tomorrow, it's my turn, along with the world, to watch the blooming season that has just unfolded after you put down the chalk.' Satisfied, she circled it and decided to pair it with a hydrangea border in watercolor tomorrow.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditating, reading, and falling asleep before bed.
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only an aromatherapy lamp. Leaning against the headboard, I closed my eyes and meditated. Today was the fifth day of persisting; my breathing was much deeper than in the past few days. In my mind surfaced the sound of the wind brushing through treetops as I ran past Green Lake in the morning, and that gentle sense of losing control as the watercolor spread in the afternoon. Finally, I silently recited 'wholeness' in my mind, counted from 1 to 10, and slowly opened my eyes. Then I picked up my phone and saw the weather forecast: tomorrow will be cloudy turning clear, 24 degrees — a good omen. I spent another five minutes flipping through Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan and read a passage about 'the old Kunming customs for eating qiguo chicken', thinking I could show off a passage to Mom at the dinner table tomorrow. At 22:25, I turned off the light and drew the curtains. Outside the window, the occasional footsteps of late-night returnees and one or two dog barks drifted in. I took a deep breath, imagining the look on Mom's face when she sees the flower bouquet and the card tomorrow. My heart felt soft. I turned over, and my consciousness gradually sank into sleep, ending this fulfilling, packed, and tender Thursday.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Early-morning wake-up and morning run
description: The alarm went off at 7 a.m. sharp. After getting up and washing up briefly, I headed out. Today was the celebration of my mother's retirement. With a solemn sense of purpose, I quickly put my hair up in a bun, changed into running clothes, and walked to Green Lake Park. I ran 1.5 kilometers along the lakeside trail, keeping the pace under 8 minutes per kilometer, feeling the morning breeze on my face and enjoying the lotuses and egrets. After the run, I did a set of stretches, feeling refreshed in body and mind.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and flower-arrangement preparation
description: After her morning jog, she bought the blueberries and fresh milk her mother likes at the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket by the neighborhood gate, then returned home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road. Her mother Li Xiulan had already cooked multigrain porridge and paired it with steamed dumplings and fried eggs. The two had breakfast together and talked about tonight's plans; her mother mentioned that she wanted to wear the new dress. After the meal, she took the initiative to clear the table, spread a waterproof table mat in the study, and prepared floral foam, scissors, and various flowers for arranging a retirement bouquet.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Arrange a retirement bouquet and write a gratitude card
description: In the study, using the basic Ikenobo "rikka" (standing flower) technique, she carefully arranged a bouquet with pink carnations and white lisianthus as the main flowers, complemented by eucalyptus leaves and baby's breath. Then, on a hand-painted watercolor hydrangea card, she wrote a blessing: "A three-foot podium has nurtured many students; may a room of flower shadows accompany your later years — Happy retirement, Mom!" and drew a heart. She wrapped the bouquet with ribbon and kraft paper and hid it behind the bookshelf.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pick up the reserved bouquet at the flower shop and purchase additional floral materials.
location: Zaiye Flower Shop (Cuihu Store), No. 22 Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Interview the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan
description: Holding the bouquet, she walked to Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. On the way, she sent her editor Xu Mingyuan a voice message to let him know the day's interview plan. After arriving, she sat down by the window with the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan in the second-floor reading area and conducted an in-depth interview on the topic “The Rise and Fall of Kunming's Independent Bookstores,” recording with a voice recorder and a notebook. Qin Mingyuan began with Bowen Bookstore and Jiuyu Xuan in the 1990s, spoke about perseverance and transformation, and gave leads on old bookstore owners, providing valuable material and the book Old Bookstores of Kunming. The interview lasted nearly two hours.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and return to the bookstore
description: After the interview, she walked to Ruili’s time-honored bean curd rice noodle shop at 202 Wenlin Street, ordered a bowl of bean curd rice noodles with extra toppings and a glass of papaya water. While eating alone, she browsed through “Old Bookstores of Kunming,” a gift from Qin Mingyuan, and folded down the corner of the page with the “Guanghua Street Bookstore” section. After the meal, she strolled back to Zhibushi Bookstore, basking in the afternoon sunlight and the shadows of plane trees.
location: Ruili Time-Honored Tofu Pudding Rice Noodles, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prose writing: "Green Lake in My Childhood".
description: Back at the wall-side workstation at Zhibushi Bookstore, she photographed the dog-eared passage in Old Bookstores of Kunming and saved it to a folder for column material. After closing her eyes and resting for five minutes, she put on earphones, listened to white noise, and began writing with full concentration. Digging through memories for details of childhood summers—rowing on Cuihu, feeding seagulls with her grandfather, drinking soda—inspiration poured out, and her writing was warm and nuanced. During the session she had a cup of pour-over coffee to refresh herself. She eventually completed a first draft of about 5000 characters of prose and felt an exhilarating sense of release.
location: Workstation at Paper Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home to prepare the dinner party surprise.
description: She put away her computer and notes, retrieved the hydrangea bouquet that had been left at the bookstore counter, and walked home. When she got home, her mother was watching TV. She quietly hid the bouquet back in the study. She took the initiative to offer to help her mother put together an outfit for the dinner party. In the bedroom, they tried silk scarves and pearl earrings, and finally settled on a light purple silk scarf. She took a photo and sent it to the family WeChat group. When her father came home from work and changed into a shirt, she exchanged a glance with him confirming the surprise preparation. Afterward, she changed into a floral-print dress, put the two bouquets and the card into a canvas bag, and checked that everything was in order.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner celebrating Mother's retirement.
description: A family of three and their neighbor Aunt Xie walked through Green Lake Park as the sunset poured over the lake; the parents strolled arm in arm. They arrived at the private-kitchen restaurant at 18 Cuihu North Road and enjoyed mushroom hot pot and crossing-the-bridge rice noodles. Her father raised his glass to thank her mother for her devotion to the family, and the atmosphere was warm. At the right moment, he took a carefully wrapped bouquet and a card from a canvas tote and presented them to her mother. After reading the card, her mother was moved to tears and thanked him repeatedly; Aunt Xie also wiped away her tears. During the meal, they recalled family memories and shared a happy time together.
location: Private kitchen restaurant beside Cuihu Lake, No. 18 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk around Green Lake and record family stories
description: After the dinner, everyone strolled along the Cuihu Lake ring road to aid digestion. Her parents walked ahead, reminiscing about how they met at Green Lake Photo Studio in their youth and dated on benches by Cuihu Lake. She followed quietly, jotting down these lively conversations in her pocket notebook to gather writing material. At the intersection, Aunt Xie and her father went home first, and she prepared to continue walking alone with her mother.
location: Ring Road, Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mother-daughter heart-to-heart at Green Lake.
description: She sat with her mother on a bench beside a pond full of lotus leaves near Shuiyue Pavilion. Her mother looked at the moon and said softly that after retirement she could finally spend more time with her. They shared recent writing and travel plans, and also listened to her mother's thoughts on retirement life. The moonlight was bright, cicadas chirped in bursts, and the mother and daughter chatted happily for nearly forty minutes, with deep emotional connection.
location: Bench near Water-Moon Pavilion in Green Lake Park, 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening work from home: watercolor archiving and cultural-creative design.
description: I walked home arm in arm with my mother along the other side of Cuihu. When we got home, my father was brewing tea. I went to the study, opened my laptop, and organized and archived this week’s watercolor photos. Then, using the drawing app Procreate, I designed sketches for the individual packaging of flower stickers, drawing two styles—blue jacaranda and magnolia—and carefully adjusting the lines and colors. After finishing, I sent the design screenshots and voice feedback to my collaborator Zhou Lin and received a suggestion to add retro borders.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening meditation and journaling.
description: I went to the living room to pour warm water and roughly recorded my three meals in my journal. After washing up and changing into pajamas, I sat cross-legged on my yoga mat in the study for 10 minutes of meditation, focusing on my breath and letting my thoughts settle. The image of my mother's surprised tears and the evening breeze by Cuihu Lake came to mind. Afterwards, I took out my beloved journal, wrote down today's keywords—'solemnity, warmth, inspiration, gratitude'—and freely painted a crescent moon, lake ripples, and a mother-and-daughter silhouette with solid watercolors. After finishing the drawing, I saw Zhou Lin's reply and smiled as I sent an OK emoji.
location: Home study and living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Turned off the desk lamp, lay down in bed, and checked tomorrow's weather on her phone—cloudy turning clear. She picked up Trivial Notes from Central Yunnan from the bedside table and flipped through a few old anecdotes about Kunming. But because the day had been too fulfilling, her eyelids grew heavier and heavier, so she closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and body-mind awakening
description: In the bedroom, I did a 20-minute flow yoga practice, focusing on spinal twists and shoulder and neck relaxation to help my body recover from yesterday's walk and dinner. During the practice, I recalled the moved look on my mom's face at her retirement dinner, and felt calm and joyful.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and life journal
description: Mom Li Xiulan had prepared breakfast: whole wheat bread, boiled eggs, kiwi slices, and black coffee. During the meal, I listened to Mom share how she slept on her first day of retirement and her plans for today. After eating, I recorded the breakfast content on my phone and took photos, planning to upload a check-in post on Xiaohongshu, with a caption mentioning how Mom's first day of retirement began with a perfect breakfast.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing yesterday's memories and cards
description: Back in the study, she quickly recorded in her material notebook the touching moment when her mother read the retirement card yesterday and the details of the dinner, as the emotional core material for the afterword of her essay collection. At the same time, she trimmed the hydrangea bouquet received yesterday and arranged it in the study vase, injecting life into her writing space.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Focused compilation of afterword materials and core theme.
description: Formally entering work mode, she organized and polished the content of yesterday's long conversation with her mother at Green Lake, and browsed through the chapters about family and inheritance in 'Miscellaneous Records of Central Yunnan' for inspiration. Centering on her mother's core idea that 'retirement is not stopping, but living at a different pace,' she built the narrative thread for the afterword to the essay collection and completed the opening and framework of the first draft.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Handle WeChat and online communications.
description: Checked the revised floral line drawings that her friend Zhou Lin had sent late at night. She replied, praising the lively jacaranda branches and the well-proportioned magnolia, and agreed to discuss in detail in the evening. Her mother brought over cut mangoes and chatted about the afternoon walk plan.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-lunch preparations and keeping accounts
description: Leaving the study, she helped her mother pick vegetables and prepare lunch. She used her expense-tracking app to record yesterday's family share of the bill at the private home-style restaurant and today's flower budget, keeping up her daily habit of tracking expenses.
location: Home living room and kitchen at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and rest
description: Had lunch with her parents. Her father talked about interesting anecdotes from his youth working at the district cultural bureau, and her mother shared her plan to organize the balcony flower stand. After the meal she cleared the dishes, went back to the bedroom, put on an eye mask, and did a brief 15-minute meditation to relax her brain from the intense thinking of the morning.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reorganizing column material
description: Feeling refreshed after meditation, she once again looked through the chapters on old-street teahouses and markets in Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan, and combined the history of independent bookstores that Uncle Qin had mentioned with her childhood memories of walking through old streets with her parents, making final preparations for the afternoon column writing.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Focus on writing and sending the draft of the column
description: She entered a deeply focused writing state and completed the first draft of the column essay Marketplace Memories of Kunming Old Street, interweaving the old street's buildings, snacks, and vendor cries with the story of an independent bookstore's struggles, giving it a humanistic touch. After repeated polishing, she sent it to editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat. She soon received a reply praising the unique perspective and suggesting slight adjustments to the rhythm of some sentences to improve fluency.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-walk preparation and afternoon snacks.
description: Marked the revision points on the computer based on the editor's suggestions, and decided to handle them after a walk. Changed into a comfortable cotton-linen long skirt, and took a notebook, pen, and water. Drank yogurt and ate Mom's homemade flower cakes to replenish energy.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Second walk with parents at Green Lake Park.
description: Walked with her parents to Cuihu Park. Under the setting sun, the lake sparkled. Her parents talked about the ups and downs of their return from the countryside as educated youth; Sun Yuwei leaned on the bench and took rapid notes of key information. Then her mother recalled the fun of catching tadpoles in childhood, and the three of them laughed. The warm atmosphere added a vivid footnote to their family oral history.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning from a walk and helping with dinner
description: After returning home, she helped her mother prepare dinner, peeling garlic and trimming vegetables. Her father watched the TV news. While preparing the meal, the mother and daughter chatted about interesting things from the walk, and her mother added a few more details about her childhood.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat together enjoying dinner. Sun Yuwei shared today's writing progress and her editor's recognition, and her parents were very happy. She also suggested taking her parents to try a newly opened mushroom hotpot restaurant next weekend, which received an enthusiastic response.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: After clearing the dining table, she called her sister Sun Yutong on video chat and excitedly shared how their mother had acted on her first day of retirement, as well as her afternoon writing inspiration. Her sister had just gotten off work in Shenzhen and teased and encouraged her. The two agreed to talk again next week.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Flower arrangement practice and watercolor illustration
description: Started evening creative work. Used the hydrangeas, lisianthus, and eucalyptus leaves bought yesterday to practice Ikenobo free-style flower arrangement, creating a cool summer feel. After taking photos as a keepsake, I painted a watercolor sketch of lotus flowers at Green Lake based on my memory of a walk, using the wet-on-wet technique to express the diffuse effect of lotus leaves.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and letting inspiration settle
description: Used the journal and stickers to record the day's editorial revision suggestions and flower arrangement practice insights. Reorganized the afterword plan and wrote down keywords as the starting point for tomorrow's revision.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and meditation before bed
description: Changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard to read Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan, about the lives of modern Kunming literati, seeking writing inspiration. After about 20 minutes, she turned off the light and meditated for 5 minutes, feeling the rise and fall of her breath and filling her heart with peace and creative motivation.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up and washing up.
description: Woken by the sound of a passing shower outside the window, I stretched lazily and got up. In the bathroom, I brushed my teeth with warm water, washed my face with cold water, combed my hair, and changed into light loungewear. Propped against the headboard, I picked up my phone to check my schedule and confirmed the day's plan.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Mom made millet porridge and fried egg pancakes, and there was cut mango on the table. While drinking porridge, Sun Yuwei shared her plans to go to Mingyuan Bookstore to do journaling in the morning and to visit Awakening Bookstore with her best friend Zhang Jing in the afternoon. Dad reminded her to come home early in the evening to take a walk at Cuihu Lake. After the meal, the three of them cleared the dishes, and Sun Yuwei helped wipe the table.
location: Home Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pack her bag and change clothes
description: Changed into a cotton-linen dress and canvas shoes, and put on a beret. Checked the canvas bag: journal, newly received flower-and-grass paper, fountain pen, power bank, and folded long-handled umbrella. Reviewed the day's plan page in the journal, confirmed the schedule, and set aside the handmade paper sent by cousin Shen Wei to sort out in the afternoon.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Creative time at Mingyuan Bookhouse
description: After the rain gradually stopped, she walked ten minutes to Mingyuan Bookstore and sat in her usual seat by the window. She took out the flower-and-grass paper, cut and pasted it onto the travel-themed journal page, and wrote a few prose drafts about the rainy morning with her fountain pen. Qin Mingyuan brought her a cup of Dianhong tea, and the two briefly chatted about the Yunnan folk poetry collection he had recently found. Sun Yuwei jotted down a few inspiring sentences in her material notebook.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 78 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home and family lunch
description: Leaving Mingyuan Bookstore, she strolled home along Wenlin Street. The air after the rain mixed the sweetness of earth and osmanthus; water droplets hung from the green tiles of the old buildings along the street. She took two photos with her phone as journal material. Passing a bakery, she smelled the fragrance of wheat but did not stop. When she got home, she had lunch with her parents; her mother made multigrain rice, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and cold eggplant salad. Sun Yuwei showed the travel journal pages she had completed that morning, and her parents praised them as exquisite. Her father told an amusing story about a former colleague from the Cultural Bureau; as she listened, she thought it could be put into the material bank for a postscript to her essays.
location: Along Wenlin Street to Renmin Middle Road in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, and Home Restaurant at 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, it was cloudy and slightly cool. She closed the curtains and lay down on the bed to rest. She played soft piano music on her phone, took a few deep breaths to relax her shoulders and neck, and after about 15 minutes closed her eyes to rest. When she woke up, she felt refreshed.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing handmade paper
description: Put on cotton gloves and spread the handmade paper sent by her cousin Shen Wei on the desk. Sort by type: mulberry bark paper, bamboo paper, and paper decorated with dried petals. Arrange by color from light beige to dark brown. Pick out a few with special textures and fix them to the inspiration board with magnets. In her notebook, record each paper's texture characteristics and potential uses (such as bookmarks, creative samples, or a watercolor paper substitute), and think about how to pair them with the previous watercolor sketches.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Browsing Juexing Bookstore with Zhang Jing
description: She changed into flat leather shoes, picked up her canvas tote bag, and headed out. After a 3-minute walk, she reached the Renmin Middle Road bus stop, took Bus No. 5 for about 3 stops, got off at Wenlin Street stop, and walked 2 minutes to Juexing Bookstore. At the bookstore entrance, she met Zhang Jing, and the two hugged with smiles. They first browsed the new book section on the first floor. Zhang Jing recommended a Japanese essay collection about daily life, while Sun Yuwei found a photography book about old streets in Kunming. The two went upstairs, sat by the window on the second floor, and each ordered a drink (rose latte, black tea). They shared recent news: Zhang Jing talked about amusing incidents at work, and Sun Yuwei showed how she used flower-and-plant paper in her journal and discussed material for her next essay collection. Before parting, Sun Yuwei bought the photography book and carefully put away the receipt to paste into her journal.
location: Juexing Bookstore, 45 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the bus ride along the way.

name: Going home and taking a family walk around Green Lake
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Jing, she walked home along Renmin Middle Road. Passing a stall selling grilled erkuai rice cakes, she smelled their aroma but didn't buy any. At the fruit stall by the community gate, she bought half a kilogram of red grapes to eat after dinner. After arriving home and putting down her canvas bag, she accompanied her parents on a walk to Green Lake Park. They circled the lake once; her father, Sun Mingyuan, talked about how he had gradually learned the ropes when he first joined the Cultural Bureau, while her mother, Li Xiulan, added amusing stories about picnicking at Green Lake after their marriage. Sun Yuwei recorded key details in a small notebook and turned on her phone's voice recorder. On the way, they paused briefly outside a flower shop, where her mother looked at the succulent potted plants.
location: Along Renmin Middle Road in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the lakeside trail around Green Lake Park.

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei changed into loungewear and went to the kitchen to help her mother wash vegetables, cut red grapes, and set out bowls and chopsticks. Her mother steamed a sea bass, her father cooked rice, and the three of them worked together to prepare dinner. During dinner, the conversation centered on the work stories her father had told during the walk around Cuihu and the old photos Sun Yuwei had seen in the bookstore that afternoon. Sun Yuwei suggested that the whole family go to Zhuanxin Market to stroll and eat next weekend, and her parents nodded in agreement. After dinner, Sun Yuwei cleared the table and washed the dishes.
location: Home Kitchen and Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Diet review and adjustment
description: Opened the diet logging app and scrolled through the meal and snack records from August 10 to 16. Found that lunch was indeed often based on leafy greens and Chinese cabbage, and dinner occasionally included chips and biscuits. At the desk, opened the journal and wrote down the analysis results: add more choy sum and broccoli next week, and add a small portion of walnuts or almonds every day at 4 p.m. Neatly wrote the adjustment plan on the 'Next Week Adjustments' page.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reflection log and free time
description: She imported the recording of the Green Lake walk into her computer, opened a document, and transcribed her parents' stories of struggle and their memories after marriage into written material, roughly producing more than a thousand characters. Then she took out her watercolor sketchbook and made a few simple strokes of an umbrella and a corner of Green Lake; she wasn't very satisfied with the sketch but put her brush down. After that, she relaxed, lay in bed listening to music for a while, and checked her phone to reply to friends' messages.
location: Bedroom and study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Skincare and journal summary
description: After washing her face and applying moisturizer, she sat back at the desk and opened her journal. She pasted in the newly bought climate-themed stickers (rain clouds, falling leaves) and the photo samples taken at the bakery this morning. She also pasted in the receipt from Awakening Bookstore, and next to it wrote a brief note about today's mood. Reviewing the whole day, she checked off "Today's plan completion rate: 95%" on the summary section, feeling calm and fulfilled inside.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading, meditation, and falling asleep before bed
description: She changed into her pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and read Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan for about 15 minutes. A passage describing the tea stalls at Green Lake during the Republican era, set against what she had seen on today's walk, gave her new insight. After turning off the light, she did five minutes of breathing meditation, focusing on the calm she had accumulated during the day. She dimmed the bedside lamp, flipped through two more pages of Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan as a closing ritual, then put the book back on the nightstand. She pulled up a thin quilt, closed her eyes, and slowly fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run and stretching
description: The alarm went off right on time. She changed into a light gray sports T-shirt and black shorts and put on her fitness tracker. She jogged along Renmin Middle Road in front of her home toward Green Lake, keeping a steady pace of about 7:30 per kilometer. When she reached the entrance of Green Lake Park, she was especially delighted by the tranquil lake in the morning mist. Then she walked briskly back and did 10 minutes of static stretching by the flower beds downstairs in her residential compound, and logged the workout data in a mobile app.
location: Along Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Green Lake Park

name: Nutritious breakfast and family chat
description: When I got home, Mom had already prepared breakfast: steamed sweet potato, hot milk, and a small bowl of washed blueberries. As we ate, I told Mom about a very affectionate stray cat I met during my morning run and mentioned that I should eat more vegetables for lunch today. She smiled and agreed.
location: Home Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revise and submit the final draft of the column essay.
description: Sitting down at her desk, she opens her laptop and brings up the first draft of “Street Life Memories of Old Kunming”. She opens her journal and, comparing it with editor Xu Mingyuan's suggestions, begins revising paragraph by paragraph. She trims away the overly ornate adjectives one by one, breaks the fast-paced parallel sentences into more relaxed short sentences, and weaves in details about the old streets that came up in yesterday's chat with her mother. After nearly three hours of polishing, she sends the final draft to Editor Xu via WeChat around 11 o'clock, with a note: “Hi Editor Xu, the revised draft has been sent. Please review it.” The other party quickly replies “Received.”
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Work wrap-up and journaling
description: Closed the document and tidied up the desk piled with reference books. In the journal, she recorded the key item "Old Street prose finalized, submitted" and drew a small checkmark beside it, satisfied with her efficiency that morning.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and dietary adjustments.
description: At lunch, there were stir-fried choy sum and garlic broccoli, and Sun Yuwei deliberately took a few extra helpings. Her mother joked, asking why she had suddenly become so fond of vegetables; she smiled and explained that lighter food felt better in summer. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, came home for lunch, praised the freshness of the dishes, and chatted about some amusing stories from work.
location: Home Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon meditation and nap
description: After the meal, she brought up a 15-minute guided meditation audio on her phone, put on her earphones, and closed her eyes, letting her mind pull away from the morning's concentrated writing to focus on her breath and feel her body relax. After the meditation, she felt her spirits restored, building up energy for the afternoon's activities.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Receiving and organizing handmade paper
description: The delivery person rang the doorbell, and she signed for a heavy cardboard box. She hugged it excitedly into her study and carefully cut the sealing tape with a craft knife. Inside the box, more than a dozen kinds of handmade paper were neatly arranged. She sorted them by material—mulberry bark paper, flower-and-plant paper, silk paper, and others—and carefully spread them on the desk to admire. As she ran her fingers over the rough, plant-fiber surfaces, she felt her cousin's thoughtfulness and the warm, delicate texture of Hangzhou.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Handmade paper appreciation and creative ideation
description: She picked out a piece of her favorite pale purple flower paper and cut it to postcard size. With her usual fountain pen, she wrote, "For someone far away — autumn has come to Kunming." The nib made a soft rustling sound against the paper, and the feel was excellent. As she watched the ink bleed and bloom, the idea of "Four Seasons Letters" gradually took shape in her mind.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bought vegetables at the supermarket.
description: After checking the fridge stock, she changed into going-out clothes and walked to the City Garden Supermarket not far from home. In the vegetable section, she carefully selected green choy sum, two heads of broccoli, and a box of fresh blueberries to complete next week's diet adjustment plan. At checkout, she used her membership card to get a 10% discount on the choy sum, and felt that saving a few yuan was a nice little pleasure.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Putting away ingredients and taking a short rest.
description: After returning home, she wrapped the vegetables she had bought in kitchen paper towels and put them in the crisper drawer of the refrigerator. She made herself a cup of green tea, sat on the living room sofa to rest, and casually flipped through the newly purchased 'Kunming Old Street Photography Collection', looking for an emotional resonance for the evening walk.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Fourth family walk and oral history recording at Green Lake.
description: Her parents were ready; Mother had specially changed into a floral dress, and Father had put on a new shirt. The three walked about five minutes from home to Green Lake Park. Today's walk theme was the story of how her parents met and fell in love. Sun Yuwei quietly placed a voice recorder in her coat pocket and guided the conversation as she walked. Mother recounted her trip from Qujing to Kunming to study, including the embarrassment of nearly losing her admission notice during registration; Father added the scene of seeing her for the first time at the registration site. On the stone bridge near the pavilion in the middle of the lake, Mother pointed to the end of the bridge and said, "This is where your dad confessed to me." Sun Yuwei listened attentively, occasionally asking, "What were you wearing then?" and "What did Dad say?", firmly locking away these precious family memories.
location: Green Lake Park and surrounding lakeside areas, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Return trip and buying flower cakes.
description: After the walk, the family slowly headed home along the tree-lined avenue. Passing a familiar pastry shop, her father went in and bought two boxes of freshly baked flower cakes, saying they would be snacks for tomorrow morning. Sun Yuwei took the bag, and the fragrance of roses drifted out through the plastic bag, making her feel especially at ease.
location: No. 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Haichao Lane, Qingyun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Jiqing Huayu Fresh-Baked Flower Cake (Yuantong Street Branch)

name: Helping with dinner and family time
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei proactively helped her mother wash and prepare vegetables. The mother and daughter chatted in the kitchen about funny moments from the earlier walk. Dinner was stir-fried choy sum, broccoli stir-fried with wood ears, and tomato egg drop soup. She used the vegetables she had bought as the main ingredients and ate with great satisfaction.
location: Home Kitchen, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and cleaning up
description: The family sat around the dinner table. During the meal, Sun Yuwei shared her plan to video-call her cousin that evening to discuss ideas for a cultural creative brand. Her parents were very supportive, and her father reminded her to ask her cousin for more advice on the market side. After dinner, she helped clear the bowls and chopsticks into the kitchen.
location: Home Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with her cousin Shen Wei.
description: She placed the video call to her cousin right on time. On the screen, Shen Wei was beaming and eagerly asked whether she had received the paper. Sun Yuwei excitedly pointed her phone at the various handmade papers spread out on the table and shared her thoughts. As they talked, Shen Wei came up with the idea of combining handmade paper with text to create cultural-creative stationery. Sun Yuwei immediately chimed in, saying she had been thinking the same thing and had even already sketched out the theme “Four Seasons of Kunming.” The more they talked, the deeper they went—from design ideas and pricing strategies to online promotion—sparking many ideas.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cultural creative inspiration notes and sketch drawing.
description: After the video ended, she was still immersed in excitement. She took out her journal and quickly sketched a design draft for the 'Four Seasons Letter Paper' series in pencil, writing down a few key points she had discussed with her older cousin, such as paper pairing, theme copy, and preliminary pricing. Then she opened the memo app on her phone and wrote, 'Consider contacting Song Wen tomorrow to hear his feedback.' After thinking it over, she decided to send him a WeChat message before bed tonight to share her initial ideas.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and meditation before bed
description: She changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and opened "Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan." She read two short essays about old Kunming teahouses; the plain yet flavorful writing gradually calmed her. After 20 minutes, she closed the book, took the yoga mat out from the bedside cabinet, spread it on the floor beside the bed, and did a 10-minute meditation on the theme of "gratitude," reviewing every fulfilling moment of the day.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal summary and daily expense tracking.
description: Coming back from meditation, she carefully wrote down several core keywords for the day on the day's page of her journal: "morning run/final draft delivery/handmade paper/Green Lake walk/parents' story/cultural creative plan". At the same time, she took out the supermarket receipt from her bag and used a mobile app to record today's vegetable expenses, maintaining her daily bookkeeping habit. Then she opened WeChat and sent a message to her friend Song Wen: "Wen, I've been thinking about a small cultural creative project using handmade paper stationery. I'd like to hear your thoughts. Can we chat when you're free?"
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up, skincare, and preparing for sleep
description: After checking tomorrow’s weather, she went into the bathroom for a quick wash-up and skincare routine. Once her skin felt fresh, she returned to the bedroom and set the alarm for 6:50. She turned off the overhead light, leaving only a desk lamp, and in the soft dim light, with the contentment of a productive day, she fell asleep peacefully before 23:20.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up at 7 a.m., washed up, weighed in at 45.2 kg, exchanged good mornings with her parents, felt the warm family atmosphere, and prepared to start a new day.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and daily communication
description: Had breakfast with my parents, eating multigrain porridge and fried eggs; discussed the handmade paper sent by my cousin; my father reminded me to use sunscreen; browsed my phone and replied to WeChat; confirmed the day's work schedule.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Changed into a cotton-linen dress, put on a canvas bag, brought the stationery sketch, walked west along Renmin Middle Road from home, passed through the south gate of Green Lake Park, and arrived at Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore after about 17 minutes, feeling the city's morning atmosphere along the way.
location: On the way from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, passing Green Lake Park, to Zhibushi Bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road

name: Bookstore communication and book purchase
description: At Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore, she showed Uncle Qin (the bookstore owner) a plan for combining handmade paper with text. Uncle Qin suggested using mulberry bark paper to echo the nostalgic flavor of her prose. They chatted about new books by local writers, and she bought the sequel to Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan to prepare for evening reading.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cycle to the printing company
description: After leaving the bookstore, she scanned a shared bike at the intersection, rode south along West Green Lake Road, then turned onto Qingnian Road. After cycling about 15 minutes and 2 kilometers, she arrived at Kunming Shenggao Printing Co., Ltd., enjoying the breeze and arriving smoothly along the route she had confirmed in advance on Amap.
location: On the way cycling from No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Kunming Shenggao Printing Co., Ltd. at No. 87 Qingnian Road.

name: Printing house coordination and sticker order confirmation.
description: At the printing company, she first confirmed the details of the line art for six flower sticker designs online with Zhou Lin via Tencent Meeting, making minor adjustments to the magnolia shadows. Then she handed the final draft on a USB drive to Supervisor Chen, specifying the material as matte art paper self-adhesive, size 8cm x 8cm, six designs with 500 sheets each, 3,000 sheets in total, and agreeing to have a proof ready before the 28th. She paid a 30% deposit through mobile banking.
location: Kunming Shenggao Printing Co., Ltd., No. 87 Qingnian Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home and helped prepare lunch
description: Rode a shared bike for about 20 minutes home, passing the vegetable stall in Cuihu Community to buy buckwheat steamed buns; after arriving home, helped her mother pick vegetables and prepare ingredients for cold rice noodles, shared the smooth experience from the morning, and her mother praised her ability to handle things independently.
location: Cycled from 87 Qingnian Road back home; activity at Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Mother-daughter lunch
description: Had lunch with my mother; my father did not come home because he was working overtime at his workplace. The meal was refreshing cold rice noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. We chatted about how smoothly things had gone at the printing company that day.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and sorting handmade paper.
description: After lunch, I rested with my eyes closed on the sofa for 15 minutes, then went to the study to sort the mulberry bark paper, flower-and-grass paper, and silk paper sent by my cousin by thickness, texture, and color, labeling them with tags such as "suitable for letter paper" and "suitable for sticky notes" to prepare for the afternoon's creative work.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Making sample sheets of handmade paper letter paper and notes
description: In the study, I immersed myself in deep creative work. First, I drew layout drafts for three styles of letter paper and two styles of sticky notes. Then I used a brush pen to transcribe my prose excerpt 'Morning Mist over Green Lake' on light purple mulberry paper, and wrote the short poem 'Rainy Season' on botanical paper covered with pressed flowers. After the ink dried, I decorated them with dried-flower stickers. Throughout the process, I was in a state of flow, feeling a dialogue between words and paper.
location: Home, Cuihu Community Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon tea and food diary
description: I paused my writing, ate about 25 grams of raw almonds, and brewed Tieguanyin oolong tea. Using the “Mint Health” app, I recorded my calorie intake (almonds about 150 kcal, tea 0 kcal) to ease the afternoon hunger and maintain my creative focus.
location: Home, Cuihu Community Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to Green Lake Park
description: She changed into athletic leggings and running shoes, took her earphones and voice recorder, walked about 10 minutes from home to Little Bird Park (Green Lake Park), and got ready for a brisk walking workout.
location: On the way from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Park

name: Brisk walk workout at Green Lake Park.
description: Walked briskly for 40 minutes on the lakeside trail around Cuihu Park, maintaining a pace of about 6 km/h and a heart rate of about 115 beats per minute; also listened to the cultural podcast "City Memories" episode about the changes of old buildings in Kunming, and observed the weeping willows by the lake and late-blooming lotus flowers as creative material.
location: Lakeside trail of Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family walk at Cuihu and oral history collection.
description: After the brisk walk, she met her parents at the Heart-of-the-Lake Pavilion and started the family walking route (Heart-of-the-Lake Pavilion, Nine-Bend Bridge, Water-Moon Pavilion); she quietly turned on the voice recorder, guiding her father to talk about his three-shift factory work back then and her mother to recall the hardships of raising the two sisters alone, recording many true details and accumulating valuable material for the essay collection “Folds of Time”.
location: Around the Mid-Lake Pavilion, Nine-Bend Bridge, and Water-Moon Pavilion in Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home from a walk and preparing dinner
description: The family walked home from the park. Mother suggested going to "Junweixian" for a mushroom hot pot on the weekend, and everyone agreed. Once home, she helped Mother pick vegetables and serve rice. The family of three had dinner together, with steamed sea bass, garlic water spinach, and tomato-egg soup—plain, yet happy.
location: Returned from Green Lake Park to home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Recording transcription and oral history material sorting
description: After dinner, she opened her laptop and iFlytek Tingjian in the study, transcribed the walking recording into text, and marked key timestamps as she listened (e.g., 18:20 father talking about job transfer, 18:35 mother recalling taking her sister to see a doctor), building a material archive for writing.
location: Home, Cuihu Community Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and financial bookkeeping
description: Using a TN journal and a fountain pen, she recorded the day's key events, pasting a printing company receipt, a scrap of flower-and-plant paper, and a bookstore purchase receipt as decoration. In the journal, she wrote: "The texture of paper gives words warmth, and family stories give life depth." Then she opened the expense-tracking app and logged expenses such as books, cycling, a printing deposit, and buckwheat steamed buns.
location: Home, Cuihu Community Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading 'Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan'
description: After changing into her pajamas, she leaned against the headboard and read the sequel to Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan that she had bought during the day. She savored the descriptions of teahouse customs along Kunming's old streets, marked the sentences she liked with a pencil, and immersed herself in the imagined scents of tea and wood brought by the words.
location: Home, bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and skincare
description: Turn off the main light and leave the warm yellow desk lamp on, play 5 minutes of stream white noise, and practice mindfulness meditation themed "Gratitude and Creation"; afterward, do basic skincare such as cleansing and applying moisturizing lotion.
location: Home - bedroom and bathroom - Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and summary
description: Lying in bed, I reviewed the stationery layout I had made that day, noted down ideas for improvement, set the alarm for 7:10 tomorrow morning, then turned off the light and fell asleep amid fulfilling and warm memories.
location: Home, bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up, washing up, and morning preparations
description: Woke up at 7:03 to the phone alarm. Outside the window the sky was faintly light, a light rain was falling, and it felt slightly cool. I threw on a knit cardigan, washed up in the bathroom, and weighed myself on the body-fat scale, which showed 45.3 kg. Then I changed into a light gray cotton-linen long dress that had been prepared in advance and started the new day.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Mother had prepared steaming small-pot rice noodles and freshly baked buckwheat cakes. At the table, Sun Yuwei shared her plan for the day: writing at home and sorting handmade paper in the morning, and going to Mingyuan Bookstore for a salon in the afternoon. She thanked her mother again for suggesting they go out for mushroom hot pot on the weekend, and her father reminded her to take an umbrella when she went out.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Final column draft submission and line-art feedback
description: Following her habit of being efficient in the morning, Sun Yuwei opened her laptop. She first logged into her email and sent the final draft of her carefully revised column article, Memories of Old Kunming Streets, to editor Xu Mingyuan, along with a writing note. Then she checked WeChat and saw the sticker line art Zhou Lin had sent last night. She carefully compared several floral patterns and gave specific feedback via voice messages, including adjusting the curvature of the petals and adding more leaf vein detail, and they agreed to confirm another version tomorrow.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Organize handmade paper samples and prepare content for the salon.
description: Sun Yuwei took out the five handmade paper samples she had made yesterday — mulberry bark paper for prose, flower-and-grass paper for poetry, etc. — and used her phone to take close-up photos of each sample, then recorded in detail her insights from making them and possible improvements in her journal. She then flipped through Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan and several notebooks on place-based writing, thinking about the topics that might be discussed at the afternoon salon. She focused on how traditional media like handmade paper could be combined with contemporary place-based writing, and wrote down a few keywords on sticky notes.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Shared lunch with my mother.
description: Her mother made Sun Yuwei’s favorite noodles with shredded pork and green peppers and added a fried egg. As she ate, she chatted with her mother about the afternoon salon, and her mother encouraged her to interact more with seniors.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing to go out and walking to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei packed her canvas bag, checking the voice recorder, notebook, pen, and portable phone charger. She opened the salon poster for Mingyuan Bookstore again to confirm the event schedule. Considering the rainy weather and the salon atmosphere, she changed into a navy blue linen-cotton shirt and jeans, added a cream-colored knit cardigan, took her folding umbrella, and put on canvas shoes. Then, holding the umbrella, she walked along the wet bluestone path from her home through the light rain to Mingyuan Bookstore. The sound of rain, the footsteps of passersby, and the lively atmosphere of the old street in the distance blended together, making her feel at ease. The whole walk took about 15 minutes.
location: Walk from 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Mingyuan Bookstore at 28 Guanghua Street.

name: Mingyuan Bookstore Cultural Salon and Social Events
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore ahead of time; there were only a few readers in the store. The bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, invited her to sit by the counter and handed her a cup of hot Pu'er tea. She took out her phone to show Uncle Qin the handmade paper samples she had made yesterday, and explained her idea of combining text with handmade paper to create creative letter stationery. Uncle Qin was very interested and gave her a few suggestions about cost and market positioning. At 2 p.m., the cultural salon on independent bookstores and place-based writing began on time. Four local writers, bookstore managers, and other participants took part in the roundtable discussion. Using her experience of working at a fixed desk in Mingyuan Bookstore as an example, Sun Yuwei shared how young creators can find inspiration in a fixed space. Her remarks were approved by the guests, and she recorded the entire session with a voice recorder. After the salon, she took the initiative to exchange WeChat contacts with two writers of her age, and they discussed creative directions and places for gathering inspiration. Then she wandered around the bookstore, was drawn to the newly arrived "An Illustrated Record of Ancient Bridges in Yunnan", bought it, and also picked up the latest issue of Duku. At checkout, she thanked Uncle Qin again.

participant.name: Two writers of the same age.

location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 28 Guanghua Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home and buy groceries
description: After leaving the bookstore, Sun Yuwei walked home with an umbrella. Passing by Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street, she remembered that she wanted to make a vegetable salad tomorrow morning, so she went in and bought lettuce, purple cabbage, cherry tomatoes, and a bottle of vinaigrette, paying with her membership card. It took about 12 minutes to walk from the bookstore to the supermarket, and then she continued home.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and on the way home

name: Video-called with my sister to choose clothes for the family portrait.
description: After returning home and putting down the shopping bags, Sun Yuwei received a video call from her elder sister, Sun Yutong. The two searched online for a local Kunming shop that rents Republican-era clothing. After comparing several qipaos and Chinese tunic suits, they decided that Yuwei would go to the physical store to try on and rent two qipaos and one Chinese tunic suit. On her sister's suggestion, she ordered a shawl to match the qipao. Yuwei completed the payment on her phone, and the delivery was expected within one week.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family stroll at Green Lake
description: The rain had let up slightly, and the air was fresh. Sun Yuwei and her parents went out with umbrellas for the sixth family walk, with the theme of how her parents first met. Along the shady trees by the lake, they recalled the details of their first encounter at the entrance of Green Lake Photo Studio. Her mother described the sounds and smells of street vendors selling roasted rice cakes back then, while her father added details about how the city's architecture had changed. Sun Yuwei turned on her voice recorder and recorded the whole time, feeling that these vivid memories were piecing together a complete picture of the city and the family.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping with dinner and having dinner together.
description: After walking home, Sun Yuwei helped her mother prepare dinner, washing the freshly bought vegetables and cutting fruit. The family sat around the table; dinner was her father's signature braised beef and stir-fried choy sum. At the table, Yuwei shared interesting insights from the salon and her elder sister's progress in choosing outfits for the family portrait.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing the walk recording
description: During the rest after the meal, Sun Yuwei connected the voice recorder to her computer, named the day's walking recording file Sixth Session - How My Parents Met - 20250820 and saved it to her cloud notes. She briefly checked her phone messages and replied to Zhou Lin's WeChat confirming the line-drawing revisions.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Studying a recorded watercolor course.
description: Sun Yuwei turned on her tablet on time and opened the first video lesson in the pre-recorded watercolor course.
