She followed the video to learn the basic techniques of wet-on-wet painting: applying water, dropping color, and color diffusion. She took out her newly purchased Baohong watercolor paper and Sakura solid watercolors and followed the teacher in practicing gradient skies and clouds. The process was a bit clumsy, but watching the colors bloom in the water felt very soothing. During the break, she made herself a cup of jasmine tea and stretched her shoulders, which had become stiff from sitting for too long.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Video consultation with my older female cousin about insurance and took notes
description: Sun Yuwei video-called her cousin Shen Wei. After chatting about recent news, she got down to business and asked how freelancers should arrange social insurance and commercial insurance. Her cousin, who was preparing for the financial planner exam, gave her specific advice: first go to the community subdistrict office to ask about social insurance for flexible employment, then add a million-yuan medical insurance policy with guaranteed renewal for 20 years. They talked for about 40 minutes. Shen Wei also recommended two specific products for Yuwei to compare on her own. Right after the video call ended, Yuwei opened her journal and used pens of different colors to carefully record in detail the application process and points to note that her cousin had mentioned. On the page, she also drew a simple flowchart, marking Step 1: consult about social insurance, Step 2: compare medical insurance, and wrote down a few keywords to look up the next day.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Journal summary and tomorrow's plan
description: Sun Yuwei began her daily review. She placed photos of today's watercolor class practice into her journal and wrote next to them an insight: too much water makes the paint run, so next time she should control the amount of water. Then she recorded the supermarket expenses and summarized the day's gains: the submission was done, the salon was inspiring, the walk had a wonderful story, and insurance now had a direction. Finally, she listed tomorrow's plan: try on a qipao in the morning, consult the community about social security in the afternoon, and go to the Paper, Cloth, and Stone Bookstore in the evening.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Reading, Meditation, and Bedtime Preparation
description: After changing into her pajamas, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and read two pieces from the sequel to Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan. Then she turned off the light and, as usual, did a five-minute gratitude meditation, reviewing the small and solid kindnesses in today's life — her parents' breakfast, Uncle Qin's Pu'er tea, her sister's suggestion, and her cousin's professionalism. After meditating, she went to the bathroom and carefully did her full skincare routine, then returned to the bedroom, took out tomorrow's clothes and placed them on a chair, and set the alarm for 7:00. Lying in bed, the day's lovely fragments flashed through her mind: walking in the rain, the scent of old books, the blooming of watercolor washes. The corners of her mouth rose unconsciously. Eventually, with a sense of harvest and the satisfaction of being loved, she fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: Woken by the alarm at 6:50 in the morning, she did a simple 5-minute yoga stretch in front of the window, then washed up and applied a hydrating mask while playing the audio of 'The Story of the Nanzhao Kingdom' on her phone to warm up for the morning's cultural exchange. Then she had breakfast with her mother Li Xiulan and father Sun Mingyuan: vegetable and lean pork congee, pickled vegetables, and fried eggs. During the meal, she shared the day's plan: going to Mingyuan Bookstore in the morning to work on her journal, a yoga class in the afternoon, and a family walk around Green Lake in the evening. Her mother reminded her that there would be a thunderstorm in the afternoon, and her father told her to ride carefully. After breakfast, she tidied up and got ready to go out, checking her journal, watercolor pen case, material kit (tickets, postcards, and pressed dried petals from the Dali trip), laptop, water bottle, and folding umbrella, and brought along the flower cakes her mother had made to give to Uncle Qin.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing journal at Mingyuan Bookstore and discussing local history with Uncle Qin.
description: Walking about 15 minutes from home to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, observing old buildings along the way to gather material for writing. After arriving, I ordered a cup of hot milk at my usual window seat and began organizing my Dali travel journal from late July: using watercolor pens to draw the gradient of Cangshan snow and Erhai moonlight, pasting in the ticket to the Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple and postcards from Xizhou Ancient Town, and writing in fountain pen about the amusing encounter with a tie-dye workshop when I got lost in the old town. Uncle Qin often praised the color scheme when he passed by. After a break in the journal, I went to the reading area and shared with Uncle Qin the inspiration about place-based writing from yesterday's salon. Uncle Qin pulled A History of the Nanzhao Kingdom and Notes on the Tea Horse Road from the shelf and recommended them to me. We had a lively discussion about the customs of the Nanzhao Kingdom, gathering material for a collection of essays.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 142 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch at Binhu Restaurant and finishing up the journal
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she walked to Binhu Restaurant on Wenlin Street and ordered a small-pot rice noodle dish and cucumber salad. While waiting, she used her phone memo to record an idea for the essay “The Embrace of Sound Waves”: “Like ancient chime bells, the vibration of a singing bowl is not a sound wave; it is ripples of time spreading through the body.” After the meal, she put the finishing touches on her journal text, feeling satisfied.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went home, changed clothes, and cycled to the yoga studio.
description: Walked 15 minutes from Binhu Hotel back home, changed into yoga clothes, and packed the folding yoga mat, water bottle, and small towel into a sports backpack. Seeing the sky turn cloudy, she took a thin jacket and set off early. She scanned a shared bike downstairs and rode along Renmin Middle Road, turning west onto Dongfeng West Road for about 12 minutes, arriving at Dechun Commercial Building.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Zhongmou Yoga Studio Hatha yoga class, singing bowl meditation, and post-class writing.
description: Arrived at the Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the 4th floor of Dechun Commercial Building, checked in early and entered the classroom. Followed Teacher He Lu through a satisfying Hatha yoga class, and held a stable headstand for 28 seconds. At the end of the class, a singing bowl meditation segment was added for the first time; lying on the mat, I felt the deep stillness of the bowl's sound passing through my body. After class, on the sofa in the rest area, while the feeling was still fresh, I wrote the short essay “The Embrace of Sound Waves” in one go, and posted it on Xiaohongshu under “Yuwei's Slow Journal” along with a blurred photo of light and shadow by the floor-to-ceiling window.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After returning home, talked with her cousin, helped her mother prepare vegetables, and read
description: After walking from the yoga studio to the bus stop and taking the bus home, I happened to catch a brief rain shower. Sitting in the bus watching the curtain of rain outside the window, I arrived home about 15 minutes later. Once home, I brewed a pot of flower tea and had a WeChat voice call with my cousin Shen Wei in the study, discussing handmade xuan paper samples in detail. Using the zoom function on my phone's photos, I pointed out text layout issues, and we reached a consensus on revisions, agreeing to talk again next Thursday. After hanging up, I went to the living room to help my mother Li Xiulan string beans, sharing the wonderful feeling of the singing bowl meditation from yoga class. Then I returned to my room, flipped through "Travel Notes on the Tea Horse Road" borrowed from the bookstore, and copied down vivid passages about the Yunnan horse caravans.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening family walk around Green Lake, finishing the oral history, and a rest at an old teahouse
description: After the rain shower, the air was fresh and moist. The family of three walked from home to Green Lake Park, slowly strolling along the lakeside path washed by the rain. Mother shared her reflections on wrapping up the family oral history project, and Father added details about going to the movies in his youth. Near the Mid-Lake Pavilion, Sun Yuwei took out her sketchbook, quickly drew a simple sketch of Green Lake, and wrote down “wrinkles of time” and “love is inheritance,” bringing the long-running oral history work to a close. Then Father suggested resting for a while at Chang Ruipu's Republic-era old teahouse by Biyi Pavilion in the park. They ordered pu'er tea and sunflower seeds, sat in bamboo chairs listening to Mom and Dad chat, and felt peaceful and happy. Afterward, the family strolled home and bought newly available autumn moon pears from the fruit stall at the entrance of their residential complex.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the Chang Ruipu Republic-era old teahouse at Biyi Pavilion in the park.

name: Family dinner preparation and sharing
description: After returning home, she helped her mother prepare dinner: washing vegetables and cutting the autumn moon pears into pieces. Her mother reheated the midday celery beef stir-fry and stir-fried a plate of water spinach with garlic. Her father brewed fresh Pu'er tea. During dinner, Sun Yuwei shared in detail the feedback on the short article 'The Embrace of Sound Waves' that she had posted on Xiaohongshu after yoga class. At her mother's request, she read the article aloud. Her father asked about the progress of organizing the oral history materials notebook, and she said she would start typesetting tomorrow.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening study: organizing materials, handling Xiaohongshu feedback, and journal bookkeeping.
description: After the meal, she returned to the study. She opened her phone and saw that "The Embrace of Sound Waves" had received more than ten comments and likes. Some local netizens shared their meditation experiences, and she seriously replied to each one. Then she used the voice recorder on her phone to record her parents' concluding remarks from their walk, preparing to organize them into a manuscript the next day. Next, she took out today's journal, pasted in the title-page information for "Tea Horse Road Travel Notes" and the sticker from an autumn moon pear, and wrote: "The seventh time, it's complete. The sound of the singing bowl is still echoing in my body." Finally, she opened the expense-tracking app and entered the lunch cost, bus fare, fruit, and teahouse expenses one by one.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime reading, meditation, and journaling.
description: After washing up and doing her skincare routine, she lay in bed and flipped through “Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan.” She was deeply moved by an essay describing the rainy season in Kunming with the line “moss creeping green up the steps.” After reading for 30 minutes, she turned off the light and did 10 minutes of mindful breathing meditation to fully relax her body and mind. After the meditation, she wrote a short note in her phone memo: “The singing bowl's resonance still lingers, the oral history has found a good home, and the warmth from RedNote is comforting. The sound of closing the notebook is like tonight's moon, round and bright.” Then she gradually drifted into sleep with a sense of happiness.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning flower arranging
description: Morning light streamed through the curtains. After getting up, I did some simple stretches, took out the lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves I had brought back from Dounan Flower Market yesterday, and cut some small daisies from the potted plants at home. I trimmed and arranged them, put them in a white ceramic vase, and placed it on my sister's bedroom windowsill. I also gave the pennywort a spritz of water, welcoming my sister home with warm flowers.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and family conversation
description: My mother cooked crossing-the-bridge rice noodles with pickled radish. As I ate, I confirmed with my father the plan to leave at 9:20 for the airport. Mother mentioned making steam pot chicken and stir-fried mushrooms with green peppers for lunch, and I reminded her not to forget the stir-fried pork my sister loves. Father suggested showing my sister the article I wrote about Green Lake, and I also shared my recent writing plans.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning preparation and tidying
description: I went back to my room, changed into a light blue dress, and put my notebook, fountain pen, voice recorder, and power bank into a canvas bag. Thinking my sister might want to see my Xiaohongshu account, I opened the article “The Embrace of Sound Waves” I published a few days ago, picked out a few interesting questions to discuss with her, and got ready for today’s time together as sisters.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Read Historical Stories of the Nanzhao Kingdom.
description: When it was almost time to leave, I sat on the living room sofa and flipped through "Historical Tales of the Nanzhao Kingdom," borrowed from Mingyuan Bookstore. I used a highlighter to underline descriptions of villages around Erhai Lake, planning to discuss this history with my father during the evening walk, and also did a brief preview for the night's reading.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Drive to the airport.
description: Father was driving. We set off from Renmin Middle Road and headed to Kunming Changshui International Airport. On the way, I rolled down the window to feel the cool breeze of the cloudy day, my heart full of excitement at the thought of seeing my sister. The navigation showed an estimated 52-minute drive. We arrived smoothly at the P3 parking lot of the airport and walked together to the domestic arrivals exit.
location: From Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District

name: Writing and waiting at the airport café
description: My sister's flight is expected to land at 11:15. My father and I are waiting at the Starbucks in the airport arrivals hall. He is reading news on his phone. I ordered a cappuccino, took out my notebook, and thought about how to combine the educated youth stories my father told with the farming and sericulture records in “Tales of the Nanzhao Kingdom,” writing down keywords such as “Memories of the Land” to find an entry point for the essay.
location: Starbucks in the arrival hall of Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Airport pickup, reunion, and heading home.
description: When I saw my sister coming out with her suitcase, I ran over excitedly and hugged her. My father also hurried over and patted her on the shoulder. My sister said I was looking better, and I joked that she had lost weight. Driving home from the P3 parking lot, the car was filled with the sisters' playful banter and our father's interjections—laughter all the way.
location: From Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District.

name: Hearty family dinner and lively conversation
description: Mother's steam-pot chicken was rich and delicious, and the stir-fried mushrooms with green peppers were fragrant. We sat around the table listening to my sister talk about the community group-buying app, a new project at her company in Shenzhen. I also shared the feedback on the article the magazine had requested. From time to time, my father asked my sister about working overtime and reminded her to take care of herself. The meal was full of warmth and lasted an hour and a half.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Sisters' heart-to-heart talk and discussion of cultural creative products
description: After my sister changed into loungewear, we leaned on the bed and chatted. I took out the cultural creative design samples from "Slow Time Journal Shop", including the Kunming Memory series postcards and floral stickers. She looked at them carefully and offered advice, saying my paintings had a spark of talent but needed story packaging. She suggested turning the Cuihu Lake images into a series and shooting short creative videos to promote on Xiaohongshu. I quickly wrote down the good ideas. Later, my sister took a half-hour nap, and I quietly drew a mind map beside her to organize them.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: Returning home and recording in journal.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Brief rest and walk preparation
description: Back home, I gave the pear to my mother and drank a glass of water. My sister was already awake; she didn't want to go out for a walk, and I said I understood. I took my voice recorder, thermos, and notebook, changed into flat cloth shoes, and got ready for the evening walk by Green Lake.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Cuihu Family Walk and Oral Recording
description: At dusk, brilliant sunset clouds appeared on the horizon, and I walked slowly along Cuihu Lake with my parents. My father talked about his years as a sent-down youth in a frontier farm, urgently repairing a reservoir; my mother added that letters in those days were written on cheap straw paper and took a month to reach home. I recorded every detail with a voice recorder, and when I got tired, I sat on a bench and noted down key times and feelings in my notebook with a fountain pen. My father's family memories gradually came alive in words.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and replenishing ingredients
description: We slowly returned along the same route. Passing Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, my mother went in again and bought pea shoots and tofu for tomorrow's breakfast, and at the fruit stand at the entrance bought winter jujubes and pomegranates. Carrying the heavy fruit, I felt happiness in my hands. By the time we walked home, dusk was just falling.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market and the surrounding area, 69 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Helped with meal preparation and chatted.
description: After getting home, my sister put down her book and joined me in the kitchen. I was in charge of trimming pea shoots, and my sister helped beat eggs. We talked about the afternoon's suggestions on serializing cultural and creative products. I connected the voice recorder to my computer and saved my father's story into the oral history folder. My mother started simmering rock sugar pear soup, and the kitchen filled with a warm aroma.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Cozy dinner and sharing
description: Dinner was my mother's home-style cooking, paired with stir-fried pea shoots; it was fresh and delicious. At the table, I shared the educated youth stories I had heard that afternoon. My sister was completely absorbed and asked about details such as the current state of the reservoir and how to contact former fellow workers. Mother served rock sugar pear soup. After dinner, the family sat around drinking tea and eating winter jujubes and pomegranates, talking about my sister's job, my writing, and amusing anecdotes from our parents' youth, with endless laughter.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening tidying and late-night chat with sisters.
description: After clearing the dishes, my sister and I carried our tea to the small balcony table and sat facing each other. I opened my laptop, imported the recording of our walk into the Yuji App for a preliminary transcription, then sketched a journal layout in a new plain notebook and wrote down the three most special moments of the day with a fountain pen: the hug at the airport, my father's face as he told stories, and the reunion scene of drinking soup that evening. My sister, meanwhile, handled work emails on her tablet, occasionally looking up with a gentle smile. We talked now and then, feeling at ease and complete.
location: Balcony, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and meditation before bed
description: After washing up, I leaned against the headboard and continued reading the chapter of Historical Tales of the Nanzhao Kingdom about the agricultural development around Erhai Lake during the Tang Dynasty, feeling a timeless echo with my father's stories. After reading for twenty minutes, I put on my earphones and listened to a fifteen-minute nature-sound meditation audio to calm my mind.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Diary and review
description: After meditation, I wrote a short note in my phone's memo: "Sister is back, and the family is whole. My father's memories are my mine, worth excavating and polishing with care. Today I did several concrete things: discussed cultural creative projects, recorded oral accounts, and read before bed—I feel a strong sense of control." After turning off the light, I was ready to fall asleep with a sense of happiness.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Early morning solitude and journaling time
description: She woke naturally in the summer sunlight, leaned against the headboard, and stroked the cover of the sample copy of *Slow Travel Notes*. Then she sat down at her desk and, on a new page of her journal, used colored pens to write down the cultural-creative ideas she discussed with her sister last night, today's task list, and the Shenzhen market situation her sister shared.
location: At home (in front of the bedroom desk), Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning outdoor errands
description: She changed into a light dress, applied sunscreen, put on a sun hat, and went out. She walked to the Nanmen Tofu Pudding Rice Noodle Shop on Cuihu South Road to buy mushroom sauce for Mom, then walked along Green Lake Park to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street to buy soda water, enjoying the birdsong and the energy of morning exercise by Green Lake, and finally walked home.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 5 Cuihu South Road, Nanmen Douhua Rice Noodles (Cuihu Zuanjie Branch) and the route along the way

name: Reading alone and preparing for work.
description: After arriving home, she saw her elder sister still sleeping soundly, so she tiptoed back to the living room. She poured herself a glass of warm water, sat on the sofa, and sent a WeChat message to Zhou Lin to confirm the afternoon inventory time. Then she quietly read Lin Qingxuan's essays, enjoying the tranquility of the weekend morning.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Verify sticker design online with Zhou Lin
description: Zhou Lin replied that she would arrive at 2:30 p.m. Taking advantage of this time, Sun Yuwei turned on her computer, had a WeChat voice call with Zhou Lin, checked the digital design files for the stickers, order information, and tonight's draft copy for Moments, and tested the backend of the 'Yuwei Slow Record' online mini-store to make sure the listing process went smoothly.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch with cookie tasting
description: Sister got up, and the family sat around the dining table. Mom made fish with pickled cabbage and sautéed seasonal vegetables. During the meal, Yuwei shared what she had seen and heard in the morning, and her sister Sun Yutong talked about a cultural merchandise case from a Shenzhen company that combined dialect with city landmarks. After the meal, Yuwei brewed Pu'er tea, and her sister brought out the handmade cookies she had brought back from Shenzhen. The whole family chatted while eating, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and tidying up
description: After the meal, I helped Mom clear the dishes and put away the mushroom sauce and sparkling water we had bought. Feeling sleepy, I lay down for a half-hour nap to recharge. When I woke up, I changed into a more comfortable cotton-linen shirt to get ready for going out in the afternoon.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sisters' old-town walk and bookstore shopping
description: The two sisters set off on foot with parasols, first going to Nanping Pedestrian Street to buy freshly baked flower cakes and fried mushrooms with chili powder, chatting about childhood summer vacations as they strolled. Then they walked to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, where the owner, Qin Mingyuan, welcomed them with surprise. Yutong chatted about the funny childhood story of reading comics at the store. Yuwei picked a newly published collection of Yunnan local essays in the essay section and shared her thoughts on reading Lin Shen's new work with Uncle Qin.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and 75 Dongfeng West Road, Nanping Pedestrian Street

name: Returning home
description: Walked home from the bookstore with my sister, passed a fruit stall and bought some bayberries to eat in the evening, and chatted all the way home.
location: From Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Counting and organizing stickers, and resting.
description: After arriving home, her sister went to her room to rest. Yuwei tidied the table in the living room by herself to make space for the inventory work after Zhou Lin arrived, and put the soda water in the fridge.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Counting and packing stickers
description: Zhou Lin arrived on time. The two moved two large boxes containing 300 sets of finished stickers into the living room, checked the colors, patterns, and quantities one by one against the orders, and once everything was confirmed, put them into custom kraft paper envelopes, stuck on address labels, and neatly stacked them by the door for the courier to pick up.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Ninth family walk at Cuihu Lake
description: Walked slowly into Green Lake Park with her parents and sat down on a lakeside bench near the Yunnan Military Academy. Her father pointed at the stone bench and told the story of coming here to study and look forward to the future after returning to the city; her mother recalled the simple happiness of their wedding, when all they had was a new quilt and a thermos flask. Yuwei listened quietly and recorded key details in her phone notes. Under the setting sun, the lotus pond was a stretch of gold. After the walk, they sat for a while on the stone bench at the park gate, warm and harmonious.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home to rest and prepare dinner
description: The whole family returned home. Mother began preparing dinner, and Yuwei went to the kitchen to help wash vegetables and cut fruit. Dinner was simple rice noodles and a sweet soup made from the bayberries they had bought.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Putting stickers on the shelf and posting to Moments.
description: After dinner, returned to the bedroom, turned on the computer, logged into the "Yuwei Slow Record" dashboard, put the sticker product page online, and set the price and limited-time discount; then composed and sent a Moments post: "The weekend surprise is flower stickers hidden in Kunming's four seasons. / From preparation to launch, thanks to classmate Zhou Lin for her support. The first batch of 300 sets is now on sale." Synchronized the listing status with Zhou Lin on WeChat.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family celebration time
description: Mom brewed a pot of pu'er, and my sister brought out the last of the handmade cookies. The whole family sat on the sofa. Yuwei excitedly handed her phone to her parents to show that someone had already ordered the first batch of stickers. The family shared the joy of starting the business, and her father also talked about amusing stories from his youth, with everyone happy and harmonious.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing with my best friend and celebrating the sticker sellout.
description: After some family chat, she went back to the bedroom still excited. In the "Three Flowers" best-friend group, she shared the news that the stickers had sold out and screenshots from her Moments. Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi congratulated her one after another. While chatting, Yuwei kept refreshing the backend and privately messaged Zhou Lin to share each moment of joy. It was not until 1 a.m., when all 300 sets had completely sold out, that she contentedly wrote in her journal and turned off the light to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting up, washing up, and stretching
description: Woken up by the alarm at 8:30 a.m., she felt energetic even though she had only slept a little over four hours because of last night’s excitement over the stickers being sold out and late-night chatting. After getting up, she made her bed and washed up in the bathroom. She looked at her left upper arm in the mirror to prepare for the vaccination. She walked out of the bedroom, exchanged morning greetings with her elder sister on the living room sofa, did a simple stretch of her tight shoulders, and started a new day.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with older sister
description: Mom prepared breakfast: soy milk, boiled eggs, and flower cakes. The two sisters chatted while eating about how the stickers sold out the night before. Her sister teased her, calling her “the big boss,” and Sun Yuwei laughed and said she would treat the whole family to milk tea. Their mother was all smiles. Sun Yuwei noticed that the only fruits at home were bananas and apples and wanted to buy seasonal fruits like kiwifruit.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Second HPV vaccine dose and post-vaccination observation
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei went back to her room to get her ID card and vaccination card, changed into a loose short-sleeved T-shirt, put on her sneakers at the entrance, slung her crossbody bag over her shoulder, and walked to the community health service center with her sister. They arrived around 09:30, showed their documents at the front desk to register, and then she received an intramuscular injection in her left upper arm. The nurse explained the precautions, and she rested in the observation area for 30 minutes. During that time, Sun Yuwei took out her journal, crossed out the syringe symbol on the August 24 page, wrote 'Love yourself, don't wait, second dose,' and chatted with her sister about funny childhood vaccination stories. At 10:30, having shown no abnormalities, she left.
location: Huashan Street Community Health Service Center, No. 78 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sisters' walk in Cuihu Park
description: After walking about five minutes from the community hospital, they entered Green Lake Park. The air was fresh after the rain, and willow branches swayed by the lake. The two sisters strolled along the path, reminiscing about childhood memories of their father taking them to feed the red-billed gulls, laughing hilariously over the funny incident when their elder sister chased a seagull and fell. Sun Yuwei pointed to a bench and said she often conceived her essays there. They took photos of each other with their phones as souvenirs.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home and bought fruit.
description: After the walk, the two sisters strolled leisurely home. Passing a fruit shop on Cuihu South Road, Sun Yuwei bought two kiwis and one dragon fruit, planning to adjust next week's breakfast fruit; her sister bought a bag of local small cherries. Chatting, they got home in about 15 minutes.
location: On the way from Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Lunch and sending out the final batch of stickers
description: Mom made lunch with green pepper stir-fried pork, tomato scrambled eggs, and vegetable soup. Sun Yuwei put the freshly bought fruit on the table and discussed with her family the idea of adding seasonal fruit to breakfast, which was met with support. After the meal, around 12:40, she contacted the courier. At about 13:00, the courier arrived at the door and shipped out the last batch of about 20 sets of leftover-stock stickers that she and Zhou Lin had counted the night before, marking a perfect conclusion to the first phase of the entrepreneurial project.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and getting ready to go out
description: After lunch and a short rest, Sun Yuwei returned to her room and reviewed the afternoon plan in her journal. She changed into an artsy dress, put a water bottle, journal, colored pencils, and the stickers she had bought earlier at Mingyuan Bookstore into her crossbody bag, and got ready for her afternoon journaling time.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei set out from home and walked about 15 minutes to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, feeling happy along the way and looking forward to some journaling and reading time.
location: On the way from Huashan West Road to Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling time and literary exchange at Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore, sat in her usual window seat, and ordered a hot Americano. She spread out her journal, colored pencils, and stickers and began organizing her daily life journal since August. She decorated the pages with the sold-out "Kunming Flower Series" stickers, pasting in categorized entries such as gathering records, flower arrangement class notes, and reading excerpts, and wrote down her creative reflections. About half an hour later, the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan came over and praised her stickers, and the two started chatting about buying books yesterday. The conversation then shifted to the language style of modern essays and the current state of Yunnan literature. Uncle Qin recommended the annotated edition of "Border Town" and "Yunnan Mountain Flowers Collection," and Sun Yuwei happily borrowed them.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Zhongmou Yoga Studio.
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, Sun Yuwei left the book house and walked to Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road. On the way, she texted her older sister to let her know the yoga class time and asked her to wait directly downstairs at the yoga studio. She arrived downstairs around 16:10, met her sister, and they took the elevator together to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the fourth floor.
location: Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga and meditation experience
description: Sun Yuwei introduced her sister to yoga teacher He Lu, and He Lu arranged a beginner-friendly class combining meditation with basic yoga for the two. During the class, Sun Yuwei guided her sister to relax her breathing and feel the body stretching. During the singing bowl meditation, her sister experienced sound healing for the first time and looked relaxed. After class, her sister said she had become interested in yoga and felt that the one-hour class gave her tired brain a rest.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-class café break
description: After yoga class, the two sisters went to the Photosynthesis café on the first floor of the building. Sun Yuwei had hot milk, her older sister ordered an Americano, and they sat by the window resting and chatting. The older sister asked questions about breathing and postures; Sun Yuwei answered patiently, and their sisterly bond became closer.
location: Photosynthesis Café, 1st Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home and start a family walk
description: The two sisters walked about 10 minutes from the cafe back home, just as their parents were also getting ready to go out. The family of four went to Green Lake Park for their tenth family walk. The atmosphere was relaxed, and the conversation shifted from the elder sister's first yoga experience to their parents' courtship days. Dad shyly recalled the funny story of his first trip to Qujing to meet Grandma, while Mom smiled and added details. Sun Yuwei recorded these vivid moments in her phone's memo app as material for future essays.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying milk tea and returning home to organize
description: After the walk, as they left the park, Sun Yuwei made good on her breakfast promise and treated the family to milk tea. At the Yi Dian Dian milk tea shop, she chose a sugar-free green tea for her father, a brown sugar pearl milk tea for her mother and elder sister, and a black tea macchiato for herself. While waiting, the family watched square dancing, enjoying a warm and harmonious time. Back home, Sun Yuwei handed out the milk teas, changed into loungewear, washed and cut the kiwi and dragon fruit she had bought that morning, and put them in a fresh-keeping box for tomorrow's breakfast. Afterwards she checked the delivery tracking and felt relieved to confirm that the leftover sticker stock was already out for delivery.
location: Yidiandian Milk Tea Shop on Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and home at No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Dinner and family chat
description: Mom had dinner ready, and the family ate and chatted. My elder sister shared fun stories from her yoga class, and Dad praised Sun Yuwei's sticker business while reminding her to rest. Dinner ended in a warm and cozy atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Diet review and adjustment plan.
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the study and pulled up two weeks of diet records on her phone. She found that she was starting to tire of the monotonous fruit-and-egg breakfast pairing, and the rice noodle portions at lunch were too large. In the 'Health Management' section of her journal, she wrote an adjustment plan: for breakfast, replace apples and bananas with kiwi and dragon fruit, and switch boiled eggs to steamed eggs or egg drop soup; every Thursday, try whole wheat toast with peanut butter; for lunch, halve the rice noodles and add blanched vegetables or cucumber salad. She labeled it 'trial run in the first week of September.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing today's journal and diary
description: Sun Yuwei recorded the day's experiences in her journal with words and simple drawings: from getting vaccinated, walking with her sister, journaling time, and yoga to an evening family walk, buying milk tea, and a diet review. She copied out the fragments of the story her father had told, labeled them 'oral history material,' and decorated the page edges with newly bought flower stickers.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading Miscellaneous Notes of Central Yunnan before bed
description: After washing up, I changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, reading Miscellaneous Records of Central Yunnan, recommended by Uncle Qin. Moved by the book's delicate descriptions of Yunnan's scenery and customs, I thought about writing warm, human-hearted essays in the future. Meanwhile, I did some simple leg stretches.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Meditation and Sleep
description: Meditated for 10 minutes by the bedside, focusing on today's peace and gains. Then she turned off the main light, left the night light on, and confirmed that she had no early class tomorrow and could sleep in. She put her journal by her pillow, closed her eyes contentedly, and turned off the light to fall asleep at 23:15.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning activities: morning jog and breakfast
description: The morning alarm went off, and morning light filtered through the curtains. After washing up briefly, I changed into sportswear and walked from Cuihu Community to Green Lake Park. In the early morning, Green Lake was shrouded in mist, and only a few black-headed gulls were swimming on the water, as they had not yet migrated south in large numbers. I jogged two laps around the lake, about 1.5 kilometers, enjoying Kunming's 20-degree autumn feel, feeling refreshed in body and mind. After returning home, I weighed 45.3 kg. Mother had prepared warm soy milk, boiled eggs, and kiwifruit. While eating breakfast, I replied to WeChat messages, quickly scanned the class group notices, and confirmed the schedule and location for the 'History of Modern Literature' course.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Cuihu Park.

name: Commuting there and getting ready to go out.
description: She packed her schoolbag with her laptop, textbooks, water bottle, and journal. After saying goodbye to her mother, she walked to Huashan West Road Metro Station. From there she took Line 5 (note: actually Line 3, but the original data says Line 5) to Dongfeng Plaza Station, then transferred to Line 1 and got off at University Town Station. On the metro, she put on earphones and listened to a Yunnan local literature podcast shared by her fellow writer Yang Xiao, reviewed the ending of the short story 'Lane Entrance,' and noted down two details she wanted to adjust in her phone memo. After getting off, she walked about 10 minutes to Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus.
location: From Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Line 5 and transferred to Line 1 to University Town Station in Chenggong District, then walked to Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus

name: Major courses and campus lunch
description: Attended the History of Modern Chinese Literature course in Room 301 of Wenhui Building, with the topic focused on Shen Congwen and modern native-soil literature. The teacher gave an in-depth analysis of the narrative techniques and cultural symbolism of Border Town. Sun Yuwei listened attentively and actively answered questions about 'pastoral sentiment and tragic color.' After class, she discussed the weekend trip to Dounan Flower Market with her roommate Liu Jia, and then went to Ziyuan Canteen for lunch with her roommate Zhao Xiaowen. For lunch, she chose a bowl of tomato-egg noodles with blanched greens, limiting her rice noodle intake to fit her diet plan. Over the meal, they talked about the class content and National Day plans.
location: Room 301, Wenhui Building, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Ziyuan Canteen

name: Midday rest and the pleasant surprise of stickers selling out
description: After dinner, she walked to the library on the Chenggong campus of Yunnan University and sat down to rest in a quiet corner. A push notification on her phone suddenly said the sticker link had sold out at around 11:45 am. She quickly opened the backend and had a voice call with her roommate Zhou Lin. After carefully checking the sales data, they found the total sales had exceeded expectations, and the two screamed with excitement for a few minutes. They then calmly discussed a restocking plan and decided to first post a "coming soon" announcement to keep up the momentum.
location: Library leisure area, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting back and drafting the submission letter.
description: Take the metro from University City Station, transferring from Line 1 to Line 3 to return to the city center. On the way, still feeling unsettled, I opened my notebook and began drafting the submission letter for "The Alleyway." In the opening, I quoted the title of an article I liked in the latest issue of Qingcheng magazine to show sincerity, and briefly introduced my identity and creative intent, preparing for the formal submission.
location: From Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, took Metro Line 1 and transferred to Line 3 to return to Huashan West Road Station.

name: Insurance consultation and regular investment
description: After arriving home, she went into the study and had a video call with her cousin Shen Wei, who lives far away in Shenzhen. Taking out a prepared checklist, she asked in detail about the terms, deductibles, and waiting periods of medical insurance and critical illness insurance. Her cousin recommended two entry-level products. She recorded key points throughout with a voice recorder and pen and paper, then organized and filed them after the call. Afterwards, she read financial-management official account articles by herself, focusing on understanding fund dollar-cost averaging strategies and the characteristics of bond funds. On the Alipay platform, she selected a pure bond fund with stable returns over the past year and a fee rate of 0.15%, set up an automatic monthly investment of 200 yuan on the 25th, and completed her first solid savings plan.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Novel polishing, submission, and sharing.
description: Riding on the momentum and excitement, she opened the first draft of “Lane Entrance” in her study for fine polishing. Based on the inspiration from the morning class and a podcast, she adjusted the first paragraph describing the early morning of the old alley to give it more of a “Kunming flavor,” and made the ending more restrained. After reading it through twice to confirm everything was right, she saved the final draft. She opened her email and sent the polished submission letter along with the final version of the novel to the submission inbox of Qingcheng magazine. After the send succeeded, she screenshot it and messaged her literary friend Yang Xiao to share the joy of the submission, and soon received Yang Xiao’s reply: “Waiting for your good news!”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and tending to houseplants
description: After finishing the novel, she went to the balcony to water the potted plants and rest her eyes. Back at the desk, she took out the carefully prepared journal and wrote down the day's three milestone events with colored markers: 'The Alley' submitted successfully, 'stickers sold out, first income from original creations', and 'regular investment plan started'. She then stuck a small star sticker on the page as a celebration and memento.
location: Balcony and study of the home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family walk around Cuihu Lake and memory collection.
description: At 6:10 in the evening, she went out with her parents on time to take a walk in Green Lake Park. Her father talked about his work unit's organized trip to Beijing in the 1980s: taking the green train, how to exchange foreign exchange certificates, buying dacron shirts, and other details. Her mother added stories about the pressure and achievement of leading her first graduating class. Sun Yuwei recorded the entire conversation with her phone and asked questions from time to time, guiding her parents to recall period details such as prices and transportation, gathering vivid material for her essay collection.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Dinner and family meeting about promoting cultural and creative products
description: After walking home, her mother had prepared a simple dinner, including vegetable salad, steamed sea bass, and mixed-grain rice. At the table, Sun Yuwei shared the good news of the successful submission and the stickers being sold out, and both parents were delighted. After dinner, she had a video call with her sister Sun Yutong, discussing in detail the progress of the essay collection and the follow-up promotion of the sticker project. From a product manager's perspective, her sister suggested posting picture-text posts on Xiaohongshu and Douban featuring 'sticker stories + Green Lake views,' and promised to contact a friend in Shenzhen who runs cultural and creative market operations, laying the groundwork for future expansion.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing audio material and sketching the outline of an essay collection
description: Back in the study, I imported the recording from the evening walk into my computer and used a speech-to-text tool to generate a draft. I focused on transcribing the two most vivid segments, 'The Green Train and Foreign Exchange Certificates' and 'Mother's Dangerous Home Visit', and created a new document called 'Chapter 3 - Memories of an Era', filling in key words from the night such as prices, transportation, and entertainment, setting up a preliminary framework for the essay collection.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening relaxation and sticker sellout celebration
description: After a tiring day, I decided to completely unwind. In the bedroom, I dimmed the lights, listened to some modern pop music, and continued refining my journal, focusing on depicting the joy of the stickers selling out and the excitement of receiving my first income from cultural creative products. I rewarded myself with a box of mini ice cream. While eating, I scrolled through Xiaohongshu to learn layout and creative ideas from other journal bloggers.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and meditation before bedtime to sleep peacefully.
description: After getting into bed, reread certain passages of the annotated edition of Border Town, which echoed the classroom content during the day. Inwardly summarized today's keywords: high energy, efficient, fulfilling. Completed ten minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on breathing and clearing the mind. Set the alarm for 23:50, switched the phone to Do Not Disturb mode, and fell asleep peacefully with a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and farewell preparations
description: Woken in the morning by light from Green Lake Park outside the window, she lingered in bed for a while before getting up, washing up, and changing into light cotton-linen loungewear. Mother had prepared a hearty breakfast, and the family sat around the table to enjoy it. Father coughed softly, while Mother kept putting food on Sister's plate and reminding her about the trip. After breakfast, Yuwei helped Sister move her suitcase to the front door, Father drove the car around from the garage to the entrance, Mother checked Sister's backpack, and the whole family got into the car, ready to go to the airport.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to Changshui Airport to see off her older sister
description: Driven by her father, the family headed to Kunming Changshui International Airport. After arriving at Terminal 1, Yuwei and her mother accompanied her elder sister to check in and drop off her luggage. In front of the security checkpoint, her mother hugged her elder sister with slightly red eyes; her father patted her elder sister on the shoulder and told her to send a message to report that she was safe. Yuwei hugged her elder sister tightly, and her elder sister whispered in her ear, telling Yuwei to write well and that she would come back during the Spring Festival to check the essay collection. Then her elder sister waved and went through security.
location: Departure Level, Terminal 1, Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and warm-up at Green Lake Park
description: Drove back from the airport with her parents. On the way, her mother talked about her sister's amusing stories, her father focused on driving, and Yuwei leaned against the window to calm herself. They arrived at the southeast gate of Cuihu Park around 9:42. Her parents drove home first. Yuwei changed into workout clothes, stored her belongings in a locker, and did a thorough dynamic warm-up by the lake, loosening her shoulders, neck, and ankles in preparation for a run.
location: Near the southeast gate of Cuihu Park, No. 66 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run, short rest, and Xiaohongshu check-in
description: Jogged 1.8 kilometers along the lake path in Green Lake Park at a pace of 7 minutes 40 seconds, focusing on breath and stride, enjoying the metasequoias and lake water along the way. After finishing, I stretched my legs on a bench and recorded the workout route with my phone. Then I sat on a bench near Guanyu Tower, posted a screenshot of the run on Xiaohongshu with a carefully written caption, and watched the black-headed gulls circling over the lake, gradually feeling calm inside.
location: Lakeside walking trail and Fish-Viewing Tower area, Cuihu Park, No. 66 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home and family lunch
description: She left Green Lake Park and walked home along the familiar streets; the steam and aromas from the breakfast shops along the road gave her a sense of calm. After arriving home, she changed into loungewear. Her mother was cooking in the kitchen, and her father was tending to the plants on the balcony. Yuwei helped serve the rice, and the family enjoyed a home-style lunch, chatting as they ate about the reunion with her sister and Yuwei's weekend classes. After the meal, Yuwei took the initiative to clear the table.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday Planning and Sending a Submission Inquiry
description: Returned to the study. Instead of taking a nap, I opened my planner to confirm the afternoon schedule. In my memo app, I listed questions I wanted to ask Uncle Qin at the bookstore, and sent a polite progress inquiry to the submission channel of 'Qingcheng' magazine.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Went to Zhibushi Bookstore to chat with Uncle Qin.
description: Wearing earphones and listening to light music, she walked about 13 minutes to Paper Stone Bookstore. There were few people inside. Uncle Qin was tidying the bookshelves. Yuwei handed him the freshly ground coffee she had brought from home and confided her worry that her submission of 'Lane Entrance' to Qingcheng magazine had received no response. Uncle Qin suggested she could submit to the young authors column of the Dianchi literary monthly, and he was willing to write a recommendation letter for her. He also recommended the book Looking Back and Moving Forward as a reference for writing her essay collection.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home and rested briefly
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she walked home carrying Looking Back and Moving Forward. At home, she drank some water, put the book on the desk, then turned on the computer and pulled up the podcast interview outline. She skimmed through it, took the printed draft of her essay collection out of the drawer, and flipped to the piece she planned to share.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Podcast interview preparation.
description: In the study, I officially began preparing for the podcast interview, sorting through my creative journey and focusing on the chapters about family, growth, and watching over in “Watching Behind the Glass.” I selected a passage from the essay “Alley Entrance” for reading practice, recorded it on my phone and listened back repeatedly to correct swallowed syllables and pace, and briefly communicated with the host via WeChat voice messages to confirm the direction of my answers.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Previewing the course and helping mother make flower cakes.
description: Bring up tomorrow's Modern Chinese Literary History course syllabus and the electronic annotated edition of Border Town, quickly skim the key points of Chapter 8, and note a few questions. Then go to the kitchen, where her mother is preparing flower cake filling. Yuwei washes her hands and joins in, kneading the dough under her mother's guidance, wrapping the rose filling in the pastry and pressing out flower shapes. Mother and daughter chat easily in the sweet, fragrant atmosphere.
location: Home study and kitchen, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family stroll at Green Lake
description: She put on a light jacket, took her notebook, and went for a walk with her parents in Green Lake Park. Her father, for once, spontaneously brought up how he had opposed her older sister going to Shenzhen but was eventually won over by her determination. Her mother recalled the details of sending packages to her sister every week. Yuwei listened attentively, jotting down keywords such as "family, distance, support," and noticed multi-generational families walking together in the park, deepening her understanding of family ties.
location: Cuihu Park, No. 66 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping and walking home
description: After the walk, she went alone to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. In the fresh food section, she bought baby bok choy, enoki mushrooms, and Red Fuji apples for her mother, then went to the beverage section and picked up a box of brown sugar bubble tea ingredient kit. After checking out, she walked home carrying the shopping bag. On the way, she passed a corner shop and bought two flower cakes as snacks for tomorrow morning.
location: No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and surrounding streets

name: Family dinner and casual chat
description: After arriving home, she gave the vegetables to her mother and put the milk tea ingredients on the sideboard. Her mother specially made dishes that Yuwei loved, including pan-fried small tofu. At the dinner table, they once again talked about her sister. Yuwei shared what she had gained at the bookstore that afternoon, and her father encouraged her to write diligently and aim to publish her essay collection as soon as possible.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Archiving materials and organizing creative work
description: After dinner, she returned to the study, turned on the computer, and integrated the oral history notes she had recorded during the walk and the stories of her elder sister's growth accumulated in the past into the essay collection folder "Letting Go and Caring." She created a new document, used the three keywords she had noted during the walk as subheadings, and wrote a passage of reflections on family decision-making and letting go.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Gentle yoga stretching.
description: She changed into workout clothes, spread out her yoga mat in the living room, and followed a yoga class cast to the screen for a 20-minute stretch of the shoulders, neck, and spine. Through poses such as Cat and Cobra, she relieved the stiffness in her shoulders and neck caused by long hours of writing, and felt much more relaxed.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entry.
description: Returning to the study, she took out her journal, drew a small rose in watercolor to represent the flower cakes she had made in the afternoon, and then wrote brief notes about the hugs at the airport, Uncle Qin's help at the bookstore, her parents' stories during the walk, and the relaxation after yoga. The words carried a faint longing for her older sister and anticipation for the new day.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime reading
description: Changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, flipping through Miscellaneous Notes of Central Yunnan borrowed from Uncle Qin. I read an article about the changes in a Yunnan merchant family during the late Qing dynasty and felt some ideas could be borrowed for my own essays, so I made a few simple marks. Reading calmed my mind.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: She video-called with her sister.
description: Sent her older sister a WeChat message asking if she had gotten home safely. Soon after, she received a voice reply saying she had arrived in Shenzhen and was having a late-night snack. The two chatted briefly over the phone, confirmed each other was safe, and said goodnight.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and bedtime preparation
description: Turn off your phone, draw the curtains, sit cross-legged on the bed, and do a 10-minute mindfulness meditation focused on breathing, letting the day's thoughts slowly settle. After the meditation, turn off the desk lamp, listen to the faint chirping of insects outside the window, and drift into sleep with a feeling of fulfillment and longing.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Woke up in the morning light, changed into a dark gray quick-dry sports T-shirt and black hiking pants, and tied my hair into a high ponytail. Packed my hiking backpack: put in a softshell jacket, 1.5 L of mineral water, mixed nuts, energy bars, sunscreen, a power bank, a journal, and a fountain pen. Simple breakfast: microwaved milk with whole-wheat toast spread with blueberry jam, to store up energy for the Western Hills hike.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Call with older sister
description: Before going out, she curled up on the sofa and sent a WeChat message to her elder sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen, telling her about today's hiking plan. Her sister immediately sent a voice message, reminding her to stretch, use sunscreen, and take other safety precautions. The nagging was full of concern, making her feel deeply warmed.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Set out for Xishan and meet up with Zheng Yu.
description: Walked to Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 3 to Xishan Park Station, and on the way used a stylus to sketch the hiking route on a journal. After arriving, transferred to a scenic-area shuttle bus to the south gate of Xishan Forest Park, where I met up with my childhood friend Zheng Yu, who had arrived early. Zheng Yu was carrying a professional hiking backpack and wearing a neon green quick-dry T-shirt. He gave me a strong hug and handed over the iced coffee his mother had prepared.
location: The square in front of the ticket office at the South Gate of Xishan Forest Park, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Hiking the Western Hills and summiting Dragon Gate.
description: Starting from the Qianbu Cliff hiking trail, the stone steps were steep and tested endurance and leg strength. Along the way, Zheng Yu and I caught up on each other's recent news: he shared his frustration over the delay of his Shenzhen project, while I talked about my idea for a submission on 'urban transformation.' As my breathing grew rapid and my calves began to ache, Zheng Yu coached me on adjusting my breathing rhythm (inhale for four steps, exhale for two), and my condition gradually improved. We rested at the viewing pavilion, shared nuts, and looked out over Dianchi Lake. We finally reached the top of Dragon Gate at 11 o'clock. Standing on the viewing platform and looking down at Dianchi Lake as if it were a piece of jade, the mountain breeze blew away our fatigue. Zheng Yu took several photos of me with the skyline.
location: Xishan Forest Park, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (from Qianbu Cliff to the Dragon Gate Grottoes viewing platform)

name: Resting at the summit and making future plans.
description: Sitting on a bench at the Longmen viewing platform, eating an energy bar, Zheng Yu proposed the 'One Mountain a Month' plan, and we agreed to meet every month to climb a mountain near Kunming. I gladly accepted and suggested Qipan Mountain or Jiaozi Snow Mountain. The sound of our laughter and conversation blended with the mountain wind, setting a new expectation for our friendship.
location: Longmen Grottoes Viewing Platform, Xishan Forest Park, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Descending the Mountain and Lunch
description: Descending the gentle slope of the walking path on the other side, Zheng Yu reminded me to protect my knees. On the way, we talked about the embarrassing moments when we rode bikes together to Haigeng Dam in junior high, and I took photos of wildflowers on the rock wall to look up later. Arriving at the foot of the mountain at Tea Horse Flower Street, we had lunch at the time-honored “Nie's Snacks”: I ordered cold rice noodles with minced pork sauce, Zheng Yu ordered rice noodles with tofu pudding, plus grilled stinky tofu and iced papaya water. Zheng Yu praised Kunming rice noodles as authentic, and told me the project would end at the end of the year, looking forward to meeting again.
location: Nie's Snack Stand, Chama Flower Street, at the foot of Xishan Forest Park, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Said goodbye to Zheng Yu and returned home.
description: After lunch, we said goodbye at the station: Zheng Yu took a taxi to Changshui Airport to hurry back to Shenzhen, while I took the scenic area shuttle bus and transferred to Metro Line 3 to return. When I arrived at Huashan West Road Station, it was past 14:20, and my legs and feet felt noticeably sore.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going home to rest and organize writing materials
description: After getting home, she boiled water to soak her feet and put in a mugwort foot bath bag to relieve fatigue. While soaking, she sorted through the hiking photos, chose three, and posted them to WeChat Moments with the caption: "The wind on the Western Hills, a promise between old friends." She saved the wildflower photos to her material library. Then she changed into loungewear, sat down at her desk, recorded the "promise" inspiration from the mountaintop in a document, and began planning an essay about "nostalgia." She leafed through "Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan," marked anecdotes of Ming Dynasty literati from Kunming, and finally leaned back in her chair for a 20-minute rest.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Homemade milk tea and podcast preparation
description: She made milk tea at home with instant brown sugar tapioca pearls and fresh milk, cooking the pearls over low heat and using a moka pot to froth milk. Holding the fragrant milk tea, she stood by the window watching the street scene. Afterward, she went back to her study, opened the podcast invitation for 'The Watch Behind the Glass,' and worked on her guest self-introduction. She listed keywords in her notebook: 'family lineage,' 'childhood by Green Lake,' 'afternoon at the Paper, Cloth and Stone Bookstore,' and practiced her opening lines to the air, adjusting her tone and pacing.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Mom made braised pork, stir-fried pea shoots, and tomato egg drop soup. At the dinner table, I excitedly shared my experience at the Western Hills: the breathing technique Zheng Yu taught me and the magnificent scenery at the Dragon Gate. Dad jokingly asked if I could get up early the next day, while Mom lovingly put food in my bowl and told me to eat more to build up my strength.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family stroll at Green Lake
description: After dinner, the family of three walked into Green Lake Park. The setting sun dyed the lake water gold. When Dad saw the students sketching, he recalled how he developed his writing hobby when he was young — submitting articles to his workplace, buying books with overtime pay, and being appreciated by a teacher at the cultural center. Mom shared the reasons why she chose to become a Chinese language teacher. I was pleasantly surprised to discover that my interest in writing has its roots in the family. On the Zigzag Bridge, Dad pointed to the Mid-lake Pavilion and told an old story about the 1986 renovation of Green Lake, and the whole family was immersed in yellowed memories.
location: Cuihu Park (Nine-Bend Bridge), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize family oral history materials
description: After walking home, I preliminarily tagged the walk recording that my parents agreed to, and uploaded it to the cloud drive for backup. Under the 'Essay Collection Materials' folder on my computer, I created a subfolder called 'Cultural Heritage', archived the recording and random notes, and accumulated precious oral materials for future creation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Watercolor recorded course: dry layering practice
description: On time, she opened her tablet to study the second watercolor lesson — the dry-on-dry method. First, on practice paper, she layered colors with a dry brush to practice a gradient effect from light to deep, and then she painted strawberries on the final watercolor paper. On her first attempt, she layered color before the base layer was fully dry, which made the painting muddy. Learning from that, she patiently waited for it to dry before layering again, and finally finished a piece that, though imperfect, showed she had mastered the technique. She photographed the work for her archive and wrote a note in her journal: 'Small win with the dry-on-dry method! Patience matters more than technique.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Yoga stretching and relaxation
description: She changed into a sports bra and did about 30 minutes of stretching on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing her sore leg and back muscles after the hike. With soft music playing from her phone, she moved from Child's Pose to Corpse Pose, and her body and mind gradually settled down from the excitement and fatigue of the day.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading, journaling, and meditation before bed
description: Leaning against the headboard, she continued reading "Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan" and came across an essay about an ancient temple at the foot of Xishan Mountain, which echoed today's experience. Then she took out her travel journal, drew a simple figure standing on a mountaintop overlooking a lake, and wrote the day's summary: "A day with both body and mind on the road. The cool breeze of Xishan, a long-awaited promise, my parents' family stories, and an imperfect 'strawberry' together made this fulfilling and peaceful Wednesday." At 10:30 she put down the book, turned off the light, and did a guided meditation on a meditation app. Her thoughts drifted through the day's moments, her heart filled with tranquility, and she fell deeply asleep as her breathing slowed.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Early rising and family breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei was woken by her phone alarm, and thinking about the surprises today held, she got out of bed with anticipation. She completed a 15-minute morning yoga stretch in bed, then washed up and changed into a knit cardigan and pants. In the dining room, her mother Li Xiulan had prepared soy milk and flaky buns. While having breakfast, Yuwei browsed her phone to check messages, opened the radio app to confirm the afternoon guest interview details, and sent a confirmation message to the host Chen Chen.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready to go out.
description: Back in the study, Sun Yuwei packed her laptop, notebook, voice recorder, material notebook, and power bank into her canvas bag one by one. She checked that the voice recorder was fully charged, confirmed that the electronic version of the interview outline was saved on her tablet, and clipped the printed excerpt from The Vigil Behind Glass into her notebook to prepare reading passages for the afternoon interview.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to the bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei put on her canvas bag and walked to Zhibushi Bookstore. Passing through the alleys around Green Lake, with morning sunlight on the bluestone-paved streets and a calm mood, she arrived at the bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road after about 12 minutes.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing at the Bookstore and the Surprise of Being Shortlisted
description: Sun Yuwei sat down at her usual window seat on the second floor of the bookstore, took out her laptop, brewed a cup of the bookstore's free Pu'er tea, and focused on tackling the column article series about Kunming's old streets for "Cultural Vision." During a break in writing, she logged on to the official website of the Kunming Literature Newcomer Award to check the progress and was delighted to find that her piece "The Watch Behind the Glass" had made it into the top thirty. Her heart surged with joy, and she immediately took a screenshot and saved it. After calming down a bit, she continued writing. At around 11, the first draft was successfully completed. After proofreading, she emailed it to editor Xu Mingyuan with a short note: "Editor Xu, this month's manuscript is submitted early. Best wishes!"
location: Second floor, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying books and cultural exchange at the bookstore
description: After finishing her writing, Sun Yuwei went downstairs to the bookstore's first floor to buy books. In the recommended books section, she saw a newly arrived copy of "Between Snow Mountains" and was deeply drawn to it.
