At the checkout, the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan was sorting newly arrived literary magazines and said with a smile, "Yuwei, I heard you've been shortlisted for a literary award? Congratulations!" Yuwei was a bit surprised and very happy, quickly thanked him, and briefly shared her writing ideas about streets and alleys and her afternoon radio interview plans.
location: 1st Floor, Kunming Paper, Cloth & Stone Bookstore, No. 32, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Coming home and having lunch with family.
description: Sun Yuwei walked home contentedly, holding the newly purchased books. When she got home, her mother Li Xiulan had already prepared lunch. At the dining table, Yuwei excitedly announced the good news of being shortlisted for the Literary Newcomer Award to her parents and showed them the screenshots. Her mother happily put food on her plate. Her father Sun Mingyuan put down his chopsticks and said seriously, 'It is indeed good, but don't be proud. This is only the beginning. For this afternoon's interview, keep your voice steady.' Yuwei knew that this was her father's way of showing care.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday Organization and Material Preparation
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei returned to her room and checked again the speech draft, notebook, and voice recorder she would take to the radio station in the afternoon. To make the interview more professional, she changed into a simple off-white shirt. She opened her phone, replied to congratulatory messages from her best friend Zhang Jing and her editor Xu Mingyuan, and felt warm inside.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to the radio station
description: Considering there might be traffic in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei booked a taxi in advance through a mobile app. The car arrived at the entrance of Cuihu Community on time. After getting in, she leaned against the car window, listened to soothing piano music, and silently went over the questions she might be asked in the interview, getting herself into the right frame of mind.
location: On the way from Cuihu Community to Kunming Broadcasting and Television Station

name: Podcast interview: "City Light Voices"
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at Kunming Radio and Television Station on time, and a staff member guided her into the recording studio. The host, Chen Chen, had a warm voice and soon put her at ease. The interview revolved around her creative journey, her observations of independent bookstores, and urban writing. Yuwei shared how she drew inspiration from walks around Green Lake, talked about the behind-the-scenes story of preparing her essay collection, and finally read an excerpt from her shortlisted work "Vigil Behind the Glass" on the spot, with smooth delivery and rich emotion. After the recording, Chen Chen praised her voice for having a strong sense of story. The recording process went very smoothly, and the sound engineer also took a group photo of the two of them as a memento.
location: Recording studio of Kunming Broadcasting and Television Station, 128 Shulin Street, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return journey and inspiration recording

On the way, she took out her phone's memo app and briefly noted down ideas from the interview that sparked new inspiration, as well as Teacher Chen Chen's suggestion that she submit her work to a national literary platform.

name: Short break and fruit time

Then she washed a plate of blueberries and kiwifruit, and while eating, flipped through the book she had just bought that day, 'Between Snow Mountains', enjoying a cozy time after the interview.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Material organization and monthly creative reflections
description: After regaining her energy, Sun Yuwei sat down at her desk, took out her watercolor paints and journal, and briefly painted and pasted into the journal the landscape photos she had taken and the fallen leaves she had picked up during yesterday’s Xishan hike. Beside them, she recorded her mood while climbing and her agreement with Zheng Yu. Then she spent a focused 20 minutes writing about her creative reflections for August, summarizing the month’s gains and shortcomings, and accumulating material for the essay collection.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

description: Coming out of the study, she heard the sound of her mother chopping vegetables in the kitchen. Sun Yuwei walked over, rolled up her sleeves, and helped her mother peel garlic and trim green beans while chatting about the details of today's radio interview. Her mother was very happy to hear about it and said she would be sure to listen in the evening. After tidying up, Yuwei changed into her flat walking shoes.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: The 14th Family Walk around Green Lake
description: The family of three set off as promised for their fourteenth evening walk around Green Lake. Today's theme was 'warm memories.' Yuwei guided the conversation, and her parents talked about the simple trip they took when they got married, the nervousness and joy when her older sister was born, and the photo the whole family took on Yuwei's first day of kindergarten. As she walked, Yuwei quickly jotted down keywords in her material notebook. Her father suggested using Green Lake's changes over the years as a hidden line running through the essay collection. Yuwei told them the collection's outline had been initially conceived as three parts: 'Ancestral Roots,' 'The Parents' Era,' and 'Our Growth.' Her parents both thought it was very good. The three walked one and a half laps around the lake as night gradually fell.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Family dinner and essay planning

The conversation at the table continued, and Yuwei shared more ideas for her essay collection “Folds of Time,” such as writing the Green Lake memories she had heard that day into the “Parents' Era” chapter. Her father suggested writing more about the changes to Kunming's old city walls, while her mother said she could write more about Kunming's snacks.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

She also organized the handwritten notes in her material notebook and labeled the file tags "Ancestral Roots" and "The Parents' Era."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

Based on the outline in her previous journal, she added the chapter structure and core imagery of 'Ancestral Roots,' along with her own reflections on the family's cultural lineage. Although it was only a framework, seeing the document take shape made her feel fulfilled.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

Shortlisted for the top thirty of the Literary Newcomer Award, completed a pleasant radio interview, and walked the fourteenth full lap around Cuihu Lake with Mom and Dad. What a wonderful day spent with words and family.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

Next, using the chapter on ancestral roots from the essay collection Folds of Time, she made a reading list of books to borrow in September, including Old Stories of Kunming and A History of the National Protection Movement, and saved it to her phone's notes app. Around 11 o'clock, Uncle Qin brought her some pu'er tea and asked about her organizing progress. Sun Yuwei shared her idea of systematically compiling her mother's oral history. Uncle Qin encouraged her and suggested organizing it by timeline or theme.

Sun Yuwei promptly recorded the conversation with a voice recorder and quickly jotted down the keywords 'learning to walk as a child,' 'family property,' and 'years of struggle' in her journal.

description: After sorting out the materials, Qin Mingyuan brewed a pot of Pu'er tea, invited me to sit in the bookstore's coffee corner, and we began an in-depth exchange at the end of the month. I shared creative inspiration about "family and urban transformation" drawn from historical books, especially the new insights from my parents' oral accounts. Uncle Qin affirmed the concept of the essay collection "Folds of Time" and suggested using key events in local history, such as the several renovations of Cuihu Park, as the historical background of the family stories to make the sense of history more vivid. He also took a copy of "History of Kunming City" from the bookshelf and handed it to me, saying it would be helpful for writing the part about "ancestral roots". The two chatted until the bookstore was about to close, and agreed to discuss further after finishing the first draft of the essay collection outline in early September.
location: Coffee corner at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Return home and sketch the initial outline of the essay collection
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she walked home with 'A History of Kunming' and valuable advice, still savoring the conversation. Once home, she sat down in the study and immediately wrote down the inspiration from the exchange along with her own thoughts. Opening her tablet, she formally began drafting the initial outline for the essay collection 'Folds of Time', further refining the original three parts—'Ancestral Roots', 'The Era of Our Parents', and 'Our Growth'—adding core story directions under each section and noting reference numbers for oral materials.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Prepare items for a walk
description: Pause writing and walk out of the study. Check the voice recorder's battery and storage to ensure they are enough to record the entire session. Write today's date and the words 'Seventeenth Time' in the material notebook, put it in a small sling bag, and remind her parents to get ready to go out for a walk together.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Seventeenth family walk around Cuihu Lake
description: In the early evening, the family of three went out on time for the last Green Lake family walk of August. The setting sun dyed the lake water gold, and a gentle breeze brushed their faces. Father Sun Jianguo recalled an amusing incident from his childhood of falling while learning to walk in the park, and Mother Li Xiulan added scenes of the elder sister playing with them. The voice recorder stayed on throughout, and key points from the conversation were quickly jotted down in the material notebook, for example, the father's saying, 'These three properties are the foundation left for you two sisters.' Halfway through the walk, the three sat on a lakeside bench, quietly watching the sun set.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: After the walk, she returned home and took the initiative to help her mother prepare dinner. Dinner was simple home-style food: stir-fried cabbage, potato stewed with beef, and tomato and egg soup. The family continued discussing the past memories mentioned during the walk while eating, and the atmosphere was very warm. After dinner, she cleared the dishes on her own.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Diet summary and evaluation, and organizing walk material
description: Back in the study, she put on her headphones, imported today's walking recordings from the voice recorder to the computer, named them by date, and archived them. Then she opened the diet tracking app and viewed the August nutrition statistics: breakfast protein intake reached the target 100% of the time, average daily vegetable intake was 230 grams, and water intake remained stable at 1.5 liters. She clearly felt more energetic in the afternoon and her body was more toned. In her journal she carefully wrote a summary: "The biggest gain this month was establishing the habit of balanced nutrition; it has become part of daily life. Keep it going in September."
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Creating journal entries and refining the outline for the essay collection.
description: I took out my beloved journal and wrote in green ink about the last day of August: "I bid farewell to the most fulfilling August. The flower arrangement corner has been set up, the outline for the essay collection has taken initial shape, and my parents' oral accounts have given me a deeper understanding of our family stories." In the blank space I drew a small sunflower, symbolizing hope. Then on the tablet I further refined the outline for Folds of Time, making the "three properties" story heard during my walk the core conflict point of the "Parents' Era" chapter, and marking the emotional thread. After writing the last word, I felt an unprecedented sense of stability and clarity.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime reading
description: After washing up, I changed into pajamas. Instead of looking at my phone or computer, I picked up *A History of Kunming City* brought back from the bookstore today. I casually turned to the chapter Uncle Qin had mentioned about the renovation of Green Lake Park in the 1980s, and leafed through it, enjoying the quiet time before bed.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Bedtime meditation and plan for tomorrow
description: She turned off the main light, switched on the bedside reading lamp, and did a simple ten-minute pre-sleep meditation to clear her mind. After lying down, she silently made a few plans for September: go to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on Wednesday to begin flower arranging practice, finish the first draft of the first chapter of Folds of Time before Friday, and borrow reference books from the school library. Looking forward to the first light of September, she fell asleep peacefully around 22:00.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning stretching, washing up, and breakfast
description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei woke up to the alarm, stretched her neck and shoulders, and drank water on an empty stomach. Then she washed up, changed into a light blue linen shirt and dark jeans. She had breakfast with her mother Li Xiulan, enjoying millet porridge, boiled eggs, and pickled vegetables, and they discussed the plan for the day.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize social security materials and commute to the social security center.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei organized the materials needed for applying for flexible-employment social insurance in her study, including her ID card and household registration booklet, and checked them against the list. She then walked to the Huashan West Road bus stop, took bus No. 119 to the Wuhua District Social Insurance Administration. On the bus, she reviewed the application process and arrived about 20 minutes later.
location: Along Renmin Middle Road in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (from Huashan West Road Bus Stop to Wancai City on Longquan Road)

name: Handle social insurance for flexible employment.
description: Sun Yuwei entered the social security center, took a number and waited, then submitted her materials to the counter staff. She completed the flexible-employment insurance registration based on the minimum contribution base and successfully received two receipts: the Pension Insurance Personal Account Handbook and the Medical Insurance Payment Voucher.
location: Wuhua District Social Insurance Administration, 4th Floor, Building 6, Wancai City, Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home, sharing social security results, and updating the study room
description: After handling social security, Sun Yuwei took Bus 1 back to Huashan West Road. When she got home, she sent a photo of the receipt to the family WeChat group and received praise from her father Sun Mingyuan, mother Li Xiulan, and sister Sun Yutong. Then, feeling cheerful, she refreshed her study workspace, replaced the decor with dried reeds and wheat ears as autumn touches, and pinned a new September essay topic sticky note to the corkboard.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping prepare lunch and enjoying lunchtime.
description: Sun Yuwei helped her mother trim vegetables and peel garlic in the kitchen, chatting about how smoothly the social security process had gone. During lunch, the three of them sat around the table and enjoyed dishes such as tomato scrambled eggs. Sun Yuwei shared the whole social security process, and her father also told an amusing story about handling paperwork in his youth. She also browsed the copy of Kunming City History that Uncle Qin had given her.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break, Subject 1 review, and preparing driving school materials
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei opened the "Driving Test Treasure" app on the living room sofa to browse the structure of Subject 1 and answered 30 traffic sign questions. After a 20-minute rest, she went to the study to organize her ID card and one-inch photos, put them in a document folder, preparing for the afternoon driving school registration, and confirmed the registration location on the map.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to sign up at a driving school and enjoying milk tea on the way back
description: Sun Yuwei and her mother walked together to the Mingtong Driving School registration office on Renmin Middle Road. There, she asked in detail about the C1 manual transmission course, the practice area, and the exam process, filled out the registration form, paid 3,980 yuan in tuition, and registered a student account. On the way back, her mother rewarded her with a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea, and the two walked home happily.
location: Mingtong Driving School registration point and the route along the way, No. 122 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Study time: sorting materials, reading, and journal planning
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei sorted the social security receipt and driving school receipt while drinking milk tea. Then she immersed herself in reading A History of Kunming City. Afterward, she did deep journaling, recording two important events with a black gel pen, drawing a study plan calendar and a knowledge tree diagram with colored pencils, and pasting the receipts into her journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Help prepare dinner.
description: Sun Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother pick vegetables and lend a hand. While chatting, they talked about the historical changes around Green Lake during the Republican era, and her mother also shared what the area around Green Lake looked like when she was a child.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family stroll at Green Lake
description: This was the nineteenth consecutive day of the family walk. Sun Yuwei and her parents strolled slowly through Green Lake Park. She excitedly told them about the smooth processing of her social security and her experience registering for driving school, while her father shared stories of learning to drive an old Jiefang truck in his youth. The family of three was full of joy and harmony.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Family dinner
description: After the walk, the family sat together for dinner, and Mom had made pork rib soup. At the table, her father affirmed Sun Yuwei's independence and initiative, and her mother reminded her to be safe while learning to drive.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening practice for Subject 1 of the driving test
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei voluntarily cleaned up the dishes. Then she curled up on the living room sofa and used the "Driving Test Master" app to practice about 400 questions for Subject 1, and made notes on the wrong ones.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and writing
description: After getting tired of doing practice questions, Sun Yuwei returned to the study and picked up A History of Kunming City again, reading the chapter “Yunnan Military Academy” that her father had mentioned. Struck by a flash of inspiration, she wrote the essay title “The Youth of Our Elders and the Rings of the City” and her reflections in her phone's memo app.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Share the evening's achievements with family
description: Sun Yuwei left the study and went to the living room to show her parents the study plan in her journal. Her father praised her good planning, and her mother reminded her to keep it up.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime stretching, reading, and going to sleep
description: Sun Yuwei did yoga mat stretching and mindfulness meditation in the bedroom to relax her body and mind. Before going to sleep, she leaned against the headboard and read History of Kunming, then recorded her sense of fulfillment in her journal. Afterward, she set tomorrow's alarm, prepared her workout clothes, turned off the light, and fell asleep. She walked about 7,500 steps in total that day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Early morning activities and flower arrangement practice
description: At 6:30 in the morning, I was woken by the alarm and woke up in the morning light. Drank a glass of warm water on an empty stomach and did simple stretches to wake up the body. Then went into the study, took out the eucalyptus leaves and white balloon flowers that had been conditioned the night before, and practiced the basic slanted arrangement of the Ikenobo school by following the ikebana notes, focusing on adjusting the angles of the main and guest branches, trimming excess leaves, and feeling the spatial sense of the vase. After finishing, took a photo with my phone and cleaned the desk. Then washed up, changed into comfortable loungewear, and checked and organized the canvas bag, laptop, Driving Exam Treasure study materials, water bottle, and other items to take out.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; bedroom and study at home

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: I went to the dining room and greeted my mother Li Xiulan, who was busy preparing breakfast: millet porridge, boiled eggs, and steamed sweet potatoes. Over breakfast, we talked about how it felt yesterday to handle flexible-employment social insurance and sign up for driving school. I shared the steady, reassuring feeling of getting the receipt and the enrollment slip. My mother smiled and encouraged me to take it slowly, one step at a time.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Study Subject 1 of the driving exam on Jiakao Baodian
description: Back in the study, she opened the Driver's Test Treasure app and studied traffic regulations one by one in sequential practice, focusing on memorizing error-prone signs, traffic police gestures, and point-deduction rules. Every 20 questions, she stopped and neatly wrote the knowledge points from the wrong questions in her notebook, building a collection of mistakes. After completing 200 questions, she took a mock exam. Although there were still errors, the number of wrong questions was fewer than yesterday, and her confidence grew.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch and chat.
description: After studying, she left the study and went to the kitchen to help her mother prepare lunch, handling the remaining greens and tomatoes. At noon, the family of three sat around the dining table. Father Sun Mingyuan asked about the morning's study progress. She explained several hard-to-remember knowledge points from her mistake notebook to them. Father nodded and shared an amusing story about getting his driver's license back in the day. The conversation naturally shifted to the exhibition plan for "Kunming Time-Honored Brands" at her father's cultural bureau next month, and she felt this was a potential writing subject.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, home kitchen and dining room

name: Afternoon rest and writing ideas.
description: After the meal, she returned to the study, leaned back in the chair, and rested with her eyes closed for 10 minutes. Then she used her phone memo to briefly sketch out ideas for revising the preface of “Slow Travel Notes” in the afternoon, deciding to shift the focus from personal memories to urban transformation and incorporate elements of the morning scene at Green Lake she had seen earlier today.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon of writing and exchanging ideas at the bookstore.
description: At 1:15 p.m., carrying her laptop and Kunming City History, she walked to the Zhibushi Bookstore on Green Lake North Road, passing along the edge of Green Lake Park and feeling the slightly warm early-autumn afternoon breeze. After arriving, she sat at her usual seat on the second floor, opened her computer, and started writing. First, she focused on revising the preface to her essay collection Slow Travel Notes, weaving in the Green Lake morning scene she had planned at midday to make the writing more vivid. Then she polished a draft for the column Kunming Slices, an article about the snack shops around Green Lake, adding colloquial descriptions of the owner to make the piece livelier. At 4 p.m., she went downstairs to find Uncle Qin, who was brewing tea, and reported on her recent writing progress and reading discoveries. Uncle Qin was intrigued, put down his teacup, and took out Kunming City Records: Folk Customs Volume and Industry and Commerce of Old Kunming to recommend to her, encouraging her to be bold, and they agreed to discuss the overall outline in more detail next week.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Owner of Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, a friend across generations.

location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, second-floor writing workstation and first-floor tea house area

name: Yoga class and leaf gathering after class
description: After bidding farewell to Uncle Qin, she walked along Wenlin Street toward Dongfeng West Road for about 18 minutes and arrived at Zhongmu Yoga Studio on the 4th floor of Dechun Commercial Building. After changing into her yoga clothes and drinking some water in the rest area, she saw that the eucalyptus leaves and white lisianthus in the flower arrangement corner by the window still looked lively, and she felt a sense of relaxation. At 5 p.m., Teacher He Lu's Hatha yoga class began, with the theme "Spinal Flow and Relaxation." She seriously practiced poses such as Cat-Cow, Downward-Facing Dog, and Child's Pose. After the 60-minute class, the stiffness in her neck, shoulders, and back was effectively relieved. After class, she briefly exchanged thoughts with He Lu about practicing flower arrangement at home that morning, and He Lu encouraged her to keep practicing. On the way home, in the green belt beside Dechun Commercial Building, she carefully found a beautiful early-yellow ginkgo leaf with slightly curled edges and carefully tucked it into her notebook.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio and its surroundings, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home and helped with dinner
description: She walked home feeling satisfied. In the dusk, the streetlights came on one after another, and the streets took on more of the warm, lively atmosphere of everyday life. About 16 minutes later, she returned to her home in the Green Lake community. Her mother had almost finished preparing dinner, so she changed out of her yoga clothes, washed her hands, helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and waited for her father to get off work.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, home kitchen and dining room

name: Family dinner time
description: After her father Sun Mingyuan returned home, the family of three sat around the dining table, and she shared with her parents what she had gained from today's exchange with Uncle Qin at the bookstore and the relaxing feeling from the yoga class. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize journal entries to record study progress.
description: Sat at her desk and opened her journal. First she drew the outline of a ginkgo leaf with a green watercolor pen, then used clear tape to stick a ginkgo leaf picked on the way home flat onto the journal page as decoration. Then she recorded in detail: for driving test study, she wrote down the total number of questions done today and the mock exam results, especially noting the key points on emergency avoidance principles she had just learned; for writing, she wrote about revising the preface of “Slow Travel Notes,” finding a new angle, and scheduling a chat with Uncle Qin next week about the outline; for yoga insights, next to the ginkgo leaf she drew a simple stick figure in Downward-Facing Dog pose and wrote, “Spine relaxed, mind at ease.” Finally, in the blank space, she wrote keywords for tomorrow’s reading of “Kunming City Gazetteer: Folk Customs Volume.”
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Deep Reading and Free Learning
description: Looking back at March, what significant changes were there in the focus of my daily activities between the first half and the second half of the month? What was the thing that made me develop a new life ritual?
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening online communication and relaxation before sleep.
description: Leaning against the headboard, she sent a voice message to her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, sharing today's joy of picking up ginkgo leaves and working on her journal. Her sister quickly replied, complaining about Shenzhen's weather and reminding her not to stay up late. She then replied to her best friend Zhang Jing's WeChat message about getting a meal together over the weekend, and chatted briefly. In the evening, she changed into her pajamas and did about fifteen minutes of pre-sleep stretching, focusing on relaxing her hips and spine. Then she sat cross-legged for ten minutes, following the breathing meditation guided by the Tide app to settle the day's thoughts. Afterward, under the warm yellow desk lamp, she picked up Summer by Dianchi Lake and read another two chapters. At exactly 23:00, she turned off the light and fell asleep, peaceful and content.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run around Green Lake and gathering inspiration
description: After getting up at 6:45, she did a simple stretch, then left home at 7:00 and walked to the south gate of Green Lake Park, jogging 3 kilometers around the lake at a pace of about 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Along the way, she observed the morning scenes along Wenlin Street (steam from a baozi shop, a flower shop tidying up, sanitation workers sweeping) and recorded details with her phone video. After finishing the run at 7:35, she did static stretches on a lakeside bench, breathing in the fresh air after the rain.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Going home for a shower and breakfast
description: After running, she walked home, took a quick shower, and changed into dry clothes. At 8:00 she enjoyed the breakfast her mother had prepared (millet porridge, boiled eggs, steamed sweet potato), listened as her mother excitedly shared her mood about going to the community choir rehearsal of 'The Flowing Stream' in the afternoon, and encouraged her. After the meal, she helped her mother clear the dishes, then returned to her room to organize the material from her morning run.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting to the bookstore
description: At 8:35, after putting the laptop, charger, notebook, and other items into a canvas bag, she went out and walked along Wenlin Street to Mingyuan Bookstore. Passing a convenience store, she bought a bottle of mineral water and enjoyed the comfortable feeling of the morning light falling on the old plane trees.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focused on column revisions
description: I sat down at the window seat on the second floor of Mingyuan Bookstore, ordered an Americano, and opened my laptop to focus on revising the column draft "Morning Hustle and Bustle on Wenlin Street." I wove in details from my morning run observations, adjusted the sentence order, and weighed the wording. During this time, the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan brought over a newly arrived essay collection and we had a brief chat. The revision was finished at 11:00. After reading it through, I emailed it to editor Xu Mingyuan along with a note on the revisions.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 148 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch: Duanshi small-pot rice noodles
description: Left the bookstore at 11:35 and walked to Duanshi Small-Pot Rice Noodles, ordered a bowl of the signature small-pot rice noodles and an extra serving of braised tofu. She sat at a street-side seat and enjoyed it slowly, watching the comings and goings on Wenlin Street while she ate.
location: Duanshi Small-Pot Rice Noodles, No. 74 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home.
description: After lunch, she walked home. She arrived at 12:25, greeted her parents, who were having their midday rest, and then went into her room.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Researching million-yuan medical insurance
description: In the afternoon, without taking a nap, she opened Alipay’s Ant Insurance on her phone, carefully browsed and compared consumer million-yuan medical insurance products (Good Medical Insurance Long-Term Medical 20-Year Edition and Good Medical Insurance Lifetime Cancer-Protection Medical Insurance), and carefully reviewed details such as coverage, deductible, premium, reimbursement ratio for out-of-hospital drugs, and value-added services. She took screenshots of the product detail pages and recorded the key points.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday nap
description: After researching insurance, her eyes felt tired, so she rested with her eyes closed on the study sofa for about 20 minutes and flipped through a few pages of 'Summer by Dianchi Lake', giving her mind and body a brief period of relaxation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Making pressed-flower bookmarks
description: Took out the ginkgo leaves she had picked up at the yoga studio the day before yesterday and the dried flower petals collected earlier. After laying out her tools on the desk, she carefully used tweezers to glue the dried flowers and leaves onto blank bookmark cards. She made 4 bookmarks in total: 2 with ginkgo leaves paired with baby's breath, and 2 with petals paired with fern leaves. After completing each one, she sealed it with cold laminating film.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Flower arrangement practice in the study
description: Took out the ikebana tool kit (flower shears, kenzan, vase) and the flowers at home (eucalyptus leaves, white balloon flowers, green leaves). Based on the memory of the practice the day before, reviewed the basic slanting style of the Ikenobo school. Used eucalyptus leaves to build the framework, with balloon flowers as the main flower, repeatedly adjusting angles. After about 40 minutes of practice, I completed a work I was satisfied with and photographed it with my phone.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Learn the technique of using masking fluid in watercolor painting
description: I moved the flower vase aside, spread out a watercolor pad, opened my saved masking-fluid tutorial on Bilibili, and followed the steps in the video. Using a nylon brush dipped in masking fluid, I painted a leaf outline. After it dried, I applied the background color, then peeled off the masking fluid. When the clear white leaf outline appeared, I was very excited and recorded the key points of this practice in detail in my journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Welcoming mother home and family interaction
description: Mother returned from community choir rehearsal with an excited flush on her face. Sun Yuwei put down her watercolor brushes and went up to her. Mother eagerly shared the rehearsal details: how the teacher taught vocalization, how beautiful 'Xiao He Tang Shui' sounded, and how she had met a few retired teachers she got along with. Sun Yuwei and her father Sun Mingyuan listened with keen interest, and the home was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner
description: Mother made a few home-style dishes: twice-cooked pork, shredded potatoes with green peppers, and tomato and egg drop soup. The family of three chatted as they ate. Sun Yuwei shared that her column revision had gone smoothly in the morning and showed the bookmarks she had made in the afternoon. Both parents were happy for her.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanied mother for a walk in the neighborhood
description: After dinner, she took the initiative to accompany her mother downstairs for a walk. They first walked two laps in the residential garden, then strolled to the nearby Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park). Her mother continued talking about the funny stories from the choir and encouraged Sun Yuwei to sit in on a rehearsal. Sun Yuwei linked arms with her mother, and the streetlights stretched their shadows long.
location: Inside Cuihu Park and the Cuihu Community residential area, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Wrapping up watercolor practice and organizing the journal
description: After walking home, she returned to the study, photographed the afternoon's watercolor practice works, analyzed their strengths and weaknesses, and added notes on masking fluid techniques to her journal. She took out the pressed-flower bookmarks she had made and carefully planned how to attach them to that day's 'Event Record' page.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Finished journal entry and evening reading
description: Sitting at the small desk by the bed in the bedroom, she carefully recorded today's journal with a fountain pen, writing about the insights from her morning run, column revision, insurance research, bookmark making, flower arranging practice, and watercolor learning. She pasted in a ginkgo leaf bookmark and an ordinary fallen leaf. After finishing the journal, she picked up “Summer by Dianchi Lake” and read two chapters.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stretching and preparation before sleep
description: Before bed, she did a simple 10-minute stretch on the yoga mat to relax her shoulders, neck, and legs. Afterward, she packed the textbooks and charger she needed to bring to school the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading

description: I turned off the lights on time, looked back on this full and peaceful day, and drifted into sleep with contentment.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

Using a kenzan, a water dish, gerbera flowers, and pothos leaves, she focused on the uprightness of the branches and the orientation of the flowers, and her mind gradually calmed.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and family conversation.

I watched dynamic diagrams and drew memory flowcharts in my journal, and organized a mistake notebook to consolidate what I learned.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Rest and preparation for writing the afterword
description: During a short break, she replied to her best friend Zhang Jing's congratulatory message. Then she opened the final draft of the essay collection Slow Travel Notes on her computer, organized an outline for the afterword Writing Is a Long Breath, recorded the core themes, moments of insight, and people to thank, and jotted down sudden aphorisms and paragraph ideas.
location: Home study and living room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

After the meal, I rested in the living room with my eyes closed for about 15 minutes, then organized my canvas bag, putting in my laptop, tablet, journal, and other items to get ready to go out.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the bookstore and write the afterword for the essay collection.
description: Walked about 13 minutes along the outer edge of Cuihu to reach Zhibushi Bookstore, and at a window seat on the second floor focused on writing the afterword 'Writing Is a Long Breath.' Using the outline from the morning, smoothly completed a first draft of about 1,500 words. During that time, bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan brought warm water and briefly greeted, without interrupting the writing state.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: She told the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan the good news that she had finished the postscript, and he suggested holding a small sharing session in the store after the manuscript was completed. Then she walked to Lvye Flower Shop on nearby Cuihu West Road, where she chose golden-brown small chrysanthemums, eucalyptus leaves, and dried lotus seed pods, with the shopkeeper adding laceflower accents, for a total of 38 yuan.

name: Go home and change into yoga clothes
description: Walked quickly home, trimmed the purchased flower materials briefly, and put them into a bucket in the living room to rehydrate. Then went back to the room, took off the coat, changed into a yoga suit, drank a few sips of water for a short rest, and got ready for yoga class.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: On the way to Dechun Commercial Building, at the intersection of Wenlin Street, she rewarded herself with a medium cup of less-sugar brown sugar pearl milk tea. After arriving at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, she followed the instructor He Lu through a vinyasa flow sequence, focusing on conquering the headstand. With assistance, she successfully held it for 35 seconds on the second attempt, breaking her personal record, and exchanged thoughts with the instructor after class.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

When I got home, Mom had already prepared braised pork ribs, stir-fried choy sum, and lotus root soup; Dad, Sun Mingyuan, also came back from work. During dinner, I shared the good news of finishing the afterword and my yoga breakthrough. Dad asked about my driving test progress. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Immersive Reading and Note-Taking
description: After dinner, I returned to the study and read Wild Grass, the collection of essays recommended by Uncle Qin. Drawn in by its unique perspective, I used Notability to capture striking passages and recorded writing techniques for discovering poetry in ordinary things, filling three pages of notes.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Arranging flower materials and journaling
description: Formally arranged the conditioned chrysanthemums, eucalyptus leaves, and dried lotus seed pods into the vase on the corner of the desk, adding an autumn touch. Then she took out her A5 journal, pasted in the screenshot of her driving test score as a label, drew a small lotus seed pod to record the flower purchase, and wrote about her yoga headstand breakthrough, bringing today's journal to a close.
location: Home study and living room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wind-down relaxation and planning for tomorrow
description: After changing into pajamas, I did bedtime stretches on the bedroom rug to relax my shoulders, back, and legs, then meditated cross-legged for 10 minutes, focusing on my breath to clear my mind. Finally, I listed tomorrow’s to-dos in the notes app on my phone: polish the first draft of Chapter One of the essay collection in the morning; go for a walk in Cuihu Park in the afternoon if the weather is nice; finish the remaining Driving Test Subject 1 questions in the evening.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and turning off the lights to sleep.
description: Lying in bed, she continued reading the rest of "Wild Grass" on her e-reader, immersed in the tranquility the words brought her. Until drowsiness crept in, she turned off the bedside lamp and fell into a deep sleep in the cool, quiet autumn night.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake-up and status recording
description: The alarm went off, Sun Yuwei woke up naturally, picked up her phone, and recorded her wake-up time and weight of 45.6 kg. She pulled open the curtains; the warm autumn sunlight streamed through the plane tree leaves into the room, and crisp birdsong came from outside the window. She felt calm and relaxed.
location: Bedroom at Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: After dynamic stretching, Sun Yuwei went out and jogged to Green Lake Park, running 2.5 kilometers around the lake at a pace of about 7 minutes 40 seconds. During the run, she deliberately observed the light and shadows on the lake, elderly people doing morning exercise, and mandarin ducks and water birds playing, gathering visual and auditory material for her essay “Day and Night at Green Lake.” After the run, she did static stretching on a bench.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Purchased the Kunming Tourism magazine
description: On the way back, passing a newsstand at Green Lake, Sun Yuwei stopped, browsed, and bought a copy of the latest issue of "Kunming Tourism" magazine (September issue). While flipping through the contents, she found a feature on "independent bookstores around Green Lake" and felt it could serve as supplementary background for her essay. Then she walked home.
location: Cuihu Newsstand, west entrance of Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

description: When she got home, her mother Li Xiulan had prepared white porridge, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables. Sun Yuwei quickly browsed her phone while eating breakfast, replied to her best friend Zhou Lin's message recommending a drawing tablet, saying she would look into it this afternoon; she also replied to editor Xu Mingyuan's confirmation email about the column.
location: Dining room, Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

location: Bathroom at Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: Sun Yuwei made herself a cup of homemade brown sugar pearl milk tea, opened her laptop and journal at the desk by the window in her study. She first outlined the framework for "Green Lake: Day and Night" (morning awakening, afternoon languor, dusk romance, and night tranquility), and incorporated the new inspiration she had gained from morning runs and magazines. After consulting a feature in Kunming Tourism magazine, she copied down 2 quotable sentences. During a break in writing, she opened the Driving Test Treasure app and did targeted practice on the error-prone points in Subject 1 (such as expressway speed limit signs and traffic police gestures), taking screenshots to save 3 new knowledge points.
location: Study, Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch preparation, lunch, and midday rest
description: Mother started preparing lunch, and Sun Yuwei took the initiative to help pick vegetables in the kitchen. Mother brought up the melody of Vineyard Nocturne that her choir had just learned. Yuwei hummed along as she listened and suggested that when they made dumplings for dinner, they could have her father sing it too. Then the mother and daughter had tomato egg noodles for lunch. After the meal, Sun Yuwei cleared the table and took a 20-minute nap in her bedroom.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and bedroom, Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: After waking from her nap, Sun Yuwei looked at the ceramic vase arrangement from yesterday, noticed that one red maple leaf was curled, gently misted it locally, and adjusted the position of the silver wormwood to make the composition more harmonious. Then she took out her watercolor and colored pencil tools and created three hand-painted postcards on A6 blank cards: "Maple Leaves and Lake Rocks" for Zhang Jing, "The Squirrel Stealing Peanuts" for Chen Sisi, and "Osmanthus and Cat" for Zhou Lin. While creating, she referred to park photos saved on her phone. After finishing, she dried them with a hairdryer and packaged them with kraft paper envelopes and small dried flower samples.
location: Desk in the bedroom, Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparations for the gathering and contacting Dad.
description: After wrapping the postcard, Sun Yuwei confirmed the preliminary ideas for tomorrow's gathering in her phone memo, texted Zhou Lin to ask about the time and place of the gathering, and planned to bring homemade flower cakes as snacks. Then she went to the living room, called her father, and confirmed that he would be home around 18:00, just in time to make dumplings together.
location: Bedroom and living room, Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: Sun Yuwei slung her shopping bag over her shoulder and walked with her mother to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. They divided the work: her mother selected fresh chives, shrimp, eggs, and flour, while Yuwei looked for fruit for the next day's gathering and bought a box of Shine Muscat grapes and a box of figs.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: After going home, Yuwei and her mother began to prepare the dumpling filling. Her mother was in charge of the secret recipe for seasoning the three-delicacy filling, while Yuwei was responsible for cutting chives and mixing the meat filling. The two continued chatting about amusing stories from the choir, and her mother proudly hummed the climax of "Vineyard Nocturne".
location: Kitchen, Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A family of three making dumplings together.
description: After returning home from work and washing his hands, her father Sun Mingyuan joined in. He was in charge of rolling out the wrappers while the mother and daughter made the dumplings. Yuwei shaped delicate willow-leaf dumplings, while her father made ingot-shaped ones. The three chatted as they worked, and the atmosphere was warm and joyful.
location: Living room dining table, Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Mother boiled dumplings, and Yuwei helped prepare the dipping sauce (vinegar, minced garlic, sesame oil, and chili oil), while Father cleaned the kneading board. After the dumplings were cooked, the family sat around and ate. Yuwei shared the good news that her column draft had been accepted and that she had scored 95 on the Subject 1 mock exam. After the meal, they chatted while eating fruit. The topics ranged from her plans after graduation (she wanted to continue writing full-time while also pursuing further studies) to whether to visit her older sister in Shenzhen during the National Day holiday. Father reminded her to take care of her health, and Mother encouraged her to keep working hard. Later, Yuwei took the initiative to clear the dishes, wash the dishes, and wipe the table. Her parents watched the TV news in the living room, and she sat with them for a while and watched part of a documentary.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with best friend and research on digital drawing tablets
description: Back in the bedroom, Sun Yuwei had a video call with her best friend Zhou Lin. Zhou Lin explained in detail the advantages of a graphics tablet, such as pressure sensitivity and layer operations, and shared a link to beginner tutorials on Bilibili. Yuwei listened while opening the link on her computer to browse, taking screenshots of key points (such as 'How to use Photoshop to test pressure sensitivity'), and felt like she had discovered a new world. The two agreed to meet at an independent café in the city center at 4 p.m. the next day.
location: Bedroom at Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and bedtime journaling
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and continued reading that obscure essay collection for about 30 minutes. The author's descriptions of hometown food reminded her of the flower cakes her mother made, and also gave her inspiration for bringing snacks to tomorrow's gathering. Afterwards, she updated her journal: pasted in a small cut-out from Kunming Tourism magazine, and recorded the changing light and shadow of the morning run, the mood of making postcards, the warmth of making dumplings, and the new inspiration she had gained from Zhou Lin. After setting the alarm, she turned off her phone and went to sleep with the lights off. Her weight was unchanged, and she felt warm and fulfilled.
location: Bedroom at Room 301, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and yoga
description: At 8:00 on Saturday morning, the alarm went off. Sun Yuwei drew open the curtains and bathed in the soft morning light of Kunming’s sunny-to-cloudy sky. After a quick wash, she drank a glass of warm water and changed into yoga clothes. She laid out her yoga mat in the bedroom and did a 30-minute morning practice, completing five rounds of Sun Salutation A and B sequences with deep breathing, and finishing with shoulder-and-neck relaxation and meditation. She felt full of energy.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: After practice, Sun Yuwei had breakfast with her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan. Her mother had made millet porridge, with homemade pickled radish peels and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Her father asked how the mock exam for Subject 1 had gone, and Sun Yuwei confidently said there was basically no problem. Her mother reminded her not to come home too late. Afterward, she sent a WeChat message to her older cousin Shen Wei, telling her that she would meet her close friends in the afternoon and look over the insurance details carefully in the evening. Before going out, she brought her reusable bag, wallet, canvas tote, and the three hand-painted postcards she had made last night.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market and tidying up at home
description: Walk about 27 minutes from Renmin Middle Road to Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. At the market, she picked out a few plump Yunnan red pears and a few pieces of pure handmade brown sugar. Passing by the flower market, she was drawn to a bunch of snow willow in bud and bought it to arrange in a vase. After getting home, she washed the red pears and put them in a fruit bowl, trimmed the snow willow and placed it in the living room vase, adding life to the home. Then she put away her yoga mat and tidied up the bedroom.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and family lunch
description: Sun Yuwei helped her mother peel garlic and trim green beans in the kitchen, then the family sat down together for lunch. Lunch was tofu pudding rice noodles topped with the savory minced-pork sauce her mother had stir-fried, and the aroma filled the air. Her father mentioned the essay contest at his workplace next week, and Sun Yuwei gave him some topic suggestions. The atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and heading out
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei went back to her bedroom for a 15-minute nap. Then she changed into a cotton-linen dress and saw that her cousin Shen Wei had replied, saying she could talk anytime in the evening. She packed a box of sesame crisp snacks her mother had made that morning into her canvas bag, ready to take to her best friend.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Learned to use a drawing tablet with Zhou Lin and shared journals
description: She walked to Douji Coffee Shop on Jianshe Road, where Zhou Lin was already waiting with an entry-level drawing tablet. They ordered Yunnan small-bean lattes. Zhou Lin patiently taught Sun Yuwei how to connect the tablet, use the pressure-sensitive pen, and draw a simple leaf outline. Sun Yuwei was amazed by the convenience of a digital journal, but she still preferred the feel of paper. Then the two walked to Wheat Field Bookstore on Wenhua Lane. On the way, Sun Yuwei took out the postcards she had made the night before—maple leaf, squirrel, and osmanthus—and showed them to Zhou Lin. Zhou Lin was full of praise for the osmanthus one and also tasted the crispy sesame snacks made by Sun Yuwei's mother.
location: Douji Coffee Shop, No. 211 Jianshe Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: At 'Wheat Field Bookstore', the independent bookstore she often went to (Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore), Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi were already sitting by the window. The four ordered plum sparkling water. Zhang Jing shared the new journal tape she had bought (cherry blossom and Japanese-style series), and everyone tried it out and chatted. Sisi enthusiastically introduced the 'Yunnan Contemporary Ink Art Exhibition' that would open next Friday at the art museum. Sun Yuwei shared a funny story about being called 'stupid' by her driving instructor for crossing the line during driving practice, which made everyone laugh. Zhou Lin also naturally joined the conversation. Finally, they took a group photo in front of the old book wall in the bookstore.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bought flower cakes and walked home.
description: After saying goodbye to her best friend, Sun Yuwei walked to Jiahua Bakery at the entrance of Wenhua Lane and bought four freshly baked classic rose flower cakes. Then she strolled back toward Green Lake and returned to her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road. The street was leisurely in the evening, and she savored the joy of the gathering.
location: Jiahua Bakery on Wenhua Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, and along the route

name: Family evening time together: afternoon tea and dinner
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei arranged the flower cakes on a plate, brewed Pu'er tea, and shared stories from the afternoon gathering with her parents in the living room. Her mother ate two flower cakes in a row, saying they were delicious; her father was very interested in Zhou Lin's drawing tablet and asked technical questions. Then the family had dinner together in the dining room. Her mother had made stir-fried bitter melon, garlic water spinach, and corn and pork rib soup—light and tasty. At the table, they talked about whether her older sister would come home for National Day.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Insurance product learning and comparison
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to the study to check WeChat messages from her cousin Shen Wei. Shen Wei sent three screenshots with red arrows marking key clauses such as '10,000 yuan deductible', '20-year guaranteed renewal (note the discontinuation risk)', and 'exclusions', along with a voice analysis. After listening carefully, Sun Yuwei opened Ant Insurance on Alipay and the Huize.com app to compare Haoyibao long-term medical insurance and Lanyibao long-term medical insurance respectively. She recorded the deductible, premium (price for a 22-year-old woman), coverage scope, and value-added services (such as priority medical treatment access and expense advance payment) in her phone notes, and starred the key points.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Organize today's journal
description: Sun Yuwei took out her TN journal, pasted in the group photo from the afternoon bookstore meetup, the small ticket stubs, and the bookmark Zhou Lin had given her, drew simple illustrations of the day's outfit and mood, and added a few insurance study notes: "The deductible is very important; read the renewal conditions carefully." Finally, she embellished it with the newly acquired cherry blossom tape.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and routine preparation.
description: She changed into her pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and continued reading the chapter in the obscure essay collection 'Plants and Trees Have Feelings' that describes the winter sunlight in Kunming, relaxing her body and mind. Then she got up to wash up, cleansed her face with a gentle facial cleanser, and patted on hyaluronic acid toner and moisturizer. Back in the bedroom, she planned the next day in the memo checklist on her phone: a morning run around Green Lake, completing the Subject 1 mock exam, and delivering brown sugar to Aunt Xie. Finally, she turned off the light, put on an eye mask, did a 10-minute body scan meditation with a meditation app, breathed steadily, and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake-up and morning routine
description: After being woken by the soft autumn light outside the window, I first weighed myself and recorded the number, then did a simple wash-up and skincare routine. Wearing my nightgown, I sat quietly for a while on the bay window in the bedroom, savoring the morning stillness and letting my thoughts slowly clear.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and daily schedule discussion.
description: She had breakfast with her parents. On the table were soy milk, fried eggs, toast, and Mom's homemade rose jam. The family of three chatted while eating. Sun Yuwei shared her plans for today: proofreading the essay collection, setting up the meditation space, and discussing insurance with her cousin. Her mother, Li Xiulan, reminded her to take brown sugar to Aunt Xie.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth review of the final draft of the essay collection.

Using a section-by-section review method, I focused on verifying the historical material in three essays about anecdotes of Kunming literati during the Republic of China period, confirming the accuracy of dates, names, and event references, and wrote down questions and notes in pencil.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Visit neighbor Aunt Xie.

location: Aunt Xie's balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and preparing before the meal

location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and midday nap
description: Had lunch with her parents, including pork rib and radish soup, stir-fried greens, and pan-fried fish. After the meal, she tasted flower cakes, chatted with her mother, and helped clear the dishes. Then she went back to her room, set an alarm, and lay down for a nap.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room and bedroom

name: Lunch break and fragmented learning
description: After waking from her nap, she leaned against the headboard and spent half an hour on her phone going through the wrong-question collection for Subject 1 in the Driving Test Treasure app. She noted easily confused traffic signs in her notes app, then closed her eyes to completely relax her mind.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: At the desk, she turned on the computer, logged into Driving Test Treasure, and took two complete mock exams in a row, scoring 97 and 99. She saved a screenshot of the 99-point score report and sent it to her cousin Shen Wei via WeChat, with a caption reporting that she had met the target.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

description: After her cousin Shen Wei replied to a message praising her exam results, she sent several comparison tables for million-yuan medical insurance. The two had a voice call of about 20 minutes to discuss key terms such as the deductible and renewal conditions. Sun Yuwei recorded the key points in her phone memo and gained a more concrete understanding of financial planning.

Then she used the wet-on-wet technique to lay down the base color, trying to create a soft transition from green to withered yellow in the leaves. Although she handled the leaf veins before the paint was fully dry, causing the edges to bleed, she was instead pleased with the mottled effect.

name: Accompany mother for a walk around Cuihu Lake

Her mother pointed to the pavilion in the middle of the lake and told the story of how she first met Sun Yuwei's father while boating there when they were young. Sun Yuwei listened quietly, occasionally using her phone's memo app to note down keywords and inspiration.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

description: After returning from the walk, they found that Aunt Xie had brought homemade osmanthus candy and left it on the coffee table. The family of three sat on the sofa, brewed some fresh tea, tasted the delicate sweetness of the osmanthus candy, and listened to Sun Yuwei recount the story her mother had told during the walk.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was simple, with leftover pork rib soup from lunch and stir-fried vegetables Mom had just cooked. During the meal, Sun Yuwei shared the takeaways from her afternoon discussion about insurance with her cousin, and her father gave sound financial advice. The family chatted pleasantly.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revising in the study and sorting out inspirations
description: Back in the study, she revised the historical materials section of the essay collection according to the morning's proofreading comments, and expanded the fragments she had noted during her walk into a roughly 300-word essay titled "My Mother's Green Lake Stories" as potential material.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and online socializing
description: I took out the A6 ring-bound journal, taped in today's watercolor practice piece (even though it had flaws), and recorded small joys such as scoring 99 on the Subject 1 mock exam and Auntie Xie's osmanthus candy. Meanwhile, I shared my thoughts on the afternoon insurance discussion in the close friends group, and Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi replied with surprised emojis.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of the home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: First bedtime meditation.
description: I went to the newly arranged meditation corner, lit lavender essential oil, and drew the curtains. Sitting on the yoga mat, I opened the Tide app and chose the 10-minute body scan practice. My thoughts occasionally drifted to the day's watercolor painting and insurance matters, but I gently brought them back. After finishing, I felt obviously relaxed in both body and mind.
location: Meditation platform by the bedroom window at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime Reading and Reflection Notes
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I lay in bed and read two chapters about silence from an obscure essay collection. After closing the book, I felt deeply touched and used my journal to record tonight's reflections on meditation and reading.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep peacefully.
description: Turn off all the lights except a small night light, think back on the richness and satisfaction of the day—plans completed, connections with people, time with nature, and inner dialogue—and soon fall asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and family breakfast.
description: At 6:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei woke up and did not get out of bed immediately. Instead, she turned sideways and let the morning light gently fall on her eyes. Then she opened the Tide app to do a body-scan meditation, gradually relaxing her whole body from her toes. After the meditation, she sat quietly by the window for a moment, feeling her breath flow. Then she went to the dining room, where her mother Zhao Fang had prepared multigrain porridge, poached eggs, and flower cakes. At the table, Sun Yuwei talked with her parents about the upcoming Subject 1 exam in a relaxed and confident tone. Her father Sun Zhiyuan put a fried egg on her plate and encouraged her to perform normally, while her mother promised to make sweet and sour pork ribs after the exam. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Room 402, Building 7, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-exam review and trip to the vehicle management office.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to her study, opened the wrong-question notebook in the Driving Test Treasure app, and quickly reviewed error-prone points such as fine amounts and traffic police gestures, silently reciting the mnemonic formulas. After about 10 minutes, she felt more confident, packed up her ID card, student ID, and notes, put on headphones and played soft music. She walked from home to the Cuihu North Road bus stop, took the No. 101 bus, got off at Xiaocaiyuan Station after four stops, and then walked three minutes to reach the vehicle management office at No. 296 Longquan Road, Wuhua District.
location: Vehicle management service window of the Wuhua Brigade of the Kunming Traffic Police Detachment, No. 296 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Subject 1 theory test
description: Entering the vehicle management office lobby, Sun Yuwei followed the signs to the theory test waiting area, queued up for ID verification, and stored her phone and other electronic devices. After entering the theory exam room, she found her assigned seat, took a deep breath, and began answering questions. She answered most questions quickly. When she encountered difficult questions on traffic signals and traffic police gestures, she read the questions carefully and used the process of elimination. Finally, she submitted the test, and the screen showed a score of 98. She passed smoothly, printed the score report, and signed for it.
location: Theory Exam Room, Wuhua Brigade, Kunming Traffic Police Detachment, No. 296 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-exam sharing and driving school appointment
description: After receiving the score report, Sun Yuwei walked to a quiet corner of the corridor at the vehicle management office. She immediately reported the good news of passing with 98 points in the family group chat 'Happy Family,' reminded her mother of the promise of sweet-and-sour spare ribs, and also shared the score in her close friends' group, receiving enthusiastic responses from Zhou Lin and others. She then walked to the Yuexin Driving School registration point on Hongshan East Road, showed the score report to the front desk, and the staff helped her schedule the Subject 2 field practice for the afternoon of September 11. She carefully clipped the appointment slip into her journal.
location: Yuexin Driving School Enrollment Point, 106 Hongshan East Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Cycle to Zhibushi Bookstore.
description: After leaving the driving school, Sun Yuwei found that the Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road was not far, so she decided to go straight there to enjoy some leisure after the exam. She scanned a shared bike and cycled along Wenlin Street, with a gentle breeze on her face and a light mood. Along the way, she noticed the everyday scenes on both sides of the street and enjoyed a moment of relaxation and freedom.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bookstore immersion: writing, lunch, and midday rest
description: Upon arriving at Zhibushi Bookstore, Sun Yuwei showed the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan her Subject 1 score report. Qin Mingyuan congratulated her with a smile and guided her to her usual seat by the window. She ordered a cup of Pu'er tea, opened her laptop, and began writing the essay 'Driving Test Notes,' pouring into it the pre-exam tension, the anxiety of doing practice questions, the focus during the exam, and the joy of passing. Around 12 o'clock, feeling hungry, she took out some pastries from the insulated lunch box her mother had prepared, paired them with tea from her own thermos, and had a simple lunch to maintain her writing flow. After eating, she put on headphones by the window and listened to rainforest white noise, taking a short nap of about 20 minutes, bathed in sunlight, peaceful and comfortable.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bookstore time: revising essays and exchanging inspiration
