description: After the midday rest, Sun Yuwei recovered and reopened the document to revise her essay "Driving Exam Notes," adjusting sentence structures and polishing wording. Then she created a new document to draft a Xiaohongshu post, planning to use her 98-point experience as the entry point, with screenshots of her score report, the quiz app, and a blue-sky photo. Later she got up and browsed the bookstore, chatting with Qin Mingyuan, who was organizing newly arrived Republic of China essay collections. Qin Mingyuan handed her a book he thought she would like; the passage about "waiting" resonated with her, and she photographed it with her phone as material. Afterwards, she noticed a female book lover studying Japanese Ikenobo flower arrangement, curiously went over to talk, and shared the concept of the "seika" three-branch style she had learned. They chatted pleasantly, and she gained new creative inspiration.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Jiuguan Fangtang Coffee and Inspiration Sketches
description: After leaving Zhibushi Bookstore, Sun Yuwei walked about 18 minutes to Jiuguan Fangtang on Zhonghe Lane, ordered a hand-drip coffee and a tiramisu. Sitting inside, she opened her journal, sketched out the flower arrangement inspiration she had just discussed with her book friends, and organized the structure of the Driving Test Notes essay and today's mood, recording it in the Inspiration Sketch section, enjoying a peaceful afternoon of creative time.
location: Jiuguan Fangtang, Zhonghe Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Autumn stroll in Green Lake Park
description: After coming out of Jiuguan Fangtang, Sun Yuwei walked five minutes to Green Lake Park, strolled leisurely along the trail, and enjoyed the sunshine and breeze of the autumn afternoon. She noticed osmanthus blooming by the roadside, with a faint sweet fragrance in the air, so she stopped to photograph the osmanthus and the sky with her phone, saving the material for future writing about Kunming.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Family reunion: helping with household chores and celebrating with dinner.
description: After leaving the park, Sun Yuwei walked ten minutes home, changed into home clothes, and took the initiative to help her mother, Zhao Fang, in the kitchen by picking vegetables and peeling garlic. Soon, her mother brought out carefully prepared sweet-and-sour spare ribs, garlic lettuce, and tomato egg drop soup. At the dinner table, Sun Yuwei recounted in detail the process of the Subject One exam, including pre-exam nervousness, handling difficult questions, and the surprise of seeing a score of 98. Her father, Sun Zhiyuan, was so happy that he drank an extra small glass of wine, while her mother began planning a family self-driving trip to Dianchi Lake after getting the driver's license. After dinner, she helped clear the dishes, then watched TV news for a while with her parents on the living room sofa, and shared her photos of Green Lake in the best-friends group, receiving praise from friends.
location: Room 402, Building 7, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Order a graphics tablet and take online courses.
description: Back in the study, Sun Yuwei remembered Zhou Lin's encouragement, opened the Tmall app, found the link to the entry-level drawing tablet, carefully read the specs and reviews, then chose local-warehouse flash delivery and placed the order, adding a note asking for prompt shipment. While waiting for the delivery, she opened her saved online courses. She first watched a 5-minute short video, Shen Congwen and Kunming, then clicked on a public course about Yunnan ethnic culture and essay writing, taking notes on creative key points in her notebook as she watched, enriching herself.
location: Study, Room 402, Building 7, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Unboxing and first experience with the graphics tablet
description: The doorbell rang, and the delivery arrived. Sun Yuwei excitedly went downstairs to pick up the package. She tore open the packaging and carefully checked the drawing tablet, pressure-sensitive pen, USB cable, driver CD, and warranty card. Following the manual, she successfully connected it to her computer and installed the driver. Then she opened the drawing software and tried drawing lines and circles, experiencing the creative feeling brought by the coordination of the pressure pen and the tablet. A surge of creative impulse welled up in her heart.
location: Study, Room 402, Building 7, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling
description: After trying out the graphics tablet, Sun Yuwei took out her favorite journal and used a fountain pen to record the day's three important events: passing Subject 1 with 98 points, completing the first draft of "Driving Test Notes" at Zhibushi Bookstore, and the joy of unboxing the graphics tablet. She also used the flower arrangement note-taking technique she had learned in the afternoon to sketch a small osmanthus flower in the margin, along with a line of inspiration she had jotted down at Jiuguan Fangtang, filling her heart with a serene sense of accomplishment and creation.
location: Study, Room 402, Building 7, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and plan for tomorrow
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei changed into comfortable pajamas, lit lavender essential oil in front of the meditation table in her bedroom, opened the Tide app and selected Body Scan mode, and followed the guidance to slowly relax from her toes all the way through her body, focusing on her breath and the stillness of the moment for 10 minutes. After meditation, she continued to write down a few small goals for tomorrow in her journal and made a simple plan for the next day.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 7, Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After meditation, Sun Yuwei lay down on the bed, picked up the essay collection Seasons of Plants and Trees from the bedside table, turned to the chapter she had planned to read, and immersed herself in the author's delicate style, thinking about how it connected with her own writing. After reading a dozen or so pages, she grew drowsy. She closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and, with the satisfaction of having accomplished many things, softly said goodnight to herself and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 7, Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine: meditation, flower arrangement practice, and journaling.
description: Woke up at 6:30, first weighed myself, then sat on the meditation cushion by the bed for 10 minutes of morning meditation. Afterward, I took out the flower materials prepared last night, such as snow willow and lisianthus, and practiced the basic slanted style arrangement in the study, repeatedly adjusting the fixing angle of the main branch to achieve balance. After practicing, I photographed the arrangement, cleaned up leftover branches, and quickly wrote down my practice reflections in the journal.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After washing up, she changed into a loose knit sweater and had breakfast with her mother: rice porridge, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables. Her mother chatted about everyday life, and Sun Yuwei talked about how she felt reading the animal and plant essays last night. Her father had already left for work.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning drawing tablet study and freehand drawing
description: In the study, she connected the drawing tablet to her laptop. After installing the driver, she followed the tutorial and started practicing pressure sensitivity using the system drawing software, drawing lines of different pressure and simple shapes. Once she got the hang of it, she tried tracing leaf outlines in a free drawing app. During the 10:00–10:20 break, she brewed osmanthus tea, took photos of rain-soaked plants by the living room window, and planned the journal layout. Afterward, she continued practicing, copying the photo of raindrops she had taken in the morning, using different brushes and opacity levels. Though the result was immature, she felt happy inside, and saved it to the folder “Rain Leaf_NEW”.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Insurance product screening
description: Referring to my cousin Shen Wei's voice notes and product screenshots, I conducted a second round of insurance product screening. I focused on comparing the deductibles and renewal conditions of 'Haoyibao Long-Term Medical' and 'Zunxiang eSheng,' narrowed the candidates down to five, and marked the key differences with different colored markers on the insurance section of my journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and rest
description: Ordered takeout of small-pot rice noodles, with a note saying no cilantro and extra braised tofu. After the delivery arrived, she ate slowly in the dining area while scrolling on her phone. She saw her close friend Zhang Jing sharing photos of a newly opened coffee shop in the group chat, and they agreed to check it out next time.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon break
description: Leaned back on the living room sofa, closed my eyes to rest while listening to the rain and traffic, and let my mind go blank for about half an hour.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Column writing and manuscript revision
description: Core creative time. Write the short essay "Rain Falling on Green Lake" for "Cultural Vision", delicately depicting the outline of the Sleeping Beauty in the Western Hills in the rain and the pedestrians. After finishing, carefully read a prose submission from a college student reader, and give comments on three aspects: rhythm, detail description, and emotional elevation, taking about 40 minutes. Finally, organize the revision suggestions into text and send them to the other party along with the annotated document.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon tea and journal organizing
description: Brew a cup of drip-bag coffee, pair it with flower cakes, and read the chapter about crape myrtle flowers in the essay collection "Seasons of Plants and Trees", marking favorite lines with sticky notes. Then, put the reduced printout of this morning's graphics tablet sketch into the journal along with the insurance screening conclusion and the raindrop photos, using green kimono obi tape to decorate the border, and write today's title: "Growing Inward on a Rainy Day".
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Get ready and walk to the yoga studio.
description: Changed into black yoga pants and a loose cotton-linen top, packed yoga clothes, water bottle, and phone into a canvas bag, and carried a folding umbrella. Walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, holding a transparent umbrella on the rain-freshened streets, observing the roadside greenery washed by rain, and photographed a hedge with hanging water droplets.
location: Walk from No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, along Huashan West Road to No. 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Hatha yoga class
description: The class started on time. Coach He Lu led us in practicing asanas such as Sun Salutation, Tree Pose, and Warrior II, focusing on breathing rhythm and working to stay balanced in Tree Pose. After class, I stayed behind to exchange meditation insights with Coach He Lu. The coach suggested trying to incorporate Ujjayi breathing into meditation to enhance body awareness.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home.
description: After yoga class, the sky cleared and the setting sun's rays peeked through the clouds. Instead of going home, I took a stroll around Cuihu Community, enjoying the after-rain flowers and plants. I crouched by the fence I had photographed before and took a picture of a spiderweb with water droplets.
location: In Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the way from No. 288 Dongfeng West Road back to No. 7 Huashan West Road)

name: Dinner and family time.
description: After arriving home, she had dinner with her parents. Her mother made stir-fried Chinese broccoli, steam-pot chicken, and cucumber salad. She shared her yoga insights and the grateful feedback from college student readers, which delighted her parents; her father rarely praised her for being conscientious. After dinner, she accompanied her parents in the living room to watch the news. Her mother talked about a neighbor lady learning piano, and her father took a work call. Sun Yuwei texted her cousin Shen Wei on her phone to give her an update on the insurance screening progress.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Reading and Journaling
description: Back in the study, she pasted the photo of the spider web taken in the evening into her journal and wrote down her feelings from the walk. Then she continued reading the chapter on time and plants in The Chronicle of Plants, and used her newly learned digital tablet skills to quickly sketch an illustration on the iPad—a leaf and a circle that seemed to breathe.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: Turned off the room light and lay in bed for a 10-minute pre-sleep meditation, trying Ujjayi breathing; the sound of the breath quickly brought calm, and the tension in my shoulders and neck dissolved. After meditation, I opened a collection of essays under the bedside lamp, finished the last piece about 'silence,' and silently noted a sentence that could be used for future writing.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed.
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up and completed the evening skincare routine. Returned to the bedroom, put the books needed for tomorrow into the bag, set the alarm for 6:30, turned off the light and got ready to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up, morning stretching, and preparation
description: Today I woke up three minutes before my alarm. When I stepped on the body fat scale, it showed 46.0 kg, the same as yesterday. When I opened the curtains, sunlight fell on the pothos on the windowsill through the thin early-autumn mist. I spread the yoga mat by the window and did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the tightness from writing last night. While washing up, I remembered Teacher He Lu's advice on Ujjayi breathing and decided to try it. I tied my hair into a fresh ponytail, went to the living room, picked up my phone, and saw a late-night WeChat message from the editor Xu Mingyuan: "Yuwei, there's an urgent article commission. If you see this, get back to me." My heart raced, both nervous and excited.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discussing commissioned article arrangements with the editor.
description: While eating the steamed sweet potato and boiled eggs her mother had left for her, she replied to Xu Mingyuan. It turned out that Traveler magazine had invited her to write a long essay about the “soul of Kunming,” and the pay had been raised to 400 yuan per 1,000 characters. She quickly called Xu Mingyuan, confirmed the theme “Kunming's Clouds, Lakes, and Daily Life,” and promised to submit the manuscript within a week. After hanging up, an excited urge to write surged within her.
location: Dining table in the living room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning: deep writing, insurance screening, and journal organizing
description: After tidying up, she rushed into the study and used a mind map to organize a new essay outline, from the morning light at Green Lake, the hustle and bustle of the old streets, to the shifting clouds and the rhythm of the city, jotting down inspirations as she wrote. During a break, she brewed some Pu-erh tea and opened "The Annals of Plants" to look for Wang Zengqi's memories of Kunming. After a pause in writing, she switched gears to handle insurance matters. She took out the notebook recording five products and used an insurance comparison app to eliminate two based on deductibles, guaranteed renewal terms (preferring 20 years), and out-of-hospital specialty drugs, finally selecting "Chaoyuebao 2020," "Zunxiang eSheng 2021," and "Haoyibao Long-term Medical." She copied the key parameters into her journal, marked the pros and cons, took a photo, and sent it to her cousin Shen Wei for advice. While waiting for a reply, she also organized the insurance parameters page sketch and yesterday's digital tablet pressure-sensitivity curve test sample into her journal, and wrote down her mood: "Efficient and full of anticipation today."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and midday break
description: Mother had already prepared lunch, and the aroma of pork rib soup filled the house. I went into the kitchen to help pick tender vegetable hearts and shared the good news of receiving a well-paid writing commission. Delighted, Mother added a tomato-and-egg dish. At the table, mother and daughter ate and chatted, and her encouraging words warmed my heart. After the meal, I leaned back on the living room sofa and scrolled for writing material on my phone, and agreed to go to the supermarket with Mother in the afternoon. To get some energy, I set a 15-minute alarm and took a nap in the bedroom. After waking, I read two elegant passages from 'The Annals of Plants' and was fully awake.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked with her mother to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket to shop.
description: Put on canvas shoes, slung a canvas bag over her shoulder, and went out with her mother. The afternoon sunlight was gentle, and plane tree leaves were beginning to fall in the street as they chatted. Mother wanted to buy seasoning for braised pork, and she herself planned to buy a bottle of the masking fluid that had been out of stock. At the supermarket, they split up: Mother went to the seasoning section, while she headed straight to the art supplies section and bought Baiyun brand masking fluid. Then she helped her mother choose several stewing spices and picked up two packs of dried purple sweet potatoes on the way. At checkout, her mother insisted on paying, saying it was to celebrate the commissioned article. Carrying the shopping bags, they walked home. Mother had wanted to take a walk in Green Lake Park, but after learning there was a yoga class in the afternoon, she did not insist. After arriving home, she put away the masking fluid and took out her drawing tablet to prepare for the afternoon's study.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Drawing tablet basics and pressure sensitivity test.
description: She turned on the computer and drawing tablet, connected the driver disc according to the bundled tutorial, adjusted the pen pressure sensitivity in the driver panel, and set the two side shortcut buttons to undo and eraser. In Photoshop, she created a new canvas and tried the pencil and round brush presets one by one, feeling how the stroke thickness changed with different pressure. She drew a few curves and triangles, thought it was very interesting, and noted her shortcut questions in her notebook.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stroll through Cuihu Park and afternoon tea at Zhibushi Bookstore
description: After sitting for too long, her eyes felt a bit sore, so she changed into canvas shoes and went alone to Green Lake Park beside the community. There were few tourists in the park, mostly locals taking a stroll nearby. Walking slowly along the lake, she saw large lotus leaves beginning to turn yellow; autumn was deepening. She took a deep breath of the crisp air, and inspiration unfurled with the breeze. After wandering for half an hour, she stopped by Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore on the way. Soft classical music was playing inside, and the owner, Uncle Qin, smiled and nodded at her. She ordered a cup of the signature osmanthus oolong tea, sat by the window, and opened a literary magazine she hadn't finished before, enjoying the peace between writing sessions. When she saw that it was about time, she closed the magazine and said goodbye to Uncle Qin. After returning home, she put away the masking fluid and fruit, changed into yoga clothes, and packed her yoga mat, clean clothes, water bottle, and an energy bar into her sports backpack.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Zhongmou Yoga Studio for a Hatha yoga class and return home
description: Carrying my yoga bag, I walked along familiar streets to the yoga studio, with the evening breeze blowing. On the way I saw an orange cat lying lazily on the steps. The class started on time, with the theme of core and breath. Teacher He Lu led everyone through variations of Plank Pose and Boat Pose; my arms and abdomen felt pleasantly sore. During the relaxation section, I mentioned to her how I tried Ujjayi breathing this morning, and she smiled and affirmed that it can effectively activate the parasympathetic nervous system. After class, I asked a few more detailed questions about shoulder and neck tension during breathing. Then in the rest area, I drank warm water and stretched my arms; the invigorating yoga session swept away my physical fatigue and left my mind especially clear. On the way home, my steps were brisk and I was in a good mood.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Father had already come home, and mother had also prepared dinner — sure enough, there was braised pork belly. At the dinner table, she talked with her parents in detail about the details of the manuscript invitation she received today. Though Father only said 'Mm' once, his eyebrows and eyes were full of smile. After dinner, the family watched local news together for a while and chatted about daily life; the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening watercolor practice: daisies
description: Back in the study, still riding the excitement, she opened her tablet and found a watercolor tutorial for daisies. She applied the masking fluid she had just bought, laid down a light blue and pale yellow base using the wet-on-wet technique as shown in the video, then dipped a small flat brush into the mixed white and light purple paint and dabbed out the petals one by one with the dry overlay method. Though the edges were a bit awkward, the final result was an improvement over yesterday's autumn leaves—at least it looked like a daisy. She wrote in her journal: “Dry overlay for petals plus splatter technique — the effect is pretty good.”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and schedule review
description: Organized a few important things from today into my journal: pasted in photos of the inspiration draft for the commissioned article, a sketch of the parameter page for insurance screening, test samples of the graphics tablet's pressure sensitivity, and a photo of the daisy watercolor painting. Beside them, I wrote down my mood in small characters: "Today was truly an efficient and fulfilling day! Although excited, I feel grounded inside." Finally, I checked tomorrow's schedule, saw "14:00 Driving practice for Subject 2," and silently repeated it to myself.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation, reading, and washing up before sleep
description: To avoid being too excited by the commissioned article to fall asleep, I prepared for bed early. I turned off the main light, leaving only the small bedside lamp, and sat cross-legged on the bed doing 10 minutes of Ujjayi breathing meditation, focusing on my breath to soothe my thoughts. After my heartbeat steadied, my body and mind relaxed. I picked up "The Annals of Plants and Trees" and read two short essays about autumn; the warm familiarity of Kunming in Wang Zengqi's writing was calming, and I didn't put the book down until my eyelids grew heavy. Then I went to the bathroom to wash up and do my skincare routine, applied hand cream, and reminded myself to stay calm during tomorrow's Subject 2 driving practice. At 22:15 sharp I turned off the light and lay down. The commissioned article and the water-print flower from today flashed through my mind, and I fell into a deep sleep with a satisfied smile.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning meditation, washing up, and weighing myself
description: Woken by sunlight at 6:30 in the morning, she first went to the bathroom to weigh herself: 46.1 kg. Then she returned to the bedroom and meditated cross-legged on her yoga mat, trying the Ujjayi breathing technique that He Lu had taught her, feeling the subtle friction of airflow in her throat, and calming her mind for 10 minutes. After meditation, she finished washing up and got ready for the new day.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Ikenobo flower arrangement class
description: He Lu came to the home and taught an Ikenobo-style slanting composition flower arrangement lesson in the small study. She had prepared snow willow branches, lisianthus, a kenzan, and a shallow water tray in advance. She first explained the relationship between the main branch and the guest branches and the aesthetic of negative space, then demonstrated how to insert the snow willow main branch into the kenzan at a 45-degree angle. He Lu then tried inserting the first guest leaf herself. During the lesson, they exchanged insights on breathing techniques; the atmosphere was relaxed, and He Lu left satisfied with the finished arrangement.
location: Small study in the bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and packing gear for the field trip
description: Mother prepared boiled eggs, multigrain porridge, and fermented tofu for breakfast. As they ate, she chatted with her parents about the day's plans. Mother reminded her not to be nervous about driving practice, and her father encouraged her to communicate more. After breakfast, she returned to her room and packed a mirrorless camera, a notebook, a pen, a sketchbook, and a power bank into a canvas bag, then checked that everything was ready.
location: Restaurant at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to Green Lake Park
description: Putting on canvas shoes and slinging on her canvas bag, she walked from home to Green Lake Park. The streets were quiet in the early morning, and the air smelled of damp earth and grass. Along the way, there were only early-rising elderly people and students. As she rotated her wrists, she took in the sounds of the city waking up. About 11 minutes later, she entered the park through the South Gate.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 67 Cuihu South Road

name: Field trip to Green Lake Park
description: At Green Lake Park, she gathered material for the essay "Kunming's Clouds, Lake, and Daily Life." First, she walked around the lake and observed, sketching the manner of elderly men playing chess in the pavilion with her sketchbook. Then she sat on a bench and used her notebook to record the light and shadow as sunlight filtered through the leaves, as well as the fine ripples on the water. She also noticed egrets foraging in the shallows. At 11:00, she strolled along the stone path at Jiulong Pool and saw a middle-aged man writing calligraphy on the ground with a long-handled water brush; the characters evaporated as soon as they were written. She wrote it down as inspiration for the blending of daily life and art, then ended the outing and headed home.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home for lunch.
description: Walked home from Green Lake, buying a cup of freshly ground soy milk at a roadside shop on the way. The proprietress added extra sugar. When she got home, her mother had already made tomato and egg noodles. While eating, she shared the funny story of the uncle writing calligraphy that she had seen in the morning. Her mother listened with relish while using her phone to check the bus route to the driving school for the afternoon.
location: Restaurant at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and driving practice preparation
description: After lunch, she changed into loose sweatpants and a T-shirt, put sunscreen, a water bottle, and tissues into her tote bag, set an alarm, and rested on the bed for half an hour with her eyes closed, reviewing the steps for reversing into a parking space in her mind to build up energy for the afternoon driving practice.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took the bus to the driving school.
description: She left home and took Bus No. 65 to the driving school training ground. There were few people on the bus, so she sat by the window and silently repeated the instructor's reminder about aligning the lower edge of the rearview mirror with the yellow line. About 20 minutes later, she got off at Xuefu Road Intersection Stop and walked to the Tuqiao Driving School training ground.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 152 Xuefu Road

name: First practice session for Subject 2 of the driving test.
description: At the driving school training ground, she practiced reverse parking into the garage under Coach Chen. The coach first explained the three-point-one-line method and the clutch half-engagement feel. On her first attempt, she turned the steering wheel too sharply and crossed the line. After adjusting, she successfully parked on the second try. The coach commented that she had good perception but needed to control the clutch more steadily. She then practiced three more times and gradually found the feel, ending around 14:50.
location: Tuqiao Driving School Training Ground, 152 Xuefu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rush to the yoga studio and buy milk tea
description: After driving practice, she hailed a taxi to the yoga studio. On the way, she made a short stop at Chayan Chayu near Dongfeng West Road, bought two hot taro paste boba milk teas, one for He Lu and one for herself, and arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio in Dechun Commercial Building about 30 minutes later.
location: No. 152 Xuefu Road to Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flow yoga class and headstand practice.
description: At Zhongmou Yoga Studio, she attended He Lu's flow yoga class. Arriving about five minutes late, she quietly set up her mat and joined in. The class linked the warrior sequence, revolved triangle, and extended side-angle stretch. He Lu focused on guiding headstand practice against the wall and corrected each student in turn. After two attempts, Yuwei found the core engagement. After class, she handed He Lu a milk tea and briefly exchanged thoughts on the day's teaching and practice.
location: Large Classroom, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home after class
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, she walked home along Dongfeng West Road in her yoga clothes. The evening breeze was cool. As she walked, she jotted down in her phone's memo app the sensation of engaging her core during the yoga class, planning to use it for her evening journal. It took about 11 minutes to walk to her home on Renmin Middle Road.
location: No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Family dinner
description: When she got home, her mother was stir-frying small pork slices. Her father was already off work, and the family sat around the dining table. She shared the experience of finally getting the feel of driving for the first time. Her father encouraged her to practice more, saying practice makes perfect, and her mother asked if she was tired and put food in her bowl. The dinner atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Restaurant at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Checked and replied to my cousin's insurance suggestion.
description: Back in the bedroom, she opened WeChat and found that her cousin Shen Wei had sent a recommendation in the afternoon for a million-yuan medical insurance, suggesting buying Chaoyuebao 2020 or Zunxiang eSheng 2021 and saying she would explain the terms in detail. She immediately replied with thanks and said she would check the terms soon. Then she scrolled through Xiaohongshu and saved posts about journal layouts and the basics of Ikenobo flower arrangement.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Line practice on the drawing tablet.
description: Opened the laptop and drawing tablet, created a new A4 canvas in Photoshop, chose a round brush to practice curves with varying thickness, imitating curling vine shapes and small flower outlines. Repeatedly adjusted pen pressure sensitivity, striving to make the lines feel alive. Saved eight line-art assets in different styles for use in journal decoration.
location: Small study in the bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidy up the journal and paste in materials
description: Using a glue stick, she pasted photocopies of the Cuihu Lake light-and-shadow photos, a printed group photo from the flower arrangement class, and the driving practice card into her journal. With a Sakura pigment liner, she wrote down today's keywords: gathering inspiration, slanted style, reverse parking, taro boba, headstand, and line practice. She also drew borders with the decorative lines she had been practicing to make the page more complete.
location: Small study in the bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I lay in bed and did a 10-minute body-scan meditation, focusing on relaxing my right leg, which was tense from afternoon driving practice, my waist from sitting too long, and my shoulders and neck, which yoga had loosened. After the meditation, I read an essay in The Annals of Plants and Trees about abandoned urban railway tracks and natural vegetation. It resonated with the observations I made at Green Lake during the day, and I felt deeply satisfied after reading.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Skincare and bedtime
description: Completed basic facial care, applied moisturizer and eye cream, and after turning off the light, recalling the fulfilling day in the darkness—from the morning ikebana outing to the evening writing and organizing—closed her eyes with a sense of satisfaction, ready to sleep.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and stretching.
description: At 7 a.m. the alarm went off. After waking up, I took a few deep breaths in bed, feeling the soft light outside the window. Then I got up and sat on the yoga mat by the window, meditating for 10 minutes cross-legged with eyes closed, focusing on my breath to calm the inexplicable melancholy stirred up by last night's reading of the autumn mountain landscape chapter in The Annals of Plants and Trees. After the meditation, I did simple shoulder, neck, and spine stretches to wake up my body.
location: At the bedroom window of home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wash-up, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: After washing up, she changed into an off-white cotton-linen shirt and dark blue jeans and went to the dining room. Her mother Li Xiulan had prepared breakfast: millet porridge, fermented tofu, and sliced boiled eggs. While drinking the porridge, she told her mother about her plan to go to the old street to gather material for her writing. Her mother asked her to bring back a jar of Jinsha sauce from Zhang's Old Sauce at the entrance to Wenming Street. After breakfast, she returned to the bedroom to check her canvas bag: the voice recorder was fully charged, the notebook and sketchbook were all there, and the newly bought M&G retractable pen wrote smoothly. At the entrance, she wrote the keywords fieldwork notes and organize prose fragments on a sticky note to remind herself of the main task. Finally, she grabbed her keys and folding umbrella, put on her white sneakers, and went out.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bathroom, dining room, bedroom, entrance hall).

name: Commute: heading to Kunming Old Street.
description: She went downstairs and out of the residential complex, walked along Renmin Middle Road for about 8 minutes to the Xiaoximen bus stop, and took a bus heading toward Zhengyifang. There were not many people on the bus; she found a window seat and watched the street scenes outside. After about 15 minutes, she got off at Zhengyifang Station, walked through a few alleys, and stepped onto the flagstone road of Wenming Street, where the old street atmosphere rushed toward her.
location: Along the bus route from Renmin Middle Road (Xiaoximen Bus Stop), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Wenming Street (Zhengyifang Station), Wuhua District.

name: In-depth exploration of Kunming's old streets
description: Walking along Wenming Street, I used my phone to photograph the quiet light and shadow of the old street in the morning. Turning into an old teahouse that had been open for over thirty years, I spent 8 yuan on a cup of gaiwan tea, sat down, observed the elderly people playing chess and chatting at leisure, and quickly took notes of interesting conversational fragments in my notebook. On Qianwang Street, I chatted with a shop owner who was making handmade leather goods and learned about his story of insisting on handmade craftsmanship. Later, at the entrance of an alley, I met an old woman selling tofu pudding. I bought a serving, crouched by the roadside, and talked with her for half an hour, listening to her describe what the street had looked like decades ago and how it had changed, while quietly recording her oral account with a voice recorder.

participant.name: The old grandma selling tofu pudding
participant.relation: An elderly person she happened to meet

location: Old street areas including Wenming Street, Qianwang Street, and Jingxing Street in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch: tasting rice noodles from a time-honored brand
description: After a morning of walking and talking, feeling hungry, I went to the "Jianxinyuan" rice noodle shop on Jingxing Street, known for its traditional flavors. The shop was crowded; I queued up and ordered a signature "braised pork small-pot rice noodles." The steaming noodles had a rich broth and fragrant meat sauce. I ate to my heart's content and casually took photos of the shop front and the rice noodles with my phone as material.
location: Jianxinyuan Rice Noodle Shop, 128 Jingxing Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bought Jinsha sauce for Mom on the way.
description: After eating the rice noodles, she walked back to Wenming Street, turned into a narrow alley, and found the time-honored sauce shop “Zhang's Old Sauce” that her mother had mentioned. The shop was small but filled with the fragrance of sauce. She bought a 500g jar of Jinsha sauce from the owner, packed it in her own eco-friendly cloth bag, and carefully put it into her canvas bag. The owner was talkative and chatted a bit about home-cooking tips.
location: Zhangji Old Sauce Shop, 71 Wenming Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk home and take a short rest
description: Carrying the sauce, she walked about 15 minutes from Wenming Street back to her home in Green Lake Community. Her mother was watching the midday news in the living room. She took the Jinsha sauce out of her canvas bag and handed it to her. Her mother took it, looked at it, and said contentedly, 'This is exactly the flavor.' After drinking a glass of water, she ate a kiwi from the fruit bowl, and briefly shared with her mother the morning's old-street experiences, especially the story of the old woman selling tofu pudding, which her mother enjoyed with great relish.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize the field notes and do initial writing.
description: After a short rest, she went to the study, turned on the computer, connected the voice recorder to the computer, put on headphones, and transcribed the morning conversation with the old lady word for word. Then she took out her sketchbook and notebook to sort and categorize handwritten notes, sketch lines, and photo materials from her phone. Once her thoughts were clear, she created a Word document named "Kunming Old Streets: Oral History and Echoes" and began writing a prose piece, focusing on the afternoon light in the old streets and the old lady selling tofu pudding. Before she knew it, she had written about 800 characters.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Break and relaxation
description: She paused her writing, stood up from the desk, stretched, and loosened her neck and wrists. She picked up her phone to check WeChat messages and saw that editor Xu Mingyuan had shared an article about urban memory in the group; she liked and saved it. On Moments, she liked a travel photo newly shared by her best friend Zhang Jingxin. She didn't see a reply from her cousin Shen Wei about insurance, thought she might still be busy, and decided to remind her again in the evening.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Enjoy journal time.
description: After relaxing, I opened my journal and carefully pasted in today's receipts from the old teahouse and the beautiful hand-drawn old-street map card from the sauce shop using washi tape. Then I opened my sketchbook and, beside the pencil lines of the old houses on Qianwang Street, wrote down the day's weather, the light, and the bird calls I heard. From the old lady's oral account, I distilled a few key words — 'copper-pot tofu pudding,' 'wutong tree shadows,' 'forty years' — and recorded them in the journal.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Accompanying mother: helping in the kitchen and walking around Green Lake
description: Closed my journal and left the study, and saw my mother preparing dinner in the kitchen. I offered to help trim the green beans and talked about the creative block I hit that afternoon regarding “heritage and change.” Mother said offhandedly, “What’s so hard about change? You people nowadays can write whatever you want—how great is that.” After the ingredients were ready, I suggested taking a walk with my mother at nearby Green Lake Park. The two of us walked half a lap around the lake, watching the sunset glow reflected on the water—it was beautiful.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Cuihu Park on Cuihu South Road

name: Family dinner
description: After the walk, she returned home, and her father Sun Mingyuan also came back from work. On the table were home-style dishes such as stir-fried green beans, braised pork ribs, and tomato egg drop soup. The dinner atmosphere was relaxed. She shared amusing stories from the gathering and the small progress of writing 800 words in the afternoon. Her father encouraged her a bit, while her mother offered her opinion but then said, 'It's your pen, so you have the final say,' which made Sun Yuwei realize her mother meant more than she said, and she planned to have a serious talk after dinner.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mother and daughter's in-depth debate and understanding about writing topics
description: After dinner, she cleared the table, washed the dishes, brewed two cups of Pu'er tea, and brought them into the living room. She sat down next to her mother and quietly asked about the remark made during dinner. Her mother put down her knitting and seriously offered a suggestion: although her writing was delicate, she could try taking on weightier subjects, such as serious historical and cultural themes, rather than always writing about the "wind, flowers, snow, and moon" of everyday life. Sun Yuwei insisted that "writing the breath of the city's daily life" is equally valuable and can touch ordinary people more deeply. The mother and daughter each expressed their views, engaging in a candid and intense debate with their own arguments and reading experiences — from scope and influence to the power of empathy and the non-utilitarian nature of signature works. The atmosphere was tense at times, but they always remained respectful. After a deep exchange lasting an hour and a half, her mother's expression softened. After a moment of silence, she said gently but firmly: "Yuwei, Mom just wants you to go higher and farther. But since you are so clear about what you want, I was overthinking. Your pen is your decision; whether you write well or not, your own heart knows." Hearing this, Sun Yuwei felt a surge of warmth throughout her body. She went over and hugged her mother, her eyes moist. Her mother gently patted her back and said: "When you write something good in the future, remember to send it to me first." Sun Yuwei nodded firmly.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Advanced line practice on the drawing tablet.
description: Carrying the emotion of understanding and being understood after the debate, I walked into the study, calmly turned on the computer and drawing tablet, and used practice software to focus on fluent long lines and pressure sensitivity changes under different brush presets. Without deliberately trying to draw anything specific, I focused on controlling the force of my wrist and arm, attempting to draw lines as steady as flowing water. After more than twenty minutes, I began to consciously combine lines, imitating the winding and twisting forms of vines, and saved several satisfactory pressure-sensitivity test materials. After practicing for about an hour, I put the equipment away.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Routine bedtime meditation
description: Despite emotional fluctuations tonight, she still persisted in completing the 10-minute bedtime meditation. Sitting cross-legged on a cushion by the bedroom window, she closed her eyes and used Ujjayi breathing to focus on the sound of inhalation and exhalation. The day's field-gathering scenes, fragments of the argument with her mother, and the present inner calm flowed through her mind like a film. With her breath, she smoothed her thoughts, and her body and mind returned to tranquility.
location: At the bedroom window of home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and writing in my diary
description: After meditation, she lay down on the bed, opened the journal's last page, and quickly wrote down what she had gained from tonight's debate and the emotion she felt after reaching mutual understanding. Then she picked up Annals of Plants, turned to the chapter she had read last night, read a few more pages, and savored the words.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Washing up, skincare, and preparing for sleep
description: After reading, she felt a little sleepy, closed the book, and went to the bathroom to wash up, wash her face, and apply some simple skincare products. She set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and lay in bed. Feeling at ease and content, she reviewed today's events in her mind. A smile crept across her lips, and she thought that tomorrow would be another day of free writing.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and stretching
description: I woke up naturally in the morning sunlight. I did 10 minutes of breathing meditation and 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches in bed, feeling my body gradually fill with energy. Drawing back the curtains, I confirmed it was a clear, crisp autumn day, and my mood brightened.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After washing up, she changed into comfortable loungewear and went into the kitchen. Her mother had already prepared steaming hot rice noodles in a small pot and fresh Yunnan red pears. She sat down and enjoyed the meal while chatting with her mother, mentioning that she planned to focus on writing at home today. Her mother smiled encouragingly and reminded her to buy yogurt at the supermarket.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sign up for the offline writing group
description: After breakfast, she cleared the dishes and chopsticks into the sink and went into the study. She put away The Annals of Plants and Trees and the journal that had been left open last night, turned on her laptop, and checked the drawing tablet connection. Then she opened Douban Events, found the recruitment post for the Ink and Breath writing group, and was deeply drawn to its philosophy of writing as naturally as breathing. She spent about 35 minutes carefully filling out the application form, sincerely expressing her desire to explore the poetry of everyday life in prose. After submitting, the screen showed under review, and she closed the page with anticipation.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning spent immersed in writing.
description: I brewed myself a cup of raw Pu'er tea, set my phone to focus mode, and turned off all notifications that might disturb me. I opened the document "Kunming, Kunming" and started with the morning exercise crowd in Green Lake Park yesterday afternoon, writing smoothly. I linked materials such as the dialect vendor calls of the old woman selling tofu pudding, the sycamore leaf-vein bookmark, and the sound of the old teahouse's wooden door into a temporal thread, writing from the clear early morning to the bustling afternoon. Around 11:45 I finished about 2,500 characters. Feeling in excellent state, I decided to pause and rest.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and family conversation
description: When she heard her mother call her to eat, she saved the document and exited focus mode. Lunch included garlic stir-fried water spinach, tomato scrambled eggs, and freshly baked flower cakes. While eating, she scrolled through social platforms and replied to the compliments and comments that her watercolor daisies had received in the past couple of days. After the meal, she chatted with her father, who had just come home from work, about the cultural program he had been watching recently. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday reading and rest
description: After the meal, leaning on the living room sofa, I browsed "The Annals of Plants and Trees" and read two essays about autumn plants; the writing was elegant. When I finished, my eyes were a bit tired, so I put down the book, closed my eyes, and rested for 20 minutes.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Hit a writing bottleneck in the afternoon
description: The afternoon goal was to conquer the ending of the essay, trying to push the small details of daily life toward a lingering, resonant mood. But I clearly hit a wall and kept cutting and rewriting. I tried ending with an old street at dusk, but always felt my writing lacked power; within an hour, I deleted nearly more than I wrote.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk by Green Lake and video call with best friend
description: She decisively closed her laptop, changed into a light jacket, and walked to Green Lake Park. The sunlight at four in the autumn afternoon fell on the withered yellow lotus leaves, the light and shadow still and calm. As she strolled along the lake, she started a video call with her best friend Wang Xinran, who was far away in Shenzhen, to share how smoothly the morning had gone and the block she hit in the afternoon. Her friend encouraged her, saying, “That's your writing thinking about how to end,” and shared information about a cultural lecture on “urban memory.” After hanging up, she sat on a lakeside bench watching the light, shadows, and passersby, and gradually the outline of an ending emerged.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping
description: With a clear direction for inspiration, she decided to finish her mother's shopping errand first. She walked about 13 minutes from Green Lake Park to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, and following her mother's instructions, picked out two large boxes of yogurt (plain and strawberry) as well as fresh blueberries and kiwifruit. After checking out, she walked home carrying the shopping bags, photographing the light and shadows of the plane trees along the way as materials for her journal.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: After returning home, she put the yogurt and fruit into the refrigerator by category and reported the prices to her mother. Her mother was preparing the clear-broth hot pot base, so she took the initiative to help peel garlic and trim beans. As they worked, they chatted about the afternoon sights by Green Lake and the new inspiration she had gained. The atmosphere was harmonious and cheerful.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: After Father came home from work, dinner was served. The whole family sat around the table enjoying clear-soup hot pot, cooking fresh vegetables and beef slices. During the meal, she shared the day's writing progress and bottlenecks, as well as the moment of inspiration by Green Lake. Her parents both encouraged her not to be anxious. Her mother especially praised the blueberries she had bought, saying they were sweet.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Digital painting practice
description: After a short rest following the meal, I returned to the study, opened the design software, and began digital painting practice. I decided to design a small geometric pink flower. Starting with a basic circle, I patiently adjusted the anchor points and Bézier curves, tried pink gradients repeatedly, and finally outlined a smooth petal shape I was satisfied with. I named the work 'Worry-Relieving Daisy,' exported it as a PNG with a transparent background, and saved it to both my phone and computer as material for future journal stickers, feeling a small sense of accomplishment.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize materials and remind cousin about insurance
description: She exited the design software, opened WeChat, and replied to some friends' messages and the author group chat. Then, remembering something important, she messaged her older female cousin Shen Wei, asking for her thoughts on the three insurance products she had previously sent: "Chaoyuebao 2020", "Zunxiang eHealth 2021", and "Haoyibao Long-term Medical". She thoughtfully reminded her to look over the policy details when she had time on the weekend and to contact her anytime with questions.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and journaling
description: She changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, used a meditation app for a 10-minute bedtime meditation to calm her mind. Then she picked up her journal and wrote down the day's feelings with a fountain pen: finishing most of the first draft, the anticipation of joining the writing group, the healing feeling of the call with her best friend, and the joy of successfully drawing a small geometric flower. She carefully tucked the plane tree leaf bookmark collected yesterday into the journal.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: She closed the notebook, went to wash up and do her skincare routine, and gave a slight smile at the mirror. Back in the bedroom, she checked the calendar on her phone, confirmed that tomorrow, Sunday, had no special plans, noted 'Contact the driving school on Monday' in her memo, and set the alarm for 8:00 the next morning. Feeling satisfied and slightly tired, she turned off the light. The faint sounds of autumn insects drifted in from outside the window, and she gradually fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wake up, meditate, and prepare for the mountain hike.
description: Woke up naturally at six in the morning, did a 10-minute morning meditation, weighed 46.2 kg, changed into a light gray sweatshirt and dark blue hiking pants, checked the soles of my sports shoes, charged my mirrorless camera, put a water bottle, nuts, dried cranberries, a sketchbook, and a pen into my hiking backpack, and wrote in my journal about looking forward to the trip to Xishan.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and preparations to leave.
description: After washing up, she went to the dining room and had breakfast with her mother, Li Xiulan. Her mother had prepared plain congee, fried eggs, and rose-flavored pickled mustard tuber. While eating, she told her mother her plan for the day: hiking in the Western Hills, writing in the afternoon, and driving practice at the driving school. Her mother reminded her to pay attention to safety and sun protection. After eating, she went back to her room, applied sunscreen, put on a sun hat, and left the house at 7:10 on time.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Xishan Forest Park
description: Walked 5 minutes to the bus stop at the east gate of Green Lake, took bus No. 104 to Xishan, and listened to light music by the window while enjoying the weekend morning street scene gradually giving way to fields and distant mountains. After about 50 minutes, got off at the Sujiacun (Xishan Forest Park) stop, then walked about 10 minutes to reach the Maomaoqing trailhead at the foot of Xishan, where the air was fresh.
location: From Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to Xishan District: take Bus No. 104 from Cuihu East Gate Bus Stop to Sujiacun Station, then walk to the Maomaoqing trailhead of Xishan Forest Park.

name: Mountain hiking and photography
description: Starting from the Maomaoqing trailhead, climb along the classic hiking trail while taking photos, using a mirrorless camera to capture details such as spiderwebs, ferns, and Dianchi Lake veiled in mist, experiencing the changes in vegetation with altitude and the layered colors of autumn leaves while enjoying the tranquility of the mountains.
location: Maomaoqing Hiking Trail, Western Hills Scenic Area, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation at Taihua Temple
description: After arriving at Taihua Temple, she found stone steps in a quiet corridor of the temple, sat facing the distant mountains and Dianchi Lake with her eyes closed, and meditated for about 20 minutes. Amid the mountain breeze and birdsong, her mind was at peace.
location: Inside Taihua Temple, Xishan Scenic Area, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Descend the mountain and take a bus for the return trip.
description: After meditation, I went down the mountain along the same route, taking photos as I walked. I picked up a reddish-brown fallen leaf and tucked it into my sketchbook. At about 11:00, I took the No. 104 bus back from the bus stop at the foot of the mountain, and on the bus I worked out my writing ideas.
location: Take bus No. 104 from Xishan Scenic Area, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Wuhua District.

name: Go home to rest and prepare lunch.
description: After getting home, she imported photos from her mirrorless camera to the computer and browsed through her collection. She took a shower and changed into a loose shirt and lounge pants. Then she went to the kitchen to help her mother pick water spinach and peel garlic, and shared photos from the mountain hike.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Had lunch with her mother, who made stir-fried bitter melon, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and winter melon soup. She told her mother about the afternoon's writing and driving school plans, and her mother reminded her to be safe.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and organizing materials
description: After lunch, she napped for half an hour. Waking at 13:20, she opened her computer and created a new document, organizing the 2,500 words she had written earlier and the audio recording from the old street field visit. She also jotted down in her journal a plan to add weekly aerobic exercise and wrote down reflections from her hiking experience.
location: Bedroom and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the first draft of “Kunming, Kunming”
description: Turning off phone notifications and wearing earphones to play white noise, she focused on writing the long essay 'Kunming, Kunming' in her study. Starting from the paragraph she had been stuck on yesterday, she combined inspiration from her walk at Green Lake with the overlook of the Western Hills, weaving together Kunming's clouds, the everyday life of old streets, and climate change. Ideas flowed, and she completed an 8,000-character first draft by 15:50.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Read through and polish the first draft
description: Read through the draft, delete redundant adjectives, adjust paragraph transitions, and ensure emotional coherence. Export the final draft as a PDF, save it to the 'Assignments/Kunming, Kunming' folder, and send it to editor Xu Mingyuan with a note asking him to check and correct.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Went to the driving school to practice for Subject 2.
description: After finishing the manuscript, I felt a great sense of accomplishment. I changed into a white cotton T-shirt and loose pants, took my driver's license and a sun umbrella, and rode a shared bike to Tuqiao Driving School, arriving at 16:58. Coach Li guided me through reverse parking and parallel parking, pointing out that my timing for straightening the wheels was a little late; after more practice, my success rate improved. The coach said I can learn curve driving next week.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Guandu District, Guanshang Subdistrict, Tuqiao Road, Tuqiao Driving School Training Ground

name: Cycling home
description: Rode a shared bike home from the driving school, enjoying the evening breeze on the way. After arriving home, she washed her face, made honey water, and checked her email. To her surprise, she found that editor Xu Mingyuan had replied, praising the quality of the first draft.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan was off duty, and the family of three had a weekend dinner together. They shared three good things from the day: climbing Western Hills to enjoy the view, completing the commissioned article, and making progress in driving practice. Father praised her efficiency, and Mother helped put food on her plate.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Designing cloud stickers with a graphics tablet
description: In the study, I used Illustrator to design a cloud sticker: I used the ellipse tool to create a fluffy shape, the pen tool to draw a flowing tail, added a drop shadow, exported it as a transparent-background PNG, and did a layout exercise. The result was cute.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and reading
description: Opened the TN journal, taped in the fallen leaves picked on Xishan, and recorded insights from eight consecutive days of meditation: falling asleep faster and anxiety reduced. I decided to keep going. Then I read the chapter about Xishan's endemic plants and climate in 'The Spring and Autumn of Plants'.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening bookstore exploration and exchange.
description: She walked to Zhibushi Bookstore, found a new book on Yunnan traditional handicrafts, and flipped through it. She shared the day's achievement with the bookstore owner, Uncle Qin, who offered his congratulations. Before leaving, she bought an indie folk CD.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, meditation, and sleep
description: After returning home, I washed up and did my skincare routine, changed into pajamas, lay down at 22:00 for a 10-minute bedtime meditation, and reviewed the day's sense of accomplishment and relaxation. Then I turned off the light and went to sleep, feeling grounded and at peace.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and weigh-in
description: Morning sunlight brightened the bedroom. Sun Yuwei woke up naturally but did not get out of bed immediately. Instead, she did her ninth consecutive day of morning meditation, focusing on her breath and feeling her body relax. After the meditation, she stepped onto the scale, recorded her weight as 46.2 kg, and felt calm and content.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wash up, tidy up, and have breakfast
description: After meditating, Sun Yuwei washed up and changed into a comfortable cotton-linen long dress. In the dining room, her mother Li Xiulan had prepared a hearty breakfast—small-pot rice noodles with soft-boiled eggs and a few pieces of ham mooncake. The mother and daughter chatted over the meal, and her mother encouraged her to focus on her writing plans without worry. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Submitting the essay and receiving a writing fee and praise.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the study and sent the carefully polished essay "Kunming, Kunming" to editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat. About 20 minutes later, Xu Mingyuan replied with a long message highly praising the piece, saying it was "full of emotion and captured the soul of Kunming precisely," and transferred 3,200 yuan as payment. Sun Yuwei jumped up excitedly and immediately expressed her gratitude.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Sun Yuwei took her phone and a small shoulder bag and stepped out briskly. She walked along Renmin Middle Road toward Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. Passing by Green Lake Park, she saw elderly people doing morning exercise. The early autumn sunlight filtered through the plane tree leaves and filled the road. She was immersed in the joy of having her manuscript accepted.
location: While walking from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Zhibushi Bookstore

name: Discuss the publication plan for the essay collection with Qin Mingyuan.
description: At Zhibushi Bookstore, Sun Yuwei excitedly shared the news of her manuscript payment with the owner, Qin Mingyuan. They then talked about the publication plan for the essay collection Notes on Slow Walking. Qin Mingyuan suggested she give priority to Yunnan People's Publishing House and offered to introduce an editor surnamed Liu, saying he was good at discovering local essay writers. Sun Yuwei carefully noted the suggestion and thanked him.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Browsed and bought new books at the bookstore
description: After the discussion, Sun Yuwei browsed leisurely in the bookstore and was drawn to a book titled Reflections on the Southwest Associated University. Flipping through it, she found the writing excellent and bought it, planning to use it as reading material for tomorrow.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home and arranged to celebrate with close friends in the evening
description: Sun Yuwei walked home along the same route, holding her newly purchased book with great satisfaction. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to her best friend Liu Jia: 'The payment came through! Let's hit up "Drunk Turtle" tonight!' Liu Jia instantly replied with an OK emoji, and they agreed to go listen to live music together in the evening.
location: On the walk back from Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore to home on Renmin Middle Road

name: Create a publisher submission list and draft an outline.
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei created a new document in her study, listing five preferred publishers: Yunnan People's Publishing House, Guangxi Normal University Press, Shanghai Literature and Art Publishing House, Jiangsu Phoenix Literature and Art Publishing House, and Thinkingdom Media. She also noted publishing cases of similar styles. She began drafting an email to Editor Liu at Yunnan People's Publishing House, and at the same time wrote the core outline for the proposal for "Slow Travel Notes," planning to submit within the week.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Share the good news with my parents over lunch
description: At lunch, Sun Yuwei officially announced the news of her manuscript fee and her plan to publish a collection of essays to her parents. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, gave rare praise and told her to calm down and write well; her mother, Li Xiulan, kept adding food to her bowl, proud of her. The family of three enjoyed home-style dishes such as spicy beef, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato egg soup, in a warm and happy atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and contacting the driving school instructor
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei returned to her bedroom, set a half-hour alarm, and prepared to take a nap. Before lying down, she remembered getting her driver's license and sent Coach Yang at the driving school a WeChat message asking about next week's practice and the S-curve driving lesson arrangement. After sending the message, she closed her eyes and rested peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and digital painting practice
description: After waking from her lunch break, Sun Yuwei first took out her beloved journal, decorated it with plaid tape and the fallen leaves she had brought back from Xishan yesterday, and carefully recorded the important experience of receiving her manuscript payment and launching the publication plan. Then she turned on her drawing tablet and practiced digital painting: she created a new canvas, designed a text box with rounded corners, and tried double-layer borders, dashed-line decorations, and folded-corner elements, adjusting repeatedly until she was satisfied. Midway through, she brewed herself some green tea and ate two flower cakes made by her mother, enjoying a quiet creative time.
location: Home study and work area, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Get changed and prepare for the evening out
description: At 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei put down her digital stylus and got ready for the evening's livehouse event. She changed into a dark blue denim skirt and white canvas shoes, put her phone, power bank, and lipstick into a small crossbody bag, gave herself a quick tidy-up in the mirror, and prepared to go out.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Leave early to go for a walk at Green Lake Park
description: Since there was still time before the agreed meeting time, Sun Yuwei first walked to Green Lake Park. The evening sunlight was soft, rowboats dotted the lake, and water birds moved leisurely. She strolled slowly along the lakeside, absorbing the relaxed atmosphere of the residents, and took a photo of the mid-lake pavilion at sunset to post in her Moments with the caption: “Good weather, good mood.”
location: Cuihu Park, Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having dinner at the 'Xiangzili' snack shop
description: After leaving Green Lake, Sun Yuwei went to the 'In the Alley' snack shop near Drunken Turtle Livehouse. She ordered a steaming bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles and a serving of fried potatoes, ate contentedly, and used the simple dinner to recharge for the evening's performance.
location: The "In the Alley" snack shop, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waiting for Liu Jia at the entrance to Drunk Turtle
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei arrived at the entrance of Zui Gui Livehouse and sat on the steps, flipping through her newly bought book "Reflections on the National Southwestern Associated University" while waiting for her best friend Liu Jia. The evening breeze was gentle, and the aroma of snacks filled the street; she felt relaxed and at ease.
location: At the entrance of Zuigui Livehouse, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watching a live performance by the 'Shanren' band with Liu Jia
description: Liu Jia arrived on time. After hugging, they entered together after ticket check. Inside the Livehouse, the lighting was dim, and the local folk band ‘Shanren’ was doing a soundcheck. They found a corner spot and each ordered lemonade. When the music started, the lead singer’s raspy, passionate voice told stories of Yunnan’s mountain wilderness. Sun Yuwei swayed gently to the rhythm, occasionally whispering with Liu Jia, enjoying the night of freedom in the music.
location: Inside the Zui Gui Livehouse, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walked home after the performance ended.
description: After the performance, Sun Yuwei said goodbye to Liu Jia at the entrance and agreed to meet again when there was another good show. As the night in Kunming turned cool, she wrapped her coat tighter and slowly walked home along the street under the streetlights, the melody still echoing in her mind.
location: The streets along the walk back from Drunk Turtle Livehouse on Cuihu South Road to her home on Renmin Middle Road.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
