description: After getting home, Sun Yuwei took a hot shower to wash away her fatigue and the excitement of watching the performance. She changed into comfortable pajamas, poured a glass of warm water, and drank it slowly with the cup in her hands, letting her body and mind gradually calm down.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Before-bed meditation and journal catch-up
description: Sun Yuwei sat on the cushion by the bed and did a 10-minute bedtime meditation, focusing on her breath, letting the day's joy and excitement settle, and feeling inner calm. After meditating, she opened her journal, added her feelings about the evening's performance, and drew a simple musical note as a memento.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Before bed, read Reflections on the National Southwestern Associated University and turned off the light to sleep.
description: Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard, opened her newly purchased "Reflections on the Southwest Associated University" and read a chapter. The writing was plain yet powerful, making her look forward to tomorrow's reading. At 23:45, she turned off the light on time and fell asleep feeling fulfilled and happy.
location: At home, on the bed, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine and family breakfast
description: Woken by sunlight at 6:50 a.m., I felt refreshed. The scale showed 46.2kg, the same as yesterday. I opened the curtains to confirm the weather was clear; the rose buds on the balcony were holding morning dew. Then I did my 10th morning meditation on the yoga mat in the bedroom, focusing on Ujjayi breathing, followed by neck and shoulder stretches. Next, I went to the balcony workbench, changed into loose clothes, and practiced flower arrangement using the dried branches, purple gentians, and small chrysanthemums bought at Dounan Flower Market the day before yesterday, following my Ikenobo school notes. I repeatedly adjusted the tilt angle of the dried branches so that the lines of the gentians echoed the main branch beautifully. After about half an hour, I achieved a satisfying composition, recorded it with my phone, and cleaned the workbench. After washing up, I had breakfast with my parents. Mom made small-pot rice noodles. I shared my flower arrangement insights and mentioned the plan for the afternoon yoga class and an evening walk to Green Lake. Dad nodded in agreement, and Mom reminded me to eat lunch on time.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Insurance Research and Travel Plans
description: Sitting at the desk at home, she opened her journal and iPad and focused intently on comparing three million-yuan medical insurance products from ZhongAn, Ping An, and PICC. Using highlighters in three colors, she listed the product names horizontally across the journal page and compared in detail vertically: coverage items, deductibles, maximum coverage limits, renewal terms, and annual premiums. When she came across unfamiliar terms like 'proton and heavy-ion therapy,' she took screenshots and saved them in iPad Notes. At the bottom of the table she wrote a note: 'Choose a 10,000 yuan deductible? Pay special attention to renewal terms.' Then she sent a WeChat message to Coach Yang at Tuqiao Driving School to confirm the arrangement for practicing Curve Driving (Subject Two) next Monday afternoon, and messaged her yoga partner He Lu to confirm meeting at the yoga studio at 1:30 p.m. and ask if she was free after class to go to the newly opened vegetarian restaurant nearby. He Lu quickly replied that it was no problem.
location: At the desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Browse Zhibushi Bookstore and return home
description: Walking to her usual Zhibushi Bookstore, she met the owner, Qin Mingyuan. They talked about the essay that had been highly praised by the editor the day before and her plan to publish it as a collection. Uncle Qin suggested that she first send him the revised draft of the essay 'Kunming, Kunming' and then discuss where to submit. In the bookstore, she leafed through a newly arrived book called 'The Taste of Plants', felt the writing style suited her, and bought it as a reference for future submissions. On her way home carrying the new book, sunlight cast mottled shadows through the plane tree leaves. In a good mood, she stopped and used her phone to take a photo of blue sage blooming in a roadside flower bed, intending to use it as material for today's journal.
location: Paper & Stone Bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and along the route from Cuihu North Road to Cuihu Community at No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Lunch and lunch break.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Changing clothes and going to the yoga studio
description: She changed into a navy blue yoga tank top and black leggings, put her yoga mat into her backpack, checked her water bottle and towel, confirmed He Lu's reply on her phone once more, and left the house in a relaxed mood. She walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, and as she passed Green Lake Park, she deliberately glanced at the wild ducks floating on the lake, feeling the gentle September breeze of Kunming and thinking how pleasant life was.
location: On the way from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Dechun Commercial Building, 4th Floor, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road.

name: Flow Yoga Class
description: Attended a flow yoga class with He Lu at Zhongmou Yoga Studio. Guided by the instructor, she and He Lu started with Sun Salutations and gradually moved into standing poses, with the main focus on the preparatory pose for shoulderstand (Ardha Sarvangasana). Her core control was stable, and with the instructor's assistance she found a more correct position. After class, she chatted with He Lu in the rest area and shared her experience of adding Ujjayi breath to meditation. He Lu affirmed her progress, and they agreed to go to a vegetarian restaurant together after class.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-class tea break and discussion
description: I walked with He Lu to Yiwei Vegetarian Restaurant, not far from the yoga studio. Each of us ordered a cup of roselle tea, and we talked about the manuscript payment I received yesterday and my publishing plans. He Lu was happy for me and encouraged me to try writing some essays about yoga and inner exploration. After chatting for about twenty minutes, seeing that it was about time, I took my leave and went home.
location: Yiwei Vegetarian Restaurant near Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and collecting material
description: After getting home, she changed out of her yoga clothes, washed her face, sat on the bay window in the study, and opened the newly bought “The Taste of Grass and Trees” and the “Reflections on the Southwest Associated University” she was currently reading, alternating between them. In her journal, she copied a passage about “free thought” from “Reflections on the Southwest Associated University” as accumulated material for her essay collection.
location: Bay window in the home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Help prepare dinner.
description: At exactly five o'clock in the afternoon, I went to the kitchen to help my mother prepare dinner. I was responsible for washing green peppers and peeling garlic, while my mother skillfully shredded the potatoes. The two of us chatted casually, and I shared how it felt to try new yoga poses in class.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and cleanup
description: The three of us sat around the dinner table. I gave a detailed report on the results of the medical insurance comparison I had researched that afternoon. Dad listened carefully, occasionally asking questions about "deductibles" and "renewal", and praised his daughter's clearly organized table. Mom reminded me not to get too tired and to take care of my health. After dinner, I cleared the dishes and put them in the dishwasher, and Mom wiped down the dining table.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanying parents for a walk at Cuihu Lake and returning home.
description: The family of three went out and strolled slowly along the lakeside path around Green Lake Park. The evening breeze was cool, an old man was playing the saxophone, and the lake surface glistened. I talked about my afternoon conversation with He Lu, and my parents also shared their health and exercise habits from when they were young. The whole family chatted while walking and felt relaxed. After the walk, they walked home together and, on the way, bought a bottle of yogurt at the convenience store at the entrance to the community.
location: The lakeside trail of Green Lake Park at No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the route back to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Design petal vector stickers
description: Opened the laptop and Illustrator, used the phone to view the rose photos taken on the balcony this morning as reference, used the Pen tool to patiently outline the five-petal flower, adjusting the Bézier curves of each petal bit by bit to make the shape softer and more natural, then filled the petals with a pink-white gradient and represented the stamens with a ring of bolded small dots. After finishing a single flower, I duplicated and rotated it to create a symmetrical four-flower version, and finally exported it as PNG in a folder named "Journal Materials_0926."
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, in front of the computer at the desk.

name: Making journal pages
description: I took out my beloved journal, used stickers to paste in the sample photos from this morning's flower-arranging practice, the bookstore receipt, and a copy of the medical insurance comparison page, painted the gorgeous sunset I saw while walking by Cuihu Lake with watercolor pens, and used a fountain pen to record today's key items: flower arrangement insights, yoga reflections, the conclusions drawn from the insurance comparison notes, and Uncle Qin's valuable advice on the essay collection.
location: At the desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: Lit the lavender essential oil diffuser on the desk, unrolled the yoga mat, opened the 10-minute nighttime meditation guide in the Tide app, sat down cross-legged, and focused on breathing. Then did some simple pre-sleep stretches to relax the neck and shoulders, which had been used a lot today.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Night reading and going to sleep
description: I lay down on the bed and leafed through a few pages of Reflections on the National Southwestern Associated University. Immersed in the stories of those great masters, I felt very much at peace. When I felt a little drowsy, I closed the book, turned off the desk lamp, and slowly fell asleep in contentment and calm.
location: At home, on the bed, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning meditation and preparation
description: Woken by the sunlight at 7:30 in the morning, she got out of bed barefoot and weighed herself: 46.1 kg, a little lighter than yesterday. She poured a glass of warm water, sat down on a cushion by the bay window, closed her eyes and did a morning meditation. Things like buying insurance, practicing driving, and telling her parents surfaced in her mind, and she gradually calmed her thoughts with ten minutes of breathing. After meditation, she got up, washed up, checked her computer and insurance documents, put The Taste of Plants and Trees into her bag, and prepared for the morning's tasks.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Walking into the living room, her mother had already cooked millet porridge, fried eggs, and pickled radish peel. While eating, she told her mother that she would go to the driving school to practice in the afternoon, and her mother reminded her to be careful and drink more water. She mentioned the new journal stickers she had made last night, and her mother suggested printing them out and putting them on the refrigerator as decoration. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Purchase a million-yuan medical insurance online.
description: She brought her computer and notes to the study and re-checked the three products from Ping An, ZhongAn, and PICC. In the end, she chose the one with an annual premium of 298 yuan, favorable renewal conditions, and a reasonable deductible. She carefully filled in the health disclosure, confirmed there were no abnormalities, and completed the payment. She immediately received the successful enrollment text message and the electronic policy. As planned, she printed the policy PDF, folded it, and tucked it into the transparent pocket of her planner.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing journal materials and reading time
description: She spread out the journal, pasted in the insurance policy voucher page, and wrote “Coverage Activated” and the day's date beside it with a rollerball pen. Then she opened The Taste of Plants and continued reading the chapter about Yunnan mushrooms. When she came across interesting passages, she used a pencil to jot down momentary thoughts beside the text. Occasionally drawn by birdsong outside the window, she savored the peaceful time of sunlight dancing on the pages.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch, casual family conversation, and midday rest.
description: Closing the book, I helped my mother bring out braised potatoes and garlic lettuce. During lunch we talked about the insurance matter from the morning; although my mother didn’t understand the details of the electronic policy, she felt reassured once she saw the procedure was formal, saying, “It’s good to spend money for peace of mind.” I also shared the passage about mushrooms from The Taste of Plants and Trees, which made my mother say she wanted to go to the market on the weekend to buy “blue-staining mushrooms.” After the meal, I helped clear the dishes, spent fifteen minutes recording my thoughts from the book on a new page of my journal as essay material, and then took a short nap on the sofa for about half an hour.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to the driving school to practice driving and returned to the metro station
description: She changed into sports pants and a T-shirt, walked to the Huashan West Road bus stop by Green Lake, took bus No. 100 toward Wuhua District, and got off about 25 minutes later at a stop near Yunnan Yitong Driving School. After arriving, Coach Yang guided her to continue practicing Subject 2 reverse parking. She adjusted the steering wheel again and again and controlled the clutch to find reference points until her arms ached, but two perfect parking attempts in a row earned the coach's praise: 'You've improved. You should have no problem practicing curve driving next week.' Her confidence soared. After practice, she thanked the coach and took bus No. 84 from the school gate to the Wuhua Sports Stadium station subway entrance.
location: Yunnan Yitong Driving School (Wuhua District First Training Ground), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the commute route along the way

name: Sit briefly at a milk tea shop and head back home.
description: Took the subway from the station to Chenggong District and arrived at Huaqianfang Commercial Street about 40 minutes later. Remembering He Lu had invited me for milk tea, I went to Cha Qianyan, ordered a cup of the signature 'Meizhan Yaohong' and sat by the window. I took out 'The Taste of Grass and Trees' to read and used my phone's memo app to record notes on the afternoon's driving practice. After sitting for about 30 minutes, I took the subway back to Huashan West Road Station and walked home.
location: Building 26, Huaqianfang Commercial Street, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province: Chaqianyan (Huaqianfang Store), and the return trip.

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner
description: After arriving home, I changed into loungewear and went to the kitchen to help my mother wash vegetables and cut scallions, chatting about being praised during the afternoon's driving practice. After my father got off work, the family sat around the dining table. Dinner was pork rib and lotus root soup and stir-fried baby bok choy. At the table, I seriously told my parents that I had bought a million-yuan medical insurance policy, costing about 300 yuan a year. My father nodded and said, "It's good for young people to have protection; spend a little to guard against great risks." My mother smiled and picked up some ribs for me, telling me to take care of my health and not stay up too late. The atmosphere was steady and warm.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-dinner walk at Green Lake
description: After dinner, I went for a walk with my mother around Green Lake to aid digestion. A gentle evening breeze was blowing, and quite a few people were walking their dogs and strolling. The mother and daughter walked side by side at a slow pace, chatting about amusing family matters. I used my phone to photograph the sunset by the lake, planning to stick the photos in my journal when I got home. Half an hour later, we walked home.
location: Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling, watercolor, and nighttime reading notes.
description: Back in the study, on the health management page of her journal, she drew a small shield pattern with a watercolor pen and wrote the inscription: "Protection activated, 2025.9.17 — an adult's sense of security." Then she pasted the sunset photos and the milk tea shop receipt onto the diary page and decorated them with new leaves drawn using a green highlighter pen. Afterwards, she leaned on the cushion on the bay window and continued reading "The Taste of Plants," moved by an essay titled "Herbs in the Kitchen." She opened her computer, created a new document titled "Little Joys in Flavor" in her essay material library, and wrote two hundred characters recording her feelings.
location: Home study and bedroom bay window, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and preparing for sleep
description: Turning off the main light and leaving the night light on, she spread out her yoga mat on the bedroom floor and sat cross-legged for a ten-minute mindfulness meditation. She reviewed the day from the finger taps of purchasing insurance in the morning to straightening the steering wheel while reversing into the garage in the afternoon, and then to the pen tip touching her journal in the evening, feeling a grounded inner calm. After the meditation, she washed up briefly, did her skincare routine, and changed into pajamas. She checked her phone; He Lu had posted the new yoga class schedule in the group chat, and she replied with a “Got it” emoji. After confirming everything was fine, she turned off the light and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up, stretching, and meditation
description: Waking up in the cool morning light, she didn't immediately pick up her phone. Barefoot on the wooden floor, she did five minutes of simple stretches to wake up her body, then sat cross-legged on the balcony facing southeast and meditated for ten minutes, focusing on her breath. She completed the meditation that had been interrupted by chatting the night before, quieting her mind.
location: Bedroom and balcony of the home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning ikebana practice: Ikenobo upright style
description: In the morning light, she spread a water-absorbing felt pad on the balcony workbench, took out the kenzan and water basin, chose a winding pine branch as the main branch, trimmed it, and inserted it into the kenzan at a 45-degree angle. Then she inserted three pure white daisies at different heights as guest branches, deliberately leaving blank space, feeling the tranquility of "a flower is a world."
location: Workstation on the balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoying a Yunnan-style breakfast with my mother
description: Walking into the living room, her mother had prepared breakfast: a steaming small-pot rice noodle soup with chicken broth, served with sour pickled vegetables and fermented bean curd. The mother and daughter chatted as they ate. Yuwei mentioned wanting to create an autumn-themed flower arrangement for Aunt Xie. Her mother chuckled and said, “With your skills, Aunt Xie is sure to love it,” and suggested using maple leaves and dried lotus seed pods as accents.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Create the autumn-themed floral art piece "Sound of Autumn"
description: After breakfast she returned to the balcony. Using dead branches, yellow chrysanthemums, red maple leaves, and purple gentians, and following the Ikenobo school's slanting composition, she used the dead branch as the main stem, chrysanthemums as the primary flower, and maple leaves and gentians as the accent branches. She pruned and adjusted the angles repeatedly, and finally completed a work named "Autumn Sound." She photographed it for the archive, changed the water, and prepared to give it to Aunt Xie that evening.
location: Workstation on the balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing for the essay collection Slow Travel Notes
description: The satisfaction brought by flower arranging made her ideas flow. She opened her laptop and wrote a passage about "neighborhood warmth" for her essay collection "Slow Travel Notes." Using this morning's flower arrangement and Aunt Xie's pickled vegetables as a starting point, she recalled the aroma of home-cooked meals in childhood alleys and the greetings from neighbors, writing nearly a thousand words in one go.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Exchange creative insights online with Wen Zi
description: Taking a break from writing, she picked up her phone and sent a message to Wenzi to ask about last night's workshop. Wenzi shared practical tips on "capturing details in nonfiction writing," and the two discussed how to give ordinary little things depth in writing. Yuwei also sent over the photo "Autumn Sound." Wenzi praised the color palette as having the beauty of a Song Dynasty painting, and they agreed to do an online creative session together next time.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and reading “Plants in the Human World”
description: Lunch was simple chicken soup rice noodles. After eating, she paced in the living room to aid digestion, then curled up on the sofa and opened Wang Zengqi's 'The Grass and Trees of the Human World.' Reading 'Grape Month by Month,' she smiled knowingly at the seasonal sense and life texture in the words, thinking that when Aunt Xie arrived later, she could start with Wang Zengqi and talk about Kunming's scenery and customs.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and preparation for yoga class
description: She spent some time on her phone dealing with emails and took a nap of about 20 minutes. After waking up, she changed into yoga clothes, packed her yoga mat, water bottle, and towel into her backpack, and organized the flower arrangement photos on her phone into a separate album to share with Lulu after class.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cycle to Zhongmou Yoga Studio
description: Left on time. I rode a shared bicycle south along Huashan West Road, passing Renmin Middle Road, for about 1.5 kilometers. The warm autumn sunshine and gentle breeze cheered me up.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Core strengthening and headstand yoga class and post-class discussion.
description: Arrived early, changed clothes, and attended Teacher He Lu's Core Strengthening and Headstand Preparation class. The classroom was filled with a soothing essential-oil aroma. From the Cat-Cow warm-up to core-activating poses like Plank and Boat, I stabilized against the wall for 30 seconds during the headstand preparation segment, and my shoulder, back, and core strength improved noticeably. After class, I sat with Lulu in the rest area and shared the 'Autumn Sounds' photos. Lulu suggested adding some moss to enhance the natural feel, and the two of us agreed to go to Dounan Flower Market together to pick floral materials.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket for supplies and walked home
description: After saying goodbye to Lulu, she walked about 8 minutes to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, bought the barley tea Auntie Xie likes and the Shine Muscat grapes her parents love. After paying, she carried the bags north along Fuchun Street, turned onto Huashan West Road, and walked about 13 minutes home.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Tidy up the living room to welcome Aunt Xie
description: After returning home, she put the barley tea in the refrigerator to chill, placed the artwork “Autumn Sounds” in the most prominent spot on the coffee table and adjusted its angle, wiped the coffee table with a damp cloth, and tidied the books and blankets on the sofa, making the living room neat and cozy.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Aunt Xie came to visit: sharing pickled vegetables and flower arranging, and chatting freely about literature and old times.
description: Auntie Xie came by with a bowl of fragrant pickled dried radish, and Yuwei happily took it and complimented her skill. Then she brought out "Autumn Sound," and Auntie Xie's eyes lit up as she said repeatedly, "This is even nicer than what you can buy—you're so thoughtful!" Yuwei invited her to sit down and poured iced barley tea. During the conversation, Auntie Xie noticed the column article on the coffee table and remarked on its delicate writing, revealing that she used to like writing in her youth and had submitted pieces to local newspapers. Yuwei was delighted, took out "The Grass and Trees of the Human World" to share with her, and the two chatted about everything from Wang Zengqi's writing style to the changes on Kunming's old streets, and from old teahouses to the demolished old houses on Wenming Street. The more they talked, the more they hit it off. When it was time to leave, Auntie Xie held Yuwei's hand and said, "Xiaowei, drop by my house whenever you're free—I'd like to read your articles too."
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: After seeing Aunt Xie off, mother had already prepared dinner. Thanks to Aunt Xie's pickled dried radish, there was an extra appetizing dish. Yuwei told her parents the "secret" that Aunt Xie also loved writing when she was young. The family of three chatted while eating, and the atmosphere was harmonious. Mother tasted the dried radish and couldn't praise it enough.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family TV time: watching National Treasure.
description: Watched the CCTV program National Treasure with my parents. This episode introduced the top treasure of the Yunnan Museum. The whole family watched with great interest. Yuwei also had a brief discussion with her father about the 'intangible cultural heritage' mentioned in the show, and her father praised her for having grown in knowledge.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: AI-created moon phase sticker design
description: Back in the room, opened the laptop, and used Midjourney to enter prompts and generate a moon-phase sticker series. After several rounds of adjustments, I generated eight moon phases from new moon to full moon. I was very satisfied with the layering of the “cloud-veiled moon” piece, so I downloaded the vector image and backed it up to an external hard drive for archiving.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling a warm day.
description: She took out her A5 ring-bound journal, used a dark green fountain pen to sketch the outline of the 'Autumn Sound' flower arrangement with simple line drawings, pasted in the warm-toned photos from the yoga studio, and wrote: 'The in-depth conversation with Aunt Xie was the biggest surprise of the day; a kindred spirit in literature is right beside me. Pickled vegetables and floral art are the gentlest connection of autumn.' She carefully recorded the day's emotions, insights on flower arrangement, and yoga reflections.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, meditation, and falling asleep
description: After washing up and doing skincare, I changed into cotton pajamas, wrote tomorrow's plan outline on a sticky note, and stuck it under the desk lamp. I lit a lavender candle and meditated for 10 minutes, feeling the warmth of the day. After meditation, I blew out the candle, lay down, and leafed through The Grass and Trees of the Human World. After reading two or three pages, I grew sleepy, turned off the lamp, and fell into a peaceful sleep amid the autumn night's insect sounds.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretching, meditation, and breakfast
description: In the early morning, woke up to the soft music of the phone alarm, did a few minutes of simple stretching on the bedroom floor to wake up the body; then meditated for 10 minutes on a cushion on the balcony, feeling the slight autumn chill and the aroma of breakfast from downstairs. Afterward, had breakfast with mother Li Xiulan, having milk, whole wheat bread, and boiled eggs. While eating, they discussed today's plan: go to Aunt Xie's house in the morning and the driving school in the afternoon. After the meal, put a blank journal and a pen into the canvas bag.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visited Aunt Xie to read the manuscript together
description: Walked from home to Aunt Xie Xiulan's home across the hallway. We sat together on the old sofa in her living room and flipped through yellowed manuscript notebooks. Aunt Xie shared passages she had written in her youth describing Green Lake, Dianchi Lake, and other places. We discussed them in low voices and copied three of the most vivid sentences into my journal. We also exchanged thoughts on Pascal's quote, 'Man is a thinking reed,' and spent a fulfilling literary time together.
location: Xie Xiulan's home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to rest and having family lunch.
description: Returned home from Aunt Xie's house, rested briefly, drank some water, and read a few pages of Human World, Grass and Trees. Then her mother prepared shredded pork with green peppers, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and clear soup, and the family of three had lunch together. During the meal, Sun Yuwei shared excerpts of old Kunming manuscripts she had seen at Aunt Xie's house, and her father Sun Mingyuan added old stories about the related streets. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap
description: To recharge for the afternoon driving practice, I went back to the bedroom, set an alarm, and took a nap of about 40 minutes. After getting up, I washed my face with cold water, tidied my clothes, and got ready to go out to the driving school.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cycle to the driving school
description: After changing into sports shoes and putting on her cross-body bag, she scanned the QR code at the entrance of her home to rent a shared e-bike and rode along Huashan West Road and Renmin West Road toward Yunnan Yitong Driving School, in the direction of Fanjiaying. Along the way, she wore earphones and played a podcast called "Using Fragmented Time to Record Life." The ride took about 25 minutes.
location: Route from Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Fanjiaying

name: Practicing curve driving at driving school
description: Practiced curve driving with Coach Li at the Yunnan Yitong Driving School training ground. The coach emphasized techniques for controlling the steering wheel and looking at reference points. After repeated practice, speed control improved significantly, and she barely touched the line. Despite sore shoulders, she felt she had made progress and was more confident about passing the exam.
location: Yunnan Yitong Driving School (Wuhua District No. 1 Training Ground), No. 200 Fanjiaying, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bus commute and milk tea refill
description: Walked from the driving school to the Puji Road South Entrance bus stop, took the bus to Zhengyifang Station, then walked to the Tea Talk milk tea shop on Wenming Street and bought a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea as a little happiness after driving practice. It took about 45 minutes in total, including waiting for the bus and making the milk tea.
location: Chayan Milk Tea Shop on Wenming Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and places along the way

name: Book hunting and reading at the Paper, Cloth, and Stone Bookstore
description: Carrying milk tea, she walked into Zhibushi Bookstore on North Green Lake Road and nodded to the owner, Uncle Qin. She leafed through the latest literary magazines Harvest and People's Literature, and in the used-book section found a 1998 edition of Selected Essays of Wang Zengqi. She sat by the window in a corner, sipping milk tea and reading until the sunset became soft. Before she left, Uncle Qin recommended a new poetry collection by a local poet.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home while shopping along the way
description: Walked home from the bookstore along Green Lake North Road and Wenlin Street. On the way, I passed a stationery store, went in and bought two new liner pens, preparing for the evening's watercolor and journaling. The autumn evening street view was pleasant, and I felt the city's slow pace.
location: A stationery store on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the route along the way.

name: Helping in the kitchen and family dinner
description: Returned home, changed into loungewear, and prepared dinner in the kitchen with her mother, tearing greens while listening to her talk about interesting happenings at the vegetable market. Dinner was pork rib soup and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. When her father came back, the three of them enjoyed a warm dinner together, sharing the joy of buying old books and amusing stories from her mother's students' essays.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Design star stickers
description: Returning to the bedroom, she turned on the computer and used vector software to design star stickers. Inspired by the afternoon in the bookstore and on the road, she used the polygon tool to draw three agile golden stars, adjusted the anchor points, and arranged them into a starry sky asset. Finally, she exported them as PNG and named the file "Galaxy Sticker-01" to prepare for making self-adhesive stickers later.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watercolor practice: distant mountains and a lake
description: She set up the easel, and using watercolor paper and a tutorial video, taught herself a landscape painting titled Distant Mountains and Lake. First she wet the paper, then mixed Prussian blue and ultramarine to create a gradient sky. During the process, she encountered some unsatisfactory water marks, but after absorbing the excess moisture with a tissue, she patiently built up the gray-blue of the distant mountains in layers. In the end, she completed a small landscape piece that was somewhat naive but had a hazy, poetic mood. When she finished, she took a photo and sent it to her friend Wenzi to share what she had learned from the practice.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entry.
description: After putting away the watercolor tools, she took out her journal and recorded the day's gains: the sentences she had copied in the morning, the doodle on the spine of the secondhand book she bought, the driving instructor's cornering tips, and the key points on water-stain handling in her watercolor practice. She also wrote down the inspiration from "Pascal's Reed" and incorporated the thoughts and reflections into her daily record.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: After turning off the lights, she sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated for 10 minutes with the white noise of a babbling stream, imagining herself as calm as a lake while thoughts floated by like clouds. Then she read 15 minutes from a secondhand old edition of Wang Zengqi's Selected Essays under the bedside lamp, savoring the warmth of everyday life in the words, and finally drifted off to sleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and stretching
description: At 7:30 in the morning, I naturally woke up in the sunlight and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation in bed, feeling my breath and my body waking up. Then I got out of bed and did a simple 5-minute stretch in front of the window, moving my shoulders, neck, and wrists to relieve the stiffness from last night's watercolor practice.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoy brunch with family
description: After washing up, I had brunch with my parents. Mom had specially made small-pot rice noodles, which were sour, spicy, and savory. We chatted while eating, and I shared the delight of finding an old edition of Wang Zengqi at Zhibushi Bookstore. Mom mentioned the newly opened bakery in the neighborhood, and Dad, reading the newspaper, occasionally chimed in. It was a warm family moment.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Conceived and wrote the prose essay 'The Landscape in a Bowl of Rice Noodles'
description: In the study, I opened my laptop and browsed Aunt Xie's manuscripts and notes. After brainstorming, I blended the story, the taste of our family's rice noodles, and the lively street life, and wrote an essay of about 2,000 words in one go.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Send the manuscript and take a brief rest
description: Read through and fine-tuned the article, and after confirming there were no errors, sent 'The Landscape in a Bowl of Rice Noodles' to editor Xu Mingyuan by email. Then she got up to relax, admired the street scene outside the window, and had some lemon water while resting.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Prepare flower arrangement tools and materials for the writing sharing session.
description: She organized the tool bag for the afternoon flower arranging work (flower shears, thin wire, hemp rope), selected two paragraphs from the essay ‘Vigil Behind the Glass’ to print, prepared a feedback record page, and clipped them all into her notebook to prepare for the evening writing gathering.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch.
description: Lunch was home-style dishes: tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and soup. At the table, we shared the afternoon and evening plans. Dad reminded us to stay safe, and Mom praised the lifestyle of combining hobbies with earning money. After the meal, I took the initiative to clean up the dishes.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rest and outing preparations
description: She set the alarm and rested in bed with her eyes closed for about 30 minutes. After getting up, she changed into a cotton-linen shirt and trousers that were easy to move in, and packed her flower-arranging tool kit and canvas tote bag (wallet, phone, keys, notebook, sunscreen).
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take the bus to the yoga studio
description: Took Bus No. 1 at the entrance of the residential community to Jianshe Road, sat by the window, and enjoyed the afternoon sunshine and breeze. Sent a message to He Lu to let her know she was on her way.
location: On the No. 1 bus from Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Jianshe Road

name: Collaboration on creating and finishing the floral installation at the yoga studio.
description: At Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio, I coordinated with He Lu to create an umbrella-shaped flower stand using bamboo poles as the frame. We hung baby's breath and inserted daisies, eucalyptus leaves, and other flowers, completing the lively installation 'Breath.' Afterward, we cleaned up the space, drank water and chatted in the rest area. He Lu transferred 300 yuan via WeChat as payment, and we agreed to collaborate on the floral design for next month's outdoor yoga event.
location: Jingxin Yoga Life Studio (second floor facing the street), No. 302 Jianshe Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to change clothes and rest
description: Took the bus back home to Cuihu Community, washed her face, changed out of clothes stained with flower juice, put on a navy blue cotton-linen dress with a white canvas bag, and checked whether she had brought all the materials for the evening sharing session.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take the bus to the café.
description: At the entrance of the residential compound, she took Bus No. 2 to the city center. On the way, she confirmed the participant list and seats in the "Ink and Breath" WeChat group and @'d the organizer to let them know she had set off.
location: On the No. 2 bus from Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Dingxin Street

name: Arrive at the café early to read and prepare.
description: Arriving at Luming Café earlier than planned, she sits down on a corner sofa and orders an osmanthus latte. She reads the essay draft silently, marks pauses in tone with a pencil, and sends a WeChat message to her friend Zhang Jing to share the event, receiving encouragement.
location: First floor, Luming Independent Café (old Western-style house), No. 4 Dingxin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attend the “Ink and Breath” writing group gathering.
description: In a private room on the second floor of a café, she met with about eight literary friends under the theme "Me and a City." In the third segment, she read a passage from "Watching from Behind the Glass"; her voice was gentle, but the words moved everyone. During the discussion, she received suggestions: add the ambient sounds of the environment after rain to the opening, adjust the frequency of the "glass" imagery, and leave the ending open. She carefully recorded the feedback and proactively added two literary friends whose styles she liked on WeChat.

participant.name: Lin Jing
participant.relation: Writing group organizer and literary friend.

location: Private room on the second floor of Luming Independent Café, No. 4 Dingxin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: On the way home by walking and bus
description: After the gathering ended, she walked out of the café with a few like-minded friends and walked to Xiaohuayuan Bus Stop. While waiting for the bus, she flipped through her notes with a smile on her face. After getting on the bus, she messaged her online literary friends that she had gained a lot. When she reached home, she saw Aunt Xie's light was on and felt a sense of calm.
location: Xiaohuayuan (Little Garden) Bus Stop on Dingxin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the bus ride back

name: Organizing writing feedback and journal records
description: Sitting at my desk, I highlighted three key revision suggestions in orange, then opened my journal, recorded today's reflections, wrote down my takeaways, and pasted in a dried bamboo leaf as decoration.
location: At the desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: After washing up, changed into pajamas and lay on the bed, did a 12-minute meditation, grateful for today's kindness and inspiration. Then read the Rain in Kunming section from Wang Zengqi's Selected Essays, felt it resonated, closed the book with satisfaction, turned off the light, and fell asleep in the moonlight and the chirping of insects.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretching and washing up
description: Waking naturally in the gentle Sunday morning sunlight, with birdsong coming from Green Lake Park outside the window. Sun Yuwei does simple stretches in bed for about 10 minutes, loosening her shoulders, neck, and her lower back, which has grown stiff from prolonged sitting. Then she gets up and does several rounds of Cat-Cow and Child's Pose on the yoga mat to wake up her body. She opens her phone to check the time and browses the weather app, which shows 'Sunny, 20-27C'. Then she goes to the bathroom to wash up and changes into comfortable loungewear.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei came to the dining room. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had already prepared breakfast — small-pot rice noodles, steaming hot, with smooth and slippery noodles, a delicious broth, and mint leaves added for extra flavor. Yuwei chatted with her parents as they ate, sharing her impressions from reading Selected Essays of Wang Zengqi the night before. She especially loved the essay about rain in Kunming, and it made her want to go try the tofu at Zhengqitang. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, also laughed and took up the conversation, talking about what he had seen and heard on the old street when he was young.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Equipment check and journal preparation.
description: After breakfast, she returned to her room. Sun Yuwei opened her laptop to check the internet connection, downloaded and logged into Tencent Meeting for tomorrow's online workshop. Then she opened a blank journal she uses for electronic journaling as a physical reference, placed three colored pens beside it, prepared a simple outline for tomorrow's online sharing, and sorted out the key points of the first module.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Send thank-you messages and exchange with literary friends
description: After the preparation work was done, Sun Yuwei opened the WeChat writing group "Ink and Breath" and sincerely posted a message of thanks, thanking each member from yesterday for their listening and valuable feedback. She then privately messaged Yang Wenyou, who had suggested the "ambient sound at the beginning," and Li Wenyou, who had suggested the "blank space at the end," and sent them the revised passages from "Vigil Behind the Glass." The two literary friends quickly replied, approved the revisions, and had a brief exchange. Yuwei recorded the insights from this exchange in her physical journal, tagging them as "material accumulation."
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready to head out to meet up with my close friend.
description: Sun Yuwei put on a white T-shirt and lightweight running shoes. Because the new shoes rubbed against her left foot, she put a band-aid on her heel. She packed her phone, power bank, a small bottle of water, tissues, and sunscreen into her shoulder bag. Before leaving, she sent a message in the three-person bestie group "What Are We Eating Today" to let them know she was heading out. Chen Sisi immediately replied "Be right there," and Zhang Jing also responded. Then she walked to the Golden Horse and Green Rooster Archway Square to meet up with her friends.
location: On the way from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Jinma Biji Square

name: Participate in the city orienteering race
description: Sun Yuwei, Chen Sisi, and Zhang Jing met at the Golden Horse and Jade Rooster Archway Square, picked up the mission booklet and map, and started the city orienteering race. They wove through old streets and lanes such as Qianwang Street, Wenming Street, and Jingxing Street, completing tasks like 'complete a transaction in dialect at a flaky bun shop' (Jingjing successfully bought three flaky buns in broken Kunming dialect, which made the vendor and her companions burst out laughing) and 'take a three-person check-in photo in front of the century-old pharmacy.' During the race, they took a few wrong turns because they didn't read the map carefully, but the three kept taking selfies and joking, so the fun never faded. Around 1 o'clock, they completed the last task in Green Lake Park, successfully finished the race, and took about 15,000 steps in total. Yuwei got a small blister on the sole of her left foot from her new shoes, but it was no big deal.
location: Jinma Biji Archway Square and surrounding old neighborhoods in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Qianwang Street, Wenming Street, Jingxing Street, Green Lake Park).

name: After the match, walked to the old teahouse.
description: After the race ended, the three of them set out for the old teahouse on Wenmiao Street they had agreed on earlier. Coming out from the west side of Cuihu Park, they walked along Qianwang Street, chatting about funny moments from the race and passing the shop where Yuwei had bought flaky buns the day before. Jingjing teased her with dialect jokes again. After about a 15-minute walk, they arrived at an old teahouse on Wenmiao Street with an old wooden sign and a threshold worn shiny.
location: From Cuihu Park to Wenmiao Zhijie, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rest and review at the old teahouse
description: The three of them sat in seats by the window and ordered a pot of 20-year raw pu-erh tea and a few freshly baked rose cakes. They quietly flipped through the orienteering race photos on their phones, sharing the stall selling painted sugar figures they had found while taking a detour. Sisi recalled the old-fashioned handmade cloth shoe shop she had seen on Wenming Street. Yuwei leaned back in the bamboo-woven rattan chair, listening to her friends chattering and laughing. Sunlight streamed through the old wooden window lattice onto the table, and the air seemed sweet. The tea master brewed the tea and explained the age of the tea cake. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: An old teahouse on Wenmiao Straight Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Said goodbye to her best friend and walked to the supermarket
description: At the entrance of the teahouse, she said goodbye to Chen Sisi and Zhang Jing; Jingjing needed to go back to school to prepare lessons, and Sisi was going to pick up her child. As planned, Sun Yuwei walked alone to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Cuihu South Road, which was about five minutes away.
location: Wenmiao Zhijie, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping
description: Sun Yuwei entered the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, pushed a shopping cart, bought her favorite blueberries and plain yogurt in the fresh produce section, and in the food section found newly arrived osmanthus-flavored honey and osmanthus oolong tea bags. She took one box of each, planning to add a little autumn happiness to her home.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Picked up the express delivery on the way home.
description: Carrying the shopping bags, she walked home, a walk of about 13 minutes. On the way, she stopped by the parcel station at the entrance of the residential compound to pick up the Prose magazine that had arrived two days earlier, and then continued home.
location: On the way from Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to Green Lake Community

name: Digital journal creation and sharing.
description: Back home, Sun Yuwei could not wait to open her iPad and transferred the star and moon phase vector stickers, imported via a data cable, into GoodNotes. She opened a blank template from the “September Starry Sky” theme, used a deep blue-purple gradient background, outlined a constellation in the center of the page with star stickers, decorated the edges with small moon phases, and adjusted the transparency and the color of the handwritten text. When she finished, she wrote an inspirational line in the corner of the page: “All running is for a deeper pause.” She took a screenshot and sent it to her cousin Shen Wei in Shenzhen, with the message: “Sis, look at my newly designed star theme! Does it look good?” Shen Wei quickly replied with a thumbs-up emoji and the comment, “Awesome, it has that calm feeling!” Yuwei happily replied with a smiley face.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with family and shared amusing stories.
description: Sun Yuwei walked out of the bedroom and smelled the familiar aroma of home cooking coming from the kitchen. Her mother had made garlic broccoli, stir-fried lotus root slices, and sparerib and radish soup. At the dinner table, Yuwei excitedly shared funny stories from the day's city orienteering race: Jingjing's story of buying flaky buns in dialect, the awkwardness of circling Green Lake looking for task points, and Sisi's embarrassment at being drawn to the sugar-painting stall. Her parents listened with great interest; her mother laughed out loud, and her father praised them for being energetic. After dinner, Yuwei took the initiative to clear the dishes and wash them in the kitchen.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read essays after showering.
description: After showering and changing into comfortable pajamas, Sun Yuwei sat on the edge of the bed, took out the paper edition of 'Selected Essays of Wang Zengqi' and continued reading. Tucked between the pages was the ginkgo leaf bookmark Uncle Qin had given her the day before yesterday. When she read the chapter about Kunming dishes, it felt familiar, so she picked up a pen and copied a passage about 'eating flowers' as a short note for today's reading.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Physical journal recording and organization
description: After reading, Sun Yuwei took out her physical journal and used colored pens and stickers to briefly record the route map of the day’s orienteering race, a printed QR code for a photo of the teahouse’s paper-cut window decorations, and a shopping list (osmanthus oolong tea, osmanthus honey). Finally, she finished the “Today’s Orienteering Race Notes,” recording how her body felt slightly sore but her spirits were high, and wrote down the sentence that had lingered in her mind during the day.
location: Desk at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Phone organization and online interaction.
description: Sun Yuwei lay down in bed, selected photos from the day's orienteering race, and posted them to the best friends' group chat 'What to Eat Today' with the caption: 'Today's dose of happiness.' Chen Sisi and Zhang Jing also shared photos, and the three chatted in the group. Meanwhile, she replied to editor Xu Mingyuan on WeChat, letting him know that the prose piece was finished and would be sent to him tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening washing, skincare, and listening to music.
description: Sun Yuwei went to the bathroom to brush her teeth and wash her face, and carefully did her evening skincare routine. Because she had been very active during the day, she soaked her feet in warm water to relieve fatigue. Then she lay in bed, put on her earphones, and played the song Clouds and Mist Turn to Rain by Landlord's Cat, enjoying a rare moment of quiet solitude and letting her body and mind completely relax.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and gratitude journal
description: After turning off the music, Sun Yuwei sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated for about 15 minutes before sleep, breathing deeply and reviewing the day: the morning breakfast, a friend's smiling face, the breeze while running, the sweet pu'er tea at the old teahouse, and the sense of accomplishment from completing the journal. Her heart was full of gratitude and joy. After the meditation, she wrote down three things she was grateful for that day in her gratitude journal.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: Putting down her gratitude journal, Sun Yuwei turned off the desk lamp and pulled up the thin quilt. Through the gap in the curtains, the moonlight outside the window cast a soft glow. She closed her eyes and slowly drifted into sleep, peaceful and content, ending this full and happy rest day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: At 7:30 Yuwei naturally woke up and did 20 minutes of meditation and stretching in bed, focusing on the recovery of the blister on her left foot. At 8:00, after a quick wash, she went to the living room and had breakfast with her mother (small-pot rice noodles + fried egg) while listening to light music. After the meal, she returned to her bedroom, packed her notebook and iPad into a canvas bag, and happily prepared to embrace new knowledge.
location: Bedroom and living room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Pre-class preparation.
description: At 8:30, Yuwei sat down in the study on time, turned on her computer, and checked the Tencent Meeting connection again. On the title page of the new notebook prepared specifically for the workshop, she wrote in pen: '2025.09.22 The Power of Story: Character Development and Plot Design in Nonfiction Writing,' and stuck on a small sun sticker she had cut out last night to encourage herself.
location: Study at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: In-depth online workshop learning
description: At 9:00, the workshop started on time. Yuwei listened attentively as the instructor explained core theories such as "character arc", "plot weaving" and "making details speak", quickly jotting down key quotes and classic cases in her journal. During the 15-minute practice session after class, as required, she immediately composed a 300-word passage on GoodNotes on her iPad - "The Old Man at the Bus Stop on a Rainy Day" - depicting his rolled-up trouser cuffs and the oil-paper umbrella in his hand, letting details speak through words, and uploaded it to the course review section.
location: Study at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lunch and writing discussion.
description: Class ended at 12:00. She left the study and had lunch with her mother. During the meal, Yuwei excitedly shared what she had learned that day about "how to make characters come alive through details," such as the eyes of the old man she had just written. After lunch, she returned to the window in the study, opened her email on her phone, and saw Editor Xu Mingyuan's reply: "Manuscript received. The topic is interesting." She felt much more relieved and replied with thanks. Then she found an invitation to contribute from a local official account. After weighing it, she politely declined and added her best wishes.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China — Restaurant and Study

name: Afternoon Rest and Recharge
description: After a busy morning, Yuwei felt her brain needed a rest. She curled up on the living room sofa, opened NetEase Cloud Music to play light music, and picked up "Selected Prose of Wang Zengqi." When she read a passage of plain description about ordinary townsfolk, her heart stirred, and she felt it perfectly echoed the content of the workshop. At that moment, she sent a WeChat voice message to Wenzi (Song Wen): "Wenzi, I attended an amazing character arc course today. I'll organize my notes and send them to you later!" The two chatted for a bit and shared tips for dealing with procrastination.
location: Living room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Workshop highlights review and note organization
description: After resting enough, Yuwei returned to the study full of energy. She took out the scrawled notes from the morning and a brand-new notebook for the workshop, and began systematically transcribing and organizing them. She wrote down the core theories with a black fountain pen, highlighted key quotes with a blue highlighter, and beside the 'Character Building' section, she pasted a sticky note with a draft of a character biography she had conceived. The whole process gave her a sense of fulfillment from internalizing and absorbing knowledge. At 17:00, she got up to put a new bandage on the blister on her left foot.
location: Study at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening restorative walk and socializing
description: At 17:15, Yuwei changed into comfortable canvas shoes and decided to go out for a walk around Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park). Considering her foot condition, she slowed down and strolled along the lakeside path, watching the sunset spread across the water and listening to the rustle of willow leaves in the wind. She didn't chat with Wenzi for long; she simply walked quietly, recording life with her eyes and savoring the peace and comfort of the evening.
location: Little Bird Park (Green Lake Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Dinner and family time.
description: At 18:30 she got home, and Yuwei had dinner with her parents. Today her mother made her favorites: stir-fried pork with pickled vegetables and sautéed pea shoots. During the meal, Yuwei shared funny stories from today's workshop and the red-billed gulls she had seen at Cuihu Lake. After dinner, she took the initiative to help her mother clear the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen, and the family chatted for a while.
location: Green Lake Community Restaurant, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Light evening relaxation.
description: At 19:30, Yuwei curled up on the living room sofa, took out her phone, and sent screenshots of today's workshop notes to the college roommate group. Jiajia (Liu Jia) and the others expressed envy, saying her life was too artistic. Yuwei chatted with them about the start of school and also made plans to explore new shops together after National Day. Then she browsed flower arrangement tutorials on Xiaohongshu for a while, gathering inspiration for the next trip with Manman to Dounan Flower Market.
location: Living room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Daily reflection and bedtime ritual
description: At 20:30, back in the study, Yuwei opened her paper diary and wrote down the three most important takeaways of the day: “Details are the soul of a character,” “The plot must follow the character arc,” and “You need to have a world in your heart.” She also wrote a one-sentence summary: “Today, I learned how to make silent characters ‘speak.’” At 21:15, she returned to the bedroom and did a 10-minute gratitude meditation, thanking Editor Xu for the recognition, her mentor for the inspiration, and herself for her dedicated state today. After the meditation, she checked the materials for tomorrow's workshop in advance.
location: Study and bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Getting ready for bed
description: At 22:00, after finishing the last two pages of "Selected Essays of Wang Zengqi," Yuwei turned off the bedside lamp, set the air conditioner to sleep mode, and briefly reviewed the fulfilling day in her mind. At 23:20, listening to the occasional chirping of insects outside the window, with a full sense of accomplishment and anticipation for tomorrow, she closed her eyes and slowly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast.
description: Waking up in the early morning, I did 10 minutes of stretching in bed to wake up my body, then did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing meditation on the yoga mat to clear my mind. Afterward, I had breakfast with my parents, Sun Mingyuan and Li Xiulan. My mother prepared hot milk, fried egg toast, and fruit. My father reminded me to drive carefully, and my mother asked about the blister on my left foot. The weather that day was cloudy, 19–24°C, suitable for going out.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Participate in an online writing workshop
description: Before class, I organized my laptop, notebook, and colored pens in the study, adjusted Tencent Meeting and the microphone, and wrote down preview key points in my journal. At 9:00 I officially attended the second day of the online writing workshop. The instructor used an award-winning feature article to explain details and emotional resonance. During the 11:00 practice session, Yuwei rewrote the opening of the column 'Landscape in a Bowl of Rice Noodles' in a colloquial style, and shared screenshots of the excellent exercises with the college roommate group (Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen) to exchange insights.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: After the workshop, she had lunch with her parents. Her mother had made stir-fried lotus root slices and shredded pork with green peppers. Yuwei shared the writing experience from the morning of rewriting the opening in dialect. After the meal, she went back to her room, set an alarm for 13:30, and took a 20-minute nap to regain her energy.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Practiced curve driving at driving school.
description: After waking from her afternoon nap, she washed her face and changed clothes, took the notebook with the S-curve driving tips and a water bottle, put a band-aid on the blister on her left foot, and added a soft insole. She walked from home to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 5 and transferred to a bus, arriving at the driving school training ground on Xuefu Road in about 40 minutes. Under the instructor's guidance, she repeatedly practiced S-curve driving, silently reciting the mnemonic 'left ridge against the right line, right ridge against the left line,' controlling the clutch to pass slowly through the S-turn. Her sense of the car and steering control improved noticeably.
location: Xuefu Road Driving School Training Ground, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping on the way back and a chance meeting with a neighbor
description: After driving practice, I took the bus back to the city along the same route, got off at the Xiaoximen (Dongfeng West Road) stop, walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, and bought a box of osmanthus-flavored instant coffee, blueberries, and yogurt. Then I walked home via Fuchun Street and Cuihu South Road. At the entrance of my building, I met Aunt Xie Xiulan, a neighbor walking her dog, greeted her, and briefly caught up.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and the downstairs of Cuihu Community, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flow yoga class and post-class discussion
description: Went home, quickly changed into yoga clothes and grabbed my yoga mat. Because the blister on my left foot had not healed, I walked more slowly than usual and arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the 4th floor of Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road in about 20 minutes. Before the class, I told the instructor He Lu about my foot condition, and we focused on core training and stretching. With assistance, I held a wall-supported headstand for about 40 seconds. After class, He Lu proactively asked about my blister and told me that the venue for the outdoor floral yoga session in the courtyard of the Fuxian Lake guesthouse at the end of the month had been confirmed, and asked Yuwei to start coming up with a floral arrangement plan.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buy flowers, go home, and have dinner
description: On the way home from the yoga studio, passing along Cuihu South Road, she bought a bunch of fresh chamomile at an elegant flower shop. When she got home, her mother saw the flowers and asked with a smile. After dinner, Yuwei put the flowers into a transparent vase on the desk, and they looked charming in the lamplight.
location: Flower shop on Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and home at Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road

name: In the evening, organizing notes and working on journal entries.
description: After the meal, she opened her laptop in the study and saved the two-day workshop's PPT screenshots and notes into Evernote by date. Then she took out colored pens and a ruler, hand-drew a “Resonance Formula” chart in her journal, reinforced her memory with keywords and illustrations, pasted in supermarket receipts and the leaves she had brought back, and completed the internalization of knowledge.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime meditation, reading, and sleep
description: She changed into her pajamas and sat on her meditation cushion for 15 minutes of breathing meditation, saving energy for tomorrow's workshop. Afterward, she browsed the "Plants in the Human World" chapter in the 1998 edition of Selected Prose of Wang Zengqi on her nightstand. After closing the book, she saved a reminder for next Friday's editor feedback deadline in the map app on her phone, did a simple skincare routine, turned off the light, put on her sleep mask, and fell asleep peacefully after reviewing what she had gained that day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: I woke up at 7:30 in the morning light from the direction of Green Lake Park. I first did ten minutes of meditation and stretching in bed, feeling the rhythm of my breath and letting my focus settle. After washing up, I walked into the dining room, where my mother Li Xiulan had already prepared small-pot rice noodles garnished with bright green mint leaves. She smiled and said, "It's the last day of the workshop—eat well and stay energetic all day!" I picked up a chopstickful of rice noodles, feeling both anticipation for the course to end and a touch of reluctance.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Pre-class preparation and equipment debugging
description: After breakfast, she returned to the study and checked the computer, camera, and network to make sure everything was ready for the Tencent Meeting. She neatly placed the course materials printed last night and her journal on the desk, with a technical pen and a plane tree leaf picked from Cuihu Park yesterday placed beside them. The leaf veins were clear, so she tucked it into the pages of a book, thinking it might serve as a reference for her evening watercolor practice.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Participate in an online writing workshop
description: At nine o'clock, I went online on time. The instructor explained the module "Editing Process from Material to Final Draft," teaching in detail how to filter through complex background material using a feature story case. I opened the outline of a nonfiction story about the changes in local old teahouses and made notes in red pen in my journal while listening. During the free discussion session, I asked: "In writing nonfiction, how do you balance the emotional truth of the people involved with the structural beauty of the article?" The instructor gave high praise and shared some practical tips, and I felt suddenly enlightened.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Course wrap-up and one-on-one feedback.
description: After the course content, we moved into the Q&A session between the instructor and students. I raised the three questions I had prepared. The instructor looked at the shared screen with my two assignments and gave specific directions for filling in the missing details in the old teahouse outline, commenting that my writing “has keen perception and a warm core, but the skeleton needs to be sturdier.” This evaluation gave me a thrill of self-affirmation and correction, and I quickly marked each piece of advice with a highlighter.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Organize class notes and file them away.
description: At noon, she saved the book lists shared by classmates and the instructor's useful screenshots from the chat window, then opened Evernote and created a new folder 'Workshop - Final Review', entering the instructor's targeted comments on the two exercises, the answers to questions, and the core formulas from the 'Reader Interaction and Emotional Resonance' module, and tagged them with '#editing skills #nonfiction #2025#'.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family lunch and midday rest
description: Had lunch with my parents at 12:45. Today featured my favorite ganba mushroom fried rice and tomato and egg soup. I shared how my advisor praised me in the morning. My father smiled and said, "Being able to learn from outstanding people is your greatest strength." After lunch, I set an alarm for 13:10 and went back to my room for a 20-minute nap to build up energy for the afternoon's plans.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Getting ready to leave for the driving school
description: When the alarm went off, I got up quickly, checked that the blister on my left foot was no longer a problem, and put on a new hydrocolloid dressing to prevent friction from shoes. I changed into thin cotton shoes, put my driver's license, a bottle of water, and my phone into a small canvas bag, changed shoes at the entryway, and called out to my mother, "Mom, I'm off to driving practice!"
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Commuted to the driving school and went shopping on the way.
description: Walked 5 minutes to the bus stop and took Bus No. 100. On the way, got off at the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket stop, quickly went into the supermarket to buy the soy sauce her mother had asked for and a bottle of shampoo, then picked two Red Fuji apples in the fruit section.
