Ten minutes later got back on the bus, heading west, and arrived at the driving school entrance on Yunxiu Road, Guandu District, around 14:40.
location: Yunnan Yitong Driving School Registration Point, No. 2116 Yunxiu Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Practiced reverse parking and parallel parking at driving school
description: I found Coach Zhang in the rest area; he was watching trainees practice driving. After getting in the car, I fastened my seatbelt and adjusted the seat and rearview mirror. On the first reverse parking attempt, the left gap was a bit wide. Coach Zhang instructed, "Turn back half a turn! Watch the prism." The second attempt was adjusted well. After practicing five reverse parking maneuvers, I moved on to parallel parking, trying hard to recall the mantra "Rear of the car enters the bay; keep your eye on the right rear wheel."
location: Yunnan Yitong Driving School Registration Point, No. 2116 Yunxiu Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Practice Summary and Return
description: At 16:00 the coach announced the end. In the rest area, she noted down the two new blind spots she had discovered today. At 16:10 she boarded the No. 100 bus for the return trip. The bus was a bit crowded, so she stood with earphones in, listening to two soothing pieces of light music to let her mind relax from the focus of driving. Forty minutes later, she got off at Cuihu South Road Station and walked back to the residential complex.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Heading home to prepare for the guests.
description: After getting home, first take out the apples and soy sauce; Mother was watering flowers on the balcony. Go into the study, open the magazine Cultural Vision to the page carrying Landscape in a Bowl of Rice Noodles, put it in the most prominent place on the desk, check the coffee table to make sure there is no clutter, then pour yourself and each guest a glass of warm water.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Aunt Xie's visit and display of works
description: At 5 p.m. the doorbell rang on time, and Aunt Xie came in smiling, carrying a bag of Red Fuji apples. I led her into the study, sat her down, opened a magazine, and showed her “The Landscape in a Bowl of Rice Noodles.” Aunt Xie put on her reading glasses, read it silently word by word, and then her eyes lit up: “This is so well written! It brings the old Kunming flavor to life!” I suggested that every Wednesday afternoon I would prepare reading notes for her in exchange for her telling old stories, and she clapped her hands and readily agreed.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Saying goodbye to Aunt Xie and taking a short rest.
description: After chatting a while longer about school life and writing, Aunt Xie got up to leave. Yuwei walked her to the door and watched her enter the apartment across the hall. Back in the study, she quickly wrote down Aunt Xie's story about the open-air movies at Green Lake on weekends in the 1980s in the "Social Inspiration" section of her journal. Then she sat in the rattan chair in the living room, closed her eyes to rest, and reviewed the day.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family dinner and relaxation
description: Father came home after work and made fried pork ribs and stir-fried luffa. At the dinner table, I happily shared the progress I'd made with reverse parking that afternoon and the good news that Aunt Xie and I had reached a weekly arrangement. Mother put a rib in my bowl. After dinner, I helped Mother with the dishes.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Preparation before creative work
description: Back in the study, she opened her phone gallery and looked through the rose photos taken at Green Lake Park yesterday, looking for one with simple petals and clear structure as a reference. She gently closed the study door, put on headphones to play a soothing piano piece, and let her mind calm down.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Watercolor line sketches and light wash painting.
description: Spread out the watercolor paper, sketched a rough spiral with a pencil, then switched to a 0.1 technical pen and started drawing petal lines extending outward from the center of the flower, aiming for clean, crisp strokes. After finishing the line drawing, she mixed an extremely light pink and gently dabbed it onto the petal edges with a moist brush tip, letting the color diffuse naturally with the water's tension. The whole process required intense concentration.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Journal records and creative diary
description: After the painting dried completely, she carefully pasted it into her journal and wrote on a blank page with a fountain pen: "The line drawing is the bone, the watercolor is the flesh. On September 24, I happily obtained this branch. The single-petal rose under my pen has a bit of the lightness of prose and a bit of the intensity of painting. For future essay collection illustrations, I'll use this style." Then she recorded her feelings about finishing the workshop, her progress at driving school, and the story inspiration from Aunt Xie.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: She filled a basin with hot water and soaked her left foot, applied body lotion, changed into loose cotton pajamas, and carefully completed her skincare routine—a gentle reward for a hard day's work.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Reading and meditation before bed
description: At 22:10, leaning against the headboard, I browsed Selected Essays of Wang Zengqi. When I reached the essay about the rain in Kunming, I felt that the warmth of everyday life in the words matched today very well. At 22:25, I put down the book, lit a sandalwood incense stick on the incense holder, sat cross-legged, and began to meditate, silently repeating 'I am a patient witness', letting the noise of the day settle and leaving behind inner calm and contentment.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Gratitude journal and sleep
description: On the gratitude journal by her bed, she wrote down three small things: 1. The workshop ended and I gained valuable self-awareness; 2. I finally got the hang of reverse parking; 3. Aunt Xie and I made a wonderful appointment. After writing, she turned off the light and slowly fell asleep amid the breeze outside the window and inner peace.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Waking up and morning ritual
description: Woken by the alarm clock, the sky outside the window was overcast, and the air carried a dampness from the passing shower. Sun Yuwei took a deep breath, sat cross-legged on the bed, and did 15 minutes of breathing meditation, silently repeating, 'I am a patient writer,' letting her thoughts settle from her dreams and gathering energy for the new day.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (bedroom)

name: Flower arranging exam sprint: slanting style practice.
description: After washing up and changing into a comfortable cotton-linen shirt, she went to the balcony. Using a kenzan to secure the dried branches and the gentian flowers covered with dewdrops, she focused on practicing the Ikenobo slanting style. While adjusting the angles of the branches, she silently reviewed the exam points: “The main branch should tilt naturally toward the left front...” She was very satisfied with today’s line quality and planned to use this composition for Saturday’s exam.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (balcony)

name: Breakfast preparation and journal recording
description: Photographed and archived the completed 'Autumn Thoughts' flower arrangement, and quickly wrote down practice notes in my journal. Then I went into the kitchen, helped my mother warm up the purple rice porridge, and fried myself a soft-yolk egg, ready to enjoy breakfast with the family.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study and kitchen)

name: Family breakfast and casual chat
description: The family sat around the dining table. While drinking porridge, Sun Yuwei mentioned the encouragement Aunt Xie had given her when she visited yesterday. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, asked with concern whether the blister on her left foot had healed, and her mother, Li Xiulan, said with a smile that she looked full of energy today.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (restaurant)

name: Texture Showdown: Hand-Drawn vs. Digital
description: Back at the desk, she stuck the watercolor single-petal rose stickers she had hand-painted yesterday (and sprinkled with gold powder) and the vector moon-phase stickers designed and printed on the iPad onto two separate pages of the journal. Closing her eyes, she gently ran her fingers over both surfaces, feeling the raised brushstrokes of paper and the smoothness of digital printing. In the journal she wrote: 'Digital is a tool; hand-drawing is the root. Use it as a supplement, but never lose sight of the original intention.' This strengthened her resolve to mainly use hand-painted watercolor when illustrating the essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes'.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Freelance writing: polishing 'Neighborhood Bonds'
description: During the prime morning hours, she opened her laptop and continued polishing the passage about neighborly warmth in Notes on Slow Living. Remembering the workshop mentor's advice from yesterday, she tried adding Aunt Xie's monologue about her memories of the textile factory to give the characters deeper motivation. Tired from writing, she got up and brewed a cup of jasmine tea, watched neighbors walking their dogs outside the window, and inspiration flowed smoothly.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Handling editorial matters
description: The phone vibrated. Editor Xu Mingyuan sent a WeChat message asking about the manuscript progress. Sun Yuwei replied that she was revising it, everything was going well, and confirmed that submitting before the October 3 feedback deadline was no problem. Xu Mingyuan gave a positive reply and told her not to rush. She felt relaxed and closed her laptop.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Lunch and household chores.
description: At lunchtime, I ate the tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried cabbage my mother made while sharing the morning's writing progress with my family. After the meal, I cleared the dishes on my own initiative and put away the things we had bought from the supermarket the day before.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (dining room/living room)

name: A brave decision: marathon registration and discussion
description: The afternoon drowsiness was replaced by excitement. She clicked open the registration link for the Kunming Plateau Half Marathon that He Lu had sent last night. Her heart beat a little faster, but remembering the phrase “dare to try and be bold,” she took a deep breath, decisively filled in the information, and registered for the 5 km fun run. After registering successfully, she excitedly sent a screenshot to He Lu and a voice message: “Lulu, I signed up! Please take me under your wing!” He Lu quickly replied, and they agreed on a training plan: start with a 3 km run along the Panlong River, meet at 7 p.m. every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday, and briefly discussed the essentials of choosing running shoes.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Reconnaissance Notes along the Panlong River
description: To familiarize herself with the future night-running route in advance, Sun Yuwei changed into sneakers and walked from home to the bank of the Panlong River (the section near Dongfeng Square in Wuhua District). The air by the river was fresh after the rain shower. She walked slowly along the trail for about 30 minutes, checking the road surface (flat and pothole-free), the scenery along the way, and the locations of restrooms. She took several photos with her phone and thought the environment there was well suited as a starting route.
location: Panlong River Trail, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near Dongfeng Square)

name: Commute to the yoga studio
description: Walked about 15 minutes from the bank of the Panlong River and arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio in Dechun Commercial Building. On the way, passed a small shop and bought a bottle of mineral water to prepare for the upcoming class.
location: Along the route from the Panlong River bank to Zhongmou Yoga Studio (Wuhua District, Kunming City)

name: Calm Yoga: Balance Pose Class
description: Started the yoga class on time; today's theme was balancing poses. Under He Lu's guidance, I successfully took on the challenging Lord of the Dance pose, and both my focus and balance improved noticeably. After class, I chatted with He Lu for a while about my excitement over registering for the marathon, and she recommended a post on beginner running shoes.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Adding running shoes to wishlist and restocking at the supermarket
description: After yoga class, it was only a 4.5-minute walk from the yoga studio to the City Garden Supermarket on Fuchun Street. While bookmarking the running-shoe post He Lu had shared on her phone, she shopped at the supermarket: bought some blueberries her mother loves, whole-wheat bread for tomorrow's breakfast, and a bottle of soy sauce (she had noticed the one at home was almost empty yesterday).
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Return home to rest and engage in mind-emptying reading
description: Carrying the shopping bags, I walked home. Once home, I made myself a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea with brown sugar and fresh milk, then curled up on the living room sofa and took out “Selected Essays of Wang Zengqi.” On an afternoon when a typhoon was approaching, reading Wang Zengqi’s descriptions of Kunming’s rain and mushrooms felt especially warm and familiar. I didn’t deliberately take notes; I simply enjoyed the leisurely feeling the words brought.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (living room)

name: Family dinner: sharing the day
description: During dinner, Sun Yuwei vividly described the story of scouting the terrain along the Panlong River and successfully registering for the marathon. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, laughed and called it her "three-minute enthusiasm," but there was approval in his eyes. Her mother, Li Xiulan, reminded her to take it gradually and not get injured. The family chatted happily while eating.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (restaurant)

name: Evening creative work and planning
description: She organized today's ikebana practice pieces and photos of the Panlong River into her journal. Then she created a new page for the Marathon Training Plan and carefully pasted in the gear list and running shoe recommendations He Lu had sent. She also found time to check her watercolor paints, confirmed that several colors in her Sakura solid watercolor set were almost used up, and noted them in her phone memo to buy refills online.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Online chat with Wenzi
description: The video call connected. Sun Yuwei shared today's 'crazy' decision to sign up for a marathon with her good friend Song Wen (Wenzi), who was greatly surprised. The two chatted for half an hour about 'how an introverted person can take up an extroverted sport.' Wenzi encouraged her, saying, 'This is definitely great material for your future novel characters!' Laughter kept breaking out.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Evening meditation and goal list
description: Bedtime ritual time. She changed into her pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bed, and did 15 minutes of breathing meditation to clear the day's thoughts. After the meditation, she opened her journal and, under the 'Half Marathon' section on the 'Goals' page, solemnly wrote: 'November 2025, Kunming highland half marathon, complete the 5K health run.' Beside it, she drew a simple sketch of a pair of running shoes.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (bedroom)

name: Reading and stretching
description: Bedtime. I took out Wang Zengqi's essay collection and read the piece 'Duck Eggs at the Dragon Boat Festival,' which I found very amusing. Then I got up and did a few simple yoga stretches to ease the stiffness in my lower back from sitting long hours writing.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (bedroom)

name: Final preparations before bed.
description: Brushed teeth and washed face, did basic skincare. Set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning and turned off social app notifications on the phone. Faint rain could be heard outside the window. Turned off the light and lay down. Every minute of today from morning to night felt solid, with a fulfilling calmness. I fell asleep with anticipation.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (bedroom)

name: Morning routine and morning preparations.
description: Woke up at 7 a.m., meditated cross-legged in bed for 15 minutes, then got out of bed for yoga stretching, loosening up her shoulders, neck and waist. After washing up, she changed into a light blue linen-cotton shirt and prepared things for going out: canvas tote bag, phone, power bank, keys, kenzan, and flower scissors. Then she had breakfast with her parents. Mom brought out her signature small-pot rice noodles, and Dad was already sitting at the table reading the news. Yuwei told her parents today's plan: go to Dounan Flower Market to prepare for tomorrow's flower arrangement exam, and run 3 km along the Panlong River in the afternoon. Dad nodded and told her to be safe; Mom smiled and teased that she was both cultured and athletic. When she left, she ran into Aunt Xie Xiulan, a neighbor returning from walking her dog in the hallway. Aunt Xie asked warmly, and Yuwei said she was going to buy flowers for an exam. Aunt Xie encouraged her to do well, and after a brief chat they said goodbye.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom, dining room, stairwell)

name: Went to Dounan Flower Market.
description: Starting from Cuihu Community, she walked along the Wutong Path to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, about 5 minutes. She took the metro (Line 2/Line 1) to Dounan Station, a ride of about 35 minutes, wearing earphones and listening to light music while mulling over the dried branches and gentian she needed to buy. She arrived at Dounan Station at 8:50, walked about 5 minutes from Exit C to the main hall of Dounan Flower Market. The morning market at the entrance was still lively, and the air was filled with the scent of various flowers.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (via Huashan West Road Metro Station and Dounan Station)

name: Select flower materials at Dounan Flower Market.
description: In Area A of the main hall at Dounan Flower Market, she carefully selected flower materials. First, in the fresh cut flower section, she found dry branches with a vigorous, gnarled posture. Then, at a stall, she carefully compared several bunches of purple gentians and chose one with full buds and fresh color. She compared smoke tree leaves at several stalls and finally picked three perfectly symmetrical leaves without blemishes. Lastly, she bought a bunch of pale green lisianthus along the way for the study. Before paying, she checked that her own kenzan and floral shears were intact, fully prepared for tomorrow's flower arrangement exam.
location: Zone A, Main Hall, Dounan Flower Market, 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Returning home
description: After visiting the flower market, she bought a grilled erkuai and a cup of freshly made soy milk from a mobile snack stall outside the market and ate while walking toward Dounan Station. At 10:40 she swiped her card to enter the station and took the subway back, guarding the canvas bag full of flowers and watching the scenery flash past the window. At 11:15 she arrived at Huashan West Road Station and walked home, picking up the delivery of her new running shoes at the entrance of the residential complex on the way.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (returned from Dounan Flower Market by metro)

name: Resting at home and doing an initial arrangement of the flower materials
description: After getting home, I laid the purchased dry branches, gentians, smoke tree leaves, and lisianthus flat on the living room floor to sort them. I first cut the lisianthus stems diagonally, put them in a clear glass vase, and placed it on the dining table to brighten the mood. Then I opened the new running shoes and tried them on, and was very satisfied with the cushioning.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Housework and flower arranging practice
description: Put last week's clothes into the washing machine. Then I returned to the study, took out the draft I had drawn during yesterday's flower arrangement practice, looked up the key points about the slanted style in "Everyday Ikebana", made pencil marks on the draft, and thought about the structural design that might be used in tomorrow's exam.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch.
description: Mom prepared garlic broccoli and steamed sea bass. Yuwei eagerly shared what she had seen at the flower market that morning, such as an auntie who brought her own flowers to set up a stall. Her parents reminded her not to be nervous about tomorrow's exam and to treat it with a calm mind. Dad also asked whether the new running shoes had arrived.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Feeling drowsy after the meal, she returned to the bedroom, set an alarm earlier in the afternoon, and lay on the bed resting with eyes closed for 30 minutes to save energy for the run later.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and essay polishing
description: After waking up, she returned to the study. First, she opened her journal and used a pencil to make a quick sketch of the dead branches and gentian she had bought today, documenting her transition to hand-drawn illustrations. Then she turned on her laptop and polished the street descriptions in her prose essay "Notes on Slow Walking", adjusting a few adjectives to make the text more textured until she was satisfied.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-run preparation
description: Went to the balcony to feel the temperature and confirmed that around 23 degrees in the afternoon was great for running. Changed into a sports bra and a quick-dry T-shirt, and put on the new Asics running shoes. In the living room, did warm-up exercises such as high knees, jumping jacks, and lunges, moved the ankles and knees, and checked whether the running app was working properly.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: First running workout and cooldown
description: She went downstairs and walked along a familiar route to the running path on Jiangbin West Road by the Panlong River (Wuhua District section), noticing that the ginkgo leaves were starting to turn yellow. At 15:35, she opened her running app and started tracking. She began with a slow jog, controlling her breathing rhythm, and followed the riverside pedestrian path north to near the Zhuantang River, then turned back. The total distance was about 3 kilometers, taking 25 minutes, with an average pace of 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, a maximum heart rate of 155 beats per minute, and about 200 calories burned. After the run, she stretched her legs on a riverside bench. After reviewing the app data, she took a screenshot and sent it to her friend He Lu with a check-in note sharing her feelings about her first training session. Then she slowly walked home.
location: Panlong River riverside running track, Jiangbin West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shower and freshen up
description: After returning home, she took a hot shower to wash off the sweat, changed into comfortable loungewear, and sat on the edge of the bed using a foam roller to relax her calf muscles, relieving the soreness after exercise.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Mom made seaweed and pork rib soup, and Dad made his signature cold wood ear mushroom salad. At the dinner table, Yuwei shared how her first run felt: it was easier than she'd imagined, except her legs were a bit weak at the end. Dad, in a rare compliment, said that persisting was what mattered, while Mom reminded her to stretch thoroughly after tomorrow's run and not to overdo it.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing flower materials and arranging flowers in the evening
description: After the meal, I moved the flower materials I had bought into the study, cut the bottoms of the withered branches at an angle and soaked them in water, pruned the stems of the gentian and smoke tree leaves, removed excess leaves, wrapped the roots in wet paper towels, rolled them in newspaper, and put them in the refrigerator to keep fresh. Then I trimmed the lisianthus and put it in a slender glass vase on a corner of the desk, adding life to the study.
location: Home study and living room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Online communication with friends
description: Received a WeChat reply from He Lu, congratulating her on the victory in her first run, praising her good pace, and asking whether she would continue running tomorrow. Yuwei replied that she had a flower arrangement exam tomorrow and would meet up to run together on Saturday evening instead, and also told her that the new running shoes had great cushioning. The two chatted about how the run felt and their upcoming training plan, in a relaxed and pleasant mood.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling my first run.
description: She opened her journal and, using the newly bought blue watercolors, painted a silhouette of the Panlong River bank and a running figure. Beside it she recorded the date, weather, first run of 3 kilometers, pace 7'28", heart rate 150, and new shoes. On the marathon goal page, next to "Complete the 5K of the November half marathon," she drew a small checkmark and wrote, "The first step begins with new shoes and the river breeze. Done."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Meditation and relaxation.
description: She turned off the room lights, lit a white tea scented candle, and sat cross-legged on the yoga mat. Meditating on the theme of “release,” she let go of the muscle soreness from running and the anxiety about tomorrow’s exam, focused on her breathing, and felt her body stretch and calm down.
location: On the yoga mat in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and preparation before bed
description: She pulled Selected Essays of Wang Zengqi from the bedside table and quietly read the piece 'The Grass and Trees of the Human World.' The delicate prose completely calmed her mood. After reading, she did a few simple yoga leg stretches to loosen up her legs and waist. She turned off the main light, set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning, turned off the desk lamp, and prepared to fall asleep in the faint moonlight.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yuwei woke up, sat cross-legged for ten minutes of meditation, focusing on her breath to release the tension from yesterday's exam. Then she gently stretched her neck, shoulders, arms, and legs to ease the slight muscle soreness from running. While washing up, she carefully examined her face and deliberately put on a crisply ironed white shirt and dark green wide-leg trousers, paired with comfortable cloth shoes, applying only lip balm to stay fresh. Her mother had already made steaming hot small-pot rice noodles; the sour and spicy broth was refreshing. As she ate, Yuwei mentally reviewed her exam tools: kenzan, flower shears, preserved dry branches, and flower materials such as gentian and smoketree leaves. After confirming everything was in order, she slung on her ikebana bag.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Went to the examination venue and took the beginner-level Ikenobo flower arrangement exam.
description: At 7:50, Yuwei left from the Cuihu Community bus stop and took a bus to a flower arrangement training center in Wuhua District. She put on her earphones and played "Kikujiro's Summer," silently memorizing the key points of the Ikenobo slanting-style structure in the morning light. After arriving at the exam venue, the topic "Autumn Sounds" was announced. She chose a thick withered branch with a texture like old camphor bark as the main branch, and repeatedly adjusted its angle to a natural slant at the left rear of the kenzan; she inserted purple gentians at varied low heights beneath the withered branch to create a sense of swaying. Finally, she used three smoke tree leaves gradually tinted with autumn colors to arrange the layers—one extending upward, two drooping as if brushed by the autumn wind. Forty minutes later, she put down her flower scissors. The proctor walked over and nodded slightly. Looking at the work in the water basin, she felt a peaceful sense of tribute to autumn and was satisfied with her performance.
location: A flower arrangement training center in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Communicated with friend Su Man and agreed on the flower market trip.
description: After the exam, Yuwei unexpectedly met her good friend Su Man under the ginkgo tree at the entrance of the training center. The two excitedly shared their piece ideas. Su Man praised the dynamic arrangement of Yuwei's smoke tree leaves, and Yuwei admired the vigorous lines of Su Man's dried branches. They asked a passing woman to take a group photo under the ginkgo tree just beginning to turn golden; Su Man carried her ikebana bag, while Yuwei held her manuscript notes. Before parting, Su Man suggested going to Dounan Flower Market next month to look for imported autumn-colored flowers, and Yuwei readily agreed.
location: At the entrance of a flower-arranging training center in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the bookstore, read, and make excerpts.
description: After saying goodbye to Su Man, Yuwei walked along the small path beside Green Lake to Zhibushi Bookstore. Sunlight filtered through the plane leaves in dappled patterns, and her steps were light. She arrived at 10:30. Uncle Qin was tidying the bookshelves and asked about her exams. After a brief reply, she took the newly arrived issue of South of the Clouds magazine from him. Sitting in a corner by the window, she ordered a signature brown-sugar pearl milk tea and opened an article titled "The Alleyway at Dusk." Written from the perspective of a grocery store, the piece linked together memories of three generations, and she was deeply moved. She took out her notebook and carefully copied the exquisite passages about light, shadow, and space.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Record of lunch conversation and after-meal stroll with Su Man
description: At noon, Su Man sent a WeChat message saying she was also nearby, so Yuwei invited her to the Guanshi Vietnamese Beef Rice Noodle Soup Restaurant next to the bookstore for lunch. The two ordered the signature combination pho and chatted about exam details as they ate. Su Man shared her dream of opening a floristry studio after graduation. Yuwei jotted down an article topic about checking out flower markets on a napkin, and they agreed to go to Dounan together next weekend to source floral materials. After the meal, Su Man left first. Yuwei sat for a while on a stone bench by Green Lake, watching the glimmering water and the egrets flying past. Using her sketchbook, she briefly outlined the composition for her exam piece and wrote down the mood behind creating “Autumn Sounds” and the new topic inspiration sparked by the conversation, planning to use them later in her journal.
location: Guanshi Pho bo Viet Nam Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup Restaurant (Cuihu Branch), 70 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Read at the bookstore and prepare writing drafts.
description: In the afternoon, Yuwei returned to the Zhibushi Bookstore and continued reading magazines, then began organizing the draft outline for the essay 'Twilight at the Alleyway' for the evening writing group. Inspired by her post-meal thoughts, she added descriptions of 'Three Generations' Grocery Store' and 'Light and Shadows of the Old Street' to the draft. Uncle Qin refilled her water, and she was completely absorbed in this little world, focusing on polishing the manuscript.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Early dinner
description: In the early evening, Yuwei put down the magazine and walked into an alley snack shop near the bookstore that she often visited. She ordered a bowl of hot and sour wontons and a serving of fried potatoes. After eating, she used mouthwash to rinse her mouth, went to the restroom to adjust her collar, and took a deep breath to encourage herself for the evening event.
location: Snack shop at the alley near Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took a walk in Green Lake Park to clear my thoughts and returned to the bookstore
description: There was still a little time before the writing group started. Yuwei walked into Cuihu Park and strolled along the lakeside path, watching people leisurely feed the seagulls. Wearing earphones and listening to light music, she went over her prepared essay ideas in her mind once more, looking for the best angle for the opening. As the sky darkened, she returned to Paper Stone Bookstore. The warm yellow lights were on. She went upstairs to a corner seat on the second floor, set out her notebook and pen, and quietly waited for the event to begin, feeling both expectant and a little nervous.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: First time participating in the local writing group and the exchange after the activity.
description: At six o'clock sharp, the writing group activity began on the second floor of Zhibushi Bookstore. The group leader, a short-haired woman in her forties, had everyone introduce themselves. When it was Yuwei's turn, she clearly said she was a third-year student in the Chinese Department at Yunnan University and a freelance writer, and she shared her concept for the essay 'Dusk at the Lane'. An auntie suggested checking old shop archives, and a journalist suggested paying attention to the network of neighborhood relationships; she listened carefully and took notes. After the activity ended, she joined a newly created WeChat group of more than thirty people, marking a substantial step into the local creative circle. Afterwards, she went downstairs to thank Uncle Qin for introducing her to the activity. Uncle Qin encouraged her, saying good drafts are refined through mutual critique. Feeling warm inside, she decided to come every week.
location: Second floor, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Night walk home and bedtime ritual
description: Leaving the bookstore, the night breeze carried the cool of autumn. Yuwei walked home along Wenlin Street and turned onto the paths near Green Lake Park, replaying the details of the writing group's discussion along the way. The suggestions about selecting material and perspective stirred ripples in her mind; she felt her essays now had several new directions to explore. After arriving home shortly after nine, she changed into pajamas, sat down at her desk, opened her journal, and used dried-branch and book-shaped stickers for the two 'firsts' of the day—the flower arrangement exam and the writing group—then carefully wrote down the core suggestions and reflections with her fountain pen. Afterward, she washed up thoroughly and relaxed, leaned against the headboard, opened the magazine South of the Clouds, and read a few short essays. Then she turned off the light and did fifteen minutes of bedtime meditation, savoring all the warm memories of the day: the touch of dried branches, the purple of the gentians, the red of the smoke tree leaves, Su Man's smile, Uncle Qin's concern, and the faces of the writing group. Filled with peace, she fell asleep with a smile at 22:30.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning preparation
description: The 6:00 alarm went off right on time. Sun Yuwei hesitated for a moment, then remembered her half-marathon goal and the peace that morning runs bring. She got up, pulled on an old light-blue athletic T-shirt and black shorts, tied her hair into a ponytail, took two sips of warm water from the bedside table, and prepared to start the new day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run and getting there and back
description: At 6:10, Yuwei quietly left the house and walked along Huashan West Road to the Panlong River, reaching the trail entrance 5 minutes later. She then started a 3-kilometer jog along the Panlong River trail at a cadence of 170 steps per minute, finishing in 21 minutes 45 seconds with a pace of 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. After the run, she did a full set of static leg stretches on the riverside viewing platform, watching a white egret standing on one leg in the river and feeling serene. After stretching, at 6:55 she walked back the same way and arrived home 5 minutes later.
location: Huashan West Road and the riverside trail along Panlong River, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bath and Relaxation
description: After returning home, Yuwei first took a hot shower to wash off the sweat, then took out a foam roller and rolled on the floor for 10 minutes on her calves and the fronts of her thighs, and did hip stretches to relieve the muscle soreness from yesterday's running.
location: Bathroom and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and chores
description: Mother Li Xiulan cooked steaming hot small-pot rice noodles, and the family of three sat around the table for breakfast. Yuwei talked about her morning run experience, her father reminded her to mind her knees, and her mother shared a story about a colleague's child completing a half marathon. After breakfast, Yuwei proactively washed the dishes and then went back to her room to tidy her desk and bookshelf, wipe the dust off the book spines, and water the pothos.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: home dining room, kitchen, and bedroom.

name: Journal making and planning
description: Yuwei took out her newly purchased September-October planner, drew a calendar in pencil, marked October 3 as the manuscript deadline and October 4 as the flower market appointment with Su Man, then used a green water-based pen to draw gentian leaf decorations, and used washi tape to make a 'Morning Run Log' frame.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Balcony reading and self-reflection
description: Yuwei brewed Yunnan black tea, moved a rattan chair to the balcony, and her cat Tuantuan curled up at her feet. She opened the magazine "Dianchi" and read an essay describing the smells of Kunming's old streets. Reminded of the writing group discussion, she decided to focus on learning the technique of "scent writing" while close-reading "Scenes of a Small Town." She stroked the warm teacup as she read.
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Studied reference books and took notes.
description: Yuwei sat quietly in her study reading Small Town Scenes, borrowed from Uncle Qin. She especially liked how the author used smells to approach urban memory, and thought this technique could be borrowed for her essay Dusk at the Lane Entrance. She highlighted wonderful passages with a highlighter and copied three detailed descriptions into her notebook, such as the shopkeeper's tea fragrance mixed with the smell of old books and ink. She was so immersed that she didn't notice it was already noon.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch
description: Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother trim vegetables and peel garlic. The family of three sat down for lunch, with dishes of stir-fried seasonal vegetables and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. At the table, Yuwei shared insights from her morning reading, mentioning the charm of “scent writing.” Her father brought up the rural prose he had read in his youth, and the conversation flowed naturally.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday rest and quick sketching
description: After lunch, Yuwei did not immediately take a nap. Instead, she picked up her sketchbook and, from memory, drew a contour line drawing of the egret she had seen during the morning run. After drawing for more than ten minutes, drowsiness set in, so she lay down for a short rest of about 40 minutes.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth study and manuscript planning.
description: After getting up full of energy, Yuwei reopened Scenes of a Small Town and tried to break down its writing framework. She found that each chapter starts with a signature scent and then brings out the local scenery and customs. She decided to use “the toasty fragrance of sugar-roasted chestnuts,” “the numbing and spicy flavor of Sichuan hot pot,” and “the delicate sweetness of jasmine tea” to connect three memories in her essay “Dusk at the Alleyway.” She drew a mind map and opened the memo app on her phone to jot down a few sentences that flashed through her mind.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon rest and reading
description: Feeling mentally drained, Yuwei made a cup of homemade brown sugar pearl milk tea with brown sugar pearls and milk, and stood by the window daydreaming, watching pedestrians in the alley. Then she picked up the magazine “Dianchi” and flipped through the remaining pages, reading a short piece about the history of Green Lake. Afterward, she changed into a long-sleeved dress and prepared to go for a walk with her parents.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: kitchen, living room, and bedroom.

name: Accompanying parents for a walk at Cuihu Lake and returning home.
description: The family of three set out on foot from home, with Yuwei holding her mother's arm and her father walking beside them. They went south along Huashan South Road through small alleys and reached the south gate of Green Lake Park in about 15 minutes. Strolling along the lake, with the afterglow of the setting sun spreading over the water, Yuwei talked about how she felt when she saw egrets during her morning run. Her father reminded her about running form and knees, and her mother shared the half-marathon experience of a colleague's child. At the water-side platform, Yuwei took a few photos of the sunset with her phone. As it grew dark, the family started back. On the way, they bought winter jujubes and pomegranates at the fruit stand near the entrance of the residential area. Yuwei helped her mother carry the bags, and they chatted as they walked home.
location: Green Lake Park and the fruit stall downstairs at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: After returning home, Yuwei helped her mother wash the winter jujubes and arrange them on a plate, then tidied the coffee table. While her mother was cooking, she replied to WeChat messages on the sofa, including sharing sunset photos with Wenzi and replying to roommate Linlin's question about tomorrow's class. Dinner was braised pork with chestnuts, stir-fried lotus root slices, and seaweed egg drop soup. The family of three chatted about tomorrow's plans while eating: her father mentioned the planning meeting for the Double Ninth Festival event, her mother wanted to experiment with new recipes, and Yuwei was about to start her final sprint toward the submission deadline.
location: At home: kitchen, living room, and dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: WeChat communication and writing brainstorming
description: Yuwei opened WeChat in her study, replied to editor Xu Mingyuan to confirm the manuscript progress, and shared what she had gained from reading Small Town Scenes. In the writing group chat, she liked and encouraged the excerpts members shared. After that, she opened Notes, organized the three scent materials and structural framework she had thought of in the afternoon, and worked out the final part of the essay.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening journaling.
description: Yuwei took out her journal and pencil case, decorated the blank pages with washi tape, and based on the egret she had seen on her morning run and the sunset over Green Lake in the evening, she painted a watercolor sketch. Then, with her fountain pen, she recorded the important tasks of the day: a 3 km morning run, close reading of “Small Town Scenery” and completing a mind map, and accompanying her parents for a walk. Finally, she wrote in the corner of the journal: “The egret standing on one leg is the most peaceful scene of today.”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: Yuwei first carefully completed her evening skincare routine, then prepared hot water with bath salts to soak her feet for 20 minutes to relieve fatigue. After changing into her pajamas, she wrote in her gratitude journal: passing the flower arrangement exam, seeing an egret during the morning run, and spending a fulfilling time with her family. She then used the Tide app for 15 minutes of meditation. After meditating, she read 'Selected Essays of Wang Zengqi' for 10 minutes, and finally turned off the lights at 22:30 and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: The alarm rang softly. Sun Yuwei slowly sat up and pulled open a corner of the curtain. Outside the window was a typical cloudy autumn day in Kunming, with cool and pleasant air. She sat cross-legged on the yoga mat and did about ten minutes of breathing meditation to settle her mind from yesterday's reading, followed by about five minutes of simple stretching to wake up her sleeping body. After washing up, she changed into comfortable loungewear. She glanced at the white egret journal she had finished the night before on her desk, felt pleased, checked today's to-do notes, and confirmed the plans to pick up books, call her advisor, and go for an evening run.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - bedroom and bathroom at home

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Mother Li Xiulan had already prepared steaming hot small-pot rice noodles, filling the air with the rich aroma of minced meat sauce and chives. Father Sun Mingyuan was browsing the news on his phone while chatting with Sun Yuwei about last night's news. Sun Yuwei shared her plans for the day: go to Mingyuan Bookstore in the morning to pick up a book, call her advisor in the afternoon, and go for a run in the evening. Listening to her mother's reminder not to push herself too hard, she felt warm inside.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to Mingyuan Bookstore, picking up a book to read, and running into a literary friend
description: Sun Yuwei slung on her canvas bag containing a notebook, sticky notes, and a draft proposal, grabbed her phone and keys, said goodbye to her parents, and strolled leisurely toward Wenlin Street. On the way, she passed several flower shops and steamed-bun shops that had just opened, feeling the morning life of the Green Lake area. After arriving at Mingyuan Bookstore, the owner Qin Mingyuan brought out Jiangnan Sketches and Small-Town Scenes wrapped in a kraft paper bag. After she paid by scanning a QR code, Qin Mingyuan recommended several newly arrived essay collections by Yunnan local authors. She happily browsed them and, sitting on an old sofa by the window, quickly went through the tables of contents and prefaces of the two books, sketching out their overall structure in her notebook. Meanwhile, Zhang Xin, a city newspaper reporter she knew from a writing group, also came to buy books. The two briefly exchanged their thoughts on Jiangnan Sketches and looked forward to seeing each other at the next group activity.
location: Walk from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 174 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Bought fruit and walked home.
description: After leaving the bookstore, Sun Yuwei stopped by the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at the street corner and bought a few fresh crisp persimmons, a box of purple-red raspberries, and a bunch of Shine Muscat grapes, thinking they would make good snacks while reading in the afternoon. Carrying the fruit bag, she slowly walked home. Sunlight spilled through the plane trees onto the ground, and the gentle autumn day lifted her spirits. When she got home, she washed the fruit and put it on a plate, then returned to the study and sat down at her desk.
location: Walking back from Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to her home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: In-depth reading and planning in the morning
description: Sun Yuwei took out Random Notes on Jiangnan and focused on reading the first chapter at her desk. She read very carefully, using sticky notes of different colors to mark the core elements that could become market selling points: the meticulous portrayal of a "sense of place," the warm stories of "humanistic care," and the popular-science passages with a "light knowledge load." After finishing each chapter, she filled the key points from the sticky notes into the already drafted proposal framework.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Her mother, Li Xiulan, made stir-fried seasonal vegetables, stir-fried porcini mushrooms, and tomato and egg soup — a simple yet thoughtful autumn lunch. At the table, Sun Yuwei shared some of her thoughts on 'Jiangnan Notes,' and her parents listened patiently. Her mother even suggested taking them to the Jiangnan towns described in the book next year, and she smiled and agreed.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and afternoon reading and organizing.
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei did not go straight back to her desk. She lay half-reclined on the sofa and did a short 15-minute meditation, listening to soothing white noise. After her body and mind were fully rested, she sat up on time. Refreshed, she continued studying Chapter 2 and part of Chapter 3, and, following the writing techniques in the book, tried rewriting some descriptive passages from her own Dusk at the Lane Entrance to make them more vivid, and noted down these inspirations. At the same time, she digitized all the sticky notes she had marked today and filled in the selling-point analysis in the corresponding planning document.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China; home study and sofa

name: Consulted advisor by phone and organized key points
description: Sun Yuwei made a WeChat call to her advisor Wu Mingyuan, succinctly explaining her positioning of the essay collection proposal around a 'cultural travel perspective' and 'local young observer' angle, and asked for his advice. Professor Wu agreed strongly but emphasized that 'the data must be current,' reminding her to be sure to use the latest city travel data from 2025 as support. The 40-minute conversation made the focus of the proposal suddenly clear to her. After hanging up, she immediately took out her notebook, added a new section titled '2025 Data Support' to the proposal document, and quickly jotted down the keywords and directions Professor Wu had raised. Then she sorted and organized all of the day's drafts, sticky notes, and electronic documents.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Get ready for exercise and go to the park to warm up.
description: Sun Yuwei changed out of her loungewear, put on a sports T-shirt and shorts, tied her running shoes, drank a small cup of warm honey water, and ate a banana to store up energy for the evening run. She also fully charged her phone and brought her wireless earbuds. She then walked five minutes to the south gate of Cuihu Park and chose the quiet trail near Cuihu West Road. After reaching the meeting point, she did a five-minute dynamic warm-up, including high knees, jumping jacks, and lunge stretches. Coach He Lu had not arrived yet, so she sat on a bench by the lake and scrolled through WeChat Moments for a while, seeing members of the writing group chat sharing photos of the sky they had taken that day.
location: Walk from Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to the west gate entrance of Green Lake Park on Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Running training with the coach and post-run conversation
description: He Lu arrived on time. After a brief chat, the two started running side by side at a steady pace. He Lu set the pace for the first half, and Sun Yuwei kept close behind. Midway, He Lu kindly reminded her to watch her breathing rhythm. They completed the 4 kilometers in a pleasant rhythm. After the run, they did a systematic stretching routine together. Sun Yuwei took off her earphones, sat on a bench to drink water, and mentioned that she had signed up for the Kunming Half Marathon early next year. He Lu excitedly high-fived her and said that from next week they could add interval running and strength training, and she would help her work out a plan. Sun Yuwei readily agreed.
location: Cuihu Park lakeside walking path and west gate entrance, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home and showering
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, Sun Yuwei walked home briskly. She was sweaty but felt refreshed. Once home, she took a hot shower, changed into clean pajamas, and felt completely fresh.
location: Returned from Cuihu Park to her home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and took a bath.

name: Family dinner and leisure
description: Dinner was mother Li Xiulan's specialty: braised pork with chestnuts and cucumber salad. At the table, Sun Yuwei shared the refreshing feeling of being fully open and light after running, and her plan to add interval runs next week. Father Sun Mingyuan reminded her to protect her knees. After dinner, she sat on the living room sofa with her parents, watching the news and chatting for a while.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening review and free reading.
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her study, took out her beloved journal, and with new watercolor paints drew a simple running figure in light blue strokes. Then she neatly recorded today's running data: 4 km, average pace 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer, and wrote her thoughts: 'Running side by side with Lulu by the lake, the wind is sweet, and the body feels strong.' After that, she also carefully noted in the 'Writing Notes' section of her journal the key inspirations for the proposal she had gained that day from Casual Notes on Jiangnan and Professor Wu. After finishing the journal, she picked up Wang Zengqi's Life Is Great Fun and turned to the pages where he writes about Kunming cuisine. The familiar words brought her deep comfort.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime gratitude meditation and reading to fall asleep
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light, and followed her routine with a 15-minute pre-sleep meditation, imagining herself running at a steady pace along the shore of Green Lake, body and mind united, breath and steps in sync. After meditation, she wrote a short 'three things to be grateful for' note in her phone memo, including today's delicious rice noodles, Teacher Wu's patient guidance, and the pleasant feeling after running. Then she leaned against the headboard and continued reading Wang Zengqi's collection of essays, reading two essays about Kunming, and her mood calmed down. At 21:00, she set tomorrow's alarm, turned off the reading light, slipped comfortably into bed, and with the fresh satisfaction of an active body, soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation, stretching, and a morning run along the Panlong River
description: After waking up naturally one minute before the alarm went off, Sun Yuwei did ten minutes of breathing meditation in bed, then about 25 minutes of morning stretching, focusing mainly on her shoulders, neck, hips, and Achilles tendons. After changing into a sports top and leggings, she walked about 5 minutes to the bank of the Panlong River, opened the running app and metronome, and did an easy 3-kilometer run with a target pace of 7:05. The air by the river was moist, carrying the fresh scent of water plants and soil. After the run, she did thorough static stretching on a riverside bench, feeling the stretch in her leg muscles.
location: Riverside walkway along the Panlong River, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China, and home in Cuihu Community

name: Going home for a shower, breakfast with parents, and writing preparation.
description: Sun Yuwei walked home and took a warm shower. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared steaming hot small-pot rice noodles with chives, pickled mustard greens, and luncheon meat, along with hot milk and flower pastries. She chatted with her father, Sun Mingyuan, and her mother about her morning run while eating, and her mother reminded her to take care of her knees. After the meal, she went back to the study, first placing Jiangnan Sketches and Scenes of a Small Town on the desk, watering the pothos, and wiping down the desk. Then she brewed a cup of black coffee with a Moka pot, opened her laptop, and prepared for the morning's writing.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Going to the inspection station to complete the annual vehicle inspection
description: Sun Yuwei drove to Kunming No. 9 Motor Vehicle Safety Inspection Station to handle her vehicle's annual inspection. Under the guidance of the staff, she completed checks including exterior condition, exhaust emissions, and braking performance. After waiting about 20 minutes, she obtained the annual inspection certificate and then drove home.
location: Kunming No. 9 Motor Vehicle Safety and Technical Inspection Station, No. 366 Haitun Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Write the topic proposal for "Slow Travel Notes"
description: Sun Yuwei was deeply engaged in writing in her study. She opened the proposal document and, referring to the key points discussed with Professor Wu earlier, began writing the “Content Summary” and “Target Reader Analysis” sections. She positioned her essay collection as “a cultural ramble by a post-90s local observer”, cited the compiled Jiangnan Travel Notes as a market comparison case, and used her phone to look up the latest data released by the Kunming cultural and tourism department in 2025 to supplement the proposal. She wrote a full three-page document with a preliminary structure.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Have lunch with parents and take a midday nap.
description: For lunch, her mother had made stir-fried seasonal vegetables and shredded pork with green peppers, plus the braised beef her father had specially bought. Sun Yuwei briefly mentioned to her parents the progress of the morning's annual inspection and proposal writing. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, expressed support for her writing plan and recalled his own passion for organizing cultural activities in his youth. After lunch, Sun Yuwei went back to her room for a 20-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon yoga class.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Make milk tea and head to the yoga studio for a vinyasa yoga class.
description: After waking from her nap, Sun Yuwei took out homemade brown sugar tapioca pearls from the refrigerator and made herself a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea, while playing the indie folk playlist recommended by Culture Horizon. Then she changed into her yoga clothes, picked up her gear, and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. In the vinyasa flow class, which focused on core strength and inversion sequences, she successfully challenged a headstand with the assistance of her instructor He Lu and held it steadily for about one minute. After class, He Lu praised her progress and confirmed with her the floral design details for the outdoor flower-arrangement yoga event at Fuxian Lake at the end of October, agreeing to use eucalyptus leaves and white primary flowers to create a cool, natural feel.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Shopping on the way home and discussing floral arrangement details with He Lu
description: After the yoga class, Sun Yuwei stopped by Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on the way and bought fresh blueberries, plain yogurt, and whole-wheat bread, then walked home. After putting the ingredients away, she opened WeChat and saw the flower arrangement layout sketch He Lu had sent. Drawing on the concept of 'Slow Walk Notes,' she replied with her thoughts on flower selection and placement, and the two quickly reached an agreement.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Revise and polish the proposal, back up files, and rest
description: Sun Yuwei read through the proposal she had written in the morning from beginning to end and polished it sentence by sentence, giving it more of the beauty of a travel essay and a youthful perspective. She also added a suggestion for combined online and offline marketing through Xiaohongshu and signings at independent bookstores. After confirming that the cited data sources were accurate, she generated the document as a PDF, saved it in the Slow Travel Collection project folder, and copied it to a USB drive as a backup. Then she stood up, stretched her neck and shoulders, made herself a cup of hot tea, and opened the running app to check her monthly mileage data, preparing for the video call with He Lu.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Video call with He Lu to review September running data.
description: Sun Yuwei connected with He Lu via video call on time and shared her September data: a total of 42 kilometers run, with the longest single run being 4 kilometers. He Lu praised her for keeping it up, and together they worked out an October training plan: maintain three runs per week, try a 5-kilometer run once, and add core strength training on Thursday evenings. Looking at the screenshots of the routes they had run, the two felt a strong sense of achievement.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Helped in the kitchen and had dinner with my parents
description: Sun Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother, washing and chopping vegetables, while her mother Li Xiulan cooked the braised pork with chestnuts, stir-fried choy sum, and tomato and egg drop soup that her father had suggested. The family of three sat around the dining table, chatting about how she felt writing the proposal that day and their plan to go to Snail Livehouse in the evening to watch the 'Erhai West' band perform. Her mother told her to be safe, and her father praised the band's name for its charm.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Taking a Walk with Her Parents in Cuihu Park
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei walked slowly along Green Lake Park with her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan. The moon had risen, and the evening breeze carried the scent of the lake. The family chatted as they walked; her father talked about amusing things at work, and her mother shared neighborhood news. Sun Yuwei linked arms with her mother, enjoying family time. Seeing someone running by the lake, her father teased her to keep up with her exercise. They returned after about 30 minutes of walking.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Prepare to go out and head to Snail Livehouse
description: Sun Yuwei returned home, changed into a white cotton-linen shirt and dark blue jeans, and put on a crossbody bag. She opened Weibo to confirm that the band 'Erhai West' was playing at Snail Livehouse that night, immediately bought tickets online, browsed social platforms for a while, then put down her phone. Afterwards she went downstairs, scanned the code for a shared bike, and rode about 10 minutes to Snail Livehouse on Jianshe Road.
location: Snail Livehouse, Jianshe Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China.

name: Watched a folk music performance and recorded inspiration.
description: The performance started right on time. Under the dim lights, the band "Erhai West" played songs about Dian Lake and love with acoustic guitar melodies and the lead singer's slightly husky voice. Sun Yuwei swayed gently in the crowd, deeply moved by several songs, her eyes growing hot. After the show, she bought a signed album at the bar and talked briefly with the lead singer, praising the music as poetic. When it was over, she cycled home, put the album on repeat in the CD player, opened her journal, and wrote: "Like a dream—guitar, soft singing, that love poem about Dian Lake. On the last day of September, healed by music." She also drew a simple little guitar beside it, and decided to use one of the songs as background music for a new essay.
location: Snail Livehouse, Jianshe Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and going to bed.
description: Although her mind was racing, Sun Yuwei still forced herself to complete a 10-minute bedtime meditation, adjusting her breath and feeling her body gradually settle from active to calm. At the end of the meditation, she practiced gratitude: 'Thank you for all of today's creative sparks, music, family love, and friendship. September, a perfect conclusion.' Then she turned off the lamp, relaxed her body to the album's melody, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning meditation, stretching, and breakfast
description: After waking up, you kept your eyes closed and did a 5-minute breathing meditation in bed, feeling your body wake up. Then you did a 15-minute full-body stretch on the yoga mat, focusing on your shoulders, neck, and hips. After washing up, you went to the dining room, where your mother had already made piping-hot small-pot rice noodles, served with a fried egg and milk. Your father was watching the morning news, and Sun Yuwei shared the folk album from last night's performance. The family chatted casually about their National Day plans. After breakfast, you returned to your room, changed into a white linen shirt and khaki cargo pants, threw on a thin denim jacket, carefully checked the mirrorless camera's battery, memory card, and spare battery, and put the tripod and thermos into your backpack.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning photos of ginkgo trees on Wenlin Street
description: After walking about 5 minutes, she arrived at Wenlin Street. The street was still quiet, and morning light cast dappled shadows through the yellowing ginkgo leaves. Sun Yuwei walked along the street looking for the best camera position, trying various angles: shooting upward to capture the light filtering through the leaves, framing the golden tree crowns with the old teaching building, and snapping a back view of an elderly person walking a dog on the fallen leaves. She carefully adjusted the aperture and shutter speed, took more than 40 photos, and was immersed in capturing the beauty of autumn.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Running training along the Panlong River
description: Quickly changed into a quick-dry running T-shirt and shorts in the public restroom on Wenlin Street, locked the backpack, and walked 5 minutes to the entrance of the Panlong River trail. Ran 4.5 kilometers along the river at about 7 minutes per kilometer. The river surface was sparkling, with an occasional waterbird flying past. Along the way, I adjusted my pace to overcome fatigue. After the run, did a full set of stretches in the fitness area and recorded the data on my phone: total time 31 minutes 38 seconds, average heart rate 154 beats per minute.
location: Riverside walkway along the Panlong River, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (Renmin Middle Road to Dongfeng West Road section)

name: Personal organizing and journaling.
description: After running, I walked home along Renmin Middle Road and arrived in about 15 minutes. I took a hot shower, changed into clean loungewear, sat down at my desk, and recorded my morning run experience and the autumn scenery by the river in my journal. Then I ate half a red-fleshed dragon fruit and a banana to replenish my energy.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: National Day lunch and housework
description: Dad cooked stir-fried bitter melon, stir-fried beef, and tomato egg drop soup. While eating, Sun Yuwei shared the ginkgo photos she had just taken on her phone and promised to accompany her parents on a walk around Cuihu Park tomorrow. After the meal, she took the initiative to clear the dishes, wiped the kitchen counter, and washed fruit together with her mother.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Setting up the writing workspace.
description: She walked to Zhibushi Bookstore carrying a cloth bag containing handwritten slogans, maple-leaf bookmarks, a vase, and daisies. At her regular window-side seat on the second floor, she removed the old stickers, used paper tape to form a heart with the Happy National Day slogan and the bookmarks, trimmed the daisies, and placed them in the vase. Then she cleared off the desk, sorted the scattered manuscripts, interview notebooks, and reference books, and put them away, restoring the desk to a neat and refreshing state. During this time, she greeted Uncle Qin, the bookstore owner.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Column writing and reading exchange
description: She opened her laptop and worked on a draft for the "Slices of Kunming" column titled "Kunming's Autumn Sounds." Combining the morning's impressions of ginkgo sounds and river sounds with earlier source material, she focused on writing about 800 characters of the opening and an outline of the paragraphs. After pausing at the end of a section, she went downstairs to the literature area and read two chapters of a newly arrived essay collection by Kyoto artisans. Later, she chatted with Uncle Qin, who was sorting through new books, and shared her marathon plan for the next day. Uncle Qin encouraged her and told stories of riding around Dianchi Lake in his youth.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Purchase supplies at the supermarket.
description: Walked about 20 minutes from the bookstore along Cuihu North Road and turned onto Fuchun Street to reach Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. Following the list, she bought three bananas, two loaves of whole wheat bread, two bottles of sports drink, and a bag of salt tablets, and bought a small bottle of jujube flower honey for her mother. She waited in line to check out and put all the items into her own cloth bag.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Went home to rest and chatted with family
description: Carrying a cloth bag, Sun Yuwei walked home along Fuchun Street and arrived in about 15 minutes. Feeling a little tired, she slumped onto the living-room sofa to rest; her mother was watching the National Day special on TV. Sun Yuwei leaned against her mother's shoulder, chatting about the marathon plans for tomorrow and the watercolor technique she wanted to try that evening, and peeled a banana to share with her mother.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Mushroom hot pot dinner.
description: Prepared dinner with my mother. Mom washed porcini, termite, and king oyster mushrooms; Sun Yuwei washed vegetables, cut tofu, and made dipping sauce, learning to slice the mushrooms to an even thickness. At dinner, a mushroom hot pot with a three-delicacy soup base simmered on the induction cooker. The family sat together, serving food to Mom and Dad; Dad told amusing stories from work, occasional fireworks sounded outside the window, and the National Day gala played on TV. It was warm and satisfying.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Comprehensive watercolor technique practice
description: Set up the easel, prepared watercolor paper, paints, brushes, and masking fluid. First sketched the bouquet outline with a pencil. Using the wet-on-wet technique, I applied clear water to the main flower head areas and dotted in pink and light yellow base colors. When half dry, I used dry brush layering to depict petal textures and shadow layers. Finally, I used masking fluid for highlights. After completing it, I pasted the painting into my journal and noted technique insights: the base color needs to be thinner, and the edges are slightly hard after removing the masking fluid.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Music appreciation, tool cleaning, and pre-competition preparation.
description: Played the folk album bought yesterday and listened while carefully cleaning the brushes, palette, and brush washer. Then opened the wardrobe, took out the dedicated sports backpack, wiped the running shoes with a slightly damp tissue, and placed them on the windowsill to air out. Folded the quick-dry workout clothes into the bag, carefully pinned the race number onto the left chest of the race T-shirt, filled the water bottle, and packed energy gels and salt tablets.
