Sent He Lu a WeChat message to confirm the 7 a.m. meeting tomorrow and got an 'OK' plus a cheering emoji in reply.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening relaxing skincare and yoga
description: Did a thorough evening skincare routine: removed makeup, cleansed, applied toner, serum, and lotion. Changed into comfortable pajamas and did 10 minutes of pre-bed yin yoga on the floor, focusing on stretching the back of the thighs and hips to loosen the muscles for tomorrow's long run.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Reading and relaxing before bed
description: She turned off the main light, leaving only a warm yellow night lamp on, and leaned against the headboard to read What I Talk About When I Talk About Running on her Kindle for about ten minutes, feeling increasingly drowsy. After closing the Kindle, she massaged her Jingming acupoints and temples and went over tomorrow's race route in her head.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Sleep
description: Closing her eyes and adjusting her breathing, she quickly fell into a quiet slumber. Her body was repaired and recharged in deep sleep. In her dream, she ran easily along the track by Dianchi Lake, welcoming the brilliant morning sun.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up naturally in the morning light, with the birdsong from Green Lake outside the window clearly audible. Weighed 45.9 kg. After a quick wash-up, I changed into a quick-dry sports T-shirt and shorts, applied sunscreen carefully, checked the phone, energy gel, and a small bottle of water in my waist pack, put on running shoes, and started the new day full of energy.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Photographing the ginkgo trees on Wenlin Street
description: Walked to Wenlin Street, used the soft morning light to photograph ginkgo trees, tried low-angle shots looking up at the canopy against the blue sky, used a macro lens for close-ups of water droplets and leaf textures, and captured a shot of an elderly person practicing tai chi framed with falling ginkgo leaves. Took about 50 photos in total.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and heading to the marathon starting point.
description: At a snack shop on the corner of Wenlin Street, she bought grilled erkuai rice cakes and hot soy milk for breakfast. Eating as she walked, she headed to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 2, transferred to Line 3, and then to Line 5 to reach Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center. Along the way, she wore earphones and listened to upbeat rhythmic music to warm up for the race. The carriage was full of runners in athletic gear, and the festive atmosphere was strong.
location: Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center, Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Participated in the Highland Half Marathon 5K health run.
description: She met her running partner He Lu at Dianchi Convention and Exhibition Center Square. They warmed up together and stored their bags. The race started at 8:30 with the gun. She kept a steady pace of 7 minutes per kilometer, while He Lu chatted beside her to distract her. She took water once at the 2.5 km mark and finally finished in about 35 minutes and 8 seconds. At the finish line, she took photos with He Lu and received a commemorative medal, then stretched carefully after the race.
location: Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center on Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the Panlong River course.

name: Reserve a family portrait photo shoot.
description: After finishing the run, took a selfie with He Lu in the rest area at the finish line using her phone, then sat on a bench and called the "Time Memory" photo studio to confirm the Republic of China-style family portrait session at 10 a.m. tomorrow (October 3). She communicated the costume sizes: her father's dark long gown (180/96A), her mother's blue embroidered cheongsam, her own S-size student outfit, and her older sister Sun Yutong's clothing size. Then she notified family members of tomorrow's time and dress code in the family group chat; her sister replied instantly to confirm. He Lu overheard and envied the family's warmth.
location: Terminal rest area at the Dianchi Convention and Exhibition Center, Huanhu East Road, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go home and rest, check the family photo outfits, and do some free reading.
description: She took a taxi from the Convention and Exhibition Center and arrived home in Cuihu Community about 30 minutes later. After a hot shower, she changed into loungewear. Thinking about the family portrait, she found her father's long gown, her mother's cheongsam, her own student outfit, and the clothes whose size her sister had confirmed, hung them up, and put them in dust-proof bags. She took a photo and sent it to her sister for another confirmation. Then she made tea, browsed the essay collection in the study, enjoyed a moment of peace, and checked the fridge, planning to help her mother prepare lunch.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sharing lunch with family and preparing for a midday rest.
description: Lunch was the clear-broth beef rice noodles my mother made, served with home-pickled mustard greens and mint. While eating, I animatedly recounted my running experience, showing the sprint photos and medal on my phone. My father teased me with words but had a smile in his eyes, while my mother kept adding food to my bowl. After the meal, I went back to my room to rest for half an hour, imported the morning's photos to the computer and browsed through them, and also found the Dali travel guide and notebook to prepare for my afternoon meeting with Fang Qing.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Planning a volunteer trip to Dali with Fang Qing
description: Walked to the usual Pho bo Viet Nam Vietnamese beef noodle soup restaurant on Cuihu North Road and had lunch with my good friend Fang Qing. Then we moved to the Huyin Teahouse on Cuihu South Road and ordered two cups of pu'er tea. Outside the window, Green Lake shimmered. The two of them took out travel guides and phone maps, and finalized the route of starting from Kunming, staying in Weishan Ancient Town for two nights, then moving on to Shaxi Ancient Town. They especially discussed the research topic of going deep into Zhoucheng to learn Bai tie-dye and visiting Xizhou Ancient Town to explore Jiama paper culture, and compared budgets at several youth hostels and guesthouses. The discussion lasted nearly three hours, and the notebook was filled with route maps and ideas.
location: Huyin Teahouse, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (transfer after dining at Guanshi Pho bo Viet Nam restaurant, 70 Cuihu North Road)

name: Bought books at the bookstore, reconfirmed the photo studio, and checked the outfit.
description: I walked from the teahouse to Zhibushi Bookstore. After greeting the owner, Uncle Qin, I went straight to the "Local Culture" section and picked out two books: The Illustrated Handbook of Yunnan Ethnic Handicrafts and Records of Dali Customs. When Uncle Qin learned that I was going to Dali for cultural research, he shared contact information of a few old friends who do field research there. On the way home, I called the "Time Memory" photo studio again to confirm the 10 a.m. photo shoot tomorrow. After arriving home, I carefully checked the buttons and piping on my sister's qipao, confirmed they were flawless, sorted all the family photo clothes by person into dust bags, and hung them in the most conspicuous spot in the dressing room.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the way, via Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District)

name: Dinner and chatting with family
description: For dinner, her father cooked tomato scrambled eggs, green pepper stir-fried pork, and vegetable soup. She continued sharing with her parents the details of the Dali trip she had planned with Fang Qing that afternoon, mentioning tie-dye and jiama paper. Her mother recalled her youth trip to Dali and was deeply impressed by Zhoucheng's tie-dye. Her father reminded her to be careful when going out and said they could go together next time. Laughter kept filling the dining table.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening photo organization and watercolor work
description: Back in the study, she turned on the computer to organize and classify the photos taken today; selected the 9 most satisfying ginkgo photos and one marathon sprint photo, added a caption, and posted them to Moments; flipped through the newly purchased Illustrated Handbook of Yunnan Ethnic Handicrafts, and, based on the afternoon discussion, drew a "Dali Cultural Research Mind Map" in her notebook, marking key interviewees and shooting materials; finally, with the comfortable feeling after running, she painted an abstract watercolor sketch full of a sense of speed.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening stretching, skincare, and meditation.
description: On the yoga mat in the living room, I did a 15-minute gentle stretching routine to ease the muscle soreness after running. Then I went to the bathroom to wash up and carefully completed my evening skincare routine. After turning off the lights, I meditated in bed for 10 minutes, focusing on all the beautiful moments of the day—ginkgo trees, the marathon, family, friends, and future plans. I felt peaceful and joyful inside.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Set an alarm for 8 a.m. the next morning to reserve plenty of time for the family photo. Opened "Records of Dali Customs" and read the preface, deeply drawn in by the descriptions. Turned off the lights at 22:00 sharp and slowly fell asleep, looking forward to tomorrow's family photo and feeling content with the day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Photographing the ginkgo trees on Wenlin Street
description: At 6:20 in the morning, Sun Yuwei put on a comfortable hoodie and sweatpants, took her camera, and went out, walking along Green Lake to Wenlin Street. The sunlight happened to be slanting in, and she concentrated on finding the best angle, trying low-angle shots of the ginkgo canopies so the backlit leaves would look translucent. She particularly captured the moments of several fallen leaves spinning in the air, as well as the interaction between morning exercisers and the golden ground. After a little over an hour, she wrapped up with satisfaction, having taken about 55 shots today.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (North Gate section of Donglu Campus, Yunnan University)

name: Packing up breakfast and returning home
description: After the shoot, Sun Yuwei walked along Wenlin Street to 'Pangdawan Small-Pot Rice Noodles' on Minsheng Street. She ordered takeout of her mother's favorite tofu-pudding rice noodles and bought soy milk and fried dough sticks for herself. The morning breeze carried the scent of osmanthus; she walked home briskly with breakfast in hand.
location: Pangdawan Small-Pot Rice Noodles (Minsheng Street Branch), Block B, Minsheng Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Family breakfast and getting ready.
description: After returning home, her parents had just gotten up not long before. The family of three enjoyed a warm breakfast on the balcony, and her mother was full of praise for the small-pot rice noodles they had bought. After breakfast, the whole family began preparing for the family portrait shoot: Sun Yuwei changed into a pressed blue Republic-era student cheongsam and combed her hair into double braids; her mother also put on the same student outfit with a touch of light makeup. Her father looked at his gray long gown and round-frame sunglasses and paced around the living room testing the effect, while Sun Yuwei snapped several candid shots of him.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to Xingya Photography
description: Sun Yuwei held her mother's arm, with her father following behind. They cut through alleys from Renmin Middle Road to Cuihu North Road, walking 10 minutes to Xingya Photography. Wearing a long gown, her father walked through the neighborhood as neighbors teased him: 'Teacher Sun, you look so stylish today!' He said 'Stop it,' but his face broke into a huge smile.
location: Xingya Photography, 40 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family Portrait Photo Session
description: This photo studio was booked yesterday. The vintage Republic of China style sets suited the family's taste. The makeup artist gave Sun Yuwei and her mother simple hairstyles and light makeup, while her father only needed a quick tidy-up. After changing costumes, the family of three posed in front of the phonograph, rattan chairs, and rickshaw sets, following the photographer's directions for formal family photos, a mother-daughter arm-in-arm shot, and a father seated portrait. Sun Yuwei also suggested a 'playful version' with everyone wearing round-frame sunglasses; the photographer praised the idea, and the whole session was filled with laughter.
location: Xingya Photography, 40 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family portrait photo selection and additional orders
description: The family sat together at the computer selecting photos. In the end, they chose a group photo of the three of them sitting on a rattan chair. Sun Yuwei suggested enlarging it to 40 inches and framing it, and the whole family agreed. Her mother also ordered two additional 6-inch prints on the spot, planning to send them to her older sister and grandmother in Shenzhen. The photo studio staff said the retouched photos would be ready within 7 business days.
location: Xingya Photography, 40 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Move on to Cuihu No. 1.
description: After leaving the photo studio, Sun Yuwei and her parents walked along Cuihu West Road to Cuihu One Boutique Hotel. The autumn sun was warm but not scorching, the lake surface sparkled, and she felt especially cheerful.
location: Cuihu No. 1 Boutique Hotel, No. 1 Cuihu West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: National Day family lunch.
description: Sun Yuwei had checked the review app in advance and decided on a window seat on the second floor of Cuihu No. 1, where the window overlooked the beautiful scenery of Green Lake. She ordered the steam-pot chicken her mother loved, the Yiliang roast duck her father liked, and a few home-style dishes. The family toasted with tea instead of alcohol to celebrate National Day and the rare family time. During the meal, her parents talked about funny and heartwarming stories of Sun Yuwei going to school near Green Lake when she was little.
location: Crane Singing Pavilion Chinese Restaurant, Cuihu No.1 Boutique Hotel, No. 1 Cuihu West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and resting
description: Her parents had other arrangements that afternoon (Dad had agreed to tea with an old friend, and Mom was going to get her hair done), so Sun Yuwei went home alone. She walked home along Green Lake and bought a seasonal osmanthus latte at the entrance to the neighborhood to treat herself in the afternoon.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon solitude: reading and planning.
description: After changing into loungewear and brewing a cup of tea, Sun Yuwei sat down at her desk. She first imported the behind-the-scenes photos and ginkgo tree photos she had taken that morning into her tablet, and created a new album called '2025 National Day Family Day.' Then she opened 'Dali Local Records' and 'An Illustrated Guide to Yunnan Ethnic Handicrafts,' and, based on the 'Dali volunteer travel' plan she had discussed with her friend Fang Qing the day before, marked key spots such as Weishan Ancient City and the tie-dye workshops with colored sticky tabs, and drew an initial research route in her notebook, confirming the leads for her jiama paper research. An osmanthus latte sat nearby, and she sipped it from time to time, in a quiet and fulfilling moment.
location: At her desk at home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to the bookstore.
description: After gathering her books and notebook and putting on her favorite knitted cardigan, Sun Yuwei walked to the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore in Kunming. She loved this route because it wound through several quiet alleys, letting her feel the most everyday atmosphere of the city.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bookstore Exchange and Exploration
description: When she arrived at the bookstore, Uncle Qin was tidying the bookshelves. Sun Yuwei ordered a signature rose latte and sat in her usual seat by the window. She took out the Dali research route map to consult Uncle Qin. He was very interested and pointed out a studio run by an intangible cultural heritage inheritor he knew in Weishan Ancient City, and even wrote her a recommendation note. Afterwards, in the secondhand book section, she found a 1980s copy of 'Collection of Yunnan Folk Literature' and happily added it to her bag.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Leisurely return home
description: Carrying the newly bought old books, Sun Yuwei walked home along Green Lake. In the evening at Green Lake, the setting sun dyed the water gold. An elderly man was playing the erhu, and she stopped to listen for a while, feeling especially peaceful.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: When she got home, her mother was preparing dinner. She reheated the dishes brought back from lunch and stir-fried two vegetable dishes. During dinner, her mother looked through the behind-the-scenes photos taken in the morning, constantly praising how nice they looked, and her father chimed in, saying she looked full of energy today.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: National Day evening walk at Green Lake
description: During the meal, Mom suggested going to see the National Day night view of Green Lake. The family of three slowly walked to the park. In the park, lanterns hung high, and in the square residents had organized an impromptu chorus of revolutionary songs. They took a slow walk around the lake, and Dad, for once, talked about some stories from his youth here. Sun Yuwei listened quietly, feeling that this moment was incredibly precious.
location: Cuihu Park (Little Bird Park), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and music.
description: After returning from the walk, Sun Yuwei took a shower and changed into comfortable pajamas. She took out the newly bought "Compendium of Yunnan Folk Literature" and leafed through a few pages, then took out several family photos and ginkgo photos printed with today's Polaroid camera and carefully pasted them into her journal. In colored pen she wrote: "2025.10.3 National Day | Mom in a cheongsam, Dad in round-framed sunglasses, red songs in the night breeze at Green Lake." Beside her, the Bluetooth speaker played songs by Landlord's Cat, the melody gentle.
location: In the room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening stretching and meditation.
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the main light and lit an aromatherapy candle. Following the yoga app on her phone, she completed a 15-minute evening stretch, easing the slight soreness from the day's walking. Then she sat cross-legged in meditation, doing a 5-minute breathing meditation, reviewing the fulfilling and warm day, with a heart full of gratitude.
location: On the yoga mat in the room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Confirm before bed and go to sleep.
description: Sun Yuwei lay in bed, opened her phone calendar to confirm that tomorrow's schedule did not conflict with tonight's, and set an alarm for 10 a.m. the next morning to accompany her parents around Green Lake. Out of habit, she scrolled through her WeChat Moments and saw that her mother had just posted an update with the caption “The happiest day,” illustrated with the playful group photo from that morning. She quietly liked it. Then she turned off the light and soon fell asleep, satisfied and at peace.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and initial screening of ginkgo photos
description: Waking up in the cool early autumn morning light, I did some simple exercises to wake up my body, including neck stretches and spinal twists. After washing up, I applied moisturizer, then opened my laptop and imported the hundred-plus ginkgo photos taken yesterday into Lightroom, quickly browsed and deleted blurry and duplicate shots, and initially selected about 50 photos worth a closer look. During this, I could faintly hear the sounds of my mother setting out breakfast.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Cuihu Community)

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: I closed the computer and went to the dining room to enjoy the rice noodles and freshly baked rose-flower pastries my mother had prepared. I chatted with my parents and confirmed the plan to accompany them to Cuihu Park. My father said the weather was pleasant for a walk, and my mother happily added another spoonful of soup.
location: Dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Cuihu Community)

name: Accompanied my parents on a visit to Green Lake Park.
description: The family of three walked to Green Lake Park, strolled along the lakeside path, and chatted about the amusing moments from yesterday's family photo while watching the morning exercise scene. Mother noticed the yellowed, withered lotus by the pond and sighed at its beauty of quiet desolation. Sun Yuwei used her phone to take photos of the water reflections and willow branches, and secretly captured a back view of her parents holding hands.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Retouch ginkgo photos and create a journal
description: After returning home from Cuihu, she sat back down at the computer, selected 20 photos with the best composition and tone out of 50, fine-tuned them in Lightroom to enhance the warm autumn feel, and exported them as JPEGs. Then she opened her journal, printed three representative photos with the vintage printer, pasted them on the right side, and noted the shooting parameters and thoughts. On the left side, she wrote down her observations and reflections from accompanying her parents around Cuihu Lake.
location: Study at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road (Cuihu Community), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Research on Jiama paper culture and compilation of related materials
description: Brewed a cup of peppermint tea and started seriously studying the chapter on the folk uses of Bai people's jiama paper in 'The Collection of Yunnan Folk Literature.' Meanwhile, used the computer to look up related academic papers and museum materials, and excerpted key information such as the symbolic meaning of jiama paper patterns and ritual scenes into the electronic document 'Dali Research Travel Handbook.'
location: Study at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road (Cuihu Community), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family lunch time
description: She enjoyed her mother's slow-cooked Chinese yam and pork rib soup, which had a milky white broth, paired with stir-fried pea shoots and dry-fried green beans. At the dinner table, she shared the results of organizing photos and her journal that morning, while her father mentioned his National Day duty arrangement at work. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Cuihu Community)

name: Midday rest and preparation for going out
description: After lunch, she proactively helped clear the dishes, then half-reclined on the living room sofa with a cushion, casually flipping through the songs and legends from the Dali region in 'Collection of Yunnan Folk Literature' to relax. Afterward, she returned to the study, encrypted and saved the document on jiama paper materials, changed into an off-white linen shirt, dark blue wide-leg trousers, and canvas shoes, and put her notebook, pen, power bank, and books into a canvas bag.
location: At home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Cuihu Community)

name: Looked up professional materials on jiama paper at the bookstore.
description: After walking about 15 minutes, she arrived at the familiar Zhibushi Bookstore. After greeting the owner, Uncle Qin, he brought out two professional books for her reference: “Research on Yunnan Ethnic Printmaking and Folk Beliefs” and “Jiama Paper Catalogue”. She sat down by the window and read attentively, copying key points into her notebook as she went.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Strolling along Cuihu North Road and going home to do supplementary research.
description: After leaving the bookstore, I strolled leisurely along Cuihu North Road toward Yuantong Street. I stopped to look at a handmade leather goods shop, and bought two freshly baked savory Guandu flatbreads from a roadside stall. After returning home, I added the new knowledge I had gained from the bookstore to the Jiama paper chapter of the Dali research travel handbook, and, referring to the illustrations in the "Illustrated Catalog of Jiama Paper," I drew a few simple human and animal figures in pencil and labeled their names.
location: Strolling along Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, then returning home to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District

name: Relaxing in the living room and talking with Mom
description: After finishing work, I walked into the living room and saw my mother knitting a sweater. I sat on the carpet beside her feet, turned on the Bluetooth speaker, and played a playlist (which happened to include Chen Li's 'Through a Thousand Hometowns'). I chatted with her about that evening's writing group activity, and she told me not to come home too late and that she had left soup in the pot.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Cuihu Community)

name: Dinner and leaving for the writing group.
description: She had a simple meal, including a bowl of yam and pork rib soup, half a reheated Guandu baba, and side dishes. After saying goodbye to her parents, she walked to Mingyuan Bookstore. On the way, she bought a room-temperature pearl milk tea at a milk tea shop and, while drinking it, sorted out the core thread of her essay outline in her mind.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (dining at home), then walked to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District

name: Writing group activity: Mastering narrative pacing
description: At the second meeting of the writing group at Mingyuan Bookstore, themed 'Mastering Narrative Pacing', I shared the outline of my prose piece and raised the question of how to let memories and reality alternate naturally. Group member Chen Chen suggested using 'imagery' as a connecting thread, and during the break we talked about our favorite writers (we both like Chi Zijian) and added each other on WeChat. In the second half of the activity, I also noted down writing tips shared by others.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and evening foot soak with reading.
description: After the event, she exchanged a few words with Chen Chen and others at the bookstore entrance, then walked home alone, using her phone's memo app to note down the keywords and ideas she had heard. After arriving home, she changed out of her outer clothes, soaked her feet in hot water with the mugwort foot bath pouch her mother had prepared, and read the chapter on the Bai people's Benzhu stories from "Yunnan Folk Literature Collection" to relieve the fatigue of the day.
location: From Cuihu North Road to the bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening skin care, meditation, and journaling
description: After soaking her feet, she did a simple evening skincare routine. Her mother knocked on the door to ask how the event went, and she happily shared her exchange with Chen Chen. After her mother left, she turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside night light, and did a 10-minute meditation to clear her mind. Then she took out her bedside journal and used a green-ink fountain pen to record the day's highlights: morning walk around Green Lake, ginkgo photo journal, progress on jiama research, writing group takeaways, and more. She stamped it with a seal featuring a Green Lake lotus pattern.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Cuihu Community).

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Closed the journal, set the phone alarm, and turned off the night light. Briefly reviewed the things worth being grateful for today, quietly said goodnight to myself, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Cuihu Community).

name: Ginkgo-themed final shoot and morning solitude
description: At 6:00 in the morning, I woke up naturally in the early autumn dawn. After a quick wash, I put on comfortable outdoor clothes, a light gray cashmere scarf, and a backpack with a camera and tripod. At 6:20 I slipped out quietly, walked west along Renmin Middle Road for about 15 minutes, and arrived at Wenlin Street at 6:35. The street was quiet, the morning light gentle, and passersby sparse. I set up the tripod and immersed myself in capturing the translucent texture of ginkgo leaves in low-angle backlight, and also tried slow shutter speed to capture the trajectory of falling leaves. At 8:00, as the morning light brightened, I began packing up. At a corner time-honored breakfast stall, I bought a hot Guandu baba and ate it while walking, arriving home at 8:15.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and morning review
description: She arrived home at 8:30, and her mother had already prepared breakfast. Sitting at the dining table, she drank hot milk and ate flower cakes while quickly browsing today's preview photos on her phone. She was satisfied and marked several well-composed shots, planning to use them as candidates for her photo collection when she organized them later. She also chatted with her mother about the lunch gathering arrangements. Her mother smiled and reminded her to eat more, and she felt very grounded.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Final preparation for submitting the manuscript of Slow Travel Notes
description: At 9:00, she went into the study and officially began the submission preparations for her manuscript. Turning on the computer, she opened the final document of Slow Travel Notes and made one last full proofread, correcting two typos and one punctuation mark. Then, using the printer at home, she carefully printed three single-sided copies and fastened them with binder clips. At 10:15, she started writing personalized submission letters tailored to the different styles of the three publishers: Chuncheng Literature and Art Press, Dianchi Book Society, and Yunling Culture. The letter to Chuncheng Literature and Art highlighted the regional cultural value of the work; the letter to Dianchi Book Society stressed the delicate texture and personal style of the prose; the letter to Yunling Culture emphasized the work's literary quality and depth of thought. Each letter was accompanied by a brief biography and contact details. After everything was done, she placed the three manuscripts into large envelopes prepared in advance and affixed stamps. At 11:40, she stood up, stretched, and took a sip of the chrysanthemum tea that had gone cold, feeling the relief of having completed a major undertaking.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family dinner: mushroom hot pot
description: At 11:50 she changed into going-out clothes and walked with her parents to Junlin Tianxia Hot Pot Restaurant, about 10 minutes away. At 12:00 the family sat down and ordered a classic wild mushroom platter and a free-range chicken soup base. Remembering that she needed to gain weight, she deliberately ate a few extra pieces of the complimentary flower cakes and the piping-hot blue-staining bolete and porcini mushrooms. During lunch, her father asked about the submission; she briefly told him her plans, and he nodded and said, 'If you have an idea, just go for it.' After the meal, feeling a little full, the family chatted about everyday things and walked home.
location: Junlin Tianxia Wild Mushroom Hot Pot, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Jiama paper research and travel journal integration.
description: She got home at 14:00 and sat in the living room for a while. She took out the excerpt notes copied yesterday from Zhibushi Bookstore: "Research on Yunnan Folk Prints and Folk Beliefs" and "A Catalogue of Jiama Paper," along with her journal and travel notebook. Referring to the materials, she drew several simplified talisman patterns onto a new page of her travel journal based on last night's notes about the role of jiama paper in Bai ethnic rituals, and annotated them with "related to the folk customs of Weishan and Shaxi." This process gave her more concrete inspiration for the upcoming field research. At 15:30, she closed the materials, decided to go out for some activity, and take the opportunity to mail her submission letter.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Send the submission letter
description: At 15:40, carrying three large envelopes with stamps already affixed, she walked about 8 minutes (about 550 meters) to the Jiangwutang Post Office on Green Lake West Road. At the counter, she watched the staff member stamp the envelopes one by one with the postmark of October 5, 2025, then solemnly dropped the letters into the mailbox, silently wishing them a bright future.
location: China Post (Jiangwutang Post Office), No. 22 Cuihu West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A stroll around Green Lake
description: After leaving the post office, instead of going straight home, I walked slowly along the flagstone road on the outer edge of Cuihu Park. The autumn breeze blew across the lake, bringing a hint of moisture. Watching the withered lotus leaves in the lake and the occasional sightseeing boats passing by, I felt the tranquility amid the city's hustle and bustle. At 16:10, after walking half a lap around the lake, feeling relaxed and happy, I walked about 8 minutes (about 600 meters) home.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Leisurely reading and relaxation
description: After returning home, she did not immediately dive into work. Instead, she poured a glass of warm water, sat down in a rattan chair on the living room balcony, opened Yunnan Folk Literature Collection, and read a few folktales about Dali. Occasionally, the sounds of children playing downstairs drifted in through the window, and she felt relaxed. At 17:30, her mother began preparing ingredients for dinner, so she went over to help pick green beans for a while, then returned to the balcony to continue reading. At 18:00, she put down the book, feeling calm, and prepared for the evening video call.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Video-called Fang Qing to finalize the travel framework
description: At 20:00, I connected with my close friend Fang Qing in Hangzhou via a WeChat video call. Skipping small talk, we went straight to the travel topic. I opened my journal, while Fang Qing opened a shared document on her computer. We went through the contact information we had each compiled for Weishan Ancient Town, Shaxi Ancient Town, Bai tie-dye experience shops, and jiama paper workshops, and confirmed the daily route and rough time frame. We initially settled on a 7-day route: Kunming, Dali Ancient Town, Weishan, Shaxi, Kunming, and agreed that each of us would book one distinctive guesthouse. We also discussed refining the detailed itinerary again in early next month, and trying to apply for volunteer positions at the tie-dye workshop recommended by Uncle Qin at Zhibushi Bookstore. After the call ended at 21:00, I carefully transcribed the newly confirmed information into the electronic version of my travel handbook.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening relaxation and sound sleep.
description: At 21:15, I started today's relaxation routine. First I spread out the yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of stretching for the shoulders, neck, and back, along with simple yin yoga poses, coordinated with deep breathing, which soothed the fatigue from sitting for long periods during the day. At 21:35, I boiled some hot water and prepared to soak my feet. While soaking my feet, I picked up a collection of essays and read for 20 minutes. At 22:00, I took out my daily journal and recorded today's mood: “The final ginkgo shoot is done, the manuscript has been sent off — a new starting point. The lunch mushroom hotpot was satisfying. The travel framework with Fang Qing is finalized; I feel excited. Good night.” After writing, I turned off the desk lamp and did 5 minutes of meditation to clear my mind. At 22:45, I adjusted my sleeping position; the temperature was just right. Thinking about the future of the manuscript and the trip, I felt both anticipation and serenity, and soon fell asleep.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning routine and journal planning
description: At 7 a.m., Lin Yuwei woke up naturally, weighing 46.4kg. After washing up, she changed into comfortable loungewear, brewed rose tea in the study, opened a new journal, wrote down the date and the opening line, 'The last day of the holiday, let me slowly get back on track,' and listed three important tasks for today: finish English reading aloud, research tie-dye in depth, and hunt for books on Wenlin Street.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Family breakfast and holiday sharing.
description: Lin Yuwei had breakfast with her parents. Her mother had prepared small-pot rice noodles, fried eggs, and braised beef. While eating, she told her parents about the day's plan: study at home in the morning and stroll around Wenlin Street in the afternoon. Her father reminded her to settle down and get ready for class, and her mother smiled and told her not to bring home another big pile of books.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home dining room).

name: Morning English reading of Walden
description: In the study, Lin Yuwei took out the 1985 English original edition of Walden she had picked up yesterday, and used a reading-aloud app to time herself reading Chapter 1, "Economy," for 40 minutes. When she encountered unfamiliar words, she looked them up and annotated the phonetic symbols and definitions in her journal with colored pencils. When she read "The mass of men lead lives of quiet desperation," she savored it repeatedly, drew a simple stick figure in the margin, and felt the power of classic literature.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Research on the tie-dye culture of the Bai people in Dali.
description: She opened the laptop and, using the Illustrated Catalog of Jiama Paper borrowed from Zhibushi Bookstore and the digital materials from the tie-dye workshop recommended by Uncle Qin, systematically studied the origin of tie-dye (traced back to the xie of the Qin and Han dynasties), the process (drawing, tying, immersion dyeing, oxidation, and untying), traditional patterns (butterflies, fish playing among lotus flowers, pomegranates, etc.), and modern innovative applications. In the Dali section of the travel guide, she created a new chapter titled Intangible Cultural Heritage Experience | Tie-Dye, hand-drawing basic tie-dye methods such as stitch binding, clamp binding, and bundle binding, and took notes on the sources and color characteristics of plant dyes such as woad, gromwell, and madder, to prepare for next year's volunteer trip.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Family lunch and rest
description: Mom made tomato egg noodles and cucumber salad as lunch. During the meal, she listened to Dad tell funny stories from work, and after eating she took the initiative to help Mom clear the dishes. Leaning on the sofa in the living room, she scrolled through WeChat Moments, saw a travel post shared by Fang Qing, liked it, and commented, "Looking forward to our volunteer trip!"
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home dining room, living room)

name: Lunch break and preparations to go out
description: Feeling sleepy, she took a 25-minute nap on the sofa. After waking up refreshed, she changed into an off-white linen dress, put on a canvas tote bag, and checked that she had her wallet, phone, and library card. She tidied her hair in front of the entryway mirror, grabbed her folding umbrella, and got ready to go out to Wenlin Street.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (living room and bedroom at home)

name: An afternoon stroll to Wenlin Street
description: Walking out of the residential compound, the afternoon sunlight is soft and the air carries the scent of osmanthus. Heading west along Renmin Middle Road, I pass the south gate of Cuihu Park and turn onto Wenlin Street. The plane tree leaves on both sides of the street are beginning to turn yellow, with dappled light and shadow. After about 30 minutes of walking, I arrive at Wenlin Street and plan to visit the usual secondhand bookstore first.
location: Along the route from Renmin Middle Road to Wenlin Street in Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Came across The Da Vinci Code while browsing at Zhizhi Bookstore.
description: Walking into Zhizhi Bookstore, the air was filled with the distinctive smell of old paper. I stopped before a corner bookshelf piled with books and found a dark green copy of Dan Brown's The Da Vinci Code (English original). It was in excellent condition, so I took it down like a treasure and also picked up an illustrated booklet on the Japanese tea ceremony. At checkout, the owner—an old gentleman with reading glasses—commented that the book combines semiotics and art history and is very enlightening. Lin Yuwei smiled and replied that she was just preparing to learn something new.
location: No. 305 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Zhizhi Bookstore)

name: Visiting Zhibushi Bookstore and talking with Uncle Qin about tie-dye
description: After a 7-minute walk from Zhizhi Bookstore, she arrived at the familiar Zhibushi Bookstore. Pushing open the door, she saw the owner, Qin Mingyuan (Uncle Qin), sorting through newly arrived poetry collections; he invited Lin Yuwei to sit down. Lin Yuwei showed him the newly acquired The Da Vinci Code, and Uncle Qin commented, 'It's popular yet has cultural depth — a good start.' She then asked for advice on the modern design application of Bai tie-dye. Uncle Qin took out a copy of An Illustrated Guide to Contemporary Yunnan Handicrafts from a locked bookcase, pointed to a studio's information, and said, 'This studio is very famous at the creative market; they make canvas bags using tie-dye techniques.' He also used his phone to help her photograph that page.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore owner and mentor

location: No. 32, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Kunming Paper, Cloth & Stone Bookstore)

name: Buy ingredients for intermittent fasting.
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, I walked about 17 minutes to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street. Pushing a shopping cart, I selected ingredients according to the intermittent fasting recipe: a large handful of okra, two heads of broccoli, a box of organic cherry tomatoes, a piece of chicken breast, a box of silken tofu, and a bottle of olive oil. At the checkout, I saw flower cakes, but thinking about my diet plan, I resisted. I walked home slowly carrying the shopping bags.
location: No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket)

name: Organizing takeaways and reading time
description: Back home, she first put the newly bought books on the bookshelf, then used her phone to scan the page of material Uncle Qin recommended and saved it into the 'Dali Volunteer Trip' folder. Next, she made herself a cup of raw Pu'er tea, sat by the window, and began flipping through the preface of The Da Vinci Code, enjoying a peaceful reading time. The light outside the window was warm and soft, and the laziness and fulfillment of the holiday blended perfectly in that moment.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Light dinner and light meal plan discussion
description: My mother made blanched okra, broccoli stir-fried with chicken breast, and tomato tofu soup from the ingredients we bought, all very light and refreshing. During the meal, Lin Yuwei took out her phone and shared the concept of intermittent fasting with her parents: it's not dieting, it's adjusting your diet structure, eating more high-fiber vegetables and reducing refined carbs. Should we start trying tomorrow? Her father thought it was healthy, and her mother suggested writing the plan down and putting it on the fridge. So after dinner, the whole family wrote on a sticky note: this week's light meal plan - half the refined carbs, double the vegetables, no food after 8 p.m. - and stuck it on the refrigerator door.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home dining room).

name: Organize travel journal and listen to folk songs.
description: Back in the study, she made final additions to today's tie-dye research notes and traced the outlines of a few interesting patterns from the Jiama Paper Catalog. Then she pasted into her journal the receipts from buying books on Wenlin Street, chatting with Uncle Qin, and shopping for ingredients, and wrote today's reflection in fountain pen: 'The last day of the holiday was not wasted. Like Thoreau, I want to live deeply, not merely pass by.' She connected her phone to the Bluetooth speaker and played Zhao Lei's Chengdu. The soft singing blended with the deepening night outside the window.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Evening family walk at Green Lake Park
description: Mom suggested 'let's take a walk around Cuihu Lake,' and Dad also agreed. Lin Yuwei changed into light flat shoes and went out with her parents. It took about five minutes on foot from home to Cuihu Park. The evening breeze was slightly cool, and the lights along the lakeside path were soft. The family walked side by side, chatting about the interesting moments of the holiday: the photos from Shenzhen her sister sent, the bookstore they visited today, and the taste of the mooncakes from yesterday's Mid-Autumn Festival. Passing the pavilion in the middle of the lake, they heard elderly people playing instruments and singing, and her mother hummed along for a few lines. This ordinary time spent with her family made her feel immensely at ease.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Reading, yoga stretching, and skincare before bed
description: After returning home from her walk, she first soaked her feet in mugwort water for 10 minutes to relieve the day's fatigue. Then she did 15 minutes of simple stretching on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing her shoulders, neck, and lower back. After washing up, she sat on the bed, took out the Chinese edition of Walden, and read the passage she had read aloud in the afternoon, feeling the subtle differences between the translation and the original. Then she carefully did her evening skincare routine, looking at herself in the mirror and sighing, "Starting tomorrow, I'm a good student again, leaving early and coming back late."
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Pack my backpack and prepare tomorrow's lunchbox
description: Remembering that classes officially start tomorrow, I packed my schoolbag at the desk, putting my textbooks, notebooks, and stationery in their places. Then I remembered my light-meal plan and washed a box of cherry tomatoes, putting them into tomorrow's lunchbox. Lying in bed, I turned off the overhead light and left only a small night light on. I checked my phone out of habit, replied to a few messages from Fang Qing, and agreed to discuss the details of the volunteer trip next week.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Meditation before bed and falling asleep with gratitude
description: Put down her phone, turned off the night light, and lay flat for a 10-minute bedtime meditation. As she breathed deeply, she reviewed the whole day: the English reading gave her an anchor for her heart, the tie-dye research made her curious about an unfamiliar culture, the newly acquired book was a delightful surprise from the trip, the light meal plan was a way of caring for her body, and the walk with her family was a warm backdrop. Filled with calm and fulfillment, she silently said, “Thank you for this fulfilling vacation,” and then fell asleep peacefully.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Wake-up and morning routine
description: Woken by the phone alarm, she felt the slightly cool air of an early autumn morning. Weighed herself: 46.3 kg. Pulled open the curtains to see the ginkgo tree outside the window. While washing up, she silently rehearsed the submission to be mailed out today, a mix of anticipation and nervousness.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, bedroom/bathroom

name: Early morning light walk around Cuihu Lake
description: Put on sports shoes, put on earphones, and walk to Green Lake Park. Walk for about 30 minutes alternating between jogging and brisk walking, breathing fresh air. The earphones play the English audio reading of Walden, learning while exercising.
location: Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (near Huashan West Road)

name: Family breakfast.
description: Walking home, her parents had already prepared breakfast: hot milk, boiled eggs, whole-wheat bread, and kiwifruit. She chatted with her parents over breakfast, shared the scenery of Green Lake, and reminded them of today's light-fasting plan.
location: Dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Sent the submission
description: Checked the three large envelopes, confirmed the addresses and submission letters were correct, and walked to the post office on Zhengyi Road. Mailed three registered letters, filled in the forms, and recorded the tracking numbers and dates in her phone memo.
location: China Post Zhengyi Road Post Office, No. 33 Zhengyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tea talk and book hunting at the bookstore
description: Walked to Zhibushi Bookstore, had tea and a conversation with the owner Qin Mingyuan, sharing my feelings about submitting the manuscript. Lingered in the bookstore, selected "Dali Folk Tie-Dye Art" and an old poetry collection, and received a bookplate as a gift.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organized journal and supplies.
description: After returning home, used a fountain pen to write the registered mail tracking number in the journal, pasted in a bookplate, and pressed a ginkgo leaf. Checked the fridge for light-meal ingredients.
location: Study/living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Lunch was stir-fried broccoli, cold shredded chicken, and tofu soup—light and healthy. I shared with my parents what I saw at the bookstore and how I felt about submitting my article, showed them the tie-dye book, and discussed ideas about a future volunteer trip to Dali.
location: Dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon nap
description: Set a 30-minute alarm, drew the curtains, put on an eye mask, and took a quiet nap. After waking up, she felt refreshed.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing creative work for watercolor class.
description: In the study, preparing for the final project of the watercolor course. Selected a photo of the Lake Heart Pavilion at Cuihu Lake, checked the paints and brushes, mounted the paper on the drawing board, and sketched the outline in pencil. Completely absorbed.
location: Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon relaxation.
description: After finishing the drawing preparations, I drank some warm water to rest and listened to two folk songs. I changed into comfortable walking clothes and soft-soled sneakers, took my water bottle and phone, and waited for my mother to go out.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, living room/bedroom

name: Took a walk with my mother
description: Walked with her mother on Wenlin Street, where the plane trees cast dappled light and shadow. She shared her ideas for completing the watercolor course and her sense of achievement; her mother recalled funny stories of learning Chinese painting in her youth, and they chatted as they walked.
location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping
description: On the walk back, she and her mother went to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, where they bought cherry tomatoes, beech mushrooms, and olive oil to prepare the salad for dinner. Her mother bought vegetables, and after paying they walked home.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Yoga relaxation
description: Changed into yoga clothes and did 15 minutes of gentle stretching in the living room: cat-cow, downward-facing dog, warrior I, etc., to relax the calves and lower back.
location: Living room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Light dinner
description: After showering, I changed into loungewear and had dinner with my parents: light noodle soup, and a cold salad of cherry tomatoes and beech mushrooms. My father asked when my watercolor class would end and reminded me to be safe.
location: Dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for watercolor class
description: She checked the watercolor kit: drawing board, paints, brushes, masking fluid, and so on, and confirmed everything was in order. She put on her backpack, changed shoes, said goodbye to her parents, and set off.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, entryway.

name: Watercolor course final project
description: In Xiuxiu's watercolor class, she freely created Mid-Lake Pavilion at Cuihu Lake. She used the wet-on-wet technique for the base, dry layering for details, and masking fluid for light spots. The teacher guided and encouraged her; the work was well received, and she received a certificate of completion. After saying goodbye to the teacher and classmates, she went home.
location: Xiuxiu Watercolor Class, 2nd Floor, Community Cultural Activity Center, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Works archive
description: After returning home, she took down the painting, pasted a photo of the work into her journal, and recorded the completion note: "2025.10.08, the eight-week watercolor course came to a successful end. 'Morning Egret at Green Lake' is a graduation gift to myself." She tucked in her certificate of completion and wrote a diary entry about how she felt.
location: Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: Soak feet in a mugwort foot bath to relax, listen to folk songs, and send a WeChat message to best friend Zhang Jing to share the joy. Lie in bed with an eye mask, take deep breaths, turn off the lights at 23:00 and fall asleep, feeling peaceful.
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, bedroom/bathroom

name: Morning English reading aloud
description: Woke up at 7:00 sharp to the alarm, did 5 minutes of meditation in bed, then picked up the new edition of Walden beside the bed and continued reading Chapter Three aloud. In today's passage, Thoreau described how he felt nature's gifts through simple living, and I felt a gentle calm. While reading, I noted down the new words 'solitude' and 'contemplation,' planning to copy them into my journal later.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Light breakfast and family time
description: After washing up, she went to the dining room, where her mother had already prepared breakfast: white congee, pickled vegetables, and boiled eggs. Her mother asked if she was going to the bookstore again today. She replied that she would go to Zhibushi in the morning to deal with work, and in the evening she had arranged to go for a walk in Green Lake Park with her father. Her mother said her father had been mentioning since yesterday that he wanted to talk. They ate breakfast quietly together, and sunlight spilled onto the dining table.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Organize new vocabulary journal pages
description: Back in the study, she took out her journal from the drawer. With a fountain pen, she neatly wrote the phonetic symbols, definitions, and example sentences excerpted from the dictionary for the two new words she had recorded that morning. Then she used a pencil to draw a small falling maple leaf, echoing the seasonal transitions described in Walden. After finishing, she closed the notebook with satisfaction, feeling that her mind was ready for the day.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Commuted to Paper Stone Bookstore
description: She put on her backpack, took her laptop and the half-written essay draft, and set off for Zhibushi Bookstore. Walking from Renmin Middle Road westward, she turned into Qianju Street, passed through an alley lined with plane trees, and enjoyed the morning sun along the way, feeling lighthearted.
location: Walk from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province to Paper Stone Bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road

name: Handling submission follow-ups and email communication.
description: She sat down in her usual window seat at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore and ordered a cup of Pu'er tea. Opening her laptop, she created a new Excel spreadsheet titled Slow Travel Notes Submission Tracker and entered the registered-mail numbers and recipient information for the letters she had sent yesterday to Spring City Literature and Art Publishing House, Dianchi Book Society, and Yunling Culture. Then she wrote an email to her supervisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, giving a detailed report on the latest revisions to the manuscript and explaining the details added to the final table of contents, and asked for his guidance. Afterward, she checked the feedback from Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Horizon, and confirmed that the outline was acceptable.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walking by Green Lake and conceiving a new essay
description: After leaving the bookstore, walked along Cuihu North Road for 20 minutes to give my overused eyes some rest. The autumn sunlight was warm and gentle, sparkling on the lake. Watching the willows and yellow leaves by the lake, I began to draft the essay on “Kunming Autumn” at the editor's request. Recalling the scene a few days earlier by Green Lake of a child picking up fallen leaves and running in the wind, I decided to use “the sound of falling leaves” as the entry point and write an essay about childhood, autumn, and the passage of time. Sat down on a quiet bench and quickly jotted down a few keywords in my notebook.
location: Lakeside footpath along Cuihu North Road, Green Lake Park, 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home and household chores
description: After the walk, I strolled home. On the way, I passed the small vegetable stall at the entrance of Cuihu Community and bought a few tomatoes and a bunch of scallions, thinking my mother could make tomato and egg soup for lunch. Once home, I put the vegetables in the kitchen, greeted my mother, who was pruning flower branches on the windowsill, and then poured a glass of water.
location: Walking from Green Lake Park to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped mother prepare lunch and shared the meal.
description: She washed and cut the tomatoes they had bought, while her mother cooked buckwheat noodles at the other burner. Together they made a simple light lunch: tomato and egg soup, cucumber salad, and buckwheat noodles. At 11:40, the two sat at the table eating and chatting about the old movie The Sound of Music they had watched yesterday; her mother said she had even learned the songs from it as a child, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: After-dinner rest and reading
description: After lunch, she leaned back in the armchair in the study and rested for about 40 minutes. She didn't fall completely asleep; half-reclining, she flipped through the Dali Folk Tie-Dye Art picture book she had bought yesterday at Zhibushi Bookstore. Looking at the exquisite tie-dye patterns inside, she felt very calm.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Studying travel books and freewriting.
description: After her lunch break, she felt full of energy. First she opened Dali Folk Tie-Dye Art and the Illustrated Record of Jiama Paper, carefully copied the key points about the flower-tying technique into her dedicated notebook for the Dali volunteer trip, and wrote several paragraphs of reflections on the possible folk-art connection between jiama paper and tie-dye. Then she turned on her computer and began writing the first draft of The Sound of Falling Leaves, which she had conceived that morning. The writing went very smoothly; keystrokes rose and fell one after another, and before she knew it, more than two hours had passed and she had completed most of the first draft.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Afternoon tea and organizing notes
description: Feeling a bit tired from writing, she went to the living room to pour a cup of chrysanthemum and goji berry tea, and chatted with her mother, who was knitting on the sofa. Her mother asked how the writing was going, and she smiled and said it was going smoothly. She organized the scattered notes recorded today, selected a few sentences she thought were good, and posted them to her Moments (visible only to herself), as a small summary of today’s writing.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home living room

name: Preparing for a walk with Dad.
description: She moved her stiff neck and remembered the appointment with her father in the evening. She took a thin jacket from the wardrobe, folded it and put it into her bag, and also held an old-style Zhongshan jacket of her father's in her hand. Seeing this, her mother asked if she was going out. She nodded and said she was going for a walk with her dad around Cuihu. Her mother smiled and said her father had been muttering at noon that he had something he wanted to ask.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, living room and bedroom at home

name: Taking a walk and having a heart-to-heart talk with father at Green Lake.
description: Waiting in the living room for Father to change his shoes. Just before heading out, I handed him his Zhongshan jacket and reminded him that it would get windy in the evening. We walked through the alley toward Cuihu Lake for 15 minutes. Walking along the shady path in the park, Father was the first to speak, asking whether there was any news about the manuscript sent yesterday. I told him honestly about the progress and about emailing Professor Wu. After we sat down on a bench by the lake, Father talked about amusing stories from his younger days when he worked at the Cultural Bureau in charge of intangible cultural heritage applications and dealt with an old craftsman. Then he changed the subject and seriously asked whether the path of writing books was hard. Seeing the white hairs on Father's head, I felt a warmth in my heart, nodded, and admitted to the occasional anxiety. Father patted my shoulder and said, "Take it slow. Dad has read the things you write — they're very good. Just write what you want to write." We sat by the lake for a long time, until the setting sun dyed the water gold.
location: No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; Green Lake Park; walk from home to the park's east gate and stroll slowly along the path.

name: On the way home
description: Walking home slowly side by side with my father, the setting sun stretched our shadows long. Neither of us spoke, but a silent understanding and warmth flowed through the air. When we passed the flowerbed at the entrance to the neighborhood, my father stopped, pointed at the Gesang flowers blooming in full beside it, and asked if I wanted to take a photo. I smiled and shook my head, saying I had already kept it in my heart.
location: Walking from Green Lake Park to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Light family dinner
description: When I got home, dinner was just being served. Mother had made loofah and egg soup and stir-fried lotus root slices, along with the leftover cucumber salad from lunch. Father rarely took the initiative to bring up the earlier walk, and with an unusually gentle smile said, "Old Li, our daughter is stronger than we thought." Mother happily said that's good, and that we should care about the girl more and not let her always stay cooped up writing alone. I lowered my head and ate, feeling a little warmth in my eyes.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home dining room

name: Journal and reading notes.
description: After dinner, I returned to the study, my heart still warm. I opened my journal and neatly wrote down the words my father said during our heart-to-heart talk today — 'persist in writing what you want to write' — and drew a small outline of Cuihu Lake beside it. Then I opened the new edition of Walden, read again the passage about 'simple living' that I had read this evening, and wrote a reflection in the margin, thinking of today's conversation with my father.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study

name: Evening yoga stretching and foot soaking
description: After sitting for a long time, my lower back was a bit sore, and I remembered I hadn't practiced yoga properly lately. I changed into loose pajamas, did 30 minutes of full-body stretching and relaxing yoga moves on the living room carpet with a mobile app, and felt the stiffness in my body ease. Then I boiled some water, poured it into a wooden bucket, added a packet of lavender foot soak powder, and listened to soothing instrumental music while soaking my feet.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, living room and bedroom at home

name: Skincare and bedtime preparation
description: After soaking her feet, she applied a warm towel to her eyes and then did a simple evening skincare routine. Then she lay against the headboard, flipped through the journal she had written in that morning, and savored the rich harvest of the day.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and relaxing before bed
description: She turned off the main light and switched on the small bedside lamp. Picking up Andersen's Fairy Tales from the bedside, she randomly flipped to a story, 'She Was Good for Nothing.' The story tells of the power of love and hope. After reading for about 15 minutes, she felt very calm inside.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to bed
description: At 20:50, she turned off the desk lamp. Recalling today's conversation with her father at Green Lake, she still felt moved and warm inside. She set the alarm for 7:00 tomorrow morning and, with this reassuring feeling, slowly fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretching, English reading aloud, and breakfast preparation
description: Yuwei got up to the sound of drizzling rain. She first did shoulder and neck stretches to wake up her body, then went to the study window and read the English version of Walden aloud, marking unfamiliar words and rereading them. After that, she warmed milk for herself, fried an egg, and paired it with whole wheat toast. At the same time, she packed photography gear such as a macro lens and a folding umbrella into a canvas bag to prepare for going out to shoot, while the white cat quietly kept her company.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Photographing the wilted lotus at Green Lake in the rain and the round trip.
description: Yuwei walked with an umbrella to Cuihu Park, where the withered lotus in the rain had a unique charm. At a sheltered corner of the waterside pavilion at Guanyu Tower, she used a macro lens to capture close-ups of water droplets sliding down leaf veins, and used her phone's slow-motion mode to record raindrops hitting the water's surface, immersed in shooting for nearly forty minutes. As the rain eased, she packed away her camera and walked home along Cuihu Lake, breathing the fresh air.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Received the Ikenobo flower arrangement certificate and shared the joy with Su Man.
description: Just as she reached her doorstep, she received a qualification certificate sent from the Ikenobo Ikebana branch via courier. After opening the envelope and confirming, Yuwei felt relieved and delighted. She immediately took a photo with her phone and sent it to her flower-arranging friend Su Man on WeChat, along with a voice message sharing the good news. Su Man quickly replied with a voice message of congratulations, and they agreed to celebrate together at the next practice.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Start yoga class.
description: In a good mood, Yuwei organized all the practice pieces from the eight-week watercolor course in the study, placed the most satisfactory ones in protective sleeves, and archived the rest by category. Then, in a prominent place in her journal, she added a full-page review for the completion of the watercolor course, recording teacher Xiuxiu's comments and her own creative insights.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Simple lunch and a short break
description: She reheated the leftover mushroom soup from the previous night and served it with plain noodles for lunch. After the meal, she leaned on the sofa and scrolled through her phone for fifteen minutes to relax, without taking a nap.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Immersing herself in outlining the essay 'Wrinkles Under the Shutter'.
description: In the study, Yuwei opened her memo notebook and, combining the notes from the previous day’s walk with her father and the emotional notes from the family portrait shoot, used “family images” as a thread to think deeply about the traces time had left on her parents’ faces. She wrote a page and a half of an outline, identified three main emotional sections, and the creative direction gradually became clear.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Walked to Zhibushi Bookstore to share the results with Uncle Qin.
description: Holding an umbrella, Yuwei walked to the Zhibushi Bookstore in Kunming, where the owner Qin Mingyuan was tidying the bookshelves. She showed him the Ikenobo flower arrangement certificate she had just received, and Uncle Qin smiled and congratulated her: 'Things done with a calm heart always leave an echo.' He then pulled out a copy of 'Biographies of Republican-Era Photographers' from the new books and recommended it to her. After thanking him, Yuwei browsed in front of the bookshelf for a while.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stopping by Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on the way to buy ingredients
description: After leaving the bookstore, Yuwei walked to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, carefully picked fresh and plump longan and autumn moon pears, and bought two fresh lily bulbs, planning to make stir-fried celery with lily bulbs for her parents in the evening.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Wrote a review of what I learned in the watercolor class and posted an update on Xiaohongshu.
description: After returning home and changing out of her slightly damp coat, Yuwei sat at the computer to write a review of her watercolor class, recording her growth from clumsy beginner to completing the piece “Pavilion in the Center of Green Lake,” and selected six photos of her most satisfactory works as accompanying images. Then she opened her Xiaohongshu account “Yuwei Slow Record,” first posting a photo of her flower arrangement certificate with the caption “Small happiness: flower arrangement exam passed, certificate in hand!” and then posted the watercolor class review with images in real time.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Warm family time with parents: meal prep, dinner, and a walk around Green Lake.
description: Mother Li Xiulan came home from work and saw Yuwei washing lilies, and said happily, "We're in for a treat." The mother and daughter chatted while preparing the ingredients. Yuwei shared the good news about the morning rain lotus and the certificate. Longan and autumn pears were arranged on a plate. After father Sun Mingyuan returned, the family enjoyed dinner of stir-fried celery with lily, steamed sea bass, and free-range chicken soup. Yuwei talked about her essay idea, and her father encouraged her to keep writing. After dinner, the rain stopped. She walked arm in arm with her mother and father around Cuihu Lake to aid digestion, with lights reflecting on the water, a gentle evening breeze, and the lingering lotus in the night exuding a special charm.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and Cuihu Park, 67 Cuihu South Road

name: New watercolor attempt: a small study of lotus in the rain
description: After returning home from the walk, inspiration surged. Yuwei spread out paper in the study and used the wet-on-wet technique to paint lotus flowers in the evening rain and mist. With a pale blue-gray background, dark green washes on the lotus leaves, and dawn red accents outlining the flowers, the image was fresh and hazy. She felt satisfied with her improved technique.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Journal tidying and foot-soaking relaxation
description: Yuwei played folk music on the Mao Wang radio and first tidied her journal: she pasted in the courier receipt for the flower arrangement certificate, the printed review of the watercolor class, and a mini version of that evening's 'Rainy Lotus' painting, and wrote down her thoughts on the lazy autumn day with a fountain pen. Afterwards, she soaked her feet while browsing 'Biographies of Republican-Era Photographers' recommended by Uncle Qin, feeling completely relaxed in body and mind.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Reading and meditation before bed
