description: After changing into pajamas and lying in bed, Yuwei turned on the bedside lamp to read the Chinese edition of Walden, comparing it with the English passages she had read aloud in the morning to appreciate the beauty of the language. The white cat curled up at her feet. After twenty minutes of reading, drowsiness set in. She turned off the light, meditated for a few minutes, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: With a joyful and fulfilled heart, Yuwei fell into a deep sleep in the cool breath of the rainy night.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning English reading aloud and breakfast.
description: After getting up in the early morning, I read aloud the chapter 'Where I Lived, and What I Lived For' from the English edition of Walden in the study, noting expressions and writing annotations. My voice was especially clear in the quiet morning and helped me ease into reading. After reading aloud, I enjoyed in the dining room the eggs my mother had boiled in advance and oatmeal I made myself, adding blueberries and bananas, with a glass of milk, while browsing Xiaohongshu for photos of sunrise over Green Lake. After eating, I washed the dishes and tidied the kitchen.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning creation: essay polishing and watercolor "Green Lake Spring"
description: Back in the study, she carefully revised the first draft of the essay 'Wrinkles Under the Shutter', focusing on polishing the emotional climax. She interwove her feelings about light and shadow with the imagery of the 'shutter sound' and 'wrinkles of time'. During this process, she paced around to think and looked through old photos of her parents. She finally completed a final draft of about 2,000 characters and added the satisfying line: 'A photo is a frozen instant, while wrinkles are the echo of time.' After a short rest, she began the watercolor 'Cuihu Spring'. Referring to photos of weeping willows and cherry blossoms by Cuihu Lake during the Qingming Festival, she sketched the outline in pencil, laid down the base colors with the wet-on-wet technique, and used stippling to paint the green willows and white flowers. Finally, she inscribed a poem at the lower right corner: 'Willow mist lightly veils the Cuihu embankment; newborn spring water mirrors the flowering branches.' As the first piece in the 'Four Seasons of Cuihu' series, she felt quite satisfied after finishing it.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday walk and supermarket shopping
description: Went out for a walk along Renmin Middle Road to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. Sunlight fell on the plane tree leaves, and I felt relaxed. At the supermarket, I picked out fresh white lilies, soft tofu, greens, and braised beef as dinner side dishes, paid, and walked home.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and leisure reading
description: After returning home, I arranged the lilies in a glass vase and placed it on the living room coffee table. I cooked a simple bowl of clear noodle soup, topped with a poached egg and green vegetable leaves for lunch. After eating, I sat on the living room sofa and browsed the chapter about Lang Jingshan from Biographies of Republican-Era Photographers, borrowed from Zhibushi Bookstore. Birds chirped outside the window, and the afternoon sunlight fell on the lily buds; I felt very content.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Visit Zhibushi Bookstore and talk with Uncle Qin
description: She walked to Zhibushi Bookstore, where Uncle Qin (Qin Mingyuan) gave her a yellowed copy of Southwest Associated University and Modern China, saying it would be helpful for writing essays about Kunming. She shared with Uncle Qin the joy of finishing that day's essay and discussed the bottleneck she had encountered in making the language more poetic. Uncle Qin brewed some Pu'er tea and, drawing on his reading experience, suggested “restrained wording and leaving blank space,” which made her suddenly see things clearly. They talked pleasantly until the bookstore closed.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Bookstore owner, a friend across generations

location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Xingguang Photo Studio to pick up the family portrait
description: After leaving Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, she walked south along Cuihu East Road. Sunlight slipped through the leaves and scattered on the lake, making the water sparkle, and she took photos of the Cuihu scenery with her phone. When she arrived at Starlight Photo Studio, she presented the pick-up slip, and the staff brought out a carefully packaged 40-inch framed family portrait and the extra printed photos. She carefully checked the clarity and color, and after confirming everything was correct, carefully put the large frame into a dust bag, carried it in her arms, and walked home, thinking that her father would surely be happy to see it.
location: Xingguang Photo Studio, No. 6 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home, organize the family portrait, and share the joy
description: After returning home, she first set the large framed photo against the living room wall, then sent a WeChat message to her mother to let her know the photos had been picked up. She chose the four with the best angles from the reprinted photos and sent them via WeChat to her older sister Sun Yutong, who is far away in Shenzhen, along with a message sharing the family's overall situation. Afterwards, she took photos of the watercolor painting she had just finished and uploaded them to Xiaohongshu, with a caption recording the start of the 'Four Seasons of Green Lake' series, sharing today's achievements with internet friends.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Free reading of *Southwest Associated University and Modern China*
description: Back in the study, she brewed a cup of flower tea and continued reading 'The National Southwestern Associated University and Modern China' that Uncle Qin had given her. When she read about the daily lives of the university's scholars in Kunming, she felt a strong resonance and jotted down interesting passages and place names for future writing material. Outside the window, the light gradually turned golden. Looking up occasionally at the green tree shadows below, she felt calm and fulfilled.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Flower arranging and preparing dinner.
description: Taking advantage of the soft sunlight, she trimmed the roots of the lilies bought that morning, removed excess leaves, arranged them at varied heights in a vase, and placed it on the side table by the sofa. Then she went into the kitchen, cut the soft tofu into pieces, washed the greens, and sliced the braised beef, arranging it on a plate—preparing everything for dinner so that she only needed to quickly stir-fry the greens when her parents came home.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner and hanging the family portrait.
description: Her father came home from work and was full of praise for the lilies and the family photo he had picked up. Dinner was made with the leftover noodles from lunch, along with vegetable tofu soup and braised beef. At the table, she showed her parents the finished essay and watercolor painting; they kept smiling and nodding. Her mother said the cherry blossoms in the painting looked very much like the ones she had seen at Yuantong Mountain in her youth. After dinner, she and her father hung the family photo on the wall facing the sofa in the living room, using a tape measure, a level, and an electric drill. She held the frame while her father drilled holes and inserted invisible picture hooks. Once it was hung, they adjusted the angle to make sure it was level. The living room felt warmer with the photo. She took a picture and sent it to the family group chat and to her Moments.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to Mingyuan Bookstore to attend the writing group
description: Packed up the printed essay manuscript, notebook, and pen, said goodbye to my parents, and told them about the writing group activity. Walked along Wenlin Street toward Mingyuan Bookstore, admiring the gentle orange-pink sunset on the way, and arrived at the bookstore about 15 minutes later.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 56 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Third session of the writing group
description: Arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore early; the reading area had already been set up as a salon space. After all the group members arrived, when it was my turn, I shared the first two paragraphs of the just-finished “Wrinkles Under the Shutter.” Lin Lu praised the opening ‘shutter sound’ as vivid but suggested making the ‘wrinkles’ image at the end more concrete, and Zhang Fan suggested trying more colloquial sentence patterns to strengthen a sense of immersion. I carefully recorded all the feedback, and during the discussion session I privately spoke with Lin Lu about poetic techniques in essay language; she recommended Li Juan's essays as a reference, and it was very inspiring.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 56 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing group late-night snack
description: After the event, still not ready to leave, everyone walked to the old neighborhood snack shop near the bookstore and ordered Jianshui grilled tofu and small-pot rice noodles. They sat together, continued talking about writing amid the smoky barbecue aroma and the steam from the rice noodles, and shared anecdotes from daily life, bringing the fulfilling Saturday to a joyful close.
location: Old Neighborhood Snacks, No. 202-1 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and preparing for the evening.
description: After saying goodbye to her group members, she walked home. Her parents were already resting, and the night light was left on in the living room. She tiptoed back to the bedroom, soaked her feet in hot water for 15 minutes to relieve fatigue, then sat down at her desk, opened her journal, pasted in the business card Uncle Qin had given her, and wrote down today's keywords: 'essay completed, watercolor first draft done, family portrait, writing group.'
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime ritual and going to bed.
description: Changed into pajamas, did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing meditation in bed, and relaxed her whole body. In the phone memo, she noted tomorrow's tasks, mentally reviewed the day's gains, felt satisfied with the good sentences in her essay and the watercolor pieces, smiled slightly, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning ritual, reading aloud, and breakfast.
description: Sun Yuwei was woken by the 7 o’clock alarm, and sunlight spilled across the floor through the curtains. She sat up and drank the warm honey water from the thermos on the nightstand to soothe her stomach, which was slightly tense from nervousness. Then she did five minutes of simple stretching and a few deep breaths before going to the bathroom to wash up, splashing cold water on her face to wake herself up. After that, she went to the study, opened the English edition of Walden, read half a chapter aloud, and marked two beautiful expressions. The sound of reading reached the kitchen, where her mother was cooking rice noodles. She put down the book and went to help set out the bowls and chopsticks. Breakfast was the braised pork rice noodles her mother had made. Her mother smiled and told her to eat more, and not to be nervous on an empty stomach.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Finalized and sent the essay.
description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop and put the final polish on the first draft of Wrinkles Under the Shutter completed yesterday, focusing on adjusting the emotional rhythm of the last paragraph to ensure the pauses between words were just right. At 9:30, she confirmed that there was nothing more to revise, and sent the final draft via WeChat to Xu Mingyuan, the editor of Cultural Vision, with a brief creative note: 'Hello, Teacher Xu, this is the final draft of Wrinkles Under the Shutter. I drew inspiration from old family photos and family portraits, and tried to use the imagery of shutter and wrinkles to explore time and memory. Please review it and let me know what needs correcting.' After sending it, she breathed a sigh of relief, feeling as though a small stone in her heart had been temporarily set down. She picked up her phone and saw the editor had replied with an emoji saying 'OK, received,' which made her feel a little better.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Previewing personal finance, helping in the kitchen, and family lunch
description: To make the evening video call with her cousin Shen Wei more efficient, Sun Yuwei used a reading app on her phone to search and browse the introduction and table of contents of The Index Fund Investment Guide. She did not understand terms like passive management and compound interest, so she wrote down a few keywords in her journal, planning to ask her cousin in the evening. Then she closed her laptop and went into the kitchen to help her mother wash vegetables and peel garlic. Her mother made a home-style stir-fried bitter melon and tomato scrambled eggs; she helped pick the vegetables and shared how relieved she felt after sending off the article that morning. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, came out of the study and asked with concern how her afternoon meeting was going. She said casually that the draft had already been sent and had received preliminary recognition from the editor, and that the editor, Zhou Mingyuan, had also arranged to meet in the afternoon. During lunch, the family chatted about everyday matters. Her mother asked what she wanted for dinner, and she said she felt like having a light winter melon soup. After the meal, she helped clear the dishes and chopsticks.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday nap
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the bedroom and leaned against the headboard. She was not sleepy, only resting with her eyes closed. Listening to a few birds chirping outside the window, she flipped through several pages of 'The National Southwestern Associated University and Modern China,' which she had received as a gift from Paper Stone Bookstore yesterday, trying to calm the turmoil in her heart with words. Reading the passages about the lives of the university's students in Kunming, a warmth surged in her heart.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Leaving early, strolling around Cuihu Lake, and waiting at the café
description: Sun Yuwei decided to leave early. She put on a comfortable white shirt and light-colored jeans, slung a canvas bag over her shoulder, and walked 12 minutes to Green Lake Park. The afternoon sun was warm, and the lake shimmered; an old man was playing erhu under the long corridor, the tune melodious. She found a bench by the lake, sat down, watched the pleasure boats glide slowly across the water, and breathed in the osmanthus fragrance. Her mood gradually shifted from nervousness to calm anticipation. When she felt it was about time, she got up and walked 7 minutes to Qianshi Cafe on Wenlin Street, chose a corner seat by the window, ordered a hot latte for herself in advance, and then went through her journal to review a few notes on her book draft ideas, making sure her thoughts were clear. Occasionally pedestrians passed by outside the window; the street was quiet.
location: Qianshi Coffee (Wenlin Garden Branch), No. 136 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Met with editor Zhou Mingyuan.
description: At exactly two o'clock, Editor Zhou Mingyuan arrived on time. He was a gentle-looking middle-aged man, wearing glasses and carrying a canvas briefcase. Sun Yuwei was a little nervous, but Editor Zhou's easygoing greeting relaxed her. He flipped through her manuscript and praised it: "The writing is full of spirit. Some passages have a real texture, especially the part about old family photos—it's emotionally resonant." He explained the publisher's topic selection meeting process, which is held quarterly, and suggested she prepare materials to submit to the meeting early next year. Sun Yuwei listened carefully, noted several key points, and also shared her original intentions and reflections when conceiving the manuscript—from the taking of the family portrait to the flow of memories. The exchange lasted about an hour in a harmonious atmosphere. When saying goodbye, Editor Zhou said he would keep an eye on her materials and suggested she put together a more complete table of contents and sample chapters.
location: Qianshi Coffee (Wenlin Garden Branch), No. 136 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Savoring the meeting, exploring Wenlin Street, and shopping at the supermarket
description: After the meeting ended, Sun Yuwei did not leave immediately. She sat for a while in the café and jotted down the key points from earlier in the memo app on her phone: the spring editorial meeting, and the need to prepare a complete table of contents and sample chapters. When she left, she walked slowly along Wenlin Street, looking at the independent shops and graffiti walls, feeling warm inside as she savored the comment that her writing had spirit. She stopped at a cultural creative shop on the street and bought a bookmark printed with a small bird. On her way home, she stopped by the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street and bought a small bag of lilies, a few straight Chinese yams, and a bunch of fresh garlic sprouts, planning to have her mother make soup with them the next day. At checkout, she noticed the small potted plants by the register and bought a succulent to put on the windowsill of her study.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Creating the watercolor 'Summer at Cuihu'.
description: Back home, Sun Yuwei's heart was surging with emotion; she felt she had to express this wonderful feeling through her paintbrush. She spread out watercolor paper, mixed emerald green, azure blue, and bright yellow, and began to paint the 'Summer at Green Lake' in her heart. She focused on capturing the layered lotus leaves and the trembling light and shadows on the water. When she was satisfied with a section, she dipped her brush in carmine and dotted a few graceful lotus flowers and a red dragonfly. Finally, she picked up her brush and wrote that line of poetry in the corner of the painting: 'The green lotus sways as a gentle breeze rises; a dragonfly alights atop the lotus flower.' After finishing, she clipped the painting onto the easel and admired it with satisfaction.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helping prepare dinner
description: Sun Yuwei put away her painting tools and went into the kitchen. Her mother, Li Xiulan, was picking vegetables. She went over to help, washing garlic sprouts and peeling Chinese yams. She proactively shared details of the afternoon meeting with her mother, saying that the editor thought the writing was good and suggested preparing for next year's topic selection meeting. Her mother was very happy and kept saying, 'That's great, that's great.' She could feel her mother was even happier than she was. While cutting winter melon, her mother hummed a tune.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: During dinner, Sun Yuwei formally announced the outcome of the meeting to her parents. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, for once didn’t say much about practical matters; he simply told her to set her own pace and not put too much pressure on herself. He took a sip of soup and said, “Take it slow—you can do it.” Her mother, meanwhile, enthusiastically planned to celebrate together on the weekend and have dinner at a restaurant by Green Lake. The family was warm and harmonious, and Sun Yuwei felt grounded and comforted.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening preparation and browsing the journal
description: After returning to the bedroom, Sun Yuwei put away her watercolor tools and tucked the newly bought bookmark into her journal. She opened the journal, browsed the finance keywords she had noted down in the afternoon, then took out her phone and silently rehearsed the questions she wanted to ask her cousin that evening. She watered the succulents on the balcony, took another look at the just-finished watercolor painting, and felt a sense of satisfaction welling up.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video call with her cousin and organizing financial study notes.
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, Sun Yuwei made a WeChat video call to her cousin Shen Wei. On the other end, her cousin had just gotten home from the gym and was in good spirits, with her hair still slightly damp. Sun Yuwei got straight to the point and asked for financial advice, and her cousin was glad to act as her 'personal little financial tutor.' Taking into account Sun Yuwei's income (mainly writing fees) and her low-risk preference, her cousin suggested she start with regular investing in index funds and once again recommended the book The Index Fund Investment Guide, also explaining the basic concepts of 'investment frequency' and the 'CSI 300.' Sun Yuwei listened very attentively, jotting down key terms in her notebook, and would occasionally ask, 'Should I invest monthly or weekly?' Her cousin answered with a smile, 'Monthly is fine at the beginning—simpler.' After the call ended, she quickly found the e-book version of The Index Fund Investment Guide on her phone, bought the first few chapters, skimmed the table of contents and introduction, and felt it was indeed well suited for her to get started. She then opened her journal and reorganized the evening's notes, using different colored pens to distinguish 'suggestions' from 'study plan.' She decided to set up a simulated recurring-investment account in a mobile app starting tomorrow to first test the waters.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Soaking feet and keeping a personal journal.
description: Sun Yuwei prepared a basin of hot water and soaked her feet comfortably. She put on earphones and played a soothing folk song. She opened her diary and wrote down the moments that had touched her most that day: the editor's recognition, the lotus pond in the watercolor painting, her cousin's patient guidance. She wrote: Today, I seem to have taken a step on a deeper path. The editor said my writing has a certain spirit. My cousin helped me open the door to managing my finances. When I finished Cuihu Summer, I felt especially quiet inside. Today is a really good day.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep.
description: After soaking her feet, Sun Yuwei felt completely relaxed. She leaned against the headboard and read the Chinese edition of Walden for 15 minutes, her mind gradually calming down. She turned off the main light, dimmed the bedside lamp, took a deep breath, and with a bit of excitement and anticipation for the future, slowly fell asleep.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: At 7:10 in the morning, the alarm went off. Yuwei stayed in bed for five minutes, feeling the autumn morning light outside the window. After getting up, she weighed 46.0 kg. After washing up, she spread out her yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of morning stretching, focusing on relaxing her spine, shoulders, and neck to prepare for the morning walk and afternoon desk work. After the stretch, her body was fully awakened.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning English reading.
description: Return to the bedroom, pick up the English edition of Walden from the bedside table, and read aloud for 10 minutes as usual. Today she read the passage on 'simplicity', and Thoreau's words gave her inner peace before the day began.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: Entering the dining room, her mother had already cooked small-pot rice noodles, and the fragrant aroma of the hot red-oil broth filled the air. Her father returned from a walk at the Cultural Bureau. As they ate and chatted, Yuwei announced the plan for mushroom hotpot that evening. Her mother said she had already reserved their usual restaurant, and her father asked about the progress of the manuscript.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize emails and study
description: After breakfast, she went to the study, took out the revised manuscript of Slow Travel Notes and the notes from her meeting with editor Zhou Mingyuan, opened her laptop, organized the editor's feedback and her own revision ideas into an email, and sent it to her supervisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, for guidance. Then she placed The Index Fund Investment Guide and the new journal in the center of the desk, tidied the desk, and put the watercolor paints and brushes back in place.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-departure preparation and making a financial learning plan
description: She changed into light going-out clothes, checked the camera battery and memory card, and stuffed the voice recorder, small notebook, and pen into her canvas bag. Seeing it was cloudy with sunny spells outside, she didn't take an umbrella. She took out "The Index Fund Investment Guide," flipped through the table of contents, and used her phone's memo app to make a study plan: read two chapters a day and take one page of journal notes. She also jotted down a to-do item: ask neighbor Aunt Xie about fund account opening details during the evening walk.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Completed the final photo shoot of the withered lotus at Green Lake.
description: It takes about 15 minutes on foot from home to reach Green Lake Park, with the goal of completing this autumn's final shoot of withered lotus flowers. She walked slowly along the lake, looking for the best compositions near the Nine-Bend Bridge and along the lotus pond. Using a macro lens, she photographed dew drops on lotus seed pods and the textures of broken lotus stems. Using reflections on the water, she took several mirror-image compositions of withered lotus with weeping willows and the stone bridge. Finally, she sat down in a quiet corner, turned off her camera, and used a voice recorder to capture the sounds of wind, water, and birds for future essays or creative inspiration.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and small talk with neighbors.
description: After the photo shoot ended, I walked slowly home along Cuihu South Road. At the entrance of the residential complex, I ran into Aunt Xie, a neighbor carrying a basket of vegetables. Remembering the index fund I had talked about with my cousin last night, I asked her for details about opening a fund account. Aunt Xie enthusiastically shared her experience of opening a securities account recently, saying that opening an account via a mobile app was very convenient. We chatted briefly for ten minutes, agreed to talk more in detail another day, and then went upstairs and home.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Lunch and midday break
description: When she got home, her mother had already prepared a light lunch: stir-fried asparagus with lily bulbs, steamed sea bass, and rice. At the table, Yuwei showed her mother the photos of the withered lotus at Green Lake she had taken that morning. Her mother praised the composition for its artistic mood. After lunch, she helped her mother clear the dishes, then returned to the bedroom, leaned against the headboard, and listened to two soothing folk songs, “Late Spring,” to relax.
location: Dining room and bedroom of her home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap
description: In order to have good energy for studying in the afternoon, Yuwei lay on the bed and took a nap for about 40 minutes. After waking up, she made a cup of drip-bag coffee and felt much refreshed.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Systematically study the first two chapters of index fund investing
description: In the aroma of coffee, I officially began studying. I took out The Index Fund Investment Guide and the planner and, as planned, focused on the first two chapters, understanding the basic concepts and common types of index funds. As I read, I highlighted key points with a highlighter and drew my first mind-map note in the planner, sorting out the relationships among core concepts such as broad-based index, sector index, and CSI 300. Along the way, I used my phone to photograph the first completed page of notes.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Brief rest and household chores.
description: After sitting in the study for a long time, she got up to move around. She went to the kitchen to cut a plate of pears, then walked to the balcony to spray water on the succulents she bought yesterday. Standing on the balcony, she looked into the distance to rest her eyes.
location: Kitchen and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth study of index fund valuation and regular investing.
description: Returned to the desk and continued reading chapters seven to nine of The Index Fund Investment Guide, focusing on index fund valuation methods (P/E ratio, P/B ratio) and dollar-cost averaging strategies. Slowed down the reading pace, worked through the valuation formulas on scratch paper, and finally drew a diagram of the 'dollar-cost averaging smile curve' on the second page of the journal with different colored pens, annotating key operational points. The financial learning task was completed successfully.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing materials and preparing social media content.
description: She imported today's Cuihu photos into her laptop, quickly browsed through them, and selected the 9 most satisfactory ones, using a mobile photo editing app to fine-tune the color tone and contrast. She also used her phone to take a photo of the financial study notes she had made in the afternoon. She opened the Xiaohongshu app, selected 3 Cuihu photos and 1 screenshot of the study notes, edited tonight's post, and wrote the caption: "Autumn, books and nature. #MyDailyLife #StudyCheckIn #CuihuWitheredLotus." After editing, she saved the post as a draft, planning to publish it together after her watercolor creation in the evening.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Relaxing and preparing for the dinner party
description: Helped Mom prepare dinner side dishes, and chatted with Dad about the Kunming Historic Architecture Photo Exhibition recently held at his workplace. Then returned to the room, changed into a slightly more formal dress, and happily got ready to go out for the family celebration dinner.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family celebration dinner (mushroom hot pot)
description: She took a taxi with her parents to Junge Wild Mushroom Hot Pot (Dianchi Lake View Branch) on Yinghai Road, Xishan District, about a 25-minute drive. To celebrate the progress of the manuscript and the smooth submission, they ordered a platter of wild mushrooms (porcini, green-cracking russula, termite mushrooms, etc.), plus the signature copper-pot rice and a few side dishes. During the meal, her father shared amusing anecdotes from the Culture Bureau, and her mother talked about a student's perfect-scoring essay. The atmosphere was warm and pleasant. Yuwei drank two bowls of delicious mushroom soup and ate plenty of mushrooms, feeling very happy.
location: Junge Wild Mushroom Hotpot (Dianchi Lake View Branch), No. 18-1 Yinghai Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Take a taxi back home
description: They were a little too full after dinner, so the family took a taxi straight home, about a 20-minute ride. In the car, they talked about funny things from when Yuwei was little and went on a spring outing to Dianchi Lake; the three of them laughed happily.
location: On the way from 18-1 Yinghai Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District

name: Watercolor creation and publishing a Xiaohongshu post.
description: After arriving home and resting briefly, I went to my desk in a happy evening mood. I spread out the watercolor paper, mixed the paints, and created a watercolor titled 'Autumn at Green Lake.' The lakeside scenes from the daytime came to mind: golden fallen leaves on the ginkgo path, dappled light and shadow under the plane trees. I used dry brush and wash techniques to capture the quietness and fullness of autumn. When the painting was almost finished, I inscribed a poem in small regular script at the lower right corner: 'Ginkgo leaves fall, covering the ground with gold; in autumn, Green Lake mirrors the clear sky.' After finishing, I took a photo and posted it to my close friends' group chat to show off, and received several replies asking for the original image. Then I opened Xiaohongshu and published the update I had edited earlier together with this watercolor painting.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and bedtime preparation.
description: Opened the journal, pasted in photos of today's study notes, and stuck in a card from the mushroom hot pot restaurant. Drew a mushroom pattern with watercolor pens and wrote beside it: 'Celebrating the smooth submission of the manuscript! Fresh mushrooms were really delicious!' Recorded a warm and fulfilling day. Then took a shower and relaxed to music.
location: Home study and bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: She changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, picked up the newly opened The Index Fund Investment Guide, quickly browsed the table of contents of Chapter 3, which she would study the next day, and previewed the main content. After finishing the preview, she turned off the light, set her alarm for 7:10 the next morning, and fell asleep feeling fulfilled and satisfied.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning English reading and journaling
description: The phone alarm went off, playing an English audiobook excerpt from Walden: "I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately..." I turned off the alarm, sat up in bed, and stretched. Outside the window there was already crisp birdsong. I picked up the original English edition of Walden that I hadn't finished reading last night from the nightstand and read aloud the opening of the "Solitude" chapter for ten minutes, highlighting sentences about solitude. Then I opened my Hobonichi journal on the bedside and, with a fountain pen, wrote today's TO-DO LIST under the date "2025.10.14": finish watercolor painting, read a personal finance book, visit Aunt Xie, and go grocery shopping with Mom. I took out a highlighter and drew a small star after "finish watercolor painting," marking it as the most important task today.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: I heard Mom calling from the kitchen, 'Are you up yet?' I answered and walked out of the bedroom. On the dining table were the white congee, fried eggs, and two small dishes of pickled vegetables that Mom had prepared (pickled mustard tuber and fermented tofu). While blowing on the hot porridge, I told Mom that in the afternoon I wanted to go with her to a farther vegetable market to buy groceries. Mom smiled and said, 'It's rare for you to volunteer for exercise.' Then I brought up the mushrooms that Auntie Xie had given us last week, which were very delicious. Mom enthusiastically joined in the discussion, saying that this year's mushroom season was almost over and that the Zhuanxin Market might still have fresh ones. Mother and daughter chatted about daily life during the warm breakfast.
location: Living room/dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and tidying after the meal
description: After breakfast, I helped my mother put the dishes away in the kitchen, then went to the bathroom to wash up and do my skincare routine. Back in the bedroom, I changed into comfortable cotton loungewear, casually pinned up my long hair with a hair clip, and made sure my face was clean so it wouldn't interfere with painting. I deliberately checked my watercolor paint box and found that the last tube of “Lake Blue” was almost used up, but I estimated it was enough for today's painting, so I made a mental note: “Tomorrow, go to Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore and ask if they have any new stock.”
location: Home bathroom/bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Creation of the watercolor 'Cuihu Winter' and completion of the 'Four Seasons of Cuihu' series
description: I sat down at the sun-drenched desk and spread out the pre-stretched watercolor paper. First, using the photo on my phone of the withered branches I took at Green Lake yesterday, I lightly sketched the outline of the Western Hills in the distance and the shoreline covered with thin ice in the foreground. Then I dipped my brush into the mixed gray-blue and washed in the cold, clear feeling of the winter lake. I carefully dotted in a few black-headed gulls perching on the withered branches and left white space for the faint mist in the background. At about 10:30, I took out a black technical pen and, in an elegant hand, inscribed Winter Rime and a short poem in the lower right corner of the painting: "The winter lake is silent, a cold crow stands; the rime glistens, reflecting the morning light." Letting out a long breath, I looked at the four paintings of spring, summer, autumn, and winter lined up on the bookshelf and felt immensely accomplished. At last, I had completed the Four Seasons of Green Lake series.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Framing the painting and sharing it on WeChat Moments.
description: I carefully slotted the four postcard-sized watercolor paintings one by one into the prepared small white square frames. I first placed them in seasonal order on the desk where the light was favorable, but feeling the light wasn't ideal, I moved them to the living room balcony and rearranged them in natural light. I used my phone to find the best angle, took three or four photos, selected the one with the most harmonious light and shadow, and opened WeChat Moments. I wrote the caption: "The four seasons turn, and Green Lake enters the frame. My 'Four Seasons of Green Lake' series is finished today, a gift to this city that grew up with me." I added the hashtags #watercolor #GreenLake #Kunming and hit publish. The moment it was posted, Sister He Lu gave it a like, and I pursed my lips and smiled.
location: Study/balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch
description: Mom made simple tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. While eating the noodles, I showed Mom the drawing I had just finished on my phone. Mom praised it, saying, 'It really looks like something! Especially this little seagull—it looks so spirited!' I smiled happily and mentioned that in the afternoon I was going to visit Aunt Xie across the hall to ask about opening a fund account. Mom thought for a moment and said, 'Well, Xiao Xie knows about these things. It is fine to go ask her, much better than buying blindly.'
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and relaxation
description: I first arranged the four framed paintings in order on the bookshelf and admired them with satisfaction for a while. Then I picked up Walden, which I hadn't finished reading the night before, from beside my pillow. After reading two chapters, I felt a little sleepy, so I set a 30-minute alarm and took a nap. When I woke up, I rubbed my eyes, put on my earphones, and listened to an episode of the podcast “Zhixing Tavern” about how ordinary people can start systematic fund investing. As I listened, I noted down some keywords in my mind to prepare for the afternoon reading and socializing.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read Chapters 3 and 4 of "The Index Fund Investment Guide"
description: I took a newly purchased notebook with a leather cover and a black pen, and sat on the bay window in the bedroom. While reading Chapter 3 "Dollar-Cost Averaging Strategy and the Smile Curve" and Chapter 4 "How to Select an Index Fund" from The Index Fund Investing Guide, I took careful notes. I summarized the principle of the "average cost method" in my own words (P78 in the book), and circled the "three-step fund selection method," marking it as a key practical focus. I also wrote a marginal note in pencil at the edge of the page: "Ask Aunt Xie: for the bank, choose China Merchants Bank?" I frowned in thought from time to time and quickly jotted down notes, completely immersed in the new world of financial knowledge.
location: Bedroom/study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Visited neighbor Xie Xiulan to consult about opening a fund account.
description: I brought my notepad and a black gel pen, walked across to the door opposite, and gently knocked on Aunt Xie's door. Aunt Xie warmly opened the door and invited me in. On the coffee table in the living room sat a plate of freshly cut apples. I asked Aunt Xie about the process and precautions for opening a fund account. Aunt Xie brought out the apples and, drawing on her own experience buying bank wealth management products and funds, gave very specific advice. For example, she suggested I choose a large bank with a big scale and many branches, such as China Merchants Bank or ICBC, to open online banking, and reminded me to pay attention to fund management fees and redemption times. I nodded and jotted down the key points in detail in my notepad, and also asked what documents were needed to open an account. The two of us chatted for about forty minutes.
location: Xie Xiulan's home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Briefly returned home to rest and freshen up.
description: After leaving Aunt Xie's house, I went home, put down my journal and pen, changed into a pair of light sneakers, grabbed a bottle of water and the folded canvas shopping bag, and called out from the doorway: 'Mom, I'm ready, let's go!'
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanying my mother to the wet market and walking.
description: I left the residential complex with my mother, walked south along Huashan West Road, crossed Renmin Middle Road, and turned into Zhuantang Road. Along the way, I talked about the details of today’s watercolor painting, while my mother talked about the latest thing she heard at work—a colleague’s child looking for a job. We chatted as we walked and before we knew it arrived at the food market. At the market, my mother skillfully selected items at stall after stall while I helped carry the vegetables and occasionally offered my own opinions. Seeing the bright red pomegranates, I suggested buying a few to take home. My mother also bought a piece of fresh pork ribs and a handful of tender green pea shoots. After shopping for about 40 minutes, we headed back carrying heavy bags. The sun was setting, golden light spilling across the street. The round trip on foot took nearly an hour, and by the time we got home, I was slightly sweaty but in a cheerful mood.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zhuangtang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the round trip.

name: Help prepare dinner and rest.
description: After getting home, I helped my mother put the groceries into the refrigerator by category, then started washing and trimming the vegetables, and chopped the spare ribs into small pieces. When my mother began making the soup, I took a pomegranate, sat on the living room sofa, and while shelling pomegranate seeds into a small bowl, I watched the news on TV. Mother and daughter chatted casually about the day's experiences in a relaxed and warm atmosphere.
location: Kitchen/living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was the pork rib and lotus root soup stewed by Mom, stir-fried pea shoots, and cucumber salad. I drank two bowls of soup and tried to control the amount of staple rice, eating only a small half bowl. At the table, I told Mom about the fund account opening knowledge I learned at Aunt Xie’s house today. Mom encouraged me to give it a try and start developing my own financial management mindset. She also calculated for me, saying that I had saved nearly 3,000 yuan from college writing fees, which could serve as the principal.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Conceived a floral design for the yoga studio.
description: I opened the photo album on my phone to look at the photos of various autumn plants I had taken at the flower market last month. Then, on a new page of my journal, I began sketching ideas with an HB pencil. I came up with a theme called "Quiet Autumn Fruits": in the center, a ceramic jar with bronze-colored cracks held dried lotus seed pods, reeds, and a few orange-yellow pompon chrysanthemums, with small pumpkins and pinecones placed around it as accents. I carefully annotated the proportions of the different plant materials and the color transitions, and wrote a design note: "Through the lines of dried lotus and the colors of orange fruits, create a sense of quiet warmth after harvest, matching the meditative atmosphere of yoga." Then I took a photo of the sketch in my journal with my phone and sent it to He Lu, the yoga studio owner, on WeChat, with the message: "Sister Lu, I've done an initial concept for an 'Autumn Fruits' theme. Take a look and see if you like it."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Chatting online with friends
description: After sending the message to He Lu, I lay in bed looking through my phone. On Moments, the Four Seasons of Cuihu series I had posted had already received more than twenty likes and comments. My high school best friend Zhang Jing commented, That's amazing! I really want to come to your house and see the originals! I replied instantly, Anytime! Put on some gloves and come get them! My college roommate Zhou Lin posted a photo of the Shenzhen sunset in the group chat and said she missed Kunming's autumn. I replied with a hug emoji and chatted with my roommates for ten minutes. Liu Jia talked about an interesting little boy she had met while tutoring recently, and we all burst out laughing.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading and journal organizing
description: I opened NetEase Cloud Music and played the “Quiet Study” light music playlist, then sat at my desk. First I took out the “Autumn Fruit” sketch I had drawn in the evening, used a ruler and black pen to neaten the lines, attached it to the right-hand page of today's journal with glue dots, and decorated the side with tape. Then I continued reading the chapter on “Solitude” in Walden. When I came across sentences I liked, such as “I wanted to live deeply and suck out all the marrow of life,” I copied them into the excerpts section of my journal. As I read, I thought about how to incorporate Thoreau's idea of “simplicity” into the essay “A Journey Alone” that I am currently revising.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening wash-up and meditation preparation
description: I went to the bathroom to wash my face and do a simple nighttime skincare routine (patting on a layer of toner and lotion). After changing into comfortable cotton pajamas, I didn't lie down right away. Instead, I sat cross-legged on the yoga mat at the foot of the bed, closed my eyes, and began a 10-minute abdominal breathing meditation to let go of the day's thoughts. I focused on my breath, letting my thoughts drift by like clouds, and gradually calmed down inside.
location: Bedroom/bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: After meditation, I felt clear-headed and calm. I set my phone alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning and turned on Do Not Disturb. Under the soft light of the bedside lamp, I flipped through a few pages of Walden and read, 'Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth.' Five minutes later, feeling drowsy, I put the book on the nightstand, gently turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully with a slight smile on my lips.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: Waking up early, I curled up in bed and softly read Chapter 3 of the English edition of Walden, then got up and did some simple stretches to wake up my body. In my dark green journal, I wrote down today's three important tasks: the Subject 3 driving test, consignment at Mingyuan Bookstore, and a headstand breakthrough, and drew stars next to them. After washing up, I changed into a light gray cotton T-shirt and navy casual pants, carefully checked my ID card and admission ticket, put them in a transparent document folder, and placed the folder in my crossbody bag. I gave myself an encouraging smile in the mirror. My mother was already in the kitchen preparing chicken soup rice noodles.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast.
description: Sitting around the dining table with my parents, I enjoyed the chicken soup rice noodles my mother made, topped with ham slices and chopped scallions, served with pickled cabbage. My father had just brought back a bundle of baby bok choy from the morning market. To stay in good shape for the exam, I only had half a bowl of the soup. My parents kept reminding me not to be nervous and to watch the rearview mirror. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cycle to the driving school meeting point.
description: She unlocked a Meituan bike at the entrance to her residential complex and rode along familiar streets against the morning breeze. Passing Green Lake Park, she heard morning exercise music, and riding down Wenlin Street, she caught the burnt aroma of grilled erkuai. About 8 minutes later, she arrived at the driving school meeting point on North Cuihu Road, where the white Jetta training car was already waiting.
location: Starting from No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, ride along Cuihu North Road to the driving school meeting point.

name: The whole process of the Subject 3 driving test
description: I got into Coach Li’s Jetta training car and headed to the Longquan Road exam site. A safety charm hung in the car. Coach Li went over the procedures as he drove, while Xiao Wang, another candidate in the back seat, nervously wrung her hands. I softly comforted her. After arriving at the waiting area, I sat in a corner and flipped through photos of Green Lake on my phone to calm my nerves. Candidates around me were quietly reciting the light-control mnemonics. When it was my turn, I got in the car and drew Route 1. I did the walk-around inspection, adjusted the seat, and fastened my seatbelt in one smooth sequence. The car started smoothly, and the gear shifts were fluid. I slowed down in the school zone and yielded before the crosswalk. When pulling over, I signaled right and came to a steady stop. The examiner nodded and said, “Passed.” After signing the score sheet, I immediately called my mother to share the good news, then sent a WeChat message to my friend He Lu: “Today is a great day!”

participant.name: Xiao Wang
participant.relation: Fellow test-taker on the same bus.

location: Kunming Motor Vehicle Driver Subject 3 Examination Base, Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming (including the exam route and waiting area)

name: Morning photography at Cuihu Park
description: While waiting for the driver's license to be produced, she took a taxi to Green Lake Park. The morning sunlight was just right; the withered lotus on the lake had clear outlines, their stems broken yet still upright. She used her phone to take multiple wide shots and close-ups, and used a voice recorder to capture the sound of the wind and the distant choir's singing. She sat briefly on a lakeside bench, looked through the withered lotus series photos taken since October 10, and felt the relief of completing a series. Then she took a taxi back to the exam venue.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Pick up driver's license and return home to announce the good news.
description: She queued at the license issuance hall to collect her brand-new C1 driver's license, flipped through every page to confirm the information, and then took a photo to post on WeChat Moments: 'Only when the steering wheel is in your own hands do you understand what freedom means.' Then she cycled home, passing a milk tea shop and mentally planning to buy ingredients for brown sugar pearls that evening. As soon as she got home, she rushed into the kitchen and handed the license to her mother, who wiped her hands on her apron, opened it carefully, and grinned from ear to ear. The stairwell was filled with the aroma of mushrooms.
location: Starting from the certificate issuance hall of the Subject 3 driving test site on Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, cycling to Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and midday break
description: Mother served golden mushroom fried rice and tomato egg drop soup. Father made a special trip home for lunch and, after hearing about it, said he would take me to Dianchi Lake for a test drive on the weekend. After the meal, I helped Mother clear the dishes, then went back to the bedroom, lounged on the bed for half an hour, and mulled over going to the bookstore in the afternoon.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Selling paintings on consignment at Mingyuan Bookstore
description: I walked from home to Mingyuan Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. On the way, I passed Wenlin Street and saw a queue in front of a braised-food shop. At the bookstore, I handed the framed 'Four Seasons of Green Lake' watercolor series to the owner Qin Mingyuan. After examining them carefully, he especially praised the tone of 'Green Lake Spring'. We agreed on the consignment details: each piece priced at 15 yuan, displayed in a dedicated section on the cultural-creative shelf, with settlement at the end of the month. After signing the contract, Uncle Qin was very satisfied and even asked me to paint a few small-format pieces next week to hang by the entrance.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Purchases at Paper-Cloth-Stone Bookstore and journaling time
description: Crossing the road from Mingyuan Bookstore, she arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore, and the bamboo wind chime rang a few times. In the watercolor section, she chose two tubes of Winsor & Newton ultramarine and burnt sienna, and one tube of permanent light green. The clerk recommended the newly arrived Cuihu Reflection washi tape, and she happily bought it, for a total of 58 yuan. Then she sat down in a seat by the window, ordered a hot milk, opened her journal, and quickly recorded the morning's exam process with a fountain pen, drawing a small daisy in the "Today's Achievements" column. Next she read part of the newly arrived Miscellaneous Notes from Central Yunnan, and the chapter on Shaxi, Dali planted a seed of interest, making her imagine a future trip.

participant.name: Shop assistant.
participant.relation: Clerk at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore

location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and preparing for yoga class
description: Walking home from the bookstore, sunlight slanting across the stone-paved road, she passed a flower shop and saw lisianthus in full bloom. She paused for a few seconds, thinking she would come pick a bouquet on the weekend. After returning to the community, she took the newly arrived Prose magazine from the mailbox. Once home, she changed into slippers, drank a glass of warm water, opened the wardrobe, took out the navy-blue yoga clothes and towel she had prepared earlier, and put them in her sports bag. Then she picked up her phone and replied to a few comments on Moments: Zhang Jing said, "Wow Yuwei, you're amazing!" and Zhou Lin said, "Take me along and give me a ride!" She felt delighted.
location: Walked back from 32 Cuihu North Road to Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, passing a flower shop along the way.

name: Cycle to Zhongmou Yoga Studio
description: Riding a bike along Renmin Middle Road, turning west onto Dongfeng West Road; the evening crowd was growing, and the roadside fruit stalls were bustling. After arriving at Dechun Commercial Building, I went up to the fourth floor by the side entrance; the entrance of the yoga studio was carpeted in dark gray.
location: Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Zhongmou Yoga Studio)

name: Yoga Class and Headstand Breakthrough
description: After changing into yoga clothes and entering the studio, coach He Lu said with a smile that today we'd practice headstands. After warming up, I began trying away from the wall: on the first attempt, my lower back tensed, I wobbled twice, and came down; on the second, I engaged my core but my weight shifted right, and my right arm gave way, so I toppled again; on the third attempt, following the coach's soft cue, I imagined my tailbone reaching toward the ceiling, took a deep breath, and slowly lifted my legs—holding steady in the air, one second, two seconds... five seconds! After landing, He Lu patted my shoulder and praised, "Next class you can try the slow lift." I was flushed and my heart was racing; in the locker room mirror, I made a heart sign for myself.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping and returning home
description: After yoga class, she changed back into casual clothes and cycled to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street. She bought bananas, cherry tomatoes, and kiwifruit, then went to the milk tea ingredients section and picked up brown sugar pearls, brown sugar syrup, and a box of Meiji fresh milk. She also grabbed a box of local flower cakes. The total came to 82.6 yuan. After paying, she walked home carrying the shopping bags. Downstairs, she ran into Aunt Li, who runs the small shop, and proudly told her the good news of passing the driving test. Aunt Li smiled and congratulated her.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; then walk back to No. 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Dinner time and sharing with family.
description: After getting home, I sorted the purchases, handed the flower cakes to my mother and said, 'a little extra treat for you two,' and put the fruit and milk in the fridge. For dinner, my father reheated the midday mushroom fried rice, and my mother stir-fried baby bok choy with garlic and fried sunny-side-up eggs. I placed my driver's license in the middle of the dining table; my parents took turns examining it. My father reminded me that I cannot drive on the highway during the probationary period, and my mother teased him for being too nervous. I shared the news that Uncle Qin wants to collaborate long term. My father thought the 15-yuan price was a bit low but supported me in trying it first. The dining table was filled with the aroma of mushrooms and laughter, warm and cozy.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reply to advisor's email
description: After a short rest following the meal, she opened her laptop, logged into her school email, and saw an email from Professor Wu Mingyuan: 'The part about Cuihu in the second chapter of Slow Travel Notes has improved a lot. I suggest merging "Old Streets and Alleys" and "Cuihu" into one chapter.' After reading it carefully, she spent fifteen minutes typing a reply, thanking her teacher for the affirmation and promising to complete the second-draft revisions within the week.
location: Bedroom desk at Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal keeping and financial planning
description: Take out the dark green journal and open it to a new page. With a fountain pen, write down the date and weather, then list today's achievements: 1. Got my C1 driver's license; 2. Signed the consignment agreement with Mingyuan Bookstore; 3. Completed a headstand for the third time — five seconds; 4. Received an email from my advisor. Stick a gold star sticker next to each item. Then turn to the "To Explore" page and write down plans such as consulting China Merchants Bank about opening a fund account, continuing to read money-management books, and making a timeline for revising the first chapter, and draw a simple sketch of a brown-sugar boba milk tea next to it.
location: Bedroom desk at Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxing reading and chatting
description: She poured half a cup of hot milk and sat on the living room sofa. The TV was broadcasting the weather forecast: cloudy tomorrow, 17-24°C. She casually opened Random Notes from Central Yunnan, bought that afternoon, and when she saw the passage about Xizhou, Dali, thought that she could plan a short trip after finishing the manuscript revision. Her phone vibrated. It was a message from He Lu saying that she was really happy for her today and suggesting celebrating with milk tea after the next class. She immediately replied with a good and three smiley faces.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and bedtime reading
description: Washed her face with warm water, applied moisturizing lotion, and changed into light blue striped cotton pajamas. Sitting on the edge of the bed, she opened the English edition of Walden and read for ten minutes. When she came to the passage about simple living, she thought of the focus she had at the exam hall and during yoga during the day, and felt a perfectly fitting peace. Then she set the alarm for 7:10 tomorrow morning and neatly placed her journal and ID card on the desk.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Fell asleep through meditation
description: Sitting cross-legged on the bed, she turned off the main light, leaving the warm bedside lamp on, and opened a meditation app to play mixed white noise of rain and cello. Starting from her toes, she slowly relaxed her whole body. The scenes of the day flowed by like water: the driving school car, Uncle Qin's expression as he looked at the painting, He Lu saying "tailbone up," her mother's smiling face... Finally, she turned off the lamp, smiled faintly in the darkness, silently recited the line from Walden, "I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately," and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretching, a walk and photography at Cuihu Park, and buying breakfast.
description: I woke up naturally in the morning light, drank a glass of warm water, and did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in front of the bedroom window. I changed into a comfortable cotton-linen long dress and a knit cardigan, and packed my mirrorless camera, 50mm prime lens, and spare battery into a canvas bag. I walked about 8 minutes to Green Lake Park. In the early morning, the park was quiet and serene, with only birdsong and elderly people doing morning exercise. I used the camera to capture the morning light reflected on the lake, the lingering silhouettes of lotus leaves, and the gradient textures of maple leaves, while quietly planning the sketch composition for my journal. After exiting through the east gate of the park, I bought two portions of small-pot rice noodles from the familiar breakfast stall at the entrance of the residential community, one for my mother, and brought them home in takeout containers.
location: Cuihu Park, No. 67 South Cuihu Road, and Cuihu Community, No. 7 West Huashan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Index fund study and note organization.
description: I spread out the yoga mat and did 15 minutes of neck rehabilitation yoga in the half-light by the window, including head turns, lateral flexion, and shoulder shrugs to relax. It eased the stiffness from sitting for a long time; the shoulder and neck pain lessened and my energy recovered.
location: Study at Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having lunch with my mother
description: In the dining room, she shared the photos she had taken in the morning with her mother and told her that she was going to the bank in the afternoon to ask about wealth management. Her mother mentioned that Aunt Xie from next door had been admitted to the community hospital after a relapse of an old illness, so she decided to visit her on the way that afternoon.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and light reading
description: After lunch, I leaned back in the lounge chair on the balcony and read a bit of Walden, feeling Thoreau's tranquility. The sunlight outside the window was just right, and I closed my eyes for a short nap of about 20 minutes.
location: Balcony, Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to the bank to inquire about opening a fund account.
description: I packed my ID card and bank card, walked about 12 minutes to the China Merchants Bank Kunming Cuihu Sub-branch. After taking a number and waiting, I consulted the wealth management manager Xiao Liu about opening a fund account and automatic investment. He answered the questions from my morning study and recommended two conservative index funds. I decided to open the account once the funds arrive next Monday. The whole process took about 35 minutes.
location: China Merchants Bank (Kunming Green Lake Sub-branch), No. 75 Qingyun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stopping by to visit neighbor Aunt Xie on the way
description: After leaving the bank, she rode a shared bike for about 25 minutes to reach the Gulou Taoyuan Community Health Service Station in Panlong District. She chatted with Aunt Xie for half an hour, sharing the good news of getting her driver's license and planning finances, especially mentioning the joy of passing Subject 3 yesterday. Aunt Xie was in good spirits and reminded her to be careful.
location: Panlong District Gulou Taoyuan Community Health Service Station, No. 86-87 Taoyuan Street, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore to check postcard sales
description: After leaving the hospital, she cycled about 20 minutes to Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. The bookstore owner, Uncle Qin Mingyuan, said that two postcards from the Autumn series of the Four Seasons of Cuihu postcards that had been left on consignment at the bookstore yesterday had already been sold. He helped rearrange the remaining postcards and suggested designing them as a set of bookmarks. The two chatted about the bookstore's recent customer traffic.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the supermarket to stock up on daily necessities
description: Walked about 17 minutes from the bookstore to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and, following Mom's instructions, bought fresh blueberries, kiwifruit, a bottle of whole milk, and a case of mineral water. Seeing the newly arrived organic brown sugar, she thought she could make pearl milk tea, so she also picked up a bag. The total at checkout was 68 yuan.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Go home and organize the photography materials.
description: Walk home and put away the purchased items by category. Then turn on the computer, import the morning photos into Lightroom, quickly browse and select 15 photos with good composition and lighting, and tag them as 'Morning Light - Autumn Leaves - Lake Shadows' to get a feel for a future Western Hills photography series.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revise the structure of Chapter 2 of Slow Travel Notes
description: Opened advisor Professor Wu's email and, based on the suggestions, began drafting a plan to merge Chapter 2. In the journal, I drew a new chapter structure diagram, marked the content that needed to be cut and expanded, and thought about how to blend the two sections 'Childhood Street Scenes' and 'Family Memories' more naturally.
location: Study at Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping with dinner preparations and casual family conversation
description: Walked into the kitchen, helped Mom pick vegetables and peel garlic, and listened to her chatter about household matters. Dad came home from work with a pack of newly arrived Yunnan black tea. Dinner was stir-fried Chinese yam, shredded pork with green peppers, and the leftover mushrooms from yesterday. At the dinner table, shared with my parents what I saw and heard at the bank and the bookstore today. Dad expressed support for the financial plan and suggested we go look at cars together next weekend.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Accompany parents on a walk in Cuihu Park.
description: The three of them put on comfortable shoes and strolled along the Green Lake trail. The evening breeze was cool. She walked arm in arm with her mother and listened to her father tell stories about his days at the Cultural Bureau when he was young. She took a few photos of the Green Lake night view at dusk with her phone and sent them to her older sister in Shenzhen.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal recording and in-depth conception of 'Notes on Slow Travel'.
description: After the walk, I took a hot shower and sat down at my desk to open my journal: first I pasted in selected small photos from this morning's shoot and drew quick sketches beside them; then, combining today's observations and the results of the bank consultation, I wrote in detail about what I'd learned about index funds; finally, I spent a full 30 minutes sketching out a complete revision outline for Chapter Two of Slow Travel Notes in the journal, and wrote down the core revision principle: "the emotional line and the timeline run in parallel."
location: Study at Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and free time
description: Leaning against the headboard, I first read a short passage from the English edition of Walden and felt Thoreau's writing style. Then I picked up my phone and saw a Moment from my friend Zhang Jing about her students, so I liked it. He Lu sent a message saying she was going back to her hometown next week and asked if I wanted to go with her to her yoga studio to take a makeup class. I replied yes.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime body scan meditation
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I turned off the main light and turned on the night light, then sat cross-legged on the bed. I opened a meditation app on my phone and followed the guidance for a 10-minute body scan meditation, from the top of my head to my toes, feeling my body relax and my breathing become steady.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed.
description: After meditation, her mind was calm. She picked up the copy of Walden by her bed and softly read two pages. When she came to the line, 'I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately...' she closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep around 22:30 with a fulfilling and contented feeling.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation, reading aloud, and quick journaling.
description: On an autumn morning, she naturally woke up to the slight chill of 16°C, did a five-minute gratitude meditation, and gave thanks for the new day. Then she sat at her desk, opened the English edition of Walden, and softly read a passage from “The Bean-Field.” After reading, she wrote down the day's keywords in her journal: “Xishan light, family, financial management,” and used Cuihu Lake washi tape to make a simple border.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and getting ready to leave
description: Mother prepared warm milk oatmeal porridge with kiwi and blueberries for breakfast. While eating, they chatted about the plan to go to Western Hills for photography, and mother reminded her to bring a jacket because it was windy on the mountain. She checked the mirrorless camera, battery, and memory card, and stuffed water and two flower cakes into her backpack as provisions.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Xishan Forest Park
description: Before heading out, I took a 10-minute slow walk downstairs, then walked to the Huashan West Road bus stop at the entrance of Cuihu Park and took Bus 104 at 7:45. Sitting by the window with earphones on, I listened to light music. The ride took about 30 minutes, with urban buildings gradually receding outside the window and greenery growing denser.
location: Bus 104 (from Huashan West Road Station to Xishan Forest Park Station)

name: Photography at Xishan Forest Park
description: Arrived at Xishan Forest Park and took deep breaths of the crisp mountain air. Walked up along the Taihua Ancient Trail, focusing on capturing light and shadows. In the dense red-leaf area, I photographed morning dew and maple leaf textures, and halfway up captured the 'god rays' shining through the trees. At 10:30, I rested on a stone bench by the roadside, drank water, and ate a flower cake. Before descending, I lingered again in the red-leaf forest, picked up a perfect red leaf, and pressed it into my journal.
location: Xishan Forest Park, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home, breakfast, and tidying up
description: She took Bus No. 104 back from Xishan. After arriving home, she washed her hands and face and had a simple meal of a bowl of oatmeal with milk and fruit. She imported the photos from her camera into the computer, then read aloud an English passage from Chapter 7 of Walden for 10 minutes, and finally organized and stored her camera equipment.
