location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and sharing
description: Mother had made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and shredded pork with green peppers. At the table, she enthusiastically showed her mother the red leaf photos she had just taken on the camera screen, and her mother praised the composition.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Photo post-processing and academic communication.
description: Using Lightroom, she selected and post-processed the morning photos, adjusting highlights, shadows, and color temperature to make the red leaves more vivid. While editing, she opened WeChat and saw a message from her advisor Wu Mingyuan suggesting that she merge "Childhood Old Street" and "School Days Memories" in Chapter 2 of "Slow Travel Notes." After reading it carefully, she replied to her advisor, saying she would organize her thoughts tonight and revise over the weekend.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Learn financial management knowledge.
description: She took out the fund regular investment flyer given by her neighbor Aunt Xie and, combined with knowledge from books, initially planned the fund allocation in her notebook: invest 800 yuan per month from manuscript fees and pocket money into one hybrid fund. For unfamiliar terms like 'broad-based index' and 'expense ratio', she circled them with a red pen, ready to ask for advice.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing dinner with her mother.
description: Went into the kitchen to help her mother, who was rendering chicken fat, the aroma filling the air. She helped break down the black-boned chicken and cut it up, rinsed the cooked rice noodles in cold water, and also learned to make flower cake filling by mixing rose jam, cooked flour, and lard. During this, she took close-up photos and sent them to her older sister in Shenzhen; her sister responded and interacted, and the mother and daughter chatted while working, relaxed and happy.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family celebration dinner
description: Dad came home from work, and the three of us sat around the dining table. On the table were steaming crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, freshly baked flower cakes, and a few small dishes. Dad opened a bottle of green plum wine and raised a toast to celebrate Yuwei's recent small achievements, such as getting her driver's license, the postcards selling well, and 'Notes on Slow Travel' being recognized. He also shared stories from 'Reflections on the Southwest Associated University.' The three of us chatted while eating, cozy and happy.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-dinner walk around the community
description: After dinner, the family of three put on comfortable shoes and went downstairs for a walk in the Cuihu community to help digest the meal. Yuwei took out her phone and showed her parents the photos taken at the Western Hills today, telling them funny stories from the climb and sharing her photography insights. Golden ginkgo leaves shimmered under the streetlights, the evening breeze was gentle, and the family's laughter echoed along the path.
location: A small path in Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Ask a neighbor about the details of financial management
description: After returning home from her walk, she sat at her desk and made a WeChat video call to Aunt Xie, her neighbor. After greeting her politely, she asked in detail about regular fund investment operations, including share confirmation, setting take-profit points, and fund conversion. Aunt Xie answered patiently and suggested starting with the CSI 300 Index Fund. Yuwei carefully noted the key points.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Photo retouching and journal documentation
description: After hanging up, I felt fulfilled. I turned on the computer and picked 6 photos from today's "Western Hills Autumn Charm" series, fine-tuned them with a photo editing app, added a watermark, and saved them to the "2025 Autumn Photography" folder. I brewed a cup of jasmine tea, opened my journal, decorated it with red leaf specimens I had collected from the Western Hills, and wrote down my photography insights, study takeaways, and gratitude diary.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening reading, meditation, and bedtime
description: Changed into loungewear, sat on the bedroom bay window and read the corresponding chapter of the Chinese edition of *Walden*. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up, got into bed, dimmed the lights, and did a 10-minute gratitude meditation, recalling the good things of the day. Finally, she turned off the light and fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and getting ready
description: At 7:00 the alarm rang softly. Sun Yuwei did not get up immediately after turning it off; instead, she did 5 minutes of deep-breathing meditation in bed, feeling her chest rise and fall. Then she sat up and completed several sets of gentle morning stretches to wake up her sleeping muscles. She stood barefoot on the scale; her weight was 46.2kg. She changed into a light workout T-shirt and leggings, ready to go out for morning exercise.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cross-training by the Panlong River
description: Breakfast and post-meal preparations.
location: Panlong River trail from Renmin East Road to Yuantong Bridge, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga stretching and shower
description: Back home, she spread out her yoga mat on the living room balcony and did 20 minutes of yin yoga stretching facing the community garden, focusing on relaxing her legs and hips. Then she took a hot shower and changed into comfortable cotton-linen loungewear.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning reading and family breakfast
description: She sat on the sofa and read aloud passages about solitude from the original English edition of Walden. Mom brought out small-pot rice noodles with soft-boiled eggs, and Dad prepared shredded radish with sesame oil. The three chatted while eating. Sun Yuwei shared the photos of the “Jesus light” she took at Xishan yesterday, and her father recalled having captured similar light and shadow when he was young.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Systematic financial learning
description: In the study, I opened 'The Index Fund Investment Guide' and studied chapters seven to nine as planned. Using colored gel pens and sticky notes, I made practical notes in my journal. On one page I drew a flowchart of the four-step dollar-cost averaging plan, and on another page I listed a risk-control checklist with small icons, making the dry knowledge vivid.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and family lunch
description: She took the initiative to help her mother in the kitchen pick vegetables, peel garlic, and cut broccoli. Her mother laughed at her for cutting the pieces too big. Lunch was garlic broccoli, stir-fried beef, and tomato egg drop soup. While working, they chatted about the afternoon writing group, and her mother told her not to come home too late. After the meal, Sun Yuwei washed the dishes, then set a 15-minute nap alarm for a short rest.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon reading and preparations for the gathering.
description: Cuddled on the sofa reading Wang Zengqi's 'The Grass and Trees of the Human World' for half an hour, feeling calm. Back in the bedroom, I used a red pen to circle the core issues in editor Xu Mingyuan's feedback email on Chapter 2 of 'Slow Travel Notes'—the narrative pace being too fast and the transition chapters being loose—and copied them into the small journal. Packed the canvas bag: journal, Lamy pen, power bank, tissues, and the red leaves picked on Xishan yesterday, ready for the afternoon gathering.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth writing group gathering.
description: After a 15-minute walk to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, the gathering officially began at 14:00. Sun Yuwei first shared her writing progress and editor feedback, honestly analyzing the structure and pacing issues. The group members discussed warmly and suggested using flashbacks to soften the pacing or cutting irrelevant scenery descriptions. At 15:40, they moved to the topic of creative blocks and breakthroughs. She analyzed how her perfectionism led to procrastination, which resonated warmly with everyone. During the break, she noticed that another of her "Autumn" series watercolor postcards had sold; Li Meng proactively added her on WeChat and said she liked her writing style. Afterwards, she privately asked Uncle Qin about the feasibility of designing themed bookmarks, and Uncle Qin explained in detail, from costs and channels to pricing. The gathering continued until nearly 18:00.

participant.name: Uncle Qin
participant.relation: Owner of Mingyuan Bookstore, member of the writing group

participant.name: Li Meng
participant.relation: A new member of the writing group, a newly made friend.

location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 144 Wenlin Street, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bookstore visit and bookmark design consultation
description: After leaving Mingyuan Bookstore, she took a stroll to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. Uncle Qin was also there, and the two discussed bookmark materials and binding in front of the independent-design shelf. Uncle Qin showed her samples such as card paper, transparent PVC, ribbons, and metal clips, giving her a lot of inspiration. Sun Yuwei decided to go home and design a draft using her own watercolor painting Four Seasons of Green Lake. Before leaving the shop, she flipped through Chinese National Geography but didn't buy it.

participant.name: Uncle Qin
participant.relation: Owner of Mingyuan Bookstore, member of the writing group

location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home and light housework
description: Walked 12 minutes home, and after putting down the bag, quickly jotted down the group members' suggestions and Uncle Qin's points about the bookmark in a small journal. Then went to the kitchen to help her mother blanch the pork ribs for the evening's soup.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was sweet yam and pork rib soup, stir-fried garland chrysanthemum, and Mom's signature pan-fried tofu. Sun Yuwei shared the afternoon discussion about overcoming perfectionism, and her father was deeply moved, feeling that his own worries were not unique. After the meal, she rushed to clear the table.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cuihu Family Night Tour
description: The family of three went out for a walk on a cloudy evening with a gentle breeze. They entered Green Lake Park from the south gate and walked a full circle around the lake. Dad mentioned that he wanted to look at new-energy vehicles, and Sun Yuwei agreed and recommended a store a classmate had been to. By the lake, she opened her journal and showed her mother the sketch outline of the new bookmark.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Organizing and Socializing
description: Changed into pajamas and sat at the desk. First, she sent a WeChat message to her friend Zhang Jing to invite her out for coffee, with a night-view photo of Cuihu Lake attached. Then she focused on organizing her journal: she sorted out a detailed revision checklist for "Slow Travel Notes," recorded three tips for overcoming perfectionism, and drew a basic template draft for the bookmark. She also sent her sister the gathering photos and the Western Hills red leaves, and chatted a bit.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading time
description: I put down my phone, poured a cup of warm osmanthus honey water, and continued reading the “Solitude” chapter of Walden, immersed in Thoreau's descriptions of nature and solitude. My heart felt especially tranquil.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: After washing up and doing her skincare routine, she sat cross-legged on the bed at exactly 22:00, opened the meditation app, and played a 10-minute body-scan meditation. Following the guidance, she relaxed from her toes to the top of her head one part at a time, and her whole body settled into stillness.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Final journal entry and tomorrow's plan
description: After meditating, I wrote today's final reflections and a summary of my financial notes in the journal beside my pillow with a fountain pen. Turning to a new page, I wrote a simple plan for tomorrow: organize the bookmark design drafts, go to Zhongmou Yoga Studio to make up the vinyasa flow class, and share the essay with Li Meng.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading to help sleep.
description: She turned off the main light, switched on the dim bedside lamp, and read two short essays about plants, insects, and fish from Selected Prose of Wang Zengqi, feeling relaxed and warm. She turned off the light at 23:30 and fell asleep peacefully in the quiet night of Wuhua District.
location: Room 202, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and sharing
description: After waking up naturally, Sun Yuwei drank a glass of warm water on an empty stomach. While tying her hair into a high ponytail in the washroom, she used her phone to send Li Meng from her writing group an excerpt from Chapter 2 of Slow Travel Notes, with the message: "Sharing a passage I read this morning; I hope it brings you a moment of peace."
location: Bedroom and washroom at home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go to the convention center, warm up and check in
description: Sun Yuwei put on fluorescent pink running shoes and a light gray quick-dry T-shirt, grabbed her running belt and water bottle, and called a ride-hailing car at the entrance of Green Lake Community to go to Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center. She arrived around 06:55, met He Lu near the starting area, and the two did dynamic stretching and a light jog to warm up together. He Lu handed her energy gels and salt tablets. Then they went to the bag-drop area to store their belongings and entered the starting area to wait. While waiting, she posted on the Xiaohongshu app, with photos of the dawn glow and her running shoes, captioned: “Good morning, Kunming. Ready to start a full-energy day with 5K! #KunmingRunning #HealthyRun” and @-mentioned He Lu.
location: Depart from No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and head to Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center on East Huanhu Road, Chenggong District.

name: 5 km health run and post-race relaxation
description: At exactly 7 o'clock, the starting gun sounded. Sun Yuwei and He Lu set off with the crowd, moving at a steady pace of 7 minutes 48 seconds per kilometer, with He Lu cheering her on. Along the course, the morning light over Dianchi Lake and the outline of the Western Hills were visible. They finished with a net time of 39 minutes. After crossing the finish line, they collected their finisher medals and took photos of each other in front of the finish-line backdrop. Then they walked slowly for 10 minutes, drinking water and stretching to relax. He Lu praised Sun Yuwei for being in great shape.
location: Race course and finish zone outside the Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center, Huanhu East Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip and activity log.
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, I got a ride-hailing car around 08:20 and returned to Cuihu Community. In the car, I posted my second Xiaohongshu update, a photo with the finisher's medal, with the caption: "From 800 meters to 5 kilometers, it's okay to go slower. New goal: 10 kilometers!" After getting home, I took a quick shower and changed into loungewear.
location: From East Huanhu Road, Chenggong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District.

name: Morning study activities
description: In her study, Sun Yuwei took out her dedicated journal, recorded this morning’s running data (5 km, 39 min), physical feelings, and mood with a fountain pen, and drew a little running figure. Then she opened the English edition of Walden and reviewed the vocabulary of Chapter 10. At 09:55 she began reading the chapter aloud with emotion. When she reached “I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately,” she marked it with a highlighter and wrote a Chinese annotation: “return to life itself,” paying special attention to intonation and linking. At 10:25 she closed the book and continued reading the last two chapters of The Index Fund Investment Guide, highlighting key points such as “the smile curve of regular investing” and “asset allocation rebalancing.” At 11:40 she organized her insights and key data into her finance notebook, completing one page of notes summary.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped her mother prepare the meal
description: Sun Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan. While picking vegetables, she shared funny moments from this morning's run, saying that He Lu praised her for her improved core strength. Her mother smiled and said she looked energetic, and told her the chicken soup simmered in the afternoon would be used as the base for rice noodles, and that there was still tofu skin in the fridge.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch, a short rest, and setting out for the vegetable market.
description: Sun Yuwei had a simple lunch with her parents, including stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tomato scrambled eggs, and rice. After the meal, she helped clear the table, then grabbed a small blanket and lay on the recliner on the balcony with her eyes closed for 20 minutes. At 1:25 p.m., she took her shopping list and canvas tote bag, set off from home, walked south along Huashan West Road, turned onto Renmin Middle Road, then walked west to Zhuantang Road, heading to the Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market.
location: Home dining room and balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; then along the way walking to No. 69 Zhuantang Road.

name: Shopping at Zhuanxin Food Market and returning home
description: Sun Yuwei arrived at Zhuanxin Market. First, she bought 150 grams of Xuanwei ham slices at Jianxin Yuan next to Xinhua Bookstore. Then she went into the market and, in turn, bought fresh termite mushrooms (asking the vendor to clean them), chives, tender tofu skin, quail eggs, and small chili peppers, and also bought kiwifruit and strawberries from a fruit stall. After shopping, she walked back home along the same route for about 30 minutes.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, return to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road

name: Preparing ingredients and setting up
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei sorted the ingredients and put them away, boiled water to blanch the chives, and at the same time cut the ham slices into thin strips, shredded the tofu skin, boiled and peeled the quail eggs, and sliced the little millet peppers into rings. She divided all the prepared ingredients into small dishes and arranged them nicely. At 16:20 she took a photo and sent it to the dormitory group chat with the caption: 'Tonight's crossing-the-bridge rice noodles alert!' and showed the photo of the arranged ingredients.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Room tidying and bookmark idea planning.
description: Sun Yuwei used a damp cloth to wipe dust off the living room coffee table and bookshelf, put scattered books back in place, and lit a sage-scented aromatherapy candle. At 17:00 she sat at her desk, took out a sketchbook and a 2B pencil, and began conceptualizing bookmarks themed "Four Seasons of Green Lake." She tried drawing minimalist line versions of Green Lake's outline for different seasons (spring willows, summer lotus, autumn leaves, winter gulls) and used watercolor pens to briefly sketch color schemes.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A friend's visit and sightseeing
description: At 18:00 the doorbell rang. Sun Yuwei opened the door and gave Liu Jia a big hug. Liu Jia brought a box of dragon beard candy, a specialty of Sichuan and Chongqing. Sun Yuwei took her hand and showed her around the newly arranged desk corner, displaying her journal and the just-finished Green Lake bookmark sketch.
location: At the front door and in the study of the home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Cooking together and preparing dinner
description: Sun Yuwei turned on the speaker and played a podcast about Dream of the Red Chamber, while the aroma of chicken soup filled the kitchen. The two chatted about school gossip and graduation thesis topics as they cooked together. Sun Yuwei directed, and Liu Jia helped bring the side dishes to the table. Finally, Sun Yuwei added quail eggs, ham slices, jizong mushrooms, tofu skin, and rice noodles one by one into the bowl of piping hot chicken soup, and at the very last second added chives, completing the crossing-the-bridge rice noodles.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Have dinner together
description: The two sat at the dining table enjoying steaming cross-the-bridge rice noodles. They chatted as they ate; Sun Yuwei shared insights on running and money management, while Liu Jia said she was agonizing over whether to take the postgraduate entrance exam. The table was filled with a warm, lively atmosphere, and the chicken soup was delicious.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Four-person video call.
description: Sun Yuwei set up her phone stand and started a group video call with Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin. Wenwen was in her pajamas looking over a publisher's manuscript, while Linlin was showing off her newly adopted kitten in her rental apartment in Shenzhen. The four of them gossiped about their lives and joked about funny interview experiences. One of them suggested a 'cloud toast,' and they clinked their oolong tea glasses across the distance.
location: Living room sofa area at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Seeing Off a Good Friend
description: After the video ended, Liu Jia got ready to take a taxi back to school. Sun Yuwei accompanied her downstairs and waited with her at the entrance of Cuihu Community. The night wind was cold; they hugged one last time. Sun Yuwei urged, 'Message me when you get there!' When the taxi arrived, Liu Jia waved goodbye.
location: Entrance of Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Before-bed wash-up, journaling, meditation, and going to sleep
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei quickly cleaned up the dishes and the living room, then went to wash up and changed into loose pajamas. She lay down on the bed, took out her journal, and wrote down today's reflections: "The sense of control from breaking through in my run, the steadiness of financial planning, the warmth of gathering with old friends, and the little spark of inspiration for the bookmark design — today was a day filled with love and strength." At 23:05 she turned off the main light, put on an eye mask, opened the "Tide" app for a body-scan meditation session, relaxed her body from head to toe, and soon fell asleep.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province: in the washroom and on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Early morning wake-up and pre-departure preparations.
description: After the 4:45 alarm went off, I got up right on time, quickly washed up, and did a 5-minute morning stretch to wake up my body. Then I packed a thermos full of hot water, a camera bag, and a windbreaker, making final preparations for the early morning trip to the Western Hills.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning photography excursion at Xishan.
description: Left on time at 5:00 and took a ride-hailing car to Xishan Forest Park. Arrived at the foot of the mountain around 5:40; the sky was faintly light and morning mist swirled. She climbed up along the Taihua Ancient Trail, stopped at Huating Temple's entrance to photograph the tranquil scene of the ancient temple's eaves blending with the blue smoke from incense burners, and captured a back view of two monks doing morning prayers sweeping moss-covered stone steps, adding atmosphere to the humanistic photo series. At 6:30, a light rain began at the mountaintop, so she put away her camera, walked down the mountain, and took a taxi home.
location: Xishan Forest Park (Taihua Ancient Trail, Huating Temple), Xishan District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Go home to freshen up and have a simple breakfast
description: Returned home at 7:10, took off the slightly damp softshell jacket, and took a hot shower to dispel the morning chill. After changing into cozy home clothes, she warmed a glass of milk in the kitchen, paired it with two slices of whole-wheat toast and a boiled egg, replenishing energy simply and nutritiously.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: English reading aloud and annotation
description: After her mother went out to buy groceries, the house was quiet. She sat down in the study, opened the English original of Walden, and continued reading aloud the passage about “simplicity” in Chapter Ten. As she read, she slowed her pace to feel the rhythm of the words and wrote a Chinese note in pencil in the margin: “Thoreau's simplicity is not poverty; it is the freedom of choice.”
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Donating the manuscript fee and recording it in the journal.
description: Opened mobile banking to check the newly received 800 yuan manuscript fee, copied the receiving account of the "Independent Bookstore Alliance Fund," donated the full 800 yuan anonymously, and wrote the note "Support independent bookstores." Then I took the journal out of the drawer and wrote solemnly with a fountain pen: "What words have given me, I wish to flow back to bookstores in a small way." I also stuck in a bookmark sticker purchased at Zhibushi Bookstore as a memento.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Financial archiving and recurring investment allocation
description: She took out the financial notes she had filled in last week and the China Merchants Bank account opening documents, scanned each page of notes into PDFs, and saved them to the "Study Materials/Finance" folder in her cloud drive. Then she opened the bank app, enabled the index fund automatic investment plan according to the consultation guide, and set it to auto-debit 500 yuan on the 10th of every month starting next month. In the investment insights section of her journal, she drew a pie chart: 60% bond funds as a stable base, 40% index funds for growth, with a note: "Like flower arrangement, the main branch and guest branch coexist in harmony."
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Self-driving route planning and rental car browsing
description: I opened the 'Wish List' section and drew the route starting from Kunming, passing Fuxian Lake to Dali, marking Shuanglang Ancient Town and Xizhou Wheat Fields as places I wanted to stop. For concrete planning, I opened a car rental app to check daily rates and pickup/return locations for economy cars and SUVs, and found that weekend prices are 30% higher. I quietly compared the costs, preparing for the self-driving trip at the end of October.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Writing the first draft of the essay collection (Part 1)
description: Inspiration struck. In the study, I opened my laptop and closed my eyes, recalling the afternoon light that leaked through the gaps in the library curtains in my high school campus, and the scent of old book pages mixed with the osmanthus from outside the window. Using this as a lead, I began typing the first paragraph of the new chapter of 'The Scent of Books on Campus.' Halfway through, my mother called me to lunch, so I saved my progress and paused.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Lunch and midday break
description: Her mother had prepared scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried choy sum, and winter melon and pork rib soup at home. During the meal, the two talked about the morning photography and the donation, and her mother smiled in approval. After dinner, Sun Yuwei leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes to store up energy for the afternoon's writing.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Walking to the bookstore and completing writing
description: At 13:00, I carried my canvas bag and walked to Mingyuan Bookstore, deliberately passing through Cuihu Park. Watching the seagulls gliding on the lake and the elderly taking a stroll, I blended the real autumn atmosphere with the scenes in my article, and inspiration kept flowing. At 13:35, I arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, ordered a hot Americano in a corner by the window, and opened my computer to focus on writing. Following the suggestion of Li Meng from the writing group, I focused on depicting "smell and sound" and wrote the first draft of "The Scent of Books on Campus" in one sitting, about 2,700 characters, typing the final period at 16:00.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discussing bookmark design at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore.
description: After leaving Mingyuan Book House, she walked three minutes to Zhibushi Bookstore and showed the owner, Qin Mingyuan, the bookmark sketches she had drawn over the weekend for “Four Seasons of Green Lake” (spring willows, summer lotus, autumn leaves, winter gulls). The two discussed making the four into a series, using thick white cardstock and trying spot UV finishing to highlight the patterns. Midway through the conversation, Uncle Qin went to greet a regular customer, and Sun Yuwei casually flipped through Japanese magazine layout designs for more inspiration.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Finalized the flower arrangement class at Jingxin Yoga Studio.
description: Walked 15 minutes to Jingxin Yoga Studio and discussed the flower arrangement course framework item by item with He Lu, who had just finished class, on the tatami in the rest area. In the end, we settled on three progressive themes: the first, 'Getting to Know Flower Forms (Upright Style)'; the second, 'Spatial Composition (Slanting Style)'; and the third, 'Free Creation and Insights.' He Lu said she had gathered at least 8 people, and the first class was scheduled for 15:00-17:00 on October 25 (Saturday).
location: Jingxin Yoga Studio, No. 195 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home, rest, and have a light dinner.
description: Walked home from the yoga studio. After changing into loungewear, I saw that my mother had already cooked tremella soup. I drank a bowl and ate a few pieces of fruit. Then I leaned on the sofa and scrolled through my phone, replying to Li Meng in the writing group on WeChat that the new chapter was done, and responding to the photo of the Shenzhen sunset my sister posted in the family group chat.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Accompanying my parents on a walk in Green Lake Park
description: In the evening, she went to Green Lake Park with her father and mother, strolling slowly along the lake. Her father talked about amusing incidents at his workplace, and her mother mentioned wanting to buy a new orchid. Sun Yuwei carried a mini journal and occasionally recorded atmospheric snippets such as the cool autumn night breeze, the distant square-dance music, and her parents' figures walking ahead.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Evening vinyasa yoga relaxation
description: After returning home, I spread out the yoga mat in the living room. Because my shoulders and neck were stiff from hiking during the day and sitting for a long time writing, I followed a 25-minute vinyasa yoga video saved on my phone, focusing on cat-cow pose, threading the needle, and shoulder stretches, coordinating each movement with slow breathing. After finishing, I used a foam roller to roll out the backs of my thighs and my back, and my body felt much more relaxed.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Organizing the flower arrangement course outline and transcribing materials.
description: After putting away her yoga mat, she opened her computer, organized the flower arrangement course outline discussed in the afternoon into a clear Word document, and sent it to He Lu for confirmation. She then transcribed the inspirations she had recorded at Cuihu Park in the evening into the material notebook for 'Slow Travel Notes,' accumulating material for future creative work.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening journal wrap-up and meditation
description: In the "Today's Completed" section of the journal, she listed Xishan photography, donating the manuscript fee, archiving finances, finishing the first draft of a new chapter, and confirming the flower arrangement class. In the "Gratitude" section, she wrote about her mother's lunch, Uncle Qin's advice, and He Lu's support. After closing the journal, she turned off the main light, lit an aromatherapy candle, sat on the floor mat in front of her desk, and did a 10-minute body scan meditation, slowly moving her attention from her toes to the top of her head to settle her thoughts.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Free reading before bed.
description: After a quick wash, she changed into pajamas, propped up in bed, and opened Wang Zengqi's "Plants in the Human World" to read two short essays. The writing was light and warm. At 21:00 she turned off the reading lamp and reflected that although the day had been busy, everything had been accomplished as planned. Feeling fulfilled and at peace, she soon fell asleep.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning preparations and heading to Xishan.
description: At 5 a.m., gently awakened by the phone alarm, I spread a yoga mat on the floor and did 5 minutes of stretching to wake up my body. I changed into a navy-blue windbreaker and checked my camera bag. Then I used a ride-hailing app on my phone to call a car and took it from the neighborhood gate to Xishan Scenic Area. It was still dark and drizzling, with few cars on the road. About 48 minutes later, I arrived near the eco-bus boarding point for the Xishan Nie'er Tomb Scenic Area.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Nie Er’s Tomb Viewing Platform, Xishan Scenic Area, Xishan District, Kunming.

name: Xishan rain scene photography
description: Holding an umbrella, she climbed the wet stone steps to the viewing platform at Nie Er's Tomb. The sky was just beginning to lighten, and misty rain swirled around. She patiently set up her camera and adjusted the settings, waiting for nearly half an hour in the fine rain. Finally, the morning light broke through the clouds, gilding the rain curtain, Sleeping Beauty Mountain, and the surface of Dianchi Lake in pale gold. She took the satisfying shot, completing her photography goal for the trip. Though her waterproof jacket was soaked through, she was filled with joy.
location: Nie Er's Tomb Viewing Platform, Xishan Forest Park, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to rest, breakfast, and morning journal
description: She went down the mountain contentedly, took a taxi from the pick-up point at Nie Er's Tomb, and returned home, a ride of about 40 minutes. After arriving home, she shook off the rainwater at the door, tiptoed into her room, quickly took a hot shower, and changed into dry loungewear. Her mother had prepared rice porridge, boiled eggs, and steamed buns. While eating breakfast, she used her phone to transfer the Xishan photos to GoodNotes on her iPad. Back at the desk in her study, she opened her physical journal, printed small sample photos with a mini printer and pasted them in, and wrote down in her LAMY fountain pen: 'Some scenery only waits for you in certain weather.'
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning English reading of Walden
description: With the patter of rain outside the window, she sat at her desk, opened Chapter 11 of the English edition of Walden, read aloud softly for 30 minutes, and left markings on the pages, enjoying the peace brought by the quiet atmosphere.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Departure preparation and walking to the bookstore.
description: After the reading session, she packed her canvas backpack with a laptop, charger, grid notebook, and fountain pen, and checked the essay outline in her phone memo. She put on a beige thin jacket, took a folding umbrella, and went out, walking along Huashan West Road. The air was fresh after the rain, and the road was slightly damp. Fifteen minutes later, she arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province to Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road.

name: Bookstore writing, lunch, and editor communication.
description: Walking into Zhibushi Bookstore, the owner Qin Mingyuan saw that Yuwei was damp with moisture and smiled as he brewed her a cup of hot black tea. She sat down in her usual window seat on the second floor, opened her laptop, and continued organizing her essay collection, weaving the images that had come to mind on Xishan Road — old people queuing for rice noodles, white steam from steaming baskets, and rain-soaked flagstone paths — into a vivid half-chapter, completing her conception of a morning breakfast market in Kunming. At noon, she walked to Binhu Restaurant at 202 Wenlin Street, ordered a small-pot rice noodles and braised tofu, and ate slowly. Back at the bookstore, she rested her head on the table for a 15-minute nap. After waking, she recorded inspirations on her phone. Later, she discussed the November column topic with Beijing editor Xu Mingyuan over a WeChat voice call. Xu praised the idea of 'The Aesthetics of Life in Kunming's Food Market' and asked her to submit the first draft at the beginning of next month. Yuwei was overjoyed.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, and Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Material selection and writing preparation
description: After communicating with the editor, I felt more energized. I opened my computer and searched for specialty stalls, cultural images, and food documentary clips from wet markets such as Zhuanxin and Donghua in Kunming, then screenshotted the key material and organized it into my writing notes to build up material for later in-depth writing.
location: Second-floor workstation at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Processing messages and selecting photographs.
description: Stepping away from writing, I browsed and replied to WeChat messages: Zhang Jing, a close friend from high school, invited me out for coffee this weekend, and the college roommate group was discussing where to have dinner. I also did a rough filter of the Western Hills scenery photos on my phone and saved the three best ones to the 'Essay Collection Materials' album.
location: Second-floor workstation at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio and attend yoga class
description: Leaving the bookstore, she walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the 4th floor of Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, about 35 minutes away, relaxing to light music along the way. She arrived on time for He Lu's yoga class themed "Flow and Balance". During the forward fold, He Lu helped her deepen the stretch, and she felt the release in her shoulders, neck, and back. During the post-class relaxation, lying on the yoga mat, she felt calm and at ease.
location: Classroom 3, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: After-class discussion and walking home.
description: After class, she had a brief exchange with Teacher He Lu. He Lu asked if she had been busy lately; Yuwei replied that doing yoga had already eased the stress. They also chatted about the recommended weekend meditation class. Then she changed clothes and leisurely walked back to her home in Cuihu Community.
location: Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: The rain had stopped. After returning home, she went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare dinner. While mincing garlic skillfully, she chatted with her mother about her experiences writing at the bookstore that day and the editor's praise. Her mother was delighted to hear it.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and casual chat
description: Father came home from work, and the family of three sat around the dining table, enjoying the mother's specialty dishes: steamed baby cabbage with garlic and vermicelli, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and braised chicken. During the meal, they shared feelings about trying a new sequence in yoga class, while her parents chatted about daily trivialities at work. The atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk in Cuihu Park after the rain
description: After dinner, the air after the rain was unusually clean. I walked slowly with my parents around the neighborhood and the adjacent Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park). Mother talked about amusing stories about familiar people at the vegetable market, Father said he had a meeting at work tomorrow, the streetlights reflected on the wet ground like bits of gold, and ordinary family talk warmed the heart.
location: Cuihu Community and Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and free time
description: After walking home, she went back to the bedroom. First she used her phone to fine-tune the photo “Morning Light in the Rain Curtain” and synced it to the cloud drive. Then she opened her journal and recorded all the heart-touching moments of the day: the patient waiting for photography at Western Hills, Uncle Qin's hot tea, the editor's affirmation, the lightness after stretching her body, and the peace of walking with her parents.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Meditating, reading, and falling asleep before bed.
description: After washing up and changing into cotton pajamas, I sat cross-legged on the bed, closed my eyes, and meditated for 10 minutes, replaying the day's experiences like a movie and then gently letting them go. After meditation, I picked up the worn Chinese edition of Walden from the nightstand and casually read my favorite passages. About 20 minutes later, drowsiness set in, so I closed the book, turned off the light, and drifted into sleep.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Early rising and morning preparations
description: At 7 a.m. sharp, I got up on time, waking in a light drizzle. Pulling back the curtain, I saw the plane tree leaves outside the window wet with rain. I sat up in bed for a moment to check in with my body, then drank a glass of warm water on an empty stomach. Hearing my mother preparing breakfast in the kitchen put me at ease. Afterward, I spread a yoga mat in the living room and did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching, focusing on my hips and spine, to get ready for the morning run.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning run in rain at Cuihu Park
description: I changed into a rainproof jacket and running shoes and walked 5 minutes to the east gate of Green Lake Park. In the rain, Green Lake resembled a splashed-ink landscape painting; there were few people, only the sound of raindrops. I ran 5 kilometers at a pace of about 7 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer, turning back at the trail on the southeast corner of the park. Breathing the slightly cool air, I felt wakeful. At 8:20 I reached the hallway outside my home, did static stretches, and dried my hair with a dry towel.
location: Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the roads to and from home

name: Shower and breakfast
description: After returning home, I took a hot shower and changed into dry loungewear. Mother had already cooked a steaming pot of small-pot rice noodles, with pickled cabbage and minced pork. While eating breakfast, I shared the scene of seeing an egret standing on the railing of the lake-center pavilion during my morning run, and Mother smiled in response.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, home bathroom and dining room

name: Morning English reading and prose organization.
description: Sitting at the desk, I opened the second half of Chapter Twelve, “Higher Laws,” of Walden, first reading it through and marking unfamiliar words and long sentences, then reading aloud. When I reached the passage about wildness, I felt a primitive resonance. After each page, I stretched my shoulders and neck. Then I opened my laptop and re-reviewed the table of contents of the essay collection “Slow Travel Notes,” making the chapter “Kunming Breakfast Market” written yesterday the third chapter, and adjusting the order of “Morning Light over Green Lake” and “A Tour of the Wet Market” so the thread moves more naturally from the outdoors to everyday street life. Next, I took out the journal where I had pasted reduced-print photos of the Western Hills the night before, and with a brown pen wrote beside the photos: “Dampness, waiting, and then a flash of light.”
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading on the balcony and selecting photos
description: After finishing her journaling, she sat in the rattan chair on the balcony and took “The World of Plants” from the bookshelf. She read Wang Zengqi's vivid and touching description of Kunming's mushrooms. The rain gradually stopped, and the sky brightened. She then picked up her phone to look through yesterday's photos of the Western Hills, chose a few with good composition, and planned to use them for the bookmark design.
location: Home study balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch with family and midday rest
description: Lunch was prepared by my mother, with stir-fried choy sum and braised beef with carrots. My father was working from home and talked about the cultural activity at his workplace next month. I shared an amusing anecdote about mushrooms from "The Grass and Trees of the Human World", and my mother said we could buy jizong mushrooms to stir-fry on the weekend. After the meal, I returned to the bedroom, set a 20-minute alarm, lay on the beanbag chair by the window with my eyes closed, and listened to the birds outside. When the alarm rang, I washed my face, changed into jeans and a white shirt, and put on a canvas bag with printed copies of Western Hills scenery photos, before heading to the bookstore.
location: The dining room and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore for exchange and postcard restocking.
description: Leaving the residential community, I walked slowly along Green Lake. The air was fresh after the rain, and I saw elderly people sitting at leisure and children picking up ginkgo leaves. After passing through alleys, I arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore. Uncle Qin was tidying the bookshelves and told me that the “Green Lake Four Seasons” series had sold six sets last week, and that a customer had suggested using photos of other places in Kunming. I replenished ten sets of stock and showed Uncle Qin the printed photos of the Western Hills. He suggested launching a series of postcards called “Western Hills Dawn.” I noted down the idea, then looked around the bookstore and picked out a literary magazine with an attractive cover.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 18 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Milk tea and sketching at Lakeside Hotel
description: After leaving the bookstore, the rain had stopped and sunlight was shining on the wet bluestone road. She walked into the Lakeside Hotel, ordered a cup of her usual brown sugar pearl milk tea, and sat by the window. She took out her sketchbook and used a pencil to draw the plane tree leaves outside the window and the parked bicycle, recording a moment of the autumn afternoon.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing the Flower Arrangement Class lesson plan and chatting with family
description: After walking home from Binhu Hotel, she sat down in the study, opened her laptop, and wrote the lesson plan for the October 25 flower arrangement class, themed "Getting Acquainted with Autumn Home Flower Arranging." She wrote out the procedure: introduce the three flower materials—daisy, goldenrod, and eucalyptus leaves—explain handling and the use of the kenzan, demonstrate the basic upright style, guide students through practice, and include hand-drawn step-by-step diagrams, rehearsing the explanation of the length ratio between the main and secondary branches. At 5:10 p.m., she left the study and saw her mother trimming vegetables, so she helped and chatted. They talked about Uncle Qin's suggestion to release a Western Hills postcard series; her mother supported it and said she wanted to give some to her students. Then she changed into a light trench coat and got ready to go out.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; home study and living room

name: Accompanying my parents on a walk in Green Lake Park
date: At 6:30 in the morning, I brewed Yunnan ancient-tree pu-erh in a purple clay pot and savored its mellow, sweet aftertaste; at 21:00 in the evening, I cold-brewed Moonlight White tea in a glass and drank it while reading essays under the desk lamp, noting its clear and cool sensation.
description: The family of three walked along the lake shore. After the rain, Green Lake looked like a green palette, and the air smelled of earth and grass. Her father pointed at mushrooms that had sprouted on the rain-soaked grass. When they reached the bamboo grove in the southwest corner, they heard a thrush singing. Her mother exclaimed how comfortable the weather was.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: When I got home, dinner was already on the table, with tomato egg drop soup and twice-cooked pork. I suggested trying the newly opened Huaiyang restaurant on the weekend. My parents agreed and we planned to take a stroll around too.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journal entries and wrapping up the lesson plan
description: After dinner, she returned to the study and refined the final reminder steps of the flower arrangement lesson plan, confirming everything from cutting the flower materials to shaping them. Then she opened her journal and wrote, "Uncle Qin's suggestion: launch the 'Xishan Dawn' postcard plan," pasted in another printed photo of Xishan, and recorded her feelings for the day.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: After tidying up my journal, I saw the photo of a new desk that my sister Sun Yutong had posted in the family group, so I started a WeChat video call. We chatted for half an hour. She complained that Shenzhen was hot, and I said Kunming had already turned cool. She encouraged me to prepare well for the flower arrangement course and said she wanted to be one of the first online students.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Relaxing and reading before bed
description: After hanging up, she picked out jeans and a beige sweater for tomorrow and placed them beside the bed. She closed the curtains, dimmed the lights, and did a 10-minute meditation in bed, focusing on her breath and letting her thoughts drift by. Afterward, she picked up the Chinese edition of Walden and read two passages about simple living, feeling at peace.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Gratitude journal and bedtime
description: Closed the book, wrote a gratitude journal in the small notebook on the nightstand: recorded the quiet of Green Lake after the rain, the new direction brought by Uncle Qin's suggestion, and the improvement of the ikebana class lesson plan. Checked the bag and keys needed for tomorrow. At 22:00 turned off the desk lamp, lay down listening to the wind outside the window, looking forward to hot soy milk in the morning, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 5 a.m., felt the faint light of dawn outside the window, did some simple stretches to loosen the shoulders and neck, and drank a glass of warm water to wake up the body. Checked the photography equipment prepared last night, including a tripod, camera bag, and hiking shoes. Then shouldered the camera bag and went out. In the elevator, met Aunt Xie, a neighbor who was out early walking her dog. After a brief greeting, walked to the Renmin Middle Road bus stop.
location: Cuihu Community and surrounding areas, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Western Hills Photography Trip
description: From Renmin Middle Road Station, I took the special bus route to Xishan Park, about an hour and a half in total. Along the way, I sat by the window with earphones on, playing the 'An Evening Walk' playlist on repeat, watching the city slowly wake in the morning light, letting my thoughts settle in the music. The morning air at Xishan was crisp and misty. At the viewing platform at Nie Er's Tomb and on the surrounding trails, I set up the tripod, adjusted the camera parameters, and used slow shutter speeds (1/8 second to 2 seconds) to capture the movement of the mist, focusing on the 'moss-covered wet stone steps' and the 'ancient temple eaves half-hidden in the mist,' concentrating on the cool gray-blue tones and subtle light and shadow, feeling a nearly transparent calm inside. After the photo session, I went down the mountain and bought two mushroom-and-vegetable buns and a cup of soy milk at the bun shop next to the bus stop for breakfast. On the return bus, I ate breakfast while going over the satisfying photos I had taken that morning, and kept listening to music. The whole round trip was long, but it was very rewarding.
location: Xishan Forest Park, Xishan District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (main activity location); on the bus route between Cuihu Community and Xishan Park

name: Morning study and lecture preparation
description: After returning home, she carefully put away the camera bag, changed into home clothes, and washed up briefly. Then she went into the study, sat at the desk, opened the remaining part of Chapter 12 of the English edition of Walden, and read aloud at a moderate pace for about half an hour, feeling the tranquility and power in Thoreau's words. Afterward, she inserted the camera memory card into the computer, quickly browsed the photos taken this morning, selected five or six with the best composition and lighting, and saved them in a new folder. At the same time, she picked up her journal and recorded the shooting parameters, weather and light conditions, feelings, and mood with sketches and text, accumulating material for the "Western Hills Dawn" postcard series. After a short rest, she looked at the greenery downstairs from the balcony to relax her eyes and neck. Then she returned to the study, opened her laptop, and used the university library's electronic resources to look up the academic background and recent papers of Teacher Chen, the speaker of the afternoon anthropology lecture, learning about his research topic of "the poetry of everyday life," with which she deeply resonated. She wrote down a few key questions in her notebook, such as "In fieldwork, how can observation be transformed from recording into feeling?" Then she packed the journal, a pen, and shorthand reference cards into a canvas bag, fully preparing for the afternoon lecture.
location: Study and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and casual family chat
description: She went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare lunch, volunteering to wash the vegetables and chop the scallions while chatting and mentioning that there was an anthropology lecture this afternoon and that she might need to sit writing for a long time in the evening. At lunch, she sat face to face with her mother, tasting the steaming beef ersi noodles she had made, talking about the mist and weather on the Western Hills that morning. Her mother mentioned that the daughter of their neighbor Aunt Xie was returning from Shenzhen. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and yoga class preparation
description: After lunch, returned to the bedroom for a short nap of about 20 minutes and woke up feeling full of energy. Since there was a yoga class in the evening, packed yoga clothes, a towel, and a water bottle into the sports bag in advance and placed it by the door to avoid a last-minute rush when getting back from school.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attended the anthropology lecture "The Poetry of Everyday Life"
description: After putting on lightweight canvas shoes, carrying a canvas tote bag, and wearing earphones, Sun Yuwei walked about 20 minutes along the lakeside path of Cuihu Lake to the School of Liberal Arts at Yunnan University. Sunlight filtered through the gaps in the leaves, casting dappled light, and she felt cheerful and expectant. She arrived at the lecture hall early, found a seat near the front but not in the center, sat down, and took out her notebook and pen to prepare. The lecture lasted two and a half hours. The speaker, Teacher Chen, told captivating fieldwork stories, especially the descriptions of the transient beauty of the Mosuo people's fire pits and the Tibetan sang ritual, which stirred her heart. She used her own shorthand symbols to quickly record core points and thought-provoking sentences. During the Q&A session, she raised her hand and asked the speaker how creators transform the "poetic quality" of the field into their own aesthetic language, and received a detailed answer. After the lecture, she stood in the corridor reflecting on the teacher's answer, feeling that her thinking had been opened up. She then paced in the small garden of the School of Liberal Arts, breathing fresh air and letting her thoughts gradually settle.
location: Lecture hall and surrounding area of the School of Literature, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening yoga class: Core and Balance
description: From the College of Liberal Arts garden, she walked about 15 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, passing familiar streets and coffee shops along the way. After changing into her yoga clothes, she took Coach He Lu's 'Core Strengthening and Balance' class, practicing with six or seven other students. During the final 15-minute inversion segment, with the coach's help, she successfully tried a headstand away from the wall and held it for about 7 seconds, feeling a small but genuine joy. After class, she specially thanked Coach He Lu and asked about the venue setup details for the October 25 flower arrangement class; Coach He Lu smiled and said she looked forward to her work.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and sharing with family
description: As the sky darkened and the streetlights came on, she walked home with earphones on, listening to light music. After arriving home, she had dinner with her parents. Her mother specially made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. While eating, she vividly shared the highlights of the afternoon lecture and the speaker's positive response to her question. Her parents were happy for her, and the family atmosphere was pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening creative writing and publishing an article on the WeChat official account.
date: The bus arrived at Lu Xun's Hometown.
description: After taking a comfortable hot shower, I brewed a cup of Lapsang Souchong black tea, sat down at my desk, and opened my laptop. I placed the lecture notes and the photos of the Western Hills taken this morning within reach, and began writing the review article “Seeing Poetry in the Fields,” starting from this morning's cool-toned feeling of the Western Hills and connecting it to the afternoon lecture's discussion of “poetic everyday life.” When I got stuck on a paragraph, I rode a shared bike to Mingyuan Bookstore (Kunming Paper-Cloth-Stone Bookstore) on Green Lake North Road to clear my mind. At the bookstore, I talked with the owner, Qin Mingyuan, bought 6 more sets of the best-selling “Four Seasons of Green Lake” postcards, and chatted about the misty Western Hills I had photographed that morning. Qin Mingyuan's eyes lit up at the photos on my phone, and he encouraged me to start thinking about a new series, “Morning Glow at the Western Hills,” saying, “The mist on the Western Hills this year alone could make a set.” With the refreshing breeze of that conversation, I cycled back to my study, sat down again, and wove the lecture's “poetic fields” together with Qin Mingyuan's comments on “the mist of the Western Hills” into my argument. In one go, I completed the draft, revisions, and layout before 22:00, titled it “Seeing Poetry Between the Fields and the Western Hills,” and after checking it, published it on my personal WeChat official account “Yuwei's Patchwork,” sharing it simultaneously to Moments and the writing group “Word Believers.”
location: Mainly at the home study (Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province); midway went to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening review and bedtime ritual
description: After the official account post was published, I received a like from the editor, Xu Mingyuan, and encouragement from friends in the writing group on my phone. I replied to each one and thanked everyone for their support, feeling satisfied. Then I prepared for bed: brushed my teeth, washed my face, did my skincare routine, and changed into comfortable pajamas. After turning off the light, I put on an eye mask and did 10 minutes of breathing meditation to let the day's full thoughts settle. After meditation, I turned on the light, jotted down inspiration fragments in my journal such as 'the cold tones of the Western Hills,' 'the courage to ask questions at the lecture,' and 'the joy of a free-standing headstand for 7 seconds,' and wrote a gratitude journal entry: 'Grateful for this morning's mist, grateful for Teacher Chen's golden words, grateful for my body. Good night.' Finally, I read a few pages of the Chinese edition of Walden, letting my mind gradually calm, and fell into a deep sleep around 23:15, feeling fulfilled after the burst of inspiration.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up, stretching, and English reading aloud
description: At 7:00 in the morning, the soft phone alarm went off. After waking up, Sun Yuwei drank a glass of warm water, then did three rounds of stretching on the yoga mat: cat-cow, downward-facing dog, and a shoulder-and-neck relaxation sequence, letting her body wake up in the cool morning air. After stretching, she sat at her desk, opened an English copy of Walden, and read Chapter 13 aloud, slowing her pace to absorb Thoreau's stillness and abundance by the lake. Morning light cast soft shadows through the off-white curtains onto the pages. When she finished reading, she marked a small pencil note.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out.
description: Her mother Li Xiulan had prepared a simple breakfast: hot milk, whole-wheat toast, and a boiled egg. Sun Yuwei listened to her mother talk about community anecdotes as she ate, and told her she was going to get the last HPV vaccine dose today. Her mother reminded her not to shower after the shot. After breakfast, she changed into a comfortable T-shirt and a light jacket, checked her ID card and medical insurance card, and slung on a small crossbody bag, ready to go out.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to the community health service center and get the third shot of the HPV vaccine
description: Sun Yuwei set out from home, walked south along Huashan West Road, turned onto Wenlin Street, and walked for about 18 minutes, feeling content and calm in the clear autumn sunlight. After arriving at the community health service center, she registered 2 minutes early. As the first person to receive the vaccine, she had her information checked by the nurse, who administered the third dose of the HPV vaccine into the deltoid muscle of her left arm. She then sat quietly in the observation area for 30 minutes, scrolling through photos of morning mist taken at the Western Hills the day before, thinking about Teacher Chen's question of how to turn the poetry of the fields into aesthetic language. When the observation ended and no abnormalities were confirmed, she left.
location: No. 78 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Returned home to record the vaccination and organize the journal
description: After the observation period, Sun Yuwei walked home and confirmed that her arm had no redness, swelling, or fever. At home, she took out her beloved journal, carefully cut out the vaccine label from the vaccination certificate, and pasted it onto the health records page in her journal. In fountain pen she wrote: "October 24, 2025, sunny. The body is the temple of the soul. Third dose, done." She added: "Ten consecutive days of morning reading of Thoreau, and I feel my mind is clearer." Then she opened the calendar on her phone and set a follow-up reminder for next April.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Deepening academic inspiration, discussing with the advisor, and organizing lecture notes.
description: Study room reorganization: archiving watercolor course works and reviewing journals.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch time
description: Her father, Sun Mingyuan, came home for lunch, and her mother had made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, and pork rib soup. At the table, Sun Yuwei shared about getting vaccinated that morning and her advisor's encouragement. Her father said with a smile, “Professor Wu's comments are very pertinent. You should put that drive to good use.” She felt the reassurance of being understood and supported by her family.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday rest and preparation of materials for the flower arrangement class
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei went back to the bedroom to rest; because her arms were a little sore, she avoided strenuous activity. She leaned against the headboard and sent a WeChat message to her friend Su Man: 'Manman, I'm going to Dounan this afternoon. Last time you said you wanted eucalyptus leaves, and my mom said she could bring some for you. What kind do you want?' Then she took out the first lesson plan from her flower arrangement class, reviewed the basic 'upright style,' and made a simple list of the kenzan and flower materials she needed to buy, preparing for the afternoon shopping trip.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Go to the library at Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus to return books.
description: Sun Yuwei slipped on canvas shoes, slung a large canvas bag over her shoulder, and walked from home to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station. She took Metro Line 3 and transferred to Line 2 to Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus, arriving about 35 minutes later. At the library, she returned the borrowed collection of essays on Walden at the self-service book return machine, then found The Principles of Floral Design among the shelves, quickly flipped through it, photographed the parts that interested her with her phone, and put it back.
location: Yunnan University Chenggong Campus Library, Chenggong District, Kunming

name: Go to Dounan Flower Market to buy materials for the flower arrangement class
description: After leaving the library, Sun Yuwei walked back to University City Station and took Metro Line 2 to Dounan Station. Exiting the metro station, she found herself at Asia's largest fresh-cut flower market, which was still buzzing with people and fragrant with flowers in the afternoon. She first went to the second floor of the main hall to buy a pin frog, then picked seasonal flowers on the first floor: orange-yellow spray gerberas, green pompon chrysanthemums, Nandina with small red berries, eucalyptus leaves with elegant shapes, and a bunch of leatherleaf fern as filler foliage. The total came to 195 yuan, within budget. She took a photo of the flowers with her phone, satisfied.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Transporting flower materials to the yoga studio
description: Sun Yuwei carefully took the metro home with a large bunch of floral materials and a heavy kenzan, going from Dounan Station via Line 2, transferring to Line 3, and arriving at Dongfeng West Road Station. On the way, she called He Lu on her phone and said, "Lulu, I've bought the flowers. I'll be at the studio in about an hour. Let's set up the classroom together!"
location: Kunming Metro Line 2 and Line 3 (Dounan Station to Dongfeng West Road Station)

name: Preparing the classroom for the flower arranging class
description: After arriving at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Sun Yuwei and He Lu put away the yoga mats together and moved in a long table. He Lu found a small blackboard, and Sun Yuwei wrote on it: “Tomorrow’s Flower Arrangement Class: Autumn Home Flower Arrangement.” She carefully trimmed the stems, wrapped them in wet newspaper, and put them in a bucket to keep them fresh. The kenzan was left to soak in a shallow water tray, and she neatly arranged the tools and flowers at the corner of the table. He Lu couldn’t stop admiring the eucalyptus leaves, joking that the materials were too nice. The two chatted in a relaxed and happy way about their expectations for the next day’s flower arrangement class.
location: Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home and have family dinner.
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, Sun Yuwei walked home along Dongfeng West Road. Streetlights came on in the dusk, and the autumn evening breeze eased the soreness in her arms. When she got home, her mother had already set a light meal such as steamed fish on the table, specially to help her recover. During dinner, she excitedly showed flower material photos on her phone and shared her experiences at Dounan Flower Market with her parents. Her mother remarked that eucalyptus leaves suited Su Man's temperament very well.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk around the neighborhood
description: After digesting for a moment, Sun Yuwei changed into flat shoes and went out. Instead of going to the noisy Green Lake Park, she walked slowly through the residential complex, circling along the wall. She stopped for a while to watch a kitten by the roadside, enjoying the solitude and leisure.
location: Cuihu Community and its surroundings, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation
description: After walking home, she washed up briefly, changed into pajamas, and sat cross-legged on the window seat cushion in her bedroom, leaning her back against the wall. She lit a lemongrass-scented candle and played a 10-minute guided meditation audio. Focusing on her breath, she accepted and gently let go of the day's experiences—the reassurance of the vaccination, the joy of her advisor's praise, the bustle of the flower market, and the fulfillment of working with friends—feeling warm and relaxed in body and mind.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening reading and journal wrap-up
description: After meditating, Sun Yuwei picked up the Chinese edition of "Walden" by her bedside, turned to where she had left off, and read two chapters. Thoreau's views on "simplicity" resonated with the peaceful day. Before closing the book, she took out her small journal and summarized the day in one sentence: "Today, I fulfilled a promise to myself and also prepared soil for a new seed (the flower arrangement class). Good night."
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the desk lamp, leaving only a small night light. She set tomorrow's alarm on her phone to remind herself to prepare the materials for her flower arranging class. Then she lay down. The soreness in her body reminded her of the day's experiences, but her heart was calm and full, and she soon fell asleep.
