location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning wake-up.
description: Woke up in her bedroom at home in Cuihu Community as the phone alarm rang softly. She got up with anticipation for the afternoon yoga and flower arrangement classes, opened the curtains, and enjoyed the morning sunlight and birdsong.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning exercise and English reading aloud by the Panlong River
description: She changed into sportswear and went out, walked along Huashan West Road to the intersection with Renmin Middle Road, entered the Panlong River trail, and read along with essays on an English radio station while brisk walking, feeling the river breeze and the morning atmosphere. After about 30 minutes, she broke into a light sweat.
location: Riverside trail along the Panlong River, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Home stretching, breakfast, and family chatting.
description: After jogging home, I laid out a yoga mat on the balcony and did a full-body stretch, paying special attention to relaxing the arm that had been vaccinated. Then I softly read a passage from Walden to look for writing inspiration. Afterwards I showered and went downstairs to have breakfast with my parents, eating small-pot rice noodles and grilled erkuai. We chatted about last night's dream about the flower arrangement class and how I felt after the vaccine. My father encouraged me: "If you put your heart into what you do, the results won't be bad."
location: Balcony and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Focused work in the morning: organizing health data and submitting photographs.
description: In the study, she opened the body-fat scale app to go over the October data, recording that her weight was stable at 46 kg, BMI 18.0, and anemia indicators had improved. She organized the weight-gain recipes and reflections into a Xiaohongshu note and saved it as a draft. Then she opened the Xishan 'Mist' series folder, selected 20 photos out of several hundred for fine editing, adjusted color temperature and contrast to restore the misty light and shadow, and finally chose 10, naming them 'Xishan Mist No. 11,' and uploaded them to the submission page of the 'Discover the Beauty of the Mountain Wilderness' photography contest.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Community interaction before the flower arranging class and organizing lesson preparation
description: After loosening her stiff neck, she sent a warm reminder in the ikebana class student group, specifying the afternoon class time, location, content as Ohara-style Basic Upright Form, and dress code, and ran through the teaching process and key talking points in her mind.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch and a nap.
description: At lunch, her mother made garlicky water spinach, stir-fried pork with green peppers, and pumpkin soup. Yuwei taught her mother about anti-fraud awareness, reminding her not to click unfamiliar links. After lunch, she rested for twenty minutes on the living room sofa, with soft piano music playing to help her doze.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon coffee and solitary reading.
description: She walked to Rubber Bookstore, ordered a hot latte, and sat in a corner by the window. She opened Wang Zengqi’s The Grass and Trees of the Human World to read the “Kunming Dishes” chapter, feeling the taste of home in the lines. Outside the window, the plane trees on Cuihu North Road were turning yellow in the autumn.
location: Rubber Bookstore, No. 18 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore and the writing group's prose reading and exchange
description: Walked to Zhibushi Bookstore (Mingyuan Bookstore), No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Kunming. Chatted with the owner Uncle Qin about expectations for the flower arrangement class and selected “The Eight Aesthetic Sensibilities of Japan.” At 2:30 in the afternoon, all members of the writing group arrived. Yuwei read aloud her essay “Wrinkles Under the Shutter,” telling the story of using her grandmother's old camera to take photos of elderly people. It received warm applause and led to in-depth exchange. Everyone discussed how to dig out writing material from daily life, and the atmosphere was warm and fulfilling.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore (Mingyuan Book House), No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Travel to the yoga studio, prepare for the flower arrangement class, and teach the first lesson
description: After leaving the bookstore, she bought a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea along the way to replenish her energy, then walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the 4th floor of Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road. She arranged the classroom in a U shape with He Lu, handed out kenzan and flower materials (gerbera daisies, pom-pom chrysanthemums, nandina, etc.), and went through the process using the teaching cards. At 5:30 p.m., all eight students had arrived. Yuwei, wearing a cotton-linen apron, began the class. She shared the story of how she became connected with flower arranging, explained the composition principles of the Ohara school's basic upright style, and slowly demonstrated trimming branches and arranging flowers. During the free creation time, she crouched down beside each student in turn and gently guided them, helping their works become more open and story-like. After class, the students excitedly took photos, added each other on WeChat, and arranged for next month's class. He Lu excitedly suggested making this time slot a regular one for Yuwei.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tidying up after the flower arranging class and confirming the schedule
description: After seeing the students off, I cleaned up tools with He Lu, divided the remaining flower materials, washed the flower frogs, and officially confirmed the last Saturday of next month as the regular class time. I looked through photos of the students' works, full of joy.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and an after-dinner walk around Green Lake
description: After walking home, she excitedly showed her parents photos and short videos from the flower arrangement class. Dinner was simple congee with a few side dishes. After the meal, she accompanied her parents for a walk in Cuihu Park. The autumn evening breeze was gentle, and she vividly recounted amusing moments from class, such as a student's trimmed flower falling into a bucket and an aunt insisting on arranging tall eucalyptus leaves. Laughter echoed through the night sky.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Evening journal and gratitude record.
description: After going home, showering, and changing into her pajamas, she opened her journal at her desk and wrote the day's theme in fountain pen: First Encounter: Autumn Flower Arrangement Class Debut. She drew a small picture of a gerbera daisy, and tucked in eucalyptus leaves and a sticker of the group photo with the writing group. In the gratitude journal section, she wrote thanks to He Lu, the students, Uncle Qin, and her own courage, feeling warm and fulfilled.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and calming meditation
description: After setting the alarm for the next morning, I leaned against the headboard and read a chapter from The Eight Aesthetic Sensibilities of Japan, noting how the book's concepts of yūgen and wabi-sabi echoed the less-is-more idea from the flower arrangement class. Then I put on earphones and did 10 minutes of mindful meditation, letting my thoughts drift.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Quiet the mind and fall asleep
description: Turning off the desk lamp, her heart full of gratitude and contentment for this Saturday, she soon drifted into a peaceful, sweet sleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning ritual and English reading aloud
description: Woke up naturally at 7 a.m. on a weekend morning; the shower outside the window had just stopped. After drinking warm water on an empty stomach, I did 15 minutes of morning stretching yoga in front of the bedroom window, then read Chapter Fourteen of the English edition of Walden, enjoying the peaceful reading time.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (in front of the bedroom window)

name: Family breakfast and creative brainstorming
description: Shared a breakfast of small-pot rice noodles with Mother and talked about the good reviews from the flower arrangement class. After breakfast, went back to the bedroom, wrote a draft message in the phone memos for the writing group leader, and browsed the album to preselect autumn photos to send to Uncle Qin.
location: Home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (dining room and bedroom desk)

name: In-depth discussion in the writing group.
description: In the writing group's WeChat group, she posted a carefully edited long message, candidly sharing her hesitation and confusion about writing personal essays, and pasted an excerpt from Watching from Behind the Glass. The group members discussed it warmly. Teacher Weiyang encouraged her, saying, “Sincere words carry their own power,” and fellow reader Nanfang suggested trying a third-person perspective. The discussion lasted more than an hour, and her confusion gradually cleared up.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online WeChat group)

name: First Commercial Collaboration for Photography Works
description: The rain stopped and the sky cleared. I sent a set of 6 Kunming autumn photos (post-rain maple leaves, Green Lake reflections, thin mist over the Western Hills, etc.) to Uncle Qin, the owner of Mingyuan Bookstore. Uncle Qin approved and bought the rights for 500 yuan to use them for “Autumn in Kunming” postcards, and he will credit me. This was my first time earning money from photography, and I felt a huge sense of achievement, recording the milestone in my journal.
location: Cuihu Community Home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online communication via WeChat)

name: Prepared lunch with mother and had a family meal together
description: Helped mother prepare mushroom braised rice, cleaning porcini and matsutake mushrooms. At noon, father Sun Mingyuan came out of the study, and the family of three sat together to enjoy the mushroom braised rice. Yuwei shared the good news of selling photos and getting feedback on her writing from the morning. Father suggested giving the postcards to colleagues after publication. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Cuihu Community home (kitchen and dining room), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon nap and online chat
description: After dinner, she rested on the lounge chair on the balcony to help digestion, and used her phone to send her friend Su Man a group photo from the flower arrangement class and a screenshot of the closed collaboration deal. She received an exaggerated emoji sticker from Su Man, and they chatted briefly to relax.
location: Home (balcony), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Art exploration on Wenlin Street and post-rain photography at Cuihu Lake
description: Walked to Wenlin Street and entered Kaishang Gallery to see the 'Kunming Memory' watercolor exhibition, using her phone to note composition and color inspiration. After the exhibition, she walked along the street to the west gate of Green Lake Park. The weather cleared up, and she photographed corgis on the grass, rain-washed stone bridge railings, and the breeze-rippled lake surface, adding new content to her photography library.
location: The area around Kaishang Gallery on Wenlin Street and Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Run along the Panlong River in the evening.
description: Returned home, changed into workout gear, laced up her running shoes, and headed to the trail along the Panlong River. Because Green Lake was slippery, she chose a quieter riverside stretch and completed 5 kilometers at a steady pace of about 8 minutes 5 seconds per kilometer. After the run, she did a full stretching routine on a riverside bench to avoid soreness, then jogged home.
location: Riverside walkway along the Panlong River, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (section near Cuihu Community)

name: Take a relaxing shower
description: After returning home, she took a warm shower to wash away the fatigue and sweat from running, changed into comfortable cotton loungewear, and felt refreshed.
location: Home (bathroom), Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Mother prepared clear chicken soup, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and rice. The family of three chatted while eating, with topics ranging from funny stories at her father's workplace to her sister's job, and then to Yuwei's writing plans. The atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Cuihu Community Home (Restaurant), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Accompanying my parents on a walk in Green Lake Park
description: After changing into light jackets, the family of three went for a walk in Green Lake Park. The setting sun dyed the sky with evening glow, and the park was lively. Her parents chatted about childhood stories about seagulls, and her mother took her arm and softly asked if she was tired, as they enjoyed a warm family moment.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Evening essay revision
description: After walking home and washing her face, she turned on her computer to review the writing group's suggestions, focusing on revising the ending of the essay "Vigil Behind the Glass." She tried a third-person narrative, replaced direct emotions with scenic descriptions, wrote a new paragraph of about 500 characters, and read it aloud repeatedly until it flowed smoothly.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom desk).

name: Journal recording and creation
description: She opened her beloved journal, drew line dividers for sections, and wrote in blue highlighter: "First monetization of photography works—milestone achieved!" She pasted in screenshots from the writing group chat, the gallery exhibition ticket, and a maple leaf picked up at Green Lake, carefully recording the day.
location: At home in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom desk).

name: Bedtime meditation
description: Used the Tide app to meditate for 10 minutes, calming the excitement and satisfaction of the day. Focused on breathing and let the mind settle down.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, I read two essays from the new collection. Around 22:50 I felt sleepy, so I turned off the light and lay down, and drifted off to sleep around 23:00 to the birdsong outside the window.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Waking up and getting ready
description: The alarm went off at 7 a.m. sharp. I got up briskly, opened the curtains to enjoy the morning sunshine, washed up quickly, changed into a sports bra and a short-sleeve T-shirt, and drank a glass of warm water in the living room to wake up my body.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning exercise: morning run at Green Lake.
description: After changing into sportswear, I walked from home in Green Lake Community to Green Lake Park, arriving at the park entrance in about 5 minutes. I started jogging along the lakeside trail, and with upbeat music, completed a 5-kilometer run at a pace of about 7 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. I stopped near the Mid-Lake Pavilion to do 10 minutes of leg stretches. After the run, I walked home along Huashan West Road, enjoying the morning breeze and fallen plane tree leaves on the way, and arrived home.
location: Cuihu Park Lakeside Trail, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Showering and reading English aloud
description: After arriving home, she took a hot shower and changed into dry lounge clothes. Sitting down at the study desk, she read Chapter 15 of the original English edition of Walden aloud in a gentle tone for about 30 minutes, and felt peaceful inside.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and browsing the news.
description: Mom had already left for work, leaving warm milk oatmeal porridge and two flower cakes on the table. While eating breakfast, I browsed the “Cultural Horizon” editor group and official account updates on my phone to find inspiration for the day’s writing.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Xishuangbanna itinerary booking and material-gathering preparation
description: In the study, she opened her laptop, logged in to the 12306 app, and booked a high-speed rail ticket for October 28 at 8:00 from Kunming Station to Xishuangbanna Station. On Ctrip, she confirmed a saved Dai-style homestay near Gaozhuang Xishuangjing. Then she checked the latest tour routes and seasonal plants on the official website of the Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences. Finally, in a Moleskine notebook, she listed an outline for the Kunming Slices column, covering tropical rainforest and border-region customs fieldwork.
location: Home study room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: On the living room sofa, she started a video call with her older sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen, and excitedly told her about the next day's Xishuangbanna itinerary and completed bookings. Her sister reminded her to protect herself from the sun and mosquitoes, and jokingly asked her to bring back some Xishuangbanna flower cakes. They chatted casually about recent news, and she felt happy.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch and midday rest
description: After my sister hung up, Mom came home from work, and we prepared the meal together in the kitchen, making stir-fried choy sum and reheating yesterday's steam pot chicken. Mother and daughter had lunch together and shared their plans for the next day; Mom wished me a good time. After the meal, I felt a little sleepy and lay in bed for half an hour, but didn't fully fall asleep. When I got up, I synced the electronic versions of the fieldwork outline and the botanical garden guide to my phone, and checked that the camera battery was fully charged.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon outing: buy art supplies and visit Uncle Qin
description: I changed into a white cotton-linen dress, put on my canvas bag, and walked to Wenlin Street. At the "Yilin Art Supplies Store" at No. 148 Wenlin Street, I carefully picked out and bought a box of Sakura solid watercolors, medium and large watercolor brushes, a 300 gsm medium-grain watercolor pad, and an A5 leather-bound journal. Then I walked about 10 minutes along Cuihu North Road to the "Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore" at No. 32 Cuihu North Road. The owner, Qin Mingyuan, was sorting the bookshelves. When he learned that I was going to Xishuangbanna the next day to gather creative material, he recommended and gave me the book "The Edge of the Land". After a short chat, we said goodbye.
location: Yilin Art Supplies Store at No. 148 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road

name: Returned home to try out new art supplies.
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she walked home to the Green Lake community carrying her art supplies and new books. She couldn't wait to unwrap the new art materials, mixed the paints at her desk, and from memory and phone photos drew several tropical plant sketches in her sketchbook, including tall palm trees and huge monstera leaves. She was very satisfied with the diffusion and color rendering of the new paints.
location: Home desk, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking a walk with her parents around Green Lake and shopping at the supermarket
description: In the evening, Mom and Dad got off work and came home, and the family went for a walk in Green Lake Park. Under the setting sun, the lake surface was dyed gold. The three of them walked slowly along the lakeside path and chatted. After the walk, I went alone to the nearby Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and bought mints, mixed nuts, and a few mango ginseng fruits to eat on the road the next day.
location: Lakeside trail in Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District

name: Family dinner
description: After returning home from the supermarket, Mom stir-fried two quick dishes, and the family of three sat in the dining room for dinner. I showed off the watercolor materials and sketch practice I bought today. Mom and Dad praised my initiative, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Packing luggage and pre-trip preparations
description: Back in the bedroom, she opened her suitcase and packed methodically according to the checklist in her phone notes: camera and spare batteries into the camera bag, newly bought art supplies and journal into the backpack, neatly folded light long-sleeved clothes, sunscreen, and toiletries. Finally, she put her ID card, wallet, and printed high-speed rail ticket into her small crossbody bag, and watered the pothos on the bedroom windowsill.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxation: socializing, reading, and meditation.
description: Cozying up on the beanbag sofa by the study window, I sent messages to Jingjing and Wenzi in the besties group, sharing today's new sketches and tomorrow's itinerary, and received their wishes for a pleasant trip. Then I opened 'The Edge of the Land' given by Uncle Qin and finished the first chapter. Afterward, I did 10 minutes of pre-sleep meditation on the yoga mat in the bedroom, sitting quietly in the dark and focusing on my breath to calm my excited mood.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: After meditating, I lay in bed and continued reading "The Field's Edge," growing drowsy. At 23:00 I put down the book, set my phone alarm, closed my eyes, and imagined Xishuangbanna's lush greenery and exotic charm, gradually falling asleep with anticipation.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and departure preparations.
description: At 5:30 a.m., I woke in the faint light, drank a glass of warm water on an empty stomach, then completed 3 sets of full-body stretches on the yoga mat on the bedroom balcony. Next I took out Anecdotes of Yunnan and read aloud an English passage describing the local products of southern Yunnan to warm up for the upcoming trip to Xishuangbanna. Then I meditated for 5 minutes, focusing on my breath and letting anticipation settle into calm. After finishing the ritual at 6:10, I took a quick shower and changed into a light linen shirt and wide-leg pants. I shouldered the backpack I had packed last night, which held my camera, new art supplies, Field Edge, and a change of clothes. My mother, Li Hui, had already prepared breakfast: steaming-hot soy milk and two flower cakes. While eating, I once again confirmed the high-speed rail tickets and homestay reservation on my phone, and just before leaving the house I gave the pothos on the balcony one last watering.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute and high-speed rail journey.
description: At exactly 7:00, I put on my headphones, walked through the familiar alleys of Green Lake Community, and reached Exit D of Dongfeng Square Metro Station in about 5 minutes. The morning breeze was slightly cool. Then I took Line 2 toward University Town South. There were quite a few people in the carriage. I stood in a corner, took out my phone to pin my mother’s WeChat message to the top, and then browsed the electronic version of the field investigation report “The Handmade Papermaking Craft of the Dai People in Xishuangbanna.” About 50 minutes later, I arrived at Kunming South Railway Station at 7:55, followed the crowd out of the station to find the ticket gate, bought a bottle of mineral water and a pack of mint candy at a convenience store, and watched the high-speed train parked at the platform through the floor-to-ceiling windows. I boarded the high-speed train on time, found my window seat F. After the train started, the scenery outside gradually shifted from the city to mountains and red soil. I took out my watercolors and sketchbook, dipped the brush in mineral water, and sketched a few scenes outside the window. Then I quietly read “The Field Edge” for half an hour. The woman next to me, Aunt Wang, looked at my sketches curiously; I chatted with her for a few words and learned that she was going to Xishuangbanna to visit her newborn grandson.
location: From Dongfeng Square Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Kunming South Station, 328 Lianda Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the carriage of the G high-speed train.

name: Arrive in Xishuangbanna and check into the homestay.
description: At 11:25 the high-speed train arrived at Xishuangbanna Station. As soon as I stepped out of the carriage, a warm, humid air wrapped around me instantly, carrying the scent of plants transpiring. I took a few deep breaths on the platform, then queued in the taxi waiting area and told Driver Yan to go to Gaozhuang Xishuangjing. The taxi crossed the Lancang River Bridge and arrived at the “Rainforest Oasis” guesthouse in Gaozhuang Xishuangjing about 25 minutes later. The front desk was decorated with Dai pottery. While checking in, I photographed the bougainvillea in full bloom in the courtyard and a papaya tree full of fruit. My room was on the third floor, with a small balcony, and from the window I could see the spire of the Great Golden Pagoda. I took some photos and short videos with my phone and sent them to my mother and the “Besties” group chat.
location: Rainforest Isle Homestay, No. 12 Manle Road, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and a short break.
description: After putting down my luggage, I strolled through Gaozhuang looking for lunch. I saw a small restaurant called 'Dai Manor' with quite a few diners, so I went in and ordered a bowl of their signature rice noodles with sour bamboo shoots and beef. The rich sour aroma and mildly spicy taste immediately awakened my taste buds, and I ate until my forehead was slightly sweating. While eating, I imported the sketches and photos I had taken in the morning into my phone, edited them briefly, and posted a moment on WeChat with the location Xishuangbanna and the caption 'From the wind of Kunming to the clouds of Xishuangbanna.'
location: Yunnan Province, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Jinghong City, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing Dai Manor - Authentic Dai Cuisine Restaurant

name: Guest room yoga
description: Back in the guest room, I changed into yoga clothes and opened the balcony door to let the warm breeze in. I unrolled the yoga mat on the floor and did a 20-minute gentle yoga practice: several rounds of Cat-Cow, feeling the stretch in my spine; during Child's Pose I could hear birds singing in the courtyard below; in Downward Dog, sweat dripped down my cheeks as my body fully opened up in the hot, humid environment. After practice, I wiped myself down with a damp towel and changed into a fresher cotton-linen dress.
location: Guesthouse room at 'Rainforest Isle', Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, No. 12 Manle Road, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon stroll and riverside sketching
description: The afternoon sun was blazing, so I went out holding a parasol. The Starlight Night Market was very quiet during the day. I wandered aimlessly through the streets and walked into a handicraft shop selling elephant wood carvings, chatting with the owner about how the wood came from old trees in natural rubber forests. Then I stopped in front of a Dai pottery studio and watched for a long time. Following the sound of water, I walked to the path along the Lancang River, sat down on a bench under a tree, took out my sketchbook, and drew the outline of the Buddhist temple on the opposite bank and the speedboats shuttling back and forth on the river. I drew for about an hour until the light became soft, then got up and bought two cups of freshly cut tropical fruit (mango and pineapple), eating them as I walked.
location: Starlight Night Market Pedestrian Street, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, and the riverside walkway along the Lancang River

name: Dai-style hand-grabbed rice dinner
description: I searched on my phone map and found a well-reviewed restaurant specializing in Burmese, Laotian, and Thai cuisine. Since it was still early, there was no queue, and I chose a seat by the window. I ordered a single-serving Dai-style hand-grabbed rice set meal. It was beautifully plated: in the center was fragrant rice steamed in chicken broth, surrounded by grilled pork belly, lemongrass-grilled fish, fried pork skin, cucumber strips, pineapple rice, and various dipping sauces. Following the example of the next table, I used my hand to shape the rice and various side dishes into a ball and put it into my mouth. The different aromas and textures exploded in my mouth—a truly unique experience.
location: Burmese, Lao, and Thai specialty restaurant, Jingdai Village, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Dai paper crafting and a courtyard stroll.
description: After dinner, I returned to the guesthouse on time. The handicraft workshop was in a corner of the courtyard, and Teacher Yuxiang, the Dai paper artisan, had already prepared the materials. I first listened to her introduce the history and production process of Dai paper: it is made from paper mulberry bark and is a national intangible cultural heritage. Then I started to work, following the teacher's example by soaking a ball of paper mulberry bark fibers in water, rubbing and kneading it repeatedly to loosen it, and then evenly dipping the pulp into a wooden frame to form a sheet, which required great patience and balance. Finally, I carefully placed a few small leaves I had picked during the day and some frangipani petals from the courtyard onto the wet paper as decoration. The whole process lasted more than an hour, and I was completely immersed in it. Afterward, the work needed to dry and set on the wooden frame. I left it with the teacher to handle and agreed to pick it up the next morning. Then I took a leisurely walk in the guesthouse courtyard. The night breeze was cool, and tropical plants cast flickering shadows under the lights. I met Xiao Li, a guest who had also made paper in the afternoon. We showed each other photos of our work, exchanged our first impressions of Xishuangbanna, and chatted happily.
location: Craft workshop and courtyard of the Rainforest Isle homestay, 12 Manle Road, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Personal journaling and reading time.
description: Back in the guest room, I first turned on my computer, logged into my email, and quickly replied to Editor Xu's email, confirming the deadline for the next article. Then I sat down at the desk, took out the journal and pen I had bought today, and pasted the high-speed rail ticket stub, the sketch I drew by the river in the afternoon, a papaya leaf vein I brought back, and a small extra piece of paper mulberry bark given by the handicraft teacher, all with glue tape. I spent a long time recording in detail today's weather, smells, tastes, and every person I met, using green and brown water-based pens, especially the feeling of the white fibers blending in my palms while making Dai paper. Finally, I opened The Edge of the Land and skimmed again the chapter about the tropical botanical garden I planned to visit tomorrow.
location: Guesthouse room at 'Rainforest Isle', Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, No. 12 Manle Road, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: 22:30, I put down my book, turned off the main light and kept only the bedside lamp on, played white noise to help sleep, and sat cross-legged in front of the bed to begin a 10-minute bedtime meditation. I guided myself to review all of today's novel experiences: the high-speed rail sketching, the sour and spicy rice noodles, the riverside wind, the touch of paper pulp. I let these beautiful images flash through my mind, then finally settled into calm. At 23:00 I blow-dried my hair, changed into pajamas, and noted in my phone memo: "Go pick up the Dai paper tomorrow morning." At 23:15 I turned off the light and soon fell deeply asleep amid the tropical insects chirping outside and the faint sound of Dai disco music in the distance.
location: Guesthouse room at 'Rainforest Isle', Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, No. 12 Manle Road, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Morning balcony yoga and English reading aloud
description: In the faint morning light, she spread out her yoga mat on the third-floor balcony of the guesthouse, completed 20 minutes of flow yoga in the gentle morning breeze, and felt her body stretch. Then, leaning back in a rattan chair, she took out the English original of Walden that she had brought with her and started the new day by reading aloud. The breath of the rainforest blended with Thoreau's words, leaving her heart peaceful and clear.
location: Balcony on the third floor of the 'Lanjing Rainforest' homestay, Building 5, Area A, Jingdaizhai, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province.

name: Having breakfast at the guesthouse
description: I ordered a bowl of authentic Dai-style rice noodles, served with freshly cut papaya and a cup of Yunnan small-bean coffee. While eating, I browsed today's tropical botanical garden reservation code on my phone and confirmed it was correct. Then I went back to my room and checked my backpack again: camera, telephoto and macro lenses, spare battery, SD card, sketchbook, fountain pen, sunscreen, and mosquito repellent — all present.
location: First-floor restaurant of the “Lan Jing Rainforest” homestay, Building 5, Zone A, Jingdai Village, Gaozhuang Xishuang Jing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Take a ride-hailing car to the tropical botanical garden.
description: At the guesthouse entrance, she took a ride-hailing car, and the ride took about 50 minutes. Along the way, she enjoyed the tropical scenery, with patches of rubber forest and banana leaves flashing past the window. The driver was a local and talked about how the abundant rainfall this year had made the rubber forests grow well. She jotted down a few interesting Dai dialect words in her phone memo to gather material for future fieldwork.
location: On the way from Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province to Mengla County (in the car)

name: Deep exploration of the tropical botanical garden (west area)
description: After entering the park, she went straight to the Victoria lily pond, using a telephoto lens to look for geometric compositions under light and shadow, and recorded the tranquil beauty of the Victoria lily leaves and their reflections in the water. Then she went deeper into the banyan garden and was awed by the vitality of the strangler fig. She photographed a huge banyan tree from multiple angles. In her notebook, she sketched its gnarled, intertwined texture and wrote the inspirational phrase: 'Life dances in entanglement, and death and new life coexist.'
location: West Zone of the Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province (Aquatic Plant Area, Banyan Garden, Palm Garden)

name: Lunch and rest at the botanical garden
description: Walk to Tengming House restaurant and order a serving of cold sour papaya salad and chicken rice noodles; the taste is refreshing and appetizing. While eating, a fine rain began to fall outside the window, and the sound of raindrops on banana leaves was particularly charming. So I sat a little longer under the restaurant's eaves, played light music on my phone, and took advantage of the momentum to recopy and organize the notes recorded in the morning, sketching out several paragraph frameworks for the afternoon essay.
location: Tengmingwu Restaurant (near the Hundred Flowers Garden), Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Continue exploring the botanical garden and collecting material in the afternoon
description: After the rain shower stopped, the air was especially fresh. Moving to the Hundred Flowers Garden, raindrops lingered on colorful petals, creating perfect macro photography subjects. I squatted down and used the macro lens to capture crystal-clear water droplets on phalaenopsis orchids. On the path, I carefully picked up a few intact fallen leaves (purple-red, golden-yellow) and several white orchid petals knocked down by the rain, gently pressing them in my notebook as natural material for tonight's journal.
location: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province (Shade Plant Garden, Hundred Flowers Garden, Ethnobotanical Garden)

name: Go to the viewing platform by the Luosuo River
description: Walk east from Baihua Garden for about ten minutes to reach the riverside observation deck. The river is wide, and across the bank stretches a continuous rainforest. I sat down on a bench under a large banyan tree, felt the river breeze on my face, organized my camera and notebook, and cleared my mind for the writing about to begin.
location: Observation deck by the Luosuo River, near the East Gate of the Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province.

name: By the Luosuo River, wrote the first draft of the essay ‘The Depth of Green’.
description: The river breeze carried moisture and the view was wide open. Taking out my sketchbook and pen, the scenes I observed in the morning—the ferocity and vitality of the strangler fig, the Zen of raindrops falling on banana leaves, the lines of light and shadow in the rainforest—flashed through my mind like a film. The pen tip moved quickly, almost without pause, pouring out a whole day's feelings about the greenery and insights into the vitality of life. About an hour later, I drew the final period of the first draft, about 1,200 words, and felt an unprecedented sense of satisfaction and exhilaration.
location: Viewing platform by the Luosuo River, Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province.

name: Return to Gaozhuang and pick up the Dai paper made yesterday.
description: I took a taxi from the botanical garden back to Gaozhuang; the ride took about 50 minutes. After arriving, I went straight to the Daiyuan Paper Workshop in the Starlight Night Market. Sister Li warmly brought out the Dai paper that had fully dried, with dried flowers and leaf veins embedded in it. I carefully rolled it up and tied it with string, thanked Sister Li, and promised to send her photos of the work I would create with the new Dai paper once I returned to Kunming.

participant.name: Sister Li
participant.relation: Manager of the Daiyuan Paper Workshop.

location: Yunnan Province, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Jinghong City, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing Starlight Night Market, Daiyuan Paper Workshop

name: Return to the guesthouse for a short rest.
description: Walked back to the guesthouse. At the front desk downstairs, she asked the owner to heat up a pot of Pu'er tea. Back in the room, she changed out of her damp sneakers, carefully spread the Dai paper flat on the table, and placed her camera and notebook beside it. She washed her face briefly to ease the fatigue.
location: Inside the room at the "Lanjing Rainforest" homestay, Building 5, Zone A, Jingdai Village, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoyed a Dai-style dinner on the guesthouse balcony.
description: Ordered takeout on her phone from 'Dai Xiang Ge Li': lemongrass grilled fish, sticky rice, and a cup of pa lu da. Set the food out on the balcony, and while savoring authentic Dai flavor, watched the lights of Gaozhuang come on; in the distance, the pagoda shimmered gold in the twilight, and her heart felt warm.
location: Balcony on the third floor of the 'Lanjing Rainforest' homestay, Building 5, Area A, Jingdaizhai, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening: sorting photos and journaling
description: Back in the room, she inserted the camera's SD card into the iPad and selected the 30 most satisfying photos of the day, filing them by different areas of the botanical garden. After brewing some tea, she began sketching on watercolor paper: first she drew the tangled vine structure of a strangler fig she had seen during the day, then outlined the soft contour of that white orchid petal. Next, she took out the fallen leaves and petals tucked inside her notebook and carefully glued them beside the just-finished watercolor pages with white glue, creating a vivid collage. Finally, in the blank space of her journal, she wrote a fluent account of the day's full experience and her reflections on creating the essay "Deep Green."
location: Inside the room at the "Lanjing Rainforest" homestay, Building 5, Zone A, Jingdai Village, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Had a video call with my older sister and shared travel experiences.
description: The video call connected; her sister was in her rented apartment in Shenzhen. Yuwei excitedly showed photos of the giant water lilies she had taken that day, a fallen leaf picked up in the botanical garden, and the exquisite roll of Dai paper. She told her sister that she would check out and return to Kunming tomorrow, and said she planned to give the Dai paper to her mother and Uncle Qin. Her sister also shared funny stories from work, and they chatted for half an hour about family news, feeling warm at heart.
location: Inside the room at the "Lanjing Rainforest" homestay, Building 5, Zone A, Jingdai Village, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: After the call, she checked her phone calendar, deleted the reminder for today's botanical garden ticket, and set an alarm for 8:30 tomorrow (to remind herself to pack before checking out). She organized the small bag to take back to Kunming tomorrow. Turning off the light, she sat cross-legged on the bed in the dark, did 10 minutes of meditation to clear the day's thoughts, and felt the tranquility of the rainforest night.
location: Inside the room at the "Lanjing Rainforest" homestay, Building 5, Zone A, Jingdai Village, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Stretching before bed and going to sleep.
description: After meditation, she did a few simple leg stretches on the bed to relax her sore calves. Then she lay down, her heart full of gratitude for the fulfilling experiences of the day. Listening to the distant chirping of insects outside the window, she fell asleep peacefully in a state where inspiration and inner calm were interlaced.
location: Inside the room at the "Lanjing Rainforest" homestay, Building 5, Zone A, Jingdai Village, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Morning courtyard stretching and English reading aloud
description: Woken by birdsong in the guesthouse courtyard, she did 15 minutes of gentle stretching, feeling the breeze and morning light. Then she sat in a bamboo chair and read aloud the English self-translation of her draft essay 'The Depth of Green' for 30 minutes, savoring the differences between the two languages in describing the rainforest.
location: Courtyard of the 'Rainforest Oasis' homestay, No. 17 Jingliang Village, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast, booking a pottery class, and checking out and storing luggage
description: At the guesthouse restaurant, I enjoyed a breakfast of rice noodles and tropical fruit. While eating, I contacted 'Manlu Pottery Studio' via WeChat and, according to the course schedule on their official account, booked a single pottery experience class for the afternoon of November 1 and paid a deposit. Afterward, I returned to the room, quickly organized my backpack, went downstairs to the front desk to check out, chatted with the owner to express how much I liked the guesthouse, and left my hiking backpack at the front desk for storage.
location: No. 17, Jingliang Village, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, “Rainforest Oasis” Guesthouse Restaurant and Front Desk

name: Strolling through Gaozhuang Market and buying souvenirs.
description: Walked lightly to the morning market at Great Golden Pagoda Square. At the tie-dye shop, she picked out an indigo cotton-linen scarf with a subtle pattern for her mother; at the tea stall, she bought 200 grams of Menghai ripe pu-erh to give to Uncle Qin. She also bought Dai-style handmade brown sugar and tamarind cakes. She stopped at a Dai handmade-paper stall and filmed a short video of the papermaking process with her phone to collect material for her journal.
location: Grand Golden Pagoda Square and surrounding markets, Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and a short break.
description: Had a meal at the 'Manfeilong Roast Chicken' branch in Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, ordering lemongrass grilled fish, pineapple purple rice, and Lao iced coffee. While eating, she recorded the morning's experiences and feelings in her phone memo as writing inspiration for later.
location: ‘Manfeilong Roast Chicken’ branch inside Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Picked up luggage and took a taxi to Xishuangbanna Railway Station
description: Walked back to the guesthouse to pick up the stored hiking backpack, then used a ride-hailing app to call a car, drove along Mengle Avenue for about 25 minutes, and arrived at Xishuangbanna Station. The fare was 35 yuan.
location: From Gaozhuang Xishuangjing, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to Xishuangbanna Railway Station

name: Waiting for the bus and sketching
description: Sat near Gate A4 in the waiting hall, took out a watercolor sketchbook and quickly sketched an elderly Dai woman in traditional clothing carrying a bamboo basket, feeling the serene sense of line.
location: Waiting hall of Xishuangbanna Station, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Take the high-speed train back to Kunming
description: Took the C284 high-speed train, seat 05 car 08F. Once the train was steady, she systematically organized the photos taken yesterday at the Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences using her camera and iPad, selected 10 photos and sent them to editor Xu as reference images, and revised the outline for "The Depth of Green," adding details about the banyan tree's "single tree forming a forest." Afterward, she put on an eye mask and took a 35-minute nap.
location: On the high-speed train from Xishuangbanna Station to Kunming South Station.

name: Take the subway and transfer to a bus to go home.
description: The high-speed train arrived on time at Kunming South Railway Station. Then she transferred to Metro Line 1 to Dongfeng Square Station, switched to Line 3 and got out at Exit B of Panjiawan Station, then took Bus No. 95 for two stops and got off at Cuihu East Gate Station. The whole trip took about 50 minutes.
location: Rail transit and bus in Kunming, Yunnan Province, from Kunming South Station to Green Lake East Gate Station

name: Arriving home, family dinner, and sharing.
description: Pushing open the door, she hugged her mother, gave her the Dai paper and tie-dye scarf, and put away the ripe pu-erh tea cake to give to Uncle Qin. She returned to her room to drink water and relax for 10 minutes. Then the family sat around the table for dinner; her mother had made clear-broth beef, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and mushroom soup. During the meal, she enthusiastically shared her experiences in Xishuangbanna, such as seeing Victoria water lilies and making Dai paper by hand. Her father also talked about a cultural exhibition project at his workplace. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Living room at home, Room 602, Unit 3, Building 7, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Gentle yoga and meditation
description: After changing into yoga clothes, she did gentle yoga poses in the living room for 20 minutes, including Cat-Cow, Child's Pose, and Downward-Facing Dog, to relax her shoulders, neck, and lower back from sitting for long periods. Then she sat cross-legged, played a 10-minute guided meditation audio, focused on her breathing, and returned to calm.
location: Living room at home, Room 602, Unit 3, Building 7, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk with my parents around Green Lake Park.
description: Walked with her parents to Green Lake Park, strolled two laps along the lakeside path, with streetlights reflected on the lake. Dad suggested visiting Dounan Flower Market on the weekend, and Mom asked about the writing progress; she told her the revision plan was clear. The family chatted as they walked, enjoying a pleasant evening.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Organizing my journal, replying to emails, and planning tomorrow.
description: Back in the study, she took out the fallen leaves from Banna and the tea cake. Opening her journal, she pasted in the miniature photo, the dried leaves, and a corner of the tamarind cake wrapper, and wrote in colored pen the feeling of “bidding farewell to the rainforest and returning to daily life.” Then she turned on her computer and replied to editor Xu Mingyuan’s email, noting that the revision outline for The Depth of Green was basically complete and that the revised version would be submitted next Monday. Finally, in her phone’s memo app, she planned tomorrow’s tasks: revise the manuscript in the morning, and in the afternoon go to Zhibushi Bookstore to return books and deliver the tea cake.
location: Study at home, Room 602, Unit 3, Building 7, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening personal care and reading
description: Took a shower, blow-dried my hair, and changed into pajamas. Turned on the bedside night light, propped against the headboard, and read "The Submarine at Night." Around 22:15, turned off the light, reviewed the day in my mind, and fell asleep with satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 602, Unit 3, Building 7, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning personal rituals and family breakfast
description: At 7:10 in the morning, Sun Yuwei woke naturally. After doing some simple stretches by the bay window in her bedroom, she began reading aloud the last section of the English edition of Walden, completing her October reading plan. She organized the new words and beautiful sentences she had accumulated this month into an "October English Reading Summary," wrote it in her journal, and added a short reflection on sticking with reading. Then she wrote her name on the title page of The House on Mango Street to prepare for next month's reading. At about 7:50, she went to the dining room, where her mother had prepared small-pot rice noodles and flaky buns. As the family had breakfast together, Sun Yuwei gave her mother an indigo tie-dyed scarf she had brought back from Xishuangbanna. Her mother happily draped it over herself, her father watching and smiling beside them, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning material organization and work communication
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei focused on organizing the materials from the Xishuangbanna field trip in her study. She imported her sketchbook and camera photos into the computer, created the folder '2025-10 Southern Plants Materials', and did a rough selection of photos. Then she organized deeper: scanned the watercolor sketches, selected 30 representative photos (such as strangler figs, giant Victoria lilies, and unnamed plants along the Lancang River) and uploaded them to the cloud drive, and in a document systematically turned scattered impressionistic notes into well-organized notes. After finishing, at 11 o'clock she sent an email to editor Xu Mingyuan, confirming that the revised draft of 'The Depth of Green' would be submitted on November 3, and attached 10 intended accompanying images for reference, such as photos of the Luosuo River and strangler figs.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday reading, family lunch, and afternoon rest
description: Around noon, Sun Yuwei brewed a cup of Yunnan black tea brought back from Xishuangbanna, curled up on the living room sofa, and read "The Field's Edge," savoring its descriptions of Yunnan mountain camellias. At 12 o'clock, the family gathered in the dining room for lunch. Her mother made home-style dishes such as dry-fried shredded potatoes. During the conversation, she told them she planned to go to the bookstore in the afternoon. After the meal she felt drowsy, went back to her bedroom at 12:40, and took a nap of about 40 minutes to recharge for the afternoon activities.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visit Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore
description: After the lunch break, Sun Yuwei changed into a cotton-linen shirt dress, took the wrapped Menghai ripe pu'er tea cake and the books to return, and walked along Cuihu North Road for about 13 minutes to Zhibushi Bookstore. She gave the tea cake to the bookstore owner, Uncle Qin, and shared her Xishuangbanna travel stories. Uncle Qin happily savored the tea's aroma. After returning the borrowed books, she browsed the newly arrived botanical illustration books in a corner of the store and looked through the message book, enjoying the bookstore's quiet time.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing and relaxing at Wenlin Street café
description: After staying in the bookstore for about half an hour, Sun Yuwei said goodbye to Uncle Qin and walked to Wenlin Street, pausing briefly at a handicraft shop to admire the window display. Around 15:18 she arrived at Eraser Bookstore café on Wenlin Street, ordered a flat white, and sat down in a corner by the window to focus on rewriting the 'Rainforest Sounds' section of the essay 'The Depth of Green'. She used words to depict a three-dimensional soundscape in which the rustling of towering trees, rain beating on banana leaves, and insect chirping interwove, completing about 800 characters. She sent the old and new passages to her close friends Liu Jia and Yang Xiao for feedback. While waiting for their replies, she browsed the adjoining small bookstore and was tempted by 'The Gardener's Year' but did not buy it. Then she took a photo of the pothos on the windowsill and posted it to her close friends' circle with the caption 'a cure for the holiday blues'. After receiving praise from her friends, she felt delighted.
location: Rubber Bookstore Café, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Returned home and prepared for yoga.
description: In a good mood, Sun Yuwei walked back to her home in Cuihu Community. On the way, she picked up a flyer from the mailbox at the entrance. After arriving home, she greeted her mother, went to the study to jot down the café inspiration in her sketchbook, then changed into yoga clothes and laid out her yoga mat to prepare for the upcoming practice.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening yoga and meditation
description: At six in the evening, Sun Yuwei played soothing music in the living room and began a 60-minute yoga practice. She warmed up with Cat-Cow, flowed into Warrior I and Warrior II, and finally practiced Headstand away from the wall, successfully holding it steady for 12 seconds and reaching her goal. After practice, she lay on the mat for 15 minutes of meditation, reviewing October's achievements in her mind and silently considering plans for November.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner sharing
description: After yoga, Sun Yuwei took a shower and changed clothes. Wearing loose pajamas, she had dinner with her parents. The meal included lotus root and pork rib soup and stir-fried greens. She excitedly shared that her afternoon 'Rainforest Sounds' writing had received praise from friends. Her parents were happy for her, and the dinner table was filled with laughter and cheerful conversation.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stroll at Green Lake Park
description: After dinner, the family of three went to Cuihu Park for their usual walk. The late autumn night was slightly cool. They strolled along the lake, saw a night heron standing with its neck tucked in, and her father pointed out a ginkgo tree that had turned fully yellow. The air was filled with the last fragrance of osmanthus. During the walk, the family chatted and enjoyed peaceful family time.
location: Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal organizing and travel diary
description: After the walk, Sun Yuwei returned to her study and began organizing her journal. She carefully pasted the whole leaves and pressed dried petals she had brought back from the outing onto the page, attached a photo of a Victoria water lily next to them, and outlined a tree frog in watercolor. Then she wrote today's travel journal with a fountain pen, recording the burst of inspiration for revising her prose essay and the brief encounter at the bookstore, leaving a fulfilling mark on the last day of October.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening reading and reading plans
description: At nine in the evening, Sun Yuwei sat against the headboard and continued reading the passages she had marked earlier in The Edge of the Earth. After finishing, she wrote a new bookmark in her reading journal, noting her expectation for next month's reading, The House on Mango Street: I want to see how Esperanza uses poetic language to make ordinary daily life sparkle.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Sun Yuwei got up to wash up and took a warm shower to wash away her fatigue. Back in the bedroom, she turned off the light, switched on the aromatherapy diffuser, and did a 5-minute pre-sleep meditation in the faint scent of lavender, focusing on her breathing to clear her mind. Then she climbed into bed and fell asleep peacefully, feeling fulfilled and tranquil.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga meditation and morning run preparation
description: At 6:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei started her day on the bay window in her bedroom. She first did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing meditation, then flowed through yoga poses including cat-cow, downward dog, and child's pose, feeling her body stretch. After that, she quietly recorded herself reading the opening passage of The House on Mango Street on her phone as English practice. When finished, she changed into a quick-dry sports tank top and leggings, put on a sports arm pouch, drank a few sips of warm water, and prepared for the morning workout ahead.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run around Green Lake, brisk walking along the Panlong River, and post-exercise tidy-up
description: Sun Yuwei jogged from home to Cuihu Park and started a 5 km morning run at a pace of about 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. After finishing the run, she walked briskly along the pedestrian path beside the Panlong River for 30 minutes as cross-training, feeling the cool river breeze of the late autumn morning. Under Yuantong Bridge, she stopped and took a photo of the bridge arch and its reflection. After exercising, she returned home, took a warm shower, carefully stretched her calves and hamstrings in the bathroom, and synced the data from her fitness band to the app on her phone to review her running route and pace. She felt satisfied with today's workout performance.
location: Cuihu Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; Panlong River bank (section near Yuantong Bridge)

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: After changing into comfortable loungewear, Sun Yuwei went to the dining room to have breakfast with her parents. Her mother had made small-pot rice noodles with pickled greens and minced pork. During the meal, she excitedly shared what she had seen on her morning run and mentioned that she would go to Zhibushi Bookstore to give Uncle Qin a tea cake. Her father asked about the progress of revising 'The Deep Green'.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Desk organization and November planning
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei went to the study for her monthly routine tidying. She cleared the clutter from her desk, wiped the desk lamp, and stuck a note cut from an old book onto the lamp base. It read, 'Once you have passed through the storm, you are no longer the same person.' Then she opened her journal and planned her November writing schedule, including the framework for the afterword of her essay collection and two column topic ideas, and wrote down the week's to-do items.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revise the essay "The Depth of Green"
description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop and reread and revised the essay "Depth of Green." She focused on improving the passage describing the sounds of the rainforest, rewriting the sound of rain hitting broad leaves with a stronger sense of rhythm, and incorporated earlier feedback from Liu Jia and Yang Xiao, making the essay breathe more as a whole.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading "The Edge of the Land" to relax
description: Feeling slightly tired from mental work, Sun Yuwei took The Edge of the Land, a gift from Uncle Qin, from her bookshelf. She leaned back in the rattan chair by the window and read two chapters, immersed in the peaceful world created by the words, as a pre-lunch break.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Simple lunch and afternoon preparations
description: Her parents went out at noon, so Sun Yuwei reheated the leftover mushroom chicken soup from last night and ate it with rice. After the meal, she put the Menghai ripe Pu-erh tea cake she had brought back from Xishuangbanna into her canvas bag, and checked her phone and keys.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Zhibushi Bookstore to present tea.
description: Sun Yuwei walked about 15 minutes to the Paper, Cloth, and Stone Bookstore. Uncle Qin was organizing the newly arrived poetry collections. She handed him the tea cake and said, 'Uncle Qin, I brought this back from Banna — try this Menghai flavor.' Uncle Qin was very pleased and asked about the progress on the manuscript. The two briefly chatted about what they had seen in Banna, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pottery workshop hand-building course
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, Sun Yuwei walked along Wenlin Street to Wenlin Pottery House. On the way, she photographed the fallen plane-tree leaves and sent the photos to her friends' chat group. The class started at two in the afternoon. Under the shop owner's guidance, she learned to knead clay, roll coils, and shape pieces by hand. She made a teacup for her mother, with the word 'Breath' carved on the bottom, and for her sister, she shaped a pair of heart-shaped earring pendants from wet clay. After finishing the pieces, she wrapped them in a damp cloth and put them into a paper box, her heart filled with the joy of creation.

participant.name: The proprietress of Wenlin Pottery House

location: Wenlin Pottery House, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bought dried eucalyptus leaves and walked home
description: Leaving the pottery studio, Sun Yuwei passed by Huaman Flower Shop and was attracted by the dried eucalyptus at the door. She picked a bunch with graceful shapes and elegant colors, had the shopkeeper trim it and wrap it in kraft paper. Then, carrying her pottery works and flowers, she leisurely walked home, buying a cup of yogurt along the way.
location: Huaman Flower Shop, 121 Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Resting at home and journaling
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei put the pottery works and eucalyptus leaves away properly, then took a shower and changed into loungewear. While waiting for dinner, she placed the eucalyptus leaves into an old pottery jar, then opened her journal, pasted in the pottery studio's business card and a plane tree leaf, and wrote down her thoughts from today's pottery class.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Her parents returned from their walk, and her mother had already prepared dinner. The three sat around the table. Sun Yuwei took out the teacup and photos of the clay body to share her pottery experience, describing the wonderful feeling of shaping the clay. Her mother looked forward to the finished piece, and her father teased her about her craftsmanship.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore to read in advance
description: After a short rest after the meal, Sun Yuwei took the printed manuscripts of 'The Field's Edge' and 'The Depth of Green' and walked to Mingyuan Bookstore. She arrived an hour before the group activity, sat in a seat by the window on the second floor, ordered a cup of hot black tea, and quietly continued reading.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Mingyuan Bookstore writing group activity
description: The event began. Sun Yuwei was the first to share her revised prose piece about the old streets of Kunming. The group members gave serious feedback: a longtime member suggested paying attention to paragraph transitions, and another praised the poetic description of the plane-tree leaves. Sun Yuwei carefully took notes and responded, and benefited greatly.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walking home, bedtime preparation, and sleep meditation
description: After the event ended, Sun Yuwei walked home holding her manuscripts and notebook. Once home, she washed up, did her skincare routine, and changed into cotton pajamas. Before bed, she put a few drops of lavender essential oil on her pillow, opened the Tide app for a 15-minute sleep meditation, focused on the breathing guidance, let the day's thoughts gradually settle, and then fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning Yoga and Health Record
description: You woke up naturally, with sunlight streaming through the curtains onto the window seat cushion. Wearing comfortable yoga clothes, you began the second day of meditation and vinyasa yoga stretching. Compared with yesterday, you tried to make the transitions between postures smoother, paying special attention to releasing the neck and shoulders, and felt the warm soreness left from yesterday's pottery class. During meditation, you focused on the tactile feeling of the clay taking shape, letting your mind return to calm. After yoga, you used a body fat scale to measure and record your body data: weight 46.05 kg, healthy body fat percentage. Going to the study, you opened your planner and neatly wrote the data on the health record page. Comparing with last Saturday, you drew a small upward arrow to mean "stable," and wrote a new goal: "Do yoga for 3 days in a row, try adding a morning run, and resume brisk-walking cross training."
location: Bedroom and study at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: They began wiping the windows in an orderly division of labor. Sun Yuwei first used a damp cloth to clean the dust off the window frames and screens in the bedroom and study, then used a squeegee dipped in diluted detergent to wipe from top to bottom, drying the blade with a dry towel after each pass. Her father used a long-handled tool to clean the high exterior windows in the courtyard, while her mother removed and washed the screens in the kitchen. Sun Yuwei helped her mother change the water midway, and the whole family worked happily while listening to music.
description: After washing up, you walked into the dining room, where your mother had prepared small-pot rice noodles with grilled erkuai. While eating, you shared the funny stories from yesterday at Wenlin Pottery House and showed photos of the clay cups on your phone. Seeing the clay cup engraved with the words "Breath", your mother's eyes filled with smile, and you promised to ask her what character she would like engraved when you glaze it next week. Your father kindly reminded you to submit your manuscript on time, and you nodded in agreement. After breakfast, you cleared and washed the dishes. Back in the study, you checked and arranged your watercolor supplies: Sakura solid watercolors, Da Vinci watercolor brushes, Baohong cold-pressed paper, a palette, and clean water. Then you pulled up the sunset photos you had taken at Erhai Lake at the end of October from your phone album as a reference for today's watercolor creation.
location: Dining room and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watercolor painting of sunset over Erhai Lake
description: You sit at your desk and begin to fix the memory of the sunset over Erhai Lake onto paper. First, use a 2B pencil to sketch the outlines of the distant mountains and clouds. Then, using a large flat brush, wet the paper surface. With the wet-on-wet technique, swiftly lay down the sky gradient from warm orange and pink-purple to sky blue. When the paper is half dry, use a pointed brush with the dry-brush technique to capture the shimmering light on the water. About an hour later, the painting is complete. You wait for it to dry, carefully trim it, and paste it onto the right-hand page of that day's journal with a glue stick. Beside it, you write down your reflection: “That moment of sunset over Erhai Lake was a gentleness no camera could replicate. The orange-pink clouds and the golden light on the water all settled into this watercolor on paper.”
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Arranged with writing group member Zhao Xue to mutually review manuscripts.
description: You picked up your phone and saw the WeChat message Zhao Xue had sent in the early morning: "Yuwei, the rainforest passage in your 'Depth of Green'—the sound description reminds me of a musical score." Your heart warmed, and you then had an in-depth exchange with her about the aesthetics of prose writing. Your styles matched so well that you quickly settled on a mutual review plan: she would send you her draft on November 10, and you would give feedback on the 15th; she would spend a week reading your completed work, agreeing to use Word's comment feature, focusing on 'narrative rhythm' and 'texture of details'.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and midday break
description: You put down your phone and went to the kitchen to help your mother. You cleaned the fresh okra bought the day before and cut the tomatoes. Your mother took charge of the stove and presented the new Yunnan-style mixed mushroom soup she had learned—made by slow-simmering jizong mushrooms, matsutake mushrooms, and green-cap mushrooms, its fragrance filling the air. While cutting vegetables, you chatted with her about Dad's weekend plans and learned that they intended to go to the flower market in the afternoon, so you said you wanted to go too. After lunch, you didn't throw yourself straight into reading but gave yourself a buffer period. You went to the recliner on the balcony, enjoyed the warm November sun, listened to the faint birdsong drifting up from downstairs, felt the breeze on your cheeks, and let your thoughts wander freely, storing up energy for the afternoon's activities.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon reading and polishing the manuscript
description: With Wang Zengqi's "Rain in Kunming" and your journal in hand, you return to the balcony. The fine sunlight filters through the sheer curtain, casting dappled shadows on the turning pages. You are absorbed in Wang's delicate and warm prose, focusing on the passages about Kunming's rainy scenery and plants. When you read "A banksia rose climbs over the trellis, covering the courtyard tightly. Dense clusters of fine green leaves, countless half-open white flowers, and plump buds were all soaked through by the rain," your heart stirs, and you immediately copy it into your journal.
