At the same time, you open your laptop and, in between, polish the passage about the banyan tree's aerial roots in "The Depth of Green," trying to break the long sentences into shorter ones and feel the change in rhythm: "The aerial roots hang down, like countless strands of brown silk threads. They dangle among the thick branches, swaying gently in the wind, as if the heartbeat of the earth."
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal, afternoon tea, and manuscript preparation
description: Standing up to stretch your shoulders and neck, you brew yourself a cup of Menghai ripe Pu'er brought back from Xishuangbanna. The tea is deep red and bright, smooth and sweet on the palate, with a distinctive aged aroma. While sipping tea, you cut out the receipts from yesterday's visits to the handmade craft workshops in Xishuangbanna and the scraps of handmade decorative paper, then carefully paste them into the blank spaces of your journal with washi tape and glue dots, as part of the record of that trip. Then you pick up Rain in Kunming again and finish the chapters “Kunming Wild Mushrooms” and “Teachers and Students of the National Southwestern Associated University.” You take out a pressed, pale-gold osmanthus petal that had been tucked in the book for a long time and gently glue it onto the blank space on the left side of the journal. Turning back to the watercolor page from earlier, you add a reflection below the painting: “Recreating memories with a paintbrush is like deconstructing and reconstructing a moment of emotion. The technique is still immature, but the joy is real.” Afterward, you close the journal, return to the study, and use your phone to photograph today's watercolor and journal pages. After a quick photo edit, you plan to send them to Song Wen and your mother later in the evening. Then you turn on your computer, create a folder named “The Depth of Green_Revised Edition_20251103 Submission,” place the final revised manuscript inside, open the email attachment feature, and check once more that the file names and numbers in the list of 10 images match the captions in the manuscript. Everything is confirmed correct, waiting only to be sent tomorrow morning.
location: Balcony and study of the home at Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family trip to Dounan Flower Market.
description: You put on a comfortable knit cardigan and went out with your parents. After walking about 5 minutes from your door, you arrived at Exit D of Huashan West Road Station, took Metro Line 2, and about 63 minutes later reached Dounan Flower Market in Chenggong District. The market was brightly lit and noisy with people, and the mixed fragrance of all kinds of flowers and plants greeted you. Your family strolled leisurely among the stalls. Mom lingered in the fresh-cut flower section and ended up buying a large bunch of lisianthus, a few spray roses, and some eucalyptus leaves (38 yuan in total). You were more interested in dried flowers and succulents, and stopped in front of a pot of oddly shaped mountain roses and a small bunch of bunny tail grass for dried arrangements. Dad quietly paid, smiling and saying it was his support for you two artists. You also remembered to take a few photos of the spray roses for Su Man, a friend from your flower arrangement class, hoping to invite her next time. Then, carrying the spoils of the flower market, you took the metro back the same way and arrived home as it was getting dark.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: Dinner was soup made by Mom and simple tomato and egg noodles cooked by Dad. The family sat around the dining table enjoying the home-style meal. You opened your phone album and showed today's watercolor journal work. Mom praised the colors, saying, 'They look just like the real Erhai Lake.' You were overjoyed, chatted with Dad about the flower market, and the family was filled with warmth and happiness.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening free time and reading
description: You return to the study, first placing the eucalyptus leaves and bunny tail grass you bought today into an empty coarse pottery vase. Then you open WeChat and send today's watercolor painting photo to your close writing friend Song Wen, sharing your creative insights. She quickly replies, 'Wow, the atmosphere is there!' Next, you send a voice message to your older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, excitedly telling her about yesterday's pottery class progress, and you also film a video of the unfired clay piece. She replies with an amazed emoji and keeps asking when she can get the finished piece. After that, you browse your phone for a while and read a few articles about flower arrangement. Today you don't think about 'The Depth of Green'; instead, you continue reading 'Rain in Kunming' and savoring the passages you have read. Then you open a shopping app and order a new roll of watercolor paper, and also watch the replay of a watercolor blogger you follow. Around 22:00, you put down your book and start your pre-bed washing and skincare routine.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime routine and falling asleep
description: You change into pajamas and put a drop of lavender essential oil on your wrists and pillow. Under the soft light, you open your journal and use a fountain pen to write a summary of the day at the end of today's page: “Sunday is a rhythm of my own. From exploring watercolor to polishing words, everything is connected to my inner self. The lively, down-to-earth atmosphere of Dounan Flower Market was the most beautiful touch of today.” After writing, you close the journal and place it by the bedside. You turn off the main light, leaving only a small nightlight, sit cross-legged on the bed, and begin a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on your breath, turning today's satisfaction from trying new watercolor techniques and the warmth of strolling through the flower market with family into a warm current flowing through every inhale and exhale. When the meditation ends, you get under the quilt, close your eyes, and with gratitude for today's fulfilling experience and anticipation of the relief after submitting the manuscript tomorrow, gradually drift off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga, meditation, and journaling
description: In Kunming, in the faint morning light, she laid a yoga mat on the bedroom bay window and began her morning meditation for day three, extending the hold times in Cat-Cow and Downward Dog while focusing on her breath. After finishing, she sat on the edge of the bed and checked in on the Tide App, recording her physical sensations and peaceful mood.
location: Home - bedroom bay window, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: In the dining room, you shared breakfast with your parents. Mom had prepared rice noodles and boiled eggs, and Dad was watching the morning news. You mentioned your plans to submit an article and go to the bookstore today. Mom cheered you on, and Dad encouraged you to take it in stride. The warm conversation filled you with energy.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Home - Dining Room

name: Checking and sending the manuscript for submission.
description: In her study, she did the final proofreading of the essay collection manuscript and the revised edition of “The Depth of Green,” checking the format and page numbers, and revised the email drafts to editors Zhang Minghui and Xu Mingyuan. At 07:50, she solemnly sent the two submission emails, her feelings a mix of anticipation and the calm of relief.
location: China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Green Lake Community, home - study

name: Arranging floral materials, discussing gifts and shopping via video call.
description: On the balcony, she pruned lisianthus and spray roses and put them in vases. Then she went back to the study and had a video call with her sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen. They discussed buying a massage chair together for their mother's 56th birthday, browsing and comparing brands. After hanging up, she placed the order online, filled in the home address, and told her mother it was a surprise.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; home - balcony and study

name: Handling work emails and reading on the balcony
description: Checked off completed tasks in the planner, replied to emails about column topics, and browsed messages from the editors' group. Then I curled up in a chair on the balcony reading Rain in Kunming. Drawn by the synesthetic descriptions in the book, I copied passages and made notes, planning to use them in the afternoon's writing.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Home - Study and Balcony

name: Family lunch and midday rest.
description: Helped Mother prepare lunch. The family had lunch together, sharing that the submission went smoothly and updating each other on the gifts. After the meal, I changed into a light cardigan, packed my laptop and a raw Pu’er tea cake from Bulang Mountain, and leaned against the headboard with my eyes closed for 15 minutes to recharge for the afternoon writing.
location: Home - kitchen, dining room, and bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walked to Zhibushi Bookstore and shared tea and a brief chat.
description: Putting on headphones, I walked along Huashan West Road, passed through the wutong-tree lane, and arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore, where I gave the tea cake to the store owner, Uncle Qin. Uncle Qin happily gave me a photography collection of old Yunnan architecture in return, and we agreed to meet for tea next time to have a detailed chat.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Transition to Mingyuan Bookstore and writing warm-up
description: Walked along Green Lake North Road to Mingyuan Bookstore, photographing the early-yellow ginkgo leaves along the way. Sat down at a window booth on the second floor, ordered a hot Americano, and pulled up the old draft of 'Slow Travel in Kunming' to browse, thinking about rewriting the rain-scene description using the rainforest field-trip impressions and the texture of 'Rain in Kunming'.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 25 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mingyuan Book House, focusing on writing
description: She immersed herself in revising “Slow Travel in Kunming,” blending Wang Zengqi-style delicate brushwork with the moist sensory experiences of rainforest hikes into her descriptions. At 15:00, she paused, proactively messaged Zhao Xue on WeChat to arrange a Friday time to exchange and review each other’s manuscripts, then continued writing until dusk.
location: Window booth on the second floor of Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 25 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking with my parents at Little Bird Park.
description: After finishing work and backing up the manuscript, I walked to the entrance of Little Bird Park to meet my parents. I walked arm in arm with my mother along the lake shore, sharing what I'd seen at the bookstore and the photography books I'd found. My parents chatted about neighborhood anecdotes. Under the sunset we watched black-headed gulls resting, feeling peaceful and content inside.
location: Mid-Lake Pavilion and surrounding area, Little Bird Park (Green Lake Park), Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping on the way home and family dinner
description: The family walked home together and stopped by City Garden Supermarket on the way to buy vegetables, spiced dried tofu, and other ingredients. For dinner, Dad cooked braised fish and cucumber salad. You informed Mom of the massage chair delivery information and received Zhao Xue's reply agreeing to the Friday mutual review.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and home at Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road

name: Evening free time and journal organizing
description: After clearing the dishes, she changed the water for the flowers on the balcony and flipped through the photography collection Uncle Qin had given her. She sent a message to her good friend Su Man to ask about visiting Dounan Flower Market on Saturday. Then, in the study, she used a new journal to record the important moments of the day: the submission, choosing a gift, and the chat with Uncle Qin, and stuck a ginkgo leaf on it as decoration.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - Home: living room, balcony and study

name: Evening Wash-Up and Skincare
description: In the bathroom, she washed her face carefully, applied a moisturizing mask, and smoothed on body lotion, enjoying this relaxing time that belonged only to her before bed.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, home-bathroom

name: English reading and planning for tomorrow
description: Leaning against the headboard, she read aloud from the English novel 'The House on Mango Street' and marked the vivid metaphorical sentences. Then she wrote in her planner the plan to go to the library on Yunnan University's Chenggong campus tomorrow, and played folk music on her phone to fully unwind.
location: Home - Bedroom, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation, meditation, and reading to fall asleep
description: She changed into pajamas, lit lavender essential oil aromatherapy, and created a peaceful atmosphere. She meditated by the bay window before bed, letting the day's emotions flow through her and feeling grateful for the day. After meditating, she lay down and read the essay collection “The Edge of the Field.” As drowsiness set in, she turned off the light at 23:00 and fell asleep in a tranquil state of mind.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; home—bedroom bay window and bed

name: Sleep
description: Sleeping peacefully in the bedroom at home in the quiet night, gathering energy for a brand new day.
location: Bedroom in an apartment building in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: I laid out the yoga mat in front of the floor-to-ceiling window in the living room and did the fourth day of morning yoga meditation. Today I added Warrior Pose I and Triangle Pose, feeling a deep stretch in the hips and side waist. With even abdominal breathing and the sky just beginning to lighten outside the window, I felt calm inside and full of energy for the new day. After finishing, I recorded the comfortable feeling in my body in my journal.
location: Living room of an apartment building in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning run at Cuihu Park
description: After putting on my running shoes, I walked from home to the south gate of Cuihu Park, about a 10-minute walk. Once there, I ran 5 kilometers along the lakeside trail at a pace of about 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer, feeling the morning breeze on my face and the rhythm of my body gradually heating up. Along the way, I noticed that no black-headed gulls had appeared on the lake yet.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast at home and notes after communicating with the editor
description: After finishing her run and returning home, she took a comfortable hot shower, weighed herself, and recorded it (46.1 kg). Her mother, Li Xiulan, had already prepared a simple breakfast: milk, boiled eggs, and flower cakes. While eating breakfast, she quickly browsed the news and emails on her phone. After breakfast, she formally opened her computer and received a reply from Zhang Minghui, the editor at the publishing house, who highly praised the quality of the prose collection manuscript and suggested adding an afterword. Sun Yuwei immediately replied to the email agreeing, then had an in-depth discussion with Editor Zhang via WeChat voice call, and finally settled on the afterword titled "To Myself in Five Years", about 1,500 words, with the direction of reviewing her creative journey and inner changes, and a deadline of November 10.
location: Study and dining room in an apartment building, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Material collection and initial conception for the afterword.
description: After hanging up the phone, she opened the desk drawer and took out her four years of college creative notes and diaries. While flipping through them, she recorded key moments and reflections in her notebook, such as 'sophomore year inspiration for the first draft at Mingyuan Bookstore,' 'junior year late-night anxiety over revising the draft,' and 'epiphany in the Xishuangbanna rainforest.' Midway through, she stood up and did five minutes of standing meditation to relax her neck and shoulders. Around 11:15, she sketched out a brief afterword framework.
location: Study room in a residential building in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and reading break.
description: Had lunch with mother Li Xiulan: simply stir-fried seasonal vegetables and stir-fried pork. After the meal, she leaned back on the living room sofa, opened “Yunnan Old Architecture Photography Collection” given by Uncle Qin, and saw an old photo of Maitreya Temple. She felt it shared a kindred spirit with her own prose and was an excellent image to cite in the afterword. After reading for about twenty minutes, she closed her eyes and rested for a while.
location: Dining room and living room of a residential building in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon yoga class and travel to and from.
description: At 13:00 she changed into yoga clothes, took her water bottle and phone, walked to the neighborhood gate, rode a shared bike to Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road, about a 15-minute ride. After arriving, she took the elevator to the 4th floor, Zhongmou Yoga Studio. Class started on time at 14:00. The class focused on core and inversions. With the help of the instructor He Lu, she held a stable headstand away from the wall for 12 seconds, and clearly felt her core strength and sense of balance improving. After class, she chatted briefly with He Lu, who recommended a book about body energy healing; they agreed to talk more after the next class. Afterward, she lingered in the studio's rest area and drank water to relax.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Green Lake Park Afterword: Deepening and Observation
description: Walked from Dechun Commercial Building to the west gate of Cuihu Park, about 15 minutes. Deliberately went around near the park's west gate, observed the autumn lake view, and imagined the scene of red-billed gulls flying in through her father's lens. She sat on a bench, combined the physical sensations from the yoga class with the park's tranquil atmosphere, and wrote the key paragraph 'On Waiting and Persistence' from the afterword outline in her journal. The words were more specific than the morning's framework, full of imagery.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping on the way and sharing a picture album with the family.
description: Walked home from Green Lake Park, passing Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street. I remembered Aunt Xie, so I went in and bought a box of the tofu pudding my mother likes, and also grabbed a box of yogurt I could have tomorrow morning. Then I walked about 13 minutes to get home. As soon as I arrived, my father Sun Mingyuan came back from the Cultural Bureau with the first proof of his personal photography book "Creatures of Green Lake". The whole family sat in the living room and flipped through it joyfully. Sun Yuwei felt proud of her father, made him a cup of his favorite pu'er tea, and together they discussed photo selection and layout details.
location: Living room of an apartment in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, passing by the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at No. 98 Fuchun Street.

name: Family dinner
description: Prepared dinner with Mother, helping wash vegetables and serve soup. During dinner, the family chatted while eating. Sun Yuwei shared the good news of receiving the editor's affirmation and her progress in drafting the afterword, and her father also shared the follow-up publication plan for the picture album. The dining table atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Restaurant in a residential unit, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Visiting Aunt Xie
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei took the freshly bought tofu pudding and a box of snacks her mother had made and went to the neighboring building to visit her neighbor, Auntie Xie Xiulan. After chatting at Auntie Xie's home for half an hour, Auntie Xie explained the account opening process in detail, and Sun Yuwei decided to give it a try. The two agreed to meet at the community gate at exactly 9:00 tomorrow morning and go to the nearby securities company together to handle the procedures.
location: Xie Xiulan's home, the unit building next to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Personal journaling time
description: After returning home, she went to her own room and carefully worked on her journal, recording the anxiety and joy of receiving the editor's reply that day, the progress with headstands in yoga class, the autumn scenery observed in Green Lake Park, and the proud moment of her father's picture album proofing — all with words, stickers, and pressed flower specimens. This has become an important ritual for her to sort out emotions and preserve memories.
location: Bedroom in an apartment building in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading and relaxation
description: After finishing the journal, she leaned against the headboard and continued reading Rain in Kunming, which she had not finished the day before. When she came to the passage describing the mushroom market, she thought she could write an essay about the flavors of Kunming's street life next time. After 21:00, she played light music on her phone and organized the next day's writing plan.
location: Bedroom in an apartment building in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and skincare
description: Performed the evening wash-up and skincare routine, using lavender-scented body lotion to massage and relax the calves, soothing the day's fatigue.
location: Bathroom in a unit building, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: Changed into pajamas, turned off the main light, and lit an aromatherapy candle. Did a 10-minute guided meditation in bed, reviewing the day's gains and feeling full of anticipation for tomorrow. At 22:15, put down the phone, turned off the bedside lamp, adjusted her sleeping position, and fell asleep in peace and contentment.
location: Bedroom in an apartment building in Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga meditation and weigh-in record
description: After getting up in the early morning, I did the fifth day of yoga meditation on the bedroom bay window cushion, focusing on the brow chakra, feeling the breath and the stretching of the body, and the stiffness in the shoulders and neck eased. Then I stood barefoot on the scale and recorded a weight of 46.15 kg, and wrote down my meditation feelings and the book title recommended by He Lu in the journal. Outside the window, the sky was gradually brightening, and through the gap in the curtains I could see a clear sky.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family breakfast and account-opening preparations.
description: She had breakfast with her parents in the dining room. Her mother made steaming hot small-pot rice noodles and pickled radish. During the meal, they discussed the plan to buy a massage chair together with her sister. Her father was interested in the zero-gravity function, and her mother cared about how gentle the massage programs were. They decided that Sun Yuwei would compare the options in detail before placing the order. She also mentioned today's arrangement to open a securities account with Aunt Xie. After breakfast, she returned to the study, put her ID card and a frequently used bank card into her small bag, then quickly browsed her college diary and used voice memos on her phone to record keywords for the afterword, such as 'confused original aspiration', 'the texture of waiting', and 'rainforest encounter', to prepare for writing in the evening.
location: Dining room and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning reading, departure, and meeting
description: In the study, she leafed through the Photographic Collection of Old Yunnan Architecture that Uncle Qin had given her, admiring the mottled walls and graceful arcades of the French-style buildings along the Yunnan–Vietnam Railway. Then she changed into a light jacket, put on her small bag, and strolled through the residential garden, feeling the morning breeze and the scent of osmanthus as she headed to the gate of the community. Arriving five minutes early, Aunt Xie Xiulan was already waiting at the gate, dressed in a neat suit and holding a document folder. After a brief exchange, they set off together for the securities company.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province — home study and the community gate

name: Open a stock account
description: Walked with Aunt Xie for about 15 minutes to the Guotai Haitong Securities branch on Renmin Middle Road. At the counter, filled out the account application form, completed the risk assessment questionnaire (result: moderate), and with the guidance of a staff member, set the password and signed the third-party depository agreement. The whole process went smoothly and took about 1 hour and 45 minutes. While waiting, Aunt Xie shared her little experience of earning grocery money by subscribing to new bonds, which sounded more stable than stock trading.
location: No. 9-2 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Guotai Haitong Securities Kunming Renmin Middle Road Securities Business Department

name: Return home, shop, and order the massage chair
description: After leaving the business office, she walked home along Renmin Middle Road to Fuchun Street. Along the way, she asked Aunt Xie for more advice on the right mindset for a beginner in personal finance. Aunt Xie emphasized the principle of “don't invest in what you don't understand” and recommended a few introductory books. Passing by Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, she went in and bought red grapes and winter dates, and also picked up a box of the mung bean cakes Aunt Xie often bought. Back home, she immediately opened her laptop in the study, compared the lumbar and neck massage programs and the “suitable for the elderly” reviews of three massage chairs, and finally selected an OGAWA model, completing the order and payment. She then sent a WeChat message and an order screenshot to her older sister in Shenzhen. Her sister replied instantly: “Got it! Money transferred. I trust you with things,” followed by a thumbs-up emoji.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the home study at Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Family lunch and sharing
description: In the dining room, they enjoyed the stir-fried choy sum, tomato scrambled eggs, and yesterday's leftover braised pork made by her mother. At the table, she shared the entire process of opening the account that morning and the final choice of ordering the massage chair. Her father thought the selected model was good, and her mother said happily, “From now on, your dad and I can enjoy it too.” The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rest and afterword framework design.
description: After the meal, holding a cup of warm water, she sat on the beanbag chair on the bedroom’s bay window, scrolled through afterword keywords in her phone memos, and mentally connected several diary fragments to draft the structure of the afterword—from the original impulse of ‘confusion,’ to the texture of ‘waiting’ (like her father photographing black-necked cranes), to the rewards of ‘persistence’ (such as yoga and meditation). She decided to use ‘to myself five years from now’ as the emotional thread.
location: Bedroom bay window at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Zhibushi Bookstore and exchange ideas.
description: Walked about 20 minutes to Zhibushi Bookstore, passing Green Lake on the way, where many black-headed gulls were already circling over the water. When she arrived, she shared her afterword idea with Uncle Qin, who was sorting books, and mentioned that she wanted to use 'the texture of waiting' as the central image. Uncle Qin was intrigued, put down his work, and seriously suggested she read Lao She's 'Thinking of Beiping' to appreciate its plain, honest expression. After thanking him for the advice, Sun Yuwei went upstairs to her usual spot to prepare for writing.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing at the bookstore and collecting inspiration
description: She sat down by the window on the second floor of the bookstore, brewed a cup of rose black tea, and opened her laptop to try writing the opening of the afterword. But after writing about 200 characters, she felt it was formulaic and stopped. She found "Thinking of Beiping," which Uncle Qin had recommended, read a few pages, and then browsed Wang Zengqi's "Plants and Trees of the Human World," absorbing a plain and free-spirited sense of language. Then, in the notes app on her phone, she expanded fragments from her diary and turned them into more concrete scenes and feelings. After an hour of "warming up," writing once again flowed much more smoothly. Setting aside the pressure of word count, she naturally connected "the texture of waiting," "the original intention to create," and "the thrill of meeting in the rainforest." By 17:00, she had completed a solid opening of nearly 600 characters.
location: Second floor, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home, savoring the dusk.
description: After packing up and saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, I walked home along Cuihu East Road. In the early winter dusk, the sky was not yet fully dark, with a soft orange-pink glow on the horizon. The black-headed gulls by the lake were far more numerous than last month, and some even dared to fly onto the water nearby. I took a few photos with my phone, thinking they could serve as visual inspiration for the afterword.
location: Cuihu East Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner preparation and dining
description: After arriving home and changing into loungewear, she went into the kitchen to help her mother trim vegetables, cut chives, and mix the dumpling filling, and chatted about how she had felt reading "Thinking of Beiping" that afternoon. Her mother smiled and said, "Lao She's writing has the flavor of everyday life—you should learn from that too." After wrapping two large trays of dumplings, the family sat around the dining table eating steaming hot chive dumplings, dipping them in vinegar and chili oil. Sun Yuwei told her parents the good news that the afterword had already reached more than 600 characters. They were very happy. Her father said, "Settle down and write—you're the best," and her mother put a dumpling into her bowl.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Stroll at Green Lake Park
description: After dinner, she went to Green Lake Park with her parents for a walk to aid digestion. Along the lakeside path, they walked more than halfway around the lake, with a gentle evening breeze. Her mother held Sun Yuwei's arm, and her father walked ahead. The lake reflected the city's lights, and the music of square dancing came from the distance. They chatted as they walked, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afterword on writing in the study
description: After returning from the walk, I washed my face, brewed a cup of the osmanthus tea my mother had made, and sat at the desk in my study. I set my phone to Do Not Disturb mode, opened the afternoon's writing notes and original diary, and formally began writing the afterword 'To Myself Five Years from Now.' Around the key words 'original aspiration, waiting, and growth,' I filled in details from my diary. When I wrote the moving parts, my eyes became hot. I finished the first draft at about 21:45, roughly 1,500 characters, and decided to polish the whole piece tomorrow.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening washing and meditation.
description: She went to the bathroom and took a hot shower with lavender body wash, washing away the day's fatigue. Then she carefully did her evening skincare routine: toner, essence, and eye cream. After changing into pajamas, she lit the aromatherapy diffuser on the bedroom bay window, sat on her meditation cushion, opened the Tide app, and followed the guide for a 10-minute pre-sleep relaxation meditation, focusing on her breath and clearing her mind.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep journaling and reading
description: On the journal at her bedroom desk, she recorded today's reflections: taking the first step in managing finances, the afterword getting off to a smooth start, and the beautiful dusk at Green Lake. She planned to go to the Yunnan University Chenggong Campus library tomorrow to return books and borrow books on writing theory. Then she went to bed, picked up The Grass and Trees of the Human World from the bedside, and casually flipped through a few pages. Ten minutes later, drowsiness came over her; she turned off the lamp and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation, then washing up and weighing in
description: Completed Day 6 of meditation and yoga on the bedroom bay window cushion, using the breath-counting method to feel the deep and long breathing. Finished 3 rounds of Sun Salutation A and 3 rounds of Sun Salutation B. After that, stepped on the scale and it stayed stable at 46.2kg, took a quick shower, changed into sports gear, and prepared to go out for a morning run.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning jog at Cuihu Park, including walking there.
description: From home, walk along Huashan West Road for about 5 minutes to reach Cuihu Park. The autumn morning was slightly chilly, and the lake shimmered. Jogged 5 kilometers along the track at a pace of about 7:10 per kilometer, stretched after the run, and photographed the lake reflecting the blue sky and red maples as postcard material.
location: Cuihu Park, 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Going home for a shower and breakfast
description: After returning home, she took a quick shower, changed into loungewear, and enjoyed the breakfast her mother had prepared: small-pot rice noodles, fried eggs, and hot milk. While eating, she shared her morning run experience with her parents and used the journal app to record her morning weight and running data.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Polish the afterword in the study and gather inspiration during breaks.
description: In the study, she brewed some Menghai ripe pu-erh and opened the afterword document for "Letter to Myself in Five Years" to polish the first draft. She incorporated the scenes of people at the securities business hall and the feeling in her brow chakra from this morning's meditation into the paragraphs about "waiting" and "settling." During a short break, she stood by the window looking at the street and flipped through the passage in "Thinking of Beiping" that describes the old city walls and pigeon whistles, gaining inspiration to add a contrast with Kunming's slow pace.
location: Study room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Continue writing the afterword, about 2,000 words
description: Strike while the iron is hot and turn inspiration into words. Incorporating the independent bookstore culture of Kunming, she added about 2,000 words exploring how to maintain inner peace in a fast-paced era. As the afterword drew to a close, she felt satisfied.
location: Study room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lunch break and planning.
description: During lunch, she updated her parents on her writing progress and received suggestions about incorporating more Kunming elements. After the meal, she helped her mother clear the dishes, then skimmed *The World of Plants* for a short rest. After her afternoon nap, she returned to the study to organize her morning-run red maple photos into the folder 'Postcard Material - November,' searched for examples of small-size postcard albums, and took screenshots of styles to save for discussion with Uncle Qin.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore and discuss postcard design
description: After changing clothes, she walked along Huashan West Road, turned onto Wenlin Street, and headed to Mingyuan Bookstore, buying a kumquat lemon tea on the way. At the bookstore, she gave it to the owner, Uncle Qin, and greeted him, learning that autumn and winter postcard sales had been rising steadily. They had an in-depth conversation about small-size postcard albums; she showed example screenshots and received suggestions for combination sets. At a window seat in the bookstore, she sketched postcard designs on the themes of Kunming Winter Sunshine and Street Corner Coffee Shop.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 144 Wenlin Street, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Go to the yoga studio and attend yoga class
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, I walked along Wenlin Street and turned onto Dongfeng West Road to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. In class, the instructor He Lu led a shoulder-neck and core warm-up. When I tried a slow press into a headstand, although I didn't complete it independently, my core strength improved, and I held a stable handstand away from the wall for a few seconds, earning the instructor's praise. After class, I talked with He Lu about the experience of meditating on the brow chakra, and she recommended a podcast by a yoga philosophy teacher.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk by Green Lake to gather design materials.
description: After yoga class, she took a detour to Green Lake Park. At dusk, sunlight filtered through the ginkgo leaves, and she photographed everyday scenes of students sketching by the lake, an elderly person walking a dog, and ducks swimming about, as supplementary inspiration for her postcard designs.
location: The area around Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Sharing stories and experiences at family dinner
description: Went home to help set the table. During dinner, she shared with her parents the discussion at Mingyuan Bookstore and her attempt at a headstand in yoga class. Her mother reminded, 'Haste makes waste,' and her father encouraged her to enjoy the process.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Organizing materials, reading, and online exchanges
description: In the study, I pasted the morning run and dusk photos and sketch drafts into my journal, noting color combinations and layout suggestions. Then I read the Kunming rainy season chapter in The Plants of the Human World, discussed progress on the afterword with my writer friend Zhao Xue over WeChat, and agreed on a time to review each other's manuscripts online tomorrow.
location: Study room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening washing and skincare, pre-sleep meditation, and falling asleep
description: She completed her evening washing and skincare routine, changed into pure cotton pajamas, and left only an aromatherapy lamp on in the room. At 22:30, she sat cross-legged on the bed for a pre-bedtime meditation, focusing on her breath to settle her thoughts, and at 23:05 fell asleep to the white noise of the Tide app.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: Woke up at 6:15, laid out the yoga mat on the bay window, and started the 7th day of continuous meditation practice. Starting with Cat-Cow to awaken the spine and feel the vertebrae extend and flex, then transitioning to Downward-Facing Dog and holding for 5 breaths, feeling the stretch in the back of the thighs and the opening of the shoulders and upper back. Ended with 5 minutes of seated meditation, focusing on the brow chakra, letting the mind settle with the breath, and building focus for the day.
location: Bay window at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Wash up, weigh in, and check messages.
description: After finishing yoga, she took deep breaths by the window. After washing up, she weighed herself and it was 46.2 kg. She changed into loungewear, picked up her phone, and quickly checked editor Xu Mingyuan's WeChat and email; there were no new messages. She swiped through the weather app to confirm it was cloudy turning clear, 12 to 18 degrees. She glanced through other unread messages, nothing urgent.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Her mother cooked her signature guoqiao rice noodles, with a rich chicken broth and plenty of toppings. Sun Yuwei told her parents that she would send the final draft of the afterword to the editor that day, and if all went smoothly, the essay collection would be officially published. Hearing this, her mother's eyes lit up and she kept saying it was great. Her father nodded and told her to stay calm and take it slow, with pride in his tone.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revised the final afterword and sent it
description: I immersed myself in revision work in the study. I opened the afterword document "To Yourself Five Years from Now," read it through, and softly read it aloud in my mind to feel the rhythm. I made minor adjustments to the ending, borrowing the sentence patterns from "The Plants and Trees of the Human World," which I had read the night before. After finishing, I typed "Final Draft of the Afterword to 'Slow Travel Notes'" in the title. I created a new email to editor Xu Mingyuan, attached the final version, wrote a sincere note of explanation, and expressed my gratitude. After saving it as a draft, I took a deep breath and sent the email. Then I left a message on WeChat for Editor Xu. While waiting, I picked up a book to flip through, but my eyes kept drifting to the phone screen as I mentally counted the time.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Received publication confirmation and shared it with her family
description: About forty minutes later, she received a reply from editor Xu Mingyuan, praising the afterword as deeply moving and perfectly matching the temperament of Slow Travel Notes. The editorial board had confirmed it was included in the publication process, and they would discuss contract details later. Sun Yuwei was so excited she almost jumped up and immediately replied with thanks. Then she rushed out of the study, excitedly waving her phone to announce to her parents: “Mom! Dad! It’s happening! The editor said Slow Travel Notes can be published!” Her father took off his glasses and nodded repeatedly, while her mother turned off the stove and came over, beaming from ear to ear, and immediately decided to celebrate with a mushroom hotpot at noon.
location: Study and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Short break indoors.
description: After sitting at the desk for a long time, my eyes felt sore and dry, so I got up and moved around. I went to the kitchen, poured myself some warm water, and ate the apple my mother had left. While eating, I walked to the balcony, looked at the distant outline of Green Lake, let my mind empty for a few minutes, and relaxed.
location: Home kitchen and balcony, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family celebration lunch
description: Her mother deftly prepared a steaming mushroom hot pot and crossing-the-bridge rice noodles. Her father made an exception and opened a bottle of highland barley wine he had kept for years, pouring a small cup for Sun Yuwei. During the meal, the conversation revolved around Slow Travel Notes; her father talked about writing reports in his youth, and her mother recalled how cute she was as a child writing essays at her desk. The dining room was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and handling affairs
description: After lunch, she took a half-hour nap with a pleasantly tipsy sense of satisfaction. Once she woke up refreshed, she took care of business: she sent Uncle Qin a WeChat message telling him that the afterword had been approved and that 'Slow Travel Notes' was going to be published, and that she would thank him in person and talk about the new postcard designs once she had pulled herself together. Uncle Qin replied with a thumbs-up, saying 'Well done.' Then she opened her journal, cut out the sketches she had drawn the day before—'Kunming Winter Sunshine' and 'Corner Coffee Shop'—and pasted them in, writing in the blank space with colored pens: 'November 7, 2025, publication of Slow Travel Notes confirmed.'
location: Home bedroom and study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: She put on a sweater coat and walked to Zhibushi Bookstore. Passing through the tree-lined path beside Green Lake, she felt lighthearted. When she arrived, Uncle Qin was tidying the bookshelves and smiled at the sight of her. She sincerely thanked him again for his encouragement and advice. Uncle Qin brewed some newly acquired Pu'er tea and talked about his travels in Dali and his experience of publishing a book. Afterward, she picked up a newly arrived deluxe illustrated edition of Border Town in a corner on the second floor and quietly read a few chapters by the window.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked home along Green Lake.
description: After leaving the bookstore, she walked home along Green Lake. The afternoon sunlight filtered through the willow branches and leaves, making the lake surface sparkle. She slowed down to watch an old man playing the erhu, young couples whispering, and children chasing pigeons. She took out her phone to photograph the reflections by the lake and the withered lotus flowers as material for her daily journal.
location: Cuihu Park Lakeside Trail, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Assisted with meal preparation and organized editing feedback.
description: After getting home, she helped her mother pick and wash vegetables in the kitchen and chatted about the walk around Cuihu. Meanwhile, she checked her phone and saw that editor Xu Mingyuan had sent a draft contract template and details that needed confirmation. So she washed her hands, went back to the study, read the contract terms carefully, marked a few places, and planned to reply in detail in the evening.
location: Kitchen and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the table having dinner. Mother cooked some home-style dishes: stir-fried pork with green peppers and dry-fried shredded potatoes. Sun Yuwei showed the contract draft to her father, who put on his reading glasses, read it carefully, and offered several suggestions about copyright and royalty distribution. The family ate and chatted, with a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking a walk with my parents at Green Lake.
description: After dinner, the three of them put on their coats and went for a walk in Cuihu Park together. The park was quiet in the evening. Sun Yuwei walked between her parents, holding their arms. Her mother mentioned wanting to buy dried goods at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market on the weekend, and her father shared a planning idea for a cultural exhibition. She listened quietly and felt the ordinary yet precious happiness.
location: Cuihu Park Lakeside Trail, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: In the study, she made a video call to her elder sister Sun Yutong. Her sister congratulated her on publishing the book and said she had already seen the news in the family group. Sun Yuwei told her all about today's events, and her sister was happy for her and reminded her to take care of herself. The two talked about whether her sister could pick her up on the way during a business trip next year, and agreed to discuss it further once the travel plans were confirmed.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Mutual manuscript review with Zhao Xue
description: She and her friend Zhao Xue critiqued each other's drafts via WeChat voice messages. Zhao Xue sent over her article, and Sun Yuwei also sent her just-finalized afterword. During the call, Sun Yuwei shared the good news that the afterword had been accepted and confirmed for publication, and Zhao Xue gasped and offered congratulations. The two then had a serious exchange: Sun Yuwei suggested adjusting the paragraph order regarding the structure of Zhao Xue's article, while Zhao Xue praised the descriptive details in Sun Yuwei's afterword. Both were moved by the exchange.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing journal and planning itinerary
description: She felt a pleasant sense of fulfillment in her body. She took out the book cover of the newly bought Border Town and the photos she had taken at Green Lake during the day, carefully pasted them into her journal, wrote the date and weather with a fountain pen, and recorded the day's important moments: the final draft of the afterword, publication confirmation, family celebration, bookstore time, and sharing with her sister and friends. Finally, on tomorrow's schedule page, she wrote, “11:00, go to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market with Mom and Dad,” then closed her journal, bringing a perfect day to a close.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening Wash-Up and Skincare
description: Start the evening cleansing routine, carefully cleanse my face with makeup remover oil, then apply moisturizing toner and lotion. Looking at my radiant self in the mirror, I smile and feel the confidence and joy that come from being recognized.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation
description: Turning off the main light and leaving only the bedside lamp on, you sat cross-legged on the bed and began bedtime meditation. Letting today's excitement and joy gather in your chest, then slowly recede like a tide, leaving a quiet calm. In your mind, today's scenes replayed: your mother's crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, Uncle Qin's smiling face, the shimmer of Green Lake. In the end, your thoughts settled into stillness.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for sleep
description: After meditation, she got into bed, picked up 'The Grass and Trees of the Human World' and softly read a short passage about plants. As sleepiness grew with the words, she turned off the light, felt a sense of peace and contentment in the darkness, and slowly drifted off to sleep, aiming to fall asleep before 22:00.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning exercise and meditation
description: In the early morning, I completed day 8 of yoga meditation on the bedroom bay window, performing poses such as wind-blown tree pose, transforming anticipation into a calm state of mind. Then I went to Cuihu Park and ran 5.5 kilometers along the lakeside at a pace of 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer, taking photos of seagulls as journal material. Then I did 30 minutes of brisk walking by the Panlong River as cross-training, relaxing my body and thinking about the day's priorities.
location: Green Lake Park at No. 67 South Cuihu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the nearby Panlong River

name: Shower and personal care
description: After returning home, she took a hot shower to wash away the sweat from her morning run, changed into loungewear, weighed herself at 46.3 kg, recorded the data, and noted that she was underweight, mentally putting nutritional counseling on the agenda.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family breakfast.
description: Had breakfast with parents, eating rice noodles and fried eggs prepared by Mom. Discussed the day's schedule: physical exam and vegetable market in the morning, flower market and pottery class in the afternoon, writing group in the evening. Father mentioned that the proof copy of the photography book Creatures of Green Lake would arrive in the afternoon, and the whole family was full of anticipation.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Annual physical examination
description: Walked to the Wuhua District Comprehensive Health Examination Center and completed items such as height/weight, blood pressure, blood routine, and internal medicine. With a BMI of 18.1, the doctor reminded her that she was underweight and advised strengthening nutrition and building muscle. She carefully recorded the advice and planned to contact her nutritionist friend Wang Ting.
location: Wuhua District Comprehensive Health Examination Center, 188 Renmin West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market
description: I walked from the physical examination center to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market to meet up with my parents. The three of us strolled around the market together, discussed the menu for my mother's birthday, bought avocados to make smoothies, and unexpectedly discovered dried lotus seed heads and wheat stalks, which we bought as materials for dried flower bouquets.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and nutrition consultation
description: After getting home, I video-called my nutritionist friend Wang Ting to ask about a weight-gain diet plan and received detailed suggestions: increase intake of high-quality protein (chicken breast, fish, shrimp, eggs) and healthy fats (avocado, nuts, olive oil), and she shared quick recipes, which I recorded in my journal. Then I had lunch with my parents, eating steamed sea bass, boiled shrimp, and a vegetable salad. I deliberately ate more fish and shrimp and drank an avocado smoothie, practicing the first day of healthy eating.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Midday break and journaling
description: After a 30-minute nap, she organized the recipes and weight-gain tips Wang Ting had recommended into her journal in the study, pasted in a dried lotus seedpod brought back from Zhuanxin Market, and made a check-in record of "Healthy Eating Day 1".
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Shopping for dried flower materials at Dounan Flower Market
description: Took the subway from Jiaosanqiao Station to Dounan Flower Market, and on the way contacted Su Man to let her know she was going alone. At the flower market she video-called Su Man in real time and, following her suggestions, selected dried flower materials such as eucalyptus leaves, cotton, globe amaranth, and millet berries, as well as kraft paper and natural hemp rope. She then took the subway back to the city center with the flower materials.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the round-trip metro ride

name: Making a dried flower bouquet over a video call
description: After returning home, she spread the flower materials across the coffee table, video-called Su Man, and under her remote guidance arranged them by the principle of varying heights, trimmed the eucalyptus leaves, inserted cotton and globe amaranth, tied them tightly with hemp rope, wrapped them in kraft paper and ribbon, and completed a dried flower bouquet full of natural rustic charm.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Wenlin Pottery Studio ceramics class
description: After putting away the dried flower bouquet, I took a small spray bottle and walked to Wenlin Pottery Studio. Under the pottery teacher's guidance, I did fine trimming, carefully refining the clay bodies of the tea cup and earrings, scraping away uneven thickness and adjusting the curvature of the forms. The teacher praised my handling of details and suggested glaze colors that suited the shapes.
location: Wenlin Pottery House, No. 142 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and family time
description: After the pottery class, I walked home. On the way, I bought a cup of brown sugar pearl milk at a newly opened milk tea shop (using pure milk instead of creamer). When I got home and had dinner with my parents, the proof copy of my father's photography book 'Creatures of Green Lake' arrived. The whole family passed it around and admired it, praising the composition and the liveliness of the light and shadows. My mother suggested printing more copies to give to relatives and friends. After dinner, I took a walk in the neighborhood to aid digestion and savored the satisfaction of the day.
location: Cuihu Community and surrounding areas, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Mingyuan Bookstore writing group activity
description: After returning home, I prepared for the writing group activity, trial-read the opening of the new essay and marked keywords. Walked to Mingyuan Bookstore and volunteered to be the recorder. Read aloud the essay opening describing the feelings of students sketching by Cuihu Lake; the group members suggested adding interactive details to enhance the visual imagery. During the free discussion, we exchanged ideas about creative blocks and writing habits, and carefully recorded feedback. After the activity, I immediately organized the meeting minutes and posted them to the WeChat group, and received a like from the group leader, Senior Chen Ming.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 78 Wenhua Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and falling asleep.
description: After walking home, she took a shower, lay in bed, and played a sleep-assistance meditation audio to relax. Before going to sleep, she quietly placed the dried flower bouquet she had made that afternoon and a handwritten birthday card beside her mother’s pillow. Back in the bedroom, she recorded the day’s key points in her journal: physical exam reminder, recipes, dried flower bouquet, picture album, and writing feedback. She turned off the light and fell asleep, ending the day with a full sense of satisfaction.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning yoga meditation and health record.
description: Woke up naturally at 6:05 in the morning in the dim light, put on comfortable yoga clothes, laid out the yoga mat in the bedroom, and began the 9th day of yoga meditation. I focused especially on shoulder relaxation and outward rotation of the arms in downward-facing dog, and felt that my neck and shoulders were more relaxed than yesterday. During meditation, I focused on my breathing and felt the tranquility of the early weekend morning. After finishing at 6:35, I weighed myself on the body fat scale, which showed 46.35 kg. I opened my journal, recorded my weight and physical sensations, and felt reassured to see the weight steadily rising, and added the note "Next week's goal: keep up protein intake."
location: Bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and personal care.
description: While washing up, I washed my face with warm water and applied moisturizing lotion. Looking in the mirror, I saw that my complexion was a bit better than in the past few days, and I felt in a good mood. I simply combed my hair and got ready to face the new day.
location: Home bathroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Have breakfast and chat with mother
description: You came to the dining room, and your mother Li Xiulan had already prepared breakfast: plain congee, boiled eggs, stir-fried baby bok choy, and homemade pickled radish. Sitting at the table, you talked with your mother about yesterday’s physical exam results and shared the doctor’s advice about anemia and increasing nutrition. As she listened, your mother reminded you to eat on time and not stay up late. When you mentioned that you planned to make a systematic diet plan today and wanted to go for a walk with your parents at Green Lake in the afternoon, your mother smiled and agreed. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning tidying and meal plan preparation
description: After breakfast, I helped my mother clear the dishes and put them away in the kitchen. Then I returned to the study and spread my journal, pens, yesterday's physical examination report, and the basic nutrition guide from nutritionist Wang Ting on the desk. I quickly browsed a few healthy-eating apps on my phone for recipe inspiration. Finally, I opened the fridge and took inventory of the ingredients on hand, making final preparations for the shopping and planning to come.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Develop a three-week dietary adjustment plan.
description: Sitting at her desk, she began to plan the next three weeks of meals, combining the advice of nutritionist Wang Ting with her own past food diary. She divided Monday through Sunday into an 'adjustment period', a 'consolidation period', and an 'intensification period', and further broke it down into each meal: breakfast (protein + carbs + a little fruit and vegetables), lunch (high protein + lots of vegetables + quality carbs), and dinner (light vegetables + easily digestible protein). She recorded in detail the recommended daily intake of protein (such as chicken breast, fish, shrimp, eggs, and soy products) and vegetables (broccoli, spinach, tomatoes, etc.), and set a rule of only one milk tea per week, replacing chips and chocolate with nuts and fruit. In her journal, she designed a simple check-in table and set a target weight of 47 kg and a body fat goal. After finishing, she carefully double-checked the ratios and felt that the plan was clear and achievable, full of confidence.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Confirm the meal plan with nutritionist Wang Ting
description: She got up and walked to the window to rest her eyes, then took two clear photos of the diet plan notebook and sent them to nutritionist Wang Ting via WeChat, asking her to check if any adjustments were needed. While waiting for the reply, she answered a message from Xu Mingyuan, editor of 'Cultural Horizons', confirming next week's topic. Wang Ting soon replied, praised the plan's organization, and suggested changing the protein source for one day's dinner from tofu to steamed sea bass to increase high-quality protein and unsaturated fatty acids. Finding the suggestion very professional, she immediately revised the notebook and replied with thanks.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Tidy up personal space and change clothes
description: She decided to tidy up her personal belongings before going out shopping. Back in the bedroom, she sorted the pile of laundry from last week into the laundry basket and cleared the clutter off the desk. Then she changed into going-out clothes—an off-white knit sweater and dark blue jeans, with canvas shoes—and took her canvas bag and phone. Before leaving, she also checked the snack cabinet at home, picked out the chips, chocolate, and carbonated drinks, and put them in a bag to throw away later.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to Walmart to buy healthy ingredients and return home to clear out snacks
description: At 11:30 she left, walked five minutes to Xiaoximen Bus Stop, took Bus No. 98, and got off at Daguan Commercial City Stop about 20 minutes later, arriving at Walmart. Following her shopping list, she carefully selected a box of organic chicken breast, a bag of frozen broccoli, two trays of free-range eggs, and a carton of fresh milk in the fresh food section, and bought a bag of mixed nuts in the dried goods section. After shopping, she checked out and spent about 120 yuan. After taking the bus home, she first put the purchased ingredients into the refrigerator by category, then decisively threw the bags of unhealthy snacks she had previously sorted out—such as potato chips and chocolate—into the garbage can downstairs, feeling as if she had said goodbye to her past unhealthy eating habits.
location: Walmart Supermarket, Daguan Commercial City, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Quick lunch
description: Made a simple lunch: boiled a bowl of buckwheat noodles, made a side dish with spinach and eggs from the fridge, and drizzled it with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. The lunch was nutritionally balanced and fit the diet plan I just made. After eating, I washed the dishes myself.
location: Dining room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday kitchen tidying and music break
description: After the meal, instead of sitting down right away, she first wiped down the kitchen counter and the refrigerator door panels, put the scattered spice bottles back in place, and made the kitchen look neat and orderly. Then she went into the study, curled up in the chair, opened a music app to play a soft folk song playlist, closed her eyes, and relaxed for about 30 minutes.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading "River Town" and recording creative inspiration
description: She woke up to soothing music and felt refreshed. She took from the bookshelf the copy of River Town that she had not finished reading at Zhibushi Bookstore yesterday and continued reading. When she reached the passage describing life in Fuling, she was moved by the calmness and warmth of the writing and thought of the style of her own Slow Travel Notes. She took out her portable notebook, copied down a sentence describing the river scenery, and wrote beside it an annotation: “A wording approach worth borrowing.” At the same time, she began to conceive the next essay for Cultural Horizons, with the theme of “food memories of family and hometown.” The dried radish made by her mother came to mind, and she felt it was a good entry point, so she wrote an outline.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Went for a walk in Cuihu Park with my parents.
description: You closed the book and walked out of the study. Your father, Sun Mingyuan, was reading the newspaper on the balcony, and your mother, Li Xiulan, was watching TV in the living room. You suggested going for a walk around Cuihu Lake, and your parents readily agreed. The family changed into their outdoor shoes, and you brought your camera. A five-minute walk took you to Cuihu Park. In late autumn, the metasequoia trees around Cuihu Lake were turning from green to red, reflected on the water like an oil painting. Linking arms with your mother, with your father walking beside you, you strolled slowly along the lake, stopping now and then to watch wild ducks playing and to take a few photos with your phone. You shared the details of today's physical exam results and diet plan with your parents. They were happy that you were taking charge of your health; your father joked that all the family snacks would be banned from now on. The setting sun spilled through the clouds onto the lake, and the family of three enjoyed a rare leisurely time.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner at Binhu Restaurant
description: After the walk, they walked about 10 minutes to Lakeside Restaurant at No. 202 Wenlin Street. They ordered clear-soup fish, garlic broccoli, and tomato scrambled eggs, which fit the diet plan, and also ordered their parents' favorite steam-pot chicken. The family ate happily together. After the meal, the bill came to about 150 yuan, and they walked home with their parents, which helped them digest the food.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family evening time watching TV.
description: When you got home, your parents were sitting in the living room watching the news on TV. You also sat down on the sofa and, while listening to the broadcast, picked up your phone and scrolled through WeChat Moments. You saw a photo your sister Sun Yutong had shared of having a late-night snack while working overtime in Shenzhen, and replied: “Sis, don't stay up so late, take care of yourself.” Then you discussed the TV drama you had just watched with your mother.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and weekly plan preparation.
description: Back in the study, she opened her journal and recorded the day's schedule in detail, pasted in the supermarket receipt, and checked off the first day on the three-week diet check-in chart. Then she browsed the literary magazine's submission guidelines on her phone and turned the writing tasks for next Monday into a to-do list: write a 500-word outline for next week's column and reply to the editor's email. She felt her life was well organized and her plan for the coming week was clear.
location: Home study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation preparation and meditation.
description: I changed into pajamas and made up the bed. After washing up, I sprayed a little lavender sleep mist on the pillow. I turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. Sitting cross-legged on the bed, I closed my eyes and did a pre-sleep meditation, focusing on my breath and slowly going through the day's thoughts, feeling my body and mind relax. I felt satisfied with my resolve to follow the plan today, and my heart was filled with calm and gratitude.
location: Bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After meditation ended, body and mind became calm. I picked up the essay collection by Lin Qingxuan by the bedside and read quietly for 30 minutes. At 22:00, I turned off the bedside lamp and, in the darkness, savored the beautiful details of the day—Mother's smile, the sunset over Cuihu Lake, the nutritionist's affirmation, and so on—and drifted off to sleep with peace and contentment.
location: Bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga, meditation, and personal care
description: She woke up naturally in the early morning and completed 30 minutes of breathing meditation and basic yoga poses on the yoga mat on the balcony. Since it was the 10th consecutive day, she added an extra 2 minutes of relaxing Child's Pose. Afterward, she checked in on her journal, reflecting that the habit had become second nature. Then she washed up and weighed herself: 46.3 kg. She recorded the data, compared it with yesterday, and changed into loungewear.
location: Bedroom balcony and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Healthy breakfast and diet plan launch.
description: On the first day of the healthy eating plan, you made a vegetable egg roll (broccoli and eggs), whole-wheat bread, and warm milk in the kitchen, took a photo for the record, and sat at the dining table to enjoy it. Your mother got up, saw it, and praised the breakfast as healthy. You reminded her to come back home early at noon to celebrate her birthday.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Home organizing and massage chair installation
description: After breakfast, tidy up the living room, put away the magazines, wipe the TV cabinet, then take out the paper streamers and balloons to set up a birthday atmosphere. While waiting for the massage chair installation technician, communicate with editor Xu Mingyuan on the phone about feedback on the essay outline, and reply with voice messages for revision suggestions. At 9 o’clock the technician arrives; you guide the placement and check the functions of the massage chair, test it to confirm it is normal, then sign. During this time, your mother calls to ask about the installation progress.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Prepare a birthday surprise for my mother
description: After the installer left, she returned to the study and took out a dried flower bouquet she had made of pale purple forget-me-nots with white baby's breath, carefully wrapped it in kraft paper and twine, then took the small cake she had bought in advance from the fridge and placed it on the dining table, making final preparations for her mother's birthday celebration when she came home.
location: Study and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Celebrate mother's birthday.
description: Mother arrived home at 10:25. You played "Happy Birthday" and presented a dried flower bouquet and your wishes. Mother was stunned by the decorations and massage chair, and her eyes reddened slightly as she took the bouquet. Then elder sister Sun Yutong's video call connected, and the three of you sang the birthday song and cut the cake across the screen. Mother was moved to tears, and you captured the heartwarming moment with your phone.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Accompanying her mother to try the massage chair
description: After the birthday celebration, she helped her mother sit in the massage chair and taught her to use the remote control to select the relaxation mode. While her mother closed her eyes and enjoyed it, she recorded her mother's smile, her sister's words, and the taste of the cake in her journal. Her mother remarked that the massage chair was thoughtful and recalled the hardships of her youth at No. 2 Middle School.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Prepared and enjoyed a healthy lunch.
description: Following the diet plan, you cooked steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and brown rice. The mother and daughter chatted while eating. Mom was full of praise for the massage chair, saying the soreness in her lower back had eased a lot, and you felt content inside.
