location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Midday rest and afternoon tea preparation
description: After lunch I took the initiative to clear the table, then lay back in the massage chair for a 15-minute nap. When I woke up, I made myself a cup of light tea, put it on the desk, and prepared to start the afternoon's work.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Manuscript processing and contacting friends
description: I turned on my computer to refine the essay outline, adjusted the structure based on feedback from editor Xu Mingyuan, and wrote a 500-character introduction. Afterwards, I interacted with Wen Zi and Yang Xiao in the besties' group chat, sharing yoga and food photos. Yang Xiao shared a new bookstore in Chengdu, and we agreed to go together next time.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Afternoon nap and caring for green plants
description: Feeling slightly tired after writing, got up, went to the balcony to water the plants, looked at the sunlight outside the window, and did shoulder and neck stretches to relax.
location: Balcony at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Chatted with mother and reminisced about old times.
description: Once again, you sat with your mother in the massage chairs and chatted. She recalled the hardships of teaching at No. 2 Middle School and caring for the two sisters when she was young, sighed at how content life is now, and said the sisters were her pride. After hearing this, you felt warm.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Family walk at Green Lake Park.
description: As dusk fell, the family of three walked to Cuihu Park. The lake shimmered in the sunset. Father took photos, and you walked arm in arm with Mother along the lakeside. Mother laughingly said that after retirement she would come and sit here every day.
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Family dinner out
description: After the walk, the family walked 14 minutes to Binhu Restaurant on Wenlin Street and ordered mushroom hot pot, dry-fried shredded potatoes, and vegetable salad, with sour plum juice to accompany it. The parents chatted about amusing stories about their coworkers, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. After the meal, they walked another 14 minutes home. On the way, mother held your hand, and father hummed a tune.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China, and the round-trip route

name: Make a journal entry to record what moved me
description: After returning home, I washed fruit and took it to the study, made a journal entry, pasted in photos of the birthday cake and massage chair, recorded the celebration process and my mother's reaction in detail, completed the diet check-in, and copied a quote from "River Town" about time and memory: "What is time to a city? It is neither fast nor slow; it just flows on, like the Yangtze River at Fuling."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Read 'River Town'
description: Continued reading the remaining chapters of Peter Hessler's 'River Town,' immersed in the author's nuanced observations of the small city of Fuling. After finishing it, I was struck by the feeling of 'living in a foreign place yet gradually blending in.'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Bedtime meditation and relaxing into sleep.
description: Did a 15-minute bedtime meditation, focusing on breathing and relaxing her shoulders. Then she lay down to reply to her older sister's goodnight message and the close friends group's questions, browsed Lin Qingxuan's essays for 10 minutes, turned off the light at 22:00, reviewed the day's warmth, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning yoga meditation and morning preparations
description: At daybreak, Sun Yuwei began her 11th day of yoga and meditation practice on her balcony. She first spent 5 minutes on breathing and warm-up exercises, then completed a 20-minute asana flow, including Downward-Facing Dog, Warrior II, and balance poses, and finally did 10 minutes of focused meditation, feeling the connection between her breath and body. After meditating, she recorded inspirational snippets in her journal. Then she washed up, changed into sportswear, stepped on the scale and weighed 46.4kg, drank some warm water, and checked her earphones to prepare for her morning run.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to Cuihu Park and go for a 5.5 km morning run.
description: Sun Yuwei locked the door and walked along Renmin Middle Road to Green Lake Park. After arriving, she jogged along the park trail for about 5.5 kilometers. The winter morning air was crisp, and black-headed gulls were already circling over the lake. After running, she stretched by the lake and observed the gulls' flight patterns, gathering material for her essay.
location: No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Green Lake Park)

name: Walk home, take a shower, and have breakfast.
description: Sun Yuwei walked home from Green Lake Park and bought two shepherd's purse and pork buns and a cup of freshly ground soy milk at the time-honored bun shop at the entrance to the residential complex. After arriving home, she took a quick shower, changed into dry clothes, and had the buns, soy milk, and a boiled egg cooked the night before as breakfast, ensuring a balanced intake of protein and carbs.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore and do writing work
description: Sun Yuwei, carrying a canvas bag packed with a laptop and a journal, walks through a few alleys toward Zhibushi Bookstore. On the way, she meets her neighbor Aunt Xie and they chat about everyday things. After taking a seat at her usual window-side workstation on the second floor of the bookstore, she opens her phone, logs into the community health service center's official account, confirms the second HPV vaccine appointment for tomorrow (November 12) at 14:30, reviews the precautions, and puts her ID card into the inner pocket of her bag. Then she begins revising the essay outline and, drawing on yesterday's reflections from celebrating her mother's birthday, polishes the manuscript for the “Cultural Horizons” column. Around 10:30, she has a WeChat voice call with editor Xu Mingyuan for about 20 minutes, discussing the adjustment of the outline structure and the possibility of adding a “Family Warmth” section, and the editor expresses approval. After the call, she continues revising and completes the third revision of the first draft.
location: No. 32, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Kunming Paper, Cloth & Stone Bookstore)

name: Lunch and a walk on Wenlin Street
description: Sun Yuwei left the bookstore and walked to Binhu Restaurant at No. 202 Wenlin Street. She ordered a tomato and egg rice bowl and a bowl of free soup of the day, which was light and affordable. After the meal, she strolled slowly along Wenlin Street to aid digestion, admiring the plane trees on both sides of the street and the artistic little shops, relaxing and preparing herself for the afternoon yoga class.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 202 Wenlin Street (Binhu Hotel) and surrounding area

name: Walk to the yoga studio and attend the yoga class.
description: Sun Yuwei walked from Wenlin Street to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on Dongfeng West Road. After arriving, she changed into yoga clothes and drank some warm water in the rest area to prepare. The class was led by instructor He Lu. In the first half, they trained core strength and shoulder-back stability; in the second half, they practiced headstand poses. With He Lu's assistance and encouragement, Sun Yuwei tried a headstand away from the wall and successfully held it steadily for 13 seconds, breaking her personal record. She was very excited. After class, she and He Lu exchanged practice insights in the rest area and agreed to take the class again at the same time next week.
location: Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Zhongmou Yoga Studio)

name: Stopped at the supermarket for groceries on the way home
description: After saying goodbye to He Lu, Sun Yuwei walked home. Passing the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at the corner of Fuchun Street, she remembered that she needed ingredients for the evening healthy meal, so she went in to shop. She selected spinach, cherry tomatoes, chicken breast, and whole milk, stocking up for her healthy eating plan. After finishing her shopping, she carried her shopping bag and walked home.
location: No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket) and on the way home.

name: Go home to rest and read
description: Sun Yuwei went home, put away the ingredients, and then relaxed in the study. Lying on the bean bag, she read Lin Qingxuan's "Warm a Pot of Moonlight and Drink" for about half an hour, copying down a few lines that resonated with her. She then took a 20-minute nap to recharge for the evening activities.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing dinner and having dinner.
description: To attend the online sharing session on time, Sun Yuwei started preparing dinner early. She cut and marinated chicken breast, washed and blanched spinach, and made a simple Japanese teriyaki chicken salad, served with whole-wheat bread and cherry tomatoes. She enjoyed dinner alone at the table. The salad was refreshing and delicious, and she felt healthy and satisfied.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Preparing for the online sharing session
description: Sun Yuwei checked her computer network, camera, and microphone in advance, set Tencent Meeting to "Do Not Disturb" mode, and charged her earphones. She opened her journal to prepare for taking notes, reread the sharing session's agenda and guest bios, paying special attention to the writing style of essayist Chen Ruoyun.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home study)

name: Attend an online sharing session for young writers
description: Sun Yuwei attended an online sharing session organized by the Yunnan Provincial Writers' Association via Tencent Meeting. At the meeting, three young writers shared their creative insights on fiction, poetry, and prose respectively. She listened attentively and took notes. When the prose writer Chen Ruoyun talked about the blank space and rhythm of prose language, she nodded frequently and wrote down key sentences in her journal. After the session, she proactively sent Chen Ruoyun a private message in the chat window to express her admiration and asked a question about how to balance daily writing and bursts of inspiration. Chen Ruoyun replied quickly, and the two added each other on WeChat and agreed to continue the discussion in depth by email.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online meeting)

name: Organizing notes and replying to messages
description: After the sharing session ended, Sun Yuwei spent about 30 minutes organizing her notes in digital form and in her journal, connecting her reflections with the next day's writing plan. She then replied to messages from her close-friend group (Zhang Jing, Chen Sisi) and her editor, sharing what she had gained from the session, and also shared Teacher Chen Ruoyun's perspectives with Yang Xiao, her book friend far away in Chengdu.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening wash-up and relaxation
description: Sun Yuwei removed her makeup, washed up, changed into comfortable pajamas, and sprayed lavender sleep mist on her wrists to create a relaxing bedtime atmosphere.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Meditating, reading, and falling asleep before bed.
description: Sun Yuwei sat cross-legged on her bed and did a 20-minute bedtime meditation on the theme of 'gratitude and acceptance', replaying in her mind her family's warmth, her writing progress, her yoga breakthroughs, and new literary friendships. After meditating, she turned on her bedside reading lamp and continued browsing Lin Qingxuan's essay collection. About ten minutes later, drowsiness set in, so she closed the book, turned off the light, lay down, and adjusted her sleeping position. Around 22:55, she officially fell asleep.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning yoga, meditation, breakfast, and journaling
description: At 6 a.m., she unrolled her yoga mat on the bedroom balcony and did a 20-minute gentle vinyasa flow (Sun Salutations, Warrior Poses), followed by 25 minutes of seated meditation, focusing on her breath and feeling the morning breeze. After meditating, she recorded fragments of inspiration about fallen leaves on old streets and the scent of osmanthus in the memo app on her phone. Then she made a vegetable egg roll, paired it with whole-wheat bread and warm milk, took a photo to record it, and wrote in her journal. She had a brief exchange with her mother, Li Xiulan, who reminded her not to bathe and to drink plenty of water after the vaccination.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; at home: bedroom balcony and kitchen/dining room.

name: Study room work: reply to emails, read, and draft the course paper outline.
description: At the desk in the study, I replied to the email from Chen Ruoyun, whom I met at last night's online sharing session of the Yunnan Writers' Association, thanking her for sharing and exchanging thoughts on essay writing. Then I shut down the computer and read Hemingway's The Old Man and the Sea, penciling notes on the concise dialogue and symbolism. Next, I opened my course paper folder and listed the core argument, sub-argument framework, and preliminary source citations for the paper 'On the "Materialization" Imagery in Zhang Ailing's Novels.' When I hit a snag, I wrote a sticky note to ask my professor. Along the way, I checked my freelance writing inbox and noted two feasible topic directions.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Prepared and walked to the community health center
description: Checked the backpack and carried the ID card, vaccination record, medical insurance card, and a light jacket; changed into a loose long-sleeved T-shirt. location: Along the walking route from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Huashan Subdistrict Community Health Service Center, No. 78 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Get the second dose of the HPV vaccine
description: Caicun Pier.

Before leaving, she wrote: “I used to live by feelings, but now I have learned to talk with my body,” marking a new stage of health management.
location: Observation area, Huashan Subdistrict Community Health Service Center, No. 78 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home and do some shopping on the way

location: No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and the walking route home.

name: Lunch, music relaxation, and a midday nap
description: After returning home, I washed fruit, heated up last night's Japanese teriyaki chicken salad, and had it with whole wheat crackers for lunch, relaxing to Zhou Shen's songs while eating. After the meal I tidied the kitchen, then rested with my eyes closed on the living room sofa for 30 minutes to prepare for the afternoon.
location: No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; home dining room and living room sofa

name: Communicate with the editor about follow-up publishing matters
description: Contacted editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat, briefly reported that the afterword for the Cultural Horizon essay has been confirmed, hoping everything goes well. Xu Mingyuan replied that the afterword was received and would be formally submitted at next month's topic selection meeting, telling her to wait in peace.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, home study (online communication)

name: Writing time: organizing materials and planning character sketches.

Ideas flowed freely, and she decided to go deeper the next day; along the way, she also refined her mapping of the material on his entrepreneurial story.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Afternoon rest, free reading, and recording inspiration.
description: Sitting on a rattan chair on the balcony, I ate kiwifruit while flipping through Lin Qingxuan's essay collection 'Your Heart Is Soft, Yet Powerful,' and felt relaxed in body and mind. Then I returned to the study, finished the remaining chapters of 'The Old Man and the Sea,' and wrote down my thoughts on 'tough-guy spirit and loneliness' in my journal, preparing for tomorrow's discussion with my professor.
location: Home balcony and study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Spending dinner time with family
description: Went to the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan pick vegetables and shared her feelings and amusing stories about getting vaccinated today. During dinner, the family of three sat together. Her father Sun Mingyuan told amusing anecdotes from work, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, home kitchen and dining room

name: Stroll at Green Lake Park
description: After dinner, she walked with her parents to Green Lake Park. Since the doctor had advised light activity after the vaccination, they strolled slowly along the lake embankment, watching the gulls and the sunset glow, chatting, and then walked home.
location: Green Lake Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discussing the watercolor sticker collaboration with Zhou Lin
description: After washing up, she curled up in bed and had a WeChat voice call with her college roommate Zhou Lin, discussing the next season of the Yunnan Flora watercolor sticker series: they settled on 10 plants including Yunnan lilac, notoginseng flower, and wild lily, adopted a fresh and soft watercolor style, and discussed the idea of finding a local small-batch printing house in Kunming and pricing strategies.
location: Home bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (online voice)

name: Organize evening journal and work feedback
description: Organized the key information from the call notes and recordings into the journal, including plant names, style key points, printing plans, and more. Then I looked at the watercolor practice pieces sent by Zhou Lin, sent a long voice message with feedback, praised the composition and colors, and made revision suggestions.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep preparation: meditation, stretching, reading, and falling asleep
description: She did a simple wash and skincare routine, did 15 minutes of yoga on the floor to stretch her neck, shoulders, and back, then sat quietly for 10 minutes of meditation on the theme 'Acceptance and Peace', reviewing the fulfilling day and feeling grounded and content. She also recorded her weight: 47 kilograms. Afterwards, she browsed Lin Qingxuan's essay collection 'One Mind, One State' in bed to relax her mind. Finally, she turned off the lights, put her phone on silent, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: At six in the morning, Yuwei got up on time, with a fine rain tapping at the window outside. She laid out her yoga mat on the balcony and began Day 13 of practice: the first 15 minutes of deep stretches in Butterfly Pose and Lizard Pose to open up her hips and spine; the next 20 minutes of cross-legged meditation, focusing on the resonance between her breath and the sound of the rain. During meditation, inspiration surfaced, and she wrote in her journal: 'Rain is a love letter the clouds write to the earth.' The soreness in her left arm from yesterday's HPV vaccination noticeably eased after the stretching and meditation.
location: Balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run of 6 km at Cuihu Park
description: After yoga, Yuwei changed into a long-sleeved sports outfit, put her phone in a waterproof pouch, and walked to the east gate of Green Lake Park through a light drizzle to start her morning run. She planned 6 km at a pace of 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. At 2 km she felt a little strained, but she adjusted her breathing and kept going. Passing the lotus pond, she saw rain beating on the withered lotus leaves—a uniquely beautiful sight. She drank some water halfway and successfully completed the goal.
location: Green Lake Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up, having breakfast, and checking messages
description: After her morning jog, she walked home, took a quick hot shower, and changed into dry loungewear. While drying her hair, she checked the weather at Chenggong Campus on her phone. Breakfast was hot milk, two slices of whole wheat toast with avocado spread, and a boiled egg. As she ate, she browsed her phone and replied to editor Xu Mingyuan's confirmation message about the punctuation in her essay.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mentioned that long periods of working with the head down can worsen neck and shoulder pain.
description: After breakfast, Yuwei opened her laptop in the study to prepare for the weekend field research at Zhuanxin Market. The document listed sections such as winter-only ingredients, oral stories from old vendors, and descriptions of the street-market atmosphere. She also checked the DSLR camera battery and a spare notebook, confirming they were all packed into the canvas bag.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Commute to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus
description: She left the house at exactly 9:00 and walked to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, then took the metro to Chenggong University Town Station, taking about 1 hour and 50 minutes in total. On the metro, Yuwei opened her phone and read a WeChat official account article about optimizing the structure of academic papers, marking a few points that Professor Wu might raise. Outside the window, the urban landscape gradually turned into open fields and new towns.
location: Along the line from Huashan West Road Metro Station to University Town Metro Station, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Consulted Professor Wu Mingyuan about the paper outline.
description: Arrived at Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus after the rain and walked to the third floor of the School of Humanities. Professor Wu Mingyuan was already waiting in his office. He carefully reviewed the framework of the draft thesis and suggested swapping the order of the second and third chapters, and adding the viewpoints of two recent scholars as references. Yuwei took down the key points quickly and asked about the availability of one of the articles. The professor gestured for her to email him the link, saying he would help find it. After the discussion, she left at about 11:35.
location: Office on the third floor, School of Humanities, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Return commute and package pickup
description: After saying goodbye to the professor, she walked to University Town Metro Station and took the metro back to the city center. On the metro, while her memory was still fresh, she recorded several of Professor Wu's core suggestions using a voice memo. At about 13:20 she arrived at Huashan West Road Station. When she exited the station, she picked up a package from the delivery locker at the entrance of the residential community—it was the new edition of the 'Modern Chinese Dictionary' she had ordered online last week. Then she walked home.
location: Along the line from University Town Metro Station to Huashan West Road Metro Station, Kunming, Yunnan Province; parcel locker near Huashan West Road Metro Station

name: Lunch and a short rest
description: After arriving home, she made egg fried rice with leftover rice and eggs, paired with the pickled radish her mother had made. While eating, she casually flipped through the dictionary she had just picked up and confirmed the usage of a few words. After the meal, she rested on the sofa for about 15 minutes, conserving energy for the afternoon yoga class.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio and took a core deepening class.
description: After changing into yoga clothes, Yuwei walked about 15 minutes from home to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. Upon arrival, she proactively told the instructor that her left arm still felt sore from the HPV vaccine she received yesterday, and the instructor adjusted the arm-support poses accordingly. The class focused on core strength and stability and advanced headstand practice. With the instructor's assistance, she tried slowly rising into a headstand several times; although she could not fully release from the wall, she felt her core control had improved, and her movements were slower and steadier than last week—a great improvement. After class, she drank water in the lounge and confirmed her booking for next Tuesday's class on her phone.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the bookstore for afternoon tea with my best friend
description: After leaving the yoga studio, Yuwei walked to the Zhibushi Bookstore, about 1.2 kilometers away. Passing through Wenlin Street, where autumn was in full swing, she bought a takeaway oat milk latte at a corner coffee shop. When she reached the second floor of the bookstore, her close friend Zhang Jing was already waiting. After catching up, Yuwei read a passage from the afterword of an essay she had written a few days earlier. Zhang Jing was moved to tears and praised it as 'clean as if washed by rain.' Then Zhang Jing demonstrated journal layout examples from the perspectives of color matching, sectioning, and typography, and helped her design a template for her field-notes journal. They recommended books they had recently read to each other. Finally, they took out their phones and searched for knitting workshops in Kunming in December. After discussion, they chose the 'Nordic-style wall tapestry weaving' experience class and agreed to sign up together next Tuesday. Outside, the sky was getting dark; inside, the warm yellow lights created a cozy atmosphere.
location: The coffee corner on the second floor of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walking back, dinner, and family chat
description: After saying goodbye to Jingjing at the bookstore entrance, Yuwei walked home. Under the night sky, streetlights reflected off the damp ground. When she got home, her mother Li Xiulan was busy in the kitchen, so she took the initiative to help wash and chop vegetables. Dinner was her mother's specialty: tomato-braised beef brisket, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and rice. At the table, she shared with her mother her progress in the afternoon yoga class, her meeting with Jingjing at the bookstore, and her plan to visit Zhuanxin Market for inspiration over the weekend. Her mother said she would be happy to accompany her if she had time. After dinner, Yuwei washed the dishes on her own initiative.
location: Home at Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening organizing and creative writing
description: Back in the study, Yuwei organized the key points from the day's discussion with Professor Wu into clear digital notes and marked them in the corresponding places in her paper outline. Then she further refined the outline for the weekend's Zhuanxin field trip on her computer, particularly adding observation points on vendors' daily protection in the context of winter respiratory infectious diseases. After finishing, she sent the link to the knitting workshop selected that afternoon to Zhang Jing, and the two briefly discussed the specific appointment time on WeChat, deciding to sign up at the store next week.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Recorded today's reflections in her journal.
description: Yuwei took out her beloved journal and first decorated the pages with a new roll of washi tape. She recorded in detail the inspiration from her morning meditation—'Rain is a love poem the clouds write to the earth'—the gains from her exchange with Professor Wu, the breakthrough in core strength in yoga class, and the touching moment of sharing the afterword with Jingjing at the bookstore. She pasted the bookstore's cup sleeve and the subway ticket stub next to the entries as souvenirs. For the mood tag, she wrote: fulfilled, warm, grateful.
location: Home study, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After washing up and completing skincare, changed into comfortable cotton pajamas, sprayed some lavender sleep spray on the pillow, and prepared for sleep.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: Turning off the main light and leaving only the small bedside lamp, Yuwei sat quietly and meditated for 15 minutes. The theme was 'review and integration,' replaying the day's scenes in her mind: early morning drizzle, damp Cuihu, the professor's approving nod, the yoga attempt, and Jingjing's tears. She felt full and calm inside. Then she opened Lin Qingxuan's "Waiting for Spring in the Bleak Depths" and read for about 25 minutes until drowsiness set in, closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep. She took about 14,500 steps that day; yoga, running, and study tasks were all completed. Her mood was touched and warm, and her friendships were recharged.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning Yoga and Meditation
description: The phone alarm rang. Sun Yuwei got up, draped a thin blanket over her shoulders, and walked to the balcony to begin Day 14 of her morning yoga and meditation. She first did 15 minutes of Hatha yoga asanas, including Mountain, Tree, and Triangle poses, feeling the stretch in her body on the early winter morning. Then she sat cross-legged and meditated for 20 minutes, focusing on her breath, letting her thoughts settle, and silently reciting the field-gathering keywords: mushrooms, cured meats, and the warmth of everyday life. After meditation, she wrote in her journal: 'Zhuanxin in early winter must be filled with the fragrance of mushrooms and the savory flavor of cured meats.'
location: Home balcony, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and a simple breakfast
description: After finishing meditation, Sun Yuwei went to the bathroom to wash up and apply basic moisturizing skin care. Then she went to the kitchen, microwaved the milk oatmeal she had prepared last night, and toasted two slices of whole wheat bread. She sipped warm water while eating breakfast and checked the day's field-trip outline again in her phone's memo app.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: She walked to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market.
description: Sun Yuwei put on canvas shoes, took her canvas bag with a notebook, two pens, and a mirrorless camera, and headed south along Renmin Middle Road. She passed shops still asleep, feeling the crisp winter morning air and the gradually waking pulse of the city. After about 25 minutes of walking, she arrived at the main entrance of Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market.
location: Along the route from Renmin Middle Road to No. 69 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth field visit to Zhuanxin Farmers Market.
description: The market was bustling with noise. Sun Yuwei first carefully examined porcini mushrooms, dried matsutake slices, and jizong mushroom oil in the dried goods section, and chatted with a woman sorting dried chilies to learn about this year's prices and quality of dried mushrooms. Then she moved to the cured meat shop, attracted by the neatly hung Xuanwei hams, cured pork belly, and sausages. She used her camera to capture the play of light and shadow, and asked the shopkeeper to introduce the most popular cured meats among locals. Afterward, she went to the vegetable section, recording the shapes of winter-specific vegetables such as pea shoots, crown daisy, and arrowhead, and observing the expressions of people choosing vegetables. Along the way, she bought a cup of freshly ground hot soy milk at a soy milk stall, warming her hands while continuing to observe.

participant.name: The woman sorting goods in the dried goods section

location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Conduct research and enjoy lunch at the market
description: During lunchtime, the market foot traffic changed, with more office workers and students. Sun Yuwei chose a tofu pudding rice noodle shop with a long line and ordered a bowl of traditional tofu pudding rice noodles. While waiting and eating, she carefully observed the owner's workflow, the diners' conversations, and the difference in atmosphere between the midday market and the early morning market. After eating, she quickly wrote down key impressions in her notebook.
location: Time-honored douhua rice noodles at Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers Market, No. 69 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the coffee shop on Wenlin Street
description: After leaving the market, Sun Yuwei turned from Zhuantang Road onto Wenlin Street. The winter afternoon sun was a little warm, so she slowed her pace to admire the old buildings and passersby. After walking for about 40 minutes, she arrived at Long Time No See Cafe.
location: Along the route from Zhuantang Road to Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying coffee and chatting with the clerk
description: She pushed open the door and walked into the café; the familiar aroma of coffee greeted her. Sun Yuwei ordered a hot oat milk latte to go. While waiting for the coffee, the barista recognized her and asked how she had time to come by today. She smiled and replied that she was gathering material at Zhuanxin Market today and stopped by for a coffee. After getting her coffee, she walked out of the shop.
location: Long Time No See Café, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took a rest on the way home while walking
description: Sun Yuwei walked home along Wenlin Street with a hot coffee. After turning onto Renmin Middle Road, she sat on a roadside bench for a few minutes, sipped the hot latte, felt the warmth of the winter sun, sorted through her thoughts from the morning, then got up and walked about five minutes home.
location: Along the way from Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Returning home to rest and importing source material
description: After getting home, Sun Yuwei first imported the photos from her camera into her laptop, and synced the voice memos and notes from her phone to the computer. She took a few sips of the still-warm latte to warm up and prepare for the afternoon's work.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing and organizing materials in the study
description: Sun Yuwei sat at her desk and sorted the morning photos into categories: "Mushroom Area - Cured Meat Shop - Vegetable Area - People Close-ups." Then she opened iA Writer to map out the draft structure for her column article "Winter Fireworks at Zhuanxin Market," drafting subheadings such as "Fragrance of Mushrooms in Morning Mist," "Gifts of Oil and Time," and "Winter Vitality of Verdant Green," and filled the framework with observations and dialogue excerpts. During a writing break, she replied to editor Xu Mingyuan's revision comments on last week's essay and came up with a preliminary idea for a new topic to submit next week.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free relaxation and music time.
description: After finishing her focused work, Sun Yuwei stood up, stretched, went to the living room, and played her favorite folk song playlist on the Bluetooth speaker. Curled up on the sofa, she browsed the street-life photos she had taken in the morning on her phone, selected a few she was satisfied with, and posted them to her Moments with the caption: “The warmth of everyday life is what truly comforts the ordinary heart. An early-winter greeting from Zhuanxin.”
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: After work, her mother, Li Xiulan, prepared dinner. At the table, Sun Yuwei shared the day's field experiences with her parents while eating, showed them photos of cured meats from her camera, and mentioned how an elderly mushroom seller had told her about this year's matsutake market. Her mother was very interested in the new pickled-vegetable shop in the market and said she wanted to visit it on the weekend. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, asked about the progress of her paper; she told him she had also taken care of the editor's feedback in the afternoon.
location: Home Restaurant, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking a walk around Cuihu Lake with my parents
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei and her parents walked to Cuihu Park. Cuihu was quiet in the evening, with the sunset glow reflected on the lake. The family walked slowly along the lakeside; she held her mother’s arm and listened to her tell amusing stories from school, while her father walked beside them and occasionally chimed in with stories from the Cultural Bureau. After walking for about 40 minutes, they slowly made their way back.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Take a short break and head to the bookstore.
description: After seeing her parents home, Sun Yuwei changed into another jacket, grabbed her notebook, and left the house, heading west along Renmin Middle Road and turning onto Cuihu North Road, walking about 10 minutes to Zhibushi Bookstore.
location: Along the way from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to No. 32 Cuihu North Road.

name: Plan a winter reading marathon with Uncle Qin
description: When Sun Yuwei arrived at the bookstore, the owner Qin Mingyuan was already waiting for her at the window seat on the second floor, with two cups of hot tea on the table. They quickly got down to business and discussed the "Winter Reading Marathon" plan. She proposed setting the theme as "Memory and the City", emphasizing the emotional connection between literary works and personal living spaces, and recommended Calvino's "Invisible Cities". Uncle Qin added Wang Zengqi's "Kunming's Rain" and several essays about the old city of Kunming. Together they listed a preliminary list of 10 pieces in a notebook and discussed the reading session process, venue layout, and promotional slogans. Uncle Qin appreciated her ideas and asked her to sort out a detailed plan over the weekend.
location: Second floor, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Aunt Xie's house to read the manuscript.
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, Sun Yuwei walked home. Once home, she brewed a cup of chrysanthemum tea, sat down at her desk, and took out the day's journal. She first pasted in the cashier receipt from Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, the soy milk cup sleeve, and the coaster from the Long Time No See Coffee Shop. Then, while recalling the day, she wrote down her feelings, including the memorable moments in the market, the burst of inspiration during the discussion with Uncle Qin, and the warm details of walking and chatting with her parents.
location: Home Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime washing and skincare routine
description: Sun Yuwei first used the body fat scale to measure today's data, showing a weight of 46.5 kg. Then she carefully completed her evening skincare routine, changed into comfortable pajamas, and sprayed a little lavender mist on her pillow, filling the bedroom with a soothing aroma.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on. She first did a 10-minute body scan meditation, reviewing the day's fatigue and relaxing each part of her body one by one. After the meditation, she picked up Lin Qingxuan's essay collection Warm a Pot of Moonlight and Drink and read an article about winter and old memories, feeling peaceful.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing the next day's checklist and falling asleep
description: After finishing the essay, Sun Yuwei picked up her phone and quickly planned tomorrow's to-dos on TickTick: in the morning, organize the detailed plan for the "Reading Marathon" and send it to Uncle Qin; in the afternoon, do some housework; and in the evening, go to the supermarket to buy ingredients for the weekend. Then she turned off the desk lamp, savored the day's fulfillment in her mind, and slowly fell asleep to the occasional sound of cars outside the window.
location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga, meditation, and inspiration journaling
description: At first light, she completed a vinyasa flow sequence on her yoga mat on the balcony at home. During meditation, she connected the dialect of the old woman she had encountered during yesterday's fieldwork with memories of the morning mist over the Panlong River, and inspiration surged. After finishing, she drew a small sun symbol in her journal and labeled it 'Day 15: the joy of perseverance.'
location: Home balcony, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run at Cuihu Park
description: Changed into running shoes and went downstairs; reached Green Lake Park in 1 minute. Completed a 6.5 km jog around the lake at a pace of 7:15 per kilometer. After the run, I stretched while watching the black-headed gulls, feeling refreshed in body and mind, bringing a perfect end to the morning run.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Brisk walking and photography along the Panlong River
description: After my morning jog, I walked about 5 minutes to the bank of the Panlong River, then power-walked along the river for 30 minutes at a pace of 9 min/km. When passing an arch bridge, I saw an elderly person practicing tai chi in the morning and used my phone to capture light-and-shadow photos, gathering visual material for 'Morning and Dusk on the Panlong River.'
location: Riverside trail along the Panlong River, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going home to wash up, have breakfast, and prepare for the outing.
description: I walked home, where my mother had prepared small-pot rice noodles and a fried egg. We chatted while eating, and she shared funny stories from her students’ compositions. Afterward, I checked my camera and canvas tote bag to prepare for the morning outing.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning commute, small transfers, and going to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market
description: Walked about 8 minutes to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. On the way, at an ATM, she transferred 500 yuan from her royalty card to her regular debit card. At the supermarket she bought a bottle of mineral water and a pack of tissues. Then she walked about 5 minutes from the supermarket to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, imagining on the way the morning bustle and lively atmosphere of the market.
location: From Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, via Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket (No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District).

name: Additional field research and focused interviews at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market.
description: Arrived at the market, headed straight to the tofu section to find the old lady selling Shiping tofu she had chatted with yesterday, and recorded her complete 'tofu business story.' Then, in the deli section, she took close-up photos of the roast meat stall owner and promised to bring him the printed photos next time. With both her phone and voice recorder documenting, the material was solid.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Specialty lunch at Zhuanxin Market
description: She had lunch at the 'Time-Honored Tofu Pudding Rice Noodle Shop' inside the market, ordering a bowl of its signature tofu pudding rice noodles. While eating, she browsed photos on her phone, accumulating details for the 'Winter Fireworks' column.
location: Time-honored tofu pudding rice noodle shop inside the Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zhuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to organize recording materials and set up a regular fund investment plan
description: Walked home, listening to the recording and reviewing on the way. After arriving home, she imported the recording into her laptop and created a folder for the photos labeled "2025.11.15_Zhuanxin Field Trip_Supplement". Then, in the study, she took out her phone and logged into her stock account app. She successfully set up an automatic deduction of 500 yuan from her writing-fee card on the 15th of every month to buy the CSI 300 index fund. She took a screenshot and recorded in her journal: "Index + bonds, dual-track approach, steady growth."
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to the Pottery Studio and Preparing for Class
description: Walk about 5 minutes to “Fingertip Pottery Studio” on Wenlin Street to prepare for the afternoon class, thinking about the line patterns to draw along the way.
location: From home to Fingertip Pottery Studio, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Third session of the pottery workshop: underglaze painting and glazing.
description: At Fingertip Pottery Studio, she learned underglaze painting. She drew simple lines with blue-and-white pigment on the cup body, lightly sketched the characters for "Breath" on the inner side, and added blue dots to the earring blanks. Then, under the teacher's guidance, she completed dipping and spraying the glaze, carefully placed the pieces aside to dry, and looked forward to the kiln opening.
location: Fingertip Pottery Workshop, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home to rest, and sorted out ceramic artworks and manuscripts.
description: Walking home from the pottery studio, she savored the feeling of the glaze sliding over the clay body. After a short rest at home, she opened her laptop and previewed the revised essay 'Morning and Evening on the Panlong River' again, marking two pauses that needed emphasis with a red pen, preparing for the evening sharing session.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Mother made fish in clear soup and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Sun Yuwei shared her experiences at Zhuanxin Market and progress in her pottery class. Her mother was very interested in the photo of the owner of the roast meat stall, while her father asked about the progress of her thesis and praised her fulfilling schedule for the day.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanying my parents on a walk in Green Lake Park
description: After dinner, the family of three walked to Green Lake Park. The sunset glow reflected on the lake, peaceful and serene. Mother talked about interesting anecdotes from buying groceries in her youth, and father talked about a history book he was reading. The walk lasted about 40 minutes in total.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Heading to the Mingyuan Bookstore writing group
description: Go home, tidy up briefly, bring the printed draft, notebook, and water bottle, and set out on foot. It's about a 10-minute walk; rehearse the reading in my mind as I walk.
location: From home to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Third session of the Mingyuan Bookstore writing group
description: When the event began, she was the first to read aloud "Morning and Evening of the Panlong River" and specifically thanked Zhao Xue. The piece received positive feedback from group members. During the free discussion, she recommended an essay collection she had read recently and an online course. Near the end, she took the initiative to offer to the group leader Chen Ming that she would help with check-in and host part of the next session.
location: Activity area on the second floor of Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Record the monthly financial summary and today's wrap-up in the journal.
description: After returning home, she carefully organized this month's income and expenses in her journal, recording the newly added index fund investment plan as an important financial progress item, in contrast to the bond fund. Then she documented the fulfilling day with text and stickers: the sweat of the morning run, the lively atmosphere of the market, the blue-green of pottery, and the encouragement from the writing group. She checked in her diet and exercise.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime preparation, meditation, and falling asleep.
description: After washing up, I did a 10-minute body scan meditation in bed to calm my thoughts. After meditating, I flipped through a few pages of Lin Qingxuan's essays and felt a contented tiredness. I set the alarm for 6:10 tomorrow morning, reviewed tomorrow's to-do list: organize the detailed plan for the 'Winter Reading Marathon.' With anticipation for the future and satisfaction with today, I turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: At 6:00 a.m., she unrolled her yoga mat on the bedroom balcony for a Yin Yoga stretching and meditation practice, focusing on relaxing the lower back and hips, lasting about 45 minutes. During the meditation, she revisited the sense of openness from yesterday's pottery class and the Xundian grasslands. Afterward, she recorded her interwoven feelings in her journal with simple line drawings.
location: No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Kongjian Junyuan, Building D (home balcony)

name: Prepare the winter reading marathon plan and discuss it with Uncle Qin.
description: In the study, she opened her laptop and, based on the framework discussed with Uncle Qin at Zhibushi Bookstore, finalized the "Winter Reading Marathon" event plan, specifying the time, location, number of participants, theme, and recommended reading list. At 7:20, she sent the plan to Uncle Qin via WeChat with a note asking for feedback.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Manager of the Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore

location: Study, Building D, Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up, breakfast, and chatting with parents
description: Quickly washed up and completed basic skincare, then changed into a thick outdoor jacket, cargo pants, and hiking shoes. Had breakfast with my parents, enjoying the small-pot rice noodles and soft-boiled eggs my mother had prepared. During the meal we briefly discussed the day's plans; my mother reminded me to wear a hat because it was windy on the grassland, and my father told me to drive carefully.
location: Building D, Kongjian Junyuan, 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare items for going out.
date: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.
description: She checked the travel backpack and packed the DSLR camera, spare batteries, large water bottle, nuts, mineral water, portable gas stove, drip coffee bags, driver's license, and ID card. Her mother helped stuff in boiled eggs and oranges. She changed shoes at the entryway and said goodbye to her family.
location: Building D, Kongjian Junyuan, 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the car rental point
description: Wearing wireless earphones and listening to music, I followed Amap navigation from Kongjian Junyuan to the Shenzhou Car Rental pickup point near Yuantong Mountain, passing through Wuyi Road and Huashan South Road, admiring the golden plane-tree autumn scenery along the way, and sending Su Man a voice message to let her know the estimated arrival time.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: walk from No. 166 Wuyi Road to the Shenzhou Car Rental self-service point near Yuantong Hill

name: Complete car rental procedures
description: Arrived at the Shenzhou Car Rental self-service point at Yuantong Mountain, completed the formalities smoothly using her ID card and driver's license, confirmed the condition of a white Bora sedan, carefully checked the paint and tires, signed and picked up the car, adjusted the seat and rearview mirrors, and got ready to depart.
location: China Auto Rental Yuantong Mountain Self-service Point (Parking Lot Store), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Drive to pick up Su Man and head to Fenglongshan Grassland in Xundian
description: She carefully started the car and drove about 6 minutes to the Xiaojipo Residential Area to pick up her friend Su Man. Su Man got in with a canvas bag full of photography equipment, and the two drove along the Hangrui Expressway toward the Fenglong Mountain Grassland in Xundian. They chatted and shared updates on the way, and Yuwei gradually relaxed while driving. The scenery outside the window shifted from the city to golden mountain fields, and they arrived at the grassland about 2 hours later.
location: Fenglong Mountain Grassland, Xundian Hui and Yi Autonomous County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth meadow photography and plant material collection.
description: While hiking and photographing on the vast Fenglong Mountain grassland, Sun Yuwei used her DSLR to capture the withered yellow meadow, wild miscanthus, purple wild chrysanthemums, and dandelions. Su Man photographed the lines and textures of plants from a floral-design perspective and helped identify asters, sage, and other plants. The two collected dried fluffy grass and pinecones as flower-arranging materials, sketched flower forms in their journals, and thought about how to express the feeling of winter wilderness.
location: Fenglong Mountain Grassland, Xundian Hui and Yi Autonomous County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Picnic and rest at the meadow
description: They spread a picnic mat on a sheltered, sunny slope, boiled water with a portable stove, and brewed Yunnan small-bean drip-bag coffee. They shared the eggs, oranges, and nuts prepared by her mother, as well as the sandwiches and cookies brought by Su Man. After lunch, they discussed the shooting results and materials. Su Man proposed combining them into a series called The Breath of Fenglong Mountain, and Yuwei excitedly said she could write it into a new essay.
location: Fenglong Mountain Grassland, Xundian Hui and Yi Autonomous County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free exploration and exchange of flower arrangement insights
description: Going deeper to the slope on the other side of the meadow, Yuwei climbed high to take an overhead panorama, while Su Man collected silver reeds in the low-lying area. The two exchanged thoughts on Ikenobo-style flower arrangement on the spot. Su Man shared the beauty of the lines of withered branches, and Yuwei proposed the contrasting idea of incorporating everyday market-life elements from her market fieldwork into natural floral art. They cleaned up all the garbage and prepared to head back.
location: Fenglong Mountain Grassland, Xundian Hui and Yi Autonomous County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Drove back to the city and gave Su Man a ride home.
description: At 4 p.m., they set off on the return trip. Sun Yuwei drove along the highway back to Kunming. Su Man sat in the passenger seat organizing photos on her phone and used AirDrop to transfer the photos she was happy with. After arriving in the city at about 17:40, Sun Yuwei took Su Man directly back to her home in Xiaojipo Residential Community. Before parting, Su Man gave her three silver reeds, and the two said goodbye.
location: Xiaojipo Residential Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After returning the car, did some shopping on the way and walked home
description: After saying goodbye to Su Man, I drove alone to the Shenzhou Car Rental self-service return point at Yuantong Mountain; the vehicle condition check went smoothly. Then I walked home, and on the way stopped at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket to buy dinner ingredients: beef rolls, broccoli, tomatoes, udon noodles, and a large bottle of mineral water. After that, I continued walking for about 9 minutes and arrived home at Kongjian Junyuan.
location: China Auto Rental Yuantong Mountain Self-service Point and Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dining with my parents and sharing what I'd seen and heard
description: She arrived home carrying the ingredients she had bought, and her mother had already cooked several dishes. During dinner, Sun Yuwei enthusiastically showed the photos she had taken at the grassland on her phone, describing the tension of driving and the vastness of the grassland. Her father was relieved to see her back safely and encouraged her to put her personal experience into writing.
location: Building D, Kongjian Junyuan, 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the first draft of the column 'Winter Hustle and Bustle at Zhuanxin Market' in the study
description: After dinner, she returned to the study, muted her phone, and focused on opening the document. Based on the notes, recordings, and photos from the two previous field trips, she recalled the aroma of dried mushrooms at Zhuanxin Market, the golden cured meat at the roast stall, and the steam rising from the tofu-pudding rice noodle stall. Blending her personal observations with her mother's accounts, she used delicate brushstrokes to depict the winter seasonal ingredients and the market's unique bustling warmth, completing a first draft of about 2,200 characters in one go.
location: Study, Building D, Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Handle online work and publish the event post.
description: After a short rest, she saw Uncle Qin's positive reply and suggestions about the reading marathon plan. Using Canva, she quickly made a minimalist recruitment poster, turned the copy into a post, published it through the Maitian Bookstore official account and Weibo, and forwarded it to Moments, local culture enthusiast WeChat groups, and Douban groups to promote it online across platforms.

participant.name: Qin Mingyuan
participant.relation: Manager of the Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore

location: Study, Building D, Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening washing up, skincare, and journaling
description: After finishing work, I took a hot shower to relieve fatigue and did my evening skincare routine carefully. Back in the bedroom, I recorded today's activities, amusing moments, and meadow sketches in my journal, and pasted in the photo of silver reeds that Su Man gave me. Under 'Today's Reflections,' I wrote: 'From the market to the wilderness, the material has finally come to life at the tip of my pen.'
location: Building D, Kongjian Junyuan, 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and meditation relaxation
description: Changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard and read Lin Qingxuan's essay collection Warming a Pot of Moonlight to Drink for 30 minutes. At 22:45 set the alarm for tomorrow, did 5 minutes of deep-breathing meditation, reviewed the fulfilling experiences of the day, then turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Building D, Kongjian Junyuan, No. 166 Wuyi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga meditation and reading English aloud
description: At six in the morning, Sun Yuwei began her 17th day of morning yoga and meditation on a mat on the balcony. She first did 10 minutes of abdominal breathing, followed by 15 minutes of yin yoga poses (seated angle pose, frog pose), deeply relaxing her lower limbs, which were tired from yesterday's field excursion. After 10 minutes of meditation, she sat cross-legged, took out the English edition of Walden, and read aloud for 30 minutes in a calm and clear voice, immersed in Thoreau's philosophical thoughts on simplicity and nature.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom and balcony)

name: Prepare and document a healthy breakfast.
description: After the reading session, Sun Yuwei began to put into practice the advice of her nutritionist friend Wang Ting, trying to make a healthy breakfast for the first time. She skillfully chopped spinach and shredded carrots, cracked two eggs, stirred them evenly, and spread them into a golden vegetable egg roll in a frying pan. At the same time, she quickly made a fruit oatmeal cup with instant oats, yogurt, blueberries, and crushed walnuts. She took out her phone, photographed the good-looking breakfast as a record, and wrote a brief line, 'Day 1 of new breakfast routine,' planning to share it with Wang Ting in the evening.
location: Cuihu Community (Kitchen), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had breakfast with my family and shared what I'd seen and heard
description: Sun Yuwei brought breakfast to the table and shared it with her parents. Her father praised the creativity of the vegetable egg rolls, while her mother preferred the refreshing taste of the oatmeal cup. She shared with her parents what she had seen and heard during yesterday’s field visit to the Fenglong Mountain Grassland in Xundian, describing the open grassland and wildflowers, and mentioned that her friend Su Man had picked up many interesting pinecones. Her father talked about the documents he needed to handle at the Cultural Bureau today, and her mother shared amusing stories from school. The three chatted as they ate, in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (restaurant)

name: Handling bookstore event feedback and sorting manuscripts.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to the study and opened her laptop. She first logged into WeChat and saw the initial feedback sent last night by the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan (Uncle Qin) regarding the 'Winter Reading Marathon' proposal. Uncle Qin was very satisfied with the proposal and poster design, and only suggested a few detail adjustments. She jotted down the key points of the feedback. Then she opened the draft of 'Winter Fireworks at Zhuanxin Market' that she had written last night, quickly read through it, checked the basic formatting, and organized the document, ready to send it later to the editor Xu Mingyuan.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Discussed with Uncle Qin and put up the Winter Reading Marathon event poster; picked up magazines.
description: At 8:50, Sun Yuwei changed into an off-white hoodie and jeans, put on a canvas bag containing a rolled-up poster and a notebook, and walked to Zhibushi Bookstore. The morning Green Lake was quiet and fresh, with pleasant birdsong. She walked along Cuihu South Road for about fifteen minutes to arrive. At the bookstore, Uncle Qin was tidying the bookshelves and took out five printed A3 color event posters. After a brief discussion of the details of the plan (such as the check-in process and tea break preparation), they set off together. They first posted one on the bookstore's window, then walked to 'Maan Coffee' and 'Bookworm Coffee' on Wenlin Street, posted posters on the bulletin boards, and introduced the event to the staff. Finally, they went to the bulletin board outside the East Gate of Yunnan University's Donglu Campus and put up the last poster. While putting up the posters, Uncle Qin invited Sun Yuwei to have a late-night snack after this week's writing group activity, and she agreed with a smile. Then Uncle Qin took a newly arrived literary journal from his bag and handed it to her, saying he had specially saved it for her. Sun Yuwei thanked him and carefully placed it in her canvas bag.
location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province: walk from Cuihu Community to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore (No. 32 Cuihu North Road), then to Maan Coffee and Bookworm Coffee on Wenlin Street, and the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University.

name: Lunch on Wenlin Street.
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, it was almost noon. Sun Yuwei walked into her usual Lakeside Restaurant, ordered a steaming bowl of small-pot rice noodles, and added a serving of braised tofu. While eating, she browsed unread messages on her phone and saw several WeChat voice messages from her travel companion Fang Qing about their Dali travel plans.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home for a midday rest and organize the materials gathered from the outing
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei walked about fifteen minutes home, changed into loungewear, and rested for about forty minutes on the living room sofa. After waking up, she went back to the study, turned on her computer, imported the photos she had taken at the Xundian grasslands yesterday into a dedicated 'field collection' folder, and categorized them into subfolders such as 'Flowers', 'Grassland Scenery', and 'Dead Branches and Pine Cones'. She also took out her voice recorder and wrote down some inspiration keywords in a document.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (living room and study)

name: Communicate online, revise the manuscript, finalize it, and archive it.
description: After sorting out the material, Sun Yuwei sent editor Xu Mingyuan the draft document of "Winter Fireworks of Zhuanxin Market" via WeChat, along with a note. About thirty minutes later, Editor Xu replied with a voice message, suggesting that she add one or two details about the festive atmosphere and adjust the opening angle of the article to make it more engaging. Sun Yuwei carefully noted the revision points and immediately started revising. Drawing on the descriptions of everyday market life in Walden, she added to Zhuanxin's cured-meat shop the sentence: "The cured meat hanging in the winter sunlight gleamed with an oily sheen, like amber condensed by time and the smoke of daily life." She also adjusted the introduction to begin with the detail of an elderly woman buying New Year goods. After nearly an hour of revision, she read through the whole piece with satisfaction and submitted the final draft by email at exactly 3 p.m., also archiving it in her cloud working directory.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Went to the Yunnan University library to read and borrow books.
description: After submitting the manuscript, Sun Yuwei wanted a change of scenery, so she took her canvas bag and walked about fifteen minutes to the library on the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University. She lingered in the literature section on the second floor, thought of her planned topic 'Winter Ecology of Green Lake,' and borrowed Birds of Kunming and a notebook of natural history observations. Then she found a seat by the window and read quietly for forty minutes, gathering inspiration and material for her next article.
location: Library, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had a phone call with my mother on the way home.
description: As she walked home from Yunnan University, the setting sun was just right. Sun Yuwei called her mother, who was still at school, and told her she wanted to try making a refreshing cold dish that evening, and asked whether there was fresh mint at home. Her mother laughed on the other end of the line and said she had already prepared it for her.
location: On the way from No. 2 Cuihu North Road to No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (on the way home)

name: Helping her mother prepare dinner and exchanging ideas about healthy eating
description: Sun Yuwei put on an apron and walked into the kitchen. Her mother was chopping vegetables, and she volunteered to wash tomatoes and pick vegetables. Mother and daughter chatted while working. Sun Yuwei shared how she had made a healthy breakfast this morning, saying it tasted good but was time-consuming. Her mother suggested she prepare ingredients on the weekend, then simply boil or fry them on weekday mornings — healthy and time-saving. Sun Yuwei thought this was a good idea and opened her phone album to show her mother the breakfast photos she had taken.
location: Cuihu Community (Kitchen), No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner time
description: Dinner was steamed sea bass made by Mother, stir-fried vegetables with garlic, plus a cold beef and mint salad contributed by Sun Yuwei. The family of three sat around the dining table, eating and chatting. Father asked her how the manuscript had gone that day, and she said she had submitted the final draft. Mother then talked about the latest interesting news about the black-headed gulls at Cuihu Lake that she had heard in the office that afternoon. Sun Yuwei listened with great interest and felt the material could be incorporated into her column topic.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (restaurant)

name: Brainstormed column topics while taking a walk
description: Half an hour after dinner, Sun Yuwei changed into her sneakers and went downstairs alone to take a walk in the garden. The evening breeze was cool; she put on her earphones and listened to soft piano music, slowing her pace. As she walked, she organized in her mind the framework for the topic 'Winter Ecology of Cuihu Lake': starting with the southward migration of black-headed gulls, moving to the tranquility of the lake and its interaction with visitors, and finally elevating it to the harmony between humans and nature in the city. Once the idea took shape, she took out her phone's memo and jotted down a few keywords.
location: Garden inside Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Online sharing and exchange with friends.
description: After walking home, Sun Yuwei sat down at her desk. She first sent a WeChat message to her nutritionist friend Wang Ting, sharing photos and notes of this morning's breakfast and mentioning her mother's suggestion about prepping ingredients on weekends. Wang Ting quickly replied, praised her proactivity, and recommended several make-ahead frozen bento boxes. Then she opened a few voice messages from her travel companion Fang Qing about the Dali travel plans, replied briefly, and agreed to discuss the itinerary in detail in a few days when both had more time.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Create a journal and a natural-style flower arrangement.
description: Sun Yuwei took out her beloved journal, pasted in today's receipt (the rice noodle slip), the borrowing slip from Yunnan University Library, and a photo of the vegetarian breakfast she made today, then wrote down the day's summary and reflections. Next, she took out several dry pine branches and pinecones of various shapes that she had picked up on the meadow yesterday, found a gray clay pot, trimmed and inserted the pine branches, and placed the pinecones among them, completing a small tabletop decoration full of rustic charm. She took a photo with satisfaction and recorded it in her journal.
location: Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Reading, washing up, and meditating before bed.
description: After finishing her journal, Sun Yuwei took out Birds of Kunming, which she had borrowed today from the Yunnan University Library, and read for twenty minutes leaning against the headboard, feeling another kind of life rhythm in the winter of the Spring City. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up, applied moisturizer, and set her phone to Do Not Disturb. Before turning off the light, she set up her bedtime meditation audio and did a ten-minute body scan meditation to calm her mind and body. After the meditation, she put on her sleep mask, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community (bedroom)

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: Woke up naturally at six in the morning, prompted by my body clock. I unrolled the yoga mat on the wooden floor of the bedroom, starting with five minutes of abdominal breathing, feeling the cool morning air. Then I did a 20-minute vinyasa flow, focusing on camel pose and fish pose to open the chest and hips. Finally, I ended with five minutes of seated meditation, focusing on my breath and clearing my mind.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning jog and observation at Cuihu Park
description: She changed into workout clothes and walked five minutes to Green Lake Park. She started a 5 km morning run along the lakeside path, keeping a steady pace of about 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. When passing the seagull viewing spot, she slowed down and watched the black-headed gulls foraging and moving about for about five minutes. She noticed that several black-headed gulls had already flown to the islet in the middle of the lake, preening their feathers in the morning light, and she recorded a vivid first impression for her topic on the winter ecology of Green Lake.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shower, breakfast, and tidying the refrigerator
description: After returning home, I took a hot shower and changed into comfortable cotton loungewear. My mother had prepared pumpkin millet porridge, fried eggs, and blanched spinach. We ate breakfast together while chatting about each other's plans for the morning. After breakfast, I cleaned out the fridge, checked the stock of vegetables, fruit, and eggs, and threw out the wilted bok choy and scallions. Following my mother's suggestion from last weekend about “weekend meal-prep ingredients,” I put together a healthy grocery list: frozen broccoli, organic tomatoes, chicken breast, whole-wheat bread, and Greek yogurt, and planned to do the shopping over the weekend.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Handle online messages and confirm the writing plan
description: In the study, she opened her phone and saw the commission from her cousin Shen Wei for a set of poems to accompany postcards.
