She received three high-definition sample images: West Lake in morning mist, the flying eaves of Lingyin Temple, and the tea mountains. She replied, "Received, I'll start working on ideas." She checked the chat with editor Xu Mingyuan; there were no new messages. She sent a message to her best friend Zhang Jing to confirm that they would discuss signing up for the weaving workshop after afternoon class.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Concept and imagery construction for a commissioned short poem
description: Spread open the journal, placed three sample images in front of her, trying to transform visual impressions into words. Settled on the theme "Jiangnan, Winter, Morning Charm," and used an image bubble diagram to branch out: West Lake—"water light, mist, withered lotus, painted boats"; Lingyin Temple—"yellow walls, flying eaves, ancient trees, pilgrims"; tea hills—"morning dew, moss, tea pickers, thin mist." Wrote down scattered phrases such as "the shimmering water light not yet fully gathered" and "the thin mist over the tea hills, a dream not yet awake from last night," accumulating material for the afternoon's formal writing.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break
description: Mother was not home at noon, so she simply cooked some buckwheat noodles for herself, with boiled eggs and soy-braised beef. While eating, she flipped through the morning's imagery board, thinking about where to start the afternoon's creation. After the meal, she lay on the recliner in the bedroom, put on earphones, and played light music. The autumn sunlight fell on her as she took a 30-minute nap to store up energy for the afternoon yoga class and writing.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio and attend the yoga class.
description: Changed into yoga clothes, brought her water bottle and yoga mat, and walked from home to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, passing Huashan West Road and Dongfeng West Road along the way. The class started at 13:00, and instructor He Lu focused on guiding the slow lift into headstand. After multiple attempts with assistance, her core and arm strength control felt better than last week. She successfully held a stable freestanding headstand for 15 seconds away from the wall and received the instructor's approval. After class, she chatted with He Lu and shared about the black-headed gulls she had observed at Green Lake in the morning.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the bookstore to write and help tally event registrations
description: After the yoga class, she walked to Zhibushi Bookstore. On the way, passing through Wenlin Street, she bought a freshly baked rose cake as afternoon tea. After arriving at her regular seat on the second floor of the bookstore, she formally wrote the first draft of the short poem based on the ideas she had conceived in the morning, repeatedly weighing the wording, and revised a line describing West Lake from “the water’s gleam is cold and indifferent” to “the water’s gleam lightly dips into a touch of chill.” Uncle Qin brought her a hot Americano and chatted briefly. Later, she came down from the second floor and, together with Uncle Qin at the cash register, checked the registration for the “Winter Reading Marathon,” confirming a total of 22 book friends—17 online and 5 offline—and proofread the list together. Based on this, Uncle Qin adjusted his plan for buying tea and snacks.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to the supermarket to shop and returned home.
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she walked to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, enjoying the evening street scene. Inside, she quickly bought frozen broccoli, organic cherry tomatoes, and Greek yogurt according to the morning list. At checkout, she also grabbed a box of fresh strawberries. After shopping, she walked home as streetlights gradually came on, arriving at around 18:50.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Helping prepare dinner and having dinner with parents.
description: After returning home, her mother was already preparing braised pork ribs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, so she helped wash the vegetables and chop scallions, ginger, and garlic, while sharing the commission from her cousin and the progress she had made on the first draft at the bookstore that afternoon. When her father came back, the family of three had dinner together; her father mentioned the old Kunming photography exhibition being organized by the Cultural Bureau and asked whether she would be interested in helping write captions for the old photos. The atmosphere at the dinner table was warm and harmonious.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanying my parents on a walk in Green Lake Park
description: After dinner, the family of three walked to Green Lake Park for a stroll. At night, the lakeside path was dotted with lights and full of walkers. As we walked, we watched the red-billed gulls already settling on the island in the middle of the lake; they tucked in their necks like little white dots. Father said that he used to run by the lake when he was young, and Mother shared an interesting essay her students had written about Green Lake. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Continued creative work and online communication.
description: After the walk, she returned to the study, revised the draft for the third time based on inspiration from the walk, and wrote two new poems. She sent the four short poems to her older cousin Shen Wei via WeChat, with a note asking whether they fit the overall tone of the postcard. Then she called Zhang Jing, and together they searched and compared mini-programs for a 'Nordic-style wall tapestry weaving workshop,' checked the course schedule and material kits, and finally completed the registration together and paid the deposit.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Washing up, skincare, and body scan meditation
description: After washing up, she carefully completed her evening skincare routine. In the bedroom, she lit an orange blossom essential oil aroma lamp, lay on the bed, and followed the app's guidance for a 10-minute full-body body scan meditation, relaxing from her toes to the top of her head and releasing the fatigue of the day.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: She picked up 'Birds of Kunming' from the bedside, turned to the 'Black-headed Gull' chapter, quickly read the descriptions of its migration habits and wintering status in Kunming, and highlighted a few sentences with a highlighter to accumulate material for the 'Green Lake Winter Ecology' topic.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for sleep
description: I drew the curtains, put on my sleep mask, and dimmed the phone screen. Recalling the fulfilling day, I felt content and calm. After setting the alarm for the next morning, I slowly relaxed and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: Spread the yoga mat on the bay window and begin with 5 minutes of diaphragmatic breathing. Focus on solidifying headstand stability away from the wall; I tried 3 times, and the last attempt held for 17 seconds. Then completed 20 minutes of Hatha yoga (shoulder stand, bridge pose), feeling core strength. Finally, 10 minutes of body scan meditation. After finishing, rinsed off the morning sweat with warm water.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready to go out and contacting Dad
description: Put on a lightweight softshell jacket. Check the backpack: phone, keys, water bottle. In the living room, I sent my dad a WeChat message: “Dad, I’m leaving for Green Lake at seven. Want to come?” A reply came quickly: “Sure, I’ll wait for you at the door.”
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning walk with father at Green Lake Park
description: Met up with her father at the entrance of the residential community, and the two walked slowly along the shore of Green Lake. A thin mist hung over the lake, and the calls of black-headed gulls were crisp. Her father shared his plans after retiring at the end of the year: he wanted to study calligraphy at a senior citizens' college and take her mother to Beijing to see the Forbidden City. Yuwei gave a detailed report on the progress of her essay collection and mentioned that her advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, was very interested in the new topic. They bought hot grilled rice cakes at the park entrance and ate them sitting on a bench.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Returning home
description: After saying goodbye to my father, I walked home alone. On the way, I saw elderly people doing morning exercises and tourists feeding seagulls, and felt at ease.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Breakfast and preparation
description: Mother had prepared soy milk and steamed posu buns. While eating breakfast, Yuwei told her, "I'll buy some flower cakes at noon, from that Jiahua shop you love best." Mother reminded her, "Only freshly baked ones are fragrant." After the meal, Yuwei reorganized her backpack and put in the bunch of dried eucalyptus leaves she had brought from home, to be used for decorating supplies.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commute to the shopping point.
description: As she came downstairs, Qin Mingyuan arrived at the door on his e-bike. 'Yuwei, get on!' Yuwei smiled and got on. The two rode east along Renmin Middle Road. On the way they discussed the event details: Qin Mingyuan said he had confirmed attendance with several bookstore members, and Yuwei shared a new inspiration from last night for a short poem.
location: On the way from Cuihu Community to Walmart Shopping Plaza (Renmin Middle Road Branch), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Purchase supplies for the reading marathon.
description: At Walmart, the two split up. Yuwei picked out three boxes of Yunnan flower tea in different flavors (rose, osmanthus, and Dianhong) and two large bags of shortbread cookies; Qin Mingyuan pushed the cart and grabbed two cases of bottled water and disposable cups and plates. In the coffee aisle, Yuwei smelled the aroma of Yunnan Arabica coffee beans, and Qin Mingyuan said, 'I have a pour-over kettle at home; I'll bring it along when the time comes.' After checking out, they went next door to Jiahua Bakery (Jinsui Store). Yuwei bought four freshly baked classic flower cakes and two small Yunnan ham cakes, had them packed up, and planned to surprise her mother that evening.
location: Walmart Supercenter (Renmin Middle Road store), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Jiahua Bakery (Jinsui store, 177 Dongfeng West Road)

name: Returning home and handing over supplies
description: Qin Mingyuan helped Yuwei carry the large purchased supplies to her door and said, “Leave the stuff here for now; I’ll come pick it up directly for tomorrow’s event.” Yuwei nodded in thanks and watched him ride away. She carried the flower cakes and lighter items inside.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Lunch and family time
description: Mother had already prepared lunch: pickled vegetable and red bean soup, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and multigrain rice. Yuwei put the flower cakes in the middle of the table, saying they were for afternoon tea. Father took a bite and was full of praise. The family chatted as they ate, warm and ordinary.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Short rest and preparation
description: Rinse mouth quickly, pack schoolbag, put on glasses, and check phone, campus card, notebook, and pen.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuting to school and campus activities
description: Walk to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station and take Metro Line 2. On the train, open the notes app on your phone and sketch the framework for the topic “Winter Ecology of Green Lake.” Arrive at University Town Station at 13:55, then walk to the Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University. Stop briefly on campus, see the golden fallen leaves beside the ginkgo avenue, and take a few photos.
location: From Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, via Metro Line 2 to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Discussing the paper with my advisor
description: Professor Wu Mingyuan expressed appreciation for Yuwei's plan to focus her essay collection on 'City and Memory,' and suggested she pay more attention to nonfiction works by local Kunming writers, especially Wang Zengqi's essays about Kunming. He also said that if she had the energy, she could consider attempting a cross-disciplinary writing project called 'Urban Ecology Notes' next semester. Yuwei took careful notes and broadened her horizons.
location: Professor Wu Mingyuan's office, School of Humanities office building, Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Campus transition and commute home
description: Left the office building and took the subway home. On the way home, I took out my tablet and began to sketch out the new short poem I wanted to write today. The image of my father walking by the lake and my mentor's encouraging words came to mind.
location: On the metro from Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus back to Cuihu Community.

name: Afternoon short poem writing
description: Brewed a cup of rose tea and opened the laptop. First, based on my cousin Shen Wei's feedback last night, I carefully revised the rhymes of the first three poems, replacing stiff wording with more natural expressions. Then inspiration struck, and I wrote two new poems: one incorporating my father's expectations after retirement and the thin mist by the lake; the other based on the ginkgo leaves I saw on campus today, titled “Autumn Letter”.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dinner and quality time with family.
description: During dinner, Yuwei put the freshly baked Jiahua flower cakes she had bought on the table. Her mother took a bite and said happily, "This really is the most authentic flavor!" Yuwei shared how her meeting with her advisor went that afternoon, and her father encouraged her to simply do what she loves. After the meal, Yuwei took the initiative to wash the dishes so her mother could rest.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing and finalizing a short poem in the evening
description: She continued working hard in the study. She integrated the two new poems written in the afternoon with the revised first three, and conceived a sixth short poem, 'A Lamp by the West Lake,' echoing her cousin's suggestion about imagery. At 19:40, she sent the six drafts to her cousin via WeChat. At 20:10, her cousin replied, saying she was very satisfied overall and suggested fine-tuning the rhymes in two places. Yuwei revised immediately and sent the final version at 20:30. She received a voice message from her cousin praising her: 'Yuwei, you have improved so much! Each of the six poems has its own distinctive character!'
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening solo walk.
description: After completing the important task, she changed into comfortable sneakers and went out. The autumn night breeze was cool; she took two laps around Green Lake to digest dinner and also reviewed the fulfilling day: the father-daughter conversation in the morning, the harmonious cooperation with her book friends, the guidance from her advisor, and the spark of inspiration with her cousin. Her heart was filled with warm contentment.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Journaling and reading before bed
description: After showering, I changed into pajamas, sat at my desk, and opened my journal. I pasted in the ginkgo leaf photos taken today, the receipt from Jiahua Bakery, and a fallen leaf picked up during my walk around Green Lake. I wrote down my creative reflections: “Dad said he wants to learn calligraphy — that’s a great essay topic. My cousin’s feedback is always so precise.” Then I picked up *Birds of Kunming* and read quietly by the bedside lamp for half an hour.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: Put down the book, turned off the light, and lay in bed. Used the Tide app to play rain white noise and did a five-minute body-scan relaxation meditation, letting my mind detach from tension. I felt the calm and peace at the end of the day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and light stretching.
description: Did a set of relaxed shoulder and neck stretches, then pulled up the quilt and slowly fell asleep to the sound of rain.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: The alarm went off at 6 a.m. sharp. You spread out your yoga mat on the bedroom bay window cushion and began a new day. First, you did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing to calm your mind. Next was a 20-minute vinyasa flow yoga practice, focusing on Sun Salutation and Warrior III, feeling the body's stretch and the flow of strength. Finally, you meditated cross-legged for 10 minutes, clearing your mind of distractions and gathering energy for the day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run at Cuihu Park
description: After changing into sportswear, I went out and walked one minute from the neighborhood to the south gate of Green Lake Park. I ran counterclockwise along the lakeside trail at a steady pace for about 4 kilometers, with a consistent pace of around 7 minutes per kilometer. In the early morning, the air at Green Lake was fresh, and I could see elderly people exercising and egrets strolling by the lake. After the run, I did five minutes of stretching on a lakeside bench to relax my muscles.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning shower and breakfast
description: After walking home, you took a quick shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. In the dining room, your mother had already prepared breakfast: a steaming bowl of millet porridge, with fried eggs and cucumber salad. You and your mother chatted about a few amusing incidents from yesterday's shopping trip for event supplies, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning reading and receiving a nomination
description: In the study, you tidy the desk and prepare the laptop and materials. Then you pick up The Birds of Kunming, turn to the black-headed gull chapter, read immersively for 20 minutes, and make penciled notes in the margins to accumulate details for writing. Around 9 o'clock, your phone vibrates. Editor Xu Mingyuan sends a WeChat message sharing a link to a cultural media webpage; your name appears on the shortlist for the "Annual Young Author" nomination. You pause for a few seconds, carefully browse the page, take a screenshot and save it, then solemnly write on a blank page of the journal: "The road is long, but walking will get you there." as encouragement to yourself.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Writing Chapter Three of the essay collection
description: Encouraged by the nomination, I focused wholeheartedly on writing the third chapter, "The Meaning of Travel," of the essay collection "Between Breaths." I opened my computer, with photos and journal entries from my trips to Dali and Hangzhou spread out beside me. From recalling the scents of Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake during the volunteer trip in Dali, to capturing the rustling sound of tea leaves being stir-fried in the Longjing tea gardens in Hangzhou, I used words to recreate the atmosphere and human warmth of different cities. After two and a half hours of immersive writing, revising, and polishing, I completed the main body of the chapter's first draft, about 2,500 words.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Draft of Mom's retirement card.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the yoga studio and have coffee.
description: Changed into outdoor workout clothes, brought a water bottle and a light jacket, and walked 10 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. After arriving downstairs at Dechun Commercial Building, there was still some time before class, so I ordered a hot latte at the café downstairs, sat on a high stool by the window, and drank coffee while watching the people and traffic on Dongfeng West Road below, feeling relaxed.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon yoga class
description: After finishing coffee, I went upstairs into the yoga studio, changed, and attended Coach He Lu's headstand practice class. Reviewing yesterday's successful experience, I tried slow leg lifts; my core control felt better. Although I couldn't complete the slow lift perfectly, once I entered the inverted position I was much more stable than yesterday. After class, I briefly exchanged thoughts with He Lu about core engagement.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the bookstore to count the postcard inventory
description: After yoga class, I walked east along Dongfeng West Road, turned onto Cuihu North Road, and reached Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore after about 15 minutes. After entering, I greeted Qin Mingyuan and went straight to the postcard rack to carefully count the stock of my consigned Four Seasons of Cuihu series. I found that the Winter Snow Scene design was very popular, with only 3 copies left. At the counter, I counted the remaining quantities of each design with Uncle Qin, and we decided to contact the cooperative printing house to prioritize reprinting 80 copies of Winter Snow Scene and 50 copies of each other design. Uncle Qin praised your postcard sales.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping and handling royalties back home
description: After leaving the bookstore, I walked 5 minutes to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket and bought fresh fruit (apples and oranges), lettuce, ham slices, and yogurt. Then I carried the shopping bags and walked 12 minutes home. After putting things down, I received a WeChat message from my older cousin Shen Wei. She was very satisfied with the six-line short poem I had completed last night and directly transferred 2,000 yuan to me as a contribution fee. After confirming the transfer, I recorded this unexpected income on the 'Travel Fund' page of my study journal and noted it as 'Short poem contribution fee - Shen Wei'.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and a brief rest
description: You washed the apples and put them on the table. Your parents had already started preparing dinner. Tonight's home-style dishes were scrambled eggs with tomatoes, shredded pork with green peppers, and vegetable tofu soup. As you ate, you shared with them the joy of being nominated and receiving the manuscript fee. Your father Sun Mingyuan was happy for you, and your mother Li Xiulan smiled and told you not to work too hard. After helping clear the dishes, you sat on the living room sofa for a while, browsed the instructions for tomorrow's reading marathon on your phone, and mentally went over the process to make sure nothing was missed.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Venue setup at Maitian Bookstore and return home
description: Walked 10 minutes to Maitian Bookstore on Wenlin Street and set up the venue for tomorrow's event with fellow book enthusiast Qin Mingyuan. Uncle Qin was responsible for adjusting the bookshelves, while you placed folding chairs and floor cushions to form a discussion area. You turned on the sound system to play a self-selected piano piece as background music, and checked the projector and lighting to make sure everything was normal. You placed event brochures and pens on each seat, and helped arrange the refreshments and flower cakes. By 8:30, the setup was complete and the effect was satisfying. Then you said goodbye to Uncle Qin and walked home along Wenlin Street. The night was deep, and you savored the fulfilling day with light steps.
location: Wheat Field Bookstore, Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and journaling
description: After getting home, I went to the bathroom to wash up and complete my full skincare routine. Then, in my pajamas, I went to the study, opened my journal, and carefully recorded all of today's events: pasting in printed screenshots of the nomination for 'Young Writer of the Year', a screenshot of the transfer of my cousin's article payment, a memo about reprinting the postcards, and photos taken while setting up the event venue. Finally, I wrote down a reflection: 'It feels so good to have your efforts seen.'
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading before bed and meditating to fall asleep.
description: Half-lying in bed, I took out Birds of Kunming and continued reading the unfinished chapter on black-headed gulls; reading made me feel calm. After turning off the light and lying down, I put on an eye mask and did a 15-minute body scan meditation, relaxing each part of my body one by one from head to toe. After the meditation, I quickly fell asleep, feeling content and calm.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: The alarm went off on time. I spread the yoga mat on the bay window and adjusted my usual 30-minute session into a focused 20-minute practice: 5 minutes of belly breathing to calm the mind, then 15 minutes of simple flow yoga poses for the shoulders and neck, including Cat-Cow, Downward-Facing Dog, and Child's Pose, to relieve the fatigue from yesterday's writing. Finally, 5 minutes of sitting cross-legged in meditation, feeling the warmth of the sun falling on me through the curtains.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Washing up and preparing breakfast
description: After taking a warm shower, I changed into comfortable loungewear. In the kitchen, I made breakfast for myself and my mother, who had gotten up early to prepare lessons: hot milk, whole wheat toast with mashed avocado, and boiled eggs. I softly told my mother that I was going to the Provincial Writers' Association in the afternoon for Teacher Zhou Mingyuan's lecture. She smiled and told me to bring extra paper and pens for notes.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning reading and free writing
description: After breakfast, I curled up on the study sofa reading Wang Zengqi's 'Plants in the Human World,' deeply drawn to his memories of Kunming. Then I opened my journal and wrote a sketch about the 'bird calls outside the window on a winter morning' as supplementary material for 'Three Sounds of Winter at Green Lake.'
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Dealt with manuscripts and emails in the morning.
description: In the aroma of coffee, I opened my laptop. First I replied to the collaboration email from that journal brand, politely declining: “Thank you for the recognition, but I’m currently focused on personal essay writing, so I’m afraid I wouldn’t achieve the ideal collaboration. I look forward to a better-suited opportunity in the future.” After sending it, I breathed a sigh of relief. Then I opened the manuscript of “Three Sounds of Cuihu in Winter” and circled a few passages on the printed draft where sensory descriptions could be added.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Communicated with Uncle Qin and confirmed the progress of the postcards
description: WeChat buzzed — it was a message from Qin Mingyuan confirming what time I would arrive at the shop tonight. I replied: 'I'll be there at 21:15, no problem!' Then I asked: 'How are the reprinted postcards coming along?' He replied: 'I just made a call; they said they'll arrive tomorrow afternoon, in time for the event. I've checked the venue — the lights and projector are fine.' Only then did I relax, and I also sent a copy of tomorrow's event schedule to my computer desktop for checking tonight.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and keeping in touch with family and friends.
description: Mom made my favorite tomato and egg noodles. At the dinner table, I finally couldn't help telling her the good news that I had been nominated for "Young Author of the Year." Mom put down her chopsticks in surprise and said over and over, "That's wonderful! I knew you could do it!" She asked for details, but I smiled and glossed over them, feeling warm inside. After dinner, I leaned on the sofa and sent a voice message to Zhang Jing, who was at work: "Jingjing, about tomorrow afternoon's reading marathon — I just heard there are still a few spots. Do you want to come? It's really fun."
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Departure and commute preparation
description: I changed into an off-white wool sweater and dark blue trousers, and put on a canvas bag holding my notebook and printed manuscript. After confirming my phone was fully charged, I walked 8 minutes to Chuanxingulou Metro Station. While waiting for the train, I opened the memo app on my phone and reviewed the two questions I had written down the night before to ask Teacher Zhou: "How can the 'smell' of regional culture be naturally integrated into narrative?" and "How should one handle the rhythm of a prose piece?"
location: No. 123, Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to Chuanxin Gulou Metro Station

name: Arrived at the Provincial Writers' Association, waiting for the lecture.
description: There weren't many people on the metro. I wore earphones and silently rehearsed the questions I was about to ask. After getting out of the station, I walked along Cuihu West Road for 5 minutes and arrived at the old four-story building. After signing in, I walked into the meeting room on the third floor, chose a seat near the middle, took out my notebook and pen, and waited quietly.
location: 3rd Floor, Provincial Writers' Association, No. 4 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attended a literature lecture and proactively asked questions
description: Teacher Zhou Mingyuan started the lecture on time. He talked from Shen Congwen's "Border Town" to the plants in Wang Zengqi's writing, explaining in a simple and profound way how regional culture seeps into the flesh and blood of prose. I listened with great focus, quickly jotting down memorable quotes and reflections. After the lecture, I took a deep breath, gathered my courage, and walked to the front: "Hello, Teacher Zhou. I'm Sun Yuwei from the Chinese Department at Yunnan University. I've read your 'Border Town Sketches' many times. Regarding the passage describing the Hot Sea in Tengchong, how did you handle the abstract experience of the sensation of heat?" Teacher Zhou listened carefully, smiled, and gave me very specific advice. Then he took out his new book "Book of the South of the Clouds," wrote a dedication, and handed it to me: "Young lady, walk more and see more, and your words will have roots." I took it with both hands in excitement and thanked him repeatedly.
location: Meeting room on the third floor of the Provincial Writers' Association, No. 4 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing and sharing on the way back.
description: As I walked out of the Writers' Association building, I let out a long sigh of relief and felt my steps become lighter. On the metro back, I put on my earphones, looked at the note snippets I had photographed on my phone, and recorded the core points as voice memos. Thinking about the exchange just now, I couldn't wait to share it with Song Wen: "Wenwen, I met Teacher Zhou Mingyuan today! Do you know that I've been nominated? Today was amazing!" I sent several voice messages, each over 50 seconds long, and only put my phone away contentedly after Song Wen replied with a string of "Wow!" and "So happy for you!"
location: Kunming Metro Line 3, transferring to Line 2 (Wuyi Road Station to Chuanxin Gulou Station)

name: Going home to transcribe notes and having family dinner
description: Arrived home at 17:00. I washed my face, sat down in the study, and neatly copied the lecture notes from my phone memo into the dark blue creative writing notebook. Then I helped Mom set the table. When Dad came home from work, I poked my head out of the study and called out, "Dad!" At the dinner table, I showed my parents the book signed by Teacher Zhou and repeated the good news about being nominated. Dad rarely showed an approving smile, while Mom kept putting food on my plate.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Immersive revision of the manuscript
description: After dinner, I got down to the main event of the evening — revising 'Three Sounds of Winter at Cuihu Lake.' I opened the document and, referring to the afternoon's notes, started editing the passage describing 'sounds.' I changed 'The lake was quiet' to 'The lake shimmered in the cold wind, and occasionally I could hear the crisp, lonely crack of broken lotus stems.' I weighed each phrase, tapping the keyboard from time to time and pausing to think. Only when my phone vibrated — Qin Mingyuan asking if I had left — did I realize it was already 21:00.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Heading to Wheat Field Bookstore.
description: I put on my coat, grabbed my keys and phone, and hurried out. The night wind was a bit cool, but my heart felt full. After about a 10-minute walk, I saw the bookstore's warm yellow lights.
location: Walk from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Wheat Field Bookstore, No. 52 Wenming Street.

name: Reading Marathon final check
description: “Uncle Qin, I'm here!” I pushed the door open and walked in; the bookstore had already closed early. Qin Mingyuan was adjusting the projector. We went through the checklist one by one: checked the reader list and confirmed that everyone had received the reminder via WeChat; counted again the amount of flower tea, coffee beans, and handmade cookies to be provided tomorrow; I put up bright sign-in instruction stickers at the entrance and placed the sign-in sheet at the sign-in desk. Finally, Qin Mingyuan turned on the microphone to test the sound, while I gently rehearsed the opening remarks to the empty seats and confirmed with Qin Mingyuan the timing for us to take turns hosting. After all checks were done, Qin Mingyuan turned off the lights, we locked the shop door, and we said goodbye to each other at the entrance.
location: Wheat Field Bookstore, 52 Wenming Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home, wash up, and do personal care
description: I walked home through the night. After a quick wash, I applied moisturizing lotion. Looking at myself in the mirror, I softly said, “Today was great.”
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and reading before bed
description: I curled up at the head of the bed, took out my beloved journal, and wrote in green pen: "2025.11.21 Friday. Sunny, but my heart is warm. Nominated. Saw Teacher Zhou. Tomorrow is the Reading Marathon. Good night." I pasted in the lecture handout I got from the Provincial Writers' Association, then opened the book signed by Teacher Zhou Mingyuan and read a few essays about Dali Old Town. At 23:00, I closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning yoga meditation and shoulder and neck relaxation.
description: After waking up, I took a few deep breaths in bed and recalled Teacher Zhou Mingyuan's advice on sensory details. Then I unrolled the yoga mat, starting the warm-up with a 10-minute simple Sun Salutation, paying special attention to the stiff shoulders and neck from moving supplies last night; then I did 10 minutes of Yin Yoga, keeping long and deep breaths in Butterfly Pose and Dragonfly Pose; finally, I sat in meditation for 10 minutes, silently rehearsing the opening flow of the afternoon event in my mind, injecting energy for a busy day.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run around Green Lake and cross-training along the Panlong River
description: Starting from home, she jogged 5 km along the familiar route beside the water at Green Lake Park, where willows shimmered pale gold in the morning light. Then she walked along Cuihu West Road to the trail along the Panlong River and did 30 minutes of brisk walking as cross-training, feeling refreshed all over as the river breeze brushed her face. On the way home, she met Auntie Xie, who was returning from a stroll at the community entrance. Auntie Xie handed her a freshly baked flower cake and encouraged her, saying, "You'll be busy all day, so let Auntie give you a little boost first." She took the cake with a warm feeling in her heart.
location: Cuihu Park and the Panlong River trail, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning activities at home: breakfast, lesson preparation, reading, and online communication.
description: After washing up, Mom had already prepared hot milk, whole wheat bread, and a boiled egg. I ate the flower pastry Aunt Xie had given me while it was still warm and felt comforted. Then in the study, I organized my flower arrangement class materials: I copied the key points of 'matching the main branch with the guest branch' onto an index card; took out samples of snow mountain roses, eucalyptus leaves, and lisianthus; and adjusted the flower arrangement sketch according to the principles of spatial composition. Meanwhile, I received a link from my roommate Wenwen about negative space and spatial arrangement. Next, I flipped through Calvino's 'Invisible Cities,' dog-eared the passage that reads 'a city is a net whose warp and weft are woven from people's footsteps and memories,' and wrote the cue words 'memory and city' on the side of the index card. I communicated with the teaching assistant He Lu via WeChat voice call, confirmed that the afternoon student list had minor adjustments, reminded her that the kenzan and flower containers were ready, and chatted about possible questions from students after class. Finally, on the small sofa by the living room window, I recorded my morning run reflections and flower arrangement inspiration with a green fountain pen. Outside the window, the treetops of Green Lake were visible, quiet and comfortable.

participant.name: He Lu
participant.relation: Friend, teaching assistant for the flower arrangement class

location: Room 302, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and casual family chat
description: Mom made stir-fried choy sum, braised fish, and tomato egg drop soup, and the two chatted while eating. Yuwei talked about the afternoon bookstore event and flower arranging class. Mom reminded her to bring a jacket because it would get cold at night, and also asked whether her older sister hadn't called in a long time. Yuwei promised to send her sister a voice message before bed.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and pre-departure preparation.
description: After the meal, she scrolled through her phone and browsed two or three social media posts about city memory to get inspiration for the evening discussion. Then she closed her eyes and rested for 20 minutes to recharge. After getting up, she changed into a white cotton-linen shirt and dark blue wide-leg pants, and slung a canvas tote bag crossbody. The bag contained a book, lesson-prep cue cards, flower material samples, a folding umbrella, a power bank, a water bottle, and throat lozenges. She put on lightweight canvas shoes, placed two throat lozenges in her pocket, tidied herself up in front of the mirror, and got ready to go out with the confident and composed demeanor of an event organizer and flower arrangement teacher.
location: Room 302, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Host the "Winter Reading Marathon" launch event.
description: Walking about 12 minutes west along North Cuihu Road, she arrived at Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. The afternoon sunlight filtered through the plane trees, casting dappled shadows. Uncle Qin had already arranged the chairs in an arc, and the warm yellow bentwood desk lamps were dimmed to a soft glow. Yuwei first walked around the venue to straighten the desks. The event began on time. She gave a brief opening and explained the rules. Qin Mingyuan gave a speech: "This lamp is kept for readers." The first book friend read an essay aloud. Yuwei sat on a low stool at the side and adjusted the height of a lamp so that the light just fell on the page. The atmosphere was quiet and comfortable.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Transition: from the bookstore, via the coffee shop, to the yoga studio
description: She handed the hosting baton to Qin Mingyuan, nodded goodbye to a few familiar book club friends, and quickly walked out of the bookstore. After about a 10-minute walk, she went into the independent coffee shop "Shicui" near the intersection of Cuihu South Road and Dongfeng West Road and ordered a hot Americano. Sitting by the window, she took out her lesson-preparation notebook to review the demonstration steps for fixing the main branch at an angle for the ikebana class, while also quickly noting in her phone memo a sentence that touched her that she'd heard in the bookstore, as a possible entry point for the evening's discussion. After finishing her coffee, she continued walking along Dongfeng West Road for about 5 minutes to Dechun Commercial Building, took the elevator to the 4th floor, and arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio.
location: From 32 Cuihu North Road to 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, passing by Shicui Coffee Shop near the intersection of Cuihu South Road and Dongfeng West Road.

name: Pre-class preparation for flower arrangement
description: She changed into the black teaching apron and, together with the teaching assistant He Lu, took out the flower materials from the cold storage cabinet and sorted them by main branches, guest branches, and filler leaves. She checked the kenzan and flower containers of the 10 students one by one to ensure every set of tools was clean. On the classroom whiteboard, she wrote today’s key phrase: “Spatial composition — the main branch’s ‘home ground’ and the guest branch’s ‘dialogue’,” and asked He Lu to help open the windows so the afternoon light could flow in naturally.
location: Teaching area, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Second session of the flower arrangement experience class.
description: The class started on time. Yuwei first demonstrated how to fix the main branch with a kenzan, emphasizing, "It holds the dominant position in the vase, so it should be steady and strong." Then she showed how the guest branch is like "a person leaning sideways to speak," adjusting the tilt angle several times so the students could see clearly. As the students practiced, she guided each one: when someone pressed the kenzan too shallowly, she helped push it deeper; when a new student's fingers trembled slightly, she said gently, "Keep breathing; the branch also needs you to trust it." The student gradually relaxed and completed her first piece. As He Lu passed flower materials, she whispered, "Your teaching is more down-to-earth than formal flower arranging classes." After class, Yuwei arranged the students' works on the long table, photographed and archived each one, and announced, "Next class is free creation; you can bring your own vases." Everyone laughed and packed up their tools.
location: Classroom, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-class wrap-up and return to the bookstore
description: She helped He Lu sort and bag the remaining flower materials and waste leaves, then wiped her hands with a wet towel. She took out the homemade sandwich (ham, lettuce, cheese) prepared that morning from her canvas bag, stood in the rest area and took a few quick bites to regain energy, and drank some water. She sent a WeChat message to her mother: "The flower arrangement class went very smoothly; I still need to go back to the bookstore this evening." Afterwards, she walked about 8 minutes back to Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. The cool night air rushed toward her; the streetlights were just coming on, and the lights along Cuihu North Road reflected on the pavement. The city showed another kind of gentleness in the night.
location: No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 32 Cuihu North Road

name: Evening reading and themed discussion at the bookstore
description: She gently pushed the door open and stepped inside. Several reading companions were already seated around Qin Mingyuan, and a middle-aged man was reading an essay about the old streets of Kunming in a slow, gentle rhythm. Yuwei found a corner seat and listened for a while, feeling her heart completely relax. During the intermission, she softly exchanged thoughts about the reading with a young reading companion beside her. Later, she stood up, walked to the center, took out Invisible Cities and read in a calm voice, “A city is a web whose warp and weft are woven from people’s footsteps and memories.” After reading, she added, “I think of Green Lake Park. When I was little, I called it ‘Bird Park.’ That is the coordinate of my memory. What about you all? Is there a city, a street, or a streetlamp that has carried a moment of yours?” As she guided the discussion, someone talked about the corner streetlamp they had looked at one last time before leaving Kunming, someone else spoke of the childhood alleys that disappeared during the old town renovation, and Yuwei also shared her memory of “Green Lake’s Bird Park.” Several reading companions smiled with warmth in their eyes.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Late-night small-group in-depth discussion and event wrap-up.
description: The larger discussion gradually dispersed, and some book club friends left early. Yuwei remained in the corner with Qin Mingyuan, a writer, and a retired teacher. The topic moved from "memory and the city" to personal life experiences and the relationship between writing and the city. The four of them chatted softly for over an hour. Around 1 a.m., they stood up one after another to say goodbye. Qin Mingyuan helped lock the door and, before leaving, told Yuwei to get some rest.
location: Corner seat at Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home, wash up, write in her journal before bed, and contact her older sister.
description: Walked home alone; the streetlights were dim yellow and a cool breeze blew against my face. After getting home, I washed my face and changed into pajamas. Though my eyes were tired, I felt excited and fulfilled inside. Afraid my sister had already gone to sleep, I only sent a voice message: 'Today's ikebana class went well, and the reading marathon discussion was also great — everyone was willing to share the cities in their memories. You and Shenzhen count as one too. Next time I come back, I'll take you to the bookstore.' Then I opened my journal, used sketch notes to record the smiles of the ikebana class participants and the light of that desk lamp, and looked through the photos I took at today's ikebana class.
location: Room 302, Building 1, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: She closed her journal and put it on the bedside table, then turned off the light. Images of the whole day flashed quickly through her mind: the morning light at Cuihu Lake, the lights of the bookstore, the branches of ikebana, the warm smiles of book friends... She felt immensely fulfilled and satisfied, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 1, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation, stretching, and family breakfast
description: At 8:30 the alarm went off. Following last night's plan, she did a 10-minute breathing meditation in bed to let her thoughts settle from the deep conversation last night and to make up for not falling asleep until 2 a.m. After the meditation, she did a 5-minute simple standing stretch, moving her shoulders, neck, and waist to wake up her body. Then she had breakfast with her mother Li Xiulan, eating white rice porridge, fried eggs, and cucumber salad. While eating, she shared amusing moments from last night's "Memory and the City" reading event and mentioned the excellent remarks by Qin Mingyuan and several fellow readers. Her mother suggested bringing some homemade flower cakes to the bookstore to share, and she happily agreed and packed them.
location: Room 301, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the bookstore and host the reading marathon open discussion and follow-up activities.
description: At 9:10, I set off, walking along the outskirts of Green Lake Park toward Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore. The shower had just stopped, and the air was especially fresh. Watching the mist rising from the lake and the rain-washed, gleaming plane-tree leaves, I casually took a few photos with my phone as journal material. At 9:20 I arrived at the bookstore at 32 Cuihu North Road. I briefly discussed the opening procedure with Qin Mingyuan, confirmed the rules for the "Warm Winter" free-discussion session, and helped arrange seats and refreshments. At 9:30, I started hosting the free discussion on time, guiding the book club friends to share around topics such as winter memories, warm moments, and moving winter scenes from books. I skillfully wove in insights from the flower arrangement class's "spatial composition" and reflections on "urban memory," encouraging everyone to describe their stories with sensory details. The discussion was lively, and I jotted down several wonderful sharing points to use in my new essays. During the break at about 11:00, I took out the flower cakes I had brought and shared them with everyone. After the last book club friend finished sharing at 12:30, Qin Mingyuan and I each gave closing remarks and summaries, thanking all participants for their enthusiasm and dedication, and emphasizing that this marathon was not just about reading but also about spiritual exchange. Then I invited everyone to take a group photo, exchanged contact information with several book club friends, collected feedback, and recorded it in my journal. After 12:45, Qin Mingyuan and I put the chairs back, cleaned the tables, and collected the tea and snack utensils. Then, in a corner of the bookstore, I used my phone and computer to organize event photos, video clips, and shorthand notes. We discussed that I would be responsible for writing the first draft of the event recap article, while Qin Mingyuan would provide the photographer's photos and do the final review. Qin Mingyuan also gave me a few remaining bookstore cultural-creative stickers as a "host's benefit." Starting at 13:30, I sat down by the window in the bookstore, ordered a hot Americano, and took out my newly bought ink-blue fountain pen and journal. I spent the first 10 minutes recording my thoughts on the event and the feedback I had collected. Then I opened the memo app on my phone and systematized the fragments of inspiration from last night about "Fishing Lights on Dianchi Lake" and "Urban Memory," building the initial framework for a new essay, Reflections of Kunming. I stayed until 14:45 and left.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping, picking out a birthday gift, and returning home.
description: At 14:45, left the bookstore, walked south along Cuihu West Road, passed the Provincial Library, and arrived about 10 minutes later at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at 98 Fuchun Street. As planned, I bought a bag of whole wheat bread, a box of blueberries, a pack of unsweetened yogurt, and a few avocados for next week's prepared breakfast. After checking out, I remembered that next week is my sister's birthday, so I stopped by the cultural and creative area upstairs and picked out a delicate sealing wax stamp set and a blank kraft paper journal, planning to make her a handmade birthday gift during breaks from writing the review post. Then, carrying the items, I walked north along Dongfeng West Road, passed Huashan West Road Metro Station, and after about 15 minutes returned home in Cuihu Community at 15:45.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening stroll in Cuihu Park and family dinner
description: When she got home, she handed her mother the milk tea and flower cakes and invited her to take a walk in Green Lake Park. In the evening, a gentle breeze was blowing by Green Lake, and red-billed gulls circled in the sunset. Walking with her mother along the lakeside, she talked about fun moments from the event, her classmates' news, and plans for the next week—spending time with family while also letting her mind relax from intense mental work. She returned home around 16:45. Dinner was a mushroom chicken hot pot made by her mother, along with several home-style dishes. During the meal, she shared in detail her thoughts on hosting that day. Her father praised her clear logic and calm presence, and her mother was full of praise for the milk tea she had brought back. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Room 301, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening household chores, diet review, and birthday gift making
description: After dinner, she took the initiative to do some household chores, washing the dinner dishes and utensils, then rinsed and portioned the blueberries she had bought, and cut, pitted, and froze the avocado into small pieces so that she could quickly make yogurt smoothie bowls the following week. Then she went to the study and carefully reviewed the past week's food diary and weight changes (46.7kg) against her journal. She realized that on workdays, staying up late made her mornings tight, and that prepared breakfast did improve efficiency and nutritional balance. She opened the document on her phone, updated next week's breakfast plan, and drew a simple proportion chart. After that, she began making a birthday gift for her older sister using a newly bought wax seal stamp and journal, planning to stamp the words "school junior" and a small flower on the cover.
location: Home kitchen and study, Room 301, Building 3, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with nutritionist friend and phone call with elder sister.
description: At 20:00, I connected with my nutritionist friend Wang Ting over video call. I took out my trial notes for "okara cookies" and discussed the feasibility with her. She approved the idea and suggested adding some chia seeds and dried cranberries to improve the texture, and also shared her recently developed "low-calorie tiramisu" recipe. We agreed to try making them successfully next week and share the tasting. At 20:30, after the video call ended, I wrapped the wax seal stamp gift while listening to light music. Then I opened WeChat and sent a voice message to my elder sister Sun Yutong in faraway Shenzhen, sharing the sense of accomplishment from hosting today's reading marathon, and playfully hinted that a gift was on its way. After that, I spent 20 minutes syncing today's event photos and the inspiration framework for my prose to my cloud journal, and wrote a short reflection.
location: Home study and bedroom, Room 301, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up before bed, meditative reading, and falling asleep
description: At 21:15 she began her careful evening wash-up and skincare routine. At 22:00 she lay in bed and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, reviewing the fulfilling day with gratitude. After meditating, she picked up "Miscellaneous Records of Central Yunnan" and read the chapter "Remembering the Past at Green Lake Teahouse." The book's depiction of Republican-era Kunming gave her new insight into "Reflections of Kunming," which she had written that day. At 22:15 she turned off the bedside lamp and, in the darkness, recalled the warm moments of the day's activities. With a sense of fulfillment and abundant creative inspiration, she gradually fell asleep. Weight: 46.7 kg; mood: fulfilled and content.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Room 301, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: On a winter morning in Kunming, the thin mist had not yet cleared. You spread your yoga mat on the bedroom floor, wearing your cardigan pajamas, and began a gentle yoga meditation. Forgoing the elaborate Sun Salutations, you focused on spinal twists and ten minutes of seated meditation. Feeling the rhythm of your breath, the stiffness in your shoulders and neck gradually melted away through slow stretching, leaving your mind calm and clear. Afterward, you wiped your body with warm water and felt refreshed.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and preparing breakfast
description: After washing up, you change into comfortable home clothes. You walk into the kitchen; mother is already busy. You help slice the whole-wheat bread Mother just made and fry two eggs. The two of you chat about funny moments from yesterday's reading marathon. Mother smiles and praises you for hosting with more and more flair, and your heart feels warm.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoy breakfast
description: While drinking hot milk and eating a whole-wheat fried-egg sandwich, you casually broke off half a flower cake Aunt Xie had given you and tasted it—though not as crisp as fresh from the oven, the rose aroma was still pleasantly sweet. You decided to keep the remaining one and a half flower cakes and take them to Mingyuan Bookstore in the afternoon as a snack.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organized the manuscript of “Slow Travel Notes”
description: You sit at your desk, open your laptop, and pull out all the manuscripts for Slow Travel Notes (preface, fifteen essays, and afterword). This is work that requires extreme focus. You check each piece one by one to see whether the page numbers are continuous and the formatting is consistent, and in a separate memo notebook write down the revision points for each piece, such as "On P7, second paragraph, change 'willow catkins' to 'willow branches' to echo the imagery of Green Lake." It takes nearly two hours. You let out a long breath, full of a sense of accomplishment.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Conceptualized the cover and tagline.
description: Strike while the iron is hot. Take out a sheet of A4 white paper and start brainstorming the cover design. Quickly sketch a draft of "hand-drawn willow branches by Green Lake" in pencil, and write "elegant plain background, pairing light green and off-white" beside it. Then, in the "Creative Inspiration" section of your journal, write two candidate taglines: "In the breath of Kunming, discover the slow pace of life." and "Slowly wandering Kunming, hear your own echo." Take a photo for the record and prepare to send it to editor Xu Mingyuan for reference this week.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Short break and chatting with mother
description: After tidying your desk, you went to the living room and brewed a pot of jasmine tea. You sat on the sofa and chatted for a while with your mother, who was reading, letting your tense eyes and mind relax. You told Mom you might stay at the bookstore until evening, and she said she would cook dinner and wait for you.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the first draft of the event recap article
description: Back in the study, you opened a blank document and began writing the recap post for yesterday’s “Warm Winter” reading marathon. Using an “emotional guidance + fragmentary memories” approach, you opened with: “Reading without walls makes every share like a cluster of firelight in winter…” Then you incorporated the flower arrangement and city memories shared by the fellow readers yesterday, and interwove details about the flower-petal cakes. The language was warm and plain. By 11:40, a first draft of nearly 800 characters was completed smoothly, and you saved it into the event shared folder created by Uncle Qin Mingyuan.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunchtime with family
description: Mom served your favorite crossing-the-bridge rice noodles — piping hot chicken broth, rich side dishes, a standard Monday meal in Kunming. As you ate, you briefly shared the morning's work results with your parents. Your father praised your efficiency, and the family chatted in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday relaxation and journaling time
description: After lunch, you felt a little sleepy. You leaned back on the living room sofa instead of going straight back to the study. You took out your phone first and took two photos of the wax seal stamp and journal gifts that had been wrapped yesterday, sent them to your older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, and wrote: “Sister, the gifts are all wrapped! They look amazing!” After that, you opened your journal, pasted in the promotional copy and cover sketch you had conceived in the morning, and decorated the page with the newly arrived washi tape, feeling calm and happy inside.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: You put one and a half flower cakes into a canvas bag, took your fountain pen, planner, and power bank, put on a coat, and went out. The afternoon sun in Kunming was warm; it took only about ten minutes to walk from home to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. Walking along the plane-tree path by Cuihu Lake, feeling the breeze from the lake, you felt light-hearted.
location: Along the route from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road.

name: Writing Meditation Notes at the bookstore
description: You chose your usual window seat on the second floor and ordered a hot Americano. Opening your journal, you distilled the fragmentary imagery of breath, bodily sensations, and emotions from recent yoga and meditation practices into short poems. You wrote with focus and slow care, each poem four to eight lines long; after finishing each one, you neatly copied it out in fountain pen and added a small watercolor painting as decoration. By 4:15 p.m., you had completed ten short poems. After repeatedly revising the wording, you prepared to compile them into a collection titled 'Meditation Notes.'
location: Window-side seat on the second floor of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking around the bookstore and browsing new books.
description: With the writing session wrapped up, you went downstairs and wandered around the first floor of the bookstore. You flipped through a few newly arrived literary magazines and chatted briefly with Uncle Qin Mingyuan, who was tidying the bookshelves. He asked how your article was going, and you smiled and said it was going well. He gave you a thumbs-up.
location: 1st Floor, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returned home and bought milk tea.
description: After the tranquil time at the bookstore, you packed up and left. On the way back, you deliberately took a detour to the "Tea and Flowers" milk tea shop at the gate of the East Second Courtyard of Yunnan University, and bought yourself a hot brown sugar pearl milk tea at 50% sugar as a reward for a day of efficient work. Holding the warm milk tea, you slowly walked home.
location: Tea and Flowers Milk Tea Shop, No. 84 Yuantong North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and along the route

name: Shared dinner with family
description: As you walked in the door, the aroma of dinner came to meet you. At the dinner table, you excitedly shared with your parents the ten short poems from "Meditation Notes" that you had written at the bookstore today, and recited one about "breathing" to your mother. Your father listened carefully, while your mother smiled and said you had found your own style.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanied my father on a walk around the neighborhood.
description: After dinner, the sky gradually darkened. You walked arm in arm with your father in the community garden. The early winter evening breeze carried a chill, and withered yellow wutong leaves covered the path. You chatted, from your creative work to his retirement plans, the conversation light yet deep. You stopped, pointed to the last glow of sunset at the edge of the sky, and marveled at the charm of a Kunming winter.
location: Cuihu Community Garden, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Immersive evening reading.
description: After returning home from the walk, you took a hot shower and changed into comfortable pajamas. In the study, you brewed a cup of osmanthus tea, opened Wang Zengqi's "The Grass and Trees of the Human World," and found the chapter about Kunming. As you read, you took notes, carefully copying sentences like "Kunming's rainy season is bright, abundant, and stirring" into your notebook, feeling the deep affection for the city flowing through the words.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Thinking about the flower materials for the Ikebana class and washing up.
description: After closing the book, you began to plan the flower material arrangement for tomorrow's Wednesday ikebana class. You opened your phone, browsed a few push notifications from flower material subscription accounts, and jotted down a preliminary idea in your memo: "The main branch can use paperbush branches, and the guest branch can be paired with white daisies." Then you went to wash up, applied skincare, and did some simple neck stretches.
location: Study and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and closing meditation.
description: You leaned against the headboard, took out Miscellaneous Notes on Central Yunnan, and continued reading the chapter about Green Lake for several pages. Then you put down the book, turned off the bedside lamp, sat cross-legged on the bed, and did a five-minute bedtime meditation, letting your thoughts settle and feeling the inner peace and fullness after a day of work.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and creative notes
description: By the light of the bedside lamp, you open your journal and write down today’s important moments with a fountain pen: finishing organizing “Slow Travel Notes,” completing a first draft of the article, and creating ten pieces for “Meditation Notes.” Next to it, you also draw a simple sketch of a small cup of brown sugar milk tea and add a note: “The taste of creating is slightly bitter with a sweet aftertaste.”
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxation and sleep preparation.
description: After finishing your records, you felt a hint of drowsiness. You scrolled through Moments for a while and replied to a few comments about yesterday's event. At 22:45, you set your phone alarm, took a small sip of water, turned off the light, and lay down. With the heavy sense of satisfaction brought by a day's work, you slowly fell asleep in the Kunming night.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: Sunlight streamed into the bedroom through the curtains. After waking up naturally, she began a 30-minute morning practice on the yoga mat: first 10 minutes of Sun Salutation to wake up the body, then 10 minutes of Yin Yoga to stretch the shoulders, neck, and legs, and finally 10 minutes of seated meditation. Between breaths, she silently reviewed the ten short poems she had copied the day before at the bookstore from Meditation Notes, feeling the inner connection between the verses and the meditative state.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run along the Panlong River
description: Changed into workout clothes, walked 2 minutes from home to the Panlong River Trail next to Huashan West Road Metro Station, then ran north along the river to the intersection of Dongfeng West Road and turned back. In late November, the Kunming morning was slightly cool, about 9°C, but sunlight already covered the river. Completed 5 km steadily at a pace of about 7:15 per kilometer, and did post-run stretches on a bench near the turnaround point on Dongfeng West Road.
location: Along the Panlong River, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (near Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, heading north along the river to the intersection with Dongfeng West Road before turning back)

name: Purchasing flower materials after the morning run
description: On the way back from her morning run, Sun Yuwei passed by her usual flower shop "Huayu" and went in to talk with the familiar owner, Sister Wang. She confirmed that the main branch, paperbush, was in good condition and that the secondary branch, white daisies, was available in a full range of varieties. She reserved a suitable amount, asked the owner to keep it aside, and agreed to pick it up early the next morning and pay on site by scanning the QR code. Then she walked about 8 minutes home.
location: "Huayu" Flower Shop near the intersection of Cuihu South Road and Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shower and breakfast
description: After arriving home, she took a shower and changed into loungewear. Her mother Li Xiulan had prepared breakfast: whole-wheat bread, hot milk, and sliced kiwifruit and oranges. As she ate breakfast, she chatted with her mother about how the morning run felt and her plans for the day, mentioning that she would bring her brown sugar pearl milk tea after her afternoon yoga class.
location: Home at Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: After the workshop ended, mentally drained, she went to the balcony to drink warm water, gaze into the distance to rest her eyes and mind, and feel the breeze.
description: Moving to the study, she first turned on her computer and phone and logged into her Xiaohongshu alt account "Yuwei's Slow Notes." Using her camera, she photographed the pages of the ten short poems from "Meditation Notes" that she had copied into her journal, chose the one with the best lighting as the cover image, and paired it with a soft filter and the title text "Meditation Notes | Ten Short Poems Written Between Breaths." She published a text-and-image post of about 200 characters, along with her creative reflections, calling it "a natural outpouring after sustained yoga and meditation." After publishing, she actively replied to the first few reader comments. Then she forwarded the link to the poetry collection post to WeChat Moments and a freelance writers' WeChat group, refreshed her Xiaohongshu feed, and took screenshots of resonant reader comments as inspiration. She opened her journal and used a fountain pen to record the day's key moments: the morning meditation insights, the morning running route, and the first responses after the poetry collection was published. She then began planning the detailed flow and flower arrangement diagram for the next day's ikebana class. Next, she switched to work mode and opened her email to handle two solicitation letters: one from Editor Xu Mingyuan of Cultural Horizon, reminding her about next week's topic, and the other a solicitation from a travel public account. Then she opened the draft of a short essay prepared for Youth Literature, reviewed it from beginning to end, and, drawing on the feel for language gained from reading Plants in the Human World the night before, made subtle wording adjustments to the passage describing "food and memory" to make it more vivid.
location: Home study, Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and family time
description: She left the study and went to the kitchen to help her mother, who was preparing lunch; the two chatted about everyday things. Yuwei mentioned that she would buy two cups of brown sugar pearl milk tea on the way in the afternoon, one for herself and one for her mother. Her mother was very happy to hear this and told her not to come back too late.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: Had a simple and refreshing lunch with Mom: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, cold shredded chicken, and a bowl of hot soup. After the meal, Yuwei returned to her room, leaned against the headboard, and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes to recharge for the afternoon activities.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the yoga studio and buy milk tea
description: Changed into yoga clothes, took a canvas tote with phone, power bank, and notebook, and headed out. First walked 5 minutes to the “Tea and Flowers” milk tea shop on Fuchun Street, and as planned bought two cups of brown sugar pearl milk tea—one to drink in hand, one packed in an insulated bag. Then walked about 12 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, arrived early, and did basic warm-ups in the rest area.
