location: From the “Between Tea and Flowers” milk tea shop on the middle section of Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road

name: Afternoon yoga class
description: Class started on time at two. This session focused on consolidating the headstand. With the one-on-one assistance of Teacher He Lu, she was in excellent form today. She tried a slow lift-up and successfully held a stable headstand for more than 17 seconds, a small personal breakthrough. After class, she discussed ideas for flower material arrangements for tomorrow's flower arrangement class with Coach He Lu. He Lu suggested using eucalyptus leaves as filler for the supplementary main branch to add layers and a sense of line. Sun Yuwei found it inspiring and quickly wrote it down in her journal.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: After-Class Break and Note Organization
description: Leaving the yoga studio, I found a quiet corner in the familiar “Shicui” café downstairs, inserted a straw, and took a sip of the iced milk tea I'd brought along, feeling satisfied and relaxed. Using half an hour, I took out my notebook, quickly organized my class notes on the key points of headstand from yoga class, and added He Lu's suggestions on flower pairing.
location: Shicui Café, the street-front shop on the first floor of Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Refine the Dali travel plan with Fang Qing
description: Send a video call invitation to my friend Fang Qing, and the two of us begin a detailed discussion of the volunteer travel plan for March 2026. With screen sharing open on a shared document, we finalize the travel dates as March 7–21 and the route as: Dali Old Town – Weishan – Shaxi. We divide the work clearly: Fang Qing is responsible for booking hostels and contacting cultural experience programs, while I am responsible for finding lists of distinctive B&Bs, independent bookstores, and cafés, and filling the collected information into the spreadsheet. After about an hour, we wrap up the discussion happily.
location: The "Shicui" café, a street-facing shop on the first floor of Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (WeChat video call)

name: At the bookstore, handled manuscripts and exchanged ideas.
description: After the video ended, she walked ten minutes to the Paper, Cloth, and Stone Bookstore and sat down at her usual second-floor window seat. She opened her laptop, properly dealt with the backlog of writing-related emails, and did the final proofreading of the short essay drafts she had previously fine-tuned. Midway through, she went downstairs to chat with the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan and shared the good news that today’s poetry collection “Meditation Notes” had received over a hundred likes on Xiaohongshu. Uncle Qin was very happy and recommended “Winter at Green Lake” by a local writer.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening walk at Cuihu Lake and note-taking
description: Walking home from the bookstore, she deliberately took a detour, entering through the Renmin Middle Road side gate of Cuihu Park and walking around the lake. At 6 p.m., red-billed gulls fluttered over the lake, and the sunset glow dyed the water gold. She stopped, took out her phone, and snapped several photos with beautiful light and shadow. She chose the one she liked best and posted it in Moments with the caption, “Kunming's sunset is never stingy, especially with red-billed gulls.” Then she walked home in a happy mood.
location: Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (entered through the side gate on Renmin Middle Road, walked around the lake, then returned home).

name: Dinner time
description: After arriving home, she handed the milk tea in the insulated bag to her mother, who took it happily. Dinner was ready: stir-fried pea shoots, tomato and egg soup, and noodles mixed with the mushroom sauce left over from yesterday—full of flavor. Mother and daughter chatted over the meal about the photos of red-billed gulls they had just taken at Green Lake.
location: Home dining room, Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Watching a documentary with her mother
description: After dinner, I washed the fruit and snuggled with Mom on the living room sofa to watch the latest episode of “Once Upon a Bite.” When the segment about Yunnan ham and matsutake mushrooms came on, the two of us enthusiastically discussed different ways to eat them. Mom confirmed again her plan to make mushroom hot pot this weekend, and I excitedly nodded, saying I would go buy the freshest mushrooms.
location: Home living room, Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and course preparation
description: After the documentary ended, she returned to her room, opened her journal, and wrote down all the moments worth recording from the day: touching reader comments after the poetry collection was released, the sense of accomplishment from finalizing the travel plan with Fang Qing, the ease of successfully reserving flower materials, and the sunset and red-billed gulls she saw by Green Lake in the evening. Then she took out 'The Winter of Green Lake' recommended by Uncle Qin and read quietly for half an hour, underlining passages as she read. After closing the book, she handwrote a process card for tomorrow's flower arrangement class.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening washing up and getting ready for bed
description: Start the evening routine: wash my face carefully, do skincare, and soak my feet in hot water. While soaking my feet, I do a gentle pre-bed neck and shoulder stretch to relax the fatigue of the day.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home bedroom and bathroom)

name: Evening meditation and going to sleep.
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light. Sitting cross-legged on the bed, she closed her eyes and did a 10-minute meditation focused on breathing, silently reviewing the gentle moments of the day — the morning sunlight, the breakthrough of completing a headstand, the smile on her mother's face when she drank the milk tea, and the sunset by Green Lake. After finishing in a calm state, she lay down, dimmed the light, and let images of tomorrow's flower arrangement class and the winter scenery of Green Lake drift through her mind, gradually falling asleep with satisfaction and peace.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 402, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and washing up
description: The alarm rang at 6 a.m. Sun Yuwei did yoga in the bedroom, completing 5 rounds of Sun Salutation A to wake up her body, then did 15 minutes of seated meditation, focusing on her breath and gradually calming her mind. Afterward, she washed up in the bathroom, washed her face with warm water, carefully combed her long hair, and tied it into a loose side ponytail.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and housework time
description: Sun Yuwei had breakfast with her mother, eating milk, fried eggs, and flower cakes. While eating, she checked the reader comments on Meditation Notes, which she had posted on Xiaohongshu the day before, and sent screenshots of heartwarming comments to a friend. Afterward, she helped her mother clear the dishes. Her mother reminded her not to be nervous about the meeting with her editor in the afternoon, and mentioned the mushroom soup she had wanted to drink yesterday. Sun Yuwei promised to buy wild mushrooms on the weekend.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare communication materials for publication.
description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the study and, based on an email from editor Xu Mingyuan, made a detailed checklist for the publication coordination of “Slow Travel Notes,” including confirming the book title, choosing the cover style, deciding the direction of the promotional tagline, and setting publication milestones. She copied the key points into her notebook. During a break, she stood by the window to relax and recalled the headstand technique she had learned in yoga class.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Takeout snacks for an extra meal
description: Feeling hungry, Sun Yuwei found a shop called "Huajian Snacks" on a food delivery app and ordered a portion of crispy mung bean cakes and a cup of hot soy milk as a snack. After enjoying them alone at home, she felt her energy restored.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Sun Yuwei helped her mother wash vegetables and rinse rice, and together they prepared stir-fried pork with green peppers, dressed lotus root slices, and seaweed and pork rib soup for lunch. During the meal, her mother shared an excellent essay by a student in her class about winter in Kunming, which inspired the angle for her new prose piece.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon nap
description: To ensure she had enough energy for the afternoon call with the editor, Sun Yuwei took a 30-minute nap in the bedroom. After the alarm went off, she felt much better.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Rehearsal before the conversation
description: After washing her face, Sun Yuwei sat back down at her desk, went through the communication checklist again, and sent a WeChat message to editor Xu Mingyuan to confirm the 2 p.m. call. Then she practiced her opening remarks in the mirror, adjusting her tone to sound confident and not nervous.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Phone call with the editor
description: Sun Yuwei had an in-depth hour-long conversation with editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat voice call. They confirmed that the title Slow Travel Notes had passed the initial review and decided to use her hand-painted watercolor of willow branches by Green Lake as the cover. The promotional tagline was set as "In Kunming's slow time, rediscover life as it originally was." She also received follow-up suggestions such as preparing an author bio and promotional photos.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Organize the call summary and share the good news
description: After hanging up, Sun Yuwei quickly opened her memo app and jotted down the consensus and action items from the call. Then she sent a voice message in the "Three of Us" bestie group chat, sharing the good news that the cover was confirmed with her friends Zhang Jing and Wang Xinran, and received warm congratulations.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to the yoga studio
description: Sun Yuwei put on her thick wool coat, knitted hat, and scarf, then set off from home and walked about 15 minutes along Huashan West Road and Dongfeng West Road to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, feeling happy.
location: Along the route from Huashan West Road to Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Ikebana class
description: After changing at the yoga studio, Sun Yuwei attended a flower arrangement class. With the theme "Winter Vitality", she created a free-style arrangement using dragon willow branches, yellow lilies, and areca palm leaves. The teacher praised her work, saying it had "smooth lines and a positive, uplifting energy." After class, she carefully placed her work into a canvas bag.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Fetching Floral Materials and Returning Home
description: After the class, Sun Yuwei made a detour to 'Huayu Tianmeng Guesthouse' and flower shop on Caisheng Lane to pick up the carnation bouquet she had ordered and the eucalyptus leaves the shop owner had set aside for her as requested. Then she walked back to her home in Cuihu Community, ready to use the flowers for her evening floral design assignment.
location: Huayu Tianmeng Homestay, Caisheng Alley, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking with her parents around Green Lake
description: Sun Yuwei went for a walk with her parents in Green Lake Park. In the early winter evening, black-headed gulls circled over the lake and the sunset glow was brilliant. She officially announced the good news about her publishing progress to her parents; her father rarely smiled and encouraged her. The family rested on a stone bench by the lake and shared what they had learned in the flower arrangement class.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Family dinner
description: After the walk, the family returned home for dinner. Mother cooked a fragrant mushroom hot pot with fresh mushrooms. Sun Yuwei described in detail her communications with the editor and her future creative plans, while her father occasionally nodded in agreement.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Organizing publishing notes and creating journal entries
description: In her study, Sun Yuwei entered the afternoon's communication points and to-do items (polish the author bio, take promotional photos, and write an author's note) into her creative notebook. In her journal, she drew a gold star with a marker and wrote, '2025.11.26 Milestone reached. Slow Walk Notes officially begins.' She also printed photos of her flower arrangement class works and pasted them into the journal.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and outlining a new essay
description: Sun Yuwei read "The Winter of Green Lake" recommended by Uncle Qin. The allusion to Listening to Orioles Bridge in the book inspired her to create a new essay, "The Four Seasons on the Bridge". She turned off the computer and used pen and paper to write an elegant opening that combined red-billed gulls, flower path insights, and historical allusions.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime ritual
description: Sun Yuwei began her nightly routine: she washed up, soaked her feet in hot water with lavender essential oil, and did simple shoulder and neck stretches at the same time. Then she wrote in her diary in the bedroom, recording the reflection, 'Today is a day when dreams shine.' After turning off the light, she practiced loving-kindness meditation, sending blessings to herself, her family, and all her supporters, her heart filled with gratitude and calm.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Sun Yuwei set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode and fell asleep peacefully with a satisfied smile, bringing a fulfilling day to a close.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Morning Yin yoga and meditation.
description: When she woke up in the morning, her throat was dry and itchy, so she gave up the intense morning run she had planned. She unrolled her yoga mat in the bedroom and did 30 minutes of yin yoga and breathing exercises, focusing on stretching the shoulders, neck, and chest. Afterward, she drank her first glass of warm water and felt her body slowly waking up.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cuihu Park Morning Jog and Health Care
description: Walked from home to Green Lake Park. Because of a sore throat, adjusted the planned 5 km jog to 3 km (pace 8:30 per km). After the run, rested on a lakeside bench and drank the warm water she had brought. Along the way, she saw black-headed gulls circling in the sky and felt relaxed.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Going Home, Showering, Breakfast, and Family Warmth
description: After jogging home, I showered and changed into comfortable loungewear. Breakfast was small wontons and boiled eggs made by my mother. While eating, I took the initiative to ask my mother about the carnations. She smiled, answered, and said she had shown them to my father, who was pleasantly surprised. The two of us chatted happily for a while.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-breakfast cleanup and work preparation
description: Back in the study, she opened her laptop, logged in to email and WeChat, confirmed that the editor, Mr. Xu Mingyuan, had no new messages, then placed the cover design sketch and watercolor swatches she had conceived yesterday within reach, preparing for the next stage of creation.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Write the cover design proposal and promotional slogan.
description: Focused on writing the cover design proposal for the essay collection "Slow Travel Notes". Opened the document and described the visual elements in detail: using the drooping willow branches by Green Lake as the main visual, with a light gray-green background to render the misty feeling of a winter morning. Wrote a 50-character creative explanation for the tagline "Every act of writing is a deep breath of this city", and drew a simple sketch. After repeated revisions, at 11:50 packaged the final proposal and tagline document, sent it by email to editor Mr. Xu Mingyuan, and left a message on WeChat.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and rest
description: My mother made tomato and egg noodles. While eating, I told her about the morning's work achievements, and she expressed strong support. After the meal, I voluntarily cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and throat recovery
description: Back in the bedroom, I drew the curtains, dimmed the lights, put on a steam eye mask, and took a short nap of about 40 minutes. Before falling asleep, I sent my older sister a voice message, telling her my throat was a little sore but the work was going smoothly. When I woke up, my throat felt a bit better, and I drank a glass of water with a vitamin C effervescent tablet.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Restorative yoga class
description: Changed into yoga clothes, brought a water bottle and a change of clothes, and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. After arriving, she told instructor He Lu about her sore throat. He Lu thoughtfully adjusted the originally planned intense vinyasa flow class to a session themed 'neck relaxation and recovery'. During the class she did gentle poses such as Cat-Cow, Shoulder Bridge, and Fish, coordinated with Ujjayi breathing, and felt her entire upper back release. After class, He Lu reminded her to drink more pear soup, which is good for the throat.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Commuted by subway to Dounan Flower Market.
description: After tidying up her personal items in the yoga studio changing room, she put on a mask and walked to Dongfeng Square Station on Metro Line 2/Line 3. She took Line 3 to Dongfeng Square Station, transferred to Line 2 for Huancheng South Road Station, and then transferred to Line 1 to Dounan Station. On the metro, she wore earphones and listened to a podcast about gardening to pass the commute time.
location: Along the metro from Dongfeng Square Station to Dounan Station, Kunming, Yunnan Province (via Metro Line 3, Line 2, Line 1)

name: Purchasing floral materials at Dounan Flower Market
description: After exiting the metro station, she walked to the main hall of Dounan Flower Market. On Thursday afternoon there weren't many people, so she went straight to the fresh-cut flower section with a clear goal. She found a familiar flower vendor and selected eucalyptus leaves, Australian wax flowers, white ranunculus, and added a small bunch of 'Shan Guilai' red berry branches. While choosing the ranunculus, she took a photo and sent it to her floral designer friend Su Man for advice. Su Man replied that the colors were a perfect match. After purchasing, she asked the vendor to carefully wrap the flowers in newspaper.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return trip: from the flower market to home
description: Carrying a large bunch of flower materials, she took the metro back to the city from Dounan Metro Station, carefully protecting the flowers from being squeezed when transferring.
location: Along the metro from Dounan Station to Dongfeng Square Station, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: After returning home, she processed the flower materials.
description: Immediately after arriving home, she unpacked the flower materials, cut the stem ends diagonally with scissors, removed excess leaves, and placed them in several cleaned flower buckets by category. The living room was instantly filled with the crisp, cool fragrance of eucalyptus leaves, and she felt joyful.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner was home-style cooking made by my mother. At the table, my father asked about the publishing progress, and I reported in detail on today's design proposal. My mother was delighted to see the flower materials in the living room and said that after arranging a vase in the future, she would also take a photo to show her old friends. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening at home: talking with parents and watercolor practice in journal
description: After dinner, she had originally wanted to accompany her parents for a walk around Green Lake, but because her throat felt uncomfortable, she told them she would not go out for a walk that night. Her parents urged her with concern to drink more water and go to bed early, and her mother cut a plate of pears. Later, under the desk lamp in the study, she first recorded the day's work progress and what she had seen at the flower market in her journal. Then she took a branch of Australian wax flower from the flower bucket, placed it on the desk, mixed watercolors, observed the petal layers and light and shadow, and painted a small study from life. After finishing, she took a photo and sent it to her close friend Zhou Lin, asking whether it could be made into a sticker. Zhou Lin replied that the colors were great and suggested the lines could be crisper.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and health care
description: After washing up, she made a cup of warm honey water and drank it slowly. She put a drop of tea tree essential oil into the humidifier and placed it in the bedroom. After lying down in bed, she used her phone to record today's weight (46.9 kg) and set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: To relax, she didn't look at her phone but picked up the copy of Wang Zengqi's 'The Grass and Trees of the Human World' on the nightstand, flipped to the essay about Kunming's rain and mushrooms, and read for 20 minutes.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Sleep
description: Turning off the desk lamp, she fell asleep quietly in the faint scent of eucalyptus leaves and with a slight discomfort in her throat.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and journaling
description: Woke up at 6 in the morning and felt that the throat discomfort had eased. Changed into yoga clothes and did yoga meditation in the bedroom, focusing on abdominal breathing and alternate-nostril breathing, with neck stretches. After meditating, I used the A5 journal by the bedside to record yesterday's weight and today's feelings, and wrote down today's keywords: 'sorting out and connecting'.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: After the morning ritual, she went to the dining room, where her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared rock sugar, pear, and white fungus soup. As they ate, the mother and daughter chatted about the day's plans: writing a friend's recommendation in the afternoon and an online sharing session in the evening. Her mother reminded her to dress warmly as the temperature was dropping, and they discussed the evening grocery shopping list. The breakfast time was simple and warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Commutted to Yunnan University's Donglu Campus
description: After breakfast, changed into a thick hoodie and a thin down jacket, carried a canvas backpack, and walked to Exit B of Huashan West Road Metro Station. Took Metro Line 2 to Huancheng South Road Station, transferred to Line 5 to Yuantongshan Station, and after exiting walked to the Donglu Campus of Yunnan University. Along the way, felt the winter morning air and saw the black-headed gulls on Cuihu Lake from afar.
location: Kunming Metro Line 2 from Huashan West Road Station to Yuantongshan Station on Line 5, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Monthly expense tracking and budget planning at the library
description: After arriving at the self-study area on the second floor of the Yifu Building Library on Yunnan University’s Donglu Campus, I connected to the campus network, opened the mobile banking app and my journal. Starting at 8:30, I checked the November credit card, debit card, Alipay, and WeChat bills transaction by transaction and recorded the expenses by category. I found that because of my sore throat, food delivery and ride-hailing had increased, pushing food and transportation spending over budget. I then made a December budget: set a savings goal of 1500 yuan, allocated 1000 yuan for food, 300 yuan for transportation, 300 yuan for shopping, and 400 yuan for study and entertainment, and noted, “Keep spending steady and return to simplicity.” At 11:30, I completed the financial planning.
location: Second-floor study area of Yifu Building Library, Donglu Campus of Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday outdoor activities: a stroll around Cuihu Lake, lunch, and a bookstore trip.
description: After logging her expenses, she packed up her things and left the library. Wearing headphones and listening to the instrumental music “Meditation Notes,” she walked along the path by Green Lake and photographed black-headed gulls, sending the photos to her elder sister Sun Yutong. On a bench, she read through the final draft of her friend Yang Xiao's novel “The Alley” to prepare for the afternoon recommendation. At 12:10, she went to the “Suyu” vegetarian restaurant outside the west gate of Green Lake and ordered tomato and mushroom soup noodles with less oil and salt, discussing the recommendation with Yang Xiao over WeChat. After eating, she took a detour to “Paper, Cloth, Stone,” an independent bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road, where she chatted with the owner Qin Mingyuan, selected a watercolor postcard of the Fish-Watching Tower at Green Lake as the medium for the recommendation, browsed People's Literature, and agreed to attend the bookstore's new-book sharing event the following week. At 13:20, she left the bookstore and walked home.
location: Cuihu Park, 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; the vegetarian bistro on Cuihu South Road; Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road; then returned to Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Afternoon rest and sorting flower materials.
description: After arriving home, changed into loungewear, first went to the balcony to arrange the flower materials brought back from Dounan: trimmed the withered leaves of the wilted white ranunculus, cut the stems diagonally, and rehydrated them in deep water; the Australian wax flowers were in good condition. Then rested on the sofa with eyes closed for 15 minutes to regain energy.
location: Living room and balcony at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: In-depth reading and writing a recommendation.
description: At her desk in the study, she made a cup of monk fruit tea, opened her laptop and the final draft of Alleyway, and read immersively. The story's depiction of the demolishing of an old alley resonated with her, and she jotted down keywords as she read. After finishing, she wrote a recommendation on a Green Lake postcard with a fountain pen, striving to convey the novel's texture of intertwining reality and dreams. Afterward, she took a photo and sent it to Yang Xiao, and received a moved reply.
location: Study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free writing and interacting with the writing community.
description: After finishing the recommendation, she opened the WeChat group chat of the Ink and Breath writing community, browsed the members' discussions, and shared her inspiration from reading Lane Entrance and how she developed the recommendation as a warm-up for the evening sharing session. She replied to private messages from several book friends and agreed to write A Letter to an Alley for the group's next newsletter.
location: Study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shopping for ingredients with Mother in the evening
description: At 5:00 p.m., she reminded her mother to go out, and the two walked to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at No. 98 Fuchun Street. Following the shopping list, they bought healthy ingredients including chicken breast, soft tofu, broccoli, and tomatoes, and her mother taught her tips for choosing broccoli. When passing the snack section, she restrained her urge to buy, as the budget was set; she planned to reward herself on her birthday next week. Her mother paid in cash as a reward for her daughter's budget-management efforts today. After shopping, they walked home.
location: From the City Garden supermarket at No. 98 Fuchun Street, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, returning home to Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road.

name: Returning home to portion out ingredients and prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, she sorted through the purchased ingredients with her mother: they cut the chicken breast into pieces, portioned them, and froze them, and washed and cut the vegetables as prepared dishes for the next day. The mother and daughter chatted and laughed in the kitchen, and also shared the white fungus soup made that morning.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner time
description: Father Sun Mingyuan came home from work, and the family of three had dinner together. The meal was light: tomato and tofu soup, stir-fried broccoli, and steamed pumpkin. At the table, they shared the joy of today's bookkeeping results and writing a recommendation letter for a good friend, discussed the December budget execution plan, and the conversation turned to the new shop in the neighborhood and her father's weekend union activity.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Online writing sharing session.
description: She opened Tencent Meeting on time to attend the online sharing session of the “Ink and Breath” writing community, themed “Turning Daily Observations into Creative Work.” Sun Yuwei drew on her personal work “Meditation Notes” and her experience writing the day’s recommendation to share how she extracts writing material from daily life in Kunming (such as the red-billed gulls at Green Lake, old alleys, and the vegetable market). The sharing received an enthusiastic response; she answered questions carefully and noted down ideas worth exploring further. After the meeting, she agreed to write a summary article for the next issue of the newsletter.
location: Study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Journaling and Inspiration Curation
description: After the sharing session, she returned to the journal and recorded the day's financial planning, the recommendation writing, the shopping, and the takeaways from the online sharing. In the 'Today's Inspiration' section, she wrote writing directions such as 'City Narrative Beginning with a Bowl of Tomato Soup.' Flipping through 'The Winter of Green Lake,' she underlined a touching passage about 'winter mist.'
location: Study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime routine and going to bed
description: At 10 p.m., I started the bedtime routine: took a hot shower, soaked my feet with tea tree essential oil, and browsed watercolor flower tutorials on Xiaohongshu, bookmarking the step-by-step diagram for Wintersweet in the Snow. Then I did a 10-minute bedtime stretch on the bedroom floor to relax my waist and shoulders. Then I lay in bed reading the final chapter of Green Lake in Winter. At 11 p.m., I turned off the lights and fell asleep on time. My throat had fully recovered, and I drifted off with satisfaction and anticipation.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; bathroom and bedroom at home.

name: Morning yoga meditation and morning run.
description: At 6:00 a.m., Sun Yuwei did 30 minutes of flow yoga on the north bay window cushion in her bedroom at home, focusing on alternating breathing techniques and feeling the ease of breathing after recovering from a cold. She then sat in meditation for 10 minutes, focusing her attention on today's pottery course completion and writing group activity. After meditation, she changed into sportswear and jogged from Green Lake Community to the Panlong River, easily completing a 5 km run along the riverside trail (pace about 7:50 per kilometer) in warm sunshine with a gentle breeze. After the run, she power-walked for 20 minutes as cross-training to relax her leg muscles, and began jogging home around 7:30. The entire morning workout effectively awakened her body and mind, injecting energy into the day.
location: From Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to the banks of the Panlong River (Wuhua District section)

name: Shower, change clothes, and a healthy breakfast
description: After getting home, I took a hot shower and changed into a comfortable light gray hoodie and cotton pants. For breakfast, I made a whole wheat toast and fried egg sandwich with fresh lettuce and tomato, paired with a kiwi and a glass of warm water. I deliberately filled my thermos with warm water to be ready for being out all day.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Getting ready before going out and journaling
description: After breakfast, she returned to the study, opened her journal, and stuck on the "Pottery Course Completed" schedule sticker. She checked the items in her commuter bag: bus card, coin purse, thermos, tissues, and phone. She poured some of the pear soup her mother had made the night before into a small thermos, to quench her thirst during the morning at the studio.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Commuting to the pottery studio in Guandu District
description: Walked from home to Exit A of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Line 5 to Wuyi Road Station, transferred to Line 2 to Guandu Ancient Town Station, and the whole trip took about 50 minutes. On the train, I put on earphones, played light music on repeat, and watched through the window as the city gradually gave way to Guandu District. I felt full of anticipation for the upcoming completion of the pottery course.
location: Along the route of Kunming Metro Line 5 from Huashan West Road Station to Guandu Ancient Town Station on Line 2.

name: Ceramics workshop wrap-up: kiln opening and work exchange.
description: Arrived on time at Taoran Pottery Studio in Guandu Ancient Town for the most important final kiln-opening ceremony. With her fellow students gathered around the kiln, she watched Teacher Wu Mingyuan slowly open the kiln door. Sun Yuwei carefully took out seven personal pieces: a small speckled-glaze bowl with a warm and smooth glaze, a teacup clay body with smooth lines, and several irregular small plates with natural shapes. The kiln room was filled with the distinctive smell of fired clay. She examined each piece closely and asked a classmate to help take photos with her phone as a memento. Then, she presented the speckled-glaze bowl she was most satisfied with to her mentor Wu Mingyuan with both hands, sincerely expressing her gratitude for the insights into the creative process gained from pottery over the twelve-week course. Teacher Wu praised her idea of bringing the creative sensitivity of “clay and fire” into literature. The other students also shared their reflections on their own works, and the atmosphere was warm and full of accomplishment.
location: Taoran Pottery Studio, Guandu Ancient Town, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch and a stroll in Guandu Ancient Town
description: After leaving the studio, Sun Yuwei walked with her packed meal to a quiet community park in Guandu Ancient Town, sat on a bench beside the Cloud-Water Corridor, and enjoyed lunch: hummus and whole wheat flatbread, with warm water from a thermos. While eating, she used her phone’s memo app to note down the glaze color details and inspiration for one piece of work. After the meal, she strolled leisurely along the old streets and alleys of the ancient town (around Zhuangyuan Street and the Jingang Pagoda), carefully observing the textures of brick walls and the clinking sounds from silver-smithing shops. She used her phone to photograph the richly textured wooden carvings and lattice windows of old buildings, and touched the indigo printed cloth at the entrance of a tailor shop, deeply feeling the warmth of traditional handicrafts.
location: Community park and old lanes beside the Yunshui Corridor in Guandu Ancient Town, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Commuting back to Wuhua District
description: Took the metro back from Guandu Ancient Town Station, transferred at Wuyi Road Station, got off at Huashan West Road Station, and after about 30 minutes walked to Mingyuan Book House beside Paper, Cloth, Stone Bookstore to prepare in advance for the afternoon writing group activity.
location: Along the Kunming Metro from Guandu Ancient Town Station on Line 2 to Huashan West Road Station on Line 5.

name: The writing group's fourth offline activity and wrap-up
description: Sun Yuwei arrived early at Mingyuan Bookstore and took the initiative to help set up the event venue: arranging tables and chairs, adjusting the projector, and preparing the sign-in sheet. Then she sat down in the window-side sofa area on the second floor, took out the draft of her essay "Reflections of Kunming" to reread and revise the wording, making final preparations for the reading. At 15:00 the event officially began. She hosted the fourth offline meeting of the "Ink and Breath" writing group, themed "The Origin of Writing and the City," and read her latest essay "A Walk with My Father by Cuihu Lake." Her voice was clear and sincere, earning warm applause and positive feedback from the whole group. In the latter part of the event, everyone exchanged manuscripts and agreed to continue giving mutual feedback online. After the event, Yuwei helped tidy up the venue, then went downstairs to Zhibushi Bookstore to buy the latest issue of Prose magazine, and had a brief conversation with the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan about the day's event.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, 2nd Floor, Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Supermarket shopping and helping with cooking at home
description: I walked from the bookstore to City Garden Supermarket, checked the shopping list in my journal, and bought fresh pears and oranges to supplement vitamins. I also picked up a discounted pack of mushroom hot pot soup base, planning to share it with the family another day. Then I walked about 15 minutes back to my home in the Green Lake community. Once home, I washed the fruit, then took the initiative to help my mother Li Xiulan prepare dinner in the kitchen: washing rice and picking and washing vegetables (bok choy and enoki mushrooms). The mother and daughter chatted while they worked, and Yuwei excitedly told stories about the morning's ceramics kiln opening and the afternoon writing group's funny moments.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and after-dinner chores
description: The family of three sat around the dining table, enjoying a light and warm dinner: tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried greens, and a steaming bowl of mushroom chicken soup made by her mother. Yuwei took out her phone to show her parents photos of her pottery works and vividly described the details of her exchange with Teacher Wu Mingyuan. Her father Sun Mingyuan praised her for making great progress, and her mother curiously studied the small spotted glaze bowl on the screen. After dinner, Yuwei took the initiative to clear the dishes, wash the bowls, and wipe down the stove. Then she accompanied her parents to the living room to watch CCTV News and the weather forecast. Her father mentioned the temperature drop next week, and her mother told her to put on more clothes.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Journaling and artistic creation in the study.
description: Back in the study, under the warm desk lamp, she opened her journal and neatly pasted in the small printed photo of the pottery work, group photos from the event, a supermarket receipt, and bus ticket stubs. With a fountain pen, she wrote the day's core reflection: "Pottery is the tempering of clay and fire; writing is the tempering of thought and feeling." Then she took out watercolor paints and, from memory, sketched a small speckle-glazed bowl with relaxed lines and elegant colors, tucking the drawing into the manuscript of her essay collection to leave an artistic mark on the day.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening relaxation and social connection
description: After finishing her journal entry, Sun Yuwei made herself a cup of chrysanthemum tea. Picking up her phone, she saw a message from her friend Yang Xiao, who was full of praise for the recommendation blurb she had helped write for Alley Entrance the night before. Yuwei happily replied and shared the joy and sense of accomplishment from today's pottery kiln opening. The two simply agreed to catch up in more detail next week. Afterward, she browsed a few literary WeChat public accounts she followed to relax.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening wash-up and pre-bedtime reading and meditation
description: At 22:00 she began her bedtime routine: she brushed her teeth carefully, washed her face with facial cleanser, and applied Vaseline hand cream, leaving her hands feeling moisturized. Back in the bedroom, she put the books and notebook for the next day on the nightstand and set the alarm for 8:30. After turning off the main light, she opened the newly purchased 'Prose' magazine under the bedside lamp and read an essay about an ancient water town in Jiangnan for about 15 minutes. At 22:45 she put down the book, did five minutes of breathing meditation to let her mind completely relax, and then turned off the light and fell asleep around 23:00, drifting into a dream with the fullness and satisfaction of the day.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning yoga meditation and morning run preparation
description: Waking up in the late-autumn morning light filtering through the curtains, she first did five minutes of abdominal breathing and 25 minutes of gratitude meditation in bed, focusing on her heartbeat and breathing rhythm and feeling grateful for the past year of physical and mental growth. After meditation, she changed into a quick-dry long-sleeved shirt, leggings, and running shoes, packed her phone, keys, and an energy gel into her waist pack, and got ready for a morning run.
location: Bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Long-distance easy run along the Panlong River and post-run stretching
description: Walked to the bank of the Panlong River and started a long slow run at 07:00, aiming to break 8 km at a pace of 7:30 per kilometer. I ran along the riverside greenway to the base of Yuantong Bridge and back, about 60 minutes in total. During the run, my breathing was smooth, my shoulders and neck relaxed, and my endurance improved noticeably. After the run, I stretched thoroughly for 10 minutes on the riverside viewing platform to loosen my calves and hips.
location: Panlong River riverside walkway, Jiangbin West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home, showering, and having a cozy breakfast.
description: After finishing her jog, she walked home and took a warm shower to ease her muscle soreness. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared breakfast: steaming shredded chicken congee, fried eggs, and a small plate of pickled vegetables. While eating, she shared the joy of her morning run with her mother and told her that she would do her annual journal summary in the morning and go to Zhibushi Bookstore in the afternoon.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Study organization and in-depth annual journal summary
description: Back in the study, she opened the windows for ventilation, put the wet clothes in the washing machine, tidied the desk, and took out her 2025 planner, colored gel pens, washi stickers, and the iPad containing her digital materials. Using the memo app on her phone, she listed an outline for the morning summary. She then spent more than two hours carefully checking the year's data: 27 submissions, 19 published articles, total royalties of 86,000 yuan, 168 yoga sessions, 2 trips (Xi'an, Xishuangbanna), and 57 books read. With a fountain pen, she neatly wrote the data on the annual summary page, adding a small illustration beside each category (such as a money bag beside the royalties and a little figure beside the yoga). In the finance section, she solemnly recorded her first regular fund investment (CSI 300) and affixed five fallen-leaf stickers to symbolize settling and renewal. Finally, she spent 15 minutes writing her year-end outlook: try making okara cookies and write the first draft of a new essay.
location: Home study, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went out to buy fruit and mushroom ingredients
description: After finishing her journal, she took a short break and drank some water. Remembering her mother's advice to drink more water to relieve dryness, she decided to go to the supermarket to buy pears and oranges. From home, she walked along Huashan West Road to the Dushi Mingyuan supermarket on Fuchun Street. In the fresh food section, she chose a box of matsutake mushrooms and a pack of jizong mushrooms; in the fruit section, she picked five fresh pears and a few oranges. She paid by mobile phone, and the receipt amount was automatically recorded in the bookkeeping app. After shopping, she walked home and arrived at exactly 12:30.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Huguo Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch break and collecting essay inspiration
description: Mother made simple tomato and egg noodles for lunch. After eating, she leaned back on the living room sofa, flipped through an article about southern alleyways in the Prose magazine she had bought yesterday, and jotted down a few inspiration keywords in her phone memo, laying the groundwork for a new piece of prose.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bookstore postcard consignment settlement and cultural creative ideas
description: In the afternoon, she walked from home to the Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. The owner, Qin Mingyuan, was organizing the bookshelves. The two sat down in the back seats and conducted the final settlement for the consignment of the “Four Seasons of Green Lake” postcards: about 30 had been sold, and she received the balance payment; the remaining 20 unsold ones were given to the bookstore as decoration or giveaways. Uncle Qin was very interested in the suggestion of making them into a watercolor album, and the two chatted for ten minutes. Sun Yuwei noted down her initial idea for a “Green Lake Watercolor Series illustrated book” in her notebook.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon stroll in Green Lake Park and observation of daily life
description: After leaving the bookstore, took a small path into Green Lake Park. Under the warm late-autumn sun, she sat on a bench watching red-billed gulls circling and playing, and took photos with her phone. She noticed vivid details of a group of elderly people sitting around playing chess and children chasing bubbles, and silently filed them away in her mind as writing material. Then she walked slowly along the lakeshore to the south gate exit and walked home.
location: Cuihu Park, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga and meditation effect summary and healthy eating plan
description: First, on the yoga mat in front of the bedroom window, she reviewed the November meditation records, compared them with the draft of Meditation Notes, and wrote an assessment: shoulder and neck stiffness had noticeably decreased, time to fall asleep had shortened to 20 minutes, and anxiety had basically disappeared. Then she took the initiative to go to the living room and read the summary aloud to her mother, sharing her creative insights; her mother was gratified and praised her. Back in the study, on the healthy-eating page of her journal, she reviewed how the plan had gone from November 10 to 30: her weight had slowly risen from 46.5 kg to 47 kg, and both her skin condition and energy levels had improved. She planned a December meal plan, continuing the pattern of preparing in advance on weekends and simplifying on workdays, and made a note to find time next week to try making okara cookies.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family mushroom hot pot dinner and annual sharing
description: I went into the kitchen to help my mother. I carefully washed the matsutake mushrooms, sliced the termite mushrooms, and soaked the bamboo fungus to prepare for the evening's mushroom hot pot, chatting about household matters while working. My father, Sun Mingyuan, came home on time, and the three of us sat around the dinner table. During the meal, I shared highlights from my annual journal and the news that my prose collection "Slow Travel Notes" had been scheduled for publication and was awaiting release. My parents praised my discipline and growth over the past year. After dinner, I helped clear the dishes and we kept chatting.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with elder sister to share life updates
description: For the Sunday routine, I had a video call with my sister Sun Yutong. I excitedly showed off today's annual journal pages, a screenshot of my 8 km morning run data, and photos of yesterday's pottery work—a small bowl with speckled glaze. My sister shared funny stories from her company in Shenzhen, encouraged me to keep it up, and we agreed that next time we meet, we have to go to a local pottery studio together.
location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening relaxation: washing up, soaking feet, meditating, and going to sleep
description: At 21:30, started washing up and changed into comfortable cotton pajamas. Soaked feet in a foot bath bucket for 15 minutes to relieve fatigue. At 22:10, lay in bed and opened the Tide app for a 10-minute body scan meditation, moving attention from the top of the head to the toes, feeling the shoulders and neck relax and the heart rate steady. After the meditation, said goodnight softly and fell asleep peacefully at 22:30.
location: Bedroom at home, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Huashan Subdistrict, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: At six in the morning, I spent 15 minutes doing breathing meditation alone at the meditation platform by the bedroom window at home in Green Lake Community, feeling my body awaken. Then I completed 15 minutes of vinyasa yoga stretching to help wake up quickly and relax my shoulders and neck, welcoming the new day in a fresh state.
location: Meditation platform by the bedroom window at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up, personal care, and changing clothes
description: After meditating, I washed up in the bathroom with warm water, applied skincare products and sunscreen, then returned to the bedroom and changed into a cream knit top, dark blue straight-leg jeans, and a gray scarf, completing my daily personal care and dressing.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: In the dining room, she had breakfast with her mother, Li Xiulan. On the table were hot milk, whole-wheat bread, and fruit. The mother and daughter chatted casually. Her mother asked about the day's plans and reminded her to come home for lunch.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore and carry out annual workspace maintenance
description: She brought her notebook, power bank, and other items, put on her earphones, and walked about 13 minutes from home to the Paper Stone Bookstore. After briefly greeting the owner Qin Mingyuan, she carried out the annual maintenance at her fixed workstation on the second floor: she carefully removed the old sticky notes, archived more than a hundred of them by month, and put up New Year decorations such as 'Fu' character cards and dried pussy willow branches, giving the workstation a fresh new look, and took photos to mark the occasion.
location: Dedicated seat on the second floor of Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Ran into a reader and had a brief exchange
description: While tidying up at her workstation, she was recognized by a young female reader next to her as the author of Slow Travel Notes. The reader expressed her admiration, and the two talked for more than ten minutes. The reader took the initiative to add her on WeChat and said she would follow the official account.
location: Workstation area on the second floor of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Exploring the bookstore and choosing books.
description: She browsed slowly through each floor of Zhibushi Bookstore and finally bought Dianchi Reflections: Ten Years of an Ecological Photographer and a secondhand copy of Yunnan Flora Notes, seeking inspiration for her flower arrangement and watercolor work.
location: All floors of Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Check out and walk to Douhua Rice Noodle shop for lunch.
description: After paying at the bookstore counter and saying goodbye to the owner, she walked for about 12 minutes to the Nanmen Tofu Pudding Rice Noodle Shop, where she dined in on a steaming bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles, flipping through the new books she had bought as she ate, enjoying the warm midday time.
location: Nanmen Tofu Pudding Rice Noodles (Cuihu Diamond World Branch), No. 5 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Return home for a short rest and work with the editor to complete the materials for the topic selection meeting.
description: After lunch, I walked home, first rested with my eyes closed on the living room sofa for 15 minutes, then went to the study, turned on the computer, and worked with online editor Xu Mingyuan to review the final draft of the topic selection meeting for 'Slow Travel Notes'. I proposed minor adjustments to the promotional copy and cover design, communicated and confirmed them, and finally sent the finalized version to the publishing house.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Editing and publishing the WeChat official account article, stewing white fungus and snow pear soup, and monitoring data
description: In the afternoon, she beautified the layout of the WeChat article "Watercolor Painting for Absolute Beginners" in her study and scheduled its publication. In the middle, she went to the kitchen to soak white fungus and cut snow pears, greeted her mother, and started simmering white fungus and snow pear soup. At 16:00, the article was pushed on schedule. Afterward, she kept refreshing the backend to monitor data: the read count surpassed 50 and 8 new followers were added, while she also carefully replied to readers' comments.
location: Study and kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Tried making okara cookies and finished up.
description: In the kitchen, she mixed okara, cake flour and other ingredients into a dough, shaped it into small round patties and brushed them with egg wash. With her mother's help, she preheated the oven and baked them until golden and crispy. After taking them out, she tasted them with her mother; they had a rich beany flavor. Once cooled, she sealed them for storage. At the same time, she turned off the heat for the simmered snow fungus and pear soup.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: At dinner, I ate with my parents in the dining room, enjoying my mother's stir-fried choy sum, stir-fried pork with garlic sprouts, and the white fungus and pear soup I had stewed. During the meal, I shared the day's experiences of meeting a reader at the bookstore, publishing an official account post, and making homemade cookies. My father said he would forward the article, and the family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accompanying my parents on a walk in Green Lake Park
description: After dinner, the three of them put on jackets and walked to the nearby Cuihu Park. With the gentle lake breeze, they took a slow walk around the lake, chatting about the cat their sister had recently adopted and how to plan her royalty income, enjoying their family walk.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Return home to clean up the kitchen
description: After returning home from the walk, she took the initiative to go to the kitchen, let the okara cookies cool completely, seal and package them, washed the dishes and chopsticks, and wiped down the stove. Her mother praised her for being capable.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and wrapping up the day
description: At the desk in the study, she opened her journal, pasted in the before-and-after photos of the workstation maintenance and wrote down her thoughts, recorded screenshots of the official account's backend read counts, new followers, and reader comments, organized recipe notes for okara cookies and tremella snow pear soup, and drew small decorative patterns.
location: Desk in the study at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Online sharing with fellow journaling enthusiasts
description: In the study, she shared today's journal layout and photos of the finished soy pulp cookies in the "Journal Buddies" three-person group on WeChat, and also sent a link to a watercolor tutorial from a WeChat public account. She received praise and reposts from Zhou Lin and Wenwen.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening washing up, pre-sleep meditation, and falling asleep
description: Finished evening washing in the bathroom and applied a face mask, then went back to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, lay in bed listening to the audiobook "The Plants of the Human World" for about 20 minutes, then turned off the light and did a 10-minute body scan meditation, and fell asleep peacefully afterward.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Waking up and getting ready
description: The phone alarm rang on time at 6:00. It was a cloudy day, and the sky outside the window was faintly light. I gently turned off the alarm, stretched, changed into quick-dry running clothes and running shoes, drank half a glass of warm water, put on earphones, and got ready to go out.
location: Home bedroom, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming.

name: Morning run around Green Lake and yoga meditation at home.
description: At 06:15 walked from home to Cuihu Park. The morning air was crisp, and a thin mist hung over the lake. I jogged 5 km along the lakeside path at a pace of about 7 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer, and stretched by the lake afterward. At 07:10, after returning home, I did abdominal breathing meditation and shoulder-and-neck stretches on the bedroom windowsill to calm my heart rate and strengthen the mind-body connection.
location: Lakeside trail around Green Lake Park in Wuhua District, Kunming, and the bedroom windowsill at home in Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: After washing up, had breakfast with her mother in the dining room: hot milk, whole-wheat bread, and an apple. She shared funny moments from her morning run, and her mother reminded her to dress warmly as the weather turned cooler.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Morning planning and freelance writing work.
description: 08:00-08:30, tidy the study and plan the day's work priorities. Start official work at 08:30, reply to reader comments on the official account, sketch the framework for Winter Morning Running Notes and write down fragments, and finally send a reminder email to editor Xu Mingyuan.
location: The study at home in Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Helping in the kitchen and resting
description: She left the study and went to the kitchen to help her mother pick the lettuce. They talked about her morning-run essay writing, and her mother shared stories of dating her father by Cuihu Lake when they were young, providing creative inspiration.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Lunch
description: My father came home and joined me for lunch. The dishes were leaf lettuce, tomato scrambled eggs, and stir-fried pork with pickled vegetables. He asked about the progress of the essay collection and how I was managing my finances, and I reported one by one. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Midday Break and Browsing Books
description: Leaning against the headboard in the bedroom, she flipped through the photography collection "Dianchi Impressions" and was drawn to the image of seagulls skimming across the sunset over Dianchi Lake, pondering creative inspiration.
location: Home bedroom, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming.

name: Getting ready to go out
description: Packed my canvas bag, checked for keys, phone, and thermos, put on the off-white wool scarf as my mother reminded me, and put on my hoodie and sneakers, ready to head out.
location: Home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Walk to the supermarket to buy mushrooms.
description: Walked along Cuihu South Road, passed Green Lake Park and stopped to watch tourists feeding black-headed gulls, then arrived at Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, where she carefully selected Agaricus blazei, king oyster mushrooms, enoki mushrooms and other mushrooms, as well as some vegetables, spending 32.5 yuan in total.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Went to Zhongmou Yoga Studio for a regular yoga class.
description: At 13:45, she walked from the supermarket to Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road and changed into her yoga clothes at Zhongmou Yoga Studio on the 4th floor. At 14:00, she attended teacher He Lu's spinal flow themed yoga class, practicing cat-cow, sun salutation sequences, warrior poses, and other postures, followed by breathing and relaxation exercises after class.
location: Large group classroom, Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Return trip and free time for afternoon tea
description: After the yoga class, she changed clothes, picked up her purchased items, and walked home, buying 6 yuan of sugar tangerines at the entrance to the neighborhood. After arriving home, she brewed jasmine tea, ate the tangerines, painted a small landscape in watercolor, played Ryuichi Sakamoto's music, and enjoyed some time alone.
location: The study at home in Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Help mother prepare dinner
description: Went to the kitchen, washed and sliced the mushrooms, and prepared the mushroom hot pot soup base with my mother.
location: Kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Dinner: mushroom hot pot
description: A family of three sat together enjoying a mushroom hot pot with chicken broth as the base, cooking vegetables, tofu, and meat slices in it. Father praised the fresh mushrooms, and the atmosphere was cozy.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Evening walk with parents at Green Lake
description: After dinner, they went for a walk in Cuihu Park together, and her father told amusing stories about fishing by the lake in his youth, filling the air with laughter.
location: Cuihu Park Lakeside Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Minimalist evening tidying
description: After returning home, she looked through her wardrobe and, following the one-in, one-out principle, cleared out two sweaters she no longer wore, folded them into a recycling bag, and freed up space in the wardrobe.
location: Home bedroom, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming.

name: Write in journal
description: In the study, I used a fountain pen to record the day's little moments: a 5.02 km morning run, the yoga class theme, shopping expenses, and fun incidents from a walk, and I used red and gray pens to draw simple decorations of black-headed gulls.
location: The study at home in Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Evening personal care and going to sleep
description: Started washing up at 21:30; while soaking her feet in the living room, she leafed through 'A Record of Yunnan's Flora'; at 22:10 she changed into pajamas and got into bed, read 'Impressions of Dianchi Lake' and did abdominal breathing meditation; at 22:35 she turned off the lights and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: Woken up by the six o'clock alarm, the sky outside the window was overcast, and the forecast showed a high of 12 degrees. Wearing fleece-lined pajamas, I started my daily breathing meditation, feeling the coolness of the cold air entering my nasal passages and focusing on the breath sinking into the dantian. Then, on the yoga mat, I did Cat-Cow poses and shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the soreness from yesterday's long hours of writing at the desk. After finishing, I opened the curtains and saw the streetlights by Cuihu Lake still on, and a few red-billed gulls skimming across the lake in the mist.
location: Bedroom at home, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up, changing clothes, and helping in the kitchen
description: After washing up, she changed into warm fleece loungewear and went to the kitchen to help her mother, Li Xiulan, prepare breakfast. Her mother was cooking millet porridge, and the steam carried a sweet fragrance. She sliced the pickled vegetables and put the flower cakes bought yesterday into the oven to warm up. Her mother nagged about the temperature drop and urged her to wear a thick down jacket when going out.
location: Home kitchen, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: The whole family sat around the old wooden dining table, and her father Sun Mingyuan brought up the Yunnan wild mushroom export data in the news. Biting into a piping hot flower cake, Sun Yuwei reported today's plan to her parents: in the morning, she would go to the library on Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus to borrow books on Shen Congwen studies; in the afternoon, she would drop by Zhibushi Bookstore; in the evening, she would video chat with her roommate Liu Jia to review lessons. Her mother reminded her to keep warm and added another spoonful of millet porridge.
location: Home dining room, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Make a two-week review plan
description: Before leaving, she quickly opened Notion in the study and created a '2025 Final Review' project. Based on the core subjects (Modern Chinese Literary History key points: Lu Xun, Shen Congwen, Mao Dun; Linguistics key points: phoneme analysis, sentence pattern transformation), she broke down the next two weeks day by day, marked today's targets with red labels, marked the parts to memorize with yellow labels, and pinned today's to-do sticky notes onto the corkboard in front of the desk.
location: Home study, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the Chenggong Campus Library of Yunnan University.
description: She put on the backpack containing her notes for Thirty Years of Modern Literature, a thermos, and a power bank, put on her thick down jacket, and walked to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station. During the morning rush hour the subway car was crowded; she stood near the door wearing earphones listening to piano music while silently recalling the differences in narrative structure between Lu Xun's Call to Arms and Wandering. After transferring at Dongfeng Square, the whole trip took about ninety minutes before arriving at University Town Station, and after exiting the station she walked into the library against the wind.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, Huashan West Road Metro Station Exit D to Chenggong District University Town Station, metro car and walking sections

name: Entered the library and borrowed reference books.
description: After passing through security, she went straight to the bookshelf section I206.6-206.7 and took out three books: "Biography of Shen Congwen," "The World of Border Town," and "The Paradox of Simplicity." While scanning them at the self-service borrowing machine, she noticed that her last borrowing record was half a year ago, and silently remembered this detail.
location: Literature bookshelf area, 1st floor, Library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Review modern Chinese literary history at the library.
description: I sat down in a window seat on the second floor; the damp, cold garden outside contrasted with the heated interior. I quickly skimmed the prefaces and tables of contents of three books, marking key chapters with sticky notes. Then I focused on analyzing the essay on zero-degree narration in The World of Border Town. Using a mind map, I sorted out the idea that water is both the background and the protagonist, and drew a little boat beside it.
location: Window seat on the second floor of the library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch at the school cafeteria
description: Walked to Ziyuan Restaurant, ordered a steaming hot bowl of small-pot rice noodles, added pickled cabbage and chives, with a side of cold fish mint in sauce. Sat by the radiator and, while eating, sent a WeChat message to roommate Liu Jia about reviewing together by video in the evening; she instantly replied with a cat meme saying ‘Please spare me.’
location: Ziyuan Restaurant, 2nd Floor, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking on Ginkgo Avenue to aid digestion
description: She strolled two laps along the ginkgo path in front of the library. The fully yellow ginkgo leaves looked especially bright against the overcast sky. She took a few close-ups with her phone, sent one to her best friend Zhang Jing, who teaches in Dali, with the caption: "Golden hour of finals week. Missing you." She soon received an encouraging reply.
location: Ginkgo Avenue outside the Library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Review Introduction to Linguistics at the library
description: Returned to the window seat on the second floor, drank some warm water, then opened the Introduction to Linguistics textbook, focusing on mastering the two difficult points: "phonemic contrast and complementary distribution" and "sentence transformation." On A4 paper, I drew structural diagrams in different colors. When I got up to fetch water in the hallway, I did a few shoulder circles to relieve stiffness.
location: Window seat on the second floor of the library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Review the topic of schools in modern literary history at the library.
