description: Because the light dimmed, she moved to the bright study area on the fourth floor, turned to the "Literature of the 1980s" section of "Thirty Years of Modern Chinese Literature", highlighted representative writers and core features of "Root-seeking Literature" and "Avant-garde Literature", marked the pages with tabs, and prepared for an in-depth discussion during the evening video call. She deliberately sped up to catch the subway.
location: Reading Room, 4th Floor, Library, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, East Outer Ring South Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Took the subway back and stopped by Zhibushi Bookstore on the way.
description: She packed her schoolbag on time and left the library, then took the subway and arrived at Huashan West Road Station ninety minutes later. After exiting the station, she detoured and walked eight minutes to Zhibushi Bookstore. The owner, Qin Mingyuan, was tidying the bookshelves. She walked over to the magazine section and found that the new issue of Yunnan Gazetteer had not arrived. She spent a few minutes flipping through the just-arrived Yunnan special edition of Chinese National Geographic, chatted with Qin Mingyuan about end-of-term trivia, and then left.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go home to rest, drink hot tea and eat fruit
description: When she pushed open the door, she smelled the aroma of mushroom soup. She changed into loungewear and sat down on the sofa. Her mother brought osmanthus tea. Sipping it and eating oranges and winter jujubes, she opened the borrowed book The World of Border Town and skimmed the illustrations. Her taut nerves finally relaxed.
location: Living room at home, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner was a mushroom hot pot her mother had prepared in advance, with broth made from ganba mushrooms, porcini mushrooms, and an old hen. She picked up some bamboo fungus and ate it while blowing on it. Her father asked about her review difficulties. She found 'sentence transformation' in Introduction to Linguistics difficult, and her mother suggested making flashcards of the example sentences and sticking them on the headboard.
location: Home dining room, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A walk with my parents at Cuihu Park
description: She put on a lightweight down jacket and crossed the road with her parents into Green Lake Park. It was windy at night, and red-billed gulls stood on the railings with their necks tucked in. The three walked arm in arm around the lake. Her mother mentioned that the temperature would drop to zero over the weekend, and she promised to go buy ginger and red dates tomorrow to make warming tea.
location: Walking path in Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Little Bird Park)

name: Go home, wash up, and change into loungewear.
description: After getting home, she changed into thick loungewear. While washing up, she applied a hydrating moisturizing mask and soaked her feet in warm water for ten minutes. While soaking her feet, she sent a message to her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen, sharing her thoughts on reviewing Shen Congwen; her sister quickly replied that she was interested.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Building 3, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Video call with roommate to quiz each other for review
description: Propped her phone up on the desk and made a WeChat video call to her roommate Liu Jia. Following their agreement, the two took turns quizzing each other on key points in modern Chinese literary history: the similarities and differences in narrative structure between Lu Xun's 'Call to Arms' and 'Wandering', and the aesthetic features of Shen Congwen's 'Xiangxi world'. She answered almost everything fluently, only stumbling on 'the laws of sound change'. Liu Jia laughed and they agreed to sort it out together tomorrow.
location: Home study, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Journal record and tomorrow's plan
description: After hanging up the video call, she opened her journal and used a black pen to write down the day's review points: the key mind map for modern literary history was completed, and key linguistics case studies needed consolidation; she made twelve note cards in total. Using a green pen, she planned tomorrow's schedule: go to the library in the morning to continue reviewing, and go to the campus café with Liu Jia in the afternoon to consolidate the difficult points in sound change. She also drew a light bulb to note an inspiration: she could write an essay comparing the water environment in "Border Town" with Yunnan's lakes.
location: At the desk in the study at home, Building 3, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Read Border Town before bed and take notes.
description: Leaning against the headboard, I opened 'The World of Border Town,' compared the original text of 'Border Town' cited in the book with my previous notes, and wrote a thought in pencil on the blank space of the title page: 'Water is both the background and the protagonist? Worth digging deeper.' I decided to write the essay outline over the weekend and submit it to 'Cultural Horizon.'
location: Bedside in the bedroom, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: She turned off the main light, leaving only the warm yellow nightlight, and lay flat on her back, taking five deep breaths to release the tightness in her shoulders. Then she put on earphones and played folk songs. As the soft melody played, images surfaced in her mind: the day's mind maps from the library, ginkgo leaves, and the red-billed gulls at Green Lake. Her consciousness gradually blurred. Once her breathing became even, she reached out and turned off the nightlight and the music, and fell asleep with a sense of security.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Unit 2, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Got up and went to Cuihu Park for a morning run.
description: The 6 o'clock alarm went off. Sun Yuwei got up and pulled back the curtains, feeling the faint morning light and crisp air of winter, which dispelled her sleepiness. She put on simple workout clothes and warmed up. She left at around 6:10 and walked about 3 minutes from Cuihu Community at 7 Huashan West Road to Cuihu Park, ready to start her morning run.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Morning run at Cuihu Park and return.
description: Ran a 5 km morning run along the lakeside trail in Cuihu Park at a pace of about 7:10 per kilometer. On the winter morning, thin mist hung over the lake, and a few red-billed gulls paced along the shore—a tranquil scene. After running across Jiuqu Bridge, I felt at ease. The run ended around 7:10 a.m., and I walked 3 minutes back to my home in Cuihu Community, feeling full of energy.
location: Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning stretching, meditation, and shower
description: After returning home, she spread out a yoga mat by the living room window and did 15 minutes of stretching and mindfulness meditation. Closing her eyes and adjusting her breathing, she felt her body recover from fatigue to calmness, and the psychological tension eased. Then she took a shower, washed up, changed into loungewear, and felt completely refreshed.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom and living room at home)

name: Prepare breakfast with mother and have breakfast together as a family.
description: Sun Yuwei left her room, went to the kitchen to help her mother Li Xiulan prepare breakfast, made toast, cut fruit, and fried eggs, and chatted with her mother about the day's review and yoga plans. Breakfast started at 8:15, and she joined her father Sun Mingyuan and mother in the dining room. Her mother reminded her to put on a jacket when going out in the afternoon, her father looked at the news on his phone, and the family chatted warmly.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home kitchen, dining room)

name: Morning literature review and official account writing interaction
description: After breakfast, she returned to the study and first efficiently reviewed Beijing School and Shanghai School literature, focusing on the literary debate between these two schools, reading biographical materials about Shen Congwen, and compiling a comparison table of core viewpoints, which took until about 10:30. Then she opened the backend of her WeChat official account on her phone and found that the article Introduction to Watercolor Hand-Painting for Complete Beginners had exceeded 200 reads and gained 15 new followers, so she patiently replied to readers' comments about art supply brands and journal pairings, sharing money-saving tips. Around 11:00, she opened the Ink and Breath writing group chat and shared her observations and reflections on the ginkgo trees she had seen outside the Yunnan University library the previous day, writing a short piece of about 200 characters that resonated with group members and sparked discussion. She actively joined the interaction until 11:30.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (at the desk in her home study)

name: Lunch and midday relaxing reading
description: At noon, she ate tomato and egg noodles with her mother at home. During the meal, they discussed making flower cakes together on the weekend, and her mother agreed to buy the ingredients after class on Friday. After eating, she helped clear the dishes. Then, instead of going straight back to the study, she leaned on the living room sofa and read the feature report on bird migration around Kunming in the newly arrived issue of Chinese National Geographic magazine, relaxing and accumulating material for writing until 1 p.m.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home dining room and living room)

name: Attend a Vinyasa flow yoga class at Zhongmou Yoga Studio and go home to rest
description: She changed into yoga clothes and walked about 16 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio. In He Lu's regular Thursday flow yoga class, because the instructor knew she was under pressure from exam preparation, she added shoulder-opening and twisting poses to release tension. During the headstand section, she succeeded in holding a stable headstand away from the wall for a few seconds, and her core strength improved. After class, she talked with the instructor about how running can improve posture. She finished class around 14:40, walked home, arrived at 14:45, drank warm water, rested on the sofa in the living room, and checked her phone until 15:00.
location: Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Zhongmou Yoga Studio)

name: Linguistics sentence pattern transformation review
description: After the break, she returned to the study and opened the Introduction to Linguistics textbook. Focusing on the 'sentence transformation' exam point that had felt vague during last night's video call with her classmate Liu Jia, she worked through practice problems using the textbook examples, and organized notes on common mistakes. She planned to send them to Jiajia in the evening for discussion.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (at the desk in her home study)

name: Walked with parents at Green Lake and went shopping at the supermarket.
description: After finishing the review session, she put on a coat and went out, walking to Cuihu Park to meet her parents. In the winter evening, the afterglow of the setting sun spilled over Cuihu Lake, and the family of three walked around the lake, enjoying a relaxing time. Then they strolled to Metropolitan Garden Supermarket at No. 98 Fuchun Street, where she and her mother bought all-purpose flour and the milk powder her mother usually drank. After shopping, they carried the items and walked about 13 minutes back home.
location: Green Lake Park (Little Bird Park), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helped mother prepare dinner and had dinner with the whole family.
description: After getting home, Sun Yuwei went to the kitchen to help her mother: washing vegetables, peeling garlic, and trimming green beans. Her mother taught her some cooking tips, and the kitchen was filled with the aroma of food. Dinner began at 18:30, and the family sat together eating stir-fried pork, sautéed seasonal vegetables, and egg drop soup. She shared her progress with headstands in yoga class, her father praised her physical foundation, and the family chatted happily.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (home kitchen, dining room)

name: Make an evening journal entry recording small things I am grateful for.
description: After dinner, she returned to the study, took out her beloved journal, first drew a red-billed gull she had seen at Cuihu Lake with colored pens, then wrote down three small things from the day to be grateful for: 1. I saw beautiful morning mist on my morning run; 2. Mom promised to make flower cakes together this weekend; 3. I felt my progress after yoga class. After writing, she felt warm inside.
location: Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (at the desk in her home study)

name: Mindfulness meditation to relax before bed
description: After an intense day of review, Sun Yuwei washed up and returned to her bedroom. She opened the Tide app and selected the "Mountain Stream" theme for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation. Following the guided instructions, she focused on her breath and felt her stress release, after which she felt an unprecedented calm. The relaxation activity lasted until 20:30.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Read The World of Border Town before bed and fall asleep
description: She dimmed the bedside lamp and lay in bed reading the prose collection The World of Border Town, feeling the Xiangxi world depicted by Shen Congwen, and smiled knowingly at the classic lines. At about 21:00 she closed the book, put her phone aside, recalled the fulfilling day, silently reviewed tomorrow's plan, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom at home)

name: Morning meditation and washing up
description: Waking in the faint winter light, she did 15 minutes of meditation and gentle stretching in the bedroom; occasional birdsong came from outside the window, her breathing was long and deep, and her mind was clear. Then she washed up, changed into loose cotton-linen loungewear, and looked full of energy in the mirror.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with family and receiving a gift from a neighbor
description: Shared a small-pot rice noodle breakfast with her parents; the aroma of chives and minced meat lingered. Her father flipped through the morning paper while her mother asked about the day's plans. Before going out, she changed into a dark green sweater, a dark gray cotton long skirt, and a camel-colored wool coat. In the hallway, she ran into her neighbor Auntie Xie Xiulan and received a freshly baked flower cake, which she planned to eat as a snack.
location: Dining room and hallway at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walk to Zhibushi Bookstore
description: Walking north along Huashan West Road, she passed through the outskirts of Cuihu Park and headed toward the bookstore. Morning light filtered through the plane tree leaves onto the stone path. Red-billed gulls skimmed across the lake. She felt cheerful and planned to come back for a walk by the lake in the afternoon.
location: Huashan West Road and Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Work at the bookstore and receive a letter of intent for publication.
description: At her window-side workstation at Paper Stone Bookstore in Kunming, she opened her computer and checked emails and manuscript feedback. She found a letter of intent for the publication contract for "Slow Travel Notes" from Shanghai Qingniao Press, confirming a spring 2026 release with an initial print run of 2,000 copies. After reading it over and over, she was thrilled, and had a brief exchange with Uncle Qin, the bookstore owner, her heart filled with joy.
location: Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shared the good news over video and walked home
description: Excitedly, she called her mother on WeChat video to tell her about the intention to publish. Her mother was so surprised and happy that she burst into tears, and her father hurried over when he heard and praised her again and again. After hanging up, she closed her computer and walked home briskly with excitement—the winter wind blowing on her face while a fire burned in her heart.
location: Bookstore at No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and return trip via Huashan West Road.

name: Returning home to celebrate and having lunch
description: Pushed open the door and hugged my parents tightly, sharing the joy and the persistence of the past. After calming down, I ate the zhajiang noodles my mother had made for lunch. The noodles were chewy and the sauce rich and fragrant. Throughout the meal, we kept mentioning the details of the email, beaming with smiles.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon rest and journaling
description: After her mood gradually calmed, she returned to the study, opened her brown leather journal, and used a fountain pen to record the important moment of the publication intention and a summary of her feelings. Though still excited, she reminded herself to stay calm and settle her emotions for the afternoon yoga class.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going to the yoga studio and sharing the good news before class
description: She changed into gray workout clothes and walked about 15 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio in Dechun Commercial Building on Dongfeng West Road. Before class, she met her instructor He Lu in the rest area and quietly shared the good news about the publication. He Lu excitedly grasped her arm and congratulated her, saying she had earned it.
location: Rest area of Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga class and post-class discussion
description: Attended Friday yoga class, felt grounded and strong in tree pose and warrior pose; the postures became more extended and stable because of inner joy. After class, I drank tea with He Lu in the rest area and talked about the upcoming book release. He Lu said she would organize a group purchase among her yoga sisters. The atmosphere was pleasant.
location: Classroom and rest area of Zhongmou Yoga Studio, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walk home and discuss dinner.
description: Left the yoga studio and walked back to Cuihu Community feeling light and warm. After arriving home, discussed the celebration dinner with her mother and decided to go to Juncai Wild Mushroom Hotpot Restaurant on Cuihu South Road. She helped her mother trim vegetables while the two chatted warmly about the new book plan.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepared to go out with parents and walked to the hot pot restaurant.
description: When her father came home from work and learned about the dinner plan, he was very happy. Sun Yuwei changed into a navy blue dress, and the family tidied up a bit before going out. They walked along Huashan West Road to Cuihu South Road, chatting and laughing along the way and discussing which mushrooms to order.
location: Along the route from Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 4-4 Cuihu South Road

name: Family celebration dinner
description: Enjoyed a hearty dinner at Juncai Yunnan Wild Mushroom Hot Pot Restaurant; the boiling broth gave off the aroma of matsutake and porcini mushrooms. Her father raised his teacup to congratulate his daughter on her dream of becoming a writer coming true, while her mother imagined the whole family attending the new book release next spring. The atmosphere was lively and warm.
location: Juncai Yunnan Wild Mushroom Hot Pot (Green Lake Branch), No. 4-4 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Night visit to Green Lake Park and return.
description: After dinner, the family of three walked into Green Lake Park. Streetlights reflected on the lake. With her mother on her left arm and father on her right, their shadows stretched long. Father hummed Olive Tree, mother softly sang along. Sun Yuwei took a photo of the night and sent it to her sister. Then they slowly walked home. The night breeze was slightly cool, but her heart was warm.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and return

name: Shower and freshen up.
description: After returning home, she took a shower. The hot water washed away her fatigue and excitement, and she changed into comfortable loungewear. The beautiful moments of the day kept replaying in her mind.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening journaling and online records
description: Sitting in the study, she dimmed the desk lamp, used a fountain pen to record in detail today's milestone events and feelings, and drew a small daisy. Then she composed a Moments post to share the joy of publication and replied one by one to friends who sent congratulatory private messages.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime reading and relaxation meditation
description: Turn off electronic devices, lean against the headboard and read a light essay collection to calm down, then do a ten-minute bedtime meditation, recalling the beautiful moments of the day with gratitude.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing for sleep
description: I lay down with contentment and happiness. The moonlight streamed in softly, and as I reviewed this extraordinary day, I gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: Woken by last night's joy and the faint glow of my phone, I confirmed that the email with the publication contract was still in my inbox and smiled contentedly. Then I changed into light sportswear, spread the yoga mat in front of the bedroom bay window, and did 20 minutes of body flow and 15 minutes of meditation, focusing on my breath, turning yesterday's excited energy into motivation for today's actions. When I finished, my body was slightly warm, and my mood was calm and assured.
location: In front of the bay window in the south-facing bedroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning preparation and drinking water
description: After a quick wash, she went into the kitchen, poured a glass of warm water, and took small sips, feeling the moisture soothe her throat and give her energy for the new day. She took a banana from the fridge to get a little energy before going out.
location: Kitchen and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Brisk walking along the Panlong River
description: Put on my sneakers and headphones, then headed out. After walking about 10 minutes, I arrived at the greenway along the Panlong River. The sky was faintly bright, and a thin mist floated on the river. Keeping a pace of about 9 minutes per kilometer, I power-walked along the riverbank for 30 minutes, feeling the crisp winter morning air and the gradually emerging sunlight. Passing a group of elderly people doing morning exercises, I sidestepped to let them pass and continued focusing on my own rhythm. After finishing about 3.3 kilometers of power walking, I stretched by the river for 5 minutes, then walked home.
location: Panlong River greenway along Qingnian Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China (section from Yuantong Bridge to Renmin Middle Road).

name: Sharing breakfast with family
description: When you walked in, you smelled the aroma of the small-pot rice noodles Mom had cooked and sat down to eat breakfast with the family. While eating, you told them about your plans to organize the storage room today and work on the manuscript in the afternoon, and shared how comfortable the brisk morning walk felt. Mom jokingly called you an artist of iron, and Dad asked whether the publisher had said when the sample copies would be available.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning reading and online social interaction
description: After breakfast, I returned to my study but did not immediately start the intense work. I took out the essay collection "Kunming Notes" that I had pulled from the bookshelf yesterday, leaned by the window, and read for half an hour. Then I opened my phone and sent a brief greeting via WeChat to the editor Xu Mingyuan: "Teacher Xu, happy weekend. I plan to focus on the manuscript this afternoon and expect to send you the final draft and a progress email in the evening." After that, I browsed the blessings from friends under yesterday's celebratory dinner Moments post and replied with thanks one by one.
location: Study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Tidy up the storage room and family memories.
description: Started cleaning out the small storage room full of clutter at home with my mother. She took charge of sorting clothes, and I was in charge of categorizing old boxes and books. In a dusty tin box, I unexpectedly found an old photo album with black-and-white photos of old Kunming streets taken by my father with a Seagull camera when he was young. Hearing the commotion, my father came over and enthusiastically explained the story behind every photo - the old bookstore on Wenlin Street, the stream of bicycles in front of Jinri Tower... I carefully held these yellowed photos in my hands and photographed them one by one with my phone, thinking that later I could scan them as backups, and they could also provide valuable material for the chapter on urban memory in 'Slow Travel Notes'.
location: Storage room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Short rest and photo backup
description: After tidying up the storage room, she felt a bit dusty and went back to her room to change clothes. Then she sat back at her desk, turned on the computer, created a folder named 'Father's Old Kunming' in the cloud drive, and uploaded the photos she had just taken with her phone for backup.
location: Study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Lunch and casual family chat
description: Mom casually stir-fried a few dishes, including our favorite tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried pea shoots. The family chatted while eating, and the conversation drifted from old photos in the storage room to Dad's experiences when he went to Shanghai in his youth. I took the opportunity to ask his opinion on the article about Cuihu Park in "Slow Travel Notes." He said, "The ducks at Cuihu are just like you when you were little — always waiting for someone to feed them." I laughed out loud and thought it was a brilliant metaphor, one I might use in the revised draft.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Noon rest and free activities.
description: After the meal, she felt a little drowsy and lay on the bedroom bed with her eyes closed to rest for about 45 minutes. After waking up, her energy was restored. She went to the living room, watered the pothos and mint on the balcony, and changed some water for the small fish tank at home. Taking care of these daily little things was relaxing. Then she returned to the study to prepare for the afternoon's work, printing out the revision suggestions sent by the editor.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China; bedroom, living room, and study at home.

name: Finalize the final manuscript of 'Slow Travel Notes'.
description: Sitting in the study, I opened the folder 'Slow Travel Notes Final Draft.' Following the suggestions from editor Xu Mingyuan yesterday, I started adjusting the order of the contents: put the city essays about Kunming's old streets, Green Lake, and the Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore at the beginning, intersperse three pieces of family memories, and end with reflections on the natural scenery from the Dali trip. I deleted two old pieces that felt a bit dull, and tried writing a short new transition about the interweaving of urban change and personal memory. The whole process was focused and immersive; the only sounds in the study were the tapping of the keyboard and the clicking of the mouse.
location: Study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Afternoon tea break and journaling
description: After working for two hours, my eyes felt a bit sore. I got up, made myself a cup of jasmine tea, cut a small plate of the leftover flower cakes from yesterday, and took them to the bay window to enjoy. While eating, I took out my brown leather journal and noted down structural inspiration for today's manuscript organization, then crossed off the 'organize the storage room' item, feeling quite accomplished. During the break, I sent a WeChat message to my writer friend Song Wen, who is still in Chengdu: 'I'm tackling the final draft today, hope to send you good news tonight~'
location: Bay window in the study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Handling emails and social replies
description: Back at the computer, Sun Yuwei first opened her email and wrote a formal email to the editor Xu Mingyuan, attaching the afternoon's adjusted manuscript table of contents and a description of the revision approach, and asking him for the final submission deadline. Then she opened WeChat and replied to the congratulatory message from He Lu, the instructor at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, apologizing for not replying in time yesterday, confirming next week's yoga class time, and arranging a class for Thursday afternoon. Finally, seeing a reply from her writing friend Song Wen, she told her she was working hard to wrap up and would chat later.
location: Study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Evening family activities and dinner preparation.
description: After finishing work, I walked out of the study and saw my mother trimming vegetables and my father leaning on the sofa watching TV. I went over, took the vegetables from her, and helped her prepare dinner. I offered to make a cucumber salad, and my mother agreed with a smile. Washing vegetables, slicing them, arranging the plate... simple household chores made me feel calm and fulfilled.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Have dinner with the family
description: Dinner was a simple three dishes and a soup: tomato and egg soup, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and homemade cucumber salad. The family sat around the table and talked about the gains of that afternoon. She shared the new feeling the adjusted table of contents of the manuscript gave her, and her father suggested adding more details about the Kunming dialect to give it local flavor.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening walk around Green Lake
description: After dinner, she went out for a walk with her parents. This time her father deliberately brought along his film camera, which was getting old. They walked a full circle around Green Lake, the sunset glow spreading over the water, and some evening joggers passed by. Her father stopped in front of the "Fish-Viewing Pavilion," fiddled with the camera, and took a few hazy night shots of the water in the dusk. As they chatted about the structure of the Green Lake essay she had thought of while sorting through the manuscript that afternoon, he offered one or two of his own impressions, which she found very inspiring.
location: Green Lake Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Returning home and preparing for a video call
description: After the walk, I felt a little thirsty when I got home, so I drank a glass of water. Then I returned to the bedroom, plugged in the laptop to charge, adjusted the camera position, and tested the microphone volume. I took a mint candy and placed it on the desk, ready to start the video call with my sister.
location: Bedroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Video call with her elder sister Sun Yuting.
description: Right on time, I got on a WeChat video call with my elder sister Sun Yutong, who is far away in Shenzhen. On the screen, she was wearing loungewear and looked like she had just finished work not long ago. I eagerly showed her a screenshot of the publishing contract email I received yesterday, and gave her a detailed account of the whole process from receiving the letter of intent to compiling the final manuscript today, along with the follow-up plans. She was very excited as she listened, and her laughter came through the phone. She said, “I knew you could do it!” She generously promised that when the new book goes on sale, she would definitely buy 100 copies with her own money to give to her colleagues and friends. The two chatted for nearly an hour and a half, covering everything from the publishing plans to what each had been up to lately. By the time we hung up, I felt so supported.
location: In front of the computer in the bedroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening journaling and reading
description: After talking with my sister, I was still excited. I opened my journal and recorded all of today's key milestones with a green pen: morning exercise, old photos, manuscript progress, and my sister's promise. At the end, I drew a small smiley face in the footer. After finishing, I took the borrowed essay collection Kunming Notes from the bedside table and read a chapter in bed, gradually calming myself down from the excitement.
location: At the bedroom desk and on the bed, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Bedtime preparation and meditative sleep
description: I put down the book, got up, and went to the bathroom to wash up. I washed my face with warm water, applied toner and a facial mask. Returning to the bedroom, I changed into pajamas, turned off the main light, and left only a dim bedside lamp on. I lit the scented candle on the nightstand and, in the scent of apple and cinnamon, did a final 5-minute bedtime mindfulness meditation, giving thanks for all the day's gains and telling myself: 'Rest well, tomorrow is a new day.' Then I turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning wake-up and yoga meditation
description: At 6 a.m., Sun Yuwei woke to a gentle alarm. Instead of getting up immediately, she kept her eyes closed and did one minute of abdominal breathing, enjoying the stillness of the winter morning. Then she turned on the bedside lamp and began meditation and stretching on her yoga mat in the bedroom: first settling into an easy seated position to regulate her breath and let her thoughts gradually settle, then moving through poses such as Cat-Cow and Downward-Facing Dog to fully awaken her spine and hips, preparing for the morning run ahead. The whole process was slow and focused, with energy flowing gently through her body.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Long-distance slow jog of 8 km
description: At 6:40, Sun Yuwei put on her cold-weather running clothes, grabbed her phone and a small bottle of water, and left for her routine long-distance jog. Starting from home at No. 7 Huashan West Road, she jogged south along Huashan West Road for 5 minutes as a warm-up, entered Green Lake Park through the south gate, and ran east along the lake into the Panlong River greenway. On the winter morning, the temperature was about 5°C and the air was crisp. She kept a pace of about 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, with her heart rate steady at around 145, enjoying the elderly morning exercisers and the dogs being walked along the way. Around 8:00, she completed 8 kilometers, arrived at the public fitness area at the intersection of Renmin Middle Road and the Panlong River, and did 5 minutes of thorough stretching to relieve muscle tension.
location: Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Panlong River Greenway, Panlong District

name: Returning home, breakfast, and tidying up.
description: At 8:10, Sun Yuwei finished her morning run and returned home. Her mother, Li Xiulan, was already preparing breakfast in the kitchen. After washing her hands, she sat down at the table and enjoyed a steaming bowl of small-pot rice noodles with pickled vegetables, tender meat slices, and chives. As she ate, she chatted with her mother about the fun she had looking through her father's old photos the day before; her mother laughed and shared an embarrassing story about her father when he was young taking pictures. After the meal, she went back to her room, took a hot shower, changed into light loungewear, and took a screenshot of the morning run data from her phone to save.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Reading and discussion at Mingyuan Book House
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, Sun Yuwei took her journal and pencil case and walked about 8 minutes to Mingyuan Bookstore, tucked into the street-level shops of a residential area near Xuefu Road. She ordered a hot latte, sat on the sofa by the window, and continued reading The Four Seasons of Kunming, recommended by Uncle Qin. Around 10:30, the bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, came over to chat and asked for her thoughts on a book club themed “City Memories.” She readily agreed to participate and recommended a few of her favorite essays, then recorded her initial ideas for the book club in her journal.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, in the ground-floor shops of a residential complex near Xuefu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch at Home and Organizing Old Photos
description: At 11:30, she left the bookstore and walked home. Her mother had already prepared lunch: braised pork belly, broccoli with garlic, and tomato egg drop soup. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, also sat down at the table. The family chatted while eating, and her father shared his thoughts from watching the news that morning. After the meal, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to clear the dishes. At about 12:30, she returned to her own room. Instead of taking a nap, she turned on her computer and sorted through more than twenty old photos of her father that she had rephotographed yesterday, creating a folder named Father's Images: Kunming Memories for further processing later.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Taking a walk around Green Lake with best friend Zhang Jing.
description: At 14:00, Sun Yuwei received a WeChat message from her best friend Zhang Jing saying she had arrived at the south gate of Green Lake Park. Sun Yuwei immediately put on her small crossbody bag, took her journal, and walked over. When they met, Zhang Jing gave her a dried-flower bookmark in a small transparent bag, with a delicate light-purple hydrangea pressed inside. They bought gull feed and walked along the lake feeding the black-headed gulls while catching up on each other's news. Sun Yuwei shared the good news that Slow Travel Notes had received a letter of intent for a publishing contract, and Zhang Jing excitedly demanded to pre-order a signed copy. Afterwards, they browsed the lakeside handmade crafts market, and Sun Yuwei bought a handmade cowhide bookmark.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to rest and be with her parents.
description: At 16:00, she said goodbye to Zhang Jing at the north gate of Green Lake and walked home, arriving around 16:15. She drank a glass of water, put down her journal, and seeing her parents watching TV in the living room, went over to sit and chat, vividly describing the fun of feeding the black-headed gulls and receiving the dried-flower bookmark in the afternoon. Around 17:00, she got up and went to the kitchen to help her mother pick and wash vegetables, while her mother mentioned the flower cakes brought over by their neighbor, Aunt Xie. The atmosphere was warm and joyful.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening walk with parents at Green Lake
description: At 17:15, dinner was almost ready. Father suggested taking a half-hour walk around Cuihu Lake before it got too dark and then coming back to eat, so the three of them went out together. In the evening, the lights along Cuihu Lake were just coming on, giving it a tranquility that the daytime lacked. They walked most of the way around the lake. Father pointed to an old building on the opposite shore and said that in the 1980s it had been a photo studio, where he had taken his ID photo in his youth. Sun Yuwei listened attentively, quietly noting these details, thinking she could later write them into an essay about her father and Kunming.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and sister interaction
description: After returning from the walk, her mother quickly served dinner: braised pork belly, garlic broccoli, cucumber salad, and tomato egg soup. The family sat around the table eating and chatting in a relaxed atmosphere. After dinner, Sun Yuwei volunteered to wash the dishes. At 20:00, she went back to the study, opened WeChat, and sent her sister Sun Yutong a red envelope of 200 yuan with the message: "Sis, thank you for saying you'd buy 100 copies to support me. Love you!" Her sister accepted it instantly and replied with a hugging emoji and a voice message: "Go, little sis! I'm waiting to become a great writer!" Warmth welled up in Sun Yuwei's heart.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Evening writing, polishing, and planning
description: At 20:30, Sun Yuwei opened the final draft document of Slow Travel Notes in her study, finished revising a transitional sentence she had marked that afternoon that did not read smoothly, and read the whole piece through, feeling that the writing was much smoother. At 21:00, she switched to WeChat, replied to her friend Song Wen's message, and chatted a bit about her recent writing. Then she sent editor Xu Mingyuan a message: Hello, Editor Xu. The final draft of Slow Travel Notes is nearing completion. I made another small adjustment today and plan to read it through once more next week. Please feel free to contact me if needed. After sending the message, she closed her computer. At 21:30, she took out today's journal and used a fountain pen to record her feelings about the morning run, the joy of spending time with Zhang Jing, the details of receiving the dried-flower bookmark, and the story about old photographs told by her father. She also drew a simple line drawing of a black-headed gull in the margin.
location: Study, Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and meditation before sleep.
description: At 22:00, Sun Yuwei put down her journal and went to the bathroom to wash up and do her nighttime skincare routine, applying moisturizer. At 22:20, she changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed, scrolling through social media on her phone for a while. At 22:30, she turned off her phone, closed her eyes, and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath and feeling her body gradually relax, letting go of all the thoughts from the day. After the meditation, she adjusted into her most comfortable sleeping position and fell asleep peacefully to the faint night sounds of Cuihu Lake in the distance, ready for the new week.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 501, Unit 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning meditation and body awakening.
description: After the alarm clock rang, Sun Yuwei sat on the bed and meditated for 15 minutes, focusing on her breath and the quiet of the morning. She then slowly stretched to awaken her muscles, injecting calm energy into the new day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: After washing up, she went to the dining room and ate the fragrant small-pot rice noodles her mother had cooked with her parents. During the casual conversation, they mentioned that the flower cakes Aunt Xie gave yesterday were delicious, and her father's photo of the sunset over Green Lake. The room was filled with a warm, homely atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and tidying the study
description: After washing up, she changed into a loose gray sweater and beige cotton pants to feel comfortable. Then she went to the study, opened the curtains, tidied the desk, and neatly arranged her laptop, to-do notebook, black pen, and teacup, creating a quiet and orderly writing space.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Spent the morning polishing the prose and seeking inspiration.
description: She turned on the computer and found the first drafts of "Mountain Morning Mist" and "Rainy Night Stone Bridge." Putting on headphones and listening to piano music, she read through the texts word by word and polished them, replacing flat expressions with precise imagery. When her eyes grew tired, she got up to brew some rose pu-erh tea, then went to the living room to flip through old photos of old streets in her father's album, wondering whether they could serve as inspiration for illustrations. She then returned to the study and continued revising the ending.
location: Study and living room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Completed polishing, submission, and confirmation of the column topic.
description: After deleting the verbose descriptions, adding a reflective ending, and checking the word count, punctuation, and formatting, she logged into her email, wrote the submission message, and sent the two essays "Morning Mist in the Mountains" and "Stone Bridge on a Rainy Night" to the editorial office of Dianchi magazine. Then she opened WeChat and sent a message to editor Xu Mingyuan to confirm that the topic for the next column would be "Kunming's Winter Vegetable Market." She felt both relaxed and uneasy.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Mother called her to eat. Lunch featured home-style dishes: shredded pork with green peppers, stir-fried choy sum, and tomato and egg soup. She happily shared the news that her submission was done that morning. Her mother smiled and praised her, and her father, in a rare moment, said, 'Not bad, be bold in your attempts.' The taste of home made her feel at ease.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap and preparing for the afternoon itinerary.
description: On the living room sofa, I scrolled through WeChat Moments and saw photos of the school cafeteria posted by my roommate Liu Jia, so we chatted a few words on WeChat. Then I opened the official website of “Dianchi” to confirm the submission email was correct, and closed my eyes to rest for a dozen or so minutes. Back in the study, I jotted down in my journal the plan to go to the bookstore in the afternoon, put on my coat, and took the reprints of old street photos before heading out.
location: Living room and study at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Heading to Zhibushi Bookstore for a creative field trip.
description: Set off from home at 13:00, walked north along Huashan West Road, passed the east gate of Cuihu Park, enjoyed the sparkling lake and circling black-headed gulls, and arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore about 15 minutes later. Greeted the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan, showed him the old street photos, and Uncle Qin told the stories of the old houses in the photos, exchanging inspiration. Then went to the cultural creative area, picked out vintage kraft paper stickers and multicolored pens, and bought the latest issue of Prose magazine. Left the bookstore around 14:00, took photos of plane trees and a corner flower shop along the way as journal material, and walked home.
location: Kunming Paper, Cloth and Stone Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the round trip

name: Update the journal.
description: After returning home, she first took photos of the new journal supplies, then took out her beloved journal and used the newly bought colored pens and stickers to record, with both pictures and text, the joy of today's successful submission, the stories behind old photographs told by Uncle Qin, and her preliminary idea for Winter Food Market.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Help prepare dinner.
description: She went into the kitchen, tied on an apron, and helped her mother pick vegetables. While picking vegetables, she excitedly shared the interesting stories from the afternoon trip to the bookstore and chatting with Uncle Qin, as well as the relaxed feeling after submitting her work. The mother and daughter chatted and laughed while preparing dinner ingredients.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was Mom's braised pork ribs, shredded cucumber salad, and clay-pot tofu, and the mood during the meal was pleasant. Mom relayed the news that the submission that afternoon had been successful, and Dad nodded approvingly. The topic turned to the spring outing; Mom suggested going to Luoping to see the rapeseed flowers next March, and she put down her chopsticks in agreement.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Stroll at Green Lake Park
description: After the meal, the three of them put on their coats and walked along the familiar route to Cuihu Park; the winter sunset dyed the lake surface golden red, and black-headed gulls circled and called. They walked a big loop around the lake, and her father pointed at a renovated old house and talked about childhood memories. The walk made both body and mind feel especially relaxed.
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. After eating, she reclined on the living room sofa and rested for 20 minutes, giving her eyes and brain a brief rest.

name: Column material collection
description: After returning home, she turned on the computer and did research for the column topic “Kunming’s Winter Food Markets”; she searched for keywords such as “Zhuanxin Food Market” and “Kunming Old-School Markets,” browsed online articles and photos to understand the market’s history and features, and opened a new document to note the key points for the field visit, such as vendors’ shouts and the colors of ingredients at the stalls.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening reading and social sharing
description: Received a WeChat reply from editor Xu Mingyuan saying “The topic is very interesting,” and replied “Okay, I’ll go gather material this weekend.” Then she curled up in an armchair and read an essay about the lively atmosphere of a market in the afternoon’s issue of Prose magazine, drawing inspiration. Afterward, she picked a photo of Green Lake from her phone album and posted a Moments post with the caption “Today’s courage is dedicated to submitting; may all words find a home.”
location: Study and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Making journal entries and chatting with a close friend.
description: Back in the study, she opened her journal and used simple line drawings to record the winter cherry blossoms she had seen during her evening walk. Her phone lit up as her best friend Zhang Jing sent a message asking about the submission, and the two chatted on WeChat about the nervousness and anticipation of submitting.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep preparation and body relaxation
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up, cleansed my skin with a gentle facial cleanser and applied a moisturizing mask; while waiting, did leg stretches on the bedroom floor to relieve fatigue; then turned off the computer in the study, put the journal and pen back in place, and turned off the study light.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: She changed into her pajamas and lay in bed, dimmed the bedside lamp, and did a short meditation. She reviewed the key moments of the day — the focus of polishing the essay, the decisiveness of pressing send, the conversation with Uncle Qin, and the warmth of walking with her parents — and felt both satisfied and expectant. Then the alarm went off; she turned off the light, adjusted her sleeping position, and soon sank into sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning exercise and meditation
description: Woke up at 6 in the morning, washed up quickly, changed into sportswear, and went out to Green Lake Park. I jogged 5 kilometers along the path around Green Lake, admiring the early seagulls by the lakeside and the elderly doing tai chi. After jogging, I found a bench beside the Mid-Lake Pavilion, did 10 minutes of stretching, then sat cross-legged with eyes closed for 10 minutes of breathing meditation, feeling the quiet of the morning and calming my body and mind.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: After exercising, Sun Yuwei walked home. Her mother had prepared breakfast: small-pot rice noodles, boiled eggs, and hot soy milk. Her father watched the morning news while asking about today's plans. Sun Yuwei shared what she saw on her morning run and said she was going to the Zhuanxin Food Market in the morning to gather material. Her mother reminded her to dress warmly.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing and heading to the wet market for fieldwork
description: After breakfast, she organized her fieldwork tools in the study, packing her phone, mini notebook, pen, camera and thermos into a canvas bag, and quickly reviewed her topic ideas about winter vegetable markets. Then she set out on foot to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, passing an old residential area on the way, where she saw several elderly men playing chess and stopped to take photos.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Field visit to Zhuanxin Food Market
description: She gathered inspiration at the bustling Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, weaving between stalls, capturing the winter's lively atmosphere: the steam of lamb soup pots, the vendors' loud cries, and the textures of colorful ingredients. She stopped for a long time at a homemade pickle stall, chatted with the auntie wearing gold earrings, learned the secret recipe for pickled radish, and noted the details in her memo. She also bought some freshly steamed buckwheat cakes as a lunch extra.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Returning home to organize the field research notes
description: Left the market and walked home, put the buckwheat cakes away, then went back to the study and organized the scattered notes on her phone into coherent text. She also drew a simple sketch of the stall layout, marking the impressive details, to prepare for writing the column draft the next day.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and lunch
description: After organizing her notes, she leaned back in her chair to rest and read an essay about local scenery in an issue of Prose magazine. Then she had lunch with her mother, who made stir-fried snow peas, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and steamed sea bass. Sun Yuwei excitedly shared what she had seen at the morning market, especially the story of the auntie who sells mutton soup.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, go back to the bedroom and rest in bed for about 45 minutes to conserve energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon work in the study
description: After the afternoon nap, in the study, she took out the old photos of Kunming's old streets treasured by her father, scanned them one by one with the scanner, and chatted with her father, who was reading the newspaper nearby, about the stories behind the photos. She scanned about 30 photos. Then she turned on her computer, ordered “Thirty-Six Flavors of Everyday Life” on Dangdang, recommended by fellow book lover Yang Xiao, and sent a WeChat message to editor Xu Mingyuan reporting the initial findings from the morning's field trip, saying she could submit the first draft of the column within this week.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flower arranging practice
description: I did my daily flower arrangement practice in the living room, trimming and matching dried flowers and eucalyptus leaves and placing them in a ceramic jar, adding a quiet wintry beauty to the home. This is practice for studying Japanese Ikenobo flower arrangement.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga class preparation and commute.
description: After finishing the flower arranging, she changed into sportswear, put the yoga mat, towel, and insulated cup into the large canvas bag, and charged her phone. Then she went out and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, passing Dechun Commercial Building without stopping.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Yoga class
description: After arriving at the yoga studio, I checked in and changed clothes, and under the guidance of instructor He Lu, I did asana and breathing practice. Today my concentration was good, and I held Warrior III and Tree Pose steadily for longer. After class, the teacher praised me for improving my core strength.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Return home and have dinner with parents.
description: After class, she took a few sips of the ginger and red date tea she had brought, and a warm feeling spread through her as she walked home. When she arrived, her mother had already prepared dinner, including braised pork ribs and several seasonal vegetables. The family chatted while eating; her mother asked how the yoga class went, and her father asked about the progress of sorting out the photos that afternoon.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking a walk with my parents at Green Lake.
description: After dinner, the family of three went to Green Lake Park for a walk to aid digestion. Her mother took her arm and asked whether she had caught a chill during the field trip. Her father pointed to distant seagulls roosting for the night and said Green Lake in winter has its own charm. The evening breeze was cool, but being together as a family felt warm.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening time in the study.
description: After my walk home, I turned on the computer and phone in the study and shared today's field-trip photos and impressions online with my book friend Yang Xiao. I confirmed that I had ordered Thirty-Six Flavors of Fireworks, and we agreed to discuss it after finishing it. Then I took out the journal with retro stickers and recorded today's gains and reflections with colored pens.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Relaxation and family time before bed
description: She closed the journal, left the study, and watched a documentary with her parents in the living room, chatting briefly. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up and do her skincare routine, returned to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, and set the alarm. Sitting cross-legged on the bed, she did a 10-minute pre-sleep meditation to clear her mind, then turned off the lights and fell asleep.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga meditation, washing up, and changing clothes.
description: On the yoga mat in the bedroom, I completed 15 minutes of gentle stretching and 10 minutes of seated meditation. During the meditation, the smile of the vegetable-seller auntie from Zhuanxin Vegetable Market yesterday came to mind, leaving me calm and full of anticipation. After finishing, I washed up and looked in the mirror at my good complexion, feeling happy, then changed into comfortable cotton loungewear.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepared breakfast and had it with my parents
description: She stepped on the scale, and her weight held steady at 47.3 kg. Remembering her mother's mention of fried egg toast with hot milk, she tied on an apron and started preparing: frying eggs, toasting bread, and slicing apples. Outside was the clear winter morning light of Kunming. Her parents sat down one after another, and Yuwei brought breakfast to the table. Her mother praised that the fried eggs were cooked just right; her father mentioned that his company had its year-end summary meeting today; her mother reminded her to add clothes because the temperature would drop in the afternoon. The family chatted about daily life in a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Check the manuscript payment and plan finances
description: In the study, she opened the mobile banking app and saw the 8,000 yuan advance from the publisher of Slow Travel Notes, and was thrilled. With a dark green fountain pen, she wrote in her journal: “December 10, 2025, Wednesday, sunny. I received the first advance payment of my life, 8,000 yuan. It is both recognition and a new beginning.” Then she pasted on a black-headed gull sticker from Cuihu Lake. Afterward, she planned the allocation: 3,000 yuan as Spring Festival money for her parents and as a travel fund for next spring's trip to Luoping; the remaining 5,000 yuan, she planned to open a six-month fixed deposit as the “confidence fund” for her writing career. She took her ID card and bank card and got ready to go out.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked to China Construction Bank to handle a fixed deposit and returned.
description: Putting on her scarf, she walked about 8 minutes to the Kunming Xiaoximen Sub-branch of China Construction Bank. After taking a number, she waited in the waiting area and browsed the photos from yesterday's outing on her phone. When her number was called, she told the teller that she wanted to open a six-month lump-sum deposit of 5,000 yuan. After filling out the form, she completed the deposit smoothly, received a new passbook, and carefully put it in the inner pocket of her canvas tote bag. She walked home, greeted her mother, who was about to go out to buy groceries, at the entrance, then went to the study, placed the passbook in an iron box, and marked the maturity date as June 10, 2026 in her journal, feeling a stronger sense of control over the future.
location: No. 222 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Organize yesterday's field trip notes
description: After brewing a cup of hot tea, she took out the loose-leaf notebook and phone photos from yesterday's records at the Zhuanxin vegetable market, and entered key phrases such as "the vendor Auntie Wang's shouts at the lamb stew pot stall" and "the green contrast of winter bamboo shoots and pea shoots" into the "Material Library" document on her computer.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Building the framework for the column piece 'Kunming's Winter Symphony'
description: She officially began building the framework for the new column article "Kunming's Winter Symphony". She created a new Word document, used "Colors and Sounds of the Food Market" as the entry point, arranged the material in the order of sight, hearing, and smell, wrote draft versions of three subheadings, entered a flow state, and made smooth progress.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rest before noon and have lunch with mother
description: She stood in the living room doing simple shoulder and neck stretches, looked out at the golden ginkgo trees, took a photo, and shared it in the close friends group with the caption “today's winter moment.” Then her mother brought out refreshing tomato and egg noodles with home-pickled sour radish. As she ate, Yuwei told her mother about receiving the advance payment that morning and going to the bank to deposit the money. Her mother beamed with joy and praised her repeatedly.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, she lay on the bed with her eyes closed and rested for 20 minutes, feeling soothed.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Consult reference materials from columns such as “Thirty-Six Tastes of Life.”
description: To warm up for the afternoon's writing, she browsed "Thirty-Six Flavors of Everyday Life," which arrived yesterday, and marked passages related to Yunnan food markets; at the same time, she searched online for news reports about "Kunming Zhuanxin Food Market" to find new angles for writing.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the first draft of 'Winter Symphony in Kunming'.
description: Putting on noise-canceling earphones and playing light music. Combining the morning's outline and the afternoon's references, I began writing the first draft of Kunming's Winter Symphony. With the clatter of the keyboard, I turned what I had seen and felt yesterday into words, completing about 1,200 characters of the first draft.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon tea break and revising and polishing the manuscript.
description: I got up and went to the kitchen to brew a cup of osmanthus oolong tea. Holding the cup, I paced in the living room to loosen my neck and lower back from sitting for too long, and watered the asparagus fern on the windowsill. Then I returned to the desk, read through the first draft, revised two word choices, and polished the "roasted ham" detail to make it more vivid. After saving the document, I felt satisfied with today's writing progress.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walked in Cuihu Park with parents to share the good news, then returned home to help with dinner
description: After putting on a thick wool coat, a knit hat, and a scarf, and pouring a cup of warm water for each of her parents, the family of three walked about five minutes to Green Lake Park. The glow of the setting sun fell on the lake, and red-billed gulls circled overhead. During the walk, Yuwei officially told her parents the good news that she had received the advance payment and completed the deposit. Her father patted her shoulder approvingly, and her mother took her arm with a proud smile. They walked more than halfway around the lake, talking about their plans for the Spring Festival. After returning home from the park, Yuwei helped her mother in the kitchen, picking and washing the pea shoots to be stir-fried for dinner, and shared the sights she had seen during the walk.
location: No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner was mother's garlic-sprout twice-cooked pork, stir-fried pea shoots, and radish and pork rib soup. The family chatted while eating; my father shared amusing stories from the year-end summary meeting, and the table was filled with warmth and joy.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Accept best friend Chen Sisi's invitation to write the preface for her art exhibition and plan the new work.
description: After dinner, she returned to the study and her phone rang — it was a WeChat call from her best friend Chen Sisi. Sisi introduced the cutting-edge art exhibition 'Urban Fabric' that she was preparing, themed on images and memories of Kunming's old neighborhoods, and hoped Yuwei could help write an exhibition preface of about 1,500 characters. Yuwei felt the theme was very much in line with her own creative work, readily agreed, and promised to submit the manuscript by this Sunday (December 14). After hanging up, she wrote in her journal: 'Accepted Sisi's invitation: write a preface for the art exhibition "Urban Fabric," deadline December 14.' She then opened the calendar on her phone and set research and writing reminders for the next few days.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shared the good news via video call with her sister, who is far away in Shenzhen.
description: Chatted with her elder sister Sun Yutong via WeChat video, excitedly sharing the good news of receiving the advance payment and showing a photo of the newly issued bankbook. Her sister cheered for her on the video, asked about the progress of the publication plan, and invited her to Shenzhen during the winter vacation.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After hanging up the video call, she went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into her pajamas, and applied moisturizing lotion. She took Wang Zengqi's The Grass and Trees of the Human World from the bookshelf and got ready to read before bed.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Read The Human World's Grass and Trees before bed
description: Leaning against the headboard, she turned on the bedside lamp and immersed herself in the chapter about Kunming's mushrooms in Plants in the Human World. The prose was warm and gentle, and her mind was at peace.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation, journal reflection, and turning off the lights to fall asleep.
description: She turned off the light, put down her phone, lay flat, and began 10 minutes of mindfulness breathing meditation, slowly exhaling the excitement and agitation of the day, feeling the rhythm of her breath, and gradually becoming calmer. Then, by the faint light of her phone, she briefly wrote in her journal: "Made the savings deposit, finished the first section of the manuscript, and accepted Sisi's invitation. A fulfilling day. Grateful for everything." Reviewing the day, she felt strong and content. She adjusted her sleeping position, felt warm and secure in bed, and fell asleep peacefully at 23:00.
location: Room 302, Building A, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning run and meditation
description: At 6:05 in the morning, the phone alarm went off. Sun Yuwei quickly got up, changed into her sportswear and running shoes, did a few simple joint-warming exercises, and walked to the south gate of Cuihu Park at 6:15 to start a 5-kilometer morning run, keeping a steady pace of about 7 minutes 5 seconds per kilometer. After the run, she did 15 minutes of post-run stretching and meditation near the Nine-Bend Bridge to let her thoughts settle.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home and breakfast
description: After her morning run, Sun Yuwei walked about 8 minutes home. After arriving, she had breakfast with her parents. Her mother had prepared steaming hot small-pot rice noodles. While eating, she discussed the day's plans with her parents, telling them she would spend the whole day at the city library doing research for Chen Sisi's exhibition. Her mother told her to help out well.
location: Home dining room, Unit 2, Building 8, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went to Kunming Library.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei packed her canvas bag with her laptop, notebook, pen, water bottle, and scarf, and walked to Kunming Library, a journey of about 12 minutes.
location: Along the route from home to Kunming City Library, start and end points: 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province to 286 Dongfeng East Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Morning curatorial research at the library
description: After arriving at the library, Sun Yuwei went straight to the art reference section and began looking up materials based on the list of artists Chen Sisi had sent her. She flipped through exhibition catalogs and portfolios, photographed key works with her phone, and recorded career histories, stylistic evolution, and critics' comments in her notebook. During a short break in the second-floor corridor, she looked into the distance to rest her eyes. Then she returned to her seat, opened the curatorial proposal PDF on her computer, focused on the 'curatorial concept' and 'spatial narrative' sections, grasped the core theme of 'urban fabric,' and drew a preliminary structural diagram in her notebook.
location: Kunming Library Art Literature Section, No. 286 Dongfeng East Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and return to the library
description: At noon, Sun Yuwei walked about 9 minutes to Zhengyang Braised Noodle Shop and ordered a steaming bowl of braised noodles. After eating, she strolled for more than ten minutes in the nearby shade to sort out her thoughts. Then she walked slowly back to the library, met an architecture student at the entrance, and exchanged a few words about the roof structure of the old library building.
location: Zhengyang Braised Noodle Shop, No. 21 Renmin Lane, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and nearby streets; return to Kunming Library.

name: Afternoon: in-depth research and presentation at the library.
description: Back at her seat in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei integrated the scattered notes from the morning and wrote a research summary of about 500 words on her computer, extracting keywords such as “rubbing”, “seam”, and “memory layer”, and archiving high-definition images of the works by artist.
