With her thoughts clear, she drafted an introduction outline, using 'from the “rubbing” of the urban texture, through the artists' “seam”; intervention, and finally arriving at our shared “memory layer”' as the main thread. Around 16:00, she organized the research summary and outline into an 800-word document, sent it to Chen Sisi via WeChat, and attached a voice note.
location: Kunming Library Art Literature Section, No. 286 Dongfeng East Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Going home and resting.
description: After receiving an affirming reply from Chen Sisi, Sun Yuwei packed up her things and walked 12 minutes from the library back home. Once home, she changed into loungewear, organized the newly sent audio interview transcript from Chen Sisi in the study, and excerpted key points into her notebook. When finished, she leaned back in her chair to rest, drank some warm water, and flipped through Wang Zengqi's The Grass and Trees of the Human World.
location: Home study, Building 8, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Taking a walk around Cuihu Lake with my parents
description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents to Green Lake Park for a walk. The family of three walked around the lake once. Her father asked about the opening hours of Chen Sisi's exhibition, and her mother told her not to get too tired. The lake breeze was slightly cool, and the three of them enjoyed a warm family time.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner and rest after the meal
description: After returning from the walk, her mother had prepared dinner: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed sea bass, and radish and pork rib soup. The family ate and chatted. Her mother shared amusing stories from the vegetable market, and her father talked about the New Year's Day event at his workplace. After dinner, Sun Yuwei helped her mother clear the table, then watched local news on the living room sofa, while her father watered flowers on the balcony and her mother read a novel.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Unit 2, Building 8, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening material sorting and reporting
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the study, turned on her computer, and further digitized and archived the interview notes and handwritten notes she had organized that afternoon. Based on the existing material, she drew a more complete 'foreword structure tree diagram' in her journal, using different colors to mark main arguments, sub-arguments, and alternative poem lines. During this time, she again had an in-depth exchange with Chen Sisi on WeChat about key concepts, and Sisi sent more artist interview records, which she categorized and archived.
location: Home study, Building 8, Unit 2, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Shower and relax
description: After finishing work, Sun Yuwei went to the bathroom for a hot shower. The warm water eased the stiffness in her shoulders caused by sitting for a long time, and as she washed, she mentally reviewed the day's ideas.
location: Home bathroom, Unit 2, Building 8, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journaling and review
description: Changing into comfortable pajamas, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk, opened her journal, and wrote today's review in fountain pen: "Doing research quietly in the library is an immersive joy. Sisi's trust makes me feel responsibility, but also happiness." Next to it, she pasted a close-up photo of the artist's work taken in the library today, and sketched the preliminary structure of the introduction with colored pens.
location: Home study/bedroom, Unit 2, Building 8, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and reading before bed to fall asleep.
description: Turning off the main light, Sun Yuwei did a 10-minute pre-sleep meditation on the yoga mat at the foot of the bed, relaxing her shoulders and back. Then she got into the covers, picked up Kunming Notes by her bedside, and read the chapter about the changes of Xiaoximen. At 22:30, she put down the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Unit 2, Building 8, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: At first light, you put on a cashmere cardigan and sat cross-legged on the edge of the bed, beginning the day's meditation on the theme of 'embracing impermanence.' Your thoughts drifted like the hazy sky outside the window, but you tried to bring your attention back to your breath, and the soreness in your shoulders and back gradually loosened with each breath. After the meditation, you did some simple stretching.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and tidying
description: Splashed my face with warm water to wake up, made the bed, dug out the journal I didn't have time to write in last night, and put it on the desk to fill in later in the evening.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Mother had set out breakfast — millet porridge, boiled eggs, fermented bean curd, and meat buns from the bun shop downstairs. Father, sipping hot soy milk, complained about the lengthy process of the Culture Bureau's year-end summary meeting. Mother interjected that Aunt Xie had sent flower cakes again yesterday. You smiled and responded, thinking that they would be perfect with tea tonight.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning writing and contacting friends.
description: She brewed a cup of Yunnan black tea, put on noise-canceling headphones, and opened her computer. Fusing the artist materials from yesterday’s library research on “Rubbing, Seams, and Memory Layers” with the exhibition plan, she wrote the preface for the theme “Urban Memory and Reconstruction.” When ideas flowed, the keyboard made a crisp clicking sound; when she got stuck, she stood up to fiddle with the narcissus leaves or stood by the window watching the black-headed gulls in Green Lake Park below. By around 10:45, she had written about 1000 characters, but the passages connecting the artists still needed inspiration. Near 11, she picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to her best friend Zhang Jing, asking her to have lunch near Green Lake. Zhang Jing quickly replied that she had no classes in the afternoon and could meet at Wenhua Lane. You decide to go downstairs and take a walk around Green Lake to get some fresh air and clear your head.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Walked to Green Lake Park
description: I put on a coat and went out, walked through the neighborhood alleys, and arrived at the south gate of Cuihu Park a few minutes later. The weather was cloudy, the wind over the lake was gentle, and black-headed gulls kept fluttering their wings in the cold wind with crisp calls.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cuihu Lake stroll and lunch with close friends
description: You walked briskly around the lake, loosening your stiff neck and shoulders. Then you walked to Wenhua Lane to meet Zhang Jing, ducked into Binhu Restaurant, and each of you ordered a steaming bowl of braised pork rice noodles and a few side dishes. While eating, you talked to her about the bottleneck in writing the foreword. Between bites, she suggested, "Why not imagine you're a rubbing artist, rubbing down the entire exhibition, then cutting and piecing it together?" That playful remark made you thoughtful.
location: Binhu Hotel, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Mingyuan Bookstore
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Jing, you walked slowly along the bluestone-paved Wenlin Street toward Mingyuan Bookstore. The plane trees on both sides had almost lost all their leaves, leaving only gnarled branches stretching into the sky. You had sent Uncle Qin a WeChat message ahead of time, saying you would be there soon.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Kunming Paper, Cloth and Stone Bookstore)

name: Discussion and writing at Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Pushing open the bookstore's wooden door, you were greeted by the scent of old books. Uncle Qin was sorting books behind the counter and nodded in greeting. You handed him the printed draft of the foreword. He put on his reading glasses, looked at it for a while, then looked up and said that this writing style was like making yourself a museum curator and docent, calm and comprehensive, but an exhibition has warmth and you have to put yourself into it. He turned and pulled out The Four Seasons of Kunming, flipped to a page, and said that when you write about a city's texture, you should write as you would about a person, because every crack holds a story. His words made it click for you: memory fragments. After thanking him, you found a workstation in the corner, opened your laptop, revised the opening of a section of the foreword, and continued with about 300 more characters, using the memory fragments image to connect the works of several artists.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (Kunming Paper, Cloth and Stone Bookstore)

name: Accidental phone drop and repair
description: After finishing writing, you felt a sense of relief, packed up your things, said goodbye to Uncle Qin, and got ready to head home. Walking cheerfully along Wenlin Street, you took out your phone to send your mom a message saying you would be home for dinner. As you looked down and typed, the thin strap of your shoulder bag suddenly slipped off. You instinctively reached to grab it, but that caused the phone to lose its balance. “Smack!” The phone fell onto the bluestone pavement, and the outer screen at the upper left corner cracked into a fine spiderweb, though touch and display were still normal. You sighed helplessly, raised your phone toward the clouds and bare branches in the sky, and took a photo with the “damaged lens,” leaving the first record of this crack. Then you walked to the Xunjie Phone Repair Shop on Renmin Middle Road nearby. The owner, Master Li, took the phone and judged it as a cracked outer screen. Replacing it with an original outer screen would cost 270 yuan and take about an hour. You agreed, sat on a plastic stool, and waited. You chatted with Master Li as he deftly took the phone apart, remarking, “You young people can’t put your phones down all day. I repair a dozen screens a day—all from careless drops.” You silently mulled over his words, and phrases like “digital dependence” and “fragility” surfaced in your mind. An hour later, you scanned a QR code to pay 270 yuan, took the good-as-new phone, and left.
location: Wenlin Street and Xunjie Mobile Phone Repair Shop at No. 58 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Hurried home to meet up with her parents.
description: Hurrying home, you arrived half an hour later than the agreed time. When you opened the door, you saw Dad had already changed into his walking sneakers and was sitting on the sofa looking at his phone. Mom poked her head out of the kitchen: "You're finally back. Why didn't you answer my call?" Only then did you remember that your phone had been turned off during the repair. You poured out your frustrations about your smashed phone, in a tone of self-mockery and relief that it had been fixed.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Taking a Walk with My Parents Around Green Lake and Heading Home
description: The three of them went out together and walked around a relatively quiet lake. You walked in the middle, holding your mother's arm, while your father on the other side kept muttering, "Out with the old, in with the new." You told them about your experience writing the foreword today and about Uncle Qin's advice. Your mother reminded you: "Next time you walk, don't look at your phone." You walked one full loop around the lake, and by the time you finished, it was completely dark; the streetlights by the lakeside came on, reflecting in the water. Then the three of you walked home together. The evening breeze carried the scent of the lake, and you took a deep breath, feeling much calmer.
location: Cuihu Park, South Cuihu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road

name: Family dinner
description: After returning home, Mom brought out braised pork ribs, stir-fried choy sum, and the flower cakes made by Aunt Xie. At the table, you ate one flower cake; the sweet floral fragrance with the crisp crust completely softened your mood. You also casually picked up a rib for Dad.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Creative writing and journaling in the study.
description: Back in the study, you first dug out the backup phone, connected to Wi-Fi, looked up the official screen replacement policy for the phone model repaired today, and saved it. Then you used a data cable to transfer the photos of the cracked screen taken this afternoon to the computer. Looking at the details of the cracks on the screen, inspiration struck like a needle tip. You created a new Word document, titled it Fragments, and began drafting the opening and structure of the article—from Master Li's remark that repairing more than a dozen screens a day is all because of carelessness, to the feel of the bluestone-paved road at the moment the phone shattered, to the streetlights reflected in the cracks of the screen, wanting to explore how memory and everyday life depend on each other.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime breathing exercises and journaling
description: You turn off the study light and go back to the bedroom. You sit cross-legged on the floor, dim the lights, close your eyes, and do a 10-minute breathing exercise, trying to let today's racing thoughts settle. Then you take out your Bujo journal and write down everything that happened today in detail with a fountain pen—the gloomy morning, Zhang Jing's joke, Uncle Qin's advice, the shattered phone, Master Li's complaints, and your parents' words during the walk. As the nib moves across the page, you feel that this is how the day is truly 'put away'.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and bedtime
description: She picked up "Kunming Notes" from the bedside and turned to the page she had read the night before. After reading a few lines, her eyelids grew heavy. She glanced at the time on her phone: exactly 11 PM. She turned off the lamp and, in the darkness, listening to the wind outside the window, slowly drifted into a dream.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: Sun Yuwei spread a gray yoga mat on the balcony of her bedroom at home in Green Lake Community and did 25 minutes of yoga and meditation. The sky was overcast; faint sounds of morning exercise came from Green Lake in the distance. She focused on her breath, letting yesterday's frustration at her cracked phone screen and today's anticipation of writing come and go freely, and gradually felt her heart settle into peace.
location: Bedroom balcony of home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Quick wash-up and preparation
description: After meditation, Sun Yuwei quickly washed up, changed into sportswear and running shoes, put on her earphones, and got ready to go downstairs for morning exercise.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Cross-training: brisk walking in the park
description: Sun Yuwei walked about 5 minutes to the south gate of Cuihu Park and started a 30-minute brisk walk under overcast skies, at a pace of about 9 minutes per kilometer, targeting 3.5 kilometers. On the second lap, a light rain began to fall. She kept going against the rain, completing the workout and enjoying the coolness in the rain.
location: Lakeside trail, Cuihu Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: When she returned home from morning exercise, her mother had already cooked small-pot rice noodles. The family sat around the dining table, listening to her mother share an amusing story about getting fresh fennel at the market, while her father slowly flipped through the morning paper. After the meal, Sun Yuwei washed the dishes on her own initiative.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Picked up the repaired phone
description: Sun Yuwei walked about 8 minutes to arrive at the mobile phone repair service center on Kunshi Road. The repair technician, Master Li, was already at work. She checked the new outer screen, and it worked perfectly. While paying, the two chatted. Master Li said with a sigh, "The screens I repair every day are all ones people dropped while holding them."
location: Huawei Authorized Service Center, Kunshi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Write the essay "Fragments" and post it on Xiaohongshu.
description: After walking about 11 minutes from the repair shop to Kunming Zhibushi Bookstore, Sun Yuwei ordered a cup of hot Dianhong tea and sat down at her familiar window seat on the second floor. With her thoughts flowing smoothly, she wove the fragmented sentences from the previous night into a warm essay, starting from the cracked screen and reflecting on the fragility of digital life. She finished at 11:30, used the photo of light and shadow on the cracked screen she had taken the night before as an illustration, and posted it on her personal Xiaohongshu account “Yuwei’s Slow Notes.” Within minutes of posting, she received comments, and she replied to them one by one.
location: Window-side seat on the second floor of Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lunch
description: Sun Yuwei left the bookstore and walked two minutes to her usual Xiangxiang Snack Shop on Wenlin Street. She ordered a mushroom braised rice and a cold fish mint salad, and while eating, she replied to comments on Xiaohongshu while enjoying the authentic local food.
location: Xiangxiang Snacks, No. 130 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Exploring a new cultural and creative store alone
description: During an after-dinner walk, Sun Yuwei discovered a newly opened creative goods store on Wenlin Street called "Three Journals." The shop's walls covered in journals, stickers, and stamps attracted her. She chose sticky-note stickers with ginkgo leaf and raindrop patterns and a roll of pineapple washi tape as today's "useless beauty."
location: San Ge Journal Cultural and Creative General Store, 148 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Attend the Green Lake Literary Afternoon Tea Salon.
description: Sun Yuwei walked about 10 minutes to The Moment Café for a literary salon themed 'Kunming in Essays.' At the salon, she shared her reflections on writing 'Fragments' and discussed the creative possibilities of combining images and text with an independent illustrator. She also met a local writer who loved browsing independent bookstores just as much as she did, and the two exchanged WeChat contacts.
location: China, Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, No. 4 Cuihu South Road, This Moment Café, second-floor private room

name: Had an in-depth conversation with Uncle Qin and planned a reading activity.
description: After the salon ended, Sun Yuwei walked back to Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore. The owner, Qin Mingyuan, was tidying the bookshelves, and she shared the day's creations and amusing moments from the salon with Uncle Qin. The two talked about everything from smartphone dependence to the warmth of paper books, and hit it off immediately, deciding to include a one-hour digital detox segment in the January reading club. Sun Yuwei sketched a poster draft right in her journal: a phone placed on a stack of books, with the words Let go, and you can pick up written beside it. Uncle Qin helped add a stamp and the date.
location: Kunming Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Return home to rest and tidy up.
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, Sun Yuwei walked about 15 minutes back to her home in Cuihu Community, changed into loungewear, lay down on the sofa to rest, and drank half a glass of warm water. She then quickly noted down the inspiration from the afternoon salon and event planning in her phone's memo app, and organized it into her journal.
location: Living room at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Taking a walk with my parents at Green Lake.
description: After the rain, the sky cleared, and the air was fresh with moisture. Sun Yuwei took a full loop around Green Lake Park with her parents. She shared the day's fun stories and the reading event she was planning. Her father expressed support, and her mother said, 'Then I'll go to your bookstore and take a look when the time comes.'
location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan, China

name: Complete and polish the exhibition preface.
description: After returning from her walk, Sun Yuwei sat down at the study desk full of energy. She incorporated the day's thoughts on "fragments," her feelings from the salon, and inspiration for a "digital detox" poster into the exhibition preface, finishing the remaining part in one go. She then read it through, polished it, revised it, and after ensuring the delivery quality, saved a backup.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Washing up and evening journaling
description: Sun Yuwei took a shower and did her skincare, then sat at her bedroom desk and carefully decorated the day's journal page with newly bought stickers. She recorded the timeline and the mood keywords “connection, creation, satisfaction,” and pasted in the poster sketch for “Digital Detox Hour.”
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Bedtime breathing exercise
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the overhead light, leaving only the bedside lamp, and began a 10-minute pre-sleep breathing exercise. She reviewed her day—from the initial spark of inspiration to finishing the draft late at night—and felt calm and fulfilled inside.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Reading and falling asleep
description: After relaxing, Sun Yuwei picked up “Notes on Kunming” by her bedside and finished the chapter on the history of Cuihu Lake. At 23:00, she closed the book, turned off the light, and drifted into a restful sleep with a feeling of abundance and peace.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Morning meditation and yoga
description: Sun Yuwei woke up naturally at 06:02 and did not linger in bed. She sat on the edge of the bed and did ten minutes of breathing meditation, feeling the flow of breath. Then she moved to the living room, unrolled her yoga mat, did five minutes of Sun Salutation A, mobilized her hips and ankles, and used a foam roller to loosen the front of her thighs in preparation for running.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning long run
description: Sun Yuwei closed the door behind her, took the stairs down, greeted the security guard of the residential compound, and quickly walked to the starting point of the Panlong River Greenway at Green Lake Park. She started running in the cool winter morning air, keeping a steady pace of 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Crossing the Nine-Bend Bridge, she saw sunlight reflected on the lake and red-billed gulls resting on the shallows. After turning onto the Panlong River section, she put on her earphones and played her running playlist. By the 6th kilometer her legs were tired, but she regulated her breathing and pushed through to complete 9 kilometers. After the run, she stretched for 15 minutes on a bench by the river, enjoying the relaxed, pleasant feeling after exercise, then slowly walked home. Her body was slightly sweaty and she felt refreshed, and she picked up a copy of the Spring City Evening News downstairs.
location: Greenway from Green Lake Park to Panlong River, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shower and breakfast
description: After returning home, she quickly took a hot shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had prepared steaming hot small-pot rice noodles with boiled eggs. While eating, she chatted with her mother about how her morning run felt, and her mother reminded her to take care of her knees.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Study work: polishing the foreword, replying, and journaling
description: Sun Yuwei sat down in the study, opened the draft she had finished yesterday, and polished it sentence by sentence. She optimized the opening to make it more immersive and carefully checked the artists' names and artwork titles. At 09:55, she sent the finalized 1,500-word preface to Chen Sisi via WeChat with the message, 'Sisi, the final version is done. Take a look. See you at the preview today!' Shortly after, she received an excited video call from Chen Sisi, who praised the preface as excellent and said she had already sent it to the designer to put up immediately. Sun Yuwei felt relieved. Then, while in high spirits, she used her phone to reply to Song Wen's enthusiastic comments on the essay Fragments, sharing her creative insights and encouraging her. She also took out the poster draft and added in pencil a visual symbol for the 'Digital Detox Hour' segment—a simple drawing of a phone covered by a stack of books. Next, she opened her journal and used an amber fountain pen to record the details of yesterday's planning session with Uncle Qin at the Paper Stone Bookstore for the reading club, including the event theme 'Digital Detox and Urban Reading,' the interactive segments, and the poster concept. She also wrote down the sense of accomplishment from delivering the preface today, pasted in a clipping from the exhibition brochure, and marked the date.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Lunch was earlier than usual. Mother made braised crucian carp, stir-fried pea shoots, and tomato and egg soup. Sun Yuwei shared the joy of successfully delivering the preface that morning and Chen Sisi's excited feedback. Her father Sun Mingyuan asked about the artists and styles at the afternoon preview, and her mother urged her to take plenty of photos, joking that it would broaden the Chinese teacher's horizons.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and outfit preparation.
description: You have completed the 15-minute body scan meditation, from 22:50 to 23:05, with good relaxation results.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took the subway to the art museum.
description: Sun Yuwei took her phone, journal, and canvas tote bag and headed out. She reached Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station in less than two minutes, swiped her card to enter, took Metro Line 5, transferred to Line 3 at Wuyi Road Station, rode two stops, and got off at Dongfeng Square Station. She exited from Exit A and followed the navigation for a five-minute walk to arrive at CGK Kunming Contemporary Art Museum on Haihong Road.
location: Kunming Metro Line 5 Huashan West Road Station to Line 3 Dongfeng Square Station, and CGK Kunming Contemporary Art Museum, Haihong Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Attended the VIP preview of “Urban Memory and Reconstruction”.
description: Sun Yuwei checked in at the front desk and received a customized exhibition brochure. As she entered the hall, she saw that the foreword she had written had been enlarged and printed as a huge display panel, standing in the most prominent spot at the entrance. The solemn typography made her pause for a long time, her heart filled with calm joy. Then she found Chen Sisi; they exchanged smiles and took a photo together in front of the panel. Afterwards, she quietly toured the other exhibition areas, carefully reading each artwork description and absorbing the works. She also talked with other participating artists and media guests.
location: CGK Kunming Contemporary Art Museum, Haihong Road, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Strolled through Zhuanxin Wet Market and walked home.
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Sisi, Sun Yuwei walked from the art museum to Zhuanxin Market, passing a path lined with plane trees, with sunlight casting shadows through the leaves. The walk took about 35 minutes. Upon arriving at the bustling market, she went straight to the flower shop and bought a bouquet of white daisies for 10 yuan. She also bought her mother's favorite Jianshui tofu and two pieces of fermented black beans, and got a bag of fried potatoes from the deli section, eating them as she walked. Then she strolled home with the flowers and tofu, passing the west gate of Green Lake Park, thinking she might bring her parents for a walk by the lake in the evening. It took about 10 minutes to get home.
location: Daguan Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, No. 69 Zuantang Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and on the way home

name: Going home to recharge and taking a walk with parents at Green Lake
description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei put the daisies in a vase, put the tofu and fermented black beans in the fridge, changed out of her coat, washed her face, and sat for a while in the living room. She then suggested taking a walk by Green Lake with her parents. The three of them walked two minutes to Green Lake Park and strolled slowly along the lakeside. She shared what she had seen at the afternoon preview and, pointing at the black-headed gulls, remarked on how the works connected with urban memory. Her father listened with great interest, and they also explored their understanding of “urban memory” and “reconstruction.”
location: She left the study to rest her eyes. In the kitchen, she used the pork rib soup simmered yesterday and the leftover greens from the fridge to make herself a steaming bowl of noodles in pork rib soup. While cooking the noodles, she played her favorite folk playlist on her phone, enjoying a quiet lunch alone. Submitting the final draft: Sun Yuwei downloaded the final revised version of “The Slow Travel Notes” and its preface from the cloud drive, packed them into a zip file, attached a concise email body, and sent it, breathing a sigh of relief. 3. Cover discussion: The two exchanged views on the direction of the cover design. Editor Xu sent a few reference images with a “fresh, literary” style, but Sun Yuwei felt they were too vague and proposed the idea of “using the texture of the bluestone slab roads in Kunming's old streets that she had photographed, blended with rippling water-like light,” attaching photos from her phone. Editor Xu approved and agreed to have the designer produce two draft proposals next week. 4. Meeting confirmation: Yuwei checked Editor Xu's schedule and finally decided on an online internal topic selection meeting at the publishing house at 3 p.m. next Monday. She recorded the information on the dedicated task page of her planner and set a phone reminder.

She silently recited key terms such as Cuicui's symbolic meaning and poetic language, and sketched in the air a logical framework for answering questions, reinforcing her memory and increasing her confidence.

name: Taking the Subway to the Exam Hall
description: At 8:30, Yuwei carried her commuter bag containing her exam admission ticket, student ID, and stationery, and walked from home to Huashan West Road Metro Station. She took Metro Line 5 to North Railway Station, transferred to Line 4 to Kunming South Station, then transferred to the Line 1 branch to University Town Station. The entire trip took about 75 minutes. After exiting the station, she walked about 10 minutes and arrived at the No. 1 Teaching Building on the Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University at exactly 10:00.
location: Kunming, Yunnan Province: along the metro line from Wuhua District to Yunnan University Chenggong Campus in Chenggong District

name: Exam preparation and check-in.
description: Arrived at the exam hall one hour early. Yuwei found her seat in Exam Room 301 and placed her ID and stationery. In the corridor, she looked out at the golden ginkgo leaves and campus scenery, taking deep breaths to relax.
location: Exam Room 301, Teaching Building 1, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking the final exam in Modern Chinese Literary History
description: The exam started at exactly 11:00. Yuwei quickly scanned the paper. When she saw the essay question analyzing the artistic features of Border Town, she felt much more settled. She answered calmly, laying out clearly the symbolism of Cuicui's character, the novel's poetic language, and its status in Chinese local literature, filling two pages of the answer sheet. She felt the logic was rigorous and her performance was steady.
location: Exam Room 301, Teaching Building 1, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-exam exchange, return trip, and a walk around Green Lake
description: After handing in the exam, she ran into her roommate Liu Jia at the entrance to the teaching building. The two chatted briefly and both felt they had done well on the exam. They agreed to check out a newly opened independent bookstore together next semester. Yuwei then walked back along the same route to the subway station, took the metro to Huashan West Road Station, and took a detour for a stroll around Green Lake Park. The winter sun cast dappled light through the plane tree leaves. She took deep breaths to relax her tense nerves and snapped a few photos of sunlight filtering through the leaves as journal material.
location: From Yunnan University Chenggong Campus in Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Green Lake Park in Wuhua District

name: Go home for lunch.
description: It was already past 2 p.m. when she got home. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had deliberately saved some stir-fried mushrooms with pork, stir-fried choy sum, and tomato egg soup. At the table, Yuwei shared that the exam had gone smoothly. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, showed a smile at the corners of his mouth, and her mother told her to rest properly in the afternoon.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Afternoon nap and reviewing Introduction to Linguistics
description: After the meal, she took a 30-minute nap. Then Yuwei spread out the textbook and notes for 'An Introduction to Linguistics' on her desk. She used a mind map to organize key concepts in phonetics and lexicology, and completed three sets of after-class exercises, marking the wrong answers with a red pen.
location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Browsing Paper Cloth Stone Bookstore, taking a walk around Green Lake, and supermarket shopping.
description: During a break from studying, her eyes were sore, so Yuwei walked to the Zhibushi Bookstore on Cuihu North Road. Uncle Qin had specially set aside a new issue of Prose magazine for her. She flipped through it in a window seat, and also noted several new books on Yunnan local culture as inspiration for her term paper. Afterward, she strolled along Cuihu Park and took photos of red-billed gulls skimming the golden lake surface. Leaving the park, she walked through alleys to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street, bought a box of blueberries her mother liked and a bag of daily nuts, then walked home.
location: Zhibushi Bookstore, No. 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; Cuihu Park; and Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, No. 98 Fuchun Street

name: Family dinner and conversation
description: Back home, Mom had already prepared steamed cured sausage, stir-fried vegetables, and winter melon soup. The family of three chatted while eating; Yuwei shared what she saw at the bookstore in the afternoon and photos of the red-billed gulls she had taken. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening personal time: journaling, yoga, and brainstorming the thesis proposal
description: After nightfall, Yuwei spread open her journal notebook in the study, drew a lively red-billed gull with a pen, printed out the book cover photo and the red-billed gull photos at sunset she had taken in the afternoon, and pasted them in, writing next to them her feelings about the exam and her commitment to making meditation and a gratitude journal her evening ritual. After that, she spread out her yoga mat in the room and did several rounds of Cat-Cow and Child's pose to relax. Then she sat back down at the desk, turned on her computer, and under the framework of her annual thesis proposal, 'Local Writing in Contemporary Yunnan Prose,' added notes on the inspiration she had gathered from magazines and new books.
location: The study and bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime reading and skincare
description: Yuwei set aside her study tasks, put on a hydrating mask, and leaned against the headboard to flip through the Prose magazine she had brought back from Zhibushi Bookstore, immersing herself in the world of words. Twenty minutes later, she took off the mask and gently massaged her face to help it absorb.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and gratitude journal
description: Yuwei turned off the light, leaving a small nightlight on, and sat cross-legged on the bed. She opened the Tide app and followed its guidance for a ten-minute mindful breathing session, bringing her awareness back to the present. Then, in the gratitude diary section of her bedside journal, she wrote three things: she did well on today's exam, Uncle Qin had kept a magazine for her, and the golden sunset over Cuihu Lake in the evening. Filled with warmth and contentment, she turned off her phone at around 23:30, listened to her steady breathing, and slowly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and at-home stretching.
description: After waking up naturally in the early morning, Sun Yuwei did not go for a morning run but chose an at-home wake-up routine to prepare for today's journal sharing session. She opened the Tide app to play forest white noise, did spinal twists and cat-cow stretches in bed, then drank warm water, savoring the soft winter light outside the window in Kunming, gathering energy for the day's activities.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Washing up and dressing simply
description: Sun Yuwei was in a calm mood. After washing up, she did not wear makeup, only applying sunscreen and lip balm. She put on an off-white wool cardigan and dark blue jeans, slung a khaki canvas crossbody bag over her shoulder, and prepared to greet the day's activities with a comfortable, bookish look.
location: Home bathroom, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with mother and discussing plans.
description: Her mother Li Xiulan cooked steaming hot ersi. As she ate, Sun Yuwei told her mother about today's plan: in the morning she would organize materials at home, at noon she would go to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, in the afternoon she would attend a yoga class, and she would be home around five. Her mother told her not to overexert herself and reminded her to bring a USB flash drive.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Preparing materials for the journal sharing session in the study (Phase 1)
description: Sun Yuwei entered the study, opened her three journals — travel, reading, and inspiration — and selected representative pages, including a pen sketch of Dali, a review of *Border Town*, and a collage of dried flowers and movie tickets. She stuck sticky notes with key talking points next to the pages and focused on perfecting her sharing content.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Take a walk in Green Lake Park to find inspiration.
description: Sun Yuwei walked to Cuihu Park, observed the black-headed gulls by the lake and the morning exercisers, and conceived a short story for the opening of the sharing session—about how journaling captures life moments. She sat on a park bench, photographed the flying birds with her phone, and recorded inspiration in the journal she carried with her.
location: Green Lake Park, No. 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Finalize materials for the sharing session and organize tools
description: After getting inspiration from the park, Sun Yuwei returned to her study and jotted down her ideas in a document. She then packed the 'treasure box' she would bring the next day: putting tape, watercolors, scissors, a stamp-carving set, and stickers into a canvas tote bag, and following the 'tools—techniques—finished pieces' logic to ensure a smooth flow in the demonstration.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Book hunting at Mingyuan Bookstore and lunch
description: Sun Yuwei walked to Mingyuan Book House at 142 Wenlin Street, but Uncle Qin was out. She browsed the bookstore without borrowing any books, but noted down the titles of two books she was interested in. Then she went to the Binhu Restaurant across the street and had a quick lunch of small-pot rice noodles.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore and its surroundings, No. 142 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Noon break and final exam review
description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei brewed chrysanthemum goji tea on the living room sofa and used her phone to review the mind map of phonological sandhi from Introduction to Linguistics, preparing for the exam on the 22nd. She then took a 20-minute nap to regain energy.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Change into yoga clothes and prepare to go out
description: After resting at noon, her energy restored, Sun Yuwei changed into a gray sports vest and black yoga leggings, brought her water bottle and towel, checked that the yoga mat was in good condition, rolled it up into the carrying strap, and got ready to go to the yoga studio.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Hip and Shoulder Opening Class at Zhongmou Yoga Studio
description: Sun Yuwei walked 15 minutes to Zhongmou Yoga Studio in Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road. Instructor He Lu led the students through hip- and shoulder-opening exercises, including Sun Salutation, Pigeon Pose, Cow Face Pose, Shoulderstand, and more. In Warrior III, she found the joy of balance and received the instructor's approval. After class, she shared ginger and red date tea with the students, feeling relaxed in body and mind.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Grocery shopping on the way
description: After yoga class, Sun Yuwei went to the Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket on Fuchun Street. Since her mother said the family was out of saltwater shrimp, she bought a box of fresh shrimp, as well as blueberries and a lollipop.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Bumped into our neighbor Aunt Xie.
description: Carrying the shopping bag back to the apartment building, Sun Yuwei ran into Aunt Xie Xiulan from across the hall on the ground floor. When Aunt Xie learned that she was going to hold a journal-sharing session the next day, she warmly praised her and pressed two freshly made egg-white cakes into her hands. Sun Yuwei thanked her happily and went upstairs.
location: Corridor of Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Rehearse the sharing session content with my mother
description: Sun Yuwei carried the material kit into the living room and gave her mother a full 15-minute run-through, showing the journal pages and the shadow collage interactive design. After listening carefully, her mother suggested she slow down during the beginner part and use more real-life examples. This advice made her feel more at ease.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Making final adjustments based on the suggestions
description: Sun Yuwei returned to the study, took her mother's advice, and added a page to the presentation document for the beginner's guide session, showing how to make a beginner collage with old magazines, receipts, and sticky notes. She rechecked the files on the USB drive to make sure the materials for the sharing session were correct.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family dinner time
description: After her father Sun Mingyuan got off work, the family of three sat around and enjoyed dinner. Her mother made oil-braised shrimp using the shrimp she had bought, along with garlic bok choy and winter melon soup. Her father asked with concern about her preparation for tomorrow's sharing event, and the family chatted relaxedly in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening relaxation and inspiration gathering
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei helped her mother clear the dishes, then went upstairs, warmed some milk, put on headphones to listen to Landlord's Cat, and ate blueberries and a lollipop while scrolling through the latest posts from a journal blogger on her phone, completely relaxing.
location: Living room/bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mindful meditation and gratitude journal
description: Sun Yuwei performed her bedtime routine, using the Tide app to do a 10-minute body scan meditation. Afterward, she wrote a gratitude journal in her journal book: thanking her mother for breakfast and advice, thanking her yoga teacher for the guidance, and thanking herself for her focus and effort.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Free reading and essay drafting
description: Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and read the essay collection Plants and Seasons on her Kindle. When she reached the article about Yunnan camellias, she remembered what she had seen at Cuihu Lake and wrote down the keyword phrase Kunming winter plants in her phone's memo app, gathering material for future writing.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Sun Yuwei turned off the bedside lamp, set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, and fell asleep peacefully in the quiet Kunming night, with a faint sense of anticipation for tomorrow's sharing session.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning wake-up and personal ritual
description: Woke up naturally at 06:50 in the morning, turned off the phone alarm, and did breathing and stretching exercises in bed. Then got out of bed, opened the curtains, and let the winter morning sunlight pour into the room. After a simple wash-up, made a cup of warm lemon and honey water, sat on the small sofa by the window, and slowly drank it to awaken the body.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Green Lake Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning brisk walking training along the Panlong River
description: After changing into her workout clothes and running shoes, she walked about five minutes from home to the Panlong River. Along the riverside trail, she did 30 minutes of brisk walking, maintaining a pace of 9 minutes per kilometer. The morning air was fresh and the river surface sparkled. While adjusting her breathing, she mentally sorted out the opening remarks and agenda for the journal-sharing session.
location: Riverside footpath on Panjiang West Road (from Yuantong Bridge to Renmin Middle Road Bridge), Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast, preparation, and heading to the library for the sharing session.
description: After returning home from a brisk walk, her mother Li Xiulan had already prepared breakfast: steaming multigrain porridge, fried eggs, and blanched baby bok choy. Sun Yuwei had breakfast with her mother, sharing her feelings about the morning walk. After the meal, she returned to her study and checked the canvas bag again, making sure the three journals, sticky notes for the presentation, colored pens, power bank, and other items were all there. She left at 08:30 sharp and walked to Cuncaoxin Community Library. On the way, she stopped at the 'Shicui' bubble tea shop and bought a warm black sugar pearl milk tea with less sugar as today's 'sweet ritual.' She arrived at the library around 09:00.
location: Along the way from home at Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Cuncaoxin Community Library, No. 46 Huashan West Road, passing Shicui Milk Tea Shop (20 meters northwest of the intersection of Huashan West Road and Renmin Middle Road)

name: Held the second sharing session of “Life Aesthetics in Journaling.”
description: After arriving at the Cuncaoxin Community Library, she communicated with the staff about setting up the venue. The sharing session started on time at 09:30, opening with this morning's light and shadow moments along the Panlong River, leading into the theme of 'life aesthetics.' She showed three journals — travel, reading, and inspiration — and demonstrated basic collage and text layout on the spot. During the hour and a half, interaction was lively. A woman around 60 years old held her hand during the discussion and said with emotion, 'You remind me of myself when I was young, recording life with equal care.' That became the most touching moment of the sharing session. The event ended at 11:30.
location: Reading room of Cuncaoxin Community Library, No. 46 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch at home and afternoon rest and preparation
description: After the sharing session, she walked home. Her mother had already prepared lunch: shredded pork with green peppers, stir-fried choy sum, and chicken soup. She shared amusing moments from the sharing session with her parents, and they were happy for her. After lunch, she leaned back on the balcony lounge chair and rested with her eyes closed for about 15 minutes, then flipped through the unfinished “The Annals of Plants and Trees.” When her energy recovered, she returned to the study, spread open her journal, and wrote down her core insight: “Sharing makes the beauty of solitude flow.” She stuck the bookmark she had brought back from the library on the right side and recorded the details about that auntie. Then she opened her laptop to prepare for the evening's writing group activity, read the essay “Pace” again, and thought about the main takeaways. At the same time, she checked her email with her editor, Xu Mingyuan, and confirmed that “Pace” had been published in the “Kunming Slice” column of “Cultural Horizon.” She saved the link to her phone's notes.
location: Dining room, balcony, and study at home, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go to the supermarket to stock up on snacks
description: Before leaving, she checked the fridge and found the blueberries were all gone, so she walked five minutes to the nearby Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket. She bought fresh blueberries, two cartons of unsweetened yogurt, and a small bag of mixed nuts, planning to use them as snack supplies during the review period.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Heading to Zhongmou Yoga Studio and preparing before class.
description: After returning home from the supermarket and putting away the items, she went out again carrying a cloth bag containing the scissors for her flower arrangement class. After a 15-minute walk, she arrived at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, half an hour before the scheduled class. She sat down in a quiet corner of the rest area, put on earphones, listened to two pieces of soothing instrumental music, adjusted her breathing, and let herself calm down.
location: Rest area of Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Ikebana free-creation class and post-class discussion with the teacher.
description: At 16:15, Teacher He Lu announced the start of the three-hour free creation class. Sun Yuwei selected snow willow, pink lilies, and monstera leaves. Closing her eyes, she felt the form and temperament of the flowers and conceived a flowing, expansive atmosphere. Over the next two hours, she patiently pruned the branches, fixed their positions, and kept adjusting the angles of the leaves. When Teacher He Lu walked around the room, she affirmed Yuwei's use of lines and suggested “be bolder with negative space.” Sun Yuwei took the advice, trimmed the extra leaves, and the work instantly became ethereal. At 19:00, all the students finished their creations, and the class moved into critique and exchange. After class, Sun Yuwei specifically approached Teacher He Lu to discuss the curriculum for the next year, and the two agreed to offer a new themed ikebana course once every quarter starting next year.
location: Flower arrangement classroom and lounge area at Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Light meal and heading to the writing group activity venue.
description: After leaving the yoga studio, she went to the nearby small noodle shop she often frequented, ‘Xiangxiang Noodles,’ and ordered a hot bowl of small-pot rice noodles with a fried egg to quickly settle dinner. After the meal, she walked 10 minutes to Mingyuan Bookstore on Qianju Street. The street was quiet at night, and the bookstore’s warm light shone through.
location: Along the route from Xiangxiang Noodle Shop, 256 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Mingyuan Bookstore, 80 Qianju Street

name: Attend the writing group's Saturday evening year-end activity and connect with new friends
description: Arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore at 20:20, and the event officially started at 20:30. It was the last Saturday event of this year, themed around the annual summary and the selection of the preface writer for the anthology. Sun Yuwei shared her insights on writing Pace and her writing journey over the past year, earning warm applause. In the end, all members unanimously recommended her to write the preface for the 2025 Annual Anthology. Surprised and moved, she agreed. After the event, she took the initiative to chat with two new members, exchanged contact information, and agreed to meet separately to discuss writing experiences.
location: Second-floor activity area and first-floor reading area of Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 80 Qianju Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Coming home, bedtime ritual, and going to sleep.
description: At 22:55, she walked home, quickly washed up, and changed into pajamas. Before bed, she opened her phone to read the link to the online publication of "Pace" sent by editor Xu Mingyuan, carefully read the page, and saved a screenshot. Then she did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation and wrote down today's three good things in her gratitude journal. After doing all this, she turned off the desk lamp and fell asleep peacefully in the warm quilt, ending this brilliant day of "flowing" and "settling."
location: Bedroom and study at home, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation and walk to Cuihu Park
description: One winter morning, Sun Yuwei naturally woke up at 05:50. After confirming her journal plan and doing dynamic stretching, she changed into a quick-dry top and windbreaker, put on her sports watch, earphones, and a small waist pack, then walked about 5 minutes to the South Gate of Cuihu Park.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Long-distance morning run at Cuihu Park
description: Sun Yuwei entered Cuihu Park through the south gate and jogged 9 kilometers around the lake at a pace of about 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. In the morning light, she enjoyed watching the black-headed gulls on the lake, briefly rehydrated at the 6th kilometer, and took photos of the gulls. After finishing the run, she did 10 minutes of static stretching by the lake and drank some warm water.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Went home to wash up.
description: After her morning run, Sun Yuwei walked home, briefly greeted her father as he was preparing breakfast, then showered and changed into comfortable cotton loungewear, feeling fresh all over.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family Winter Solstice breakfast
description: Mother Li Xiulan cooked steaming hot small-pot rice noodles, and the family of three sat around the dining table enjoying the winter solstice breakfast. Sun Yuwei shared her morning run experiences, while her mother talked about going to the vegetable market to buy fresh ingredients.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Organizing the follow-up to the journal sharing event
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei sorted through photos from yesterday’s journal-sharing meetup in her study. She selected a group photo with an auntie and a page from her own plant specimen collage, edited them on her phone, added a caption, and sent them to the auntie. Then she recorded her reflections on the meetup in her journal.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Grocery shopping at the market and getting ready to return home.
description: Sun Yuwei walked with her mother to Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket at 98 Fuchun Street to buy ingredients for the Winter Solstice. Along the way, the mother and daughter chatted about Winter Solstice customs. At the supermarket, her mother picked out fresh ingredients such as chives, Chinese cabbage, pork, eggs, and flour. After returning home, Sun Yuwei helped sort and put them away, placing the flour and eggs on the kitchen counter and preparing the pork and vegetables for washing.
location: Dushi Mingyuan Supermarket, 98 Fuchun Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: The mother and daughter prepared the dumpling filling and kneaded the dough.
description: Mother Li Xiulan prepared the filling: she minced the pork, added Sichuan peppercorn water and beat it, then mixed in chives, cabbage, and eggs, and drizzled hot oil over it to lock in freshness. The kitchen was filled with aroma. Sun Yuwei mixed warm water and flour, kneaded it into a smooth dough, and let it rest. While the dough rested, she took out the review outline for Introduction to Linguistics, leaned against the kitchen door, and silently memorized phonetics concepts.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Making dumplings together as a family.
description: The rested dough was divided into small portions. Sun Yuwei skillfully rolled out the wrappers, her mother made ingot-shaped dumplings, and her father Sun Mingyuan also joined in. Although the shapes varied, they talked about their hometown's Winter Solstice customs and the fun of coin dumplings. The family chatted while wrapping, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Winter Solstice Dumpling Feast
description: The first batch of dumplings came out of the pot, and dipping sauce dishes were set on the table. Sun Yuwei tasted the chive-and-egg and cabbage-and-pork dumplings. Her father ate the cabbage-and-pork ones with a little wine. Her mother suggested comparing whose dumplings were made to the standard, and laughter and talking filled the room.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Clean up after the meal and take a midday nap
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei and her mother cleared the table, sealed the leftovers, and put them in the fridge. Her father went to the balcony to look at the flowers. Sun Yuwei returned to her bedroom for a half-hour nap.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family movie time and casual chat
description: Sun Yuwei boiled water to brew Pu-erh tea, prepared sunflower seeds, pistachios, and hawthorn cake, and curled up on the sofa with her parents to watch the second season of the BBC documentary "Planet Earth." Her father commented on animal behavior, her mother marveled at the wonders of nature, and Sun Yuwei refilled their tea. After the documentary ended, her mother talked about amusing neighborhood anecdotes, and Sun Yuwei replied to messages in the writing group, saying she would first work on the framework for the preface next week.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Review of Introduction to Linguistics.
description: Sun Yuwei reviewed Introduction to Linguistics in her study, focusing on the phonetics chapter content on the International Phonetic Alphabet and Mandarin initials, finals, and tones. She wrote from memory to reinforce easily confused vowels and consonants, and quickly skimmed her notes on semantic fields and semantic change.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Went downstairs with her parents for a walk to aid digestion.
description: Sun Yuwei closed her book, changed into sneakers, picked up the trash bag, and called her parents to head downstairs together. The family of three strolled along Huashan West Road to Cuihu South Road; spring couplets were already up at neighbors' doorways. Her parents chatted about work trivia while Sun Yuwei used her phone to photograph the light and shadows of the sunset through the plane trees, saving them as journal material.
location: Around Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, from Huashan West Road to Cuihu South Road.

name: A simple dinner.
description: After returning from the walk, mother fried the leftover dumplings from noon until they were golden and crispy, and also cooked plain rice porridge. The family of three had a simple dinner. Sun Yuwei ate fried dumplings and drank porridge, feeling quite comfortable.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Evening journal and gratitude diary
description: Sun Yuwei soaked her feet in hot water with dried ginger, put on her earphones to play an indie folk playlist, and picked up her journal and a hand warmer. She recorded the Winter Solstice moment, drew a simple sketch of ingot-shaped dumplings, pasted in a sunset photo, and wrote “Winter Solstice, home and warmth” with a highlighter. On the same page, she then wrote a gratitude diary: thanking her mother for the delicious filling, her father for his interesting stories, and herself for persisting in finishing the 9-kilometer run.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Focused review of key points in linguistics.
description: Sun Yuwei put away her journal and officially entered the pre-exam sprint review. She took out her mistake notebook and mind maps, focusing on weak points in the grammar chapters, such as case analyses using immediate constituent analysis, and practiced breaking down sentence structures on scratch paper while reviewing example questions.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Mindfulness meditation and bedtime preparation
description: After washing up briefly, Sun Yuwei changed into pajamas, turned off the lights, and set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode. Lying down in the dark, she did a 10-minute mindful breathing meditation, focusing her attention on her breath and feeling the calm and contentment of the day.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: After meditating, Sun Yuwei turned on the bedside lamp and read about 30 minutes of 'The Annals of Plants and Trees' on her Kindle, mainly the chapter on 'Narcissus'. When drowsiness came over her, she turned off the reader, recalled the warmest images of the day in her mind, then turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Wake-up and morning activities
description: Woken by her phone alarm at 7:07 in the morning, she felt a little sleepy but perked up when she remembered it was the last day before the exam. After stretching in bed, she spread out her yoga mat and did a 10-minute simple Sun Salutation stretch. Then she wrote in her gratitude journal at the desk with a green fountain pen, washed up, and changed into an off-white cardigan and jeans, getting ready for the new day.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Mother cooked steaming small-pot rice noodles with pickled cabbage and mint. While eating, Yuwei talked with her mother about the morning's design draft schedule and the afternoon exam. Her mother encouraged her and mentioned the dumplings they had wrapped yesterday for the Winter Solstice. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-exam review and design draft preparation
description: Back in the study, she first quickly flipped through the mistake notebook for Introduction to Linguistics, focusing on reinforcing the phonetics IPA section. Then she opened her computer to check the revision comments on the design draft sent by Zhou Lin, and organized the hand-painted watercolor originals of camellias, bougainvillea, and ferns, placing them beside the scanner for later use.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Confirmed the botanical sticker design draft online with Zhou Lin.
description: Through a WeChat video call with college roommate Zhou Lin, Yuwei showed the hand-drawn draft and discussed the gradient red of the camellia petals and the purple layers of the bougainvillea, citing the passage about the cold, clear winter flowers in Plants and Seasons as inspiration for the color scheme. They finally finalized the color layout. Zhou Lin suggested adding a light gold outline around the edges of the camellia, and Yuwei marked it on the hand-drawn draft with a pencil before they reached an agreement.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Scanning and photo retouching/color grading
description: Use a Brother scanner at 300dpi to scan the three confirmed hand-painted watercolor drafts into PNG format. On the computer, use Photoshop to adjust the levels and saturation, and use the brush tool to enhance the watercolor edge blending effect, ensuring accurate color reproduction while preserving the hand-painted texture. Save each image as PSD and TIF backups.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Printing proofs for comparison and archiving the photographed materials
description: Printed the fine-tuned electronic draft as an A5 color proof on a Canon printer, and compared it side by side with the original hand-drawn draft. When I found the bougainvillea purple was too dark, I went back to the computer to fine-tune the curves and reprinted until I was satisfied. Then I used my phone tripod to take several photos and short videos of the entire process from scanning to print comparison, organized the material, and drafted the copy framework for a Xiaohongshu tutorial. Finally, I archived the confirmed electronic design files and physical proofs to the computer and Huawei Cloud Drive, naming the folder 'Yunnan Plants Series First Batch Final Draft 20251222'.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Lunch and review before the exam
description: Lunch was the tomato egg noodles made by her mother. Her father asked about the morning's work progress, and Yuwei excitedly shared details of the design draft. After the meal, she flipped through her error notebook for Introduction to Linguistics on the living room sofa, focusing on reviewing the syntax analysis section. Her mother peeled an apple for her, and she silently recited key points while eating. At 13:00, she started packing her exam supplies into her canvas bag.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Taking the subway to the exam center and preparing for the exam.
description: At 13:00 I left and walked to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Line 5, transferred to Line 2 at North Railway Station, then transferred to Line 1 at Huancheng South Road heading toward University Town. On the train I put on headphones and listened to Song Dongye's folk songs to relax. After 40 minutes I got off at University Town Station and walked into Yunnan University's Chenggong Campus. In a quiet corner of the corridor in front of the First Teaching Building, I flipped through my notebook, finally memorizing the IPA consonant chart, took deep breaths, and looked at the winter cherry blossoms to calm my mind.
location: Exit D, Huashan West Road Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Teaching Building 1, Chenggong Campus, Yunnan University, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Took the final exam for Introduction to Linguistics
description: After the exam bell rang, she answered the questions in order. The question types included fill-in-the-blank, term explanation, short answer, and essay. She began with the phonetics section. When she encountered a question on word class division in the lexicology section, she hesitated briefly but successfully recalled examples. In the final half hour, she focused on completing the essay question on dialect sentences, explaining it using syntactic theory. She handed in her paper on time at 16:00 and felt that the overall exam went smoothly as she left the examination room.
location: A classroom in the First Teaching Building, Chenggong Campus of Yunnan University, South Dongwaihuan Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-exam return trip and contacting friends
description: After the exam, she stood at the classroom door and sent a WeChat voice message to her roommate Liu Jia to share her liberated mood. Liu Jia replied with a cheerful sticker. Then she sent Zhou Lin a message to confirm the design draft delivery time. Afterwards, she walked to University Town Metro Station, took Line 1, transferred to Line 2 and then Line 5, and returned to the city center. On the way, she browsed illustrator accounts on Xiaohongshu for inspiration, and occasionally zoned out, savoring the relaxed feeling after the exam.
location: From Yunnan University Chenggong Campus, South East Outer Ring Road, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Huashan West Road Metro Station, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (on the metro).

name: Go home to rest and take a walk around Cuihu Lake with parents
description: After getting home, she changed into white sneakers, drank some warm water, and told her parents in the living room that the exam had gone smoothly. After a short rest, the three went out on foot into Cuihu Park and strolled along the lakeside path. In the afterglow of the setting sun, Yuwei gave a detailed account of the exam and the progress of her design draft. Her mother suggested painting the lotus leaves of Cuihu next time, while her father talked about funny stories from the self-study examination. Laughter accompanied them all the way, and after about 40 minutes circling the lake, they went home.
location: Home living room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; and Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Father cooked garlic broccoli, sweet-and-sour pork ribs, and three-delicacy soup. At the dinner table, they discussed winter vacation plans. Yuwei said she wanted to focus on completing the Yunnan botanical sticker series, writing, and reading more; both parents expressed support. After the meal, she took the initiative to help clear the dishes and wipe the table.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post design process updates on Xiaohongshu
description: Back in the study, she edited the day's scanning, color-correction, and printing comparison video into a 15-second short video and added piano BGM. She wrote the post, titled "[Yunnan Flora Stickers] The First Little Creation After the Winter Solstice," attached three comparison images: the hand-drawn original, the scanned digital version, and a printed sample. She included key points of a zero-basis watercolor-to-digital tutorial, checked in at Kunming Cuihu, and published the post. Zhou Lin immediately commented that she was looking forward to the physical product, and the roommate group chat became lively. Liu Jia asked if custom orders were possible, and Sun Yuwei replied to each one.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening foot soak and reading “The Chronicles of Plants”
description: She filled a wooden bucket with hot water, added foot-soaking salt, and soaked her feet while playing a folk song playlist on her iPad. She read the fern chapter of *Spring and Autumn of Plants*, marked the description of spikemoss with a highlighter, and considered incorporating it into the next sticker design. Midway through, she checked her phone for new comments on Xiaohongshu posts and felt pleased.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mindful meditation and gratitude journal
description: Changed into pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bed, and did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on breathing to let the post-exam excitement settle. Then I opened the A5 journal and wrote a gratitude diary with a green fountain pen, recording that the exam went smoothly today, the design collaboration went well, and my parents were there with me. I marked my mood as relaxed.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime Journal and Reading Preparation
description: In her journal, she drew a simple outline sketch of the dawn redwoods she had seen on her Green Lake walk and recorded her mood about archiving the design drafts. She set an alarm for 7:00 the next morning and tidied the Kindle on her nightstand. Then, under the bedside lamp, she continued reading the rest of the fern chapter of Plants and Trees Through the Seasons, jotting down keywords. As she grew drowsy, she closed the book.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Turning off the bedside lamp, she closed her eyes, recalled the relief after the exam and the joy of being praised for the stickers, and gradually fell asleep in the quiet.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning easy run around Green Lake
description: The alarm went off right at 6:00. I pulled open the curtains; the horizon was tinged with pink and purple light, and the forecast said it would be sunny. After a few sips of warm water, I changed into my bright orange running top and shoes and left home at 6:15. After jogging along the familiar sidewalk for five minutes, I arrived at Cuihu Park at 6:20. I didn't chase a pace today; I ran about 5 kilometers around the lake at a relaxed 7:05 per kilometer, enjoying the physical and mental freedom after the exam. On the way, I saw black-headed gulls circling in the morning light, so I stopped and used my phone to take a few shots of their silhouettes skimming the lake.
