After the run, I did a full stretch on a lakeside bench. At 7:00 I ran home, took a warm shower, and changed into comfortable loungewear.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Have breakfast with parents and talk about how the exam went
description: I walked out of the room. Mom had already cooked steaming small-pot rice noodles, and Dad was setting out the bowls and chopsticks. I sat down and, while eating breakfast, shared with them how I felt after yesterday's exam: "The last analytical question on the Introduction to Linguistics exam happened to be something I had reviewed! It felt really smooth. I can finally relax for the winter vacation." Mom and Dad were both happy to hear that. Mom even put a poached egg in my bowl and said, "Since the exam is over, have a good rest for a few days." I finished eating contentedly and helped Mom clear the bowls and chopsticks into the kitchen.
location: Dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Solo time in the study: journaling and reading
description: Back in the study, I opened the curtains and let the sunlight fill the room. I took out the journal that had been on my desk since last night, decorated with a small sun labeled 'Freedom Day After Exams,' and began recording my feelings after yesterday's exams and today's plan. Then I opened a copy of Prose magazine, borrowed from the school library, which featured articles about market days in small Yunnan towns (last week I saw this issue recommended at Zhibushi Bookstore and asked Uncle Qin to set aside a copy). I read an article, and the author's delicate touch reminded me of what I had seen and heard during my field trip in Dali, so I copied down a few favorite sentences into my notebook.
location: Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helped Mom prepare lunch and practiced a new dish
description: Putting down the book, I walked into the kitchen, where my mother was preparing lunch. Today she planned to make Dai-style lemon shredded chicken. I volunteered to help her pull the chicken into shreds and was responsible for chopping the cilantro and onion. We chatted while handling the ingredients. I mentioned to my mother a trick I had seen on Xiaohongshu for garnishing dishes with mint leaves and lemon slices. She listened with great interest and said we could try it next time, so that home-cooked dishes could also be full of ritual.
location: Kitchen, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Family lunch and casual chat
description: Lunch was served on time. The main dish was the appetizing Dai-style shredded chicken with lemon, sour and spicy to whet the appetite, along with Mom's lightly stir-fried seasonal vegetables and a bowl of tomato egg drop soup. As we ate, we chatted about the photography exhibition recently held at Dad's workplace, and also mentioned that my sister said in the group chat over the weekend that Shenzhen had turned cold, reminding everyone to keep warm. I showed them the photos of black-headed gulls I had taken at Cuihu Lake in the morning. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and movie schedule preview
description: After lunch, I went back to my room. Instead of napping right away, I leaned against the headboard and scrolled on my phone. First, I continued reading 'The Annals of Plants and Trees' on WeRead, which I hadn't finished yesterday. Then I opened a local lifestyle app, searched for 'Elephant Screening Art Cinema,' and browsed their screening schedule. I saw that at 19:00 that evening there was an art film called 'Southern Afternoon,' whose synopsis said it was about changes in a Yunnan village—exactly the kind of subject I pay special attention to during my travels and creative fieldwork. So I didn't hesitate to choose a seat online, complete the ticket purchase, and save a screenshot of the ticket collection code. After that, I took a peaceful 30-minute nap.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare yoga equipment and walk to the yoga studio
description: After waking from my nap, I felt full of energy. I changed into the yoga clothes I had prepared in advance and stuffed my water bottle and phone into a canvas bag. At 13:30, I left on time and walked to Zhongmou Yoga Studio on Dongfeng West Road. The sun was warm today and there were few pedestrians. I walked west along Renmin Middle Road, turned into Dongfeng West Road, and strolled slowly for 15 minutes, feeling very relaxed.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road.

name: Attended Tuesday’s yoga class and tried wheel pose backbend.
description: At 14:00, I walked into the familiar studio, and the faint scent of white tea essential oil instantly calmed me down. Today was still Teacher He Lu's Tuesday small-group class. Guided by the teacher, we warmed up fully through poses such as Cat-Cow and Downward-Facing Dog. When we reached the backbend sequence, Teacher He came over to me, first using yoga blocks to help me find the engagement points in my core and legs, then gently encouraged me to try entering full Wheel Pose. With her assistance, I took a deep breath and successfully pushed my body up, feeling my chest and hips open. Though I only held it for a few seconds, it felt amazing—a brand-new breakthrough. After class, we did five minutes of Ujjayi breathing, then drank a cup of ginger and red date tea provided by the studio, my whole body warm and cozy.
location: Large classroom, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk home, brainstorming the angle for the review on the way.
description: Class ended at 15:30. I packed my backpack, left the yoga studio at 15:32, and walked home. On the way back, soft folk music played in my earphones, but my mind began to recall the movie synopsis I had just read. As I walked, I thought about what angles I could write in the guestbook after watching the movie in the evening—for example, 'the shaping of local imagery through light and shadow' and 'the resonance between the film's narrative and my memories from field trips'... These thoughts made my steps lighter. I arrived home at 15:50.
location: No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Writing time in the study: write a preface for the annual anthology.
description: After getting home, I first poured myself a cup of rose tea and then sat down at the desk. I opened my laptop and created a new document titled 'Draft Preface to the 2025 Annual Anthology', and began to sort through the thoughts I had after being chosen to write the preface at the writing group's year-end event. A line flashed through my mind — 'Words are the amber of time.' I felt it was good and immediately wrote it down. After about an hour of drafting, I produced a complete introductory paragraph. Around 17:30 I closed the computer, took out my fountain pen, practiced a few characters in a new leather notebook, and imagined the feel of the pen gliding across the page while sitting in the cinema tonight. My mood became expectant.
location: Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Simple dinner and getting ready to go out
description: At dinner, Mom, Dad, and I simply had some noodles in chicken broth, with a few leafy greens and a poached egg—light and healthy. I told them I was going to the movies in the evening and would be back around nine, so they didn't need to wait for me. After dinner, I put on a light jacket, packed my pen, notepad, and phone into my canvas bag, and checked the ticket pickup code screenshot on my phone again.
location: Dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk to Elephant Screening Art Cinema
description: It was already dark, and the streetlights were on. I put on my earphones, played the soundtrack of this film (I had found and downloaded it in the music app in advance), and left home at 18:35. I walked along Renmin Middle Road, turned into Cuihu South Road, and then strolled slowly to Wenlin Street. The music in my earphones carried a faint sense of nostalgia and tranquility, matching the mood of the film I was about to watch. About 20 minutes later, I saw the cinema's eye-catching sign.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 141 Wenlin Street

name: Watching the movie "Southern Afternoon"
description: Arrived at the cinema at 18:58 and picked up the tickets at the self-service ticket machine in the lobby. There were still two minutes until the screening, so I quickly flipped through several movie-themed postcards in the waiting area. At 19:00, I passed the ticket check on time and entered Hall 3, finding my seat in the middle. The movie began. During the two-hour screening, I was completely immersed. The imagery of Yunnan's countryside, the slow narrative pace, and the deep affection for the land made my nose tingle several times. Many scenes reminded me of my own field research experiences in Dali, Lijiang, and other places, filling my heart with emotion and creative inspiration.
location: Hall 3, Elephant Screening Art Cinema, No. 141 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Wrote a post-viewing reflection in the guestbook
description: The movie ended at 21:00, the lights came up, and I was still immersed in the film's lingering mood. I didn't leave immediately; instead, I walked to the old-fashioned desk at the end of the corridor, where a thick guestbook lay. I took out the fountain pen I carry with me, opened the newest page, and wrote a reflection of about 200 words: “In every frame of Southern Afternoon, the breath of home is hidden. The director uses the most restrained shots to capture the silent changes under the sunlight. The river is silent, light and shadow interweave, just like the old scenery in each of our hearts that can never be returned to.” At the signature, I wrote “Yuwei, the night of December 23, 2025.” Capping the pen, I felt that only then was the day truly complete.
location: At the corridor message book of Elephant Screening Art Cinema, No. 141 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home, savoring the light and shadows
description: At 21:20 I walked out of the cinema. The night wind touched my face with a slight chill, but my heart was warm. I walked home along the same route, without headphones, listening to the sounds of the late-night street, replaying certain scenes from the movie and the feel of the message book in my hands. Around 21:40 I reached the door of my home and quietly unlocked it with the key, not wanting to wake my parents, who might already be resting.
location: From No. 141 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province to No. 123 Renmin Middle Road

name: Record light and shadow details and today's journal
description: At 21:45 I returned to the study and switched on the desk lamp. I took out the leather-bound notepad I'd brought to the cinema, transcribed the passage I'd written in the guestbook onto a new journal page, and added a few imagery symbols from the film that had impressed me. Then I recorded the whole day's experiences—the red-billed gulls on my morning run, the successful wheel pose in yoga class, the moving light and shadow of the movie—on that day's page with different-colored watercolor pens and stickers, making it a shining landmark in the winter of 2025.
location: Study, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Meditation and gratitude journal.
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I leaned against the headboard, dimmed the lights, and did 10 minutes of mindful meditation to quiet the thoughts that had been restless all day. After meditation, I opened the memo app on my phone and wrote today's gratitude journal: 'Grateful for today's good weather, which made my run comfortable; grateful for Teacher He Lu's encouragement, which made me try Wheel Pose; grateful for the movie 'Southern Afternoon', which reaffirmed my direction in writing.'
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: At 23:00, I turned off the bedside lamp and set my phone to Do Not Disturb mode. Feeling satisfied and physically relaxed, I closed my eyes. The last image in my mind was the sunset at the end of the movie, and then I fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Early morning yoga and morning preparation
description: At 6:00 the alarm went off. After Sun Yuwei got up, she spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of gentle flow yoga and breathing meditation to stretch the leg muscles that were a bit stiff from yesterday's long run. Then she stepped on the scale: 47.2 kg. Afterwards she went to the bathroom to wash up, splashing hot water on her face to refresh herself, then returned to the vanity to apply face cream and sunscreen. She picked up the journal by her bed, flipped to the page where she had recorded her thoughts after watching 'Southern Afternoon,' and the urge to write was still vivid.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having breakfast with family and preparations after the meal
description: Coming downstairs, her mother was bringing out the broth for crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, and her father was already at the table reading the Spring City Evening News. She had breakfast with her parents, and they talked about how she would draft the preface for the writing group's anthology that morning. Her mother encouraged her, and her father reminded her to balance work and rest. After breakfast, she helped her mother clear the dishes and rinsed them briefly. Back in the second-floor study, she brewed a cup of raw Pu'er tea, took out a blank notebook and a dark green fountain pen, then took from the bookshelf the printed manuscripts of representative works written over the past year by several core members of the writing group. She spread them out, ready to reread and draw inspiration for the preface.
location: Dining room and study at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning writing preparation and drafting the preface
description: Sun Yuwei sat at her desk, drinking tea while flipping through the printed drafts from her group members, moved by the regional flavor and personal reflections in everyone's writing. She wrote down keywords such as "Growth," "Looking Back," and "The Warmth of Words" in a new notebook. She then opened her laptop and created a document titled "Foreword to the 2025 Annual Anthology." After typing the first line, she spent the whole morning weaving together works of different styles, searching for a narrative thread that could represent the group's shared journey of growth, and finally produced the skeleton of a first draft of about 600 words.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Helped her mother prepare lunch and had a family lunch
description: After nearly three hours of continuous writing, her eyes felt sore and dry, so she got up and went to the living room balcony to look at the shadows of trees in the direction of Green Lake outside the window. Her mother was in the kitchen preparing her favorite stir-fried pork with green peppers and tomato egg drop soup. She went over to help peel garlic and chatted about her morning writing progress. At lunch, the family of three sat together; the topic shifted from writing to trivial matters at her father's workplace, then to her elder sister Sun Yutong bringing a friend from Guangdong home for the Spring Festival, which made everyone curious and expectant. Lunch ended in warmth, and she helped her mother put the dishes and chopsticks into the dishwasher.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Midday rest and preparation before the video
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to her room, sat on the edge of the bed, took out the day's journal, and pasted in yesterday's movie ticket stub for "Southern Afternoon" and a fallen leaf picked at Green Lake. Using her phone, she sent a message in the "Kunming Girl Rambling" group chat, telling her roommates to video call at 1:30. Then she set an alarm for 14:00, leaned against the headboard, and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes to recharge for the afternoon activities.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Video group chat with college roommates.
description: The alarm went off, and Sun Yuwei sat back down at the computer in her study, opened a WeChat video call with her college roommates Zhou Lin, Liu Jia, and Zhao Xiaowen. She deliberately placed a bunch of eucalyptus leaves behind her to add a sense of ritual. Zhou Lin showed off her tabby cat, while Sun Yuwei held up the sketches of Yunnan flora stickers she had recently carefully drawn (a combination of camellias, bougainvillea, and ferns) to the camera, sharing the fine-tuning process after finalizing the design last week. Her roommates were full of admiration, and Zhao Xiaowen immediately ordered a set. They also chatted about holiday plans; Liu Jia said she was going to Harbin to see ice sculptures. During the conversation, a message from editor Xu Mingyuan about good news popped up, but she only glanced at it quickly and decided not to interrupt the lively atmosphere, continuing the video call until 14:30.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading 'Yunnan Here' and learning the good news of publication
description: After the video call ended, Sun Yuwei switched to reading time. She picked up Yu Jian's This Side of Yunnan, curled up in the bean bag chair by the study window, and read slowly, her heart filled with a sense of belonging from the descriptions of her hometown. At an exciting passage, she tapped on the editor's message that had popped up earlier: "The results of the topic selection meeting are out—smoother than expected. The contract process will start next week. Congratulations." She stared at the screen for a few seconds, then broke into a big smile. She closed her journal and decided not to reply right away, letting herself bask in the joy.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Revise and expand the preface
description: In a great mood, and with the new perspective offered by This Side of Yunnan, Sun Yuwei sat back down at her desk, opened the first draft of the preface, and began revising and expanding it. She tried to weave into her commentary on the group's work style the tender gaze toward the homeland found in Yu Jian's prose, giving the article a retrospective warmth from a regional cultural perspective. She expanded the draft to about 1000 words and built a clearer logical framework for the latter half.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Go out to Wenlin Street and Mingyuan Bookstore to buy books and exchange thoughts.
description: At 16:15, Sun Yuwei changed into flat shoes, slung her canvas bag over her shoulder, and left home on foot. She took a detour south along Huashan West Road, passed the south gate of Green Lake Park, and turned onto Wenlin Street. The street was already decorated for Christmas. She stopped at a roasted sweet potato stall, bought one, and ate it slowly while warming her hands. Around 16:45, she pushed open the wooden door of Mingyuan Bookstore; the owner, Qin Mingyuan, was arranging new books. Uncle Qin recommended a copy of Old Images of Kunming to her. She fell in love with it at first sight and bought it, then discussed essay writing with Uncle Qin and how to describe her hometown scenery. They also chatted about the possibility of publishing her selected works, and Uncle Qin offered a few suggestions. After saying goodbye to Uncle Qin, she walked home along Huashan West Road holding the new book, as dusk slowly deepened and streetlights came on. On the way, she replied to her editor Xu Mingyuan via her phone, expressing gratitude and promising to submit the revised draft around New Year's Day. She felt an unprecedented sense of steadiness.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, No. 202 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner and sharing what we gained.
description: When she got home, her mother had already prepared dinner. Sun Yuwei put down her canvas bag at the entrance and carefully placed the new book on the cabinet. At the dinner table, she excitedly showed her parents the newly purchased "Old Images of Kunming" and shared her afternoon conversation with Uncle Qin at the bookstore. Her mother praised the book choice, and her father, while flipping through it, pointed at an old photo of Cuihu Park and talked about memories from his youth. The whole dinner was filled with family warmth and sharing.
location: Dining room at home, Cuihu Community, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Evening reading, note-taking, and replying to messages
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei carried the fruit cut by her mother back to the study and turned on the desk lamp. She first checked her phone and saw that editor Xu Mingyuan had replied, “You're welcome. You deserve it. Stay steady.” This gave her a strong sense of security. She then read deeply into Here in Yunnan and copied lines that moved her into her journal. When she reached the passage about Green Lake, she flipped through old photos of Green Lake in Old Images of Kunming. Comparing past and present, inspiration surged, and she decided to use this sense of overlapping time and space as the core idea for continuing to revise the preface the next day.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entries and gratitude diary
description: After the reading calmed her mood, Sun Yuwei took out her evening TN journal. She had printed a sticker sample on coated paper that she had shown during the afternoon video call with her roommate, and she stuck it onto that day's page, writing in the corner: December 24, sunny turning cloudy. Wrote a first draft of the preface, laughed a lot on the video call, Uncle Qin helped me find a treasure, and the editor gave me the news I'd been waiting for. In the gratitude journal section, she wrote entries thanking her mother, Uncle Qin, the approved topic, and her roommate's warmth.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, meditation, and sleep
description: At 22:30, she closed her journal, washed up briefly, and put on a hydrating facial mask. She turned off the main light, leaving only the night light on. Sitting on the bed, she put on her earphones and played a 20-minute guided meditation audio themed around 'Acceptance and Abundance.' During the meditation, she reviewed the day's moments, letting tension and excitement settle into her breath. After it ended, she took off her earphones, set her phone to Do Not Disturb, lay down flat, and pulled up the quilt. Her roommate's smiling face and the black-and-white photos from Old Images of Kunming flashed through her mind, and she fell into a deep sleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Waking up in the early morning and running out and back along the Panlong River
description: At 6:20 in the morning, she woke up naturally. She checked her phone and confirmed that her bank card balance was 4,732.64 yuan. Thinking of today's plan to transfer money to her parents, she felt warm at heart. She changed into sportswear, washed up briefly, drank some warm water, and left the house with her phone and earphones. She walked about twenty minutes to the Panlong River trail in Panlong District (the section from Dongfeng Square to Taoyuan Square), passing elderly people doing morning exercise along the way. Folk songs played through her earphones, and her steps were brisk. She started running at 6:50, and ran an out-and-back five kilometers along the riverside trail from south to north at a pace of 7 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer. As she ran, she felt the winter chill and the sparkling light on the river. The thought of her father's possible smile rose in her mind, and she couldn't help but smile. After the run, she stretched by the river for five minutes and took two photos of the river view with her phone as a keepsake. Then she walked back home the same way, sweat on her forehead, feeling happy.
location: Panlong River Trail, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (section from Dongfeng Square to Taoyuan Square).

name: Returning home for a shower and a change of clothes
description: After a morning run, I went home and took a shower for about ten minutes, changed into an off-white knit top and dark blue jeans, pinned up my half-dry hair with a clip, and weighed myself — 47.4 kg, the same as yesterday.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Shared breakfast with parents and teased a surprise.
description: Walking into the dining room, she saw that her mother Li Xiulan had already cooked small-pot rice noodles, and her father Sun Mingyuan was reading the morning newspaper. Yuwei first drank the hot soup, then softly said that there was a surprise for her parents this morning. Her mother smiled and pressed for details, but she just blinked and said after breakfast. During breakfast, they talked about the ginkgo leaves covering the streets near home. Her mother mentioned that she would make mushroom hot pot in the evening and asked Yuwei to buy mint on the way in the afternoon. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Transfer red envelopes to parents and send a grateful voice message
description: Back in the study, I opened the mobile banking app and transferred 2,000 yuan each via WeChat to my father Sun Mingyuan and my mother Li Xiulan, totaling 4,000 yuan. Then I recorded a voice message of about one minute: "Dad, Mom, this is money I earned from writing and saved up. Thank you for always supporting me in studying and writing, and for cooking delicious food for me every day. I've truly grown up now, and I can take care of you. Merry Christmas, I love you." I listened to it twice to confirm the tone was sincere before sending. My mother immediately replied with a heart emoji and a voice message, and my father sent the words "Our daughter is making us proud" in the family group. Yuwei felt the warmth of family and the responsibility of adulthood.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organizing the draft of a botanical sticker tutorial
description: I turned on my laptop and organized the sticker material I had photographed over the previous two days (camellias, bougainvilleas, ferns) step by step: I selected six high-definition process photos and adjusted their brightness and contrast in Canva; combined with the warm brown base and low-saturation green palette suggested in the roommate group chat, I rearranged the order of images and text; in the document, I wrote a step-by-step tutorial of about 500 words and added sections for 'Tools Introduction' and 'Inspiration Source'. I plan to publish it after New Year's Day, and saved the folder as 'Yunnan Plants Sticker Tutorial | vol.02'. I felt happy and productive, and in the middle of it I drank the honey water my mother brought over.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Helped mother prepare ingredients and talked about dinner plans.
description: She got up and went to the kitchen, where her mother was washing mushrooms (jianshouqing, porcini, and bamboo fungus) and cutting vegetables. Yuwei helped peel garlic and pick mint leaves while listening to her mother enthusiastically talk about how many spices would go into tonight’s hot pot base and how her father would have a little wine. Yuwei smiled and said she would buy eucalyptus leaves on the way in the afternoon to decorate the table. Chatting and laughing, the mother and daughter agreed that Yuwei would go to the “Huayu” flower shop on Wenlin Street that afternoon to make the selection.
location: Home kitchen, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Lunch was home-style dishes: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried choy sum, and braised tofu with rice. Her parents kept talking about the money transfer received that morning. Her father, as if slightly tipsy, repeated, 'Looks like you're going to be the pillar of our family from now on,' while her mother told Yuwei to eat more and not to worry about losing weight. Yuwei responded patiently, and a strong sense of belonging surged in her heart.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Midday rest and change of clothes
description: Back in the room, set the alarm for fifteen minutes, lie down, and rest with your eyes closed. When you wake up in the afternoon, wash your face, change into a loose hooded jacket, bring 'Old Images of Kunming' and a notebook, pack a power bank and a small change purse, and get ready for the afternoon reading at Green Lake.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading “Old Images of Kunming” at Green Lake Park and taking excerpts
description: After walking about ten minutes to Cuihu Park, flocks of black-headed gulls were gathered at the entrance. She chose a bench by the lake and sat down facing the water. She opened Old Images of Kunming, recommended by Uncle Qin, and read the chapter 'Urban Changes in Kunming after the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway Opened,' highlighting key points and copying two passages about the changes in the old neighborhoods to build material for the Slow Travel Notes project. Now and then she looked up to watch the gulls skim across the water or observed elderly people feeding gulls by the lakeside. When she closed the book, she took a photo of the lake view and a side profile of the book cover.
location: Green Lake Park (near the Fish-Viewing Tower), Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Buying flowers at the Wenlin Street flower shop and visiting Mingyuan Bookstore
description: Walked from Green Lake about 12 minutes to Wenlin Street, where the plane trees on both sides had distinct bare branches. First went to the 'Flower Isle' flower shop at No. 81 Wenlin Street. Pushing open the glass door, the fresh fragrance of plants rushed in. The shop assistant recognized Yuwei as a regular customer and recommended fresh eucalyptus leaves paired with white chrysanthemums as accent flowers. Yuwei chose 5 eucalyptus branches and asked the assistant to wrap them in kraft paper, spending 20 yuan in total. While paying, she asked about the arrival time of the latest flowers (holly would arrive next week), noted it in her journal calendar, and took a close-up photo of the bouquet as she left. Then she walked 3 minutes to No. 98, Mingyuan Bookstore. Pushing open the wrought iron gate, the owner, Qin Mingyuan, was drinking tea and reading. Yuwei went over to thank him and praised 'Old Images of Kunming' as wonderful. Uncle Qin pointed to the newly arrived December 2025 issue of 'Prose' and the January 2026 issue of 'Southern Literature', suggesting they might contain useful material. Yuwei flipped through the table of contents of 'Prose', found a piece of Yunnan local prose that interested her, and took a photo for reference. After a brief chat with Uncle Qin about recent reading plans, she said goodbye. Finally, carrying the bouquet, she walked along Huashan West Road toward home for about 15 minutes, stopping at a bakery on the way to buy 2 egg tarts. Once home, she put the eucalyptus leaves into the old clay pot in the entryway, adjusted the branches, and took a photo to commemorate.
location: Huayu Flower Shop at No. 81 Wenlin Street and Mingyuan Bookstore at No. 98 Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Dinner preparation and mushroom hot pot family dinner
description: She placed the ceramic pot with eucalyptus leaves in the center of the dining table to elevate the mood. Then she helped Mother set out bowls and chopsticks, brought the mushroom hot pot to the table, and neatly arranged the ingredients. Father took out his homemade plum wine and said that today they had to have a drink. When the broth came to a boil, the aroma filled the room. The three sat around the table; Mother kept picking mushrooms and vegetables for Yuwei, while Father repeatedly looked at the transfer screenshot, the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes full of smiles, and said half-jokingly, “My daughter is finally supporting the family; I'll have enough money for wine this year.” The dinner table was full of laughter and cheerful talk. Yuwei talked about her morning-run thoughts and Uncle Qin's recommendation, Mother talked about her proud recipes, and Father told year-end anecdotes from the Cultural Bureau. Yuwei noticed new white hairs at Father's temples, and a sense of responsibility welled up in her heart. The dinner lasted about an hour and a half, and Yuwei had another glass of plum wine, her cheeks slightly flushed.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Cleaning up after the meal and posting a gratitude post on WeChat Moments.
description: After dinner, Yuwei helped clear the table and packed up the remaining mushroom soup; her mother scrubbed the pots and pans while she wiped the table and swept the floor. After tidying up, she sat on the living room sofa and picked out four photos from the day: the morning scene by the Panlong River, the book shadow by Green Lake, the eucalyptus bouquet, and a corner of the hotpot on the dining table. She wrote the caption: 'December 25, 2025. Morning jog along the Panlong River, midday reading of old Kunming photographs, evening mushroom hotpot. Using my first manuscript fee to give my parents red envelopes gives me a calm sense of adulthood. Grateful for all the gentle kindness.' After posting to Moments, her elder sister Sun Yutong commented, 'Little sister has made it!' and Yuwei replied with a hugging emoji, interacting with friends and family.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Night journaling, outlining 'Slow Travel Notes,' and reading before bed.
description: She spread open her A5 journal and recorded the day's keywords with a fountain pen: gratitude, morning light, red envelope, tutorial, Mingyuan Bookstore, mushrooms, Moments. She pasted in the printed photo of the Panlong River and pressed dried eucalyptus leaves, and outlined them with warm watercolor. Then she opened another notebook and drafted a narrative fragment for Slow Travel Notes about a "Kunming winter family dinner," writing about two hundred words, blending details of tonight's hotpot scene and the white hair at her father's temples. Then she read the remaining thirty or so pages of This Side of Yunnan, focusing on "rustic narrative amid the warmth of everyday life," and copied two passages describing "mushrooms" and "human warmth" into her quotation notebook, making up for the regret of not finishing it yesterday.
location: Desk and edge of the bed in the bedroom at home, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and gratitude journal
description: Changed into pajamas, turned off the main light and kept only the aromatherapy lamp on, spread a yoga mat on the bay window, sat down, and used the Tide app for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on today's moments of gratitude. After meditating, wrote a gratitude journal in the phone memo: grateful to herself for repaying her parents with her labor; grateful to Uncle Qin for the recommendation and to her parents for their company; grateful for the peace brought by the lake water and the morning breeze. After writing, drank a few sips of warm water.
location: Bedroom bay window at home, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Saying goodnight and going to bed
description: She drew the curtains, set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, and planned to do yoga. Lying down before closing her eyes, she thought of her sister's comments and her parents' smiling faces, and the corners of her mouth lifted. In the quiet of the winter night, she gradually fell asleep, with the steam from the hot pot and the fragrance of eucalyptus leaves drifting in her mind.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, at home on the bed in the bedroom.

name: Morning wash-up and waking up.
description: She woke to the soft alarm chime from the phone beside her pillow; outside the window was the typical lead-gray Kunming winter sky. She didn't get up right away. With her eyes closed, she savored the warm scene of last night's family dinner and felt the lingering warmth of the mushroom hot pot. She drank two sips of warm water, saw the goodnight sticker her older sister Sun Yutong had sent, and smiled as she replied, 'Morning.' She pulled open the off-white curtains to let in the faint morning light. After a brief wash-up, she ran a comb through her hair and changed into a loose off-white knit top and cotton trousers. In the bathroom she did a few stretches to loosen her neck, shoulders, and wrists, ready to start the new day.
location: Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Have breakfast with parents and tidy up after the meal
description: When she walked into the dining room, her mother Li Xiulan had already made chicken soup rice noodles, with tender shredded chicken and bright green scallions in the bowl. Her father Sun Mingyuan was holding a bowl and urged, 'Eat it while it's hot.' After sitting down, they talked about yesterday's Family Gratitude Day; her mother happily said she had sent the red envelope screenshot to her colleagues' group chat, and everyone was envious. After breakfast, she helped clear the dishes and wipe down the stove. Back in the study, she opened her laptop and wrote today's tasks on a sticky note: finalize the sticker tutorial, schedule a post, and contact Zhou Lin to confirm the product timeline. When the preparations were done, she poured a glass of warm water and got ready to enter focus mode.
location: Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning work: polished the sticker tutorial and communicated with partners.
description: In the study, I opened the draft of the botanical journal sticker tutorial I'd put together last night and checked it line by line to make sure the step descriptions were clear. I opened Photoshop and made fine color adjustments to the key step illustrations for a softer tone. I logged into Xiaohongshu and uploaded the cover image and body text as planned, filling in the title and tags: 'Yunnan Botanical Journal Sticker Tutorial | A Plant Illustration Style That Beginners Can Master.' I carefully checked the scheduled publish settings, and after confirming everything was correct, set the publish time to 10:00 a.m. on New Year's Day 2026. I breathed a sigh of relief when I saw the 'Scheduled successfully' notification. I opened WeChat and sent a message to my partner Zhou Lin, syncing up on the tutorial progress and asking about the product listing. While waiting, I got up, walked to the window, looked at the daily life of Cuihu Community downstairs, and browsed WeChat, feeling warm. Zhou Lin replied quickly, saying that because of the high requirements for paper and craftsmanship, the listing might be delayed until a week after New Year's Day. After a short voice call, we decided to release the tutorial on New Year's Day first and test the market with a pre-sale link, and agreed to look at the sample product next week. I carefully recorded the key points of the communication on the journal work page.
location: Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Green Lake Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (study)

name: Helped Mom prepare lunch and ate lunch with her.
description: Closing her laptop, she went into the kitchen, where her mother Li Xiulan was picking over baby greens, preparing to cook a home-style meal. She took the initiative to wash the vegetables and mince the garlic. As mother and daughter prepared ingredients and chatted, her mother asked about her afternoon plans and told her not to come home too late. The kitchen was filled with the comforting sounds of running water and chopping knives. Lunch was stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tomato scrambled eggs, and bamboo fungus stewed chicken soup. Her father brought up the final exam scores of a colleague's child and sighed about how much pressure kids face today; her mother said she had been an easy kid. Watching her parents bicker, she felt that this kind of daily life was the best happiness.
location: Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (kitchen and dining room)

name: Midday reading and tea-tasting time.
description: After lunch, she returned to the study, took Lei Pingyang's The Order of Yunnan Dusk from the bookshelf, and placed a ginkgo leaf bookmark inside the book. She brewed herself a cup of Dianhong black tea, watching the leaves unfold and the aroma rise. Holding the cup, she walked to the balcony, brought out a rattan chair, added a cushion, and sat down sideways with her legs resting on a small stool. On the balcony were the eucalyptus leaves she bought yesterday, holding a quiet beauty on the overcast winter day. Taking a sip of Dianhong, she opened the book and immersed herself in Lei Pingyang's delicate descriptions of Yunnan dusk. When she reached a resonant passage, she paused, looked up at the gray-white skyline toward Cuihu beyond the window, and resonated silently with the words. The entire afternoon belonged to quiet writing and solitary time; her phone was left inside the apartment.
location: Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (balcony)

name: Journaling, research preparation, and keeping my mother company
description: Returning from the balcony to the living room, she spread out her journal and colored pens on the coffee table and carefully recorded the warm moments of yesterday's Family Gratitude Day — the slight nervousness when transferring money, the wrinkles at the corners of her father's eyes, the steam of the hot pot — in words and simple drawings, attaching the receipt from buying flowers at Huayu Florist as proof. Then she turned to a new page and began to outline the topic list for next week's research visit to Dounan Flower Market, writing down plant names such as "jacaranda (late bloom), winter cherry, narcissus, camellia, Meconopsis..." and sketching their general shapes and color characteristics beside each one to gather inspiration for the next sticker design. Seeing her mother collecting clothes on the balcony, she put down the journal, went to the kitchen to refill the hot water, brewed a cup of rose tea for her, and carried it to the living room. Her mother took the tea, her expression softening, and they chatted about everyday matters. Noticing that it was about time, she went back to her room, changed into yoga clothes, put on a loose knit cardigan, and slung on a small bag with a water bottle and towel.
location: Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (living room and master bedroom)

name: Walked to the yoga studio and prepared for class
description: She put on her earphones, played the light music "Sounds of Mountains and Waters," locked the door, and walked out of the residential complex. Outside was a cloudy winter afternoon in Kunming; the air was cool but not biting. She walked along Huashan West Road, crossed Renmin Middle Road, and turned onto Dongfeng West Road. The streets were crowded, but she was immersed in the music and her thoughts, with light steps. About 25 minutes later she arrived at Dechun Commercial Building, took the elevator to the 4th floor, and walked into Zhongmu Yoga Studio. The front desk had already lit an elegant lavender aromatherapy diffuser. She greeted the instructor He Lu, went to the changing room to put on yoga socks, and locked her backpack in a locker.
location: Walk from Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, to Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road.

name: Attend yoga class.
description: Today there weren't many students, six in total. Teacher He Lu's voice was gentle yet powerful. The one-hour class included standing forward fold, triangle pose, camel pose, and a hip-opening sequence. I focused on each posture, feeling the rhythm of muscle control and breathing. In the final relaxation, with my eyes closed, I felt the fatigue in my body and the stray thoughts in my mind slowly release with each breath. After class, He Lu had prepared ginger and red date tea for everyone. Holding the hot tea, I chatted with He Lu and two other students in the lobby about year-end plans. He Lu specifically reminded me: "Yuwei, tomorrow is our final class of the year, with special practice and sharing—you really should come and experience it." I smiled and nodded in agreement, and sincerely thanked her for her careful guidance over the past year.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, No. 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walking home, having dinner with parents, and tidying up after the meal
description: Walking out of the yoga studio, the sky had already darkened completely. Streetlights and neon lights mingled into a warm yellow glow. Her body felt stretched and relaxed, and her steps were light. She took out one earbud and let the sounds of the night city surround her. When she was almost home, she saw a steamed bun shop by the roadside emitting steam. Remembering that her mother had mentioned wanting to eat coarse grains, she went in and bought three buckwheat steamed buns. When she pushed open the door, her mother, Li Xiulan, had already made clear-broth spare ribs stewed with radish and stir-fried tender bean sprouts. Seeing the buns brought back, she playfully scolded her for wasting money, but immediately heated them up. The family of three enjoyed dinner in the enveloping steam. Her father asked about her yoga class, and she shared that He Lu had invited her to the final class the next day. Her father encouraged her to stick with it. After dinner, she cleared the dishes on her own, helped her mother wash the pots, then returned to her room, turned on the desk lamp, charged her phone, and poured a glass of warm water to prepare for the evening.
location: Walked from Dechun Commercial Building back to Cuihu Community, along the way and at home (Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province).

name: Video call with her elder sister and literary brainstorming
description: In the study, she called her sister Sun Yutong on video. On the screen, her sister was wearing a face mask and working overtime remotely in her rented apartment in Shenzhen. The sisters first talked about the previous day's Gratitude Day, and her sister teased, You're our family's finance minister now. The conversation turned to New Year's plans. Sun Yuwei said she planned to invite some friends and spend two days in Dali, enjoying a quiet literary New Year. Her sister shared amusing stories about year-end overtime in Shenzhen, then urged: Book the whole family's flights to Sanya for New Year's Day right away! Mom was saying in the group chat yesterday that she wants to go for a walk by the sea. She laughed and agreed. She also shared the publication progress of her essay collection A Slow Journey; the book proposal had been approved, which was exciting. After nearly an hour, they hung up. She felt in good spirits, took out a small notebook and a fountain pen, and walked to the living room window, where the lights of Cuihu Lake and the distant city twinkled. She opened The Order of Yunnan Dusk and savored the beautiful passages she had read that afternoon, then wrote in her notebook: New thoughts on A Slow Journey: use the riverbank as the axis to connect the stories of Kunming people and the Panlong River... Inspiration surged, and she quickly jotted down keywords and paragraph frameworks, feeling a sense of creative fulfillment.
location: Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (by the windows of the study and the living room)

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, meditation, and sleep
description: Remembering He Lu's reminder, she took out tomorrow's yoga clothes from the wardrobe, folded them, and put them into a cloth bag. She set tomorrow's alarm on her phone and sent He Lu a WeChat message to confirm: "Sister He, what time is the closing class tomorrow? I want to prepare." Everything was arranged properly, and she felt at ease. She changed into pajamas, turned off the main light, and left only an aroma lamp on. Sitting cross-legged on the bed, she set a 10-minute alarm on her phone, closed her eyes, and began mindfulness meditation. Her thoughts drifted gently through the day's experiences: the rice noodles in the morning, the Dianhong tea and Lei Pingyang on the afternoon balcony, the stretch of her body after yoga class, her sister's caring urgings... She silently gave thanks for these ordinary yet beautiful moments. After the meditation, she wrote the day's gratitude note in the gratitude journal on her bedside. She closed the journal, turned off the bedside lamp, got into the warm quilt, and fell asleep peacefully, looking forward to tomorrow's closing yoga class.
location: Room 201, Unit 4, Building 3, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (bedroom).

name: Natural awakening.
description: On Saturday morning, sunlight streamed through the curtain gap into the bedroom. Sun Yuwei naturally woke at 07:20, feeling refreshed and clear-headed. She sat on the edge of the bed quietly savoring the stillness of the morning, her mind calm from last night’s meditation and reading.
location: Bedroom, Shuxiang Menti Residential Community, 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning cross-training and breakfast
description: Sun Yuwei changed into her workout clothes, went downstairs to the community garden and did 30 minutes of brisk-walking interval training at a pace of about 9 minutes per kilometer. During the session she saw a neighbor walking a golden retriever, and the morning breeze was chilly. After exercising, she went home, took a shower, and changed clothes; her mother had already prepared breakfast.
location: Garden and home at Shuxiang Mindi Community, No. 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Mom brought out steaming rice noodles and fried sauce ersi noodles, while Dad flipped through a newspaper. Sun Yuwei shared what she and her sister had video-chatted about the night before, and the conversation turned to the plan to travel to Sanya after New Year's Day. Mom said she wanted to stay in a sea-view homestay. Yuwei smiled and noted down the request, and the outline of the family trip gradually became clear at the dinner table.
location: Dining room at Shuxiang Mendi Residential Community, No. 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparations
description: Sun Yuwei brewed a cup of ancient-tree black tea, opened her laptop, flipped open her journal, and wrote down the three important things she planned to do today: the first draft of the preface, the Mingyuan Bookstore event, and a yoga class.
location: Study, Shuxiang Mendi Residential Community, No. 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Writing the first draft of the preface to the annual anthology.
description: Sun Yuwei was immersed in writing, reviewing the works of each member of the 2025 writing group: Liu Jia's essays were delicate and sentimental, Zhao Xiaowen's writing was warm and healing, and Lao Chen had a steady style that had shed all ornamentation. She spent an hour and a half writing an initial draft of about 800 words under the theme ‘Growth Between Ink and Breath,’ then read it through and made fine adjustments at 11:15, and sent it to the group leader via WeChat for feedback.
location: Desk by the window in the study, Shuxiang Mending Residential Community, 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Communicate with my sister and check flight tickets.
description: While taking a break from writing, Sun Yuwei picked up her phone and left a message for her sister to discuss the specific dates for going to Sanya after New Year's Day. Then she opened a travel app, browsed flights from Kunming to Sanya, and marked several flights with suitable prices.
location: Study, Shuxiang Mendi Residential Community, No. 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: Lunch was the tomato egg noodles my mom made—simple and refreshing. Sun Yuwei discussed the Sanya trip with her parents in more detail: if they went for five days, did they want to stay in a sea-view hotel or a homestay, and roughly what budget. Her dad said, 'You two decide,' while her mom worried about whether it would be cold to go into the sea. Sun Yuwei smiled and explained the weather in Sanya around the Spring Festival.
location: Dining room at Shuxiang Mendi Residential Community, No. 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A short rest and journaling after lunch.
description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei sat on the balcony to bask in the sun, opened her journal, and wrote down a few keywords: Sanya flight tickets, digital detox, Tea Horse Road, year-end yoga class. The sunshine was warm; she closed her eyes and rested for a moment, storing up energy for the afternoon's activities.
location: Living room balcony, Shuxiang Menti Residential Community, 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Walk over and finalize the event details
description: Sun Yuwei changed into a sweater coat, put on her canvas bag, and set out from the Shuxiang Mendi residential community. After briskly walking along the street for about 20 minutes, she arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore. Meeting Qin Mingyuan in the reception area on the second floor, they first talked about readers' resonance with Fragments on Xiaohongshu; a reader had commented that the small town morning described in the book reminded her of her grandmother. Then they formally finalized the details of the January 2026 "Digital Detox Hour" book club event. Sun Yuwei confirmed the event schedule, key points for the promotional copy, and the size, style, and required information for the poster draft one by one.
location: 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, reception area on the second floor of Mingyuan Bookstore; walking from Xiaokang Avenue to Cuihu North Road on the way.

name: Reading at the bookstore and journaling
description: After the discussion, Sun Yuwei went to the reading area by the window on the first floor and read a newly acquired copy of *The Tea Horse Road: Old Times from Pu'er to Tibet* that Qin Mingyuan had brought in. She was drawn to the passage about “transporting tea along cliff edges at the risk of one's life.” She took out a pen and her journal, sketched a quick line drawing of the bookstore corner, and beside it listed all the materials and key dates they had just confirmed.
location: First-floor reading area of Mingyuan Bookstore, 32 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, China

name: Walked to and attended the year-end closing yoga class.
description: Sun Yuwei said goodbye to Qin Mingyuan, headed west along Cuihu North Road, crossed Wenlin Street, and walked briskly along Dongfeng West Road for about 15 minutes to reach Zhongmou Yoga Studio. She changed into her practice clothes and attended Teacher He Lu's "Foundation-Building Year-End Finale" class, which focused on posture alignment and breathing. During the class, Teacher He corrected her basic poses one by one, such as Mountain Pose and Triangle Pose. After class, she specifically told Sun Yuwei that her core stability was excellent and that she could advance to a vinyasa flow sequence. Sun Yuwei felt warm inside.
location: Zhongmou Yoga Studio Large Classroom 2, Room 4001, 4th Floor, Dechun Commercial Building, 288 Dongfeng West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province; en route, walking from Cuihu North Road to Dongfeng West Road

name: Walking home and sketching the initial framework for the poster
description: After finishing her yoga class, Sun Yuwei bought a freshly roasted corn cob from a roadside stall and ate it while walking east along Dongfeng West Road for more than ten minutes to get home. After washing up, she drafted the 'One-Hour Digital Detox' poster in her sketchbook according to the plan agreed upon in the afternoon, drawing three sketches: a clock entwined with vines, a hand putting down a phone and picking up a book, and a person holding a lamp and reading under a starry sky. She decided to choose one tomorrow and make it into a digital version with Photoshop.
location: Walking route from Dongfeng West Road to Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and the study in the Shuxiang Mendi residential community.

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner was stir-fried pork with green peppers and stir-fried pea shoots made by Mom. Sun Yuwei shared what she had gained that afternoon at the bookstore and the yoga studio, and seriously discussed New Year plans with her parents. They basically reached a preliminary family consensus to travel to Sanya after New Year's Day. Her mother began thinking about which clothes to bring.
location: Dining room at Shuxiang Mendi Residential Community, No. 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Refining the poster concept and online communication
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her study, took a photo of the poster sketch she had drawn in the afternoon, and sent it to Qin Mingyuan via WeChat for his opinion. While waiting for a reply, she opened Xiaohongshu and WeChat and replied to comments from readers and the writing group about the first draft of the preface. Around 8 p.m., she received a positive reply from the group leader, and she happily took a screenshot and sent it to the writing group chat.
location: Study, Shuxiang Mendi Residential Community, No. 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Journaling and Watercolor Creation
description: Sun Yuwei changed into loungewear, sat on the bay window in the study, and opened her journal for a themed creation, "Recording Community and Connection." She used a pencil to refine the sketch she had finished at the bookstore in the afternoon, then mixed tube watercolors and painted it, with colors transitioning from light blue to warm yellow, then to the dark brown of the bookshelf. After finishing, she sent a voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing to share the work.
location: Bay window area of the study in the Shuxiang Mendi residential community, No. 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Mindful meditation and gratitude journal
description: Sun Yuwei poured a glass of warm water, lit a wooden-scented aromatherapy candle on her desk, sat cross-legged on a yoga mat, and followed the Tide app for a 15-minute body scan meditation. Afterwards, she wrote in her gratitude journal her thanks for the day's smooth communication, yoga guidance, family travel plans, and creative flow.
location: Bedroom, Shuxiang Menti Residential Community, 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading and online chatting.
description: After washing up and putting on a facial mask, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and read the chapter "Twilight in the Mountains" from Lei Pingyang's The Order of Yunnan Dusk. Seeing Song Wen and Zhang Jing chatting in the group on her phone, she joined in and shared the joy of writing the preface and designing the poster that day.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Shuxiang Menti Community, 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: Sun Yuwei removed her face mask, massaged her skin to help it absorb, applied eye cream and moisturizing lotion, and changed into comfortable silk pajamas, draping tomorrow's clothes over the chair. Once everything was ready, she turned off the main light, leaving only a warm yellow bedside night light.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Shuxiang Mendi Community, 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Listening to light music and falling asleep
description: Sun Yuwei put on her earphones and played a piano piece with rain sounds and white noise on a loop. Her body relaxed, and her breathing gradually became slow and deep. Looking back on the fulfilling day from the morning brisk walk to the watercolor painting at night, she felt rich and calm inside, and gradually drifted into sleep at around 23:20.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Shuxiang Menti Community, 346 Xiaokang Avenue, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning long-distance run, 9.5 kilometers
description: Woke up naturally at 5:50 a.m., drank some water, left at 6:05 a.m. for Cuihu Park, and ran 9.5 kilometers along the lakeside running track at a pace of about 7'30"/km. While running, she listened to folk music. After 2 kilometers, the soreness in her calves disappeared. She successfully completed nearly 10 kilometers, marked a milestone on her sports watch, and felt good. Finished running at 7:15 a.m. and walked home.
location: Cuihu Park, Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Post-run stretching, shower, and breakfast preparation
description: After the run, she went home and did 15 minutes of post-run static stretching at the front door, focusing on relaxing the back of her thighs and calves. Then she took a hot shower and got ready. When she walked out of her room, her mother had already warmed the milk and steamed the flaky buns, and she was ready to have breakfast with her parents.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Have breakfast with parents, share running achievements and travel plans
description: At the breakfast table, Sun Yuwei ate slightly sweet flaky buns while excitedly telling her parents about her breakthrough of running 9.5 kilometers in the morning. She naturally brought up the plan to book flights and a homestay to Dali, tentatively asking her parents what they thought about a New Year's Eve trip. Her mother asked detailed questions about the flights and accommodation, and her father reminded her to stay safe. The atmosphere was relaxed and warm.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Pack luggage and prepare for the trip to Dali
description: After breakfast, she returned to the bedroom and started packing for the Dali trip on December 30. She folded light purple quick-dry clothing, a thick coat, base layers, and other clothes into her travel bag, carefully checked the mirrorless camera, spare batteries, journal tool kit, and the book “The Order of Yunnan Dusk,” and put the Yunnan Baiyao band-aids her mother had given her in the side pocket.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Book flights and a homestay for the trip to Dali.
description: After packing, she leaned against the headboard and compared flight prices and schedules on several travel apps, finally booking a flight from Kunming to Dali at 9:30 a.m. on December 30. She then chose a highly rated Bai-style guesthouse by Erhai Lake and booked a room with a private balcony overlooking the snow of Cangshan Mountain. After paying, she felt the New Year plan was one step closer.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Formally informed her parents of the complete travel itinerary and accepted their earnest advice.
description: Holding her phone, she walked to the living room and formally and fully explained her itinerary to her parents: flight times, the name and address of the homestay, and the number of travel days. Her father carefully asked for the homestay's emergency contact number, while her mother took out a pack of band-aids and some Banlangen granules and pressed them into her hand, reminding her to keep warm. Sun Yuwei agreed to everything, feeling warm inside.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family lunch and farewell talk
description: Her mother had prepared sour soup pig trotters and stir-fried choy sum for lunch. At the table, the travel topic continued: her mother imagined cycling along Erhai Lake, and her father planned a family trip to Sanya after New Year's Day. Her mother also announced that she would make mushroom hot pot in the evening to see Yuwei off. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Take a nap after lunch to replenish energy.
description: Feeling a bit tired after lunch, she went back to her room, drew the curtains, and took a nap for about 40 minutes to let her body recover from the morning's long run and store up energy for the afternoon's activities.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Video-called her older sister to share travel plans.
description: After the lunch break, she called her elder sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen via video call. Excitedly, she showed photos of the guesthouse and shared her plan to spend New Year's Eve in Dali and her achievement of a 9.5-kilometer morning run. Her sister reminded her to take some good photos for wallpaper and mentioned that the family's airfare for a post-New Year trip to Sanya had already been picked out. The two sisters chatted happily for about forty minutes.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Free writing and reading time.
description: After hanging up the video call, she leaned against the bedroom bay window and read "The Order of Yunnan Dusk," underlining favorite passages. The bougainvillea in the sunlight outside the window was lovely, so she took out her watercolor sketchbook and made a quick sketch of a few bougainvillea flowers, noting the colors, to use in her journal that evening.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Helped mother prepare mushroom hot pot dinner
description: She went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare the meal; dinner was a farewell mushroom hot pot. The cleaned matsutake mushrooms, cordyceps flowers, and bamboo fungus gave off a fresh fragrance. Yuwei was responsible for washing the leafy greens and tofu and cutting the potatoes into roll-cut chunks. The mother and daughter chatted as they worked, and her mother taught her to identify the characteristics of different mushrooms. Yuwei felt this time together was especially precious.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Family farewell dinner (mushroom hot pot)
description: The mushroom hot pot was brought to the table, the broth golden and fragrant. Mother ladled soup for Yuwei, and Father quietly placed her favorite matsutake slices into her bowl. Yuwei picked food for her parents, saying she would try to take them to more places next year. Father smiled, Mother's eyes turned slightly red, and the dinner was warm with a touch of reluctance.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: After-dinner tidying and family chit-chat.
description: After the meal, she proactively cleared the dishes and washed them. Her father checked her camera bag, confirmed the charger and spare batteries were there, and asked about her camera's macro settings. Her mother, sitting on the sofa, continued to remind her to bring a thick coat, drink plenty of hot water, and be safe. Yuwei nodded as she listened, then returned to her room around 20:00 to get ready for rest.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Journaling and creative work before bed.
description: After washing up, change into pajamas, sit at the desk, and spread open your journal. Use a fountain pen to write down the date and weather, and draw a panel of a morning-run silhouette at Green Lake and a quick sketch of a bowl of mushroom soup. In the center of the page, write the title: "About to set off, flying to Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake with my family's love." Then cut out the watercolor bougainvillea petals you painted in the afternoon and paste them into the journal, and record the running data and travel plans with colored pens.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Reading and meditation before bed
description: After finishing organizing my journal, I turned off the main light, left a bedside lamp on, leaned against the headboard, and continued reading the prose about Dali in 'The Order of Yunnan Dusk.' At 22:00, I turned off the light, lay in bed, and meditated with my eyes closed for 10 minutes, letting the day's excitement and attachment settle. At 22:10, I fell asleep quietly, carrying anticipation for the trip and the warmth of home.
location: Green Lake Community, No. 7 Huaxi Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan.

name: Getting up and morning meditation
description: At 7 a.m. the phone alarm rang, and it was overcast and rainy outside. Sun Yuwei sat up and did 10 minutes of mindful breathing, feeling the slight soreness in her thighs from yesterday's run, then sat cross-legged and completed a brief body scan, letting her thoughts settle and gathering inner energy for today's final yoga practice.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: After washing up, she went downstairs. Her mother Li Xiulan had prepared steaming hot crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, and her father Sun Mingyuan was sitting at the dining table reading the morning paper. Her mother handed her chopsticks while reminding her that Dali was getting colder and to bring a thick coat. Sun Yuwei smiled and nodded, feeling the warmth of home.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning routine and journal records
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei returned to her small study, did some simple stretches to wake up her body, then opened her beloved journal for morning recording. She drew a small sapling with a green watercolor pen and wrote the words 'take root' on it, then jotted down three small things to be grateful for: her mother's rice noodles, her father's care, and herself for finishing the 9.5-kilometer run yesterday.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Pre-trip inspection and publishing contract confirmation.
description: After finishing the journal entry, Sun Yuwei did a final check before leaving, placing the camera battery, memory card, charger, journal, and sakura watercolor paints one by one into her commuter bag. She then called her editor Xu Mingyuan and learned that the letter of intent for the publishing contract for "Slow Notes" had been sent, with the first advance of 8,000 yuan to arrive next month. The worry in her heart finally eased. After hanging up, she solemnly wrote "See you in spring" in her journal and drew a sun, full of hope for the future.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Chatting with mother
description: Before going out, she saw her mother picking green beans in the living room. Sun Yuwei went over to help. While snapping the beans, they talked about tomorrow's plan: first fly to Dali to celebrate New Year's Eve, then meet up with her sister and the others to go to Sanya. Her mother smiled and said, "Make the most of your youth and travel more, and bring back some beautiful photos." The two chatted easily, and the moment was warm.
location: Living room at home, 7 Huashan West Road, Cuihu Community, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Refined the book club poster design
description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop, pulled up the three poster draft proposals she had sent to Uncle Qin on WeChat the night before, selected the concept combining “book” and “tree”, used Photoshop to highlight the theme text “Digital Detox for One Hour” in warm yellow, and added a desk lamp silhouette to make the image convey a quieter reading atmosphere. After finishing, she sent the new proposal to Uncle Qin via WeChat.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Go to Dounan Flower Market to select a travel bouquet and have lunch
description: At 10:30, Sun Yuwei left the house with a transparent umbrella, walked from Green Lake Community to Exit D of Huashan West Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 and transferred to Line 1 to Dounan Station, and arrived at Dounan Flower Market about 55 minutes later. She looked through the stalls and chose a small bunch of chamomile and eucalyptus leaves, wrapped in kraft paper. As she was about to leave, she ran into Su Man, a fellow student from her flower arrangement class. The two chatted excitedly for ten minutes, shared new flower materials, and agreed to go to the botanical garden studio after New Year’s Day to learn new flower arrangement styles. After saying goodbye, Sun Yuwei ordered a bowl of small-pot rice noodles at a small food-court stall in the market for lunch. She scrolled through Xiaohongshu while eating and drew a chamomile flower in her journal.
location: Dounan Flower Market, No. 76 Jingui Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, and its food court

name: Take the subway to Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei took Metro Line 1 from Dounan Station, transferred to Line 2 at Huanchengnan Road Station, and got off at Shizha Station. She exited from Exit B and walked 150 meters to Ruidingcheng Shopping Center, taking about an hour in total. On the metro, she wore earphones listening to soothing instrumental music and watched the rain outside the window quiet the city, feeling calmed inside.
location: Ruidingcheng Shopping Center, 168 Baiyun Road, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (during commute)

name: Yoga class preparation, participation, and receiving a complimentary book.
description: At 14:00, Sun Yuwei arrived at Jingxin Yoga Life Studio. After checking in, she changed into her yoga clothes, spread out her own mat, and sat cross-legged with eyes closed, regulating her breath. The room was faintly scented with sandalwood. At 14:30, teacher He Lu led the year-end closing class, moving from Cat-Cow pose gradually into Downward Dog, Warrior I, and Warrior II. The teacher came over and gently adjusted the engagement of her shoulder blades. During the final breathing meditation, the classroom held only the sound of rain and breath. In the gratitude segment, everyone placed a hand over their heart to thank themselves, and Sun Yuwei's eyes grew slightly moist. At 15:30, the class ended. Teacher He Lu stopped her and gave her a copy of Iyengar's The Tree of Yoga wrapped in an elegant book cover, praising her for rooting her body and mind like a tree over the past year and encouraging her to browse through it during the holiday. Sun Yuwei was moved and hugged her, and they briefly exchanged insights on practice.
location: Large Classroom, Jingxin Yoga Life Studio, 4th Floor, Ruidingcheng Shopping Center, 168 Baiyun Road, Panlong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Completed 108 Sun Salutations alone
description: The classroom returned to silence. Outside the window, the sky gradually darkened and a fine rain tapped against the glass. Sun Yuwei put 'The Tree of Yoga' in the corner, returned to the front of her mat, pressed her palms together, and began 108 Sun Salutations. Sweat soaked the hair on her forehead. She went from smoothness, through a heavy weariness midway, and finally reached peace and release. With every fold and stretch, she felt gratitude in her heart for her family, Teacher He, her friends, and herself for living seriously. After completing the last round, she lay down on the mat and felt an unprecedented lightness and clarity.
location: Large Classroom, Jingxin Yoga Life Studio, 4th Floor, Ruidingcheng Shopping Center, 168 Baiyun Road, Panlong District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Pack up my belongings and leave the yoga studio
description: After lying quietly for a moment, Sun Yuwei got up and wiped away her sweat with a towel, her body feeling as refreshed as if washed in warm water. She carefully put away her yoga mat and clothes, held The Tree of Yoga to her chest, changed into her own clothes, said goodbye to Teacher He Lu, and left the yoga studio.
location: Jingxin Yoga Life Center, 4th Floor, Ruiding City Shopping Mall, 168 Baiyun Road, Panlong District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Took the subway back home
