description: Walking out of Ruidingcheng, the rain had stopped and the air was fresh. Sun Yuwei took Metro Line 2 from Shizha Station to Dongfeng Square Station, transferred to Line 1, and went to Huashan West Road Station. She exited from Exit D and walked 170 meters home, taking about 30 minutes in total. Leaning back in the metro seat, watching the familiar streetscape flash by outside the window, she felt calm and fulfilled.
location: Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province (during commute, destination: home)

name: Organizing and recording after returning home
description: After getting home, Sun Yuwei placed “The Tree of Yoga” in a conspicuous spot on her desk, took off her coat, washed her face, and changed into loungewear. She then washed the yoga clothes she had worn today and hung them on the balcony. Looking at the watercolor painting and the book on her desk, she felt the day’s emotions echoing in her heart.
location: At home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Mother made stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, shredded pork with green peppers, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and seaweed egg drop soup. At the dinner table, Sun Yuwei excitedly shared the surprise of meeting Su Man at the flower market and her gratitude for the book given by Teacher He Lu. Father asked with a smile what time they would go to the airport tomorrow, and Mother again reminded her about the next day's trip.
location: Home dining room, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Journal entries and gratitude diary
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to her study, turned on the desk lamp, and used a blue ink pen to record in detail in her journal the process of doing 108 Sun Salutations and her physical and mental feelings. She also painted the outline of a small book in watercolor and wrote beside it: “2025.12.29 Teacher He Lu’s gift: The Tree of Yoga.” Finally, she wrote a gratitude diary, thanking her family for their love, Teacher He for her guidance, her chance encounter with Su Man, and her own persistence over the past year.
location: Home study, Cuihu Community, 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Bedtime meditation
description: Leaving the study and returning to the bedroom, Sun Yuwei sat cross-legged on the bed for a 10-minute bedtime meditation, focusing on her breath and feeling grateful for the mind-body connection brought by yoga and the growth from this year of practice. After the meditation, she smiled at herself in the mirror and whispered softly, "See you tomorrow, Dali."
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Prepare tomorrow's luggage and wash up
description: After meditating, Sun Yuwei took out her suitcase and rechecked her ID documents, change of clothes, camera, journal, chamomile bouquet, and The Tree of Yoga. After confirming everything was in order, she arranged them neatly. Then she went to the bathroom, applied a moisturizing mask, and washed up comfortably.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Reading, then lights out and sleep
description: After washing up, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard and opened the first few pages of The Tree of Yoga. When she read, 'Yoga is connection, the poetry of the body,' she smiled knowingly. At 22:45 she turned off the bedside lamp on schedule, and in the quiet world after the rain, she fell into a deep sleep filled with emotion and anticipation for tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, Cuihu Community, No. 7 Huashan West Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Morning preparation, breakfast, and farewell
description: I woke up naturally before the alarm went off, lay quietly in bed enjoying the serene morning, then quickly washed up, changed into an all-cotton white shirt and corduroy trousers, and tied a low ponytail. Then I had breakfast with my parents in the dining room, enjoying the small-pot rice noodles and soft-boiled eggs my mother had prepared. My father checked his ID, plane tickets, and B&B reservation once more, and told me to let them know when I landed. After breakfast, I went back to my room for a final check of my luggage, confirmed that my DSLR camera, watercolor notebook, TN journal, and The Tree of Yoga were all in the canvas bag, carefully wrapped the chamomile and eucalyptus leaves, hugged my parents goodbye at the entrance, and walked out the door under their warm gaze.
location: No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: My parents drove me to the airport.
description: Her father drove, her mother sat in the front passenger seat, and Sun Yuwei sat in the back. The city streetscape outside the window gradually lit up. There was little conversation in the car, but the atmosphere was comforting. The car entered the airport expressway and, after about 55 minutes, stopped smoothly outside Gate 5 of the departure hall at Changshui International Airport.
location: Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Going through check-in and waiting for the flight alone
description: After saying goodbye to her parents at the entrance of the departure hall, she walked into the airport alone, pushing her suitcase, printed her boarding pass at the self-service check-in kiosk, and chose a window seat. After passing through security, she bought a hot latte at a cafe near the boarding gate, sat down in a quiet corner, and opened The Tree of Yoga to read a few pages. More often, she looked out through the floor-to-ceiling windows at the planes on the apron, feeling calm and expectant.
location: Kunming Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Flight and arrival in Dali
description: The plane took off on time and soared through the clouds. After about 50 minutes of flight, it began to descend. Through the window, she saw the Cangshan Mountains stretching majestically and Erhai Lake set like a sapphire. At 9:25, the plane landed smoothly at Dali Airport. Stepping out of the cabin, she took a deep breath of the dry, cool air filled with sunshine and felt relaxed in body and mind.
location: Dali Airport, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Take a taxi to the homestay
description: At the airport taxi waiting area, she got into a car driven by a local driver, who enthusiastically introduced the cloud-shrouded Three Pagodas and the snow-covered Cangshan Mountain along the way. The car drove from Airport Road onto Huanhai Road, with the shimmering Erhai Lake and Bai ethnic dwellings outside the window. She rolled down the window to let the warm breeze touch her face and used her phone to capture scenery photos full of a sense of speed.
location: Qiyun Courtyard, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Check in at the Bai ethnic guesthouse
description: Arriving at Qiyun Xiaoyuan, a traditional Bai courtyard house with green tiles, white walls, and richly carved beams in the three-house-one-screen-wall style, the guesthouse owner, Sister Yang, warmly helped carry her luggage and showed her around the courtyard. From the second-floor room, she could push open the wooden window and gaze at the magnificent view of Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake. She placed the chamomile she had brought into a coarse pottery vase on the windowsill and arranged eucalyptus leaves, adding a sense of ritual to the trip.
location: Qiyun Courtyard, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Strolled through the villages around the homestay.
description: After changing into canvas shoes, I wandered aimlessly along the stone-paved road in the village where the homestay was located. I watched elderly people basking in the sun and chatting by the wall corners, village dogs chasing and playing, and the ink-wash and color paintings and upturned eaves on Bai-style houses. I used my phone to record the small details of life, and at a corner I happened upon a tree full of golden citrons. Everything felt vivid and interesting.
location: Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Enjoying the first lunch in Dali.
description: Following the aroma, she found a small eatery called Yunwei Bistro on the main road of the village. She sat down at a bamboo table dappled with sunlight at the entrance and ordered the sour-spicy fish and cold chicken rice noodles recommended by the proprietress. The sour-spicy fish was made with crucian carp from Erhai Lake—appetizing and delicious; the cold chicken rice noodles were smooth and refreshing. She opened her TN journal and sketched a mint leaf dotted with dew as her lunch record.
location: Yunnan Province, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Dali City, Dali Town, at the entrance to Zhongyanghe Village, Yunwei Eatery

name: Walk to the Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor
description: Walking along the village road toward Erhai Lake, passing through a path full of winter cherry blossoms, after about 20 minutes the view suddenly opened up, and the blue Erhai Lake and Cangshan Mountain appeared unobstructed before her. She found the Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor signpost, took a deep breath, and prepared to start hiking.
location: Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor, 17 Huanhai West Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Hiking along Erhai Lake to gather material and sketch.
description: She strolled along the newly renovated ecological corridor, bathed in the warm winter sun and bright blue sky. She raised her DSLR camera to capture the shifting clouds over Cangshan Mountain and the birds skimming across the water. When she reached the shallows near Haishe Park, she saw fishermen hauling in their nets, so she watched quietly and recorded the scene with her lens. After hiking for about two hours, she sat down in front of a secluded lake bay, facing Erhai Lake, took out her watercolor sketchbook and portable watercolor box, and sketched the mountains, water, clouds, and withered trees before her, feeling time flow through the tip of her brush.
location: Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor, 17 Huanhai West Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: On the way back, sampled grilled erkuai from a street stall.
description: On the way back, at the exit of the corridor, I met an old woman selling roasted erkuai. Beside her the charcoal fire was burning brightly, and the aroma of rice and charcoal was tempting. She bought a roasted erkuai spread with peanut butter and chili sauce. The outside was crispy and the inside soft and sticky, with the sauce and rice aromas blending together—a simple comfort on a winter day.
location: At the exit of the Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Return to the guesthouse to rest up
description: She walked about 20 minutes along the country path back to Qiyun Courtyard. The courtyard was quiet, and sunlight slanted across the white wall, casting dappled tree shadows. After returning to her room, she changed out of her dusty shoes, washed her face, and backed up the photos from her camera to her tablet.
location: Qiyun Courtyard, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Resting in the courtyard and photographing the sunset
description: Carrying a cup of hot Pu'er tea given by the proprietress, she went to the second-floor terrace, leaned back in the rattan lounge chair, and sipped tea while watching the sky change from azure to orange to blue-purple. The outline of Cangshan Mountain was soft and deep in the twilight. She photographed the courtyard lights and the silhouettes of distant mountains during the 'blue hour' and sent them to her mother far away in Kunming, writing, 'The evening in Dali is like a spilled paint palette.'
location: Qiyun Courtyard, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Simple dinner
description: At the guesthouse restaurant, I ordered a bowl of clear soup with mushroom and vegetable noodles. The noodles were smooth, the broth savory, with a few greens and mushrooms — very refreshing. Outside the window, night had fully fallen, and Cangshan Mountain stood as a dark blue silhouette.
location: Qiyun Courtyard, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Bent over my desk, recording field-trip notes in my journal.
description: She spread out her Traveler's Notebook journal on the wooden table in front of the windowsill and used washi tape to attach today's boarding pass, a reddish fallen leaf she had picked up by Erhai Lake, and the business card of Yunwei Small Restaurant. Then, with a dip pen, she dissolved the day's impressions of light and shadow - the shifting clouds, the silent lake, the charcoal aroma of grilled erkuai rice cakes, the peaceful scene of fishermen hauling in nets - into delicate words and lines, recording the first harvest of her field trip. On the last page of the journal, she planned the next day's route: go to the North Gate vegetable market in the old town to experience the lively atmosphere of daily life.
location: Room, Qiyun Xiaoyuan, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Letting the family know I'm safe.
description: Sent a WeChat voice message to my mother, along with a photo of the sunset over Cangshan taken in the evening. My mother quickly replied, telling me to have fun, eat well, and keep warm. After briefly talking about what I had seen and heard that day, we ended the call.
location: Room, Qiyun Xiaoyuan, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Reading “The Tree of Yoga” before bed
description: Changed into comfortable cotton pajamas, slipped under the covers, leaned against the headboard, and took out "The Tree of Yoga," a gift from her teacher He Lu, to continue reading. In the quiet night by Erhai Lake, she contemplated the philosophy of "rooting" and "stretching," recalled the sensation of her body merging with nature during the afternoon lakeside walk, and smiled knowingly.
location: Room, Qiyun Xiaoyuan, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only the warm yellow bedside night light, and lay down for a brief pre-sleep mindfulness meditation, reviewing the nervous excitement of the early morning to the calm peace of this moment, feeling grateful for everything encountered and seen today. Physical fatigue slowly released into the soft mattress, consciousness gradually sank, and wearing an eye mask, she fell asleep peacefully under the silence of Erhai Lake and the protection of Cangshan Mountain.
location: Room, Qiyun Xiaoyuan, No. 273, Group 6, Zhongyanghe Village, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Cangshan sunrise meditation and a slow walk along Erhai Lake
description: At 6 a.m., as the sky was just beginning to lighten, Sun Yuwei wrapped a blanket around herself and went up to the third-floor terrace of the guesthouse. Facing Mount Cangshan, she sat down cross-legged, closed her eyes, and did 15 minutes of breathing meditation, feeling the morning breeze on her cheeks and hearing the sound of lake water lapping against the shore. After the meditation, she walked slowly for half an hour along the Erhai Lake ecological corridor outside the guesthouse, passing a patch of withered reeds. When she happened upon early-rising seagulls skimming over the water, she stopped to listen to their calls and recorded a clip on her phone.
location: China, Yunnan Province, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Dali City, Dali Town, Caicun Pier, the third-floor terrace of Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Guesthouse and the Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor outside the guesthouse

name: Read aloud from the English edition of Walden.
description: Back at the guesthouse, Sun Yuwei sat down in the reading nook by the window on the first floor, poured a cup of hot plain water, opened her English edition of Walden, and read aloud the chapter Where I Lived, and What I Lived For for 30 minutes. She deliberately slowed her pace, feeling a wonderful resonance between Thoreau's lakeside philosophy and the mood of Erhai Lake before her. The light outside gradually grew brighter, spilling across the pages, warm and quiet.
location: Public reading corner on the first floor of the Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Group Homestay, Caicun Wharf, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Guesthouse breakfast and casual chat
description: After the reading, Sun Yuwei went to the dining area. The guesthouse hostess served her a bowl of steaming white congee, with a plate of rushan and a plate of pickled vegetables. As she ate, she chatted with the hostess about the changing sunrise time in Dali. The hostess told her that today it was about 5 minutes later than around the winter solstice. She also asked the hostess for shops in the old town that do good indigo dyeing, and the hostess recommended 'Lanxu', saying it was opened by her cousin, right on Renmin Road.
location: Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Guesthouse Restaurant, Caicun Pier, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Cycling to Wase Town.
description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei changed into light sneakers and rented a bicycle from a small stall at the entrance of the guesthouse. She cycled south along the Erhai Lake ecological corridor, the breeze brushing through her hair, with the green Cangshan Mountains on her left and the sparkling Erhai Lake on her right. She rode at a leisurely pace and, upon encountering a patch of winter cherry blossoms in full bloom, stopped to take a few photos. About 40 minutes later, she arrived at Wase Town.
location: Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China (cycling from Caicun Pier to Wase Town)

name: Field trip to Wase and completing nature notes
description: After arriving at Wase Town, Sun Yuwei locked her bike and walked along the lake with her canvas bag, sketching and observing the scenery. She stopped at a shallow shoal where she could see the full reflection of Cangshan Mountain, took out her sketchbook, and completed yesterday's nature notes, recording the direction of the wind and the swaying posture of the reeds, while sketching the gradient of blue and purple on Cangshan in a pencil style. Around 11 o'clock, about 1 kilometer from Xiaoputuo, she met an elderly man painting in watercolor. Pointing at the clouds in the distance, he told her that this was "Clouds Flowing Over the Peak," one of the eleven scenic views of Cangshan. The two exchanged views on the similarities and differences between photography and painting for 15 minutes and appreciated each other's work.
location: Ecological corridor along the shore of Erhai Lake and in the direction of Xiaoputuo, Wase Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Lunch at a Small Bai Restaurant
description: Around noon, Sun Yuwei walked into a small Bai-style eatery called 'Hai Yueliang' with dried fish drying at the door. She ordered a clay-pot hot and sour fish and a serving of grilled milk fan. The sourness of the fish came from local papaya, and the spiciness was mellow; she ate until her forehead was slightly damp with sweat. While waiting, she took a close-up photo of the restaurant's old wooden door with her phone. After paying, she also bought two small packs of home-dried roses from the proprietress, planning to brew them in water when she got home.
location: Haiyueliang Bai Ethnic Flavor Restaurant, Jixing Lane, Wase Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Meditation and prose brainstorming by Xiaoputuo Lake
description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei rode her bicycle south along Huanhai East Road, arriving at the Xiaoputuo Scenic Area about 20 minutes later. She found a flat stone to sit on in a grassy area beside a pine grove by the lake, played a soothing piano piece on her phone, closed her eyes, and did a 15-minute short meditation. Then, she took her new journal out of her canvas bag and wrote an outline for “The First Essay of the New Year,” planning to title it “The Lake’s Breath” and to write in today’s light and shadows, the sound of the wind, and the chance dialogues she encountered.
location: Grassland by the pine forest on the north side of the Xiaoputuo Scenic Area, Huanhai East Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Cycling back to Caicun Pier
description: Getting up from the grass, Sun Yuwei got on her bicycle and rode back along the same route. The wind was a bit stronger on the way back, so she pedaled hard into it. Along the way, she stopped again in front of the reed patch from that morning and used her camera with a slow shutter speed to take an abstract photo of the rippling lake surface. Afterward, she quickened her pace and returned to the homestay before around 15:00, returning the bicycle.
location: Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China (cycling back from Xiaoputuo to Caicun Pier)

name: Organize notes and take a rest
description: Back in her room, Sun Yuwei took off her hiking shoes stained with mud and briefly washed her face and hands. She sat down at the small table by the window, opened her laptop, and imported several selected photos (including a slow-shutter shot of the ripples on the lake and a moment of interaction with an elderly man) into her computer for backup. Next, she scanned the key points of her handwritten nature notes from the morning with her phone and uploaded them to a cloud note app. After that, she organized her canvas bag, placing a power bank, camera, thermos, and wallet inside, ready to head to the ancient town.
location: Room at Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Guesthouse, Caicun Wharf, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Took a tricycle to Dali Old Town.
description: The guesthouse sister's tricycle was already parked at the door. Sun Yuwei climbed into the carriage, and beside her sat another guest who was also going to explore the ancient town. The tricycle moved along the country dirt road and the ancient town's stone road. The evening breeze carried a slight chill, making the little roadside flags flap loudly. About 40 minutes later, the tricycle stopped outside the South Gate of Dali Old Town. She gave the sister 10 yuan for the ride and thanked her again for the recommendation.

participant.name: Middle-aged female tourist
participant.relation: Other travelers staying at the same guesthouse

location: Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China, from Erhai Moon Bai Guesthouse to the South Gate of Dali Old Town

name: Strolling in the ancient city and choosing tie-dye gifts
description: The ancient town had already lit its red lanterns, and tourists thronged the streets. Following her sister's directions, Sun Yuwei found the "Lanxu" tie-dye shop. She wandered slowly around the shop, touching the texture of the hand-dyed indigo cloth, and finally picked out a small indigo- and persimmon-dyed pendant whose pattern was a variant of the character "Fu." She asked the shopkeeper to wrap it in a kraft paper box; it was a New Year gift for Aunt Xie next door. She also took a few photos of the tie-dyed cloth in the sunset in a corner of the shop.
location: Lanxu Tie-Dye Experience Shop, Renmin Road, Dali Old Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Video call with girlfriends to celebrate the New Year.
description: Carrying her gift bag, Sun Yuwei found a quiet corner by the South Gate City Wall, leaned against the blue bricks, and called her best friends' group video chat. She saw Zhang Jing in the teacher's dormitory, Chen Sisi at a coffee shop, and Wang Xinran at home. Across the screen, they clinked glasses with each other (she used the lid of her thermos as a substitute) and shared their growth over the past year. She showed them the outline of Cangshan Mountain behind her through the camera, and her friends screamed, "So beautiful!" Together they counted down to welcome 2026 and agreed to wear qipao and take photos at Green Lake Park in the spring. After the call ended, she stared blankly at the brilliant lights of the ancient city outside the city wall for a while.
location: At a secluded brick battlement on the South Gate city wall of the Old Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Return to the homestay by car.
description: It was completely dark. Sun Yuwei came down from the city wall, called a Didi Express, and arrived at the guesthouse entrance 10 minutes later. The driver was a local, playing folk songs along the way, and the warm lights of the old city flashed past outside the window.
location: Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China, from the south gate of Dali Old Town to Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Guesthouse

name: Guesthouse dinner and preparation for filming
description: Sun Yuwei had a bowl of hot rice noodles made by Sister Ajie at the guesthouse restaurant; the broth was rich, with pickled cabbage and minced meat. After the meal, she returned to her room, took out her camera, checked the locks on the tripod, and fully charged the camera battery. She also dug out a spare small blanket from her suitcase to prepare for going up to the terrace for shooting in the middle of the night.
location: Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Guesthouse restaurant and rooms, Caicun Wharf, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Photographing the starry sky on the rooftop and setting New Year goals
description: Sun Yuwei carried a blanket and her camera up to the third-floor rooftop. Although the lights from the guesthouse were somewhat intrusive, the night sky was still clear and she could see quite a few stars. She set up her tripod and tried taking a few photos of the starry sky. Then she sat cross-legged on the rooftop mat, opened her newly purchased journal, and solemnly wrote on the first page: “2026, deepen Yunnan nature writing.” She also exported a photo of light and shadow on Erhai Lake that she had taken that day, printed it with a small printer, and pasted it beside the writing.
location: Rooftop terrace on the third floor of the Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Guesthouse, Caicun Wharf, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Body scan meditation and gratitude journal
description: Back in her room, Sun Yuwei drew the curtains to create a quiet environment. She lay flat on the bed, followed a 10-minute body scan meditation guide on her phone, and relaxed her whole body from head to toe. After the meditation, she opened her diary and wrote a gratitude journal: thanking the encounter and friendship on New Year’s Eve, the warm hospitality of Ah Jie, the trust of editor Xu Mingyuan, and her own perseverance over the past year.
location: Room at Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Guesthouse, Caicun Wharf, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Reading 'The Tree of Yoga'
description: Sun Yuwei turned off her phone and iPad and put them on a table away from the bed. Then she sat propped against the headboard, opened The Tree of Yoga given by her teacher He Lu, and read for 30 minutes from the chapter “Yoga and Life.”
location: Head of the bed in the room at Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Guesthouse, Caicun Pier, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China

name: Going to bed
description: At exactly 10 p.m., Sun Yuwei closed her book and turned off the bedside lamp. In the darkness, she recalled the moments of the day — Cangshan Mountain, Erhai Lake, the old town, the starry sky, her best friend's laughter... With a relaxed sense of fulfillment and anticipation, she fell asleep before 10:30 p.m.
location: Bed in a room at Erhai Moon Bai Ethnic Homestay, Caicun Wharf, Dali Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China
